object.name: books
object.sql: CREATE TABLE books ( book_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, osis TEXT NOT NULL, eng_name TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, testament TEXT NOT NULL, chapters INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 )

object.name: verses
object.sql: CREATE TABLE verses ( book_id INTEGER NOT NULL, chapter INTEGER NOT NULL, verse INTEGER NOT NULL, text TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (book_id, chapter, verse) )

object.name: version
object.sql: CREATE TABLE version ( slug TEXT NOT NULL, label TEXT NOT NULL )

object.name: idx_v_bc
object.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_v_bc ON verses(book_id, chapter)

object.name: indexing
object.sql: CREATE VIEW indexing AS SELECT b.book_id, b.osis, b.eng_name, b.name, b.testament, b.chapters, v.slug, v.label FROM books b, version v

column.name: text
column.value: Then God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: The fear of you and the terror of you will be on every animal of the earth and on every bird of the sky; on everything that crawls on the ground, and on all the fish of the sea. They are handed over to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Every moving thing that is alive shall be food for you; I have given everything to you, as I gave the green plant.

column.name: text
column.value: But you shall not eat flesh with its life, that is, its blood.

column.name: text
column.value: I certainly will require ①your lifeblood; ②from every animal I will require it. And ③from every person, ④from every man as his brother I will require the life of a person. ▷ ①Lit your blood of your lives ②Lit from the hand of ③Lit from the hand of ④Lit from the hand of

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever sheds human blood, By man his blood shall be shed, For in the image of God He made mankind.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Then God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Now behold, I Myself am establishing My covenant with you, and with your ①descendants after you; ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you; of all that comes out of the ark, every animal of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: I establish My covenant with you; and all flesh shall never again be eliminated by the waters of a flood, nor shall there again be a flood to destroy the earth.”

column.name: text
column.value: God said, “This is the sign of the covenant which I am making between Me and you and every living creature that is with you, for ①all future generations; ▷ ①Or everlasting generations

column.name: text
column.value: I have set My rainbow in the cloud, and it shall ①serve as a sign of a covenant between Me and the earth. ▷ ①Lit be for

column.name: text
column.value: It shall come about, when I make a cloud appear over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,

column.name: text
column.value: and I will remember My covenant, which is between Me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and never again shall the water become a flood to destroy all flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: When the rainbow is in the cloud, then I will look at it, to remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”

column.name: text
column.value: And God said to Noah, “This is the sign of the covenant which I have established between Me and all flesh that is on the earth.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth; and Ham was the father of Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was ①populated. ▷ ①Lit scattered

column.name: text
column.value: Then Noah began ①farming and planted a vineyard. ▷ ①Lit to be a farmer

column.name: text
column.value: He drank some of the wine and became drunk, and uncovered himself inside his tent.

column.name: text
column.value: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.

column.name: text
column.value: But Shem and Japheth took a garment and laid it on both their shoulders and walked backward and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were ①turned away, so that they did not see their father’s nakedness. ▷ ①Lit backward

column.name: text
column.value: When Noah awoke from his wine, he knew what his youngest son had done to him.

column.name: text
column.value: So he said, “Cursed be Canaan; ①A servant of servants He shall be to his brothers.” ▷ ①I.e., The lowest of servants

column.name: text
column.value: He also said, “Blessed be the LORD, The God of Shem; And may Canaan be ①his servant. ▷ ①Or their

column.name: text
column.value: May God enlarge Japheth, And may he live in the tents of Shem; And may Canaan be ①his servant.” ▷ ①Or their

column.name: text
column.value: Noah lived 350 years after the flood.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the days of Noah were 950 years, and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD said to Abram, “Go from your country, And from your relatives And from your father’s house, To the land which I will show you;

column.name: text
text
column.value: And I will bless those who bless you, And the one who ①curses you I will ②curse. And in you all the families of the earth will be blessed.” ▷ ①Or reviles ②Or bind under a curse

column.name: text
column.value: So Abram went away as the LORD had spoken to him; and Lot went with him. Now Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.

column.name: text
column.value: Abram took his wife Sarai and his nephew Lot, and all their possessions which they had accumulated, and the ①people which they had acquired in Haran, and they ②set out for the land of Canaan; so they came to the land of Canaan. ▷ ①Lit souls ②Lit went forth to go to

column.name: text
column.value: Abram passed through the land as far as the site of Shechem, to the ①oak of Moreh. Now the Canaanites were in the land at that time. ▷ ①Or terebinth

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD appeared to Abram and said, “To your ①descendants I will give this land.” So he built an altar there to the LORD who had appeared to him. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: Then he proceeded from there to the mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east; and there he built an altar to the LORD and called upon the name of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Abram journeyed on, continuing toward the ①Negev. ▷ ①I.e., South country

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was a famine in the land; so Abram went down to Egypt to live there for a time, because the famine was severe in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: It came about, when he ①was approaching Egypt, that he said to his wife Sarai, “See now, I know that you are a ②beautiful woman; ▷ ①Lit came near to enter ②Lit woman of beautiful appearance

column.name: text
column.value: and when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife’; and they will kill me, but they will let you live.

column.name: text
column.value: Please say that you are my sister so that it may go well for me because of you, and that ①I may live on account of you.” ▷ ①Lit my soul

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about, when Abram entered Egypt, that the Egyptians ①saw that the woman was very beautiful. ▷ ①Lit saw the woman that she was

column.name: text
column.value: Pharaoh’s officials saw her and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore he treated Abram well for her sake; and ①he gave him sheep, oxen, male donkeys, male servants and female servants, female donkeys, and camels. ▷ ①Lit there was to him

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD struck Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this that you have done to me? Why did you not tell me that she was your wife?

column.name: text
column.value: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her for myself as a wife? Now then, ①here is your wife, take her and go!” ▷ ①Or behold

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him; and they ①escorted him away, with his wife and all that belonged to him. ▷ ①Lit sent

column.name: text
column.value: And so the heavens and the earth were completed, and all their heavenly ①lights. ▷ ①Lit host i.e., sun, stars, etc.

column.name: text
column.value: By the seventh day God completed His work which He had done, and He rested on the seventh day from all His work which He had done.

column.name: text
column.value: Then God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it, because on it He rested from all His work which God had created ①and made. ▷ ①Lit to make

column.name: text
column.value: ①This is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made earth and heaven. ▷ ①Lit These are the generations

column.name: text
column.value: Now no shrub of the field was yet on the earth, and no plant of the field had yet sprouted, for the LORD God had not sent rain upon the earth, and there was no man to ①cultivate the ground. ▷ ①Lit work, serve

column.name: text
column.value: But a ①mist used to rise from the earth and water the whole ②surface of the ground. ▷ ①Or flow ②Lit face of

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD God formed the man of dust from the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and the man became a living ①person. ▷ ①Or soul

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD God planted a garden toward the east, in Eden; and there He placed the man whom He had formed.

column.name: text
column.value: Out of the ground the LORD God caused every tree to grow that is pleasing to the sight and good for food; the tree of life was also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Now a river ①flowed out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it divided and became four ②rivers. ▷ ①Lit was going out ②Lit heads

column.name: text
column.value: The name of the first is Pishon; it ①flows around the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold. ▷ ①Lit surrounds

column.name: text
column.value: The gold of that land is good; the bdellium and the onyx stone are there as well.

column.name: text
column.value: The name of the second river is Gihon; it ①flows around the whole land of Cush. ▷ ①Lit is the one surrounding

column.name: text
column.value: The name of the third river is ①Tigris; it ②flows east of Assyria. And the fourth river is the ③Euphrates. ▷ ①Heb Hiddekel ②Lit is the one going ③Heb Perath

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to cultivate it and tend it.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD God commanded the man, saying, “From any tree of the garden you may freely eat;

column.name: text
column.value: but from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you shall not ①eat, for on the day that you eat from it you will certainly die.” ▷ ①Lit eat from it

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone; I will make him a helper ①suitable for him.” ▷ ①Lit corresponding to

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every animal of the field and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them; and whatever the man called a living creature, that was its name.

column.name: text
column.value: The man gave names to all the livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field, but for ①Adam there was not found a helper ②suitable for him. ▷ ①Or man ②Lit corresponding to

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon the man, and he slept; then He took one of his ribs and closed up the flesh at that place.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD God ①fashioned into a woman the rib which He had taken from the man, and brought her to the man. ▷ ①Lit built

column.name: text
column.value: Then the man said, “At last this is bone of my bones, And flesh of my flesh; ①She shall be called ②‘woman,’ Because ③she was taken out of ④man.” ▷ ①Lit This one ②Heb ishshah ③Lit This one ④Heb ish

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason a man shall leave his father and his mother, and be joined to his wife; and they shall become one flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man and his wife were both naked, but they were not ashamed.

column.name: text
column.value: But God remembered Noah and all the animals and all the livestock that were with him in the ark; and God caused a wind to pass over the earth, and the water subsided.

column.name: text
column.value: Also the fountains of the deep and the ①floodgates of the sky were closed, and the rain from the sky was restrained; ▷ ①Or windows of the heavens

column.name: text
column.value: and the water receded steadily from the earth, and at the end of 150 days the water decreased.

column.name: text
column.value: Then in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, the ark rested upon the mountains of Ararat.

column.name: text
column.value: And the water decreased steadily until the tenth month; in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains became visible.

column.name: text
column.value: Then it came about at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made;

column.name: text
column.value: and he sent out a raven, and it ①flew here and there until the water was dried up ②from the earth. ▷ ①Lit went out, going and returning ②Lit from upon

column.name: text
column.value: Then he sent out a ①dove, to see if the water was low on the ②surface of the land; ▷ ①Lit dove from him ②Lit face

column.name: text
column.value: but the dove found no resting place for the sole of its foot, so it returned to him in the ark, for the water was on the ①surface of all the earth. Then he put out his hand and took it, and brought it into the ark to himself. ▷ ①Lit face

column.name: text
column.value: So he waited another seven days longer; and again he sent out the dove from the ark.

column.name: text
column.value: And the dove came to him in ①the evening, and behold, in its ②beak was a fresh olive leaf. So Noah knew that the water was low on the earth. ▷ ①Lit the time of evening ②Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Then he waited another seven days longer, and sent out the dove; but it did not return to him again.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about in the six hundred and first year, in the first month, on the first of the month, that the water was dried up ①from the earth. Then Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and behold, the ②surface of the ground had dried up. ▷ ①Lit from upon ②Lit face

column.name: text
column.value: And in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

column.name: text
column.value: Then God spoke to Noah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Go out of the ark, you and your wife and your sons and your sons’ wives with you.

column.name: text
column.value: Bring out with you every living thing of all flesh that is with you, birds and animals and every crawling thing that crawls on the earth, that they may ①breed abundantly on the earth, and be fruitful and multiply on the earth.” ▷ ①Or swarm

column.name: text
column.value: So Noah went out, and his sons and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Every animal, every crawling thing, and every bird, everything that moves on the earth, went out ①by their families from the ark. ▷ ①Or according to their kind

column.name: text
column.value: Then Noah built an altar to the LORD, and took some of every kind of clean animal and some of every clean bird and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD smelled the soothing aroma, and the LORD said ①to Himself, “I will never again curse the ground on account of man, for the ②intent of man’s heart is evil from his youth; and I will never again ③destroy every living thing, as I have done. ▷ ①Lit to His heart ②Or inclination ③Lit strike

column.name: text
column.value: While the earth remains, Seedtime and harvest, Cold and heat, Summer and winter, And day and night Shall not cease.”

column.name: text
column.value: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the earth was a ①formless and desolate emptiness, and darkness was over the ②surface of the deep, and the Spirit of God was hovering over the ③surface of the waters. ▷ ①Or waste ②Lit face of ③Lit face of

column.name: text
column.value: Then God said, “ ①Let there be light”; and there was light. ▷ ①I.e., a command, not a request; and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: God saw that the light was good; and God separated the light from the darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: God called the light “day,” and the darkness He called “night.” And there was evening and there was morning, one day.

column.name: text
column.value: Then God said, “Let there be ①an expanse in the midst of the waters, and let it separate the waters from the waters.” ▷ ①Or a firmament; i.e., atmosphere and space

column.name: text
column.value: God made the ①expanse, and separated the waters that were below the ②expanse from the waters that were above the ③expanse; and it was so. ▷ ①Or firmament ②Or firmament ③Or firmament

column.name: text
column.value: God called the ①expanse “heaven.” And there was evening and there was morning, a second day. ▷ ①Or firmament

column.name: text
column.value: Then God said, “Let the waters below the heavens be gathered into one place, and let the dry land appear”; and it was so.

column.name: text
column.value: And God called the dry land “earth,” and the gathering of the waters He called “seas”; and God saw that it was good.

column.name: text
column.value: Then God said, “Let the earth sprout ①vegetation, ②plants yielding seed, and fruit trees on the earth bearing fruit according to ③their kind ④with seed in them”; and it was so. ▷ ①Or grass ②Or herbs ③Lit its ④Lit in which is its seed

column.name: text
column.value: The earth produced ①vegetation, ②plants yielding seed according to ③their kind, and trees bearing fruit ④with seed in them, according to ⑤their kind; and God saw that it was good. ▷ ①Or grass ②Or herbs ③Lit its ④Lit in which is its seed ⑤Lit its

column.name: text
column.value: And there was evening and there was morning, a third day.

column.name: text
column.value: Then God said, “Let there be ①lights in the ②expanse of the heavens to separate the day from the night, and they shall ③serve as signs and for seasons, and for days and years; ▷ ①Or luminaries, light-bearers, and so throughout the ch ②Or firmament; i.e., atmosphere and space ③Lit be for

column.name: text
column.value: and they ①shall serve as lights in the ②expanse of the heavens to give light on the earth”; and it was so. ▷ ①Lit be for ②Or firmament

column.name: text
column.value: God made the two great lights, the greater light ①to govern the day, and the lesser light ②to govern the night; He made the stars also. ▷ ①Lit for the dominion of ②Lit for the dominion of

column.name: text
column.value: God placed them in the ①expanse of the heavens to give light on the earth, ▷ ①Or firmament

column.name: text
column.value: and ①to govern the day and the night, and to separate the light from the darkness; and God saw that it was good. ▷ ①Lit for the dominion of

column.name: text
column.value: And there was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

column.name: text
column.value: Then God said, “Let the waters ①teem with swarms of living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth ②in the open ③expanse of the heavens.” ▷ ①Or swarm ②Lit on the face of ③Or firmament

column.name: text
column.value: And God created the great sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, according to their kind, and every winged bird according to its kind; and God saw that it was good.

column.name: text
column.value: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”

column.name: text
column.value: And there was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

column.name: text
column.value: Then God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures according to ①their kind: livestock and crawling things and animals of the earth according to ②their kind”; and it was so. ▷ ①Lit its ②Lit its

column.name: text
column.value: God made the animals of the earth according to ①their kind, and the livestock according to ②their kind, and everything that crawls on the ground according to its kind; and God saw that it was good. ▷ ①Lit its ②Lit its

column.name: text
column.value: Then God said, “ ①Let Us make mankind in Our image, according to Our likeness; and ②let them rule over the fish of the sea and over the birds of the sky and over the livestock and over all the earth, and over every crawling thing that crawls on the earth.” ▷ ①I.e., indicating united action, not a request ②I.e., have them rule

column.name: text
column.value: So God created man in His own image, in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.

column.name: text
column.value: God blessed them; and God said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth, and subdue it; and rule over the fish of the sea and over the birds of the sky and over every living thing that ①moves on the earth.” ▷ ①Or crawls

column.name: text
column.value: Then God said, “Behold, I have given you every plant yielding seed that is on the ①surface of all the earth, and every tree ②which has fruit yielding seed; it shall be food for you; ▷ ①Lit face of ②Lit in which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed

column.name: text
column.value: and to every animal of the earth and to every bird of the sky and to everything that ①moves on the earth ②which has life, I have given every green plant for food”; and it was so. ▷ ①Or crawls ②Lit in which is living breath

column.name: text
column.value: And God saw all that He had made, and behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the serpent was more cunning than any animal of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat from any tree of the garden’?”

column.name: text
column.value: The woman said to the serpent, “From the fruit of the trees of the garden we may eat;

column.name: text
column.value: but from the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden, God has said, ‘You shall not eat from it or touch it, or you will die.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: The serpent said to the woman, “You certainly will not die!

column.name: text
column.value: For God knows that on the day you eat from it your eyes will be opened, and you will ①become like God, knowing good and evil.” ▷ ①Or be

column.name: text
column.value: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was desirable to make one wise, she took some of its fruit and ate; and she also gave some to her husband with her, and he ate.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the eyes of both of them were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together and made themselves waist coverings.

column.name: text
column.value: Now they heard the sound of the LORD God walking in the garden in the ①cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden. ▷ ①Lit breeze of

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”

column.name: text
column.value: He said, “I heard the sound of You in the garden, and I was afraid because I was naked; so I hid myself.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree from which I commanded you not to eat?”

column.name: text
column.value: The man said, “The woman whom You gave to be with me, she gave me some of the fruit of the tree, and I ate.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD God said to the woman, “What is this that you have done?” And the woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, Cursed are you more than all the livestock, And more than any animal of the field; On your belly you shall go, And dust you shall eat All the days of your life;

column.name: text
column.value: And I will ①make enemies Of you and the woman, And of your ②offspring and her ③Descendant; He shall ④bruise you on the head, And you shall bruise Him on the heel.” ▷ ①Lit put enmity between you ②Lit seed ③Lit Seed; i.e., a prophetic reference to Christ ④Or crush

column.name: text
column.value: To the woman He said, “I will greatly multiply Your pain ①in childbirth, In pain you shall deliver children; Yet your desire will be for your husband, And he shall rule over you.” ▷ ①Lit and your pregnancy

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: By the sweat of your face You shall eat bread, Until you return to the ground, Because from it you were taken; For you are dust, And to dust you shall return.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now the man named his wife ①Eve, because she was the mother of all the living. ▷ ①I.e., living; or life

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife, and clothed them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of Us, knowing good and evil; and now, he might reach out with his hand, and take fruit also from the tree of life, and eat, and live forever”—

column.name: text
column.value: therefore the LORD God sent him out of the Garden of Eden, to cultivate the ground from which he was taken.

column.name: text
column.value: So He drove the man out; and at the east of the Garden of Eden He stationed the cherubim and the flaming sword which turned every direction to guard the way to the tree of life.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about, when mankind began to multiply on the face of the land, and daughters were born to them,

column.name: text
column.value: that the sons of God saw that the daughters of mankind were ①beautiful; and they took wives for themselves, whomever they chose. ▷ ①Lit good

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said, “My Spirit will not ①remain with man forever, ②because he is also flesh; ③nevertheless his days shall be 120 years.” ▷ ①Or rule in; or strive with; meaning uncertain ②Or in his going astray he is flesh ③Or therefore

column.name: text
column.value: The ①Nephilim were on the earth in those days, and also afterward, when the sons of God came in to the daughters of mankind, and they bore children to them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown. ▷ ①Lit fallen ones; LXX giants

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD saw that the wickedness of mankind was great on the earth, and that every intent of the thoughts of ①their hearts was only evil continually. ▷ ①Lit his heart

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD was sorry that He had made mankind on the earth, and He was grieved ①in His heart. ▷ ①Lit to

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said, “I will wipe out mankind whom I have created from the face of the land; mankind, and animals as well, and crawling things, and the birds of the sky. For I am sorry that I have made them.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the records of the generations of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, ①blameless in his generation. Noah walked with God. ▷ ①Lit complete, perfect; or having integrity

column.name: text
column.value: And Noah fathered three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the earth was corrupt in the sight of God, and the earth was filled with violence.

column.name: text
column.value: And God looked on the earth, and behold, it was corrupt; for ①humanity had corrupted its way upon the earth. ▷ ①Lit all flesh

column.name: text
column.value: Then God said to Noah, “The end of ①humanity has come before Me; for the earth is filled with violence because of ②people; and behold, I am about to destroy them with the earth. ▷ ①Lit all flesh ②Lit them

column.name: text
column.value: Make for yourself an ark of ①gopher wood; you shall make the ark with compartments, and ②cover it inside and out with pitch. ▷ ①I.e., Unknown species of tree ②Or pitch

column.name: text
column.value: This is how you shall make it: the length of the ark shall be ①three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits. ▷ ①About 450 ft. long, 75 ft. wide, and 45 ft. high or 135 m, 23 m, and 14 m

column.name: text
column.value: You shall make a ①window for the ark, and finish it to a ②cubit from ③the top; and put the door of the ark on the side; you shall make it with lower, second, and third decks. ▷ ①Or roof ②One cubit is about 18 in. or 45 cm ③Lit above

column.name: text
column.value: Now behold, I Myself am bringing the flood of water upon the earth, to destroy all flesh in which there is the breath of life, from under heaven; everything that is on the earth shall perish.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will establish My covenant with you; and you shall enter the ark—you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.

column.name: text
column.value: And of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every kind into the ark, to keep them alive with you; they shall be male and female.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the birds according to their kind, and of the animals according to their kind, of every crawling thing of the ground according to its kind, two of every kind will come to you to keep them alive.

column.name: text
column.value: As for you, take for yourself some of every food that is edible, and gather it to yourself; and it shall be food for you and them.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Noah did these things; according to everything that God had commanded him, so he did.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Noah, “Enter the ark, you and all your household, for you alone I have seen to be righteous before Me in this generation.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall take ①with you ②seven pairs of every clean animal, a male and his female; and two of the animals that are not clean, a male and his female; ▷ ①Lit to ②Lit seven seven

column.name: text
column.value: also of the birds of the sky, ①seven pairs, male and female, to keep their ②offspring alive on the face of all the earth. ▷ ①Lit seven seven ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: For after seven more days, I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights; and I will wipe out from the face of the land every living thing that I have made.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Noah acted in accordance with everything that the LORD had commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of water ①came upon the earth. ▷ ①Lit was

column.name: text
column.value: Then Noah and his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him entered the ark because of the waters of the flood.

column.name: text
column.value: Of clean animals and animals that are not clean and birds and everything that crawls on the ground,

column.name: text
column.value: they all went into the ark to Noah ①by twos, male and female, as God had commanded Noah. ▷ ①Lit two two

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about after the seven days, that the waters of the flood ①came upon the earth. ▷ ①Lit were

column.name: text
column.value: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the ①floodgates of the sky were opened. ▷ ①Or windows of the heavens

column.name: text
column.value: The rain ①fell upon the earth for forty days and forty nights. ▷ ①Lit was

column.name: text
column.value: On this very same day Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered the ark,

column.name: text
column.value: they and every animal according to its kind, and all the livestock according to ①their kind, and every crawling thing that crawls on the earth according to its kind, and every bird according to its kind, ②all sorts of birds. ▷ ①Lit its ②Lit every bird, every wing

column.name: text
column.value: So they went into the ark to Noah, by twos of all flesh in which there was the breath of life.

column.name: text
column.value: Those that entered, male and female of all flesh, entered as God had commanded him; and the LORD closed the door behind him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the flood ①came upon the earth for forty days, and the water increased and lifted up the ark, so that it rose above the earth. ▷ ①Lit was

column.name: text
column.value: The water prevailed and increased greatly upon the earth, and the ark ①floated on the ②surface of the water. ▷ ①Lit went ②Lit face

column.name: text
column.value: And the water prevailed more and more upon the earth, so that all the high mountains ①everywhere under the heavens were covered. ▷ ①Lit which were under all the heavens

column.name: text
column.value: The water prevailed ①fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered. ▷ ①About 23 ft. or 6.7 m

column.name: text
column.value: So all ①creatures that moved on the earth perished: birds, livestock, animals, and every swarming thing that swarms upon the earth, and all mankind; ▷ ①Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: of all that was on the dry land, all in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.

column.name: text
column.value: So He wiped out ①every living thing that was upon the face of the land, from mankind to animals, to crawling things, and the birds of the sky, and they were wiped out from the earth; and only Noah was left, together with those that were with him in the ark. ▷ ①Lit all existence

column.name: text
column.value: The water prevailed upon the earth for 150 days.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the book of the generations of Adam. On the day when God created man, He made him in the likeness of God.

column.name: text
column.value: He created them male and female, and He blessed them and named them “mankind” on the day when they were created.

column.name: text
column.value: When Adam had lived 130 years, he fathered a son in his own likeness, according to his image, and named him Seth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the days of Adam after he fathered Seth were eight hundred years, and he fathered other sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the days that Adam lived were 930 years, and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Seth lived 105 years, and fathered Enosh.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Seth lived 807 years after he fathered Enosh, and he fathered other sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the days of Seth were 912 years, and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Enosh lived ninety years, and fathered Kenan.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Enosh lived 815 years after he fathered Kenan, and he fathered other sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the days of Enosh were 905 years, and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Kenan lived seventy years, and fathered Mahalalel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Kenan lived 840 years after he fathered Mahalalel, and he fathered other sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the days of Kenan were 910 years, and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, and fathered Jared.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Mahalalel lived 830 years after he fathered Jared, and he fathered other sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the days of Mahalalel were 895 years, and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jared lived 162 years, and fathered Enoch.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jared lived eight hundred years after he fathered Enoch, and he fathered other sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the days of Jared were 962 years, and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Enoch lived sixty-five years, and fathered Methuselah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Enoch walked with God three hundred years after he fathered Methuselah, and he fathered other sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the days of Enoch were 365 years.

column.name: text
column.value: Enoch walked with God; and he was ①not, for God took him. ▷ ①LXX not found

column.name: text
column.value: Now Methuselah lived 187 years, and fathered Lamech.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Methuselah lived 782 years after he fathered Lamech, and he fathered other sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the days of Methuselah were 969 years, and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Lamech lived 182 years, and fathered a son.

column.name: text
column.value: And he named him Noah, saying, “This one will give us comfort from our work and from the hard labor of our hands caused by the ground which the LORD has cursed.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Lamech lived 595 years after he fathered Noah, and he fathered other sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the days of Lamech were 777 years, and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: Now after Noah was five hundred years old, Noah fathered Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

column.name: text
column.value: Now all the earth ①used the same language and ②the same words. ▷ ①Lit was one lip ②Or few or one set of words

column.name: text
column.value: And it came about, as they journeyed ①east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar and ②settled there. ▷ ①Or from the east ②Lit dwelt

column.name: text
column.value: Then they said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks and ①fire them thoroughly.” And they used brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar. ▷ ①I.e., in a kiln to harden them

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top will reach into heaven, and let’s make a name for ourselves; otherwise we will be scattered abroad over the face of all the earth.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD came down to see the city and the tower which the ①men had built. ▷ ①Lit sons of mankind

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have ①the same language. And this is what they have started to do, and now nothing which they plan to do will be ②impossible for them. ▷ ①Lit one lip ②Lit inaccessible to

column.name: text
column.value: Come, ①let Us go down and there confuse their ②language, so that they will not understand one another’s ③speech.” ▷ ①I.e., indicating united action, not a request ②Lit lip ③Lit lip

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD scattered them abroad from there over the face of all the earth; and they stopped building the city.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore it was named ①Babel, because there the LORD confused the ②language of all the earth; and from there the LORD scattered them abroad over the face of all the earth. ▷ ①Or Babylon; cf. Heb balal, confuse ②Lit lip

column.name: text
column.value: These are the records of the generations of Shem. Shem was a hundred years old when he fathered Arpachshad, two years after the flood;

column.name: text
column.value: and Shem lived five hundred years after he fathered Arpachshad, and he fathered other sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years, and fathered Shelah;

column.name: text
column.value: and Arpachshad lived 403 years after he fathered Shelah, and he fathered other sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Shelah lived thirty years, and fathered Eber;

column.name: text
column.value: and Shelah lived 403 years after he fathered Eber, and he fathered other sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Eber lived thirty-four years, and fathered Peleg;

column.name: text
column.value: and Eber lived 430 years after he fathered Peleg, and he fathered other sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Peleg lived thirty years, and fathered Reu;

column.name: text
column.value: and Peleg lived 209 years after he fathered Reu, and he fathered other sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Reu lived thirty-two years, and fathered Serug;

column.name: text
column.value: and Reu lived 207 years after he fathered Serug, and he fathered other sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Serug lived thirty years, and fathered Nahor;

column.name: text
column.value: and Serug lived two hundred years after he fathered Nahor, and he fathered other sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and fathered Terah;

column.name: text
column.value: and Nahor lived 119 years after he fathered Terah, and he fathered other sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Terah lived seventy years, and fathered Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these are the records of the generations of Terah. Terah fathered Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran fathered Lot.

column.name: text
column.value: Haran died ①during the lifetime of his father Terah in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldeans. ▷ ①Lit before the face of

column.name: text
column.value: Abram and Nahor took wives for themselves. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah ①and Iscah. ▷ ①Lit and the father of

column.name: text
column.value: Sarai was unable to conceive; she did not have a child.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Terah took his son Abram, and Lot the son of Haran, his grandson, and his daughter-in-law Sarai, his son Abram’s wife, and they departed ①together from Ur of the Chaldeans to go to the land of Canaan; and they went as far as Haran and ②settled there. ▷ ①Lit with them ②Lit dwelt

column.name: text
column.value: The days of Terah were 205 years; and Terah died in Haran.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these are the records of the generations of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth; and sons were born to them after the flood.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Japheth were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Gomer were Ashkenaz, ①Riphath, and Togarmah. ▷ ①In 1 Chr 1:6, Diphath

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Javan were Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and ①Dodanim. ▷ ①In 1 Chr 1:7, Rodanim

column.name: text
column.value: From these the people of the coastlands of the nations ①were separated into their lands, every one according to his language, according to their families, into their nations. ▷ ①Or separated themselves

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Ham were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca; and the sons of Raamah were Sheba and Dedan.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Cush fathered Nimrod; he ①became a mighty one on the earth. ▷ ①Lit began to be

column.name: text
column.value: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD; therefore it is said, “Like Nimrod a mighty hunter before the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the beginning of his kingdom was ①Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar. ▷ ①Or Babylon

column.name: text
column.value: From that land he went to Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Calah,

column.name: text
column.value: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah; that is the great city.

column.name: text
column.value: Mizraim fathered Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

column.name: text
column.value: Pathrusim, Casluhim (from whom came the Philistines), and Caphtorim.

column.name: text
column.value: Canaan fathered Sidon, his firstborn, and Heth,

column.name: text
column.value: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,

column.name: text
column.value: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,

column.name: text
column.value: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite; and afterward the families of the Canaanite were spread abroad.

column.name: text
column.value: The territory of the Canaanite ①extended from Sidon ②going toward Gerar, as far as Gaza; and ③going toward Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha. ▷ ①Lit was ②Lit as you go ③Lit as you go

column.name: text
column.value: These are the sons of Ham, according to their families, according to their languages, by their lands, and by their nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Also to Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, and the older brother of Japheth, children were born.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Shem were Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Aram were Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

column.name: text
column.value: Arpachshad fathered Shelah; and Shelah fathered Eber.

column.name: text
column.value: Two sons were born to Eber; the name of the one was ①Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan. ▷ ①I.e., division

column.name: text
column.value: Joktan fathered Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

column.name: text
column.value: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

column.name: text
column.value: ①Obal, Abimael, Sheba, ▷ ①In 1 Chr 1:22, Ebal

column.name: text
column.value: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab; all of these were the sons of Joktan.

column.name: text
column.value: Now their ①settlement ②extended from Mesha ③going toward Sephar, the hill country of the east. ▷ ①Lit dwelling ②Lit was ③Lit as you go

column.name: text
column.value: These are the sons of Shem, according to their families, according to their languages, by their lands, and according to their nations.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the families of the sons of Noah, according to their descendants, by their nations; and out of these the nations were separated on the earth after the flood.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the man ①had relations with his wife Eve, and she conceived and gave birth to Cain, and she said, “I have obtained a male child with the help of the LORD.” ▷ ①Lit knew his

column.name: text
column.value: And again, she gave birth to his brother Abel. Now Abel was a keeper of flocks, but Cain was a cultivator of the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: So it came about ①in the course of time that Cain brought an offering to the LORD from the fruit of the ground. ▷ ①Lit at the end of days

column.name: text
column.value: Abel, on his part also brought an offering, from the firstborn of his flock and from their fat portions. And the LORD had regard for Abel and his offering;

column.name: text
column.value: but for Cain and his offering He had no regard. So Cain became very angry and his face ①was gloomy. ▷ ①Lit fell

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Cain, “Why are you angry? And why is your face ①gloomy? ▷ ①Lit fallen

column.name: text
column.value: If you do well, ①will your face not be ②cheerful? And if you do not do well, sin is lurking at the door; and its desire is for you, but you must master it.” ▷ ①Or you will certainly be accepted ②Lit lifted up

column.name: text
column.value: Cain ①talked to his brother Abel; and it happened that when they were in the field Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him. ▷ ①Lit said to

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Cain, “Where is Abel your brother?” And he said, “I do not know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”

column.name: text
column.value: Then He said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood is crying out to Me from the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: Now you are cursed from the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.

column.name: text
column.value: When you cultivate the ground, it will no longer yield its strength to you; you will be a wanderer and a drifter on the earth.”

column.name: text
column.value: Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is too great to endure!

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, You have driven me this day from the face of the ground; and I will be hidden from Your face, and I will be a wanderer and a drifter on the earth, and whoever finds me will kill me.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD said to him, “Therefore whoever kills Cain, vengeance will be taken on him seven times as much.” And the LORD ①placed a mark on Cain, so that no one finding him would kill him. ▷ ①Or set a sign for

column.name: text
column.value: Then Cain left the presence of the LORD, and ①settled in the land of ②Nod, east of Eden. ▷ ①Lit dwelt ②I.e., wandering

column.name: text
column.value: Cain ①had relations with his wife and she conceived, and gave birth to Enoch; and Cain built a city, and named the city Enoch, after the name of his son. ▷ ①Lit knew his

column.name: text
column.value: Now to Enoch was born Irad, and Irad fathered Mehujael, and Mehujael fathered Methushael, and Methushael fathered Lamech.

column.name: text
column.value: Lamech took two wives for himself: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other, Zillah.

column.name: text
column.value: Adah gave birth to Jabal; he was the father of those who live in tents and have livestock.

column.name: text
column.value: His brother’s name was Jubal; he was the father of all those who play the lyre and flute.

column.name: text
column.value: As for Zillah, she also gave birth to Tubal-cain, the forger of all implements of bronze and iron; and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.

column.name: text
column.value: Lamech said to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, Listen to my voice, You wives of Lamech, Pay attention to my words, For I have killed a man for wounding me; And a boy for striking me!

column.name: text
column.value: If Cain is avenged seven times, Then Lamech seventy-seven times!”

column.name: text
column.value: Adam ①had relations with his wife again; and she gave birth to a son, and named him ②Seth, for, she said, “God ③has appointed me another ④child in place of Abel, because Cain killed him.” ▷ ①Lit knew his ②Heb Sheth ③Heb shath ④Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: To Seth also a son was born; and he named him Enosh. Then people began to call ①upon the name of the LORD. ▷ ①Or by

column.name: text
column.value: So Abram went up from Egypt to the ①Negev, he and his wife and all that belonged to him, and Lot with him. ▷ ①I.e., South country

column.name: text
column.value: Now Abram was very rich in livestock, silver, and gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went ①on his journeys from the ②Negev as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai, ▷ ①Lit by his stages ②I.e., South country

column.name: text
column.value: to the place of the altar which he had made there previously; and there Abram called on the name of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Lot, who went with Abram, also had flocks, herds, and tents.

column.name: text
column.value: And the land could not ①support both of them ②while living together, for their possessions were so great that they were not able to remain together. ▷ ①Lit bear ②Lit to live

column.name: text
column.value: And there was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. Now the Canaanites and the Perizzites were living in the land at that time.

column.name: text
column.value: So Abram said to Lot, “Please let there be no strife between you and me, nor between my herdsmen and your herdsmen, for we are relatives!

column.name: text
column.value: Is the entire land not before you? Please separate from me; if you choose the left, then I will go to the right; or if you choose the right, then I will go to the left.”

column.name: text
column.value: Lot raised his eyes and saw all the ①vicinity of the Jordan, that it was well watered everywhere—this was before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah—like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt ②going toward Zoar. ▷ ①Lit circle ②Lit as you go

column.name: text
column.value: So Lot chose for himself all the ①vicinity of the Jordan, and Lot journeyed eastward. So they separated from each other. ▷ ①Lit circle

column.name: text
column.value: Abram ①settled in the land of Canaan, while Lot ②settled in the cities of the ③vicinity of the Jordan, and moved his tents as far as Sodom. ▷ ①Lit dwelt ②Lit dwelt ③Lit circle

column.name: text
column.value: Now the men of Sodom were ①exceedingly wicked sinners against the LORD. ▷ ①Lit wicked and sinners exceedingly

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Abram, after Lot had separated from him, “Now raise your eyes and look from the place where you are, northward and southward, and eastward and westward;

column.name: text
column.value: for all the land which you see I will give to you and to your ①descendants forever. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: I will make your ①descendants as plentiful as the dust of the earth, so that if anyone can count the dust of the earth, then your ②descendants could also be counted. ▷ ①Lit seed ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, walk about in the land through its length and width; for I will give it to you.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Abram moved his tent and came and lived by the ①oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron; and there he built an altar to the LORD. ▷ ①Or terebinths

column.name: text
column.value: And it came about in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of ①Goiim, ▷ ①Or nations

column.name: text
column.value: that they made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar).

column.name: text
column.value: All these kings ①came as allies to the Valley of Siddim (that is, the Salt Sea). ▷ ①Lit joined together

column.name: text
column.value: For twelve years they had served Chedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came and ①defeated the Rephaim in Ashteroth-karnaim, and the Zuzim in Ham, and the Emim in ②Shaveh-kiriathaim, ▷ ①Lit struck ②Or the plain of Kiriathaim

column.name: text
column.value: and the Horites on their Mount Seir, as far as El-paran, which is by the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they turned back and came to En-mishpat (that is, Kadesh), and ①conquered all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, who lived in Hazazon-tamar. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Sodom and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) came out; and they lined up for battle against them in the Valley of Siddim,

column.name: text
column.value: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of ①Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar—four kings against five. ▷ ①Or nations

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and they fell ①into them. But those who survived fled to the hill country. ▷ ①Lit there

column.name: text
column.value: Then they took all the possessions of Sodom and Gomorrah and all their food supply, and departed.

column.name: text
column.value: They also took Lot, Abram’s nephew, and his possessions and departed, for he was living in Sodom.

column.name: text
column.value: Then ①a survivor came and told Abram the Hebrew. Now he was residing by the ②oaks of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner, and they were ③allies with Abram. ▷ ①Lit the ②Or terebinths ③Lit possessors of the covenant

column.name: text
column.value: When Abram heard that his relative had been taken captive, he ①led out his trained men, born in his house, numbering 318, and went in pursuit as far as Dan. ▷ ①Or mustered

column.name: text
column.value: Then he divided ①his forces against them by night, he and his servants, and ②defeated them, and pursued them as far as Hobah, which is ③north of Damascus. ▷ ①Lit himself ②Lit struck ③Lit on the left

column.name: text
column.value: He brought back all the possessions, and also brought back his relative Lot with his possessions, and also the women, and the other people.

column.name: text
column.value: Then after his return from the ①defeat of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, the king of Sodom went out to meet him at the Valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley). ▷ ①Lit striking

column.name: text
column.value: And Melchizedek the king of Salem brought out bread and wine; now he was a priest of ①God Most High. ▷ ①Heb El Elyon

column.name: text
column.value: And he blessed him and said, “Blessed be Abram of ①God Most High, ②Possessor of heaven and earth; ▷ ①Heb El Elyon ②Or Creator

column.name: text
column.value: And blessed be ①God Most High, Who has handed over your enemies to you.” And he gave him a tenth of everything. ▷ ①Heb El Elyon

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give the ①people to me and take the possessions for yourself.” ▷ ①Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have ①sworn to the LORD ②God Most High, ③Possessor of heaven and earth, ▷ ①Lit lifted up my hand ②Heb El Elyon ③Or Creator

column.name: text
column.value: that I will not take a thread or a sandal strap or anything that is yours, so that you do not say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’

column.name: text
column.value: ①I will take nothing except what the young men have eaten, and the share of the men who went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their share.” ▷ ①Lit Not to me except

column.name: text
column.value: Now the two angels came to Sodom in the evening as Lot was sitting at the gate of Sodom. When Lot saw them, he stood up to meet them and ①bowed down with his face to the ground. ▷ ①Lit bowed himself

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, “Now behold, my lords, please turn aside into your servant’s house, and spend the night, and wash your feet; then you may rise early and go on your way.” They said, “No, but we shall spend the night in the public square.”

column.name: text
column.value: Yet he strongly urged them, so they turned aside to him and entered his house; and he prepared a feast for them and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.

column.name: text
column.value: Before they lay down, the men of the city—the men of Sodom—surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people ①from every quarter; ▷ ①Or without exception; lit from every end

column.name: text
column.value: and they called to Lot and said to him, “Where are the men who came to you tonight? Bring them out to us that we may ①have relations with them.” ▷ ①Lit know them; i.e., have intercourse

column.name: text
column.value: But Lot went out to them at the doorway, and shut the door behind him,

column.name: text
column.value: and said, “Please, my brothers, do not act wickedly.

column.name: text
column.value: Now look, I have two daughters who have not ①had relations with any man; please let me bring them out to you, and do to them ②whatever you like; only do not do anything to these men, because they have come under the ③shelter of my roof.” ▷ ①Lit known man ②Lit as is good in your sight ③Lit shadow

column.name: text
column.value: But they said, “Get out of the way!” They also said, “This one came in ①as a foreigner, and already he is acting like a judge; now we will treat you worse than them!” So they pressed hard against ②Lot and moved forward to break the door. ▷ ①Lit to sojourn ②Lit the man, against Lot

column.name: text
column.value: But the men reached out their ①hands and brought Lot into the house ②with them, and shut the door. ▷ ①Lit hand ②Lit to

column.name: text
column.value: Then they struck the men who were at the doorway of the house with blindness, from the small to the great, so that they became weary of trying to find the doorway.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the two men said to Lot, “Whom else do you have here? A son-in-law and your sons and daughters, and whomever you have in the city, bring them out of the place;

column.name: text
column.value: for we are about to destroy this place, because their outcry has become so great before the LORD that the LORD has sent us to destroy it.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law, who ①were to marry his daughters, and said, “Up, get out of this place, for the LORD is destroying the city.” But he appeared to his sons-in-law ②to be joking. ▷ ①Or had married; lit were taking ②Lit like one who was joking

column.name: text
column.value: When morning dawned, the angels urged Lot, saying, “Up, take your wife and your two daughters who are here, or you will be swept away in the ①punishment of the city.” ▷ ①Or wrongdoing

column.name: text
column.value: But he hesitated. So the men grasped his hand and the hand of his wife and the ①hands of his two daughters, because the compassion of the LORD was upon him; and they brought him out and put him outside the city. ▷ ①Lit hand

column.name: text
column.value: When they had brought them outside, ①one said, “Escape for your life! Do not look behind you, and do not stay ②anywhere in the surrounding area; escape to the ③mountains, or you will be swept away.” ▷ ①Lit he ②Lit in all the circle ③Lit mountain

column.name: text
column.value: But Lot said to them, “Oh no, my lords!

column.name: text
column.value: Now behold, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your compassion, which you have shown me by saving my life; but I cannot escape to the ①mountains, for the disaster will overtake me and I will die; ▷ ①Lit mountain

column.name: text
column.value: now behold, this town is near enough to flee to, and it is small. Please, let me escape there (is it not small?) ①so that my life may be saved.” ▷ ①Lit and my soul will live

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, “Behold, I grant you this ①request also, not to overthrow the town of which you have spoken. ▷ ①Lit thing

column.name: text
column.value: Hurry, escape there, for I cannot do anything until you arrive there.” Therefore the town was named ①Zoar. ▷ ①I.e., small

column.name: text
column.value: The sun had risen over the earth when Lot came to Zoar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD rained brimstone and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah from the LORD out of heaven,

column.name: text
column.value: and He overthrew those cities, and all the surrounding area, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and what grew on the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: But ①Lot’s wife, from behind him, looked back, and she became a pillar of salt. ▷ ①Lit his

column.name: text
column.value: Now Abraham got up early in the morning and went to the place where he had stood before the LORD;

column.name: text
column.value: and he looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the surrounding area; and ①behold, he saw the smoke of the land ascended like the smoke of a ②furnace. ▷ ①Lit he saw, and behold ②Lit kiln

column.name: text
column.value: So it came about, when God destroyed the cities of the surrounding area, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the destruction, when He overthrew the cities in which Lot had lived.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Lot went up from Zoar with his two daughters and stayed in the ①mountains, because he was afraid to stay in Zoar; and he stayed in a cave, he and his two daughters. ▷ ①Lit mountain

column.name: text
column.value: Then the firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man ①on earth to ②have relations with us according to the custom of all the earth. ▷ ①Or in the land ②Lit come in to

column.name: text
column.value: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and let’s sleep with him so that we may keep ①our family alive through our father.” ▷ ①Lit seed from our father

column.name: text
column.value: So they made their father drink wine that night, and the firstborn went in and slept with her father; and he did not know when she lay down or got up.

column.name: text
column.value: On the following day, the firstborn said to the younger, “Look, I slept last night with my father; let’s make him drink wine tonight too, then you go in and sleep with him, so that we may keep ①our family alive through our father.” ▷ ①Lit seed from our father

column.name: text
column.value: So they had their father drink wine that night too, and the younger got up and slept with him; and he did not know when she lay down or got up.

column.name: text
column.value: And so both of the daughters of Lot conceived by their father.

column.name: text
column.value: The firstborn gave birth to a son, and named him Moab; he is the father of the Moabites to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the younger, she also gave birth to a son, and named him Ben-ammi; he is the father of ①the sons of Ammon to this day. ▷ ①Heb Beney-Ammon

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am ①God Almighty; Walk before Me, and be ②blameless. ▷ ①Heb El Shaddai ②Lit complete, perfect; or having integrity

column.name: text
column.value: I will ①make My covenant between Me and you, And I will multiply you exceedingly.” ▷ ①Lit give

column.name: text
column.value: Abram fell on his face, and God talked with him, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “As for Me, behold, My covenant is with you, And you will be the father of a multitude of nations.

column.name: text
column.value: No longer shall you be named ①Abram, But your name shall be ②Abraham; For I have made you the father of a multitude of nations. ▷ ①I.e., exalted father ②I.e., father of a multitude

column.name: text
column.value: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you, and kings will come from you.

column.name: text
column.value: I will establish My covenant between Me and you and your ①descendants after you throughout their generations as an everlasting covenant, to be God to you and to your ②descendants after you. ▷ ①Lit seed ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: And I will give to you and to your ①descendants after you the land where you live as a stranger, all the land of Canaan, as an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.” ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: God said further to Abraham, “Now as for you, you shall keep My covenant, you and your ①descendants after you throughout their generations. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: This is My covenant, which you shall keep, between Me and you and your ①descendants after you: every male among you shall be circumcised. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin, and it shall be the sign of the covenant between Me and you.

column.name: text
column.value: And every male among you who is eight days old shall be circumcised throughout your generations, including a slave who is born in the house or who is bought with money from any foreigner, who is not of your ①descendants. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: A slave who is born in your house or who is bought with your money shall certainly be circumcised; so My covenant shall be in your flesh as an everlasting covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for an uncircumcised male, one who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that person shall be cut off from his people; he has broken My covenant.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then God said to Abraham, “As for your wife Sarai, you shall not call her by the name ①Sarai, but ②Sarah shall be her name. ▷ ①I.e., princess ②I.e., princess (in another dialect)

column.name: text
column.value: I will bless her, and indeed I will give you a son by her. Then I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of peoples will ①come from her.” ▷ ①Lit be

column.name: text
column.value: Then Abraham fell on his face and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to a man a hundred years old? And will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth to a child?”

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before You!”

column.name: text
column.value: But God said, “No, but your wife Sarah will bear you a son, and you shall name him ①Isaac; and I will establish My covenant with him as an everlasting covenant for his ②descendants after him. ▷ ①I.e., he laughs ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: As for Ishmael, I have heard you; behold, I will bless him, and make him fruitful and multiply him exceedingly. He shall father twelve princes, and I will make him into a great nation.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will establish My covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this season next year.”

column.name: text
column.value: When He finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Abraham took his son Ishmael, and all the slaves who were born in his house and all who were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham’s household, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin on this very same day, as God had said to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

column.name: text
column.value: And his son Ishmael was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

column.name: text
column.value: On this very same day Abraham was circumcised, as well as his son Ishmael.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the men of his household, those who were born in the house or bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, had not borne him a child, but she had an Egyptian slave woman whose name was Hagar.

column.name: text
column.value: So Sarai said to Abram, “See now, the LORD has prevented me from bearing children. Please have relations with my slave woman; perhaps I will ①obtain children through her.” And Abram listened to the voice of Sarai. ▷ ①Lit be built from her

column.name: text
column.value: And so after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, Abram’s wife Sarai took Hagar the Egyptian, her slave woman, and gave her to her husband Abram as his wife.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he had relations with Hagar, and she conceived; and when Hagar became aware that she had conceived, her mistress was insignificant in her sight.

column.name: text
column.value: So Sarai said to Abram, “May the wrong done to me be upon you! I put my slave woman into your ①arms, but when she saw that she had conceived, I was insignificant in her ②sight. May the LORD judge between ③you and me.” ▷ ①Lit breast ②Lit eyes ③Lit me and you

column.name: text
column.value: But Abram said to Sarai, “Look, your slave woman is in your ①power; do to her what is good in your ②sight.” So Sarai treated her harshly, and she fled from her presence. ▷ ①Lit hand ②Lit eyes

column.name: text
column.value: Now the angel of the LORD found her by a spring of water in the wilderness, by the spring on the way to Shur.

column.name: text
column.value: He said, “Hagar, Sarai’s slave woman, from where have you come, and where are you going?” And she said, “I am fleeing from the presence of my mistress Sarai.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the angel of the LORD said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit ①to her authority.” ▷ ①Lit under her hands

column.name: text
column.value: The angel of the LORD also said to her, “I will greatly multiply your ①descendants so that ②they will be too many to count.” ▷ ①Lit seed ②Lit they shall not be counted for multitude

column.name: text
column.value: The angel of the LORD said to her further, “Behold, you are pregnant, And you will give birth to a son; And you shall name him ①Ishmael, Because the LORD has heard your affliction. ▷ ①I.e., God hears

column.name: text
text
column.value: Then she called the name of the LORD who spoke to her, “ ①You are ②a God who sees me”; for she said, “Have I even seen Him here and lived after ③He saw me?” ▷ ①Or You, God, see me ②Heb Elroi ③Lit His seeing me

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the well was called ①Beer-lahai-roi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered. ▷ ①I.e., the well of the living one who sees me

column.name: text
column.value: So Hagar bore a son to Abram; and Abram named his son, to whom Hagar gave birth, Ishmael.

column.name: text
column.value: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to ①him. ▷ ①Lit Abram

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about after these things, that God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” And he said, “Here I am.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then He said, “Take now your son, your only son, whom you love, Isaac, and go to the land of Moriah, and offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains of which I will tell you.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Abraham got up early in the morning and saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him and his son Isaac; and he split wood for the burnt offering, and set out and went to the place of which God had told him.

column.name: text
column.value: On the third day Abraham raised his eyes and saw the place from a distance.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey, and I and the boy will go over there; and we will worship and return to you.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering and laid it on his son Isaac, and he took in his hand the fire and the knife. So the two of them walked on together.

column.name: text
column.value: Isaac spoke to his father Abraham and said, “My father!” And he said, “Here I am, my son.” And he said, “Look, the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?”

column.name: text
column.value: Abraham said, “God will ①provide for Himself the lamb for the burnt offering, my son.” So the two of them walked on together. ▷ ①Lit see

column.name: text
column.value: Then they came to the place of which God had told him; and Abraham built the altar there and arranged the wood, and bound his son Isaac and laid him on the altar, on top of the wood.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham reached out with his hand and took the knife to ①slaughter his son. ▷ ①I.e., following prescribed ritual

column.name: text
column.value: But the angel of the LORD called to him from heaven and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” And he said, “Here I am.”

column.name: text
column.value: He said, “Do not reach out your hand against the boy, and do not do anything to him; for now I know that you ①fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from Me.” ▷ ①Or revere; lit are a fearer of God

column.name: text
column.value: Then Abraham raised his eyes and looked, and behold, behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by its horns; and Abraham went and took the ram and offered it up as a burnt offering in the place of his son.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham named that place ①The LORD Will Provide, as it is said to this day, “On the mountain of the LORD it will ②be provided.” ▷ ①Heb YHWH-jireh; lit the LORD will see ②Lit be seen

column.name: text
column.value: Then the angel of the LORD called to Abraham a second time from heaven,

column.name: text
column.value: and said, “By Myself I have sworn, declares the LORD, because you have done this thing and have not withheld your son, your only son,

column.name: text
column.value: indeed I will greatly bless you, and I will greatly multiply your ①seed as the stars of the heavens and as the sand, which is on the seashore; and your ②seed shall possess the gate of ③their enemies. ▷ ①Or descendants ②Or descendants ③Lit his

column.name: text
column.value: And in your ①seed all the nations of the earth shall ②be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice.” ▷ ①Or descendants ②Or bless themselves

column.name: text
column.value: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they got up and went together to Beersheba; and Abraham lived in Beersheba.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about after these things, that Abraham was told, saying, “Behold, Milcah ①also has borne children to your brother Nahor: ▷ ①Lit she also

column.name: text
column.value: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel (the father of Aram),

column.name: text
column.value: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel”—

column.name: text
column.value: and it was Bethuel who fathered Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

column.name: text
column.value: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, ①also gave birth to Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah. ▷ ①Lit she also

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD appeared to ①Abraham by the ②oaks of Mamre, while he was sitting at the tent door in the heat of the day. ▷ ①Lit him ②Or terebinths

column.name: text
column.value: When he raised his eyes and looked, behold, three men were standing opposite him; and when he saw them, he ran from the tent door to meet them and bowed down to the ground,

column.name: text
column.value: and said, “ ①My Lord, if now I have found favor in Your sight, please do not ②pass Your servant by. ▷ ①Or O Lord ②Lit pass away from Your servant

column.name: text
column.value: Please let a little water be brought and wash ①your feet, and make yourselves comfortable under the tree; ▷ ①I.e., referring to the three visitors

column.name: text
column.value: and I will ①bring a piece of bread, so that you may ②refresh yourselves; after that you may go on, since you have ③visited your servant.” And they said, “So do as you have said.” ▷ ①Lit take ②Lit sustain your heart ③Lit come to

column.name: text
column.value: So Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “ ①Quickly, prepare three ②measures of fine flour, knead it, and make bread cakes.” ▷ ①Lit Hasten three measures ②Heb seah; one seah is about 7 qt. or 7.7 liters

column.name: text
column.value: Abraham also ran to the herd, and took a tender and ①choice calf and gave it to the servant, and he hurried to prepare it. ▷ ①Lit good

column.name: text
