column.value: and their forty bases of silver; two bases under one board and two bases under another board.

column.name: text
column.value: For the ①back of the tabernacle, to the west, you shall make six boards. ▷ ①Lit far parts

column.name: text
column.value: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle at the ①back. ▷ ①Lit far parts

column.name: text
column.value: They shall be double beneath, and together they shall be complete ①to its top ②to the first ring; this is how it shall be with both of them: they shall form the two corners. ▷ ①Or at its head ②Or with reference to

column.name: text
column.value: And there shall be eight boards with their bases of silver, sixteen bases; two bases under one board and two bases under another board.

column.name: text
column.value: “Then you shall make bars of acacia wood, five for the boards of one side of the tabernacle,

column.name: text
column.value: and five bars for the boards of the ①other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle for the ②back side to the west. ▷ ①Lit second ②Lit far parts

column.name: text
column.value: The middle bar in the ①center of the boards shall pass through from end to end. ▷ ①Lit midst

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold as holders for the bars; and you shall overlay the bars with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall erect the tabernacle according to its plan which you have been shown on the mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall also make a veil of violet, purple, and scarlet material, and fine twisted linen; it shall be made with cherubim, the work of a skilled embroiderer.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall ①hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold, their hooks also of gold, on four bases of silver. ▷ ①Lit put

column.name: text
column.value: You shall ①hang up the veil under the clasps, and bring in the ark of the testimony there within the veil; and the veil shall ②serve as a partition for you between the Holy Place and the Most Holy Place. ▷ ①Lit put ②Lit separate for you between

column.name: text
column.value: You shall put the ①atoning cover on the ark of the testimony in the Most Holy Place. ▷ ①Also called mercy seat; i.e., where blood was sprinkled on the Day of Atonement

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall set the table outside the veil, and the lampstand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south; and you shall put the table on the north side.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall also make a curtain for the doorway of the tent of violet, purple, and scarlet material and fine twisted linen, the work of a ①weaver. ▷ ①Lit variegator; i.e., a weaver in colors

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall make five pillars of acacia for the curtain and overlay them with gold, their hooks also of gold; and you shall cast five bases of ①bronze for them. ▷ ①Or copper

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not give a false report; do not join your hand with a wicked person to be a malicious witness.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not follow ①the crowd in doing evil, nor shall you ②testify in a dispute so as to join together with ③a crowd in order to pervert justice; ▷ ①Lit many ②Or answer ③Lit many

column.name: text
column.value: nor shall you ①show favor to a poor person in his dispute. ▷ ①Lit honor

column.name: text
column.value: “If you encounter your enemy’s ox or his donkey wandering away, you must return it to him.

column.name: text
column.value: If you see the donkey of one who hates you lying helpless under its load, you shall not leave it helpless for ①its owner; you must arrange the load with him. ▷ ①Lit him

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not pervert the justice due to your needy brother in his dispute.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep far from a false charge, and do not kill the innocent or the righteous, for I will not acquit the guilty.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the clear-sighted and ①subverts the cause of the just. ▷ ①Or distorts the words

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not oppress a stranger, since you yourselves know the ①feelings of a stranger, for you also were strangers in the land of Egypt. ▷ ①Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: “Now you shall sow your land for six years and gather in its yield,

column.name: text
column.value: but in the seventh year you shall let it ①rest and lie uncultivated, so that the needy of your people may eat; and whatever they leave the animal of the field may eat. You are to do the same with your vineyard and your olive grove. ▷ ①Lit drop

column.name: text
column.value: “For six days you are to do your work, but on the seventh day you shall cease from labor so that your ox and your donkey may rest, and the son of your female slave, as well as the stranger residing with you, may refresh themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Now concerning everything which I have said to you, be careful; and do not mention the name of other gods, nor let them be heard ①from your mouth. ▷ ①Lit on

column.name: text
column.value: “Three times a year you shall celebrate a feast to Me.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread; for seven days you are to eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the appointed time in the month of Abib, for in ①that month you came out of Egypt. And ②no one is to appear before Me empty-handed. ▷ ①Lit it ②Lit they shall not

column.name: text
column.value: Also you shall keep the Feast of the Harvest of the first fruits of your labors from what you sow in the field; also the Feast of the Ingathering at the end of the year when you gather in the fruit of your labors from the field.

column.name: text
column.value: Three times a year all your males shall appear before the Lord ①GOD. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not offer the blood of My sacrifice with leavened bread; nor is the fat of My ①feast to remain overnight until morning. ▷ ①Or festival

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall bring the choice first fruits of your soil into the house of the LORD your God. “You are not to boil a young goat in the milk of its mother.

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, I am going to send an angel before you to guard you along the way and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

column.name: text
column.value: Be attentive to him and obey his voice; do not be rebellious toward him, for he will not pardon your rebellion, since My name is in him.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you truly obey his voice and do all that I say, then I will be an enemy to your enemies and an adversary to your adversaries.

column.name: text
column.value: For My angel will go before you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I will completely destroy them.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not worship their gods, nor serve them, nor do according to their deeds; but you shall utterly overthrow them and break their memorial stones in pieces.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall serve the LORD your God, ①and He will bless your bread and your water; and I will remove sickness from your midst. ▷ ①Or that He may bless

column.name: text
column.value: There will be no one miscarrying or unable to have children in your land; I will fulfill the number of your days.

column.name: text
column.value: I will send My terror ahead of you, and throw into confusion all the people among whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will send hornets ahead of you so that they will drive out the Hivites, the Canaanites, and the Hittites from you.

column.name: text
column.value: I will not drive them out from you in a single year, so that the land will not become desolate and the animals of the field become too numerous for you.

column.name: text
column.value: I will drive them out from you little by little, until you become fruitful and take possession of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: I will set your boundary from the ①Red Sea to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the Euphrates River; for I will hand over the inhabitants of the land to you, and you will drive them out from you. ▷ ①Lit Sea of Reeds

column.name: text
column.value: You shall ①make no covenant with them or with their gods. ▷ ①Lit cut

column.name: text
column.value: They shall not live in your land, otherwise they will make you sin against Me; for if you serve their gods, it is certain to be a snare to you.”

column.name: text
column.value: “Now you shall make the altar of acacia wood, ①five cubits long and five cubits wide; the altar shall be square, and its height shall be ②three cubits. ▷ ①About 7.5 ft. or 2.3 m ②About 4.5 ft. or 1.4 m

column.name: text
column.value: You shall make its horns on its four corners; its horns shall be of one piece with it, and you shall overlay it with ①bronze. ▷ ①Or copper, and so for bronze throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall make its pails for removing its ashes, and its shovels, its basins, its forks, and its firepans; you shall make all its utensils of bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also make for it a grating, a netting of bronze, and on the netting you shall make four bronze rings ①at its four corners. ▷ ①Lit on

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall put it under the ledge of the altar, so that the netting will reach halfway up the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also make carrying poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood and overlay them with bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: Its poles shall be inserted into the rings, so that the poles will be on the two sides of the altar when it is carried.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall make it hollow with planks; as it was shown to you on the mountain, so they shall make it.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now you shall make the courtyard of the ①tabernacle. ②On the south side there shall be hangings for the courtyard of fine twisted linen, a ③hundred cubits long for one side; ▷ ①Or dwelling place ②Lit For the side of the Negev to the south ③About 150 ft. or 46 m

column.name: text
column.value: and its pillars shall be twenty, with their twenty bases of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their ①bands shall be of silver. ▷ ①Or rings

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings a ①hundred cubits long, and its twenty pillars with their twenty bases of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their bands shall be of silver. ▷ ①About 150 ft. or 46 m

column.name: text
column.value: For the width of the courtyard on the west side shall be hangings of ①fifty cubits, with their ten pillars and their ten bases. ▷ ①About 75 ft. or 23 m

column.name: text
column.value: The width of the courtyard on the ①east side shall be fifty cubits. ▷ ①Lit east side eastward

column.name: text
column.value: The hangings for the one ①side of the gate shall be ②fifteen cubits, with their three pillars and their three bases. ▷ ①Lit shoulder ②About 23 ft. or 6.8 m

column.name: text
column.value: And for the ①other ②side there shall be hangings of fifteen cubits, with their three pillars and their three bases. ▷ ①Lit second ②Lit shoulder

column.name: text
column.value: And for the gate of the courtyard there shall be a curtain of ①twenty cubits, of ②violet, purple, and scarlet material and fine twisted linen, the work of a ③weaver, with their four pillars and their four bases. ▷ ①About 30 ft. or 9 m ②Or bluish; LXX hyacinth in color ③Lit variegator; i.e., a weaver in colors

column.name: text
column.value: All the pillars around the courtyard shall be joined together with silver, with their hooks of silver and their bases of bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: The length of the courtyard shall be a ①hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits of fine twisted linen, and their bases of bronze. ▷ ①About 150 ft. long, 75 ft. wide, and 7.5 ft. high or about 46 m, 23 m, and 2.3 m

column.name: text
column.value: All the utensils of the tabernacle used in all its service, and all its pegs, and all the pegs of the courtyard, shall be of bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: “And you shall command the sons of Israel that they bring you clear oil of beaten olives for the ①light, to make a lamp ②burn continually. ▷ ①Or luminary ②Lit ascend

column.name: text
column.value: In the tent of meeting, outside the veil which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD; it shall be a permanent statute throughout their generations ①for the sons of Israel. ▷ ①Lit from

column.name: text
column.value: “Then bring forward to yourself your brother Aaron, and his sons with him, from among the sons of Israel, to serve as priest to Me—Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall speak to all the ①skillful people whom I have endowed with ②the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to consecrate him, that he may serve as priest to Me. ▷ ①Lit wise of heart ②I.e., artistic skill

column.name: text
column.value: And these are the garments which they shall make: a ①breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a tunic of checkered work, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for your brother Aaron and his sons, so that he may serve as priest to Me. ▷ ①Or pouch

column.name: text
column.value: They shall take the gold, the ①violet, the purple, the scarlet material, and the fine linen. ▷ ①Or bluish; LXX hyacinth in color, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: “They shall also make the ephod of gold, of violet, purple, and scarlet material, and fine twisted linen, the work of the skilled embroiderer.

column.name: text
column.value: It shall have two shoulder pieces joined to its two ends, so that it may be joined.

column.name: text
column.value: The skillfully woven band of its overlay, which is on it, shall be like its workmanship, ①of the same material: of gold, of violet and purple and scarlet material and fine twisted linen. ▷ ①Lit from it

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: six of their names on the one stone and the names of the remaining six on the ①other stone, according to their birth. ▷ ①Lit second

column.name: text
column.value: ①As a jeweler engraves a signet, you shall engrave the two stones according to the names of the sons of Israel; you shall ②set them in filigree settings of gold. ▷ ①Lit A work of a lapidary, engravings of a seal ②Lit make them to be surrounded

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall put the two stones on the shoulder pieces of the ephod, as stones of memorial for the sons of Israel, and Aaron shall carry their names before the LORD on his two shoulders as a memorial.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall make filigree settings of gold,

column.name: text
column.value: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them of twisted cord work, and you shall put the corded chains on the filigree settings.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall make a ①breastpiece of judgment, the work of a skilled embroiderer; like the work of the ephod you shall make it: of gold, of violet, purple, and scarlet material, and fine twisted linen you shall make it. ▷ ①Or pouch

column.name: text
column.value: It shall be square and folded double, a ①span ②in length and a ③span ④in width. ▷ ①About 9 in. or 23 cm ②Lit its ③About 9 in. or 23 cm ④Lit its

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall ①mount on it four rows of stones; the first row shall be a row of ruby, topaz, and emerald; ▷ ①Lit fill in a setting of stones, four rows of stones

column.name: text
column.value: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;

column.name: text
column.value: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

column.name: text
column.value: and the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper; they shall be set in gold filigree.

column.name: text
column.value: The stones shall be engraved according to the names of the sons of Israel: twelve, according to their names; they shall be like the engravings of a signet, each according to his name for the twelve tribes.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also make on the ①breastpiece twisted chains of cord work in pure gold. ▷ ①Or pouch, and so through v 30

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall make on the breastpiece two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastpiece.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall put the two cords of gold on the two rings at the ends of the breastpiece.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall put the other two ends of the two cords on the two filigree settings, and put them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod, at the front of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall make two rings of gold and place them on the two ends of the breastpiece, on the edge of it, which is toward the inner side of the ephod.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall make two rings of gold and put them on the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on the front of it close to the place where it is joined, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall bind the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a violet cord, so that it will be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastpiece will not come loose from the ephod.

column.name: text
column.value: So Aaron shall carry the names of the sons of Israel in the breastpiece of judgment over his heart when he enters the Holy Place, as a memorial before the LORD continually.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall put in the breastpiece of judgment the ①Urim and the Thummim, and they shall be over Aaron’s heart when he goes in before the LORD; and Aaron shall carry the judgment of the sons of Israel over his heart before the LORD continually. ▷ ①I.e., lights and perfections

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of violet.

column.name: text
column.value: There shall be an opening ①at its top in the middle of it; around its opening there shall be a binding of woven work, like the opening of a coat of mail, so that it will not be torn. ▷ ①Or for his head

column.name: text
column.value: You shall make on its hem pomegranates of violet, purple, and scarlet material all around on its hem, and bells of gold between them all around:

column.name: text
column.value: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, all around on the hem of the robe.

column.name: text
column.value: It shall be on Aaron ①when he ministers; and its sound shall be heard when he enters and leaves the Holy Place before the LORD, so that he will not die. ▷ ①Lit for ministering

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall also make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘Holy to the LORD.’

column.name: text
column.value: You shall ①fasten it on a violet cord, and it shall be on the turban; it shall be at the front of the turban. ▷ ①Lit place

column.name: text
column.value: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall ①take away the guilt of the holy things which the sons of Israel consecrate, regarding all their holy gifts; and it shall always be on his forehead, so that they may be accepted before the LORD. ▷ ①Or bear

column.name: text
column.value: “And you shall weave the tunic of checkered work of fine linen, and shall make a turban of fine linen, and you shall make a sash, the work of a ①weaver. ▷ ①Lit variegator; i.e., a weaver in colors

column.name: text
column.value: “For Aaron’s sons you shall also make tunics; you shall also make sashes for them, and you shall make ①caps for them, for glory and for beauty. ▷ ①Lit headgear

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall put them on Aaron your brother and on his sons with him; and you shall anoint them and ①ordain them and consecrate them, so that they may serve Me as priests. ▷ ①Lit fill their hand

column.name: text
column.value: You shall make for them linen undergarments to cover their bare flesh; they shall ①reach from the waist even to the thighs. ▷ ①Lit be

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall be on Aaron and on his sons when they enter the tent of meeting, or when they approach the altar to minister in the Holy Place, so that they do not incur ①guilt and die. It shall be a statute forever to him and to his ②descendants after him. ▷ ①Or wrongdoing ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: “Now this is ①what you shall do to them to consecrate them to serve as priests to Me: take one bull and two rams without blemish, ▷ ①Lit the thing which

column.name: text
column.value: and unleavened bread and unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers ①spread with oil; you shall make them of fine wheat flour. ▷ ①Or anointed

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall put them in one basket, and present them in the basket along with the bull and the two rams.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the doorway of the tent of meeting and wash them with water.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall take the garments, and put on Aaron the tunic and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod and the ①breastpiece, and wrap his waist with the skillfully woven band of the ephod; ▷ ①Or pouch

column.name: text
column.value: and you shall set the turban on his head and put the holy crown on the turban.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall take the anointing oil and pour it on his head, and anoint him.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also bring his sons and put tunics on them.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall wrap their waists with sashes, Aaron and his sons, and fit ①caps on them, and they shall have the priesthood by a permanent statute. So you shall ②ordain Aaron and his sons. ▷ ①Lit headgear ②Lit fill the hand of

column.name: text
column.value: “Then you shall bring the bull in front of the tent of meeting, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall slaughter the bull before the LORD at the doorway of the tent of meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall take some of the blood of the bull and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; and you shall pour out all the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall take all the fat that covers the entrails, and the ①lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, and offer them up in smoke on the altar. ▷ ①Or appendage on

column.name: text
column.value: But the flesh of the bull and its hide and its refuse, you shall burn with fire outside the camp; it is a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall also take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram;

column.name: text
column.value: and you shall slaughter the ram and take its blood and sprinkle it around on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its entrails and its legs, and put them ①with its pieces and ②its head. ▷ ①Lit on ②Lit on its

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall offer up in smoke the whole ram on the altar; it is a burnt offering to the LORD: it is a soothing aroma, an offering by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “Then you shall take the ①other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram. ▷ ①Lit second

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall slaughter the ram, and take some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron’s right ear and on the lobes of his sons’ right ears, and on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet, and sprinkle the rest of the blood around on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall take some of the blood that is on the altar and some of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron and on his garments, and on his sons and on his sons’ garments with him; so he and his garments shall be consecrated, as well as his sons and his sons’ garments with him.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall also take the fat from the ram and the fat tail, and the fat that covers the entrails and the ①lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of ②ordination), ▷ ①Or appendage on ②Lit filling

column.name: text
column.value: and one loaf of bread, and one cake of bread mixed with oil, and one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread which is set before the LORD;

column.name: text
column.value: and you shall put ①all these ②in the ③hands of Aaron and ④in the ⑤hands of his sons, and shall wave them as a wave offering before the LORD. ▷ ①Lit the whole ②Lit on ③Lit palms ④Lit on ⑤Lit palms

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall take them from their hands, and offer them up in smoke on the altar on the burnt offering for a soothing aroma before the LORD; it is an offering by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “Then you shall take the breast of Aaron’s ram of ①ordination, and wave it as a wave offering before the LORD; and it shall be your portion. ▷ ①Lit filling

column.name: text
column.value: You shall consecrate the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the ①contribution which was waved and which was ②offered from the ram of ③ordination, from the one which was for Aaron and from the one which was for his sons. ▷ ①Or uplifted offering ②Lit lifted up ③Lit filling

column.name: text
column.value: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion forever from the sons of Israel, for it is ①a contribution; and it shall be ②a contribution from the sons of Israel from the sacrifices of their peace offerings, their ③contribution to the LORD. ▷ ①Or uplifted offering ②Or uplifted offering ③Or uplifted offering

column.name: text
column.value: “The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, ①so that they may be anointed and ordained in them. ▷ ①Lit for anointing in them and filling their hand in them

column.name: text
column.value: For seven days the one of his sons who is priest in his place shall put them on when he enters the tent of meeting to minister in the Holy Place.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now you shall take the ram of ①ordination and boil its flesh in a holy place. ▷ ①Lit filling

column.name: text
column.value: Then Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram and the bread that is in the basket, at the doorway of the tent of meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: So they shall eat ①those things by which atonement was made ②at their ordination and consecration; but a ③layman shall not eat them, because they are holy. ▷ ①Lit them ②Lit to fill their hand to sanctify them ③Lit stranger

column.name: text
column.value: And if any of the flesh of ①ordination or any of the bread remains until morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire; it shall not be eaten, because it is holy. ▷ ①Lit filling

column.name: text
column.value: “So you shall do for Aaron and for his sons, according to all that I have commanded you; you shall ①ordain them for seven days. ▷ ①Lit fill their hand

column.name: text
column.value: Each day you shall offer a bull as a sin offering for atonement, and you shall ①purify the altar when you make atonement ②for it, and you shall anoint it to consecrate it. ▷ ①Or offer a sin offering on the altar ②Lit upon

column.name: text
column.value: For seven days you shall make atonement ①for the altar and consecrate it; then the altar shall be most holy, and whatever touches the altar shall be holy. ▷ ①Lit upon

column.name: text
column.value: “Now this is what you shall offer on the altar: two one-year-old lambs each day, continuously.

column.name: text
column.value: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the ①other lamb you shall offer at ②twilight; ▷ ①Lit second ②Lit between the two evenings

column.name: text
column.value: and there shall be a ①tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a ②fourth of a hin of beaten oil, and a fourth of a hin of wine for a drink offering with one lamb. ▷ ①About 3 qt. or 2.8 liters ②About 0.95 qt. or 0.9 liter

column.name: text
column.value: The ①other lamb you shall offer at ②twilight, and shall offer with it ③the same grain offering and ④the same drink offering as in the morning, for a soothing aroma, an offering by fire to the LORD. ▷ ①Lit second ②Lit between the two evenings ③Lit according to the grain offering of the morning ④Lit according to its

column.name: text
column.value: It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the doorway of the tent of meeting before the LORD, where I will meet with you, to speak to you there.

column.name: text
column.value: I will meet there with the sons of Israel, and it shall be consecrated by My glory.

column.name: text
column.value: I will consecrate the tent of meeting and the altar; I will also consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve as priests to Me.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will dwell among the sons of Israel and will be their God.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God who brought them out of the land of Egypt, so that I might dwell among them; I am the LORD their God.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now you shall make an altar as a place for burning incense; you shall make it of acacia wood.

column.name: text
column.value: Its length shall be ①a cubit, and its width a cubit; it shall be square, and its height shall be two cubits; its horns shall be ②of one piece with it. ▷ ①About 1.5 ft. long and wide and 3 ft. high or 45 cm and 90 cm ②Lit from itself

column.name: text
column.value: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top and its ①sides all around, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding all around for it. ▷ ①Lit walls

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also make two gold rings for it under its molding; you shall make them on its two sides—on ①opposite sides—and ②they shall be holders for poles with which to carry it. ▷ ①Lit its two ②Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall put ①this altar in front of the veil that is ②near the ark of the testimony, in front of the ③atoning cover that is over the ark of the testimony, where I will meet with you. ▷ ①Lit it ②Lit upon; or over ③Also called mercy seat; i.e., where blood was sprinkled on the Day of Atonement

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron shall burn fragrant incense on it; he shall burn it every morning when he trims the lamps.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Aaron sets up the lamps at ①twilight, he shall burn incense. There shall be perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations. ▷ ①Lit between the two evenings

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not offer any ①strange incense on ②this altar, or burnt offering, or meal offering; and you shall not pour out a drink offering on it. ▷ ①I.e., prohibited ②Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: However, Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once a year; he shall make atonement on it with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once a year throughout your generations. It is most holy to the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD also spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “When you take a ①census of the sons of Israel ②to count them, then each one of them shall give a ransom for ③himself to the LORD, when you ④count them, so that there will be no plague among them when you ⑤count them. ▷ ①Lit sum ②Lit for their being mustered ③Lit his soul ④Lit muster ⑤Lit muster

column.name: text
column.value: This is what everyone who ①is counted shall give: half a ②shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs), half a shekel as a ③contribution to the LORD. ▷ ①Lit passes over to those who are mustered ②A shekel was about 0.5 oz. or 14 gm ③Or uplifted offering

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone who ①is counted, from twenty years old and over, shall give the ②contribution to the LORD. ▷ ①See note 1 v 13 ②Or uplifted offering of the LORD

column.name: text
column.value: The rich shall not pay more, and the poor shall not pay less, than the half shekel, when you give the ①contribution to the LORD to make atonement for ②yourselves. ▷ ①Or uplifted offering of the LORD ②Lit your souls

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall take the atonement money from the sons of Israel and give it for the service of the tent of meeting, so that it may be a memorial for the sons of Israel before the LORD, to make atonement for ①yourselves.” ▷ ①Lit your souls

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall also make a basin of ①bronze, with its base of bronze, for washing; and you shall put it between the tent of meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it. ▷ ①Or copper

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet from it;

column.name: text
column.value: when they enter the tent of meeting, they shall wash with water, so that they do not die; or when they approach the altar to minister, by offering up in smoke a fire sacrifice to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, so that they do not die; and it shall be a permanent statute for them, for ①Aaron and his ②descendants throughout their generations.” ▷ ①Lit him ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Take also for yourself the finest of spices: of liquid myrrh ①five hundred shekels, and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, 250, and of fragrant cane 250, ▷ ①About 15.5 and 7.75 lb. or 7 and 3.5 kg

column.name: text
column.value: and of cassia 500, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, and of olive oil a ①hin. ▷ ①About 1 gallon or 3.8 liters

column.name: text
column.value: You shall make ①from these a holy anointing oil, a fragrant mixture of ointments, the work of a perfumer; it shall be a holy anointing oil. ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall anoint the tent of meeting with it, and the ark of the testimony,

column.name: text
column.value: and the table and all its utensils, and the lampstand and its utensils, and the altar of incense,

column.name: text
column.value: and the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the basin and its stand.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also consecrate them, so that they may be most holy; whatever touches them shall be holy.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, so that they may serve as priests to Me.

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore, you shall speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to Me throughout your generations.

column.name: text
column.value: It shall not be poured on ①anyone’s body, nor shall you make any like it in ②the same proportions; it is holy, and it shall be holy to you. ▷ ①Lit the flesh of mankind ②Lit its proportion

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever mixes any like it or whoever puts any of it on a ①layman ②shall be cut off from his people.’ ” ▷ ①Lit stranger ②Lit even he shall

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Take for yourself spices—stacte, onycha, and galbanum, spices and pure frankincense; there shall be an equal part of each.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall make incense from it all, a skillful mixture, the work of a perfumer, salted, pure, and holy.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall crush some of it very fine, and put part of it in front of the testimony in the tent of meeting where I will meet with you; it shall be most holy to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the incense which you shall make, you shall not make in ①the same proportions for yourselves; it shall be holy to you for the LORD. ▷ ①Lit its proportion

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever makes any like it, to ①use as perfume, ②shall be cut off from his people.” ▷ ①Lit smell of it ②Lit even he shall

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “See, I have called by name Bezalel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And I have filled him with the Spirit of God in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of ①craftsmanship, ▷ ①Or workmanship

column.name: text
column.value: to create ①artistic designs for work in gold, in silver, and in ②bronze, ▷ ①Lit devices ②Or copper

column.name: text
column.value: and in the cutting of stones ①for settings, and in the carving of wood, so that he may work in all kinds of ②craftsmanship. ▷ ①Lit to fill in (for a setting) ②Or workmanship

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, I Myself have ①appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the hearts of all who are ②skillful I have put ③skill, so that they may make everything that I have commanded you: ▷ ①Lit given ②Lit wise of heart ③Lit wisdom

column.name: text
column.value: the tent of meeting, the ark of testimony, the ①atoning cover that is on it, and all the furniture of the tent, ▷ ①Also called mercy seat; i.e., where blood was sprinkled on the Day of Atonement

column.name: text
column.value: the table and its ①utensils, the pure gold lampstand with all its ②utensils, and the altar of incense, ▷ ①Or vessels ②Or vessels

column.name: text
column.value: the altar of burnt offering with all its ①utensils, and the basin and its stand, ▷ ①Or vessels

column.name: text
column.value: the ①woven garments as well: the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons, with which to ②carry out their priesthood; ▷ ①Or service garments ②Lit minister as priests

column.name: text
column.value: the anointing oil also, and the fragrant incense for the Holy Place, they are to make them according to everything that I have commanded you.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Now as for you, speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘You must keep My Sabbaths; for this is a sign between Me and you throughout your generations, so that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore you are to keep the Sabbath, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it must be put to death; for whoever does any work on it, that person shall be cut off from among his people.

column.name: text
column.value: For six days work may be done, but on the seventh day there is a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to the LORD; whoever does any work on the Sabbath day must be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: So the sons of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to ①celebrate the Sabbath throughout their generations as a permanent covenant.’ ▷ ①Lit perform

column.name: text
column.value: It is a sign between Me and the sons of Israel forever; for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, but on the seventh day He ceased from labor, and was refreshed.”

column.name: text
column.value: When He had finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, He gave Moses the two tablets of the testimony, tablets of stone, written by the finger of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mountain, the people assembled around Aaron and said to him, “Come, make us ①a god who will go before us; for this Moses, the man who brought us up from the land of Egypt—we do not know what happened to him.” ▷ ①Or gods

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron said to them, “Tear off the gold rings which are in the ears of your wives, your sons, and your daughters, and bring them to me.”

column.name: text
column.value: So all the people tore off the gold rings which were in their ears and brought them to Aaron.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he took the gold from their ①hands, and fashioned it with an engraving tool and made it into a cast metal calf; and they said, “ ②This is your god, Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt.” ▷ ①Lit hand ②Or These are your gods

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Aaron saw this, he built an altar in front of it; and Aaron made a proclamation and said, “Tomorrow shall be a feast to the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the next day they got up early and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and got up to engage in lewd behavior.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, “Go ①down at once, for your people, whom you brought up from the land of Egypt, have behaved corruptly. ▷ ①Lit go down

column.name: text
column.value: They have quickly turned aside from the way which I commanded them. They have made for themselves a cast metal calf, and have worshiped it and have sacrificed to it and said, ‘ ①This is your god, Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt!’ ” ▷ ①Or These are your gods

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses, “I have seen this people, and behold, they are ①an obstinate people. ▷ ①Or a stiff-necked

column.name: text
column.value: So now leave Me alone, that My anger may burn against them and that I may destroy them; and I will make of you a great nation.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses pleaded with the LORD his God, and said, “LORD, why does Your anger burn against Your people whom You have brought out from the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?

column.name: text
column.value: Why should the Egyptians talk, saying, ‘With evil motives He brought them out, to kill them on the mountains and to destroy them from the face of the earth’? Turn from Your burning anger and relent of doing harm to Your people.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, Your servants to whom You swore by Yourself, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your ①descendants as the stars of the heavens, and all this land of which I have spoken I will give to your ②descendants, and they shall inherit it forever.’ ” ▷ ①Lit seed ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD relented of the harm which He said He would do to His people.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses turned and went down from the mountain with the two tablets of the testimony in his hand, tablets which were written on both ①sides; they were written on one side and the other. ▷ ①Lit their sides

column.name: text
column.value: The tablets were God’s work, and the writing was God’s writing engraved on the tablets.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Joshua heard the sound of the people ①as they shouted, he said to Moses, “There is a sound of war in the camp.” ▷ ①Lit in its shouting

column.name: text
column.value: But he said, “It is not the sound of the cry of victory, Nor is it the sound of the cry of defeat; But I hear the sound of singing.”

column.name: text
column.value: And it came about, as soon as ①Moses approached the camp, that he saw the calf and the people dancing; and Moses’ anger burned, and he threw the tablets from his hands and shattered them to pieces ②at the foot of the mountain. ▷ ①Lit he ②Lit beneath

column.name: text
column.value: Then he took the calf which they had made and completely burned it with fire, and ground it to powder, and scattered it over the surface of the water and made the sons of Israel drink it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses said to Aaron, “What did this people do to you, that you have brought such a great sin upon them?”

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron said, “Do not let the anger of my lord burn; you know the people yourself, that they are ①prone to evil. ▷ ①Lit in evil

column.name: text
column.value: For they said to me, ‘Make ①a god for us who will go before us; for this Moses, the man who brought us up from the land of Egypt—we do not know what happened to him.’ ▷ ①Or gods

column.name: text
column.value: So I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them tear it off.’ Then they gave it to me, and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Moses saw that the people were ①out of control—for Aaron had let them ②get out of control to the point of being an object of ridicule among ③their enemies— ▷ ①Lit let loose ②Lit go loose ③Lit those who rise against them

column.name: text
column.value: Moses then stood at the gate of the camp, and said, “Whoever is for the LORD, come to me!” And all the sons of Levi gathered together to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘Every man of you put his sword on his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate in the camp, and kill every man his brother, and every man his friend, and every man his ①neighbor.’ ” ▷ ①Or kin

column.name: text
column.value: So the sons of Levi did ①as Moses instructed, and about three thousand men of the people fell that day. ▷ ①Lit according to Moses’ word

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses said, “ ①Dedicate yourselves today to the LORD—for every man has been against his son and against his brother—in order that He may bestow a blessing upon you today.” ▷ ①Lit Fill your hand

column.name: text
column.value: And on the next day Moses said to the people, “You yourselves have ①committed a great sin; and now I am going up to the LORD; perhaps I can make atonement for your sin.” ▷ ①Lit sinned

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses returned to the LORD and said, “Oh, this people has ①committed a great sin, and they have made a god of gold for themselves! ▷ ①Lit sinned

column.name: text
column.value: But now, if You will forgive their sin, very well; but if not, please wipe me out from Your book which You have written!”

column.name: text
column.value: However, the LORD said to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against Me, I will wipe him out of My book.

column.name: text
column.value: But go now, lead the people where I told you. Behold, My angel shall go before you; nevertheless on the day when I ①punish, I will ②punish them for their sin.” ▷ ①Lit visit ②Lit visit their sin upon them

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD struck the people with a plague, because of what they did with the calf which Aaron had made.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD said to Moses, “Cut out for yourself two stone tablets like the former ones, and I will write on the tablets the words that were on the former tablets which you smashed.

column.name: text
column.value: So be ready by morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and ①present yourself there to Me on the top of the mountain. ▷ ①Or place yourself before Me

column.name: text
column.value: And no one is to come up with you, nor let anyone be seen ①anywhere on the mountain; even the flocks and the herds are not to graze in front of that mountain.” ▷ ①Lit on all

column.name: text
column.value: So he cut out two stone tablets like the former ones, and Moses got up early in the morning and went up to Mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and he took the two stone tablets in his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD descended in the cloud and stood there with him as he ①called upon the name of the LORD. ▷ ①Or called out with the name of the LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD passed by in front of him and proclaimed, “The LORD, the LORD God, compassionate and merciful, slow to anger, and abounding in faithfulness and ①truth; ▷ ①Or trustworthiness

column.name: text
column.value: who keeps faithfulness for thousands, who forgives wrongdoing, violation of His Law, and sin; yet He will by no means leave the guilty unpunished, inflicting the ①punishment of fathers on the children and on the grandchildren to the third and fourth generations.” ▷ ①I.e., punishment for the wrongdoing

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses hurried ①to bow low toward the ground and worship. ▷ ①Lit and bowed...worshiped

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said, “If in any way I have found favor in Your sight, Lord, please may the Lord go along in our midst, even though ①the people are so obstinate, and pardon our wrongdoing and our sin, and take us as Your own ②possession.” ▷ ①Lit it is a people stiff-necked ②Or inheritance

column.name: text
column.value: Then ①God said, “Behold, I am going to make a covenant. Before all your people I will perform miracles which have not been ②produced in all the earth nor among any of the nations; and all the people ③among whom you live will see the working of the LORD, for it is a fearful thing that I am going to perform with you. ▷ ①Lit He ②Lit created ③Lit in whose midst you are

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①Be sure to comply with what I am commanding you this day: behold, I am going to drive out the Amorite from you, and the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite. ▷ ①Lit Observe for yourself

column.name: text
column.value: Be careful that you do not make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land into which you are going, or it will become a snare in your midst.

column.name: text
column.value: But rather, you are to tear down their altars and smash their memorial stones, and cut down their ①Asherim ▷ ①I.e., wooden symbols of a female deity (Asherah)

column.name: text
column.value: —for you shall not worship any other god, because the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God—

column.name: text
column.value: otherwise you might make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they would prostitute themselves with their gods and sacrifice to their gods, and someone might invite you ①to eat of his sacrifice, ▷ ①Lit and you eat

column.name: text
column.value: and you might take some of his daughters for your sons, and his daughters might prostitute themselves with their gods and cause your sons also to prostitute themselves with their gods.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not make for yourself any gods cast in metal.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread. For seven days you are to eat unleavened bread, ①as I commanded you, at the appointed time in the month of Abib; for in the month of Abib you came out of Egypt. ▷ ①Or which

column.name: text
column.value: “The ①firstborn from every womb belongs to Me, and all your male livestock, the ②firstborn from ③cattle and sheep. ▷ ①Lit every firstborn of a womb ②Lit every firstborn of a womb ③Or oxen

column.name: text
column.value: You shall redeem with a lamb the firstborn from a donkey; and if you do not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons. ①None are to appear before Me empty-handed. ▷ ①Lit They shall not

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall work six days, but on the seventh day you shall rest; even during plowing time and harvest you shall rest.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall celebrate the Feast of Weeks, that is, the first fruits of the wheat harvest, and the Feast of Ingathering at the turn of the year.

column.name: text
column.value: Three times a year all your males are to appear before the Lord ①GOD, the God of Israel. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: For I will ①drive out nations from you and enlarge your borders, and no one will covet your land when you go up three times a year to appear before the LORD your God. ▷ ①Or dispossess

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not ①offer the blood of My sacrifice with leavened bread, nor is the sacrifice of the Feast of the Passover to ②be left over until morning. ▷ ①Lit slaughter ②Lit remain overnight

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall bring the very first of the first fruits of your soil into the house of the LORD your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Write ①down these words, for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.” ▷ ①Lit for yourself

column.name: text
column.value: So he was there with the LORD for forty days and forty nights; he did not eat bread or drink water. And ①He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the Ten ②Commandments. ▷ ①I.e., the LORD ②Lit Words

column.name: text
column.value: And it came about, when Moses was coming down from Mount Sinai (and the two tablets of the testimony were in Moses’ hand as he was coming down from the mountain), that Moses did not know that the skin of his face shone because of his speaking with Him.

column.name: text
column.value: So when Aaron and all the sons of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone, and they were afraid to approach him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers in the congregation returned to him; and Moses spoke to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Afterward all the sons of Israel came near, and he commanded them to do everything that the LORD had spoken ①to him on Mount Sinai. ▷ ①Lit with

column.name: text
column.value: When Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil over his face.

column.name: text
column.value: But whenever Moses went in before the LORD to speak with Him, he would take off the veil until he came out; and whenever he came out and spoke to the sons of Israel what he had been commanded,

column.name: text
column.value: the sons of Israel would see the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone. So Moses would put the veil back over his face until he went in to speak with Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, “Depart, go up from here, you and the people whom you have brought up from the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, ‘To your ①descendants I will give it.’ ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: And I will send an angel before you and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

column.name: text
column.value: Go up to a land flowing with milk and honey; for I will not go up in your midst, because you are ①an obstinate people, and I might destroy you on the way.” ▷ ①Ora stiff-necked

column.name: text
column.value: When the people heard this ①sad word, they went into mourning, and none of them put on his jewelry. ▷ ①Lit evil

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD had said to Moses, “Say to the sons of Israel, ‘You are ①an obstinate people; if I ②were to go up in your midst for just one moment, I would destroy you. So now, take off your ③jewelry that I may know what I shall do to you.’ ” ▷ ①Ora stiff-necked ②Or go up...I will destroy ③Lit jewelry from you, that

column.name: text
column.value: So the sons of Israel stripped themselves of their jewelry, from Mount Horeb onward.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, a good distance from the camp, and he called it the tent of meeting. And everyone who sought the LORD would go out to the tent of meeting which was outside the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came about, whenever Moses went out to the tent, that all the people would arise and stand, each at the entrance of his tent, and gaze after Moses until he entered the tent.

column.name: text
column.value: Whenever Moses entered the tent, the pillar of cloud would descend and stand at the entrance of the tent; and ①the LORD would speak with Moses. ▷ ①Lit He

column.name: text
column.value: When all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance of the tent, all the people would stand and worship, each at the entrance of his tent.

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD used to speak to Moses face to face, just as a man speaks to his friend. When ①Moses returned to the camp, his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, would not depart from the tent. ▷ ①Lit he

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses said to the LORD, “See, You say to me, ‘Bring up this people!’ But You Yourself have not let me know whom You will send with me. Moreover, You have said, ‘I have known you by name, and you have also found favor in My sight.’

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, if I have found favor in Your sight in any way, please let me know Your ways so that I may know You, in order that I may find favor in Your sight. Consider too, that this nation is Your people.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said, “My presence shall go with you, and I will give you rest.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to Him, “If Your presence does not go with us, do not lead us up from here.

column.name: text
column.value: For how then can it be known that I have found favor in Your sight, I and Your people? Is it not by Your going with us, so that we, I and Your people, may be distinguished from all the other people who are on the face of the ①earth?” ▷ ①Lit ground

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses, “I will also do this thing of which you have spoken; for you have found favor in My sight and I have known you by name.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses said, “Please, show me Your glory!”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said, “I Myself will make all My goodness pass before you, and will proclaim the name of the LORD before you; and I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show compassion to whom I will show compassion.”

column.name: text
column.value: He further said, “You cannot see My face, for mankind shall not see Me and live!”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said, “Behold, there is a place ①by Me, and you shall stand there on the rock; ▷ ①Lit with

column.name: text
column.value: and it will come about, while My glory is passing by, that I will put you in the cleft of the rock and cover you with My hand until I have passed by.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will take My hand away and you shall see My back, but My face shall not be seen.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses assembled all the congregation of the sons of Israel, and said to them, “These are the things that the LORD has commanded you to ①do: ▷ ①Lit do them

column.name: text
column.value: “For six days work may be done, but on the seventh day you shall have a holy day, a Sabbath of complete rest to the LORD; whoever does any work on it shall be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not kindle a fire in any of your dwellings on the Sabbath day.”

column.name: text
column.value: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Take from among you a ①contribution to the LORD; whoever is of a willing heart is to bring it as the LORD’S ②contribution: gold, silver, and ③bronze, ▷ ①Or uplifted offering ②Or uplifted offering ③Or copper

column.name: text
column.value: and ①violet, purple, and scarlet material, fine linen, goats’ hair, ▷ ①Or bluish; LXX hyacinth in color, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: and rams’ skins ①dyed red, and ②fine leather, and acacia wood, ▷ ①Or tanned ②Meaning of the Heb uncertain, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: and oil for lighting, and spices for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense,

column.name: text
column.value: and onyx stones and setting stones for the ephod and for the ①breastpiece. ▷ ①Or pouch

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Have every skillful person among you come and make all that the LORD has commanded:

column.name: text
column.value: the ①tabernacle, its tent and its covering, its hooks and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its bases; ▷ ①Lit dwelling place

column.name: text
column.value: the ark and its poles, the ①atoning cover, and the covering curtain; ▷ ①Also called mercy seat; i.e., where blood was sprinkled on the Day of Atonement

column.name: text
column.value: the table and its poles, and all its ①utensils, and the bread of the ②Presence; ▷ ①Or vessels ②Lit Face

column.name: text
column.value: the lampstand also for the light and its utensils and its lamps, and the oil for the light;

column.name: text
column.value: and the altar of incense and its poles, and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the doorway at the ①entrance of the tabernacle; ▷ ①Or doorway

column.name: text
column.value: the altar of burnt offering with its ①bronze grating, its poles, and all its ②utensils, the basin and its stand; ▷ ①Or copper ②Or vessels

column.name: text
column.value: the hangings of the courtyard, its pillars and its bases, and the curtain for the gate of the courtyard;

column.name: text
column.value: the pegs of the tabernacle and the pegs of the courtyard and their ropes;

column.name: text
column.value: the ①woven garments for ministering in the Holy Place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons, to serve as priests.’ ” ▷ ①Or service garments

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the congregation of the sons of Israel departed from Moses’ presence.

column.name: text
column.value: And everyone whose heart ①stirred him and everyone whose spirit ②moved him came and brought the LORD’S ③contribution for the work of the tent of meeting and for all its service, and for the holy garments. ▷ ①Lit lifted him up ②Or made him willing ③Or uplifted offering

column.name: text
column.value: Then all ①whose hearts moved them, both men and women, came and brought brooches and ②earrings and signet rings and bracelets, all articles of gold; so did everyone who ③presented an offering of gold to the LORD. ▷ ①Or who were willing-hearted ②Or nose rings ③Lit waved a wave offering

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone ①who was in possession of violet, purple, or scarlet material or fine linen or goats’ hair, or rams’ skins ②dyed red or fine leather, brought them. ▷ ①Lit with whom was found ②Or tanned

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone who could make a ①contribution of silver and ②bronze brought the LORD’S ③contribution; and everyone ④who was in possession of acacia wood for any work of the service brought it. ▷ ①Or uplifted offering ②Or copper ③Or uplifted offering ④Lit with whom was found

column.name: text
column.value: And all the ①skilled women spun with their hands, and brought what they had spun, in violet, purple, and scarlet material, and in fine linen. ▷ ①Lit women wise of heart

column.name: text
column.value: And all the women whose heart ①stirred with a skill spun the goats’ hair. ▷ ①Lit lifted them up in wisdom

column.name: text
column.value: The rulers, moreover, brought the onyx stones and the stones for setting for the ephod and for the ①breastpiece; ▷ ①Or pouch

column.name: text
column.value: and the spice and the oil for the light and for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①Israelites, all the men and women, whose heart ②moved them to bring material for all the work, which the LORD had commanded through Moses to be done, brought a ③voluntary offering to the LORD. ▷ ①Lit sons of Israel ②Lit made them willing ③Or freewill offering

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses said to the sons of Israel, “See, the LORD has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all ①craftsmanship; ▷ ①Or work

column.name: text
column.value: to create ①designs for working in gold, in silver, and in ②bronze, ▷ ①Litdevices ②Or copper

column.name: text
column.value: and in the cutting of stones for settings and in the carving of wood, so as to perform in every inventive work.

column.name: text
column.value: He also has put in his heart to teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

column.name: text
column.value: He has filled them with ①skill to perform every work of an engraver, of a designer, and of an embroiderer, in violet, purple, and in scarlet material, and in fine linen, and of a weaver, as performers of every work and makers of designs. ▷ ①Lit wisdom of heart

column.name: text
column.value: “Now Bezalel, Oholiab, and every ①skillful person in whom the LORD has put ②skill and understanding to know how to perform all the work ③in the construction of the sanctuary, shall perform in accordance with everything that the LORD has commanded.” ▷ ①Lit man wise of heart ②Lit wisdom ③Or connected with the service of; lit of the service of

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses called Bezalel, Oholiab, and every ①skillful person in ②whom the LORD had put ③skill, everyone whose heart stirred him, to come to the work to perform it. ▷ ①Lit man wise of heart ②Lit whose heart ③Lit wisdom

column.name: text
column.value: They received from Moses every ①contribution which the sons of Israel had brought to perform ②the work ③in the construction of the sanctuary. And they still continued bringing to him ④voluntary offerings every morning. ▷ ①Or uplifted offering ②Lit it for the work ③Lit of the service of ④Or freewill offering

column.name: text
column.value: And all the ①skillful people who were performing all the work of the sanctuary came, each from ②the work which they were performing, ▷ ①Lit wise ②Lit his

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses issued a command, and circulated a ①proclamation throughout the camp, saying, “No man or woman is to perform work any longer for the ②contributions of the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing any more. ▷ ①Lit voice ②Or uplifted offering

column.name: text
column.value: For the ①material they had was sufficient and more than enough for all the work, to perform it. ▷ ①Lit work

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: The length of each curtain was ①twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; all the curtains had ②the same measurements. ▷ ①About 42 ft. long and 6 ft. wide or 13 m and 1.8 m ②Lit one measure

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops on the ①edge of the curtain that was in the second ②set; the loops were opposite each other. ▷ ①Lit end ②Lit coupling

column.name: text
column.value: He also made fifty clasps of gold, and ①joined the curtains to one another with the clasps, so that the tabernacle was ②a unit. ▷ ①Or coupled ②Lit one

column.name: text
column.value: Then he made curtains of goats’ hair for a tent over the tabernacle; he ①made eleven curtains in all. ▷ ①Lit made them

column.name: text
column.value: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the width of each curtain; the eleven curtains had ①the same measurements. ▷ ①Lit one measure

column.name: text
column.value: He ①joined five curtains by themselves, and the other six curtains by themselves. ▷ ①Or coupled

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the first ①set, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second ②set. ▷ ①Lit tie ②Lit tie

column.name: text
column.value: He also made fifty clasps of ①bronze to ②join the tent together so that it would be ③a unit. ▷ ①Or copper ②Or couple ③Lit one

column.name: text
column.value: And he made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins ①dyed red, and a covering of ②fine leather above. ▷ ①Or tanned ②Meaning of the Heb uncertain

column.name: text
column.value: Then he made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.

column.name: text
column.value: Ten cubits was the length of ①each board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board. ▷ ①Lit the

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: And for the ①back of the tabernacle, to the west, he made six boards. ▷ ①Lit far parts

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.value: With him was Oholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver and a skilled embroiderer, and a ①weaver in violet, in purple, and in scarlet material, and fine linen. ▷ ①Lit variegator; i.e., a weaver in colors

column.name: text
column.value: All the gold that was used for the work, in all the work of the sanctuary, ①which was the gold of the wave offering, was twenty-nine ②talents and 730 ③shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary. ▷ ①Lit and it was ②A talent was about 75 lb. or 34 kg ③A shekel was about 0.5 oz. or 14 gm

column.name: text
column.value: And the silver of those of the congregation who were ①counted was a hundred talents and 1,775 shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; ▷ ①Lit mustered

column.name: text
column.value: a beka a head (that is, half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary), assessed to each one who passed over to those who were ①counted, from twenty years old and upward, for 603,550 men. ▷ ①Lit mustered

column.name: text
column.value: The hundred talents of silver were used for casting the bases of the sanctuary and the bases of the veil; a hundred bases for the hundred talents, a talent for a base.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the 1,775 shekels, he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their tops and made ①bands for them. ▷ ①Or rings

column.name: text
column.value: And the bronze of the wave offering was seventy talents and 2,400 shekels.

column.name: text
column.value: With it he made the bases to the doorway of the tent of meeting, and the bronze altar and its bronze grating, and all the utensils of the altar,

column.name: text
column.value: and the bases of the courtyard all around and the bases of the gate of the courtyard, and all the pegs of the ①tabernacle and all the pegs of the courtyard all around. ▷ ①Lit dwelling place

column.name: text
column.value: Now from the ①violet, purple, and scarlet material they made finely woven garments for ministering in the Holy Place, ②as well as the holy garments which were for Aaron, just as the LORD had commanded Moses. ▷ ①Or bluish; LXX hyacinth in color, and so throughout the ch ②Lit and they made

column.name: text
column.value: He made the ephod of gold and of violet, purple, and scarlet material, and fine twisted linen.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they hammered out gold sheets and cut them into threads ①to be woven in with the violet, the purple, and the scarlet material, and the fine linen, the work of a skilled embroiderer. ▷ ①Lit to work

column.name: text
column.value: They made attaching shoulder pieces for ①the ephod; it was attached at its two upper ends. ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: And the skillfully woven band of its overlay which was on it was like its workmanship, ①of the same material: of gold and of violet, purple, and scarlet material, and fine twisted linen, just as the LORD had commanded Moses. ▷ ①Lit from it

column.name: text
column.value: They also made the onyx stones, set in gold filigree settings; they were engraved like the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he placed them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the breastpiece, the work of a skilled embroiderer, like the workmanship of the ephod: of gold and of violet, purple, and scarlet material and fine twisted linen.

column.name: text
column.value: It was square; they made the breastpiece folded double, a ①span ②long and a span ③wide when folded double. ▷ ①About 9 in. or 23 cm ②Lit its length ③Lit its width

column.name: text
column.value: And they ①mounted four rows of stones on it. The first row was a row of ruby, topaz, and emerald; ▷ ①Lit filled

column.name: text
column.value: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;

column.name: text
column.value: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

column.name: text
column.value: and the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. They were set in gold filigree settings when they were ①mounted. ▷ ①Lit filled

column.name: text
column.value: The stones corresponded to the names of the sons of Israel; they were twelve, corresponding to their names, engraved with the engravings of a signet, each with its name for the twelve tribes.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made for the breastpiece chains like cords, work of twisted cords of pure gold.

column.name: text
column.value: They made two gold filigree settings and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastpiece.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they put the two gold cords in the two rings at the ends of the breastpiece.

column.name: text
column.value: And they put the other two ends of the two cords on the two filigree settings, and put them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front of it.

column.name: text
column.value: They made two gold rings and placed them on the two ends of the breastpiece, on its inner edge which was next to the ephod.

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore, they made two gold rings and placed them on the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on the front of it, close to the place where it joined, above the woven band of the ephod.

column.name: text
column.value: And they bound the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a violet cord, so that it would be on the woven band of the ephod, and that the breastpiece would not come loose from the ephod, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of violet;

column.name: text
column.value: and the opening of the robe was at the top in the center, as the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding all around its opening, so that it would not be torn.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made pomegranates of violet, purple, and scarlet material and twisted linen on the hem of the robe.

column.name: text
column.value: They also made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates all around on the hem of the ①robe, ▷ ①Lit robe, between the pomegranates

column.name: text
column.value: ①alternating a bell and a pomegranate all around on the hem of the robe for the service, just as the LORD had commanded Moses. ▷ ①Lit a bell and a pomegranate, a bell...

column.name: text
column.value: They also made the tunics of finely woven linen for Aaron and his sons,

column.name: text
column.value: and the turban of fine linen, and the decorated ①caps of fine linen, and the linen undergarments of fine twisted linen, ▷ ①Lit headgear

column.name: text
column.value: and the sash of fine twisted linen, and violet, purple, and scarlet material, the work of the ①weaver, just as the LORD had commanded Moses. ▷ ①Lit variegator; i.e., a weaver in colors

column.name: text
column.value: They also made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and ①inscribed it like the engravings of a signet, “Holy to the LORD.” ▷ ①Lit wrote on it a writing

column.name: text
column.value: Then they ①fastened a violet cord to it, to ②fasten it on the turban above, just as the LORD had commanded Moses. ▷ ①Lit put ②Lit put

column.name: text
column.value: So all the work of the ①tabernacle of the tent of meeting was completed; and the sons of Israel did according to all that the LORD had commanded Moses; so they did. ▷ ①Lit dwelling place

column.name: text
column.value: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses, the tent and all its ①furnishings: its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its bases; ▷ ①Or utensils

column.name: text
column.value: and the covering of rams’ skins ①dyed red, and the covering of ②fine leather, and the covering curtain; ▷ ①Or tanned ②Meaning of the Heb uncertain

column.name: text
column.value: the ark of the testimony, its poles, and the ①atoning cover; ▷ ①Also called mercy seat; i.e., where blood was sprinkled on the Day of Atonement

column.name: text
column.value: the table, all its utensils, and the bread of the ①Presence; ▷ ①Lit Face

column.name: text
column.value: the pure gold lampstand, ①with its arrangement of lamps and all its utensils, and the oil for the light; ▷ ①Lit its lamps, the lamps set in order

column.name: text
column.value: and the gold altar, and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the doorway of the tent;

column.name: text
column.value: the ①bronze altar and its ②bronze grating, its poles and all its utensils, the basin and its stand; ▷ ①Or copper ②Or copper

column.name: text
column.value: the hangings for the courtyard, its pillars and its bases, and the curtain for the gate of the courtyard, its ropes and its pegs, and all the ①equipment for the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting; ▷ ①Or utensils

column.name: text
column.value: the woven garments for ministering in the Holy Place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons, to serve as priests.

column.name: text
column.value: So the sons of Israel did all the work according to everything that the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses ①examined all the work, and behold, they had done it; just as the LORD had commanded, this they had done. So Moses blessed them. ▷ ①Lit saw

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “On the first day of the first month you shall set up the ①tabernacle of the tent of meeting. ▷ ①Or dwelling place

column.name: text
column.value: You shall place the ark of the testimony there, and you shall screen off the ark with the veil.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall bring in the table and arrange ①what belongs on it; and you shall bring in the lampstand and ②mount its lamps. ▷ ①Lit its arrangement ②Or light

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also set the gold altar of incense in front of the ark of the testimony, and set up the curtain for the doorway to the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall set the altar of burnt offering in front of the doorway of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall set the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water ①in it. ▷ ①Lit there

column.name: text
