column.value: You shall also set up the courtyard all around and ①hang up the curtain for the gate of the courtyard. ▷ ①Lit put the screen

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything that is in it, and consecrate it and all its ①furnishings; and it shall be holy. ▷ ①Or utensils

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and consecrate the altar, and the altar shall be most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall anoint the basin and its stand, and consecrate it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the doorway of the tent of meeting and wash them with water.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall put the holy garments on Aaron and anoint him and consecrate him, so that he may serve as a priest to Me.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also bring his sons and put tunics on them;

column.name: text
column.value: and you shall anoint them just as you have anointed their father, so that they may serve as priests to Me; and their anointing will ①qualify them for a permanent priesthood throughout their generations.” ▷ ①Lit be for them

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses did these things; according to all that the LORD had commanded him, so he did.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the first month ①of the second year, on the first day of the month, the ②tabernacle was erected. ▷ ①Lit in ②Lit dwelling place

column.name: text
column.value: Moses erected the tabernacle and ①laid its bases, and set up its boards, and ②inserted its bars, and erected its pillars. ▷ ①Lit put ②Lit put

column.name: text
column.value: And he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering of the tent ①on top of it, just as the LORD had commanded Moses. ▷ ①Lit over it above

column.name: text
column.value: Then he took the testimony and put it into the ark, and ①attached the poles to the ark, and put the ②atoning cover ③on top of the ark. ▷ ①Lit set ②Also called mercy seat; i.e., where blood was sprinkled on the Day of Atonement ③Lit over the ark above

column.name: text
column.value: He then brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up a veil for the covering, and screened off the ark of the testimony, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: He also put the table in the tent of meeting on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the veil.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set the arrangement of bread in order on it before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he placed the lampstand in the tent of meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And he lighted the lamps before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he placed the gold altar in the tent of meeting in front of the veil;

column.name: text
column.value: and he burned fragrant incense on it, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he set up the curtain for the doorway of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set the altar of burnt offering in front of the doorway of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: He placed the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it for washing.

column.name: text
column.value: From it Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet.

column.name: text
column.value: When they entered the tent of meeting, and when they approached the altar, they washed, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And he erected the courtyard all around the ①tabernacle and the altar, and ②hung up the curtain for the gate of the courtyard. So Moses finished the work. ▷ ①Or dwelling place ②Lit put the screen

column.name: text
column.value: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses was not able to enter the tent of meeting because the cloud had settled on it, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: Throughout their journeys, whenever the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the sons of Israel would set out;

column.name: text
column.value: but if the cloud was not taken up, then they did not set out until the day when it was taken up.

column.name: text
column.value: For throughout their journeys, the cloud of the LORD was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD called to Moses and spoke to him from the tent of meeting, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When anyone of you brings an offering to the LORD, you shall bring your offering of livestock from the herd or the flock.

column.name: text
column.value: If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect; he shall offer it at the doorway of the tent of meeting, so that he may be accepted before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, so that it may be accepted for him to make atonement on his behalf.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he shall ①slaughter the ②bull before the LORD; and Aaron’s sons the priests shall offer up the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the doorway of the tent of meeting. ▷ ①I.e., following a prescribed ritual, and so through ch 22 ②Lit son of the herd

column.name: text
column.value: He shall then skin the burnt offering and cut it into its pieces.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Aaron’s sons the priests shall arrange the pieces, with the head and the suet, on the wood which is on the fire that is on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Its entrails, however, and its legs he shall wash with water. And the priest shall offer all of it up in smoke on the altar as a burnt offering, an offering by fire as a soothing aroma to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘But if his offering is from the flock, either from the sheep or from the goats, as a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall slaughter it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD, and Aaron’s sons the priests shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall then cut it into its pieces with its head and its suet, and the priest shall arrange them on the wood which is on the fire that is on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: The entrails, however, and the legs he shall wash with water. And the priest shall offer all of it, and offer it up in smoke on the altar; it is a burnt offering, an offering by fire of a soothing aroma to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘But if his offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall bring his offering from the turtledoves or from young doves.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and pinch off its head, and offer it up in smoke on the altar; and its blood is to be drained out on the side of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall also remove its craw with its feathers and throw it beside the altar eastward, to the place of the fatty ashes.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he shall tear it by its wings, but shall not sever it. And the priest shall offer it up in smoke on the altar, on the wood which is on the fire; it is a burnt offering, an offering by fire of a soothing aroma to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now if his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he is going to offer from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without defect before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it at the doorway of the tent of meeting, and Aaron’s sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: From the sacrifice of the peace offerings he shall then present an offering by fire to the LORD, the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,

column.name: text
column.value: and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them, which is on the loins, and the ①lobe of the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys. ▷ ①Or appendage on

column.name: text
column.value: Then Aaron’s sons shall offer it up in smoke on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire; it is an offering by fire of a soothing aroma to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD is from the flock, he shall offer it, male or female, without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: If he is going to offer a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it in front of the tent of meeting, and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: From the sacrifice of peace offerings he shall then bring as an offering by fire to the LORD, its fat, the entire fat tail which he shall remove close to the backbone, the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat that is on the entrails,

column.name: text
column.value: and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them, which is on the loins, and the ①lobe of the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys. ▷ ①Or appendage on

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall offer it up in smoke on the altar as food, an offering by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now if his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: and he shall lay his hand on its head and slaughter it in front of the tent of meeting, and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: From it he shall present his offering as an offering by fire to the LORD, the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,

column.name: text
column.value: and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them, which is on the loins, and the ①lobe of the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys. ▷ ①Or appendage on

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall offer them up in smoke on the altar as food, an offering by fire as a soothing aroma; all fat is the LORD’S.

column.name: text
column.value: It is a permanent statute throughout your generations in all your dwelling places: you shall not eat any fat or any blood.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now when anyone presents a grain offering as an offering to the LORD, his offering shall be of fine flour, and he shall pour oil on it and put frankincense on it.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall then bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests; and he shall take from it his handful of its fine flour and of its oil, with all of its frankincense. And the priest shall offer it up in smoke as its memorial portion on the altar, an offering by fire of a soothing aroma to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The remainder of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons: a most holy part of the offerings to the LORD by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now when you bring an offering of a grain offering baked in an oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers ①spread with oil. ▷ ①Lit anointed

column.name: text
column.value: And if your offering is a grain offering made on the griddle, it shall be of fine flour, unleavened, mixed with oil;

column.name: text
column.value: you shall break it into bits and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Now if your offering is a grain offering made in a ①pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil. ▷ ①Lit lidded cooking pan

column.name: text
column.value: When you bring in the grain offering which is made of these things to the LORD, it shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it to the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest then shall take up from the grain offering its memorial portion, and shall offer it up in smoke on the altar as an offering by fire of a soothing aroma to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The remainder of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons: a most holy part of the offerings to the LORD by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘No grain offering, which you bring to the LORD, shall be made with leaven, for you shall not offer ①up in smoke any leaven or any honey as an offering by fire to the LORD. ▷ ①Lit up from it

column.name: text
column.value: As an offering of first fruits you shall bring them to the LORD, but they shall not ascend as a soothing aroma on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Every grain offering of yours, moreover, you shall season with salt, so that the salt of the covenant of your God will not be lacking from your grain offering; with all your offerings you shall offer salt.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Also if you bring a grain offering of early ripened things to the LORD, you shall bring fresh heads of grain roasted in the fire, crushed grain of new growth, for the grain offering of your early ripened produce.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall then put oil on it and place incense on it; it is a grain offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall offer up in smoke its memorial portion, part of its crushed grain and its oil with all its incense as an offering by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘If a person sins unintentionally in any of the ①things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, and commits any of them, ▷ ①Lit commands of the LORD which are not to be done

column.name: text
column.value: if the anointed priest sins so as to bring guilt on the people, then he is to offer to the LORD a ①bull without defect as a sin offering for his sin which he has ②committed. ▷ ①Lit bull of the herd ②Lit sinned

column.name: text
column.value: He shall bring the bull to the doorway of the tent of meeting before the LORD, and he shall lay his hand on the head of the bull and slaughter the bull before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the anointed priest is to take some of the blood of the bull and bring it to the tent of meeting,

column.name: text
column.value: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the LORD, in front of the veil of the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall also put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense which is before the LORD in the tent of meeting; and all the rest of the blood of the bull he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the doorway of the tent of meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall remove from it all the fat of the bull of the sin offering: the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat which is on the entrails,

column.name: text
column.value: and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them, which is on the loins, and the ①lobe of the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys ▷ ①Or appendage on

column.name: text
column.value: (just as it is removed from the ox of the sacrifice of peace offerings); and the priest is to offer them up in smoke on the altar of burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: But the hide of the bull and all its flesh, along with its head, its legs, its entrails, and its refuse,

column.name: text
column.value: ①that is, all the rest of the bull, he is to bring out to a clean place outside the camp where the fatty ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire; where the fatty ashes are poured out it shall be burned. ▷ ①Lit and

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now if the entire congregation of Israel does wrong unintentionally and the matter ①escapes the notice of the assembly, and they commit any of the ②things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, and they become guilty; ▷ ①Lit is hidden from the eyes of ②Lit commands of the LORD which are not to be done

column.name: text
column.value: when the sin ①which they have ②committed becomes known, then the assembly shall offer a ③bull of the herd as a sin offering and bring it in front of the tent of meeting. ▷ ①Lit concerning which ②Lit sinned ③Lit son of the herd

column.name: text
column.value: Then the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before the LORD, and the bull shall be slaughtered before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the anointed priest is to bring some of the blood of the bull to the tent of meeting;

column.name: text
column.value: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, in front of the veil.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall then put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before the LORD ①in the tent of meeting; and all the rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering which is at the doorway of the tent of meeting. ▷ ①Lit which is in

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall remove all its fat from it and offer it up in smoke on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall also do with the bull just as he did with the bull of the sin offering; he shall do the same with it. So the priest shall make atonement for them, and they will be forgiven.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he is to bring the bull out to a place outside the camp and burn it just as he burned the first bull; it is the sin offering for the assembly.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘When a leader sins and unintentionally does any of ①the things which the LORD his God has commanded not to be done, and he becomes guilty, ▷ ①Lit all commands of the LORD which are not to be done

column.name: text
column.value: ①if his sin ②which he has committed is made known to him, he shall bring as his offering a ③goat, a male without defect. ▷ ①Lit or ②Lit in which he has sinned ③Lit buck of the goats

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the male goat and slaughter it in the place where they slaughter the burnt offering before the LORD; it is a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall offer all its fat up in smoke on the altar as in the case of the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings. So the priest shall make atonement for him regarding his sin, and he will be forgiven.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now if ①anyone of the ②common people sins unintentionally by doing any of the ③things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, and becomes guilty, ▷ ①Lit one soul ②Lit people of the land ③Lit commands of the LORD which are not to be done

column.name: text
column.value: ①if his sin which he has ②committed is made known to him, then he shall bring as his offering a ③goat, a female without defect, for his sin which he has ④committed. ▷ ①Lit or ②Lit sinned ③Or female goat ④Lit sinned

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter the sin offering at the place of the burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall then take some of its blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and all the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he shall remove all its fat, just as the fat was removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall offer it up in smoke on the altar as a soothing aroma to the LORD. So the priest shall make atonement for him, ①and he will be forgiven. ▷ ①Or so that he may be

column.name: text
column.value: ‘But if he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without defect.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it as a sin offering in the place where they slaughter the burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and all the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he shall remove all its fat, just as the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of the peace offerings, and the priest shall offer ①it up in smoke on the altar, on the offerings by fire to the LORD. So the priest shall make atonement for him regarding his sin which he has ②committed, and he will be forgiven. ▷ ①Lit them ②Lit sinned

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now if a person sins after he hears a ①public order to testify when he is a witness, whether he has seen or otherwise known, if he does not tell it, then he will bear his punishment. ▷ ①Lit voice of a curse

column.name: text
column.value: Or if a person touches any unclean thing, whether a carcass of an unclean animal, or the carcass of unclean cattle, or a carcass of unclean swarming things, though it is hidden from him and he is unclean, then he will be guilty.

column.name: text
column.value: Or if he touches human uncleanness, of whatever sort his uncleanness may be with which he becomes unclean, and it is hidden from him, and then he comes to know it, he will be guilty.

column.name: text
column.value: Or if a person swears thoughtlessly with his lips to do evil or to do good, in whatever matter people speak thoughtlessly with an oath, and it is hidden from him, and then he comes to know it, he will be guilty of one of these things.

column.name: text
column.value: So it shall be when he becomes guilty of one of these things, that he shall confess that in which he has sinned.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall also bring his guilt offering to the LORD for his sin which he has ①committed, a female from the flock, a lamb or a ②goat as a sin offering. So the priest shall make atonement on his behalf for his sin. ▷ ①Lit sinned ②Lit female goat

column.name: text
column.value: ‘But if ①he cannot afford a lamb, then he shall bring to the LORD his guilt offering for that in which he has sinned, two turtledoves or two young doves, one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. ▷ ①Lit his hand does not reach enough for

column.name: text
column.value: He shall bring them to the priest, who shall first offer that which is for the sin offering, and shall pinch off its head at the front of its neck, but he shall not sever it.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall also sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar, while the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar: it is a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: The second he shall then prepare as a burnt offering according to the ordinance. So the priest shall make atonement on his behalf for his sin which he has ①committed, and it will be forgiven him. ▷ ①Lit sinned

column.name: text
column.value: ‘But if his ①means are insufficient for two turtledoves or two young doves, then for his offering for that which he has sinned, he shall bring the tenth of an ②ephah of fine flour as a sin offering; he shall not put oil on it or place incense on it, for it is a sin offering. ▷ ①Lit hand does not reach ②About 1 cubic foot or 0.03 cubic meters

column.name: text
column.value: He shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as its memorial portion and offer it up in smoke on the altar, ①with the offerings of the LORD by fire: it is a sin offering. ▷ ①Lit upon

column.name: text
column.value: So the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has ①committed from one of these, and it will be forgiven him; then the rest shall become the priest’s, like the grain offering.’ ” ▷ ①Lit sinned

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “If a person acts unfaithfully and sins unintentionally against the LORD’S holy things, then he shall bring his guilt offering to the LORD: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your assessment in silver by shekels, in terms of the shekel of the sanctuary, as a guilt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall make restitution for that which he has sinned against the holy thing, and shall add to it a fifth part of it and give it to the priest. The priest shall then make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering, and it will be forgiven him.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now if a person sins and does any of the things ①which the LORD has commanded not to be done, though he was unaware, he is still guilty and shall bear his punishment. ▷ ①Lit the commands of the LORD which are

column.name: text
column.value: He is then to bring to the priest a ram without defect from the flock, according to your assessment, as a guilt offering. So the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he committed unintentionally and did not know it, and it will be forgiven him.

column.name: text
column.value: It is a guilt offering; he was certainly guilty before the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now this is the law of the guilt offering; it is most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: In the place where they slaughter the burnt offering they are to slaughter the guilt offering, and the priest shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he shall offer from it all its fat: the fat tail and the fat that covers the entrails,

column.name: text
column.value: and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them, which is on the loins; and he shall remove the lobe on the liver with the kidneys.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall offer them up in smoke on the altar as an offering by fire to the LORD; it is a guilt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Every male among the priests may eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place; it is most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: The guilt offering is like the sin offering: there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with it ①shall have it. ▷ ①Lit it shall be for him

column.name: text
column.value: Also the priest who presents anyone’s burnt offering, ①that priest shall have for himself the hide of the burnt offering which he has presented. ▷ ①Lit for the priest, it shall be for him

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise, every grain offering that is baked in the oven and everything prepared in a ①pan or on a griddle ②shall belong to the priest who presents it. ▷ ①Lit lidded cooking pan ②Lit for the priest, it shall be for him

column.name: text
column.value: Every grain offering, mixed with oil or dry, shall ①belong to all the sons of Aaron, ②to all alike. ▷ ①Lit be ②Lit a man as his brother

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings which shall be presented to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: If he offers it by way of thanksgiving, then along with the sacrifice of thanksgiving he shall offer unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers ①spread with oil, and cakes of well stirred fine flour mixed with oil. ▷ ①Or anointed

column.name: text
column.value: With the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving, he shall present his offering with cakes of leavened bread.

column.name: text
column.value: Of ①this he shall present one of every offering as a ②contribution to the LORD; it shall ③belong to the priest who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings. ▷ ①Lit it ②Or uplifted offering ③Lit be for

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now as for the flesh of the sacrifice of his thanksgiving peace offerings, it shall be eaten on the day of his offering; he shall not leave any of it over until morning.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the sacrifice of his offering is a ①vow or a ②voluntary offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice, and on the next ③day what is left of it may be eaten; ▷ ①Or vowed offering ②Or freewill offering ③Lit day and what

column.name: text
column.value: but what is left over from the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: So if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is ever eaten on the third day, he who offers it will not be accepted, and it will not be credited to him. It will be an unclean thing, and the person who eats it shall bear his punishment.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Also the flesh that touches anything unclean shall not be eaten; it shall be burned with fire. ①As for other flesh, anyone who is clean may eat such flesh. ▷ ①Lit And the flesh

column.name: text
column.value: But the person who eats the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings which belong to the LORD, ①when he is unclean, that person shall be cut off from his people. ▷ ①Lit and his uncleanness is on him

column.name: text
column.value: When anyone touches anything unclean, whether human uncleanness, or an unclean animal, or any unclean ①detestable thing, and eats of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings which belong to the LORD, that person shall be cut off from his people.’ ” ▷ ①Some mss swarming thing

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘You shall not eat any fat from an ox, a sheep, or a goat.

column.name: text
column.value: Also the fat of an animal which dies and the fat of an animal torn by animals may be put to any other use, but you certainly are not to eat it.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever eats the fat of the animal from which ①an offering by fire is offered to the LORD, the person who eats it shall also be cut off from his people. ▷ ①Lit he offers an offering by fire

column.name: text
column.value: And you are not to eat any blood, either of bird or animal, in any of your dwellings.

column.name: text
column.value: Any person who eats any blood, that person shall also be cut off from his people.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to the LORD shall bring his offering to the LORD from the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: His own hands are to bring offerings by fire to the LORD. He shall bring the fat with the breast, so that the breast may be ①presented as a wave offering before the LORD. ▷ ①Lit waved

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall offer up the fat in smoke on the altar, but the breast shall belong to Aaron and to his sons.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall give the right thigh to the priest as a ①contribution from the sacrifices of your peace offerings. ▷ ①Or uplifted offering

column.name: text
column.value: The one among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings and the fat, the right thigh shall be his as his portion.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have taken from the sons of Israel the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the ①contribution from the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their allotted portion forever from the sons of Israel. ▷ ①Or uplifted offering

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is the allotment to Aaron and the allotment to his sons from the offerings by fire to the LORD, on that day when he presented them to serve as priests to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: ①These the LORD had commanded to be given them from the sons of Israel on the day that He anointed them. It is their allotted portion forever throughout their generations.’ ” ▷ ①Lit Which

column.name: text
column.value: This is the law of the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering and the guilt offering, and the ordination offering and the sacrifice of peace offerings,

column.name: text
column.value: which the LORD commanded Moses on Mount Sinai on the day that He commanded the sons of Israel to ①present their offerings to the LORD in the wilderness of Sinai. ▷ ①Or offer

column.name: text
column.value: “When a person sins and acts unfaithfully against the LORD, and disavows the rightful claim of his neighbor regarding a deposit or a security entrusted to him, or regarding robbery, or he has extorted from his neighbor,

column.name: text
column.value: or has found what was lost and lied about it and sworn falsely, so that he sins regarding any of the things that people do;

column.name: text
column.value: then it shall be, when he sins and becomes guilty, that he shall restore what he took by robbery or acquired by extortion, or the deposit which was ①entrusted to him, or the lost property which he found, ▷ ①Or deposited with

column.name: text
column.value: or anything about which he swore falsely; he shall make restitution for it ①in full and add to it a fifth more. He shall give it to the one to whom it belongs on the day he presents his guilt offering. ▷ ①Lit in its sum

column.name: text
column.value: Then he shall bring to the priest his guilt offering to the LORD, a ram without defect from the flock, according to your assessment, as a guilt offering,

column.name: text
column.value: and the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD, and he will be forgiven for any one of the things which he may have done to incur guilt.”

column.name: text
column.value: ①Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying, ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: in Heb

column.name: text
column.value: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law for the burnt offering: the burnt offering itself shall remain on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning, and the fire on the altar is to be kept burning on it.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest is to put on his linen robe, and he shall put on linen undergarments next to his ①body; and he shall take up the fatty ashes to which the fire ②reduces the burnt offering on the altar and place them beside the altar. ▷ ①Lit flesh ②Lit consumes

column.name: text
column.value: Then he shall take off his garments and put on other garments, and carry the fatty ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

column.name: text
column.value: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it. It shall not go out, but the priest shall burn wood on it every morning; and he shall lay out the burnt offering on it, and offer up in smoke the fat portions of the peace offerings on it.

column.name: text
column.value: Fire shall be kept burning continually on the altar; it is not to go out.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now this is the law of the grain offering: the sons of Aaron shall present it before the LORD in front of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then one of them shall lift up from it a handful of the fine flour of the grain offering, ①with its oil and all the incense that is on the grain offering, and he shall offer it up in smoke on the altar, a soothing aroma, as its memorial offering to the LORD. ▷ ①Lit and some of

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron and his sons are to eat what is left of it. It shall be eaten as unleavened cakes in a holy place; they are to eat it in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it as their share from My offerings by fire; it is most holy, like the sin offering and the guilt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Every male among the sons of Aaron may eat it; it is a permanent ordinance throughout your generations, from the offerings by fire to the LORD. ①Whoever touches them ②will become consecrated.’ ” ▷ ①Or Whatever ②Or shall firstbe

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is the offering which Aaron and his sons are to present to the LORD on the day when he is anointed; the tenth of an ①ephah of fine flour as a ②regular grain offering, half of it in the morning and half of it in the evening. ▷ ①About 1 cubic foot or 0.03 cubic meters ②Lit grain offering continually

column.name: text
column.value: It shall be prepared with oil on a griddle. When it is well stirred, you shall bring it. You shall present the grain offering in baked pieces as a soothing aroma to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The anointed priest who will be in his place ①among his sons shall ②offer it. By a permanent ordinance it shall be entirely offered up in smoke to the LORD. ▷ ①Lit from among ②Lit do

column.name: text
column.value: So every grain offering of the priest shall be burned entirely. It shall not be eaten.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, the sin offering shall be slaughtered before the LORD; it is most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Whoever touches its flesh ②will become consecrated; and when any of its blood spatters on a garment, you shall wash what spattered on it in a holy place. ▷ ①Or Whatever ②Or shall firstbe

column.name: text
column.value: Also the earthenware vessel in which it was boiled shall be broken; and if it was boiled in a bronze vessel, then it shall be scoured and rinsed in water.

column.name: text
column.value: Every male among the priests may eat it; it is most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: But no sin offering of which any of the blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place shall be eaten; it shall be burned with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams and the basket of unleavened bread,

column.name: text
column.value: and assemble all the congregation at the doorway of the tent of meeting.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses did just as the LORD commanded him. When the congregation was assembled at the doorway of the tent of meeting,

column.name: text
column.value: Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded us to do.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses had Aaron and his sons come near, and he washed them with water.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he put the tunic on ①Aaron and wrapped his waist with the sash, and clothed him with the robe and put the ephod on him; and he wrapped his waist with the artistic band of the ephod, ②with which he fitted it to him. ▷ ①Lit him ②Lit and with it

column.name: text
column.value: He then placed the ①breastpiece on him, and in the ②breastpiece he put the ③Urim and the Thummim. ▷ ①Or breast pouch ②Or breast pouch ③Meanings of Urim and Thummim uncertain

column.name: text
column.value: He also placed the turban on his head, and on the turban, at its front, he placed the golden plate, the holy crown, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses then took the anointing oil and anointed the ①tabernacle and everything that was in it, and consecrated them. ▷ ①Or dwelling place

column.name: text
column.value: He also sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times and anointed the altar and all its utensils, and the basin and its stand, to consecrate them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed him, to consecrate him.

column.name: text
column.value: Next Moses had Aaron’s sons come near, and he clothed them with tunics and wrapped their waists with sashes, and bound ①caps on them, just as the LORD had commanded Moses. ▷ ①Lit headgear

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Next ①Moses slaughtered it and took the blood and with his finger put some of it around on the horns of the altar, and purified the altar. Then he poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar and consecrated it, to make atonement for it. ▷ ①Lit he slaughtered it and Moses took

column.name: text
column.value: He also took all the fat that was on the entrails and the ①lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and their fat; and Moses offered it up in smoke on the altar. ▷ ①Or appendage on

column.name: text
column.value: But the bull and its hide, its flesh, and its refuse he burned in the fire outside the camp, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he presented the ram of the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

column.name: text
column.value: And ①Moses slaughtered it and sprinkled the blood around on the altar. ▷ ①Lit He slaughtered it and Moses sprinkled

column.name: text
column.value: When he had cut the ram into its pieces, Moses offered up the head and the pieces and the suet in smoke.

column.name: text
column.value: After he had washed the entrails and the legs with water, Moses offered up the whole ram in smoke on the altar. It was a burnt offering for a soothing aroma; it was an offering by fire to the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he presented the second ram, the ram of ①ordination, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram. ▷ ①Lit filling, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: ①And Moses slaughtered it and took some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron’s right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot. ▷ ①Lit He slaughtered it and Moses took

column.name: text
column.value: He also had Aaron’s sons come near; and Moses put some of the blood on the lobe of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand and on the big toe of their right foot. Moses then sprinkled the rest of the blood around on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: He then took the fat, and the fat tail, and all the fat that was on the entrails, and the ①lobe of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh. ▷ ①Or appendage on

column.name: text
column.value: And from the basket of unleavened bread that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake and one cake of bread mixed with oil and one wafer, and placed them on the portions of fat and on the right thigh.

column.name: text
column.value: He then put all these on the hands of Aaron and on the hands of his sons, and presented them as a wave offering before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses took them from their hands and offered them up in smoke on the altar with the burnt offering. They were an ordination offering for a soothing aroma; it was an offering by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses also took the breast and presented it as a wave offering before the LORD; it was Moses’ portion of the ram of ordination, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him; and he consecrated Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and the garments of his sons with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Boil the flesh at the doorway of the tent of meeting, and eat it there together with the bread which is in the basket of the ordination offering, just as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’

column.name: text
column.value: And the remainder of the flesh and of the bread you shall burn in the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall not go outside the doorway of the tent of meeting for seven days, until the day that the period of your ordination is fulfilled; for he will ①ordain you through seven days. ▷ ①Lit fill your hands

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has commanded us to do as has been done this day, to make atonement on your behalf.

column.name: text
column.value: At the doorway of the tent of meeting, moreover, you shall remain day and night for seven days and fulfill your duty to the LORD, so that you will not die; for so I have been commanded.”

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron and his sons did all the things which the LORD had commanded through Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about on the eighth day that Moses called Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel;

column.name: text
column.value: and he said to Aaron, “Take for yourself a calf, a bull, as a sin offering and a ram as a burnt offering, both without defect, and offer them before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘Take a male goat as a sin offering, and a calf and a lamb, both one year old, without defect, as a burnt offering,

column.name: text
column.value: and an ox and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD, and a grain offering mixed with oil; for today the LORD will appear to you.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: So they took what Moses had commanded to the front of the tent of meeting, and the whole congregation came near and stood before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded you to do, so that the glory of the LORD may appear to you.”

column.name: text
column.value: Moses then said to Aaron, “Come near to the altar and ①offer your sin offering and your burnt offering, so that you may make atonement for yourself and for the people; then make the offering ②for the people, so that you may make atonement for them, just as the LORD has commanded.” ▷ ①Lit make ②Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: So Aaron came near to the altar and slaughtered the calf of the sin offering which was for himself.

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron’s sons then presented the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in the blood and put some on the horns of the altar, and poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: The fat and the kidneys and the ①lobe of the liver of the sin offering he then offered up in smoke on the altar, just as the LORD had commanded Moses. ▷ ①Or appendage on

column.name: text
column.value: The flesh and the hide, however, he burned with fire outside the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he slaughtered the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons brought the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: They brought the burnt offering to him in ①pieces, with the head, and he offered them up in smoke on the altar. ▷ ①Lit its pieces

column.name: text
column.value: He also washed the entrails and the legs, and offered them up in smoke with the burnt offering on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and slaughtered it and offered it for sin, like the first.

column.name: text
column.value: He also presented the burnt offering, and ①offered it according to the ordinance. ▷ ①Lit made

column.name: text
column.value: Next he presented the grain offering, and filled his ①hand with some of it and offered it up in smoke on the altar, besides the burnt offering of the morning. ▷ ①Lit palm

column.name: text
column.value: Then he slaughtered the ox and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings which was for the people; and Aaron’s sons brought the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the portions of fat from the ox and from the ram, the fat tail, the fat covering, the kidneys, and the ①lobe of the liver, ▷ ①Or appendage on

column.name: text
column.value: they now placed the portions of fat on the breasts; and he offered ①them up in smoke on the altar. ▷ ①Lit the portions of fat

column.name: text
column.value: But the breasts and the right thigh Aaron ①presented as a wave offering before the LORD, just as Moses had commanded. ▷ ①Lit waved

column.name: text
column.value: Then Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people and blessed them, and he stepped down after making the sin offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Aaron went into the tent of meeting. When they came out and blessed the people, the glory of the LORD appeared to all the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Then fire went out from the LORD and consumed the burnt offering and the portions of fat on the altar; and when all the people saw it, they shouted and fell ①face downward. ▷ ①Lit on their faces

column.name: text
column.value: Now Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took their respective firepans, and after putting fire in them, placed incense on ①the fire and offered ②strange fire before the LORD, which He had not commanded them. ▷ ①Lit it ②I.e., unauthorized

column.name: text
column.value: And fire came out from the presence of the LORD and consumed them, and they died before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses said to Aaron, “It is what the LORD spoke, saying, ‘By those who come near Me I ①will be treated as holy, And before all the people I will be honored.’ ” So Aaron, therefore, kept silent. ▷ ①Or will show Myself holy

column.name: text
column.value: Moses called also to Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Aaron’s uncle Uzziel, and said to them, “Come forward, carry your relatives away from the front of the sanctuary to an area outside of the camp.”

column.name: text
column.value: So they came forward and carried them, still in their tunics, to an area outside the camp, just as Moses had said.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses said to Aaron and to his sons Eleazar and Ithamar, “Do not ①uncover your heads nor tear your clothes, so that you do not die and He does not become wrathful against all the congregation. But your ②kinsmen, the entire house of Israel, shall weep for the burning which the LORD has ③brought about. ▷ ①Lit unbind ②Lit brothers ③Lit burned

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not even go out from the doorway of the tent of meeting, or you will die; for the LORD’S anointing oil is upon you.” So they did according to the word of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD then spoke to Aaron, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Do not drink wine or strong drink, neither you nor your sons with you, when you come into the tent of meeting, so that you do not die—it is a permanent statute throughout your generations—

column.name: text
column.value: and to make a distinction between the holy and the profane, and between the unclean and the clean,

column.name: text
column.value: and so as to teach the sons of Israel all the statutes which the LORD has spoken to them through Moses.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his surviving sons, Eleazar and Ithamar, “Take the grain offering that is left over from the LORD’S offerings by fire and eat it as unleavened bread beside the altar, for it is most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your allotted portion and your sons’ allotted portion from the LORD’S offerings by fire; for so I have been commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: The breast of the wave offering, however, and the thigh of the offering you may eat in a clean place, you and your sons and your daughters with you; for they have been given as your allotted portion and your sons’ allotted portion from the sacrifices of the peace offerings of the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall bring the thigh offered by lifting up and the breast offered by waving, along with the offerings by fire of the portions of fat, to present as a wave offering before the LORD; so it shall be a thing perpetually due you and your sons with you, just as the LORD has commanded.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Moses searched carefully for the goat of the sin offering, and behold, it had been burned! So he was angry with Aaron’s surviving sons Eleazar and Ithamar, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Why did you not eat the sin offering at the ①holy place? For it is most holy, and ②He gave it to you to take away the guilt of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD. ▷ ①I.e., the courtyard of the tabernacle, not the sanctuary ②Or was given

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, since its blood had not been brought inside, into the sanctuary, you certainly should have eaten it in the sanctuary, just as I commanded!”

column.name: text
column.value: But Aaron said to Moses, “Behold, this very day they presented their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD. When things like these happened to me, if I had eaten a sin offering today, would it have been good in the sight of the LORD?”

column.name: text
column.value: When Moses heard that, it was good in his sight.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying: ‘When a woman gives birth and delivers a male child, then she shall be unclean for seven days; as she is in the days of her menstruation, she shall be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: Then on the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

column.name: text
column.value: And she shall stay at home in her condition of ①blood purification for thirty-three days; she shall not touch any consecrated thing, nor enter the sanctuary until the days of her purification are completed. ▷ ①Lit blood of purifying; i.e., ritually clean blood from childbirth

column.name: text
column.value: But if she gives birth to a female child, then she shall be unclean for two weeks, as in her menstruation; and she shall stay at home in her condition of ①blood purification for sixty-six days. ▷ ①See note v 4

column.name: text
column.value: ‘When the days of her purification are completed, for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring to the priest at the doorway of the tent of meeting a one-year-old lamb as a burnt offering and a young pigeon or a turtledove as a ①sin offering. ▷ ①Or purification offering

column.name: text
column.value: Then he shall offer it before the LORD and make atonement for her, and she shall be cleansed from the ①flow of her blood. This is the law for her who gives birth to a child, whether a male or a female. ▷ ①Lit fountain

column.name: text
column.value: But if ①she cannot afford a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two young doves, the one as a burnt offering and the other as a ②sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her, and she will be clean.’ ” ▷ ①Lit her hand does not find enough for ②Or purification offering

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD spoke again to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘These are the creatures which you may eat from all the animals that are on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever has a divided hoof, showing split hoofs, and chews the cud, among the animals, that you may eat.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, you are not to eat of these, among those which chew the cud, or among those which have a divided hoof: the camel, for though it chews cud, it does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise, the rock hyrax, for though it chews cud, it does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean to you.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①rabbit also, for though it chews cud, it does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean to you. ▷ ①Or hare

column.name: text
column.value: And the pig, for though it has a divided hoof, and so it shows a split hoof, it does not chew cud; it is unclean to you.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not eat any of their flesh nor touch their carcasses; they are unclean to you.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘These you may eat, of whatever is in the water: everything that has fins and scales, in the water, in the seas, or in the rivers, you may eat.

column.name: text
column.value: But whatever is in the seas and in the rivers that does not have fins and scales among all the teeming life of the water, and among all the living creatures that are in the water, they are detestable things to you,

column.name: text
column.value: and they shall be detestable to you; you may not eat any of their flesh, and you shall detest their carcasses.

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever in the water does not have fins and scales is detestable to you.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Moreover, these you shall detest among the birds; they are detestable, not to be eaten: the ①eagle, the vulture, and the ②buzzard, ▷ ①Or vulture ②Or black vulture

column.name: text
column.value: the red kite, the falcon in its kind,

column.name: text
column.value: every raven in its kind,

column.name: text
column.value: the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, and the hawk in its kind,

column.name: text
column.value: the little owl, the cormorant, and the ①great owl, ▷ ①Specifically, great horned owl

column.name: text
column.value: the white owl, the ①pelican, and the carrion vulture, ▷ ①Or owl; or jackdaw

column.name: text
column.value: the stork, the heron in its kinds, the hoopoe, and the bat.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘All the ①winged insects that walk on all fours are detestable to you. ▷ ①Lit swarming things with wings

column.name: text
column.value: Yet these you may eat among all the ①winged insects that walk on all fours: those which have jointed legs above their feet with which to jump on the earth. ▷ ①See note v 20

column.name: text
column.value: These of them you may eat: the locust in its kinds, the devastating locust in its kinds, the cricket in its kinds, and the grasshopper in its kinds.

column.name: text
column.value: But all other ①winged insects which are four-footed are detestable to you. ▷ ①See note v 20

column.name: text
column.value: ‘By these, moreover, you will be made unclean; whoever touches their carcasses becomes unclean until evening,

column.name: text
column.value: and whoever picks up any of their carcasses shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening.

column.name: text
column.value: As for all the animals which have a divided hoof but do not show a split hoof, or do not chew the cud, they are unclean to you; whoever touches them becomes unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: Also whatever walks on its paws, among all the creatures that walk on all fours, are unclean to you; whoever touches their carcasses becomes unclean until evening,

column.name: text
column.value: and the one who picks up their carcasses shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening; they are unclean to you.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now these are to you the unclean among the swarming things which swarm on the earth: the mole, the mouse, and the ①great lizard in its kinds, ▷ ①Or thorn-tailed lizard

column.name: text
column.value: the gecko, the ①crocodile, the lizard, the ②sand reptile, and the chameleon. ▷ ①Or lizard ②Species as yet undefined

column.name: text
column.value: These are to you the unclean among all the swarming things; whoever touches them when they are dead becomes unclean until evening.

column.name: text
column.value: Also anything on which one of them may fall when they are dead becomes unclean, including any wooden article, or clothing, or a hide, or a sack—any article ①of which use is made—it shall be put in the water and be unclean until evening, then it becomes clean. ▷ ①Lit with which work is done

column.name: text
column.value: As for any earthenware vessel into which one of them may fall, whatever is in it becomes unclean and you shall break ①the vessel. ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: Any of the ①food which may be eaten, on which water comes, shall become unclean, and any ②liquid which may be drunk in every vessel shall become unclean. ▷ ①I.e., if touched by a carcass; cf. vv 29-32 ②I.e., if touched by a carcass; cf. vv 29-32

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, everything on which part of their carcass may fall becomes unclean; an oven or a ①stove shall be smashed; they are unclean and shall continue as unclean to you. ▷ ①Lit hearth for supporting (two) pots

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, a spring or a cistern ①collecting water shall be clean, though the one who touches their carcass shall be unclean. ▷ ①Lit a collecting place of

column.name: text
column.value: Now if a part of their carcass falls on any seed for sowing which is to be sown, it is clean.

column.name: text
column.value: But if water is put on the seed and a part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean to you.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Also if one of the animals dies which you have for food, the one who touches its carcass becomes unclean until evening.

column.name: text
column.value: He, too, who eats some of its carcass shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening, and the one who picks up its carcass shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now every swarming thing that swarms on the earth is detestable, not to be eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever crawls on its belly, and whatever walks on all fours, whatever has many feet, in regard to every swarming thing that swarms on the earth, you shall not eat them, because they are detestable.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not make ①yourselves detestable through any of the swarming things that swarm; and you shall not make yourselves unclean with them so that you become unclean. ▷ ①Lit your souls

column.name: text
column.value: For I am the LORD your God. Consecrate yourselves therefore, and be holy, because I am holy. And you shall not make yourselves unclean with any of the swarming things that swarm on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: For I am the LORD who brought you up from the land of Egypt, to be your God; so you shall be holy, because I am holy.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: This is the law regarding the animal and the bird, and every living thing that moves in the waters and everything that swarms on the earth,

column.name: text
column.value: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the edible creature and the creature which is not to be eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD also spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel, and say to them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his ①body, ②his discharge is unclean. ▷ ①Lit flesh, and so throughout the ch ②Or by his discharge, he is unclean

column.name: text
column.value: This, moreover, shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: it is his uncleanness whether his body allows its discharge to flow or whether his body obstructs its discharge.

column.name: text
column.value: Every bed on which the man with the discharge lies becomes unclean, and everything on which he sits becomes unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone, moreover, who touches his bed shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening;

column.name: text
column.value: and whoever sits on the thing on which the man with the discharge has been sitting, shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.

column.name: text
column.value: Also whoever touches the ①man with the discharge shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening. ▷ ①Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: Or if the man with the discharge spits on one who is clean, he too shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.

column.name: text
column.value: Every saddle on which the man with the discharge rides becomes unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever then touches any of the things which were under him shall be unclean until evening, and the one who carries them shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise, whomever the man with the discharge touches without having rinsed his hands in water shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.

column.name: text
column.value: However, an earthenware vessel which the man with the discharge touches shall be broken, and every wooden vessel shall be rinsed in water.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now when the man with the discharge becomes cleansed from his discharge, then he shall count off for himself seven days for his cleansing; he shall then wash his clothes and bathe his body in ①running water and will become clean. ▷ ①Lit living

column.name: text
column.value: Then on the eighth day he shall take for himself two turtledoves or two young doves, and come before the LORD to the doorway of the tent of meeting and give them to the priest;

column.name: text
column.value: and the priest shall offer them, one as a ①sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. So the priest shall make atonement on his behalf before the LORD because of his discharge. ▷ ①Or purification offering

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now if a ①man has a seminal emission, he shall bathe all his body in water and be unclean until evening. ▷ ①Lit man’s...goes out from him

column.name: text
column.value: As for any garment or any leather on which there is a seminal emission, it shall be washed with water and be unclean until evening.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man sleeps with a woman so that there is a seminal emission, they shall both bathe in water and be unclean until evening.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘When a woman has a discharge, if her discharge in her body is blood, she shall continue in her menstrual impurity for seven days; and whoever touches her shall be unclean until evening.

column.name: text
column.value: Everything also on which she lies during her menstrual impurity shall be unclean, and everything on which she sits shall be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who touches her bed shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever touches any object on which she sits shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.

column.name: text
column.value: Whether it be on the bed or on the thing on which she is sitting, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until evening.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man actually sleeps with her so that her menstrual impurity is on him, he shall be unclean seven days, and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now if a woman has a discharge of her blood for many days, not at the period of her menstrual impurity, or if she has a discharge beyond ①that period, for all the days of her impure discharge she shall continue as though ②in her menstrual impurity; she is unclean. ▷ ①Lit her menstrual impurity ②Lit in the days of

column.name: text
column.value: Any bed on which she lies all the days of her discharge shall be to her like ①her bed at menstruation; and every object on which she sits shall be unclean, like ②her uncleanness at that time. ▷ ①Lit the bed of her menstrual impurity ②Lit the uncleanness of her menstrual impurity

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise, whoever touches them shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.

column.name: text
column.value: When she becomes clean from her discharge, she shall count off for herself seven days; and afterward she will be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: Then on the eighth day she shall take for herself two turtledoves or two young doves, and bring them to the priest, to the doorway of the tent of meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall offer the one as a ①sin offering, and the other as a burnt offering. So the priest shall make atonement on her behalf before the LORD because of her impure discharge.’ ▷ ①Or purification offering

column.name: text
column.value: “And so you shall keep the sons of Israel separated from their uncleanness, so that they will not die in their uncleanness by their defiling My ①tabernacle that is among them.” ▷ ①Or dwelling place

column.name: text
column.value: This is the law for the one with a discharge, and for the man ①who has a seminal emission so that he is unclean by it, ▷ ①Lit whose seminal emission goes out from him

column.name: text
column.value: and for the woman who is ill because of menstrual impurity, and for the one who has a discharge, whether a male or a female, or a man who sleeps with an unclean woman.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “When someone has on the skin of his ①body a swelling, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it becomes an infection of ②leprosy on the skin of his ③body, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons the priests. ▷ ①Lit flesh ②I.e., or a serious, unspecified disease, and so throughout the ch ③Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall look at the infected area on the skin of the ①body, and if the hair in the infection has turned white and the infection appears to be deeper than the skin of his ②body, it is an infection of leprosy; when the priest has looked at him, he shall pronounce him unclean. ▷ ①Lit flesh ②Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: But if the bright spot is white on the skin of his ①body, and ②it does not appear to be deeper than the skin, and the hair on it has not turned white, then the priest shall ③isolate the person who has the infection for seven days. ▷ ①Lit flesh ②Lit the appearance of it is not deeper ③Lit separate

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall look at him on the seventh day, and if in his eyes the infection has ①not changed and the infection has not spread on the skin, then the priest shall ②isolate him for seven more days. ▷ ①Lit stood ②Lit separate

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall then look at him again on the seventh day, and if the infected area has faded and the infection has not spread on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean; it is only a rash. And he shall wash his clothes and be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: “But if the rash spreads farther on the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall appear again to the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall look, and if the rash has spread on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is leprosy.

column.name: text
column.value: “When the infection of leprosy is on someone, then he shall be brought to the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall then look, and if there is a white swelling on the skin, and it has turned the hair white, and there is new raw flesh in the swelling,

column.name: text
column.value: it is ①a chronic leprosy on the skin of his ②body, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean; he shall not ③isolate him, for he is unclean. ▷ ①Lit aging ②Lit flesh ③Lit separate

column.name: text
column.value: If the leprosy breaks out farther on the skin, and the leprosy covers all the skin of the person who has the infection from his head even to his feet, ①as far as the priest can see, ▷ ①Lit to the entire sight of the priest’s eyes

column.name: text
column.value: then the priest shall look, and behold, if the leprosy has covered his entire ①body, he shall pronounce the one who has the infection clean; it has all turned white and he is clean. ▷ ①Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: But whenever raw flesh appears on him, he shall be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall look at the raw flesh, and he shall pronounce him unclean; the raw flesh is unclean, it is leprosy.

column.name: text
column.value: Or if the raw flesh turns back and is changed to white, then he shall come to the priest,

column.name: text
column.value: and the priest shall look at him, and behold, if the infected area has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce the one who has the infection clean; he is clean.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now when the ①body has a boil on its skin and it is healed, ▷ ①Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: and in the place of the boil there is a white swelling or a reddish-white, bright spot, then it shall be shown to the priest;

column.name: text
column.value: and the priest shall look, and behold, if ①it appears to be deeper than the skin, and the hair on it has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is the infection of leprosy, it has broken out in the boil. ▷ ①Lit the appearance of it is deeper

column.name: text
column.value: But if the priest looks at it, and behold, there are no white hairs in it and it is not deeper than the skin and is faded, then the priest shall ①isolate him for seven days; ▷ ①Lit separate

column.name: text
column.value: and if it spreads farther on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is an infection.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the bright spot remains in its place and does not spread, it is only the scar of the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

column.name: text
column.value: “Or if the ①body sustains in its skin a burn by fire, and the raw flesh of the burn becomes a bright spot, reddish-white, or white, ▷ ①Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: then the priest shall look at it. And if the hair in the bright spot has turned white and it appears to be deeper than the skin, it is leprosy; it has broken out in the burn. Therefore, the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is an infection of leprosy.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the priest looks at it, and indeed, there is no white hair in the bright spot and it is no deeper than the skin, but is dim, then the priest shall ①isolate him for seven days; ▷ ①Lit separate

column.name: text
column.value: and the priest shall look at him on the seventh day. If it spreads farther in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is an infection of leprosy.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the bright spot remains in its place and has not spread in the skin, but is dim, it is the swelling from the burn; and the priest shall pronounce him clean, for it is only the scar of the burn.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now if a man or woman has an infection on the head or on the beard,

column.name: text
column.value: then the priest shall look at the infection, and if it appears to be deeper than the skin and there is thin yellowish hair in it, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is a scale, it is leprosy of the head or of the beard.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the priest looks at the infection of the scale, and indeed, it appears to be no deeper than the skin and there is no black hair in it, then the priest shall ①isolate the person with the scaly infection for seven days. ▷ ①Lit separate

column.name: text
column.value: And on the seventh day the priest shall look at the infection, and if the scale has not spread and no yellowish hair has ①grown in it, and the appearance of the scale is no deeper than the skin, ▷ ①Lit been

column.name: text
column.value: then he shall shave himself, but he shall not shave the scale; and the priest shall ①isolate the person with the scale for seven more days. ▷ ①Lit separate

column.name: text
column.value: Then on the seventh day the priest shall look at the scale, and if the scale has not spread in the skin and it appears to be no deeper than the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean; and he shall wash his clothes and be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the scale spreads farther in the skin after his cleansing,

column.name: text
column.value: then the priest shall look at him, and if the scale has spread on the skin, the priest need not look for the yellowish hair; he is unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: If in his sight the scale has remained, however, and black hair has grown in it, the scale has healed, and he is clean; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

column.name: text
column.value: “When a man or a woman has bright spots on the skin of the ①body, white bright spots, ▷ ①Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: then the priest shall look, and if the bright spots on the skin of their ①bodies are a faint white, it is ②eczema that has broken out on the skin; he is clean. ▷ ①Lit flesh ②Lit vitiligo

column.name: text
column.value: “Now if a man ①loses the hair of his head, he is only bald; he is clean. ▷ ①Lit becomes bald on his head

column.name: text
column.value: And if his head becomes bald at the ①front and sides, he is bald on the forehead; he is clean. ▷ ①Lit border of his face

column.name: text
column.value: But if on the bald head or the bald forehead there occurs a reddish-white infection, it is leprosy breaking out on his bald head or on his bald forehead.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall look at him; and if the swelling of the infection is reddish-white on his bald head or on his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the ①body, ▷ ①Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: he is a leprous man, he is unclean. The priest must pronounce him unclean; his infection is on his head.

column.name: text
column.value: “As for the person who has the leprous infection, his clothes shall be torn and the hair of his head shall be ①uncovered, and he shall cover his ②mustache and call out, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’ ▷ ①Or disheveled ②I.e., mouth

column.name: text
column.value: He shall remain unclean all the days during which he has the infection; he is unclean. He shall live alone; he shall live outside the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: “When a garment has ①a mark of leprosy in it, whether it is a wool garment or a linen garment, ▷ ①Lit an infection, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
