column.value: whether in ①warp or ②woof, of linen or of wool, whether in leather or in any article made of leather, ▷ ①I.e., lengthwise material in weaving ②I.e., material woven crosswise

column.name: text
column.value: if the ①mark is greenish or reddish in the garment or in the leather, whether in the ②warp or in the woof, or in any article of leather, it is a leprous ③mark and it shall be shown to the priest. ▷ ①Lit infestation; possibly material already contaminated prior to weaving ②See notes v 48 ③Lit infestation; possibly material already contaminated prior to weaving

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall look at the mark and shall ①quarantine the article with the mark for seven days. ▷ ①Lit separate

column.name: text
column.value: He shall then look at the mark on the seventh day; if the mark has spread in the garment, whether in the ①warp or in the woof, or in the leather, whatever the purpose for which the leather is used, the mark is a ②leprous malignancy, it is unclean. ▷ ①See notes v 48 ②Lit malignant leprosy

column.name: text
column.value: So he shall burn the garment, whether it is the ①warp or the woof, in wool or in linen, or any article of leather, in which the mark occurs; for it is a ②leprous malignancy. It shall be burned in the fire. ▷ ①See notes v 48 ②Lit malignant leprosy

column.name: text
column.value: “But if the priest looks, and indeed the mark has not spread in the garment, either in the ①warp or in the woof, or in any article of leather, ▷ ①See notes v 48

column.name: text
column.value: then the priest shall order them to wash the thing in which the mark occurs, and he shall ①quarantine it for seven more days. ▷ ①Lit separate

column.name: text
column.value: After the article with the mark has been washed, the priest shall again look, and if the mark has not changed its appearance, even if the mark has not spread, it is unclean; you shall burn it in the fire, whether an eating away has produced bareness on the back or on the front of it.

column.name: text
column.value: “But if the priest looks, and indeed the mark has faded after it has been washed, then he shall tear it out of the garment or out of the leather, whether from the ①warp or from the woof; ▷ ①See notes v 48

column.name: text
column.value: yet if it appears again in the garment, whether in the warp or in the woof, or in any article of leather, it is an outbreak; the article with the mark shall be burned in the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: But the garment, whether the warp or the woof, or any article of leather from which the mark has disappeared when you washed it, shall then be washed a second time and will be clean.”

column.name: text
column.value: This is the law for the mark of leprosy in a garment of wool or linen, whether in the warp or in the woof, or in any article of leather, for pronouncing it clean or unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This shall be the law of the person with leprosy on the day of his cleansing. Now he shall be brought to the priest;

column.name: text
column.value: and the priest shall go out to a place outside of the camp. Then the priest shall look, and if the ①leprous infection has been healed in the person with leprosy, ▷ ①I.e., or a serious, unspecified disease, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: then the priest shall give orders to take two live clean birds, cedar wood, a ①scarlet string, and hyssop for the one who is to be cleansed. ▷ ①Lit scarlet color and

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall also give orders to slaughter the one bird in an earthenware vessel over ①running water. ▷ ①Lit living

column.name: text
column.value: As for the live bird, he shall take it together with the cedar wood, the ①scarlet string, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the live bird in the blood of the bird that was slaughtered over the ②running water. ▷ ①Lit scarlet color and ②Lit living

column.name: text
column.value: He shall then sprinkle seven times the one who is to be cleansed from the leprosy and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the live bird go free over the open field.

column.name: text
column.value: The one to be cleansed shall then wash his clothes and shave off all his hair, and bathe in water and be clean. And afterward he may enter the camp, but he shall stay outside his tent for seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: Then it shall be on the seventh day that he shall shave off all his hair: he shall shave his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair. He shall then wash his clothes and bathe his ①body in water and be clean. ▷ ①Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: “Now on the eighth day he is to take two male lambs without defect, and a yearling ewe lamb without defect, and three-tenths of an ①ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, and one ②log of oil; ▷ ①About 1 cubic foot or 0.03 cubic meters ②About 0.6 pt. or 0.3 liter

column.name: text
column.value: and the priest who is going to pronounce him clean shall present the person to be cleansed and ①the offerings before the LORD at the doorway of the tent of meeting. ▷ ①Lit them

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall take the one male lamb and bring it as a guilt offering, with the ①log of oil, and present them as a wave offering before the LORD. ▷ ①About 0.6 pt. or 0.3 liter

column.name: text
column.value: Next he shall slaughter the male lamb in the place where they slaughter the ①sin offering and the burnt offering, at the place of the sanctuary—for the guilt offering, like the ②sin offering, belongs to the priest; it is most holy. ▷ ①Or purification offering ②Or purification offering

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall then take some of the blood of the guilt offering, and the priest shall put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall also take some of the ①log of oil, and pour it into his left palm; ▷ ①About 0.6 pt. or 0.3 liter

column.name: text
column.value: the priest shall then dip his right-hand finger into the oil that is in his left palm, and with his finger sprinkle some of the oil seven times before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the remaining oil which is in his palm, the priest shall put some on the right ear lobe of the one to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the blood of the guilt offering;

column.name: text
column.value: as for the rest of the oil that is in the priest’s palm, he shall put it on the head of the one to be cleansed. So the priest shall make atonement on his behalf before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall next offer the ①sin offering and make atonement for the one to be cleansed from his uncleanness. Then afterward, he shall slaughter the burnt offering. ▷ ①Or purification offering

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall offer up the burnt offering and the grain offering on the altar. So the priest shall make atonement for him, and he will be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: “But if he is poor and his ①means are insufficient, then he is to take one male lamb for a guilt offering as a wave offering to make atonement for him, and a tenth of an ②ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, and a ③log of oil, ▷ ①Lit hand is not reaching ②About 1 cubic foot or 0.03 cubic meters ③About 0.6 pt. or 0.3 liter

column.name: text
column.value: and two turtledoves or two young doves, which ①are within his means. The one shall be a ②sin offering, and the other a burnt offering. ▷ ①Lit his hand reaches ②Or purification offering

column.name: text
column.value: Then on the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to the priest, at the doorway of the tent of meeting, before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall take the lamb of the guilt offering and the ①log of oil, and the priest shall offer them as a wave offering before the LORD. ▷ ①About 0.6 pt. or 0.3 liter

column.name: text
column.value: Next he shall slaughter the lamb of the guilt offering; and the priest is to take some of the blood of the guilt offering and put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall also pour some of the oil into his left palm;

column.name: text
column.value: and with his right-hand finger the priest shall sprinkle some of the oil that is in his left palm seven times before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall then put some of the oil that is in his palm on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the guilt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the rest of the oil that is in the priest’s palm, he shall put on the head of the one to be cleansed, to make atonement on his behalf before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall then offer one of the turtledoves or young doves, ①which are within his means. ▷ ①Lit from which his hand reaches

column.name: text
column.value: He shall offer what ①he can afford, the one as a ②sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, together with the grain offering. So the priest shall make atonement before the LORD on behalf of the one to be cleansed. ▷ ①Lit his hand reaches ②Or purification offering

column.name: text
column.value: This is the law for him in whom there is an infection of leprosy, whose ①means are limited for his cleansing.” ▷ ①Lit hand does not reach

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD further spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying:

column.name: text
column.value: “When you enter the land of Canaan, which I am giving you as a possession, and I put a spot of leprosy on a house in the land of your possession,

column.name: text
column.value: then the one who owns the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, ‘Something like a spot of leprosy has become visible to me in the house.’

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall then command that they empty the house before the priest goes in to look at the spot, so that everything in the house need not become unclean; and afterward the priest shall go in to look at the house.

column.name: text
column.value: So he shall look at the spot, and if the spot on the walls of the house has greenish or reddish depressions and appears deeper than the ①surface, ▷ ①Lit wall

column.name: text
column.value: the priest shall come out of the house, to the ①doorway, and ②quarantine the house for seven days. ▷ ①Lit doorway of the house ②Lit separate

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall return on the seventh day and ①make an inspection. If the spot has indeed spread on the walls of the house, ▷ ①Lit look

column.name: text
column.value: the priest shall order them to pull out the stones with the spot on them and throw them away ①at an unclean place outside the city. ▷ ①Lit to

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall have the house scraped all around ①inside, and they shall dump the plaster that they scrape off at an unclean place outside the city. ▷ ①Lit from the house

column.name: text
column.value: Then they shall take other stones and replace the discarded stones, and he shall take other plaster and replaster the house.

column.name: text
column.value: “If, however, the spot breaks out again in the house after he has pulled out the stones and scraped the house, and after it has been replastered,

column.name: text
column.value: then the priest shall come in and ①make an inspection. If he sees that the spot has indeed spread in the house, it is a malignant spot in the house; it is unclean. ▷ ①Lit look

column.name: text
column.value: The owner shall therefore tear down the house, its stones, its timbers, and all the plaster of the house, and he shall take them outside the city to an unclean place.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, whoever goes into the house during the time that he has ①quarantined it, becomes unclean until evening. ▷ ①Lit separated

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise, whoever lies down in the house shall wash his clothes, and whoever eats in the house shall wash his clothes.

column.name: text
column.value: “If, on the other hand, the priest comes in and ①makes an inspection and the spot has not indeed spread in the house after the house has been replastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean because the spot has ②not reappeared. ▷ ①Lit looks ②Lit healed

column.name: text
column.value: To cleanse the house then, he shall take two birds, cedar wood, a ①scarlet string, and hyssop, ▷ ①Lit scarlet color

column.name: text
column.value: and he shall slaughter the one bird in an earthenware vessel over ①running water. ▷ ①Lit living

column.name: text
column.value: Then he shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, and the ①scarlet string, with the live bird, and dip them in the blood of the slaughtered bird as well as in the ②running water, and sprinkle the house seven times. ▷ ①Lit scarlet color ②Lit living

column.name: text
column.value: So he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird and with the ①running water, along with the live bird, the cedar wood, the hyssop, and the ②scarlet string. ▷ ①Lit living ②Lit scarlet color

column.name: text
column.value: However, he shall let the live bird go free outside the city into the open field. So he shall make atonement for the house, and it will be clean.”

column.name: text
column.value: This is the law for any spot of leprosy—even for a scale,

column.name: text
column.value: and for the leprous garment or house,

column.name: text
column.value: and for a swelling, for a scab, and for a bright spot—

column.name: text
column.value: to teach ①when they are unclean and ②when they are clean. This is the law of leprosy. ▷ ①Lit on the day of uncleanness ②Lit on the day of cleanness

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they had approached the presence of the LORD and died.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses: “Tell your brother Aaron that he shall not enter at ①any time into the Holy Place inside the veil, before the ②atoning cover which is on the ark, or he will die; for I will appear in the cloud over the ③atoning cover. ▷ ①I.e., of his own choosing ②Also called mercy seat, and so throughout the ch; i.e., where blood was sprinkled on the Day of Atonement ③Also called mercy seat, and so throughout the ch; i.e., where blood was sprinkled on the Day of Atonement

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron shall enter the Holy Place with this: with a ①bull as a ②sin offering and a ram as a burnt offering. ▷ ①Or bull of the herd ②Or purification offering

column.name: text
column.value: He shall put on the holy linen tunic, and the linen undergarments shall be next to his ①body, and he shall be wrapped about the waist with the linen sash and the linen turban wound around his forehead (these are holy garments). He shall bathe his ②body in water and put them on. ▷ ①Lit flesh ②Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall take from the congregation of the sons of Israel two male goats as a ①sin offering, and one ram as a burnt offering. ▷ ①Or purification offering

column.name: text
column.value: Then Aaron shall offer the bull as the ①sin offering, which is for himself, so that he may make atonement for himself and for his household. ▷ ①Or purification offering

column.name: text
column.value: He shall then take the two goats and present them before the LORD at the doorway of the tent of meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats, one lot for the LORD and the other lot for ①the ②scapegoat. ▷ ①Or possibly, Azazel (a name) ②I.e., the goat that leaves (escapes); or goat of removal of sins

column.name: text
column.value: Then Aaron shall offer the goat on which the lot for the LORD fell, and make it a ①sin offering. ▷ ①Or purification offering

column.name: text
column.value: But the goat on which the lot for ①the ②scapegoat fell shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make atonement upon it, to send it into the wilderness ③as the ④scapegoat. ▷ ①Or possibly, Azazel (a name) ②I.e., the goat that leaves (escapes); or goat of removal of sins ③Or possibly, for Azazel ④I.e., the goat that leaves (escapes); or goat of removal of sins

column.name: text
column.value: “Then Aaron shall offer the bull of the ①sin offering which is for himself and make atonement for himself and for his household, and he shall slaughter the bull of the ②sin offering which is for himself. ▷ ①Or purification offering ②Or purification offering

column.name: text
column.value: He shall take a firepan full of coals of fire from upon the altar before the LORD and ①two handfuls of finely ground sweet incense, and bring it inside the veil. ▷ ①Lit the filling of the hollow of his hands

column.name: text
column.value: He shall put the incense on the fire before the LORD, so that the cloud of incense may cover the atoning cover that is on the ark of the testimony, otherwise he will die.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, he shall take some of the blood of the bull and sprinkle it with his finger on the atoning cover on the east side; also in front of the atoning cover he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.

column.name: text
column.value: “Then he shall slaughter the goat of the sin offering, which is for the people, and bring its blood inside the veil and do with its blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the atoning cover and in front of the atoning cover.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the impurities of the sons of Israel and because of their unlawful acts regarding all their sins; and he shall do so for the tent of meeting which remains with them in the midst of their impurities.

column.name: text
column.value: When he goes in to make atonement in the Holy Place, no one shall be in the tent of meeting until he comes out, so that he may make atonement for himself and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he shall go out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it; he shall take some of the blood from the bull and some of the blood from the goat, and put it on the horns of the altar on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: With his finger he shall sprinkle some of the blood on it seven times and cleanse it, and consecrate it from the impurities of the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: “When he finishes atoning for the Holy Place and the tent of meeting and the altar, he shall offer the live goat.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Aaron shall lay both of his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over it all the wrongdoings of the sons of Israel and all their unlawful acts regarding all their sins; and he shall place them on the head of the goat and send it away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who stands ready.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the goat shall carry on itself all their wrongdoings to an ①isolated territory; he shall release the goat in the wilderness. ▷ ①Or infertile

column.name: text
column.value: “Then Aaron shall come into the tent of meeting and take off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall bathe his ①body with water in a holy place and put on his clothes, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people. ▷ ①Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: Then he shall offer up in smoke the fat of the sin offering on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who released the goat ①as the ②scapegoat shall wash his clothes and bathe his ③body with water; then afterward he shall come into the camp. ▷ ①Or possibly, for Azazel (a name) ②I.e., the goat that leaves (escapes); or goat of removal of sins ③Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: But the bull of the ①sin offering and the goat of the ②sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be taken outside the camp, and they shall burn their hides, their flesh, and their refuse in the fire. ▷ ①Or purification offering ②Or purification offering

column.name: text
column.value: Then the one who burns them shall wash his clothes and bathe his body with water; and afterward he shall come into the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: “This shall be a permanent statute for you: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall humble ①yourselves and not do any work, whether the native, or the stranger who resides among you; ▷ ①Lit your souls

column.name: text
column.value: for it is on this day that ①atonement shall be made for you to cleanse you; you will be clean from all your sins before the LORD. ▷ ①Lit he shall make atonement

column.name: text
column.value: It is to be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, so that you may humble ①yourselves; it is a permanent statute. ▷ ①Lit your souls

column.name: text
column.value: So the priest who is anointed and ①ordained to serve as priest in his father’s place shall make atonement: he shall put on the linen garments, the holy garments, ▷ ①Lit whose hand is filled

column.name: text
column.value: and make atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make atonement for the tent of meeting and for the altar. He shall also make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.

column.name: text
column.value: Now you shall have this as a permanent statute, to make atonement for the sons of Israel for all their sins once every year.” And just as the LORD had commanded Moses, so he did.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the sons of Israel, and say to them, ‘This is what the LORD has commanded, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Anyone from the house of Israel who slaughters an ox, a lamb, or a goat in the camp, or slaughters it outside the camp,

column.name: text
column.value: and has not brought it to the doorway of the tent of meeting to present it as an offering to the LORD in front of the ①tabernacle of the LORD, bloodshed is to be counted against that person. He has shed blood, and that person shall be cut off from among his people. ▷ ①Lit dwelling place

column.name: text
column.value: This shall be done so that the sons of Israel will bring their sacrifices which they were sacrificing ①in the open field—so that they will bring them to the LORD at the doorway of the tent of meeting to the priest, and sacrifice them as sacrifices of peace offerings to the LORD. ▷ ①Lit on the face of the field

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall sprinkle the blood on the altar of the LORD at the doorway of the tent of meeting, and offer up the fat in smoke as a soothing aroma to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall no longer offer their sacrifices to the ①goat demons with which they play the prostitute. This shall be a permanent statute to them throughout their generations.” ’ ▷ ①Or goat idols

column.name: text
column.value: “Then you shall say to them, ‘Anyone from the house of Israel, or from the strangers who reside among them, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,

column.name: text
column.value: and does not bring it to the doorway of the tent of meeting to ①offer it to the LORD, that person also shall be cut off from his people. ▷ ①Lit do

column.name: text
column.value: ‘And anyone from the house of Israel, or from the strangers who reside among them, who eats any blood, I will set My face against that person who eats the blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

column.name: text
column.value: For the ①life of the flesh is in the blood, and I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood by reason of the ②life that makes atonement.’ ▷ ①Lit soul ②Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I said to the sons of Israel, ‘No person among you may eat blood, nor may any stranger who resides among you eat blood.’

column.name: text
column.value: So when anyone from the sons of Israel, or from the strangers who reside among them, ①while hunting catches an animal or a bird which may be eaten, he shall pour out its blood and cover it with dirt. ▷ ①Lit who hunts game, animal

column.name: text
column.value: “For as for the ①life of all flesh, its blood is identified with its ②life. Therefore I said to the sons of Israel, ‘You are not to eat the blood of any flesh, for the ③life of all flesh is its blood; whoever eats it shall be cut off.’ ▷ ①Lit soul ②Lit soul ③Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: And any person who eats an animal which dies or is torn by animals, whether he is a native or a stranger, shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and remain unclean until evening; then he will become clean.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he does not wash his clothes and bathe his body, then he shall bear the responsibility for his ①guilt.” ▷ ①Or wrongdoing

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not do ①what is done in the land of Egypt where you lived, nor are you to do ②what is done in the land of Canaan where I am bringing you; you shall not walk in their statutes. ▷ ①Lit according to the deed of ②Lit according to the deed of

column.name: text
column.value: You are to perform My judgments and keep My statutes, ①to live in accord with them; I am the LORD your God. ▷ ①Lit to walk in them

column.name: text
column.value: So you shall keep My statutes and My judgments, which, if ①a person ②follows them, then he will live by them; I am the LORD. ▷ ①Lit the person ②Lit does them

column.name: text
column.value: ‘None of you shall approach any blood relative ①of his to uncover nakedness; I am the LORD. ▷ ①Lit of his flesh

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, that is, the nakedness of your mother. She is your mother; you are not to uncover her nakedness.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife; it is your father’s nakedness.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the nakedness of your sister, either your father’s daughter or your mother’s daughter, whether born in the household or born outside the household, you shall not uncover their nakedness.

column.name: text
column.value: The nakedness of your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter, their nakedness you shall not uncover; for ①their nakedness is yours. ▷ ①Lit they are your nakedness

column.name: text
column.value: The nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, born to your father, she is your sister; you shall not uncover her nakedness.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister; she is your father’s blood relative.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s blood relative.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother. You shall not approach his wife; she is your aunt.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife; you shall not uncover her nakedness.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife; it is your brother’s nakedness.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and of her daughter, nor shall you take her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; they are blood relatives. It is an outrageous sin.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall not ①marry a woman in addition to her sister ②as a second wife while she is alive, to uncover her nakedness. ▷ ①Lit take ②Lit to be

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Also you shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness during her menstrual impurity.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall not have sexual intercourse with your neighbor’s wife, to be defiled with her.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not give any of your children to ①offer them to Molech, nor shall you profane the name of your God; I am the LORD. ▷ ①Lit make them pass over

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not sleep with a male as ①one sleeps with a female; it is an abomination. ▷ ①Lit a woman’s bed

column.name: text
column.value: Also you shall not have sexual intercourse with any animal to be defiled with it, nor shall any woman stand before an animal to ①mate with it; it is a perversion. ▷ ①Or lie

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Do not defile yourselves by any of these things; for by all these things the nations which I am driving out from you have become defiled.

column.name: text
column.value: For the land has become defiled, therefore I have brought its punishment upon it, so the land has vomited out its inhabitants.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for you, you are to keep My statutes and My judgments, and you shall not do any of these abominations, neither the native, nor the stranger who resides among you

column.name: text
column.value: (for the people of the land who were there before you did all these abominations, and the land has become defiled),

column.name: text
column.value: so that the land will not vomit you out should you defile it, as it has vomited out the nation which was there before you.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever does any of these abominations, those persons who do so shall be cut off from among their people.

column.name: text
column.value: So you are to keep your ①commitment to Me not to practice any of the abominable customs which have been practiced before you, so that you do not defile yourselves with them; I am the LORD your God.’ ” ▷ ①Lit obligation

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to all the congregation of the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘You shall be holy, for I the LORD your God am holy.

column.name: text
column.value: Every one of you shall revere his mother and his father, and you shall keep My Sabbaths; I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not turn to idols or make for yourselves cast metal gods; I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now when you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.

column.name: text
column.value: It shall be eaten on the same day you offer it, and on the next day; but what remains until the third day shall be burned with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: So if it is eaten at all on the third day, it is unclean; it will not be accepted.

column.name: text
column.value: And everyone who eats it will bear the consequences for his guilt, because he has profaned the holy thing of the LORD; and that person shall be cut off from his people.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not reap to the very edges of your field, nor shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall not glean your vineyard, nor shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard; you shall leave them for the needy and for the stranger. I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You shall not steal, nor deal falsely, nor lie to one another.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall not swear falsely by My name, so as to profane the name of your God; I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. The wages of a hired worker are not to remain with you all night until morning.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not curse a person who is deaf, nor put a stumbling block before a person who is blind, but you shall revere your God; I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You shall not do injustice in judgment; you shall not show partiality to the poor nor give preference to the great, but you are to judge your neighbor fairly.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not go about as a slanderer among your people; and you are not to ①jeopardize the ②life of your neighbor. I am the LORD. ▷ ①Lit stand on ②Lit blood

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You shall not hate your fellow countryman in your heart; you may certainly rebuke your neighbor, but you are not to incur sin because of him.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not take vengeance, nor hold any grudge against the sons of your people, but you shall love your neighbor as yourself; I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You are to keep My statutes. You shall not cross-breed two kinds of your cattle; you shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed, nor wear a garment of two kinds of material mixed together.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now if a man has sexual relations with a woman who is a slave acquired for another man, but who has in no way been redeemed nor given her freedom, there shall be punishment; they shall not, however, be put to death, because she was not free.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall bring his guilt offering to the LORD to the doorway of the tent of meeting, a ram as a guilt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall also make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering before the LORD for his sin which he has committed, and the sin which he has committed will be forgiven him.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now when you enter the land and plant all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as ①forbidden. For three years it shall be ②forbidden to you; it shall not be eaten. ▷ ①Lit uncircumcised ②Lit uncircumcised

column.name: text
column.value: And in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, an offering of praise to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But in the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, so that its yield may increase for you; I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood. You shall not practice divination nor soothsaying.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not round off the ①hairline of your heads, nor trim the edges of your beard. ▷ ①Lit side

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not make any cuts in your ①body for the ②dead, nor make any tattoo marks on yourselves: I am the LORD. ▷ ①Lit flesh ②Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Do not profane your daughter by making her a prostitute, so that the land does not fall into prostitution, and the land does not become full of outrageous sin.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall keep My Sabbaths and revere My sanctuary; I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Do not turn to ①mediums or spiritists; do not seek them out to be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God. ▷ ①Or ghosts or spirits

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You shall stand up in the presence of the grayheaded and honor ①elders, and you shall ②fear your God; I am the LORD. ▷ ①Lit the face of the old ②Or revere

column.name: text
column.value: ‘When a stranger resides with you in your land, you shall not ①do him wrong. ▷ ①Lit oppress him

column.name: text
column.value: The stranger who resides with you shall be to you as the native among you, and you shall love him as yourself, for you were strangers in the land of Egypt; I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You shall do no wrong in judgment, in measurement of weight, or volume.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall have accurate balances, accurate weights, an accurate ①ephah, and an accurate ②hin; I am the LORD your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt. ▷ ①I.e., a dry measure, about 1 cubic foot or 0.03 cubic meters ②I.e., a liquid measure, about 1 gallon or 3.8 liters

column.name: text
column.value: So you shall keep all My statutes and all My ordinances, and do them; I am the LORD.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them: ‘No one shall defile himself for a dead person among his people,

column.name: text
column.value: except for his relatives who are nearest to him, his mother, his father, his son, his daughter, and his brother,

column.name: text
column.value: also for his virgin sister who is near to him ①because she has not had a husband; for her, he may defile himself. ▷ ①Or who has not belonged to a man

column.name: text
column.value: He shall not defile himself as a ①relative by marriage among his people, so as to profane himself. ▷ ①Lit husband among

column.name: text
column.value: They shall not shave any area on their heads bald, nor shave off the edges of their beards, nor make any cuts in their flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God, because they present the offerings by fire ①to the LORD, the food of their God; so they shall be holy. ▷ ①Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: They shall not take a woman who is a prostitute and ①profaned, nor shall they take a woman divorced from her husband; for he is holy to his God. ▷ ①I.e., deflowered

column.name: text
column.value: You shall consecrate him, therefore, because he offers the food of your God. He shall be holy to you; for I the LORD, who sanctifies you, am holy.

column.name: text
column.value: Also the daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by prostitution, she profanes her father; she shall be burned with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘The priest who is ①highest among his brothers, on whose head the anointing oil has been poured and ②who has been consecrated to wear the garments, shall not ③uncover his head nor tear his clothes; ▷ ①I.e., the high priest ②Lit whose hand has been filled ③Lit unbind

column.name: text
column.value: nor shall he approach any dead person, nor defile himself even for his father or his mother;

column.name: text
column.value: nor shall he leave the sanctuary nor profane the sanctuary of his God, for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is on him; I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall take a wife in her virginity.

column.name: text
column.value: A widow, or a divorced woman, or one who is profaned by prostitution, these he shall not take; but rather he is to ①marry a virgin of his own people, ▷ ①Lit take as wife

column.name: text
column.value: so that he will not profane his ①children among his people; for I am the LORD who sanctifies him.’ ” ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to Aaron, saying, ‘None of your ①descendants throughout their generations who has an impairment shall approach to offer the food of his God. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: For no one who has an impairment shall approach: a man who is blind, or one who limps, or one who has a slit nose, or one with any conspicuous feature,

column.name: text
column.value: or someone who has a broken foot or broken hand,

column.name: text
column.value: or a contorted back, or one who is a dwarf, or has a spot in his eye, or a festering rash or scabs, or crushed testicles.

column.name: text
column.value: No man among the ①descendants of Aaron the priest who has an impairment is to come forward to offer the LORD’S offerings by fire; since he has an impairment, he shall not come forward to offer the food of his God. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: He may eat the food of his God, both of the most holy and of the holy,

column.name: text
column.value: only he shall not come up to the veil or approach the altar, since he has an impairment, so that he does not profane My sanctuaries. For I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses spoke to Aaron and to his sons and to all the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall also say to the sons of Israel: ‘Anyone from the sons of Israel or from the strangers residing in Israel who gives any of his ①children to Molech, shall certainly be put to death; the people of the land shall stone him with stones. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: I will also set My face against that man and will cut him off from among his people, because he has given some of his ①children to Molech, so as to defile My sanctuary and to profane My holy name. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: If the people of the land, however, ①should ever disregard that man when he gives any of his ②children to Molech, so as not to put him to death, ▷ ①Lit hiding they hide their eyes from ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: then I Myself will set My face against that man and against his family, and I will cut off from among their people both him and all those who play the prostitute with him, by playing the prostitute with Molech.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘As for the person who turns to ①mediums and to spiritists, to play the prostitute with them, I will also set My face against that person and will cut him off from among his people. ▷ ①Or ghosts and spirits

column.name: text
column.value: You shall consecrate yourselves therefore and be holy, for I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: So you shall keep My statutes and practice them; I am the LORD who sanctifies you.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘If there is anyone who curses his father or his mother, he shall certainly be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother, and has brought his ①own death upon himself. ▷ ①Lit bloodguilt upon

column.name: text
column.value: ‘If there is a man who commits adultery with another man’s wife, one who commits adultery with his friend’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress must be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: If there is a man who sleeps with his father’s wife, he has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both of them must be put to death, they have brought their ①own deaths upon themselves. ▷ ①Lit bloodguilt upon

column.name: text
column.value: If there is a man who sleeps with his daughter-in-law, both of them must be put to death. They have committed ①incest, and have brought their ②own deaths upon themselves. ▷ ①Lit disgracefulness ②Lit bloodguilt upon

column.name: text
column.value: If there is a man who sleeps with a male as those who sleep with a woman, both of them have committed a detestable act; they must be put to death. They have brought their ①own deaths upon themselves. ▷ ①Lit bloodguilt upon

column.name: text
column.value: If there is a man who ①marries a woman and her mother, it is an outrageous sin; both he and they shall be burned with fire, so that there will be no such outrageous sin in your midst. ▷ ①Lit takes

column.name: text
column.value: If there is a man who has sexual intercourse with an animal, he must be put to death; you shall also kill the animal.

column.name: text
column.value: If there is a woman who approaches any animal to ①mate with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal; they must be put to death. They have brought their ②own deaths upon themselves. ▷ ①Lit lie ②Lit bloodguilt upon

column.name: text
column.value: ‘If there is a man who takes his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter, so that he sees her nakedness and she sees his nakedness, it is a disgrace; and they shall be cut off in the sight of the sons of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he bears his guilt.

column.name: text
column.value: If there is a man who sleeps with a menstruous woman and uncovers her nakedness, he has exposed her flow, and she has uncovered the flow of her blood; so both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister or of your father’s sister, for such a one has uncovered his ①blood relative; they will bear their guilt. ▷ ①Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: If there is a man who sleeps with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness; they will bear their sin. They will die childless.

column.name: text
column.value: If there is a man who takes his brother’s wife, it is ①detestable; he has uncovered his brother’s nakedness. They will be childless. ▷ ①Or an abomination

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You are therefore to keep all My statutes and all My ordinances, and do them, so that the land to which I am bringing you to ①live will not vomit you out. ▷ ①Lit dwell in it

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore, you shall not ①follow the customs of the nation which I am going to drive out before you, because they did all these things; therefore I have felt disgust for them. ▷ ①Lit walk in

column.name: text
column.value: So I have said to you, “You are to take possession of their land, and I Myself will give it to you to possess, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I am the LORD your God, who has singled you out from the peoples.

column.name: text
column.value: You are therefore to make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean bird and the clean; and you shall not make ①yourselves detestable by animal or by bird, or by anything ②that crawls on the ground, which I have distinguished for you as unclean. ▷ ①Lit your souls ②Lit with which the ground crawls

column.name: text
column.value: So you are to be holy to Me, for I the LORD am holy; and I have singled you out from the peoples to be Mine.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now a man or a woman who is a medium or a spiritist ①must be put to death. They shall be stoned with stones; they have brought their ②own deaths upon themselves.’ ” ▷ ①Lit among them must ②Lit bloodguilt upon

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Tell Aaron and his sons to be careful with the holy gifts of the sons of Israel, which they dedicate to Me, so as not to profane My holy name; I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to them, ‘Any man among all your ①descendants throughout your generations who approaches the holy gifts which the sons of Israel consecrate to the LORD, while he has an uncleanness, that person shall be cut off from My presence; I am the LORD. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: No man of the ①descendants of Aaron, who has ②leprosy or has a discharge, may eat of the holy gifts until he is clean. And one who touches anything made unclean by a corpse, or a man who has a seminal emission, ▷ ①Lit seed ②I.e., leprosy or another serious skin disease

column.name: text
column.value: or a man who touches any swarming things by which he is made unclean, or touches any person by whom he is made unclean, whatever his uncleanness;

column.name: text
column.value: a ①person who touches any such thing shall be unclean until evening, and shall not eat of the holy gifts unless he has bathed his ②body in water. ▷ ①Lit soul ②Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: But when the sun sets, he will be clean, and afterward he may eat of the holy gifts, for it is his ①food. ▷ ①Lit bread

column.name: text
column.value: He shall not eat an animal which dies or is torn by animals, becoming unclean by it; I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall therefore perform their duty to Me, so that they do not bear sin because of it and die by it because they profane it; I am the LORD who sanctifies them.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘No ①layman, however, is to eat the holy gift; a foreign resident with the priest or a hired worker shall not eat the holy gift. ▷ ①Or unauthorized person

column.name: text
column.value: But if a priest buys a ①slave as his property with his money, ②that person may eat of it, and those who are born in his house may eat of his ③food. ▷ ①Lit soul ②Lit he may ③Lit bread

column.name: text
column.value: If a priest’s daughter is married to a ①layman, she shall not eat of the ②offering of the holy gifts. ▷ ①Lit stranger ②Or uplifted offering

column.name: text
column.value: But if a priest’s daughter becomes a widow or divorced, and has no child and returns to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s ①food; but no ②layman shall eat of it. ▷ ①Lit bread ②Lit stranger

column.name: text
column.value: If, however, someone eats a holy food unintentionally, then he shall add to it a fifth of it and shall give the holy food to the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall not profane the holy gifts of the sons of Israel, which they offer to the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: and thereby bring upon them ①punishment for guilt by eating their holy gifts; for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’ ” ▷ ①Or wrongdoing requiring a guilt offering

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, and to all the sons of Israel, and say to them, ‘Anyone of the house of Israel or of the strangers in Israel who presents his offering, whether it is any of their ①vows or any of their ②voluntary offerings, which they present to the LORD as a burnt offering— ▷ ①Or vowed offerings ②Or freewill offerings

column.name: text
column.value: for you to be accepted—it must be a male without defect ①from the cattle, the sheep, or the goats. ▷ ①Lit among

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever has a defect, you shall not offer, for it will not be accepted for you.

column.name: text
column.value: When someone offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD to fulfill a special vow or for a ①voluntary offering, ②of the herd or ③of the flock, it must be without defect to be accepted; there shall be no defect in it. ▷ ①Or freewill offering ②Lit among ③Lit among

column.name: text
column.value: Those that are blind, fractured, maimed, or have a wart, a festering rash, or scabs, you shall not offer to the LORD, nor make of them an offering by fire on the altar to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Now as for an ox or a lamb which has an ①overgrown or stunted member, you may present it as a ②voluntary offering, but for a vow it will not be accepted. ▷ ①Or a deformed ②Or freewill offering

column.name: text
column.value: Also anything with its testicles squashed, crushed, torn off, or cut off, you shall not offer to the LORD, nor ①sacrifice in your land, ▷ ①Lit do

column.name: text
column.value: nor shall you offer any of these animals taken from the hand of a ①foreigner as the ②food of your God; for their deformity is in them, they have an impairment. They will not be accepted for you.’ ” ▷ ①Lit son of a stranger ②Lit bread

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “When an ox or a sheep or a goat is born, it shall ①remain seven days ②with its mother, and from the eighth day on it will be considered acceptable as a sacrifice of an offering by fire to the LORD. ▷ ①Lit be ②Lit under

column.name: text
column.value: But, whether it is an ox or a sheep, you shall not slaughter both it and its young in one day.

column.name: text
column.value: When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the LORD, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.

column.name: text
column.value: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until morning. I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So you shall keep My commandments, and do them; I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “And you shall not profane My holy name, but I will be sanctified among the sons of Israel; I am the LORD who sanctifies you,

column.name: text
column.value: who brought you out from the land of Egypt, to be your God; I am the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Command the sons of Israel that they bring to you clear oil from beaten olives for the ①light, to make a lamp ②burn continually. ▷ ①Or luminary ②Lit ascend

column.name: text
column.value: Outside the veil of the testimony in the tent of meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD continually; it shall be a permanent statute throughout your generations.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall keep the lamps in order on the pure gold lampstand before the LORD continually.

column.name: text
column.value: “Then you shall take fine flour and bake twelve ①cakes with it; ②two-tenths of an ephah shall be in each cake. ▷ ①I.e., ring-shaped bread loaves ②About 0.13 cubic feet or 0.004 cubic meters

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall set them in two rows, six to a row, on the pure gold table before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall put pure frankincense on each row so that it may be a memorial portion for the bread, an offering by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before the LORD continually; it is an everlasting covenant ①for the sons of Israel. ▷ ①Lit from

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be for Aaron and his sons, and they shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him from the LORD’S offerings by fire, his portion forever.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now the son of an Israelite woman—his father was an Egyptian—went out among the sons of Israel; and the Israelite woman’s son and an Israelite man had a fight within the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And the son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name and cursed. So they brought him to Moses. (Now his mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.)

column.name: text
column.value: Then they put him in custody, waiting for Moses to give them a clear decision in accordance with the command of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Bring the one who has cursed outside the camp, and have all who heard him lay their hands on his head; then have all the congregation stone him.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘If anyone curses his God, then he will bear the responsibility for his sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the one who blasphemes the name of the LORD must be put to death; all the congregation shall certainly stone him. The stranger as well as the native, when he blasphemes the Name, shall be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now if someone ①takes any human life, he must be put to death. ▷ ①Lit strikes

column.name: text
column.value: But the one who ①takes the life of an animal shall make restitution, life for life. ▷ ①Lit strikes

column.name: text
column.value: If someone injures his neighbor, just as he has done, so shall it be done to him:

column.name: text
column.value: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; just as he has injured a person, so shall it be ①inflicted on him. ▷ ①Lit given

column.name: text
column.value: So the one who ①kills an animal shall make restitution, but the one who ②kills a person shall be put to death. ▷ ①Lit strikes down ②Lit strikes down

column.name: text
column.value: There shall be only one ①standard for you; it shall be for the stranger as well as the native, for I am the LORD your God.’ ” ▷ ①Lit judgment

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, and they brought the one who had cursed outside the camp, and stoned him with stones. So the sons of Israel did just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD spoke again to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘The LORD’S appointed times which you shall proclaim as holy convocations—My appointed times are these:

column.name: text
column.value: ‘For six days work may be done, but on the seventh day there is a Sabbath of complete rest, a holy convocation. You shall not do any work; it is a Sabbath to the LORD in all your dwellings.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘These are the appointed times of the LORD, holy convocations which you shall proclaim at the times appointed for them.

column.name: text
column.value: In the ①first month, on the fourteenth day of the month ②at twilight is the LORD’S Passover. ▷ ①I.e., Nisan = March/April ②Lit between the two evenings

column.name: text
column.value: Then on the fifteenth day of the same month there is the Feast of Unleavened Bread to the LORD; for seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.

column.name: text
column.value: On the first day you shall have a holy convocation; you shall not do any laborious work.

column.name: text
column.value: But for seven days you shall present an offering by fire to the LORD. On the seventh day is a holy convocation; you shall not do any laborious work.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When you enter the land which I am going to give to you and you gather its harvest, then you shall bring in the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall wave the sheaf before the LORD for you to be accepted; on the day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.

column.name: text
column.value: Now on the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb one year old without defect as a burnt offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Its grain offering shall then be ①two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering by fire to the LORD for a soothing aroma, with its drink offering, a ②fourth of a hin of wine. ▷ ①About 0.13 cubic feet or 0.004 cubic meters ②About 0.25 gallon or 1 liter

column.name: text
column.value: Until this very day, until you have brought in the offering of your God, you shall eat neither bread nor roasted grain nor new produce. It is to be a permanent statute throughout your generations in all your dwelling places.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You shall also count for yourselves from the day after the Sabbath, from the day when you brought in the sheaf of the wave offering; there shall be seven complete Sabbaths.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall count fifty days to the day after the seventh Sabbath; then you shall present a new grain offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall bring in from your dwelling places two loaves of bread as a wave offering, made of ①two-tenths of an ephah; they shall be of a fine flour, baked with leaven as first fruits to the LORD. ▷ ①About 0.13 cubic feet or 0.004 cubic meters

column.name: text
column.value: Along with the bread you shall present seven one-year-old male lambs without defect, and a bull of the herd and two rams; they are to be a burnt offering to the LORD, with their grain offering and their drink offerings, an offering by fire of a soothing aroma to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also offer one male goat as a ①sin offering, and two male lambs one year old as a sacrifice of peace offerings. ▷ ①Or purification offering

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall then wave them with the bread of the first fruits as a wave offering with two lambs before the LORD; they are to be holy to the LORD for the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: On this very day you shall make a proclamation as well; you are to have a holy convocation. You shall do no laborious work. It is to be a permanent statute in all your dwelling places throughout your generations.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘When you reap the harvest of your land, moreover, you shall not reap to the very edges of your field nor gather the gleaning of your harvest; you are to leave them for the needy and the stranger. I am the LORD your God.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘In the ①seventh month on the first of the month you shall have a ②rest, a reminder by blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation. ▷ ①I.e., Tishri = September/October ②Lit Sabbath rest

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not do any laborious work, but you shall present an offering by fire to the LORD.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “On exactly the tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement; it shall be a holy convocation for you, and you shall humble ①yourselves and present an offering by fire to the LORD. ▷ ①Lit your souls

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not do any work on this very day, for it is a Day of Atonement, to make atonement on your behalf before the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: If there is any ①person who does not humble himself on this very day, he shall be cut off from his people. ▷ ①Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: As for any person who does any work on this very day, that person I will eliminate from among his people.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not do any work. It is to be a permanent statute throughout your generations in all your dwelling places.

column.name: text
column.value: It is to be a Sabbath of complete rest for you, and you shall humble ①yourselves; on the ninth of the month at evening, from evening until evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.” ▷ ①Lit your souls

column.name: text
column.value: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘On the fifteenth of this ①seventh month is the Feast of Booths for seven days to the LORD. ▷ ①I.e., Tishri = September/October

column.name: text
column.value: On the first day is a holy convocation; you shall not do any laborious work.

column.name: text
column.value: For seven days you shall present an offering by fire to the LORD. On the eighth day you shall have a holy convocation and present an offering by fire to the LORD; it is an assembly. You shall not do any laborious work.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘These are the appointed times of the LORD which you shall proclaim as holy convocations, to present offerings by fire to the LORD—burnt offerings and grain offerings, sacrifices and drink offerings, each day’s matter on its own day—

column.name: text
column.value: besides those of the Sabbaths of the LORD, and besides your gifts and besides all your ①vowed and ②voluntary offerings, which you give to the LORD. ▷ ①Lit vows, and besides all your ②Or freewill offerings

column.name: text
column.value: ‘On exactly the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the crops of the land, you shall celebrate the feast of the LORD for seven days, with a ①rest on the first day and a ②rest on the eighth day. ▷ ①Lit Sabbath rest ②Lit Sabbath rest

column.name: text
column.value: Now on the first day you shall take for yourselves the ①foliage of beautiful trees, palm branches and branches of trees with thick branches and willows of the brook, and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God for seven days. ▷ ①Lit products; or fruit

column.name: text
column.value: So you shall celebrate it as a feast to the LORD for seven days in the year. It shall be a permanent statute throughout your generations; you shall celebrate it in the seventh month.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall live in booths for seven days; all the native-born in Israel shall live in booths,

column.name: text
column.value: so that your generations may know that I had the sons of Israel live in booths when I brought them out from the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses declared to the sons of Israel the appointed times of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD then spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When you come into the land which I am going to give you, then the land shall have a Sabbath to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For six years you shall sow your field, and for six years you shall prune your vineyard and gather in its produce,

column.name: text
column.value: but during the seventh year the land shall have a Sabbath rest, a Sabbath to the LORD; you shall not sow your field nor prune your vineyard.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not reap your harvest’s ①aftergrowth, and you shall not gather your grapes of untrimmed vines; the land shall have a sabbatical year. ▷ ①Lit growth from spilled kernels

column.name: text
column.value: All of you shall have the Sabbath produce of the land as food; for yourself, your male and female slaves, and your hired worker and your foreign resident, those who live as strangers among you.

column.name: text
column.value: Even your cattle and the animals that are in your land shall have all its produce to eat.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You are also to count off seven Sabbaths of years for yourself, seven times seven years, so that you have the time of the seven Sabbaths of years, that is, forty-nine years.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall then sound a ram’s horn ①abroad on the tenth day of the seventh month; on the Day of Atonement you shall sound a horn all through your land. ▷ ①Lit signal

column.name: text
column.value: So you shall consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim ①a release throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee for you, ②and each of you shall return to his own property, ③and each of you shall return to his family. ▷ ①Or freedom ②Or when ③Or when

column.name: text
column.value: You shall have the fiftieth year as a jubilee; you shall not sow, nor harvest its aftergrowth, nor gather grapes from its untrimmed vines.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat its produce from the field.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘On this year of jubilee each of you shall return to his own property.

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore, if you make a sale to your friend, or buy from your friend’s hand, you shall not ①wrong one another. ▷ ①Lit oppress

column.name: text
column.value: Corresponding to the number of years after the jubilee, you shall buy from your ①friend; he is to sell to you according to the number of years of crops. ▷ ①Lit friend’s hands

column.name: text
column.value: In proportion to ①a greater number of years you shall increase its price, and in proportion to ②fewer years you shall decrease its price, because it is the number of crops that he is selling to you. ▷ ①Lit the multitude of ②Lit the years being few

column.name: text
column.value: So you shall not ①wrong one another, but you shall ②fear your God; for I am the LORD your God. ▷ ①Lit oppress ②Or revere

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You shall therefore ①follow My statutes and keep My judgments so as to carry them out, so that you may live securely on the land. ▷ ①Lit do My

column.name: text
column.value: Then the land will yield its produce, so that you can eat your fill and live securely on it.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you say, “What are we going to eat in the seventh year if we do not sow nor gather in our produce?”

column.name: text
column.value: then I will so order My blessing for you in the sixth year that it will bring forth the produce for three years.

column.name: text
column.value: When you are sowing the eighth year, you can still eat old things from the produce, eating the old until the ninth year when its produce comes in.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘The land, moreover, shall not be sold permanently, because the land is Mine; for you are only strangers and residents with Me.

column.name: text
column.value: So for every ①piece of your property, you are to provide for the redemption of the land. ▷ ①Lit land

column.name: text
column.value: ‘If a fellow countryman of yours becomes so poor that he sells part of his property, then his closest ①redeemer is to come and buy back what his relative has sold. ▷ ①I.e., male relative to act in his behalf

column.name: text
column.value: Or in case someone has no redeemer, but ①recovers to find sufficient means for its redemption, ▷ ①Lit his hand reaches

column.name: text
column.value: then he shall calculate the years since its sale and refund the balance to the man to whom he sold it, and so return to his property.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ①he has not found sufficient means to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hands of its purchaser until the year of jubilee; but at the jubilee it shall ②revert, so that he may return to his property. ▷ ①Lit his hand has not found sufficient to ②Lit go out

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Likewise, if a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then his redemption right remains valid until a full year after its sale; his right of redemption lasts a full year.

column.name: text
column.value: But if it is not bought back for him within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city passes permanently to its purchaser throughout his generations; it does not ①revert in the jubilee. ▷ ①Lit go out

column.name: text
column.value: The houses of the villages, however, which have no surrounding wall, shall be regarded ①as open fields; they have redemption rights and ②revert in the jubilee. ▷ ①Lit according to ②Lit go out

column.name: text
column.value: As for the cities of the Levites, the Levites have a permanent right of redemption for the houses of the cities which are their possession.

column.name: text
column.value: What, therefore, ①belongs to the Levites may be redeemed, and a house sale ②in the city of this possession ③reverts in the jubilee, because the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the sons of Israel. ▷ ①Lit is from ②Lit and ③Lit goes out

column.name: text
column.value: But pasture fields of their cities shall not be sold, for that is their permanent possession.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now in case a countryman of yours becomes poor and his ①means among you falter, then you are to sustain him, like a stranger or a resident, so that he may live with you. ▷ ①Lit hand

column.name: text
column.value: Do not take ①any kind of interest from him, but ②fear your God, so that your countryman may live with you. ▷ ①Prob. interest on money and food loans ②Or revere

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not give him your silver at interest, nor your food ①for profit. ▷ ①Lit at interest

column.name: text
column.value: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now if a countryman of yours becomes so poor with regard to you that he sells himself to you, you shall not subject him to a slave’s service.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall be with you as a hired worker, as if he were a foreign resident; he shall serve with you up to the year of jubilee.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall then leave you, he and his sons with him, and shall go back to his family, so that he may return to the property of his forefathers.

column.name: text
column.value: For they are My servants whom I brought out from the land of Egypt; they are not to be sold in a slave sale.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not rule over him with ①severity, but are to revere your God. ▷ ①Or violence

column.name: text
column.value: As for your male and female slaves whom you may have—you may acquire male and female slaves from the pagan nations that are around you.

column.name: text
column.value: You may also acquire them from the sons of the foreign residents who reside among you, and from their families who are with you, whom they will have produced in your land; they also may become your possession.

column.name: text
column.value: You may also pass them on as an inheritance to your sons after you, to receive as a possession; you can use them as permanent slaves. But in respect to your countrymen, the sons of Israel, you shall not rule with ①severity over one another. ▷ ①Or violence

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now if the ①means of a stranger or of a foreign resident with you becomes sufficient, and a countryman of yours becomes poor in relation to him and sells himself to a stranger who is residing with you, or to the descendants of a stranger’s family, ▷ ①Lit hand...reaches

column.name: text
column.value: then he shall have redemption right after he has been sold. One of his brothers may redeem him,

column.name: text
column.value: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son may redeem him, or one of his blood relatives from his family may redeem him; or ①if he prospers, he may redeem himself. ▷ ①Lit his hand has reached and he

column.name: text
column.value: He then, with his purchaser, shall calculate from the year when he sold himself to him up to the year of jubilee; and the price of his sale shall correspond to the number of years calculated. It is like the days of a hired worker that he will be with him.

column.name: text
column.value: If there are still many years remaining, he shall refund part of his purchase price in proportion to them for his own redemption;

column.name: text
column.value: but if few years remain until the year of jubilee, he shall so calculate with him. In proportion to his years he is to refund the amount for his redemption.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall be with him like a worker hired year by year; he shall not rule over him with ①severity in your sight. ▷ ①Or violence

column.name: text
column.value: Even if he is not redeemed by ①these means, he shall still leave in the year of jubilee, he and his sons with him. ▷ ①Or these years

column.name: text
column.value: For the sons of Israel are My servants; they are My servants whom I brought out from the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Again, the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When someone makes an explicit vow, he shall be valued according to your assessment of persons belonging to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: If your assessment is of a male from twenty years even to sixty years old, then your assessment shall be fifty shekels of silver, by the shekel of the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: Or if ①the person is a female, then your assessment shall be thirty shekels. ▷ ①Lit she

column.name: text
column.value: And if the person is from five years even to twenty years old, then your assessment for a male shall be twenty shekels, and for a female, ten shekels.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the person is from a month even up to five years old, then your assessment shall be five shekels of silver for a male, and for a female your assessment shall be three shekels of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: If the person is from sixty years old and upward, if a male, then your assessment shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female, ten shekels.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he is poorer than your assessment, then he shall be presented before the priest, and the priest shall assess him; according to ①the means of the one who vowed, the priest shall assess him. ▷ ①Lit what the hand reaches

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now if it is an animal of the kind that ①one can present as an offering to the LORD, any such animal that one gives to the LORD shall be holy. ▷ ①Lit they

column.name: text
column.value: He shall not replace it nor exchange it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good; yet if he does exchange animal for animal, then both it and its substitute shall become holy.

column.name: text
column.value: If, however, it is any unclean animal of the kind which ①one does not present as an offering to the LORD, then he shall place the animal before the priest. ▷ ①Lit they

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall assess it ①as either good or bad; as you, the priest, assess it, so shall it be. ▷ ①Lit between

column.name: text
column.value: But if he should ever want to redeem it, then he shall add a fifth of it to your assessment.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now if someone consecrates his house as holy to the LORD, then the priest shall assess it ①as either good or bad; as the priest assesses it, so shall it stand. ▷ ①Lit between good

column.name: text
column.value: Yet if the one who consecrates it should want to redeem his house, then he shall add a fifth of your assessment price to it, so that it may be his.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Again, if someone consecrates to the LORD part of the field of his own property, then your assessment shall be ①proportionate to the seed needed for it: a ②homer of barley seed at fifty shekels of silver. ▷ ①Lit according to its seed ②About 7.7 cubic feet or 0.22 cubic meters

column.name: text
column.value: If he consecrates his field as of the year of jubilee, according to your assessment it shall stand.

column.name: text
column.value: If he consecrates his field after the jubilee, however, then the priest shall calculate the price for ①him ②proportionate to the years that are left until the year of jubilee; and it shall be deducted from your assessment. ▷ ①Or it ②Lit according to the years

column.name: text
column.value: If the one who consecrates it should ever want to redeem the field, then he shall add a fifth of your assessment price to it, so that it may belong to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet if he does not redeem the field, ①but has sold the field to another person, it may no longer be redeemed; ▷ ①Or if he

column.name: text
column.value: and when it ①reverts in the jubilee, the field shall be holy to the LORD, like a field banned from secular use; it shall be for the priest as his property. ▷ ①Lit goes out

column.name: text
column.value: Or if he consecrates to the LORD a field which he has bought, which is not a part of the field of his own property,

column.name: text
column.value: then the priest shall calculate for ①him the amount of your assessment up to the year of jubilee; and he shall on that day give your assessment as holy to the LORD. ▷ ①Or it

column.name: text
column.value: In the year of jubilee the field shall return to the one from whom he bought it, to whom the possession of the land belongs.

column.name: text
column.value: Every assessment of yours, moreover, shall be by the shekel of the sanctuary. The shekel shall be twenty gerahs.

column.name: text
