column.value: ‘However, a firstborn among animals, which as a firstborn belongs to the LORD, no one may consecrate; whether ox or sheep, it is the LORD’S.

column.name: text
column.value: But if it is among the unclean animals, then he shall ①redeem it according to your assessment and add to it a fifth of it; and if it is not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your assessment. ▷ ①Or ransom

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Nevertheless, ①anything which someone sets apart to the LORD for ②destruction out of all that he has, of man or animal or of the field of his own property, shall not be sold nor redeemed. Anything set apart for destruction is most holy to the LORD. ▷ ①Lit anything banned ②I.e., as an offering

column.name: text
column.value: No ①one who may have been ②set apart among mankind shall be ransomed; he must be put to death. ▷ ①Lit one devoted; or banned ②Lit put under the ban

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now all the tithe of the land, of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD’S; it is holy to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: If, therefore, someone should ever want to redeem part of his tithe, he shall add to it a fifth of it.

column.name: text
column.value: For every tenth part of herd or flock, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth one shall be holy to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: He is not to be concerned whether it is good or bad, nor shall he exchange it; yet if he does exchange it, then both it and its substitute shall become holy. It shall not be redeemed.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: These are the commandments which the LORD commanded Moses for the sons of Israel on Mount Sinai.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You shall not make for yourselves idols, nor shall you set up for yourselves a carved image or a memorial stone, nor shall you place a figured stone in your land to bow down ①to it; for I am the LORD your God. ▷ ①Lit over

column.name: text
column.value: You shall keep My Sabbaths and revere My sanctuary; I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: If you walk in My statutes and keep My commandments so as to carry them out,

column.name: text
column.value: then I shall give you rains in their season, so that the land will yield its produce and the trees of the field will bear their fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, your threshing season will last for you until grape gathering, and grape gathering will last until sowing time. So you will eat your ①food to the full and live securely in your land. ▷ ①Lit bread

column.name: text
column.value: I shall also grant peace in the land, so that you may lie down, with no one to make you afraid. I shall also eliminate harmful animals from the land, and no sword will pass through your land.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, you will chase your enemies, and they will fall before you by the sword;

column.name: text
column.value: five of you will chase a hundred, and a hundred of you will chase ten thousand; and your enemies will fall before you by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will turn toward you and make you fruitful and multiply you, and I will confirm My covenant with you.

column.name: text
column.value: And you will eat the old supply, and clear out the old because of the new.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, I will make My ①dwelling among you, and My soul will not ②reject you. ▷ ①Or tabernacle ②Lit abhor

column.name: text
column.value: I will also walk among you and be your God, and you shall be My people.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt so that you would not be their slaves, and I broke your yoke and made you walk erect.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘But if you do not obey Me and do not carry out all these commandments,

column.name: text
column.value: if, instead, you reject My statutes, and if your soul loathes My ordinances so as not to carry out all My commandments, but rather to break My covenant,

column.name: text
column.value: I, in turn, will do this to you: I will ①summon a sudden terror against you, consumption and fever that will make the eyes fail and the soul languish; also, you will sow your seed uselessly, for your enemies will eat it. ▷ ①Or impose...on you

column.name: text
column.value: And I will set My face against you so that you will be defeated before your enemies; and those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee when no one is pursuing you.

column.name: text
column.value: If also after these things you do not obey Me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also break down your pride of power; and I will make your sky like iron and your earth like bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: Your strength will be consumed uselessly, for your land will not yield its produce and the trees of the land will not yield their fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Yet if you ①show hostility toward Me and are unwilling to obey Me, I will increase the plague on you seven times according to your sins. ▷ ①Lit walk with Me hostilely, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: I will also let loose among you the animals of the field, which will deprive you of your children and eliminate your cattle, and reduce your number so that your roads become deserted.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘And if by these things you do not learn your lesson regarding Me, but you show hostility toward Me,

column.name: text
column.value: then I in turn will show hostility toward you; and I, even I, will strike you seven times for your sins.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also bring upon you a sword which will execute vengeance for the covenant; and when you gather together into your cities, I will send a plague among you, so that you will be handed over to the enemy.

column.name: text
column.value: When I break your staff of bread, ten women will bake your bread in one oven, and they will bring back your bread ①in rationed amounts, so that you will eat and not be satisfied. ▷ ①Lit by weight

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Yet if in spite of this you do not obey Me, but act with hostility against Me,

column.name: text
column.value: then I will act with wrathful hostility against you, and I for My part will punish you seven times for your sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Further, you will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: I then will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and ①pile your ②remains on the ③remains of your idols, for My soul will loathe you. ▷ ①Lit give ②Lit corpses ③Lit corpses

column.name: text
column.value: I will turn your cities into ruins as well and make your sanctuaries desolate, and I will not smell your soothing aromas.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make the land desolate so that your enemies who settle in it will be appalled at it.

column.name: text
column.value: You, however, I will scatter among the nations, and I will draw out a sword after you, as your land becomes desolate and your cities become ruins.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Then the land will restore its Sabbaths all the days of the desolation, while you are in your enemies’ land; then the land will rest and restore its Sabbaths.

column.name: text
column.value: All the days of its desolation it will have the rest which it did not have on your Sabbaths, while you were living on it.

column.name: text
column.value: As for those among you who are left, I will also bring despair into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. And the sound of a scattered leaf will chase them, and even when no one is pursuing they will flee ①as though from the sword, and they will fall. ▷ ①Lit the flight of the sword

column.name: text
column.value: They will then stumble over each other as if running from the sword, although no one is pursuing; and you will have no strength to stand before your enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, you will perish among the nations, and your enemies’ land will consume you.

column.name: text
column.value: So those of you who may be left will rot away because of their wrongdoing in the lands of your enemies; and also because of the wrongdoing of their forefathers they will rot away with them.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘But if they confess their wrongdoing and the wrongdoing of their forefathers, in their unfaithfulness which they committed against Me, and also in their acting with hostility against Me—

column.name: text
column.value: I also was acting with hostility against them, to bring them into the land of their enemies—or if their uncircumcised heart is humbled so that they then make amends for their wrongdoing,

column.name: text
column.value: then I will remember My covenant with Jacob, and I will remember also My covenant with Isaac, and My covenant with Abraham as well, and I will remember the land.

column.name: text
column.value: For the land will be abandoned by them, and will restore its Sabbaths while it is made desolate without them. They, meanwhile, will be making amends for their wrongdoing, ①because they rejected My ordinances and their soul loathed My statutes. ▷ ①Lit because and by the cause

column.name: text
column.value: Yet in spite of this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, nor will I so loathe them as to destroy them, breaking My covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will remember for them the covenant with their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, so that I might be their God. I am the LORD.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: These are the statutes and ordinances and laws which the LORD established between Himself and the sons of Israel ①through Moses on Mount Sinai. ▷ ①Lit by the hand of

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tent of meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Take a ①census of all the congregation of the sons of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ households, according to the number of names, every male, head by head ▷ ①Lit sum

column.name: text
column.value: from twenty years old and upward, whoever is able to go to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall ①count them by their armies. ▷ ①Lit muster, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: With you, moreover, there shall be a man of each tribe, each one head of his father’s household.

column.name: text
column.value: These then are the names of the men who shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben, Elizur the son of Shedeur;

column.name: text
column.value: of the tribe of Simeon, Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai;

column.name: text
column.value: of the tribe of Judah, Nahshon the son of Amminadab;

column.name: text
column.value: of Issachar, Nethanel the son of Zuar;

column.name: text
column.value: of Zebulun, Eliab the son of Helon;

column.name: text
column.value: of the sons of Joseph: of Ephraim, Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh, Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur;

column.name: text
column.value: of Benjamin, Abidan the son of Gideoni;

column.name: text
column.value: of Dan, Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai;

column.name: text
column.value: of Asher, Pagiel the son of Ochran;

column.name: text
column.value: of Gad, Eliasaph the son of Deuel;

column.name: text
column.value: of Naphtali, Ahira the son of Enan.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the men who were called from the congregation, the leaders of their fathers’ tribes; they were the heads of ①divisions of Israel.” ▷ ①Lit thousands; or clans

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses and Aaron took these men who had been designated by name,

column.name: text
column.value: and they assembled all the congregation on the first day of the second month. Then they registered by ancestry in their families, by their fathers’ households, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, head by head,

column.name: text
column.value: just as the LORD had commanded Moses. So he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their descendants by their families, by their fathers’ households, according to the number of names, head by head, every male from twenty years old and upward, whoever was able to go to war,

column.name: text
column.value: their numbered men of the tribe of Reuben were 46,500.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Simeon, their descendants by their families, by their fathers’ households, their numbered men, according to the number of names, head by head, every male from twenty years old and upward, whoever was able to go to war,

column.name: text
column.value: their numbered men of the tribe of Simeon were 59,300.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Gad, their descendants by their families, by their fathers’ households, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, whoever was able to go to war,

column.name: text
column.value: their numbered men of the tribe of Gad were 45,650.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Judah, their descendants by their families, by their fathers’ households, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, whoever was able to go to war,

column.name: text
column.value: their numbered men of the tribe of Judah were 74,600.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Issachar, their descendants by their families, by their fathers’ households, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, whoever was able to go to war,

column.name: text
column.value: their numbered men of the tribe of Issachar were 54,400.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Zebulun, their descendants by their families, by their fathers’ households, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, whoever was able to go to war,

column.name: text
column.value: their numbered men of the tribe of Zebulun were 57,400.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Joseph, namely, of the sons of Ephraim, their descendants by their families, by their fathers’ households, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, whoever was able to go to war,

column.name: text
column.value: their numbered men of the tribe of Ephraim were 40,500.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Manasseh, their descendants by their families, by their fathers’ households, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, whoever was able to go to war,

column.name: text
column.value: their numbered men of the tribe of Manasseh were 32,200.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Benjamin, their descendants by their families, by their fathers’ households, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, whoever was able to go to war,

column.name: text
column.value: their numbered men of the tribe of Benjamin were 35,400.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Dan, their descendants by their families, by their fathers’ households, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, whoever was able to go to war,

column.name: text
column.value: their numbered men of the tribe of Dan were 62,700.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Asher, their descendants by their families, by their fathers’ households, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, whoever was able to go to war,

column.name: text
column.value: their numbered men of the tribe of Asher were 41,500.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Naphtali, their descendants by their families, by their fathers’ households, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, whoever was able to go to war,

column.name: text
column.value: their numbered men of the tribe of Naphtali were 53,400.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the ones who were numbered, whom Moses and Aaron counted, with the leaders of Israel, twelve men, each of whom was of his father’s household.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the numbered men of the sons of Israel by their fathers’ households, from twenty years old and upward, whoever was able to go to war in Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: all the numbered men were 603,550.

column.name: text
column.value: The Levites, however, were not counted among them by their fathers’ tribe.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD had spoken to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, nor shall you take their ①census among the sons of Israel. ▷ ①Lit sum

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall appoint the Levites over the ①tabernacle of the testimony, and over all its furnishings and over everything that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings, and they shall take care of it; they shall also camp around the ②tabernacle. ▷ ①Lit dwelling place, and so throughout the ch ②Lit dwelling place, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: So when the tabernacle is to move on, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle encamps, the Levites shall set it up. But the ①layman who comes near it shall be put to death. ▷ ①Lit stranger

column.name: text
column.value: So the sons of Israel shall camp, each man by his own camp, and each man by his own ①flag, according to their armies. ▷ ①Or division

column.name: text
column.value: But the Levites shall camp around the tabernacle of the testimony, so that there will be no divine wrath against the congregation of the sons of Israel. So the Levites shall be responsible for service to the tabernacle of the testimony.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Israel did so; in accordance with all that the LORD had commanded Moses, so they did.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “The sons of Israel shall camp, each by his own ①flag, with the banners of their fathers’ households; they shall camp around the tent of meeting ②at a distance. ▷ ①Or facing it ②Or division, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: Now those who camp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the flag of the camp of Judah, by their armies; and the leader of the sons of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab,

column.name: text
column.value: and his army, their ①numbered men: 74,600. ▷ ①Lit mustered, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: Those who camp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar; and the leader of the sons of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar,

column.name: text
column.value: and his army, their numbered men: 54,400.

column.name: text
column.value: Then follows the tribe of Zebulun; and the leader of the sons of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon,

column.name: text
column.value: and his army, his numbered men: 57,400.

column.name: text
column.value: The total of the numbered men of the camp of Judah: 186,400, by their armies. They shall set out first.

column.name: text
column.value: “On the south side shall be the flag of the camp of Reuben by their armies; and the leader of the sons of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur,

column.name: text
column.value: and his army, their numbered men: 46,500.

column.name: text
column.value: And those who camp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon; and the leader of the sons of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai,

column.name: text
column.value: and his army, their numbered men: 59,300.

column.name: text
column.value: Then follows the tribe of Gad; and the leader of the sons of Gad: Eliasaph the son of ①Deuel, ▷ ①Many mss (cf. 1:14); some ancient versions Reuel

column.name: text
column.value: and his army, their numbered men: 45,650.

column.name: text
column.value: The total of the numbered men of the camp of Reuben: 151,450 by their armies. And they shall set out second.

column.name: text
column.value: “Then the tent of meeting shall set out with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camps; just as they camp, so they shall set out, every man in his place by their flags.

column.name: text
column.value: “On the west side shall be the flag of the camp of Ephraim by their armies; and the leader of the sons of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud,

column.name: text
column.value: and his army, their numbered men: 40,500.

column.name: text
column.value: Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh; and the leader of the sons of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur,

column.name: text
column.value: and his army, their numbered men, 32,200.

column.name: text
column.value: Then follows the tribe of Benjamin; and the leader of the sons of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni,

column.name: text
column.value: and his army, their numbered men, 35,400.

column.name: text
column.value: The total of the numbered men of the camp of Ephraim: 108,100, by their armies. And they shall set out third.

column.name: text
column.value: “On the north side shall be the flag of the camp of Dan by their armies; and the leader of the sons of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai,

column.name: text
column.value: and his army, their numbered men: 62,700.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who camp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher; and the leader of the sons of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran,

column.name: text
column.value: and his army, their numbered men: 41,500.

column.name: text
column.value: Then follows the tribe of Naphtali; and the leader of the sons of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan,

column.name: text
column.value: and his army, their numbered men: 53,400.

column.name: text
column.value: The total of the numbered men of the camp of Dan was 157,600. They shall set out last by their flags.”

column.name: text
column.value: These are the numbered men of the sons of Israel by their fathers’ households; the total of the numbered men of the camps by their armies, 603,550.

column.name: text
column.value: The Levites, however, were not counted among the sons of Israel, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: So the sons of Israel did all this; according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they camped by their flags, and so they set out, everyone by his family according to his father’s household.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these are the records of the generations of Aaron and Moses at the time when the LORD spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.

column.name: text
column.value: These then are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the anointed priests, whom he ①ordained to serve as priests. ▷ ①Lit filled their hand

column.name: text
column.value: But Nadab and Abihu died in the presence of the LORD when they offered ①strange fire before the LORD in the wilderness of Sinai; and they had no children. So Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests ②in the lifetime of their father Aaron. ▷ ①I.e., prohibited ②Lit before the face

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Bring the tribe of Levi forward and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may serve him.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall perform the duties for ①him and for the whole congregation in front of the tent of meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle. ▷ ①Lit him and the duties of the whole congregation

column.name: text
column.value: They shall also take care of all the furnishings of the tent of meeting, along with the duties of the sons of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: So you shall assign the Levites to Aaron and to his sons; they are exclusively assigned to him from the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: So you shall appoint Aaron and his sons that they may ①keep their priesthood, but the ②layman who comes near shall be put to death.” ▷ ①Or perform ②Lit stranger

column.name: text
column.value: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Now, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the sons of Israel instead of every firstborn, the firstborn of the womb among the sons of Israel. So the Levites shall be Mine.

column.name: text
column.value: For all the firstborn are Mine; on the day that I fatally struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified to Myself all the firstborn in Israel, from the human firstborn to animals. They shall be Mine; I am the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①Count the sons of Levi by their fathers’ households, by their families; every male from a month old and upward you shall count.” ▷ ①Lit muster, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses counted them according to the ①word of the LORD, just as he had been commanded. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: These, then, are the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

column.name: text
column.value: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei;

column.name: text
column.value: and the sons of Kohath by their families: Amram and Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel;

column.name: text
column.value: and the sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites and the family of the Shimeites; these were the families of the Gershonites.

column.name: text
column.value: Their numbered men, in the counting of every male from a month old and upward, their numbered men were 7,500.

column.name: text
column.value: The families of the Gershonites were to camp behind the ①tabernacle westward, ▷ ①Lit dwelling place, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: and the leader of the fathers’ households of the Gershonites: Eliasaph the son of Lael.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the duties of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting included the tabernacle and the tent, its covering, and the curtain for the entrance of the tent of meeting,

column.name: text
column.value: and the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain for the entrance of the courtyard which is around the tabernacle and the altar, and its ropes, according to all the service ①concerning them. ▷ ①Lit of it

column.name: text
column.value: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites; these were the families of the Kohathites.

column.name: text
column.value: In the counting of every male from a month old and upward, there were 8,600, performing the duties of the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: The families of the sons of Kohath were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle,

column.name: text
column.value: and the leader of the fathers’ households of the Kohathite families: ①Elizaphan the son of Uzziel. ▷ ①In Ex 6:22, Elzaphan

column.name: text
column.value: Now their duties included the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the utensils of the sanctuary with which they minister, the ①curtain, and all the service ②concerning them; ▷ ①I.e., the veil between the Holy Place and Most Holy Place ②Lit of it

column.name: text
column.value: and Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest was the head of the leaders of Levi, and he had the supervision of those who performed the duties of the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites; these were the families of Merari.

column.name: text
column.value: Their numbered men in the counting of every male from a month old and upward: 6,200.

column.name: text
column.value: And the leader of the fathers’ households of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They were to camp on the northward side of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the appointment of duties of the sons of Merari included the framework of the tabernacle, its bars, its pillars, its bases, all its equipment, and all the service concerning them,

column.name: text
column.value: and the pillars around the courtyard with their bases, their pegs, and their ropes.

column.name: text
column.value: Now those who were to camp in front of the tabernacle eastward, in front of the tent of meeting toward the sunrise, were Moses and Aaron and his sons, performing the duties of the sanctuary for the obligation of the sons of Israel; but the ①layman coming near was to be put to death. ▷ ①Lit stranger

column.name: text
column.value: All the numbered men of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the ①command of the LORD by their families, every male from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Count every firstborn male of the sons of Israel from a month old and upward, and ①make a list of their names. ▷ ①Lit take up the number

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall take the Levites for Me—I am the LORD—instead of all the firstborn among the sons of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the cattle of the sons of Israel.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses counted all the firstborn among the sons of Israel, just as the LORD had commanded him;

column.name: text
column.value: and all the firstborn males, by the number of names from a month old and upward for their numbered men, were 22,273.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the sons of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites in place of their cattle. And the Levites shall be Mine; I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And as ①a redemption price for the 273 of the firstborn of the sons of Israel who are in excess of the number of the Levites, ▷ ①Or ransom

column.name: text
column.value: you shall take five shekels apiece, per head; you shall take them in terms of the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty ①gerahs), ▷ ①A gerah is about 0.025 oz. or 0.7 gm

column.name: text
column.value: and you shall give the money, the redemption price of those who are in excess among them, to Aaron and to his sons.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses took the redemption money from those who were in excess of the number of those redeemed by the Levites;

column.name: text
column.value: from the firstborn of the sons of Israel he took the money in terms of the shekel of the sanctuary, 1,365.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, at the ①command of the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Take a ①census of the ②descendants of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ households, ▷ ①Lit sum ②Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: from thirty years old and upward, even to fifty years old, everyone who can enter the service of ministry to do work in the tent of meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the work of the ①descendants of Kohath in the tent of meeting, concerning the most holy things. ▷ ①Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: “When the camp sets out, Aaron and his sons shall go in and take down the veil of the curtain, and cover the ark of the testimony with it;

column.name: text
column.value: and they shall place a covering of ①fine leather on it, and spread over it a cloth of pure ②violet, and insert its carrying poles. ▷ ①Meaning of the Heb uncertain, and so throughout the ch ②Or bluish; LXX hyacinth in color, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: Over the table of the bread of the Presence they shall also spread a cloth of violet and put on it the dishes, the pans, the sacrificial bowls, and the jugs for the drink offering; and the continual bread shall be on it.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall spread over them a cloth of scarlet material, and cover the same with a covering of fine leather, and they shall insert its carrying poles.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they shall take a violet cloth and cover the lampstand for the light, along with its lamps, its tongs, its trays, and all its oil containers, by which they attend to it;

column.name: text
column.value: and they shall put it and all its utensils in a covering of fine leather, and put it on the carrying ①bars. ▷ ①Or frame

column.name: text
column.value: Over the golden altar they shall spread a violet cloth, and cover it with a covering of fine leather, and they shall insert its carrying poles;

column.name: text
column.value: and they shall take all the utensils of service, with which they serve in the sanctuary, and put them in a violet cloth and cover them with a covering of fine leather, and put them on the carrying ①bars. ▷ ①Or frame

column.name: text
column.value: Then they shall clean away the ①ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth over it. ▷ ①Or fatty ashes; i.e., soaked with fat

column.name: text
column.value: They shall also put on it all its utensils by which they serve in connection with it: the firepans, the forks, shovels, and the basins, all the utensils of the altar; and they shall spread a cover of fine leather over it and insert its carrying poles.

column.name: text
column.value: When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy objects and all the furnishings of the sanctuary, when the camp is to set out, after that the sons of Kohath shall come to carry them by the poles, so that they will not touch the holy objects and die. These are the ①things in the tent of meeting that the sons of Kohath are to carry. ▷ ①Lit burden...of the sons

column.name: text
column.value: “Now the responsibility of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest is the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the continual grain offering, and the anointing oil—the responsibility of all the ①tabernacle and everything that is in it, with the sanctuary and its furnishings.” ▷ ①Lit dwelling place, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Do not let the tribe of the families of the Kohathites be eliminated from among the Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: Rather, do this for them so that they will live and not die when they approach the most holy objects: Aaron and his sons shall go in and assign each of them to his work and to his load;

column.name: text
column.value: but they shall not come in to see the holy objects even for a moment, or they will die.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Take a ①census of the sons of Gershon ②also, by their fathers’ households, by their families; ▷ ①Lit sum ②Lit also them

column.name: text
column.value: from thirty years old and upward to fifty years old you shall ①count them: all who can enter to perform service, to do the work in the tent of meeting. ▷ ①Lit muster, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in carrying:

column.name: text
column.value: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the tent of meeting with its covering and the covering of fine leather that is on top of it, and the curtain for the entrance of the tent of meeting,

column.name: text
column.value: and the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain for the entrance of the gate of the courtyard that is around the tabernacle and the altar, and their ropes and all the equipment for their service; and everything that is to be done ①by them, ②they shall perform. ▷ ①Or to them ②Lit so they shall serve

column.name: text
column.value: All the service of the sons of the Gershonites, that is, all their loads and all their work, shall be performed at the ①command of Aaron and his sons; and you shall assign to them as a duty all their loads. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the tent of meeting; and their duties shall be ①under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest. ▷ ①Lit in the hand

column.name: text
column.value: “As for the sons of Merari, you shall count them by their families, by their fathers’ households;

column.name: text
column.value: from thirty years old and upward, even to fifty years old, you shall count them, everyone who can enter the service to do the work of the tent of meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: Now this is the duty of their loads, for all their service in the tent of meeting: the boards of the tabernacle, its bars, its pillars, and its bases,

column.name: text
column.value: and the pillars around the courtyard and their bases, their pegs, and their ropes, with all their equipment and with all their service; and you shall assign by names of the men the items ①that each is to carry. ▷ ①Lit of the duty of their loads

column.name: text
column.value: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service in the tent of meeting, ①under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.” ▷ ①Lit in the hand

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of the congregation counted the sons of the Kohathites by their families and by their fathers’ households,

column.name: text
column.value: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who could enter the service for work in the tent of meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: Their numbered men by their families were 2,750.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the numbered men of the Kohathite families, everyone who was serving in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the ①commandment of the LORD ②through Moses. ▷ ①Lit mouth ②Lit by the hand of

column.name: text
column.value: And the numbered men of the sons of Gershon by their families and by their fathers’ households,

column.name: text
column.value: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who could enter the service for work in the tent of meeting—

column.name: text
column.value: their numbered men by their families, by their fathers’ households, were 2,630.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the numbered men of the families of the sons of Gershon, everyone who was serving in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the ①commandment of the LORD. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: And the numbered men of the families of the sons of Merari by their families, by their fathers’ households,

column.name: text
column.value: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who could enter the service for work in the tent of meeting—

column.name: text
column.value: their numbered men by their families were 3,200.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the numbered men of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the ①commandment of the LORD ②through Moses. ▷ ①Lit mouth ②Lit by the hand of

column.name: text
column.value: All the numbered men of the Levites, whom Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of Israel counted, by their families and by their fathers’ households,

column.name: text
column.value: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who could enter to do the work of service and the work of carrying in the tent of meeting—

column.name: text
column.value: their numbered men were 8,580.

column.name: text
column.value: According to the ①commandment of the LORD ②through Moses, they were counted, everyone by his serving or carrying; so these were his numbered men, just as the LORD had commanded Moses. ▷ ①Lit mouth ②Lit by the hand of

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Command the sons of Israel that they send away from the camp everyone with leprosy, everyone having a discharge, and everyone who is unclean because of contact with a dead person.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall send away both male and female; you shall send them outside the camp so that they do not defile their camp where I dwell in their midst.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Israel did so and sent them outside the camp; just as the LORD had spoken to Moses, that is what the sons of Israel did.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any of the sins of mankind, acting unfaithfully against the LORD, and that person is guilty,

column.name: text
column.value: then ①he shall confess ②his sin which ③he has committed, and he shall make restitution in full for his wrong and add to it a fifth of it, and give it to him whom he has wronged. ▷ ①Lit they ②Lit their ③Lit they have

column.name: text
column.value: But if the person has no ①redeemer to whom restitution may be made for the wrong, the restitution which is made for the wrong must go to the LORD for the priest, besides the ram of atonement, by which atonement is made for him. ▷ ①I.e., male relative to act in his behalf

column.name: text
column.value: Also every ①contribution pertaining to all the holy gifts of the sons of Israel, which they offer to the priest, shall be his. ▷ ①Or uplifted offering

column.name: text
column.value: So every person’s holy gifts shall be his; whatever anyone gives to the priest, it becomes his.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘If any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him,

column.name: text
column.value: and a man has sexual relations with her and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and she remains undiscovered, although she has defiled herself, and there is no witness against her and she has not been caught in the act,

column.name: text
column.value: ①if ②an attitude of jealousy comes over him and he is jealous of his wife when she has defiled herself, or if ③an attitude of jealousy comes over him and he is jealous of his wife when she has not defiled herself, ▷ ①Lit and ②Lit a spirit ③Lit a spirit

column.name: text
column.value: the man shall then bring his wife to the priest, and shall bring as ①an offering for her a tenth of an ②ephah of barley meal; he shall not pour oil on it nor put frankincense on it, because it is a grain offering of jealousy, a grain offering of reminder, a reminder of wrongdoing. ▷ ①Lit her offering ②About 1 cubic foot or 0.03 cubic meters

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Then the priest shall bring her forward and have her stand before the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: and the priest shall take holy water in an earthenware container; and ①he shall take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it in the water. ▷ ①Lit the priest

column.name: text
column.value: The priest shall then have the woman stand before the LORD and let down the hair of the woman’s head, and place the grain offering of reminder ①in her hands, that is, the grain offering of jealousy; and in the hand of the priest is to be the water of bitterness that brings a curse. ▷ ①Lit on her palms

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall have her take an oath and shall say to the woman, “If no man has had sexual relations with you and if you have not gone astray into uncleanness, as you are under the authority of your husband, be ①immune to this water of bitterness that brings a curse; ▷ ①Lit free from

column.name: text
column.value: if, however, you have gone astray, though under the authority of your husband, and if you have defiled yourself and a man other than your husband has had sexual intercourse with you”

column.name: text
column.value: (then the priest shall have the woman swear with the oath of the curse, and the priest shall say to the woman), “may the LORD make you a curse and an oath among your people by the LORD’S making your thigh ①shriveled and your ②belly swollen; ▷ ①Lit collapsed ②Possibly the womb, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: and this water that brings a curse shall go into your ①stomach, to make your belly swell up and your thigh ②shrivel.” And the woman shall say, “Amen, Amen.” ▷ ①Or inward parts ②Lit collapse

column.name: text
column.value: ‘The priest shall then write these curses on a scroll, and he shall ①wash them off into the water of bitterness. ▷ ①Lit wipe

column.name: text
column.value: Then he shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that brings a curse, so that the water which brings a curse will go into her ①and cause bitterness. ▷ ①Lit for bitterness

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall take the grain offering of jealousy from the woman’s hand, and he shall wave the grain offering before the LORD and bring it to the altar;

column.name: text
column.value: and the priest shall take a handful of the grain offering as its reminder offering and offer it up in smoke on the altar, and afterward he shall make the woman drink the water.

column.name: text
column.value: When he has made her drink the water, then it will come about, if she has defiled herself and has been unfaithful to her husband, that the water which brings a curse will go into her ①and cause bitterness, and her belly will swell up and her thigh will ②shrivel, and the woman will become a curse among her people. ▷ ①Lit for bitterness ②Lit collapse

column.name: text
column.value: But if the woman has not defiled herself and is clean, she will be ①immune and conceive ②children. ▷ ①Lit free ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is the law of jealousy: when a wife, who is under the authority of her husband, goes astray and defiles herself,

column.name: text
column.value: or when ①an attitude of jealousy comes over a man and he is jealous of his wife, he shall then have the woman stand before the LORD, and the priest shall apply all of this law to her. ▷ ①Lit a spirit

column.name: text
column.value: The man, moreover, will be free of ①guilt, but that woman shall bear the consequences of her ②guilt.’ ” ▷ ①Or wrongdoing ②Or wrongdoing

column.name: text
column.value: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When a man or woman makes ①a special vow, namely, the vow of a ②Nazirite, to live as a Nazirite for the LORD, ▷ ①Or an extraordinary ②I.e., one consecrated to God

column.name: text
column.value: he shall abstain from wine and ①strong drink; he shall ②consume no vinegar, whether made from wine or strong drink, nor shall he drink any grape juice nor eat fresh or dried grapes. ▷ ①I.e., other alcoholic drink ②Lit drink

column.name: text
column.value: All the days of his consecration he shall not eat anything that is produced from the grape vine, from the seeds even to the skin.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘All the days of his vow of consecration no razor shall pass over his head. He shall be holy until the days are fulfilled which he lives as a Nazirite for the LORD; he shall let the locks of hair on his head grow long.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘All the days of his life as a Nazirite for the LORD he shall not come up to a dead person.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall not make himself unclean for his father or for his mother, for his brother or for his sister, when they die, because his consecration to God is ①on his head. ▷ ①I.e., referring either to the visibility of the long hair, or to the consequences of violating the vow

column.name: text
column.value: All the days of his consecration he is holy to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘But if someone dies very suddenly beside him and he defiles his consecrated head of hair, then he shall shave his head on the day when he becomes clean; he shall shave it on the seventh day.

column.name: text
column.value: Then on the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young doves to the priest, to the entrance of the tent of meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, and make atonement for him ①regarding his sin because of the dead person. And on that same day he shall consecrate his head, ▷ ①Lit because of that which he sinned

column.name: text
column.value: and shall live his days of consecration as a Nazirite for the LORD, and shall bring a male lamb a year old as a guilt offering; but the preceding days will ①not count, because his consecration was defiled. ▷ ①Lit fall

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now this is the law of the Nazirite when the days of his consecration are fulfilled: he shall bring ①his offering to the entrance of the tent of meeting. ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall present his offering to the LORD: one male lamb a year old without defect as a burnt offering, one ewe lamb a year old without defect as a sin offering, one ram without defect as a peace offering,

column.name: text
column.value: and a basket of unleavened loaves of fine flour mixed with oil and unleavened wafers spread with oil, along with their grain offering and their drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall present them before the LORD and offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall also offer the ram as a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, together with the basket of unleavened bread; the priest shall also offer its grain offering and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: The Nazirite shall then shave his consecrated head of hair at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and take the consecrated hair of his head and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall take the ram’s shoulder when it has been boiled, and one unleavened loaf from the basket and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them on the ①hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved his consecrated hair. ▷ ①Lit palms

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall wave them as a wave offering before the LORD. It is holy for the priest, together with the breast offered as a wave offering, and the thigh offered as ①a contribution; and afterward the Nazirite may drink wine.’ ▷ ①Or an uplifted offering

column.name: text
column.value: “This is the law of the Nazirite who vows his offering to the LORD according to his consecration, in addition to what else ①he can afford; corresponding to his vow which he makes, so he shall do according to the law of his consecration.” ▷ ①Lit his hand reaches

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘In this way you shall bless the sons of Israel. You are to say to them:

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD bless you, and ①keep you; ▷ ①Or watch over; or take care of

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD cause His face to shine on you, And be gracious to you;

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD lift up His face to you, And give you peace.’

column.name: text
column.value: So they shall ①invoke My name on the sons of Israel, and then I will bless them.” ▷ ①Lit put

column.name: text
column.value: Now on the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, he anointed it and consecrated it with all its furnishings, and the altar and all its utensils; he anointed them and consecrated them also.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the leaders of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ households, made an offering (they were the leaders of the tribes; they were the ①supervisors over the ②numbered men). ▷ ①Lit ones standing ②Lit mustered

column.name: text
column.value: When they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered carts and twelve oxen, a cart for every two of the leaders and an ox for each one, then they presented them in front of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Accept these things from them, that they may be ①used in the service of the tent of meeting, and you shall give them to the Levites, to each man according to his service.” ▷ ①Lit for serving

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses took the carts and the oxen and gave them to the Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: Two carts and four oxen he gave to the sons of Gershon, according to their service,

column.name: text
column.value: and four carts and eight oxen he gave to the sons of Merari, according to their service, ①under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest. ▷ ①Lit by the hand

column.name: text
column.value: But he did not give any to the sons of Kohath, because theirs was the service of the holy objects, which they carried on the shoulder.

column.name: text
column.value: And the leaders offered the dedication offering ①for the altar ②when it was anointed, so the leaders offered their offering before the altar. ▷ ①Lit of ②Lit in the day that

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses, “They shall present their offering, one leader each day, for the dedication of the altar.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now the one who presented his offering on the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah;

column.name: text
column.value: and his offering was one silver ①dish whose weight was 130 shekels, and one silver bowl of seventy shekels in ②sanctuary shekels, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering; ▷ ①Or platter, and so through v 85 ②About 0.5 oz. or 14 gm, and so through v 86

column.name: text
column.value: one gold pan of ten shekels, full of incense;

column.name: text
column.value: one ①bull, one ram, and one male lamb one year old, as a burnt offering; ▷ ①Lit bull, a son of the herd, and so through v 81

column.name: text
column.value: one male goat as a sin offering;

column.name: text
column.value: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs one year old. This was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

column.name: text
column.value: On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, leader of Issachar, presented an offering;

column.name: text
column.value: he presented as his offering one silver dish whose weight was 130 shekels, and one silver bowl of seventy shekels in sanctuary shekels, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one gold pan of ten shekels, full of incense;

column.name: text
column.value: one bull, one ram, and one male lamb one year old, as a burnt offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one male goat as a sin offering;

column.name: text
column.value: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs one year old. This was the offering of Nethanel the son of Zuar.

column.name: text
column.value: On the third day it was Eliab the son of Helon, leader of the sons of Zebulun;

column.name: text
column.value: his offering was also one silver dish whose weight was 130 shekels, and one silver bowl of seventy shekels in sanctuary shekels, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one gold pan of ten shekels, full of incense;

column.name: text
column.value: one bull, one ram, and one male lamb one year old, as a burnt offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one male goat as a sin offering;

column.name: text
column.value: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs one year old. This was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.

column.name: text
column.value: On the fourth day it was Elizur the son of Shedeur, leader of the sons of Reuben;

column.name: text
column.value: his offering was also one silver dish whose weight was 130 shekels, and one silver bowl of seventy shekels in sanctuary shekels, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one gold pan of ten shekels, full of incense;

column.name: text
column.value: one bull, one ram, and one male lamb one year old, as a burnt offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one male goat as a sin offering;

column.name: text
column.value: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs one year old. This was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur.

column.name: text
column.value: On the fifth day it was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, leader of the sons of Simeon;

column.name: text
column.value: his offering was also one silver dish whose weight was 130 shekels, and one silver bowl of seventy shekels in sanctuary shekels, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one gold pan of ten shekels, full of incense;

column.name: text
column.value: one bull, one ram, and one male lamb one year old, as a burnt offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one male goat as a sin offering;

column.name: text
column.value: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs one year old. This was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

column.name: text
column.value: On the sixth day it was Eliasaph the son of Deuel, leader of the sons of Gad;

column.name: text
column.value: his offering was also one silver dish whose weight was 130 shekels, and one silver bowl of seventy shekels in sanctuary shekels, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one gold pan of ten shekels, full of incense;

column.name: text
column.value: one bull, one ram, and one male lamb one year old, as a burnt offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one male goat as a sin offering;

column.name: text
column.value: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs one year old. This was the offering of Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

column.name: text
column.value: On the seventh day it was Elishama the son of Ammihud, leader of the sons of Ephraim;

column.name: text
column.value: his offering was also one silver dish whose weight was 130 shekels, and one silver bowl of seventy shekels in sanctuary shekels, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one gold pan of ten shekels, full of incense;

column.name: text
column.value: one bull, one ram, and one male lamb one year old, as a burnt offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one male goat as a sin offering;

column.name: text
column.value: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs one year old. This was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.

column.name: text
column.value: On the eighth day it was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, leader of the sons of Manasseh;

column.name: text
column.value: his offering was also one silver dish whose weight was 130 shekels, and one silver bowl of seventy shekels in sanctuary shekels, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one gold pan of ten shekels, full of incense;

column.name: text
column.value: one bull, one ram, and one male lamb one year old, as a burnt offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one male goat as a sin offering;

column.name: text
column.value: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs one year old. This was the offering of Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

column.name: text
column.value: On the ninth day it was Abidan the son of Gideoni, leader of the sons of Benjamin;

column.name: text
column.value: his offering was also one silver dish whose weight was 130 shekels, and one silver bowl of seventy shekels in sanctuary shekels, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one gold pan of ten shekels, full of incense;

column.name: text
column.value: one bull, one ram, and one male lamb one year old, as a burnt offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one male goat as a sin offering;

column.name: text
column.value: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs one year old. This was the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni.

column.name: text
column.value: On the tenth day it was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai, leader of the sons of Dan;

column.name: text
column.value: his offering was also one silver dish whose weight was 130 shekels, and one silver bowl of seventy shekels in sanctuary shekels, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one gold pan of ten shekels, full of incense;

column.name: text
column.value: one bull, one ram, and one male lamb one year old, as a burnt offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one male goat as a sin offering;

column.name: text
column.value: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs one year old. This was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

column.name: text
column.value: On the eleventh day it was Pagiel the son of Ochran, leader of the sons of Asher;

column.name: text
column.value: his offering was also one silver dish whose weight was 130 shekels, and one silver bowl of seventy shekels in sanctuary shekels, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one gold pan of ten shekels, full of incense;

column.name: text
column.value: one bull, one ram, and one male lamb one year old, as a burnt offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one male goat as a sin offering;

column.name: text
column.value: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs one year old. This was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ochran.

column.name: text
column.value: On the twelfth day it was Ahira the son of Enan, leader of the sons of Naphtali;

column.name: text
column.value: his offering was also one silver dish whose weight was 130 shekels, and one silver bowl of seventy shekels in sanctuary shekels, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one gold pan of ten shekels, full of incense;

column.name: text
column.value: one bull, one ram, and one male lamb one year old, as a burnt offering;

column.name: text
column.value: one male goat as a sin offering;

column.name: text
column.value: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs one year old. This was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.

column.name: text
column.value: This was the dedication offering ①for the altar from the leaders of Israel ②when it was anointed: twelve silver dishes, twelve silver bowls, and twelve gold pans, ▷ ①Lit of ②Lit in the day that

column.name: text
column.value: each silver dish weighing 130 shekels and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the utensils totaled 2,400 in sanctuary shekels;

column.name: text
column.value: the twelve gold pans full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece in sanctuary shekels, all the gold of the pans totaled 120 shekels.

column.name: text
column.value: All the oxen for the burnt offering totaled twelve bulls, all the rams, twelve, the male lambs one year old with their grain offering, twelve, and the male goats as a sin offering, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: and all the oxen for the sacrifice of peace offerings totaled twenty-four bulls, all the rams, sixty, the male goats, sixty, and the male lambs one year old, sixty. This was the dedication offering for the altar after it was anointed.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Moses entered the tent of meeting to speak with Him, he heard the voice speaking to him from above the ①atoning cover that was on the ark of the testimony, from between the two ②cherubim; so He spoke to him. ▷ ①Also called mercy seat; i.e., where blood was sprinkled on the Day of Atonement ②Heb plural of cherub

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Now the sons of Israel are to ①celebrate the Passover at its appointed time. ▷ ①Lit perform, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: On the fourteenth day of this month, ①at twilight, you shall celebrate it at its appointed time; you shall celebrate it in accordance with all its statutes and all its ordinances.” ▷ ①Lit between the two evenings, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses ①told the sons of Israel to celebrate the Passover. ▷ ①Lit spoke to

column.name: text
column.value: And they celebrated the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, at twilight, in the wilderness of Sinai; in accordance with everything that the LORD had commanded Moses, so the sons of Israel did.

column.name: text
column.value: But there were some men who were unclean because of contact with a ①dead person, so that they could not celebrate Passover on that day; and they came before Moses and Aaron on that day. ▷ ①Lit soul of man

column.name: text
column.value: Those men said to him, “Though we are unclean because of a ①dead person, why are we kept from presenting the offering of the LORD at its appointed time among the sons of Israel?” ▷ ①Lit soul of man

column.name: text
column.value: Moses then said to them, “ ①Wait, and I will listen to what the LORD will command concerning you.” ▷ ①Lit Stand

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘If any one of you or of your generations becomes unclean because of a dead ①person, or is on a distant journey, he may, however, celebrate the Passover to the LORD. ▷ ①Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: In the second month on the fourteenth day at twilight, they shall celebrate it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall not leave any of it until morning, nor break a bone of it; they shall celebrate it in accordance with the whole statute of the Passover.

column.name: text
column.value: But the person who is clean and is not on a journey, yet refrains from celebrating the Passover, that ①person shall then be cut off from his people, because he did not present the offering of the LORD at its appointed time. That person will bear the responsibility for his sin. ▷ ①Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: And if a stranger resides among you and ①celebrates the Passover to the LORD, according to the statute of the Passover and its ordinance, so he shall celebrate it; you shall have ②the same statute, both for the stranger and for the native of the land.’ ” ▷ ①Or would celebrate ②Or one statute

column.name: text
column.value: Now on the day that the tabernacle was erected, the cloud covered the tabernacle, the tent of the testimony, and in the evening it was like the appearance of fire over the tabernacle until morning.

column.name: text
column.value: That is how it was continuously; the cloud would cover it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.

column.name: text
column.value: Whenever the cloud was lifted from over the tent, afterward the sons of Israel would set out; and in the place where the cloud settled down, there the sons of Israel would camp.

column.name: text
column.value: At the ①command of the LORD the sons of Israel would set out, and at the ②command of the LORD they would camp; as long as the cloud settled over the tabernacle, they remained camped. ▷ ①Lit mouth ②Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Even when the cloud lingered over the tabernacle for many days, ①the sons of Israel would comply with the LORD’S ordinance and not set out. ▷ ①Lit and the

column.name: text
column.value: If ①sometimes the cloud remained a few days over the tabernacle, in accordance with the ②command of the LORD they remained camped. Then in accordance with the ③command of the LORD they set out. ▷ ①Lit it was that ②Lit mouth ③Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: If ①sometimes the cloud ②remained from evening until morning, when the cloud was lifted in the morning they would set out; or if it remained in the daytime and at night, whenever the cloud was lifted, they would set out. ▷ ①Lit it was that ②Lit was

column.name: text
column.value: Whether it was two days, a month, or a year that the cloud lingered over the tabernacle, staying above it, the sons of Israel remained camped and did not set out; but when it was lifted, they did set out.

column.name: text
column.value: At the ①command of the LORD they camped, and at the ②command of the LORD they set out; they did what the LORD required, in accordance with the ③command of the LORD through Moses. ▷ ①Lit mouth ②Lit mouth ③Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to Aaron and say to him, ‘When you ①mount the lamps, the seven lamps will provide light in the front of the lampstand.’ ” ▷ ①Lit put up

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Aaron did so; he ①mounted its lamps at the front of the lampstand, just as the LORD had commanded Moses. ▷ ①Lit put up

column.name: text
column.value: Now this was the workmanship of the lampstand, hammered work of gold; from its base to its flower ornamentation it was hammered work; according to the ①pattern which the LORD had shown Moses, so he made the lampstand. ▷ ①Lit appearance

column.name: text
column.value: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Take the Levites from among the sons of Israel and cleanse them.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what you shall do to them, for their cleansing: sprinkle ①purifying water on them, and have them ②use a razor over their whole ③body, and they shall wash their clothes and cleanse themselves. ▷ ①Lit water of expiation ②Lit cause to pass ③Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: Then have them take a ①bull with its grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and you shall take a second ②bull as a sin offering. ▷ ①Lit bull, a son of the herd ②Lit bull, a son of the herd

column.name: text
column.value: So you shall present the Levites in front of the tent of meeting. You shall also assemble the whole congregation of the sons of Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: and present the Levites before the LORD; and the sons of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron then shall ①present the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the sons of Israel, so that they may ②qualify to perform the service of the LORD. ▷ ①Lit wave, and so throughout the ch ②Lit be to perform

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls; then you are to offer the one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to the LORD, to make atonement for the Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall have the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons so as to present them as a wave offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “So you shall single out the Levites from among the sons of Israel, and the Levites shall be Mine.

column.name: text
column.value: Then after that the Levites may go in to serve the tent of meeting. But you shall cleanse them and present them as a wave offering;

column.name: text
column.value: for they are exclusively given to Me from among the sons of Israel. I have taken them for Myself instead of the firstborn of every womb, the firstborn of all the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: For every firstborn among the sons of Israel is Mine, among the people and among the animals; on the day that I fatally struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for Myself.

column.name: text
column.value: But I have taken the Levites instead of every firstborn among the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And I have given the Levites as ①a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the sons of Israel, to perform the service of the sons of Israel at the tent of meeting and to make atonement on behalf of the sons of Israel, so that there will be no affliction among the sons of Israel due to ②their approaching the sanctuary.” ▷ ①Lit given ones ②Lit the sons of Israel’s

column.name: text
column.value: So this is what Moses, Aaron, and all the congregation of the sons of Israel did to the Levites; according to everything that the LORD had commanded Moses regarding the Levites, so the sons of Israel did to them.

column.name: text
column.value: The Levites, too, purified themselves from sin and washed their clothes; and Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the LORD. Aaron also made atonement for them to cleanse them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then after that the Levites went in to perform their service in the tent of meeting before Aaron and his sons; just as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what applies to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward ①they shall enter to perform service in the work of the tent of meeting. ▷ ①Lit he

column.name: text
column.value: But at the age of fifty years they shall ①retire from service in the work and not work anymore. ▷ ①Lit return

column.name: text
column.value: They may, however, ①assist their brothers in the tent of meeting, to fulfill an obligation, but they themselves shall do no work. In this way you shall deal with the Levites in their obligations.” ▷ ①Lit serve

column.name: text
column.value: Then Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married (for he had married a Cushite woman);

column.name: text
column.value: and they said, “Is it a fact that the LORD has spoken only through Moses? Has He not spoken through us as well?” And the LORD heard this.

column.name: text
column.value: (Now the man Moses was very humble, more than any person who was on the face of the earth.)

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD suddenly said to Moses and to Aaron and Miriam, “You three go out to the tent of meeting.” So the three of them went out.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD came down in a pillar of cloud and stood at the entrance of the tent; and He called Aaron and Miriam. When they had both come forward,

column.name: text
column.value: He said, “Now hear My words: If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will make Myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.

column.name: text
column.value: It is not this way for My servant Moses; He is faithful in all My household;

column.name: text
column.value: With him I speak mouth to mouth, That is, openly, and not ①using ②mysterious language, And he beholds the form of the LORD. So why were you not afraid To speak against My servant, against Moses?” ▷ ①Lit in ②Lit riddles

column.name: text
column.value: And the anger of the LORD burned against them and He departed.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the cloud had withdrawn from above the tent, behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. As Aaron turned toward Miriam, behold, she was leprous.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, I beg you, do not ①hold us responsible for this sin by which we have turned out to be foolish, and by which we have sinned. ▷ ①Lit place the sin on us

column.name: text
column.value: Oh, do not let her be like a dead person, whose flesh is half eaten away when he comes out of his mother’s womb!”

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses cried out to the LORD, saying, “God, heal her, please!”

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD said to Moses, “If her father had only spit in her face, would she not be put to shame for seven days? Have her shut outside the camp for seven days, and afterward she may be received again.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Miriam was shut outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not move on until Miriam was received again.

column.name: text
column.value: Afterward, however, the people moved on from Hazeroth and camped in the wilderness of Paran.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the people became like those who complain of adversity in the ears of the LORD; and the LORD heard them and His anger was kindled, and the fire of the LORD burned among them and consumed some at the outskirts of the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: The people then cried out to Moses; and Moses prayed to the LORD, and the fire ①died out. ▷ ①Lit sank down

column.name: text
column.value: So that place was named ①Taberah, because the fire of the LORD burned among them. ▷ ①I.e., the place for burning

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rabble who were among them ①had greedy cravings; and the sons of Israel also wept again and said, “Who will give us ②meat to eat? ▷ ①Lit desired a desire ②Lit flesh, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: We remember the fish which we used to eat for free in Egypt, the cucumbers, the melons, the leeks, the onions, and the garlic;

column.name: text
column.value: but now our ①appetite is gone. There is nothing at all ②to look at except this manna!” ▷ ①Lit soul has dried up ②Lit for our eyes

column.name: text
column.value: Now the manna was like coriander seed, and its appearance like that of ①bdellium. ▷ ①I.e., a tree gum

column.name: text
column.value: The people would roam about and gather it and grind it ①between two millstones, or pound it in the mortar, and boil it in the pot and make loaves with it; and its taste was like the taste of ②cake baked with oil. ▷ ①Lit with ②Lit juice of oil

column.name: text
column.value: When the dew came down on the camp at night, the manna would come down ①with it. ▷ ①Lit on

column.name: text
column.value: Now Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, each one at the entrance of his tent; and the anger of the LORD became very hot, and ①Moses was displeased. ▷ ①Lit it was evil in Moses’ eyes

column.name: text
