column.value: for they have been hostile to you with their tricks, with which they have deceived you in the matter of Peor and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of the leader of Midian, their sister who was killed on the day of the plague because of Peor.”

column.name: text
column.value: in Heb

column.name: text
column.value: “Take a ①census of all the congregation of the sons of Israel from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ households, whoever is able to go to war in Israel.” ▷ ①Lit sum

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Take a census of the people from twenty years old and upward, as the LORD has commanded Moses.” Now the sons of Israel who came out of the land of Egypt were as follows:

column.name: text
column.value: Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;

column.name: text
column.value: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the families of the Reubenites, and those who were counted of them were 43,730.

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Pallu: Eliab.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are the Dathan and Abiram who were called by the congregation, who fought against Moses and against Aaron in the group of Korah, when they fought against the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up along with Korah, when that group died, when the fire devoured 250 men, so that they became a warning sign.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Korah, however, did not die.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Simeon by their families: of ①Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of ②Jachin, the family of the Jachinites; ▷ ①In Gen

column.name: text
column.value: of ①Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites. ▷ ①In Gen 46:10, Zohar

column.name: text
column.value: These are the families of the Simeonites, 22,200 in number.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Gad by their families: of ①Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites; ▷ ①In Gen 46:16, Ziphion

column.name: text
column.value: of ①Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites; ▷ ①In Gen 46:16, Ezbon

column.name: text
column.value: of ①Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites. ▷ ①In Gen 46:16, Arodi

column.name: text
column.value: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were numbered of them, 40,500.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan, but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Judah by their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the families of Judah by those who were numbered of them, 76,500.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Issachar by their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of ①Puvah, the family of the Punites; ▷ ①In Gen 46:13, Puvvah; in 1 Chr 7:1, Puah

column.name: text
column.value: of ①Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites. ▷ ①In Gen 46:13, Iob

column.name: text
column.value: These are the families of Issachar by those who were numbered of them, 64,300.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Zebulun by their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the families of the Zebulunites by those who were numbered of them, 60,500.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Joseph by their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir fathered Gilead: of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the sons of Gilead: of ①Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites; ▷ ①In Josh 17:2, Abiezer

column.name: text
column.value: and of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;

column.name: text
column.value: and of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, only daughters; and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the families of Manasseh; and those who were numbered of them were 52,700.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the sons of Ephraim by their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of ①Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites. ▷ ①In 1 Chr 7:20, Bered

column.name: text
column.value: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim by those who were numbered of them, 32,500. These are the sons of Joseph by their families.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Benjamin by their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of ①Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites; ▷ ①In Gen 46:21, Ehi; in 1 Chr 8:1, Aharah

column.name: text
column.value: of ①Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of ②Hupham, the family of the Huphamites. ▷ ①In Gen 46:21, Muppim; in 1 Chr 7:12, Shuppim ②In Gen 46:21, Huppim

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Bela were ①Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites. ▷ ①In 1 Chr 8:3, Addar

column.name: text
column.value: These are the sons of Benjamin by their families; and those who were numbered of them were 45,600.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the sons of Dan by their families: of ①Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan by their families. ▷ ①In Gen 46:23, Hushim

column.name: text
column.value: All the families of the Shuhamites, by those who were numbered of them, were 64,400.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Asher by their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

column.name: text
column.value: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the families of the sons of Asher by those who were numbered of them, 53,400.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Naphtali by their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;

column.name: text
column.value: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the families of Naphtali by their families; and those who were numbered of them were 45,400.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the ones who were numbered of the sons of Israel, 601,730.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①Among these the land shall be divided as an inheritance according to the number of names. ▷ ①Lit To

column.name: text
column.value: To a larger group you shall increase their inheritance, and to a smaller group you shall decrease their inheritance; each shall be given their inheritance corresponding to the total of those who were numbered of them.

column.name: text
column.value: But the land shall be divided by lot. They shall receive their inheritance according to the names of the tribes of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Corresponding to the selection by lot, their inheritance shall be divided between the larger and the smaller groups.”

column.name: text
column.value: These are those who were numbered of the Levites according to their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath fathered Amram.

column.name: text
column.value: And the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt; and she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and their sister Miriam.

column.name: text
column.value: And to Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

column.name: text
column.value: But Nadab and Abihu died when they offered ①strange fire before the LORD. ▷ ①I.e., prohibited

column.name: text
column.value: Those who were numbered of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward, for they were not numbered among the sons of Israel since no inheritance was given to them among the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the ones who were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the sons of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: But among these there was not a man of those who were numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest, who numbered the sons of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD had said ①of them, “They shall certainly die in the wilderness.” And not a man was left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun. ▷ ①Or to

column.name: text
column.value: When the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the ①Negev, heard that Israel was coming by the way of Atharim, he fought against Israel and took some of them captive. ▷ ①I.e., South country

column.name: text
column.value: So Israel made a vow to the LORD and said, “If You will indeed hand over this people to me, then I will ①utterly destroy their cities.” ▷ ①Lit devote to destruction

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD heard the voice of Israel and turned over the Canaanites; then they ①utterly destroyed them and their cities. And the place was named ②Hormah. ▷ ①Litdevoted to destruction ②I.e., a devoted thing; or Destruction

column.name: text
column.value: Then they set out from Mount Hor by the way of the ①Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom; and the ②people became impatient because of the journey. ▷ ①Lit Sea of Reeds ②Lit soul of the people was short

column.name: text
column.value: So the people spoke against God and Moses: “Why have you brought us up from Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no ①food and no water, and ②we are disgusted with ③this miserable food.” ▷ ①Lit bread ②Lit our soul is disgusted ③I.e., the manna

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people and they bit the people, so that many people of Israel died.

column.name: text
column.value: So the people came to Moses and said, “We have sinned, because we have spoken against the LORD and against you; intercede with the LORD, that He will remove the serpents from us.” And Moses interceded for the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses, “ ①Make a fiery serpent, and put it on a flag pole; and it shall come about, that everyone who is bitten, and looks at it, will live.” ▷ ①Lit Make for yourself

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses made a bronze serpent and put it on the flag pole; and it came about, that if a serpent bit someone, and he looked at the bronze serpent, he lived.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of Israel moved out and camped in Oboth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they journeyed from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim, in the wilderness which is opposite Moab, to the ①east. ▷ ①Lit sunrise

column.name: text
column.value: From there they set out and camped in ①Wadi Zered. ▷ ①I.e., a dry stream bed, except in the rainy season

column.name: text
column.value: From there they journeyed and camped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that comes out of the border of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

column.name: text
column.value: For that reason it is said in the Book of the Wars of the LORD, “Waheb in Suphah, And the ①wadis of the Arnon, ▷ ①I.e., dry stream beds

column.name: text
column.value: And the slope of the wadis That extends to the site of Ar, And leans to the border of Moab.”

column.name: text
column.value: From there they continued to ①Beer, that is the well where the LORD said to Moses, “Assemble the people, that I may give them water.” ▷ ①I.e., a well

column.name: text
column.value: Then Israel sang this song: “Spring up, O well! Sing to it!

column.name: text
column.value: The well, which the leaders dug, Which the nobles of the people hollowed out, With the scepter and with their staffs.” And from the wilderness they continued to Mattanah,

column.name: text
column.value: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel, and from Nahaliel to Bamoth,

column.name: text
column.value: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the land of Moab, at the top of Pisgah, which overlooks the ①desert. ▷ ①Or Jeshimon

column.name: text
column.value: Then Israel sent messengers to Sihon, king of the Amorites, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Let me pass through your land. We will not turn off into field or vineyard; we will not drink water from wells. We will go by the king’s road until we have passed through your border.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Sihon would not permit Israel to pass through his border. Instead, Sihon gathered all his people and went out against Israel in the wilderness, and came to Jahaz and fought against Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and took possession of his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, as far as the sons of Ammon; for the border of the sons of Ammon was ①Jazer. ▷ ①So LXX; MT strong

column.name: text
column.value: Israel took all these cities, and Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon and in all her ①villages. ▷ ①Lit daughters

column.name: text
column.value: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab and had taken all his land out of his hand, as far as the Arnon.

column.name: text
column.value: For that reason those who use proverbs say, “Come to Heshbon! Let it be built! So let the city of Sihon be established.

column.name: text
column.value: For a fire spread from Heshbon, A flame from the town of Sihon; It devoured Ar of Moab, The ①dominant ②heights of the Arnon. ▷ ①Lit lords of the ②Or Bamoth

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you, Moab! You are destroyed, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, And his daughters into captivity, To an Amorite king, Sihon.

column.name: text
column.value: But we have shot them down with arrows, Heshbon is destroyed as far as Dibon, Then we have laid waste as far as Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Moses sent men to spy out Jazer, and they captured its villages and dispossessed the Amorites who were there.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they turned and went up by the way of Bashan, and Og the king of Bashan went out against them ①with all his people, for battle at Edrei. ▷ ①Lit he and

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD said to Moses, “Do not fear him, for I have handed him over to you, and all his people and his land; and you shall do to him as you did to Sihon, king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon.”

column.name: text
column.value: So they ①killed him and his sons and all his people, until there was no survivor left; and they took possession of his land. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph, came forward; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

column.name: text
column.value: They stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, before the leaders, and all the congregation at the entrance of the tent of meeting, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Our father died in the wilderness, yet he was not among the group of those who gathered together against the LORD, in the group of Korah; but he died in his own sin, and he had no sons.

column.name: text
column.value: Why should the name of our father be withdrawn from among his family simply because he had no son? Give us property among our father’s brothers.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses brought their case before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to ①Moses, ▷ ①Lit Moses, saying

column.name: text
column.value: “The daughters of Zelophehad are right about their statements. You shall certainly give them hereditary property among their father’s brothers, and you shall transfer the inheritance of their father to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Further, you shall speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies and has no son, then you shall transfer his inheritance to his daughter.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: And if his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his nearest relative in his own family, and he shall take possession of it; and it shall be a statutory ordinance to the sons of Israel, just as the LORD has commanded Moses.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go up to this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: When you have seen it, you too will be gathered to your people, just as Aaron your brother ①was; ▷ ①Lit was gathered

column.name: text
column.value: for in the wilderness of Zin, during the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against My ①command to treat Me as holy before their eyes at the water.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.) ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “May the LORD, the God of the spirits of ①humanity, appoint a man over the congregation, ▷ ①Lit all flesh

column.name: text
column.value: who will go out ①and come in before them, and lead them out and ②bring them in, so that the congregation of the LORD will not be like sheep that have no shepherd.” ▷ ①Lit before them and who will ②Lit who will bring

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD said to Moses, “ ①Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him; ▷ ①Lit Take for yourself

column.name: text
column.value: and have him stand before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation, and commission him in their sight.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall put some of your ①authority on him, so that all the congregation of the sons of Israel will obey him. ▷ ①Lit majesty

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before the LORD. At his ①command they shall go out, and at his ②command they shall come in, both he and all the sons of Israel with him, all the congregation.” ▷ ①Lit mouth ②Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses did just as the LORD commanded him; he took Joshua and had him stand before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he laid his hands on him and commissioned him, just as the LORD had spoken ①through Moses. ▷ ①Lit by the hand of

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy assembly; you shall do no laborious work. It will be to you a day for blowing trumpets.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall offer a burnt offering as a soothing aroma to the LORD: one ①bull, one ram, and seven male lambs one year old without defect; ▷ ①Lit bull, a son of the herd, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: also their grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ①ephah for the bull, two-tenths for the ram, ▷ ①About 1 cubic foot or 0.03 cubic meters, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: and a tenth for ①each of the seven lambs, ▷ ①Lit each lamb, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: and one male goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you,

column.name: text
column.value: besides the burnt offering of the new moon and its grain offering, and the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a soothing aroma, an offering by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Then on the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy assembly, and you shall humble yourselves; you shall not do any work.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall present a burnt offering to the LORD as a soothing aroma: one bull, one ram, and seven male lambs one year old, that you have without defect;

column.name: text
column.value: and their grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for the bull, two-tenths for the one ram,

column.name: text
column.value: and a tenth for each of the seven lambs;

column.name: text
column.value: one male goat as a sin offering, besides the sin offering of atonement and the continual burnt offering, and its grain offering, and their drink offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Then on the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy assembly; you shall do no laborious work, and you shall celebrate with a feast to the LORD for seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall present a burnt offering, an offering by fire as a soothing aroma to the LORD: thirteen bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs one year old, which are without defect;

column.name: text
column.value: and their grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for ①each of the thirteen bulls, two-tenths for ②each of the two rams, ▷ ①Lit each bull of ②Lit each ram of

column.name: text
column.value: and a tenth for each of the fourteen lambs;

column.name: text
column.value: and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Then on the second day: twelve bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs one year old without defect;

column.name: text
column.value: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number according to the ordinance;

column.name: text
column.value: and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, and their drink offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Then on the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs one year old without defect;

column.name: text
column.value: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number according to the ordinance;

column.name: text
column.value: and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Then on the fourth day: ten bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs one year old without defect;

column.name: text
column.value: their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number according to the ordinance;

column.name: text
column.value: and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Then on the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs one year old without defect;

column.name: text
column.value: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number according to the ordinance;

column.name: text
column.value: and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Then on the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs one year old without defect;

column.name: text
column.value: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number according to the ordinance;

column.name: text
column.value: and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Then on the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs one year old without defect;

column.name: text
column.value: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number according to the ordinance;

column.name: text
column.value: and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘On the eighth day you shall have a sacred assembly; you shall do no laborious work.

column.name: text
column.value: But you shall present a burnt offering, an offering by fire, as a soothing aroma to the LORD: one bull, one ram, and seven male lambs one year old without defect;

column.name: text
column.value: their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, by their number according to the ordinance;

column.name: text
column.value: and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You shall present these to the LORD at your appointed times, besides your vowed offerings and your ①voluntary offerings, for your burnt offerings, your grain offerings, your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.’ ” ▷ ①Or freewill offerings

column.name: text
column.value: ①And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel in accordance with everything that the LORD had commanded Moses. ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: ①Then Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the sons of Israel, saying, “This is the word which the LORD has commanded: ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: If a man makes a vow to the LORD, or takes an oath to ①put himself under a binding obligation, he shall not break his word; he shall act in accordance with everything that comes out of his mouth. ▷ ①Lit bind on his soul, and similarly throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: “And if a woman makes a vow to the LORD, and puts herself under a binding obligation in her father’s house in her youth,

column.name: text
column.value: and her father hears her vow and her obligation under which she has put herself, and her father ①says nothing to her, then all her vows shall ②remain valid and every binding obligation under which she has put herself shall ③remain valid. ▷ ①Lit is silent to her, and so throughout the ch ②Lit stand, and so throughout the ch ③Lit stand, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: But if her father expresses disapproval to her on the day he hears of it, none of her vows or her obligations under which she has put herself shall remain valid; and the LORD will ①forgive her because her father has expressed disapproval to her. ▷ ①I.e., for not fulfilling them

column.name: text
column.value: “However, if she happens to ①marry while ②under her vows or the impulsive statement of her lips by which she has obligated herself, ▷ ①Lit become a husband’s ②Lit her vows are on her

column.name: text
column.value: and her husband hears of it and says nothing to her on the day he hears it, then her vows shall remain valid and her binding obligations under which she has put herself shall remain valid.

column.name: text
column.value: But if on the day her husband hears of it, he expresses disapproval to her, then he will annul her vow which ①she is under and the impulsive statement of her lips by which she has obligated herself; and the LORD will ②forgive her. ▷ ①Lit is on her ②I.e., for not fulfilling them

column.name: text
column.value: “But as for the vow of a widow or of a divorced woman, every binding obligation under which she has put herself, shall remain valid against her.

column.name: text
column.value: However, if a married woman vowed in her husband’s house, or put herself under a binding obligation with an oath,

column.name: text
column.value: and her husband heard it, but said nothing to her and did not express disapproval to her, then all her vows shall remain valid and every binding obligation under which she put herself shall remain valid.

column.name: text
column.value: But if her husband actually annuls them on the day he hears them, then no utterance from her lips concerning her vows or the obligation she put on herself shall remain valid; her husband has annulled them, and the LORD will ①forgive her. ▷ ①I.e., for not fulfilling them

column.name: text
column.value: “Every vow and every binding oath to humble herself, her husband may confirm it or her husband may annul it.

column.name: text
column.value: But if her husband in fact says nothing to her from day to day, then he confirms all her vows or all her binding obligations which are on her; he has confirmed them, because he said nothing to her on the day he heard them.

column.name: text
column.value: However, if he actually annuls them ①after he has heard them, then he shall bear the responsibility for her guilt.” ▷ ①I.e., perhaps a long delay before he annuls them

column.name: text
column.value: These are the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses concerning matters between a man and his wife, and between a father and his daughter while she is in her youth in her father’s house.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Take vengeance on the Midianites for the sons of Israel; afterward you will be gathered to your people.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for the war, so that they may ①go against Midian to execute the LORD’S vengeance on Midian. ▷ ①Lit be

column.name: text
column.value: You shall send a thousand from each tribe of all the tribes of Israel to the war.”

column.name: text
column.value: So there were selected from the thousands of Israel, a thousand from each tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses sent them, a thousand from each tribe, to the war, and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war with them, and the holy implements and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: So they made war against Midian, just as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they killed every male.

column.name: text
column.value: They killed the kings of Midian along with the rest of those killed: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Israel took captive the women of Midian and their little ones; and they plundered all their cattle, all their flocks, and all their property.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they ①burned all their cities where they lived and all their encampments. ▷ ①Lit burned with fire

column.name: text
column.value: And they took all the plunder and all the spoils, both of people and of livestock.

column.name: text
column.value: They brought the captives and the spoils and the plunder to Moses, to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the sons of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab which are by the Jordan, opposite Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses, Eleazar the priest, and all the leaders of the congregation went out to meet them outside the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: But Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds, who had come from service in the war.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to them, “Have you ①spared all the women? ▷ ①Lit let...live

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, they caused the sons of Israel, through the ①counsel of Balaam, to be unfaithful to the LORD in the matter of Peor, so that the plague took place among the congregation of the LORD! ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known a man ①intimately. ▷ ①Lit in bed with a man

column.name: text
column.value: However, all the ①girls who have not known a ②man intimately, keep alive for yourselves. ▷ ①Lit children among the women ②Lit man’s bed

column.name: text
column.value: And as for you, camp outside the camp for seven days; whoever has killed a person and whoever has touched anyone killed, purify yourselves, you and your captives, on the third day and on the seventh day.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall purify for yourselves every garment, every article of leather, every work of goats’ hair, and every article of wood.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who had gone to battle, “This is the statute of the Law which the LORD has commanded Moses:

column.name: text
column.value: only the gold and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

column.name: text
column.value: everything that can ①withstand the fire, you shall pass through the fire, and it will be clean, only it shall be purified with water for impurity. But whatever cannot ②withstand the fire you shall pass through the water. ▷ ①Lit come into ②Lit come into

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall wash your clothes on the seventh day and you will be clean; and afterward you may enter the camp.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “You and Eleazar the priest and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation take a count of the spoils ①that were captured, both of people and of livestock; ▷ ①Lit of captives

column.name: text
column.value: and divide the spoils between the warriors who went to battle and all the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: Also, collect a tribute tax for the LORD from the men of war who went to battle, one ①in five hundred of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the sheep; ▷ ①Lit soul from

column.name: text
column.value: take it from their half and give it to Eleazar the priest, as an ①offering to the LORD. ▷ ①Or uplifted offering, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: And from the sons of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn from every fifty of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the sheep, from all the animals; and give them to the Levites who perform the duty of the tabernacle of the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: Moses and Eleazar the priest did just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the spoils that remained from the plunder which the ①men of war had plundered was 675,000 sheep, ▷ ①Lit people

column.name: text
column.value: seventy-two thousand cattle,

column.name: text
column.value: sixty-one thousand donkeys,

column.name: text
column.value: and of captive people, of the women who had not known a ①man intimately, in all were thirty-two thousand people. ▷ ①Lit man’s bed

column.name: text
column.value: The half, the share of those who went to war, was as follows: the number of sheep was 337,500,

column.name: text
column.value: the LORD’S tribute tax of the sheep was 675;

column.name: text
column.value: the cattle were thirty-six thousand, from which the LORD’S tribute tax was seventy-two;

column.name: text
column.value: the donkeys were 30,500, from which the LORD’S tribute tax was sixty-one;

column.name: text
column.value: and the captive people were sixteen thousand, from whom the LORD’S tribute tax was thirty-two persons.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses gave the tribute tax, which was the LORD’S offering, to Eleazar the priest, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the sons of Israel’s half, which Moses ①separated from the men who had gone to war— ▷ ①Lit divided

column.name: text
column.value: now the congregation’s half was 337,500 sheep,

column.name: text
column.value: thirty-six thousand cattle,

column.name: text
column.value: 30,500 donkeys,

column.name: text
column.value: and the captive people were sixteen thousand—

column.name: text
column.value: from the sons of Israel’s half Moses took one drawn from every fifty, both of people and of animals, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of the tabernacle of the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the officers who were over the thousands of the army, the commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds, approached Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: and they said to Moses, “Your servants have taken a census of the men of war who are ①under our authority, and no man of us is missing. ▷ ①Lit in our hand

column.name: text
column.value: So we have brought as an offering to the LORD what each man found, articles of gold, armlets and bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for ourselves before the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from them, all kinds of crafted articles.

column.name: text
column.value: All the gold of the offering which they offered up to the LORD, from the commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds, was 16,750 shekels.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of war had taken plunder, every man for himself.

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it to the tent of meeting as a memorial for the sons of Israel before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad had a very large number of livestock. So when they saw the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead, that ①it was indeed a place suitable for livestock, ▷ ①Lit behold, the place, a place of

column.name: text
column.value: the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, Eleazar the priest, and to the leaders of the congregation, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,

column.name: text
column.value: the land which the LORD ①conquered before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock, and your servants have livestock.” ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants as our property; do not take us across the Jordan.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Moses said to the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben, “Should your brothers go to war while you remain here?

column.name: text
column.value: And why are you discouraging the ①sons of Israel from crossing over into the land which the LORD has given them? ▷ ①Lit heart of the sons

column.name: text
column.value: This is what your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.

column.name: text
column.value: For when they went up to the ①Valley of Eshcol and saw the land, they discouraged the ②sons of Israel so that they did not go into the land which the LORD had given them. ▷ ①Or wadi ②Lit heart of the sons

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD’S anger burned on that day, and He swore, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘None of the men who came up from Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; for they did not follow Me fully,

column.name: text
column.value: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua the son of Nun; for they have followed the LORD fully.’

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD’S anger burned against Israel, and He made them wander in the wilderness for forty years, until the entire generation of those who had done evil in the sight of the LORD came to an end.

column.name: text
column.value: Now behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, born of sinful men, to add still more to the burning anger of the LORD against Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: For if you turn away from following Him, He will once more leave them in the wilderness, and you will destroy all these people.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then they approached him and said, “We will build sheepfolds for our livestock here and cities for our little ones;

column.name: text
column.value: but we ourselves will be armed, hurrying ahead of the sons of Israel, until we have brought them to their place, while our little ones live in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: We will not return to our homes until every one of the sons of Israel has gained possession of his inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: But we will not have an inheritance with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan toward the east.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses said to them, “If you will do ①this, if you will arm yourselves before the LORD for the war, ▷ ①Lit this thing

column.name: text
column.value: and all of you armed men cross over the Jordan before the LORD until He has driven His enemies out from Him,

column.name: text
column.value: and the land is subdued before the LORD, then afterward you may return and be ①free of obligation toward the LORD and toward Israel, and this land shall be yours as property before the LORD. ▷ ①Lit blameless toward

column.name: text
column.value: But if you do not do so, behold, you have sinned against the LORD, and be sure that your sin will find you out.

column.name: text
column.value: Build yourselves cities for your little ones, and sheepfolds for your sheep, and do ①what you have promised.” ▷ ①Lit that which has gone out of your mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Then the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do just as my lord commands.

column.name: text
column.value: Our little ones, our wives, our livestock, and all our cattle shall ①remain there in the cities of Gilead, ▷ ①Lit be

column.name: text
column.value: while your servants, that is, everyone who is armed for war, cross over in the presence of the LORD to battle, just as my lord says.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses gave the command regarding them to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to them, “If the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben, everyone who is armed for battle, cross with you over the Jordan in the presence of the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead as their property;

column.name: text
column.value: but if they do not cross over with you armed, they shall instead be settled among you in the land of Canaan.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben answered, saying, “As the LORD has said to your servants, so we will do.

column.name: text
column.value: We ourselves will cross over armed in the presence of the LORD into the land of Canaan, and the property of our inheritance shall remain with us across the Jordan.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses gave to them, to the sons of Gad, the sons of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Joseph’s son Manasseh, the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og, the king of Bashan, the land with its cities with their ①territories, the cities of the surrounding land. ▷ ①Lit borders

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

column.name: text
column.value: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,

column.name: text
column.value: Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran as fortified cities, and sheepfolds for sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,

column.name: text
column.value: Nebo, and Baal-meon—their names being changed—and Sibmah, and they gave other names to the cities which they built.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead and took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were in it.

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh, and he lived in it.

column.name: text
column.value: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its ①towns, and called them ②Havvoth-jair. ▷ ①Lit tent villages ②I.e., the towns of Jair

column.name: text
column.value: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and named it Nobah, after his own name.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Command the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘You shall be careful to present to Me My offering, My food for My offerings by fire, of a soothing aroma to Me, at their appointed time.’

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall say to them, ‘This is the offering by fire which you shall offer to the LORD: two male lambs one year old without defect as a continual burnt offering every day.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and the other lamb you shall offer ①at twilight; ▷ ①Lit between the two evenings; i.e., the time between sunset and nightfall

column.name: text
column.value: also a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with a fourth of a ①hin of pure oil. ▷ ①About 1 gallon or 3.8 liters, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained on Mount Sinai as a soothing aroma, an offering by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the drink offering with it shall be a fourth of a hin for each lamb; in the Holy Place pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The other lamb you shall offer ①at twilight; as the grain offering of the morning and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering by fire, a soothing aroma to the LORD. ▷ ①See note v 4

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Then on the Sabbath day two male lambs one year old without defect, and two-tenths of an ①ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, and its drink offering: ▷ ①About 1 cubic foot or 0.03 cubic meters, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: This is the burnt offering of every Sabbath in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Then at the beginning of each of your months you shall present a burnt offering to the LORD: two ①bulls and one ram, seven male lambs one year old without defect; ▷ ①Lit bulls, sons of the herd

column.name: text
column.value: and three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, for each bull; and two-tenths of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, for the one ram;

column.name: text
column.value: and a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering for each lamb, as a burnt offering of a soothing aroma, an offering by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull and a third of a hin for the ram and a fourth of a hin for a lamb; this is the burnt offering of each month throughout the months of the year.

column.name: text
column.value: And one male goat as a sin offering to the LORD; it shall be offered with its drink offering in addition to the continual burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘The LORD’S Passover shall be on the fourteenth day of the first month.

column.name: text
column.value: On the fifteenth day of this month there shall be a feast; unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: On the first day there shall be a holy assembly; you shall do no laborious work.

column.name: text
column.value: But you shall present an offering by fire, a burnt offering to the LORD: two ①bulls and one ram, and seven male lambs one year old, that you have without defect. ▷ ①Lit bulls, sons of the herd

column.name: text
column.value: For their grain offering, you shall offer fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for a bull, and two-tenths for the ram.

column.name: text
column.value: A tenth of an ephah you shall offer for ①each of the seven lambs; ▷ ①Lit each lamb of

column.name: text
column.value: and one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall present these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: In this way you shall present daily, for seven days, the food of the offering by fire, of a soothing aroma to the LORD; it shall be presented with its drink offering in addition to the continual burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: On the seventh day you shall have a holy assembly; you shall do no laborious work.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Also on the day of the first fruits, when you present a new grain offering to the LORD in your Feast of Weeks, you shall have a holy assembly; you shall do no laborious work.

column.name: text
column.value: But you shall offer a burnt offering as a soothing aroma to the LORD: two bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs one year old;

column.name: text
column.value: and as their grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for each bull, two-tenths for the one ram,

column.name: text
column.value: and a tenth for ①each of the seven lambs; ▷ ①Lit each lamb of

column.name: text
column.value: also one male goat to make atonement for you.

column.name: text
column.value: Besides the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, you shall present them with their drink offerings. They shall be without ①defect. ▷ ①Lit defect to you

column.name: text
column.value: These are the journeys of the sons of Israel, by which they came out of the land of Egypt by their armies, ①under the leadership of Moses and Aaron. ▷ ①Lit by the hand

column.name: text
column.value: Moses recorded their starting places according to their journeys by the ①command of the LORD, and these are their journeys according to their starting places. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Now they journeyed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the day after the Passover the sons of Israel started out ①boldly in the sight of all the Egyptians, ▷ ①Lit with a high hand

column.name: text
column.value: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn whom the LORD had fatally struck among them. The LORD had also executed judgments against their gods.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the sons of Israel journeyed from Rameses and camped in Succoth.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Succoth and camped in Etham, which is on the edge of the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they journeyed from Etham and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, which faces Baal-zephon; and they camped before Migdol.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed ①from Pi-hahiroth and passed through the midst of the sea to the wilderness; and they went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham and camped at Marah. ▷ ①Many mss and some ancient versions; MT from before Hahiroth

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Marah and came to Elim; and in Elim there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Elim and camped by the ①Red Sea. ▷ ①Lit Sea of Reeds

column.name: text
column.value: And they journeyed from the ①Red Sea and camped in the wilderness of Sin. ▷ ①Lit Sea of Reeds

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from the wilderness of Sin and camped at Dophkah.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Dophkah and camped at Alush.

column.name: text
column.value: And they journeyed from Alush and camped at Rephidim; now it was there that the people had no water to drink.

column.name: text
column.value: And they journeyed from Rephidim and camped in the wilderness of Sinai.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from the wilderness of Sinai, and camped at Kibroth-hattaavah.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Kibroth-hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon-perez.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Rimmon-perez and camped at Libnah.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Libnah and camped at Rissah.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Rissah and camped in Kehelathah.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Tahath and camped at Terah.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Terah and camped at Mithkah.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Moseroth and camped at Bene-jaakan.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Bene-jaakan and camped at Hor-haggidgad.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Hor-haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Abronah and camped at Ezion-geber.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Ezion-geber and camped in the wilderness of Zin, that is, Kadesh.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, at the edge of the land of Edom.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Aaron the priest went up to Mount Hor at the ①command of the LORD, and died there in the fortieth year after the sons of Israel had come from the land of Egypt, on the first day in the fifth month. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron was 123 years old when he died on Mount Hor.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Canaanite, the king of Arad ①who lived in the ②Negev in the land of Canaan, heard about the coming of the sons of Israel. ▷ ①Lit and he ②I.e., South country

column.name: text
column.value: Then they journeyed from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Punon and camped at Oboth.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim, at the border of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Iyim and camped at Dibon-gad.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

column.name: text
column.value: They journeyed from the mountains of Abarim and camped in the plains of Moab, by the Jordan opposite Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: They camped by the Jordan, from Beth-jeshimoth as far as Abel-shittim, in the plains of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan opposite Jericho, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

column.name: text
column.value: you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from you, and destroy all their idolatrous sculptures, destroy all their cast metal images, and eliminate all their high places;

column.name: text
column.value: and you shall take possession of the land and live in it, for I have given the land to you to possess it.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall maintain the land as an inheritance by lot according to your families; to the larger you shall give more inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give less inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to anyone, that shall be his. You shall pass on land as an inheritance according to the tribes of your fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from you, then it will come about that those whom you let remain of them will be like thorns in your eyes and like pricks in your sides, and they will trouble you in the land in which you live.

column.name: text
column.value: And just as I plan to do to them, I will do to you.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Now the heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came forward and spoke before Moses and before the leaders, the heads of the fathers’ households of the sons of Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: and they said, “The LORD commanded my lord to give the land by lot to the sons of Israel as an inheritance, and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: But if they ①marry one of the sons of the other tribes of the sons of Israel, their inheritance will be withdrawn from the inheritance of our fathers and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they belong; so it will be withdrawn from our allotted inheritance. ▷ ①Lit become wives to, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: And when the jubilee of the sons of Israel takes place, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they belong; so their inheritance will be withdrawn from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses commanded the sons of Israel in accordance with the ①word of the LORD, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph is right in its statements. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: This is ①what the LORD has commanded regarding the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them marry ②whomever they wish; only they must marry within the family of the tribe of their father.’ ▷ ①Lit the word which ②Lit the good one in their eyes

column.name: text
column.value: So no inheritance of the sons of Israel will ①be transferred from tribe to tribe, for the sons of Israel shall each ②retain possession of the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers. ▷ ①Lit turn about ②Lit cling to

column.name: text
column.value: And every daughter who comes into possession of an inheritance of any tribe of the sons of Israel shall marry one of the family of the tribe of her father, so that the sons of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: So no inheritance will ①be transferred from one tribe to another tribe, for the tribes of the sons of Israel shall each ②retain possession of its own inheritance.” ▷ ①Lit turn about ②Lit cling to

column.name: text
column.value: Just as the LORD had commanded Moses, so the daughters of Zelophehad did:

column.name: text
column.value: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad married their uncles’ sons.

column.name: text
column.value: They married those from the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance ①remained with the tribe of the family of their father. ▷ ①Lit was to the

column.name: text
column.value: These are the commandments and the ordinances which the LORD commanded to the sons of Israel through Moses in the plains of Moab, by the Jordan opposite Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Command the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When you enter the land of Canaan, this is the land that shall fall to you as an inheritance, that is, the land of Canaan according to its borders.

column.name: text
column.value: Your southern region shall ①extend from the wilderness of Zin along the side of Edom, and your southern border shall ②extend from the end of the Salt Sea eastward. ▷ ①Lit be ②Lit be

column.name: text
column.value: Then your border shall change direction from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim and ①continue to Zin, and its ②termination shall be to the south of Kadesh-barnea; and it shall ③reach Hazaraddar and ④continue to Azmon. ▷ ①Lit pass along ②Lit exits, and so throughout the ch ③Lit go forth to ④Lit pass along

column.name: text
column.value: Then the border shall change direction from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and its termination shall be at the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘As for the western border, you shall have the Great Sea, that is, its ①coastline; this shall be your western border. ▷ ①Lit border

column.name: text
column.value: ‘And this shall be your northern border: you shall draw your boundary from the Great Sea to Mount Hor.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall draw a boundary from Mount Hor to the ①Lebo-hamath, and the termination of the border shall be at Zedad; ▷ ①Or entrance of Hamath

column.name: text
column.value: and the border shall proceed to Ziphron, and its termination shall be at Hazar-enan. This shall be your northern border.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘For your eastern border you shall also draw a boundary from Hazar-enan to Shepham,

column.name: text
column.value: and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain; and the border shall go down and reach to the slope on the east side of the Sea of Chinnereth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the border shall go down to the Jordan, and its termination shall be at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders on all sides.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses commanded the sons of Israel, saying, “This is the land that you are to possess by lot, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine and a half tribes.

column.name: text
column.value: For the tribe of the sons of Reuben have received theirs according to their fathers’ households, and the tribe of the sons of Gad according to their fathers’ households, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their possession.

column.name: text
column.value: The two and a half tribes have received their possession across the Jordan opposite Jericho, eastward toward the sunrise.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “These are the names of the men who shall assign the land to you as an inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall take one leader of each tribe to assign the land as an inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the names of the men: of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of the sons of Simeon, Samuel the son of Ammihud.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the tribe of the sons of Dan, a leader, Bukki the son of Jogli.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Joseph: of the tribe of the sons of Manasseh, a leader, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of the sons of Ephraim, a leader, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of the sons of Zebulun, a leader, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of the sons of Issachar, a leader, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of the sons of Asher, a leader, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali, a leader, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”

column.name: text
column.value: These are the ones whom the LORD commanded to apportion the inheritance to the sons of Israel in the land of Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the words that Moses spoke to all Israel across the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah opposite ①Suph, between Paran and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab. ▷ ①Perhaps the Red Sea

column.name: text
column.value: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by way of Mount Seir to Kadesh-barnea.

column.name: text
column.value: In the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, in accordance with everything that the LORD had commanded him to declare to them,

column.name: text
column.value: after he had ①defeated Sihon the king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth ②and in Edrei. ▷ ①Lit struck ②So ancient versions; MT omits and

column.name: text
column.value: Across the Jordan in the land of Moab, Moses began to explain this Law, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “The LORD our God spoke to us at Horeb, saying, ‘You have stayed long enough at this mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: Turn and set out on your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites, and to all their neighbors in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland, in the ①Negev, by the seacoast, the land of the Canaanites, and Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates. ▷ ①I.e., South country

column.name: text
column.value: See, I have placed the land before you; go in and take possession of the land which the LORD swore to give to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, and their ①descendants after them.’ ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: “And I spoke to you at that time, saying, ‘I am not able to endure you alone.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are this day like the stars of heaven in number.

column.name: text
column.value: May the LORD, the God of your fathers increase you a thousand times more than you are, and bless you, just as He has ①promised you! ▷ ①Lit spoken to

column.name: text
column.value: How can I alone endure the burden and weight of you and your strife?

column.name: text
column.value: Obtain for yourselves men who are wise, discerning, and informed from your tribes, and I will appoint them as your heads.’

column.name: text
column.value: And you answered me and said, ‘The thing which you have said to do is good.’

column.name: text
column.value: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and informed men, and ①appointed them as heads over you, commanders of thousands, ②hundreds, ③fifties, and ④tens, and officers for your tribes. ▷ ①Lit commanders of ②Lit gave them as ③Lit commanders of ④Lit commanders of

column.name: text
column.value: “Then I ordered your judges at that time, saying, ‘Hear the cases between your fellow countrymen and judge righteously between a person and his fellow countryman, or the stranger who is with him.

column.name: text
column.value: You are not to ①show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You are not to be afraid of any person, for the judgment is God’s. The case that is too difficult for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it.’ ▷ ①Lit recognize faces

column.name: text
column.value: At that time I commanded you all the things that you were to do.

column.name: text
column.value: “Then we set out from Horeb, and went through all that great and terrible wilderness that you saw on the way to the hill country of the Amorites, just as the LORD our God had commanded us; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to you, ‘You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God is about to give us.

column.name: text
column.value: See, the LORD your God has placed the land before you; go up, take possession, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has spoken to you. Do not fear or be dismayed.’

column.name: text
column.value: “Then all of you approached me and said, ‘Let us send men ahead of us, so that they may spy out the land for us, and bring back to us word of the way by which we should go up, and the cities which we should enter.’

column.name: text
column.value: The ①plan pleased me, and I took twelve of your men, one man for each tribe. ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: Then they turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the Valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took some of the fruit of the land in their hands and brought it down to us. They also brought us back a report and said, ‘The land that the LORD our God is about to give us is good.’

column.name: text
column.value: “Yet you were unwilling to go up; instead you rebelled against the ①command of the LORD your God; ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: and you grumbled in your tents and said, ‘Because the LORD hates us, He has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to hand us over to the Amorites to destroy us.

column.name: text
column.value: Where can we go up? Our brothers have made our hearts melt, by saying, “The people are bigger and taller than we; the cities are large and fortified up to heaven. And besides, we saw the sons of the Anakim there.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: But I said to you, ‘Do not be terrified, nor fear them.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD your God, who goes before you, will Himself fight for you, ①just as He did for you in Egypt before your eyes, ▷ ①Lit according to all that

column.name: text
column.value: and in the wilderness where you saw how the LORD your God carried you, just as a man carries his son, on all of the road which you have walked until you came to this place.’

column.name: text
column.value: Yet ①in spite of all this, you did not trust the LORD your God, ▷ ①Lit in this matter

column.name: text
column.value: who goes before you on your way, to seek out a place for you to make camp, in the fire by night to show you the way by which you should go, and in the cloud by day.

column.name: text
column.value: “Then the LORD heard the sound of your words, and He was angry and swore an oath, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Not one of these men, this evil generation, shall see the good land which I swore to give your fathers,

column.name: text
column.value: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him I will give the land on which he has set foot, and to his sons, because he has followed the LORD fully.’

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD was angry with me also on your account, saying, ‘Not even you shall enter there.

column.name: text
column.value: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall himself enter there; encourage him, for he will give it to Israel as an inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, your little ones who, you said, would become plunder, and your sons, who this day have no knowledge of good and evil, shall enter there, and I will give it to them and they shall take possession of it.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for you, turn around and set out for the wilderness by the way of the ①Red Sea.’ ▷ ①Lit Sea of Reeds

column.name: text
column.value: “Then you replied to me, ‘We have sinned against the LORD; we ourselves will go up and fight, just as the LORD our God commanded us.’ And every man of you strapped on his weapons of war, and you viewed it as easy to go up into the hill country.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD said to me, ‘Say to them, “Do not go up nor fight, for I am not among you; otherwise you will be ①defeated ②by your enemies.” ’ ▷ ①Lit struck ②Lit before

column.name: text
column.value: So I spoke to you, but you would not listen. Instead, you rebelled against the ①command of the LORD, and acted presumptuously and went up into the hill country. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: And the Amorites who lived in that hill country came out against you and chased you as bees do, and they scattered you from Seir to Hormah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you returned and wept before the LORD; but the LORD did not listen to your voice, nor pay attention to you.

column.name: text
column.value: So you remained at Kadesh for many days, ①the days that you spent there. ▷ ①Lit as the days

column.name: text
column.value: “Then we turned and went up the road to Bashan, and Og, king of Bashan, came out ①with all his people to meet us in battle at Edrei. ▷ ①Lit he and

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD said to me, ‘Do not fear him, for I have handed him and all his people and his land over to you; and you shall do to him just as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon.’

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD our God also handed over to us Og, king of Bashan, with all his people, and we struck ①them until no survivor was ②left. ▷ ①Lit him ②Lit left to him

column.name: text
column.value: We captured all his cities at that time; there was not a city which we did not take from them: sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

column.name: text
column.value: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, besides a great many ①unwalled towns. ▷ ①Or rural

column.name: text
column.value: We ①utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, ②utterly destroying ③the men, women, and children of every city. ▷ ①Or put them under the ban ②Or putting under the ban ③Lit every city of men...

column.name: text
column.value: But all the animals and the spoils of the cities we took as our plunder.

column.name: text
column.value: “So at that time we took the land from the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the ①Valley of Arnon to Mount Hermon ▷ ①Or wadi

column.name: text
column.value: (Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir):

column.name: text
column.value: all the cities of the plateau, all Gilead, and all Bashan, as far as Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

column.name: text
column.value: (For only Og king of Bashan was left of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his ①bed was a ②bed of iron; it is in Rabbah of the sons of Ammon. Its length was nine cubits, and its width four cubits by ③the usual cubit.) ▷ ①Or couch ②Or couch ③Lit by a man’s forearm; about 14 ft. long and 6 ft. wide or 4 m and 1.8 m

column.name: text
column.value: “So we took possession of this land at that time. From Aroer, which is by the ①Valley of Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead and its cities I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites. ▷ ①Or wadi

column.name: text
column.value: The rest of Gilead and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh, all the region of Argob. (As to all Bashan, it is called the land of Rephaim.

column.name: text
column.value: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, that is, Bashan, and named ①it after his own name: ②Havvoth-jair, as it is to this day.) ▷ ①Lit them ②I.e., the towns of Jair

column.name: text
column.value: To Machir I gave Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: To the Reubenites and the Gadites I gave from Gilead even as far as the ①Valley of Arnon, the middle of the ②valley ③as a border, and as far as the ④river Jabbok, the border of the sons of Ammon; ▷ ①Or wadi ②Or wadi ③Lit and ④Or wadi

column.name: text
column.value: the Arabah also, with the Jordan ①as a border, from ②Chinnereth even as far as the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, ③at the foot of the slopes of Pisgah on the east. ▷ ①Lit and ②I.e., the Sea of Galilee ③Lit under

column.name: text
column.value: “Then I commanded you at that time, saying, ‘The LORD your God has given you this land to possess it; all you ①valiant men shall cross over armed ahead of your brothers, the sons of Israel. ▷ ①Lit sons of valor

column.name: text
column.value: However, your wives, your little ones, and your livestock (I know that you have much livestock) shall remain in your cities which I have given you,

column.name: text
column.value: until the LORD gives rest to your fellow countrymen as to you, and they also take possession of the land which the LORD your God is giving them beyond the Jordan. Then you may return, each man to his possession which I have given you.’

column.name: text
column.value: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, ‘Your eyes have seen everything that the LORD your God has done to these two kings; the LORD will do the same to all the kingdoms into which you are about to cross.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not fear them, for the LORD your God is the One fighting for you.’

column.name: text
column.value: “I also pleaded with the LORD at that time, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Lord ①GOD, You have begun to show Your servant Your greatness and Your strong hand; for what god is there in heaven or on earth who can do such works and mighty acts as Yours? ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Please let me cross over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, ①that good hill country, and Lebanon.’ ▷ ①Lit this

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD was angry with me on your account, and would not listen to me; instead, the LORD said to me, ‘ ①Enough! Do not speak to Me any more about this matter. ▷ ①Lit Much for you

column.name: text
column.value: Go up to the top of Pisgah and raise your eyes to the west, the north, the south, and the east, and see it with your eyes; for you shall not cross over this Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: But commission Joshua and encourage him and strengthen him, for he shall go across ①leading this people, and he will give to them, as an inheritance, the land which you will see.’ ▷ ①Lit before this

column.name: text
