column.value: So we remained in the valley opposite Beth-peor.

column.name: text
column.value: “Then we turned and set out for the wilderness by the way of the ①Red Sea, as the LORD spoke to me, and we circled Mount Seir for many days. ▷ ①Lit Sea of Reeds

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You have circled this mountain long enough. Now turn north,

column.name: text
column.value: and command the people, saying, “You are going to pass through the territory of your brothers the sons of Esau, who live in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. So be very careful;

column.name: text
column.value: do not ①provoke them, for I will not give you any of their land, not even as much as a ②footprint, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau as a possession. ▷ ①Or engage in strife with ②Lit treading of a sole of a foot

column.name: text
column.value: You are to buy food from them with money so that you may eat, and you shall also purchase water from them with money so that you may drink.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD your God has blessed you in all ①that you have done; He has known your ②wandering through this great wilderness. These forty years the LORD your God has been with you; you have not lacked anything.” ’ ▷ ①Lit the work of your hand ②Lit going

column.name: text
column.value: “So we passed beyond our brothers the sons of Esau, who live in Seir, away from the Arabah road, away from Elath and Ezion-geber. And we turned and passed through by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me, ‘Do not attack Moab, nor provoke them to war, for I will not give you any of ①their land as a possession, because I have given Ar to the sons of Lot as a possession.’ ▷ ①Lit his

column.name: text
column.value: (The Emim lived there previously, a people as great, numerous, and tall as the Anakim.

column.name: text
column.value: Like the Anakim, they too are regarded as Rephaim, but the Moabites call them Emim.

column.name: text
column.value: The Horites previously lived in Seir, but the sons of Esau dispossessed them and destroyed them from before ①them, and settled in their place; just as Israel did to the land of ②their possession which the LORD gave them.) ▷ ①I.e., the sons of Esau ②Lit his

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now arise and cross over the ①Wadi Zered yourselves.’ So we crossed over the ②Wadi Zered. ▷ ①I.e., dry stream bed, except in the rainy season ②I.e., dry stream bed, except in the rainy season

column.name: text
column.value: Now the ①time that it took for us to come from Kadesh-barnea until we crossed over the ②Wadi Zered was thirty-eight years, until all the generation of the men of war perished from within the camp, just as the LORD had sworn to them. ▷ ①Lit days in which we went ②See note v 13

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from within the camp until they all perished.

column.name: text
column.value: “So it came about, when all the men of war had finally perished from among the people,

column.name: text
column.value: that the LORD spoke to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Today you shall cross over Ar, the border of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: When you come opposite the sons of Ammon, do not attack them nor provoke them, for I will not give you any of the land of the sons of Ammon as a possession, because I have given it to the sons of Lot as a possession.’

column.name: text
column.value: (It is also regarded as the land of the Rephaim, because the Rephaim previously lived in it, but the Ammonites call them Zamzummin,

column.name: text
column.value: a people as great, numerous, and tall as the Anakim; but the LORD destroyed them before ①them. And they dispossessed them and settled in their place, ▷ ①I.e., the Ammonites

column.name: text
column.value: just as He did for the sons of Esau, who live in Seir, when He destroyed the Horites from before them; they dispossessed them and settled in their place, where they remain even to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And as for the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza, the ①Caphtorim, who came from ②Caphtor, destroyed them and lived in their place.) ▷ ①I.e., Philistines ②I.e., Crete

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Arise, set out, and pass through the ①Valley of Arnon. Look! I have handed over to you Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; start taking possession and plunge into battle with him. ▷ ①Or wadi

column.name: text
column.value: This day I will begin to put the dread and fear of you upon the faces of ①people everywhere, ②who, when they hear the news of you, will tremble and be in anguish because of you.’ ▷ ①Lit peoples under all the heavens ②Lit who will hear...and tremble

column.name: text
column.value: “So I sent messengers from the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Let me pass through your land; I will ①travel only on the road. I will not turn aside to the right or to the left. ▷ ①Lit go on the road, on the road

column.name: text
column.value: You will sell me food for money so that I may eat, and give me water for money so that I may drink, only let me pass through on ①foot, ▷ ①Lit my feet

column.name: text
column.value: just as the sons of Esau who live in Seir and the Moabites who live in Ar did for me, until I cross over the Jordan into the land that the LORD our God is giving us.’

column.name: text
column.value: But Sihon king of Heshbon was not willing for us to pass ①through his land; for the LORD your God hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, in order to hand him over to you, as he is today. ▷ ①Lit by him

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, ‘See, I have begun to turn Sihon and his land over ①to you. Begin taking possession, so that you may possess his land.’ ▷ ①Lit before you

column.name: text
column.value: “Then Sihon came out ①with all his people to meet us in battle at Jahaz. ▷ ①Lit he and

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD our God turned him over ①to us, and we ②defeated him with his sons and all his people. ▷ ①Lit before us ②Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: So we captured all his cities at that time and ①utterly destroyed ②the men, women, and children of every city. We left no survivor. ▷ ①Or put under the ban ②Lit every city of men...

column.name: text
column.value: We took only the animals as our plunder, and the spoils of the cities which we had captured.

column.name: text
column.value: From Aroer which is on the edge of the ①Valley of Arnon and from the city which is in the ②valley, even to Gilead, there was no city that was too ③high for us; the LORD our God turned it all over ④to us. ▷ ①Or wadi ②Or wadi ③Or strong ④Lit before us

column.name: text
column.value: Only you did not go near the land of the sons of Ammon, all along the ①river Jabbok and the cities of the hill country, and wherever the LORD our God had commanded us to avoid. ▷ ①Or wadi

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab, by the Jordan opposite Jericho, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Command the sons of Israel that they give to the Levites from the inheritance of their possession cities to live in; and you shall give to the Levites pasture lands around the cities.

column.name: text
column.value: The cities shall be theirs to live in; and their pasture lands shall be for their cattle and for their equipment and for all their other animals.

column.name: text
column.value: “The pasture lands of the cities which you are to give to the Levites shall extend from the wall of the city ①outward a thousand cubits around. ▷ ①Lit and outward

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also measure outside the city on the east side two thousand cubits, on the south side two thousand cubits, on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits, with the city in the center. This shall become theirs as pasture lands for the cities.

column.name: text
column.value: The cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall provide for the one who commits manslaughter to flee to; and in addition to them you shall give forty-two cities.

column.name: text
column.value: The total number of the cities which you are to give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities, ①together with their pasture lands. ▷ ①Lit them together with

column.name: text
column.value: As for the cities which you shall give them from the possession of the sons of Israel, you shall take more from the larger, and you shall take fewer from the smaller; each shall give some of his cities to the Levites in proportion to his inheritance which he possesses.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

column.name: text
column.value: then you shall select for yourselves cities to be your cities of refuge, so that the one who commits manslaughter by ①killing a person unintentionally may flee there. ▷ ①Lit fatally striking

column.name: text
column.value: The cities shall ①serve you as a refuge from the avenger, so that the one who commits manslaughter does not die until he stands before the congregation for ②trial. ▷ ①Lit be to you ②Lit judgment

column.name: text
column.value: So the cities which you are to provide shall be six cities of refuge for you.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall provide three cities across the Jordan, and three cities ①in the land of Canaan; they are to be cities of refuge. ▷ ①Lit you shall give in

column.name: text
column.value: These six cities shall be a refuge for the sons of Israel, for the stranger, and for the foreign resident among them; so that anyone who ①kills a person unintentionally may flee there. ▷ ①Lit strikes

column.name: text
column.value: ‘But if he struck him with an iron object, so that he died, he is a murderer; the murderer must be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which he would die, and as a result he did die, he is a murderer; the murderer must be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: Or if he struck him with a wooden object in the hand, by which he would die, and as a result he did die, he is a murderer; the murderer must be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: The blood avenger himself shall put the murderer to death; he himself shall put him to death when he meets him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now if he pushed him in hatred, or he threw something at him ①with malicious intent, and as a result he died, ▷ ①Lit in pursuit

column.name: text
column.value: or if he struck him with his hand with hostility, and as a result he died, the one who struck him must be put to death; he is a murderer. The blood avenger shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘But if he pushed him suddenly, without hostility, or threw any object at him without ①malicious intent, ▷ ①Lit pursuit

column.name: text
column.value: or had any ①deadly stone, and without looking he dropped it on him so that he died, while he was not his enemy nor was he seeking ②to harm him, ▷ ①Lit stone by which he would die ②Lit his harm

column.name: text
column.value: then the congregation shall judge between the one who fatally struck the victim and the blood avenger in accordance with these ordinances.

column.name: text
column.value: And the congregation shall save the one who committed manslaughter from the hand of the blood avenger, and the congregation shall return him to his city of refuge to which he fled; and he shall live in it until the death of the high priest who was anointed with the holy oil.

column.name: text
column.value: But if at any time ①he goes beyond the border of his city of refuge to which he flees, ▷ ①Lit the one who committed manslaughter

column.name: text
column.value: and the blood avenger finds him outside the border of his city of refuge, and the blood avenger kills ①him, he ②will not be guilty of bloodshed, ▷ ①Lit the one who committed manslaughter ②Lit he has no bloodguilt

column.name: text
column.value: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest the one who committed manslaughter may return to the land of his property.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘These things shall be a statutory ordinance for you throughout your generations in all your dwelling places.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘If anyone kills a person, the murderer shall be put to death on the ①testimony of witnesses, but no person shall be put to death on the testimony of only one witness. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, you shall not accept a ransom for the life of a murderer who is ①condemned to death, but he must be put to death. ▷ ①Lit guilty

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall not accept a ransom for one who has fled to his city of refuge, so that he may return to live in the land ①before the death of the priest. ▷ ①Or until

column.name: text
column.value: So you shall not defile the land in which you live; for blood defiles the land, and no atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed on it, except by the blood of the one who shed it.

column.name: text
column.value: So you shall not defile the land in which you live, in the midst of which I dwell; for I the LORD am dwelling in the midst of the sons of Israel.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Now Moses summoned all Israel and said to them: “Listen, Israel, to the statutes and ordinances which I am speaking today ①for you to hear, so that you may learn them and be careful to do them. ▷ ①Lit in your ears

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD did not make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, all ①of us who are alive here today. ▷ ①Lit these of us ourselves

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD spoke with you face to face at the mountain from the midst of the fire,

column.name: text
column.value: while I was standing between the LORD and you at that time, to declare to you the word of the LORD; for you were afraid because of the fire, and you did not go up on the mountain. ①He said, ▷ ①Lit saying

column.name: text
column.value: ‘I am the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of ①slavery. ▷ ①Lit slaves

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You shall have no other gods besides Me.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You shall not make for yourself a carved image, or any ①likeness of what is in heaven above ②or on the earth beneath ③or in the water under the earth. ▷ ①Or manifestation ②Lit or what is on ③Lit or what is on

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not worship them nor serve them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, inflicting the ①punishment of the fathers on the children, ②even on the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me, ▷ ①I.e., punishment for the wrongdoing ②Or and on

column.name: text
column.value: but showing ①favor to thousands, to those who love Me and keep My commandments. ▷ ①Or faithfulness

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You shall not take the name of the LORD your God ①in vain, for the LORD will not ②leave unpunished the one who takes His name in vain. ▷ ①I.e., uselessly or abusively ②Or hold guiltless

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Keep the Sabbath day to treat it as holy, as the LORD your God commanded you.

column.name: text
column.value: For six days you ①shall labor and do all your work, ▷ ①Or may

column.name: text
column.value: but the seventh day is a Sabbath of the LORD your God; you shall not do any work that day, you or your son or your daughter, or your male slave or your female slave, or your ox, your donkey, or any of your cattle, or your ①resident who ②stays with you, so that your male slave and your female slave may rest as well as you. ▷ ①Lit stranger ②Lit is in your gates

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm; therefore the LORD your God commanded you to ①celebrate the Sabbath day. ▷ ①Lit perform

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Honor your father and your mother, just as the LORD your God has commanded you, so that your days may be prolonged and that it may go well for you on the land which the LORD your God is giving you.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You shall not murder.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You shall not commit adultery.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You shall not steal.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor desire your neighbor’s house, his field, his male slave or his female slave, his ox, his donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.’

column.name: text
column.value: “These words the LORD spoke to your whole assembly at the mountain from the midst of the fire, from the cloud, and from the thick darkness, with a great voice, and He added nothing more. He wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And when you heard the voice from the midst of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you approached me, all the heads of your tribes and your elders.

column.name: text
column.value: You said, ‘Behold, the LORD our God has shown us His glory and His greatness, and we have heard His voice from the midst of the fire; we have seen today that God speaks with mankind, yet he lives.

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us; if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any longer, then we will die!

column.name: text
column.value: For who is there of ①humanity who has heard the voice of the living God speaking from the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived? ▷ ①Lit all flesh

column.name: text
column.value: ①Go near and listen to everything that the LORD our God says; then speak to us everything that the LORD our God speaks to you, and we will listen and do it.’ ▷ ①Lit Go yourself

column.name: text
column.value: “Now the LORD heard the sound of your words when you spoke to me, and the LORD said to me, ‘I have heard the sound of the words of this people which they have spoken to you. They have done well in all that they have spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: If only they had such a heart in them, to fear Me and keep all My commandments always, so that it would go well with them and with their sons forever!

column.name: text
column.value: Go, say to them, “Return to your tents.”

column.name: text
column.value: But as for you, stand here by Me, that I may speak to you all the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments which you shall teach them, so that they may ①follow them in the land which I am giving them to possess.’ ▷ ①Lit perform

column.name: text
column.value: So you shall be careful to do just as the LORD your God has commanded you; you shall not turn aside to the right or to the left.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall walk ①entirely in the way which the LORD your God has commanded you, so that you may live and that it may be well for you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you will possess. ▷ ①Lit in all the way of

column.name: text
column.value: “Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and the judgments which I am teaching you to perform, so that you will live and go in and take possession of the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, is giving you.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not add to the word which I am commanding you, nor take away from it, so that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I am commanding you.

column.name: text
column.value: Your eyes have seen what the LORD has done in the case of Baal-peor, for all the men who followed Baal-peor, the LORD your God has destroyed ①them from among you. ▷ ①Lit him

column.name: text
column.value: But you who clung to the LORD your God are alive today, every one of you.

column.name: text
column.value: “See, I have taught you statutes and judgments just as the LORD my God commanded me, that you are to do these things in the land where you are entering to take possession of it.

column.name: text
column.value: So keep and do them, for that is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who will hear all these statutes and say, ‘Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.’

column.name: text
column.value: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to it as is the LORD our God whenever we call on Him?

column.name: text
column.value: Or what great nation is there that has statutes and judgments as righteous as this whole Law which I am setting before you today?

column.name: text
column.value: “Only be careful for yourself and watch over your soul diligently, so that you do not forget the things which your eyes have seen and they do not depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your sons and your grandsons.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember the day you stood before the LORD your God at Horeb, when the LORD said to me, ‘Assemble the people to Me, that I may have them hear My words so that they may learn to ①fear Me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.’ ▷ ①Or revere

column.name: text
column.value: You came forward and stood at the foot of the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire to the heart of the heavens: darkness, cloud, and thick gloom.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to you from the midst of the fire; you heard the sound of words, but you saw no form—there was only a voice.

column.name: text
column.value: So He declared to you His covenant which He commanded you to perform, that is, the Ten ①Commandments; and He wrote them on two tablets of stone. ▷ ①Lit Words

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, so that you would perform them in the land where you are going over to take possession of it.

column.name: text
column.value: “So be very careful ①yourselves, since you did not see any form on the day the LORD spoke to you at Horeb from the midst of the fire, ▷ ①Or for your own lives

column.name: text
column.value: so that you do not act corruptly and make a carved image for yourselves in the form of any figure, a representation of male or female,

column.name: text
column.value: a representation of any animal that is on the earth, a representation of any winged bird that flies in the sky,

column.name: text
column.value: a representation of anything that crawls on the ground, or a representation of any fish that is in the water below the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And be careful not to raise your eyes to heaven and look at the sun, the moon, and the stars, all the heavenly ①lights, and allow yourself to be drawn away and worship them and serve them, things which the LORD your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole heaven. ▷ ①Lit host

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD has taken you and brought you out of the iron furnace, from Egypt, to be a people of His own possession, as today.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now the LORD was angry with me on your account, and He swore that I would not cross the Jordan, and that I would not enter the good land which the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: For I am going to die in this land; I am not crossing the Jordan, but you are going to cross, and you will take possession of this good land.

column.name: text
column.value: So be careful ①yourselves, that you do not forget the covenant of the LORD your God which He made with you, and make for yourselves a carved image in the form of anything against which the LORD your God has commanded you. ▷ ①Or for yourselves

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.

column.name: text
column.value: “When you father children and have ①grandchildren, and you grow old in the land, and you act corruptly, and make ②an idol in the form of anything, and do what is evil in the sight of the LORD your God to provoke Him to anger, ▷ ①Lit children’s children ②Or a carved image

column.name: text
column.value: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you today, that you will certainly perish quickly from the land where you are going over the Jordan to take possession of it. You will not ①live long on it, but will be utterly destroyed. ▷ ①Lit prolong your days

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where the LORD drives you.

column.name: text
column.value: There you will serve gods, the work of human hands, wood and stone, which neither see nor hear, nor eat nor smell anything.

column.name: text
column.value: But from there you will seek the LORD your God, and you will find Him if you search for Him with all your heart and all your soul.

column.name: text
column.value: When you are in distress and all these things happen to you, in the latter days you will return to the LORD your God and listen to His voice.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD your God is a compassionate God; He will not abandon you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant with your fathers which He swore to them.

column.name: text
column.value: “Indeed, ask now about the earlier days that were ①before your time, since the day that God created ②mankind on the earth, and inquire from one end of the heavens to the other. Has anything been done like this great thing, or has anything been heard like it? ▷ ①Lit before you ②Or Adam

column.name: text
column.value: Has any people heard the voice of God speaking from the midst of the fire, as you have heard it, and survived?

column.name: text
column.value: Or has a god ventured to go to take for himself a nation from within another nation by trials, by signs and wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, ①just as the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes? ▷ ①Lit according to all that

column.name: text
column.value: You were shown these things so that you might know that the LORD, He is God; there is no other besides Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Out of the heavens He let you hear His voice to discipline you; and on earth He let you see His great fire, and you heard His words from the midst of the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Because He loved your fathers, He chose ①their descendants after them. And He ②personally brought you from Egypt by His great power, ▷ ①Lit his seed ②Lit with His presence

column.name: text
column.value: driving out from before you nations greater and mightier than you, to bring you in and to give you their land as an inheritance, as it is today.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore know today, and take it to your heart, that the LORD, He is God in heaven above and on the earth below; there is no other.

column.name: text
column.value: So you shall keep His statutes and His commandments which I am ①giving you today, so that it may go well for you and for your children after you, and that you may ②live long on the land which the LORD your God is giving you for all time.” ▷ ①Lit commanding ②Lit prolong your days

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses set apart three cities across the Jordan to the ①east, ▷ ①Lit sunrise

column.name: text
column.value: for ①one to flee there who unintentionally killed his neighbor, without having hatred for him in time past; and by fleeing to one of these cities he might live: ▷ ①Lit one who committed manslaughter

column.name: text
column.value: Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau for the Reubenites, Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites, and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.

column.name: text
column.value: Now this is the Law which Moses set before the sons of Israel;

column.name: text
column.value: these are the testimonies and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, when they came out of Egypt,

column.name: text
column.value: across the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, whom Moses and the sons of Israel ①defeated when they came out of Egypt. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: And they took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were across the Jordan to the ①east, ▷ ①Lit sunrise

column.name: text
column.value: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the ①Valley of Arnon, even as far as Mount Sion (that is, Hermon), ▷ ①Or wadi

column.name: text
column.value: with all the Arabah across the Jordan to the east, even as far as the sea of the Arabah, ①at the foot of the slopes of Pisgah. ▷ ①Lit under

column.name: text
column.value: “Now this is the commandment, the statutes, and the judgments which the LORD your God has commanded me to teach you, so that you may do them in the land where you are going over to take possession of it,

column.name: text
column.value: so that you, your son, and your grandson will fear the LORD your God, to keep all His statutes and His commandments which I command you, all the days of your life, and that your days may be prolonged.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Israel, you shall listen and be careful to do them, so that it may go well for you and that you may increase greatly, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has ①promised you, in a land flowing with milk and honey. ▷ ①Lit spoken to

column.name: text
column.value: “Hear, Israel! The LORD is our God, the LORD is one!

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.

column.name: text
column.value: These words, which I am commanding you today, shall be on your heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall repeat them diligently to your sons and speak of them when you sit in your house, when you walk on the road, when you lie down, and when you get up.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also tie them as a ①sign to your ②hand, and they shall be as ③frontlets ④on your forehead. ▷ ①I.e., reminder ②Or forearm ③Or phylacteries ④Lit between your eyes

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also write them on the ①doorposts of your house and on your gates. ▷ ①Heb mezuzoth

column.name: text
column.value: “Then it shall come about when the LORD your God brings you into the land that He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give you, great and splendid cities which you did not build,

column.name: text
column.value: and houses full of all good things which you did not fill, and carved cisterns which you did not carve out, vineyards and olive trees which you did not plant, and you eat and are satisfied,

column.name: text
column.value: be ①careful that you do not forget the LORD who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of ②slavery. ▷ ①Or careful yourself ②Lit slaves

column.name: text
column.value: You shall ①fear only the LORD your God; and you shall ②worship Him and swear by His name. ▷ ①Or revere ②Or serve

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not follow other gods, any of the gods of the peoples who surround you,

column.name: text
column.value: for the LORD your God who is in the midst of you is a jealous God; so follow Him, or else the anger of the LORD your God will be kindled against you, and He will ①wipe you off the face of the earth. ▷ ①Lit destroy

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not put the LORD your God to the test, as you tested Him at Massah.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and His provisions and His statutes which He has commanded you.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall do what is right and good in the sight of the LORD, so that it may go well for you and that you may go in and take possession of the good land which the LORD swore to give your fathers,

column.name: text
column.value: by driving out all your enemies from you, as the LORD has spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: “When your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What do the provisions and the statutes and the judgments mean which the LORD our God commanded you?’

column.name: text
column.value: then you shall say to your son, ‘We were slaves to Pharaoh in Egypt, and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the LORD provided great and terrible signs and wonders before our eyes against Egypt, Pharaoh, and all his household;

column.name: text
column.value: He brought us out of there in order to bring us in, to give us the land which He had sworn to our fathers.’

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD commanded us to ①follow all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God for our own good always and for our survival, as it is today. ▷ ①Lit perform

column.name: text
column.value: And it will be righteousness for us if we are careful to ①follow all this commandment before the LORD our God, just as He commanded us. ▷ ①Lit perform

column.name: text
column.value: “All the commandments that I am commanding you today you shall be careful to do, so that you may live and increase, and go in and take possession of the land which the LORD swore to give to your forefathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall remember all the way which the LORD your God has led you in the wilderness these forty years, in order to humble you, putting you to the test, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep His commandments or not.

column.name: text
column.value: And He humbled you and let you go hungry, and fed you with the manna which you did not know, nor did your fathers know, in order to make you ①understand that man shall not live on bread alone, but man shall live on everything that comes out of the mouth of the LORD. ▷ ①Lit know

column.name: text
column.value: Your clothing did not wear out on you, nor did your foot swell these forty years.

column.name: text
column.value: So you are to know in your heart that the LORD your God was disciplining you just as a man disciplines his son.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, to walk in His ways and to ①fear Him. ▷ ①Or revere

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD your God is bringing you into a good land, a land of streams of water, of fountains and springs, flowing out in valleys and hills;

column.name: text
column.value: a land of wheat and barley, of vines, fig trees, and pomegranates, a land of olive oil and honey;

column.name: text
column.value: a land where you will eat food without shortage, in which you will not lack anything; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you can dig copper.

column.name: text
column.value: When you have eaten and are satisfied, you shall bless the LORD your God for the good land which He has given you.

column.name: text
column.value: “Be careful that you do not forget the LORD your God by failing to keep His commandments, His ordinances, and His statutes which I am commanding you today;

column.name: text
column.value: otherwise, when you eat and are satisfied, and you build good houses and live in them,

column.name: text
column.value: and when your herds and your flocks increase, and your silver and gold increase, and everything that you have increases,

column.name: text
column.value: then your heart will ①become proud and you will forget the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of ②slavery; ▷ ①Lit be high ②Lit slaves

column.name: text
column.value: He who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with its fiery serpents and scorpions, and its thirsty ground where there was no water; He who brought water for you out of the rock of flint.

column.name: text
column.value: In the wilderness it was He who fed you manna which your fathers did not know, in order to humble you and in order to put you to the test, to do good for you ①in the end. ▷ ①Lit at your end

column.name: text
column.value: Otherwise, you may say in your heart, ‘My power and the strength of my hand made me this wealth.’

column.name: text
column.value: But you are to remember the LORD your God, for it is He who is giving you power to make wealth, in order to confirm His covenant which He swore to your fathers, as it is this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come about, if you ever forget the LORD your God and follow other gods and serve and worship them, I testify against you today that you will certainly perish.

column.name: text
column.value: Like the nations that the LORD eliminates from you, so you shall perish, because you would not listen to the voice of the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: “When the LORD your God brings you into the land where you are entering to take possession of it, and He drives away many nations from before you, the Hittites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than you,

column.name: text
column.value: and when the LORD your God turns them over to you and you ①defeat them, you shall ②utterly destroy them. You shall not make a covenant with them nor be gracious to them. ▷ ①Lit strike ②Or certainly devote to the ban

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore, you shall not intermarry with them: you shall not give your ①daughters to ②their sons, nor shall you take ③their daughters for your ④sons. ▷ ①Lit daughter ②Lit his son ③Lit his daughter ④Lit son

column.name: text
column.value: For ①they will turn your ②sons away from ③following Me, and they will serve other gods; then the anger of the LORD will be kindled against you and He will quickly destroy you. ▷ ①Lit he ②Lit son ③Lit after

column.name: text
column.value: But this is what you shall do to them: you shall tear down their altars, smash their memorial stones, cut their ①Asherim to pieces, and burn their carved images in the fire. ▷ ①I.e., wooden symbols of a female deity (Asherah)

column.name: text
column.value: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God; the LORD your God has chosen you to be a people for His personal possession out of all the peoples who are on the face of the ①earth. ▷ ①Lit ground

column.name: text
column.value: “The LORD did not ①make you His beloved nor choose you because you were greater in number than any of the peoples, since you were the fewest of all peoples, ▷ ①Or become so attached to

column.name: text
column.value: but because the LORD loved you and kept the oath which He swore to your forefathers, the LORD brought you out by a mighty hand and redeemed you from the house of ①slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt. ▷ ①Lit slaves

column.name: text
column.value: Know therefore that the LORD your God, He is God, the faithful God, who keeps ①His covenant and ②His faithfulness to a thousand generations for those who love Him and keep His commandments; ▷ ①Lit the ②Lit the

column.name: text
column.value: but He repays those who hate Him to ①their faces, to eliminate ②them; He will not hesitate toward him who hates Him, He will repay him to his face. ▷ ①Lit his face ②Lit him

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, you shall keep the commandment, the statutes, and the judgments which I am commanding you today, to do them.

column.name: text
column.value: “Then it shall come about, because you listen to these judgments and keep and do them, that the LORD your God will keep ①His covenant with you and ②His faithfulness which He swore to your forefathers. ▷ ①Lit the ②Lit the

column.name: text
column.value: And He will love you, bless you, and make you numerous; He will also bless the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your ground, your grain, your new wine, and your oil, the newborn of your cattle and the offspring of your flock, ①in the land which He swore to your forefathers to give you. ▷ ①Lit on the ground

column.name: text
column.value: You shall be blessed above all peoples; there will be no sterile male or infertile female among you or among your cattle.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD will remove from you all sickness; and He will not inflict upon you any of the harmful diseases of Egypt which you have known, but He will give them to all who hate you.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall consume all the peoples whom the LORD your God will turn over to you; your eye shall not pity them, nor shall you serve their gods, for that would be a snare to you.

column.name: text
column.value: “If you say in your heart, ‘These nations are greater than I; how can I dispossess them?’

column.name: text
column.value: you are not to be afraid of them; you shall remember well what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:

column.name: text
column.value: the great trials which your eyes saw and the signs and the wonders, and the mighty hand and the outstretched arm by which the LORD your God brought you out. The LORD your God will do the same to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, the LORD your God will send the hornet against them, until those who are left and hide themselves from you perish.

column.name: text
column.value: You are not to be terrified of them, because the LORD your God is in your midst, a great and awesome God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD your God will drive away these nations from you little by little; you will not be able to put an end to them quickly, otherwise the ①wild animals would become too numerous for you. ▷ ①Lit animals of the field

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD your God will turn them over to you, and will ①throw them into great confusion until they are destroyed. ▷ ①Lit confuse them with

column.name: text
column.value: And He will hand over their kings to you, so that you will eliminate their name from under heaven; no one will be able to stand against you until you have destroyed them.

column.name: text
column.value: The carved images of their gods you are to burn with fire; you shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourselves, or you will be trapped by it; for it is an abomination to the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall not bring an abomination into your house and become designated for destruction, like it; you are to utterly detest it, and you are to utterly loathe it, for it is something designated for destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: “At that time the LORD said to me, ‘Cut out for yourself two tablets of stone like the first two, and come up to Me on the mountain, and make an ①ark of wood for yourself. ▷ ①I.e., sacred chest

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you smashed to pieces, and you shall put them in the ark.’

column.name: text
column.value: So I made an ark of acacia wood and cut out two tablets of stone like the first two, and I went up on the mountain with the two tablets in my hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He wrote on the tablets, like the first writing, the Ten ①Commandments which the LORD had spoken to you on the mountain from the midst of the fire on the day of the assembly; and the LORD gave them to me. ▷ ①Lit Words

column.name: text
column.value: Then I turned and came down from the mountain, and I put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and they are there, just as the LORD commanded me.”

column.name: text
column.value: (Now the sons of Israel set out from ①Beeroth Bene-jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died and there he was buried, and his son Eleazar served as priest in his place. ▷ ①Or the wells of the sons of Jaakan

column.name: text
column.value: From there they set out to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of streams of water.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time the LORD singled out the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to serve Him and to bless in His name, until this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, Levi does not have a portion or inheritance with his brothers; the LORD is his inheritance, just as the LORD your God spoke to him.)

column.name: text
column.value: “I, moreover, stayed on the mountain for forty days and forty nights like the first time, and the LORD listened to me that time also; the LORD was not willing to destroy you.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me, ‘Arise, proceed on your journey ahead of the people, so that they may go in and take possession of the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.’

column.name: text
column.value: “And now, Israel, what does the LORD your God require of you, but to ①fear the LORD your God, to walk in all His ways and love Him, and to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul, ▷ ①Or revere

column.name: text
column.value: and to keep the LORD’S commandments and His statutes which I am commanding you today for your good?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, to the LORD your God belong heaven and the ①highest heavens, the earth and all that is in it. ▷ ①Lit heaven of heavens

column.name: text
column.value: Yet the LORD set His affection on your fathers, to love them, and He chose their ①descendants after them, you over all the other peoples, as it is this day. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: So circumcise ①your heart, and do not stiffen your neck any longer. ▷ ①Lit the foreskin of your heart,

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD your God is the God of gods and the Lord of lords, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who does not show partiality, nor take a bribe.

column.name: text
column.value: He executes justice for the orphan and the widow, and shows His love for the stranger by giving him food and clothing.

column.name: text
column.value: So show your love for the stranger, for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall fear the LORD your God; you shall serve Him, and cling to Him, and you shall swear by His name.

column.name: text
column.value: He is your glory and He is your God, who has done these great and awesome things for you which your eyes have seen.

column.name: text
column.value: Your fathers went down to Egypt seventy persons in all, and now the LORD your God has made you as numerous as the stars of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall therefore love the LORD your God, and always keep His directive, His statutes, His ordinances, and His commandments.

column.name: text
column.value: Know this day that I am not speaking with your sons who have not known and who have not seen the ①discipline of the LORD your God—His greatness, His mighty hand, His outstretched arm, ▷ ①Or instruction

column.name: text
column.value: and His signs and His works which He did in the midst of Egypt to Pharaoh the king of Egypt and to all his land;

column.name: text
column.value: and what He did to Egypt’s army, to its horses and its chariots, when He made the water of the ①Red Sea ②engulf them while they were pursuing you, and the LORD ③completely eliminated them; ▷ ①Lit Sea of Reeds ②Lit flow over their faces ③Lit to this day

column.name: text
column.value: and what He did to you in the wilderness, until you came to this place;

column.name: text
column.value: and what He did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben, when the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them, their households, their tents, and every living thing that ①followed them, among all Israel— ▷ ①Lit was at their feet

column.name: text
column.value: but your own eyes have seen all the great work of the LORD which He did.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall therefore keep every commandment which I am commanding you today, so that you may be strong and go in and take possession of the land into which you are about to cross to possess it;

column.name: text
column.value: and so that you may prolong your days on the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give to them and to their ①descendants, a land flowing with milk and honey. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: For the land, into which you are entering to possess it, is not like the land of Egypt from which you came, where you used to sow your seed and water it ①by your foot like a vegetable garden. ▷ ①I.e., use of foot to facilitate irrigation

column.name: text
column.value: But the land into which you are about to cross to possess it, a land of hills and valleys, drinks water from the rain of heaven,

column.name: text
column.value: a land for which the LORD your God cares; the eyes of the LORD your God are continually on it, from the ①beginning even to the end of the year. ▷ ①Lit beginning of the year

column.name: text
column.value: “And it shall come about, if you listen obediently to my commandments which I am commanding you today, to love the LORD your God and to serve Him with all your heart and all your soul,

column.name: text
column.value: that ①He will provide rain for your land in its season, the ②early and ③late rain, so that you may gather your grain, your new wine, and your oil. ▷ ①As in some ancient versions; MT I ②I.e., autumn ③I.e., spring

column.name: text
column.value: ①He will also provide grass in your field for your cattle, and you will eat and be satisfied. ▷ ①As in some ancient versions; MT I

column.name: text
column.value: ①Beware that your hearts are not easily deceived, and that you do not turn away and serve other gods, and worship them. ▷ ①Lit Watch yourselves

column.name: text
column.value: Otherwise, the anger of the LORD will be kindled against you, and He will shut up the sky so that there will be no rain, and the ground will not yield its produce; then you will quickly perish from the good land which the LORD is giving you.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall therefore take these words of mine to ①heart and to soul; and you shall tie them as a sign on your ②hand, and they shall be as ③frontlets ④on your forehead. ▷ ①Lit your heart ②Or forearm ③Or phylacteries ④Lit between your eyes

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also teach them to your sons, speaking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk along the road, when you lie down, and when you get up.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates,

column.name: text
column.value: so that your days and the days of your sons may be increased on the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give them, as ①long as the heavens are above the earth. ▷ ①Lit the days of the heavens

column.name: text
column.value: For if you are careful to keep all of this commandment which I am commanding you to do, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all His ways and cling to Him,

column.name: text
column.value: then the LORD will ①dispossess all these nations from you, and you will ②dispossess nations greater and mightier than you. ▷ ①Or drive out ②Or drive out

column.name: text
column.value: Every place on which the sole of your foot steps shall be yours; your border will be from the wilderness to Lebanon, and from the river, the river Euphrates, as far as ①the western sea. ▷ ①I.e., the Mediterranean

column.name: text
column.value: No one will be able to stand against you; the LORD your God will ①instill the dread of you and the fear of you in all the land on which you set foot, just as He has spoken to you. ▷ ①Lit give...over all

column.name: text
column.value: “See, I am placing before you today a blessing and a curse:

column.name: text
column.value: the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God, which I am commanding you today;

column.name: text
column.value: and the curse, if you do not listen to the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn aside from the way which I am commanding you today, ①by following other gods which you have not known. ▷ ①Lit to follow

column.name: text
column.value: “And it shall come about, when the LORD your God brings you into the land where you are entering to possess it, that you shall place the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.

column.name: text
column.value: Are they not across the Jordan, west of the road toward the sunset, in the land of the Canaanites who live in the Arabah, opposite Gilgal, beside the ①oaks of Moreh? ▷ ①Or terebinths

column.name: text
column.value: For you are about to cross the Jordan to go in to take possession of the land which the LORD your God is giving you, and you shall possess it and live in it,

column.name: text
column.value: and you shall be careful to do all the statutes and the judgments which I am placing before you today.

column.name: text
column.value: “Hear, Israel! You are crossing the Jordan today, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than you, cities that are great and fortified to heaven,

column.name: text
column.value: a people who are great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know and of whom you have heard it said, ‘Who can stand against the sons of Anak?’

column.name: text
column.value: So be aware today that it is the LORD your God who is crossing over ahead of you as a consuming fire. He will destroy them and He will subdue them before you, so that you may drive them out and eliminate them quickly, just as the LORD has spoken to you.

column.name: text
column.value: “Do not say in your heart when the LORD your God has driven them away from ①you, ‘Because of my righteousness the LORD has brought me in to take possession of this land.’ Rather, it is because of the ②wickedness of these nations that the LORD is dispossessing them before you. ▷ ①Lit you, saying ②Or godlessness

column.name: text
column.value: It is not because of your righteousness or the uprightness of your heart that you are going in to take possession of their land, ①but it is because of the ②wickedness of these nations that the LORD your God is driving them out from before you, and in order to confirm the ③oath which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. ▷ ①Or for ②Or godlessness ③Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: “Know, then, that it is not because of your righteousness that the LORD your God is giving you this good land to possess, for you are a ①stubborn people. ▷ ①Lit stiff-necked

column.name: text
column.value: Remember, do not forget how you provoked the LORD your God to anger in the wilderness; from the day that you left the land of Egypt until you arrived at this place, you have been rebellious against the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Even at Horeb you provoked the LORD to anger, and the LORD was so angry with you that He would have destroyed you.

column.name: text
column.value: When I went up to the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I remained on the mountain for forty days and nights; I neither ate bread nor drank water.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD gave me the two tablets of stone written by the finger of God; and on them were all the words which the LORD had spoken with you at the mountain from the midst of the fire on the day of the assembly.

column.name: text
column.value: It came about at the end of forty days and nights that the LORD gave me the two tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me, ‘Arise, go down from here quickly, because your people, whom you brought out of Egypt, have behaved corruptly. They have quickly turned aside from the way that I commanded them; they have made a cast metal image for themselves.’

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD also said to ①me, ‘I have seen this people, and indeed, it is a ②stubborn people. ▷ ①Lit me, saying ②Lit stiff-necked

column.name: text
column.value: Leave Me alone, that I may destroy them and wipe out their name from under heaven; and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.’

column.name: text
column.value: “So I turned and came down from the mountain while the mountain was burning with fire, and the two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw that you had indeed sinned against the LORD your God. You had made for yourselves a cast metal image of a calf; you had quickly turned aside from the way that the LORD had commanded you.

column.name: text
column.value: So I took hold of the two tablets and threw them from my two hands, and smashed them to pieces before your eyes!

column.name: text
column.value: Then I fell down before the LORD like the first time, for forty days and nights; I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all your sin which you had committed by doing what was evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke Him to anger.

column.name: text
column.value: For I was afraid of the anger and the rage with which the LORD was angry with you so as to destroy you; but the LORD listened to me that time as well.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD was also angry enough with Aaron to destroy him; so I also prayed for Aaron at the same time.

column.name: text
column.value: And I took your ①sinful thing which you had made, the calf, and burned it in the fire and crushed it, grinding it thoroughly until it was as fine as dust; and I threw its dust into the stream that came down from the mountain. ▷ ①Lit sin

column.name: text
column.value: “Then at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah you kept provoking the LORD to anger.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the LORD sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, ‘Go up and take possession of the land which I have given you,’ you rebelled against the ①command of the LORD your God; you neither trusted Him nor listened to His voice. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: You have been rebellious toward the LORD since the day I knew you.

column.name: text
column.value: “So I fell down before the LORD for the forty days and nights, which I ①did because the LORD said He would destroy you. ▷ ①Lit fell down

column.name: text
column.value: And I prayed to the LORD and said, ‘Lord GOD, do not destroy Your people, Your inheritance, whom You have redeemed through Your greatness, whom You have brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand!

column.name: text
column.value: Remember Your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; do not turn Your attention to the stubbornness of this people, or to their wickedness, or their sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Otherwise, the people of the land from which You brought us will say, “Since the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which He had ①promised them, and since He hated them, He has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness!” ▷ ①Lit spoken to

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they are Your people, and Your inheritance, whom You brought out by Your great power and Your outstretched arm.’

column.name: text
column.value: “These are the statutes and the judgments which you shall carefully ①follow in the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess ②as long as you live on the ③earth. ▷ ①Lit perform ②Lit all the days ③Lit ground

column.name: text
column.value: You shall utterly destroy all the places where the nations whom you are going to dispossess serve their gods, on the high mountains, on the hills, and under every leafy tree.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall tear down their altars and smash their memorial stones to pieces, and burn their ①Asherim in the fire, and cut to pieces the carved images of their gods; and you shall eliminate their name from that place. ▷ ①I.e., wooden symbols of a female deity (Asherah)

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not act this way toward the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: But you shall seek the LORD at the place which the LORD your God will choose from all your tribes, to establish His name there for His dwelling, and you shall come there.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall bring there your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the ①contribution of your hand, your vowed offerings, your ②voluntary offerings, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock. ▷ ①Or uplifted offering ②Or freewill offerings

column.name: text
column.value: There you and your households shall eat before the LORD your God, and rejoice in all ①your undertakings in which the LORD your God has blessed you. ▷ ①Lit the putting forth of your hand

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not do at all what we are doing here today, everyone doing whatever is right in his own eyes;

column.name: text
column.value: for you have not as yet come to the resting place and the inheritance which the LORD your God is giving you.

column.name: text
column.value: When you cross the Jordan and live in the land which the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and He gives you rest from all your enemies around you so that you live in security,

column.name: text
column.value: then it shall come about that the place in which the LORD your God will choose for His name to dwell, there you shall bring everything that I command you: your burnt offerings and your sacrifices, your tithes and the ①contribution of your hand, and all your choice vowed offerings which you will vow to the LORD. ▷ ①Or uplifted offering

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall rejoice before the LORD your God, you and your sons and daughters, your male and female slaves, and the Levite who is within your gates, since he has no portion or inheritance with you.

column.name: text
column.value: “Be careful that you do not offer your burnt offerings in any cultic place that you see,

column.name: text
column.value: but only in the place which the LORD chooses in one of your tribes: there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do everything that I command you.

column.name: text
column.value: “However, you may slaughter and eat meat within any of your gates, ①whatever you desire, according to the blessing of the LORD your God which He has given you; the unclean and the clean alike may eat it, as the gazelle and the deer. ▷ ①Lit in every desire of your soul

column.name: text
column.value: Only you shall not eat the blood; you are to pour it out on the ground like water.

column.name: text
column.value: You are not allowed to eat within your gates the tithe of your grain, new wine, or oil, or the firstborn of your herd or flock, or any of your vowed offerings which you vow, or your ①voluntary offerings, or the ②contribution of your hand. ▷ ①Or freewill offerings ②Or uplifted offering

column.name: text
column.value: But you shall eat them before the LORD your God in the place which the LORD your God will choose, you and your son and daughter, and your male and female slaves, and the Levite who is within your gates; and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God in all ①your undertakings. ▷ ①Lit the putting forth of your hand

column.name: text
column.value: Be careful that you do not abandon the Levite ①as long as you live in your land. ▷ ①Lit all your days upon your land

column.name: text
column.value: “When the LORD your God extends your border as He has ①promised you, and you say, ‘I will eat meat,’ because ②you desire to eat meat, then you may eat meat, ③whatever you desire. ▷ ①Lit spoken to ②Lit your soul desires ③Lit in every desire of your soul

column.name: text
column.value: If the place where the LORD your God chooses to put His name is too far from you, then you may slaughter animals from your herd and flock which the LORD has given you, as I have commanded you; and you may eat within your gates ①whatever you desire. ▷ ①Lit in every desire of your soul

column.name: text
column.value: Just as a gazelle or a deer is eaten, so you may eat it; the unclean and the clean alike may eat it.

column.name: text
column.value: Only be sure not to eat the blood, for the blood is the ①life, and you shall not eat the ②life with the flesh. ▷ ①Lit soul ②Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not eat it; you shall pour it out on the ground like water.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not eat it, so that it may go well for you and your sons after you, since you will be doing what is right in the sight of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Only your holy things which you may have and your vowed offerings, you shall take and go to the place which the LORD chooses.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall offer your burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, on the altar of the LORD your God; and the blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on the altar of the LORD your God, and you shall eat the flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: “Be careful and listen to all these words which I am commanding you, so that it may go well for you and your sons after you forever, for you will be doing what is good and right in the sight of the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: “When the LORD your God cuts off from you the nations which you are going in to dispossess, and you dispossess them and live in their land,

column.name: text
column.value: be careful that you are not ensnared ①to follow them, after they are destroyed from your presence, and that you do not inquire about their gods, saying, ‘How do these nations serve their gods, that I also may do likewise?’ ▷ ①Lit after them

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not behave this way toward the LORD your God, because every abominable act which the LORD hates, they have done for their gods; for they even burn their sons and daughters in the fire for their gods.

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①Whatever I command you, you shall be careful to do; you shall not add to nor take anything away from it. ▷ ①Lit Everything that

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises among you and gives you a sign or a wonder, ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: and the sign or the wonder comes true, of which he spoke to you, saying, ‘Let’s follow other gods (whom you have not known) and let’s serve them,’

column.name: text
column.value: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet or dreamer of dreams; for the LORD your God is testing you to find out whether you love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall follow the LORD your God and fear Him; and you shall keep His commandments, listen to His voice, serve Him, and cling to Him.

column.name: text
column.value: But that prophet or that dreamer of dreams shall be put to death, because he has spoken falsely against the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of ①slavery, to drive you from the way in which the LORD your God commanded you to walk. So you shall eliminate the evil from among you. ▷ ①Lit slaves

column.name: text
column.value: “If your brother, your mother’s son, or your son or daughter, or the wife ①you cherish, or your friend who is like your own soul, entices you secretly, saying, ‘Let’s go and serve other gods’ (whom neither you nor your fathers have known, ▷ ①Lit of your breast

column.name: text
column.value: of the gods of the peoples who are around you, near you, or far from you, from one end of the earth to the other end),

column.name: text
column.value: you shall not consent to him or listen to him; and your eye shall not pity him, nor shall you spare or conceal him.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, you shall most certainly kill him; your hand shall be first against him to put him to death, and afterward the hand of all the people.

column.name: text
column.value: So you shall stone him ①to death, because he has attempted to drive you away from the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of ②slavery. ▷ ①Lit with stones so that he dies ②Lit slaves

column.name: text
column.value: Then all Israel will hear about it and be afraid, and will not do such a wicked thing among you again.

column.name: text
column.value: “If you hear in one of your cities, which the LORD your God is giving you to live in, anyone saying that

column.name: text
column.value: some worthless men have gone out from among you and have seduced the inhabitants of their city, saying, ‘Let’s go and serve other gods’ (whom you have not known),

column.name: text
column.value: then you shall investigate, search out, and inquire thoroughly. And if it is true and the matter is certain that this abomination has been committed among you,

column.name: text
column.value: you shall most certainly strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword. ①Utterly destroy it and all who are in it and its cattle, with the edge of the sword. ▷ ①Or Put it under the ban

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall gather all its plunder into the middle of its public square, and burn the city and all its plunder with fire as a whole burnt offering to the LORD your God; and it shall be a ①ruin forever. It shall never be rebuilt. ▷ ①Lit rubbish heap

column.name: text
column.value: Nothing at all from what is designated for destruction is to cling to your hand, in order that the LORD may turn from His burning anger and show mercy to you, and have compassion on you and make you increase, just as He has sworn to your fathers,

column.name: text
column.value: ①if you will listen to the voice of the LORD your God, ②keeping all His commandments which I am commanding you today, ③and doing what is right in the sight of the LORD your God. ▷ ①Or for ②Lit to keep ③Lit to do

column.name: text
column.value: “You are sons of the LORD your God; you shall not cut yourselves nor ①shave a bald spot ②above your forehead for the dead. ▷ ①Lit make ②Lit between your eyes

column.name: text
column.value: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God, and the LORD has chosen you to be a people for His personal possession out of all the peoples who are on the face of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not eat any detestable thing.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the animals that you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,

column.name: text
column.value: ①the deer, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the mountain sheep. ▷ ①Exact identification of these animals is uncertain

column.name: text
column.value: And any animal that has a divided hoof and has its hoofs split in two, and ①chews the cud, among the animals, ②that animal you may eat. ▷ ①Lit brings up ②Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: However, you are not to eat these among the ones that ①chew the cud, or among those that have the hoof divided in ②two: the camel, the ③rabbit, and the rock hyrax, for though they ④chew the cud, they do not have a divided hoof; they are unclean to you. ▷ ①Lit bring up ②Lit a cleaving ③Or hare ④Lit bring up

column.name: text
column.value: And the pig, because it has a divided hoof but does not chew the cud, it is unclean for you. You shall not eat any of their flesh, nor touch their carcasses.

column.name: text
column.value: “These you may eat of everything that is in the water: anything that has fins and scales you may eat,

column.name: text
column.value: but anything that does not have fins and scales, you shall not eat; it is unclean for you.

column.name: text
column.value: “You may eat any clean bird.

column.name: text
column.value: But these are the ones that you shall not eat: the ①eagle and the vulture and the ②buzzard, ▷ ①Or vulture ②Or black vulture

column.name: text
column.value: and the red kite, the falcon, and the kite in their kinds,

column.name: text
column.value: and every raven in its kind,

column.name: text
column.value: and the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, and the hawk in their kinds,

column.name: text
column.value: the little owl, the ①great owl, the white owl, ▷ ①Or great horned owl

column.name: text
column.value: the pelican, the carrion vulture, the cormorant,

column.name: text
column.value: the stork, and the heron in their kinds, and the hoopoe and the bat.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the swarming insects with wings are unclean to you; they shall not be eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: You may eat any clean bird.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not eat anything which dies of itself. You may give it to the stranger who is in your ①town, so that he may eat it, or you may sell it to a stranger; for you are a holy people to the LORD your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk. ▷ ①Lit gates

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall certainly tithe all the produce from ①what you sow, which comes from the field every year. ▷ ①Lit your seed

column.name: text
column.value: You shall eat in the presence of the LORD your God, at the place where He chooses to establish His name, the tithe of your grain, your new wine, your oil, and the firstborn of your herd and your flock, so that you may learn to fear the LORD your God always.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the ①distance is so great for you that you are not able to ②bring the tithe, since the place where the LORD your God chooses to set His name is too far away from you when the LORD your God blesses you, ▷ ①Lit way ②Lit carry it

column.name: text
column.value: then you shall ①exchange it for money, and bind the money in your hand and go to the place which the LORD your God chooses. ▷ ①Lit give in money

column.name: text
column.value: And you may spend the money on whatever your ①heart desires: on oxen, sheep, wine, other strong drink, or whatever your ②heart ③desires; and there you shall eat in the presence of the LORD your God and rejoice, you and your household. ▷ ①Lit soul ②Lit soul ③Lit asks of you

column.name: text
column.value: Also you shall not neglect the Levite who is in your ①town, for he has no portion or inheritance among you. ▷ ①Lit gates

column.name: text
column.value: “At the end of every third year you shall bring out all the tithe of your produce in that year, and you shall deposit it in your ①town. ▷ ①Lit gates

column.name: text
column.value: And the Levite, because he has no portion or inheritance among you, and the stranger, the ①orphan, and the widow who are in your ②town, shall come and eat and be satisfied, in order that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do. ▷ ①Or fatherless ②Lit gates

column.name: text
column.value: “At the end of every seven years you shall ①grant a release of debts. ▷ ①Lit make

column.name: text
column.value: And this is the regulation for the release of debts: every creditor is to forgive what he has loaned to his neighbor; he shall not require it of his neighbor and his brother, because the LORD’S release has been proclaimed.

column.name: text
column.value: From a foreigner you may require it, but your hand shall ①forgive whatever of yours is with your brother. ▷ ①Lit release

column.name: text
column.value: However, there will be no poor among you, since the LORD will certainly bless you in the land which the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance to possess,

column.name: text
column.value: if only you listen obediently to the voice of the LORD your God, to ①follow carefully all this commandment which I am commanding you today. ▷ ①Lit perform

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD your God will have blessed you just as He has promised you, and you will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow; and you will rule over many nations, but they will not rule over you.

column.name: text
column.value: “If there is a poor person among you, one of your brothers, in any of your ①towns in your land which the LORD your God is giving you, you shall not harden your heart, nor close your hand from your poor brother; ▷ ①Lit gates

column.name: text
column.value: but you shall fully open your hand to him, and generously lend him enough for his need in whatever he lacks.

column.name: text
column.value: Be careful that there is no mean-spirited ①thought in your heart, ②such as, ‘The seventh year, the year of release of debts, is near,’ and your eye is malicious toward your poor brother, and you give him nothing; then he may cry out to the LORD against you, and it will be a sin in you. ▷ ①Lit word ②Lit saying

column.name: text
column.value: You shall generously give to him, and your heart shall not be ①grudging when you give to him, because for this thing the LORD your God will bless you in all your work, and in all ②your undertakings. ▷ ①Lit evil ②Lit the putting forth of your hand

column.name: text
column.value: For the poor will not cease ①to exist in the land; therefore I am commanding you, saying, ‘You shall fully open your hand to your brother, to your needy and poor in your land.’ ▷ ①Lit from the midst of

column.name: text
column.value: “If your fellow countryman, a Hebrew man or woman, is sold to you, then he shall serve you for six years, but in the seventh year you shall set him ①free. ▷ ①Lit free from you

column.name: text
column.value: And when you set him ①free, you shall not send him away empty-handed. ▷ ①Lit free from you

column.name: text
column.value: You shall give generously to him from your flock, your threshing floor, and from your wine vat; you shall give to him as the LORD your God has blessed you.

column.name: text
column.value: And you are to remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you; therefore I am commanding ①this of you today. ▷ ①Lit this thing

column.name: text
column.value: But it shall come about, if he says to you, ‘I will not leave you,’ because he loves you and your household, since he is doing well with you,

column.name: text
column.value: then you shall take an ①awl and pierce it through his ear into the door, and he shall be your servant permanently. You shall also do the same to your female slave. ▷ ①I.e., a pointed tool

column.name: text
column.value: “It shall not seem difficult for you when you set him ①free, because he has given you six years with double the ②service of a hired worker; so the LORD your God will bless you in whatever you do. ▷ ①Lit free from you ②Lit wages

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall consecrate to the LORD your God all the firstborn males that are born in your herd and in your flock; you shall not work with the firstborn of your herd, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.

column.name: text
column.value: You and your household shall eat it every year before the LORD your God in the place which the LORD chooses.

column.name: text
column.value: But if it has any impairment, such as a limp, or blindness, or any serious impairment, you shall not sacrifice it to the LORD your God.

column.name: text
