column.value: You shall eat it within your gates; the unclean and the clean alike may eat it, as a gazelle or a deer.

column.name: text
column.value: Only you shall not eat its blood; you are to pour it out on the ground like water.

column.name: text
column.value: “Observe the month of Abib and ①celebrate the Passover to the LORD your God, for in the month of Abib the LORD your God brought you out of Egypt by night. ▷ ①Lit perform

column.name: text
column.value: You shall sacrifice the Passover to the LORD your God from the flock and the herd, in the place where the LORD chooses to establish His name.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not eat leavened bread with it; for seven days you shall eat unleavened bread with it, the bread of affliction (for you came out of the land of Egypt in a hurry), so that you will remember the day when you came out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.

column.name: text
column.value: For seven days no leaven shall be seen with you in your entire territory, and none of the meat which you sacrifice on the evening of the first day shall be left overnight until the morning.

column.name: text
column.value: You are not allowed to sacrifice the Passover in any of your ①towns which the LORD your God is giving you; ▷ ①Lit gates

column.name: text
column.value: but only at the place where the LORD your God chooses to establish His name, you shall sacrifice the Passover in the evening at sunset, at the time that you came out of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall cook and eat it in the place which the LORD your God chooses. In the morning you are to return to your tents.

column.name: text
column.value: For six days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day there shall be a festive assembly to the LORD your God; you shall do no work on it.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall count seven weeks for yourself; you shall begin to count seven weeks from the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall ①celebrate the Feast of Weeks to the LORD your God with a ②voluntary offering of your hand in a proportional amount, which you shall give just as the LORD your God blesses you; ▷ ①Lit perform ②Or freewill offering

column.name: text
column.value: and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God, you, your son and your daughter, and your male and female slaves, and the Levite who is in your ①town, and the stranger, the ②orphan, and the widow who are in your midst, at the place where the LORD your God chooses to establish His name. ▷ ①Lit gates ②Or fatherless

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and you shall be careful and ①comply with these statutes. ▷ ①Lit perform these

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall ①celebrate the Feast of ②Booths for seven days when you have gathered in from your threshing floor and your wine vat; ▷ ①Lit perform ②Or Tabernacles

column.name: text
column.value: and you shall rejoice in your feast, you, your son and your daughter, and your male and female slaves, and the Levite, the stranger, the ①orphan, and the widow who are in your ②towns. ▷ ①Or fatherless ②Lit gates

column.name: text
column.value: For seven days you shall celebrate a feast to the LORD your God in the place which the LORD chooses, because the LORD your God will bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands, so that you will be altogether joyful.

column.name: text
column.value: “Three times a year all your males shall appear before the LORD your God at the place which He chooses: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, at the Feast of Weeks, and at the Feast of Booths; and they are not to appear before the LORD empty-handed.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone ①shall give as he is able, in accordance with the blessing of the LORD your God which He has given you. ▷ ①Lit according to the gift of his hand

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall appoint for yourself judges and officers in all your ①towns which the LORD your God is giving you, according to your tribes, and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment. ▷ ①Lit gates

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not distort justice, you shall not ①show partiality; and you shall not accept a bribe, because a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and distorts the words of the righteous. ▷ ①Lit recognize faces

column.name: text
column.value: Justice, and only justice, you shall pursue, so that you may live and possess the land which the LORD your God is giving you.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not plant for yourself an ①Asherah of any kind of tree beside the altar of the LORD your God, which you shall make for yourself. ▷ ①I.e., wooden symbol of a female deity

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall not set up for yourself a memorial stone, which the LORD your God hates.

column.name: text
column.value: “When the LORD your God cuts off the nations whose land the LORD your God is giving you, and you dispossess them and settle in their cities and in their houses,

column.name: text
column.value: you shall set aside for yourself three cities in the midst of your land which the LORD your God is giving you to ①possess. ▷ ①Lit possess it

column.name: text
column.value: You shall prepare the ①roads for yourself, and divide into three regions the territory of your land which the LORD your God will give you as an inheritance, ②so that anyone who commits manslaughter may flee there. ▷ ①Lit road ②Lit and it shall be for everyone who committed manslaughter to flee there

column.name: text
column.value: “Now this is the case of the one who commits manslaughter, who may flee there and live: when he ①kills his friend ②unintentionally, ③not hating him previously— ▷ ①Lit strikes ②Lit without knowledge ③Lit and he was not hating him previously

column.name: text
column.value: as when a person goes into the forest with his friend to cut wood, and his hand ①swings the axe to cut down the tree, and the iron head slips off the ②handle and ③strikes his friend so that he dies—he may flee to one of these cities and live. ▷ ①Lit is put to the ②Lit wood ③Lit finds

column.name: text
column.value: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue ①him ②in the heat of his anger, and overtake him because the way is long, and ③take his life, though he was not sentenced to death since he had not hated him previously. ▷ ①Lit the one who committed manslaughter ②Lit while his heart is hot ③Lit strike him in the soul

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I command you, saying, ‘You shall set aside for yourself three cities.’

column.name: text
column.value: “And if the LORD your God enlarges your territory, just as He has sworn to your fathers, and gives you all the land that He ①promised to give your fathers— ▷ ①Lit spoke

column.name: text
column.value: if you ①carefully follow all of this commandment which I am commanding you today, to love the LORD your God, and to walk in His ways always—then you shall add three more cities for yourself, besides these three. ▷ ①Lit keep all...to do it

column.name: text
column.value: So innocent blood will not be shed in the midst of your land which the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and guilt for bloodshed will not be on you.

column.name: text
column.value: “But if there is a person who hates his neighbor, and waits in ambush for him and rises up against him and strikes ①him so that he dies, and he flees to one of these cities, ▷ ①Lit him in the soul

column.name: text
column.value: then the elders of his city shall send men and take him from there, and hand him over to the avenger of blood, so that he may die.

column.name: text
column.value: ①You shall not pity him, but you shall eliminate the guilt for the bloodshed of the innocent from Israel, so that it may go well for you. ▷ ①Lit Your eye

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not displace your neighbor’s boundary marker, which the ancestors have set, in your inheritance which you will inherit in the land that the LORD your God is giving you to ①possess. ▷ ①Lit possess it

column.name: text
column.value: “A single witness shall not rise up against a person regarding any wrongdoing or any sin ①that he commits; on the ②testimony of two or three witnesses a matter shall be confirmed. ▷ ①Lit in any sin, that he sins ②Lit mouth of two witnesses, or by the mouth of three

column.name: text
column.value: If a malicious witness rises up against a person to testify against him of wrongdoing,

column.name: text
column.value: then both people who have the dispute shall stand before the LORD, before the priests and the judges who will be in office in those days.

column.name: text
column.value: And the judges shall investigate thoroughly, and if the witness is a false witness and he has testified against his brother falsely,

column.name: text
column.value: then you shall do to him just as he had planned to do to his brother. So you shall eliminate the evil from among you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the people will hear and be afraid, and will never again do such an evil thing among you.

column.name: text
column.value: So ①you shall not show pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, and foot for foot. ▷ ①Lit your eye

column.name: text
column.value: “When you go out to battle against your enemies and see horses, chariots, and people more numerous than you, do not be afraid of them; for the LORD your God, who brought you up from the land of Egypt, is with you.

column.name: text
column.value: When you are approaching the battle, the priest shall come forward and speak to the people.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall say to them, ‘Hear, Israel, you are approaching the battle against your enemies today. Do not be fainthearted. Do not be afraid, or panic, or be terrified by them,

column.name: text
column.value: for the LORD your God is the One who is going with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.’

column.name: text
column.value: The officers also shall speak to the people, saying, ‘Who is the man that has built a new house but has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, otherwise he might die in the battle and another man would dedicate it.

column.name: text
column.value: And who is the man that has planted a vineyard but has not ①put it to use? Let him go and return to his house, otherwise he might die in the battle and another man ②would put it to use. ▷ ①Lit treat(ed) it as common ②Lit treat(ed) it as common

column.name: text
column.value: And who is the man that is ①betrothed to a woman and has not ②married her? Let him go and return to his house, otherwise he might die in the battle and another man would ③marry her.’ ▷ ①A betrothed couple was considered legally married, but did not yet live together ②Lit taken ③Lit take

column.name: text
column.value: Then the officers shall speak further to the people and say, ‘Who is the man that is afraid and fainthearted? Let him go and return to his house, so that ①he does not make his brothers’ hearts melt like his heart!’ ▷ ①As in LXX and other ancient versions; MT his brothers’ hearts do not melt like

column.name: text
column.value: And when the officers have finished speaking to the people, they shall appoint commanders of armies at the head of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: “When you approach a city to fight against it, you shall ①offer it terms of peace. ▷ ①Lit call to it for peace

column.name: text
column.value: And if it ①agrees to make peace with you and opens to you, then all the people who are found in it shall become your forced labor and serve you. ▷ ①Lit answers peace to you

column.name: text
column.value: However, if it does not make peace with you, but makes war against you, then you shall besiege it.

column.name: text
column.value: When the LORD your God gives it into your hand, you shall strike all the ①men in it with the edge of the sword. ▷ ①Lit males

column.name: text
column.value: However, the women, the children, the animals, and everything that is in the city, all of its spoils, you shall take as plunder for yourself; and you shall ①use the spoils of your enemies which the LORD your God has given you. ▷ ①Lit eat

column.name: text
column.value: This is what you shall do to all the cities that are very far from you, which are not of the cities of these nations ①nearby. ▷ ①Lit here

column.name: text
column.value: Only in the cities of these peoples that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, you shall not leave anything that breathes alive.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, you shall ①utterly destroy them, the Hittite and the Amorite, the Canaanite and the Perizzite, the Hivite and the Jebusite, just as the LORD your God has commanded you, ▷ ①Or put them under the ban

column.name: text
column.value: so that they will not teach you to do ①all the same detestable practices of theirs which they have done for their gods, ②by which you would sin against the LORD your God. ▷ ①Lit according to all the detestable ②Lit and you would

column.name: text
column.value: “When you besiege a city for a long time, to make war against it in order to capture it, you shall not destroy its trees by swinging an axe against them; for you may eat from them, so you shall not cut them down. For ①is the tree of the field a human, that it should ②be besieged by you? ▷ ①Read as interrogative with ancient versions; MT the tree of the field is man ②Lit come before you in the siege

column.name: text
column.value: Only the trees that you know ①are not fruit trees you shall destroy and cut down, so that you may construct siegeworks against the city that is making war against you until it falls. ▷ ①Lit that it is not a tree of food

column.name: text
column.value: “The Levitical priests, the whole tribe of Levi, shall not have a portion or inheritance with Israel; they shall eat the LORD’S offerings by fire and His ①property. ▷ ①Or inheritance

column.name: text
column.value: They shall not have an inheritance among their countrymen; the LORD is their inheritance, as He ①promised them. ▷ ①Lit spoke to

column.name: text
column.value: “Now this shall be the priests’ portion from the people, from those who offer a sacrifice, either an ox or a sheep: they shall give the priest the shoulder, the two cheeks, and the stomach.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall give him the first fruits of your grain, your new wine, and your oil, and the first fleece of your sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD your God has chosen him and his sons from all your tribes, to stand to serve in the name of the LORD always.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now if a Levite comes from any of your ①towns throughout Israel where he resides, and he comes ②whenever he desires to the place which the LORD chooses, ▷ ①Lit gates ②Lit with all the desire of his soul

column.name: text
column.value: then he shall serve in the name of the LORD his God, like all his fellow Levites who stand there before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall eat ①equal portions, except for what they receive from the sale of their fathers’ estates. ▷ ①Lit portion like portion

column.name: text
column.value: “When you enter the land which the LORD your God is giving you, you shall not learn to ①imitate the detestable things of those nations. ▷ ①Lit do as

column.name: text
column.value: There shall not be found among you anyone who makes his son or his daughter pass through the fire, one who uses divination, a soothsayer, one who interprets omens, or a sorcerer,

column.name: text
column.value: or one who casts a spell, or a medium, or a spiritist, or one who consults the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever does these things is detestable to the LORD; and because of these detestable things the LORD your God is going to drive them out before you.

column.name: text
column.value: You are to be blameless before the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: For these nations, which you are going to dispossess, listen to soothsayers and diviners, but as for you, the LORD your God has not allowed you to do so.

column.name: text
column.value: “The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among you, from your countrymen; to him you shall listen.

column.name: text
column.value: This is in accordance with everything that you asked of the LORD your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly, saying, ‘Do not let me hear the voice of the LORD my God again, and do not let me see this great fire anymore, or I will die!’

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, ‘They have ①spoken well. ▷ ①Lit done well what they have spoken

column.name: text
column.value: I will raise up for them a prophet from among their countrymen like you, and I will put My words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them everything that I command him.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come about that whoever does not listen to My words which he speaks in My name, I Myself will ①require it of him. ▷ ①I.e., hold him responsible

column.name: text
column.value: But the prophet who speaks a word presumptuously in My name, a word which I have not commanded him to speak, or which he speaks in the name of other gods, ①that prophet shall die.’ ▷ ①Lit then that

column.name: text
column.value: And if you say in your heart, ‘How will we recognize the word which the LORD has not spoken?’

column.name: text
column.value: When the prophet speaks in the name of the LORD, and the thing does not happen or come true, that is the thing which the LORD has not spoken. The prophet has spoken it presumptuously; you are not to be afraid of him.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not see your countryman’s ox or his sheep straying away, and avoid them; you shall certainly bring them back to your countryman.

column.name: text
column.value: And if your countryman is not near you, or if you do not know him, then you shall bring it to your house, and it shall remain with you until your countryman looks for it; then you shall restore it to him.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also do this with his donkey, and you shall do the same with his garment, and you shall do likewise with any lost property of your countryman, which has been lost by him and you have found. You are not allowed to avoid them.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not see your countryman’s donkey or his ox fallen down on the road, and avoid them; you shall certainly help him raise them up.

column.name: text
column.value: “A woman shall not wear a man’s clothing, nor shall a man put on a woman’s clothing; for whoever does these things is an abomination to the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: “If you happen to come upon a bird’s nest along the way, in any tree or on the ground, with young ones or eggs in it, and the mother sitting on the young or on the eggs, you shall not take the mother with the young;

column.name: text
column.value: you shall certainly let the mother go, but the young you may take for yourself, in order that it may go well for you and that you may prolong your days.

column.name: text
column.value: “When you build a new house, you shall make a ①parapet for your roof, so that you will not bring guilt for bloodshed on your house if anyone falls from it. ▷ ①I.e., a protective railing

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, otherwise ①all the produce of the seed which you have sown and the yield of the vineyard will be ②forfeited to the sanctuary. ▷ ①Lit the fullness ②Or forfeit, adj sense

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not wear a material of wool and linen combined together.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall make yourself tassels on the four corners of your garment with which you cover yourself.

column.name: text
column.value: “If any man takes a wife and goes in to her and then ①turns against her, ▷ ①Lit hates her

column.name: text
column.value: and he charges her with shameful behavior and ①publicly defames her, and says, ‘I took this woman, but when I came near her, I did not find her to have evidence of virginity,’ ▷ ①Lit brings out an evil reputation against her

column.name: text
column.value: then the girl’s father and her mother shall take and bring out the evidence of the girl’s virginity to the elders of the city at the gate.

column.name: text
column.value: And the girl’s father shall say to the elders, ‘I gave my daughter to this man as a wife, but he ①turned against her; ▷ ①Lit hated her

column.name: text
column.value: and behold, he has charged her with shameful behavior, saying, “I did not find your daughter to have evidence of virginity.” But ①this is the evidence of my daughter’s virginity.’ And they shall spread out the garment before the elders of the city. ▷ ①Lit these are

column.name: text
column.value: Then the elders of that city shall take the man and rebuke him,

column.name: text
column.value: and they shall fine him a hundred shekels of silver and give it to the girl’s father, because he ①publicly defamed a virgin of Israel. And she shall remain his wife; he is not allowed to ②divorce her all his days. ▷ ①Lit brought out an evil reputation against a virgin ②Lit send her away

column.name: text
column.value: “But if this ①charge is true, and they did not find the girl to have evidence of virginity, ▷ ①Lit matter

column.name: text
column.value: then they shall bring the girl out to the doorway of her father’s house, and the men of her city shall stone her ①to death, because she has committed a disgraceful sin in Israel by playing the prostitute in her father’s house; so you shall eliminate the evil from among you. ▷ ①Lit with stones so that she dies

column.name: text
column.value: “If a man is found sleeping with a married woman, then both of them shall die, the man who slept with the woman, and the woman; so you shall eliminate the evil from Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: “If there is a girl who is a virgin ①betrothed to a man, and another man finds her in the city and sleeps with her, ▷ ①A betrothed couple was considered legally married, but did not yet live together

column.name: text
column.value: then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city and you shall stone them ①to death: the girl, because she did not cry out for help though she was in the city, and the man, because he has violated his neighbor’s wife. So you shall eliminate the evil from among you. ▷ ①Lit with stones so that they die

column.name: text
column.value: “But if the man finds the girl who is betrothed in the field, and the man seizes her and ①rapes her, then only the man who ②raped her shall die. ▷ ①Lit lies down with ②Lit lies down with

column.name: text
column.value: And you are not to do anything to the girl; there is no sin in the girl worthy of death, for just as a man rises against his neighbor and murders him, ①so is this case. ▷ ①I.e., she is only a victim

column.name: text
column.value: When he found her in the field, the betrothed girl ①cried out, but there was no one to save her. ▷ ①I.e., presumably did so

column.name: text
column.value: “If a man finds a girl who is a virgin, who is not betrothed, and he seizes her and has sexual relations with her, and they are discovered,

column.name: text
column.value: then the man who had sexual relations with her shall give the girl’s father fifty shekels of silver, and she shall become his wife, because he has violated her; he is not allowed to divorce her all his days.

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①A man shall not take ②his father’s wife in marriage, so that he does not ③uncover his father’s garment. ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: “If a person who has been killed by someone is found lying in the open country in the land which the LORD your God is giving you to ①possess, and it is not known who struck him, ▷ ①Lit possess it

column.name: text
column.value: then your elders and your judges shall go out and measure the distance to the cities which are around the one who was killed.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be that the city which is nearest to the person killed, that is, that the elders of that city shall take a heifer of the herd that has not been worked ①and has not pulled in a yoke; ▷ ①Lit which has not

column.name: text
column.value: and the elders of that city shall bring the heifer down to a valley with running water, which has not been plowed or sown, and they shall break the heifer’s neck there in the valley.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priests, the sons of Levi, shall come forward, because the LORD your God has chosen them to serve Him and to bless in the name of the LORD; and every dispute and ①violent crime shall be ②settled by them. ▷ ①Lit blow ②Lit according to their mouth

column.name: text
column.value: And all the elders of that city ①which is nearest to the person killed shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley; ▷ ①Lit who are

column.name: text
column.value: and they shall respond and say, ‘Our hands did not shed this blood, nor did our eyes see who did.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Forgive Your people Israel whom You have redeemed, LORD, and do not place the guilt for innocent blood in the midst of Your people Israel.’ And the guilt for bloodshed shall be ②forgiven them. ▷ ①Lit Cover over, atone for ②Lit covered over, atoned for

column.name: text
column.value: So you shall remove the guilt for innocent blood from your midst, when you do what is right in the eyes of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “When you go out to battle against your enemies, and the LORD your God hands them over to you and you take them away captive,

column.name: text
column.value: and you see among the captives a beautiful woman, and are strongly attracted to her and would take her as a wife for yourself,

column.name: text
column.value: then you shall bring her into your home, and she shall shave her head and ①trim her nails. ▷ ①Lit do

column.name: text
column.value: She shall also ①remove the clothes of her captivity and shall remain in your house, and weep for her father and mother a full month; and after that you may have relations with her and become her husband and she shall be your wife. ▷ ①Lit remove from her

column.name: text
column.value: But it shall be, if you are not pleased with her, then you shall let her go ①wherever she wishes; and you certainly shall not sell her for money, you shall not treat her as merchandise, since you have ②humiliated her. ▷ ①Lit according to her soul ②I.e., by a forced marriage

column.name: text
column.value: “If a man has two wives, the one loved and the other ①unloved, and both the loved and the ②unloved have borne him sons, and the firstborn son belongs to the ③unloved, ▷ ①Or scorned; lit hated ②Or scorned; lit hated ③Or scorned; lit hated

column.name: text
column.value: then it shall be on the day that he wills what he owns as an inheritance to his sons, he is not allowed to treat the son of the loved wife as the firstborn, ①at the expense of the son of the ②unloved, who actually is the firstborn son. ▷ ①Lit against the face of ②See note v 15

column.name: text
column.value: On the contrary, he shall acknowledge the firstborn, the son of the ①unloved wife, by giving him a double ②portion of everything that ③he owns, for he was the beginning of his ④strength; to him belongs the right of the firstborn. ▷ ①See note v 15 ②Lit mouthful ③Lit is found with him ④I.e., power of procreation

column.name: text
column.value: “If any person has a stubborn and rebellious son who does not obey his father or his mother, and when they discipline him, he does not listen to them,

column.name: text
column.value: then his father and mother shall seize him, and bring him out to the elders of his city ①at the gateway of his hometown. ▷ ①Lit and to the gate of his place

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall say to the elders of his city, ‘This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious; he does not obey us, he is thoughtless and given to drinking.’

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the men of his city shall stone him to death; so you shall eliminate the evil from your midst, and all Israel will hear about it and fear.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now if ①a person has committed a sin carrying a sentence of death and he is put to death, and you hang him on ②a tree, ▷ ①Lit a sin is in a person carrying ②Lit wood

column.name: text
column.value: his body is not to be left overnight on the ①tree, but you shall certainly bury him on the same day (for he who is hanged is cursed of God), so that you do not defile your land which the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance. ▷ ①Lit wood

column.name: text
column.value: “If there is a dispute between people and they go to ①court, and ②the judges decide their case, and they declare the righteous innocent and pronounce the wicked guilty, ▷ ①Lit the judgment ②Lit they judge them

column.name: text
column.value: then it shall be if the wicked person ①deserves to be beaten, the judge shall then make him lie down and have him beaten in his presence with the number of lashes according to his ②wrongful act. ▷ ①Lit is a son of beating ②Or guilt

column.name: text
column.value: He may have him beaten forty times, but not more, so that he does not have him beaten with many more lashes than these, and that your brother does not become contemptible in your eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not muzzle the ox while it is threshing.

column.name: text
column.value: “When brothers live together, and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the deceased shall not be married outside the family to a strange man. Her husband’s brother shall have relations with her and take her to himself as his wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her.

column.name: text
column.value: It shall then be that the firstborn to whom she gives birth shall ①assume the name of his father’s deceased brother, so that his name will not be wiped out from Israel. ▷ ①Lit stand on

column.name: text
column.value: But if the man does not desire to take his brother’s widow, then his brother’s widow shall go up to the gate to the elders, and say, ‘My husband’s brother refuses to establish a name for his brother in Israel; he is not willing to perform the duty of a husband’s brother to me.’

column.name: text
column.value: Then the elders of his city shall summon him and speak to him. And if he persists and says, ‘I do not desire to take her,’

column.name: text
column.value: then his brother’s widow shall come up to him in the sight of the elders, and pull his sandal off his foot and spit in his face; and she shall ①declare, ‘This is what is done to the man who does not build up his brother’s house!’ ▷ ①Lit answer and say

column.name: text
column.value: And in Israel ①his family shall be called by the name, ‘The house of him whose sandal was removed.’ ▷ ①Lit his name shall be called

column.name: text
column.value: “If two men, a man and his countryman, have a fight ①with each other, and the wife of one comes up to save her husband from the hand of the one who is hitting him, and she reaches out with her hand and grasps ②that man’s genitals, ▷ ①Lit together ②Lit his

column.name: text
column.value: then you shall cut off her ①hand; ②you shall not show pity. ▷ ①Lit palm ②Lit your eye

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not have in your bag ①differing weights, a large and a small. ▷ ①Lit a stone and a stone

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not have in your house ①differing measures, a large and a small. ▷ ①Lit an ephah and an ephah

column.name: text
column.value: You shall have a correct and honest ①weight; you shall have a correct and honest ②measure, so that your days may be prolonged ③in the land which the LORD your God is giving you. ▷ ①Lit stone ②Lit ephah ③Lit on the ground

column.name: text
column.value: For everyone who does these things, everyone who acts unjustly is an abomination to the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: “Remember what Amalek did to you on the way when you came out of Egypt,

column.name: text
column.value: how he confronted you on the way and attacked among you all the stragglers at your rear when you were tired and weary; and he did not ①fear God. ▷ ①Or revere

column.name: text
column.value: So it shall come about, when the LORD your God has given you rest from all your surrounding enemies in the land which the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance to ①possess, that you shall wipe out the mention of the name Amalek from under heaven; you must not forget. ▷ ①Lit possess it

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not sacrifice to the LORD your God an ox or a sheep which has a blemish or any ①defect, for that is a detestable thing to the LORD your God. ▷ ①Lit bad thing

column.name: text
column.value: “If there is found in your midst, in any of your ①towns which the LORD your God is giving you, a man or a woman who does what is evil in the sight of the LORD your God, by violating His covenant, ▷ ①Lit gates

column.name: text
column.value: and that person has gone and served other gods and worshiped them, or the sun, the moon, or any of the heavenly ①lights, which I have commanded not to do, ▷ ①Lit host

column.name: text
column.value: and if it is reported to you and you have heard about it, then you shall investigate thoroughly. And ①if it is true and the report is trustworthy that this detestable thing has been done in Israel, ▷ ①Lit behold, true

column.name: text
column.value: then you are to bring out to your gates that man or woman who has done this evil deed, that is, the man or the woman, and you shall stone them to ①death. ▷ ①Lit death with stones

column.name: text
column.value: On the ①testimony of two witnesses or three witnesses, the ②condemned shall be put to death; he shall not be put to death on the ③testimony of only one witness. ▷ ①Lit mouth ②Lit one dying ③Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: The hands of the witnesses shall be first against him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So you shall eliminate the evil from your midst.

column.name: text
column.value: “If a case is too difficult for you to decide, between ①one kind of homicide or another, between ②one kind of lawsuit or another, and between ③one kind of assault or another, that are cases of dispute in your ④courts, then you shall arise and go up to the place which the LORD your God chooses. ▷ ①Lit blood to blood ②Lit lawsuit to lawsuit ③Lit blow to blow ④Lit gates

column.name: text
column.value: So you shall come to the Levitical priests or the judge who is in office in those days, and you shall inquire of them and they will declare to you the ①verdict. ▷ ①Lit word of decision

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall act in accordance with the ①terms of the verdict which they declare to you from that place which the LORD chooses; and you shall be careful to act in accordance with everything that they instruct you to do. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: In accordance with the ①terms of the law about which they instruct you, and in accordance with the verdict which they tell you, you shall act; you shall not turn aside from the word which they declare to you, to the right or the left. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: But the person who acts insolently by not listening to the priest who stands there to serve the LORD your God, nor to the judge, that person shall die; so you shall eliminate the evil from Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the people will hear and be afraid, and will not act insolently again.

column.name: text
column.value: “When you enter the land which the LORD your God is giving you, and you take possession of it and live in it, and you say, ‘I will appoint a king over me like all the nations who are around me,’

column.name: text
column.value: you shall in fact appoint a king over you whom the LORD your God chooses. One from among your countrymen you shall appoint as king over yourselves; you may not put a foreigner over yourselves, anyone who is not your countryman.

column.name: text
column.value: In any case, he is not to acquire many horses for himself, nor shall he make the people return to Egypt in order to acquire many horses, since the LORD has said to you, ‘You shall never again return that way.’

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall not acquire many wives for himself, so that his heart does not turn away; nor shall he greatly increase silver and gold for himself.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now it shall come about, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write for himself a copy of this Law on a scroll ①in the presence of the Levitical priests. ▷ ①Lit from before

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be with him, and he shall read it all the days of his life, so that he will learn to fear the LORD his God, ①by carefully following all the words of this Law and these statutes, ▷ ①Lit to keep all...to do them,

column.name: text
column.value: so that his heart will not be haughty toward his countrymen, and that he will not turn away from the commandment to the right or the left, so that he and his sons may ①live long in his kingdom in the midst of Israel. ▷ ①Lit prolong days

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep all the commandments which I am commanding you today.

column.name: text
column.value: So it shall be on the day when you cross the Jordan to the land which the LORD your God is giving you, that you shall set up for yourself large stones and coat them with lime

column.name: text
column.value: and write on them all the words of this Law, when you cross over, so that you may enter the land which the LORD your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, ①promised you. ▷ ①Lit spoke to

column.name: text
column.value: So it shall be when you cross the Jordan, you shall set up these stones on Mount Ebal, ①as I am commanding you today, and you shall coat them with lime. ▷ ①Lit which

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, you shall build there an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones; you shall not wield an iron tool on them.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall build the altar of the LORD your God of ①uncut stones, and you shall offer on it burnt offerings to the LORD your God; ▷ ①Lit intact

column.name: text
column.value: and you shall sacrifice peace offerings and eat there, and rejoice before the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall write on the ①stones all the words of this Law very clearly.” ▷ ①I.e., stones coated with lime, cf. v 4

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, “Be silent and listen, Israel! This day you have become a people for the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: So you shall ①obey the LORD your God, and do His commandments and His statutes which I am commanding you today.” ▷ ①Lit listen to the voice of

column.name: text
column.value: Moses also commanded the people on that day, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “When you cross the Jordan, these tribes shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: For the curse, these tribes shall stand on Mount Ebal: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

column.name: text
column.value: The Levites shall then respond and say to all the people of Israel with a loud voice,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Cursed is the person who makes a carved image or cast metal image, an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of a craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ And all the people shall reply and say, ‘Amen.’

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Cursed is one who treats his father or mother contemptuously.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Cursed is one who displaces his neighbor’s boundary marker.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Cursed is one who misleads a person who is blind on the road.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Cursed is one who distorts the justice due a stranger, an ①orphan, or a widow.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’ ▷ ①Or fatherless

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his father’s wife, because he has ①uncovered his father’s garment.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’ ▷ ①Idiom for violated his father’s marriage

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Cursed is one who has sexual intercourse with any animal.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his sister, the daughter of his father or of his mother.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his mother-in-law.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Cursed is he who attacks his neighbor in secret.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Cursed is he who accepts a bribe to attack an innocent person.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Cursed is anyone who does not fulfill the words of this Law by doing them.’ And all the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

column.name: text
column.value: “Now it shall be, if you diligently ①obey the LORD your God, being careful to do all His commandments which I am commanding you today, that the LORD your God will put you high above all the nations of the earth. ▷ ①Lit listen to the voice of

column.name: text
column.value: And all these blessings will come to you and reach you if you ①obey the LORD your God: ▷ ①Lit listen to the voice of

column.name: text
column.value: “Blessed will you be in the city, and blessed will you be in the ①country. ▷ ①Lit field

column.name: text
column.value: “Blessed will be the ①children of your womb, the ②produce of your ground, and the ③offspring of your animals: the newborn of your herd and the young of your flock. ▷ ①Lit fruit ②Lit fruit ③Lit fruit

column.name: text
column.value: “Blessed will be your basket and your kneading bowl.

column.name: text
column.value: “Blessed will you be when you come in, and blessed will you be when you go out.

column.name: text
column.value: “The LORD will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be ①defeated by you; they will go out against you one way and will flee at your presence seven ways. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will command the blessing for you in your ①barns and in everything that you put your hand to, and He will bless you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you. ▷ ①Or storehouses

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will establish you as a holy people to Himself, as He swore to you, if you keep the commandments of the LORD your God and walk in His ways.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the peoples of the earth will see that ①you are called by the name of the LORD, and they will be afraid of you. ▷ ①Lit the name of the LORD is called upon you

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD will give you more than enough prosperity, in the ①children of your womb, in the ②offspring of your livestock, and in the ③produce of your ground, in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give you. ▷ ①Lit fruit ②Lit fruit ③Lit fruit

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will open for you His good storehouse, the heavens, to give rain to your land in its season and to bless every work of your hand; and you will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD will make you the head and not the tail, and you will only be above, and not be underneath, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God which I am commanding you today, to ①follow them carefully, ▷ ①Lit be careful and to perform

column.name: text
column.value: and do not turn aside from any of the words which I am commanding you today, to the right or the left, to pursue other gods to serve them.

column.name: text
column.value: “But it shall come about, if you do not ①obey the LORD your God, to be careful to ②follow all His commandments and His statutes which I am commanding you today, that all these curses will come upon you and overtake you: ▷ ①Lit listen to the voice of ②Lit perform

column.name: text
column.value: “Cursed will you be in the city, and cursed will you be in the ①country. ▷ ①Lit field

column.name: text
column.value: “Cursed will be your basket and your kneading bowl.

column.name: text
column.value: “Cursed will be the ①children of your womb, the ②produce of your ground, the newborn of your herd, and the offspring of your flock. ▷ ①Lit fruit ②Lit fruit

column.name: text
column.value: “Cursed will you be when you come in, and cursed will you be when you go out.

column.name: text
column.value: “The LORD will send against you curses, panic, and rebuke, in ①everything you undertake to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, on account of the evil of your deeds, because you have abandoned Me. ▷ ①Lit every putting forth of your hand which you do

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will make the plague cling to you until He has eliminated you from the land where you are entering to take possession of it.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will strike you with consumption, inflammation, fever, feverish heat, and with ①the sword, with blight, and with mildew, and they will pursue you until you perish. ▷ ①Another reading is drought

column.name: text
column.value: ①The heaven which is over your head shall be bronze, and the earth which is under you, iron. ▷ ①Lit Your

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will make the rain of your land powder and dust; from heaven it shall come down on you until you are destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: “The LORD will cause you to be defeated by your enemies; you will go out one way against them, but you will flee seven ways from their presence, and you will be an example of terror to all the kingdoms of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Your dead bodies will ①serve as food for all birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth, and there will be no one to frighten them away. ▷ ①Lit be for

column.name: text
column.value: “The LORD will strike you with the boils of Egypt and with tumors, the festering rash, and with scabies, from which you cannot be healed.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will strike you with insanity, blindness, and with confusion of ①mind; ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: and you will be groping about at noon, just as a person who is blind gropes in the darkness, and you will not be successful in your ways; but you will only be ①oppressed and robbed all the time, with no one to save you. ▷ ①Or exploited

column.name: text
column.value: You will ①betroth a woman, but another man will ②violate her; you will build a house, but you will not live in it; you will plant a vineyard, but you will not make use of its fruit. ▷ ①A betrothed couple was considered legally married, but did not yet live together ②Or be intimate with

column.name: text
column.value: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes, but you will not eat of it; your donkey will be snatched away from you, and will not ①be restored to you; your ②sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you. ▷ ①Lit return to ②Or flock

column.name: text
column.value: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people, while your eyes look on and long for them constantly; but there will be nothing ①you can do. ▷ ①Lit to the power of your hand

column.name: text
column.value: A people whom you do not know will eat the produce of your ground and every product of your labor, and you will never be anything but oppressed and mistreated continually.

column.name: text
column.value: You will also be driven insane by the sight of ①what you see. ▷ ①Lit your eyes which you

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will strike you on the knees and thighs with severe boils from which you cannot be healed, and strike you from the sole of your foot to the top of your head.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will bring you and your king, whom you appoint over you, to a nation that neither you nor your fathers have known, and there you shall serve other gods, made of wood and stone.

column.name: text
column.value: And you will become an object of horror, a song of mockery, and an object of taunting among all the peoples where the LORD drives you.

column.name: text
column.value: “You will bring out a great amount of seed to the field, but you will gather in little, because the locust will devour it.

column.name: text
column.value: You will plant and cultivate vineyards, but you will neither drink of the wine nor bring in the harvest, because the worm will eat it.

column.name: text
column.value: You will have olive trees throughout your territory but you will not anoint yourself with the oil, because your olives will drop off prematurely.

column.name: text
column.value: You will father sons and daughters but they will not remain yours, because they will go into captivity.

column.name: text
column.value: The cricket will take possession of all your trees and the produce of your ground.

column.name: text
column.value: The stranger who is among you will rise above you higher and higher, and you will go down lower and lower.

column.name: text
column.value: He will lend to you, but you will not lend to him; he will be the head, and you will be the tail.

column.name: text
column.value: “So all these curses shall come upon you and pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, because you would not ①obey the LORD your God by keeping His commandments and His statutes which He commanded you. ▷ ①Lit listen to the voice of

column.name: text
column.value: And they will become a sign and a wonder ①against you and your ②descendants forever. ▷ ①Or on ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: “Since you did not serve the LORD your God with joy and a cheerful heart, in gratitude for the abundance of all things,

column.name: text
column.value: you will serve your enemies whom the LORD will send against you, in hunger, thirst, nakedness, and devoid of all things; and He will put an iron yoke on your neck until He has destroyed you.

column.name: text
column.value: “The LORD will bring a nation against you from far away, from the end of the earth, as the eagle swoops down; a nation whose language you will not understand,

column.name: text
column.value: a nation ①with a defiant attitude, who will have no respect for the old, nor show favor to the young. ▷ ①Lit defiant-faced

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore, it will eat the ①offspring of your herd and the produce of your ground until you are destroyed; a nation that will leave you no grain, new wine, or oil, nor the newborn of your cattle or the young of your flock, until they have eliminated you. ▷ ①Lit fruit

column.name: text
column.value: And it will besiege you in all your ①towns until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down throughout your land, and it will besiege you in all your ②towns throughout your land which the LORD your God has given you. ▷ ①Lit gates ②Lit gates

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will eat the ①offspring of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters whom the LORD your God has given you, during the siege and the hardship by which your enemy will ②oppress you. ▷ ①Lit fruit of your womb ②Or torment

column.name: text
column.value: The man who is ①refined and very delicate among you ②will be hostile toward his brother, toward the wife ③he cherishes, and toward the rest of his children who are left, ▷ ①Or spoiled and pampered ②Lit his eye will be evil toward ③Lit of his breast

column.name: text
column.value: so that he will not give even one of them any of the flesh of his children which he will eat, since he has nothing else left, during the siege and the hardship by which your enemy will ①oppress you in all your ②towns. ▷ ①Or torment ②Lit gates

column.name: text
column.value: The ①refined and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground because of her delicateness and tenderness, ②will be hostile toward the husband ③she cherishes and toward her son and daughter, ▷ ①Or spoiled and pampered ②Lit her eye shall be evil toward ③Lit of her breast

column.name: text
column.value: and toward her afterbirth that comes from between her ①legs, and toward her children to whom she gives birth, because she will eat them secretly for lack of anything else, during the siege and the hardship with which your enemy will ②oppress you in your ③towns. ▷ ①Lit feet ②Or torment ③Lit gates

column.name: text
column.value: “If you are not careful to ①follow all the words of this Law that are written in this book, to ②fear this honored and awesome name, ③the LORD your God, ▷ ①Lit perform ②Or revere ③Heb YHWH

column.name: text
column.value: then the LORD will bring extraordinary plagues on you and ①your descendants, ②severe and lasting plagues, and miserable and chronic sicknesses. ▷ ①Lit plagues on your seed ②Lit great

column.name: text
column.value: And He will bring back on you every disease of Egypt of which you were afraid, and they will cling to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Also every sickness and every plague, which are not written in the book of this Law, the LORD will bring on you until you are destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will be left few in ①number, whereas you were as numerous as the stars of heaven, because you did not ②obey the LORD your God. ▷ ①Lit people ②Lit listen to the voice of

column.name: text
column.value: And it will come about that, just as the LORD rejoiced over you to be good to you, and make you numerous, so will the LORD rejoice over you to wipe you out and destroy you; and you will be torn away from the land which you are entering to possess.

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore, the LORD will scatter you among all the peoples, from one end of the earth to ①the other; and there you will serve other gods, made of wood and stone, which you and your fathers have not known. ▷ ①Lit the end of the earth

column.name: text
column.value: Among those nations you will find no peace, and there will be no resting place for the sole of your foot; but there the LORD will give you a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and despair of soul.

column.name: text
column.value: So your lives will be ①hanging in doubt before you; and you will be terrified night and day, and have no assurance of your life. ▷ ①Lit be hung for you in front

column.name: text
column.value: In the morning you will say, ‘If only it were evening!’ And at evening you will say, ‘If only it were morning!’ because of the terror of your heart which you fear, and the sight of your eyes which you will see.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD will bring you back to Egypt in ships, by the way about which I said to you, ‘You will never see it again!’ And there you will offer yourselves for sale to your enemies as male and female slaves, but there will be no buyer.”

column.name: text
column.value: ①And Moses summoned all Israel and said to them, “You have seen all that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh and all his servants, and to all his land; ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: in Heb

column.name: text
column.value: the great trials which your eyes have seen, those great signs and wonders.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet to this day the LORD has not given you a heart to know, nor eyes to see, nor ears to hear.

column.name: text
column.value: And I have led you in the wilderness for forty years; your clothes have not worn out on you, and your sandal has not worn out on your foot.

column.name: text
column.value: You have not eaten bread, nor have you drunk wine or other strong drink, in order that you might know that I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: When you ①reached this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out to meet us for battle, but we ②defeated them; ▷ ①Lit came to ②Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: and we took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites.

column.name: text
column.value: So you will keep the words of this covenant and do them, in order that you may be successful in everything that you do.

column.name: text
column.value: “You stand today, all of you, before the LORD your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders and your officers, that is, all the men of Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: your little ones, your wives, and the stranger who is within your camps, from the one who gathers your firewood to the one who draws your water,

column.name: text
column.value: so that you may enter into the covenant with the LORD your God, and into His oath which the LORD your God is making with you today,

column.name: text
column.value: in order that He may establish you today as His people, and that He may be your God, just as He spoke to you and as He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now it is not with you alone that I am making this covenant and this oath,

column.name: text
column.value: but both with those who stand here with us today in the presence of the LORD our God, and with those who are not with us here today

column.name: text
column.value: (for you know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we passed through the midst of the nations through which you passed;

column.name: text
column.value: moreover, you have seen their abominations and their idols made of wood and stone, silver and gold, which they had with them);

column.name: text
column.value: so that there will not be among you a man or woman, or family or tribe, whose heart turns away today from the LORD our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; that there will not be among you a root bearing poisonous fruit and wormwood.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be when he hears the words of this curse, that he will consider himself fortunate in his heart, saying, ‘I will do well though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart in order ①to destroy the watered land along with the dry.’ ▷ ①I.e., to destroy everything

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will not be willing to forgive him, but rather the anger of the LORD and His wrath will ①burn against that person, and every curse that is written in this book will lie upon him, and the LORD will wipe out his name from under heaven. ▷ ①Lit smoke

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD will single him out for disaster from all the tribes of Israel, in accordance with all the curses of the covenant which is written in this Book of the Law.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now the future generation, your sons who rise up after you and the foreigner who comes from a distant land, when they see the plagues of that land and the diseases with which the LORD has afflicted it, will say,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘All its land is brimstone and salt, burned debris, ①unsown and unproductive, and no grass grows on it, like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which the LORD overthrew in His anger and in His wrath.’ ▷ ①Lit it is not sown and does not make plants sprout

column.name: text
column.value: All the nations will say, ‘Why has the LORD done all this to this land? Why this great ①outburst of anger?’ ▷ ①Lit heat

column.name: text
column.value: Then people will say, ‘It is because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD, the God of their fathers, which He made with them when He brought them out of the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods that they have not known and whom He had not ①assigned to them. ▷ ①Lit apportioned

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, the anger of the LORD burned against that land, to bring upon it every curse which is written in this book;

column.name: text
column.value: and the LORD uprooted them from their land in anger, fury, and in great wrath, and hurled them into another land, as it is this day.’

column.name: text
column.value: “The secret things belong to the LORD our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our sons forever, so that we may ①follow all the words of this Law. ▷ ①Lit perform

column.name: text
column.value: “No one who is ①emasculated or has his male organ cut off may enter the assembly of the LORD. ▷ ①Lit wounded by crushing of testicles

column.name: text
column.value: No one of illegitimate birth may enter the assembly of the LORD; none of his descendants, even to the tenth generation, may enter the assembly of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: No Ammonite or Moabite may enter the assembly of the LORD; none of their descendants, even to the tenth generation, may ever enter the assembly of the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: because they did not meet you with ①food and water on the way when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of ②Mesopotamia, to curse you. ▷ ①Lit bread ②Heb Aram-naharaim

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, the LORD your God was unwilling to listen to Balaam, but the LORD your God turned the curse into a blessing for you because the LORD your God loves you.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall never seek their peace or their prosperity all your days.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not loathe an ①Edomite, for he is your brother; you shall not loathe an Egyptian, because you were a stranger in his land. ▷ ①I.e., a descendant of Esau

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of the third generation who are born to them may enter the assembly of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “When you go out as ①an army against your enemies, you shall be on guard against every evil thing. ▷ ①Or a camp

column.name: text
column.value: “If there is among you any man who is unclean because of a nocturnal emission, then he must go outside the camp; he may not ①reenter the camp. ▷ ①Lit come to the midst of

column.name: text
column.value: But when evening approaches, he shall bathe himself with water, and at sundown he may ①reenter the camp. ▷ ①Lit come to the midst of

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall also have a place allocated outside the camp, so that you may go out there to relieve yourself,

column.name: text
column.value: and you shall have a ①spade among your tools, and it shall be when you sit down outside, you shall dig with it and shall turn and cover up your excrement. ▷ ①Lit peg

column.name: text
column.value: Since the LORD your God walks in the midst of your camp to save you and to ①defeat your enemies before you, your camp must be holy; so He must not see ②anything indecent among you ③or He will turn away from you. ▷ ①Lit give ②Lit nakedness of anything ③Lit and

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not hand over to his master a slave who has ①escaped from his master to you. ▷ ①Lit delivered himself

column.name: text
column.value: He shall live with you in your midst, in the place that he chooses in one of your ①towns where it pleases him; you shall not mistreat him. ▷ ①Lit gates in the good to him

column.name: text
column.value: “None of the daughters of Israel shall be a cult prostitute, nor shall any of the sons of Israel be a cult prostitute.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not bring the earnings of a prostitute or the money for a ①dog into the house of the LORD your God as payment for any vowed offering, because both of these are an abomination to the LORD your God. ▷ ①Prob. refers to a male prostitute

column.name: text
column.value: “You are not to charge interest to your countrymen: interest on money, food, or anything that may be loaned on interest.

column.name: text
column.value: You may charge interest to a foreigner, but to your countrymen you shall not charge interest, so that the LORD your God may bless you in all ①that you undertake in the land which you are about to enter to ②possess. ▷ ①Lit the putting forth of your hand ②Lit possess it

column.name: text
column.value: “When you make a vow to the LORD your God, you shall not delay to pay it, for the LORD your God will certainly require it of you, and it will be a sin ①for you. ▷ ①Lit in you

column.name: text
column.value: However, if you refrain from making vows, it will not be a sin ①for you. ▷ ①Lit in you

column.name: text
column.value: You shall be careful and perform what goes out of your lips, since in fact you have vowed a ①voluntary offering to the LORD your God, whatever you have ②promised. ▷ ①Or freewill offering ②Lit spoken with your mouth

column.name: text
column.value: “When you enter your neighbor’s vineyard, you may eat grapes ①until you are satisfied; but you are not to put any in your ②basket. ▷ ①Lit according to your soul, your satiation ②Lit container

column.name: text
column.value: “When you enter your neighbor’s standing grain, you may pluck the heads of grain with your hand, but you are not to ①use a sickle on your neighbor’s standing grain. ▷ ①Lit brandish

column.name: text
column.value: “So it will be when all of these things have come upon you, the blessing and the curse which I have placed before you, and you ①call them to mind in all the nations where the LORD your God has scattered you, ▷ ①Lit return them to your heart

column.name: text
column.value: and you return to the LORD your God and ①obey Him with all your heart and soul in accordance with everything that I am commanding you today, you and your sons, ▷ ①Lit listen to His voice

column.name: text
column.value: then the LORD your God will restore ①you from captivity, and have compassion on you, and will gather you again from all the peoples where the LORD your God has scattered you. ▷ ①Lit your captivity

column.name: text
column.value: If any of your scattered countrymen are at the ①ends of the earth, from there the LORD your God will gather you, and from there He will ②bring you back. ▷ ①Lit end of the sky ②Lit take you

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you shall possess it; and He will be good to you and make you more numerous than your fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: “Moreover, the LORD your God will circumcise your heart and the hearts of your ①descendants, to love the LORD your God with all your heart and all your soul, so that you may live. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD your God will ①inflict all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you. ▷ ①Lit give

column.name: text
column.value: And you will again ①obey the LORD, and ②follow all His commandments which I am commanding you today. ▷ ①Lit listen to the voice of ②Lit perform

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD your God will prosper you ①abundantly in every work of your hand, in the ②children of your womb, the ③offspring of your cattle, and in the ④produce of your ground, for the LORD will again rejoice over you for good, just as He rejoiced over your fathers; ▷ ①Lit for good ②Lit fruit ③Lit fruit ④Lit fruit

column.name: text
column.value: ①if you ②obey the LORD your God, to keep His commandments and His statutes which are written in this Book of the Law, ③if you turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and soul. ▷ ①Or for you will ②Lit listen to the voice of ③Or for you will

column.name: text
column.value: “For this commandment which I am commanding you today is not too difficult for you, nor is it far away.

column.name: text
column.value: It is not in heaven, ①that you could say, ‘Who will go up to heaven for us and get it for us, and proclaim it to us, so that we may ②follow it?’ ▷ ①Lit to say ②Lit perform

column.name: text
column.value: Nor is it beyond the sea, ①that you could say, ‘Who will cross the sea for us and get it for us and proclaim it to us, so that we may ②follow it?’ ▷ ①Lit to say ②Lit perform

column.name: text
column.value: On the contrary, the word is very near you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may ①follow it. ▷ ①Lit perform

column.name: text
column.value: “See, I have placed before you today life and ①happiness, and death and ②adversity, ▷ ①Lit good ②Lit evil

column.name: text
column.value: in that I am commanding you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in His ways and to keep His commandments, His statutes, and His judgments, so that you may live and become numerous, and that the LORD your God may bless you in the land where you are entering to take possession of it.

column.name: text
column.value: But if your heart turns away and you will not obey, but allow yourself to be led astray and you worship other gods and serve them,

column.name: text
column.value: I declare to you today that you will certainly perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you are crossing the Jordan to enter ①and take possession of it. ▷ ①Lit to

column.name: text
column.value: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that I have placed before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. So choose life in order that you may live, you and your ①descendants, ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: by loving the LORD your God, by obeying His voice, and by holding close to Him; for ①this is your life and the length of your days, ②so that you may live in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give them.” ▷ ①Lit that ②Lit to dwell

column.name: text
column.value: “Then it shall be, when you enter the land which the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and you take possession of it and live in it,

column.name: text
column.value: that you shall take some of the first of all the produce of the ground which you bring in from your land that the LORD your God gives you, and you shall put it in a basket and go to the place where the LORD your God chooses to establish His name.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall go to the priest who is in office at that time and say to him, ‘I declare today to the LORD ①my God that I have entered the land which the LORD swore to our fathers to give us.’ ▷ ①As in LXX; MT your

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall take the basket from your hand and set it before the altar of the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall respond and say before the LORD your God, ‘My father was a ①wandering Aramean, and he went down to Egypt and ②resided there, few in number; but there he became a great, mighty, and populous nation. ▷ ①Or perishing ②Or lived as a foreigner

column.name: text
column.value: And the Egyptians treated us badly and oppressed us, and imposed hard labor on us.

column.name: text
column.value: Then we cried out to the LORD, the God of our fathers, and the LORD heard our voice and saw our wretched condition, our trouble, and our oppression;

column.name: text
column.value: and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand, an outstretched arm, and with great terror, and with signs and wonders;

column.name: text
column.value: and He has brought us to this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.

column.name: text
column.value: And now behold, I have brought the first of the produce of the ground which You, LORD have given me.’ Then you shall set it before the LORD your God, and worship before the LORD your God;

column.name: text
column.value: and you, the Levite, and the stranger who is among you shall rejoice in all the good which the LORD your God has given you and your household.

column.name: text
column.value: “When you have finished paying all the tithe of your produce in the third year, the year of the tithe, then you shall give it to the Levite, to the stranger, to the ①orphan, and to the widow, so that they may eat in your ②towns and be satisfied. ▷ ①Or fatherless ②Lit gates

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall say before the LORD your God, ‘I have removed the sacred portion from my house, and have also given it to the Levite, the stranger, the ①orphan, and the widow, in accordance with all Your commandments which You have commanded me; I have not violated or forgotten any of Your commandments. ▷ ①Or fatherless

column.name: text
column.value: I have not eaten of it while mourning, nor have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor offered any of it to the dead. I have listened to the voice of the LORD my God; I have acted in accordance with everything that You have commanded me.

column.name: text
column.value: Look down from Your holy dwelling place, from heaven, and bless Your people Israel, and the ground which You have given us, a land flowing with milk and honey just as You swore to our fathers.’

column.name: text
column.value: “This day the LORD your God commands you to perform these statutes and ordinances. Therefore you shall be careful to perform them with all your heart and with all your soul.

column.name: text
column.value: Today you have declared the LORD to be your God, and ①that you will walk in His ways and keep His statutes, His commandments, and His ordinances, and listen to His voice. ▷ ①Lit to walk in

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD has today declared you to be His people, His personal possession, just as He promised you, and ①that you are to keep all His commandments; ▷ ①Lit to keep all

column.name: text
column.value: and ①that He will put you high above all the nations which He has made, for glory, fame, and honor; and that you shall be a consecrated people to the LORD your God, just as He has spoken.” ▷ ①Lit to put you

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, “I am 120 years old today; I am no longer able to ①go out and come in, and the LORD has told me, ‘You shall not cross this Jordan.’ ▷ ①I.e., as Israel’s leader

column.name: text
column.value: It is the LORD your God who is going to cross ahead of you; He Himself will destroy these nations before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua is the one who is going to cross ahead of you, just as the LORD has spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD will do to them just as He did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when He destroyed them.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will turn them over to you, and you will do to them in accordance with all the commandments which I have commanded you.

column.name: text
column.value: Be strong and courageous, do not be afraid or in dread of them, for the LORD your God is the One who is going with you. He will not desert you or abandon you.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses called to Joshua and said to him in the sight of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you will go with this people into the land which the LORD has sworn to their fathers to give them, and you will give it to them as an inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD is the one who is going ahead of you; He will be with you. He will not desert you or abandon you. Do not fear and do not be dismayed.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses wrote this Law and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and to all the elders of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses commanded them, saying, “At the end of every seven years, at the time of the year of the release of debts, at the Feast of Booths,

column.name: text
column.value: when all Israel comes to appear before the LORD your God at the place which He will choose, you shall read this Law before all Israel ①so that they hear it. ▷ ①Lit in their ears

column.name: text
column.value: Assemble the people, the men, the women, the children, and the stranger who is in your ①town, so that they may hear and learn and fear the LORD your God, and be careful to ②follow all the words of this Law. ▷ ①Lit gates ②Lit perform

column.name: text
column.value: And their children, who have not known, will hear and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as you live on the land ①which you are about to cross the Jordan to ②possess.” ▷ ①Lit where ②Lit possess it

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Behold, ①the time for you to die is near; call Joshua and present yourselves at the tent of meeting, and I will commission him.” So Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves at the tent of meeting. ▷ ①Lit your days to die are

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD appeared in the tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood at the entrance of the tent.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, you are about to ①lie down with your fathers; and this people will arise and play the prostitute with the foreign gods of the land into the midst of which they are going, and they will abandon Me and break My covenant which I have made with them. ▷ ①I.e., die

column.name: text
column.value: Then My anger will be kindled against them on that day, and I will abandon them and hide My face from them, and they will be consumed, and many evils and troubles will find them; so they will say on that day, ‘Is it not because our God is not among us that these evils have found us?’

column.name: text
column.value: But I will assuredly hide My face on that day because of all the evil that they will have done, for they will have turned away to other gods.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now then, write this song for yourselves, and teach it to the sons of Israel; put it ①on their lips, so that this song may be a witness for Me against the sons of Israel. ▷ ①Lit in their mouths

column.name: text
column.value: For when I bring them into the land flowing with milk and honey, which I swore to their fathers, and they eat and are satisfied and become ①prosperous, then they will turn to other gods and serve them, and spurn Me and break My covenant. ▷ ①Lit fat

column.name: text
column.value: Then it will come about, when many evils and troubles find them, that this song will testify before them as a witness (for it shall not be forgotten from the mouth of their ①descendants); for I know their inclination which they are ②developing today, before I bring them into the land which I swore.” ▷ ①Lit seed ②Lit making

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses wrote down this song on the same day, and taught it to the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, “Be strong and courageous, for you will bring the sons of Israel into the land which I swore to them, and I will be with you.”

column.name: text
column.value: It came about, when Moses finished writing the words of this Law in a book until they were complete,

column.name: text
