column.value: that Moses commanded the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Take this Book of the Law and place it beside the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, so that it may ①remain there as a witness against you. ▷ ①Lit be

column.name: text
column.value: For I know your rebellion and your ①stubbornness; behold, as long as I have been alive with you until today, you have been rebellious against the LORD; how much more, then, after my death? ▷ ①Lit stiff neck

column.name: text
column.value: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officers, that I may speak these words in their hearing and call the heavens and the earth as witnesses against them.

column.name: text
column.value: For I know that after my death you will behave very corruptly and turn from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will confront you in the latter days, because you will do that which is evil in the sight of the LORD, provoking Him to anger with the work of your hands.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses spoke in the hearing of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, until they were complete:

column.name: text
column.value: “When a man takes a wife and marries her, and it happens, if she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some indecency in her, that he writes her a certificate of divorce, puts it in her hand, and ①sends her away from his house, ▷ ①Or dismisses her

column.name: text
column.value: and she leaves his house and goes and becomes another man’s wife,

column.name: text
column.value: and the latter husband ①turns against her, writes her a certificate of divorce and puts it in her hand, and ②sends her away from his house, or if the latter husband who took her to be his wife dies, ▷ ①Lit hates her ②Or dismisses her

column.name: text
column.value: then her former husband who ①sent her away is not allowed to take her again to be his wife, after ②she has been defiled; for that is an abomination before the LORD, and you shall not bring sin on the land which the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance. ▷ ①Or dismissed her ②I.e., in relationship to him

column.name: text
column.value: “When a man takes a new wife, he is not to go out with the army, nor be assigned any duty; he shall be free at home for one year and shall make his wife whom he has taken happy.

column.name: text
column.value: “No one shall seize a handmill or an upper millstone as a pledge for a loan, since he would be seizing the debtor’s ①means of life as a pledge. ▷ ①Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: “If someone is ①caught kidnapping any of his countrymen of the sons of Israel, and he treats him as merchandise and sells him, then that thief shall die; so you shall eliminate the evil from among you. ▷ ①Lit found stealing

column.name: text
column.value: “Be careful about an infestation of leprosy, that you are very attentive and act in accordance with everything that the Levitical priests teach you; just as I have commanded them, you shall be careful to act.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam on the way as you came out of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: “When you make your neighbor a loan of any kind, you shall not enter his house to take his pledge.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall stand outside, and the person to whom you are making the loan shall bring the pledge outside to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he is a poor man, you shall not sleep with his pledge.

column.name: text
column.value: When the sun goes down you shall certainly return the pledge to him, so that he may sleep in his cloak and bless you; and it will be righteousness for you before the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not exploit a hired worker who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your countrymen or one of your strangers who are in your land in your ①towns. ▷ ①Lit gates

column.name: text
column.value: You shall give him his wages on his day ①before the sun sets—for he is poor and sets his ②heart on it—so that he does not cry out against you to the LORD, and it becomes a sin in you. ▷ ①Lit that the sun shall not go down on it ②Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: “Fathers shall not be put to death for their sons, nor shall sons be put to death for their fathers; everyone shall be put to death for his own sin alone.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not pervert the justice ①due a stranger or ②an orphan, nor seize a widow’s garment as a ③pledge. ▷ ①Lit of ②Or the fatherless ③I.e., for a loan

column.name: text
column.value: But you are to remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and that the LORD your God redeemed you from there; therefore I am commanding you to do this thing.

column.name: text
column.value: “When you reap your harvest in your field and forget a sheaf in the field, you are not to go back to get it; it shall belong to the stranger, the ①orphan, and to the widow, in order that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands. ▷ ①Or fatherless

column.name: text
column.value: When you beat the olives off your olive tree, you are not to search through the branches ①again; that shall be left for the stranger, the ②orphan, and for the widow. ▷ ①Lit after yourself ②Or fatherless

column.name: text
column.value: “When you gather the grapes of your vineyard, you are not to ①go over it again; that shall be left for the stranger, the ②orphan, and the widow. ▷ ①Lit glean it after yourself ②Or fatherless

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt; therefore I am commanding you to do this thing.

column.name: text
column.value: “Listen, you heavens, and I will speak; And let the earth hear the words of my mouth!

column.name: text
column.value: May my teaching drip as the rain, My speech trickle as the dew, As droplets on the fresh grass, And as the showers on the vegetation.

column.name: text
column.value: For I proclaim the name of the LORD; Ascribe greatness to our God!

column.name: text
column.value: The Rock! His work is perfect, For all His ways are ①just; A God of faithfulness and without injustice, Righteous and just is He. ▷ ①Or judgment

column.name: text
column.value: ①They have acted corruptly against Him, They are not His children, because of their defect; But are a perverse and crooked generation. ▷ ①Lit It has

column.name: text
column.value: Is this what you do to the LORD, You foolish and unwise people? Is He not your Father who has purchased you? He has made you and established you.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember the days of old, Consider the years of all generations. Ask your father and he will inform you, Your elders, and they will tell you.

column.name: text
column.value: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, When He separated the sons of ①mankind, He set the boundaries of the peoples According to the number of the ②sons of Israel. ▷ ①Or Adam ②As in MT; DSS sons of God; LXX angels of God

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD’S portion is His people; Jacob is the allotment of His inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: He found him in a desert land, And in the howling wasteland of a wilderness; He encircled him, He cared for him, He guarded him as the ①apple of His eye. ▷ ①Lit pupil

column.name: text
column.value: As an eagle stirs up its nest, And hovers over its young, He spread His wings, He caught them, He carried them on His pinions.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD alone guided him, And there was no foreign god with him.

column.name: text
column.value: He had him ride on the high places of the earth, And he ate the produce of the field; And He had him suck honey from the rock, And ①oil from the flinty rock, ▷ ①I.e., olive oil

column.name: text
column.value: Curds of the herd, and milk of the flock, With fat of lambs And rams, the breed of Bashan, and of goats, With the best of the wheat; And you drank wine of the blood of grapes.

column.name: text
column.value: “But ①Jeshurun became fat and kicked— You have become fat, thick, and obstinate— Then he abandoned God who made him, And ②rejected the Rock of his salvation. ▷ ①I.e., Israel ②Lit declared void

column.name: text
column.value: They made Him jealous with strange gods; With abominations they provoked Him to anger.

column.name: text
column.value: They sacrificed to demons, who were not God, To gods whom they have not known, New gods who came lately, Whom your fathers did not know.

column.name: text
column.value: You forgot the Rock who fathered you, And forgot the God who gave you birth.

column.name: text
column.value: “The LORD saw this, and spurned them Because of the provocation by His sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He said, ‘I will hide My face from them, I will see what their end will be; For they are a perverse generation, Sons in whom there is no faithfulness.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For a fire has flared in My anger, And it burns to the lowest part of ①Sheol, And devours the earth with its yield, And sets on fire the foundations of the mountains. ▷ ①I.e., the netherworld

column.name: text
column.value: ‘I will add misfortunes to them; I will use up My arrows on them.

column.name: text
column.value: They will be wasted by famine, and emaciated by ①plague And a bitter epidemic; And the teeth of beasts I will send against them, With the venom of crawling things of the dust. ▷ ①Lit burning heat

column.name: text
column.value: Outside the sword will make them childless, And inside, terror— Both young man and virgin, The nursing child with the man of gray hair.

column.name: text
column.value: I would have said, “I will wipe them out, I will remove the mention of ①their name from humanity,” ▷ ①Lit them

column.name: text
column.value: Had I not feared the provocation by the enemy, That their adversaries would misjudge, That they would say, “Our hand is ①triumphant, And the LORD has not performed all this.” ’ ▷ ①Lit high

column.name: text
column.value: “For they are a nation ①destitute of counsel, And there is no understanding in them. ▷ ①Lit perishing of

column.name: text
text
column.value: How could one chase a thousand, And two put ten thousand to flight, Unless their Rock had sold them, And the LORD had given them up?

column.name: text
text
column.value: For their vine is from the vine of Sodom, And from the fields of Gomorrah; Their grapes are grapes of poison, Their clusters, bitter.

column.name: text
column.value: Their wine is the venom of ①serpents, And the ②deadly poison of vipers. ▷ ①Lit dragons ②Lit cruel

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Is it not stored up with Me, Sealed up in My treasuries?

column.name: text
column.value: Vengeance is Mine, and retribution; In due time their foot will slip. For the day of their disaster is near, And the impending things are hurrying to them.’

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD will vindicate His people, And will have compassion on His servants, When He sees that their ①strength is gone, And there is none remaining, bond or free. ▷ ①Lit hand

column.name: text
column.value: And He will say, ‘Where are their gods, The rock in which they took refuge?

column.name: text
column.value: Those who ate the fat of their sacrifices, And drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you, Let them be your protection!

column.name: text
column.value: See now that I, I am He, And there is no god besides Me; It is I who put to death and give life. I have wounded and it is I who heal, And there is no one who can save anyone from My hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, I raise My hand to heaven, And say, as I live forever,

column.name: text
column.value: If I have sharpened ①My flashing sword, And My hand has taken hold of justice, I will return vengeance on My adversaries, And I will repay those who hate Me. ▷ ①Lit the lightning of My sword

column.name: text
column.value: I will make My arrows drunk with blood, And My sword will devour flesh, With the blood of the slain and the captives, From the long-haired ①leaders of the enemy.’ ▷ ①Lit head

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice, you nations, with His people; For He will avenge the blood of His servants, And will return vengeance on His adversaries, And will atone for His land and His people.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the hearing of the people, he, with ①Joshua the son of Nun. ▷ ①Lit Hoshea

column.name: text
column.value: When Moses had finished speaking all these words to all Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: he said to them, “Take to your heart all the words with which I am warning you today, which you will command your sons to ①follow carefully, all the words of this Law. ▷ ①Lit be careful to perform

column.name: text
column.value: For it is not a ①trivial matter for you; indeed it is your life. And by this word you will prolong your days in the land, ②which you are about to cross the Jordan to ③possess.” ▷ ①Lit empty word ②Lit where ③Lit possess it

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD spoke to Moses that very same day, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Go up to this mountain of the Abarim, Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab ①opposite Jericho, and look at the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the sons of Israel as a possession. ▷ ①Lit which is opposite

column.name: text
column.value: Then you are to die on the mountain where you ascend, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people,

column.name: text
column.value: because you broke faith with Me in the midst of the sons of Israel at the waters of Meribah-kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin, because you did not treat Me as holy in the midst of the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: For you will see the land at a distance but you will not go there, into the land which I am giving the sons of Israel.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD, that the LORD spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ ①servant, saying, ▷ ①Or minister

column.name: text
column.value: “Moses My servant is dead; so now arise, cross this Jordan, you and all this people, to the land which I am giving to them, to the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Every place on which the sole of your foot steps, I have given it to you, just as I spoke to Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: From the wilderness and this Lebanon, even as far as the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and as far as the Great Sea toward the setting of the sun will be your territory.

column.name: text
column.value: No one will be able to oppose you all the days of your life. Just as I have been with Moses, I will be with you; I will not desert you nor abandon you.

column.name: text
column.value: Be strong and courageous, for you shall give this people possession of the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.

column.name: text
column.value: Only be strong and very courageous; ①be careful to do according to all the Law which Moses My servant commanded you; do not turn from it to the right or to the left, so that you may ②achieve success wherever you go. ▷ ①Lit to observe ②Or have insight

column.name: text
column.value: This Book of the Law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, so that you may ①be careful to do according to all that is written in it; for then you will make your way prosperous, and then you will ②achieve success. ▷ ①Lit observe ②Or have insight

column.name: text
column.value: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous! Do not be terrified nor dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Pass through the midst of the camp and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare provisions for yourselves, for within three days you are going to cross this Jordan, to go in to take possession of the land which the LORD your God is giving you, to possess it.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: But to the Reubenites, to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua ①said, ▷ ①Lit said, saying

column.name: text
column.value: “Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying, ‘The LORD your God is giving you rest, and will give you this land.’

column.name: text
column.value: Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall remain in the land which Moses gave you beyond the Jordan, but you shall cross ahead of your brothers in battle formation, all your valiant warriors, and shall help them,

column.name: text
column.value: until the LORD gives your brothers rest, as He is giving you, and they also possess the land which the LORD your God is giving them. Then you may return to ①your own land, and take possession of ②that which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise.” ▷ ①Lit the land of your possession ②Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: They answered Joshua, saying, “All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.

column.name: text
column.value: Just as we obeyed Moses in all things, so we will obey you; only may the LORD your God be with you as He was with Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who rebels against your ①command and does not obey your words in all that you command him, shall be put to death; only be strong and courageous.” ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Now Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, which is opposite Jericho. And the LORD showed him all the land, Gilead as far as Dan,

column.name: text
column.value: and all Naphtali and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah as far as the ①western sea, ▷ ①I.e., Mediterranean Sea

column.name: text
column.value: and the ①Negev and the territory in the Valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, as far as Zoar. ▷ ①I.e., South country

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to him, “This is the land which I swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your ①descendants’; I have let you see it with your eyes, but you will not go over there.” ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, in accordance with the ①word of the LORD. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: And He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab, opposite Beth-peor; but no one knows his burial place to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Although Moses was 120 years old when he died, his eyesight was not dim, nor had his vigor left him.

column.name: text
column.value: So the sons of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab for thirty days; then the days of weeping and mourning for Moses came to an end.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Joshua the son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom, because Moses had laid his hands on him; and the sons of Israel listened to him and did as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Since that time no prophet has risen in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,

column.name: text
column.value: for all the signs and wonders which the LORD sent him to perform in the land of Egypt against Pharaoh, all his servants, and all his land—

column.name: text
column.value: and for all the mighty ①power and all the great terror which Moses performed in the sight of all Israel. ▷ ①Lit hand

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua the son of Nun sent two men as spies secretly from Shittim, saying, “Go, view the land, especially Jericho.” So they went and entered the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab, and rested there.

column.name: text
column.value: But it was told to the king of Jericho, saying, “Behold, men from the sons of Israel have come here tonight to spy out the land.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Jericho sent word to Rahab, saying, “Bring out the men who have come to you, who have entered your house, for they have come to spy out all the land.”

column.name: text
column.value: But the woman had taken the two men and hidden them, and she said, “Yes, the men came to me, but I did not know where they were from.

column.name: text
column.value: It came about, when it was time to shut the gate at dark, that the men went out; I do not know where the men went. Pursue them quickly, for you will overtake them.”

column.name: text
column.value: But she had brought them up to the roof and hidden them in the stalks of flax which she had laid in order on the roof.

column.name: text
column.value: So the men pursued them on the road to the Jordan, to the crossing places; and as soon as those who were pursuing them had gone out, they shut the gate.

column.name: text
column.value: Now before ①the spies lay down, she came up to them on the roof, ▷ ①Lit they lay

column.name: text
column.value: and said to the men, “I know that the LORD has given you the land, and that the terror of you has fallen on us, and that all the inhabitants of the land have despaired because of you.

column.name: text
column.value: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the ①Red Sea before you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon and Og, whom you ②utterly destroyed. ▷ ①Lit Sea of Reeds ②Or put under the ban

column.name: text
column.value: When we heard these reports, our hearts melted and no ①courage remained in anyone any longer because of you; for the LORD your God, He is God in heaven above and on earth below. ▷ ①Lit spirit arose

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, please swear to me by the LORD, since I have dealt kindly with you, that you also will deal kindly with my father’s household, and give me a pledge of ①truth, ▷ ①Or faithfulness

column.name: text
column.value: and ①spare my father and my mother, and my brothers and my sisters, and all who belong to them, and save our ②lives from death.” ▷ ①Lit let live ②Lit souls

column.name: text
column.value: So the men said to her, “Our ①life ②for yours if you do not tell this business of ours; and it shall come about when the LORD gives us the land that we will deal kindly and ③faithfully with you.” ▷ ①Lit soul ②Lit instead of you to die ③Or truly

column.name: text
column.value: Then she let them down by a rope through the window, for her house was on the city wall, so that she was living on the wall.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said to them, “Go to the hill country, so that the pursuers will not encounter you, and hide yourselves there for three days until the pursuers return. Then afterward you may go on your way.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the men said to her, “We shall be exempt from this oath ①to you which you have made us swear, ▷ ①Lit of yours

column.name: text
column.value: ①unless, when we come into the land, you tie this cord of scarlet thread in the window through which you let us down, and gather into your house your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father’s household. ▷ ①Lit behold

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come about that anyone who goes out of the doors of your house outside will have ①his blood on his own head, and we will be innocent; but anyone who is with you in the house, his blood will be on our head if a hand is laid on him. ▷ ①I.e., responsibility for his death

column.name: text
column.value: But if you tell this business of ours, then we shall be exempt from the oath which you have made us swear.”

column.name: text
column.value: She then said, “According to your words, so be it.” So she sent them away, and they departed; and she tied the scarlet cord in the window.

column.name: text
column.value: So they departed and came to the hill country, and remained there for three days, until the pursuers returned. Now the pursuers had searched for them ①all along the road, but had not found them. ▷ ①Lit through all the road

column.name: text
column.value: Then the two men returned and came down from the hill country, and they crossed over and came to Joshua the son of Nun. Then they reported to him all that had happened to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to Joshua, “The LORD has indeed handed over to us all the land; furthermore, all the inhabitants of the land have despaired because of us.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now this is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the sons of Israel before his death.

column.name: text
column.value: He said, “The LORD came from Sinai, And ①dawned on them from Seir; He shone from Mount Paran, And He came from the midst of myriads of ②holy ones; At His right hand there was ③flashing lightning for them. ▷ ①Lit rose to ②Lit holiness ③Or a fiery law

column.name: text
text
column.value: Moses issued to us the Law, A possession for the assembly of Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: And He was king in ①Jeshurun, When the heads of the people gathered, The tribes of Israel together. ▷ ①A symbolic name for Israel

column.name: text
column.value: “May Reuben live and not die, Nor may his people be few.”

column.name: text
column.value: And this was regarding Judah; so he said: “Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah, And bring him to his people. With his hands he contended for ①them, And may You be a help against his adversaries.” ▷ ①Lit him

column.name: text
column.value: Of Levi he said, “Let Your Thummim and Your Urim belong to Your godly man, Whom You tested at Massah, With ①whom You contended at the waters of Meribah; ▷ ①Lit him

column.name: text
column.value: Who said of his father and his mother, ‘I did not consider them’; And he did not acknowledge his brothers, Nor did he regard his own sons, For they kept Your word, And complied with Your covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: They will teach Your ordinances to Jacob, And Your Law to Israel. They shall put ①incense before You, And whole burnt offerings on Your altar. ▷ ①Lit smoke in Your nostrils

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, bless his strength, And accept the work of his hands; Smash the ①hips of those who rise up against him, And those who hate him, so that they do not rise again.” ▷ ①Lit loins

column.name: text
column.value: Of Benjamin he said, “May the beloved of the LORD live in security beside Him Who shields him all the day long, And he lives between His shoulders.”

column.name: text
column.value: Of Joseph he said, “Blessed of the LORD be his land, With the choice things of heaven, with the dew, And from the deep waters lying beneath,

column.name: text
column.value: And with the choice yield of the sun, And the choice produce of the months;

column.name: text
column.value: And with the ①best things of the ancient mountains, With the choice things of the everlasting hills, ▷ ①Or chief

column.name: text
column.value: And with the choice things of the earth and its fullness, And the favor of Him who dwelt in the bush. Let it come to the head of Joseph, And to the top of the head of the one who was prince among his brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: As the firstborn of his ox, majesty is his, And his horns are the horns of the wild ox; With them he will gore the peoples All ①at once, to the ends of the earth. And those are the ten thousands of Ephraim, And those are the thousands of Manasseh.” ▷ ①Or together

column.name: text
column.value: Of Zebulun he said, “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out, And, Issachar, in your tents.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Of Gad he said, “Blessed is the one who enlarges Gad; He lies down as a ①lion, And tears the arm, also the crown of the head. ▷ ①Or lioness

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Of Naphtali he said, “Naphtali, satisfied with favor, And full of the blessing of the LORD, Take possession of the sea and the south.”

column.name: text
column.value: Of Asher he said, “More blessed than sons is Asher; May he be favored by his brothers, And may he dip his foot in olive oil.

column.name: text
column.value: Your ①bars will be iron and bronze, And as your days, so will your strength be. ▷ ①I.e., to secure gates

column.name: text
column.value: “There is no one like the God of ①Jeshurun, Who rides the heavens ②to your help, And the clouds in His majesty. ▷ ①I.e., Israel ②Lit in

column.name: text
column.value: The eternal God is a ①hiding place, And underneath are the everlasting arms; And He drove out the enemy from you, And said, ‘Destroy!’ ▷ ①Or refuge

column.name: text
column.value: So Israel lives in security, The fountain of Jacob secluded, In a land of grain and new wine; His heavens also drip down dew.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are you, Israel; Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD, The shield of your help, And He who is the sword of your majesty! So your enemies will cringe before you, And you will trample on their high places.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua got up early in the morning; and he and all the sons of Israel set out from Shittim and came to the Jordan, and they spent the night there before they crossed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then at the end of three days the officers went through the midst of the camp;

column.name: text
column.value: and they commanded the people, saying, “When you see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God with the Levitical priests carrying it, then you shall set out from your place and go after it.

column.name: text
column.value: However, there shall be a distance between you and it of about ①two thousand cubits by measurement. Do not come near it, so that you may know the way by which you shall go, for you have not passed this way before.” ▷ ①About 3,000 ft. or 914 m

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua said to the people, “Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the LORD will do miracles among you.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, “Take up the ark of the covenant and cross over ahead of the people.” So they took up the ark of the covenant and went ahead of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD said to Joshua, “This day I will begin to exalt you in the sight of all Israel, so that they will know that just as I have been with Moses, I will be with you.

column.name: text
column.value: So you shall command the priests who are carrying the ark of the covenant, saying, ‘When you come to the edge of the waters of the Jordan, you shall stand still in the Jordan.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua said to the sons of Israel, “Come here, and hear the words of the LORD your God.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua said, “By this you will know that the living God is among you, and that He will assuredly drive out from you the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Hivite, the Perizzite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, and the Jebusite.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth is crossing over ahead of you into the Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, take for yourselves twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one man for each tribe.

column.name: text
column.value: And it will come about when the soles of the feet of the priests who carry the ark of the LORD, the Lord of all the earth, rest in the waters of the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan will be cut off, that is, the waters which are ①flowing down from above; and they will stand in one heap.” ▷ ①Lit going

column.name: text
column.value: So when the people set out from their tents to cross the Jordan, with the priests carrying the ark of the covenant before the people,

column.name: text
column.value: and when those who were carrying the ark came up to the Jordan and the feet of the priests carrying the ark ①stepped down into the edge of the water (for the Jordan overflows all its banks all the days of harvest), ▷ ①Lit were dipped in

column.name: text
column.value: then the waters which were ①flowing down from above stood and rose up in one heap, a great distance away at Adam, the city that is beside Zarethan; and those which were ②flowing down toward the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, were completely cut off. So the people crossed opposite Jericho. ▷ ①Lit going ②Lit going

column.name: text
column.value: And the priests who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan while all Israel crossed on dry ground, until all the nation had finished crossing the Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the entire nation had finished crossing the Jordan, the LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Take for yourselves twelve men from the people, one man from each tribe,

column.name: text
column.value: and command them, saying, ‘Take up for yourselves twelve stones from here out of the middle of the Jordan, from the place where the priests’ feet are standing firmly, and carry them over with you and lay them down in the encampment where you will spend the night.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua called the twelve men whom he had appointed from the sons of Israel, one man from each tribe;

column.name: text
column.value: and Joshua said to them, “ ①Cross again to the ark of the LORD your God into the middle of the Jordan, and each of you take up a stone on his shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Israel. ▷ ①Lit Cross before the ark

column.name: text
column.value: ①This shall be a sign among you; when your children ask ②later, saying, ‘What do these stones mean to you?’ ▷ ①Lit So that this may be ②Lit tomorrow

column.name: text
column.value: then you shall say to them, ‘That the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD; when it crossed the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off.’ So these stones shall become a memorial to the sons of Israel forever.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the sons of Israel did exactly as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, just as the LORD spoke to Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Israel; and they carried them over with them to the encampment and put them down there.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan at the place where the feet of the priests who carried the ark of the covenant were standing, and they are there to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: For the priests who carried the ark were standing in the middle of the Jordan until everything was completed that the LORD had commanded Joshua to speak to the people, according to all that Moses had commanded Joshua. And the people hurried and crossed;

column.name: text
column.value: and when all the people had finished crossing, then the ark of the LORD and the priests crossed in front of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Reuben, the sons of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over in battle formation before the sons of Israel, just as Moses had spoken to them;

column.name: text
column.value: about forty thousand equipped for war, crossed for battle before the LORD to the desert plains of Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day the LORD exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel, so that they ①revered him, just as they had ②revered Moses all the days of his life. ▷ ①Or feared ②Or feared

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD said to ①Joshua, ▷ ①Lit Joshua, saying

column.name: text
column.value: “Command the priests who carry the ark of the testimony that they come up from the Jordan.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua commanded the priests, saying, “Come up from the Jordan.”

column.name: text
column.value: It came about when the priests who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD had come up from the middle of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet were ①lifted up to the dry ground, that the waters of the Jordan returned to their place, and went over all its banks as before. ▷ ①Lit drawn out

column.name: text
column.value: Now the people came up from the Jordan on the tenth of the first month and camped at Gilgal, on the eastern edge of Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: As for ①those twelve stones which they had taken from the Jordan, Joshua set them up at Gilgal. ▷ ①Lit these

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to the sons of ①Israel, “When your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, ‘What are these stones?’ ▷ ①Lit Israel, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: then you shall inform your children, saying, ‘Israel crossed this Jordan on dry ground.’

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of the Jordan before you until you had crossed, just as the LORD your God had done to the ①Red Sea, which He dried up before us until we had crossed; ▷ ①Lit Sea of Reeds

column.name: text
column.value: so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the hand of the LORD is mighty, so that you may ①fear the LORD your God ②forever.” ▷ ①Or revere ②Lit all the days

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about when all the kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan to the west, and all the kings of the Canaanites who were by the sea, heard how the LORD had dried up the waters of the Jordan before the sons of Israel until ①they had crossed, that their hearts melted, and there was no spirit in them any longer because of the sons of Israel. ▷ ①Other mss we

column.name: text
column.value: At that time the LORD said to Joshua, “Make for yourself flint knives and circumcise again the sons of Israel the second time.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua made himself flint knives and circumcised the sons of Israel at ①Gibeath-haaraloth. ▷ ①I.e., the hill of the foreskins

column.name: text
column.value: This is the reason why Joshua circumcised them: all the people who came out of Egypt who were males, all the men of war, died in the wilderness along the way after they came out of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: For all the people who came out were circumcised, but all the people who were born in the wilderness along the way as they came out of Egypt had not been circumcised.

column.name: text
column.value: For the sons of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, until all the nation, that is, the men of war who came out of Egypt, ①perished because they did not listen to the voice of the LORD, to whom the LORD had sworn that He would not let them see the land which the LORD had sworn to their fathers to give us, a land flowing with milk and honey. ▷ ①Lit were finished

column.name: text
column.value: So their children whom He raised up in their place, Joshua ①circumcised; for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them along the way. ▷ ①Lit circumcised them

column.name: text
column.value: Now when they had finished circumcising all the nation, they remained in their places in the camp until they recovered.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away the shame of Egypt from you.” So the name of that place is called ①Gilgal to this day. ▷ ①I.e., wheel, or stone circle

column.name: text
column.value: While the sons of Israel camped at Gilgal they celebrated the Passover on the evening of the fourteenth day of the month on the desert plains of Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: Then on the day after the Passover, on ①that very day, they ate some of the produce of the land, unleavened cakes and roasted grain. ▷ ①Lit this

column.name: text
column.value: And the manna ceased on the day after they had eaten some of the produce of the land, so that the sons of Israel no longer had manna, but they ate some of the yield of the land of Canaan during that year.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about when Joshua was by Jericho, he raised his eyes and looked, and behold, a man was standing opposite him with his sword drawn in his hand, and Joshua went to him and said to him, “Are you for us or for our enemies?”

column.name: text
column.value: He said, “No; rather I have come now as captain of the army of the LORD.” And Joshua fell on his face to the ground, and bowed down, and said to him, “What has my lord to say to his servant?”

column.name: text
column.value: And the captain of the LORD’S army said to Joshua, “Remove your sandals from your feet, for the place where you are standing is holy.” And Joshua did so.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jericho was tightly shut because of the sons of Israel; no one went out and no one came in.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD said to Joshua, “See, I have handed Jericho over to you, with its king and the valiant warriors.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall march around the city, all the men of war circling the city once. You shall do so for six days.

column.name: text
column.value: Also seven priests shall carry seven trumpets of rams’ horns in front of the ark; then on the seventh day you shall march around the city seven times, and the priests shall blow the trumpets.

column.name: text
column.value: It shall be that when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city will fall down ①flat, and the people shall go up, everyone ②straight ahead.” ▷ ①Lit in its place ②Lit before himself

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua the son of Nun called the priests and said to them, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and have seven priests carry seven trumpets of rams’ horns in front of the ark of the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then ①he said to the people, “Go forward and march around the city, and the armed men shall go on ahead of the ark of the LORD.” ▷ ①Another reading is they

column.name: text
column.value: And it was so, that when Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests carrying the seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the LORD went forward and blew the trumpets; and the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the armed men went ahead of the priests who blew the trumpets, and the rear guard came after the ark, while they continued to blow the trumpets.

column.name: text
column.value: But Joshua commanded the people, saying, “You shall not shout nor let your voice be heard, nor let a word proceed from your mouth, until the day I tell you, ‘Shout!’ Then you shall shout!”

column.name: text
column.value: So he had the ark of the LORD ①taken around the city, circling it once; then they came into the camp and spent the night in the camp. ▷ ①Lit to go around

column.name: text
column.value: Now Joshua got up early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the seven priests carrying the seven trumpets of rams’ horns in front of the ark of the LORD went on continually, and blew the trumpets; and the armed men went ahead of them, and the rear guard came after the ark of the LORD, while they continued to blow the trumpets.

column.name: text
column.value: So the second day they marched around the city once and returned to the camp; they did the same for six days.

column.name: text
column.value: Then on the seventh day they got up early at the dawning of the day and marched around the city in the same way seven times; only on that day did they march around the city seven times.

column.name: text
column.value: And at the seventh time, when the priests blew the trumpets, Joshua said to the people, “Shout! For the LORD has given you the city.

column.name: text
column.value: But the city shall be designated for ①destruction, it and everything that is in it belongs to the LORD; only Rahab the prostitute ②and all who are with her in the house shall live, because she hid the messengers whom we sent. ▷ ①I.e., as an offering to God ②Lit she and all

column.name: text
column.value: But as for you, only keep yourselves from the things designated for destruction, so that you do not covet them and take some of the designated things, and turn the camp of Israel into something designated for destruction and bring disaster on it.

column.name: text
column.value: But all the silver and gold, and articles of bronze and iron are holy to the LORD; they shall go into the treasury of the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the people shouted, and ①the priests blew the trumpets; and when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, the people shouted with a great shout, and the wall fell down ②flat, so that the people went up into the city, everyone straight ③ahead, and they took the city. ▷ ①Lit they ②Lit in its place ③Lit before himself

column.name: text
column.value: They ①utterly destroyed everything in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, sheep, and donkey, with the edge of the sword. ▷ ①Or put under the ban

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, “Go into the prostitute’s house and bring the woman and all she has out of there, just as you have sworn to her.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the young men who were spies went in and brought out Rahab, her father, her mother, her brothers, and all she had; they also brought out all her relatives, and placed them outside the camp of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they burned the city with fire, and all that was in it. Only the silver and gold, and the articles of bronze and iron, they put into the treasury of the ①house of the LORD. ▷ ①I.e., tabernacle

column.name: text
column.value: However, Rahab the prostitute and her father’s household and all she had, Joshua ①spared; and she has lived in the midst of Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho. ▷ ①Lit let live

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua made them take an oath at that time, saying, “Cursed before the LORD is the man who rises up and builds this city Jericho; with the loss of his firstborn he will lay its foundation, and with the loss of his youngest son he will set up its gates.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD was with Joshua, and his fame was in all the land.

column.name: text
column.value: But the sons of Israel acted unfaithfully regarding the things designated for destruction, for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, from the tribe of Judah, took some of the designated things; therefore the anger of the LORD burned against the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is near Beth-aven, east of Bethel, and said to them, “ ①Go up and spy out the land.” So the men went up and spied out Ai. ▷ ①Lit saying, Go

column.name: text
column.value: Then they returned to Joshua and said to him, “Do not have all the people go up; have only about two or three thousand men go up and attack Ai; do not trouble all the people there, for they are few.”

column.name: text
column.value: So about three thousand men from the people went up there, but they fled ①from the men of Ai. ▷ ①Lit before

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of Ai struck and killed about thirty-six of their men, and pursued them ①from the gate as far as Shebarim and struck them on the mountainside; and the hearts of the people melted and became like water. ▷ ①Lit before

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua tore his clothes and fell to the ground on his face before the ark of the LORD until the evening, both he and the elders of Israel; and they put dust on their heads.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua said, “Oh, Lord ①GOD! Why did You ever bring this people across the Jordan, only to hand us over to the Amorites, to eliminate us? If only we had been willing ②to live beyond the Jordan! ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD ②Lit and had lived

column.name: text
column.value: O Lord, what can I say since Israel has turned their ①back before their enemies? ▷ ①Lit neck

column.name: text
column.value: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear about it, and they will surround us and eliminate our name from the earth. And what will You do for Your great name?”

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD said to Joshua, “Stand up! Why is it that you have fallen on your face?

column.name: text
column.value: Israel has sinned, and they have also violated My covenant which I commanded them. And they have even taken some of the things designated for destruction, and have both stolen and kept it a secret. Furthermore, they have also put them among their own things.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the sons of Israel cannot stand against their enemies; they turn their ①backs before their enemies, because they have become designated for destruction. I will not be with you anymore unless you eliminate from your midst the things designated for destruction. ▷ ①Lit necks

column.name: text
column.value: Stand up! Consecrate the people and say, ‘Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, because the LORD, the God of Israel, has said this: “There are things designated for destruction in your midst, Israel. You cannot stand against your enemies until you have removed the designated things from your midst.”

column.name: text
column.value: So in the morning you shall come forward by your tribes. And it shall be that the tribe which the LORD selects by lot shall come forward by families, and the family which the LORD selects shall come forward by households, and the household which the LORD selects shall come forward man by man.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be that the one who is selected with the things designated for destruction shall be burned with fire, he and all that belongs to him, because he has violated the covenant of the LORD, and because he has committed a disgraceful thing in Israel.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua got up early in the morning and brought Israel forward by ①tribes, and the tribe of Judah was selected. ▷ ①Lit its tribes

column.name: text
column.value: So he brought the family of Judah forward, and he selected the family of the Zerahites; then he brought the family of the Zerahites forward man by man, and Zabdi was selected.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought his household forward man by man; and Achan, son of Carmi, son of Zabdi, son of Zerah, from the tribe of Judah, was selected.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua said to Achan, “My son, I implore you, give glory to the LORD, the God of Israel, and give praise to Him; and tell me now what you have done. Do not hide it from me.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Achan answered Joshua and said, “Truly, I have sinned against the LORD, the God of Israel, and ①this is what I did: ▷ ①Lit thus and thus I did

column.name: text
column.value: when I saw among the spoils a beautiful robe from Shinar, two hundred shekels of silver, and a bar of gold fifty shekels in weight, then I wanted them and took them; and behold, they are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent; and behold, it was hidden in his tent with the silver underneath it.

column.name: text
column.value: So they took them from inside the tent and brought them to Joshua and to all the sons of Israel; and they ①laid them out before the LORD. ▷ ①Lit emptied

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, the silver, the robe, the bar of gold, his sons, his daughters, his ①oxen, his donkeys, his sheep, his tent, and all that belonged to him; and they brought them up to the Valley of ②Achor. ▷ ①Or cattle ②I.e., disaster

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua said, “Why have you brought disaster on us? The LORD will bring disaster on you this day.” And all Israel stoned ①them with stones; and they burned them with fire ②after they had stoned them with stones. ▷ ①Lit him ②Lit and they stoned

column.name: text
column.value: Then they erected over him a large heap of stones that stands to this day, and the LORD turned from the fierceness of His anger. Therefore the name of that place has been called the Valley of ①Achor to this day. ▷ ①I.e., disaster

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD said to Joshua, “Do not fear or be dismayed. Take all the people of war with you. Arise, go up to Ai; see, I have handed over to you the king of Ai, his people, his city, and his land.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall do to Ai and its king just as you did to Jericho and its king; you shall take only its spoils and its cattle as plunder for yourselves. ①Set an ambush for the city behind it.” ▷ ①Lit Set for yourself

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua rose up with all the people of war to go up to Ai; and Joshua chose thirty thousand men, valiant warriors, and sent them out at night.

column.name: text
column.value: He commanded them, saying, “See, you are going to ambush the city from behind ①it. Do not go very far from the city, but all of you be ready. ▷ ①Lit the city

column.name: text
column.value: Then I and all the people who are with me will approach the city. And when they come out to meet us as they did the first time, we will flee before them.

column.name: text
column.value: They will come out after us until we have lured them away from the city, for they will say, ‘They are fleeing before us just as they did the first time.’ So we will flee before them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall rise from your ambush and take possession of the city, for the LORD your God will hand it over to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Then it will be when you have seized the city, that you shall set the city on fire. You shall do it in accordance with the word of the LORD. See, I have commanded you.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua sent them away, and they went to the place of ambush and remained between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of Ai; but Joshua spent that night among the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Joshua got up early in the morning and mustered the people, and he went up with the elders of Israel before the people to Ai.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the people of war who were with him went up and approached, and arrived in front of the city; and they camped on the north side of Ai. And there was a valley between him and Ai.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he took about five thousand men and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the ①city. ▷ ①I.e., Ai

column.name: text
column.value: So they stationed the people, all the army that was on the north side of the city, and its rear guard on the west side of the city, and Joshua spent that night in the midst of the valley.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came about, when the king of Ai saw them, that the men of the city hurried and got up early, and went out to meet Israel in battle, he and all his people at the appointed place before the desert plain. But he did not know that there was an ambush against him behind the city.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua and all Israel ①pretended to be defeated before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness. ▷ ①Lit reversed before

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people who were in the city were called together to pursue them, and they pursued Joshua and were lured away from the city.

column.name: text
column.value: So not a man was left in Ai or Bethel, ①but they had all gone out after Israel, and they left the city ②unguarded and pursued Israel. ▷ ①Lit who had not gone ②Lit open

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Reach out with the sword that is in your hand toward Ai, for I will hand it over to you.” So Joshua reached out with the sword that was in his hand toward the city.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the men in ambush rose quickly from their place, and when he had reached out with his hand, they ran and entered the city and captured it, and they quickly set the city on fire.

column.name: text
column.value: When the men of Ai turned ①back and looked, behold, the smoke of the city ascended to the sky, and they had no place to flee this way or that, for the people who had been fleeing to the wilderness turned against the pursuers. ▷ ①Lit behind them

column.name: text
column.value: When Joshua and all Israel saw that the men in ambush had captured the city and that the smoke of the city ascended, they turned back and ①killed the men of Ai. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: ①The others came out from the city to confront them, so that they were trapped in the midst of Israel, ②some on this side and some on that side; and they ③killed them until there was not one ④left who escaped or survived. ▷ ①Lit These came ②Lit these...these ③Lit struck ④Lit left to it one

column.name: text
column.value: But they captured the king of Ai alive and brought him to Joshua.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Israel had finished killing all the inhabitants of Ai in the field in the wilderness where they pursued them, and all of them had fallen by the edge of the sword until they were destroyed, then all Israel returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: So all who fell that day, both men and women, were twelve thousand—all the ①people of Ai. ▷ ①Lit men

column.name: text
column.value: For Joshua did not withdraw his hand with which he reached out with the sword until he had ①utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai. ▷ ①Litput under the ban

column.name: text
column.value: Israel took only the cattle and the spoils of that city as plunder for themselves, in accordance with the word of the LORD which He had commanded Joshua.

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a refuse heap forever, a desolation until this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And he hanged the king of Ai on ①a tree until evening; but at sunset Joshua gave the command and they took his body down from ②the tree and threw it at the entrance of the city gate, and erected over it a large heap of stones that stands to this day. ▷ ①Lit the wood ②Lit the wood

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua built an altar to the LORD, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal,

column.name: text
column.value: just as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded the sons of Israel, as it is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, an altar of uncut stones on which no one had wielded an iron tool; and they offered burnt offerings on it to the LORD, and sacrificed peace offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: And he wrote there on the stones a copy of the Law of Moses, which ①he had written, in the presence of the sons of Israel. ▷ ①I.e., Moses

column.name: text
column.value: And all Israel with their elders, officers, and their judges were standing on both sides of the ark before the Levitical priests who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD, the stranger as well as the native. Half of them stood in front of Mount Gerizim, and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, just as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded at first to bless the people of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then afterward he read all the words of the Law, the blessing and the curse, according to everything that is written in the Book of the Law.

column.name: text
column.value: There was not a word of all that Moses had commanded which Joshua did not read before all the assembly of Israel with the women, the little ones, and the strangers who were ①living among them. ▷ ①Lit walking

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had captured Ai, and had ①utterly destroyed it (just as he had done to Jericho and its king, so he had done to Ai and its king), and that the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and were ②within their land, ▷ ①Or put under the ban ②Lit among them

column.name: text
column.value: that ①he feared greatly because Gibeon was a great city, like one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all its men were mighty. ▷ ①Lit they

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent word to Hoham king of Hebron, to Piram king of Jarmuth, to Japhia king of Lachish, and to Debir king of Eglon, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Come up to me and help me, and let’s ①attack Gibeon, for it has made peace with Joshua and with the sons of Israel.” ▷ ①Lit strike

column.name: text
column.value: So the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon, gathered together and went up, they with all their armies, and camped by Gibeon and fought against it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the men of Gibeon sent word to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, saying, “Do not ①abandon your servants; come up to us quickly and save us and help us, for all the kings of the Amorites that live in the hill country have assembled against us.” ▷ ①Lit slacken your hands from

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and all the people of war with him, and all the valiant warriors.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Joshua, “Do not fear them, for I have handed them over to you; not ①one of them will stand against you.” ▷ ①Lit a man

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua came upon them suddenly ①by marching all night from Gilgal. ▷ ①Lit he went up

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD brought them into confusion before Israel, and He struck them down in a great defeat at Gibeon, and pursued them by the way of the ascent to Beth-horon and struck them as far as Azekah and Makkedah.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they fled from Israel, while they were at the descent of Beth-horon, the LORD hurled large stones from heaven on them as far as Azekah, and they died; there were more who died ①from the hailstones than those whom the sons of Israel killed with the sword. ▷ ①Lit with

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua spoke to the LORD on the day when the LORD turned the Amorites over to the sons of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, “Sun, stand still at Gibeon, And moon, at the Valley of Aijalon!”

column.name: text
column.value: So the sun stood still, and the moon stopped, Until the nation avenged themselves of their enemies. Is it not written in the Book of Jashar? And the sun stopped in the middle of the sky and did not hurry to go down for about a whole day.

column.name: text
column.value: There was no day like that before it or after it, when the LORD listened to the voice of a man; for the LORD fought for Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua and all Israel with him returned to the camp ①at Gilgal. ▷ ①Lit to Gilgal

column.name: text
column.value: Now these five kings had fled and hidden themselves in the cave at Makkedah.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was told to Joshua, saying, “The five kings have been found hidden in the cave at Makkedah.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua said, “Roll large stones against the mouth of the cave, and post men by it to guard them,

column.name: text
column.value: but do not stay there yourselves; pursue your enemies and ①attack them from behind. Do not allow them to enter their cities, for the LORD your God has handed them over to you.” ▷ ①Lit strike their tail

column.name: text
column.value: It came about when Joshua and the sons of Israel had finished striking them down in a very great defeat, until they were destroyed, and the survivors of them who escaped ①had entered the fortified cities, ▷ ①Lit and had

column.name: text
column.value: that all the people returned to the camp, to Joshua at Makkedah in peace. No one ①uttered a word against any of the sons of Israel. ▷ ①Lit moved his tongue

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua said, “Open the mouth of the cave and bring these five kings out to me from the cave.”

column.name: text
column.value: They did so, and brought these five kings out to him from the cave: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.

column.name: text
column.value: When they brought these kings out to Joshua, Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said to the leaders of the men of war who had gone with him, “Come forward, put your feet on the necks of these kings.” So they came forward and put their feet on their necks.

column.name: text
column.value: Joshua then said to them, “Do not fear or be dismayed! Be strong and courageous, for the LORD will do this to all your enemies with whom you fight.”

column.name: text
column.value: So afterward Joshua struck them and put them to death, and he hanged them on five ①trees; and they were hung on the ②trees until evening. ▷ ①Or wooden posts ②Or wooden posts

column.name: text
column.value: Then it came about at ①sunset that Joshua gave the command, and they took them down from the ②trees and threw them into the cave where they had hidden themselves, and put large stones over the mouth of the cave, to this very day. ▷ ①Lit the time of the going of the sun ②Or wooden posts

column.name: text
column.value: Now Joshua captured Makkedah on that day, and struck it and its king with the edge of the sword; he ①utterly destroyed ②it and every ③person who was in it. He left no survivor. So he did to the king of Makkedah just as he had done to the king of Jericho. ▷ ①Lit put under the ban ②Some mss them ③Lit soul, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua and all Israel with him passed on from Makkedah to Libnah, and fought against Libnah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD also handed it over to Israel, with its king, and he struck it and every person who was in it with the edge of the sword. He left no survivor in it. So he did to its king just as he had done to the king of Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua and all Israel with him passed on from Libnah to Lachish, and they camped by it and fought against it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD handed Lachish over to Israel; and he captured it on the second day, and struck it and every person who was in it with the edge of the sword, according to all that he had done to Libnah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish, and Joshua ①defeated him and his people until he had left him no survivor. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua and all Israel with him passed on from Lachish to Eglon, and they camped by it and fought against it.

column.name: text
column.value: They captured it on that day and struck it with the edge of the sword; and he ①utterly destroyed on that day every person who was in it, according to all that he had done to Lachish. ▷ ①Litput under the ban

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon to Hebron, and they fought against it.

column.name: text
column.value: And they captured it and struck it and its king and all its cities and all the persons who were in it with the edge of the sword. He left no survivor, according to all that he had done to Eglon. And he ①utterly destroyed it and every person who was in it. ▷ ①Lit put it under the ban

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua and all Israel with him returned to Debir, and they fought against it.

column.name: text
column.value: He captured it and its king and all its cities, and they struck them with the edge of the sword, and ①utterly destroyed every person who was in it. He left no survivor. Just as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir and its king, as he had also done to Libnah and its king. ▷ ①Litput under the ban

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua struck all the land, the hill country and the ①Negev and the lowland and the slopes, and all their kings. He left no survivor, but he ②utterly destroyed all who breathed, just as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded. ▷ ①I.e., South country ②Lit put under the ban

column.name: text
column.value: Joshua struck them from Kadesh-barnea even as far as Gaza, and all the country of Goshen even as far as Gibeon.

column.name: text
column.value: Joshua captured all these kings and their lands at one time, because the LORD, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua and all Israel with him returned to the camp ①at Gilgal. ▷ ①Lit to Gilgal

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about when all the kings who were beyond the Jordan, in the hill country, the lowland, and on all the coast of the Great Sea toward Lebanon, the Hittite and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard about it,

column.name: text
column.value: that they met together with one ①purpose, to fight with Joshua and with Israel. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: The inhabitants of Gibeon also heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Ai,

column.name: text
column.value: but they on their part acted craftily and went and took provisions for a journey, and took worn-out sacks on their donkeys, and wineskins that were worn out, split open, and patched,

column.name: text
column.value: and worn-out and patched sandals on their feet, and worn-out clothes on themselves; and all the bread of their provision was dry and had become crumbled.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal and said to him and to the men of Israel, “We have come from a far country; now then, make a covenant with us.”

column.name: text
column.value: But the men of Israel said to the Hivites, “Perhaps you are living ①within our land; how then are we to make a covenant with you?” ▷ ①Lit among us

column.name: text
column.value: So they said to Joshua, “We are your servants.” Then Joshua said to them, “Who are you and where do you come from?”

column.name: text
column.value: They said to him, “Your servants have come from a very distant country because of the ①fame of the LORD your God; for we have heard the report about Him and all that He did in Egypt, ▷ ①Or name

column.name: text
column.value: and all that He did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon and to Og king of Bashan who was in Ashtaroth.

column.name: text
column.value: So our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spoke to us, saying, ‘Take provisions in your hand for the journey, and go to meet them, and say to them, “We are your servants; now then, make a covenant with us.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: This bread of ours was hot when we took it for our provisions from our houses on the day that we left to come to you; but now behold, it is dry and has become crumbled.

column.name: text
column.value: And these wineskins which we filled were new, and behold, they are split open; and these clothes of ours and our sandals are worn out from the very long journey.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the men of Israel took some of their provisions, and did not ask for the ①counsel of the LORD. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua made peace with them and made a covenant with them, to let them live; and the leaders of the congregation swore an oath to them.

column.name: text
column.value: However, it came about at the end of three days after they had made a covenant with them, that they heard that they were neighbors and that they were living ①within their land. ▷ ①Lit in the middle of it

column.name: text
column.value: Then the sons of Israel set out and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath-jearim.

column.name: text
column.value: But the sons of Israel did not ①attack them because the leaders of the congregation had sworn to them by the LORD, the God of Israel. And the whole congregation grumbled against the leaders. ▷ ①Lit strike

column.name: text
column.value: But all the leaders said to the whole congregation, “We have sworn to them by the LORD, the God of Israel, and now we cannot touch them.

column.name: text
column.value: This we will do to them, even let them live, so that wrath will not be on us because of the oath which we swore to them.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the leaders said to them, “Let them live.” And they became gatherers of firewood and ①labor to draw water for the whole congregation, just as the leaders had spoken to them. ▷ ①Lit people drawing

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua called for them and spoke to them, saying, “Why have you deceived us, saying, ‘We are very far from you,’ when you are living ①within our land? ▷ ①Lit among us

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, you are cursed, and ①you will never cease to be slaves, both gatherers of firewood and ②labor to draw water for the house of my God.” ▷ ①Lit a servant will not be cut off from you ②Lit people drawing

column.name: text
column.value: So they answered Joshua and said, “Since your servants were fully informed that the LORD your God had commanded His servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land before you, we feared greatly for our lives because of you, and did this thing.

column.name: text
column.value: And now behold, we are in your hands; do to us as it seems good and right in your sight to do.”

column.name: text
column.value: This he did to them, and saved them from the hands of the sons of Israel, and they did not kill them.

column.name: text
column.value: But on that day Joshua made them gatherers of firewood and ①labor to draw water for the congregation and for the altar of the LORD, to this day, in the place which He would choose. ▷ ①Lit people drawing

column.name: text
column.value: Then it came about, when Jabin king of Hazor heard about it, that he sent word to Jobab king of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of Achshaph,

column.name: text
column.value: and to the kings who were of the north in the hill country, and in the Arabah—south of ①Chinneroth and in the lowland, and on the ②heights of Dor on the west— ▷ ①I.e., Sea of Galilee ②Or Naphoth-dor

column.name: text
column.value: to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the hill country, and the Hivite ①at the foot of Hermon in the land of Mizpeh. ▷ ①Lit under

column.name: text
column.value: Then they came out, they and all their armies with them, as many people as the sand that is on the seashore, with very many horses and chariots.

column.name: text
column.value: So all of these kings gathered together, and came and encamped together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet the LORD said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid because of them, for tomorrow at this time I am going to turn all of them over to Israel as good as dead; you shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua and all the people of war with him came upon them suddenly at the waters of Merom, and attacked them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD handed them over to Israel, so that they ①defeated them, and pursued them as far as Great Sidon, and Misrephoth-maim, and the Valley of Mizpeh to the east; and they struck them until no survivor was left to them. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua did to them just as the LORD had told him; he hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua turned back at that time and captured Hazor, and struck its king with the sword; for Hazor previously was the head of all these kingdoms.

column.name: text
column.value: They struck every person who was in it with the edge of the sword, ①utterly destroying them; there was no one left who breathed. And he burned Hazor with fire. ▷ ①Lit putting them under the ban, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: Joshua captured all the cities of these kings, and all their kings; and he struck them with the edge of the sword and utterly destroyed them, just as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: However, Israel did not burn any cities that stood on their mounds, except Hazor alone, which Joshua burned.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the spoils of these cities and the cattle, the sons of Israel took as their plunder; but they struck every person with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them. They left no one breathing.

column.name: text
column.value: Just as the LORD had commanded His servant Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua, and so Joshua did; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua took all that land: the hill country and all the ①Negev, all the land of Goshen, the lowland, the Arabah, the hill country of Israel and its lowland ▷ ①I.e., South country

column.name: text
column.value: from Mount Halak, that rises toward Seir, even as far as Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon ①at the foot of Mount Hermon. And he captured all their kings, and struck them and put them to death. ▷ ①Lit under

column.name: text
column.value: Joshua waged war a long time with all these kings.

column.name: text
column.value: There was not a city which made peace with the sons of Israel except the Hivites living in Gibeon; they took them all in battle.

column.name: text
column.value: For it was of the LORD to ①harden their hearts, to meet Israel in battle in order that he might utterly destroy them, that they might ②receive no mercy, but that he might destroy them, just as the LORD had commanded Moses. ▷ ①Lit make strong ②Lit have

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua came at that time and eliminated the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron, Debir, Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah and all the hill country of Israel. Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.

column.name: text
column.value: There were no Anakim left in the land of the sons of Israel; only in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod some remained.

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua took the whole land, in accordance with everything that the LORD had spoken to Moses; and Joshua gave it as an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. So the land was at rest from war.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Joshua was old and advanced in years when the LORD said to him, “You are old and advanced in years, and a very large amount of the land remains to be possessed.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the land that remains: all the regions of the Philistines and all those of the Geshurites;

column.name: text
