column.value: from the Shihor which is ①east of Egypt, even as far as the border of Ekron to the north (it is counted as Canaanite); the five governors of the Philistines: the Gazite, the Ashdodite, the Ashkelonite, the Gittite, the Ekronite; and the Avvite ▷ ①Lit to the face of

column.name: text
column.value: ①to the south, all the land of the Canaanite, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians, as far as Aphek, to the border of the Amorite; ▷ ①Or from the Teman

column.name: text
column.value: and the land of the Gebalite, and all of Lebanon, toward the ①east, from Baal-gad below Mount Hermon as far as ②Lebo-hamath. ▷ ①Lit sunrise ②Or the entrance of Hamath

column.name: text
column.value: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon as far as Misrephoth-maim, all the Sidonians, I will ①drive out from the sons of Israel; only allot it to Israel as an inheritance as I have commanded you. ▷ ①Or dispossess them from

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, apportion this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”

column.name: text
column.value: With ①the other half-tribe, the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance which Moses gave them beyond the Jordan to the east, just as Moses the servant of the LORD gave to them; ▷ ①Lit it, the

column.name: text
column.value: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Valley of the Arnon, with the city which is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba, as far as Dibon;

column.name: text
column.value: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, as far as the border of the sons of Ammon;

column.name: text
column.value: and Gilead, and the ①territory of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan as far as Salecah; ▷ ①Or border

column.name: text
column.value: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (he alone was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses struck them and ①drove them out. ▷ ①Or dispossessed them

column.name: text
column.value: But the sons of Israel did not ①drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites; instead, Geshur and Maacath live among Israel to this day. ▷ ①Or dispossess

column.name: text
column.value: Only to the tribe of Levi he did not give an inheritance; the offerings by fire to the LORD, the God of Israel, are ①their inheritance, as He spoke to him. ▷ ①Lit his

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses gave an inheritance to the tribe of the sons of Reuben according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: Their ①territory was from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Valley of the Arnon, with the city which is in the middle of the valley and all the plain by Medeba; ▷ ①Or border

column.name: text
column.value: Heshbon and all its cities which are on the plain: Dibon, Bamoth-baal, Beth-baal-meon,

column.name: text
column.value: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,

column.name: text
column.value: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth-shahar on the hill of the valley,

column.name: text
column.value: Beth-peor, the slopes of Pisgah, Beth-jeshimoth,

column.name: text
column.value: even all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses struck with the leaders of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the leaders of Sihon, who lived in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the diviner, with the sword among the rest of their dead.

column.name: text
column.value: The border of the sons of Reuben was the ①Jordan. This was the inheritance of the sons of Reuben according to their families, the cities and their villages. ▷ ①Lit Jordan and border

column.name: text
column.value: Moses also gave an inheritance to the tribe of Gad, to the sons of Gad according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: Their territory was Jazer and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the sons of Ammon, as far as Aroer which is opposite Rabbah;

column.name: text
column.value: and from Heshbon as far as Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim as far as the border of ①Debir; ▷ ①Or Lidebir

column.name: text
column.value: and in the valley, Beth-haram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, with the Jordan ①as a border, as far as the lower end of the Sea of ②Chinnereth beyond the Jordan to the east. ▷ ①Lit and border ②I.e., Galilee

column.name: text
column.value: This is the inheritance of the sons of Gad according to their families, the cities and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses also gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh; and it was for the half-tribe of the sons of Manasseh according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: Their territory was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the ①towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities; ▷ ①Lit tent villages

column.name: text
column.value: also half of Gilead, with Ashtaroth and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the sons of Machir the son of Manasseh, for half of the sons of Machir according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the territories which Moses apportioned as an inheritance in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho to the east.

column.name: text
column.value: But to the tribe of Levi, Moses did not give an inheritance; the LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as He had ①promised to them. ▷ ①Lit spoken to

column.name: text
column.value: Now these are the territories which the sons of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the sons of Israel apportioned to them as inheritances,

column.name: text
column.value: by the lot of their inheritance, just as the LORD commanded ①through Moses, for the nine tribes and the half-tribe. ▷ ①Lit by the hand of

column.name: text
column.value: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan; but he did not give an inheritance to the Levites among them.

column.name: text
column.value: For the sons of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim, and they did not give a portion to the Levites in the land, except cities to live in, with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Israel did exactly as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they divided the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the sons of Judah approached Joshua in Gilgal, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know the word which the LORD spoke to Moses the man of God on account of ①you and me in Kadesh-barnea. ▷ ①Lit me and you

column.name: text
column.value: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land, and I brought word back to him as it was in my heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people ①melt with fear; but I followed the LORD my God fully. ▷ ①I.e., become demoralized

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘The land on which your foot has walked shall certainly be an inheritance to you and to your children forever, because you have followed the LORD my God fully.’

column.name: text
column.value: And now behold, the LORD has let me live, just as He spoke, these forty-five years, from the time that the LORD spoke this word to Moses, when Israel walked in the wilderness; and now behold, I am eighty-five years old today.

column.name: text
column.value: I am still as strong today as I was on the day Moses sent me; as my strength was then, so my strength is now, for war and for going out and coming in.

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, give me this hill country about which the LORD spoke on that day, for you heard on that day that Anakim were there, with great fortified cities; perhaps the LORD will be with me, and I will ①drive them out just as the LORD has spoken.” ▷ ①Or dispossess

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua blessed him and gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh as an inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he followed the LORD God of Israel fully.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the name of Hebron was previously ①Kiriath-arba; for Arba was the greatest man among the Anakim. Then the land was at rest from war. ▷ ①I.e., the city of Arba

column.name: text
column.value: Now these are the kings of the land whom the sons of Israel ①defeated, and they took possession of their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, from the Valley of the Arnon as far as Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah to the east: ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Valley of the Arnon, both the middle of the valley and half of Gilead, even as far as the brook Jabbok, the border of the sons of Ammon;

column.name: text
column.value: and the Arabah as far as the Sea of ①Chinneroth toward the east, and as far as the Sea of the Arabah, that is, the Salt Sea, eastward ②toward Beth-jeshimoth, and on the south, ③at the foot of the slopes of Pisgah; ▷ ①I.e., Galilee ②Lit the way of ③Lit under

column.name: text
column.value: and the territory of Og king of Bashan, one of the remnant of Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

column.name: text
column.value: and ruled over Mount Hermon, Salecah, and all Bashan, as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half of Gilead, as far as the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses the servant of the LORD and the sons of Israel ①defeated them; and Moses the servant of the LORD gave it to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh as a possession. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: Now these are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the sons of Israel ①defeated beyond the Jordan toward the west, from Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon even as far as Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir; and Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel as a possession according to their divisions, ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: in the hill country, in the lowland, in the Arabah, on the slopes, in the wilderness, and in the ①Negev; the Hittite, the Amorite and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite: ▷ ①I.e., South country

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Dor in the ①heights of Dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one; ▷ ①Or Naphath-dor

column.name: text
column.value: the king of Tirzah, one: in all, thirty-one kings.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the lot for the tribe of the sons of Judah according to their families ①reached the border of Edom, southward to the wilderness of Zin at the extreme south. ▷ ①Lit was to

column.name: text
column.value: Their southern border was from the lower end of the Salt Sea, from the bay that turns to the south.

column.name: text
column.value: Then it proceeded southward to the ascent of Akrabbim and continued to Zin, then went up by the south of Kadesh-barnea and continued to Hezron, and went up to Addar and turned to Karka.

column.name: text
column.value: It continued to Azmon and proceeded to the ①brook of Egypt, and the ②border ended at the sea. This shall be your southern border. ▷ ①Or wadi ②Lit goings out of the border were

column.name: text
column.value: The eastern border was the Salt Sea, as far as the ①mouth of the Jordan. And the border of the north side was from the bay of the sea at the ②mouth of the Jordan. ▷ ①Lit end ②Lit end

column.name: text
column.value: Then the border went up to Beth-hoglah, and continued on the north of Beth-arabah, and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

column.name: text
column.value: And the border went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor, and turned northward toward Gilgal which is opposite the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south of the valley; and the border continued to the waters of En-shemesh and ①it ended at En-rogel. ▷ ①Lit the goings out of it were

column.name: text
column.value: Then the border went up the Valley of Ben-hinnom to the slope of the Jebusite on the south (that is, Jerusalem); and the border went up to the top of the mountain which is opposite the Valley of Hinnom to the west, which is at the end of the Valley of Rephaim toward the north.

column.name: text
column.value: And from the top of the mountain the border turned to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah and proceeded to the cities of Mount Ephron, then the border turned to Baalah (that is, Kiriath-jearim).

column.name: text
column.value: The border turned from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and continued to the slope of Mount Jearim on the north (that is, Chesalon), and went down to Beth-shemesh and continued through Timnah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the border proceeded to the side of Ekron northward. And the border turned to Shikkeron and continued to Mount Baalah and proceeded to Jabneel, and the ①border ended at the sea. ▷ ①Lit goings out...were

column.name: text
column.value: The western border was at the Great Sea, even its ①coastline. This is the border around the sons of Judah according to their families. ▷ ①Lit border

column.name: text
column.value: Now he gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the sons of Judah, in accordance with the ①command of the LORD to Joshua, namely, ②Kiriath-arba, Arba being the father of Anak (that is, Hebron). ▷ ①Lit mouth ②I.e., the city of Arba

column.name: text
column.value: And Caleb ①drove out from there the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak. ▷ ①Or dispossessed them

column.name: text
column.value: Then he went up from there against the inhabitants of Debir; now the name of Debir previously was Kiriath-sepher.

column.name: text
column.value: And Caleb said, “The one who ①attacks Kiriath-sepher and captures it, ②I will give him Achsah my daughter as a wife.” ▷ ①Lit strikes ②Lit and I

column.name: text
column.value: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, captured it; so he gave him Achsah his daughter as a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And it happened that when she came to him, she incited him to ask her father for a field. So she dismounted from the donkey, and Caleb said to her, “What do you want?”

column.name: text
column.value: Then she said, “Give me a blessing; since you have given me the land of the ①Negev, give me springs of water also.” So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs. ▷ ①I.e., South country

column.name: text
column.value: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Judah according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the cities at the extremity of the tribe of the sons of Judah toward the border of Edom in the south were Kabzeel, Eder, and Jagur,

column.name: text
column.value: Kinah, Dimonah, and Adadah,

column.name: text
column.value: Kedesh, Hazor, and Ithnan,

column.name: text
column.value: Ziph, Telem, and Bealoth,

column.name: text
column.value: Hazor-hadattah, Kerioth-hezron (that is, Hazor),

column.name: text
column.value: Amam, Shema, and Moladah,

column.name: text
column.value: Hazar-gaddah, Heshmon, and Beth-pelet,

column.name: text
column.value: Hazar-shual, Beersheba, and Biziothiah,

column.name: text
column.value: Baalah, Iim, and Ezem,

column.name: text
column.value: Eltolad, Chesil, and Hormah,

column.name: text
column.value: Ziklag, Madmannah, and Sansannah,

column.name: text
column.value: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon; in all, twenty-nine cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: In the lowland: Eshtaol, Zorah, and Ashnah,

column.name: text
column.value: Zanoah, En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,

column.name: text
column.value: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,

column.name: text
column.value: Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Zenan, Hadashah, and Migdal-gad,

column.name: text
column.value: Dilean, Mizpeh, and Joktheel,

column.name: text
column.value: Lachish, Bozkath, and Eglon,

column.name: text
column.value: Cabbon, Lahmas, and Chitlish,

column.name: text
column.value: Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Libnah, Ether, and Ashan,

column.name: text
column.value: Iphtah, Ashnah, and Nezib,

column.name: text
column.value: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Ekron, with its towns and its villages;

column.name: text
column.value: from Ekron even to the sea, all that were by the ①side of Ashdod, with their villages. ▷ ①Lit hand

column.name: text
column.value: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages, as far as the ①brook of Egypt and the Great Sea, even its ②coastline. ▷ ①Or wadi ②Lit border

column.name: text
column.value: In the hill country: Shamir, Jattir, and Socoh,

column.name: text
column.value: Dannah, Kiriath-sannah (that is, Debir),

column.name: text
column.value: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,

column.name: text
column.value: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Arab, Dumah, and Eshan,

column.name: text
column.value: Janum, Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah,

column.name: text
column.value: Humtah, Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), and Zior; nine cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, and Juttah,

column.name: text
column.value: Jezreel, Jokdeam, and Zanoah,

column.name: text
column.value: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Halhul, Beth-zur, and Gedor,

column.name: text
column.value: Maarath, Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: In the wilderness: Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah,

column.name: text
column.value: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and Engedi; six cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Now as for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the sons of Judah could not ①drive them out; so the Jebusites live with the sons of Judah in Jerusalem to this day. ▷ ①Or dispossess them

column.name: text
column.value: Then the lot for the sons of Joseph went from the Jordan at Jericho to the waters of Jericho on the east into the wilderness, going up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel.

column.name: text
column.value: It went from Bethel to Luz, and continued to the border of the Archites at Ataroth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then it went down westward to the territory of the Japhletites, as far as the territory of lower Beth-horon even to Gezer, and ①it ended at the sea. ▷ ①Lit the goings out of it were

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, received their inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: Now this was the territory of the sons of Ephraim according to their families: the border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth-addar, as far as upper Beth-horon.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the border went westward at Michmethath on the north, and the border turned eastward to Taanath-shiloh and continued beyond it to the east of Janoah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then it went down from Janoah to Ataroth and to Naarah, then reached Jericho and came out at the Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: From Tappuah the border continued westward to the ①brook of Kanah, and ②it ended at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Ephraim according to their families, ▷ ①Or wadi ②Lit the goings out of it were

column.name: text
column.value: together with the cities which were set apart for the sons of Ephraim in the midst of the inheritance of the sons of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: But they did not ①drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, so the Canaanites live in the midst of Ephraim to this day, and they became forced laborers. ▷ ①Or dispossess

column.name: text
column.value: Now this was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. To Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, ①were allotted Gilead and Bashan, because he was a man of war. ▷ ①Lit and there was to him

column.name: text
column.value: So the lot was made for the rest of the sons of Manasseh according to their families: for the sons of Abiezer, the sons of Helek, the sons of Asriel, the sons of Shechem, the sons of Hepher, and the sons of Shemida; these were the male ①descendants of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families. ▷ ①Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: However, Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, only daughters; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

column.name: text
column.value: They approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the leaders, saying, “The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” So in accordance with the ①command of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among their father’s brothers. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: So ten portions fell to Manasseh, besides the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan,

column.name: text
column.value: because the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance among his sons. And the land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.

column.name: text
column.value: The border of Manasseh ①ran from Asher to Michmethath which was east of Shechem; then the border went ②southward to the inhabitants of En-tappuah. ▷ ①Lit was ②Lit to the right hand

column.name: text
column.value: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the sons of Ephraim.

column.name: text
column.value: And the border went down to the ①brook of Kanah, southward of the ②brook (these cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh), and the border of Manasseh was on the north side of the ③brook, and ④it ended at the sea. ▷ ①Or wadi ②Or wadi ③Or wadi ④Lit goings out of it were

column.name: text
column.value: The south side belonged to Ephraim and the north side to Manasseh, and the sea was ①their border; and they reached to Asher on the north and to Issachar on the east. ▷ ①Lit its

column.name: text
column.value: In Issachar and in Asher, Manasseh had Beth-shean and its towns and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of En-dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; the third is Napheth.

column.name: text
column.value: But the sons of Manasseh could not take possession of these cities, because the Canaanites persisted in living in this land.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came about when the sons of Israel became strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, but they did not ①drive them out completely. ▷ ①Or dispossess

column.name: text
column.value: Then the sons of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me only one lot and one portion as an inheritance, though I am a numerous people whom the LORD has blessed up to this point?”

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua said to them, “If you are a numerous people, go ①up to the forest and clear a place for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you.” ▷ ①Lit up for yourself

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Joseph then said, “The hill country is not enough for us, but all the Canaanites who live in the valley land have iron chariots, both those who are in Beth-shean and its towns and those who are in the Valley of Jezreel.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, to Ephraim and Manasseh, saying, “You are a numerous people and have great power; you shall not have one lot only,

column.name: text
column.value: but the hill country shall be yours. For though it is a forest, you shall clear it, and to its ①farthest borders it shall be yours; for you shall ②drive out the Canaanites, even though they have iron chariots and though they are strong.” ▷ ①Lit goings out ②Or dispossess

column.name: text
column.value: Then the whole congregation of the sons of Israel assembled at Shiloh, and set up the tent of meeting there; and the land was subdued before them.

column.name: text
column.value: But there remained among the sons of Israel seven tribes who had not divided their inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua said to the sons of Israel, “How long will you ①put off entering to take possession of the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you? ▷ ①Or show yourselves lax in

column.name: text
column.value: Provide for yourselves three men from ①each tribe so that I may send them, and that they may arise and walk through the land and write a description of it according to their inheritance; then they shall ②return to me. ▷ ①Lit the ②Lit come

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall divide it into seven portions; Judah shall stay in its territory on the south, and the house of Joseph shall stay in their territory on the north.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall write a description of the land in seven divisions, and bring the description here to me. Then I will cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Levites have no portion among you, because the priesthood of the LORD is ①their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh also have received their inheritance eastward beyond the Jordan, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.” ▷ ①Lit his

column.name: text
column.value: Then the men arose and went, and Joshua commanded those who went to write a description of the land, saying, “Go and walk through the land and write a description of it, and return to me; then I will cast lots for you here before the LORD in Shiloh.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the men went and passed through the land, and wrote a description of it by cities in seven divisions in a book; and they came to Joshua at the camp at Shiloh.

column.name: text
column.value: Joshua then cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD, and there Joshua divided the land for the sons of Israel according to their divisions.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the lot of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin came up according to their families, and the territory of their lot ①lay between the sons of Judah and the sons of Joseph. ▷ ①Lit went out

column.name: text
column.value: Their border on the north side was from the Jordan, then the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill country westward, and ①it ended at the wilderness of Beth-aven. ▷ ①Lit the goings out of it were

column.name: text
column.value: Then from there the border continued to Luz, to the side of Luz (that is, Bethel) southward; and the border went down to Ataroth-addar, near the hill which lies on the south of lower Beth-horon.

column.name: text
column.value: And the border changed direction from there and turned around on the west side southward, from the hill which lies opposite Beth-horon southward; and ①it ended at Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), a city of the sons of Judah. This was the west side. ▷ ①Lit the goings out of it were

column.name: text
column.value: Then the south side was from the edge of Kiriath-jearim, and the border went westward and went to the fountain of the waters of Nephtoah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the border went down to the edge of the hill which is ①in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, which is in the Valley of Rephaim northward; and it went down to the Valley of Hinnom, to the slope of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En-rogel. ▷ ①Lit on the face of

column.name: text
column.value: Then it turned northward and went to En-shemesh, and went to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim, and it went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

column.name: text
column.value: And it continued to the side in front of the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the border continued to the side of Beth-hoglah northward; and the ①border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the southern border. ▷ ①Lit goings out of the border were

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the Jordan was its border on the east side. This was the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin according to their families, and according to its borders all around.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the cities of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, Beth-hoglah, and Emek-keziz,

column.name: text
column.value: Beth-arabah, Zemaraim, and Bethel,

column.name: text
column.value: Avvim, Parah, and Ophrah,

column.name: text
column.value: Chephar-ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Gibeon, Ramah, and Beeroth,

column.name: text
column.value: Mizpeh, Chephirah, and Mozah,

column.name: text
column.value: Rekem, Irpeel, and Taralah,

column.name: text
column.value: Zelah, Haeleph, the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah, Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘ ①Designate the cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you ②through Moses, ▷ ①Lit Give for yourselves ②Lit by the hand of

column.name: text
column.value: so that one who commits manslaughter by ①killing a person unintentionally, without premeditation, may flee there, and they shall become your refuge from the avenger of blood. ▷ ①Lit striking

column.name: text
column.value: Then he shall flee to one of these cities, and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and state his case in the ①presence of the elders of that city; and they shall ②receive him into the city to them and give him a place, so that he may remain among them. ▷ ①Lit ears of ②Lit gather

column.name: text
column.value: Now if the avenger of blood pursues him, then they are not to hand the one who committed manslaughter over to him, since he struck his neighbor without premeditation and did not hate him previously.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall remain in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the one who is high priest in those days. Then ①he shall ②return to his own city and to his own house, to the city from which he fled.’ ” ▷ ①Lit the one who committed manslaughter ②Lit return and come

column.name: text
column.value: So they ①set apart Kedesh in ②Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, and Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah. ▷ ①Lit sanctified ②Heb Galil

column.name: text
column.value: And beyond the Jordan east of Jericho, they ①designated Bezer in the wilderness on the plain from the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead from the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan from the tribe of Manasseh. ▷ ①Lit gave

column.name: text
column.value: These were the designated cities for all the sons of Israel and for the stranger who resides among them, so that whoever ①kills a person unintentionally may flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood until he stands before the congregation. ▷ ①Lit strikes

column.name: text
column.value: Then the second lot went to Simeon, to the tribe of the sons of Simeon according to their families; and their inheritance was in the midst of the inheritance of the sons of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: So they had in their inheritance Beersheba or ①Sheba and Moladah, ▷ ①In Josh 15:26, Shema

column.name: text
column.value: Hazar-shual, Balah, and Ezem,

column.name: text
column.value: Eltolad, Bethul, and Hormah,

column.name: text
column.value: Ziklag, Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,

column.name: text
column.value: Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages;

column.name: text
column.value: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages;

column.name: text
column.value: and all the villages which were around these cities as far as Baalath-beer, Ramah of the ①Negev. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Simeon according to their families. ▷ ①I.e., South country

column.name: text
column.value: The inheritance of the sons of Simeon was taken from the portion of the sons of Judah, because the share of the sons of Judah was too large for them; so the sons of Simeon received an inheritance in the midst of ①Judah’s inheritance. ▷ ①Lit their

column.name: text
column.value: Now the third lot came up for the sons of Zebulun according to their families. And the territory of their inheritance was as far as Sarid.

column.name: text
column.value: Then their border went up to the west and to Maralah, and it reached Dabbesheth and reached to the ①brook that is opposite Jokneam. ▷ ①Or wadi

column.name: text
column.value: Then it turned from Sarid to the east toward the sunrise as far as the border of Chisloth-tabor, and it proceeded to Daberath and ①up to Japhia. ▷ ①Lit went up

column.name: text
column.value: From there it continued eastward toward the sunrise to Gath-hepher, to Eth-kazin, and it proceeded to Rimmon ①which stretches to Neah. ▷ ①Or and is marked off

column.name: text
column.value: Then the border circled around it on the north to Hannathon, and ①it ended at the Valley of Iphtahel. ▷ ①Lit the goings out of it were

column.name: text
column.value: Included also were Kattah, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem; twelve cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: This was the inheritance of the sons of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: The fourth lot went to Issachar, to the sons of Issachar according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: Their territory was to Jezreel and included Chesulloth, Shunem,

column.name: text
column.value: Hapharaim, Shion, and Anaharath,

column.name: text
column.value: Rabbith, Kishion, and Ebez,

column.name: text
column.value: Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez.

column.name: text
column.value: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth-shemesh, and ①their border ended at the Jordan; sixteen cities with their villages. ▷ ①Lit the goings out of their border were

column.name: text
column.value: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the fifth lot went to the tribe of the sons of Asher according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: Their territory was Helkath, Hali, Beten, and Achshaph,

column.name: text
column.value: Allammelech, Amad, and Mishal; and it reached to Carmel on the west and Shihor-libnath.

column.name: text
column.value: It turned toward the ①east to Beth-dagon and reached Zebulun, and to the Valley of Iphtahel northward to Beth-emek and Neiel; then it proceeded on ②north to Cabul, ▷ ①Lit sunrise ②Lit from the left hand

column.name: text
column.value: Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, as far as Great Sidon.

column.name: text
column.value: The border turned to Ramah and to the fortified city of Tyre; then the border turned to Hosah, and ①it ended at the sea by the region of Achzib. ▷ ①Lit the goings out of it were

column.name: text
column.value: Included also were Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob; twenty-two cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: The sixth lot went to the sons of Naphtali; to the sons of Naphtali according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, and Adami-nekeb and Jabneel, as far as Lakkum, and ①it ended at the Jordan. ▷ ①Lit the goings out of it were

column.name: text
column.value: Then the border turned westward to Aznoth-tabor and proceeded from there to Hukkok; and it reached Zebulun on the south and reached Asher on the west, and Judah at the Jordan toward the ①east. ▷ ①Lit sunrise

column.name: text
column.value: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,

column.name: text
column.value: Adamah, Ramah, and Hazor,

column.name: text
column.value: Kedesh, Edrei, and En-hazor,

column.name: text
column.value: Yiron, Migdal-el, Horem, Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: The seventh lot went to the tribe of the sons of Dan according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: The territory of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, and Ir-shemesh,

column.name: text
column.value: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, and Ithlah,

column.name: text
column.value: Elon, Timnah, and Ekron,

column.name: text
column.value: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, and Baalath,

column.name: text
column.value: Jehud, Bene-berak, and Gath-rimmon,

column.name: text
column.value: Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, with the territory opposite ①Joppa. ▷ ①Heb Japho

column.name: text
column.value: The territory of the sons of Dan proceeded ①beyond them; for the sons of Dan went up and fought with Leshem and captured it. Then they struck it with the edge of the sword and took possession of it and ②settled in it; and they named ③Leshem Dan after the name of their father Dan. ▷ ①Lit from ②Lit dwelt ③In Judg

column.name: text
column.value: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: When they finished apportioning the land for inheritance by its borders, the sons of Israel gave an inheritance among them to Joshua the son of Nun.

column.name: text
column.value: In accordance with the ①command of the LORD, they gave him the city for which he asked, Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim. So he built the city and ②settled in it. ▷ ①Lit mouth ②Lit dwelt

column.name: text
column.value: These are the inheritances which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the sons of Israel apportioned by lot in Shiloh before the LORD at the doorway of the tent of meeting. So they finished dividing the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the heads of fathers’ households of the Levites approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of fathers’ households of the tribes of the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And they spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, “The LORD commanded ①through Moses to give us cities to live in, with their pasture lands for our cattle.” ▷ ①Lit by the hand of

column.name: text
column.value: So the sons of Israel gave the Levites from their inheritance these cities with their pasture lands, in accordance with the ①command of the LORD. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Then the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. And to the sons of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, thirteen cities were given by lot from the tribe of Judah, from the tribe of the Simeonites, and from the tribe of Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the rest of the sons of Kohath ten cities were given by lot from the families of the tribe of Ephraim, from the tribe of Dan, and from the half-tribe of Manasseh.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the sons of Gershon thirteen cities were given by lot from the families of the tribe of Issachar, from the tribe of Asher, from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

column.name: text
column.value: To the sons of Merari according to their families twelve cities were given from the tribe of Reuben, from the tribe of Gad, and from the tribe of Zebulun.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of Israel gave by lot to the Levites these cities with their pasture lands, as the LORD had commanded ①through Moses. ▷ ①Lit by the hand of

column.name: text
column.value: They gave these cities which are mentioned here by name from the tribe of the sons of Judah and from the tribe of the sons of Simeon;

column.name: text
column.value: and they were for the sons of Aaron, one of the families of the Kohathites, of the sons of Levi, because the lot was theirs first.

column.name: text
column.value: So they gave them Kiriath-arba (Arba being the father of Anak), that is, Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with its surrounding pasture lands.

column.name: text
column.value: But the fields of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh as his possession.

column.name: text
column.value: So to the sons of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron, the city of refuge for the one who commits manslaughter, with its pasture lands, Libnah with its pasture lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Jattir with its pasture lands, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,

column.name: text
column.value: ①Holon with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands, ▷ ①In 1 Chr 6:58, Hilen

column.name: text
column.value: ①Ain with its pasture lands, Juttah with its pasture lands, and Beth-shemesh with its pasture lands; nine cities from these two tribes. ▷ ①In 1 Chr 6:59, Ashan

column.name: text
column.value: From the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its pasture lands, Geba with its pasture lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Anathoth with its pasture lands, and ①Almon with its pasture lands; four cities. ▷ ①In 1 Chr 6:60, Allemeth

column.name: text
column.value: All the cities of the sons of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the cities from the tribe of Ephraim were allotted to the families of the sons of Kohath, the Levites, that is, to the rest of the sons of Kohath.

column.name: text
column.value: They gave them Shechem, the city of refuge for the one who commits manslaughter, with its pasture lands, in the hill country of Ephraim, and Gezer with its pasture lands,

column.name: text
column.value: and Kibzaim with its pasture lands, and Beth-horon with its pasture lands; four cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And from the tribe of Dan, Elteke with its pasture lands, Gibbethon with its pasture lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath-rimmon with its pasture lands; four cities.

column.name: text
column.value: From the half-tribe of Manasseh, they allotted Taanach with its pasture lands and Gath-rimmon with its pasture lands; two cities.

column.name: text
column.value: All the cities with their pasture lands for the families of the rest of the sons of Kohath were ten.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the sons of Gershon, one of the families of the Levites, from the half-tribe of Manasseh, they gave Golan in Bashan, the city of refuge for the one who commits manslaughter, with its pasture lands, and Be-eshterah with its pasture lands; two cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And from the tribe of Issachar they gave Kishion with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Jarmuth with its pasture lands, and En-gannim with its pasture lands; four cities.

column.name: text
column.value: From the tribe of Asher, they gave Mishal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Helkath with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands; four cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And from the tribe of Naphtali, they gave Kedesh in Galilee, the city of refuge for the one who commits manslaughter, with its pasture lands, Hammoth-dor with its pasture lands, and Kartan with its pasture lands; three cities.

column.name: text
column.value: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the families of the sons of Merari, the rest of the Levites, they gave from the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its pasture lands, Kartah with its pasture lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Dimnah with its pasture lands, and Nahalal with its pasture lands; four cities.

column.name: text
column.value: From the tribe of Reuben they gave Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahaz with its pasture lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands; four cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And from the tribe of Gad, they gave Ramoth in Gilead, the city of refuge for the one who commits manslaughter, with its pasture lands, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands; four cities in all.

column.name: text
column.value: All these were the cities of the sons of Merari according to their families, the rest of the families of the Levites; and their lot was twelve cities.

column.name: text
column.value: All the cities of the Levites in the midst of the possession of the sons of Israel were forty-eight cities with their pasture lands.

column.name: text
column.value: These cities individually had ①their surrounding pasture lands; this is how it was with all these cities. ▷ ①Lit its

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD gave Israel all the land which He had sworn to give to their fathers, and they took possession of it and lived in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD gave them rest on every side, in accordance with everything that He had sworn to their fathers, and no one of all their enemies stood before them; the LORD handed all their enemies over to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Not ①one of the good promises which the LORD had ②made to the house of Israel failed; everything came to pass. ▷ ①Lit a word from every good word ②Lit spoken

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,

column.name: text
column.value: and said to them, “You have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have listened to my voice in all that I commanded you.

column.name: text
column.value: You have not abandoned your brothers these many days to this day, but have fulfilled the obligation of the commandment of the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: And now the LORD your God has given rest to your brothers, as He spoke to them; therefore turn now and go to your tents, to the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you beyond the Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: Only be very careful to ①follow the commandment and the Law which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, to love the LORD your God and walk in all His ways, and keep His commandments and cling to Him, and serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul.” ▷ ①Lit perform

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua blessed them and sent them away, and they went to their tents.

column.name: text
column.value: Now to the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given a possession in Bashan, but to the other half Joshua gave a possession among their brothers westward beyond the Jordan. So when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he also blessed them,

column.name: text
column.value: and said to ①them, “Return to your tents with great riches and with very many livestock, with silver, gold, bronze, iron, and with very many clothes; divide the spoils of your enemies with your brothers.” ▷ ①Lit them, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: So the sons of Reuben, the sons of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned home, ①leaving the sons of Israel at Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession in which they had settled, in accordance with the ②command of the LORD ③through Moses. ▷ ①Lit and went from ②Lit mouth ③Lit by the hand of

column.name: text
column.value: When they came to the region of the Jordan which is in the land of Canaan, the sons of Reuben, the sons of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan, ①a large altar in appearance. ▷ ①Or an altar clearly visible

column.name: text
column.value: But the sons of Israel ①heard a report: “Behold, the sons of Reuben, the sons of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar at the ②frontier of the land of Canaan, in the region of the Jordan, on the side belonging to the sons of Israel.” ▷ ①Lit heard, saying, Behold ②Lit front

column.name: text
column.value: And when the sons of Israel heard about it, the entire congregation of the sons of Israel assembled at Shiloh to go up against them in battle.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the sons of Israel sent to the sons of Reuben, to the sons of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, in the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,

column.name: text
column.value: and with him ten leaders, one leader for each father’s household from each of the tribes of Israel; and each one of them was the head of his father’s household among the ①thousands of Israel. ▷ ①Or families

column.name: text
column.value: They came to the sons of Reuben, the sons of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, in the land of Gilead, and they spoke with them, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the whole congregation of the LORD says: ‘What is this unfaithful act which you have committed against the God of Israel, turning away from following the LORD this day, by building yourselves an altar, to rebel against the LORD this day?

column.name: text
column.value: Is the wrongdoing of Peor ①not enough for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day, although ②a plague came on the congregation of the LORD, ▷ ①Lit a trifle for us ②Lit an affliction

column.name: text
column.value: that you must turn away this day from following the LORD? If you rebel against the LORD today, He will be angry with the entire congregation of Israel tomorrow.

column.name: text
column.value: If, however, the land of your possession is unclean, then ①cross into the land of the possession of the LORD, where the LORD’S ②tabernacle ③stands, and settle among us. Only do not rebel against the LORD, or rebel against us, by building an altar for yourselves besides the altar of the LORD our God. ▷ ①Lit cross for yourselves ②Lit dwelling place ③Lit resides

column.name: text
column.value: Did Achan the son of Zerah not act unfaithfully in the things designated for destruction, and wrath fall on the entire congregation of Israel? So that man did not perish alone in his guilt.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the sons of Reuben, the sons of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered and spoke to the heads of the ①families of Israel. ▷ ①Lit thousands

column.name: text
column.value: “The Mighty One, God, the LORD, the Mighty One, God, the LORD! He knows, and may Israel itself know. If it was in rebellion, or if in an unfaithful act against the LORD, do not save us this day!

column.name: text
column.value: If we have built us an altar to turn away from following the LORD, or if to offer a burnt offering or grain offering on it, or if to offer sacrifices of peace offerings on it, may the LORD Himself ①demand it. ▷ ①I.e., hold him responsible

column.name: text
column.value: But truly we have done this out of concern, ①for a reason, saying, ‘In time to come your sons may say to our ②sons, “What have you to do with the LORD, the God of Israel? ▷ ①Lit from ②Lit sons, saying

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD has made the Jordan a border between us and you, you sons of Reuben and sons of Gad; you have no portion in the LORD.” So your sons may make our sons stop fearing the LORD.’

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore we said, ‘Let’s ①build an altar, not for burnt offering or for sacrifice; ▷ ①Lit prepare to build for ourselves

column.name: text
column.value: rather, it shall be a witness between us and you and between our generations after us, that we are to perform the service of the LORD before Him with our burnt offerings, our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings, so that your sons will not say to our sons in time to come, “You have no portion in the LORD.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore we said, ‘It shall also come about if they say this to us or to our generations in time to come, then we shall say, “See the copy of the altar of the LORD which our fathers made, not for burnt offering or for sacrifice; rather, it is a witness between us and you.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: Far be it from us that we should rebel against the LORD and turn away from following the LORD this day, by building an altar for burnt offering, for grain offering, or for sacrifice, besides the altar of the LORD our God which is before His ①tabernacle.” ▷ ①Lit dwelling place

column.name: text
column.value: So when Phinehas the priest and the leaders of the congregation, that is, the heads of the ①families of Israel who were with him, heard the words which the sons of Reuben, the sons of Gad, and the sons of Manasseh spoke, it pleased them. ▷ ①Lit thousands

column.name: text
column.value: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said to the sons of Reuben, the sons of Gad, and to the sons of Manasseh, “Today we know that the LORD is in our midst, because you have not committed this unfaithful act against the LORD; now you have saved the sons of Israel from the hand of the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest and the leaders returned from the sons of Reuben and from the sons of Gad, from the land of Gilead to the land of Canaan, to the sons of Israel, and brought back word to them.

column.name: text
column.value: The word pleased the sons of Israel, and the sons of Israel blessed God; and they did not speak of going up against them in battle to destroy the land in which the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad were living.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad called the altar Witness; “For,” they said, “it is a witness between us that the LORD is God.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about after many days, when the LORD had given rest to Israel from all their enemies on every side, and Joshua was old, advanced in years,

column.name: text
column.value: that Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders, their heads, their judges, and their officers, and said to them, “I am old, advanced in years.

column.name: text
column.value: And you have seen all that the LORD your God has done to all these nations because of you, for the LORD your God is He who has been fighting for you.

column.name: text
column.value: See, I have apportioned to you these nations which remain as an inheritance for your tribes, with all the nations which I have eliminated, from the Jordan even to the Great Sea toward the ①west. ▷ ①Lit sunset

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD your God, He will thrust them away from you and ①drive them from you; and you will take possession of their land, just as the LORD your God ②promised you. ▷ ①Or dispossess ②Lit spoke to

column.name: text
column.value: Be very determined, then, to keep and do everything that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, so that you will not turn aside from it to the right or to the left,

column.name: text
column.value: so that you will not ①associate with these nations, these which remain with you, or mention the name of their gods, or make anyone swear by them, or serve them, or bow down to them. ▷ ①Lit come among

column.name: text
column.value: But you are to cling to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD has ①driven out great and mighty nations from before you; and as for you, no one has stood against you to this day. ▷ ①Or dispossessed

column.name: text
column.value: One of your men puts to flight a thousand, for the LORD your God is He who fights for you, just as He ①promised you. ▷ ①Lit spoke to

column.name: text
column.value: So take great care for yourselves that you love the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: For if you ever go back and cling to the rest of these nations, these which remain with you, and intermarry with them, so that you ①associate with them and they with you, ▷ ①Lit come among

column.name: text
column.value: know with certainty that the LORD your God will not continue to ①drive these nations out from before you; but they will be a snare and a trap to you, and a whip on your sides and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land which the LORD your God has given you. ▷ ①Or dispossess

column.name: text
column.value: “Now behold, today I am going the way of all the earth, and you know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one word of all the good words which the LORD your God spoke concerning you has failed; they all have ①been fulfilled for you, not ②one of them has failed. ▷ ①Lit come ②Lit one word

column.name: text
column.value: But it will come about that just as all the good words which the LORD your God spoke to you have come upon you, so the LORD will bring upon you ①all the warnings, until He has eliminated you from this good land which the LORD your God has given you. ▷ ①Lit every bad word

column.name: text
column.value: When you violate the covenant of the LORD your God, which He commanded you, and you go and serve other gods and bow down to them, then the anger of the LORD will burn against you, and you will perish quickly from the good land which He has given you.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel at Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, their heads, their judges, and their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

column.name: text
column.value: Joshua said to all the people, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘From ancient times your fathers lived beyond the Euphrates River, namely, Terah, the father of Abraham and the father of Nahor, and they served other gods.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I took your father Abraham from beyond the Euphrates River and led him through all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his ①descendants and gave him Isaac. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: To Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau, and to Esau I gave Mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt ①by what I did in its midst; and afterward I brought you out. ▷ ①Lit according to

column.name: text
column.value: So I brought your fathers out of Egypt, and you came to the sea; and Egypt pursued your fathers with chariots and horsemen to the ①Red Sea. ▷ ①Lit Sea of Reeds

column.name: text
column.value: But when they cried out to the LORD, He put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them and covered them; and your own eyes saw what I did in Egypt. And you lived in the wilderness for a long time.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I brought you into the land of the Amorites, who lived beyond the Jordan, and they fought with you; but I handed them over to you, and you took possession of their land when I eliminated them before you.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, rose up and fought against Israel, and he sent messengers and summoned Balaam the son of Beor to curse you.

column.name: text
column.value: But I was not willing to listen to Balaam. So he had to bless you, and I saved you from his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: You crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho; and the citizens of Jericho fought against you, and the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite. Therefore I handed them over to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I sent the hornet before you and it ①drove out the two kings of the Amorites from you—not by your sword nor your bow. ▷ ①Lit drove them out

column.name: text
column.value: And I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities which you had not built, and you have lived in them; you are eating of vineyards and olive groves which you did not plant.’

column.name: text
column.value: “Now, therefore, ①fear the LORD and serve Him in sincerity and ②truth; and do away with the gods which your fathers served beyond the Euphrates River and in Egypt, and serve the LORD. ▷ ①Or revere ②Or faithfulness

column.name: text
column.value: But if it is disagreeable in your sight to serve the LORD, choose for yourselves today whom you will serve: whether the gods which your fathers served, which were beyond the Euphrates River, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living; but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: The people answered and said, “Far be it from us that we would abandon the LORD to serve other gods;

column.name: text
column.value: for the LORD our God is He who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of slaves, and did these great signs in our sight and watched over us through all the way in which we went and among all the peoples through whose midst we passed.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. We also will serve the LORD, for He is our God.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua said to the people, “You will not be able to serve the LORD, for He is a holy God. He is a jealous God; He will not forgive your wrongdoing or your sins.

column.name: text
column.value: If you abandon the LORD and serve foreign gods, then He will turn and do you harm and destroy you after He has done good to you.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the people said to Joshua, “No, but we will serve the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen for yourselves the LORD, to serve Him.” And they said, “We are witnesses.”

column.name: text
column.value: “Now then, do away with the foreign gods which are in your midst, and incline your hearts to the LORD, the God of Israel.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the people said to Joshua, “We will serve the LORD our God and ①obey His voice.” ▷ ①Lit listen to

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua wrote these words in the Book of the Law of God; and he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua said to all the people, “Behold, this stone shall be a witness against us, because it has heard all the words of the LORD which He spoke ①to us; so it shall be a witness against you, so that you do not deny your God.” ▷ ①Lit with

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua dismissed the people, each to his inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about after these things that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being 110 years old.

column.name: text
column.value: And they buried him in the territory of his inheritance, in Timnath-serah, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of Mount Gaash.

column.name: text
column.value: Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua and all the days of the elders who ①survived Joshua, and had known every deed of the LORD which He had done for Israel. ▷ ①Lit prolonged days after

column.name: text
column.value: Now they buried the bones of Joseph, which the sons of Israel brought up from Egypt, at Shechem, in the plot of land which Jacob had bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred ①pieces of money; and they became the inheritance of Joseph’s sons. ▷ ①Heb qesitah

column.name: text
column.value: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him at Gibeah, the town of his son Phinehas, which was given to him in the hill country of Ephraim.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about after the death of Joshua that the sons of Israel inquired of the LORD, saying, “Who shall go up first for us against the Canaanites, to fight against them?”

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said, “Judah shall go up; behold, I have handed the land over to him.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Judah said to his brother Simeon, “Go up with me into ①the territory allotted me, and let’s fight the Canaanites; and ②I in turn will go with you into ③the territory allotted you.” So Simeon went with him. ▷ ①Lit my lot ②Lit I, even I ③Lit your lot

column.name: text
column.value: Judah went up, and the LORD handed over to them the Canaanites and the Perizzites, and they ①defeated ten thousand men at Bezek. ▷ ①Lit struck them

column.name: text
column.value: They found Adoni-bezek in Bezek and fought against him, and they ①defeated the Canaanites and the Perizzites. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: But Adoni-bezek fled; and they pursued him and caught him, and cut off his ①thumbs and big toes. ▷ ①Lit thumbs of his hands and his feet

column.name: text
column.value: And Adoni-bezek said, “Seventy kings with their thumbs and their big toes cut off used to gather up scraps under my table; as I have done, so God has repaid me.” So they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the sons of Judah fought against Jerusalem and captured it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Afterward, the sons of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites living in the hill country, and in the ①Negev, and in the lowland. ▷ ①I.e., South country

column.name: text
column.value: So Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron (the name of Hebron was previously Kiriath-arba); and they struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.

column.name: text
column.value: Then from there he went against the inhabitants of Debir (the name of Debir was previously Kiriath-sepher).

column.name: text
column.value: And Caleb said, “Whoever attacks Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give him my daughter Achsah as a wife.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, captured it; so he gave him his daughter Achsah as a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: Then it happened that when she came to him, she incited him to ask her father for a field. Then later, she dismounted from ①her donkey, and Caleb said to her, “What ②do you want?” ▷ ①Lit the ②Lit to you, an ancient idiom

column.name: text
column.value: She said to him, “Give me a blessing: since you have given me the land of the ①Negev, give me springs of water also.” So Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs. ▷ ①I.e., South country

column.name: text
column.value: Now the ①descendants of the Kenite, Moses’ father-in-law, went up from the city of palms with the sons of Judah, to the wilderness of Judah which is in the south of Arad; and they went and lived with the people. ▷ ①Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: Then Judah went with his brother Simeon, and they struck the Canaanites living in Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. So the name of the city was called Hormah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah took Gaza with its territory, Ashkelon with its territory, and Ekron with its territory.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD was with Judah, and they took possession of the hill country; but they could not ①drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had iron chariots. ▷ ①Or dispossess

column.name: text
column.value: Then they gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had ①promised; and he drove out from there the three sons of Anak. ▷ ①Lit spoken

column.name: text
column.value: But the sons of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem; so the Jebusites have lived with the sons of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise the house of Joseph went up against Bethel, and the LORD was with them.

column.name: text
column.value: The house of Joseph had men spy out Bethel (the name of the city previously was Luz).

column.name: text
column.value: And the spies saw a man coming out of the city, and they said to him, “Please show us the entrance to the city, and we will treat you kindly.”

column.name: text
column.value: So he showed them the entrance to the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword, but they let the man and all his family go free.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the man went to the land of the Hittites and built a city, and named it Luz, ①which is its name to this day. ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: But Manasseh did not take possession of Beth-shean and its villages, or Taanach and its villages, or the inhabitants of Dor and its villages, or the inhabitants of Ibleam and its villages, or the inhabitants of Megiddo and its villages; so the Canaanites persisted in living in this land.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came about, when Israel became strong, that they put the Canaanites to forced labor; but they did not drive them out completely.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites who were living in Gezer; so the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.

column.name: text
column.value: Zebulun did not drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, or the inhabitants of ①Nahalol; so the Canaanites lived among them and became subject to forced labor. ▷ ①Perhaps same as Nahalal

column.name: text
column.value: Asher did not drive out the inhabitants of Acco, or the inhabitants of Sidon, or of Ahlab, or of Achzib, Helbah, Aphik, or of Rehob.

column.name: text
column.value: So the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land; for they did not drive them out.

column.name: text
column.value: Naphtali did not drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh, or the inhabitants of Beth-anath, but lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land; and the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath became forced labor for them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Amorites ①forced the sons of Dan into the hill country, for they did not allow them to come down to the valley; ▷ ①Lit pushed

column.name: text
column.value: yet the Amorites persisted in living on Mount Heres, in Aijalon and Shaalbim; but when the ①power of the house of Joseph ②grew strong, they became forced labor. ▷ ①Lit hand ②Lit was heavy

column.name: text
column.value: The border of the Amorites ran from the ascent of Akrabbim, from Sela and upward.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal to Bochim. And he said, “I brought you up out of Egypt and led you into the land which I have sworn to your fathers; and I said, ‘I will never break My covenant with you,

column.name: text
column.value: and as for you, you shall not make a covenant with the inhabitants of this land; you shall tear down their altars.’ But you have not ①obeyed Me; what is this thing that you have done? ▷ ①Lit listened to My voice

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I also said, ‘I will not drive them out from you; but they will ①become like thorns in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.’ ” ▷ ①Some ancient mss become adversaries to you and

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the angel of the LORD spoke these words to all the sons of Israel, the people raised their voices and wept.

column.name: text
column.value: So they named that place ①Bochim; and there they sacrificed to the LORD. ▷ ①I.e., weepers

column.name: text
column.value: When Joshua had dismissed the people, the sons of Israel went, each one to his inheritance, to take possession of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: The people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who ①survived Joshua, who had seen all the great work of the LORD which He had done for Israel. ▷ ①Lit prolonged days after

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of 110.

column.name: text
column.value: And they buried him in the territory of his inheritance in Timnath-heres, in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

column.name: text
column.value: All that generation also were gathered to their fathers; and another generation rose up after them who did not know the LORD, nor even the work which He had done for Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the sons of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD and ①served the Baals, ▷ ①Or worshiped

column.name: text
column.value: and they abandoned the LORD, the God of their fathers, who had brought them out of the land of Egypt, and they followed other gods from the gods of the peoples who were around them, and bowed down to them; so they provoked the LORD to anger.

column.name: text
column.value: They abandoned the LORD and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He handed them over to plunderers, and they plundered them; and He sold them into the hands of their enemies around them, so that they could no longer stand ①against their enemies. ▷ ①Lit before

column.name: text
column.value: Wherever they went, the hand of the LORD was against them for ①evil, as the LORD had spoken and just as the LORD had sworn to them, so that they were severely distressed. ▷ ①Or misfortune

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD raised up judges ①who saved them from the hands of those who plundered them. ▷ ①Lit and they

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they did not listen to their judges, for they ①committed infidelity with other gods and bowed down to them. They turned aside quickly from the way in which their fathers had walked in obeying the commandments of the LORD; they did not do the same as their fathers. ▷ ①I.e., against God

column.name: text
column.value: And when the LORD raised up judges for them, the LORD was with the judge and saved them from the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge; for the LORD was moved to pity by their groaning because of those who tormented and oppressed them.

column.name: text
column.value: But it came about, when the judge died, that they would turn back and act more corruptly than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them and bow down to them; they did not abandon their practices or their obstinate ways.

column.name: text
column.value: So the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He said, “Because this nation has violated My covenant which I commanded their fathers, and has not listened to My voice,

column.name: text
column.value: I in turn will no longer drive out from them any of the nations which Joshua left when he died,

column.name: text
column.value: in order to test Israel by them, whether they will keep the way of the LORD to walk in it as their fathers ①did, or not.” ▷ ①Lit kept

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD allowed those nations to remain, not driving them out quickly; and He did not hand them over to Joshua.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the sons of Israel again did evil in the sight of the LORD, after Ehud died.

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor; and the commander of his army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth-hagoyim.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Israel cried out to the LORD; for he had nine hundred iron chariots, and he oppressed the sons of Israel severely for twenty years.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Deborah, a ①prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, was judging Israel at that time. ▷ ①Lit woman prophetess

column.name: text
column.value: She used to ①sit under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the sons of Israel went up to her for judgment. ▷ ①Or live

column.name: text
column.value: Now she sent word and summoned Barak the son of Abinoam from Kedesh-naphtali, and said to him, “ ①The LORD, the God of Israel, has indeed commanded, ‘Go and march to Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men from the sons of Naphtali and from the sons of Zebulun. ▷ ①Lit Has the LORD not commanded...?

column.name: text
column.value: I will draw out to you Sisera, the commander of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his ①many troops to the river Kishon, and I will hand him over to you.’ ” ▷ ①Lit multitude

column.name: text
column.value: Then Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, then I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.”

column.name: text
column.value: She said, “I will certainly go with you; however, the fame shall not be yours on the journey that you are about to take, for the LORD will sell Sisera into the hand of a woman.” Then Deborah got up and went with Barak to Kedesh.

column.name: text
column.value: Barak summoned Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh, and ten thousand men went up ①with him; Deborah also went up with him. ▷ ①Lit at his feet

column.name: text
