column.value: Are Zadok and Abiathar the priests not with you there? So it shall be that whatever you hear from the king’s house, you shall report to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold their two sons are there with them, Ahimaaz, Zadok’s son and Jonathan, Abiathar’s son; and by them you shall send me everything that you hear.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Hushai, David’s friend, came into the city, and Absalom came into Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Now a worthless man happened to be there whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjaminite; and he blew the trumpet and said, “We have no share in David, Nor do we have an inheritance in the son of Jesse; Every man to his tents, Israel!”

column.name: text
column.value: So all the men of Israel ①withdrew from following David and followed Sheba the son of Bichri; but the men of Judah ②remained loyal to their king, from the Jordan even to Jerusalem. ▷ ①Lit went up ②Lit clung to

column.name: text
column.value: Then David came to his house in Jerusalem, and the king took the ten women, the concubines whom he had left behind to take care of the house, and put them in custody and provided them with food, but did not ①have relations with them. So they were locked up until the day of their death, living as widows. ▷ ①Lit come in to

column.name: text
column.value: Now the king said to Amasa, “Summon the men of Judah for me within three days, and be present here yourself.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Amasa went to summon the men of Judah, but he was delayed longer than the set time which he had designated for him.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom; take your lord’s servants and pursue him, so that he does not find for himself fortified cities and escape from our sight.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Joab’s men went out after him, along with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the warriors; and they left Jerusalem to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.

column.name: text
column.value: When they were at the large stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came ①to meet them. Now Joab was dressed in his military attire, and over it he had a belt with a sword in its sheath strapped on at his waist; and as he went forward, it fell out. ▷ ①Lit before

column.name: text
column.value: And Joab said to Amasa, “Is it going well for you, my brother?” And Joab took hold of Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.

column.name: text
column.value: But Amasa was not on guard against the sword which was in Joab’s hand, so he struck him in the belly with it and spilled out his intestines on the ground, and did not strike him again, and he died. Then Joab and his brother Abishai pursued Sheba the son of Bichri.

column.name: text
column.value: Now one of Joab’s young men stood by him and said, “Whoever favors Joab and whoever is for David, follow Joab!”

column.name: text
column.value: But Amasa was wallowing in his own blood in the middle of the road. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa from the road to the field and threw a garment over him when he saw that everyone who came by him stood still.

column.name: text
column.value: As soon as he was removed from the road, all the men went on after Joab to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.

column.name: text
column.value: Now he went on through all the tribes of Israel to Abel, that is, Beth-maacah, and all the Berites; and they assembled and went after him as well.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came and besieged him in Abel Beth-maacah, and they ①built up an assault ramp against the city, and it stood against the outer rampart; and all the people who were with Joab were wreaking destruction in order to topple the wall. ▷ ①Lit poured out

column.name: text
column.value: Then a wise woman called out from the city, “Listen, listen! Please tell Joab, ‘Come here that I may speak with you.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: So he approached her, and the woman said, “Are you Joab?” And he answered, “I am.” Then she said to him, “Listen to the words of your slave.” And he said, “I am listening.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then she spoke, saying, “In the past they used to say, ‘They will undoubtedly ask advice at Abel,’ and that is how they ended a dispute.

column.name: text
column.value: I am one of those who are ready for peace and faithful in Israel. You are trying to destroy a city, even a mother in Israel. Why would you swallow up the inheritance of the LORD?”

column.name: text
column.value: Joab replied, “Far be it, far be it from me that I would consume or destroy!

column.name: text
column.value: Such is not the case. But a man from the hill country of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has raised his hand against King David. Only turn him over, and I will depart from the city.” And the woman said to Joab, “Behold, his head will be thrown to you over the wall.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the woman wisely came to all the people. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri and threw it to Joab. So he blew the trumpet, and they were dispersed from the city, each to his tent. Joab also returned to the king at Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Joab was in command of the entire army of Israel, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites;

column.name: text
column.value: and Adoram was over the forced labor, and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the secretary;

column.name: text
column.value: and Sheva was scribe, and Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

column.name: text
column.value: Ira the Jairite also was a priest to David.

column.name: text
column.value: Now David spoke the words of this song to the LORD on the day that the LORD had saved him from the ①hand of all his enemies and from the ②hand of Saul. ▷ ①Lit palm ②Lit palm

column.name: text
text
column.value: ①My God, my rock, in whom I take refuge, My shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold and my refuge; My savior, You save me from violence. ▷ ①As in LXX; MT God of my rock

column.name: text
column.value: I call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised, And I am saved from my enemies.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: In my distress I called upon the LORD, Yes, I called out to my God; And from His temple He heard my voice, And my cry for help came into His ears.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the earth shook and quaked, The foundations of heaven were trembling And were shaken, because He was angry.

column.name: text
column.value: Smoke went up ①out of His nostrils, And fire from His mouth was devouring; Coals were kindled by it. ▷ ①I.e., in his anger

column.name: text
column.value: He also bowed the heavens down low, and came down With thick darkness under His feet.

column.name: text
text
column.value: He made darkness canopies around Him, A mass of waters, thick clouds of the sky.

column.name: text
column.value: From the brightness before Him Coals of fire were kindled.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD thundered from heaven, And the Most High uttered His voice.

column.name: text
column.value: And He shot arrows and scattered them, Lightning, and ①routed them. ▷ ①Lit confused

column.name: text
column.value: Then the channels of the sea appeared, The foundations of the world were exposed By the rebuke of the LORD, From the blast of the breath of His nostrils.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent from on high, He took me; He drew me out of many waters.

column.name: text
column.value: He rescued me from my strong enemy, From those who hated me, for they were too strong for me.

column.name: text
column.value: They confronted me on the day of my disaster, But the LORD was my support.

column.name: text
column.value: He also brought me out into an open place; He rescued me, because He delighted in me.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has treated me in accordance with my righteousness; In accordance with the cleanliness of my hands He has repaid me.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, And have not acted wickedly against my God.

column.name: text
column.value: For all His ordinances were before me, And as for His statutes, I did not deviate from ①them. ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: I was also ①blameless toward Him, And I have kept myself from my wrongdoing. ▷ ①Lit complete; or having integrity

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD has repaid me in accordance with my righteousness, In accordance with my cleanliness before His eyes.

column.name: text
text
column.value: With the one who is pure You show Yourself pure, But with the perverted You ①show Yourself astute. ▷ ①As in two Heb mss and Ps 18:26; MT pretend stupidity

column.name: text
column.value: And You save an afflicted people; But Your eyes are on the haughty whom You humiliate.

column.name: text
column.value: For You are my lamp, LORD; And the LORD illuminates my darkness.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: For who is God, except the LORD? And who is a rock, except our God?

column.name: text
text
column.value: He makes ①my feet like deer’s feet, And sets me on my high places. ▷ ①Another reading is His

column.name: text
column.value: He trains my hands for battle, So that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: You have also given me the shield of Your salvation, And Your ①help makes me great. ▷ ①Lit answering

column.name: text
column.value: You enlarge my steps under me, And my ①feet have not slipped. ▷ ①Lit ankles

column.name: text
column.value: I pursued my enemies and eliminated them, And I did not turn back until they were finished off.

column.name: text
column.value: And I have devoured them and smashed them, so that they would not rise; And they fell under my feet.

column.name: text
column.value: For You have encircled me with strength for battle; You have forced those who rose up against me to bow down under me.

column.name: text
column.value: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, And I ①destroyed those who hated me. ▷ ①Or silenced

column.name: text
column.value: They looked, but there was no one to save them; Even to the LORD, but He did not answer them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I pulverized them as the dust of the earth; I crushed and trampled them like the mud of the streets.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Foreigners pretend to obey me; As soon as they hear, they obey me.

column.name: text
column.value: Foreigners lose heart, And ①come trembling out of their fortresses. ▷ ①Reading based on Ps 18:45; MT belt up themselves

column.name: text
text
column.value: The God who executes vengeance for me, And brings down peoples under me,

column.name: text
text
column.value: Therefore I will ①give thanks to You, LORD, among the nations, And I will sing praises to Your name. ▷ ①Or praise

column.name: text
column.value: He is a tower of ①salvation to His king, And shows favor to His anointed, To David and his ②descendants forever.” ▷ ①Lit acts of salvation ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was a famine in the days of David for three years, year after year; and David sought the presence of the LORD. And the LORD said, “It is because of Saul and his bloody house, because he put the Gibeonites to death.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the king called the Gibeonites and spoke to them (now the Gibeonites were not of the sons of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites, and the sons of Israel had ①made a covenant with them, but Saul had sought to ②kill them in his zeal for the sons of Israel and Judah). ▷ ①Lit sworn to ②Lit strike

column.name: text
column.value: David said to the Gibeonites, “What should I do for you? And how can I make amends, so that you will bless the inheritance of the LORD?”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Gibeonites said to him, “For us it is not a matter of silver or gold with Saul or his house, nor is it for us to put anyone to death in Israel.” Nevertheless David said, “I will do for you whatever you say.”

column.name: text
column.value: So they said to the king, “The man who destroyed us and who planned ①to eliminate us so that we would not exist within any border of Israel— ▷ ①Lit against us that we are eliminated from

column.name: text
column.value: let seven men from his sons be given to us, and we will ①hang them before the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of the LORD.” And the king said, “I will give them.” ▷ ①Or expose them

column.name: text
column.value: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, because of the oath of the LORD which was between them, between David and Saul’s son Jonathan.

column.name: text
column.value: So the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, Armoni and Mephibosheth whom she had borne to Saul, and the five sons of ①Merab the daughter of Saul, whom she had borne to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite. ▷ ①As in some ancient versions and two Heb mss; MT Michal

column.name: text
column.value: Then he handed them over to the Gibeonites, and they ①hanged them on the mountain before the LORD, so that the seven of them fell together; and they were put to death in the first days of harvest at the beginning of barley harvest. ▷ ①Or exposed them

column.name: text
column.value: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it out for herself on the rock, from the beginning of harvest until ①it rained on them from the sky; and she ②allowed neither the birds of the sky to rest on them by day nor the wild animals by night. ▷ ①Lit water gushed forth ②Lit gave

column.name: text
column.value: When it was reported to David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done,

column.name: text
column.value: then David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of his son Jonathan from the citizens of Jabesh-gilead, who had stolen them from the public square of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hanged them on the day the Philistines struck and killed Saul in Gilboa.

column.name: text
column.value: He brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of his son Jonathan, and they gathered the bones of those who had been ①hanged. ▷ ①Or exposed

column.name: text
column.value: Then they buried the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the grave of his father Kish; So they did everything that the king commanded, and after that God responded to prayer for the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the Philistines were at war with Israel again, David went down, and his servants with him; and when they fought against the Philistines, David became weary.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Ishbi-benob, who was among the descendants of the ①giant, the weight of whose spear was ②three hundred shekels of bronze in weight, ③had strapped on a new sword, and he ④intended to kill David. ▷ ①Heb Raphah ②About 9 lb. or 4 kg ③Lit and he had strapped ④Lit said

column.name: text
column.value: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah helped him, and struck the Philistine and killed him. Then David’s men swore to him, saying, “You shall not go out again with us to battle, so that you do not extinguish the lamp of Israel.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about after this that there was war again with the Philistines at Gob; then Sibbecai the Hushathite struck and killed Saph, who was among the descendants of the ①giant. ▷ ①Heb Raphah

column.name: text
column.value: And there was war with the Philistines again at Gob, and Elhanan the son of Jaare-oregim the Bethlehemite ①killed ②Goliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam. ▷ ①Lit struck ②In 1 Chr 20:5, Lahmi, the brother of Goliath

column.name: text
column.value: And there was war at Gath again, where there was a man of great stature who had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot, twenty-four in number; and he also had been born to the ①giant. ▷ ①Heb Raphah

column.name: text
column.value: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David’s brother, struck and killed him.

column.name: text
column.value: These four were born to the ①giant at Gath, and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants. ▷ ①Heb Raphah

column.name: text
column.value: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse declares, The man who was raised on high, The anointed of the God of Jacob And the sweet psalmist of Israel, declares,

column.name: text
column.value: “The Spirit of the LORD spoke through me, And His word was on my tongue.

column.name: text
column.value: The God of Israel said it; The Rock of Israel spoke to me: ‘He who rules over mankind righteously, Who rules in the fear of God,

column.name: text
column.value: Is like the light of the morning when the sun rises, A morning without clouds, When the fresh grass springs out of the earth From sunshine after rain.’

column.name: text
column.value: Is my house not indeed so with God? For He has made an everlasting covenant with me, Properly ordered in all things, and secured; For will He not indeed make All my salvation and all my delight grow?

column.name: text
column.value: But the worthless, every one of them, are like scattered thorns, Because they cannot be taken in hand;

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, the man who touches them Must be ①armed with iron and the shaft of a spear, And they will be completely burned with fire in their ②place.” ▷ ①Lit filled ②Lit sitting

column.name: text
column.value: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb-basshebeth, a Tahchemonite, chief of the ①captains; he was called Adino the Eznite because of eight hundred who were killed by him at one time. ▷ ①Or three

column.name: text
column.value: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David when they defied the Philistines who were gathered there to battle and the men of Israel had ①withdrawn. ▷ ①Lit gone up

column.name: text
column.value: He rose up and struck the Philistines until his hand was weary and ①it clung to the sword, and the LORD brought about a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to plunder the dead. ▷ ①Lit his hand

column.name: text
column.value: Now after him was Shammah the son of Agee, a Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered ①into an army where there was a plot of land full of lentils, and the people fled from the Philistines. ▷ ①Or possibly, at Lehi

column.name: text
column.value: But he took his stand in the midst of the plot, defended it, and struck the Philistines; and the LORD brought about a great victory.

column.name: text
column.value: Then three of the thirty chief men went down and came to David at harvest time to the cave of Adullam, while the army of the Philistines was camping in the Valley of Rephaim.

column.name: text
column.value: David was then in the stronghold, while the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.

column.name: text
column.value: And David had a craving and said, “Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem which is by the gate!”

column.name: text
column.value: So the three mighty men forced their way into the camp of the Philistines, and drew water from the well of Bethlehem which was by the gate, and carried it and brought it to David. Yet he would not drink it, but poured it out as an offering to the LORD;

column.name: text
column.value: and he said, “Far be it from me, LORD, that I would do this! Should I drink the blood of the men who went at the risk of their lives?” So he would not drink it. These things the three mighty men did.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the ①thirty. And he swung his spear against three hundred ②and killed them, and had a name ③as well as the three. ▷ ①As in two Heb mss and Syriac; MT three ②Lit slain ones ③Lit among the

column.name: text
column.value: He was the most honored among the thirty, so he became their commander; however, he did not attain to the reputation of the three.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done great deeds, ①killed the ②two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day. ▷ ①Lit struck ②Or two warriors of Moab

column.name: text
column.value: And he ①killed an Egyptian, ②an impressive man. Now the Egyptian had a spear in his hand, but he went down to him with a club and snatched the spear from the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear. ▷ ①Lit struck ②Lit a man of appearance

column.name: text
column.value: These things Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did, and had a name ①as well as the three mighty men. ▷ ①Lit among the

column.name: text
column.value: He was honored among the thirty, but he did not attain the reputation of the three. And David appointed him over his bodyguard.

column.name: text
column.value: Asahel the brother of Joab was among the thirty; and there was Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

column.name: text
column.value: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

column.name: text
column.value: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

column.name: text
column.value: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

column.name: text
column.value: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

column.name: text
column.value: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the sons of Benjamin,

column.name: text
column.value: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,

column.name: text
column.value: Abi-albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

column.name: text
column.value: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

column.name: text
column.value: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite,

column.name: text
column.value: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

column.name: text
column.value: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

column.name: text
column.value: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

column.name: text
column.value: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armor bearers of Joab the son of Zeruiah,

column.name: text
column.value: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

column.name: text
column.value: and Uriah the Hittite; thirty-seven in all.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the anger of the LORD burned against Israel again, and He incited David against them to say, “Go, count Israel and Judah.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the king said to Joab the commander of the army, who was with him, “Roam about now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan to Beersheba, and conduct a census of the people, so that I may know the number of the people.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Joab said to the king, “May the LORD your God add to the people a hundred times as many as they are, while the eyes of my lord the king can still see; but why does my lord the king delight in this thing?”

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, the king’s order prevailed against Joab and against the commanders of the army. So Joab and the commanders of the army left the presence of the king to conduct a census of the people of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: They crossed the Jordan and camped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the Valley of Gad and toward Jazer.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they came to Gilead and to ①the land of Tahtim-hodshi, and they came to Dan-jaan and around to Sidon, ▷ ①Another reading is Kadesh in the land of the Hittite

column.name: text
column.value: then they came to the fortress of Tyre and to all the cities of the Hivites and of the Canaanites, and they went out to the south of Judah, to Beersheba.

column.name: text
column.value: So when they had roamed about through the whole land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joab gave the number of the census of the people to the king: in Israel there were eight hundred thousand valiant men who drew the sword, and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.

column.name: text
column.value: Now David’s heart ①troubled him after he had counted the people. So David said to the LORD, “I have sinned greatly in what I have done. But now, LORD, please ②overlook the guilt of Your servant, for I have acted very foolishly.” ▷ ①Lit struck ②Lit allow to pass

column.name: text
column.value: When David got up in the morning, the word of the LORD came to Gad the prophet, David’s seer, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Go and speak to David, ‘This is what the LORD says: “I am imposing upon you three choices; choose for yourself one of them, and I will do it to you.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: So Gad came to David and told him, and said to him, “Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? Or will you flee for three months before your enemies while they pursue you? Or shall there be three days’ of plague in your land? Now consider and see what answer I shall return to Him who sent me.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then David said to Gad, “I am in great distress. Let us now fall into the hand of the LORD, for His mercies are great; but do not let me fall into human hands.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD ①sent a plague upon Israel from the morning until the appointed time, and seventy thousand men of the people from Dan to Beersheba died. ▷ ①Lit gave

column.name: text
column.value: When the angel extended his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD relented of the disaster and said to the angel who destroyed the people, “It is enough! Now drop your hand!” And the angel of the LORD was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David spoke to the LORD when he saw the angel who was striking down the people, and said, “Behold, it is I who have sinned, and it is I who have done wrong; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let Your hand be against me and against my father’s house!”

column.name: text
column.value: So Gad came to David that day and said to him, “Go up, erect an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of ①Araunah the Jebusite.” ▷ ①In 2 Chr 3:1, Ornan

column.name: text
column.value: Then David went up in accordance with the word of Gad, just as the LORD had commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: And Araunah looked down and saw the king and his servants crossing over toward him; so Araunah went out and bowed his face to the ground before the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Araunah said, “Why has my lord the king come to his servant?” And David said, “To buy the threshing floor from you, in order to build an altar to the LORD, so that the plague may be ①withdrawn from the people.” ▷ ①Or brought to a halt

column.name: text
column.value: Araunah then said to David, “Let my lord the king take and offer up what is good in his sight. Look, here are the oxen for the burnt offering, the threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen for the wood.

column.name: text
column.value: Everything, O king, Araunah gives to the king.” And Araunah said to the king, “May the LORD your God be favorable to you.”

column.name: text
column.value: However, the king said to Araunah, “No, but I will certainly buy it from you for a price; for I will not offer burnt offerings to the LORD my God ①that cost me nothing.” So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver. ▷ ①Lit gratuitously

column.name: text
column.value: Then David built there an altar to the LORD, and he offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. And the LORD responded to prayer for the land, and the plague was ①withdrawn from Israel. ▷ ①Or brought to a halt

column.name: text
column.value: Now King David was old, ①advanced in age; and they covered him with garments, but he could not keep warm. ▷ ①Lit coming into days

column.name: text
column.value: So his servants said to him, “Have them search for a young virgin for my lord the king, and have her ①attend the king and become his nurse; and have her lie on your chest, so that my lord the king may keep warm.” ▷ ①Lit stand before

column.name: text
column.value: So they searched for a beautiful girl throughout the territory of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

column.name: text
column.value: The girl was very beautiful; and she became the king’s nurse and served him, but the king did not ①become intimate with her. ▷ ①Lit know her

column.name: text
column.value: Now Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, “I will be king.” So he prepared for himself chariots and horsemen, with fifty men to run before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And his father had never rebuked him at any time by asking, “Why have you done so?” And he was also a very handsome man, and ①he was born after Absalom. ▷ ①Lit she gave him birth

column.name: text
column.value: Now ①he had conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest; and they allied themselves with Adonijah. ▷ ①Lit his words were

column.name: text
column.value: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.

column.name: text
column.value: Adonijah sacrificed sheep, oxen, and fattened steers by the ①stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En-rogel; and he invited all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah, the king’s servants. ▷ ①Or Sliding; or Serpent Stone

column.name: text
column.value: But he did not invite Nathan the prophet, Benaiah, the mighty men, or his brother Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, “Have you not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith has become king, and David our lord does not know it?

column.name: text
column.value: So now come, please let me give you advice, and save your life and the life of your son Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: Go ①at once to King David and say to him, ‘Have you not, my lord the king, sworn to your servant, saying, “Solomon your son certainly shall be king after me, and he shall sit on my throne”? Why then has Adonijah become king?’ ▷ ①Lit and enter to

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, while you are still there speaking with the king, I will come in after you and confirm your words.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Bathsheba entered to the king in the bedroom. Now the king was very old, and Abishag the Shunammite was serving the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Bathsheba bowed and prostrated herself ①before the king. And the king said, “What ②is on your mind?” ▷ ①Lit to ②Lit to you

column.name: text
column.value: So she said to him, “My lord, you yourself swore to your servant by the LORD your God, saying, ‘Your son Solomon certainly shall be king after me, and he shall sit on my throne.’

column.name: text
column.value: But now, behold, Adonijah is king; and now, my lord the king, you do not know it.

column.name: text
column.value: He has sacrificed oxen and fattened steers and sheep in abundance, and has invited all the sons of the king, Abiathar the priest, and Joab the commander of the army, but he has not invited Solomon your servant.

column.name: text
column.value: And as for you, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are upon you, to announce to them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

column.name: text
column.value: Otherwise it will come about, as soon as my lord the king ①lies down with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be considered ②offenders.” ▷ ①I.e., dies ②Lit sinners

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, while she was still speaking with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.

column.name: text
column.value: They informed the king, saying, “Nathan the prophet is here.” And when he came into the king’s presence, he prostrated himself ①before the king with his face to the ground. ▷ ①Lit to

column.name: text
column.value: Then Nathan said, “My lord the king, have you yourself said, ‘Adonijah shall be king after me, and he shall sit on my throne’?

column.name: text
column.value: For he has gone down today and has sacrificed oxen and fattened steers and sheep in abundance, and has invited all the king’s sons, the commanders of the army, and Abiathar the priest, and behold, they are eating and drinking in his presence; and they say, ‘Long live King Adonijah!’

column.name: text
column.value: But me, even me your servant, Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon, he has not invited.

column.name: text
column.value: Has this thing been done by my lord the king, and you have not let your ①servants know who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?” ▷ ①Some mss servant

column.name: text
column.value: Then King David responded and said, “Summon Bathsheba to me.” And she came into the king’s presence and stood before the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king vowed and said, “As the LORD lives, who has redeemed my life from all distress,

column.name: text
column.value: certainly as I vowed to you by the LORD, the God of Israel, saying, ‘Your son Solomon certainly shall be king after me, and he shall sit on my throne in my place’; I will indeed do so this day.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the ground, and prostrated herself before the king and said, “May my lord King David live forever.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then King David said, “Summon to me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada.” And they came into the king’s presence.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to them, “Take with you the servants of your lord, and have my son Solomon ride on my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon.

column.name: text
column.value: And have Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there as king over Israel, and blow the trumpet and say, ‘Long live King Solomon!’

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall come up after him, and he shall come and sit on my throne, and he shall be king in my place; for I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and Judah.”

column.name: text
column.value: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king and said, “Amen! May the LORD, the God of my lord the king, say the same.

column.name: text
column.value: Just as the LORD has been with my lord the king, so may He be with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord King David!”

column.name: text
column.value: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the Cherethites, and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.

column.name: text
column.value: And Zadok the priest then took the horn of oil from the tent and anointed Solomon. Then they blew the trumpet, and all the people said, “Long live King Solomon!”

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people went up after him, and the people were playing on flutes and rejoicing with great joy, so that the earth ①shook at their noise. ▷ ①Lit was split

column.name: text
column.value: Now Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard this as they finished eating. When Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, “Why is the ①city making such an uproar?” ▷ ①Lit sound of the city an uproar

column.name: text
column.value: While he was still speaking, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came. Then Adonijah said, “Come in, for you are a valiant man and you bring good news.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jonathan replied to Adonijah, “On the contrary! Our lord King David has made Solomon king!

column.name: text
column.value: The king has also sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the Cherethites, and the Pelethites; and they have mounted him on the king’s mule.

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore, Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon, and they have come up from there rejoicing, so that the city is going wild. This is the noise which you have heard.

column.name: text
column.value: Besides, Solomon has even taken his seat on the throne of the kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the king’s servants came to bless our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and his throne greater than your throne!’ And the king bowed himself on the bed.

column.name: text
column.value: The king has also said this: ‘Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who has granted one to sit on my throne today while my own eyes see it.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the guests of Adonijah trembled and got up, and each went on his way.

column.name: text
column.value: Adonijah also was afraid of Solomon, and he got up, and went, and took hold of the horns of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it was reported to Solomon, saying, “Behold, Adonijah is afraid of King Solomon, for behold, he has taken hold of the horns of the altar, saying, ‘May King Solomon swear to me today that he will not put his servant to death with the sword.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon said, “If he is a worthy man, not one of his hairs will fall to the ground; but if wickedness is found in him, he will die.”

column.name: text
column.value: So King Solomon sent men, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and prostrated himself before King Solomon, and Solomon said to him, “Go to your house.”

column.name: text
column.value: As David’s ①time to die drew near, he commanded his son Solomon, saying, ▷ ①Lit days

column.name: text
column.value: “I am going the way of all the earth. So be strong, and ①prove yourself a man. ▷ ①Lit become a man

column.name: text
column.value: Do your duty to the LORD your God, to walk in His ways, to ①keep His statutes, His commandments, His ordinances, and His testimonies, according to what is written in the Law of Moses, so that you may succeed in all that you do and wherever you turn, ▷ ①Or carefully perform

column.name: text
column.value: so that the LORD may fulfill His ①promise which He spoke regarding me, saying, ‘If your sons are careful about their way, to walk before Me in ②truth with all their heart and all their soul, ③you shall not be deprived of a man to occupy the throne of Israel.’ ▷ ①Lit word ②Or faithfulness ③Lit there shall not be cut off to you a man from upon

column.name: text
column.value: “Now you yourself also know what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, what he did to the two commanders of the armies of Israel, to Abner the son of Ner and to Amasa the son of Jether, whom he killed; he also ①shed the blood of war in peace. And he put the blood of war on his belt that was on his waist, and on his sandals that were on his feet. ▷ ①Lit brought blood...on peace

column.name: text
column.value: So act as your wisdom dictates, and do not let his gray hair go down to ①Sheol in peace. ▷ ①I.e., the netherworld

column.name: text
column.value: However, show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table; for ①they assisted me when I fled from Absalom your brother. ▷ ①Lit so they came near to me

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, you have with you Shimei the son of Gera the Benjaminite, of Bahurim; now it was he who cursed me with a painful curse on the day I went to Mahanaim. But when he came down to meet me at the Jordan, I swore to him by the LORD, saying, ‘I will not put you to death with the sword.’

column.name: text
column.value: But now do not leave him unpunished, for you are a wise man; and you will know what to do to him, and you will bring his gray hair down to ①Sheol with blood.” ▷ ①I.e., the netherworld

column.name: text
column.value: Then David ①lay down with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David. ▷ ①I.e., died

column.name: text
column.value: Now the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: in Hebron he reigned for seven years, and in Jerusalem he reigned for thirty-three years.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon sat on the throne of his father David, and his kingdom was firmly established.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. So she said, “Do you come peacefully?” And he said, “Peacefully.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said, “I have something to say to you.” And she said, “Speak.”

column.name: text
column.value: So he said, “You yourself know that the kingdom was mine and that all Israel ①intended for me to be king; however, the kingdom has turned around and become my brother’s, for it was his from the LORD. ▷ ①Lit set their faces toward me

column.name: text
column.value: So now I am making one request of you; do not ①refuse me.” And she said to him, “Speak.” ▷ ①Lit turn away my face

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said, “Please speak to Solomon the king—for he will not ①refuse you—that he may give me Abishag the Shunammite as a wife.” ▷ ①Lit turn away your face

column.name: text
column.value: And Bathsheba said, “Very well; I will speak to the king for you.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Bathsheba went to King Solomon, to speak to him for Adonijah. And the king stood to meet her, bowed to her, and sat on his throne; then he had a throne set up for the king’s mother, and she sat on his right.

column.name: text
column.value: Then she said, “I am making one small request of you; do not ①refuse me.” And the king said to her, “Ask, my mother, for I will not ②refuse you.” ▷ ①Lit turn away my face ②Lit turn away your face

column.name: text
column.value: So she said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as a wife.”

column.name: text
column.value: But King Solomon answered and said to his mother, “And why are you requesting Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Request for him the kingdom as well—since he is my older brother—for him, for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah!”

column.name: text
column.value: Then King Solomon swore by the LORD, saying, “May God do so to me and more so, if Adonijah has not spoken this word against his own ①life! ▷ ①Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, as the LORD lives, who has established me and set me on the throne of David my father, and has made me a house just as He ①promised, Adonijah certainly shall be put to death today!” ▷ ①Lit spoke

column.name: text
column.value: Then King Solomon sent the order by Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he ①struck him so that he died. ▷ ①Lit attacked

column.name: text
column.value: Then to Abiathar the priest the king said, “Go to Anathoth to your own field, for you ①deserve to die; but I will not put you to death at this ②time, because you carried the ark of the Lord ③GOD before my father David, and because you were afflicted in everything with which my father was afflicted.” ▷ ①Lit are a man of death ②Lit day ③Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: So Solomon dismissed Abiathar from being priest to the LORD, to fulfill the word of the LORD, which He had spoken regarding the house of Eli in Shiloh.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the news came to Joab because Joab had followed Adonijah, though he had not followed Absalom. So Joab fled to the tent of the LORD and took hold of the horns of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was reported to King Solomon that Joab had fled to the tent of the LORD, and ①was beside the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, “Go, ②execute him.” ▷ ①Lit behold, beside ②Lit attack

column.name: text
column.value: So Benaiah came to the tent of the LORD and said to him, “This is what the king has said: ‘Come out.’ ” But he said, “No, for I will die here.” So Benaiah brought back word to the king, saying, “This is what Joab spoke, and so he answered me.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to him, “Do just as he has spoken, and ①execute him and bury him, so that you may remove from me and from my father’s house the blood which Joab shed without ②justification. ▷ ①Lit attack ②Or cause

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will return his blood on his own head, because he ①struck two men more righteous and better than he, and killed them with the sword, while my father David did not know about it: Abner the son of Ner, commander of the army of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, commander of the army of Judah. ▷ ①Lit attacked

column.name: text
column.value: So their blood shall return on the head of Joab and on the head of his ①descendants forever; but for David and his ②descendants, and his house and his throne, may there be peace from the LORD forever.” ▷ ①Lit seed ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: Then Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up and ①struck him and put him to death, and he was buried at his own house in the wilderness. ▷ ①Lit attacked

column.name: text
column.value: And the king appointed Benaiah the son of Jehoiada over the army in his place, and the king appointed Zadok the priest in place of Abiathar.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the king sent men and summoned Shimei, and said to him, “Build yourself a house in Jerusalem and live there, and do not leave there for any other place.

column.name: text
column.value: For on the day you leave and cross the ①brook Kidron, you will know for certain that you will assuredly die; your blood will be ②on your own head.” ▷ ①Or wadi ②I.e., your own responsibility

column.name: text
column.value: Shimei then said to the king, “The word is good. Just as my lord the king has spoken, so your servant shall do.” So Shimei lived in Jerusalem for many days.

column.name: text
column.value: But it came about at the end of three years, that two of Shimei’s servants ran away to Achish son of Maacah, king of Gath. And others told Shimei, saying, “Behold, your servants are in Gath.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Shimei got up and saddled his donkey, and went to Gath to Achish, to search for his servants. And Shimei went and brought his servants from Gath.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was reported to Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and had returned.

column.name: text
column.value: So the king sent men and summoned Shimei, and said to him, “Did I not make you swear by the LORD, and solemnly warn you, saying, ‘Know for certain that on the day you depart and go anywhere, you shall assuredly die’? And you said to me, ‘The word I have heard is good.’

column.name: text
column.value: Why then have you not kept the oath of the LORD, and the command which I ①imposed on you?” ▷ ①Lit commanded

column.name: text
column.value: The king also said to Shimei, “You yourself know all the evil that ①you acknowledge in your heart, which you did to my father David; therefore the LORD will return your evil on your own head. ▷ ①Lit your heart acknowledges

column.name: text
column.value: But King Solomon will be blessed, and the throne of David will be established before the LORD forever.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and he went out and ①struck him so that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hands of Solomon. ▷ ①Lit attacked

column.name: text
column.value: Now Solomon ①formed a marriage alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh’s daughter and brought her to the city of David until he had finished building his own house and the house of the LORD, and the wall around Jerusalem. ▷ ①Lit made himself a son-in-law of Pharaoh

column.name: text
column.value: The people were still sacrificing on the high places, because there was no house built for the name of the LORD until those days.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of his father David, except that he was sacrificing and burning incense on the high places.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, because that was the great high place; Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.

column.name: text
column.value: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream at night; and God said, “Ask what you wish Me to give you.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon said, “You have shown great faithfulness to Your servant David my father, according as he walked before You in ①truth, righteousness, and uprightness of heart toward You; and You have ②reserved for him this great faithfulness, that You have given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day. ▷ ①Or faithfulness ②Lit kept

column.name: text
column.value: And now, LORD my God, You have made Your servant king in place of my father David, yet I am like a little boy; I do not know how to ①go out or come in. ▷ ①I.e., conduct daily business

column.name: text
column.value: And Your servant is in the midst of Your people whom You have chosen, a great people who are too many to be numbered or counted.

column.name: text
column.value: So give Your servant ①an understanding heart to judge Your people, to discern between good and evil. For who is capable of judging this ②great people of Yours?” ▷ ①Or a heart that listens ②Lit heavy

column.name: text
column.value: Now ①it was pleasing in the sight of the Lord that Solomon had asked this thing. ▷ ①Lit the thing was

column.name: text
column.value: And God said to him, “Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked for yourself ①a long life, nor have asked riches for yourself, nor have you asked for the lives of your enemies, but have asked for yourself discernment to understand justice, ▷ ①Lit many days

column.name: text
column.value: behold, I have done according to your words. Behold, I have given you a wise and discerning heart, so that there has been no one like you before you, nor shall one like you arise after you.

column.name: text
column.value: I have also given you what you have not asked, both riches and honor, so that there will not be any among the kings like you all your days.

column.name: text
column.value: And if you walk in My ways, keeping My statutes and commandments, as your father David walked, then I will prolong your days.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon awoke, and behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem and stood before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and made peace offerings, and held a feast for all his servants.

column.name: text
column.value: Then two women who were prostitutes came to the king and stood before him.

column.name: text
column.value: The one woman said, “Pardon me, my lord: ①this woman and I live in the same house; and I gave birth to a child ②while she was in the house. ▷ ①Lit I and this woman ②Lit with her in

column.name: text
column.value: And it happened on the third day after I gave birth, that this woman also gave birth to a child, and we were together. There was no stranger with us in the house, only the two of us in the house.

column.name: text
column.value: Then this woman’s son died in the night, because she lay on him.

column.name: text
column.value: So she got up in the middle of the night and took my son from beside me while your servant was asleep, and she laid him at her breast, and laid her dead son at my breast.

column.name: text
column.value: When I got up in the morning to nurse my son, behold, he was dead! But when I examined him closely in the morning, behold, he was not my son, whom I had borne!”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the other woman said, “No! For the living one is my son, and the dead one is your son.” But ①the first woman said, “No! For the dead one is your son, and the living one is my son.” So they spoke before the king. ▷ ①Lit this one was saying

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king said, “ ①The one says, ‘This is my son who is living, and your son is the dead one’; and ②the other says, ‘No! For your son is the dead one, and my son is the living one.’ ” ▷ ①Lit this one ②Lit this one

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said, “Get me a sword.” So they brought a sword before the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said, “Cut the living child in two, and give half to the one and half to the other.”

column.name: text
column.value: But the woman whose child was the living one spoke to the king, for ①she was deeply stirred over her son, and she said, “Pardon me, my lord! Give her the living child, and by no means kill him!” But the other woman was saying, “He shall be neither mine nor yours; cut him!” ▷ ①Lit her compassion grew hot

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king replied, “Give ①the first woman the living child, and by no means kill him. She is his mother.” ▷ ①Lit her the living

column.name: text
column.value: When all Israel heard about the judgment which the king had ①handed down, they feared the king, because they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to ②administer justice. ▷ ①Lit judged ②Lit do

column.name: text
column.value: ①Now Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon when he heard that they had anointed him king in place of his father, for Hiram had ②always been a friend of David. ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon sent word to Hiram, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “You know that David my father was unable to build a house for the name of the LORD his God because of the wars which surrounded him, until the LORD put them under the soles of his feet.

column.name: text
column.value: But now the LORD my God has secured me rest on every side; there is neither adversary nor ①misfortune. ▷ ①Lit evil occurrence

column.name: text
column.value: So behold, I ①intend to build a house for the name of the LORD my God, just as the LORD spoke to David my father, saying, ‘Your son, whom I will put on your throne in your place, he will build the house for My name.’ ▷ ①Lit say

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, issue orders that they cut cedars from Lebanon for me, and my servants will be with your servants; and I will give you wages for your servants in accordance with all that you say, for you yourself know that there is no one among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians.”

column.name: text
column.value: When Hiram heard the words of Solomon, he greatly rejoiced; and he said, “Blessed be the LORD today, who has given to David a wise son over this great people.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Hiram sent word to Solomon, saying, “I have heard the message which you sent me; I will do everything you wish concerning the cedar and juniper timber.

column.name: text
column.value: My servants will bring the timbers down from Lebanon to the sea; and I will have them made into rafts to go by sea to the place where you ①direct me, and I will have them broken up there, and you will carry them away. Then you shall do what I wish, by giving food to my household.” ▷ ①Lit send to me

column.name: text
column.value: So ①Hiram ②gave Solomon all that he wished of the cedar and juniper timber. ▷ ①Heb Hirom ②Lit was giving

column.name: text
column.value: Solomon then gave ①Hiram ②twenty thousand kors of wheat as food for his household, and ③twenty kors of pure oil; this is what Solomon would give Hiram year by year. ▷ ①In 2 Chr 2:3, Huram ②About 154,000 cubic feet or 4,360 cubic meters ③About 154 cubic feet or 4.4 cubic meters

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD gave wisdom to Solomon, just as He ①promised him; and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a covenant. ▷ ①Lit spoke to

column.name: text
column.value: Now King Solomon ①conscripted forced laborers from all Israel; and the forced laborers numbered thirty thousand men. ▷ ①Lit raised up

column.name: text
column.value: Then he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month in shifts; they were in Lebanon for a month, and two months at home. And Adoniram was in charge of the forced laborers.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Solomon had seventy thousand porters, and eighty thousand stonemasons in the mountains,

column.name: text
column.value: besides Solomon’s 3,300 chief deputies who were in charge of the ①project and ruled over the people who were doing the work. ▷ ①Lit work

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king issued orders, and they quarried large stones, valuable stones, to lay the foundation of the house with cut stones.

column.name: text
column.value: So Solomon’s builders and ①Hiram’s builders and the Gebalites ②cut the stones, and they prepared the timbers and the stones to build the house. ▷ ①Heb Hirom’s ②Or chiseled

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about in the four hundred and eightieth year after the sons of Israel came out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month of Ziv, that is, the second month, that he ①began to build the house of the LORD. ▷ ①Lit built

column.name: text
column.value: And the house which King Solomon built for the LORD was ①sixty cubits in its length, and twenty cubits in its width, and its height was thirty cubits. ▷ ①About 90 ft. long, 30 ft. wide, and 45 ft. high or 27 m, 9 m, and 14 m

column.name: text
column.value: The porch in front of the main room of the house was ①twenty cubits in ②length, ③corresponding to the width of the house, and its width along the front of the house was ten cubits. ▷ ①About 30 ft. long and 15 ft. deep or 9 m and 4.6 m ②Lit its length ③Lit on the face of

column.name: text
column.value: Also for the house he made windows with artistic frames.

column.name: text
column.value: Against the wall of the house he built stories encompassing the walls of the house around both the main room and the ①inner sanctuary; so he made side chambers all around. ▷ ①I.e., Most Holy Place

column.name: text
column.value: The lowest story was ①five cubits wide, the middle was six cubits wide, and the third was seven cubits wide; for on the outside he ②made offsets in the wall of the house all around so that the beams would not ③be inserted into the walls of the house. ▷ ①About 7.5 ft. wide, 9 ft. wide, and 11 ft. wide or 2.3 m, 2.7 m, and 3.3 m ②Lit gave ③Lit take hold

column.name: text
column.value: The house, while it was being built, was built of stone finished at the quarry, and neither hammer, nor axe, nor any iron tool was heard in the house while it was being built.

column.name: text
column.value: The doorway for the ①lowest side chamber was on the right side of the house; and they would go up by a winding staircase to the middle story, and from the middle to the third. ▷ ①As in LXX and ancient versions; MT middle

column.name: text
column.value: So he built the house and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and ①planks of cedar. ▷ ①Or rows

column.name: text
column.value: He also built the stories against the whole house, each ①five cubits high; and they ②were attached to the house with timbers of cedar. ▷ ①About 7.5 ft. or 2.3 m ②Lit took hold

column.name: text
column.value: Now the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “As for this house which you are building, if you will walk in My statutes and execute My ordinances and keep all My commandments by walking in them, then I will fulfill My word with you which I spoke to David your father.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will dwell among the sons of Israel, and will not abandon My people Israel.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Solomon built the house and finished it.

column.name: text
column.value: He built the walls of the house on the inside with boards of cedar; from the floor of the house to the ①ceiling he paneled the walls on the inside with wood, and he paneled the floor of the house with boards of juniper. ▷ ①Lit walls of the ceiling

column.name: text
column.value: He also built ①twenty cubits on the rear part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the ②ceiling; he built them for it on the inside as an inner sanctuary, as the Most Holy Place. ▷ ①About 30 ft. or 9 m ②Lit walls

column.name: text
column.value: The house, that is, the main room in front of the inner sanctuary, was ①forty cubits long. ▷ ①About 60 ft. or 18 m

column.name: text
column.value: There was cedar inside the house, carved in the shape of gourds and open flowers; everything was cedar, there was no stone visible.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he prepared an inner sanctuary inside the house in order to place there the ark of the covenant of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: ①The inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length, twenty cubits in width, and twenty cubits in height; and he overlaid it with pure gold. He also paneled the altar with cedar. ▷ ①Lit Before the

column.name: text
column.value: So Solomon overlaid the inside of the house with pure gold. And he extended chains of gold across the front of the inner sanctuary, and he overlaid it with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: He overlaid the entire house with gold, until all the house was finished. Also the entire altar which was by the inner sanctuary he overlaid with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the inner sanctuary he made two ①cherubim of olive wood, each ②ten cubits high. ▷ ①Heb plural of cherub ②About 15 ft. or 4.6 m

column.name: text
column.value: The one wing of the first cherub was five cubits, and the other wing of the first cherub was five cubits; from the end of one wing to the end of the other wing were ten cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: The second cherub was ten cubits; both of the cherubim were of the same measurement and the same form.

column.name: text
column.value: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was that of the other cherub.

column.name: text
column.value: He placed the cherubim in the midst of the inner house, and the wings of the cherubim spread out so that the wing of the one was touching the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub was touching the other wall. And their wings were touching ①end to ②end in the center of the house. ▷ ①Lit wing ②Lit wing

column.name: text
column.value: He also overlaid the cherubim with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he carved all the surrounding walls of the house with engravings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, for the inner and outer sanctuaries.

column.name: text
column.value: And he overlaid the floor of the house with gold, for the inner and outer sanctuaries.

column.name: text
column.value: And for the entrance of the inner sanctuary he made doors of olive wood, the lintel, and five-sided doorposts.

column.name: text
column.value: So he made two doors of olive wood, and he carved on them carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold; and he overlaid the cherubim and the palm trees with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: So too he made for the entrance of the main room four-sided doorposts of olive wood,

column.name: text
column.value: and two doors of juniper wood; the two leaves of the one door turned on pivots, and the two ①leaves of the other door turned on pivots. ▷ ①As in LXX; MT curtains

column.name: text
column.value: He carved on it cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold plated on the carved work.

column.name: text
column.value: And he built the inner courtyard with three rows of cut stone and a row of cedar beams.

column.name: text
column.value: In the fourth year the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid, in the month of Ziv.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the eleventh year, in the month of Bul, that is, the eighth month, the house was finished in all its parts and in accordance with all its plans. So he was seven years in building it.

column.name: text
column.value: Now King Solomon was king over all Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: These were his officials: Azariah the son of Zadok was the priest;

column.name: text
column.value: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha were scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the secretary;

column.name: text
column.value: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the army; and Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

column.name: text
column.value: and Azariah the son of Nathan was over the deputies; and Zabud the son of Nathan, a priest, was the king’s confidant;

column.name: text
column.value: and Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the forced labor.

column.name: text
column.value: Solomon had twelve deputies over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household; each deputy had to provide food for a month in the year.

column.name: text
column.value: And these were their names: Ben-hur, in the hill country of Ephraim;

column.name: text
column.value: Ben-deker in Makaz and Shaalbim, and Beth-shemesh, and Elonbeth-hanan;

column.name: text
column.value: Ben-hesed in Arubboth (Socoh was his and all the land of Hepher);

column.name: text
column.value: Ben-abinadab in all ①the hills of Dor (Taphath the daughter of Solomon was his wife); ▷ ①Or Naphoth-dor

column.name: text
column.value: Baana the son of Ahilud in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth-shean which is beside Zarethan below Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah as far as the other side of Jokmeam;

column.name: text
column.value: Ben-geber in Ramoth-gilead (the villages of Jair, the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead were his: the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars were his);

column.name: text
column.value: Ahinadab the son of Iddo in Mahanaim;

column.name: text
column.value: Ahimaaz in Naphtali (he also married Basemath the daughter of Solomon);

column.name: text
column.value: Baana the son of Hushai in Asher and ①Bealoth; ▷ ①Or in Aloth

column.name: text
column.value: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah in Issachar;

column.name: text
column.value: Shimei the son of Ela in Benjamin;

column.name: text
column.value: Geber the son of Uri in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only deputy who was in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Judah and Israel were as numerous as the sand that is on the ①seashore in abundance; they were eating, drinking, and rejoicing. ▷ ①Lit sea

column.name: text
column.value: ①Now Solomon was ruling over all the kingdoms from the Euphrates River to the land of the Philistines and to the border of Egypt; they brought tribute and served Solomon all the days of his life. ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: Solomon’s ①provision for one day was ②thirty kors of fine flour and ③sixty kors of meal, ▷ ①Lit bread ②About 231 cubic feet or 6.5 cubic meters ③About 462 cubic feet or 13 cubic meters

column.name: text
column.value: ten fat oxen, twenty ①pasture-fed oxen, and a hundred sheep, besides deer, gazelles, roebucks, and fattened geese. ▷ ①Lit oxen of the pasture

column.name: text
column.value: For he was ruling over everything ①west of the Euphrates River, from Tiphsah even to Gaza, over all the kings ②west of the River; and he had peace on all sides surrounding him. ▷ ①Lit beyond ②Lit beyond

column.name: text
column.value: So Judah and Israel lived securely, everyone under his vine and his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: Solomon had ①forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen. ▷ ①One LXX ms reads 4,000, cf. 2 Chr

column.name: text
column.value: And those deputies provided food for King Solomon and all who came to King Solomon’s table, each in his month; they allowed nothing to be lacking.

column.name: text
column.value: They also brought barley and straw for the war horses and baggage horses to the place where it was required, each deputy according to his duty.

column.name: text
column.value: Now God gave Solomon wisdom and very great discernment and breadth of ①mind, like the sand that is on the seashore. ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: Solomon’s wisdom surpassed the wisdom of all the ①people of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt. ▷ ①Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: For he was wiser than all other people, more than Ethan the Ezrahite, Heman, Calcol, and ①Darda, the sons of Mahol; and his ②fame was known in all the surrounding nations. ▷ ①In 1 Chr 2:6, Dara ②Lit name

column.name: text
column.value: He also told three thousand proverbs, and his songs numbered 1,005.

column.name: text
column.value: He told of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even to the hyssop that grows on the wall; he told also of animals, birds, crawling things, and fish.

column.name: text
column.value: People came from all the ①nations to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all the kings of the earth who had heard of his wisdom. ▷ ①Lit peoples

column.name: text
column.value: Now Solomon built his own house over the course of thirteen years, and he finished all of his house.

column.name: text
column.value: He built the house of the timber from Lebanon; its length was ①a hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits, on four rows of cedar pillars with cedar beams on the pillars. ▷ ①About 150 ft. long, 75 wide, and 45 high or 46 m long, 23 wide, and 14 high;

column.name: text
column.value: And it was paneled with cedar above the side chambers which were on the forty-five pillars, fifteen in each row.

column.name: text
column.value: There were artistic window frames in three rows, and window was opposite window at three ①intervals. ▷ ①Lit paces

column.name: text
column.value: And all the doorways and doorposts had squared artistic frames, and window was opposite window at three ①intervals. ▷ ①Lit paces

column.name: text
column.value: Then he made the hall of pillars; its length was ①fifty cubits and its width thirty cubits, and a porch was in front of them and pillars and a threshold in front of them. ▷ ①About 75 ft. long and 45 ft. wide or 23 m long and 7 m wide

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the hall of the throne where he was to judge, the hall of judgment, and it was paneled with cedar from floor to floor.

column.name: text
column.value: And his house where he was to live, the other courtyard inward from the hall, was of this same workmanship. He also made a house like this hall for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom Solomon had married.

column.name: text
column.value: All of these were made of valuable stones, of stone cut according to measure, sawed with saws, inside and outside; even from the foundation to the ①coping, and from the outside to the large courtyard. ▷ ①I.e., top sloping course of stone

column.name: text
column.value: And the foundation was of valuable stones, large stones, stones of ①ten cubits and stones of eight cubits. ▷ ①About 15 and 12 ft. or 4.5 and 3.7 m

column.name: text
column.value: And above were valuable stones, cut according to measure, and cedar.

column.name: text
column.value: So the large courtyard all around had three rows of cut stone and a row of cedar beams as well as the inner courtyard of the house of the LORD, and the porch of the house.

column.name: text
column.value: Now King Solomon sent word and had Hiram brought from Tyre.

column.name: text
column.value: He was a widow’s son from the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, an artisan in bronze; and he was filled with wisdom, skill, and knowledge for doing any work in bronze. So he came to King Solomon and performed all his work.

column.name: text
column.value: He fashioned the two pillars of bronze; ①eighteen cubits was the height of ②each pillar, and a line of ③twelve cubits ④measured the circumference of both. ▷ ①About 27 ft. or 8 m ②Lit the one ③About 18 ft. or 5.5 m ④Lit went around the other pillar

column.name: text
column.value: He also made two capitals of cast bronze to put on the tops of the pillars; the height of the one capital was ①five cubits and the height of the other capital was ②five cubits. ▷ ①About 7.5 ft. or 2.3 m ②About 7.5 ft. or 2.3 m

column.name: text
column.value: There were lattices of latticework and wreaths of chainwork for the capitals which were on the top of the pillars; seven for the one capital and seven for the other capital.

column.name: text
column.value: So he made the pillars, and two rows around on the one lattice to cover the capitals which were on the top of the pomegranates; and so he did for the other capital.

column.name: text
column.value: The capitals which were on the tops of the pillars in the porch were of lily design, four cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: So there were capitals on the two pillars, also above and close to the ①rounded projection which was beside the lattice; and the pomegranates totaled two hundred in rows around ②both capitals. ▷ ①Lit belly ②Lit on the other capital

column.name: text
column.value: And he set up the pillars at the porch of the ①main room: he set up the right pillar and named it ②Jachin, and he set up the left pillar and named it ③Boaz. ▷ ①Lit sanctuary ②I.e., he shall establish ③I.e., in it is strength

column.name: text
column.value: On the top of the pillars was the lily design. So the work of the pillars was finished.

column.name: text
column.value: He also he made the ①Sea of cast metal ②ten cubits from brim to brim, circular in shape, and its height was five cubits, and ③it was ④thirty cubits in circumference. ▷ ①I.e., large basin ②About 15 ft. in diameter and 7.5 ft. high or 4.6 m and 2.3 m high ③Lit a line of 30 cubits went around it all around; ④About 45 ft. or 14 m

column.name: text
column.value: Under its brim gourds went around encircling it ten to a cubit, completely surrounding the Sea; the gourds were in two rows, cast ①with the rest. ▷ ①Lit in its casting

column.name: text
column.value: It was standing on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east; and the Sea was set on top of them, and all their rear parts turned inward.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was a ①hand width thick, and its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like a lily blossom; it could hold ②two thousand baths. ▷ ①About 3 in. or 7.6 cm ②About 12,000 gallons or 45,424 liters

column.name: text
column.value: Then he made the ten stands of bronze; the length of each stand was ①four cubits, its width four cubits, and its height was three cubits. ▷ ①About 6 ft. long and wide and 4.5 ft. high or 1.8 m and 1.4 m

column.name: text
column.value: This was the design of the stands: they had borders, that is, borders between the crossbars,

column.name: text
column.value: and on the borders which were between the crossbars were lions, oxen, and cherubim; and on the crossbars there was a pedestal above, and beneath the lions and oxen were wreaths of hanging work.

column.name: text
column.value: Now each stand had four bronze wheels with bronze axles, and its four feet had supports; beneath the basin were cast supports with wreaths at each side.

column.name: text
column.value: And its opening inside the crown at the top was a ①cubit, and its opening was round like the design of a pedestal, a cubit and a half; and on its opening also there were engravings, and their borders were square, not round. ▷ ①About 18 in. or 45 cm

column.name: text
column.value: The four wheels were underneath the borders, and the axles of the wheels were on the stand. And the height of a wheel was a cubit and a half.

column.name: text
column.value: The workmanship of the wheels was like the workmanship of a chariot wheel. Their axles, their rims, their spokes, and their hubs were all cast.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there were four supports at the four corners of each stand; its supports were part of the stand itself.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the top of the stand there was a circular form ①half a cubit high, and on the top of the stand its ②stays and its borders were part of it. ▷ ①About 9 in. or 23 cm ②Lit hands

column.name: text
column.value: And he engraved on the plates of its stays and on its borders cherubim, lions, and palm trees, as there was clear space on each, with wreaths all around.

column.name: text
column.value: He made the ten stands like this: all of them had the ①same casting, ②same measure, and ③same form. ▷ ①Lit one ②Lit one ③Lit one

column.name: text
column.value: And he made ten basins of bronze, ①each holding ②forty baths; each basin was ③four cubits, and on each of the ten stands was one basin. ▷ ①Lit the one basin held ②About 240 gallons or 908 liters ③About 6 ft. or 1.8 m

column.name: text
column.value: Then he placed the stands, five on the right side of the house and five on the left side of the house; and he set the ①Sea of cast metal on the right side of the house eastward toward the south. ▷ ①I.e., large basin

column.name: text
column.value: Now Hiram made the basins and the shovels and the bowls. So Hiram finished doing all the work which he performed for King Solomon in the house of the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: the two pillars and the two bowls of the capitals which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two lattices to cover the two bowls of the capitals which were on the top of the pillars;

column.name: text
column.value: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two lattices, two rows of pomegranates for each lattice to cover the two bowls of the capitals which were on the tops of the pillars;

column.name: text
column.value: and the ten stands with the ten basins on the stands;

column.name: text
column.value: and the one ①Sea and the twelve oxen under the Sea; ▷ ①I.e., large basin

column.name: text
column.value: and the buckets, the shovels, and the bowls; indeed, all these utensils which Hiram made for King Solomon in the house of the LORD were of polished bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: The king had them cast in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.

column.name: text
column.value: However, Solomon left all the utensils unweighed, because they were too many; the weight of the bronze could not be determined.

column.name: text
column.value: Solomon also made all the furniture that was in the house of the LORD: the golden altar and the golden table on which was set the bread of the Presence;

column.name: text
column.value: and the lampstands of pure gold, five on the right side and five on the left, in front of the inner sanctuary; and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs, of gold;

column.name: text
column.value: also the cups, the ①shears, the bowls, the ladles, and the firepans, of pure gold; and the hinges both for the doors of the inner house, the Most Holy Place, and for the doors of the house, that is, for the main room, of gold. ▷ ①I.e., a tool to trim wicks

column.name: text
column.value: So all the work that King Solomon performed in the house of the LORD was finished. And Solomon brought in the offerings vowed by his father David, the silver and the gold and the utensils, and he put them in the treasuries of the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
