column.value: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes, the leaders of the fathers’ households of the sons of Israel, to King Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the city of David, that is, Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the men of Israel assembled themselves before King Solomon at the feast, in the month Ethanim, that is, the seventh month.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought up the ark of the LORD, the tent of meeting, and all the holy utensils which were in the tent; the priests and the Levites brought them up.

column.name: text
column.value: And King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, who were gathered together to him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing ①so many sheep and oxen that they could not be counted or numbered. ▷ ①Lit sheep and oxen...numbered for multitude

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priests brought the ark of the covenant of the LORD to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the Most Holy Place, under the wings of the cherubim.

column.name: text
column.value: For the cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim made a covering over the ark and its carrying poles from above.

column.name: text
column.value: But the poles were so long that the ends of the poles could be seen from the holy place in front of the inner sanctuary, but they could not be seen outside; they are there to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets of stone which Moses put there at Horeb, where the LORD made a covenant with the sons of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And it happened that when the priests came from the holy place, the cloud filled the house of the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: so that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud, for the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon said, “The LORD has said that He would dwell in the thick darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: I have truly built You a lofty house, A place for Your dwelling forever.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king ①turned around and blessed all the assembly of Israel, while all the assembly of Israel was standing. ▷ ①Lit turned his face about

column.name: text
column.value: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who spoke with His mouth to my father David, and fulfilled it with His hands, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Since the day that I brought My people Israel from Egypt, I did not choose a city out of all the tribes of Israel in which to build a house so that My name would be there, but I chose David to be over My people Israel.’

column.name: text
column.value: Now it was ①in the heart of my father David to build a house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel. ▷ ①Lit with

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD said to my father David, ‘Because it was ①in your heart to build a house for My name, you did well that it was ②in your heart. ▷ ①Lit with ②Lit with

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless you shall not build the house, but your son who ①will be born to you, he will build the house for My name.’ ▷ ①Lit will come forth from your loins

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD has fulfilled His word which He spoke; for I have risen in place of my father David and I sit on the throne of Israel, just as the LORD ①promised, and I have built the house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel. ▷ ①Lit spoke

column.name: text
column.value: And there I have set a place for the ark, in which is the covenant of the LORD, which He made with our fathers when He brought them out of the land of Egypt.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and he spread out his hands toward heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, “LORD, God of Israel, there is no God like You in heaven above or on earth beneath, keeping the covenant and showing faithfulness to Your servants who walk before You with all their heart,

column.name: text
column.value: You who have kept with Your servant, my father David, that which You ①promised him; You have spoken with Your mouth and have fulfilled it with Your hand, as it is this day. ▷ ①Lit spoken to

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, LORD, God of Israel, keep with Your servant David my father that which You have ①promised him, saying, ‘ ②You shall not be deprived of a man to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your sons are careful about their way, to walk before Me as you have walked.’ ▷ ①Lit spoken to ②Lit There shall not be cut off to you a man from before Me

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, God of Israel, let Your words, please, be confirmed, which You have spoken to Your servant, my father David.

column.name: text
column.value: “But will God indeed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the ①highest heaven cannot contain You, how much less this house which I have built! ▷ ①Lit heaven of heavens

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, turn Your attention to the prayer of Your servant and to his plea, LORD, my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which Your servant prays before You today,

column.name: text
column.value: so that Your eyes may be open toward this house night and day, toward the place of which You have said, ‘My name shall be there,’ to listen to the prayer which Your servant will pray toward this place.

column.name: text
column.value: And listen to the plea of Your servant and of Your people Israel, when they pray toward this place; hear in heaven Your dwelling place; hear and forgive!

column.name: text
column.value: “If a person sins against his neighbor and is compelled to take an oath of innocence, and he comes and takes an oath before Your altar in this house,

column.name: text
column.value: then hear in heaven and act and judge Your servants, condemning the wicked by ①bringing his way on his own head, and acquitting the righteous by giving him according to his righteousness. ▷ ①Lit giving

column.name: text
column.value: “When Your people Israel are ①defeated before an enemy because they have sinned against You, if they turn to You again and confess Your name and pray and implore Your ②favor in this house, ▷ ①Lit struck ②Or compassion

column.name: text
column.value: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of Your people Israel, and bring them back to the land which You gave their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: “When the heavens are shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against You, and they pray toward this place and praise Your name, and turn from their sin when You afflict them,

column.name: text
column.value: then hear in heaven and forgive the sin of Your servants and Your people Israel; indeed, teach them the good way in which they are to walk. And provide rain on Your land, which You have given to Your people as an inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: “If there is a famine in the land, if there is a plague, if there is ①blight or mildew, locust or grasshopper, if their enemy harasses them in the land of their ②cities, whatever plague, whatever sickness there is, ▷ ①Lit scorching ②Lit gates

column.name: text
column.value: whatever prayer or plea ①is offered by any person or by all Your people Israel, ②each knowing the affliction of his own heart, and spreading his ③hands toward this house; ▷ ①Lit takes place ②Lit who know each ③Lit palms

column.name: text
column.value: then hear in heaven, Your dwelling place, and forgive and act, and give to each in accordance with all his ways, whose heart You know—for You alone know the hearts of all ①mankind— ▷ ①Lit the sons of mankind

column.name: text
column.value: so that they will ①fear You all the days that they live on the ②land which You have given to our fathers. ▷ ①Or revere ②Lit face of the land

column.name: text
column.value: “Also regarding the foreigner who is not of Your people Israel, when he comes from a far country on account of Your name

column.name: text
column.value: (for they will hear of Your great name and Your mighty hand, and of Your outstretched arm); when he comes and prays toward this house,

column.name: text
column.value: hear in heaven Your dwelling place, and act in accordance with all for which the foreigner calls to You, in order that all the peoples of the earth may know Your name, to ①fear You, as do Your people Israel, and that they may know that ②this house which I have built is called by Your name. ▷ ①Or revere ②Lit Your name is called upon this house which I have built

column.name: text
column.value: “When Your people go out to battle against ①their enemy, by whatever way You send them, and they pray to the LORD ②toward the city which You have chosen and the house which I have built for Your name, ▷ ①Lit his ②Lit in the way of

column.name: text
column.value: then hear in heaven their prayer and their pleading, and maintain their cause.

column.name: text
column.value: “When they sin against You (for there is no person who does not sin) and You are angry with them and turn them over to an enemy, so that ①they take them away captive to the land of the enemy, distant or near; ▷ ①Lit their captors take them captive

column.name: text
column.value: if they ①take it to heart in the land where they have been taken captive, and repent and implore Your ②favor in the land of those who have taken them captive, saying, ‘We have sinned and done wrong, we have acted wickedly’; ▷ ①Lit return to their heart ②Or compassion

column.name: text
column.value: if they return to You with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies who have taken them captive, and pray to You toward their land which You have given to their fathers, the city which You have chosen, and the house which I have built for Your name;

column.name: text
column.value: then hear their prayer and their pleading in heaven, Your dwelling place, and maintain their cause,

column.name: text
column.value: and forgive Your people who have sinned against You and all their wrongdoings which they have committed against You, and make them objects of compassion before those who have taken them captive, so that they will have compassion on them

column.name: text
column.value: (for they are Your people and Your inheritance which You have brought out of Egypt, from the midst of the iron furnace),

column.name: text
column.value: so that Your eyes may be open to the pleading of Your servant and to the pleading of Your people Israel, to listen to them whenever they call to You.

column.name: text
column.value: For You have singled them out from all the peoples of the earth as Your inheritance, just as You spoke through Moses Your servant, when You brought our fathers out of Egypt, Lord ①GOD.” ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: When Solomon had finished praying this entire prayer and plea to the LORD, he stood up from the altar of the LORD, from kneeling on his knees with his ①hands spread toward heaven. ▷ ①Lit palms

column.name: text
column.value: And he stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying:

column.name: text
column.value: “Blessed be the LORD, who has given rest to His people Israel in accordance with everything that He ①promised; not one word has ②failed of all His good ③promise, which He ④promised through Moses His servant. ▷ ①Lit spoke ②Lit fallen ③Lit word ④Lit spoke

column.name: text
column.value: May the LORD our God be with us, as He was with our fathers; may He not leave us nor forsake us,

column.name: text
column.value: so that He may guide our hearts toward Himself, to walk in all His ways and to keep His commandments, His statutes, and His ordinances, which He commanded our fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And may these words of mine, with which I have implored the ①favor of the LORD, be near to the LORD our God day and night, so that He will maintain the cause of His servant and the cause of His people Israel, ②as each day requires, ▷ ①Or compassion ②Lit the matter of a day in its day

column.name: text
column.value: so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the LORD is God; there is no one else.

column.name: text
column.value: Your hearts therefore shall be ①wholly devoted to the LORD our God, to walk in His statutes and to keep His commandments, as at this day.” ▷ ①Lit complete with

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king and all Israel with him offered sacrifice before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to the LORD, twenty-two thousand oxen and 120,000 sheep. So the king and all the sons of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: On the same day the king consecrated the middle of the courtyard that was in front of the house of the LORD, because there he ①offered the burnt offering, the grain offering, and the fat of the peace offerings; for the bronze altar that was before the LORD was too small to hold the burnt offering, the grain offering, and the fat of the peace offerings. ▷ ①Lit made

column.name: text
column.value: So Solomon held the ①feast at that time, and all Israel with him, a great assembly from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt, before the LORD our God, for seven days and seven more days, that is, fourteen days. ▷ ①I.e., of Booths

column.name: text
column.value: On the eighth day he dismissed the people, and they blessed the king. Then they went to their tents joyful and with happy hearts for all the goodness that the LORD had ①shown to David His servant, and to Israel His people. ▷ ①Lit done

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about when Solomon had finished building the house of the LORD and the king’s house, and all ①that Solomon desired to do, ▷ ①Lit Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do

column.name: text
column.value: that the LORD appeared to Solomon a second time, as He had appeared to him at Gibeon.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to him, “I have heard your prayer and your plea which you have offered before Me; I have consecrated this house which you have built, by putting My name there forever, and My eyes and My heart will be there ①always. ▷ ①Lit all the days

column.name: text
column.value: As for you, if you walk before Me as your father David walked, in integrity of heart and honesty, acting in accordance with everything that I have commanded you, and if you keep My statutes and My ordinances,

column.name: text
column.value: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom over Israel forever, just as I ①promised to your father David, saying, ‘ ②You shall not be deprived of a man on the throne of Israel.’ ▷ ①Lit spoke ②Lit There shall not be cut off to you a man

column.name: text
column.value: “But if you or your sons indeed turn away from following Me, and do not keep My commandments and My statutes which I have placed before you, but you go and serve other gods and worship them,

column.name: text
column.value: then I will cut Israel off from the land which I have given them, and the house which I have consecrated for My name, I will ①expel from My sight. So Israel will become a saying and an object of derision among all peoples. ▷ ①Lit send

column.name: text
column.value: And this house will become a heap of ruins; everyone who passes by it will be appalled and ①hiss and say, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land and this house?’ ▷ ①Or whistle

column.name: text
column.value: And they will say, ‘Because they abandoned the LORD their God, who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and they ①adopted other gods and worshiped and served them, for that reason the LORD has brought all this adversity on them.’ ” ▷ ①Lit laid hold of

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about at the end of twenty years in which Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the LORD and the king’s house

column.name: text
column.value: (Hiram king of Tyre had supplied Solomon with cedar and juniper timber and gold, ①satisfying all his desire), that King Solomon then gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee. ▷ ①Lit to all

column.name: text
column.value: So Hiram left Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him, and they ①did not please him. ▷ ①Lit were not right in his sight

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, “What are these cities which you have given me, my brother?” So ①they have been called the land of ②Cabul to this day. ▷ ①Lit he called them ②I.e., like nothing

column.name: text
column.value: And Hiram sent to the king ①120 talents of gold. ▷ ①About 4.5 tons or 4 metric tons

column.name: text
column.value: Now this is the account of the forced labor which King Solomon conscripted to build the house of the LORD, his own house, the ①Millo, the wall of Jerusalem, Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer. ▷ ①I.e., terraced structure

column.name: text
column.value: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up and overthrown Gezer and burned it with fire, and killed the Canaanites who lived in the city; and he had given it as a dowry to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.

column.name: text
column.value: So Solomon rebuilt Gezer and the lower Beth-horon,

column.name: text
column.value: and Baalath and Tamar in the wilderness, in the land of Judah,

column.name: text
column.value: and all the storage cities which Solomon had, that is, the cities for ①his chariots and the cities for ②his horsemen, and ③everything that it pleased Solomon to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land ④under his rule. ▷ ①Lit the ②Lit the ③Lit the desire of Solomon which he desired to build in Jerusalem ④Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: As for all the people who were left of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of the sons of Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: their descendants who were left after them in the land, whom the sons of Israel were unable to completely eliminate, from them Solomon conscripted forced laborers, as they are to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: But Solomon did not make slaves of the sons of Israel; for they were men of war, his servants, his commanders, his charioteers, his chariot commanders, and his horsemen.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the ①chief officers who were in charge of Solomon’s work, 550, who ruled over the people doing the work. ▷ ①Or officers of the deputies

column.name: text
column.value: As soon as Pharaoh’s daughter came up from the city of David to her house which Solomon had built for her, he then built the Millo.

column.name: text
column.value: Now three times a year Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar which he had built for the LORD, burning incense with them on the altar which was before the LORD. So he finished the house.

column.name: text
column.value: King Solomon also built a fleet of ships in Ezion-geber, which is near Eloth on the shore of the ①Red Sea, in the land of Edom. ▷ ①Lit Sea of Reeds

column.name: text
column.value: And Hiram sent his servants with the fleet, sailors who knew the sea, along with the servants of Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went to Ophir and received ①420 talents of gold from there, and brought it to King Solomon. ▷ ①About 16 tons or 14 metric tons

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the queen of Sheba heard about the fame of Solomon in relation to the name of the LORD, she came to test him with riddles.

column.name: text
column.value: So she came to Jerusalem with a very large entourage, with camels carrying balsam oil and a very large quantity of gold and precious stones. When she came to Solomon, she spoke to him about everything that was in her heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon ①answered all her questions; nothing was concealed from the king which he did not explain to her. ▷ ①Lit told her all her words

column.name: text
column.value: When the queen of Sheba saw all the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,

column.name: text
column.value: and the food of his table, the seating of his servants, the service of his waiters and their attire, his cupbearers, and his burnt offerings which he offered at the house of the LORD, ①she was breathless. ▷ ①Lit there was no more breath in her

column.name: text
column.value: Then she said to the king, “It was a true ①story that I heard in my own land about your words and your wisdom. ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: But I did not believe the ①stories until I came and my own eyes saw it all. And behold, the half of it was not reported to me. You have exceeded in wisdom and prosperity the report which I heard. ▷ ①Lit words

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are your men, and blessed are these servants of yours who stand before you continually and hear your wisdom!

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed be the LORD your God who delighted in you to put you on the throne of Israel; because the LORD loves Israel forever, He made you king, to do justice and righteousness.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then she gave the king ①120 talents of gold, and a very large amount of balsam oil and precious stones. Never again did such a large quantity of balsam oil come in as that which the queen of Sheba gave King Solomon. ▷ ①About 4.5 tons or 4 metric tons

column.name: text
column.value: And the ships of Hiram as well, which brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir a very great number of almug trees and precious stones.

column.name: text
column.value: The king made from the almug trees supports for the house of the LORD and for the king’s house, and lyres and harps for the singers; such almug trees have not come in again, nor have they been seen to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And King Solomon granted the queen of Sheba everything she desired, whatever she requested, besides what he gave her in proportion to ①his royal bounty. Then she ②departed and went to her own land ③together with her servants. ▷ ①Lit the hand of King Solomon ②Lit turned around ③Lit she and her

column.name: text
column.value: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was ①666 talents of gold, ▷ ①About 25 tons or 23 metric tons

column.name: text
column.value: besides that from the traders, and the ①wares of the merchants and all the kings of the Arabs and the governors of the country. ▷ ①Or traffic

column.name: text
column.value: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of beaten gold, ①using six hundred shekels of gold on each large shield. ▷ ①Lit he brought up

column.name: text
column.value: And he made three hundred small shields of beaten gold, ①using ②three minas of gold on each shield; and the king put them in the house of the timber of Lebanon. ▷ ①Lit he brought up ②About 3.8 lb. or 1.7 kg

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the king made a large throne of ivory and overlaid it with fine gold.

column.name: text
column.value: There were six steps to the throne and a round top to the throne at its back, and ①armrests ②on each side of the seat, and two lions standing beside the ③armrests. ▷ ①Lit hands ②Lit from this and from this at the place of the seat ③Lit hands

column.name: text
column.value: Twelve lions were standing there on the six steps on the one side and on the other; nothing like it was made for ①any other kingdom. ▷ ①Lit all kingdoms

column.name: text
column.value: Now all King Solomon’s drinking utensils were of gold, and all the utensils of the house of the timber of Lebanon were of pure gold. None was of silver; it was not considered as amounting to anything in the days of Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: For the king had the ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s ships; once every three years the ships of Tarshish would come carrying gold and silver, ivory, monkeys, and peacocks.

column.name: text
column.value: So King Solomon became greater than all the kings of the earth in wealth and wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the earth was seeking the ①attention of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart. ▷ ①Lit face

column.name: text
column.value: And they were bringing, everyone, ①a gift: articles of silver and gold, garments, weapons, balsam oil, horses, and mules, so much year by year. ▷ ①Lit his gift

column.name: text
column.value: Now Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen; and he had 1,400 chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, and he ①stationed them in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem. ▷ ①As in ancient versions; MT led

column.name: text
column.value: And the king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem, and he made cedars as plentiful as sycamore trees that are in the ①lowland. ▷ ①Heb Shephelah

column.name: text
column.value: Also Solomon’s import of horses was from Egypt and Kue, and the king’s merchants acquired them from Kue for a price.

column.name: text
column.value: A chariot ①was imported from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for 150; and ②by the same means they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of the Arameans. ▷ ①Lit came up and went out from ②Lit in the same way by their hand

column.name: text
column.value: Now King Solomon loved many foreign women along with the daughter of Pharaoh: Moabite, Ammonite, Edomite, Sidonian, and Hittite women,

column.name: text
column.value: from the nations of which the LORD had said to the sons of Israel, “You shall not ①associate with them, nor shall they ②associate with you; they will certainly turn your heart away ③to follow their gods.” Solomon clung to these in love. ▷ ①Lit go among ②Lit go among ③Lit after their

column.name: text
column.value: He had seven hundred wives, who were ①princesses, and three hundred concubines; and his wives turned his heart away. ▷ ①Or women of rank

column.name: text
column.value: For when Solomon was old, his wives turned his heart away ①to follow other gods; and his heart was not ②wholly devoted to the LORD his God, as the heart of his father David had been. ▷ ①Lit after other ②Lit complete with

column.name: text
column.value: For Solomon became a follower of Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and of ①Milcom the abhorrent idol of the Ammonites. ▷ ①In Jer 49:1, 3, Malcam

column.name: text
column.value: So Solomon did what was evil in the sight of the LORD, and did not follow the LORD fully, as his father David had done.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh, the abhorrent idol of Moab, on the mountain that is ①east of Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abhorrent idol of the sons of Ammon. ▷ ①Lit before

column.name: text
column.value: He also did the same for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD was angry with Solomon because his heart had turned away from the LORD, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,

column.name: text
column.value: and had commanded him regarding this thing, that he was not to follow other gods; but he did not comply with what the LORD had commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD said to Solomon, “Since ①you have done this, and you have not kept My covenant and My statutes, which I have commanded you, I will certainly tear the kingdom away from you, and will give it to your servant. ▷ ①Lit this has happened with you

column.name: text
column.value: However, I will not do it in your days, only for the sake of your father David; but I will tear it away from the hand of your son.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I will not tear away all the kingdom, but I will give one tribe to your son for the sake of My servant David, and for the sake of Jerusalem, which I have chosen.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD raised up an adversary against Solomon, Hadad the Edomite; he was of the ①royal line in Edom. ▷ ①Lit king’s seed

column.name: text
column.value: For it came about, when David was in Edom and Joab the commander of the army had gone up to bury those killed in battle, and had struck and killed every male in Edom

column.name: text
column.value: (for Joab and all Israel stayed there for six months, until he had eliminated every male in Edom),

column.name: text
column.value: that Hadad fled ①to Egypt, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, while Hadad was a young boy. ▷ ①Lit to go into

column.name: text
column.value: They set out from Midian and came to Paran; and they took men with them from Paran and came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house and assigned him food and gave him land.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him in marriage the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sister of Tahpenes gave birth to his son Genubath, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Hadad heard in Egypt that David ①lay down with his fathers and that Joab the commander of the army was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, “Let me go, so that I may go to my own country.” ▷ ①I.e., died

column.name: text
column.value: However, Pharaoh said to him, “But what have you lacked with me that you are here, requesting to go to your own country?” And he answered, “Nothing; nevertheless you must let me go.”

column.name: text
column.value: God also raised up another adversary against him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his master Hadadezer, king of Zobah.

column.name: text
column.value: And he gathered men to himself and became leader of a marauding band, after David killed those of Zobah; and they went to Damascus and stayed ①there, and reigned in Damascus. ▷ ①Lit in it

column.name: text
column.value: So he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, along with the harm that Hadad inflicted; and he felt disgust for Israel and reigned over Aram.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, Solomon’s servant, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also ①rebelled against the king. ▷ ①Lit lifted up a hand

column.name: text
column.value: Now this was the reason why he ①rebelled against the king: Solomon built the ②Millo, and closed up the breach of the city of his father David. ▷ ①Lit lifted up a hand ②I.e., terraced structure

column.name: text
column.value: Now the man Jeroboam was a valiant warrior, and when Solomon saw that the young man was ①industrious, he appointed him over all the ②forced labor of the house of Joseph. ▷ ①Lit a performer of work ②Lit burden of

column.name: text
column.value: And it came about at that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the road. Now ①Ahijah had clothed himself with a new cloak; and both of them were alone in the field. ▷ ①Lit he

column.name: text
column.value: Then Ahijah took hold of the new cloak which was on him and tore it into twelve pieces.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to Jeroboam, “Take for yourself ten pieces; for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘Behold, I am going to tear the kingdom away from the hand of Solomon and give you ten tribes

column.name: text
column.value: (but he shall have one tribe, for the sake of My servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen from all the tribes of Israel),

column.name: text
column.value: because they have abandoned Me, and have worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the sons of Ammon; and they have not walked in My ways, doing what is right in My sight and keeping My statutes and My ordinances, as his father David did.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand, but I will make him ruler all the days of his life, for the sake of My servant David whom I chose, who kept My commandments and My statutes;

column.name: text
column.value: but I will take the kingdom from his son’s hand and give it to you; that is, ten tribes.

column.name: text
column.value: But to his son I will give one tribe, so that My servant David may always have a lamp before Me in Jerusalem, the city where I have chosen for Myself to put My name.

column.name: text
column.value: However I will take you, and you shall reign over all that ①you desire, and you shall be king over Israel. ▷ ①Lit your soul desires

column.name: text
column.value: Then it shall be, that if you listen to all that I command you and walk in My ways, and do what is right in My sight by keeping My statutes and My commandments, as My servant David did, then I will be with you and build you an enduring house as I built for David, and I will give Israel to you.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will oppress the ①descendants of David for this, but not always.’ ” ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: Solomon sought therefore to put Jeroboam to death; but Jeroboam set out and fled to Egypt to Shishak king of Egypt, and he was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon and whatever he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the Book of the Acts of Solomon?

column.name: text
column.value: So the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon ①lay down with his fathers and was buried in the city of his father David, and his son Rehoboam reigned in his place. ▷ ①I.e., died

column.name: text
column.value: Then Rehoboam went to Shechem, because all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard about this, ①he was living in Egypt (for he was still in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon). ▷ ①Lit Jeroboam

column.name: text
column.value: Then they sent word and summoned him, and Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Your father made our yoke hard; but now, lighten the hard labor imposed by your father and his heavy yoke which he put on us, and we will serve you.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to them, “Depart ①for three days, then return to me.” So the people departed. ▷ ①Lit three more

column.name: text
column.value: And King Rehoboam consulted with the elders who had ①served his father Solomon while he was still alive, saying, “How do you advise me to answer this people?” ▷ ①Lit stood before

column.name: text
column.value: Then they spoke to him, saying, “If you will be a servant to this people today, and will serve them and ①grant them their request, and speak pleasant words to them, then they will be your servants always.” ▷ ①Lit answer them

column.name: text
column.value: But he ignored the advice of the elders which they had given him, and consulted with the young men who had grown up with him ①and served him. ▷ ①Lit who stood before

column.name: text
column.value: He said to them, “What advice do you give, so that we may answer this people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Lighten the yoke which your father put on us’?”

column.name: text
column.value: And the young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, “This is what you should say to this people who spoke to you, saying: ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, now you make it lighter for us!’ You should speak this way to them: ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist!

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, my father loaded you with a heavy yoke; yet I will add to your yoke. My father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with ①scorpions!’ ” ▷ ①Prob. a brutal type of whip

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, just as the king had ①directed, saying, “Return to me on the third day.” ▷ ①Lit spoken

column.name: text
column.value: And the king answered the people harshly, for he ignored the advice of the elders which they had ①given him, ▷ ①Lit advised

column.name: text
column.value: and he spoke to them according to the advice of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke; my father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with ①scorpions!” ▷ ①See note v 11

column.name: text
column.value: So the king did not listen to the people; because it was ①a turn of events from the LORD, in order to establish His word which the LORD spoke through Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat. ▷ ①Or the providence of the LORD

column.name: text
column.value: When all Israel saw that the king had not listened to them, the people replied to the king, saying, “What share do we have in David? We have no inheritance in the son of Jesse; To your tents, Israel! Now look after your own house, David!” So Israel went away to their tents.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for the sons of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was in charge of the forced labor, and all Israel stoned him ①to death. And King Rehoboam hurried to mount his chariot to flee to Jerusalem. ▷ ①Lit with stones that he died

column.name: text
column.value: So Israel has broken with the house of David to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came about, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, that they sent word and called him to the assembly, and made him king over all Israel. None except the tribe of Judah alone followed the house of David.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, 180,000 chosen warriors, to fight against the house of Israel to restore the kingdom to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Tell Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and the rest of the people, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the LORD says: “You shall not go up nor fight against your relatives the sons of Israel; return, every man to his house, for this thing has come from Me.” ’ ” So they listened to the word of the LORD, and returned to go their way in accordance with the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and lived ①there. And he went out from there and built Penuel. ▷ ①Lit in it

column.name: text
column.value: And Jeroboam said in his heart, “Now the kingdom will return to the house of David.

column.name: text
column.value: If this people go up to ①offer sacrifices in the house of the LORD in Jerusalem, then the heart of this people will return to their lord, to Rehoboam king of Judah; and they will kill me and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.” ▷ ①Lit do

column.name: text
column.value: So the king ①consulted, and he made two golden calves; and he said to ②the people, “It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem; behold your gods, Israel, that brought you up from the land of Egypt.” ▷ ①Littook counsel ②Lit them

column.name: text
column.value: And he set up one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.

column.name: text
column.value: Now this thing became a sin, for the people went to worship before the one as far as Dan.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made houses on high places, and ①appointed priests from ②all the people who were not of the sons of Levi. ▷ ①Lit made ②Lit the extremities of the

column.name: text
column.value: Jeroboam also ①instituted a feast in the eighth month on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that is in Judah, and he ②went up to the altar. So he did in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves which he had made. And he stationed in Bethel the priests of the high places which he had made. ▷ ①Lit made ②Or offered upon

column.name: text
column.value: Then he ①went up to the altar which he had made in Bethel on the fifteenth day in the eighth month, the month that he had ②devised ③in his own heart; and he ④instituted a feast for the sons of Israel and ⑤went up to the altar to burn ⑥incense. ▷ ①Or offered upon ②Lit made ③Lit from ④Lit made ⑤Or offered upon ⑥Or sacrifices

column.name: text
column.value: Now behold, a man of God came from Judah to Bethel by the word of the LORD, while Jeroboam was standing at the altar to burn incense.

column.name: text
column.value: And he cried out against the altar by the word of the LORD and said, “Altar, altar, this is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, a son shall be born to the house of David, Josiah by name; and on you he shall sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense on you, and human bones shall burn on you.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then he gave a ①sign on the same day, saying, “This is the ②sign which the LORD has spoken: ‘Behold, the altar shall be torn to pieces and the ③ashes which are on it shall be poured out.’ ” ▷ ①Or wonder ②Or wonder ③Lit ashes of fat

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the king heard the statement of the man of God which he cried out against the altar in Bethel, Jeroboam stretched out his hand from the altar, saying, “Seize him!” But his hand which he had stretched out toward him dried up, and he could not draw it back to himself.

column.name: text
column.value: The altar also was torn to pieces and the ①ashes were poured out from the altar, in accordance with the ②sign which the man of God had given by the word of the LORD. ▷ ①Lit ashes of fat ②Or wonder

column.name: text
column.value: And the king responded and said to the man of God, “Please ①appease the LORD your God and pray for me, so that my hand may be restored to me.” So the man of God ②appeased the LORD, and the king’s hand was restored to him, and it became as it was before. ▷ ①Lit soften the face of ②Lit softened the face of

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king said to the man of God, “Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a gift.”

column.name: text
column.value: But the man of God said to the king, “If you were to give me half your house, I would not go with you, nor would I eat bread or drink water in this place.

column.name: text
column.value: For so ①it was commanded me by the word of the LORD, saying, ‘You shall not eat bread nor drink water, nor return by the way that you came.’ ” ▷ ①Lit He commanded me

column.name: text
column.value: So he went another way and did not return by the way that he had come to Bethel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now an old prophet was living in Bethel; and his ①sons came and told him all the deeds which the man of God had done that day in Bethel; the words which he had spoken to the king, these also they reported to their father. ▷ ①Lit son

column.name: text
column.value: And their father said to them, “ ①Which way did he go?” Now his sons ②had seen the way that the man of God who came from Judah had gone. ▷ ①Lit Where is this, the way he went ②Some ancient versions showed him

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled the donkey for him and he rode away on it.

column.name: text
column.value: So he went after the man of God and found him sitting under ①an oak; and he said to him, “Are you the man of God who came from Judah?” And he said, “I am.” ▷ ①Or a terebinth

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to him, “Come home with me and eat bread.”

column.name: text
column.value: But he said, “I cannot return with you, nor come with you, nor will I eat bread or drink water with you in this place.

column.name: text
column.value: For a ①command came to me by the word of the LORD: ‘You shall not eat bread, nor drink water there; do not return by going the way that you came.’ ” ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to him, “I too am a prophet like you, and an angel spoke to me by the word of the LORD, saying, ‘Bring him back with you to your house, so that he may eat bread and drink water.’ ” But he lied to him.

column.name: text
column.value: So he went back with him, and ate bread in his house and drank water.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about, as they were sitting down at the table, that the word of the LORD came to the prophet who had brought him back;

column.name: text
column.value: and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Because you have ①disobeyed the ②command of the LORD, and have not kept the commandment which the LORD your God commanded you, ▷ ①Lit rebelled against ②Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: but have returned and eaten bread and drunk water in the place of which He said to you, “You are not to eat bread nor drink water”; your dead body will not come to the grave of your fathers.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: It came about after he had eaten bread and after he had drunk, that he saddled the donkey for him, for the prophet whom he had brought back.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when he had gone, a lion met him on the way and killed him, and his body was thrown on the road, with the donkey standing beside it; the lion also was standing beside the body.

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, men passed by and saw the body thrown on the road, and the lion standing beside the body; so they came and told about it in the city where the old prophet had lived.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the prophet who had brought him back from the way heard about it, he said, “It is the man of God, who ①disobeyed the ②command of the LORD; therefore the LORD has given him to the lion, which has torn him and killed him, in accordance with the word of the LORD which He spoke to him.” ▷ ①Lit rebelled against ②Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Then he spoke to his sons, saying, “Saddle the donkey for me.” And they saddled it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he went and found his body thrown on the road, with the donkey and the lion standing beside the body; the lion had not eaten the body nor ①harmed the donkey. ▷ ①Lit broken

column.name: text
column.value: So the prophet picked up the body of the man of God and laid it on the donkey and brought it back; and he came to the city of the old prophet to mourn and to bury him.

column.name: text
column.value: He laid his body in his own grave, and they mourned over him, saying, “Oh, my brother!”

column.name: text
column.value: And after he had buried him, he talked to his sons, saying, “When I die, bury me in the grave in which the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones.

column.name: text
column.value: For the thing will certainly come to pass which he cried out by the word of the LORD against the altar that is in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria.”

column.name: text
column.value: After this event, Jeroboam did not ①abandon his evil way, but he again ②appointed priests of the high places from ③all the people; anyone who wanted, he ordained, and he became ④one of the priests of the high places. ▷ ①Lit turn away from ②Lit made ③Lit the extremities of the ④Ancient versions a priest of

column.name: text
column.value: ①This event also became a sin of the house of Jeroboam, even to wipe it out and eliminate it from the face of the earth. ▷ ①As in LXX and Targum; MT By this event also it became

column.name: text
column.value: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam became sick.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jeroboam said to his wife, “Now arise and disguise yourself so that they will not know that you are the wife of Jeroboam, and go to Shiloh. Behold, Ahijah the prophet is there, who said regarding me that I would be king over this people.

column.name: text
column.value: Take ten loaves with you, some pastries, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will happen to the boy.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jeroboam’s wife did so, and set out and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. Now Ahijah could not see because his eyes were ①glossy from his old age. ▷ ①Lit set

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD had said to Ahijah, “Behold, the wife of Jeroboam is coming to ①inquire of you about her son, because he is sick. You shall say such and such to her, for it will be when she arrives, that she is going to make herself unrecognizable.” ▷ ①Lit seek a word from

column.name: text
column.value: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet coming in the doorway, he said, “Come in, wife of Jeroboam; why do you make yourself unrecognizable? Nevertheless, I am sent to you with a harsh message.

column.name: text
column.value: Go, say to Jeroboam, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of Israel says: “Because I exalted you from among the people and made you leader over My people Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: and tore the kingdom away from the house of David and gave it to you—yet you have not been like My servant David, who kept My commandments and followed Me with all his heart, to do only that which was right in My sight;

column.name: text
column.value: you also have done more evil than all who were before you, and you have gone and made for yourself other gods and cast metal images to provoke Me to anger, and have thrown Me behind your back—

column.name: text
column.value: therefore behold, I am bringing disaster on the house of Jeroboam, and I will eliminate from Jeroboam ①every male person, both ②bond and free in Israel, and I will make a clean sweep of the house of Jeroboam, just as one sweeps away dung until it is all gone. ▷ ①Lit him who urinates against the wall ②Or children and adults in

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone belonging to Jeroboam who dies in the city, the dogs will eat. And anyone who dies in the field, the birds of the sky will eat; for the LORD has spoken it.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: Now you, arise, go to your house. When your feet enter the city the child will die.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all Israel will mourn for him and bury him, for ①he alone of Jeroboam’s family will come to the grave, because in him something good was found toward the LORD God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam. ▷ ①Lit this one

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the LORD will raise up for Himself a king over Israel who will eliminate the house of Jeroboam this day ①and from now on. ▷ ①Lit and what even now?

column.name: text
column.value: “For the LORD will strike Israel, just as a reed sways in the water; and He will uproot Israel from this good land which He gave to their fathers, and will scatter them beyond the Euphrates River, because they have made their ①Asherim, provoking the LORD to anger. ▷ ①I.e., wooden symbols of a female deity (Asherah)

column.name: text
column.value: He will give up Israel because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he ①committed and with which he misled Israel into sin.” ▷ ①Lit sinned

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeroboam’s wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah. As she was entering the threshold of the house, the child died.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all Israel buried him and mourned for him, in accordance with the word of the LORD which He had spoken through His servant Ahijah the prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: Now as for the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he made war and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the time that Jeroboam reigned was twenty-two years; and he ①lay down with his fathers, and his son Nadab reigned in his place. ▷ ①I.e., died

column.name: text
column.value: Now Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned for seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen from all the tribes of Israel to put His name there. And his mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people of Judah did evil in the sight of the LORD, and they provoked Him to jealousy with their sins which they ①committed, more than all that their fathers had done. ▷ ①Lit sinned

column.name: text
column.value: For they, too, built for themselves high places, memorial stones, and ①Asherim on every high hill and under every luxuriant tree. ▷ ①I.e., wooden symbols of a female deity (Asherah)

column.name: text
column.value: There were also male cult prostitutes in the land. They committed ①all the same abominations of the nations which the LORD dispossessed before the sons of Israel. ▷ ①Lit according to all

column.name: text
column.value: Now it happened in the fifth year of King Rehoboam, that Shishak the king of Egypt marched against Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took away the treasures of the house of the LORD and the treasures of the king’s house, and he took everything; he even took all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

column.name: text
column.value: So King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and entrusted them to the ①care of the commanders of the ②guard who guarded the doorway of the king’s house. ▷ ①Lit hand ②Lit runners

column.name: text
column.value: And it happened as often as the king entered the house of the LORD, that the ①guards would carry them and would bring them back into the ②guards’ room. ▷ ①Lit runners ②Lit runners

column.name: text
column.value: Now as for the rest of the acts of Rehoboam and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?

column.name: text
column.value: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rehoboam ①lay down with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of David; and his mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess. And his son Abijam became king in his place. ▷ ①I.e., died

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, Abijam became king over Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: He reigned for three years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was ①Maacah the daughter of ②Abishalom. ▷ ①In 2 Chr 13:2, Micaiah, the daughter of Uriel ②In 2 Chr 11:20, Absalom

column.name: text
column.value: He walked in all the sins of his father which he had committed before him; and his heart was not ①wholly devoted to the LORD his God, like the heart of his father David. ▷ ①Lit complete with

column.name: text
column.value: But for David’s sake the LORD his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, to raise up his son after him and to establish Jerusalem,

column.name: text
column.value: because David did what was right in the sight of the LORD, and did not deviate from anything that He commanded him all the days of his life, except in the case of Uriah the Hittite.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

column.name: text
column.value: Now as for the rest of the acts of Abijam and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abijam ①lay down with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David; and his son Asa became king in his place. ▷ ①I.e., died

column.name: text
column.value: So in the twentieth year of Jeroboam the king of Israel, Asa began to reign as king of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: He reigned for forty-one years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Asa did what was right in the sight of the LORD, like his father David.

column.name: text
column.value: He also removed the male cult prostitutes from the land and removed all the idols which his fathers had made.

column.name: text
column.value: And even his mother Maacah, he also removed her from the position of queen mother, because she had made an abominable image ①as an Asherah; and Asa cut down her abominable image and burned it at the brook Kidron. ▷ ①Or for Asherah; i.e., wooden symbol of a female deity

column.name: text
column.value: But the high places ①were not eliminated; nevertheless Asa’s heart was ②wholly devoted to the LORD all his days. ▷ ①Lit did not cease ②Lit complete with

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought into the house of the LORD the ①holy gifts of his father and his own ②holy gifts: silver, gold, and valuable utensils. ▷ ①Or votive offerings; i.e., gifts vowed ②Or votive offerings; i.e., gifts vowed

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

column.name: text
column.value: Baasha king of Israel marched against Judah and ①fortified Ramah in order to prevent anyone from going out or coming in to Asa king of Judah. ▷ ①Lit built

column.name: text
column.value: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that was left in the treasuries of the house of the LORD and the treasuries of the king’s house, and handed it over to his servants. And King Asa sent them to Ben-hadad the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Aram, who lived in Damascus, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Let’s make a treaty between ①you and me, as there was between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent you a gift of silver and gold; go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel so that he will withdraw from me.” ▷ ①Lit me and you

column.name: text
column.value: So Ben-hadad listened to King Asa and sent the commanders of his armies against the cities of Israel, and ①conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maacah, and all Chinneroth, besides all the land of Naphtali. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: When Baasha heard about it, he stopped ①fortifying Ramah and remained in Tirzah. ▷ ①Lit building

column.name: text
column.value: Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah—no one was exempt—and they carried away the stones of Ramah and its timber with which Baasha had built fortifications. And King Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin and Mizpah.

column.name: text
column.value: Now as for the rest of all the acts of Asa and all his might, and all that he did and the cities which he built, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

column.name: text
column.value: And Asa ①lay down with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of his father David; and his son Jehoshaphat reigned in his place. ▷ ①I.e., died

column.name: text
column.value: Now Nadab the son of Jeroboam became king over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel for two years.

column.name: text
column.value: He did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father and in his sin into which he misled Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Baasha the son of Ahijah of the house of Issachar conspired against him, and Baasha struck and killed him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines, while Nadab and all Israel were laying siege to Gibbethon.

column.name: text
column.value: So Baasha killed him in the third year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.

column.name: text
column.value: And as soon as he was king, he struck and killed all the household of Jeroboam. He did not leave Jeroboam any ①persons alive, but kept killing until he had eliminated them, in accordance with the word of the LORD which He spoke by His servant Ahijah the Shilonite, ▷ ①Lit breath

column.name: text
column.value: and because of the sins of Jeroboam which he ①committed, and into which he misled Israel, because of his provocation with which he provoked the LORD God of Israel to anger. ▷ ①Lit sinned

column.name: text
column.value: Now as for the rest of the acts of Nadab and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

column.name: text
column.value: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha the son of Ahijah became king over all Israel at Tirzah, and he reigned for twenty-four years.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of Jeroboam and in his sin into which he misled Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the word of the LORD came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Since I exalted you from the dust and made you leader over My people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have misled My people Israel into sin, provoking Me to anger with their sins,

column.name: text
column.value: behold, I am going to ①burn Baasha and his house, and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat. ▷ ①Another reading is sweep away

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone belonging to Baasha who dies in the city, the dogs will eat; and anyone belonging to him who dies in the field, the birds of the sky will eat.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now as for the rest of the acts of Baasha and what he did and his might, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: And Baasha ①lay down with his fathers and was buried in Tirzah, and his son Elah became king in his place. ▷ ①I.e., died

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the word of the LORD through the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came against Baasha and his household, both because of all the evil that he did in the sight of the LORD, provoking Him to anger with the work of his hands, by being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he struck ①it. ▷ ①Or him

column.name: text
column.value: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha became king over Israel at Tirzah, and reigned for two years.

column.name: text
column.value: And his servant Zimri, commander of half his chariots, conspired against him. Now ①Elah was in Tirzah drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, who was in charge of the household in Tirzah. ▷ ①Lit he

column.name: text
column.value: Then Zimri came in and struck him and put him to death in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and he became king in his place.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he became king, as soon as he sat on his throne, he ①killed all the household of Baasha; he did not leave ②a single male alive, either of his ③relatives or of his friends. ▷ ①Lit struck ②Lit him who urinates against the wall ③Lit blood avengers

column.name: text
column.value: So Zimri eliminated all the household of Baasha, in accordance with the word of the LORD which He spoke against Baasha through Jehu the prophet,

column.name: text
column.value: for all the sins of Baasha and the sins of his son Elah, which they ①committed and into which they misled Israel, provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their ②idols. ▷ ①Lit sinned ②Lit non-existing things

column.name: text
column.value: Now as for the rest of the acts of Elah and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned for seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were camped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people who were camped heard ①it being said, “Zimri has conspired and has also struck and killed the king!” Therefore all Israel made Omri, the commander of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp. ▷ ①Lit saying

column.name: text
column.value: Then Omri and all Israel with him went up from Gibbethon and besieged Tirzah.

column.name: text
column.value: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the citadel of the king’s house and burned the king’s house over himself with fire, and died,

column.name: text
column.value: because of his sins which he ①committed, doing evil in the sight of the LORD, walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he committed, misleading Israel into sin. ▷ ①Lit sinned

column.name: text
column.value: Now as for the rest of the acts of Zimri and his conspiracy which he ①carried out, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel? ▷ ①Lit conspired

column.name: text
column.value: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; the other half followed Omri.

column.name: text
column.value: But the people who followed Omri prevailed over the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath. And Tibni died and Omri became king.

column.name: text
column.value: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri became king over Israel and reigned for twelve years; he reigned for six years at Tirzah.

column.name: text
column.value: And he purchased the hill ①Samaria from Shemer for ②two talents of silver; and he built on the hill, and named the city which he built ③Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill. ▷ ①Heb Shomeron ②About 150 lb. or 68 kg ③Heb Shomeron

column.name: text
column.value: Now Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD, and acted more wickedly than all who were before him.

column.name: text
column.value: For he walked ①entirely in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat and in his sins into which he misled Israel, provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their ②idols. ▷ ①Lit in all the way of ②Lit non-existing things

column.name: text
column.value: Now as for the rest of the acts of Omri which he did and his might which he ①displayed, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel? ▷ ①Lit did

column.name: text
column.value: And Omri ①lay down with his fathers and was buried in Samaria; and his son Ahab became king in his place. ▷ ①I.e., died

column.name: text
column.value: Now Ahab the son of Omri became king over Israel in the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria for twenty-two years.

column.name: text
column.value: Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD more than all who were before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And as though it had been a trivial thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he married Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshiped him.

column.name: text
column.value: So he erected an altar for Baal at the house of Baal, which he built in Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: Ahab also made the ①Asherah. So Ahab did more to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him. ▷ ①I.e., wooden symbol of a female deity

column.name: text
column.value: In his days Hiel the Bethelite rebuilt Jericho; he laid its foundations with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates with the loss of his youngest son Segub, in accordance with the word of the LORD, which He spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Elijah the Tishbite, who was of ①the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As the LORD, the God of Israel lives, before whom I stand, there shall certainly be neither dew nor rain during these years, except by my word.” ▷ ①Another reading is Tishbe in Gilead

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to him, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Go away from here and turn eastward, and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, which is ①east of the Jordan. ▷ ①Lit facing

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be that you will drink from the brook, and I have commanded the ravens to provide food for you there.”

column.name: text
column.value: So he went and did everything according to the word of the LORD, for he went and lived by the brook Cherith, which is ①east of the Jordan. ▷ ①Lit facing

column.name: text
column.value: And the ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning and bread and meat in the evening, and he would drink from the brook.

column.name: text
column.value: But it happened after a while that the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to him, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there; behold, I have commanded a widow there to provide food for you.”

column.name: text
column.value: So he arose and went to Zarephath, and when he came to the entrance of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks; and he called to her and said, “Please get me a little water in a ①cup, so that I may drink.” ▷ ①Lit vessel

column.name: text
column.value: As she was going to get it, he called to her and said, “Please bring me a piece of bread in your hand.”

column.name: text
column.value: But she said, “As the LORD your God lives, I have no food, only a handful of flour in the ①bowl and a little oil in the jar; and behold, I am gathering ②a few sticks so that I may go in and prepare it for me and my son, so that we may ③eat it and die.” ▷ ①Lit pitcher ②Lit two ③I.e., have their last meal

column.name: text
column.value: However, Elijah said to her, “Do not fear; go, do as you have said. Just make me a little bread loaf from ①it first and bring it out to me, and afterward you may make one for yourself and for your son. ▷ ①Lit there

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘The ①bowl of flour shall not be used up, nor shall the jar of oil become empty, until the day that the LORD provides rain on the face of the earth.’ ” ▷ ①Lit pitcher

column.name: text
column.value: So she went and did everything in accordance with the word of Elijah, and she and he and her household ate for many days.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①bowl of flour was not used up, nor did the jar of oil become empty, in accordance with the word of the LORD which He spoke through Elijah. ▷ ①Lit pitcher

column.name: text
column.value: Now it happened after these things that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became sick; and his ①condition became very grave, until at the end ②he was no longer breathing. ▷ ①Lit illness ②Lit breath was not left in him

column.name: text
column.value: So she said to Elijah, “ ①Why is my business any of yours, you man of God? Yet you have come to me to bring my wrongdoing to remembrance, and to put my son to death!” ▷ ①Lit What to me and to you, an ancient idiom

column.name: text
column.value: But he said to her, “Give me your son.” Then he took him from her ①arms and carried him up to the upstairs room where he was living, and laid him on his own bed. ▷ ①Lit breast

column.name: text
column.value: And he called to the LORD and said, “LORD, my God, have You also brought catastrophe upon the widow with whom I am ①staying, by causing her son to die?” ▷ ①Lit sojourning

column.name: text
column.value: Then he stretched himself out over the boy three times, and called to the LORD and said, “LORD, my God, please, let this boy’s life return ①to him.” ▷ ①Lit upon his inward part

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD listened to the voice of Elijah, and the life of the boy returned ①to him and he revived. ▷ ①Lit upon his inward part

column.name: text
column.value: Elijah then took the boy and brought him down from the upstairs room into the house and gave him to his mother; and Elijah said, “See, your son is alive.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God, and that the word of the LORD in your mouth is truth.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now it happened after many days that the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying, “Go, present yourself to Ahab, and I will provide rain on the face of the earth.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Elijah went to present himself to Ahab. Now the famine was severe in Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: Ahab summoned Obadiah, who was in charge of the household. (Now Obadiah ①feared the LORD greatly; ▷ ①Or revered

column.name: text
column.value: for when Jezebel killed the prophets of the LORD, Obadiah took a hundred prophets and hid them by fifties in a cave, and provided them with bread and water.)

column.name: text
column.value: Then Ahab said to Obadiah, “Go through the land to all the springs of water and to all the river valleys; perhaps we will find grass and keep the horses and mules alive, and not have to kill some of the cattle.”

column.name: text
column.value: So they divided the land between them to ①survey it; Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself. ▷ ①Lit pass through

column.name: text
column.value: Now as Obadiah was on the way, behold, Elijah met him, and he recognized him and fell on his face and said, “Is it you, Elijah my master?”

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, “It is I. Go, say to your master, ‘Behold, Elijah is here.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: But he said, “What ①sin have I committed, that you are handing your servant over to Ahab, to put me to death? ▷ ①Lit have I sinned

column.name: text
column.value: As surely as the LORD your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom to which my master has not sent word to search for you; and whenever they say, ‘He is not here,’ he makes the kingdom or nation swear that they could not find you.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet now you are saying, ‘Go, say to your master, “Behold, Elijah is here!” ’

column.name: text
column.value: And it will come about when I leave you that the Spirit of the LORD will carry you to where I do not know; so when I come and inform Ahab and he cannot find you, he will kill me, though I, your servant, have ①feared the LORD from my youth. ▷ ①Or revered

column.name: text
column.value: Has it not been reported to my master what I did when Jezebel killed the prophets of the LORD, that I hid a hundred ①prophets of the LORD by fifties in a cave, and provided them with bread and water? ▷ ①Lit men of the prophets

column.name: text
column.value: Yet now you are saying, ‘Go, say to your master, “Behold, Elijah is here” ’; he will then kill me!”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Elijah said, “As surely as the LORD of armies lives, before whom I stand, I will certainly present myself to him today.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab and informed him; then Ahab went to meet Elijah.

column.name: text
column.value: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, “Is this you, the cause of disaster to Israel?”

column.name: text
column.value: He said, “I have not brought disaster to Israel, but you and your father’s house have, because you have abandoned the commandments of the LORD and you have followed the Baals.

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, send orders and gather to me all Israel at Mount Carmel, together with 450 prophets of Baal and four hundred prophets of ①the Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table.” ▷ ①I.e., wooden symbol of a female deity

column.name: text
column.value: So Ahab sent orders among all the sons of Israel and brought the prophets together at Mount Carmel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Elijah approached all the people and said, “How long are you going to ①struggle with the two choices? If the LORD is God, follow Him; but if Baal, follow him.” But the people did not answer him so much as a word. ▷ ①Lit limp on the two crutches

column.name: text
column.value: Then Elijah said to the people, “I alone am left as a prophet of the LORD, while Baal’s prophets are 450 men.

column.name: text
column.value: Now have them give us two oxen; and have them choose the one ox for themselves and cut it up, and place it on the wood, but put no fire under it; and I will prepare the other ox and lay it on the wood, and I will not put a fire under it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you call on the name of your god, and I will call on the name of the LORD; and the God who answers by fire, He is God.” And all the people replied, “ ①That is a good idea.” ▷ ①Lit The matter is good

column.name: text
column.value: So Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose the one ox for yourselves and prepare it first, since there are many of you, and call on the name of your god, but put no fire under the ox.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then they took the ox which ①was given them and they prepared it, and they called on the name of Baal from morning until noon, saying, “O Baal, answer us!” But there was no voice and no one answered. And they ②limped about the altar which ③they had made. ▷ ①Lit he gave ②I.e., in a type of ceremonial dance ③As in some mss and ancient versions; MT he

column.name: text
column.value: And at noon Elijah ridiculed them and said, “Call out with a loud voice, since he is a god; undoubtedly he is attending to business, or is on the way, or is on a journey. Perhaps he is asleep, and will awaken.”

column.name: text
column.value: So they cried out with a loud voice, and cut themselves according to their custom with swords and lances until blood gushed out on them.

column.name: text
column.value: When midday was past, they raved until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice; but there was no voice, no one answered, and ①no one paid attention. ▷ ①Lit there was no attention

column.name: text
column.value: Then Elijah said to all the people, “Come forward to me.” So all the people came forward to him. And he repaired the altar of the LORD which had been torn down.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Elijah took twelve stones, corresponding to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the word of the LORD had come, saying, “Israel shall be your name.”

column.name: text
column.value: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD; and he made a trench around the altar, large enough to hold two ①measures of seed. ▷ ①Heb seahs; i.e., one seah equals about 7 qt. or 7.7 liters

column.name: text
column.value: Then he laid out the wood, and he cut the ox in pieces and placed it on the wood.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, “Fill four large jars with water and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood.” And he said, “Do it a second time,” so they did it a second time. Then he said, “Do it a third time,” so they did it a third time.

column.name: text
column.value: The water flowed around the altar, and he also filled the trench with water.

column.name: text
column.value: Then at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, Elijah the prophet approached and said, “LORD, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, today let it be known that You are God in Israel and that I am Your servant, and that I have done all these things at Your word.

column.name: text
