column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?

column.name: text
column.value: He was buried in his grave in the garden of Uzza, and his son Josiah became king in his place.

column.name: text
column.value: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned for thirty-one years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Jedidah the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.

column.name: text
column.value: He did what was right in the sight of the LORD and walked ①entirely in the way of his father David, and did not turn aside to the right or to the left. ▷ ①Lit in all the way that

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, the king sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah the son of Meshullam the scribe, to the house of the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, and have him ①count all the money brought into the house of the LORD, which the doorkeepers have collected from the people. ▷ ①Or total

column.name: text
column.value: And have them hand it over to the workmen who have the oversight of the house of the LORD, and have them give it to the workmen who are in the house of the LORD to repair the ①damage to the house: ▷ ①Lit breach

column.name: text
column.value: to the carpenters, the builders, the masons, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the house.

column.name: text
column.value: However, no accounting shall be made with them for the money handed over to them, because they deal honestly.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the LORD.” And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, who read it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Shaphan the scribe came to the king and brought back word to the king and said, “Your servants have emptied out the money that was found in the house, and have handed it over to the workmen who have the oversight of the house of the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, Shaphan the scribe informed the king, saying, “Hilkiah the priest has given me a book.” And Shaphan read it in the presence of the king.

column.name: text
column.value: When the king heard the words of the Book of the Law, he tore his clothes.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, ①Achbor the son of Micaiah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying, ▷ ①In 2 Chr 34:20, Abdon, son of Micah

column.name: text
column.value: “Go, inquire of the LORD for me and for the people and all Judah concerning the words of this book that has been found, for the wrath of the LORD that burns against us is great, because our fathers did not listen to the words of this book, to act in accordance with everything that is written regarding us.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of ①Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe (and she lived in Jerusalem in the Second Quarter); and they spoke to her. ▷ ①In 2 Chr 34:22, Tokhath, son of Hasrah

column.name: text
column.value: Then she said to them, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘Tell the man who sent you to Me,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I am going to bring disaster on this place and on its inhabitants, all the words of the book which the king of Judah has read.

column.name: text
column.value: Since they have abandoned Me and have burned incense to other gods so that they may provoke Me to anger with all the work of their hands, My wrath burns against this place, and it shall not be quenched.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: But to the king of Judah who sent you to inquire of the LORD, this is what you shall say to him: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘Regarding the words which you have heard,

column.name: text
column.value: since your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before the LORD when you heard what I spoke against this place and against its inhabitants, that they would become an object of horror and a curse, and you have torn your clothes and wept before Me, I have indeed heard you,’ declares the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, behold, I am going to gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace, and your eyes will not look at all the devastation that I am going to bring on this place.’ ” So they brought back word to the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the ninth year of his reign, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, camped against it, and built a siege wall all around ①it. ▷ ①Lit against it

column.name: text
column.value: So the city was under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

column.name: text
column.value: On the ninth day of the fourth month the famine was so severe in the city that there was no food for the people of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the city was broken into, and all the men of war fled by night by way of the gate between the two walls that were beside the king’s garden, though the Chaldeans were all around the city. And ①they went by way of the Arabah. ▷ ①As in some mss and ancient versions; MT he

column.name: text
column.value: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king and overtook him in the plains of Jericho, and all his army was scattered from him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they captured the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah, and he ①passed sentence on him. ▷ ①Lit spoke judgment with him

column.name: text
column.value: And they slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, then put out Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him with bronze shackles, and brought him to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Now on the seventh day of the fifth month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguards, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And he burned the house of the LORD, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem; even every great house he burned with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the army of the Chaldeans who were with the captain of the bodyguards tore down the walls around Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Nebuzaradan, the captain of the bodyguards, led into exile the rest of the people who were left in the city and the deserters who had deserted to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the ①people. ▷ ①Lit multitude

column.name: text
column.value: But the captain of the bodyguards left some of the poorest of the land to be vinedressers and farmers.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Chaldeans smashed to pieces the bronze pillars which were in the house of the LORD, and the stands and the bronze ①Sea which were in the house of the LORD, and carried the ②bronze to Babylon. ▷ ①I.e., a very large basin ②Lit bronze of them

column.name: text
column.value: And they took away the pots, the shovels, the ①shears, the spoons, and all the bronze utensils ②which were used in temple service. ▷ ①I.e., wick trimmers ②Lit with which they served

column.name: text
column.value: The captain of the bodyguards also took away the firepans and the basins, what was fine gold and what was fine silver.

column.name: text
column.value: The two pillars, the one Sea, and the stands which Solomon had made for the house of the LORD— ①the bronze of all these articles was too heavy to weigh. ▷ ①Lit there was no weight for the bronze of

column.name: text
column.value: The height of the one pillar was ①eighteen cubits, and a bronze capital was on it; the height of the capital was ②three cubits, with latticework and pomegranates on the capital all around, all of bronze. And the second pillar was like these, same features with latticework. ▷ ①About 27 ft. or 8 m ②About 4.5 ft. or 1.3 m

column.name: text
column.value: Then the captain of the bodyguards took Seraiah the chief priest and Zephaniah the second priest, with the three ①doorkeepers. ▷ ①Lit keepers of the threshold

column.name: text
column.value: And from the city he took one official who was overseer of the men of war, and five ①of the king’s advisers who were found in the city; and the ②scribe of the captain of the army who mustered the people of the land; and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city. ▷ ①Lit men of those seeing the king’s face ②Or scribe, a captain

column.name: text
column.value: Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguards took them and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king of Babylon struck them down and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah went into exile from its land.

column.name: text
column.value: Now as for the people who were left in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, he appointed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan over them.

column.name: text
column.value: When all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah, namely, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, Johanan the son of Kareah, Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gedaliah swore to them and their men and said to them, “Do not be afraid of the servants of the Chaldeans; live in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well for you.”

column.name: text
column.value: But it happened in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal ①family, came ②with ten men and struck Gedaliah down so that he died along with the Jews and the Chaldeans who were with him at Mizpah. ▷ ①Lit seed ②Lit and ten men with him

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the people, from the small to the great, and the captains of the forces set out and came to Egypt; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about in the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon, in the year that he became king, ①released Jehoiachin king of Judah from prison; ▷ ①Lit raised the head of

column.name: text
column.value: and he spoke kindly to him and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: So ①Jehoiachin changed his prison clothes, and ②had his meals in ③the king’s presence regularly all the days of his life; ▷ ①Lit he ②Lit ate bread ③Lit his presence

column.name: text
column.value: and as his allowance, a regular allowance was given to him by the king, a portion for each day, all the days of his life.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn was Amnon, by Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second was Daniel, by Abigail the Carmelitess;

column.name: text
column.value: the third was Absalom the son of Maacah, the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth was Adonijah the son of Haggith;

column.name: text
column.value: the fifth was Shephatiah, by Abital; the sixth was Ithream, by his wife Eglah.

column.name: text
column.value: Six were born to him in Hebron, and he reigned there for seven years and six months. And in Jerusalem he reigned for thirty-three years.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the children born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four by Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel;

column.name: text
column.value: and Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,

column.name: text
column.value: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

column.name: text
column.value: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

column.name: text
column.value: All of these were the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, then Abijah was his son, Asa, his son, Jehoshaphat, his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Joram, his son, Ahaziah, his son, Joash, his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Amaziah, his son, Azariah, his son, Jotham, his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Ahaz, his son, Hezekiah, his son, Manasseh, his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Amon, his son, and Josiah, his son.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Josiah were Johanan, the firstborn, the second was Jehoiakim, the third, Zedekiah, and the fourth, Shallum.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Jehoiakim were his son Jeconiah and his son Zedekiah.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Jeconiah, the prisoner, were his son Shealtiel

column.name: text
column.value: and Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Pedaiah were Zerubbabel and Shimei. And the ①sons of Zerubbabel were Meshullam and Hananiah, and Shelomith was their sister; ▷ ①Lit son

column.name: text
column.value: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed, five.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①sons of Hananiah were Pelatiah and Jeshaiah, the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah. ▷ ①Lit son

column.name: text
column.value: The ①descendants of Shecaniah were Shemaiah, and the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six. ▷ ①Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: The ①sons of Neariah were Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three. ▷ ①Lit son

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Elioenai were Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king sent messengers, and they gathered to him all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king went up to the house of the LORD and every man of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, the prophets, and all the people, from the small to the great; and he read in their ①presence all the words of the Book of the Covenant which was found in the house of the LORD. ▷ ①Lit ears

column.name: text
column.value: And the king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep His commandments, His provisions, and His statutes with all his heart and all his soul, to carry out the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people ①entered into the covenant. ▷ ①Lit took a stand in

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, the priests of the second order, and the ①doorkeepers to bring out of the temple of the LORD all the utensils that had been made for Baal, for ②Asherah, and for all the heavenly ③lights; and he burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron Valley, and carried their ashes to Bethel. ▷ ①Lit keepers of the threshold ②I.e., a wooden symbol of a female deity, and so throughout the ch ③Lit host

column.name: text
column.value: Then he did away with the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had appointed to burn incense on the high places in the cities of Judah and in the surrounding area of Jerusalem, as well as those who burned incense to Baal, to the sun, to the moon, to the constellations, and to all the remaining heavenly ①lights. ▷ ①Lit host

column.name: text
column.value: He also brought out the Asherah from the house of the LORD outside Jerusalem to the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and ground it to dust, and threw its dust on the graves of the ①common people. ▷ ①Lit sons of the people

column.name: text
column.value: And he tore down the cubicles of the male cult prostitutes which were in the house of the LORD, where the women were weaving ①hangings for the Asherah. ▷ ①Or dresses

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought all the priests from the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba; and he tore down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on one’s left at the city gate.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless the priests of the high places did not go up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread among their brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: He also defiled ①Topheth, which is in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, so that no one would make his son or his daughter pass through the fire for Molech. ▷ ①I.e., place of burning

column.name: text
column.value: And he did away with the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entrance of the house of the LORD, by the chamber of Nathan-melech the official, which was at the ①covered courtyard; and he burned the chariots of the sun with fire. ▷ ①Meaning of the Heb uncertain

column.name: text
column.value: The king also tore down the altars that were on the roof, the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courtyards of the house of the LORD; and he ①smashed them there and threw their dust into the brook Kidron. ▷ ①Or ran from there

column.name: text
column.value: And the king defiled the high places that were opposite Jerusalem, which were on the right of the mount of destruction which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the sons of Ammon.

column.name: text
column.value: He also smashed to pieces the memorial stones and cut down the ①Asherim, and filled their places with human bones. ▷ ①I.e., wooden symbols of a female deity (Asherah)

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore, the altar that was at Bethel and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who misled Israel into sin, had made, even that altar and the high place he tore down. Then he burned the high place, ground the remains to dust, and burned the Asherah.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Josiah turned, he saw the graves that were there on the mountain, and he sent men and took the bones from the graves, and burned them on the altar and defiled it in accordance with the word of the LORD which the man of God proclaimed, the one who proclaimed these things.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said, “What is this gravestone there that I see?” And the men of the city told him, “It is the grave of the man of God who came from Judah and proclaimed these things which you have done against the altar of Bethel.”

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, “Leave him alone; no one is to disturb his bones.” So they left his bones undisturbed with the bones of the prophet who came from Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Josiah also removed all the houses of the high places which were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had constructed, ①provoking the LORD to anger; and he did to them ②just as he had done in Bethel. ▷ ①As in ancient versions; MT provoking; and he ②Lit according to all the acts

column.name: text
column.value: And he slaughtered all the priests of the high places who were there on the altars, and burned human bones on them; then he returned to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king commanded all the people, saying, “Celebrate the Passover to the LORD your God as it is written in this Book of the Covenant.”

column.name: text
column.value: Truly such a Passover had not been celebrated since the days of the judges who judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel and the kings of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: But in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, this Passover was celebrated to the LORD in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, Josiah removed the mediums, the spiritists, the ①household idols, the idols, and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, so that he might ②fulfill the words of the Law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the LORD. ▷ ①Heb teraphim ②Or perform

column.name: text
column.value: Before him there was no king like him who turned to the LORD with all his heart, all his soul, and all his might, in conformity to all the Law of Moses; nor did any like him arise after him.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, the LORD did not turn from the fierceness of His great wrath with which His anger burned against Judah, because of all the provocations with which Manasseh had provoked Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said, “I will also remove Judah from My sight, just as I have removed Israel. And I will reject this city which I have chosen, Jerusalem, and the ①temple of which I said, ‘My name shall be there!’ ” ▷ ①Lit house

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?

column.name: text
column.value: In his days Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt went up to the king of Assyria at the river Euphrates. And King Josiah went to meet him, and when Pharaoh Neco saw him he killed him at Megiddo.

column.name: text
column.value: His servants carried ①his body in a chariot from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem and buried him in his own tomb. Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah and anointed him and made him king in place of his father. ▷ ①Lit him, dead

column.name: text
column.value: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned for three months in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

column.name: text
column.value: He did evil in the sight of the LORD, in accordance with all that his forefathers had done.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh Neco imprisoned him at Riblah in the land of Hamath, so that he would not reign in Jerusalem; and he imposed on the land a fine of ①a hundred talents of silver and ②a talent of gold. ▷ ①About 3.75 tons or 3.4 metric tons ②About 75 lb. or 34 kg

column.name: text
column.value: Then Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of his father Josiah, and he changed his name to Jehoiakim. But he took Jehoahaz and ①brought him to Egypt, and he died there. ▷ ①As in LXX; MT he came

column.name: text
column.value: So Jehoiakim gave the silver and gold to Pharaoh, but he assessed the land in order to give the money at the ①command of Pharaoh. He collected the silver and gold from the people of the land, each according to his assessment, to give to Pharaoh Neco. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned for eleven years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Zebidah the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

column.name: text
column.value: He did evil in the sight of the LORD, in accordance with all that his forefathers had done.

column.name: text
column.value: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant for three years; then he turned and revolted against him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD sent against him bands of Chaldeans, bands of Arameans, bands of Moabites, and bands of Ammonites. He sent them against Judah to destroy it, in accordance with the word of the LORD which He had spoken through His servants the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: It indeed came upon Judah at the ①command of the LORD, to remove them from His sight due to the sins of Manasseh, in accordance with everything that he had done, ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: and also for the innocent blood which he shed, for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; and the LORD was unwilling to forgive.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?

column.name: text
column.value: So Jehoiakim ①lay down with his fathers, and his son Jehoiachin became king in his place. ▷ ①I.e., died

column.name: text
column.value: Now the king of Egypt did not come out of his land again, because the king of Babylon had taken everything that belonged to the king of Egypt from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates.

column.name: text
column.value: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned for three months in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: He did evil in the sight of the LORD, in accordance with all that his father had done.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon went up to Jerusalem, and the city came under siege.

column.name: text
column.value: And Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon came to the city, while his servants were besieging it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, his mother, his servants, his commanders, and his officials. And the king of Babylon took him prisoner in the eighth year of his reign.

column.name: text
column.value: He also brought out from there all the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king’s house, and he smashed all the articles of gold that Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the LORD, just as the LORD had said.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he led into exile all the people of Jerusalem and all the commanders and all the valiant warriors, ten thousand exiles, and all the craftsmen and the smiths. None were left except the poorest people of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: So he led Jehoiachin into exile to Babylon; also the king’s mother, the king’s wives, and his officials and the leading men of the land, he led into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the valiant men, seven thousand, and the craftsmen and the smiths, a thousand, all strong and fit for war, these too the king of Babylon brought into exile to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king of Babylon made ①his uncle Mattaniah king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah. ▷ ①I.e., Jehoiachin’s uncle

column.name: text
column.value: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned for eleven years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

column.name: text
column.value: He did evil in the sight of the LORD, in accordance with everything that Jehoiakim had done.

column.name: text
column.value: For it was due to the anger of the LORD that this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until He cast them out of His presence. And Zedekiah revolted against the king of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

column.name: text
column.value: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

column.name: text
column.value: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

column.name: text
column.value: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Japheth were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Gomer were Ashkenaz, ①Diphath, and Togarmah. ▷ ①In Gen 10:3, Riphath

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Javan were Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and ①Rodanim. ▷ ①In Gen 10:4, Dodanim

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Ham were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, and Sabteca; and the sons of Raamah were Sheba and Dedan.

column.name: text
column.value: Cush fathered Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Mizraim fathered the people of Lud, Anam, Lehab, Naphtuh,

column.name: text
column.value: Pathrus, and Casluh, from whom the Philistines came, and the ①Caphtorim. ▷ ①Or Cretans

column.name: text
column.value: Canaan fathered Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,

column.name: text
column.value: and the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

column.name: text
column.value: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

column.name: text
column.value: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Shem were Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and ①Meshech. ▷ ①In Gen 10:23, Mash

column.name: text
column.value: Arpachshad fathered Shelah, and Shelah fathered Eber.

column.name: text
column.value: Two sons were born to Eber: the name of the one was ①Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan. ▷ ①I.e., division

column.name: text
column.value: Joktan fathered Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

column.name: text
column.value: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

column.name: text
column.value: ①Ebal, Abimael, Sheba, ▷ ①In Gen 10:28, Obal

column.name: text
column.value: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab; all these were the sons of Joktan.

column.name: text
column.value: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,

column.name: text
column.value: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

column.name: text
column.value: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

column.name: text
column.value: and Abram, that is Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.

column.name: text
column.value: These are their genealogies: the firstborn of Ishmael was Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

column.name: text
column.value: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,

column.name: text
column.value: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah; these were the sons of Ishmael.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine, to whom she gave birth, were Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan were Sheba and Dedan.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

column.name: text
column.value: Abraham fathered Isaac. The sons of Isaac were Esau and ①Israel. ▷ ①I.e., Jacob

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Esau were Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, ①Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek. ▷ ①In Gen 36:11, Zepho

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Reuel were Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Seir were Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Lotan were Hori and ①Homam; and Lotan’s sister was Timna. ▷ ①In Gen 36:22, Hemam

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Shobal were ①Alian, Manahath, Ebal, ②Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon were Aiah and Anah. ▷ ①In Gen 36:23, Alvan ②In Gen 36:23, Shepho

column.name: text
column.value: The ①son of Anah was Dishon. And the sons of Dishon were ②Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran. ▷ ①Lit sons ②In Gen 36:26, Hemdan

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Ezer were Bilhan, Zaavan, and ①Jaakan. The sons of Dishan were Uz and Aran. ▷ ①Another reading is Akan, as in Gen

column.name: text
column.value: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king from the sons of Israel reigned. Bela was the son of Beor, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

column.name: text
column.value: When Bela died, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah became king in his place.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jobab died, Husham of the land of the Temanites became king in his place.

column.name: text
column.value: When Husham died, Hadad the son of Bedad, who ①defeated Midian in the field of Moab, became king in his place; and the name of his city was Avith. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: When Hadad died, Samlah of Masrekah became king in his place.

column.name: text
column.value: When Samlah died, Shaul of Rehoboth by the Euphrates River became king in his place.

column.name: text
column.value: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan the son of Achbor became king in his place.

column.name: text
column.value: When Baal-hanan died, ①Hadad became king in his place; and the name of his city was ②Pai, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab. ▷ ①In Gen 36:39, Hadar ②In Gen 36:39, Pau

column.name: text
column.value: Then Hadad died. Now the tribal chiefs of Edom were chief Timna, chief ①Aliah, chief Jetheth, ▷ ①In Gen 36:40, Alvah

column.name: text
column.value: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

column.name: text
column.value: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

column.name: text
column.value: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

column.name: text
column.value: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Judah were Er, Onan, and Shelah; these three were born to him by Bath-shua the Canaanitess. But Er, Judah’s firstborn, was evil in the sight of the LORD, so He put him to death.

column.name: text
column.value: His daughter-in-law Tamar bore him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Zerah were ①Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and ②Dara; five of them in all. ▷ ①In Josh 7:1, Zabdi ②In 1 Kin 4:31, Darda

column.name: text
column.value: The ①son of Carmi was ②Achar, the one who brought disaster on Israel ③by violating the ④ban. ▷ ①Lit sons ②In Josh 7:18, Achan ③Lit who violated ④I.e., the ban against forbidden spoils

column.name: text
column.value: The ①son of Ethan was Azariah. ▷ ①Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of Hezron who were born to him were Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.

column.name: text
column.value: Ram fathered Amminadab, and Amminadab fathered Nahshon, leader of the sons of Judah;

column.name: text
column.value: Nahshon fathered Salma, Salma fathered Boaz,

column.name: text
column.value: Boaz fathered Obed, and Obed fathered Jesse;

column.name: text
column.value: and Jesse fathered Eliab his firstborn, then Abinadab, the second, ①Shimea, the third, ▷ ①In 1 Sam 16:9, Shammah; in 2 Sam 13:3, Shimeah

column.name: text
column.value: Nethanel, the fourth, Raddai, the fifth,

column.name: text
column.value: Ozem, the sixth, and David, the seventh.

column.name: text
column.value: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the three sons of Zeruiah were ①Abshai, Joab, and Asahel. ▷ ①In 2 Sam 2:18, Abishai

column.name: text
column.value: Abigail gave birth to Amasa, and the father of Amasa was ①Jether the Ishmaelite. ▷ ①In 2 Sam 17:25, Ithra the Israelite

column.name: text
column.value: Now Caleb the son of Hezron had sons by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

column.name: text
column.value: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore to him Hur.

column.name: text
column.value: Hur fathered Uri, and Uri fathered Bezalel.

column.name: text
column.value: Later, Hezron had relations with the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was sixty years old; and she bore to him Segub.

column.name: text
column.value: Segub fathered Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: But Geshur and Aram took ①the villages of Jair from them, with Kenath and its villages, sixty settlements. All of these were the sons of Machir, the father of Gilead. ▷ ①Or Havvoth-jair

column.name: text
column.value: After the death of Hezron in Caleb-ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore to him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of Jerahmeel, the firstborn of Hezron, were Ram the firstborn, then Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

column.name: text
column.value: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Ram, the firstborn of Jerahmeel, were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. And the sons of Shammai were Nadab and Abishur.

column.name: text
column.value: The name of Abishur’s wife was Abihail, and she bore to him Ahban and Molid.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Nadab were Seled and Appaim, and Seled died without sons.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①son of Appaim was Ishi. And the ②son of Ishi was Sheshan, and the ③son of Sheshan, Ahlai. ▷ ①Lit sons ②Lit sons ③Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai were Jether and Jonathan, and Jether died without sons.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Jonathan were Peleth and Zaza. These were the ①descendants of Jerahmeel. ▷ ①Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: Now Sheshan had no sons, only daughters. Sheshan also had an Egyptian servant, whose name was Jarha.

column.name: text
column.value: Sheshan gave his daughter to his servant Jarha in marriage, and she bore to him Attai.

column.name: text
column.value: Attai fathered Nathan, Nathan fathered Zabad,

column.name: text
column.value: Zabad fathered Ephlal, Ephlal fathered Obed,

column.name: text
column.value: Obed fathered Jehu, Jehu fathered Azariah,

column.name: text
column.value: Azariah fathered Helez, Helez fathered Eleasah,

column.name: text
column.value: Eleasah fathered Sismai, Sismai fathered Shallum,

column.name: text
column.value: Shallum fathered Jekamiah, and Jekamiah fathered Elishama.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel, were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph; and ①his son was Mareshah, the father of Hebron. ▷ ①Lit the sons of

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Hebron were Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

column.name: text
column.value: Shema fathered Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem fathered Shammai.

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Bethzur.

column.name: text
column.value: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, gave birth to Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran fathered Gazez.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Jahdai were Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

column.name: text
column.value: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, gave birth to Sheber and Tirhanah.

column.name: text
column.value: She also gave birth to Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the sons of Caleb. The ①sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, were Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim, ▷ ①Lit son

column.name: text
column.value: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth-gader.

column.name: text
column.value: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Manahathites,

column.name: text
column.value: and the families of Kiriath-jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from these came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Salma were Bethlehem and the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

column.name: text
column.value: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. Those are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Judah were Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

column.name: text
column.value: Reaiah the son of Shobal fathered Jahath, and Jahath fathered Ahumai and Lahad. These were the families of the Zorathites.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the ①sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash; and the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi. ▷ ①As in some ancient versions; MT father

column.name: text
column.value: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These were the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.

column.name: text
column.value: Ashhur, the father of Tekoa, had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

column.name: text
column.value: Naarah bore to him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Helah were Zereth, ①Izhar, and Ethnan. ▷ ①Another reading is Zohar

column.name: text
column.value: Koz fathered Anub and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel, the son of Harum.

column.name: text
column.value: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers, and his mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I gave birth to him in pain.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that You would greatly bless me and extend my border, and that Your hand might be with me, and that You would ①keep me from harm so that it would not hurt me!” And God brought about what he requested. ▷ ①Lit take action

column.name: text
column.value: Chelub the brother of Shuhah fathered Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

column.name: text
column.value: Eshton fathered Beth-rapha and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of ①Ir-nahash. These are the men of Recah. ▷ ①Or the city of Nahash

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of Kenaz were Othniel and Seraiah. And the sons of Othniel were Hathath and Meonothai.

column.name: text
column.value: Meonothai fathered Ophrah, and Seraiah fathered Joab the father of ①Ge-harashim, for they were craftsmen. ▷ ①Or valley of craftsmen

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh were Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the ①son of Elah was ②Kenaz. ▷ ①Lit sons ②Lit and Kenaz

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Jehallelel were Ziph and Ziphah, Tiria and Asarel.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①sons of Ezrah were Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. And Mered’s wife conceived and gave birth to ②Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa. ▷ ①Lit son ②LXX Maron

column.name: text
column.value: (His Jewish wife gave birth to Jered, the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.) ①These were the sons of Bithia the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered ②married. ▷ ①I.e., those listed at the end of v 17 ②Lit took

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the ①fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite. ▷ ①Lit father

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Shimon were Amnon and Rinnah, and Benhanan and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were Er the father of Lecah and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of the linen workers at Beth-ashbea;

column.name: text
column.value: and Jokim, the men of Cozeba, Joash, Saraph, who ruled in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And the ①records are ancient. ▷ ①Lit words

column.name: text
column.value: These were the potters and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Simeon were ①Nemuel and Jamin, ②Jarib, ③Zerah, and Shaul; ▷ ①In Gen

column.name: text
column.value: Shallum was his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Mishma were Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, and Shimei his son.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers did not have many sons, nor did all their family increase like the sons of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: They lived in Beersheba, Moladah, and Hazar-shual,

column.name: text
column.value: in Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,

column.name: text
column.value: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,

column.name: text
column.value: Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, and Shaaraim. These were their cities until the reign of David.

column.name: text
column.value: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities,

column.name: text
column.value: and all their settlements that were around the same cities as far as ①Baal. These were their dwellings, and they have their genealogy. ▷ ①In Josh 19:8, Baalath

column.name: text
column.value: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,

column.name: text
column.value: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

column.name: text
column.value: and Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,

column.name: text
column.value: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—

column.name: text
column.value: these ①mentioned by name were leaders in their families; and their fathers’ houses spread out greatly. ▷ ①Lit coming

column.name: text
column.value: They went to the entrance of Gedor, as far as the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

column.name: text
column.value: They found pasture that was rich and good, and the land was spread out on both sides, and peaceful and undisturbed; for those who lived there previously were Hamites.

column.name: text
column.value: These people, recorded by name, came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and they ①attacked their tents and the Meunites who were found there, and utterly destroyed them to this day; and they lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: From them, from the sons of Simeon, five hundred men went to Mount Seir, with Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, as their leaders.

column.name: text
column.value: They ①destroyed the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and they have lived there to this day. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father’s bed, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph, the son of Israel; so he is not enrolled in the genealogy according to the birthright.

column.name: text
column.value: Though Judah prevailed over his brothers, and from him came the leader, yet the birthright belonged to Joseph),

column.name: text
column.value: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were Hanoch and Pallu, and Hezron and Carmi.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Joel were Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

column.name: text
column.value: and Beerah his son, whom ①Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria took into exile; he was leader of the Reubenites. ▷ ①In 2 Kin 15:29, Tiglath-pileser

column.name: text
column.value: His relatives by their families, in the genealogy of their generations, were Jeiel the chief, then Zechariah

column.name: text
column.value: and Bela, the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, as far as Nebo and Baal-meon.

column.name: text
column.value: Toward the east he settled as far as the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock had increased in the land of Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: In the days of Saul they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand, so that they ①occupied their tents throughout the ②land east of Gilead. ▷ ①Lit lived in ②Lit face of the east

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of Gad lived opposite them in the land of Bashan, as far as Salecah.

column.name: text
column.value: Joel was the head and Shapham the second, then Janai and Shaphat in Bashan.

column.name: text
column.value: Their relatives of their fathers’ households were Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

column.name: text
column.value: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, was head of their fathers’ households.

column.name: text
column.value: They lived in Gilead, in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon, as far as their ①borders. ▷ ①Lit goings out

column.name: text
column.value: All of these were enrolled in the genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, consisting of valiant men, men who carried shield and sword and shot with a bow and were skillful in battle, totaled 44,760 who went to war.

column.name: text
column.value: They made war against the Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.

column.name: text
column.value: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites and all who were with them were handed over to them; for they cried out to God in the battle, and He answered their prayers because they trusted in Him.

column.name: text
column.value: They took away their livestock: their fifty thousand camels, 250,000 sheep, and two thousand donkeys; and a hundred thousand ①people. ▷ ①Lit souls of mankind

column.name: text
column.value: For many fell mortally wounded, because the war was of God. And they settled in their place until the exile.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land; from Bashan to Baal-hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon they were numerous.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the heads of their fathers’ households: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, valiant mighty men, famous men, heads of their fathers’ households.

column.name: text
column.value: But they were untrue to the God of their fathers and prostituted themselves with the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.

column.name: text
column.value: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul, king of Assyria, that is, the spirit of ①Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he took them into exile, namely the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, where they are to this day. ▷ ①In 2 Kin 15:29, Tiglath-pileser

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Amram were Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

column.name: text
column.value: Eleazar fathered Phinehas, Phinehas fathered Abishua,

column.name: text
column.value: Abishua fathered Bukki, Bukki fathered Uzzi,

column.name: text
column.value: Uzzi fathered Zerahiah, Zerahiah fathered Meraioth,

column.name: text
column.value: Meraioth fathered Amariah, Amariah fathered Ahitub,

column.name: text
column.value: Ahitub fathered Zadok, Zadok fathered Ahimaaz,

column.name: text
column.value: Ahimaaz fathered Azariah, Azariah fathered Johanan,

column.name: text
column.value: Johanan fathered Azariah (it was he who served as the priest in the house which Solomon built in Jerusalem),

column.name: text
column.value: Azariah fathered Amariah, Amariah fathered Ahitub,

column.name: text
column.value: Ahitub fathered Zadok, Zadok fathered ①Shallum, ▷ ①In 9:11, Meshullam

column.name: text
column.value: Shallum fathered Hilkiah, Hilkiah fathered Azariah,

column.name: text
column.value: Azariah fathered Seraiah, and Seraiah fathered Jehozadak;

column.name: text
column.value: Jehozadak went along when the LORD led Judah and Jerusalem into exile ①by Nebuchadnezzar. ▷ ①Lit by the hand of

column.name: text
column.value: ①The sons of Levi were ②Gershom, Kohath, and Merari. ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: in Heb ②In v 1, Gershon

column.name: text
column.value: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Kohath were Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Elkanah were Amasai and Ahimoth.

column.name: text
column.value: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah were Zophai his son, Nahath his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Samuel were Joel, the firstborn, and Abijah, the second.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Merari were Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, and Asaiah his son.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these are the ones whom David appointed over the ①service of song in the house of the LORD, after the ark rested there. ▷ ①Lit hands

column.name: text
column.value: They were ministering in song in front of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting until Solomon’s building of the house of the LORD in Jerusalem; and they ①served in their office according to their order. ▷ ①Lit stood over

column.name: text
column.value: These are the ones who ①served with their sons: From the sons of the Kohathites were Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel, ▷ ①Lit stood

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Heman’s brother Asaph stood at his right hand, Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

column.name: text
column.value: On the left hand were their kinsmen the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

column.name: text
column.value: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

column.name: text
column.value: Their kinsmen the Levites were ①appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of the house of God. ▷ ①Lit given

column.name: text
column.value: But Aaron and his sons ①offered on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the Most Holy Place, and to make atonement for Israel, in accordance with everything that Moses the servant of God had commanded. ▷ ①Lit offered up in smoke

column.name: text
column.value: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these are their settlements according to their camps within their borders. To the sons of Aaron of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),

column.name: text
column.value: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah and its pasture lands around it;

column.name: text
column.value: but they gave the fields of the city and its settlements to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

column.name: text
column.value: To the sons of Aaron they gave the following cities of refuge: Hebron, Libnah together with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,

column.name: text
column.value: ①Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands, ▷ ①In Josh 21:15, Holon

column.name: text
column.value: ①Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth-shemesh with its pasture lands; ▷ ①In Josh 21:16, Ain

column.name: text
column.value: and from the tribe of Benjamin: Geba with its pasture lands, ①Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. Their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities in all. ▷ ①In Josh 21:18, Almon

column.name: text
column.value: Then to the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, from the family of the tribe, from the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.

column.name: text
column.value: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, were given from the tribe of Issachar, the tribe of Asher, the tribe of Naphtali, and the tribe of Manasseh, thirteen cities in Bashan.

column.name: text
column.value: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, from the tribe of Reuben, the tribe of Gad, and the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

column.name: text
column.value: So the sons of Israel gave the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.

column.name: text
column.value: They gave by lot from the tribe of the sons of Judah, the tribe of the sons of Simeon, and the tribe of the sons of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.

column.name: text
column.value: Now some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their territory from the tribe of Ephraim.

column.name: text
column.value: They gave to them the following cities of refuge: Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands, Gezer with its pasture lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Jokmeam with its pasture lands, Beth-horon with its pasture lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Aijalon with its pasture lands, and Gath-rimmon with its pasture lands;

column.name: text
column.value: and from the half-tribe of Manasseh: Aner with its pasture lands and Bileam with its pasture lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.

column.name: text
column.value: To the sons of Gershom were given, from the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh: Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands;

column.name: text
column.value: and from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Ramoth with its pasture lands, and Anem with its pasture lands;

column.name: text
column.value: and from the tribe of Asher: Mashal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Hukok with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands;

column.name: text
column.value: and from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, Hammon with its pasture lands, and Kiriathaim with its pasture lands.

column.name: text
column.value: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, from the tribe of Zebulun: Rimmono with its pasture lands, Tabor with its pasture lands,

column.name: text
column.value: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them, from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, Jahzah with its pasture lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;

column.name: text
column.value: and from the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of Issachar were four: Tola, ①Puah, ②Jashub, and Shimron. ▷ ①In Gen 46:13, Puvvah; in Num 26:23, Puvah ②In Gen 46:13, Iob

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Tola were Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Samuel, heads of their fathers’ households. The sons of Tola were valiant warriors in their generations. Their number in the days of David was 22,600.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①son of Uzzi was Izrahiah. And the sons of Izrahiah were Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah; all five of them were chief men. ▷ ①Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: And with them by their generations according to their fathers’ households were thirty-six thousand ①troops of the army for war; for they had many wives and sons. ▷ ①Or bands

column.name: text
column.value: Their relatives among all the families of Issachar were valiant warriors, registered by genealogy, eighty-seven thousand in all.

column.name: text
column.value: Benjamin had three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Bela were five: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were heads of fathers’ households, valiant warriors, 22,034 registered by genealogy.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Becher were Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

column.name: text
column.value: They were registered by genealogy according to their generations, heads of their fathers’ households, 20,200 valiant warriors.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①son of Jediael was Bilhan. And the sons of Bilhan were Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar. ▷ ①Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, 17,200 valiant warriors who were ①ready to go out with the army to war. ▷ ①Lit going out

column.name: text
column.value: ①Shuppim and ②Huppim were the sons of ③Ir; Hushim was the ④son of ⑤Aher. ▷ ①In Num 26:39, Shephupham ②In Num 26:39, Hupham ③In v 7, Iri ④Lit sons ⑤In Num 26:38, Ahiram

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Naphtali were ①Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and ②Shallum, the sons of Bilhah. ▷ ①In Gen 46:24, Jahzeel ②In Gen

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Manasseh were Asriel, to whom his Aramean concubine gave birth; she also gave birth to Machir, the father of Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: Machir took a wife from Huppim and Shuppim, ①whose name was Maacah. And the name of the second was Zelophehad, and Zelophehad had daughters. ▷ ①Lit and his sister’s; MT their sister; Lucian’s Gr, Targum

column.name: text
column.value: Maacah the wife of Machir gave birth to a son, and she named him Peresh; the name of his brother was Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①son of Ulam was Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh. ▷ ①Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: His sister Hammolecheth gave birth to Ishhod, ①Abiezer, and Mahlah. ▷ ①In Num 26:30, Iezer

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Ephraim were Shuthelah and ①Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son, ▷ ①In Num 26:35, Becher

column.name: text
column.value: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, and Ezer and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take their livestock.

column.name: text
column.value: Their father Ephraim mourned for many days, and his relatives came to comfort him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he went in to his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to a son, and he named him ①Beriah, because misfortune had come upon his house. ▷ ①I.e., in misfortune

column.name: text
column.value: His daughter was Sheerah, who built lower and upper Beth-horon, as well as Uzzen-sheerah.

column.name: text
column.value: Rephah was his son along with Resheph, Telah his son, Tahan his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

column.name: text
column.value: ①Non his son, and Joshua his son. ▷ ①In Ex

column.name: text
column.value: Their possessions and dwelling places were Bethel with its towns, and to the east, ①Naaran, and to the west, Gezer with its towns, and Shechem with its towns, as far as ②Ayyah with its towns, ▷ ①Many mss Azzah ②In Josh 16:7, Naarah

column.name: text
column.value: and along the borders of the sons of Manasseh, Beth-shean with its towns, Taanach with its towns, Megiddo with its towns, and Dor with its towns. In these regions lived the sons of Joseph the son of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Asher were Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah was their sister.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Beriah were Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

column.name: text
column.value: Heber fathered Japhlet, ①Shomer, and Hotham, and their sister Shua. ▷ ①In v 34, Shemer

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Japhlet were Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These were the sons of Japhlet.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of ①Shemer were Ahi and Rohgah, and Jehubbah and Aram. ▷ ①In v 32, Shomer

column.name: text
column.value: The ①sons of his brother Helem were Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal. ▷ ①Lit son

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Zophah were Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,

column.name: text
column.value: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Jether were Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Ulla were Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.

column.name: text
column.value: All these were the sons of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice, valiant mighty men, and heads of the leaders. And the number of them registered by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.

column.name: text
column.value: And Benjamin fathered Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,

column.name: text
column.value: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

column.name: text
column.value: Bela had sons: ①Addar, Gera, Abihud, ▷ ①In Gen

column.name: text
column.value: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

column.name: text
column.value: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, and they took them into exile to Manahath,

column.name: text
column.value: namely, Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera—he exiled them; and he fathered Uzza and Ahihud.

column.name: text
column.value: Shaharaim fathered children in the ①country of Moab after he had sent his wives Hushim and Baara away. ▷ ①Lit field

column.name: text
column.value: By Hodesh his wife he fathered Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,

column.name: text
column.value: Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.

column.name: text
column.value: By Hushim he fathered Abitub and Elpaal.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Elpaal were Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;

column.name: text
column.value: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put the inhabitants of Gath to flight;

column.name: text
column.value: and ①Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth. ▷ ①Or his brothers

column.name: text
column.value: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,

column.name: text
column.value: Michael, Ishpah, and Joha were the sons of Beriah.

column.name: text
column.value: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,

column.name: text
column.value: Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal.

column.name: text
column.value: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,

column.name: text
column.value: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,

column.name: text
column.value: Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath were the sons of ①Shimei. ▷ ①In v 13, Shema

column.name: text
column.value: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,

column.name: text
column.value: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,

column.name: text
column.value: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,

column.name: text
column.value: Iphdeiah, and Penuel were the sons of Shashak.

column.name: text
column.value: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,

column.name: text
column.value: Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri were the sons of Jeroham.

column.name: text
column.value: These were heads of the fathers’ households according to their generations, chief men ①who lived in Jerusalem. ▷ ①Lit these

column.name: text
column.value: Now, Jeiel, the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon, and his wife’s name was Maacah;

column.name: text
column.value: and his firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,

column.name: text
column.value: Gedor, Ahio, and ①Zecher. ▷ ①In 9:37, Zechariah

column.name: text
column.value: Mikloth fathered ①Shimeah. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem opposite their other relatives. ▷ ①In 9:38, Shimeam

column.name: text
column.value: Ner fathered Kish, Kish fathered Saul, and Saul fathered Jonathan, Malchi-shua, ①Abinadab, and ②Eshbaal. ▷ ①1 Sam 14:49, Ishvi ②In 2 Sam 2:8, Ish-bosheth

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Jonathan was ①Merib-baal, and Merib-baal fathered Micah. ▷ ①In 2 Sam 4:4, Mephibosheth

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Micah were Pithon, Melech, ①Tarea, and Ahaz. ▷ ①In 9:41, Tahrea

column.name: text
column.value: Ahaz fathered ①Jehoaddah, Jehoaddah fathered Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri fathered Moza. ▷ ①In 9:42, Jarah

column.name: text
column.value: Moza fathered Binea; ①Raphah was his son, Eleasah, his son, and Azel, his son. ▷ ①In 9:43, Rephaiah

column.name: text
column.value: Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of his brother Eshek were Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Ulam were valiant mighty men, archers, and they had many sons and grandsons, 150 of them. All these were among the sons of Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: So all Israel was enrolled in genealogies; and behold, they are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel. And Judah was taken into exile to Babylon for their infidelity.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the first inhabitants who lived on their own property in their cities were people of Israel, including the priests, the Levites, and the ①temple servants. ▷ ①Heb Nethinim

column.name: text
column.value: Some of the sons of Judah, some of the sons of Benjamin, and some of the sons of Ephraim and Manasseh lived in Jerusalem:

column.name: text
column.value: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, from the sons of Perez the son of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: From the Shilonites were Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

column.name: text
column.value: From the sons of Zerah were Jeuel and their relatives, 690 of them.

column.name: text
column.value: From the sons of Benjamin were Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah,

column.name: text
column.value: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

column.name: text
column.value: and their relatives according to their generations, 956. All these men were heads of fathers’ households according to their fathers’ houses.

column.name: text
column.value: From the priests were Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,

column.name: text
column.value: and ①Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the chief officer of the house of God; ▷ ①In Neh 11:11, Seraiah

column.name: text
column.value: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

column.name: text
column.value: and their relatives, heads of their fathers’ households, 1,760 competent men for the work of the service of the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the Levites, there were Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

column.name: text
column.value: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal; and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of ①Zichri, the son of Asaph, ▷ ①In Neh 11:17, Zabdi

column.name: text
column.value: and ①Obadiah the son of ②Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the settlements of the Netophathites. ▷ ①In Neh 11:17, Abda ②In Neh 11:17, Shammua

column.name: text
column.value: Now the gatekeepers were ①Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives (Shallum the chief ▷ ①In v 21, Meshelemiah; in 26:14, Shelemiah; in Neh 12:25, Meshullam

column.name: text
column.value: being stationed until now at the king’s gate to the east). These were the gatekeepers for the camp of the sons of Levi.

column.name: text
column.value: Shallum the son of Kore, the son of ①Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his relatives of his father’s house, the Korahites, were in charge of the work of the service, doorkeepers of the tent; and their fathers had been in charge of the camp of the LORD, keepers of the entrance. ▷ ①In Ex 6:24, Abiasaph

column.name: text
column.value: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was supervisor over them previously, and the LORD was with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the entrance of the tent of meeting.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who were chosen to be gatekeepers at the thresholds were 212 in all. They were registered by genealogy in their settlements, those whom David and Samuel the seer appointed in their official capacity.

column.name: text
column.value: So they and their sons were in charge of the gates of the house of the LORD, the house of the tent, in their divisions of service.

column.name: text
column.value: The gatekeepers were ①on the four sides, to the east, west, north, and south. ▷ ①Lit to the four winds

column.name: text
column.value: Their relatives in their settlements were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with ①them; ▷ ①Lit these

column.name: text
column.value: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, served in an official capacity, and were in charge of the chambers and in charge of the treasuries in the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: They spent the night around the house of God, because the watch was ①committed to them; and they were in charge of opening it morning by morning. ▷ ①Lit on them

column.name: text
column.value: Now some of them were in charge of the utensils of the service, for ①they counted them when they brought them in and when they took them out. ▷ ①Lit by count they brought them in and by count they took them out

column.name: text
column.value: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture and over all the utensils of the sanctuary, and over the finely milled flour, the wine, the olive oil, the frankincense, and the balsam oil.

column.name: text
column.value: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the balsam oil.

column.name: text
column.value: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the ①responsibility for the baking of cakes in pans. ▷ ①Lit official capacity over

column.name: text
column.value: Some of their relatives of the sons of the Kohathites were in charge of the showbread to prepare it every Sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the chambers of the temple free of other duties; for they were ①engaged in their work day and night. ▷ ①Lit over them in the work

column.name: text
column.value: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites according to their generations, chief men ①who lived in Jerusalem. ▷ ①Lit these

column.name: text
column.value: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon, and his wife’s name was Maacah,

column.name: text
column.value: and his firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

column.name: text
column.value: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.

column.name: text
column.value: Mikloth fathered Shimeam. And they also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem opposite their other relatives.

column.name: text
column.value: Ner fathered Kish, Kish fathered Saul, and Saul fathered Jonathan, Malchi-shua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Jonathan was ①Merib-baal; and Merib-baal fathered Micah. ▷ ①In 2 Sam 4:4, Mephibosheth

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Micah were Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

column.name: text
column.value: Ahaz fathered Jarah, Jarah fathered Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri fathered Moza.

column.name: text
column.value: Moza fathered Binea, and Rephaiah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

column.name: text
column.value: Azel had six sons whose names were these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel fled from the Philistines but fell fatally wounded on Mount Gilboa.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Philistines also overtook Saul and his sons, and the Philistines ①killed Jonathan, ②Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul. ▷ ①Lit struck ②In 1 Sam 14:49, Ishvi

column.name: text
column.value: The battle became severe against Saul, and the archers found him; and he was wounded by the archers.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword and thrust me through with it, otherwise these uncircumcised Philistines will come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not, for he was very afraid. So Saul took his own sword and fell on it.

column.name: text
column.value: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.

column.name: text
column.value: So Saul died with his three sons, and all those of his house died together.

column.name: text
column.value: When all the people of Israel who were in the valley saw that they had fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

column.name: text
column.value: It came about the next day, when the Philistines came to strip those killed, that they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

column.name: text
column.value: So they stripped him and took his head and his armor and sent messengers around the land of the Philistines to carry the good news to their idols and to the people.

column.name: text
