column.value: They put his armor in the house of their gods and ①impaled his head in the house of Dagon. ▷ ①Or pinned up

column.name: text
column.value: When all Jabesh-gilead heard everything that the Philistines had done to Saul,

column.name: text
column.value: all the valiant men got up and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh; and they buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted for seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: So Saul died for his unfaithfulness which he committed against the LORD, because of the word of the LORD which he did not keep; and also because he asked counsel of a medium, making inquiry of her,

column.name: text
column.value: and did not inquire of the LORD. Therefore He killed him and turned the kingdom over to David, the son of Jesse.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David consulted with the captains of the thousands and the hundreds, with every leader.

column.name: text
column.value: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is from the LORD our God, ①let us send word everywhere to our kinsmen who remain in all the land of Israel, and to the priests and Levites who are with them in their cities with pasture lands, that they meet with us; ▷ ①Indicating a proposal, not a request

column.name: text
column.value: and ①let us bring back the ark of our God to us, since we did not seek it in the days of Saul.” ▷ ①See note v 2

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the assembly said that they would do so, for ①this was right in the eyes of all the people. ▷ ①Lit the thing

column.name: text
column.value: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor of Egypt to the entrance of Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.

column.name: text
column.value: David and all Israel went up to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath-jearim, which belongs to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God, the LORD who is enthroned above the cherubim, where His name is called.

column.name: text
column.value: And they ①carried the ark of God on a new cart from the house of Abinadab, and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart. ▷ ①Lit caused the ark of God to ride

column.name: text
column.value: David and all Israel were celebrating before God with all their might, with songs and with lyres, harps, tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.

column.name: text
column.value: When they came to the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, because the oxen nearly overturned it.

column.name: text
column.value: But the anger of the LORD burned against Uzza, so He struck him because he had put out his hand toward the ark; and he died there before God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David became angry because ①of the LORD’S outburst against Uzza; and he called that place ②Perez-uzza as it is to this day. ▷ ①Lit the LORD had made an outburst ②I.e., the outburst against Uzza

column.name: text
column.value: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring the ark of God home to me?”

column.name: text
column.value: So David did not take the ark with him to the city of David, but took it aside to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

column.name: text
column.value: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house for three months; and the LORD blessed the family of Obed-edom and all that he had.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these are the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he was still restricted because of Saul the son of Kish; and they were among the mighty men who helped him in war.

column.name: text
column.value: They were equipped with bows, using both the right hand and the left to sling stones and shoot arrows with the bow; they were Saul’s kinsmen from Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth, and Beracah, and Jehu the Anathothite,

column.name: text
column.value: and Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and in charge of the thirty. ①Then Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, Jozabad the Gederathite, ▷ ①In Heb the beginning of v 5, making 41 vv in this ch

column.name: text
column.value: ①Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, Shephatiah the Haruphite, ▷ ①V 6 in Heb

column.name: text
column.value: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, Jashobeam, the Korahites,

column.name: text
column.value: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

column.name: text
column.value: From the Gadites valiant mighty men went over to David at the stronghold in the wilderness, men trained for war who could handle a large shield and spear, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains.

column.name: text
column.value: Ezer was the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

column.name: text
column.value: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

column.name: text
column.value: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

column.name: text
column.value: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

column.name: text
column.value: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai, the eleventh.

column.name: text
column.value: These men from the sons of Gad were ①captains of the army; the one who was least was equal to a hundred, and the greatest, to a thousand. ▷ ①Or chiefs

column.name: text
column.value: These are the ones who crossed the Jordan in the first month, when it was overflowing all its banks, and they put to flight all those in the valleys, to the east and to the west.

column.name: text
column.value: Then some of the sons of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.

column.name: text
column.value: David went out to meet them, and said to them, “If you come peacefully to help me, my heart shall be united with you; but if to betray me to my enemies, since there is no ①wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers look on it and decide.” ▷ ①Lit violence

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Spirit ①covered Amasai like clothing, the chief of the thirty; and he said, “We are yours, David, And are with you, son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, And peace to him who helps you; Indeed, your God helps you!” Then David received them and made them ②captains of the troops. ▷ ①Lit clothed ②Or commanders

column.name: text
column.value: From Manasseh some also defected to David when he was about to go to battle with the Philistines against Saul. But they did not help them, because the governors of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “At the cost of our heads he might defect to his master Saul.”

column.name: text
column.value: As he was going to Ziklag, men from Manasseh defected to him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, ①captains of thousands who belonged to Manasseh. ▷ ①Or chiefs

column.name: text
column.value: They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all valiant mighty men, and were captains in the army.

column.name: text
column.value: For day by day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army like the army of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these are the numbers of the ①divisions equipped for war, who came to David at Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the ②word of the LORD. ▷ ①Lit heads ②Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Judah who carried shield and spear numbered 6,800, equipped for war.

column.name: text
column.value: From the sons of Simeon, valiant mighty men of war, 7,100.

column.name: text
column.value: From the sons of Levi, 4,600.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jehoiada was the leader of the house of Aaron, and with him were 3,700,

column.name: text
column.value: also Zadok, a young valiant mighty man, and from his father’s house, twenty-two captains.

column.name: text
column.value: From the sons of Benjamin, Saul’s kinsmen, three thousand; for until now the majority of them had kept their allegiance to the house of Saul.

column.name: text
column.value: From the sons of Ephraim 20,800, valiant mighty men, famous men in their fathers’ households.

column.name: text
column.value: From the half-tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, who were designated by name to come and make David king.

column.name: text
column.value: From the sons of Issachar, men who understood the times, with knowledge of what Israel should do, their chiefs were two hundred; and all their kinsmen were at their command.

column.name: text
column.value: From Zebulun, there were fifty thousand who went out in the army, who could draw up in battle formation with all kinds of weapons of war and helped David ①with an undivided heart. ▷ ①Lit not heart and heart

column.name: text
column.value: From Naphtali there were a thousand captains, and with them thirty-seven thousand with shield and spear.

column.name: text
column.value: From the Danites who could draw up in battle formation, there were 28,600.

column.name: text
column.value: From Asher there were forty thousand who went out in the army to draw up in battle formation.

column.name: text
column.value: From the other side of the Jordan, from the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, there were 120,000 with all kinds of weapons of war for the battle.

column.name: text
column.value: All of these, being men of war who helped in battle formation, came to Hebron with a perfect heart to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest of Israel also were of one mind to make David king.

column.name: text
column.value: They were there with David for three days, eating and drinking, for their kinsmen had prepared for them.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, those who were near to them, as far as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, brought food on donkeys, camels, mules, and on oxen, great quantities of flour cakes, fig cakes and bunches of raisins, wine, oil, oxen, and sheep. There was joy indeed in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now David built houses for himself in the city of David; and he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David said, “No one is to carry the ark of God except the Levites; for the LORD chose them to carry the ark of the LORD and to serve Him forever.”

column.name: text
column.value: And David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the LORD to its place which he had prepared for it.

column.name: text
column.value: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:

column.name: text
column.value: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and 120 of his relatives;

column.name: text
column.value: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and 220 of his relatives;

column.name: text
column.value: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and 130 of his relatives;

column.name: text
column.value: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and two hundred of his relatives;

column.name: text
column.value: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and eighty of his relatives;

column.name: text
column.value: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and 112 of his relatives.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David called for the priests Zadok and Abiathar, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab;

column.name: text
column.value: and he said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites; consecrate yourselves, you and your relatives, so that you may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel to the place that I have prepared for it.

column.name: text
column.value: Because you did not carry it at the first, the LORD our God made an outburst against us, since we did not seek Him according to the ordinance.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the priests and the Levites consecrated themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of the Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders with the poles on them, just as Moses had commanded in accordance with the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David spoke to the chiefs of the Levites to appoint their relatives as the singers, with musical instruments, harps, lyres, and cymbals, playing to raise sounds of joy.

column.name: text
column.value: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel, and from his relatives, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and from the sons of Merari their relatives, Ethan the son of Kushaiah,

column.name: text
column.value: and with them their relatives of the second rank, Zechariah, ①Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the gatekeepers. ▷ ①Omitted in LXX and many mss

column.name: text
column.value: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound aloud cymbals of bronze;

column.name: text
column.value: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with harps tuned to ①alamoth; ▷ ①Or perhaps the pitch of young girls

column.name: text
column.value: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, to lead with ①lyres tuned to the sheminith. ▷ ①Or octave

column.name: text
column.value: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was in charge of the singing; he gave instruction in singing because he was skillful.

column.name: text
column.value: Berechiah and Elkanah were gatekeepers for the ark.

column.name: text
column.value: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-edom and Jehiah also were gatekeepers for the ark.

column.name: text
column.value: So it was David, with the elders of Israel and the captains of thousands, who went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the house of Obed-edom with joy.

column.name: text
column.value: Because God was helping the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

column.name: text
column.value: Now David was clothed with a robe of fine linen with all the Levites who were carrying the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the leader of the singing with the singers. David also wore an ephod of linen.

column.name: text
column.value: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with the sound of the horn, with trumpets, with loud-sounding cymbals, with harps, and lyres.

column.name: text
column.value: When the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out of the window and saw King David dancing and celebrating; and she despised him in her heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build a house for him.

column.name: text
column.value: And David realized that the LORD had established him as king over Israel, and that his kingdom was highly exalted, for the sake of His people Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David fathered more sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the names of the children ①born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon, ▷ ①Lit were to

column.name: text
column.value: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,

column.name: text
column.value: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

column.name: text
column.value: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.

column.name: text
column.value: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up in search of David; and David heard about it and went out against them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Philistines had come and carried out a raid in the Valley of Rephaim.

column.name: text
column.value: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? And will You hand them over to me?” Then the LORD said to him, “Go up, for I will hand them over to you.”

column.name: text
column.value: So they came up to Baal-perazim, and David ①defeated them there; and David said, “God has broken through my enemies by my hand, like the breakthrough of waters.” Therefore they named that place ②Baal-perazim. ▷ ①Lit struck ②I.e., the master of breakthroughs

column.name: text
column.value: They abandoned their gods there; so David gave the order and they were burned with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: The Philistines carried out yet another raid in the valley.

column.name: text
column.value: David inquired again of God, and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them; circle around ①behind them and come at them in front of the baka-shrubs. ▷ ①Lit from upon

column.name: text
column.value: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the baka-shrubs, then you shall go out to battle, for God will have gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

column.name: text
column.value: David did just as God had commanded him, and they defeated the army of the Philistines from ①Gibeon even as far as Gezer. ▷ ①In 2 Sam 5:25, Geba

column.name: text
column.value: Then the fame of David spread in all the lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him on all the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all Israel gathered to David at Hebron ①and said, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh. ▷ ①Lit saying

column.name: text
column.value: In times past, even when Saul was king, you were the one who led out and brought in Israel; and the LORD your God said to you, ‘You shall shepherd My people Israel, and you shall be leader over My people Israel.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel, in accordance with the word of the LORD through Samuel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (that is, Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.

column.name: text
column.value: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You shall not enter here.” Nevertheless David took the mountain stronghold of Zion (that is, the city of David).

column.name: text
column.value: Now David had said, “Whoever is first to ①kill a Jebusite shall be chief and commander.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, so he became chief. ▷ ①Lit strike

column.name: text
column.value: Then David lived in the stronghold; therefore it was called the city of David.

column.name: text
column.value: He ①built the city all around, from the ②Millo to the surrounding area; and Joab ③repaired the rest of the city. ▷ ①Or fortified ②I.e., terraced structure ③Lit revived

column.name: text
column.value: And David became greater and greater, for the LORD of armies was with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these are the heads of the mighty men whom David had, who remained faithful to him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, in accordance with the word of the LORD concerning Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: These constitute the list of David’s mighty men: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he wielded his spear against three hundred ①whom he killed at one time. ▷ ①Lit slain ones

column.name: text
column.value: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was ①one of the three mighty men. ▷ ①Lit among

column.name: text
column.value: He was with David at ①Pas-dammim when the Philistines were gathered together there to battle, and there was a plot of land full of barley; and the people fled from the Philistines. ▷ ①In 1 Sam 17:1, Ephes-dammim

column.name: text
column.value: But they took their stand in the midst of the plot and defended it, and defeated the Philistines; and the LORD saved them with a great ①victory. ▷ ①Or salvation

column.name: text
column.value: Now three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam, while the army of the Philistines was camping in the Valley of Rephaim.

column.name: text
column.value: David was then in the stronghold, while the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.

column.name: text
column.value: And David had a craving and said, “Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”

column.name: text
column.value: So the three broke through the camp of the Philistines and drew water from the well of Bethlehem which was by the gate, and took it and brought it to David; however, David would not drink it, but poured it out to the LORD;

column.name: text
column.value: and he said, “Far be it from me before my God that I would do this. Shall I drink the blood of these men who went ①at the risk of their lives? For they brought it at the risk of their lives.” Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things. ▷ ①Lit with their souls

column.name: text
column.value: As for ①Abshai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the ②thirty, and he wielded his spear against three hundred ③and killed them; and he had a name ④as well as the ⑤thirty. ▷ ①In 2 Sam 23:18, Abishai ②As in Syriac; MT three ③Lit slain ones ④Lit among the ⑤As in Syriac; MT three

column.name: text
column.value: Of the three in the second rank he was the most honored, and he became their commander; however, he did not attain the reputation of the first three.

column.name: text
column.value: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a warrior of Kabzeel, mighty in deeds, struck and killed the ①two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and struck and killed a lion inside a pit on a snowy day. ▷ ①Or two lion-like heroes of

column.name: text
column.value: And he killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature ①five cubits tall. Now in the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam, but he went down to him with a club and snatched the spear from the Egyptian’s hand and killed him with his own spear. ▷ ①About 7.5 ft. or 2.3 m

column.name: text
column.value: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things, and had a name ①as well as the three mighty men. ▷ ①Lit among the

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, he was honored among the thirty, but he did not attain the reputation of the first three; and David appointed him over his bodyguard.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the mighty men of the armies were Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

column.name: text
column.value: ①Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the ②Pelonite, ▷ ①In 2 Sam 23:25, Shammah the Harodite ②In 2 Sam 23:26, Paltite

column.name: text
column.value: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

column.name: text
column.value: ①Sibbecai the Hushathite, ②Ilai the Ahohite, ▷ ①In 2 Sam 23:27, Mebunnai ②In 2 Sam 23:28, Zalmon

column.name: text
column.value: Maharai the Netophathite, ①Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite, ▷ ①In 2 Sam 23:29, Heleb

column.name: text
column.value: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the sons of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

column.name: text
column.value: ①Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, ②Abiel the Arbathite, ▷ ①In 2 Sam 23:30, Hiddai ②In 2 Sam 23:31, Abi-albon

column.name: text
column.value: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

column.name: text
column.value: the sons of ①Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite, ▷ ①In 2 Sam 23:32, Jashen

column.name: text
column.value: Ahiam the son of ①Sacar the Hararite, ②Eliphal the son of Ur, ▷ ①In 2 Sam 23:33, Sharar ②In 2 Sam 23:34, Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai

column.name: text
column.value: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

column.name: text
column.value: Hezro the Carmelite, ①Naarai the son of Ezbai, ▷ ①In 2 Sam 23:35, Paarai the Arbite

column.name: text
column.value: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,

column.name: text
column.value: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,

column.name: text
column.value: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

column.name: text
column.value: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

column.name: text
column.value: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a chief of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,

column.name: text
column.value: Hanan the son of Maacah and Joshaphat the Mithnite,

column.name: text
column.value: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

column.name: text
column.value: Jediael the son of Shimri and his brother Joha the Tizite,

column.name: text
column.value: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, Ithmah the Moabite,

column.name: text
column.value: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought in the ark of God and placed it inside the tent which David had pitched for it, and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.

column.name: text
column.value: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he distributed to everyone of Israel, both men and women, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a raisin cake.

column.name: text
column.value: He appointed some of the Levites as ministers before the ark of the LORD, to celebrate and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then ①Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, and Jeiel, with musical instruments, harps, and lyres; also Asaph played loud-sounding cymbals, ▷ ①In 1 Chr 15:18, Jaaziel

column.name: text
column.value: and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel blew trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then on that day David first assigned ①Asaph and his relatives to give thanks to the LORD. ▷ ①Lit by the hand of Asaph

column.name: text
column.value: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; Make His deeds known among the peoples.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Boast in His holy name; Let the heart of those who seek the LORD be joyful.

column.name: text
column.value: Seek the LORD and His strength; Seek His face continually.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember His wonderful deeds which He has done, His marvels and the judgments from His mouth,

column.name: text
column.value: You ①descendants of Israel His servant, Sons of Jacob, His chosen ones! ▷ ①Lit seed of

column.name: text
column.value: He is the LORD our God; His judgments are in all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember His covenant forever, The word which He commanded to a thousand generations,

column.name: text
column.value: The covenant which He made with Abraham, And His oath to Isaac.

column.name: text
column.value: He also confirmed it to Jacob as a statute, To Israel as an everlasting covenant,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, As the portion of your inheritance.”

column.name: text
column.value: When they were only a few in number, Very few, and strangers in it,

column.name: text
column.value: And they wandered from nation to nation, And from one kingdom to another people,

column.name: text
column.value: He allowed no one to oppress them, And He rebuked kings for their sakes, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Do not touch My anointed ones, And do not harm My prophets.”

column.name: text
column.value: Sing to the LORD, all the earth; Proclaim good news of His salvation from day to day.

column.name: text
column.value: Tell of His glory among the nations, His wonderful deeds among all the peoples.

column.name: text
column.value: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He also is to be feared above all gods.

column.name: text
column.value: For all the gods of the peoples are ①idols, But the LORD made the heavens. ▷ ①Or non-existent things

column.name: text
column.value: Splendor and majesty are before Him, Strength and joy are in His place.

column.name: text
column.value: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples, Ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Tremble before Him, all the earth; Indeed, the world is firmly established, it will not be moved.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy in the presence of the LORD; For He is coming to judge the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; For His faithfulness is everlasting.

column.name: text
column.value: Then say, “Save us, God of our salvation, And gather us and save us from the nations, To give thanks to Your holy name, And ①glory in Your praise.” ▷ ①Lit boast

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, From everlasting to everlasting! Then all the people said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So he left Asaph and his relatives there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required,

column.name: text
column.value: and Obed-edom with ①his sixty-eight relatives; Obed-edom, the son of Jeduthun, and Hosah as gatekeepers. ▷ ①Lit their brothers, sixty-eight

column.name: text
column.value: He left Zadok the priest and his relatives the priests before the ①tabernacle of the LORD in the high place which was at Gibeon, ▷ ①Lit dwelling place

column.name: text
column.value: to offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to everything that is written in the Law of the LORD, which He commanded Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: With them were Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest who were chosen, who were designated by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because His ①kindness is everlasting. ▷ ①Or faithfulness

column.name: text
column.value: And with them were Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those who were to play them, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun for the gate.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the people departed, each to his house; and David returned to bless his household.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about after this, that Nahash the king of the sons of Ammon died, and his son became king in his place.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to console him concerning his father. And David’s servants came into the land of the sons of Ammon to Hanun to console him.

column.name: text
column.value: But the commanders among the sons of Ammon said to Hanun, “ ①Do you think that David is honoring your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Have his servants not come to you to search, to demolish, and to spy out the land?” ▷ ①Lit Is David honoring your father in your eyes

column.name: text
column.value: So Hanun took David’s servants and shaved them, and cut off their robes in the middle as far as their buttocks, and sent them away.

column.name: text
column.value: Then certain people went and told David about the men. And he sent messengers to meet them, because the men were very humiliated. And the king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards grow back, then return.”

column.name: text
column.value: When the sons of Ammon saw that they had made themselves repulsive to David, Hanun and the sons of Ammon sent ①a thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Mesopotamia, Aram-maacah, and Zobah. ▷ ①About 38 tons or 34 metric tons

column.name: text
column.value: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah and his people, who came and camped opposite Medeba. And the sons of Ammon gathered together from their cities and came to the battle.

column.name: text
column.value: When David heard about it, he sent Joab and all the army, the mighty men.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Ammon came out and drew up in battle formation at the entrance of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Joab saw that the ①battle was set against him at the front and at the rear, he selected warriors from all the choice men in Israel and lined them up against the Arameans. ▷ ①Lit face of the battle

column.name: text
column.value: But the remainder of the people he placed ①under the command of ②Abshai his brother; and they lined up against the sons of Ammon. ▷ ①Lit in the hand of ②In 2 Sam 10:10, Abishai

column.name: text
column.value: He said, “If the Arameans are too strong for me, then you shall help me; but if the sons of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.

column.name: text
column.value: Be strong, and let’s show ourselves courageous for the benefit of our people and the cities of our God; and may the LORD do what is good in His sight.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Joab and the people who were with him advanced to battle against the Arameans, and they fled from him.

column.name: text
column.value: When the sons of Ammon saw that the Arameans had fled, they also fled from his brother Abshai and entered the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: When the Arameans saw that they had been ①defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and brought out the Arameans who were beyond the Euphrates River, with Shophach the commander of the army of Hadadezer ②leading them. ▷ ①Lit struck before ②Lit before

column.name: text
column.value: When it was reported to David, he gathered all Israel together and crossed the Jordan, and came upon them and drew up in formation against them. And when David drew up in battle formation against the Arameans, they fought against him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Arameans fled from Israel, and David killed of the Arameans seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers; and he put Shophach the commander of the army to death.

column.name: text
column.value: So when the servants of Hadadezer saw that they had been ①defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. So the Arameans were not willing to help the sons of Ammon anymore. ▷ ①Lit struck before

column.name: text
column.value: Then it happened ①in the spring, at the time when kings go out to battle, that Joab led out the army and ravaged the land of the sons of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed in Jerusalem. And Joab struck Rabbah and overthrew it. ▷ ①Lit at the return of the year

column.name: text
column.value: David took the crown of ①their king from his head, and he found it to weigh a ②talent of gold, and there was a precious stone in it; and it was placed on David’s head. And he brought out the spoils of the city, a very great amount. ▷ ①Another reading is Malcam from, a variant of the Ammonite god Milcom ②About 75 lb. or 34 kg

column.name: text
column.value: He brought out the people who were in it, and ①put them to work at saws, iron picks, and axes. And David did the same to all the cities of the sons of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem. ▷ ①So 2 Sam 12:31; MT sawed them apart with

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about after this, that war ①broke out at ②Gezer with the Philistines; then Sibbecai the Hushathite ③killed Sippai, one of the descendants of the ④giants, and they were subdued. ▷ ①Lit stood up ②In 2 Sam 21:18, Gob ③Lit struck ④Heb Raphah, and so in vv 6, 8

column.name: text
column.value: And there was war with the Philistines again, and Elhanan the son of Jair ①killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: Again there was war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot; and he also was descended from the giants.

column.name: text
column.value: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, ①killed him. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: These were descended from the giants in Gath, and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came about, when David lived in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, “Look, I am living in a house of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD is under tent curtains.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Nathan said to David, “Do whatever is in your heart, for God is with you.”

column.name: text
column.value: But it happened that same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Go and tell David My servant, ‘This is what the LORD says: “You shall not build a house for Me to dwell in;

column.name: text
column.value: for I have not dwelt in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day, but I have ①gone from tent to tent and from one dwelling place to another. ▷ ①Lit been

column.name: text
column.value: In all places where I have walked with all Israel, have I spoken a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to shepherd My people, saying, ‘Why have you not built Me a house of cedar?’ ” ’

column.name: text
column.value: Now, therefore, this is what you shall say to My servant David: ‘This is what the LORD of armies says: “I took you from the pasture, from following the sheep, to be leader over My people Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have eliminated all your enemies from you; and I will make for you a name like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will appoint a place for My people Israel, and will plant them there, so that they may live in their own place and not tremble with anxiety again; and the ①wicked will not make them waste away anymore as they did previously, ▷ ①Lit sons of injustice

column.name: text
column.value: even from the day that I commanded judges to be over My people Israel. And I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover, I tell you that the LORD will build a house for you.

column.name: text
column.value: When your days are fulfilled that you must ①go to be with your fathers, then I will set up one of your ②descendants after you, who will be from your sons; and I will establish his kingdom. ▷ ①I.e., die ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: He shall build for Me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.

column.name: text
column.value: I will be his father and he shall be My son; and I will not take My favor away from him, as I took it from him who was before you.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will settle him in My house and in My kingdom forever, and his throne will be established forever.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: According to all these words and according to all of this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.

column.name: text
column.value: Then King David came in and sat before the LORD, and said, “Who am I, LORD God, and what is my house that You have brought me this far?

column.name: text
column.value: This was a small thing in Your eyes, God; but You have spoken of Your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have viewed me according to the standard of a person of high degree, LORD God.

column.name: text
column.value: What more can David still say to You concerning the honor bestowed on Your servant? For You know Your servant.

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, for Your servant’s sake, and according to Your own heart, You have accomplished all this greatness, to make known all these great things.

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, there is none like You, nor is there any God besides You, according to everything that we have heard with our ears.

column.name: text
column.value: And what one nation on the earth is like Your people Israel, whom God went to redeem for Himself as a people, to make for You a name by great and awesome things, by driving out nations from before Your people, whom You redeemed from Egypt?

column.name: text
column.value: For You have made Your people Israel Your own people forever, and You, LORD, became their God.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now, LORD, let the word that You have spoken concerning Your servant and concerning his house be established forever, and do just as You have spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: Let Your name be established and be great forever, saying, ‘The LORD of armies is the God of Israel, a God to Israel; and the house of Your servant David is established before You.’

column.name: text
column.value: For You, my God, have revealed to Your servant that You will build him a house; therefore Your servant has found courage to pray before You.

column.name: text
column.value: Now, LORD, You are God, and have ①promised this good thing to Your servant. ▷ ①Lit said

column.name: text
column.value: And now You have decided to bless the house of Your servant, that it may ①continue forever before You; for You, LORD, have blessed, and it is blessed forever.” ▷ ①Lit be

column.name: text
column.value: Now after this it came about that David ①defeated the Philistines and subdued them and took Gath and its towns from the hand of the Philistines. ▷ ①Lit struck, and so in vv 1-3

column.name: text
column.value: And he defeated Moab, and the Moabites became servants to David, bringing tribute.

column.name: text
column.value: David also defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah as far as Hamath, as he went to establish his ①rule to the river Euphrates. ▷ ①Lit hand

column.name: text
column.value: David took from him a thousand chariots and seven thousand horsemen and twenty thousand foot soldiers, and David hamstrung almost all the chariot horses, but left enough of them for a hundred chariots.

column.name: text
column.value: When the Arameans of ①Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David ②killed twenty-two thousand men of the Arameans. ▷ ①Heb Darmeseq ②Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: Then David put garrisons among the Arameans of ①Damascus; and the Arameans became servants to David, bringing tribute. And the LORD helped David wherever he went. ▷ ①Heb Darmeseq

column.name: text
column.value: And David took the shields of gold which were ①carried by the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem. ▷ ①Lit on

column.name: text
column.value: Also from ①Tibhath and Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took a very large amount of bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze ②Sea and the pillars and the bronze utensils. ▷ ①In 2 Sam 8:8, Betah ②I.e., large basin

column.name: text
column.value: Now when ①Tou king of Hamath heard that David had ②defeated all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah, ▷ ①In 2 Sam 8:9, Toi ②Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: he sent ①Hadoram his son to King David to ②greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and had ③defeated him; for Hadadezer had been at war with Tou. And Hadoram brought all kinds of articles of gold and silver and bronze. ▷ ①In 2 Sam 8:10, Joram ②Lit ask him of his welfare ③Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and the gold which he had carried away from all the nations: from Edom, Moab, the sons of Ammon, the Philistines, and from Amalek.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, Abishai the son of Zeruiah ①defeated eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: Then he put garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites became servants to David. And the LORD helped David wherever he went.

column.name: text
column.value: So David reigned over all Israel; and he ①administered justice and righteousness for all his people. ▷ ①Lit was doing

column.name: text
column.value: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was secretary;

column.name: text
column.value: and Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were priests, and Shavsha was secretary;

column.name: text
column.value: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites, and the sons of David were chiefs at the king’s side.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Satan stood up against Israel and incited David to count Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: So David said to Joab and to the leaders of the people, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba to Dan, and bring me word so that I may know their number.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Joab said, “May the LORD add to His people a hundred times as many as they are! My lord the king, are they not all my lord’s servants? Why does my lord seek this thing? Why should he be a cause of guilt to Israel?”

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore, Joab departed and went throughout Israel, and came to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joab gave the number of the census of the people to David. Israel was 1,100,000 men in all who drew the sword; and Judah was 470,000 men who drew the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: But he did not ①count Levi and Benjamin among them, because the king’s ②command was abhorrent to Joab. ▷ ①Lit muster ②Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: Now ①God was displeased with this thing, so He struck Israel. ▷ ①Lit it was evil in the sight of God

column.name: text
column.value: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly, ①by doing this thing. But now, please overlook Your servant’s guilt, for I have behaved very foolishly.” ▷ ①that I did

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Go and speak to David, saying, ‘This is what the LORD says: “I extend to you three choices; choose for yourself one of them, which I will do to you.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: So Gad came to David and said to him, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Take for yourself

column.name: text
column.value: three years of famine, or three months to be swept away before your foes while the sword of your enemies overtakes you, or else three days of the sword of the LORD: a plague in the land, and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout the territory of Israel.’ Now, therefore, consider what answer I shall bring back to Him who sent me.”

column.name: text
column.value: David said to Gad, “I am in great distress; please let me fall into the hand of the LORD, for His mercies are very great. But do not let me fall into human hands.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD ①sent a plague on Israel; seventy thousand men of Israel fell. ▷ ①Lit gave

column.name: text
column.value: And God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it; but as he was about to destroy it, the LORD saw and was sorry about the catastrophe, and said to the destroying angel, “It is enough; now relax your hand.” And the angel of the LORD was standing by the threshing floor of ①Ornan the Jebusite. ▷ ①In 2 Sam 24:16, Araunah

column.name: text
column.value: Then David raised his eyes and saw the angel of the LORD standing between earth and heaven, with his drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, covered with sackcloth, fell on their faces.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to God, “Is it not I who ①commanded to count the people? Indeed, I am the one who has sinned and acted very wickedly, but these sheep, what have they done? LORD, my God, just let Your hand be against me and my father’s household, and not against Your people as a plague.” ▷ ①Lit said

column.name: text
column.value: Then the angel of the LORD ①commanded Gad to say to David, that David was to go up and build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite. ▷ ①Lit said to

column.name: text
column.value: So David went up at the word of Gad, which he spoke in the name of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Ornan turned back and saw the angel, and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. And Ornan was threshing wheat.

column.name: text
column.value: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out from the threshing floor and prostrated himself to David with his face to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David said to Ornan, “Give me the ①site of this threshing floor, so that I may build on it an altar to the LORD; you shall give it to me for the full price, so that the plague may be brought to a halt from the people.” ▷ ①Lit place

column.name: text
column.value: But Ornan said to David, “Take it for yourself, and may my lord the king do what is good in his sight. See, I am giving the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing sledges for wood and the wheat for the grain offering; I am giving it all.”

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, King David said to Ornan, “No, but I will certainly buy it for the full price; for I will not take what is yours for the LORD, nor offer a burnt offering ①which costs me nothing.” ▷ ①Lit gratuitously

column.name: text
column.value: So David gave Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the ①site. ▷ ①Lit place

column.name: text
column.value: Then David built an altar there to the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. And he called to the LORD, and He answered him with fire from heaven on the altar of burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD commanded the angel, and he returned his sword to its sheath.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he offered sacrifice there.

column.name: text
column.value: For the tabernacle of the LORD, which Moses had made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering were on the high place at Gibeon at that time.

column.name: text
column.value: But David could not go before it to inquire of God, for he was terrified by the sword of the angel of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when David ①reached old age, he made his son Solomon king over Israel. ▷ ①Lit became old and sated with days

column.name: text
column.value: And he gathered together all the leaders of Israel with the priests and the Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward, and their number by ①head count of men was thirty-eight thousand. ▷ ①Lit their heads

column.name: text
column.value: Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of the house of the LORD; and six thousand were officers and judges,

column.name: text
column.value: and four thousand were gatekeepers, and four thousand were praising the LORD with the instruments which ①David made for giving praise. ▷ ①Lit I made

column.name: text
column.value: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the Gershonites there were ①Ladan and Shimei. ▷ ①In Ex 6:17, Libni

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Ladan were Jehiel the first, and Zetham and Joel, three.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Shimei were Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Shimei were Jahath, ①Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei. ▷ ①In v 11, Zizah

column.name: text
column.value: Jahath was the first and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons, so they became a father’s household, one group for duty.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Kohath were four in number: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Amram were Aaron and Moses. And Aaron was set apart to sanctify him as most holy, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the LORD, to serve Him and bless in His name forever.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for Moses, the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Moses were Gershom and Eliezer.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①son of Gershom was ②Shebuel the chief. ▷ ①Lit sons ②In 24:20, Shubael

column.name: text
column.value: The ①son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many. ▷ ①Lit sons...were

column.name: text
column.value: The ①son of Izhar was ②Shelomith the chief. ▷ ①Lit sons ②In 24:22, Shelomoth

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Hebron were Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Uzziel were Micah the first and Isshiah the second.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli were Eleazar and Kish.

column.name: text
column.value: Eleazar died and had no sons, but only daughters; so their relatives, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Mushi were three: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the sons of Levi according to their fathers’ households, the heads of the fathers’ households of those among them who were ①counted, in the number of names by their ②head count, doing the work for the service of the house of the LORD, from twenty years old and upward. ▷ ①Lit mustered ②Lit heads

column.name: text
column.value: For David said, “The LORD God of Israel has given rest to His people, and He dwells in Jerusalem forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Also, the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its utensils for its service.”

column.name: text
column.value: For by the last words of David, the sons of Levi were counted from twenty years old and upward.

column.name: text
column.value: For their office is ①to assist the sons of Aaron with the service of the house of the LORD, in the courtyards and in the chambers, and in the purification of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God, ▷ ①Lit at the hand of

column.name: text
column.value: and with the showbread, and the fine flour for a grain offering, and unleavened wafers, or what is baked in the pan or what is well-mixed, and all measures of volume and size.

column.name: text
column.value: They are to stand every morning to thank and to praise the LORD, and likewise at evening,

column.name: text
column.value: and to offer all burnt offerings to the LORD, on the Sabbaths, the new moons and the appointed festivals, in the number determined by the ordinance concerning them, continually before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So they are to perform the ①duties of the tent of meeting, the holy place, and of assisting the sons of Aaron their relatives, for the service of the house of the LORD. ▷ ①Lit duty of...the duty of...

column.name: text
column.value: Then David said, “This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”

column.name: text
column.value: So David ①gave orders to gather the strangers who were in the land of Israel, and he set stonecutters to cut out stones to build the house of God. ▷ ①Lit said to

column.name: text
column.value: And David prepared large quantities of iron ①to make the nails for the doors of the gates and for the clamps, and more bronze than could be weighed; ▷ ①Lit for

column.name: text
column.value: and timbers of cedar beyond number, for the Sidonians and Tyrians brought large quantities of cedar timber to David.

column.name: text
column.value: David said, “My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house that is to be built for the LORD shall be exceedingly magnificent, famous, and glorious throughout the lands. Therefore I now will make preparations for it.” So David made ample preparations before his death.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he called for his son Solomon, and commanded him to build a house for the LORD God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: David said to Solomon, “My son, ①I had intended to build a house for the name of the LORD my God. ▷ ①Lit as for me, it was with my heart

column.name: text
column.value: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying, ‘You have shed much blood and have ①waged great wars; you shall not build a house to My name, because you have shed so much blood on the earth before Me. ▷ ①Lit made

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, a son will be born to you, who shall be a man of rest, and I will give him rest from all his enemies on every side; for his name will be ①Solomon, and I will give peace and quiet to Israel in his days. ▷ ①I.e., peaceful

column.name: text
column.value: He shall build a house for My name, and he shall be My son and I will be his Father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’

column.name: text
column.value: Now, my son, the LORD be with you that you may be successful, and build the house of the LORD your God just as He has spoken concerning you.

column.name: text
column.value: Only the LORD give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the Law of the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will prosper, if you are careful to ①follow the statutes and the ordinances which the LORD commanded Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous, do not fear nor be dismayed. ▷ ①Lit do the

column.name: text
column.value: Now behold, ①with great pains I have prepared for the house of the LORD a hundred thousand ②talents of gold and a million talents of silver, and bronze and iron beyond measure, for ③they are in great quantity; I have also prepared timber and stone, and you may add to that. ▷ ①Lit in my affliction ②A talent was about 75 lb. or 34 kg ③Lit it is

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover there are many workmen with you, stonecutters, masons of stone, and carpenters; and all of them are skillful in every kind of work.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the gold, silver, bronze, and iron there is no limit. Arise and work, and may the LORD be with you.”

column.name: text
column.value: David also commanded all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Is the LORD your God not with you? And has He not given you rest on every side? For He has handed over to me the inhabitants of the land, and the land is subdued before the LORD and before His people.

column.name: text
column.value: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD your God; then arise, and build the sanctuary of the LORD God, so that you may bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for the name of the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now the divisions of the ①descendants of Aaron were these: the sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. ▷ ①Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no ①sons. So Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests. ▷ ①Or children

column.name: text
column.value: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their offices ①for their ministry. ▷ ①Lit in their service

column.name: text
column.value: Since more chief men were found from the ①descendants of Eleazar than the ②descendants of Ithamar, they divided them this way: there were sixteen heads of fathers’ households of the ③descendants of Eleazar, and eight of the ④descendants of Ithamar according to their fathers’ households. ▷ ①Lit sons ②Lit sons ③Lit sons ④Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: So they were divided by lot, the one as the other; for they were officers of the sanctuary and officers of God, both from the ①descendants of Eleazar and the ②descendants of Ithamar. ▷ ①Lit sons ②Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: Shemaiah, the son of Nethanel the scribe, from the Levites, recorded them in the presence of the king, the leaders, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and the Levites; one father’s household taken for Eleazar and one taken for Ithamar.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the first lot came out for Jehoiarib, the second for Jedaiah,

column.name: text
column.value: the third for Harim, the fourth for Seorim,

column.name: text
column.value: the fifth for Malchijah, the sixth for Mijamin,

column.name: text
column.value: the seventh for Hakkoz, the eighth for Abijah,

column.name: text
column.value: the ninth for Jeshua, the tenth for Shecaniah,

column.name: text
column.value: the eleventh for Eliashib, the twelfth for Jakim,

column.name: text
column.value: the thirteenth for Huppah, the fourteenth for Jeshebeab,

column.name: text
column.value: the fifteenth for Bilgah, the sixteenth for Immer,

column.name: text
column.value: the seventeenth for Hezir, the eighteenth for Happizzez,

column.name: text
column.value: the nineteenth for Pethahiah, the twentieth for Jehezkel,

column.name: text
column.value: the twenty-first for Jachin, the twenty-second for Gamul,

column.name: text
column.value: the twenty-third for Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth for Maaziah.

column.name: text
column.value: These were their offices for their ministry when they entered the house of the LORD according to the ordinance given to them through their father Aaron, just as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now for the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, ①Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah. ▷ ①In 23:16, Shebuel

column.name: text
column.value: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah, the first.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the Izharites, ①Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath. ▷ ①In 23:18, Shelomith

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Uzziel, Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.

column.name: text
column.value: The brother of Micah, Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Merari, Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Jaaziah, Beno.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Merari: by Jaaziah were Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

column.name: text
column.value: By Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

column.name: text
column.value: By Kish: the sons of Kish, Jerahmeel.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.

column.name: text
column.value: These also cast lots just as their relatives, the sons of Aaron did in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites—the head of fathers’ households as well as those of his younger brother.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, David and the commanders of the army set apart for the service some of the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with lyres, harps, and cymbals; and the number of ①those who performed this service was: ▷ ①Lit workmen according to their service

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and ①Asharelah; the sons of Asaph were ②under the direction of Asaph, who prophesied ③under the direction of the king. ▷ ①In v 14, Jesharelah ②Lit on the hand ③Lit on the hands

column.name: text
column.value: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, ①Zeri, Jeshaiah, ②Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six in all, ③under the direction of their father Jeduthun with the harp, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising the LORD. ▷ ①In v 11, Izri ②As in one ms and ancient versions, cf. v 17 ③Lit on the hands

column.name: text
column.value: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, ①Uzziel, ②Shebuel and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth. ▷ ①In v 18, Azarel ②In v 20, Shubael

column.name: text
column.value: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer to ①exalt him according to the words of God, for God gave fourteen sons and three daughters to Heman. ▷ ①Lit raise the horn

column.name: text
column.value: All of these were under the ①direction of their father to sing in the house of the LORD, with cymbals, harps, and lyres, for the service of the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman were ②under the direction of the king. ▷ ①Lit on the hands ②Lit on the hands

column.name: text
column.value: Their number who were trained in singing to the LORD, with their relatives, all who were skillful, was 288.

column.name: text
column.value: They cast lots for their duties, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the pupil.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph, the second for Gedaliah, he with his relatives and sons were twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his relatives, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: the fourth to ①Izri, his sons and his relatives, twelve; ▷ ①In v 3, Zeri

column.name: text
column.value: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his relatives, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his relatives, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: the seventh to ①Jesharelah, his sons and his relatives, twelve; ▷ ①In v 2, Asherelah

column.name: text
column.value: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his relatives, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his relatives, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his relatives, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his relatives, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his relatives, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: for the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his relatives, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: for the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his relatives, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: for the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his relatives, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: for the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his relatives, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his relatives, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: for the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his relatives, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: for the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his relatives, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: for the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his relatives, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: for the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons and his relatives, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: for the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons and his relatives, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: for the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his relatives, twelve;

column.name: text
column.value: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-ezer, his sons and his relatives, twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: For the divisions of the gatekeepers there were of the Korahites, ①Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of ②Asaph. ▷ ①In v 14, Shelemiah ②In 9:19, Ebiasaph

column.name: text
column.value: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

column.name: text
column.value: Elam the fifth, Johanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.

column.name: text
column.value: Obed-edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

column.name: text
column.value: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; God had indeed blessed him.

column.name: text
column.value: Also to his son Shemaiah sons were born who ruled over the house of their father, for they were valiant mighty men.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Shemaiah were Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose brothers, Elihu and Semachiah, were valiant men.

column.name: text
column.value: All these were of the sons of Obed-edom; they and their sons and relatives were able men with strength for the service, sixty-two from Obed-edom.

column.name: text
column.value: Meshelemiah had sons and relatives, eighteen valiant men.

column.name: text
column.value: Also Hosah, one of the sons of Merari had sons: Shimri the first (although he was not the firstborn, his father made him first),

column.name: text
column.value: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth; the sons and relatives of Hosah were thirteen in all.

column.name: text
column.value: To these divisions of the gatekeepers, to the chief men, were given duties like their relatives, to serve in the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: They cast lots, the small and the great alike, according to their fathers’ households, for every gate.

column.name: text
column.value: The lot to the east fell to ①Shelemiah. Then they cast lots for his son Zechariah, a counselor with insight, and his lot came out to the north. ▷ ①In 9:17, Shallum

column.name: text
column.value: For Obed-edom it fell to the south, and to his sons went the storehouse.

column.name: text
column.value: For Shuppim and Hosah it was to the west, by the gate of Shallecheth, on the ascending highway. Guard corresponded to guard.

column.name: text
column.value: On the east there were six Levites, on the north four daily, on the south four daily, and at the storehouse two by two.

column.name: text
column.value: At the ①annex on the west there were four at the highway and two at the annex. ▷ ①Possibly court or colonnade

column.name: text
column.value: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers of the sons of Korah and of the sons of Merari.

column.name: text
column.value: ①The Levites, their relatives, were in charge of the treasures of the house of God and of the treasures of the dedicated gifts. ▷ ①As in LXX; MT As for the Levites, Ahijah had

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, namely, the Jehielites, were the heads of the fathers’ households, belonging to Ladan the Gershonite.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Jehieli, Zetham, and his brother Joel, were in charge of the treasures of the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites,

column.name: text
column.value: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was officer over the treasures.

column.name: text
column.value: His relatives by Eliezer were Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.

column.name: text
column.value: This Shelomoth and his relatives were in charge of all the treasures of the dedicated gifts which King David and the heads of the fathers’ households, the commanders of thousands and hundreds, and the commanders of the army, had dedicated.

column.name: text
column.value: They dedicated ①part of the spoils won in battles to repair the house of the LORD. ▷ ①Heb from the battles and from the spoils

column.name: text
column.value: And all that Samuel the seer had dedicated, and Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, everyone who had dedicated anything, all of this was ①under the care of ②Shelomoth and his relatives. ▷ ①Lit on the hand ②Heb Shelomith

column.name: text
column.value: As for the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were assigned to outside duties for Israel, as officers and judges.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his relatives, 1,700 capable men, ①were responsible for the affairs of Israel ②west of the Jordan, for all the work of the LORD and the service of the king. ▷ ①Lit were over ②Lit beyond the Jordan westward

column.name: text
column.value: As for the Hebronites, Jerijah the chief ①(these Hebronites were sought out according to their genealogies and fathers’ households, in the fortieth year of David’s reign, and men of outstanding capability were found among them at Jazer of Gilead) ▷ ①Heb according to the Hebronites...father’s households

column.name: text
column.value: and his relatives, capable men, numbered 2,700, heads of fathers’ households. And King David appointed them as overseers of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites concerning ①all the affairs of God and of the king. ▷ ①Lit every matter of God and matter of the king

column.name: text
column.value: Now this is the number of the sons of Israel, the heads of fathers’ households, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in all the affairs of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout the months of the year, each division numbering twenty-four thousand:

column.name: text
column.value: Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel ①was in charge of the first division for the first month; and in his division were twenty-four thousand. ▷ ①Lit was over, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: He was from the sons of Perez, and was chief of all the commanders of the army for the first month.

column.name: text
column.value: Dodai the Ahohite and his division was in charge of the division for the second month, Mikloth being the chief officer; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: The third commander of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the priest, as chief; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: This Benaiah was the mighty man of the thirty, and was in charge of thirty; and over his division was his son Ammizabad.

column.name: text
column.value: The fourth, for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: The fifth, for the fifth month was the commander Shamhuth the Izrahite; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: The sixth, for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: The seventh, for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite of the sons of Ephraim; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: The eighth, for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite of the Zerahites; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: The ninth, for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite of the Benjaminites; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: The tenth, for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite of the Zerahites; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: The eleventh, for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite of the sons of Ephraim; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: The twelfth, for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite of Othniel; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in charge of the tribes of Israel: chief officer for the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri; for the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;

column.name: text
column.value: for Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; for Aaron, Zadok;

column.name: text
column.value: for Judah, Elihu, one of David’s brothers; for Issachar, Omri the son of Michael;

column.name: text
column.value: for Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah; for Naphtali, Jeremoth the son of Azriel;

column.name: text
column.value: for the sons of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; for the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;

column.name: text
column.value: for the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; for Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;

column.name: text
column.value: for Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the leaders of the tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: But David did not ①count those twenty years of age and under, because the LORD had said He would multiply Israel as the stars of heaven. ▷ ①Lit take their number of

column.name: text
column.value: Joab the son of Zeruiah had begun to count them, but did not finish; and because of this, wrath came upon Israel, and the number was not included in the account of the chronicles of King David.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Azmaveth the son of Adiel was responsible for the king’s storehouses. And Jonathan the son of Uzziah was responsible for the storehouses in the country, the cities, the villages, and the towers.

column.name: text
column.value: Ezri the son of Chelub was responsible for the ①agricultural workers who tilled the soil. ▷ ①Lit doers of the work of the field for the work of...

column.name: text
column.value: Shimei the Ramathite was responsible for the vineyards; and Zabdi the Shiphmite was responsible for the ①produce of the vineyards stored in the wine cellars. ▷ ①Lit what was in the vineyards

column.name: text
column.value: Baal-hanan the Gederite was responsible for the olive and sycamore trees in the ①Shephelah; and Joash was responsible for the stores of oil. ▷ ①Or lowlands

column.name: text
column.value: Shitrai the Sharonite was responsible for the cattle which were grazing in Sharon; and Shaphat the son of Adlai was responsible for the cattle in the valleys.

column.name: text
column.value: Obil the Ishmaelite was responsible for the camels; and Jehdeiah the Meronothite was responsible for the donkeys.

column.name: text
column.value: Jaziz the Hagrite was responsible for the flocks. All these were ①overseers of the property which belonged to King David. ▷ ①Or rulers

column.name: text
column.value: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe; and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni ①tutored the king’s sons. ▷ ①Lit was with

column.name: text
column.value: Ahithophel was counselor to the king; and Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.

column.name: text
column.value: Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar ①succeeded Ahithophel; and Joab was the commander of the king’s army. ▷ ①Lit after

column.name: text
column.value: Now David assembled at Jerusalem all the officials of Israel, the leaders of the tribes, and the commanders of the divisions that served the king, the commanders of thousands, and the commanders of hundreds, and the overseers of all the property and livestock belonging to the king and his sons, with the officials and the mighty men, all the valiant warriors.

column.name: text
column.value: Then King David rose to his feet and said, “Listen to me, my brothers and my people; ①I had intended to build a ②permanent home for the ark of the covenant of the LORD and for the footstool of our God. So I had made preparations to build it. ▷ ①Lit as for me, it was with my heart ②Lit house of rest

column.name: text
column.value: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for My name, because you are a man of war and have shed blood.’

column.name: text
