column.value: Yet, the LORD, the God of Israel, chose me from all the household of my father to be king over Israel forever. For He has chosen Judah to be a leader; and in the house of Judah, my father’s house, and among the sons of my father He took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Of all my sons (for the LORD has given me many sons), He has chosen my son Solomon to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to me, ‘Your son Solomon is the one who shall build My house and My courtyards; for I have chosen him to be a son to Me, and I will be a Father to him.

column.name: text
column.value: I will establish his kingdom forever if he resolutely performs My commandments and My ordinances, as ①is done now.’ ▷ ①Lit this day

column.name: text
column.value: So now, in the sight of all Israel, the assembly of the LORD, and in the ①presence of our God, keep and seek after all the commandments of the LORD your God so that you may possess the good land and leave it as an inheritance to your sons after you forever. ▷ ①Lit ears of

column.name: text
column.value: “As for you, my son Solomon, know the God of your father, and serve Him wholeheartedly and with a willing ①mind; for the LORD searches all hearts, and understands every intent of the thoughts. If you seek Him, He will let you find Him; but if you forsake Him, He will reject you forever. ▷ ①Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: Consider now, for the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary; be courageous and act.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then David gave to his son Solomon the plan of the porch of the temple, its buildings, its storehouses, its upper rooms, its inner rooms, and the room for the ①atoning cover; ▷ ①Also called mercy seat; i.e., where blood was sprinkled on the Day of Atonement

column.name: text
column.value: and the plan of all that he had in ①mind, for the courtyards of the house of the LORD, and for all the surrounding rooms, for the storehouses of the house of God and for the storehouses of the dedicated things; ▷ ①Lit the spirit with him

column.name: text
column.value: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites and for all the work of the service of the house of the LORD and for all the utensils of service in the house of the LORD;

column.name: text
column.value: for the golden utensils, by weight of gold for all utensils for every service; for all the silver utensils, by weight of silver for all utensils for every service;

column.name: text
column.value: and the weight of gold for the golden lampstands and their golden lamps, with the weight of each lampstand and its lamps; and the weight of silver for the silver lampstands, with the weight of each lampstand and its lamps according to the use of each lampstand;

column.name: text
column.value: and the gold by weight for the tables of the showbread, for each table; and silver for the silver tables;

column.name: text
column.value: and the forks, the basins, and the pitchers of pure gold; and for the golden bowls with the weight for each bowl; and for the silver bowls with the weight for each bowl;

column.name: text
column.value: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the model of the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out their wings and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “All this,” said David, “the LORD made me understand in writing by His hand upon me, all the ①details of this pattern.” ▷ ①Lit works

column.name: text
column.value: Then David said to his son Solomon, “Be strong and courageous, and act; do not fear nor be dismayed, for the LORD God, my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you until all the work for the service of the house of the LORD is finished.

column.name: text
column.value: Now behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of the house of God, and every willing man of any skill will be with you in all the work for all kinds of service. The officials also and all the people will be entirely at your command.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then King David said to the entire assembly, “My son Solomon, whom alone God has chosen, is still young and inexperienced, and the work is great; for the ①temple is not for mankind, but for the LORD God. ▷ ①Lit palace

column.name: text
column.value: Now with all my ability I have provided for the house of my God the gold for the things of gold, the silver for the things of silver, the bronze for the things of bronze, the iron for the things of iron, wood for the things of wood, onyx stones and inlaid stones, stones of antimony and stones of various colors, and all kinds of precious stones and alabaster in abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: In addition, in my delight in the house of my God, the treasure I have of gold and silver, I give to the house of my God, over and above all that I have already provided for the holy ①temple, ▷ ①Lit house

column.name: text
column.value: namely, three thousand ①talents of gold, from the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the ②buildings; ▷ ①A talent was about 75 lb. or 34 kg ②Lit houses

column.name: text
column.value: gold for the things of gold and silver for the things of silver, that is, for all the work ①done by the craftsmen. Who then is willing ②to consecrate himself this day to the LORD?” ▷ ①Lit by the hand of the craftsmen ②Lit to fill his hand

column.name: text
column.value: Then the rulers of the fathers’ households, the leaders of the tribes of Israel, and the commanders of thousands and hundreds, with the supervisors of the king’s work, offered willingly;

column.name: text
column.value: and for the service of the house of God they gave five thousand talents and ten thousand ①darics of gold, ten thousand talents of silver, eighteen thousand talents of brass, and a hundred thousand talents of iron. ▷ ①A coin weighing about 0.25 oz. or 7 gm

column.name: text
column.value: ①Whoever possessed precious stones gave them to the treasury of the house of the LORD, ②in care of Jehiel the Gershonite. ▷ ①Lit Those with whom were found ②Lit on the hand of

column.name: text
column.value: Then the people rejoiced because they had offered so willingly, for they made their offering to the LORD wholeheartedly, and King David also rejoiced greatly.

column.name: text
column.value: So David blessed the LORD in the sight of all the assembly; and David said, “Blessed are You, LORD God of Israel our father, forever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Yours, LORD, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty, indeed everything that is in the heavens and on the earth; Yours is the dominion, LORD, and You exalt Yourself as head over all.

column.name: text
column.value: Both riches and honor come from You, and You rule over all, and in Your hand is power and might; and it lies in Your hand to make great and to strengthen everyone.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, our God, we thank You, and praise Your glorious name.

column.name: text
column.value: “But who am I and who are my people that we should ①be able to offer as generously as this? For all things come from You, and from Your hand we have given to You. ▷ ①Lit keep strength

column.name: text
column.value: For we are strangers before You, and temporary residents, as all our fathers were; our days on the earth are like a shadow, and there is no hope.

column.name: text
column.value: LORD our God, all this abundance that we have provided to build You a house for Your holy name, it is from Your hand, and everything is Yours.

column.name: text
column.value: Since I know, my God, that You put the heart to the test and delight in uprightness, I, in the integrity of my heart, have willingly offered all these things; so now with joy I have seen Your people, who are present here, make their offerings willingly to You.

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, our fathers, keep this forever in the ①intentions of the hearts of Your people, and direct their hearts to You; ▷ ①Lit intent of the thoughts of

column.name: text
column.value: and give my son Solomon a perfect heart to keep Your commandments, Your testimonies, and Your statutes, and to do them all, and to build the ①temple for which I have made provision.” ▷ ①Lit palace

column.name: text
column.value: Then David said to all the assembly, “Now bless the LORD your God.” And all the assembly blessed the LORD, the God of their fathers, and bowed down and paid ①homage to the LORD and the king. ▷ ①I.e., great respect and honor to a superior

column.name: text
column.value: On the next day they ①made sacrifices to the LORD and offered burnt offerings to the LORD, a thousand bulls, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel. ▷ ①Lit sacrificed

column.name: text
column.value: So they ate and drank that day before the LORD with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king a second time, and they anointed him as ruler for the LORD and Zadok as priest.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of his father David; and he prospered, and all Israel obeyed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the officials, the mighty men, and also all the sons of King David ①pledged allegiance to King Solomon. ▷ ①Lit put a hand under Solomon

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD highly honored Solomon in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed on him royal majesty which had not been bestowed on any king before him in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: The period which he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned in Hebron seven years and ①in Jerusalem thirty-three years. ▷ ①Lit he reigned in

column.name: text
column.value: Then he died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and his son Solomon reigned in his place.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the acts of King David, from the first to the last, are written in the chronicles of Samuel the seer, in the chronicles of Nathan the prophet, and in the chronicles of Gad the seer,

column.name: text
column.value: with all of his reign, his power, and the circumstances which came upon him, Israel, and all the kingdoms of the lands.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Solomon the son of David established himself securely over his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him and exalted him greatly.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the commanders of thousands, of hundreds, and to the judges and to every leader in all Israel, the heads of the fathers’ households.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon and all the assembly with him went to the high place which was at Gibeon, because God’s tent of meeting was there which Moses, the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: However, David had brought up the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim ①to the place he had prepared for it, for he had pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem. ▷ ①Lit where David had prepared for it

column.name: text
column.value: Now the bronze altar which Bezalel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was there before the tabernacle of the LORD, and Solomon and the assembly sought it out.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon went up there before the LORD to the bronze altar which was at the tent of meeting, and offered a thousand burnt offerings on it.

column.name: text
column.value: In that night God appeared to Solomon and said to him, “Ask what I shall give you.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon said to God, “You have dealt with my father David with great faithfulness, and have made me king in his place.

column.name: text
column.value: Now, LORD God, Your ①promise to my father David is fulfilled, for You have made me king over a people as numerous as the dust of the earth. ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: Now give me wisdom and knowledge, so that I may go out and come in before this people, for who can rule this great people of Yours?”

column.name: text
column.value: Then God said to Solomon, “Because this was ①in your heart, and you did not ask for riches, wealth, or honor, or the life of those who hate you, nor did you even ask for long life, but you asked for yourself wisdom and knowledge so that you may rule My people over whom I have made you king, ▷ ①Lit with

column.name: text
column.value: wisdom and knowledge have been granted to you. I will also give you riches, wealth, and honor, ①such as none of the kings who were before you has possessed, nor will those who will ②come after you.” ▷ ①Lit which was not so to the kings who were before you ②Lit be

column.name: text
column.value: So Solomon went ①from the high place which was at Gibeon, from the tent of meeting, to Jerusalem, and he reigned over Israel. ▷ ①As in other ancient versions; MT to

column.name: text
column.value: Solomon amassed chariots and horsemen. He had 1,400 chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, and he stationed them in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: The king made silver and gold as plentiful in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars as plentiful as sycamores in the ①lowland. ▷ ①Heb shephelah

column.name: text
column.value: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from Kue; the king’s traders acquired them from Kue for a price.

column.name: text
column.value: They ①imported chariots from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver apiece, horses for 150 apiece, and ②by the same means they ③exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Aram. ▷ ①Lit brought out ②Lit brought up and brought out ③Lit in the same way by their hand

column.name: text
column.value: ①So Solomon ②assigned seventy thousand men to carry loads, eighty thousand men to quarry stone in the mountains, and 3,600 to supervise them. ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: in Heb ②Lit counted

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon sent word to ①Huram the king of Tyre, saying, “As you dealt with my father David and sent him cedars to build him a house to live in, do it for me. ▷ ①In 1 Kin 5:18, Hiram

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I am about to build a house for the name of the LORD my God, dedicating it to Him, to burn fragrant incense before Him and to set out the showbread continually, and to offer burnt offerings morning and evening, on Sabbaths, on new moons, and on the appointed feasts of the LORD our God. This is to be done in Israel forever.

column.name: text
column.value: The house which I am about to build will be great, for our God is greater than all the gods.

column.name: text
column.value: But who is able to build a house for Him, since the heavens and the highest heavens cannot contain Him? And who am I, that I should build a house for Him, except to ①burn incense before Him? ▷ ①Lit offer up in smoke

column.name: text
column.value: Now send me a skilled man to work in gold, silver, brass, iron, and in purple, crimson, and violet fabrics, one who knows how to make engravings, to work with the skilled workers ①whom I have in Judah and Jerusalem, whom my father David provided. ▷ ①Lit who are with me

column.name: text
column.value: Send me also cedar, juniper, and algum timber from Lebanon, for I know that your servants know how to cut timber of Lebanon; and indeed my servants will work with your servants,

column.name: text
column.value: to prepare timber in abundance for me, for the house which I am about to build will be great and wonderful.

column.name: text
column.value: Now behold, I will give your servants, the woodsmen who cut the timber, ①twenty thousand kors of crushed wheat, twenty thousand kors of barley, ②twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.” ▷ ①About 154,000 cubic feet or 4,360 cubic meters ②About 120,000 gallons or 454,249 liters

column.name: text
column.value: Then Huram, king of Tyre, ①answered in a letter sent to Solomon: “Because the LORD loves His people, He has made you king over them.” ▷ ①Lit said...and he sent

column.name: text
column.value: Then Huram ①continued, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given King David a wise son, ②endowed with discretion and understanding, who will build a house for the LORD and a ③royal palace for himself. ▷ ①Lit said ②Lit knowing discretion ③Lit house for his royalty

column.name: text
column.value: “Now then, I am sending Huram-abi, a skilled man, ①endowed with understanding, ▷ ①Lit knowing understanding

column.name: text
column.value: the son of a ①Danite woman and ②a Tyrian father, who knows how to work in gold, silver, bronze, iron, stone, and wood, and in purple, violet, linen, and crimson fabrics, and who knows how to make all kinds of engravings and to ③execute any design which is assigned to him, to work with your skilled workers and with ④those of my lord, your father David. ▷ ①Lit a woman of the daughters of Dan ②Lit whose father is a Tyrian man ③Lit devise any device ④Lit skilled men

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, let my lord send his servants wheat and barley, oil and wine, of which he has spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: We will cut whatever timber you need from Lebanon and bring it to you as rafts by sea to Joppa, so that you may carry it up to Jerusalem.”

column.name: text
column.value: Solomon counted all the foreigners who were in the land of Israel, following the ①census which his father David had ②taken; and 153,600 were found. ▷ ①Lit numbering ②Lit numbered of them

column.name: text
column.value: He appointed seventy thousand of them to carry loads and eighty thousand to quarry stones in the mountains, and 3,600 supervisors to make the people work.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he made a bronze altar, ①twenty cubits in length, ②twenty cubits in width, and ③ten cubits in height. ▷ ①About 30 ft. or 9 m ②About 30 ft. or 9 m ③About 15 ft. or 4.6 m

column.name: text
column.value: He also made the ①Sea of cast metal, ②ten cubits from brim to brim, circular in form, and its height was ③five cubits and ④its circumference ⑤thirty cubits. ▷ ①I.e., large basin ②About 15 ft. or 4.6 m ③About 7.5 ft. or 2.3 m ④Lit a line of 30 cubits encircling it round about ⑤About 45 ft. or 14 m

column.name: text
column.value: Now figures like oxen were under it and all around it, ①ten cubits, entirely encircling the Sea. The oxen were in two rows, cast ②in one piece. ▷ ①About 15 ft. or 4.6 m ②Lit in its casting

column.name: text
column.value: It was standing on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east; and the Sea was set on top of them and all their hindquarters turned inward.

column.name: text
column.value: It was a ①hand width thick, and its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like a lily blossom; it could hold three thousand ②baths. ▷ ①About 3 in. or 7.6 cm ②About 18,000 gallons or 68,137 liters

column.name: text
column.value: He also made ten basins in which to wash, and he set five on the right side and five on the left ①to rinse things for the burnt offering; but the Sea was for the priests to wash in. ▷ ①Lit in which to

column.name: text
column.value: Then he made the ten golden lampstands in the way prescribed for them, and he set them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left.

column.name: text
column.value: He also made ten tables and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left. And he made a hundred golden bowls.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he made the courtyard of the priests and the great courtyard, and doors for the courtyard, and overlaid their doors with bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: He put the Sea on the right side of the house toward the southeast.

column.name: text
column.value: Huram also made the pails, the shovels, and the bowls. So Huram finished the work that he did for King Solomon in the house of God:

column.name: text
column.value: the two pillars, the bowls and the two capitals on top of the pillars, and the two latticeworks to cover the two bowls of the capitals which were on top of the pillars,

column.name: text
column.value: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two latticeworks, two rows of pomegranates for each latticework to cover the two bowls of the capitals which were on the pillars.

column.name: text
column.value: He also made the stands and he made the basins on the stands,

column.name: text
column.value: and the one Sea with the twelve oxen under it.

column.name: text
column.value: The pails, the shovels, the forks, and all its utensils, Huram-abi made of polished bronze for King Solomon, for the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: On the plain of the Jordan the king cast them in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.

column.name: text
column.value: So Solomon made all these utensils in great quantities, for the weight of the bronze could not be determined.

column.name: text
column.value: Solomon also made all the things that were in the house of God: the golden altar, the tables with the bread of the Presence on them,

column.name: text
column.value: the lampstands with their lamps of pure gold, to burn in front of the inner sanctuary in the way prescribed;

column.name: text
column.value: the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs of gold, that is, of purest gold;

column.name: text
column.value: and the snuffers, the bowls, the spoons, and the firepans of pure gold; and the entrance of the house, its inner doors for the Most Holy Place and the doors of the house, that is, of the main room, of gold.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD had appeared to his father David, at the place that David had prepared on the threshing floor of ①Ornan the Jebusite. ▷ ①In 2 Sam 24:18, Araunah

column.name: text
column.value: He began to build on the second day in the second month ①of the fourth year of his reign. ▷ ①Lit in

column.name: text
column.value: Now these are the ①foundations which Solomon laid for building the house of God. The length in cubits, according to the old standard, was ②sixty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits. ▷ ①Lit founding of Solomon to build ②About 90 ft. long and 30 ft. wide or 27 m long and 9 m wide

column.name: text
column.value: The porch which was in front of the house was as long as the width of the house, ①twenty cubits, and the height ②twenty; and inside he overlaid it with pure gold. ▷ ①About 30 ft. or 9 m ②As in ancient versions; MT 120 cubits or about 180 ft. or 55 m

column.name: text
column.value: He overlaid the ①main room with juniper wood and overlaid it with fine gold; and he ②ornamented it with palm trees and chains. ▷ ①Lit great house ②Lit put on it palm trees

column.name: text
column.value: Further, he overlaid the house ①with precious stones; and the gold was gold from Parvaim. ▷ ①Lit for beauty

column.name: text
column.value: He also overlaid the house with gold—the beams, the thresholds, and its walls and doors; and he carved cherubim on the walls.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he made the ①room of the Most Holy Place: its length across the width of the house was ②twenty cubits, and its width was twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to ③six hundred talents. ▷ ①Lit house ②About 30 ft. or 9 m ③About 23 tons or 21 metric tons

column.name: text
column.value: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He also overlaid the upper rooms with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he made two ①sculptured cherubim in the room of the Most Holy Place and overlaid them with gold. ▷ ①Lit cherubim of cast work

column.name: text
column.value: The wingspan of the ①cherubim was twenty ②cubits; the wing of one, of five cubits, touched the wall of the house, and its other wing, of five cubits, touched the wing of the other cherub. ▷ ①Heb plural of cherub ②About 18 in. or 45 cm

column.name: text
column.value: The wing of the other cherub, of five cubits, touched the wall of the house; and its other wing, of five cubits, was attached to the wing of the ①first cherub. ▷ ①Lit other

column.name: text
column.value: The wings of these cherubim extended twenty cubits, and they stood on their feet ①facing the main room. ▷ ①Lit and their faces to

column.name: text
column.value: He made the veil of violet, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and he worked cherubim into it.

column.name: text
column.value: He also made two pillars for the front of the house, thirty-five cubits ①high, and the capital on the top of each was five cubits. ▷ ①Lit long

column.name: text
column.value: He made chains in the inner sanctuary and placed them on the tops of the pillars; and he made a hundred pomegranates and placed them on the chains.

column.name: text
column.value: He erected the pillars in front of the temple, one on the right and the other on the left, and named the one on the right Jachin and the one on the left Boaz.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the work that Solomon performed for the house of the LORD was finished. And Solomon brought in the ①things that his father David had dedicated, the silver, the gold, and all the utensils, and he put them in the treasuries of the house of God. ▷ ①Lit dedicated things of his

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon assembled at Jerusalem the elders of Israel, all the heads of the tribes, and the leaders of the fathers’ households of the sons of Israel, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD up from the city of David, which is Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: All the men of Israel assembled themselves before the king at the feast, that is in the seventh month.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the elders of Israel came, and the Levites picked up the ark.

column.name: text
column.value: They brought up the ark, the tent of meeting, and all the holy utensils that were in the tent. The Levitical priests brought them up.

column.name: text
column.value: And King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel who had assembled with him before the ark were sacrificing ①so many sheep and oxen that they could not be counted or numbered. ▷ ①Lit sheep...numbered for multitude

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priests brought the ark of the covenant of the LORD to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the Most Holy Place, under the wings of the cherubim.

column.name: text
column.value: For the cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark, so that the cherubim made a covering over the ark and its ①poles. ▷ ①Lit poles above

column.name: text
column.value: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles of the ark could be seen in front of the inner sanctuary, but they could not be seen outside; and ①they are there to this day. ▷ ①Lit it is

column.name: text
column.value: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, where the LORD made a covenant with the sons of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: When the priests came out from the holy place (for all the priests who were present had sanctified themselves, without regard to divisions),

column.name: text
column.value: and all the Levitical singers, Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and kinsmen, clothed in fine linen, with cymbals, harps, and lyres, standing east of the altar, and with them 120 priests blowing trumpets

column.name: text
column.value: in unison when the trumpeters and the singers were to make themselves heard with one voice to praise and to glorify the LORD, and when they raised their voices accompanied by trumpets, cymbals, and other musical instruments, and when they praised the LORD saying, “He indeed is good for His ①kindness is everlasting,” then the house, the house of the LORD, was filled with a cloud, ▷ ①Or faithfulness

column.name: text
column.value: so that the priests could not rise to minister because of the cloud, for the glory of the LORD filled the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon said, “The LORD has said that He would dwell in the thick darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: I have built You a lofty house, And a place for Your dwelling forever.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king turned around and blessed all the assembly of Israel, while all the assembly of Israel was standing.

column.name: text
column.value: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who spoke with His mouth to my father David, and fulfilled it with His hands, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Since the day that I brought My people from the land of Egypt, I did not choose a city out of all the tribes of Israel in which to build a house, so that My name might be there, nor did I choose a man to be the leader over My people Israel;

column.name: text
column.value: but I have chosen Jerusalem so that My name might be there, and I have chosen David to be over My people Israel.’

column.name: text
column.value: Now it was ①in the heart of my father David to build a house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel. ▷ ①Lit with

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD said to my father David, ‘Because it was ①in your heart to build a house for My name, you did well that it was ②in your heart. ▷ ①Lit with ②Lit with

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless you shall not build the house, but your son who ①will be born to you, he shall build the house for My name.’ ▷ ①Lit will come forth from your loins

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD has fulfilled His word which He spoke; for I have risen in place of my father David and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD ①promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel. ▷ ①Lit spoke

column.name: text
column.value: There I have placed the ark in which is the covenant of the LORD, which He made with the sons of Israel.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then he stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the assembly of Israel and spread out his hands.

column.name: text
column.value: For Solomon had made a bronze platform, ①five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the courtyard; and he stood on it, knelt on his knees in the presence of all the assembly of Israel and spread out his hands toward heaven. ▷ ①About 7.5 ft. long and wide and 4.5 ft. high or 2.3 m and 1.4 m

column.name: text
column.value: He said, “LORD, God of Israel, there is no god like You in heaven or on earth, keeping ①Your covenant and ②Your faithfulness to Your servants who walk before You with all their heart; ▷ ①Or the ②Or the

column.name: text
column.value: You who have kept with Your servant, my father David, that which You ①promised him; You have spoken with Your mouth and have fulfilled it with Your hand, as it is this day. ▷ ①Lit spoke to

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, LORD, God of Israel, keep to Your servant David, my father, that which You ①promised him, saying, ‘ ②You shall not lack a man to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your sons pay attention to their way, to walk in My Law as you have walked before Me.’ ▷ ①Lit have spoken to ②Lit There shall not be cut off to you a man from before Me

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, LORD, God of Israel, let Your word be confirmed which You have spoken to Your servant David.

column.name: text
column.value: “But will God really dwell with mankind on the earth? Behold, heaven and the ①highest heaven cannot contain You; how much less this house which I have built! ▷ ①Lit heaven of heavens

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, turn Your attention to the prayer of Your servant and to his plea, LORD, my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which Your servant prays before You;

column.name: text
column.value: that Your eye will be open toward this house day and night, toward the place of which You have said that You would put Your name there, to listen to the prayer which Your servant shall pray toward this place.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen to the pleadings of Your servant and of Your people Israel when they pray toward this place; hear from Your dwelling place, from heaven; hear and forgive.

column.name: text
column.value: “If someone sins against his neighbor and is made to take an oath, and he comes and takes an oath before Your altar in this house,

column.name: text
column.value: then hear from heaven and take action and judge Your servants, ①punishing the wicked by bringing his way on his own head, and justifying the righteous by ②repaying him according to his righteousness. ▷ ①Lit returning ②Lit giving

column.name: text
column.value: “If Your people Israel are ①defeated before an enemy because they have sinned against You, and they return to You and praise Your name, and pray and plead before You in this house, ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of Your people Israel, and bring them back to the land which You have given to them and to their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: “When the heavens are shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against You, and they pray toward this place and praise Your name, and turn from their sin when You afflict them,

column.name: text
column.value: then hear in heaven and forgive the sin of Your servants and Your people Israel; indeed, teach them the good way in which they are to walk. And provide rain on Your land, which You have given to Your people as an inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: “If there is a famine in the land, if there is a plague, if there is blight or mildew, if there is locust or grasshopper, if their enemies besiege them in the land of their ①cities, whatever plague or whatever sickness there is, ▷ ①Lit gates

column.name: text
column.value: whatever prayer or plea is made by anyone or by all Your people Israel, ①each knowing his own affliction and his own pain, and spreading his hands toward this house, ▷ ①Lit whoever shall know

column.name: text
column.value: then hear from heaven, Your dwelling place, and forgive, and render to each according to all his ways, whose heart You know—for You alone know the hearts of the sons of mankind—

column.name: text
column.value: so that they may ①fear You, to walk in Your ways ②as long as they live in the land which You have given to our fathers. ▷ ①Or revere ②Lit all the days that they live on the face of the land

column.name: text
column.value: “Also concerning the foreigner who is not from Your people Israel, when he comes from a far country on account of Your great name and Your mighty hand and Your outstretched arm, when they come and pray toward this house,

column.name: text
column.value: then hear from heaven, from Your dwelling place, and do according to all for which the foreigner calls to You, so that all the peoples of the earth may know Your name, and ①fear You as do Your people Israel, and that they may know that ②this house which I have built is called by Your name. ▷ ①Or revere ②Lit Your name is called upon this house

column.name: text
column.value: “When Your people go out to battle against their enemies, by whatever way You send them, and they pray to You toward this city which You have chosen and the house which I have built for Your name,

column.name: text
column.value: then hear from heaven their prayer and their pleading, and maintain their cause.

column.name: text
column.value: “When they sin against You (for there is no one who does not sin), and You are angry with them and turn them over to an enemy, so that ①they take them away captive to a land far off or near, ▷ ①Lit their captors lead them captive

column.name: text
column.value: if they ①take it to heart in the land where they are taken captive, and repent and plead to You in the land of their captivity, saying, ‘We have sinned, we have done wrong and have acted wickedly’; ▷ ①Lit return to their heart

column.name: text
column.value: if they return to You with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, where they have been taken captive, and pray toward their land which You have given to their fathers and the city which You have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for Your name,

column.name: text
column.value: then hear from heaven, from Your dwelling place, their prayer and pleadings, and maintain their cause, and forgive Your people who have sinned against You.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now, my God, please, let Your eyes be open and Your ears attentive to the prayer offered in this place.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now then arise, LORD God, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your might; let Your priests, LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let Your godly ones rejoice in what is good.

column.name: text
column.value: “LORD God, do not turn away the face of Your anointed; remember Your faithfulness to Your servant David.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the queen of Sheba heard about the fame of Solomon, she came to Jerusalem to test Solomon with riddles. She had a very large entourage, with camels carrying balsam oil and a large amount of gold and precious stones; and when she came to Solomon, she spoke with him about everything that was on her heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Solomon ①answered all her questions; nothing was hidden from Solomon which he did not ②explain to her. ▷ ①Lit told her all her words ②Lit tell

column.name: text
column.value: When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house which he had built,

column.name: text
column.value: the food at his table, the seating of his servants, the attendance of his ministers and their attire, his cupbearers and their attire, and ①his stairway by which he went up to the house of the LORD, she was breathless. ▷ ①Or his burnt offering which he offered

column.name: text
column.value: Then she said to the king, “It was a true ①story that I heard in my own land about your words and your wisdom. ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: But I did not believe their ①stories until I came and my own eyes saw it all. And behold, not even half of the greatness of your wisdom was reported to me. You have surpassed the report that I heard. ▷ ①Lit words

column.name: text
column.value: How ①blessed are your men, how ②blessed are these servants of yours, who stand before you continually and hear your wisdom! ▷ ①Or happy ②Or happy

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed be the LORD your God who delighted in you, setting you on His throne as king for the LORD your God; because your God loved Israel, establishing them forever, He made you king over them, to carry out justice and righteousness.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then she gave the king ①120 talents of gold and a very great amount of balsam oil and precious stones; there had never been balsam oil like that which the queen of Sheba gave King Solomon. ▷ ①About 4.5 tons or 4 metric tons

column.name: text
column.value: The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious stones.

column.name: text
column.value: From the algum trees the king made steps to the house of the LORD and for the king’s palace, and lyres and harps for the singers; and nothing like them was seen before in the land of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba her every desire, whatever she requested, besides gifts equal to what she had brought to the king. Then she turned and went to her own land with her servants.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was ①666 talents of gold, ▷ ①About 25 tons or 23 metric tons

column.name: text
column.value: besides what the traders and merchants brought; and all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of beaten gold, ①using six hundred shekels of beaten gold on each large shield. ▷ ①Lit he brought up

column.name: text
column.value: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold, ①using three hundred shekels of gold on each shield; and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon. ▷ ①Lit he brought up

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

column.name: text
column.value: There were six steps to the throne and a footstool in gold attached to the throne, and ①arms ②on each side of the seat, and two lions standing beside the ③arms. ▷ ①Lit hands ②Lit from this and from this at the place of the seat ③Lit hands

column.name: text
column.value: Twelve lions were standing there on the six steps on the one side and on the other; nothing like it was made for any other kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; silver was not considered ①valuable in the days of Solomon. ▷ ①Lit anything

column.name: text
column.value: For the king had ships which went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram; once every three years the ships of Tarshish came bringing gold and silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

column.name: text
column.value: So King Solomon became greater than all the kings of the earth in wealth and wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the kings of the earth were seeking the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom which God had put in his heart.

column.name: text
column.value: They were bringing, each of them his gift: articles of silver and gold, garments, weapons, balsam oil, horses, and mules, so much year by year.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, and he stationed them in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: He was ruler over all the kings from the Euphrates River to the land of the Philistines, and as far as the border of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem, and he made cedars as plentiful as sycamore trees that are in the ①lowland. ▷ ①Heb shephelah

column.name: text
column.value: And they were bringing horses for Solomon from Egypt and from all countries.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, from the first to the last, are they not written in the ①records of Nathan the prophet, in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of ②Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat? ▷ ①Lit words ②Heb Jedo

column.name: text
column.value: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel for forty years.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon ①lay down with his fathers and was buried in the city of his father David; and his son Rehoboam reigned in his place. ▷ ①I.e., died

column.name: text
column.value: Then Rehoboam went to Shechem, because all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard about it (he was in Egypt where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon), Jeroboam returned from Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: So they sent word and summoned him. When Jeroboam and all Israel came, they spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Your father made our yoke hard; but now, lighten the hard labor imposed by your father and his heavy yoke which he put on us, and we will serve you.”

column.name: text
column.value: He said to them, “Return to me again in three days.” So the people departed.

column.name: text
column.value: And then King Rehoboam consulted with the elders who had ①served his father Solomon while he was still alive, saying, “How do you advise me to answer this people?” ▷ ①Lit stood before

column.name: text
column.value: They spoke to him, saying, “If you are kind to this people and please them and speak pleasant words to them, then they will be your servants always.”

column.name: text
column.value: But he ignored the advice of the elders which they had given him, and consulted with the young men who had grown up with him ①and served him. ▷ ①Lit who stood before

column.name: text
column.value: He said to them, “What advice do you give, so that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Lighten the yoke which your father put on us’?”

column.name: text
column.value: The young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, “This is what you should say to the people who spoke to you, saying: ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but you make it lighter for us!’ You should speak this way to them: ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist!

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, my father loaded you with a heavy yoke; yet I will add to your yoke. My father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with ①scorpions!’ ” ▷ ①Prob. a brutal type of whip

column.name: text
column.value: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, just as the king had ①directed, saying, “Return to me on the third day.” ▷ ①Lit spoken

column.name: text
column.value: The king answered them harshly, and King Rehoboam ignored the advice of the elders.

column.name: text
column.value: He spoke to them according to the advice of the young men, saying, “ ①My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it; my father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with ②scorpions.” ▷ ①Many mss I have made ②Prob. a brutal type of whip

column.name: text
column.value: So the king did not listen to the people, because it was a turn of events from God so that the LORD might establish His word, which He spoke through Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

column.name: text
column.value: When all Israel saw that the king had not listened to them, the people replied to the king, saying, “What share do we have in David? We have no inheritance in the son of Jesse. Everyone to your tents, Israel! Now look after your own house, David!” So all Israel went away to their tents.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for the sons of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was in charge of the forced labor, and the sons of Israel stoned him ①to death. And King Rehoboam hurried to mount his chariot to flee to Jerusalem. ▷ ①Lit with stones that he died

column.name: text
column.value: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about at the end of the twenty years in which Solomon had built the house of the LORD and his own house,

column.name: text
column.value: that he built the cities which Huram had given ①him, and settled the sons of Israel there. ▷ ①Lit Solomon

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon went to Hamath-zobah and captured it.

column.name: text
column.value: He built Tadmor in the wilderness and all the storage cities which he had built in Hamath.

column.name: text
column.value: He also built upper Beth-horon and lower Beth-horon, which were fortified cities with walls, gates, and bars;

column.name: text
column.value: and Baalath and all the storage cities that Solomon had, and all the cities for ①his chariots and cities for ②his horsemen, and everything that it pleased Solomon to build in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and all the land ③under his rule. ▷ ①Lit the ②Lit the ③Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: All of the people who were left of the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: that is, from their descendants who were left after them in the land, whom the sons of Israel had not destroyed, Solomon raised them as forced laborers to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: But Solomon did not make slaves from the sons of Israel for his work; for they were men of war, his chief captains and commanders of his chariots and his horsemen.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the chief ①officers of King Solomon, 250 who ruled over the people. ▷ ①Or deputies

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon brought Pharaoh’s daughter up from the city of David to the house which he had built for her, for he said, “My wife shall not live in the house of David king of Israel, because ①the places where the ark of the LORD has entered are holy.” ▷ ①Lit they are

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of the LORD which he had built in front of the porch;

column.name: text
column.value: and he did so according to the daily rule, offering them up according to the commandment of Moses, for the Sabbaths, the new moons, and the three annual feasts—the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Booths.

column.name: text
column.value: Now according to the ordinance of his father David, he appointed the divisions of the priests for their service, and the Levites for their duties of praise and ministering before the priests according to the daily rule, and the gatekeepers by their divisions at every gate; for this is what David, the man of God, had commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: And they did not deviate from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites in any matter or regarding the storehouses.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the work of Solomon was carried out ①from the day of the foundation of the house of the LORD, until it was finished. So the house of the LORD was completed. ▷ ①As in ancient versions; MT as far as

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon went to Ezion-geber and to Eloth on the seashore in the land of Edom.

column.name: text
column.value: And by his servants Huram sent him ships and servants who knew the sea; and they went with Solomon’s servants to Ophir and took from there ①450 talents of gold, and brought it to King Solomon. ▷ ①About 17 tons or 15 metric tons

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, 180,000 chosen warriors, to fight against Israel to restore the kingdom to Rehoboam.

column.name: text
column.value: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Tell Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the LORD says: “You shall not go up nor fight against your relatives; return, every man, to his house, for this ①event is from Me.” ’ ” So they listened to the words of the LORD and returned from going against Jeroboam. ▷ ①Lit thing

column.name: text
column.value: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem and built cities for defense in Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: He built Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,

column.name: text
column.value: Beth-zur, Soco, Adullam,

column.name: text
column.value: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,

column.name: text
column.value: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,

column.name: text
column.value: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, which are fortified cities in Judah and Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: He also strengthened the fortresses and put officers in them and supplies of food, oil, and wine.

column.name: text
column.value: He put shields and spears in every city and strengthened them greatly. So he held Judah and Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the priests and the Levites who were in all Israel also stood with him from all their districts.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Levites left their pasture lands and their property and went to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons had excluded them from serving as priests to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: He set up priests of his own for the high places, for the satyrs and the calves which he had made.

column.name: text
column.value: Those from all the tribes of Israel who set their hearts on seeking the LORD God of Israel ①followed them to Jerusalem, to sacrifice to the LORD God of their fathers. ▷ ①Lit came after

column.name: text
column.value: They strengthened the kingdom of Judah and supported Rehoboam the son of Solomon for three years, for they walked in the way of David and Solomon for three years.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Rehoboam married Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David and of Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse,

column.name: text
column.value: and she bore to him sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.

column.name: text
column.value: After her he married Maacah the daughter of ①Absalom, and she bore to him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith. ▷ ①In 1 Kin 15:2, Abishalom

column.name: text
column.value: Rehoboam loved Maacah the daughter of Absalom more than all his other wives and concubines. For he had taken eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and fathered twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah as head and leader among his brothers, for he intended to make him king.

column.name: text
column.value: He acted wisely and distributed ①some of his sons through all the territories of Judah and Benjamin to all the fortified cities, and he gave them plenty of provisions. And he sought many wives for them. ▷ ①Lit from all

column.name: text
column.value: ①And Asa did what was good and right in the sight of the LORD his God, ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: in Heb

column.name: text
column.value: for he removed the foreign altars and high places, tore down the memorial stones, cut down the ①Asherim, ▷ ①I.e., wooden symbols of a female deity (Asherah)

column.name: text
column.value: and commanded Judah to seek the LORD God of their fathers and to ①comply with the Law and the commandment. ▷ ①Lit do the

column.name: text
column.value: He also removed the high places and the incense altars from all the cities of Judah. And the kingdom was undisturbed under him.

column.name: text
column.value: He built fortified cities in Judah, since the land was undisturbed, and ①there was no one at war with him during those years, because the LORD had given him rest. ▷ ①Lit no war was with him

column.name: text
column.value: For he said to Judah, “Let’s build these cities and surround them with walls and towers, gates and bars. The land is still ①ours because we have sought the LORD our God; we have sought Him, and He has given us rest on every side.” So they built and prospered. ▷ ①Lit before us

column.name: text
column.value: Now Asa had an army of three hundred thousand from Judah, carrying large shields and spears, and 280,000 from Benjamin, carrying shields and wielding bows; all of them were valiant warriors.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Zerah the Ethiopian went out against them with an army of a million men and three hundred chariots, and he came to Mareshah.

column.name: text
column.value: So Asa went out ①to meet him, and they drew up in battle formation in the Valley of Zephathah at Mareshah. ▷ ①Lit before him

column.name: text
column.value: Then Asa called to the LORD his God and said, “LORD, there is no one besides You to help in the battle between the powerful and those who have no strength; help us, LORD our God, for we trust in You, and in Your name have come against this multitude. LORD, You are our God; do not let man prevail against You.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD ①routed the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah, and the Ethiopians fled. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: Asa and the people who were with him pursued them as far as Gerar; and so many Ethiopians fell that ①they could not recover, for they were shattered before the LORD and before His army. And they carried away a very large amount of plunder. ▷ ①Or there was none left alive

column.name: text
column.value: They ①destroyed all the cities around Gerar, for the dread of the LORD had fallen on them; and they pillaged all the cities, for there was much plunder in them. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: They also fatally struck ①those who owned livestock, and they led away large numbers of sheep and camels. Then they returned to Jerusalem. ▷ ①Lit tents of livestock

column.name: text
column.value: When the kingdom of Rehoboam was established and strong, he and all Israel with him abandoned the Law of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came about in King Rehoboam’s fifth year, because they had been unfaithful to the LORD, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem

column.name: text
column.value: with 1,200 chariots and sixty thousand horsemen. And the people who came with him from Egypt were innumerable: the Lubim, the Sukkiim, and the Ethiopians.

column.name: text
column.value: And he captured the fortified cities of Judah and came as far as Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and the princes of Judah who had gathered at Jerusalem because of Shishak, and he said to them, “This is what the LORD says: ‘You have abandoned Me, so I also have abandoned you ①to Shishak.’ ” ▷ ①Lit in the hand of

column.name: text
column.value: So the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said, “The LORD is righteous.”

column.name: text
column.value: When the LORD saw that they had humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, “They have humbled themselves, so I will not destroy them; and I will grant them a little deliverance, and My wrath will not be poured out on Jerusalem by means of Shishak.

column.name: text
column.value: But they will become his slaves, so that they may learn the difference between My service and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Shishak king of Egypt went up against Jerusalem, and he took the treasures of the house of the LORD and the treasures of the king’s palace. He took everything; he even took the gold shields which Solomon had made.

column.name: text
column.value: Then King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place and committed them to the ①care of the commanders of the ②guards who guarded the entrance of the king’s house. ▷ ①Lit hands ②Lit runners

column.name: text
column.value: As often as the king entered the house of the LORD, the ①guards came and carried them and then brought them back into the ②guards’ room. ▷ ①Lit runners ②Lit runners

column.name: text
column.value: And when he humbled himself, the anger of the LORD turned away from him, so as not to destroy him completely; and conditions were also good in Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: So King Rehoboam became powerful in Jerusalem and reigned there. For Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen from all the tribes of Israel, to put His name there. And his mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

column.name: text
column.value: But he did evil because he did not set his heart to seek the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the acts of Rehoboam, from the first to the last, are they not written in the ①records of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer, according to genealogical enrollment? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually. ▷ ①Lit words

column.name: text
column.value: And Rehoboam ①lay down with his fathers and was buried in the city of David; and his son Abijah became king in his place. ▷ ①I.e., died

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded,

column.name: text
column.value: and he went out ①to meet Asa and said to him, “Listen to me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin: the LORD is with you when you are with Him. And if you seek Him, He will let you find Him; but if you abandon Him, He will abandon you. ▷ ①Lit before Asa

column.name: text
column.value: For many days Israel was without the true God and without a teaching priest and without the Law.

column.name: text
column.value: But in their distress they turned to the LORD God of Israel, and they sought Him, and He let them find Him.

column.name: text
column.value: In those times there was no peace for him who went out or him who came in, because many disturbances ①afflicted all the inhabitants of the lands. ▷ ①Lit were on

column.name: text
column.value: Nation was crushed by nation, and city by city, for God troubled them with every kind of distress.

column.name: text
column.value: But you, be strong and do not ①lose courage, for there is a reward for your work.” ▷ ①Lit let your hands drop

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Asa heard these words and the ①prophecy which Azariah the son of Oded the prophet spoke, he took courage and removed the abominable idols from all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and from the cities which he had captured in the hill country of Ephraim. He then restored the altar of the LORD which was in front of the porch of the LORD. ▷ ①With several ancient versions; MT the prophecy, Oded the prophet

column.name: text
column.value: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those from Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon who resided with them, for many defected to him from Israel when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.

column.name: text
column.value: So they assembled at Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.

column.name: text
column.value: They sacrificed to the LORD on that day seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep from the spoils they had brought.

column.name: text
column.value: They entered into the covenant to seek the LORD God of their fathers with all their heart and soul;

column.name: text
column.value: and whoever would not seek the LORD God of Israel was to be put to death, whether small or great, man or woman.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, they made an oath to the LORD with a loud voice, with shouting, trumpets, and with horns.

column.name: text
column.value: All Judah rejoiced concerning the oath, for they had sworn with all their heart and had sought Him ①earnestly, and He let them find Him. So the LORD gave them rest on every side. ▷ ①Lit with all their whole desire

column.name: text
column.value: He also removed Maacah, the mother of King Asa, from the position of queen mother, because she had made an abominable image ①as an Asherah, and Asa cut down her abominable image, crushed it, and burned it at the brook Kidron. ▷ ①Or for Asherah; i.e., a wooden symbol of a female deity

column.name: text
column.value: But the high places were not removed from Israel; nevertheless Asa’s heart was blameless all his days.

column.name: text
column.value: He brought into the house of God the dedicated things of his father and his own dedicated things: silver, gold, and utensils.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was no more war until the thirty-fifth year of Asa’s reign.

column.name: text
column.value: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah became king over Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: He reigned in Jerusalem for three years; and his mother’s name was ①Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. Now there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam. ▷ ①In 1 Kin 15:2, Maacah the daughter of Abishalom

column.name: text
column.value: Abijah began the battle with an army of warriors, four hundred thousand chosen men, while Jeroboam drew up in battle formation against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men who were valiant warriors.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, “Listen to me, Jeroboam and all Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not know that the LORD God of Israel gave the rule over Israel forever to David ①and his sons by a covenant of salt? ▷ ①Lit to him and to his sons

column.name: text
column.value: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up and rebelled against his ①master, ▷ ①Or lord

column.name: text
column.value: and worthless men gathered to him, wicked men, who proved too strong for Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, when ①he was young and timid and could not hold his own against them. ▷ ①Lit Rehoboam

column.name: text
column.value: “So now you intend to assert yourselves against the kingdom of the LORD ①through the sons of David, ②being a great multitude and having with you the golden calves which Jeroboam made for you as gods. ▷ ①Lit by the hand of ②Lit and you are a

column.name: text
column.value: Have you not driven out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron and the Levites, and made for yourselves priests like the peoples of other lands? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a bull and seven rams, even he may become a priest of things that are not gods.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not abandoned Him; and the sons of Aaron are ministering to the LORD as priests, and the Levites ①attend to their work. ▷ ①Lit in the work

column.name: text
column.value: Every morning and evening they ①burn to the LORD burnt offerings and fragrant incense, and the showbread is set on the clean table, and the golden lampstand with its lamps is ready to light every evening; for we perform our duty to the LORD our God, but you have abandoned Him. ▷ ①Lit offer up in smoke

column.name: text
column.value: Now behold, God is with us at our head, and His priests with the signal trumpets to sound the war cry against you. Sons of Israel, do not fight against the LORD God of your fathers, for you will not succeed.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jeroboam had set an ambush to come from behind, so that Israel was in front of Judah and the ambush was behind them.

column.name: text
column.value: When Judah turned around, behold, ①they were attacked both from front and rear; so they cried out to the LORD, and the priests blew the trumpets. ▷ ①Lit the battle was in front and behind them

column.name: text
column.value: Then the men of Judah raised a war cry, and when the men of Judah raised the war cry, God ①defeated Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: When the sons of Israel fled from Judah, God handed them over to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Abijah and his people defeated them with a great slaughter, so that five hundred thousand chosen men of Israel fell slain.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Israel were subdued at that time, and the sons of Judah ①conquered because they trusted in the LORD, the God of their fathers. ▷ ①Lit were strong

column.name: text
column.value: Abijah pursued Jeroboam and captured from him several cities, Bethel with its villages, Jeshanah with its villages, and ①Ephron with its villages. ▷ ①Another reading is Ephrain

column.name: text
column.value: Jeroboam did not again recover strength in the days of Abijah; and the LORD struck him and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: But Abijah became powerful, and he took fourteen wives for himself, and fathered twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways and his words are written in the ①treatise of Iddo the prophet. ▷ ①Heb midrash

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Solomon had finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices, and the glory of the LORD filled the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priests could not enter the house of the LORD because the glory of the LORD filled the LORD’S house.

column.name: text
column.value: All the sons of Israel, seeing the fire come down and the glory of the LORD upon the house, bowed down on the pavement with their faces to the ground, and they worshiped and gave praise to the LORD, saying, “Certainly He is good, certainly His faithfulness is everlasting.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifice before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand oxen and 120,000 sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: The priests stood at their posts, and the Levites also, with the musical instruments for the LORD, which King David had made for giving praise to the LORD—“for His faithfulness is everlasting”—whenever David gave praise through their ①ministry; the priests on the other side blew trumpets and all Israel was standing. ▷ ①Lit hand

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon consecrated the middle of the courtyard that was before the house of the LORD, for he offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings there, because the bronze altar which Solomon had made was not able to contain the burnt offering, the grain offering, and the fat.

column.name: text
column.value: So Solomon held the feast at that time for seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great assembly that came from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the eighth day they held a solemn assembly, because they held the dedication of the altar for seven days, and the feast for seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: Then on the twenty-third day of the seventh month he sent the people to their tents, rejoicing and happy in heart because of the goodness that the LORD had shown to David, to Solomon, and to His people Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: So Solomon finished the house of the LORD and the king’s palace, and successfully completed everything that ①he had planned on doing in the house of the LORD and in his palace. ▷ ①Lit came upon the heart of Solomon to do

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD appeared to Solomon at night and said to him, “I have heard your prayer and have chosen this place for Myself as a house of sacrifice.

column.name: text
column.value: If I shut up the heavens so that there is no rain, or if I command the locust to devour the land, or if I send a plague among My people,

column.name: text
column.value: and My people ①who are called by My name humble themselves, and pray and seek My face, and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, and I will forgive their sin and will heal their land. ▷ ①Lit over whom My name is called

column.name: text
column.value: Now My eyes will be open and My ears attentive to the ①prayer offered in this place. ▷ ①Lit prayer of this place

column.name: text
column.value: For now I have chosen and consecrated this house so that My name may be there forever, and My eyes and My heart will be there ①always. ▷ ①Lit all the days

column.name: text
column.value: As for you, if you walk before Me as your father David walked, to do according to everything that I have commanded you, and keep My statutes and My ordinances,

column.name: text
column.value: then I will establish your royal throne as I covenanted with your father David, saying, ‘ ①You shall not lack a man to be ruler in Israel.’ ▷ ①Lit There shall not be cut off to you a man

column.name: text
column.value: “But if you turn away and abandon My statutes and My commandments which I have set before you, and go and serve other gods and worship them,

column.name: text
column.value: then I will uproot ①you from My land which I have given ②you, and this house which I have consecrated for My name I will cast out of My sight; and I will make it a proverb and an object of scorn among all peoples. ▷ ①As in ancient versions; MT them ②As in some ancient versions; MT them

column.name: text
column.value: As for this house, which was exalted, everyone who passes by it will be astonished and say, ‘Why has the LORD done these things to this land and to this house?’

column.name: text
column.value: And they will say, ‘Because they abandoned the LORD, the God of their fathers, who brought them from the land of Egypt, and they adopted other gods, and worshiped and served them; therefore He has brought all this adversity on them.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: His son Jehoshaphat then became king in his place, and he proved himself strong over Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: He placed troops in all the fortified cities of Judah, and placed garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim which his father Asa had captured.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD was with Jehoshaphat because he ①followed the example of his father David’s earlier days and did not seek the Baals, ▷ ①Lit walked in the earlier ways of his father

column.name: text
column.value: but sought the God of his father, ①followed His commandments, and did not act as Israel did. ▷ ①Lit walked in

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD established the kingdom in his ①control, and all Judah gave tribute to Jehoshaphat, and he had great riches and honor. ▷ ①Lit hand

column.name: text
column.value: ①He took great pride in the ways of the LORD, and again removed the high places and the ②Asherim from Judah. ▷ ①Lit his heart was high ②I.e., wooden symbols of a female deity (Asherah)

column.name: text
column.value: Then in the third year of his reign he sent his officials, Ben-hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;

column.name: text
column.value: and with them the Levites, Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, the Levites; and with them the priests Elishama and Jehoram.

column.name: text
column.value: They taught in Judah, having the Book of the Law of the LORD with them; and they went throughout the cities of Judah and taught among the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the dread of the LORD was on all the kingdoms of the lands which were around Judah, so that they did not make war against Jehoshaphat.

column.name: text
column.value: Some of the Philistines brought gifts and silver as tribute to Jehoshaphat; the Arabians also brought him flocks, 7,700 rams and 7,700 male goats.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jehoshaphat grew greater and greater, and he built fortresses and storage cities in Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: He had large supplies in the cities of Judah, and warriors, valiant mighty men, in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: This was their muster according to their fathers’ households: of Judah, commanders of thousands, Adnah was the commander, and with him three hundred thousand valiant warriors;

column.name: text
column.value: and next to him was Johanan the commander, and with him 280,000;

column.name: text
column.value: and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who volunteered for the LORD, and with him two hundred thousand valiant warriors;

column.name: text
column.value: and of Benjamin, Eliada, a valiant warrior, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield;

column.name: text
column.value: and next to him Jehozabad, and with him 180,000 equipped for war.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the ones who served the king, apart from those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jehoshaphat had great riches and honor; and he allied himself by marriage to Ahab.

column.name: text
column.value: Some years later he went down to visit Ahab at Samaria, and Ahab slaughtered many sheep and oxen for him and the people who were with him. And he incited him to go up against Ramoth-gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, “Will you go with me against Ramoth-gilead?” And he said to him, “I am as you are, and my people as your people, and we will be with you in the battle.”

column.name: text
column.value: However, Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please request the word of the LORD ①first.” ▷ ①Lit today

column.name: text
column.value: So the king of Israel assembled the ①prophets, four hundred men, and said to them, “Should we go to battle against Ramoth-gilead, or should I refrain?” And they said, “Go up, for God will hand it over to the king.” ▷ ①I.e., official prophets who at that time were false

column.name: text
column.value: But Jehoshaphat said, “Is there no longer a prophet of the LORD here, that we may inquire of him?”

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is still one man by whom we may inquire of the LORD, but I hate him, for he never prophesies anything good regarding me, but always bad. He is Micaiah the son of Imlah.” But Jehoshaphat said, “May the king not say so.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king of Israel summoned an officer and said, “Bring Micaiah son of Imlah quickly.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting, each on his throne, dressed in their robes, and they were sitting at the threshing floor at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made horns of iron for himself and said, “This is what the LORD says: ‘With these you will gore the Arameans until they are destroyed!’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: All the prophets were prophesying this as well, saying, “Go up to Ramoth-gilead and be successful, for the LORD will hand it over to the king.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the messenger who went to summon Micaiah spoke to him saying, “Behold, the words of the prophets are ①unanimously favorable to the king. So please let your word be like one of them, and speak favorably.” ▷ ①Lit of one mouth

column.name: text
column.value: But Micaiah said, “As the LORD lives, whatever my God says, I will speak it.”

column.name: text
column.value: When he came to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, should we go to battle against Ramoth-gilead, or should I refrain?” He said, “Go up and succeed, for they will be handed over to you!”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king said to him, “How many times must I make you swear that you will tell me nothing but the truth in the name of the LORD?”

column.name: text
column.value: So he said, “I saw all Israel Scattered on the mountains, Like sheep that have no shepherd. And the LORD said, ‘These people have no master. Each of them is to return to his house in peace.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Did I not tell you that he would not prophesy anything good regarding me, but only bad?”

column.name: text
column.value: And Micaiah said, “Therefore, hear the word of the LORD. I saw the LORD sitting on His throne, and all the ①angels of heaven standing on His right and on His left. ▷ ①Lit host

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said, ‘Who will ①entice Ahab king of Israel to go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead?’ And one spirit said this, while another said that. ▷ ①Or persuade

column.name: text
