column.name: text
column.value: All the temple servants and the sons of Solomon’s servants totaled 392.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these were the ones who came up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, ①Addan, and Immer, but they were not able to ②provide evidence of their fathers’ households and their ③descendants, whether they were of Israel: ▷ ①In Neh 7:61, Addon ②Lit tell ③Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: the sons of Delaiah, the sons of Tobiah, and the sons of Nekoda, 652.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of the priests: the sons of Hobaiah, the sons of Hakkoz, the sons of Barzillai, who took a wife from the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and he was called by their name.

column.name: text
column.value: These searched among their genealogical registration but they could not be located; so they were considered defiled and excluded from the priesthood.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①governor said to them that they were not to eat from the most holy things until a priest stood up with Urim and Thummim. ▷ ①Heb Tirshatha, a Persian title

column.name: text
column.value: The whole assembly together totaled 42,360,

column.name: text
column.value: besides their male and female slaves ①who totaled 7,337; and they had two hundred singing men and women. ▷ ①Lit these

column.name: text
column.value: Their horses numbered 736; their mules, 245;

column.name: text
column.value: their camels, 435; their donkeys, 6,720.

column.name: text
column.value: Some of the heads of fathers’ households, when they arrived at the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem, offered willingly for the house of God to erect it on its site.

column.name: text
column.value: According to their ability they gave to the treasury for the work sixty-one thousand gold drachmas, five thousand silver minas, and a hundred priestly ①garments. ▷ ①Or tunics

column.name: text
column.value: Now the priests and the Levites, some of the people, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants lived in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.

column.name: text
column.value: Then King Darius issued a decree, and a search was conducted in the ①archives, where the treasures were stored in Babylon. ▷ ①Lit house of the books

column.name: text
column.value: And in ①Ecbatana, in the fortress which is in the province of Media, a scroll was found; and the following was written in it: “Memorandum— ▷ ①Aram Achmetha

column.name: text
column.value: In the first year of King Cyrus, Cyrus the king issued a decree: ‘Concerning the house of God in Jerusalem, let the ①temple, the place where sacrifices are offered, be rebuilt, and let ②its foundations be repaired, its height being ③sixty cubits and its width sixty cubits, ▷ ①Lit house ②Or perhaps offerings by fire be offered ③About 90 ft. or 27 m

column.name: text
column.value: with three layers of large stones and ①one layer of timber. And the cost is to be paid from the ②royal treasury. ▷ ①As in LXX; Aram a layer of new timber ②Lit king’s house

column.name: text
column.value: Also the gold and silver utensils of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple in Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, are to be returned and ①brought to their places in the temple in Jerusalem; and you shall put them in the house of God.’ ▷ ①Lit go

column.name: text
column.value: “Now as for you, Tattenai, governor of the province beyond the Euphrates River, Shethar-bozenai, and ①your colleagues, the officials of the provinces beyond the River, ②stay away from there. ▷ ①Aram their ②Lit be distant

column.name: text
column.value: Leave that work on the house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews rebuild that house of God on its site.

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore, I issue a decree concerning what you are to do for these elders of Judah in the rebuilding of that house of God: the full cost is to be paid to those people from the royal treasury out of the taxes of the provinces beyond the Euphrates River, and that without interruption.

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever is needed, bulls, rams, and lambs for burnt offerings to the God of heaven, and wheat, salt, wine, and anointing oil, as the priests in Jerusalem order, it is to be given to them daily without fail,

column.name: text
column.value: so that they may offer acceptable sacrifices to the God of heaven and pray for the lives of the king and his sons.

column.name: text
column.value: And I issued a decree that any person who violates this decree, a timber shall be pulled out of his house and he shall be impaled on it; and his house shall be turned into a refuse heap on account of this.

column.name: text
column.value: May the God who has caused His name to dwell there overthrow any king or people who ①attempts to ②change it, so as to destroy that house of God in Jerusalem. I, Darius, have issued this decree; it is to be carried out with all diligence!” ▷ ①Lit sends his hand ②Or violate

column.name: text
column.value: Then Tattenai, the governor of the province beyond the Euphrates River, Shethar-bozenai, and their colleagues carried out the decree with all diligence, just as King Darius had ①ordered. ▷ ①Lit sent

column.name: text
column.value: And the elders of the Jews ①were successful in building through the prophecy of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And ②they finished building following the command of the God of Israel and the decree of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia. ▷ ①Lit were building and succeeding ②Lit built and finished

column.name: text
column.value: Now this ①temple was completed ②on the third day of the month Adar; it was the sixth year of the reign of King Darius. ▷ ①Lit house ②Lit until

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the ①exiles, celebrated the dedication of this house of God with joy. ▷ ①Lit sons of the exile

column.name: text
column.value: They offered for the dedication of this temple of God a hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs, and as a sin offering for all Israel twelve male goats, corresponding to the number of the tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they appointed the priests to their divisions and the Levites in their sections for the service of God in Jerusalem, as it is written in the Book of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: The exiles held the Passover on the fourteenth of the first month.

column.name: text
column.value: For the priests and the Levites had purified themselves together; all of them were pure. Then they slaughtered the Passover lambs for all the exiles, both for their brothers the priests and for themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Israel who returned from exile and all those who had separated themselves from the impurity of the nations of the land to join them, to seek the LORD God of Israel, ate the Passover.

column.name: text
column.value: And they held the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days with joy, because the LORD had made them happy, and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria toward them to ①encourage them in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel. ▷ ①Lit strengthen their hands

column.name: text
column.value: Now when these things had been completed, the officials approached me, saying, “The people of Israel and the priests and the Levites have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands, as to their abominations, those of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.

column.name: text
column.value: For they have taken some of their daughters as wives for themselves and for their sons, so that the holy ①race has intermingled with the peoples of the lands; indeed, the hands of the officials and the leaders have taken the lead in this unfaithfulness.” ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: When I heard about this matter, I tore my garment and my robe, and pulled out some of the hair from my head and my beard, and sat down ①appalled. ▷ ①Or shattered

column.name: text
column.value: Then everyone who was frightened by the words of the God of Israel on account of the unfaithfulness of the exiles gathered to me, and I sat ①appalled until the evening offering. ▷ ①Or shattered

column.name: text
column.value: But at the evening offering I stood up from my ①humiliation, even with my garment and my robe torn, and I bowed down on my knees and spread out my ②hands to the LORD my God; ▷ ①Or penitence ②Lit palms

column.name: text
column.value: and I said, “My God, I am ashamed and humiliated to lift up my face to You, my God, for our wrongful deeds have ①risen above our heads, and our guilt has grown even to the heavens. ▷ ①Lit increased over the head

column.name: text
column.value: Since the days of our fathers to this day we have been in great guilt, and because of our wrongful deeds we, our kings, and our priests have been handed over to the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, to plunder, and to ①open shame, as it is this day. ▷ ①Lit shame of faces

column.name: text
column.value: But now for a brief moment grace has been shown from the LORD our God, to leave us an escaped remnant and to give us a ①peg in His holy place, so that our God may enlighten our eyes and grant us a little reviving in our bondage. ▷ ①I.e., a foothold

column.name: text
column.value: For we are slaves; yet in our bondage our God has not abandoned us, but has extended favor to us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us reviving to erect the house of our God, to restore its ruins, and to give us a wall in Judah and Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: “And now, our God, what shall we say after this? For we have abandoned Your commandments,

column.name: text
column.value: which You have commanded by Your servants the prophets, saying, ‘The land which you are entering to possess is an unclean land with the uncleanness of the peoples of the lands, with their abominations which have filled it from end to end, and with their impurity.

column.name: text
column.value: So now do not give your daughters to their sons nor take their daughters for your sons, and never seek their peace or their prosperity, so that you may be strong and may eat the good things of the land, and leave it as an inheritance to your sons forever.’

column.name: text
column.value: And after everything that has come upon us for our evil deeds and our great guilt, since You our God have spared us by inflicting less than our wrongdoing deserves, and have given us such an escaped remnant as this,

column.name: text
column.value: shall we again break Your commandments and intermarry with the peoples ①who commit these abominations? Would You not be angry with us ②to the point of destruction, until there would be no remnant nor any who would escape? ▷ ①Lit of these abominations ②Lit to destroy

column.name: text
column.value: LORD God of Israel, You are righteous, for we have been left an escaped remnant, as it is this day; behold, we are before You in our guilt, for no one can stand before You because of this.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now these are the heads of their fathers’ households and the genealogical enrollment of those who went up with me from Babylon in the reign of King Artaxerxes:

column.name: text
column.value: of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom; of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel; of the sons of David, Hattush;

column.name: text
column.value: of the sons of Shecaniah who was of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah, and with him 150 males who were in the genealogical list;

column.name: text
column.value: of the sons of Pahath-moab, Eliehoenai the son of Zerahiah and two hundred males with him;

column.name: text
column.value: of the sons of ①Zattu, Shecaniah, the son of Jahaziel and three hundred males with him; ▷ ①As in LXX; MT omits Zattu

column.name: text
column.value: and of the sons of Adin, Ebed the son of Jonathan and fifty males with him;

column.name: text
column.value: and of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah and seventy males with him;

column.name: text
column.value: and of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Michael and eighty males with him;

column.name: text
column.value: of the sons of Joab, Obadiah the son of Jehiel and 218 males with him;

column.name: text
column.value: and of the sons of ①Bani, Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah and 160 males with him; ▷ ①As in LXX; MT omits Bani

column.name: text
column.value: and of the sons of Bebai, Zechariah the son of Bebai and twenty-eight males with him;

column.name: text
column.value: and of the sons of Azgad, Johanan the son of Hakkatan and 110 males with him;

column.name: text
column.value: and of the sons of Adonikam, the last ones, these being their names: Eliphelet, ①Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and sixty males with them; ▷ ①Or Jeuel

column.name: text
column.value: and of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and ①Zabbud, and seventy males with ②them. ▷ ①Or Zakkur ②Or him

column.name: text
column.value: Now I assembled them at the river that runs to Ahava, where we camped for three days; and when I paid close attention to the people and the priests, I did not find any Levites there.

column.name: text
column.value: So I sent for Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam, ①leading men, and for Joiarib and Elnathan, teachers. ▷ ①Lit heads

column.name: text
column.value: And I sent them to Iddo the ①leading man at the place called Casiphia; and I ②told them what to say to ③Iddo and his brothers, the temple servants at the place Casiphia, that is, to bring ministers to us for the house of our God. ▷ ①Lit head ②Lit put words in their mouth to say ③As in LXX; MT Iddo his brother

column.name: text
column.value: And as the good hand of our God was upon us, they brought us a man of insight from the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel, namely Sherebiah, and his sons and brothers, eighteen men;

column.name: text
column.value: and Hashabiah and ①Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, with his brothers and their sons, twenty men; ▷ ①As in LXX; MT with him Jeshaiah

column.name: text
column.value: and 220 of the temple servants, whom David and the officials had provided for the service of the Levites, all of them designated by name.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I proclaimed a fast there at the river of Ahava, to humble ourselves before our God, to seek from Him a ①safe journey for us, our little ones, and all our possessions. ▷ ①Lit smooth way

column.name: text
column.value: For I was ashamed to request from the king troops and horsemen to ①protect us from the enemy on the way, because we had said to the king, “The hand of our God is ②favorably disposed to all who seek Him, but His power and His anger are against all those who abandon Him.” ▷ ①Lit help ②Lit upon all...for good

column.name: text
column.value: So we fasted and sought our God concerning this matter, and He ①listened to our pleading. ▷ ①Lit was entreated by us

column.name: text
column.value: Then I selected twelve of the leading priests: Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and with them ten of their brothers;

column.name: text
column.value: and I weighed out to them the silver, the gold, and the utensils, the offering for the house of our God which the king, his counselors, his officials, and all Israel who were present there had contributed.

column.name: text
column.value: So I weighed into their hands ①650 talents of silver, and silver utensils worth ②a hundred talents, and a hundred gold talents, ▷ ①About 24 tons or 22 metric tons ②About 3.75 tons or 3.4 metric tons

column.name: text
column.value: and twenty gold bowls worth a thousand ①darics, and two utensils of fine shiny bronze, precious as gold. ▷ ①A coin weighing about 0.25 oz. or 7 gm

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said to them, “You are holy to the LORD, and the utensils are holy; and the silver and the gold are a ①voluntary offering to the LORD God of your fathers. ▷ ①Or freewill offering

column.name: text
column.value: Watch and keep them until you weigh them before the leading priests, the Levites, and the leaders of the fathers’ households of Israel in Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the priests and the Levites accepted the weight of silver and gold and the utensils, to bring them to Jerusalem to the house of our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then we journeyed from the river Ahava on the twelfth of the first month to go to Jerusalem; and the hand of our God was upon us, and He rescued us from the hand of the enemy and the ambushes by the road.

column.name: text
column.value: So we came to Jerusalem and remained there for three days.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the fourth day the silver, the gold, and the utensils were weighed out in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest, and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them were the Levites, Jozabad the son of Jeshua and Noadiah the son of Binnui.

column.name: text
column.value: A notation was made for everything by number and weight, and all the weight was recorded at that time.

column.name: text
column.value: The exiles who had come from the captivity offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel: twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, twelve male goats for a sin offering, all as a burnt offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they delivered the king’s edicts to the king’s satraps and the governors in the provinces beyond the Euphrates River, and they supported the people and the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra went up to Jerusalem; Ezra was the son of Seraiah, son of Azariah, son of Hilkiah,

column.name: text
column.value: son of Shallum, son of Zadok, son of Ahitub,

column.name: text
column.value: son of Amariah, son of Azariah, son of Meraioth,

column.name: text
column.value: son of Zerahiah, son of Uzzi, son of Bukki,

column.name: text
column.value: son of Abishua, son of Phinehas, son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the chief priest.

column.name: text
column.value: So this Ezra went up from Babylon, and he was a scribe skilled in the Law of Moses, which the LORD God of Israel had given; and the king granted him all ①he requested because the hand of the LORD his God was upon him. ▷ ①Lit his request

column.name: text
column.value: Some of the sons of Israel and some of the priests, the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants went up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of King Artaxerxes.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.

column.name: text
column.value: For on the first day of the first month he began to go up from Babylon; and on the first of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem, because the good hand of his God was upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: For Ezra had ①firmly resolved to study the Law of the LORD and to practice it, and to teach His statutes and ordinances in Israel. ▷ ①Lit set his heart

column.name: text
column.value: Now this is the copy of the letter which King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest, the scribe, ①learned in the words of the commandments of the LORD and His statutes to Israel: ▷ ①Or the scribe of

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①Artaxerxes, king of kings, to Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven, ②perfect peace. And now ▷ ①Ch 7:12-26 is in Aram ②Or perhaps it is determined

column.name: text
column.value: I have issued a decree that any of the people of Israel and their priests and the Levites in my kingdom who are willing to go to Jerusalem, may go with you.

column.name: text
column.value: Since you are sent ①on the part of the king and his seven advisers to inquire about Judah and Jerusalem according to the Law of your God which is in your hand, ▷ ①Lit from before

column.name: text
column.value: and to bring the silver and gold, which the king and his advisers have voluntarily given to the God of Israel, whose dwelling is in Jerusalem,

column.name: text
column.value: with all the silver and gold which you find in the entire province of Babylon, along with the ①voluntary offering of the people and of the priests, who offered willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem; ▷ ①Or freewill offering

column.name: text
column.value: with this money, therefore, you shall diligently buy bulls, rams, and lambs, with their grain offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them on the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever seems good to you and your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and gold, you may do according to the will of your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Also the utensils which are given to you for the service of the house of your God, deliver in full before the God of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the needs of the house of your God, for which it may be incumbent upon you to provide, provide for them from the royal treasury.

column.name: text
column.value: “I myself, King Artaxerxes, issue a decree to all the treasurers who are in the provinces beyond the Euphrates River, that whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven, may require of you, it shall be done diligently,

column.name: text
column.value: up to ①a hundred talents of silver, ②a hundred kors of wheat, ③a hundred baths of wine, ④a hundred baths of anointing oil, and salt ⑤as needed. ▷ ①About 3.75 tons or 3.4 metric tons ②About 770 cubic feet or 22 cubic meters ③About 600 gallons or 2,271 liters ④About 600 gallons or 2,271 liters ⑤Lit without instruction

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever is ①commanded by the God of heaven, it shall be done with zeal for the house of the God of heaven, so that there will not be wrath against the kingdom of the king and his sons. ▷ ①Lit from the command of

column.name: text
column.value: We also inform you that it is not allowed to impose tax, tribute, or toll on any of the priests, Levites, singers, doorkeepers, temple servants, or other servants of this house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: “And you, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God which is in your hand, appoint magistrates and judges so that they may judge all the people who are in the province beyond the Euphrates River, that is, all those who know the laws of your God; and you may teach anyone who is ignorant of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever does not comply with the Law of your God and the law of the king, judgment is to be executed upon him strictly, whether for death or for banishment, or for ①confiscation of property or for imprisonment.” ▷ ①Or fines

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed be the LORD, the God of our fathers, who has put such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to glorify the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem,

column.name: text
column.value: and has extended favor to me before the king and his counselors and before all the king’s mighty officials. So I was strengthened according to the hand of the LORD my God that was upon me, and I gathered ①leading men from Israel to go up with me. ▷ ①Lit heads

column.name: text
column.value: Now while Ezra was praying and making confession, weeping and prostrating himself before the house of God, a very large assembly, men, women, and children, gathered to him from Israel; for the people wept greatly.

column.name: text
column.value: Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, said to Ezra, “We have been unfaithful to our God and have ①married foreign women from the peoples of the land; yet now there is hope for Israel in spite of this. ▷ ①Lit given dwelling to

column.name: text
column.value: So now let’s make a covenant with our God to send away all the wives and ①their children, following the counsel of ②my lord and of those who fear the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the Law. ▷ ①Lit that which is born of them ②Or the Lord

column.name: text
column.value: Arise! For this matter is ①your responsibility, but we will be with you; be courageous and act.” ▷ ①Lit upon you

column.name: text
column.value: Then Ezra stood and made the leading priests, the Levites, and all Israel take an oath that they would do according to this ①proposal; so they took the oath. ▷ ①Lit word; or thing

column.name: text
column.value: Then Ezra rose from before the house of God and went into the chamber of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib. Although he went there, he did not eat bread nor drink water, because he was mourning over the unfaithfulness of the exiles.

column.name: text
column.value: So they made a proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the exiles, that they were to assemble at Jerusalem,

column.name: text
column.value: and that whoever did not come within three days, in accordance with the counsel of the leaders and the elders, all his property would be forfeited, and he himself would be excluded from the assembly of the exiles.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the men of Judah and Benjamin assembled at Jerusalem within the three days. It was the ninth month on the twentieth of the month, and all the people sat in the public square before the house of God, trembling because of this matter and the heavy rain.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have been unfaithful and have married foreign wives, adding to the guilt of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, make confession to the LORD God of your fathers and do His will; and separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign wives.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the assembly replied with a loud voice, “It is ①our duty to do exactly as you have said! ▷ ①Lit upon us

column.name: text
column.value: However, there are many people, it is the rainy season, and we are not able to stand in the open. Nor can the task be done in one or two days, because we have done a great wrong in this matter.

column.name: text
column.value: Please let our leaders ①represent all the assembly and have all those in our cities who have married foreign wives come at appointed times, together with the elders and judges of each city, until the fierce anger of our God on account of this matter is turned away from us.” ▷ ①Lit stand for

column.name: text
column.value: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah ①opposed this, with Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite supporting them. ▷ ①Lit stood against

column.name: text
column.value: But the exiles did so. And ①Ezra the priest selected men who were the heads of fathers’ households for each of their father’s households, all of them by name. So they ②convened on the first day of the tenth month to investigate the matter. ▷ ①Heb there were set apart Ezra the priest, men... ②Lit sat

column.name: text
column.value: And they finished investigating all the men who had married foreign wives by the first day of the first month.

column.name: text
column.value: Now among the sons of the priests who had married foreign wives were found of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.

column.name: text
column.value: They ①pledged to send away their wives, and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt. ▷ ①Lit gave their hand

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Immer, there were Hanani and Zebadiah;

column.name: text
column.value: and of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah;

column.name: text
column.value: and of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the Levites there were Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (that is, Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the singers there was Eliashib; and of the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Israel, of the sons of Parosh there were Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah;

column.name: text
column.value: and of the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah;

column.name: text
column.value: and of the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza;

column.name: text
column.value: and of the sons of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai;

column.name: text
column.value: and of the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch and Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth;

column.name: text
column.value: and of the sons of Pahath-moab: Adna and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh;

column.name: text
column.value: and of the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

column.name: text
column.value: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah;

column.name: text
column.value: of the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei;

column.name: text
column.value: of the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,

column.name: text
column.value: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,

column.name: text
column.value: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

column.name: text
column.value: Mattaniah, Mattenai, Jaasu,

column.name: text
column.value: Bani, Binnui, Shimei,

column.name: text
column.value: Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,

column.name: text
column.value: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

column.name: text
column.value: Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,

column.name: text
column.value: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Nebo there were Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah.

column.name: text
column.value: All of these men had married foreign wives, and some of them had wives by whom they had children.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Eliashib the high priest arose with his brothers the priests and built the Sheep Gate; they consecrated it and installed its doors. They consecrated ①the wall to the Tower of the Hundred and the Tower of Hananel. ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: And next to him the men of Jericho built, and next to ①them Zaccur the son of Imri built. ▷ ①Lit him

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of Hassenaah built the Fish Gate; they laid its beams and installed its doors with its bolts and bars.

column.name: text
column.value: Next to them Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz made repairs. And next to ①him Meshullam the son of Berechiah the son of Meshezabel made repairs. And next to ②him Zadok the son of Baana also made repairs. ▷ ①Lit them ②Lit them

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, next to ①him the Tekoites made repairs, but their nobles did not ②support the work of their masters. ▷ ①Lit them ②Lit bring their neck to

column.name: text
column.value: Now Joiada the son of Paseah and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah repaired the Ancient Gate; they laid its beams and installed its doors with its bolts and its bars.

column.name: text
column.value: Next to them Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah, ①also made repairs for the official seat of the governor of the province beyond the Euphrates River. ▷ ①Or which was under the jurisdiction of the governor of the province beyond the River, also made repairs

column.name: text
column.value: Next to him Uzziel the son of Harhaiah of the goldsmiths made repairs. And next to him Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made repairs, and they restored Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.

column.name: text
column.value: And next to them Rephaiah the son of Hur, the official of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs.

column.name: text
column.value: Next to them Jedaiah the son of Harumaph made repairs opposite his house. And next to him Hattush the son of Hashabneiah made repairs.

column.name: text
column.value: Malchijah the son of Harim and Hasshub the son of Pahath-moab repaired another section and the Tower of Furnaces.

column.name: text
column.value: Next to him Shallum the son of Hallohesh, the official of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs, he and his daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the Valley Gate. They built it and installed its doors with its bolts and its bars, and a ①thousand cubits of the wall to the Dung Gate. ▷ ①About 1,500 ft. or 457 m

column.name: text
column.value: And Malchijah the son of Rechab, the official of the district of Beth-haccherem repaired the Dung Gate. He built it and installed its doors with its bolts and its bars.

column.name: text
column.value: Shallum the son of Col-hozeh, the official of the district of Mizpah, repaired the Fountain Gate. He built it, made a roof for it, and installed its doors with its bolts and its bars, and the wall of the Pool of Shelah at the king’s garden as far as the steps that descend from the city of David.

column.name: text
column.value: After him Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, official of half the district of Beth-zur, made repairs as far as a point opposite the tombs of David, and as far as the ①artificial pool and the house of the mighty men. ▷ ①Lit constructed

column.name: text
column.value: After him the Levites carried out repairs under Rehum the son of Bani. Next to him Hashabiah, the official of half the district of Keilah, carried out repairs for his district.

column.name: text
column.value: After him their brothers carried out repairs under Bavvai the son of Henadad, official of the other half of the district of Keilah.

column.name: text
column.value: And next to him Ezer the son of Jeshua, the official of Mizpah, repaired ①another section in front of the ascent of the armory at the Angle. ▷ ①Lit a second measure, and so in vv 20, 21, 24, 30

column.name: text
column.value: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai zealously repaired another section, from the Angle to the doorway of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

column.name: text
column.value: After him Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz repaired another section, from the doorway of Eliashib’s house even as far as the end of ①his house. ▷ ①Lit Eliashib’s

column.name: text
column.value: And after him the priests, the men of the ①vicinity, carried out repairs. ▷ ①I.e., the lower Jordan Valley

column.name: text
column.value: After ①them Benjamin and Hasshub carried out repairs in front of their house. After ②them Azariah the son of Maaseiah, son of Ananiah, carried out repairs beside his house. ▷ ①Lit him ②Lit him

column.name: text
column.value: After him Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another section, from the house of Azariah as far as the Angle and as far as the corner.

column.name: text
column.value: Palal the son of Uzai made repairs in front of the Angle and the tower projecting from the upper house of the king, which is by the courtyard of the guard. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh made repairs.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the temple servants living in Ophel made repairs as far as the front of the Water Gate toward the east and the projecting tower.

column.name: text
column.value: After ①them the Tekoites repaired another section in front of the great projecting tower and as far as the wall of Ophel. ▷ ①Lit him

column.name: text
column.value: Above the Horse Gate the priests carried out repairs, each in front of his house.

column.name: text
column.value: After ①them Zadok the son of Immer carried out repairs in front of his house. And after him Shemaiah the son of Shecaniah, the keeper of the East Gate, carried out repairs. ▷ ①Lit him

column.name: text
column.value: After him Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another section. After him Meshullam the son of Berechiah carried out repairs in front of his own quarters.

column.name: text
column.value: After him Malchijah, ①one of the goldsmiths, carried out repairs as far as the house of the temple servants and of the merchants, in front of the ②Inspection Gate and as far as the upper room of the corner. ▷ ①Lit son of ②Or Numbering

column.name: text
column.value: And between the upper room of the corner and the Sheep Gate the goldsmiths and the merchants carried out repairs.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came about in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, that wine was before him, and I picked up the wine and gave it to the king. Now I had not been sad in his presence.

column.name: text
column.value: So the king said to me, “Why is your face sad, though you are not ill? This is nothing but sadness of heart.” Then I was very much afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to the king, “May the king live forever. Why should my face not be sad when the city, the ①site of my fathers’ tombs, is desolate and its gates have been consumed by fire?” ▷ ①Lit house

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king said to me, “ ①What would you request?” So I prayed to the God of heaven. ▷ ①Lit For what is this you

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, and if your servant has found favor before you, I request that you send me to Judah, to the city of my fathers’ tombs, that I may rebuild it.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king said to me, with the queen sitting beside him, “How long will your journey be, and when will you return?” So it pleased the king to send me, and I gave him a definite time.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, let letters be given me for the governors of the provinces beyond the River, so that they will allow me to pass through until I come to Judah,

column.name: text
column.value: and a letter to Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, so that he will give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel which is by the ①temple, for the wall of the city, and for the house to which I will go.” And the king granted them to me because the good hand of my God was on me. ▷ ①Lit house

column.name: text
column.value: Then I came to the governors of the provinces beyond the Euphrates River and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent with me officers of the army and horsemen.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite ①official heard about it, it was very displeasing to them that someone had come to seek the welfare of the sons of Israel. ▷ ①Lit servant

column.name: text
column.value: So I came to Jerusalem and was there for three days.

column.name: text
column.value: And I got up in the night, I and a few men with me. I did not tell anyone what my God was putting into my ①mind to do for Jerusalem, and there was no animal with me except the animal on which I was riding. ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: So I went out at night by the Valley Gate in the direction of the Dragon’s Spring and on to the Dung Gate, and I was inspecting the walls of Jerusalem which were broken down and its gates which had been consumed by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I passed on to the Fountain Gate and the King’s Pool, but there was no place for ①my mount to pass. ▷ ①Lit the animal under me

column.name: text
column.value: So I was going up at night by the ravine and inspecting the wall. Then I entered the Valley Gate again and returned.

column.name: text
column.value: However, the officials did not know where I had gone or what I was doing; nor had I as yet told the Jews, the priests, the nobles, the officials, or the rest who were doing the work.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said to them, “You see the bad situation we are in, that Jerusalem is desolate and its gates have been burned by fire. Come, let’s rebuild the wall of Jerusalem so that we will no longer be a disgrace.”

column.name: text
column.value: And I told them how the hand of my God had been favorable to me and also about the king’s words which he had spoken to me. Then they said, “Let’s arise and build.” So they put their hands to the good work.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite ①official, and Geshem the Arab heard about it, they mocked us and despised us, and said, “What is this thing that you are doing? Are you rebelling against the king?” ▷ ①Lit servant

column.name: text
column.value: So I answered them and said to them, “The God of heaven will make us successful; therefore we His servants will arise and build, but you have no part, right, or memorial in Jerusalem.”

column.name: text
column.value: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah. Now it happened in the month Chislev, in the twentieth year, while I was in Susa the ①capitol, ▷ ①Or acropolis

column.name: text
column.value: that Hanani, one of my brothers, ①and some men from Judah came; and I asked them about the Jews who had escaped ②and had survived the captivity, and about Jerusalem. ▷ ①Lit he and men ②Lit who survived

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to me, “The remnant there in the province who survived the captivity are in great distress and disgrace, and the wall of Jerusalem is broken down and its gates have been burned with fire.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now when I heard these words, I sat down and wept and mourned for days; and I was fasting and praying before the God of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: I said, “Please, LORD God of heaven, the great and awesome God, who keeps the covenant and faithfulness for those who love Him and keep His commandments:

column.name: text
column.value: let Your ear now be attentive and Your eyes open, to hear the prayer of Your servant which I am praying before You now, day and night, on behalf of the sons of Israel Your servants, confessing the sins of the sons of Israel which we have committed against You; I and my father’s house have sinned.

column.name: text
column.value: We have acted very corruptly against You and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the ordinances which You commanded Your servant Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember, please, the word which You commanded Your servant Moses, saying, ‘If you are unfaithful, I will scatter you among the peoples;

column.name: text
column.value: but if you return to Me and keep My commandments and do them, though those of you who have been scattered were in the most remote part of the heavens, I will gather them from there and bring them to the place where I have chosen to have My name dwell.’

column.name: text
column.value: They are Your servants and Your people whom You redeemed by Your great power and by Your strong hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Please, Lord, may Your ear be attentive to the prayer of Your servant and the prayer of Your servants who delight to ①revere Your name, and please make Your servant successful today and grant him mercy before this man.” Now I was the cupbearer to the king. ▷ ①Or fear

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was a great outcry of the people and of their wives against their Jewish brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: For there were those who said, “We, our sons, and our daughters are many; therefore let’s get grain so that we may eat and live.”

column.name: text
column.value: And there were others who said, “We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our houses so that we might get grain because of the famine.”

column.name: text
column.value: There also were those who said, “We have borrowed money for the king’s tax on our fields and our vineyards.

column.name: text
column.value: And now our flesh is like the flesh of our brothers, our children like their children. Yet behold, we are forcing our sons and our daughters to be slaves, and some of our daughters are forced into bondage already, and ①we are helpless because our fields and vineyards belong to others.” ▷ ①Lit there is no power in our hands

column.name: text
column.value: Then I was very angry when I heard their outcry and these words.

column.name: text
column.value: So I thought it over and contended with the nobles and the leading people, and said to them, “You are lending at interest, each to his brother!” Therefore, I held a great assembly against them.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to them, “We, according to our ability, have ①redeemed our Jewish brothers who were sold to the nations; now would you even sell your brothers that they may be sold to us?” Then they were silent and could not find a word to say. ▷ ①Lit purchased

column.name: text
column.value: So I said, “The thing which you are doing is not good; should you not walk in the fear of our God because of the taunting of the nations, our enemies?

column.name: text
column.value: And likewise I, my brothers, and my servants are lending them money and grain. Please, let’s ①do without this interest. ▷ ①Lit abandon

column.name: text
column.value: Please, give back to them this very day their fields, their vineyards, their olive groves, and their houses, as well as the hundredth part of the money and of the grain, the new wine, and the oil that you are charging as interest from them.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then they said, “We will give it back and will require nothing from them; we will do exactly as you say.” So I called the priests and made them take an oath to act in accordance with this ①promise. ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: I also shook out the ①front of my garment and said, “So may God shake out every person from his house and from his possessions who does not keep this ②promise; just so may he be shaken out and emptied.” And all the assembly said, “Amen!” And they praised the LORD. Then the people acted in accordance with this ③promise. ▷ ①Lit fold ②Lit word ③Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore, since the day that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year to the thirty-second year of King Artaxerxes, for twelve years, neither I nor my kinsmen have eaten the governor’s food allowance.

column.name: text
column.value: But the previous governors who were before me ①laid burdens on the people and took from them bread and wine besides forty shekels of silver; even their servants domineered the people. But I did not do so because of my fear of God. ▷ ①Lit made heavy

column.name: text
column.value: I also ①applied myself to the work on this wall; we did not buy any land, and all my servants were gathered there for the work. ▷ ①Or held fast

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, there were at my table 150 Jews and officials, besides those who came to us from the nations that were around us.

column.name: text
column.value: Now that which was prepared for each day was one ox and six choice sheep; also birds were prepared for me, and every ten days all sorts of wine were provided in abundance. Yet for all this I did not request the governor’s food allowance, because the forced labor was heavy on this people.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember me, my God, for good, in return for all that I have done for this people.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when it was reported to Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arab, and to the rest of our enemies that I had rebuilt the wall, and that no breach was left in it, although at that time I had not installed the doors in the gates,

column.name: text
column.value: Sanballat and Geshem sent a message to me, saying, “Come, let’s meet together ①at Chephirim in the plain of Ono.” But they were plotting to ②harm me. ▷ ①LXX in the villages in ②Lit do evil to me

column.name: text
column.value: So I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work and am unable to come down. Why should the work stop while I leave it and come down to you?”

column.name: text
column.value: Then they sent messages to me four times worded in this way, and I answered them with the same wording.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me in the same way a fifth time with an open letter in his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: In it was written: “It is reported among the nations, and ①Gashmu says, that you and the Jews intend to rebel; for that reason you are rebuilding the wall. And you are to be their king, according to these reports. ▷ ①In v 1 and elsewhere, Geshem

column.name: text
column.value: You have also appointed prophets to proclaim in Jerusalem concerning ①you, ‘A king is in Judah!’ And now it will be reported to the king according to these reports. So come now, let’s consult together.” ▷ ①Lit you, saying

column.name: text
column.value: Then I sent a message to him saying, “Nothing like these things that you are saying has been done, but you are inventing them ①in your own mind.” ▷ ①Lit from your heart

column.name: text
column.value: For all of them were trying to frighten us, ①thinking, “ ②They will become discouraged with the work and it will not be done.” But now, God, strengthen my hands. ▷ ①Lit saying, ②Lit Their hands will go slack from

column.name: text
column.value: When I entered the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah, son of Mehetabel, who was confined at home, he said, “Let’s meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let’s close the doors of the temple, for they are coming to kill you, and they are coming to kill you at night.”

column.name: text
column.value: But I said, “Should a man like me flee? And who is there like me who would go into the temple ①to save his own life? I will not go in.” ▷ ①Lit and live

column.name: text
column.value: Then I realized ①that God certainly had not sent him, but he uttered his prophecy against me because Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him. ▷ ①Lit and behold God had not

column.name: text
column.value: He was hired for this reason, that I would become frightened and act accordingly and sin, so that they might have an evil report in order that they could taunt me.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat in accordance with these works of theirs, and also Noadiah the prophetess and the rest of the prophets, who were trying to frighten me.

column.name: text
column.value: So the wall was completed on the twenty-fifth of the month Elul, in fifty-two days.

column.name: text
column.value: When all our enemies heard about it, and all the nations surrounding us saw it, they ①lost their confidence; for they realized that this work had been accomplished ②with the help of our God. ▷ ①Lit fell exceedingly in their own eyes ②Lit from our God

column.name: text
column.value: Also in those days many letters went from the nobles of Judah to Tobiah, and ①Tobiah’s letters came to them. ▷ ①Lit what was Tobiah’s came

column.name: text
column.value: For many in Judah were bound by oath to him because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah, and his son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, they were speaking about his good deeds in my presence, and were reporting my words to him. Then Tobiah sent letters to frighten me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke in the presence of his brothers and the ①wealthy people of Samaria and said, “What are these feeble Jews doing? Are they going to restore the temple for themselves? Can they offer sacrifices? Can they finish it in a day? Can they revive the stones from the heaps of rubble, even the burned ones?” ▷ ①Or army

column.name: text
column.value: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was near him, and he said, “Even what they are building—if a fox were to ①jump on it, it would break their stone wall down!” ▷ ①Lit go up

column.name: text
column.value: Hear, O our God, how we are an object of contempt! Return their taunting on their own heads, and turn them into plunder in a land of captivity.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not ①forgive their guilt and do not let their sin be wiped out before You, for they have ②demoralized the builders. ▷ ①Lit cover ②Lit offended against

column.name: text
column.value: So we built the wall, and the entire wall was joined together to half its height, for the people had a ①mind to work. ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: ①Now when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the ②repair of the walls of Jerusalem went ③on, and that the breaches began to be closed, they were very angry. ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: in Heb ②Lit healing ③Lit up

column.name: text
column.value: So all of them conspired together to come to fight against Jerusalem and to cause confusion in it.

column.name: text
column.value: But we prayed to our God, and because of them we set up a guard against them day and night.

column.name: text
column.value: And so ①in Judah it was said: “The strength of the burden bearers is failing, Yet there is much rubble; And we ourselves are unable To rebuild the wall.” ▷ ①Lit Judah said

column.name: text
column.value: And our enemies said, “They will not know or see until we come among them, kill them, and put a stop to the work.”

column.name: text
column.value: When the Jews who lived near them came and told us ten times, “ ①They will come up against us from every place where you may turn,” ▷ ①As in LXX; MT omits they...up

column.name: text
column.value: then I stationed men in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, the exposed places, and I stationed the people in families with their swords, spears, and bows.

column.name: text
column.value: When I saw their fear, I stood and said to the nobles, the officials, and the rest of the people: “Do not be afraid of them; remember the Lord who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your houses.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now when our enemies heard that it was known to us, and that God had frustrated their plan, then all of us returned to the wall, each one to his work.

column.name: text
column.value: And from that day on, half of my servants carried on the work while half of them kept hold of the spears, the shields, the bows, and the coats of mail; and the captains were behind all the house of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who were rebuilding the wall and those who carried burdens carried with one hand doing the work, and the other keeping hold of a weapon.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the builders, each wore his sword strapped to his waist as he built, while ①the trumpeter stood near me. ▷ ①Lit he who sounded the trumpet

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to the nobles, the officials, and the rest of the people, “The work is great and extensive, and we are separated on the wall far from one another.

column.name: text
column.value: At whatever place you hear the sound of the trumpet, assemble to us there. Our God will fight for us.”

column.name: text
column.value: So we carried on the work with half of them holding spears from ①dawn until the stars ②appeared. ▷ ①Lit rising of the dawn ②Lit came out

column.name: text
column.value: At that time I also said to the people, “Each man with his servant shall spend the night within Jerusalem, so that they may be a guard for us by night and a laborer by day.”

column.name: text
column.value: So neither I, my brothers, my servants, nor the men of the guard who followed me—none of us ①removed our clothes; each took his weapon even to the water. ▷ ①I.e., for washing or resting

column.name: text
column.value: When the prophets, Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews who were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, who was over them,

column.name: text
column.value: then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Jeshua the son of Jozadak rose up and began to rebuild the house of God which is in Jerusalem; and the prophets of God were with them, supporting them.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time Tattenai, the governor of the province beyond the Euphrates River, and Shethar-bozenai and their colleagues came to them and spoke to them as follows: “Who issued you a decree to rebuild this ①temple and to finish this structure?” ▷ ①Lit house, and so in vv 9, 11, 12

column.name: text
column.value: Then we told them accordingly what the names of the men were who were reconstructing this building.

column.name: text
column.value: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, and they did not stop them until the report could reach Darius, and then the decree concerning it could be sent back.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the copy of the letter that Tattenai, the governor of the province beyond the Euphrates River, and Shethar-bozenai and his colleagues the officials, who were beyond the River, sent to Darius the king.

column.name: text
column.value: They sent the report to him in which it was written as follows: “To Darius the king, all peace.

column.name: text
column.value: May it be known to the king that we have gone to the province of Judah, to the house of the great God which is being built with large stones, and ①beams are being laid in the walls; and this work is being performed with great care and is succeeding in their hands. ▷ ①Lit timber is

column.name: text
column.value: Then we asked those elders and said to them as follows: ‘Who issued you a decree to rebuild this temple and to finish this structure?’

column.name: text
column.value: We also asked them their names so as to inform you, in order that we might write down the names of the men who were ①in charge. ▷ ①Lit at their heads

column.name: text
column.value: So they ①answered us as follows, saying, ‘We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and are rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and finished. ▷ ①Lit returned us the word

column.name: text
column.value: But because our fathers provoked the God of heaven to wrath, He handed them over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this temple and deported the people to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: However, in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, King Cyrus issued a decree to rebuild this house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Also the gold and silver utensils of the house of God which Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the temple in Jerusalem and brought them to the temple of Babylon, King Cyrus took them from the temple of Babylon and they were given to one whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had appointed governor.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, “Take these utensils, go and deposit them in the temple in Jerusalem, and have the house of God rebuilt in its place.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then that Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of the house of God in Jerusalem; and from then until now it has been under construction and it is not yet completed.’

column.name: text
column.value: And now, if it pleases the king, let a search be conducted in the king’s treasure house, which is there in Babylon, as to whether a decree was issued by King Cyrus to rebuild this house of God in Jerusalem; and let the king send to us his decision concerning this matter.”

column.name: text
column.value: ①Now on the sealed document were the names of: Nehemiah the ②governor, the son of Hacaliah, and Zedekiah, ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,

column.name: text
column.value: Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah,

column.name: text
column.value: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,

column.name: text
column.value: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the temple servants, and all those who had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands to the Law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, all those who had knowledge and understanding,

column.name: text
column.value: are joining with their kinsmen, their nobles, and are ①taking on themselves a curse and an oath to walk in God’s Law, which was given through Moses, God’s servant, and to keep and to ②comply with all the commandments of ③GOD our Lord, and His ordinances and statutes; ▷ ①Lit entering into a ②Lit do all ③Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: and that we will not give our daughters to the peoples of the land or take their daughters for our sons.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the peoples of the land who bring wares or any grain on the Sabbath day to sell, we will not ①buy from them on the Sabbath or on any holy day; and we will forgo the crops of the seventh year and ②every debt. ▷ ①Lit take ②Lit the loan from every hand

column.name: text
column.value: We also imposed ①on ourselves the obligation to contribute yearly a third of a shekel for the service of the house of our God: ▷ ①Lit commandments on us

column.name: text
column.value: for the showbread, for the continual grain offering, for the continual burnt offering, the Sabbaths, the new moons, for the appointed times, for the holy things, and for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and all the work of the house of our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise we cast lots for the supply of wood among the priests, the Levites, and the people so that they could bring it to the house of our God, according to our fathers’ households, at set times annually, to burn on the altar of the LORD our God, as it is written in the Law;

column.name: text
column.value: and so that they could bring the first fruits of our ground and the first fruits of all the fruit of every tree to the house of the LORD annually,

column.name: text
column.value: and bring to the house of our God the firstborn of our sons and of our cattle, and the firstborn of our herds and our flocks as it is written in the Law, for the priests who are ministering in the house of our God.

column.name: text
column.value: We will also bring the first of our ①dough, our contributions, the fruit of every tree, the new wine, and the oil to the priests at the chambers of the house of our God, and the tithe of our ground to the Levites, for the Levites are they who receive the tithes in all the rural towns. ▷ ①Or coarse meal

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest, the son of Aaron, shall be with the Levites when the Levites receive tithes, and the Levites shall bring up the tenth of the tithes to the house of our God, to the chambers of the storehouse.

column.name: text
column.value: For the sons of Israel and the sons of Levi shall bring the contribution of the grain, the new wine, and the oil to the chambers; the utensils of the sanctuary, the priests who are ministering, the gatekeepers, and the singers are there. So we will not ①neglect the house of our God. ▷ ①Lit abandon

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people gathered as one person at the public square which was in front of the Water Gate, and they ①asked Ezra the scribe to bring the Book of the Law of Moses which the LORD had ②given to Israel. ▷ ①Lit said to ②Lit commanded

column.name: text
column.value: Then Ezra the priest brought the Law before the assembly of men, women, and all who could listen with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.

column.name: text
column.value: And he read from it before the public square which was in front of the Water Gate, from ①early morning until midday, in the presence of men and women, those who could understand; and ②all the people were attentive to the Book of the Law. ▷ ①Lit the light ②Lit the ears of all...were to

column.name: text
column.value: Ezra the scribe stood at a wooden podium which they had made for the purpose. And beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah on his right; and Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam on his left.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people, for he was standing above all the people; and when he opened it, all the people stood up.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God. And all the people answered, “Amen, Amen!” with the raising of their hands; then they kneeled down and worshiped the LORD with their faces to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: Also Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites explained the Law to the people while the people remained in their place.

column.name: text
column.value: They read from the book, from the Law of God, ①translating to give the sense so that they understood the reading. ▷ ①Or explaining

column.name: text
column.value: Then Nehemiah, who was the ①governor, and Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who taught the people said to all the people, “This day is holy to the LORD your God; do not mourn or weep.” For all the people were weeping when they heard the words of the Law. ▷ ①Heb Tirshatha, a Persian title

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to them, “Go, eat the festival foods, drink the sweet drinks, and send portions to him who has nothing prepared; for this day is holy to our Lord. Do not be grieved, for the joy of the LORD is your ①refuge.” ▷ ①Or stronghold

column.name: text
column.value: So the Levites silenced all the people, saying, “Be still, for the day is holy; do not be grieved.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the people went away to eat, drink, to send portions, and to ①celebrate a great feast, because they understood the words which had been made known to them. ▷ ①Lit make a great rejoicing

column.name: text
column.value: Then on the second day the heads of fathers’ households of all the people, the priests, and the Levites were gathered to Ezra the scribe so that they might gain insight into the words of the Law.

column.name: text
column.value: And they found written in the Law how the LORD had commanded through Moses that the sons of Israel were to live in ①booths during the feast of the seventh month. ▷ ①I.e., huts, also called tabernacles

column.name: text
column.value: And that they were to proclaim and circulate a proclamation in all their cities and in Jerusalem, saying, “Go out to the hills, and bring olive branches and ①wild olive branches, myrtle branches, palm branches, and branches of other trees with thick branches, to make booths, as it is written.” ▷ ①Lit oil tree, species unknown

column.name: text
column.value: So the people went out and brought them and made booths for themselves, each on his roof, and in their courtyards and in the courtyards of the house of God, and in the public square at the Water Gate, and in the square at the Gate of Ephraim.

column.name: text
column.value: The entire assembly of those who had returned from the captivity made booths and lived in the booths. Indeed, the sons of Israel had not done so since the days of Joshua the son of Nun to that day. And there was very great rejoicing.

column.name: text
column.value: He read from the Book of the Law of God daily, from the first day to the last day. And they celebrated the feast seven days, and on the eighth day there was a festive assembly in accordance with the ordinance.

column.name: text
column.value: Now on the twenty-fourth day of this month the sons of Israel assembled with fasting, in sackcloth and with dirt upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①descendants of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners, and they stood and confessed their sins and the wrongdoings of their fathers. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: While they stood in their place, they read from the Book of the Law of the LORD their God for a fourth of the day; and for another fourth they confessed and worshiped the LORD their God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now on the Levites’ platform stood Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani, and they cried out with a loud voice to the LORD their God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Levites, Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah said, “Arise, bless the LORD your God forever and ever! May Your glorious name be blessed And exalted above all blessing and praise!

column.name: text
column.value: You alone are the LORD. You have made the heavens, The heaven of heavens with all their ①lights, The earth and everything that is on it, The seas and everything that is in them. You give life to all of them, And the heavenly ②lights bow down before You. ▷ ①Lit host; i.e., sun, stars, etc. ②Lit host; i.e., sun, stars, etc.

column.name: text
column.value: You are the LORD God, Who chose Abram And brought him out from Ur of the Chaldees, And gave him the name Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: You found his heart faithful before You, And made a covenant with him To give him the land of the Canaanite, Of the Hittite and the Amorite, Of the Perizzite, the Jebusite, and the Girgashite— To give it to his ①descendants. And You have fulfilled Your ②promise, Because You are righteous. ▷ ①Lit seed ②Lit words

column.name: text
column.value: “You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, And heard their cry by the ①Red Sea. ▷ ①Lit Sea of Reeds

column.name: text
column.value: Then You performed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, Against all his servants and all the people of his land; For You knew that they acted arrogantly toward them, And You made a name for Yourself as it is this day.

column.name: text
column.value: You divided the sea before them, So they passed through the midst of the sea on dry ground; And You hurled their pursuers into the depths, Like a stone into ①raging waters. ▷ ①Lit strong, mighty

column.name: text
column.value: And with a pillar of cloud You led them by day, And with a pillar of fire by night To light for them the way In which they were to go.

column.name: text
column.value: Then You came down on Mount Sinai, And spoke with them from heaven; You gave them just ordinances and true laws, Good statutes and commandments.

column.name: text
column.value: So You made known to them Your holy Sabbath, And gave them commandments, statutes, and law, Through Your servant Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: You provided bread from heaven for them for their hunger, You brought out water from a rock for them for their thirst, And You told them to enter in order to take possession of The land which You ①swore to give them. ▷ ①Lit lifted up Your hand

column.name: text
text
column.value: They refused to listen, And did not remember Your wondrous deeds which You performed among them; So they became stubborn and appointed a leader to return to their slavery in ①Egypt. But You are a God of forgiveness, Gracious and compassionate, Slow to anger and abounding in ②mercy; And You did not abandon them. ▷ ①As in LXX and some Heb mss; MT their rebellion ②Or faithfulness

column.name: text
column.value: Even when they made for themselves A calf of cast metal And said, ‘This is your ①god Who brought you up from Egypt,’ And committed great blasphemies, ▷ ①Or God; i.e., an idol intended to represent God

column.name: text
column.value: You, in Your great compassion, Did not abandon them in the wilderness; The pillar of cloud did not leave them by day, To guide them on their way, Nor the pillar of fire by night, to light for them the way in which they were to go.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, You gave Your good Spirit to instruct them, You did not withhold Your manna from their mouth, And You gave them water for their thirst.

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, for forty years You provided for them in the wilderness and they were not lacking; Their clothes did not wear out, nor did their feet swell up.

column.name: text
column.value: You also gave them kingdoms and peoples, And allotted them to them as a ①boundary. They took possession of the land of Sihon ②the king of Heshbon And the land of Og the king of Bashan. ▷ ①Lit side, corner ②As in LXX and Lat; MT and the land of the king of Heshbon

column.name: text
column.value: You made their sons as numerous as the stars of heaven, And You brought them into the land Which You had told their fathers to enter and possess.

column.name: text
column.value: So their sons entered and took possession of the land. And You subdued before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, And You handed them over to them, with their kings and the peoples of the land, To do with them ①as they desired. ▷ ①Lit according to their desire

column.name: text
column.value: They captured fortified cities and a ①fertile land. They took possession of houses full of every good thing, Carved out cisterns, vineyards, olive groves, Fruit trees in abundance. So they ate, were filled and put on fat, And lived luxuriously in Your great goodness. ▷ ①Lit fat

column.name: text
column.value: “But they became rebellious and revolted against You, And threw Your Law behind their backs And killed Your prophets who had admonished them In order to bring them back to You, And they committed great blasphemies.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore You handed them over to their enemies who oppressed them, But when they cried out to You in the time of their distress, You heard from heaven, and according to Your great compassion You gave them ①people who saved them from the hand of their enemies. ▷ ①Lit deliverers

column.name: text
column.value: But as soon as they had rest, they did evil again before You; Therefore You abandoned them to the hand of their enemies, so that they ruled over them. When they cried out again to You, You heard from heaven, And many times You rescued them according to Your compassion,

column.name: text
column.value: And admonished them in order to turn them back to Your Law. Yet they acted arrogantly and did not listen to Your commandments but sinned against Your ordinances, Which, if a person ①follows them, then he will live by them. And they ②turned a stubborn shoulder and stiffened their neck, and would not listen. ▷ ①Lit does them ②Lit gave

column.name: text
column.value: However, You remained patient with them for many years, And admonished them by Your Spirit through Your prophets, Yet they would not listen. Therefore You handed them over to the peoples of the lands.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, in Your great compassion You did not make an end of them or abandon them, For You are a gracious and compassionate God.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now then, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who keeps His covenant and faithfulness, Do not let all the hardship seem insignificant before You, Which has happened to us, our kings, our leaders, our priests, our prophets, our fathers, and to all Your people, From the days of the kings of Assyria to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: However, You are righteous in everything that has happened to us; For You have dealt faithfully, but we have acted wickedly.

column.name: text
column.value: For our kings, our leaders, our priests, and our fathers have not kept Your Law Or paid attention to Your commandments and Your ①admonitions with which You have ②admonished them. ▷ ①Lit testimonies ②Or testified to

column.name: text
column.value: But they, in their own kingdom, With Your great goodness which You gave them, With the broad and rich land which You placed before them, Did not serve You or turn from their evil deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, we are slaves today, And as for the land which You gave to our fathers to eat its fruit and its bounty, Behold, we are slaves on it.

column.name: text
column.value: And its abundant produce is for the kings Whom You have set over us because of our sins; They also rule over our bodies And over our cattle as they please, So we are in great distress.

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①Now because of all this We are making an agreement in writing; And on the sealed document are the names of our leaders, our Levites, and our priests.” ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the wall was rebuilt and I had installed the doors, and the gatekeepers, the singers, and the Levites were appointed,

column.name: text
column.value: then I put Hanani my brother, and Hananiah the commander of the citadel, in charge of Jerusalem, for he was a faithful man and feared God more than many.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said to them, “The gates of Jerusalem are not to be opened until the sun is hot, and while they are standing guard, the gatekeepers are to ①keep the doors shut and bolted. Also appoint guards from the inhabitants of Jerusalem, each at his post, and each in front of his own house.” ▷ ①Lit shut the doors and bolt

column.name: text
column.value: Now the city was large and spacious, but the people in it were few and the houses were not built.

column.name: text
column.value: Then my God put it into my heart to assemble the nobles, the officials, and the other people to be enrolled by genealogies. Then I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up first, ①in which I found the following record: ▷ ①Lit and I found written in it

column.name: text
column.value: These are the ①people of the province who came up from the captivity of the exiles whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had taken into exile, and who returned to Jerusalem and Judah, each to his city, ▷ ①Lit sons

column.name: text

column.name: text
