column.value: He deprives the trusted ones of speech, And takes away the discernment of the elders.

column.name: text
column.value: He pours contempt on nobles, And loosens the belt of the strong.

column.name: text
column.value: He reveals mysteries from the darkness, And brings the deep darkness into light.

column.name: text
text
column.value: He deprives the leaders of the earth’s people of ①intelligence And makes them wander in a pathless wasteland. ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: They grope in darkness with no light, And He makes them stagger like a drunken person.

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, my eye has seen all this, My ear has heard and understood it.

column.name: text
column.value: What you know I also know; I am not inferior to you.

column.name: text
column.value: “But I would speak to ①the Almighty, And I desire to argue with God. ▷ ①Heb Shaddai

column.name: text
column.value: But you smear me with lies; You are all worthless physicians.

column.name: text
column.value: Oh that you would be completely silent, And that it would become your wisdom!

column.name: text
column.value: Please hear my argument, And give your attention to the contentions of my lips.

column.name: text
column.value: Will you speak what is unjust for God, And speak what is deceitful for Him?

column.name: text
column.value: Will you show partiality for Him? Will you contend for God?

column.name: text
column.value: Will it go well when He examines you? Or will you deceive Him as one deceives a man?

column.name: text
column.value: He will certainly punish you If you secretly show partiality.

column.name: text
column.value: Will His ①majesty not terrify you, And the dread of Him fall upon you? ▷ ①Lit exaltation

column.name: text
column.value: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes, Your defenses are defenses of clay.

column.name: text
column.value: “Be silent before me so that I may speak; Then let come upon me what may.

column.name: text
column.value: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, And put my life in my ①hands? ▷ ①Lit palm

column.name: text
column.value: Though He slay me, I will ①hope in Him. Nevertheless I will argue my ways ②before Him. ▷ ①Lit wait for ②Lit to His face

column.name: text
column.value: This also will be my salvation, For a godless person cannot come before His presence.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen carefully to my speech, And let my declaration fill your ears.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold now, I have prepared my case; I know that I will be vindicated.

column.name: text
column.value: Who could contend with me? For then I would be silent and die.

column.name: text
column.value: “Only two things I ask that You do not do to me, Then I will not hide from Your face:

column.name: text
column.value: Remove Your ①hand from me, And may the dread of You not terrify me. ▷ ①Lit palm

column.name: text
column.value: Then call and I will answer; Or let me speak, then reply to me.

column.name: text
column.value: How many are my guilty deeds and sins? Make known to me my wrongdoing and my sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Why do You hide Your face And consider me Your enemy?

column.name: text
column.value: Will You scare away a scattered leaf? Or will You pursue the dry chaff?

column.name: text
column.value: For You write bitter things against me And make me inherit the guilty deeds of my youth.

column.name: text
column.value: You put my feet in the stocks And watch all my paths; You ①set a limit for the soles of my feet, ▷ ①Lit carve for

column.name: text
column.value: While ①I am decaying like a rotten thing, Like a garment that is moth-eaten. ▷ ①Lit he is

column.name: text
column.value: “My spirit is broken, my days are extinguished, The ①grave is ready for me. ▷ ①Lit graves are

column.name: text
column.value: Mockers are certainly with me, And my eye ①gazes on their provocation. ▷ ①Lit dwells

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: He who informs against friends for a share of the spoils, The eyes of his children also will perish.

column.name: text
column.value: “But He has made me a proverb among the people, And I am ①one at whom people spit. ▷ ①Lit a spitting to the faces

column.name: text
column.value: My eye has also become inexpressive because of grief, And all my body parts are like a shadow.

column.name: text
column.value: The upright will be appalled at this, And the innocent will stir himself up against the godless.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless the righteous will hold to his way, And the one who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.

column.name: text
column.value: But come again all of ①you now, For I do not find a wise man among you. ▷ ①As in some mss and ancient versions; MT them

column.name: text
column.value: My days are past, my plans are torn apart, The wishes of my heart.

column.name: text
column.value: They make night into day, saying, ‘The light is near,’ in the presence of darkness.

column.name: text
text
column.value: If I call to the grave, ‘You are my father’; To the maggot, ‘my mother and my sister’;

column.name: text
column.value: Where then is my hope? And who looks at my hope?

column.name: text
column.value: ①Will it go down with me to Sheol? Shall we together go down into the dust?” ▷ ①As in LXX; Heb possibly Let my limbs sink down to Sheol, since there is rest in the dust for all.

column.name: text
column.value: “Man, who is born of woman, Is ①short-lived and full of turmoil. ▷ ①Lit short of days

column.name: text
column.value: Like a flower he comes out and withers. He also flees like a shadow and does not remain.

column.name: text
column.value: You also open Your eyes on him And bring ①him into judgment with Yourself. ▷ ①As in some ancient versions; MT me

column.name: text
column.value: Who can make the clean out of the unclean? No one!

column.name: text
column.value: Since his days are determined, The number of his months is with You; And You have ①set his limits so that he cannot pass. ▷ ①Lit made

column.name: text
column.value: Look away from him so that he may ①rest, Until he ②fulfills his day like a hired worker. ▷ ①Lit cease ②Lit makes acceptable

column.name: text
column.value: “For there is hope for a tree, When it is cut down, that it will sprout again, And its shoots will not ①fail. ▷ ①Or cease

column.name: text
column.value: Though its roots grow old in the ground, And its stump dies in the dry soil,

column.name: text
column.value: At the scent of water it will flourish And produce sprigs like a plant.

column.name: text
column.value: But a man dies and lies prostrate. A person passes away, and where is he?

column.name: text
column.value: As water ①evaporates from the sea, And a river becomes parched and dried up, ▷ ①Lit disappears

column.name: text
column.value: So a man lies down and does not rise. Until the heavens no longer exist, ①He will not awake nor be woken from ②his sleep. ▷ ①Lit They ②Lit their

column.name: text
column.value: “Oh that You would hide me in ①Sheol, That You would conceal me until Your wrath returns to You, That You would set a limit for me and remember me! ▷ ①I.e., the netherworld

column.name: text
column.value: If a man dies, will he live again? All the days of my struggle I will wait Until my relief comes.

column.name: text
column.value: You will call, and I will answer You; You will long for the work of Your hands.

column.name: text
column.value: For now You number my steps, You do not observe my sin.

column.name: text
column.value: My wrongdoing is sealed up in a bag, And You cover over my ①guilt. ▷ ①Or unjust deed

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: You forever overpower him and he departs; You change his appearance and send him away.

column.name: text
column.value: His sons achieve honor, but he does not know it; Or they become insignificant, and he does not perceive it.

column.name: text
column.value: However, his ①body pains him, And his soul mourns for himself.” ▷ ①Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: Then Eliphaz the Temanite responded,

column.name: text
column.value: “Should a wise man answer with windy knowledge, And fill ①himself with the east wind? ▷ ①Lit his belly

column.name: text
column.value: Should he argue with useless talk, Or with words which do not benefit?

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, you do away with ①reverence, And hinder meditation before God. ▷ ①Lit fear

column.name: text
column.value: For your wrongdoing teaches your mouth, And you choose the language of the cunning.

column.name: text
column.value: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I; And your own lips testify against you.

column.name: text
column.value: “Were you the first person to be born, Or were you brought forth before the hills?

column.name: text
column.value: Do you hear the secret discussion of God, And limit wisdom to yourself?

column.name: text
column.value: What do you know that we do not know? What do you understand that ①we do not? ▷ ①Lit is not within us?

column.name: text
column.value: Both the gray-haired and the aged are among us, Older than your father.

column.name: text
column.value: Are the consolations of God too little for you, Or the word spoken gently to you?

column.name: text
column.value: Why does your heart take you away? And why do your eyes wink,

column.name: text
column.value: That you can turn your spirit against God And produce such words from your mouth?

column.name: text
column.value: What is man, that he would be pure, Or he who is born of a woman, that he would be righteous?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, He has no trust in His holy ones, And the heavens are not pure in His sight;

column.name: text
column.value: How much less one who is detestable and corrupt: A person who drinks ①malice like water! ▷ ①Or injustice

column.name: text
column.value: “I will tell you, listen to me; And what I have seen I will also declare;

column.name: text
column.value: What wise people have told, And have not concealed from their fathers,

column.name: text
column.value: To whom alone the land was given, And no stranger passed among them.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked person writhes in pain all his days, And the ①years reserved for the ruthless are numbered. ▷ ①Lit number of years are reserved for

column.name: text
text
column.value: He does not believe that he will return from darkness, And he is destined for the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: He wanders about for food, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that a day of darkness is ①at hand. ▷ ①Lit ready at his hand

column.name: text
column.value: Distress and anguish terrify him, They overpower him like a king ready for the attack,

column.name: text
column.value: Because he has reached out with his hand against God, And is arrogant toward ①the Almighty. ▷ ①Heb Shaddai

column.name: text
column.value: He rushes ①headlong at Him With his ②massive shield. ▷ ①Lit with a stiff neck ②Lit thick-bossed shields

column.name: text
column.value: For he has covered his face with his fat, And ①put fat on his waist. ▷ ①Lit made

column.name: text
column.value: He has lived in desolate cities, In houses no one would inhabit, Which are destined to become ①ruins. ▷ ①Or heaps

column.name: text
column.value: He will not become rich, nor will his wealth endure; And his property will not stretch out on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: He will not ①escape from darkness; The flame will dry up his shoot, And he will go away by the breath of His mouth. ▷ ①Lit turn aside

column.name: text
text
column.value: It will be accomplished before his time, And his palm branch will not be green.

column.name: text
column.value: He will drop off his unripe grape like the vine, And will cast off his flower like the olive tree.

column.name: text
column.value: For the company of the godless is barren, And fire consumes the tents of ①the corrupt. ▷ ①Lit a bribe

column.name: text
column.value: They conceive ①harm and give birth to wrongdoing, And their ②mind prepares deception.” ▷ ①Or pain ②Lit belly

column.name: text
column.value: Then Job responded,

column.name: text
text
column.value: Is there no end to windy words? Or what provokes you that you answer?

column.name: text
column.value: I too could speak like you, If only ①I were in your place. I could compose words against you And shake my head at you. ▷ ①Lit your soul were in place of my soul

column.name: text
column.value: Or I could strengthen you with my mouth, And the condolence of my lips could lessen your pain.

column.name: text
column.value: “If I speak, my pain is not lessened, And if I refrain, what pain leaves me?

column.name: text
column.value: But now He has exhausted me; You have laid waste all my group of loved ones.

column.name: text
column.value: And you have shriveled me up, ①It has become a witness; And my infirmity rises up against me, It testifies to my face. ▷ ①I.e., Job’s condition

column.name: text
column.value: His anger has torn me and ①hunted me down, He has gnashed at me with His teeth; My enemy ②glares at me. ▷ ①Lit borne a grudge against me ②Lit sharpens his eyes

column.name: text
column.value: They have gaped at me with their mouths, They have ①slapped me on the cheek with contempt; They have massed themselves against me. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: God hands me over to criminals, And tosses me into the hands of the wicked.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: He breaks through me with breach after breach; He runs at me like a warrior.

column.name: text
column.value: I have sewed sackcloth over my skin, And thrust my horn in the dust.

column.name: text
column.value: My face is flushed from weeping, And deep darkness is on my eyelids,

column.name: text
column.value: Although there is no violence in my hands, And my prayer is pure.

column.name: text
column.value: “Earth, do not cover my blood, And may there be no resting place for my cry.

column.name: text
column.value: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven, And my ①advocate is on high. ▷ ①Or witness

column.name: text
column.value: My friends are my scoffers; My eye weeps to God,

column.name: text
column.value: That one might plead for a man with God As a son of man with his neighbor!

column.name: text
column.value: For when a few years are past, I shall go the way of no return.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Bildad the Shuhite responded,

column.name: text
column.value: “How long will you hunt for words? Show understanding, and then we can talk.

column.name: text
column.value: Why are we regarded as animals, As stupid in your eyes?

column.name: text
column.value: ①You who tear yourself in your anger— Should the earth be abandoned for your sake, Or the rock moved from its place? ▷ ①Lit The one who tears himself in his

column.name: text
column.value: “Indeed, the light of the wicked goes out, And the spark from his fire does not shine.

column.name: text
column.value: The light in his tent is darkened, And his lamp goes out above him.

column.name: text
column.value: His ①vigorous stride is shortened, And his own plan brings him down. ▷ ①Lit steps of his strength

column.name: text
column.value: For he is thrown into the net by his own feet, And he steps on the webbing.

column.name: text
column.value: A snare seizes him by the heel, And a trap snaps shut on him.

column.name: text
column.value: A noose for him is hidden in the ground, And a trap for him on the pathway.

column.name: text
column.value: All around sudden terrors frighten him, And harass him at every step.

column.name: text
column.value: His strength is famished, And disaster is ready at his side.

column.name: text
column.value: ①It devours parts of his skin, The firstborn of death devours his ②limbs. ▷ ①Another reading isHis skin is devoured by illness ②Or parts

column.name: text
column.value: He is torn from ①the security of his tent, And ②they march him before the king of terrors. ▷ ①Lit his tent his trust ②Lit you march or she marches

column.name: text
text
column.value: His roots are dried below, And his branch withers above.

column.name: text
column.value: The memory of him perishes from the earth, And he has no name abroad.

column.name: text
column.value: ①He is driven from light into darkness, And chased from the inhabited world. ▷ ①Lit They drive him...And chase him

column.name: text
column.value: He has no offspring or descendants among his people, Nor any survivor where he resided.

column.name: text
column.value: Those in the west are appalled at his ①fate, And those in the east are seized with horror. ▷ ①Lit day

column.name: text
column.value: Certainly these are the dwellings of the wicked, And this is the place of him who does not know God.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Job responded,

column.name: text
column.value: “How long will you torment ①me And crush me with words? ▷ ①Lit my soul

column.name: text
column.value: These ten times you have insulted me; You are not ashamed to wrong me.

column.name: text
column.value: Even if I have truly done wrong, My error stays with me.

column.name: text
column.value: If indeed you exalt yourselves against me And prove my disgrace to me,

column.name: text
column.value: Know then that God has wronged me And has surrounded me with His net.

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, I cry, ‘Violence!’ but I get no answer; I shout for help, but there is no justice.

column.name: text
column.value: He has blocked my way so that I cannot pass, And He has put darkness on my paths.

column.name: text
column.value: He has stripped my honor from me And removed the crown from my head.

column.name: text
column.value: He breaks me down on every side, and I am gone; And He has uprooted my hope like a tree.

column.name: text
column.value: He has also kindled His anger against me And considered me as His enemy.

column.name: text
column.value: His troops come together And build up their ①way against me And camp around my tent. ▷ ①I.e., siege ramp

column.name: text
column.value: “He has removed my brothers far from me, And my acquaintances have completely turned away from me.

column.name: text
column.value: My relatives have failed, And my close friends have forgotten me.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who live in my house and my servant women consider me a stranger. I am a foreigner in their sight.

column.name: text
column.value: I call to my servant, but he does not answer; I have to implore his favor with my mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: My breath is offensive to my wife, And I am loathsome to my own brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: Even young children despise me; I stand up and they speak against me.

column.name: text
column.value: All ①my associates loathe me, And those I love have turned against me. ▷ ①Lit the men of my council

column.name: text
column.value: My bone clings to my skin and my flesh, And I have escaped only by the skin of my teeth.

column.name: text
column.value: Pity me, pity me, you friends of mine, For the hand of God has struck me.

column.name: text
column.value: Why do you persecute me as God does, And are not satisfied with my flesh?

column.name: text
column.value: “Oh that my words were written! Oh that they were recorded in a book!

column.name: text
column.value: That with an iron stylus and lead They were engraved in the rock forever!

column.name: text
column.value: Yet as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives, And at the last, He will take His stand on the ①earth. ▷ ①Lit dust

column.name: text
column.value: Even after my skin ①is destroyed, Yet from my flesh I will see God, ▷ ①Lit which they have cut off

column.name: text
column.value: Whom I, on my part, shall behold for myself, And whom my eyes will see, and not another. My ①heart faints ②within me! ▷ ①Lit kidneys ②Lit in my loins

column.name: text
column.value: If you say, ‘How shall we persecute him?’ And ‘ ①What pretext for a case against him can we find?’ ▷ ①Or the root of the matter is found in him

column.name: text
column.value: Then be afraid of the sword for yourselves, For wrath brings the punishment of the sword, So that you may know there is judgment.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Job responded,

column.name: text
column.value: “Listen carefully to my speech, And let this be your way of consolation.

column.name: text
column.value: Bear with me that I may speak; Then after I have spoken, you may mock me.

column.name: text
column.value: As for me, is my complaint ①to a mortal? Or why should ②I not be impatient? ▷ ①Or against ②Lit my spirit

column.name: text
column.value: Look at me, and be astonished, And put your hand over your mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Even when I remember, I am disturbed, And horror takes hold of my flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: Why do the wicked still live, Grow old, and also become very ①powerful? ▷ ①Or superior

column.name: text
column.value: Their ①descendants endure with them in their sight, And their offspring before their eyes, ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: Their houses are safe from fear, And the ①rod of God is not on them. ▷ ①I.e., punishment

column.name: text
text
column.value: They send out their boys like the flock, And their children dance.

column.name: text
column.value: They ①sing with the tambourine and harp, And rejoice at the sound of the flute. ▷ ①Lit lifted up the voice

column.name: text
column.value: They spend their days in prosperity, And ①suddenly they go down to ②Sheol. ▷ ①Or in peacefulness ②I.e., the netherworld

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they say to God, ‘Go away from us! We do not even desire the knowledge of Your ways.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Who is ②the Almighty, that we should serve Him, And what would we gain if we plead with Him?’ ▷ ①Lit What ②Heb Shaddai

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand; The advice of the wicked is far from me.

column.name: text
column.value: “How often is the lamp of the wicked put out, Or does their disaster fall on them? Does ①God apportion destruction in His anger? ▷ ①Lit He

column.name: text
column.value: Are they as straw before the wind, And like chaff which the storm carries away?

column.name: text
column.value: You say, ‘God saves up ①a person’s ②wrongdoing for his sons.’ Let ③God repay him so that he may know it. ▷ ①Lit his ②Or disaster ③Lit Him

column.name: text
column.value: Let his own eyes see his destruction, And let him drink of the wrath of ①the Almighty. ▷ ①Heb Shaddai

column.name: text
column.value: For what does he care about his household ①after him, When the number of his months is at an end? ▷ ①I.e., after he dies

column.name: text
column.value: Can anyone teach God knowledge, In that He judges those on high?

column.name: text
column.value: One dies in his full strength, Being wholly undisturbed and at ease;

column.name: text
column.value: His ①sides are filled with fat, And the marrow of his bones is wet, ▷ ①As in Syriac; Heb uncertain. Some render as his pails are full of milk

column.name: text
column.value: While another dies with a bitter soul, Never even ①tasting anything good. ▷ ①Lit eating

column.name: text
column.value: Together they lie down in the dust, And maggots cover them.

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, I know your thoughts, And the plots you devise against me.

column.name: text
column.value: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the nobleman, And where is the tent, the dwelling places of the wicked?’

column.name: text
column.value: Have you not asked travelers, And do you not examine their ①evidence? ▷ ①Lit signs

column.name: text
text
column.value: Who ①confronts him with his actions, And who repays him for what he has done? ▷ ①Lit declares his way to his face

column.name: text
column.value: When he is carried to the grave, People will keep watch over his tomb.

column.name: text
column.value: The clods of the valley will ①gently cover him; Moreover, all mankind will ②follow after him, While countless others go before him. ▷ ①Lit be sweet to him ②Lit draw

column.name: text
column.value: So how dare you give me empty comfort? For your answers remain nothing but falsehood!”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Job responded,

column.name: text
text
column.value: Oh that I knew how to find Him, That I might come to His home!

column.name: text
column.value: I would present my case before Him And fill my mouth with arguments.

column.name: text
column.value: I would learn the words which He would ①answer, And perceive what He would tell me. ▷ ①Lit answer me

column.name: text
column.value: Would He contend with me by the greatness of His power? No, surely He would pay attention to me.

column.name: text
text
column.value: “Behold, I go forward but He is not there, And backward, but I cannot perceive Him;

column.name: text
column.value: When He acts on the left, I cannot see Him; He turns to the right, but I cannot see Him.

column.name: text
text
column.value: My foot has held on to His path; I have kept His way and not turned aside.

column.name: text
text
column.value: But He is unique, and who can ①make Him turn? Whatever His soul desires, He does it. ▷ ①Or deprive Him of anything

column.name: text
column.value: For He carries out what is destined for me, And many such destinies are with Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, I would be terrified at His presence; When I consider this, I am frightened of Him.

column.name: text
column.value: It is God who has made my heart faint, And the Almighty who has terrified me,

column.name: text
column.value: But I am not destroyed by darkness, Nor by deep gloom which covers me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Zophar the Naamathite responded,

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore my disquieting thoughts make me ①respond, Even because of my ②inward agitation. ▷ ①Lit return ②Lit haste within me

column.name: text
column.value: I listened to the reprimand which insults me, And the spirit of my understanding makes me answer.

column.name: text
column.value: Do you know this from ancient times, From the establishment of mankind on earth,

column.name: text
column.value: That the rejoicing of the wicked is short, And the joy of the godless momentary?

column.name: text
column.value: Though his arrogance ①reaches the heavens, And his head touches the clouds, ▷ ①Lit goes up to

column.name: text
column.value: He perishes forever like his refuse; Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’

column.name: text
column.value: He flies away like a dream, and they cannot find him; Like a vision of the night he is chased away.

column.name: text
column.value: The eye which saw him sees him no longer, And his place no longer beholds him.

column.name: text
column.value: His sons ①favor the poor, And his hands give back his wealth. ▷ ①Or seek the favor of

column.name: text
column.value: His bones are full of his youthful strength, But it lies down with him ①in the dust. ▷ ①Lit on

column.name: text
column.value: “Though evil tastes sweet in his mouth And he hides it under his tongue,

column.name: text
column.value: Though he ①desires it and will not let it go, But holds it in his ②mouth, ▷ ①Lit spares it ②Lit palate

column.name: text
column.value: Yet his food in his stomach is changed To the ①venom of cobras within him. ▷ ①Lit gall

column.name: text
text
column.value: He sucks the poison of cobras; The viper’s tongue kills him.

column.name: text
column.value: He does not look at the streams, The rivers flowing with honey and curds.

column.name: text
column.value: He returns the product of his labor And cannot swallow it; As to the riches of his trading, He cannot even enjoy them.

column.name: text
column.value: For he has oppressed and neglected the poor; He has seized a house which he has not built.

column.name: text
column.value: “Because he knew no quiet ①within him, He does not retain anything he desires. ▷ ①Lit in his belly

column.name: text
column.value: Nothing remains ①for him to devour, Therefore his prosperity does not endure. ▷ ①Or of what he devours

column.name: text
column.value: In the fullness of his excess he will be cramped; The hand of everyone who suffers will come against him.

column.name: text
column.value: When he fills his belly, God will send His fierce anger on him And rain it on him ①while he is eating. ▷ ①Or as his food

column.name: text
column.value: He may flee from the iron weapon, But the bronze bow will pierce him.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: The heavens will reveal his guilt, And the earth will rise up against him.

column.name: text
column.value: The increase of his house will disappear; His possessions will flow away on the day of His anger.

column.name: text
column.value: This is a wicked person’s portion from God, The inheritance decreed to him by God.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Eliphaz the Temanite responded,

column.name: text
column.value: “Can a strong man be of use to God, Or a wise one be useful to himself?

column.name: text
column.value: Is it any pleasure to ①the Almighty if you are righteous, Or gain if you make your ways blameless? ▷ ①Heb Shaddai

column.name: text
column.value: Is it because of your ①reverence that He punishes you, That He enters into judgment against you? ▷ ①Or fear

column.name: text
column.value: Is your wickedness not abundant, And is there no end to your guilty deeds?

column.name: text
column.value: For you have seized pledges from your brothers without cause, And ①stripped people naked. ▷ ①Lit stripped clothing of the naked

column.name: text
column.value: You have given the weary no water to drink, And you have withheld bread from the hungry.

column.name: text
column.value: But the earth belongs to the powerful man, And the one who is honorable dwells on it.

column.name: text
column.value: You have sent widows away empty, And the ①strength of orphans has been crushed. ▷ ①Lit arms

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore traps surround you, And sudden dread terrifies you,

column.name: text
column.value: Or darkness, so that you cannot see, And a flood of water covers you.

column.name: text
column.value: “Is God not in the height of heaven? Look also at the ①highest stars, how high they are! ▷ ①Lit head, top-most

column.name: text
column.value: But you say, ‘What does God know? Can He judge through the thick darkness?

column.name: text
text
column.value: Will you keep to the ancient path Which wicked people have walked,

column.name: text
column.value: Who were snatched away before their time, Whose foundations were ①washed away by a river? ▷ ①Lit poured out

column.name: text
column.value: They said to God, ‘Go away from us!’ And ‘What can ①the Almighty do to them?’ ▷ ①Heb Shaddai

column.name: text
column.value: Yet He filled their houses with good things; But the advice of the wicked is far from me.

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous see and are glad, And the innocent mock them, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Truly our enemies are eliminated, And fire has consumed their ①abundance.’ ▷ ①Or excess

column.name: text
column.value: “Be reconciled with Him, and be at peace; Thereby good will come to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Please receive ①instruction from His mouth, And put His words in your heart. ▷ ①Or law

column.name: text
text
column.value: And put your ①gold in the dust, And the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks, ▷ ①Lit ore

column.name: text
column.value: Then ①the Almighty will be your ②gold And abundant silver to you. ▷ ①Heb Shaddai ②Lit ore

column.name: text
column.value: For then you will take pleasure in ①the Almighty And lift up your face to God. ▷ ①Heb Shaddai

column.name: text
column.value: You will pray to Him, and He will hear you; And you will pay your vows.

column.name: text
column.value: You will also decide something, and it will be established for you; And light will shine on your ways.

column.name: text
column.value: When ①they have brought you low, you will speak with ②confidence, And He will save the ③humble person. ▷ ①Lit they cast you down ②Lit pride ③Lit lowly of eyes

column.name: text
column.value: He will rescue one who is not innocent, And he will be rescued due to the cleanness of your hands.”

column.name: text
column.value: “Why are ①times not stored up by the Almighty, And why do those who know Him not see His ②days? ▷ ①I.e., of judgment for the wicked ②I.e., of judgment for the wicked

column.name: text
text
column.value: They drive away the donkeys of orphans; They seize the widow’s ox as a pledge.

column.name: text
column.value: They push the needy aside from the road; The poor of the land have to hide themselves together.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, like wild donkeys in the wilderness They go out scavenging for food in their activity, As ①bread for their children in the desert. ▷ ①Lit his bread

column.name: text
column.value: They harvest their feed in the field And glean the vineyard of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: They spend the night naked, without clothing, And have no covering against the cold.

column.name: text
column.value: They are wet from the mountain rains, And they hug the rock for lack of a shelter.

column.name: text
column.value: Others snatch an orphan from the breast, And they seize it as a pledge against the poor.

column.name: text
column.value: The poor move about naked without clothing, And they carry sheaves, while going hungry.

column.name: text
column.value: Within the walls they produce oil; They tread wine presses but go thirsty.

column.name: text
text
column.value: “ ①Others have been with those who rebel against the light; They do not want to know its ways Nor stay in its paths. ▷ ①Lit They

column.name: text
text
column.value: The eye of the adulterer watches for ①twilight, Saying, ‘No eye will see me.’ And he ②disguises his face. ▷ ①Lit the twilight ②Or puts a covering on his face

column.name: text
text
column.value: For the morning is the same to him as thick darkness, For he is familiar with the terrors of thick darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: “They are ①insignificant on the surface of the water; Their plot of land on the earth is cursed. They do not turn ②toward the vineyards. ▷ ①Or light; or swift ②Lit to the path of

column.name: text
column.value: Dryness and heat snatch away the snow waters, As ①Sheol snatches those who have sinned. ▷ ①I.e., the netherworld

column.name: text
column.value: A ①mother will forget him; The maggot feeds sweetly until he is no longer remembered. And injustice will be broken like a tree. ▷ ①Lit womb

column.name: text
column.value: He wrongs the ①infertile woman, And does no good for the widow. ▷ ①Lit infertile who does not bear

column.name: text
column.value: But He drags off the mighty by His power; He rises, but no one has assurance of life.

column.name: text
column.value: He provides them with security, and they are supported; And His eyes are on their ways.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Now if it is not so, who can prove me a liar, And make my speech worthless?”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Bildad the Shuhite responded,

column.name: text
column.value: “Dominion and awe ①belong to Him Who makes peace in His heights. ▷ ①Lit are with Him

column.name: text
column.value: Is there any number to His troops? And upon whom does His light not rise?

column.name: text
column.value: How then can mankind be righteous with God? Or how can anyone who is born of woman be pure?

column.name: text
column.value: If even the moon has no brightness And the stars are not pure in His sight,

column.name: text
column.value: How much less man, that maggot, And a son of man, that worm!”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Job responded,

column.name: text
column.value: “What a help you are to ①the weak! You have saved the arm without strength! ▷ ①Lit no strength

column.name: text
column.value: What advice you have given to one without wisdom! What helpful insight you have abundantly ①provided! ▷ ①Lit made known

column.name: text
column.value: To whom have you uttered words? And whose ①spirit was expressed through you? ▷ ①Lit breath has gone forth

column.name: text
column.value: “The ①departed spirits are made to tremble Under the waters and their inhabitants. ▷ ①Or shades; Heb Rephaim

column.name: text
column.value: ①Sheol is naked before Him, And ②Abaddon has no covering. ▷ ①I.e., the netherworld ②I.e., the place of destruction

column.name: text
column.value: He stretches out the north over empty space And hangs the earth on nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: He wraps up the waters in His clouds, And the cloud does not burst under them.

column.name: text
column.value: He ①obscures the face of the ②full moon And spreads His cloud over it. ▷ ①Lit covers ②Or throne

column.name: text
column.value: He has inscribed a circle on the surface of the waters At the boundary of light and darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: The pillars of heaven tremble And are amazed at His rebuke.

column.name: text
column.value: With His power He quieted the sea, And by His understanding He shattered ①Rahab. ▷ ①I.e., a sea monster, not to be confused with Rahab in Joshua 2

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: “Certainly there is a ①mine for silver And a place ②for refining gold. ▷ ①Lit source ②Lit for gold they refine

column.name: text
column.value: Iron is taken from the dust, And copper is smelted from rock.

column.name: text
column.value: Man puts an end to darkness, And to the farthest limit he searches out The rock in gloom and deep shadow.

column.name: text
column.value: He ①sinks a shaft away from ②inhabited areas, Forgotten by the foot; They hang and swing, away from people. ▷ ①Lit breaks open ②Lit sojourning

column.name: text
column.value: ①From the earth comes food, And underneath, it is turned over like fire. ▷ ①Lit Earth, from it

column.name: text
column.value: Its rocks are the ①source of sapphires, And its dust contains gold. ▷ ①Or place

column.name: text
column.value: No bird of prey knows the path, Nor has the falcon’s eye caught sight of it.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①proud animals have not trodden it, Nor has the lion passed over it. ▷ ①Lit sons of pride

column.name: text
text
column.value: He carves out channels through the rocks, And his eye sees anything precious.

column.name: text
column.value: He dams up the streams from ①flowing, And brings to light what is hidden. ▷ ①Lit weeping

column.name: text
column.value: “But where can wisdom be found? And where is the place of understanding?

column.name: text
column.value: Mankind does not know its value, Nor is it found in the land of the living.

column.name: text
column.value: The ocean depth says, ‘It is not in me’; And the sea says, ‘It is not with me.’

column.name: text
column.value: Pure gold cannot be given in exchange for it, Nor can silver be weighed as its price.

column.name: text
column.value: It cannot be valued in the gold of Ophir, In precious onyx, or sapphire.

column.name: text
column.value: Gold or glass cannot equal it, Nor can it be exchanged for articles of pure gold.

column.name: text
column.value: Coral and crystal are not to be mentioned; And the acquisition of wisdom is more valuable than pearls.

column.name: text
column.value: The topaz of ①Cush cannot equal it, Nor can it be valued in pure gold. ▷ ①Or Ethiopia

column.name: text
column.value: Where then does wisdom come from? And where is this place of understanding?

column.name: text
column.value: It is hidden from the eyes of every living creature, And concealed from the birds of the sky.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Abaddon and Death say, ‘With our ears we have heard a report of it.’ ▷ ①I.e., Destruction

column.name: text
column.value: “God understands its way, And He knows its place.

column.name: text
column.value: For He looks to the ends of the earth; He sees everything under the heavens.

column.name: text
column.value: When He imparted weight to the wind, And assessed the waters by measure,

column.name: text
column.value: When He made a limit for the rain, And a course for the thunderbolt,

column.name: text
column.value: Then He saw it and declared it; He established it and also searched it out.

column.name: text
column.value: And to mankind He said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; And to turn away from evil is understanding.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Job again took up his discourse and said,

column.name: text
column.value: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, And the Almighty, who has embittered my soul,

column.name: text
column.value: For as long as ①life is in me, And the ②breath of God is in my nostrils, ▷ ①Lit breath ②Or spirit

column.name: text
column.value: My lips certainly will not speak unjustly, Nor will my tongue mutter deceit.

column.name: text
text
column.value: I have kept hold of my righteousness and will not let it go. My heart does not rebuke any of my days.

column.name: text
column.value: “May my enemy be as the wicked, And ①my opponent as the criminal. ▷ ①Lit one who rises up against me

column.name: text
column.value: For what is the hope of the godless when he makes an end of life, When God requires his ①life? ▷ ①Or soul

column.name: text
column.value: Will God hear his cry When distress comes upon him?

column.name: text
column.value: Or will he take pleasure in the Almighty? Will he call on God at all times?

column.name: text
text
column.value: Behold, all of you have seen it; Why then do you talk of nothing?

column.name: text
column.value: “This is the portion of a wicked person from God, And the inheritance which tyrants receive from the Almighty:

column.name: text
text
column.value: His survivors will be buried because of the plague, And ①their widows will not be able to weep. ▷ ①As in ancient versions; Heb his

column.name: text
column.value: Though he piles up silver like dust, And prepares garments as plentiful as the clay,

column.name: text
column.value: He may prepare it, but the righteous will wear it And the innocent will divide the silver.

column.name: text
column.value: He has built his house like the ①spider’s web, Or a hut which the watchman has made. ▷ ①As in ancient versions; Heb moth

column.name: text
text
column.value: Terrors overtake him like a flood; A storm steals him away in the night.

column.name: text
column.value: The east wind carries him away, and he is gone; For it sweeps him away from his place.

column.name: text
text
column.value: People will ①clap their hands at him, And will whistle at him from their places. ▷ ①I.e., mock and ridicule him

column.name: text
column.value: Job again took up his discourse and said,

column.name: text
column.value: “Oh that I were as in months gone by, As in the days when God watched over me;

column.name: text
column.value: When His lamp shone over my head, And by His light I walked through darkness;

column.name: text
column.value: Just as I was in the days of my youth, When the protection of God was over my tent;

column.name: text
text
column.value: When my steps were bathed in cream, And the rock poured out streams of oil for me!

column.name: text
column.value: When I went out to the gate of the city, When I ①took my seat in the public square, ▷ ①Lit set up

column.name: text
column.value: The young men saw me and hid themselves, And the old men arose and stood.

column.name: text
column.value: The leaders stopped talking And put their hands on their mouths;

column.name: text
column.value: The voices of the prominent people were ①hushed, And their tongues stuck to their palates. ▷ ①Lit hidden

column.name: text
column.value: For when an ear heard, it called me blessed, And when an eye saw, it testified in support of me,

column.name: text
column.value: Because I saved the poor who cried for help, And the orphan who had no helper.

column.name: text
column.value: The blessing of the one who was about to perish came upon me, And I made the widow’s heart sing for joy.

column.name: text
column.value: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me; My justice was like a robe and a headband.

column.name: text
column.value: I was eyes to those who were blind, And feet to those who ①could not walk. ▷ ①Or limped

column.name: text
column.value: I was a father to the poor, And I investigated the case which I did not know.

column.name: text
column.value: I broke the jaws of the wicked And rescued the prey from his teeth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I ①thought, ‘I will die with my ②family, And I will multiply my days as the sand. ▷ ①Lit said ②Lit nest

column.name: text
column.value: My root is spread out to the waters, And dew lies on my branch all night.

column.name: text
column.value: My glory is ever new with me, And my bow is renewed in my hand.’

column.name: text
column.value: “To me they listened and waited, And they kept silent for my advice.

column.name: text
column.value: After my words they did not speak again, And my speech dropped on them.

column.name: text
column.value: They waited for me as for the rain, And opened their mouths as for the late rain.

column.name: text
column.value: I smiled at them when they did not believe, And they did not look at ①my kindness ungraciously. ▷ ①Lit the light of my face

column.name: text
column.value: I chose a way for them and sat as chief, And lived as a king among the troops, As one who comforted the mourners.

column.name: text
column.value: “But now those who are younger than I mock me, Whose fathers I refused to put with the dogs of my flock.

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, what good was the strength of their hands to me? Vigor had perished from them.

column.name: text
column.value: From poverty and famine they are gaunt, They who gnaw at the dry ground by night in waste and desolation,

column.name: text
column.value: Who pluck saltweed by the bushes, And whose food is the root of the broom shrub.

column.name: text
column.value: They are driven from the community; They shout against them as against a thief,

column.name: text
column.value: So that they live on the slopes of ravines, In holes in the ground and among the rocks.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Worthless ①fellows, even ②those without a name, They were cast out from the land. ▷ ①Lit sons ②Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: “And now I have become their ①taunt, And I have become a ②byword to them. ▷ ①Lit song ②I.e., prob. a word of insult

column.name: text
column.value: They loathe me and stand aloof from me, And they do not ①refrain from spitting in my face. ▷ ①Lit withhold spit from my face

column.name: text
column.value: Because He has undone ①my ②bowstring and afflicted me, They have cast off the bridle before me. ▷ ①Some mss His ②Or cord

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: As through a wide gap they come, ①Amid the storm they roll on. ▷ ①Lit Under

column.name: text
column.value: Sudden terrors are turned upon me; They chase away my dignity like the wind, And my ①prosperity has passed away like a cloud. ▷ ①Or welfare

column.name: text
text
column.value: At night it pierces my bones ①within me, And my gnawing pains do not rest. ▷ ①Lit from upon

column.name: text
column.value: By a great force my garment is distorted; It ties me up like the collar of my coat.

column.name: text
column.value: He has thrown me into the mire, And I have become like dust and ashes.

column.name: text
column.value: I cry out to You for help, but You do not answer me; I stand up, and You turn Your attention against me.

column.name: text
text
column.value: You lift me up to the wind and make me ride it; And You dissolve me in a storm.

column.name: text
column.value: For I know that You will bring me to death, And to the house of meeting for all living.

column.name: text
column.value: “Yet does one in a heap of ruins not reach out with his hand, Or in his disaster does he not cry out for help?

column.name: text
column.value: Have I not wept for the ①one whose life is hard? Was my soul not grieved for the needy? ▷ ①Lit hard of day

column.name: text
column.value: When I expected good, evil came; When I waited for light, darkness came.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: I have become a brother to jackals, And a companion of ostriches.

column.name: text
column.value: My skin turns black ①on me, And my bones burn with ②fever. ▷ ①Lit from upon ②Lit heat

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore my harp ①is turned to mourning, And my flute to the sound of those who weep. ▷ ①Lit becomes

column.name: text
column.value: “I have made a covenant with my eyes; How then could I look at a virgin?

column.name: text
column.value: And what is the portion of God from above, Or the inheritance of the Almighty from on high?

column.name: text
column.value: Is it not disaster to the criminal, And misfortune to those who practice injustice?

column.name: text
column.value: Does He not see my ways, And count all my steps?

column.name: text
column.value: “If I have walked with deception, And my foot has hurried after deceit,

column.name: text
column.value: Let Him weigh me with ①accurate scales, And let God know my integrity. ▷ ①Lit just

column.name: text
column.value: If my step has turned from the way, Or my heart ①followed my eyes, Or if any spot has stuck to my hands, ▷ ①Lit walked after

column.name: text
column.value: Let me sow and another eat, And let my ①crops be uprooted. ▷ ①Or offspring

column.name: text
column.value: “If my heart has been enticed by a woman, Or I have lurked at my neighbor’s doorway,

column.name: text
column.value: May my wife grind grain for another, And let others ①kneel down over her. ▷ ①I.e., have sexual relations with her

column.name: text
column.value: For that would be a lustful crime; Moreover, it would be wrongdoing punishable by judges.

column.name: text
column.value: For it would be fire that consumes to ①Abaddon, And would uproot all my ②increase. ▷ ①I.e., the place of destruction ②Or yield

column.name: text
column.value: “If I have rejected the claim of my male or female slaves When they filed a complaint against me,

column.name: text
column.value: What then could I do when God arises? And when He calls me to account, how am I to answer Him?

column.name: text
column.value: Did He who made me in the womb not make him, And the same one create us in the womb?

column.name: text
column.value: “If I have kept the poor from their desire, Or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,

column.name: text
column.value: Or have eaten my morsel alone, And the orphan has not ①shared it ▷ ①Lit eaten from it

column.name: text
column.value: (But from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, And from ①my infancy I guided her), ▷ ①Lit my mother’s womb

column.name: text
column.value: If I have seen anyone perish for lack of clothing, Or that the needy had no covering,

column.name: text
column.value: If his waist has not ①thanked me, And if he has not been warmed with the fleece of my sheep, ▷ ①Lit blessed; i.e., for clothing

column.name: text
column.value: If I have lifted up my hand against the orphan, Because I saw ①I had support in the gate, ▷ ①Lit my help

column.name: text
column.value: May my shoulder fall from its ①socket, And my arm be broken off ②at the elbow. ▷ ①Lit neck-joint ②Lit from the bone of the upper arm

column.name: text
column.value: For disaster from God is a terror to me, And because of His majesty I can do nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: “If I have put my confidence in gold, And called fine gold my trust,

column.name: text
column.value: If I have gloated because my wealth was great, And because my hand had obtained so much;

column.name: text
column.value: If I have looked at the ①sun when it shone, Or the moon going in splendor, ▷ ①Lit light

column.name: text
column.value: And my heart was secretly enticed, And my hand ①threw a kiss from my mouth, ▷ ①Lit kissed my mouth

column.name: text
column.value: That too would have been a guilty deed calling for ①judgment, For I would have denied God above. ▷ ①Lit judges

column.name: text
column.value: “Have I rejoiced at the misfortune of my enemy, Or become excited when evil found him?

column.name: text
column.value: ①No, I have not ②allowed my mouth to sin By asking for his life in a curse. ▷ ①Lit And ②Lit given my palate

column.name: text
column.value: Have the people of my tent not said, ‘Who can ①find one who has not been satisfied with his meat’? ▷ ①Lit give

column.name: text
column.value: The stranger has not spent the night outside, For I have opened my doors to the ①traveler. ▷ ①MT way

column.name: text
column.value: Have I covered my wrongdoings like a man, By hiding my guilt in my shirt pocket,

column.name: text
column.value: Because I feared the great multitude And the contempt of families terrified me, And I kept silent and did not go out of doors?

column.name: text
column.value: Oh that I had one to hear me! Here is my ①signature; Let the Almighty answer me! And the indictment which my adversary has written, ▷ ①Lit mark

column.name: text
column.value: I would certainly carry it on my shoulder, I would tie it to myself like a garland.

column.name: text
column.value: I would declare to Him the number of my steps; Like a prince, I would approach Him.

column.name: text
column.value: “If my land cries out against me, And its furrows weep together;

column.name: text
column.value: If I have eaten its ①fruit without money, Or have caused ②its owners to lose their lives, ▷ ①Lit strength ②Lit the soul of its owners to expire

column.name: text
column.value: May the thorn-bush ①grow instead of wheat, And stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended. ▷ ①Lit come forth

column.name: text
column.value: Then these three men stopped answering Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: But the anger of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram, burned against Job; his anger burned because he justified himself ①before God. ▷ ①Or more than

column.name: text
column.value: And his anger burned against his three friends because they had found no answer, yet they had condemned Job.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Elihu had waited ①to speak to Job because they were years older than he. ▷ ①Lit for Job with words; or possibly while they were speaking with Job

column.name: text
column.value: But when Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of the three men, his anger burned.

column.name: text
column.value: So Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite ①spoke out and said, “I am young in years and you are old; Therefore I was shy and afraid to tell you ②what I think. ▷ ①Lit answered ②Lit my knowledge

column.name: text
column.value: I ①thought ②age should speak, And ③increased years should teach wisdom. ▷ ①Lit said ②Lit days ③Lit many

column.name: text
column.value: But it is a spirit that is in mankind, And the breath of the Almighty gives them understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①abundant in years may not be wise, Nor may elders understand justice. ▷ ①Lit great (i.e., in years); or nobles

column.name: text
column.value: So I ①say, ‘Listen to me, I too will tell ②what I think.’ ▷ ①Or said ②Lit my knowledge

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, I waited for your words, I listened to your skillful speech, While you ①pondered what to say. ▷ ①Lit searched out words

column.name: text
column.value: I also paid close attention to you; But ①indeed, there was no one who refuted Job, Not one of you who answered his words. ▷ ①Lit Behold

column.name: text
column.value: So do not say, ‘We have found wisdom: God will ①defeat him, not man.’ ▷ ①Lit scatter

column.name: text
column.value: But he has not presented his words against me, Nor will I reply to him with your ①arguments. ▷ ①Lit words

column.name: text
text
column.value: Should I wait, because they are not speaking, Because they have ①stopped and no longer answer? ▷ ①Lit stand

column.name: text
text
column.value: For I am full of words; The spirit within me compels me.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, my belly is like unvented wine; Like new wineskins, it is about to burst.

column.name: text
column.value: Let me speak so that I may get relief; Let me open my lips and answer.

column.name: text
column.value: Let me be partial to no one, Nor flatter any man.

column.name: text
column.value: For I do not know how to flatter, Otherwise my Maker would quickly take me away.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Elihu continued and said,

column.name: text
column.value: “Hear my words, you wise men, And listen to me, you who understand.

column.name: text
column.value: For the ear tests words As the palate tastes food.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us choose for ourselves what is right; Let us understand among ourselves what is good.

column.name: text
column.value: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, But God has taken away my right;

column.name: text
column.value: ①Should I lie about my right? My ②wound is incurable, though I am without wrongdoing.’ ▷ ①Or Although I am right I am accounted a liar. ②Lit arrow

column.name: text
column.value: What man is like Job, Who drinks up derision like water,

column.name: text
column.value: Who goes in company with the workers of injustice, And walks with wicked people?

column.name: text
column.value: For he has said, ‘It is of no use to a man When he becomes friends with God.’

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore, listen to me, you men of understanding. Far be it from God to do evil, And from the Almighty to do wrong.

column.name: text
column.value: For He repays a person for his work, And lets things happen in correspondence to a man’s ①behavior. ▷ ①Lit way

column.name: text
column.value: God certainly will not act wickedly, And the Almighty will not pervert justice.

column.name: text
column.value: Who gave Him authority over the earth? And who has placed the whole world on Him?

column.name: text
column.value: If He were to ①determine to do so, If He were to gather His ②spirit and His breath to Himself, ▷ ①Lit set His mind on Himself ②Or Spirit

column.name: text
column.value: ①Humanity would perish together, And mankind would return to dust. ▷ ①Lit All flesh

column.name: text
column.value: “But if you have understanding, hear this; Listen to the sound of my words.

column.name: text
column.value: Shall one who hates justice rule? And will you condemn the righteous mighty One,

column.name: text
column.value: Who says to a king, ‘You worthless one,’ To nobles, ‘You wicked one’;

column.name: text
column.value: Who shows no partiality to the prominent, Nor regards the rich as above the poor, Since they are all the work of His hands?

column.name: text
column.value: In a moment they die, and at midnight People are shaken and pass away, And the powerful are taken away without a hand.

column.name: text
column.value: “For His eyes are upon the ways of a person, And He sees all his steps.

column.name: text
column.value: There is no darkness or deep shadow Where the workers of injustice can hide themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: For He does not need to consider a person further, That he should go before God in judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: He breaks in pieces the mighty without investigation, And sets others in their place.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore He knows their deeds, And He overthrows them in the night, And they are crushed.

column.name: text
column.value: He strikes them like the wicked ①In a public place, ▷ ①Lit In the place of the ones seeing

column.name: text
column.value: Because they turned aside from following Him, And had no regard for any of His ways,

column.name: text
column.value: So that they caused the cry of the poor to come to Him, And that He would hear the cry of the afflicted—

column.name: text
column.value: When He keeps quiet, who can condemn? And when He hides His face, who then can look at Him, That is, regarding both nation and a person?—

column.name: text
column.value: So that godless people would not rule, Nor be snares for the people.

column.name: text
text
text
text
column.value: Men of understanding will say to me, And a wise man who hears me,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Job speaks without knowledge, And his words are without wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: Oh that Job were tested ①to the limit, Because ②he answers like sinners. ▷ ①Or to the end ②Lit of answers like

column.name: text
text
column.value: Then Elihu continued and said,

column.name: text
column.value: “Do you think this is in accordance with justice? Do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s’?

column.name: text
column.value: For you say, ‘What advantage will it be to ①You? What benefit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’ ▷ ①Or me

column.name: text
column.value: I will answer you, And your friends with you.

column.name: text
column.value: Look at the heavens and see; And look at the clouds—they are higher than you.

column.name: text
column.value: If you have sinned, what do you accomplish against Him? And if your wrongdoings are many, what do you do to Him?

column.name: text
column.value: If you are righteous, what do you give to Him, Or what does He receive from your hand?

column.name: text
column.value: Your wickedness is for a man like yourself, And your righteousness is for a son of man.

column.name: text
column.value: “Because of the multitude of oppressions they cry out; They cry for help because of the arm of the mighty.

column.name: text
column.value: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, Who gives songs in the night,

column.name: text
column.value: Who teaches us more than the animals of the earth And makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’

column.name: text
column.value: There they cry out, but He does not answer Because of the pride of evil people.

column.name: text
column.value: God certainly will not listen to ①an empty cry, Nor will the Almighty regard it. ▷ ①Or falsehood

column.name: text
column.value: How much less when you say you do not look at Him, The case is before Him, and you must wait for Him!

column.name: text
column.value: And now, because He has not avenged His anger, Nor has He acknowledged ①wrongdoing well, ▷ ①Or arrogance

column.name: text
column.value: So Job opens his mouth with empty words; He multiplies words without knowledge.”

column.name: text
column.value: “However, please hear my speech, Job, And listen to all my words.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold now, I open my mouth, My tongue in my ①mouth speaks. ▷ ①Lit palate

column.name: text
column.value: My words are from the integrity of my heart, And my lips speak knowledge sincerely.

column.name: text
column.value: The Spirit of God has made me, And the breath of ①the Almighty gives me life. ▷ ①Heb Shaddai

column.name: text
column.value: Refute me if you can; Line up against me, take your stand.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Behold, no fear of me should terrify you, Nor should my pressure weigh heavily on you.

column.name: text
column.value: “You have in fact spoken ①while I listened, And I heard the sound of your words: ▷ ①Lit in my ears

column.name: text
column.value: ‘I am pure, without wrongdoing; I am innocent and there is no guilt in me.

column.name: text
text
column.value: He puts my feet in the stocks; He watches all my paths.’

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, let me respond to you, you are not right in this, For God is greater than mankind.

column.name: text
column.value: “Why do you complain to Him That He does not give an account of all His doings?

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed God speaks once, Or twice, yet no one notices it.

column.name: text
column.value: In a dream, a vision of the night, When deep sleep falls on people, While they slumber in their beds,

column.name: text
column.value: Then He opens the ears of people, And horrifies them with warnings,

column.name: text
text
column.value: He keeps his soul back from the pit, And his life from perishing by the spear.

column.name: text
column.value: “A person is also rebuked by pain in his bed, And with constant complaint in his bones,

column.name: text
column.value: So that his life loathes bread, And his soul, food ①that he should crave. ▷ ①Lit of craving

column.name: text
column.value: His flesh wastes away from sight, And his bones, which were not seen, stick out.

column.name: text
column.value: Then his soul comes near to the pit, And his life to those who bring death.

column.name: text
column.value: “If there is an interceding angel for him, One out of a thousand, To remind a person of what is ①right for him, ▷ ①Lit his uprightness

column.name: text
text
column.value: Let his flesh become fresher than in youth, Let him return to the days of his youthful vigor;

column.name: text
column.value: Then he will pray to God, and He will accept him, So that he may see His face with joy, And He will restore His righteousness to that person.

column.name: text
column.value: He will sing to people and say, ‘I have sinned and perverted what is right, And it is not proper for me.

column.name: text
column.value: He has redeemed my soul from going to the pit, And my life will see the light.’

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, God does all these things for a man two or three times,

column.name: text
column.value: To bring back his soul from the pit, So that he may be enlightened with the light of life.

column.name: text
column.value: Pay attention, Job, listen to me; Keep silent, and let me speak.

column.name: text
text
column.value: If not, listen to me; Keep silent, and I will teach you wisdom.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Elihu continued and said,

column.name: text
column.value: “Wait for me a little, and I will show you That there ①is still more to be said on God’s behalf. ▷ ①Lit are yet words for God

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring my knowledge from afar, And ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

column.name: text
column.value: For truly my words are not false; One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, God is mighty but does not reject anyone; He is mighty in strength of understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: He does not keep the wicked alive, But gives justice to the afflicted.

column.name: text
column.value: He does not withdraw His eyes from the righteous, But with kings on the throne He has seated them forever, and they are exalted.

column.name: text
column.value: And if they are bound in shackles, And are caught in the snares of misery,

column.name: text
column.value: Then He declares to them their work And their wrongdoings, that they have been arrogant.

column.name: text
column.value: He opens their ears to instruction, And commands that they return from injustice.

column.name: text
column.value: If they listen and serve Him, They will end their days in prosperity, And their years in happiness.

column.name: text
column.value: But if they do not listen, they will ①perish by the sword, And die without knowledge. ▷ ①Lit pass away

column.name: text
column.value: But the godless in heart nurture anger; They do not call for help when He binds them.

column.name: text
column.value: ①They die in youth, And their life perishes among the cult prostitutes. ▷ ①Lit Their soul dies

column.name: text
column.value: He rescues the afflicted in ①their misery, And opens their ears in time of oppression. ▷ ①Lit his

column.name: text
column.value: Then indeed, He induced you away from the mouth of distress, And instead of it, a broad place with no constraint; And your table was full of ①rich food. ▷ ①Or fatness

column.name: text
column.value: “But you were full of judgment on the wicked; Judgment and justice take hold of you.

column.name: text
column.value: Beware that wrath does not entice you to mockery; And do not let the greatness of the ransom turn you aside.

column.name: text
column.value: Will your cry for help keep you from distress, Or all the exertions of your strength?

column.name: text
column.value: Do not long for the night, When people ①vanish in their places. ▷ ①Lit go up

column.name: text
column.value: Be careful, do not turn to evil, For you preferred this to misery.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, God is exalted in His power; Who is a teacher like Him?

column.name: text
column.value: Who has appointed Him His way, And who has said, ‘You have done wrong’?

column.name: text
column.value: “Remember that you are to exalt His work, Of which people have sung.

column.name: text
column.value: All people have seen it; Mankind looks at it from afar.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, God is exalted, and we do not know Him; The number of His years is unsearchable.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Which clouds pour down; They drip upon mankind abundantly.

column.name: text
column.value: Can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds, The thundering of His ①pavilion? ▷ ①Lit booth

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, He spreads His ①lightning about Him, And He covers the depths of the sea. ▷ ①Lit light

column.name: text
column.value: For by them He judges peoples; He gives food in abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: He covers His hands with the ①lightning, And commands it to strike the target. ▷ ①Lit light

column.name: text
text
column.value: “At this also my heart trembles, And leaps from its place.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen closely to the thunder of His voice, And the rumbling that goes out from His mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Under the whole heaven He lets it loose, And His ①lightning travels to the ends of the earth. ▷ ①Lit light

column.name: text
column.value: After it, a voice roars; He thunders with His majestic voice, And He does not restrain ①the lightning when His voice is heard. ▷ ①Lit them

column.name: text
column.value: God thunders wondrously with His voice, Doing great things which we do not comprehend.

column.name: text
column.value: For to the snow He says, ‘Fall on the earth,’ And to the ①downpour and the rain, ‘Be strong.’ ▷ ①Lit shower of rain and shower of rains

column.name: text
column.value: He seals the hand of every person, So that all people may know His work.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the animal goes into its lair And remains in its ①den. ▷ ①Lit dens

column.name: text
column.value: From the ①south comes the storm, And from the north wind the cold. ▷ ①Lit chamber

column.name: text
column.value: From the breath of God ice is made, And the expanse of the waters is frozen.

column.name: text
text
column.value: It changes direction, turning around by His guidance, That ①it may do whatever He commands ②it On the face of the inhabited earth. ▷ ①Lit they ②Lit them

column.name: text
column.value: Whether for ①correction, or for His earth, Or for goodness, He causes it to ②happen. ▷ ①Lit the rod ②Lit be found

column.name: text
column.value: “Listen to this, Job; Stand and consider the wonders of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Do you know how God establishes them, And makes the ①lightning of His clouds to shine? ▷ ①Lit light

column.name: text
column.value: Do you know about the hovering of the clouds, The wonders of One who is perfect in knowledge,

column.name: text
column.value: You whose garments are hot When the land is still because of the south wind?

column.name: text
column.value: Can you, with Him, spread out the skies, Strong as a cast metal mirror?

column.name: text
column.value: Teach us what we are to say to Him; We cannot present our case because of darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: Shall it be told Him that I would speak? ①Or should a man say that he would be swallowed up? ▷ ①Or If a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up

column.name: text
column.value: “Now people do not see the light which is bright in the skies; But the wind has passed and cleared them.

column.name: text
column.value: From the north comes golden splendor; Around God is awesome majesty.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Therefore people fear Him; He does not regard any who are wise of heart.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Job,

column.name: text
column.value: “Will the faultfinder contend with the Almighty? Let him who rebukes God ①give an answer.” ▷ ①Lit answer it

column.name: text
column.value: Then Job answered the LORD and said,

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, I am insignificant; what can I say in response to You? I put my hand on my mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: I have spoken once, and I will not reply; Or twice, and I will add nothing more.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD answered Job from the whirlwind and said,

column.name: text
text
column.value: Will you really nullify My judgment? Will you condemn Me so that you may be justified?

column.name: text
column.value: Or do you have an arm like God, And can you thunder with a voice like His?

column.name: text
column.value: “Adorn yourself with pride and dignity, And clothe yourself with honor and majesty.

column.name: text
column.value: Let out your outbursts of anger, And look at everyone who is arrogant, and humble him.

column.name: text
column.value: Look at everyone who is arrogant, and humble him, And trample down the wicked ①where they stand. ▷ ①Lit under them

column.name: text
text
column.value: Then I will also ①confess to you, That your own right hand can save you. ▷ ①Or praise you

column.name: text
text
column.value: Behold, his strength in his waist, And his power in the muscles of his belly.

column.name: text
column.value: He hangs his tail like a cedar; The tendons of his thighs are knit together.

column.name: text
text
column.value: “He is the first of the ways of God; Let his Maker bring His sword near.

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed the ①mountains bring him food, And all the animals of the field play there. ▷ ①I.e., the mountain streams

column.name: text
column.value: He lies down under the lotus plants, In the hiding place of the reeds and the marsh.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Can anyone capture him ①when he is on watch, Can anyone pierce his nose with barbs? ▷ ①Lit in his eyes

column.name: text
column.value: Then Job answered the LORD and said,

column.name: text
column.value: “I know that You can do all things, And that no plan is impossible for You.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Who is this who conceals advice without knowledge?’ Therefore I have declared that which I did not understand, Things too wonderful for me, which I do not know.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Please listen, and I will speak; I will ask You, and You instruct me.’

column.name: text
column.value: I have heard of You by the hearing of the ear; But now my eye sees You;

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I retract, And I repent, sitting on dust and ashes.”

column.name: text
column.value: It came about after the LORD had spoken these words to Job, that the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled against you and against your two friends, because you have not spoken of Me what is trustworthy, as My servant Job has.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, take for yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to My servant Job, and offer up a burnt offering for yourselves, and My servant Job will pray for you. For I will ①accept him so as not to do with you as your foolishness deserves, because you have not spoken of Me what is trustworthy, as My servant Job has.” ▷ ①Lit lift up his face

column.name: text
column.value: So Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite went and did as the LORD told them; and the LORD ①accepted Job. ▷ ①Lit lifted up the face of

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD also restored the fortunes of Job when he prayed for his friends, and the LORD increased double all that Job had.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all his brothers, all his sisters, and all who had known him before came to him, and they ate bread with him in his house; and they sympathized with him and comforted him for all the adversities that the LORD had brought on him. And each one gave him a ①piece of money, and each a ring of gold. ▷ ①Heb qesitah

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD blessed the latter days of Job more than his beginning; and he had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.

column.name: text
column.value: He also had seven sons and three daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: He named the first Jemimah, the second Keziah, and the third Keren-happuch.

column.name: text
column.value: In all the land no women were found as beautiful as Job’s daughters; and their father gave them inheritances among their brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: After this, Job lived 140 years, and saw his sons and his grandsons, four generations.

column.name: text
column.value: And Job died, an old man and full of days.

column.name: text
column.value: “Do you know the time the ①mountain goats give birth? Do you observe the calving of the deer? ▷ ①Lit goats of the rock

column.name: text
column.value: Can you count the months they fulfill, Or do you know the time they give birth?

column.name: text
column.value: They kneel down, they deliver their young, They get rid of their labor pains.

column.name: text
column.value: Their offspring become strong, they grow up in the open field; They leave and do not return to them.

column.name: text
column.value: “Who sent the wild donkey out free? And who opened the bonds of the swift donkey,

column.name: text
column.value: To whom I gave the wilderness as his home, And the salt land as his dwelling place?

column.name: text
column.value: He laughs at the turmoil of the city, He does not hear the shouting of the taskmaster.

column.name: text
column.value: He explores the mountains of his pasture, And searches after every green thing.

column.name: text
column.value: Will the wild bull be willing to serve you, Or will he spend the night at your feeding trough?

column.name: text
column.value: Can you tie down the wild bull in a furrow with ①ropes, Or will he ②plow the valleys after you? ▷ ①Lit his rope ②I.e., pull a harrow, a farming device

column.name: text
column.value: Will you trust him because his strength is great, And leave your labor to him?

column.name: text
column.value: Will you have faith in him that he will return your ①grain And gather it from your threshing floor? ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: “The wings of the ostrich flap joyously, With the pinion and feathers of ①love, ▷ ①Or a stork

column.name: text
column.value: For she abandons her eggs to the earth And warms them in the dust,

column.name: text
column.value: And she forgets that a foot may crush ①them, Or that a wild animal may trample ②them. ▷ ①Lit it ②Lit it

column.name: text
text
column.value: Because God has made her forget wisdom, And has not given her a share of understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: When she rushes away on high, She laughs at the horse and his rider.

column.name: text
column.value: “Do you give the horse his might? Do you clothe his neck with a mane?

column.name: text
column.value: Do you make him leap like locusts? His majestic snorting is frightening.

column.name: text
text
column.value: He laughs at fear and is not dismayed; And he does not turn back from the sword.

column.name: text
