column.value: The quiver rattles against him, The flashing spear and javelin.

column.name: text
column.value: He ①races over the ground with a roar and fury, And he does not stand still when he hears the sound of the trumpet. ▷ ①Lit swallows up

column.name: text
column.value: As often as the trumpet sounds he says, ‘Aha!’ And he senses the battle from afar, And the thunder of the captains and the war cry.

column.name: text
column.value: “Is it by your understanding that the hawk soars, Stretching his wings toward the south?

column.name: text
column.value: Is it at your ①command that the eagle flies high, And makes his nest on high? ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: He dwells and spends his nights on the cliff, On the rocky cliff, an inaccessible place.

column.name: text
column.value: From there he tracks food; His eyes look at it from afar.

column.name: text
column.value: His young ones also lick up blood greedily; And where the slain are, there he is.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD answered Job from the whirlwind and said,

column.name: text
column.value: “Who is this who darkens the divine plan By words without knowledge?

column.name: text
column.value: Now ①tighten the belt on your waist like a man, And I shall ask you, and you inform Me! ▷ ①I.e., as if for battle

column.name: text
column.value: Where were you when I laid the foundation of the earth? Tell Me, if you ①have understanding, ▷ ①Lit know understanding

column.name: text
column.value: Who set its measurements? Since you know. Or who stretched the measuring line over it?

column.name: text
column.value: On what were its bases sunk? Or who laid its cornerstone,

column.name: text
column.value: When the morning stars sang together And all the sons of God shouted for joy?

column.name: text
column.value: “Or who enclosed the sea with doors When it went out from the womb, bursting forth;

column.name: text
column.value: When I made a cloud its garment, And thick darkness its swaddling bands,

column.name: text
column.value: And I ①placed boundaries on it And set a bolt and doors, ▷ ①Lit broke My decree on it

column.name: text
column.value: And I said, ‘As far as this point you shall come, but no farther; And here your proud waves shall stop’?

column.name: text
column.value: “Have you ①ever in your life commanded the morning, And made the dawn know its place, ▷ ①Lit from your days commanded

column.name: text
column.value: So that it would take hold of the ends of the earth, And the wicked would be shaken off from it?

column.name: text
column.value: It is changed like clay under the seal; And they stand out like a garment.

column.name: text
column.value: Their light is withheld from the wicked, And the uplifted arm is broken.

column.name: text
column.value: “Have you entered the springs of the sea, And walked ①in the depth of the ocean? ▷ ①Or in search of the deep

column.name: text
column.value: Have the gates of death been revealed to you, And have you seen the gates of deep darkness?

column.name: text
column.value: Have you understood the ①expanse of the earth? Tell Me, if you know all this. ▷ ①Or width

column.name: text
column.value: “Where is the way to the dwelling of light? And darkness, where is its place,

column.name: text
column.value: That you would take it to its territory, And discern the paths to its ①home? ▷ ①Lit house

column.name: text
column.value: You know, for you were born then, And the number of your days is great!

column.name: text
column.value: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, And have you seen the storehouses of the hail,

column.name: text
column.value: Which I have reserved for a time of distress, For a day of war and battle?

column.name: text
column.value: Where is the way that the light is divided, And the east wind scattered on the earth?

column.name: text
column.value: “Who has split open a channel for the flood, And a way for the thunderbolt,

column.name: text
column.value: To bring rain on a land without ①people, On a desert without a person in it, ▷ ①Lit man

column.name: text
column.value: To satisfy the waste and desolate land, And to make the ①seeds of grass to sprout? ▷ ①Or growth

column.name: text
column.value: Does the rain have a father? Or who has fathered the drops of dew?

column.name: text
column.value: From whose womb has come the ice? And the frost of heaven, who has given it birth?

column.name: text
column.value: Water ①becomes hard like stone, And the surface of the deep is imprisoned. ▷ ①Lit hides itself like

column.name: text
column.value: “Can you tie up the chains of the Pleiades, Or untie the cords of Orion?

column.name: text
column.value: Can you bring out a ①constellation in its season, And guide the Bear with her ②satellites? ▷ ①Heb Mazzaroth ②Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: Do you know the ordinances of the heavens, Or do you establish their rule over the earth?

column.name: text
column.value: “Can you raise your voice to the clouds, So that an abundance of water will cover you?

column.name: text
column.value: Can you send flashes of lightning, so that they may go And say to you, ‘Here we are’?

column.name: text
column.value: Who has put wisdom in the innermost being, Or given understanding to the ①mind? ▷ ①Or rooster

column.name: text
column.value: Who can count the clouds by wisdom, And pour out the water jars of the heavens,

column.name: text
column.value: When the dust hardens into a mass And the clods stick together?

column.name: text
column.value: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, Or satisfy the appetite of young lions,

column.name: text
column.value: When they crouch in their hiding places, And lie in wait in their lair?

column.name: text
column.value: Who prepares ①feed for the raven When its young cry to God, And wander about without food? ▷ ①Lit its feed

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is the person who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, Nor stand in the ①path of sinners, Nor sit in the seat of scoffers! ▷ ①Or way

column.name: text
column.value: But his delight is in the Law of the LORD, And on His Law he meditates day and night.

column.name: text
column.value: He will be like a tree planted by ①streams of water, Which yields its fruit in its season, And its ②leaf does not wither; And ③in whatever he does, he prospers. ▷ ①Or canals ②Or foliage ③Or all that he does prospers

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked are not so, But they are like chaff which the wind blows away.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, Nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD ①knows the way of the righteous, But the way of the wicked will perish. ▷ ①Or approves; or has regard to

column.name: text
column.value: Can you put a ①rope in his nose, And pierce his jaw with a ②hook? ▷ ①Lit rope of rushes ②Or thorn; or ring

column.name: text
column.value: Will he make many pleas to you, Or will he speak to you gentle words?

column.name: text
column.value: Will he make a covenant with you? Will you take him as a servant forever?

column.name: text
column.value: Will you play with him as with a bird, And tie him down for your young girls?

column.name: text
column.value: Will the ①traders bargain for him? Will they divide him among the merchants? ▷ ①Lit partners

column.name: text
column.value: Can you fill his skin with harpoons, Or his head with fishing spears?

column.name: text
column.value: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle; ①you will not do it again! ▷ ①Lit do not add

column.name: text
text
column.value: in Heb ②Lit his ③Lit he

column.name: text
column.value: No one is so reckless that he dares to stir him; Who then is he who opposes Me?

column.name: text
column.value: Who has been first to give to Me, that I should repay him? Whatever is under the entire heaven is Mine.

column.name: text
column.value: “I will not be silent about his limbs, Or his mighty strength, or his graceful frame.

column.name: text
column.value: Who can ①strip off his outer covering? Who can ②pierce his double ③armor? ▷ ①Lit uncover the face of his garment ②Lit come into ③As in LXX; Heb bridle

column.name: text
column.value: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth there is terror.

column.name: text
column.value: His ①strong scales are his pride, Locked as with a tight seal. ▷ ①Lit rows of shields

column.name: text
column.value: One is so close to another That no air can come between them.

column.name: text
column.value: They are joined one to another; They clasp each other and cannot be separated.

column.name: text
column.value: His sneezes flash forth light, And his eyes are like the eye of dawn.

column.name: text
column.value: From his mouth go burning torches; Sparks of fire leap forth.

column.name: text
column.value: From his nostrils smoke goes out As from a boiling pot and burning reeds.

column.name: text
column.value: His breath sets coals aglow, And a flame goes forth from his mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: In his neck dwells strength, And dismay leaps before him.

column.name: text
column.value: The folds of his flesh are joined together, Firm and immovable on him.

column.name: text
column.value: His heart is as firm as a stone, And as firm as a lower millstone.

column.name: text
text
column.value: He regards iron as straw, Bronze as rotten wood.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Clubs are regarded as stubble; He laughs at the rattling of the javelin.

column.name: text
text
column.value: He makes the depths boil like a pot; He makes the sea like a jar of ointment.

column.name: text
column.value: Behind him he illuminates a pathway; One would think the deep to be gray-haired.

column.name: text
column.value: Nothing on ①earth is like him, One made without fear. ▷ ①Lit dust

column.name: text
text
column.value: in Heb

column.name: text
column.value: Why are the ①nations restless And the peoples plotting in vain? ▷ ①Or Gentiles

column.name: text
column.value: The kings of the earth take their stand And the rulers conspire together Against the LORD and against His ①Anointed, saying, ▷ ①Or Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: “Let’s tear their shackles apart And throw their ropes away from us!”

column.name: text
column.value: He who ①sits in the heavens laughs, The Lord scoffs at them. ▷ ①Or is enthroned

column.name: text
column.value: Then He will speak to them in His anger And terrify them in His fury, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “But as for Me, I have installed My King Upon Zion, My holy mountain.”

column.name: text
column.value: “I will announce the ①decree of the LORD: He said to Me, ‘You are My Son, Today I have fathered You. ▷ ①Or decree: The LORD said to Me

column.name: text
column.value: Ask it of Me, and I will certainly give the ①nations as Your inheritance, And the ends of the earth as Your possession. ▷ ①Or Gentiles

column.name: text
column.value: You shall ①break them with a ②rod of iron, You shall shatter them like ③earthenware.’ ” ▷ ①Another reading is rule ②Or scepter; or staff ③Lit potter’s ware

column.name: text
text
column.value: Serve the LORD with ①reverence And rejoice with trembling. ▷ ①Or fear

column.name: text
column.value: ①Kiss the Son, that He not be angry and you perish on the way, For His wrath may be kindled quickly. How blessed are all who take refuge in Him! ▷ ①I.e., probably kiss the feet of the Son

column.name: text
column.value: [A Psalm of David, when ①he fled from his son Absalom.] LORD, how my enemies have increased! Many are rising up against me. ▷ ①2 Sam 15:13-17, 29

column.name: text
column.value: Many are saying of my soul, “There is no salvation for him in God.” Selah

column.name: text
column.value: But You, LORD, are a shield around me, My glory, and the One who lifts my head.

column.name: text
column.value: I was crying out to the LORD with my voice, And He answered me from His holy ①mountain. Selah ▷ ①Or hill

column.name: text
text
column.value: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people Who have set themselves against me all around.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, LORD; save me, my God! For You ①have struck all my enemies on the ②cheek; You ③have shattered the teeth of the wicked. ▷ ①Or strike ②Or jaw ③Or shatter

column.name: text
text
column.value: [ ①For the music director; on stringed instruments. A Psalm of David.] Answer me when I call, God ②of my righteousness! You have ③relieved me in my distress; Be gracious to me and hear my prayer. ▷ ①I.e., Belonging to the choir director’s anthology ②I.e., who maintains my right ③Lit made room for

column.name: text
column.value: You sons of man, how long will my ①honor be treated as an insult? How long will you love what is worthless and strive for a lie? Selah ▷ ①Or glory

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Offer ①the sacrifices of righteousness, And trust in the LORD. ▷ ①Or righteous sacrifices

column.name: text
column.value: Many are saying, “Who will show us anything good?” Lift up the light of Your face upon us, LORD!

column.name: text
column.value: You have put joy in my heart, More than when their grain and new wine are abundant.

column.name: text
column.value: In peace I will ①both lie down and sleep, For You alone, LORD, have me dwell in safety. ▷ ①Or at the same time

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director; for ①flute accompaniment. A Psalm of David.] Listen to my words, LORD, Consider my sighing. ▷ ①Heb Nehiloth

column.name: text
column.value: Listen to the sound of my cry for help, my King and my God, For to You I pray.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For You are not a God who takes pleasure in wickedness; No evil can dwell with You.

column.name: text
column.value: The boastful will not stand before Your eyes; You hate all who do injustice.

column.name: text
column.value: You destroy those who speak lies; The LORD loathes the person of bloodshed and deceit.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for me, by Your abundant graciousness I will enter Your house, ①At Your holy temple I will bow in reverence for You. ▷ ①Or Toward

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Make them pay, God; Have them fall by their own schemes! Scatter them in the multitude of their wrongdoings, For they are rebellious against You.

column.name: text
column.value: But rejoice, all who take refuge in You, Sing for joy forever! And ①may You shelter them, That those who love Your name may rejoice in You. ▷ ①Or You shelter

column.name: text
column.value: For You bless the righteous person, LORD, You surround him with favor as with a shield.

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director; with stringed instruments, ①upon an eight-string lyre. A Psalm of David.] LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger, Nor discipline me in Your wrath. ▷ ①Or according to a lower octave (Heb Sheminith)

column.name: text
column.value: Be gracious to me, LORD, for I am frail; Heal me, LORD, for my bones are horrified.

column.name: text
column.value: And my soul is greatly horrified; But You, LORD—how long?

column.name: text
text
text
text
column.value: My eye has wasted away with grief; It has grown old because of all my enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: Leave me, all you who practice injustice, For the LORD has heard the sound of my weeping.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has heard my pleading, The LORD receives my prayer.

column.name: text
text
column.value: [A ①Shiggaion of David, which he sang to the Lord ②concerning Cush, a Benjaminite.] O LORD my God, in You I have taken refuge; Save me from all those who pursue me, and rescue me, ▷ ①I.e., Dithyrambic rhythm; or wild, passionate song ②Or concerning the words of

column.name: text
column.value: Or he will tear ①my soul like a lion, Dragging me away, while there is no one to rescue me. ▷ ①Or me

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD my God, if I have done this, If there is injustice in my hands,

column.name: text
column.value: If I have done evil to ①my friend, Or have plundered ②my enemy for no reason, ▷ ①Lit him who was at peace with me ②Or him who for no reason was my enemy,

column.name: text
column.value: Let the enemy pursue ①my soul and overtake ②it; And let him trample my life to the ground And lay my glory in the dust. Selah ▷ ①Or me ②Or me

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, LORD, in Your anger; Raise Yourself against the rage of my enemies, And stir Yourself ①for me; You have ordered judgment. ▷ ①One ancient version reads O my God

column.name: text
column.value: Let the assembly of the peoples encompass You, And return on high over it.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: My shield is ①with God, Who saves the upright in heart. ▷ ①Lit upon

column.name: text
column.value: God is a righteous judge, And a God who shows indignation every day.

column.name: text
column.value: If one does not repent, He will sharpen His sword; He has bent His bow and taken aim.

column.name: text
column.value: He has also prepared deadly weapons for Himself; He makes His arrows fiery shafts.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, an evil person is pregnant with injustice, And he conceives harm and gives birth to lies.

column.name: text
column.value: He has dug a pit and hollowed it out, And has fallen into the hole which he made.

column.name: text
column.value: His harm will return on his own head, And his violence will descend on the top of his own head.

column.name: text
column.value: I will give thanks to the LORD according to His righteousness And will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, our Lord, How majestic is Your name in all the earth, You who have ①displayed Your splendor above the heavens! ▷ ①Lit put

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director; on the Gittith. A Psalm of David.] From the mouths of infants and nursing babies You have established ①strength Because of Your enemies, To do away with the enemy and the revengeful. ▷ ①Or a strength

column.name: text
text
column.value: What is man that You think of him, And a son of man that You are concerned about him?

column.name: text
column.value: Yet You have made him a little lower than ①God, And You crown him with glory and majesty! ▷ ①LXX angels

column.name: text
column.value: You have him rule over the works of Your hands; You have put everything under his feet,

column.name: text
column.value: All sheep and oxen, And also the animals of the field,

column.name: text
column.value: The birds of the sky, and the fish of the sea, Whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, our Lord, How majestic is Your name in all the earth!

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director; on ①Muth-labben. A Psalm of David.] I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart; I will tell of all Your ②wonders. ▷ ①Meaning of the Heb uncertain ②Or miracles

column.name: text
column.value: I will rejoice and be jubilant in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.

column.name: text
column.value: When my enemies turn back, They stumble and perish before You.

column.name: text
text
column.value: You have rebuked the nations, You have eliminated the wicked; You have wiped out their name forever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: ①The enemy has come to an end in everlasting ruins, And You have uprooted the cities; The very memory of them has perished. ▷ ①Or O enemy, desolations are finished forever; And their cities You have uprooted

column.name: text
text
column.value: And He will judge the world in righteousness; He will execute judgment for the peoples fairly.

column.name: text
text
column.value: And ①those who know Your name will put their trust in You, For You, LORD, have not abandoned those who seek You. ▷ ①Or let those...name put

column.name: text
column.value: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion; Declare His deeds among the peoples.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: So that I may tell of all Your praises, That in the gates of the daughter of Zion I may rejoice in Your ①salvation. ▷ ①Or deliverance

column.name: text
column.value: The nations have sunk down into the pit which they have made; In the net which they hid, their own foot has been caught.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has made Himself known; He has executed judgment. A wicked one is ensnared in the work of his own hands. ①Higgaion Selah ▷ ①Perhaps, resounding music or meditation

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked will ①return to ②Sheol, All the nations who forget God. ▷ ①Or turn ②I.e., the netherworld

column.name: text
column.value: For the needy will not always be forgotten, Nor the hope of the afflicted perish forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, LORD, do not let mankind prevail; Let the nations be judged before You.

column.name: text
column.value: Put them in fear, LORD; Let the nations know that they are merely human. Selah

column.name: text
text
column.value: For, behold, the wicked bend the bow, They have ①set their arrow on the string To shoot in darkness at the upright in heart. ▷ ①Or fixed

column.name: text
column.value: If the foundations are destroyed, What can the righteous do?”

column.name: text
text
column.value: The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked, And His soul hates one who loves violence.

column.name: text
column.value: He will rain ①coals of fire upon the wicked, And brimstone and burning wind will be the portion of their cup. ▷ ①As in a Gr version; MT snares; Fire and

column.name: text
text
column.value: [For the music director; ①upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David.] Help, LORD, for the godly person has come to an end, For the faithful have disappeared from the sons of mankind. ▷ ①Or according to a lower octave (Heb Sheminith)

column.name: text
text
text
text
column.value: “Because of the devastation of the poor, because of the groaning of the needy, Now I will arise,” says the LORD; “I will put him in the safety for which he longs.”

column.name: text
column.value: The words of the LORD are pure words; Like silver refined in a furnace on the ground, filtered seven times.

column.name: text
column.value: You, LORD, will keep them; You will protect him from this generation forever.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked strut about on every side When ①vileness is exalted among the sons of mankind. ▷ ①Or worthlessness

column.name: text
column.value: Why do You stand far away, LORD? Why do You hide ①Yourself in times of trouble? ▷ ①Or Your eyes

column.name: text
text
column.value: For the wicked boasts of his soul’s desire, And ①the greedy person curses and shows disrespect to the LORD. ▷ ①Or blesses the greedy man

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked, ①in his haughtiness, does not seek Him. There is no God in all his schemes. ▷ ①Lit the height of his nose

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression; Under his tongue is harm and injustice.

column.name: text
text
text
text
column.value: He says to himself, “God has forgotten; He has hidden His face; He will never see it.”

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, LORD; God, lift up Your hand. Do not forget the humble.

column.name: text
column.value: Why has the wicked treated God disrespectfully? He has said to himself, “ ①You will not require an account.” ▷ ①I.e., as though God will ignore it

column.name: text
column.value: You have seen it, for You have looked at harm and provocation to ①take it into Your hand. The ②unfortunate commits himself to You; You have been the helper of the orphan. ▷ ①Lit put, give ②Or poor

column.name: text
column.value: Break the arm of the wicked and the evildoer, ①Seek out his wickedness until You find none. ▷ ①Or May You seek

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is King forever and ever; Nations have perished from His land.

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, You have heard the desire of the humble; You will strengthen their heart, You will make Your ear attentive

column.name: text
column.value: To ①vindicate the orphan and the oppressed, So that mankind, which is of the earth, will no longer cause terror. ▷ ①Lit judge

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director. A Psalm of David.] How long, LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?

column.name: text
column.value: How long am I to feel anxious in my soul, With grief in my heart all the day? How long will my enemy be exalted over me?

column.name: text
column.value: Consider and answer me, O LORD my God; Enlighten my eyes, or I will sleep the sleep of death,

column.name: text
column.value: And my enemy will say, “I have overcome him,” And my adversaries will rejoice when I am shaken.

column.name: text
column.value: But I have trusted in Your faithfulness; My heart shall rejoice in Your salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: I will sing to the LORD, Because He has looked after me.

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director. A Psalm of David.] The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, they have committed detestable acts; There is no one who does good.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has looked down from heaven upon the sons of mankind To see if there are any who ①understand, Who seek God. ▷ ①Or act wisely

column.name: text
column.value: They have all turned aside, together they are corrupt; There is no one who does good, not even one.

column.name: text
column.value: Do all the workers of injustice not know, Who devour my people as they eat bread, And do not call upon the LORD?

column.name: text
column.value: There they are in great dread, For God is with a righteous generation.

column.name: text
column.value: You would put to shame the plan of the poor, But the LORD is his refuge.

column.name: text
column.value: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of His people, Jacob will rejoice, Israel will be glad.

column.name: text
column.value: [A Psalm of David.] LORD, who may reside in Your tent? Who may settle on Your holy hill?

column.name: text
column.value: One who walks with integrity, practices righteousness, And speaks truth in his heart.

column.name: text
column.value: He does not slander ①with his tongue, Nor do evil to his neighbor, Nor bring shame on his friend; ▷ ①Lit according to

column.name: text
text
column.value: He does not ①lend his money ②at interest, Nor does he take a bribe against the innocent. One who does these things will never be shaken. ▷ ①Lit give ②I.e., to a fellow Israelite

column.name: text
column.value: [A ①Mikhtam of David.] Protect me, God, for I take refuge in You. ▷ ①Possibly Epigrammatic Poem or Atonement Psalm

column.name: text
text
column.value: As for the ①saints who are on the earth, ②They are the majestic ones; all my delight is in them. ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people ②Lit They, even the

column.name: text
column.value: ①The pains of those who have acquired another god will be multiplied; I will not pour out their drink offerings of blood, Nor will I take their names upon my lips. ▷ ①Lit Their pains, they who acquired

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is the portion of my inheritance and my cup; You support my lot.

column.name: text
column.value: The measuring lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; Indeed, my inheritance is beautiful to me.

column.name: text
text
column.value: I have set the LORD continually before me; Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore my heart is glad and my glory rejoices; My flesh also will dwell securely.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: [For the music director. A Psalm of David, the servant of the LORD, ①who spoke to the LORD the words of this song on the day that the LORD rescued him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul. And he said,] “I love You, LORD, my strength.” ▷ ①2 Sam 22:1-51

column.name: text
text
column.value: I call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised, And I am saved from my enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: The ropes of death encompassed me, And the torrents of ①destruction ②terrified me. ▷ ①Or ungodliness; Heb Belial ②Or were assailing; or terrifying

column.name: text
text
column.value: In my distress I called upon the LORD, And cried to my God for help; He heard my voice from His temple, And my cry for help before Him came into His ears.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Smoke went up ①out of His nostrils, And fire from His mouth was devouring; Coals burned from it. ▷ ①Or in His wrath

column.name: text
column.value: He also bowed the heavens down low, and came down With thick darkness under His feet.

column.name: text
column.value: He rode on a cherub and flew; And He sped on the wings of the wind.

column.name: text
column.value: He made darkness His hiding place, His ①canopy around Him, Darkness of waters, thick clouds. ▷ ①Or pavilion

column.name: text
column.value: From the brightness before Him passed His thick clouds, Hailstones and coals of fire.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, And the Most High uttered His voice, Hailstones and coals of fire.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent out His arrows, and scattered them, And lightning flashes in abundance, and ①routed them. ▷ ①Lit confused

column.name: text
column.value: Then the channels of water appeared, And the foundations of the world were exposed By Your rebuke, LORD, At the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent from on high, He took me; He drew me out of many waters.

column.name: text
column.value: He saved me from my strong enemy, And from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me.

column.name: text
column.value: They confronted me in the day of my disaster, But the LORD was my support.

column.name: text
column.value: He also brought me out into an open place; He rescued me, because He delighted in me.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands He has repaid me.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, And have not acted wickedly against my God.

column.name: text
column.value: For all His judgments were before me, And I did not put away His statutes from me.

column.name: text
column.value: I was also ①blameless with Him, And I kept myself from my wrongdoing. ▷ ①Lit complete; or having integrity; or perfect

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands in His eyes.

column.name: text
text
column.value: With the pure You show Yourself pure, And with the crooked You show Yourself ①astute. ▷ ①Lit twisted

column.name: text
column.value: For You save an afflicted people, But You humiliate haughty eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: For You light my lamp; The LORD my God illumines my darkness.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: For who is God, but the LORD? And who is a rock, except our God,

column.name: text
column.value: The God who encircles me with strength, And ①makes my way ②blameless? ▷ ①Or has made ②Lit complete; or having integrity

column.name: text
column.value: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, And sets me up on my high places.

column.name: text
column.value: He trains my hands for battle, So that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

column.name: text
column.value: You have also given me the shield of Your salvation, And Your right hand upholds me; And Your ①gentleness makes me great. ▷ ①Or condescension

column.name: text
column.value: You enlarge my steps under me, And my ①feet have not slipped. ▷ ①Lit ankles

column.name: text
column.value: I pursued my enemies and overtook them, And I did not turn back until they were consumed.

column.name: text
column.value: I shattered them, so that they were not able to rise; They fell under my feet.

column.name: text
column.value: For You have encircled me with strength for battle; You have forced those who rose up against me to bow down under me.

column.name: text
column.value: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, And I ①destroyed those who hated me. ▷ ①Or silenced

column.name: text
column.value: They cried for help, but there was no one to save, They cried to the LORD, but He did not answer them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I beat them fine like the dust before the wind; I emptied them out like the mud of the streets.

column.name: text
text
column.value: As soon as they hear, they obey me; Foreigners pretend to obey me.

column.name: text
column.value: Foreigners lose heart, And come trembling out of their ①fortresses. ▷ ①Or prisons

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD lives, and blessed be my rock; And exalted be the God of my salvation,

column.name: text
column.value: The God who executes vengeance for me, And subdues peoples under me.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Therefore I will give thanks to You among the nations, LORD, And I will sing praises to Your name.

column.name: text
column.value: He gives great ①salvation to His king, And shows faithfulness to His anointed, To David and his ②descendants forever. ▷ ①I.e., victories; lit salvations ②Lit seed

column.name: text
text
text
text
column.value: As for the works of mankind, by the word of Your lips I have kept from the ways of the violent.

column.name: text
column.value: My steps have held to Your ①paths. My feet have not slipped. ▷ ①Lit tracks

column.name: text
column.value: I have called upon You, for You will answer me, God; Incline Your ear to me, hear my speech.

column.name: text
column.value: Show Your wonderful faithfulness, Savior of those who take refuge ①at Your right hand From those who rise up against them. ▷ ①Or from those who rise up...at Your right hand

column.name: text
text
column.value: From the wicked who deal violently with me, My deadly enemies who surround me.

column.name: text
column.value: They have closed their ①unfeeling hearts, With their mouths they speak proudly. ▷ ①Lit fat

column.name: text
column.value: They have now surrounded us in our steps; They set their eyes to cast us down to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: He is like a lion that is eager to tear, And as a young lion lurking in secret places.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, LORD, confront him, make him bow down; Save my soul from the wicked with Your sword,

column.name: text
column.value: From people by Your hand, LORD, From people ①of the world, whose portion is in this life, And whose belly You fill with Your treasure; They are satisfied with children, And leave their abundance to their babies. ▷ ①Or whose portion in life is of the world

column.name: text
column.value: As for me, I shall behold Your face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied with Your likeness when I awake.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Day to day pours forth speech, And night to night reveals knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: There is no speech, nor are there words; Their voice is not heard.

column.name: text
column.value: Their ①line has gone out into all the earth, And their words to the end of the world. In them He has placed a tent for the sun, ▷ ①Another reading is sound

column.name: text
column.value: Which is like a groom coming out of his chamber; It rejoices like a strong person to run his course.

column.name: text
column.value: Its rising is from ①one end of the heavens, And its circuit to the ②other end of them; And there is nothing hidden from its heat. ▷ ①Lit the end ②Lit the ends

column.name: text
text
column.value: The precepts of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart; The commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever; The judgments of the LORD are true; they are righteous altogether.

column.name: text
column.value: They are more desirable than gold, yes, than much pure gold; Sweeter also than honey and drippings of the honeycomb.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, Your servant is warned by them; In keeping them there is great reward.

column.name: text
column.value: Who can discern his errors? Acquit me of hidden faults.

column.name: text
text
column.value: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in Your sight, LORD, my rock and my Redeemer.

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director. A Psalm of David.] May the LORD answer you on a day of trouble! May the name of the God of Jacob ①protect you! ▷ ①Lit make you high and inaccessible

column.name: text
column.value: May He send you help from the sanctuary, And support you from Zion!

column.name: text
column.value: May He remember all your meal offerings And ①accept your burnt offering! Selah ▷ ①Lit consider your...as fat

column.name: text
column.value: May He grant you your heart’s desire And fulfill your whole plan!

column.name: text
column.value: ①We will sing for joy over your ②victory, And in the name of our God we will set up our banners. May the LORD fulfill all your desires. ▷ ①Or Let’s sing ②Or salvation

column.name: text
column.value: Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He will answer him from His holy heaven With the ①saving strength of His right hand. ▷ ①Or mighty deeds of the victory of His right hand

column.name: text
column.value: Some praise their chariots and some their horses, But we will praise the name of the LORD, our God.

column.name: text
column.value: They have bowed down and fallen, But we have risen and stood upright.

column.name: text
text
column.value: [For the music director. A Psalm of David.] LORD, in Your strength the king will be glad, And in Your ①salvation how greatly he will rejoice! ▷ ①Or victory

column.name: text
column.value: You have given him his heart’s desire, And You have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: For You meet him with the blessings of good things; You set a crown of pure gold on his head.

column.name: text
column.value: He asked for life from You, You gave it to him, Length of days forever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: His glory is great through Your ①salvation, Splendor and majesty You place upon him. ▷ ①Or victory

column.name: text
text
column.value: For the king trusts in the LORD, And through the faithfulness of the Most High he will not be shaken.

column.name: text
column.value: Your hand will find all your enemies; Your right hand will find those who hate you.

column.name: text
column.value: You will make them as a fiery oven in the time ①of your anger; The LORD will swallow them up in His wrath, And fire will devour them. ▷ ①Or of your presence

column.name: text
column.value: You will eliminate their ①descendants from the earth, And their ②children from among the sons of mankind. ▷ ①Lit fruit ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: Though they ①intended evil against You And devised a plot, They will not succeed. ▷ ①Lit stretched out

column.name: text
column.value: For You will make them turn their back; You will take aim at their faces with Your bowstrings.

column.name: text
column.value: Be exalted, LORD, in Your strength; We will sing and praise Your power.

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director; upon ①Aijeleth Hashshahar. A Psalm of David.] My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Far from my ②help are the words of my ③groaning. ▷ ①Lit the doe of the morning ②Or deliverance ③Lit screaming

column.name: text
text
column.value: Yet You are holy, You who ①are enthroned upon the praises of Israel. ▷ ①Or inhabit the praises

column.name: text
column.value: In You our fathers trusted; They trusted and You rescued them.

column.name: text
text
column.value: But I am a worm and not a person, A disgrace of mankind and despised by the people.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Yet You are He who brought me forth from the womb; You made me trust when upon my mother’s breasts.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Many bulls have surrounded me; Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.

column.name: text
column.value: They open their mouths wide at me, As a ravening and roaring lion.

column.name: text
text
column.value: My strength is dried up like a piece of pottery, And my tongue clings to my jaws; And You lay me ①in the dust of death. ▷ ①Lit to

column.name: text
text
column.value: I can count all my bones. They look, they stare at me;

column.name: text
column.value: They divide my garments among them, And they cast lots for my clothing.

column.name: text
column.value: But You, LORD, do not be far away; You who are my help, hurry to my assistance.

column.name: text
column.value: Save my ①soul from the sword, My only life from the ②power of the dog. ▷ ①Or life ②Lit paw

column.name: text
column.value: Save me from the lion’s mouth; From the horns of the wild oxen You answer me.

column.name: text
column.value: I will proclaim Your name to my brothers; In the midst of the assembly I will praise You.

column.name: text
column.value: You who fear the LORD, praise Him; All you ①descendants of Jacob, glorify Him, And stand in awe of Him, all you ②descendants of Israel. ▷ ①Lit seed ②Lit seed

column.name: text
text
column.value: From You comes my praise in the great assembly; I shall pay my vows before those who fear Him.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①afflicted will eat and be satisfied; Those who seek Him will praise the LORD. May your heart live forever! ▷ ①Or poor

column.name: text
column.value: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD, And all the families of the nations will worship before ①You. ▷ ①Some ancient versions Him

column.name: text
column.value: For the kingdom is the LORD’S And He rules over the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: All the ①prosperous of the earth will eat and worship, All those who go down to the dust will kneel before Him, Even he who ②cannot keep his soul alive. ▷ ①Lit fat ones ②Or did not

column.name: text
text
column.value: They will come and will declare His righteousness To a people who will be born, that He has performed it.

column.name: text
column.value: [A Psalm of David.] The LORD is my shepherd, I will not be in need.

column.name: text
text
column.value: He restores my soul; He guides me in the ①paths of righteousness For the sake of His name. ▷ ①Lit tracks

column.name: text
column.value: Even though I walk through the ①valley of the shadow of death, I fear no ②evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me. ▷ ①Or valley of deep darkness ②Or harm

column.name: text
text
column.value: ①Certainly goodness and ②faithfulness will follow me all the days of my life, And my dwelling will be in the house of the LORD ③forever. ▷ ①Or Only ②Or mercy ③Lit for length of days

column.name: text
column.value: [A Psalm of David.] The earth is the LORD’S, and ①all it contains, The world, and those who live in it. ▷ ①Lit its fullness

column.name: text
column.value: For He has founded it upon the seas And established it upon the rivers.

column.name: text
column.value: Who may ascend onto the hill of the LORD? And who may stand in His holy place?

column.name: text
column.value: One who has clean hands and a pure heart, Who has not lifted up his soul to deceit And has not sworn deceitfully.

column.name: text
column.value: He will receive a blessing from the LORD And ①righteousness from the God of his salvation. ▷ ①I.e., as vindicated

column.name: text
column.value: ①This is the generation of those who seek Him, Who seek Your face—even Jacob. Selah ▷ ①Or Such

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up your heads, you gates, And be lifted up, you ①ancient doors, That the King of glory may come in! ▷ ①Lit everlasting

column.name: text
column.value: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, The LORD mighty in battle.

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up your heads, you gates, And lift them up, you ①ancient doors, That the King of glory may come in! ▷ ①Lit everlasting

column.name: text
column.value: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of armies, He is the King of glory. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: [A Psalm of David.] ①Vindicate me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity, And I have trusted in the LORD ②without wavering. ▷ ①Lit Judge ②Lit I do not slide

column.name: text
text
column.value: For Your ①goodness is before my eyes, And I have walked in Your truth. ▷ ①Or faithfulness

column.name: text
column.value: I do not sit with ①deceitful people, Nor will I go with ②pretenders. ▷ ①Or worthless men; lit men of falsehood ②Or dissemblers, hypocrites

column.name: text
column.value: I hate the assembly of evildoers, And I will not sit with the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: I will wash my hands in innocence, And I will go around Your altar, LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: That I may proclaim with the voice of thanksgiving And declare all Your ①wonders. ▷ ①Or miracles

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, I love the dwelling of Your house, And the place ①where Your glory remains. ▷ ①Lit of the tabernacle of Your glory

column.name: text
column.value: Do not ①take my soul away along with sinners, Nor my life with men of bloodshed, ▷ ①Lit gather

column.name: text
column.value: In whose hands is a wicked scheme, And whose right hand is full of bribes.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity; Redeem me, and be gracious to me.

column.name: text
column.value: My foot stands on level ground; In the congregations I will bless the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: [A Psalm of David.] To You, LORD, I lift up my soul.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Make me know Your ways, LORD; Teach me Your paths.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Remember, LORD, Your compassion and Your faithfulness, For they have been ①from of old. ▷ ①Or everlasting

column.name: text
text
column.value: The LORD is good and upright; Therefore He instructs sinners in the way.

column.name: text
column.value: He leads the ①humble in justice, And He teaches the ②humble His way. ▷ ①Or afflicted ②Or afflicted

column.name: text
column.value: All the paths of the LORD are faithfulness and truth To those who comply with His covenant and His testimonies.

column.name: text
column.value: For the sake of Your name, LORD, Forgive my wrongdoing, for it is great.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is the person who fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the way he should choose.

column.name: text
column.value: His soul will dwell in ①prosperity, And his ②descendants will inherit the ③land. ▷ ①Lit good ②Lit seed ③Or earth

column.name: text
column.value: The ①secret of the LORD is for those who fear Him, ②And He will make them know His covenant. ▷ ①Or counsel; or intimacy ②Or And His covenant, to make them know it

column.name: text
column.value: My eyes are continually toward the LORD, For He will ①rescue my feet from the net. ▷ ①Lit bring out

column.name: text
column.value: Turn to me and be gracious to me, For I am lonely and afflicted.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Look at my misery and my trouble, And forgive all my sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Look at my enemies, for they are many, And they hate me with violent hatred.

column.name: text
column.value: Guard my soul and save me; Do not let me be ashamed, for I take refuge in You.

column.name: text
column.value: Let integrity and uprightness protect me, For I wait for You.

column.name: text
column.value: Redeem Israel, God, From all his distress.

column.name: text
column.value: [A Psalm of David.] To You, LORD, I call; My rock, do not be deaf to me, For if You are silent to me, I will become like those who go down to the pit.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear the sound of my pleadings when I cry to You for help, When I raise my hands toward ①Your holy sanctuary. ▷ ①Lit the innermost place of Your sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: Do not drag me away with the wicked And with those who practice injustice, Who speak peace with their neighbors, While evil is in their hearts.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Because they do not regard the works of the LORD Nor the deeds of His hands, He will tear them down and not build them up.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed be the LORD, Because He has heard the sound of my pleading.

column.name: text
text
column.value: The LORD is ①their strength, And He is a refuge of salvation to His anointed. ▷ ①A few mss and ancient versions the strength of His people

column.name: text
column.value: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; Be their shepherd also, and carry them forever.

column.name: text
column.value: [A Psalm; a Song at the Dedication of the House. A Psalm of David.] I will exalt You, LORD, for You have lifted me up, And have not let my enemies rejoice over me.

column.name: text
column.value: LORD my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Sing praise to the LORD, you His godly ones, And praise the mention of His holiness.

column.name: text
column.value: For His anger is but for a moment, His favor is for a lifetime; Weeping may last for the night, But a shout of joy comes in the morning.

column.name: text
column.value: Now as for me, I said in my prosperity, “I will never be moved.”

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, by Your favor You have made my mountain to stand strong; You hid Your face, I was dismayed.

column.name: text
column.value: To You, LORD, I called, And to the Lord I pleaded for compassion:

column.name: text
column.value: “What gain is there in my blood, if I go down to the pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it declare Your faithfulness?

column.name: text
column.value: “Hear, LORD, and be gracious to me; LORD, be my helper.”

column.name: text
column.value: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me; You have untied my sackcloth and encircled me with joy,

column.name: text
column.value: That my ①soul may sing praise to You and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to You forever. ▷ ①Lit glory

column.name: text
text
column.value: Incline Your ear to me, rescue me quickly; Be a rock of ①strength for me, A ②stronghold to save me. ▷ ①Or refuge, protection ②Lit house of a stronghold

column.name: text
column.value: For You are my rock and my fortress; For the sake of Your name You will lead me and guide me.

column.name: text
column.value: You will pull me out of the net which they have secretly laid for me, For You are my strength.

column.name: text
text
column.value: I hate those who devote themselves to worthless ①idols, But I trust in the LORD. ▷ ①Lit futilities

column.name: text
text
column.value: And You have not handed me over to the enemy; You have set my feet in a large place.

column.name: text
column.value: Be gracious to me, LORD, for I am in distress; My eye is wasted away from grief, my soul and my body too.

column.name: text
column.value: For my life is spent with sorrow And my years with sighing; My strength has failed because of my guilt, And my ①body has wasted away. ▷ ①Or bones, substance

column.name: text
column.value: Because of all my adversaries, I have become a disgrace, Especially to my neighbors, And an object of dread to my acquaintances; Those who see me in the street flee from me.

column.name: text
column.value: I am forgotten like a dead person, out of mind; I am like a broken vessel.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have heard the ①slander of many, Terror is on every side; While they took counsel together against me, They schemed to take away my life. ▷ ①Lit whispering

column.name: text
column.value: But as for me, I trust in You, LORD, I say, “You are my God.”

column.name: text
column.value: My times are in Your hand; Rescue me from the hand of my enemies and from those who persecute me.

column.name: text
column.value: Make Your face shine upon Your servant; Save me in Your faithfulness.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Let the lying lips be speechless, Which speak arrogantly against the righteous With pride and contempt.

column.name: text
column.value: How great is Your goodness, Which You have stored up for those who fear You, Which You have performed for those who take refuge in You, Before the sons of mankind!

column.name: text
text
column.value: Blessed be the LORD, For He has shown His marvelous faithfulness to me in a besieged city.

column.name: text
column.value: As for me, I said in my alarm, “I am cut off from Your eyes”; Nevertheless You heard the sound of my pleadings When I called to You for help.

column.name: text
column.value: Love the LORD, all His godly ones! The LORD watches over the faithful But fully repays the one who acts arrogantly.

column.name: text
column.value: Be strong and let your heart take courage, All you who wait for the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: [A Psalm of David. A ①Maskil.] How blessed is he whose wrongdoing is forgiven, Whose sin is covered! ▷ ①Possibly Contemplative; or Didactic; or Skillful Psalm

column.name: text
column.value: How blessed is a person whose guilt the LORD does not take into account, And in whose spirit there is no deceit!

column.name: text
column.value: When I kept silent about my sin, my ①body wasted away Through my ②groaning all day long. ▷ ①Or bones, substance ②Lit roaring

column.name: text
text
text
text
text
column.value: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you should go; I will advise you with My eye upon you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be like the horse or like the mule, which have no understanding, Whose trappings include bit and bridle to hold them in check, Otherwise they will not come near to you.

column.name: text
column.value: The sorrows of the wicked are many, But the one who trusts in the LORD, goodness will surround him.

column.name: text
column.value: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, you righteous ones; And shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart.

column.name: text
column.value: [A Psalm of David, when he pretended to be insane before ①Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed.] I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise shall continually be in my mouth. ▷ ①Possibly a title of King Achish of Gath, see 1 Sam 21:10-15

column.name: text
column.value: My soul will make its boast in the LORD; The humble will hear it and rejoice.

column.name: text
column.value: Exalt the LORD with me, And let’s exalt His name together.

column.name: text
column.value: I sought the LORD and He answered me, And rescued me from all my fears.

column.name: text
column.value: They looked to Him and were radiant, And their faces will never be ashamed.

column.name: text
column.value: This wretched man cried out, and the LORD heard him, And saved him out of all his troubles.

column.name: text
column.value: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, And rescues them.

column.name: text
column.value: Taste and see that the LORD is good; How blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!

column.name: text
column.value: Fear the LORD, you His saints; For to those who fear Him there is no lack of anything.

column.name: text
column.value: The young lions do without and suffer hunger; But they who seek the LORD will not lack any good thing.

column.name: text
column.value: Come, you children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is the person who desires life And loves length of days, that he may see good?

column.name: text
column.value: Keep your tongue from evil And your lips from speaking deceit.

column.name: text
column.value: Turn from evil and do good; Seek peace and pursue it.

column.name: text
column.value: The eyes of the LORD are toward the righteous, And His ears are toward their cry for help.

column.name: text
column.value: The face of the LORD is against evildoers, To eliminate the memory of them from the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears And rescues them from all their troubles.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted And saves those who are ①crushed in spirit. ▷ ①Or contrite

column.name: text
column.value: The afflictions of the righteous are many, But the LORD rescues him from them all.

column.name: text
column.value: He protects all his bones, Not one of them is broken.

column.name: text
column.value: Evil will bring death to the wicked, And those who hate the righteous will suffer for their guilt.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD redeems the souls of His servants, And none of those who take refuge in Him will suffer for their guilt.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Take hold of ①buckler and shield And rise up as my help. ▷ ①I.e., small shield

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Let them be like chaff before the wind, With the angel of the LORD driving them on.

column.name: text
column.value: Let their way be dark and slippery, With the angel of the LORD pursuing them.

column.name: text
column.value: For they hid their net for me without cause; Without cause they dug a pit for my soul.

column.name: text
text
column.value: So my soul shall rejoice in the LORD; It shall rejoice in His salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: All my bones will say, “LORD, who is like You, Who rescues the afflicted from one who is too strong for him, And the afflicted and the poor from one who robs him?”

column.name: text
column.value: Malicious witnesses rise up; They ask me things that I do not know.

column.name: text
column.value: They repay me evil for good, To the bereavement of my soul.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth; I humbled my soul with fasting, But my prayer kept returning to ①me. ▷ ①Lit my chest

column.name: text
text
column.value: But at my ①stumbling they rejoiced and gathered themselves together; The ②afflicted people whom I did not know gathered together against me, They ③slandered me without ceasing. ▷ ①Or limping ②Or struck ones ③Lit tore

column.name: text
column.value: Like godless jesters at a feast, They gnashed at me with their teeth.

column.name: text
column.value: Lord, how long will You look on? Rescue my soul from their ravages, My only life from the lions.

column.name: text
column.value: I will give You thanks in the great congregation; I will praise You among a mighty people.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For they do not speak peace, But they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: They opened their mouth wide against me; They said, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen it!”

column.name: text
column.value: You have seen it, LORD, do not keep silent; Lord, do not be far from me.

column.name: text
column.value: Stir Yourself, and awake to my right And to my cause, my God and my Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Judge me, LORD my God, according to Your righteousness, And do not let them rejoice over me.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not let them say in their heart, “Aha, our desire!” Do not let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”

column.name: text
column.value: May those be ashamed and altogether humiliated who rejoice at my distress; May those who exalt themselves over me be clothed with shame and dishonor.

column.name: text
text
column.value: And my tongue shall proclaim Your righteousness And Your praise all day long.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing for joy in the LORD, you righteous ones; Praise is becoming to the upright.

column.name: text
column.value: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre; Sing praises to Him with a harp of ten strings.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing to Him a new song; Play skillfully with a shout of joy.

column.name: text
column.value: For the word of the LORD is right, And all His work is done in faithfulness.

column.name: text
column.value: He loves righteousness and justice; The earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, And by the breath of His mouth all their ①lights. ▷ ①Lit host; i.e., sun, stars, etc.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Let all the earth fear the LORD; Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of Him.

column.name: text
text
column.value: The LORD nullifies the plan of nations; He frustrates the plans of peoples.

column.name: text
column.value: The plan of the LORD stands forever, The plans of His heart from generation to generation.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, The people He has chosen for His own inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD looks from heaven; He sees all the sons of mankind;

column.name: text
column.value: From His dwelling place He looks out On all the inhabitants of the earth,

column.name: text
column.value: He who fashions ①the hearts of them all, He who understands all their works. ▷ ①Or their heart together

column.name: text
column.value: The king is not saved by a mighty army; A warrior is not rescued by great strength.

column.name: text
column.value: A horse is a false hope for victory; Nor does it rescue anyone by its great strength.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the eye of the LORD is on those who fear Him, On those who wait for His faithfulness,

column.name: text
column.value: To rescue their soul from death And to keep them alive in famine.

column.name: text
column.value: Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.

column.name: text
column.value: For our heart rejoices in Him, Because we trust in His holy name.

column.name: text
column.value: Let Your favor, LORD, be upon us, Just as we have waited for You.

column.name: text
text
column.value: When evildoers came upon me to devour my flesh, My adversaries and my enemies, they stumbled and fell.

column.name: text
column.value: If an army encamps against me, My heart will not fear; If war arises against me, In spite of this I am confident.

column.name: text
column.value: One thing I have asked from the LORD, that I shall seek: That I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, To behold the ①beauty of the LORD And to ②meditate in His temple. ▷ ①Lit delightfulness ②Lit inquire

column.name: text
text
column.value: And now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me, And I will offer sacrifices in His tent ①with shouts of joy; I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD. ▷ ①Lit of shouts

column.name: text
column.value: Hear, LORD, when I cry with my voice, And be gracious to me and answer me.

column.name: text
column.value: When You said, “Seek My face,” my heart said to You, “I shall seek Your face, LORD.”

column.name: text
text
column.value: ①For my father and my mother have forsaken me, But the LORD will take me up. ▷ ①Or If my father...forsake me, Then the LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Teach me Your way, LORD, And lead me on a level path Because of my enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not turn me over to the ①desire of my enemies, For false witnesses have risen against me, And the violent witness. ▷ ①Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: I certainly believed that I would see the goodness of the LORD In the land of the living.

column.name: text
text
column.value: [A Psalm of David.] Ascribe to the LORD, ①sons of the mighty, Ascribe to the LORD glory and strength. ▷ ①Lit sons of gods

column.name: text
text
column.value: The voice of the LORD is on the waters; The God of glory thunders, The LORD is over ①many waters. ▷ ①Or great

column.name: text
column.value: The voice of the LORD is powerful, The voice of the LORD is majestic.

column.name: text
column.value: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; Yes, the LORD breaks the cedars of Lebanon in pieces.

column.name: text
column.value: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, And Sirion like a young wild ox.

column.name: text
column.value: The voice of the LORD divides ①flames of fire. ▷ ①I.e., lightning

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: The LORD sat as King at the flood; Yes, the LORD sits as King forever.

column.name: text
text
column.value: [For the music director. A Psalm of David the servant of the LORD.] ①Wrongdoing speaks to the ungodly within ②his heart; There is no fear of God before his eyes. ▷ ①Or Rebellion ②Another reading is my heart

column.name: text
column.value: For it flatters him in his own eyes Concerning the discovery of his wrongful deed and the hatred of it.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Your mercy, LORD, ①extends to the heavens, Your faithfulness reaches to the skies. ▷ ①Lit is in

column.name: text
column.value: Your righteousness is like the ①mountains of God; Your judgments are like the great deep. LORD, You ②protect mankind and animals. ▷ ①Or mighty mountains ②Or help

column.name: text
column.value: How precious is Your mercy, God! And the sons of mankind take refuge in the shadow of Your wings.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For the fountain of life is with You; In Your light we see light.

column.name: text
column.value: Prolong Your mercy to those who know You, And Your righteousness to the upright of heart.

column.name: text
column.value: May the foot of pride not come upon me, And may the hand of the wicked not drive me away.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who do injustice have fallen there; They have been thrust down and cannot rise.

column.name: text
column.value: [A Psalm of David.] Do not get upset because of evildoers, Do not be envious of wrongdoers.

column.name: text
column.value: For they will wither quickly like the grass, And decay like the green plants.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Delight yourself in the LORD; And He will give you the desires of your heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Commit your way to the LORD, Trust also in Him, and He will do it.

column.name: text
column.value: He will bring out your righteousness as the light, And your judgment as the noonday.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Rest in the LORD and wait ②patiently for Him; Do not get upset because of one who is successful in his way, Because of the person who carries out wicked schemes. ▷ ①Or Be still ②Or longingly

column.name: text
column.value: Cease from anger and abandon wrath; Do not get upset; it leads only to evildoing.

column.name: text
column.value: For evildoers will be eliminated, But those who wait for the LORD, they will inherit the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet a little while and the wicked person will be no more; And you will look carefully for his place and he will not be there.

column.name: text
column.value: But the humble will inherit the land And will delight themselves in abundant prosperity.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked plots against the righteous, And gnashes at him with his teeth.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord laughs at him, For He sees that his day is coming.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent their bow To take down the afflicted and the needy, To kill off those who are upright in conduct.

column.name: text
column.value: Their sword will enter their own heart, And their bows will be broken.

column.name: text
column.value: Better is the little of the righteous Than the abundance of many wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, But the LORD sustains the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD knows the days of the ①blameless, And their inheritance will be forever. ▷ ①Lit complete; or perfect

column.name: text
column.value: They will not be ashamed in the time of evil, And in the days of famine they will have plenty.

column.name: text
column.value: But the wicked will perish; And the enemies of the LORD will be like the ①glory of the pastures, They vanish—like smoke they vanish away. ▷ ①I.e., flowers

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked borrows and does not pay back, But the righteous is gracious and gives.

column.name: text
column.value: For those blessed by Him will inherit the land, But those cursed by Him will be eliminated.

column.name: text
column.value: The steps of a man are established by the LORD, And He delights in his way.

column.name: text
column.value: When he falls, he will not be hurled down, Because the LORD is the One ①who holds his hand. ▷ ①Or who sustains him with His hand

column.name: text
column.value: I have been young and now I am old, Yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken Or his ①descendants begging for bread. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: All day long he is gracious and lends, And his ①descendants are a blessing. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: Turn from evil and do good, So that you will dwell forever.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD loves ①justice And does not abandon His godly ones; They are protected forever, But the ②descendants of the wicked will be eliminated. ▷ ①Lit judgment ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous will inherit the land And dwell in it forever.

column.name: text
column.value: The mouth of the righteous utters wisdom, And his tongue speaks justice.

column.name: text
column.value: The Law of his God is in his heart; His steps do not slip.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked spies upon the righteous And seeks to kill him.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will not leave him in his hand Or let him be condemned when he is judged.

column.name: text
text
column.value: I have seen a wicked, violent person Spreading himself like a luxuriant ①tree in its native soil. ▷ ①Lit native; Heb obscure

column.name: text
column.value: Then he passed away, and behold, he was no more; I searched for him, but he could not be found.

column.name: text
text
column.value: But wrongdoers will altogether be destroyed; The future of the wicked will be eliminated.

column.name: text
column.value: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; He is their strength in time of trouble.

column.name: text
text
column.value: [A Psalm of David, for a memorial.] LORD, do not rebuke me in Your wrath, And do not punish me in Your burning anger.

column.name: text
column.value: For Your arrows have sunk deep into me, And Your hand has pressed down on me.

column.name: text
column.value: There is no healthy part in my flesh because of Your indignation; There is no health in my bones because of my sin.

column.name: text
column.value: For my guilty deeds have gone over my head; Like a heavy burden they weigh too much for me.

column.name: text
column.value: My ①wounds grow foul and fester Because of my foolishness. ▷ ①Or stripes

column.name: text
column.value: I am bent over and greatly bowed down; I go in mourning all day long.

column.name: text
column.value: For my ①sides are filled with burning, And there is no healthy part in my flesh. ▷ ①Lit loins

column.name: text
text
text
text
text
column.value: Those who seek my life lay snares for me; And those who seek to injure me have ①threatened destruction, And they plot deception all day long. ▷ ①Lit spoken

column.name: text
column.value: But I, like a person who is deaf, do not hear; And I am like a person who cannot speak, who does not open his mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Yes, I am like a person who does not hear, And in whose mouth are no arguments.

column.name: text
column.value: For I wait for You, LORD; You will answer, Lord my God.

column.name: text
column.value: For I said, “May they not rejoice over me, Who, when my foot slips, would exalt themselves over me.”

column.name: text
column.value: For I am ready to fall, And my ①sorrow is continually before me. ▷ ①Lit pain

column.name: text
column.value: For I admit my guilt; I am full of anxiety because of my sin.

column.name: text
column.value: But my enemies are vigorous and ①strong, And those who wrongfully hate me are many. ▷ ①Or numerous

column.name: text
column.value: And those who repay evil for good, They become my enemies, because I follow what is good.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not abandon me, LORD; My God, do not be far from me!

column.name: text
column.value: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation!

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director, for ①Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.] I said, “I will keep watch over my ways So that I do not sin with my tongue; I will keep watch over my mouth as with a muzzle While the wicked are in my presence.” ▷ ①1 Chr

column.name: text
column.value: I was mute ①and silent, I ②refused to say even something good, And my pain was stirred up. ▷ ①Lit with silence ②Lit was silent from good

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Behold, You have made my days like ①hand widths, And my lifetime as nothing in Your sight; Certainly all mankind standing is ②a mere breath. Selah ▷ ①I.e., short ②Or altogether breath

column.name: text
text
column.value: “And now, Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in You.

column.name: text
column.value: Save me from all my wrongdoings; Do not make me an object of reproach for the foolish.

column.name: text
column.value: I have become mute, I do not open my mouth, Because it is You who have done it.

column.name: text
text
text
text
column.value: Turn Your eyes away from me, that I may become cheerful again Before I depart and am no more.”

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director. A Psalm of David.] I waited ①patiently for the LORD; And He reached down to me and heard my cry. ▷ ①Or intently

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: How blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, And has not turned to the ①proud, nor to those who become involved in falsehood. ▷ ①Or enemies

column.name: text
column.value: Many, LORD my God, are the wonders which You have done, And Your thoughts toward us; There is no one to compare with You. If I would declare and speak of them, They would be too numerous to count.

column.name: text
text
text
text
text
text
text
text
column.value: Be pleased, LORD, to rescue me; Hurry, LORD, to help me.

column.name: text
column.value: May those be ashamed and humiliated together Who seek my ①life to destroy it; May those be turned back and dishonored Who delight ②in my hurt. ▷ ①Or soul ②Or to injure me

column.name: text
column.value: May those be ①appalled because of their shame Who say to me, “Aha, aha!” ▷ ①Or desolated

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: [For the music director. A Psalm of David.] Blessed is one who considers the ①helpless; The LORD will save him on a day of ②trouble. ▷ ①Or poor ②Or evil

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will protect him and keep him alive, And he will be called ①blessed upon the earth; And do not turn him over to the desire of his enemies. ▷ ①Or happy

column.name: text
text
column.value: As for me, I said, “LORD, be gracious to me; Heal my soul, for I have sinned against You.”

column.name: text
column.value: My enemies speak evil against me, “When will he die, and his name perish?”

column.name: text
text
column.value: All who hate me whisper together against me; They plot my harm against me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “A wicked thing is poured out ①upon him, So that when he lies down, he will not get up again.” ▷ ①Or within

column.name: text
column.value: Even my ①close friend in whom I trusted, Who ate my bread, Has lifted up his heel against me. ▷ ①Lit man of peace

column.name: text
column.value: But You, LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, That I may repay them.

column.name: text
column.value: By this I know that You are pleased with me, Because my enemy does not shout in triumph over me.

column.name: text
column.value: As for me, You uphold me in my integrity, And You place me in Your presence forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, From everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director. A ①Maskil of the sons of Korah.] As the deer ②pants for the water brooks, So my soul ③pants for You, God. ▷ ①Possibly Contemplative; or Didactic; or Skillful Psalm ②Lit longs for ③Lit longs for

column.name: text
text
column.value: My tears have been my food day and night, While they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”

column.name: text
column.value: I remember these things and pour out my soul within me. For I used to go over with the multitude and walk them to the house of God, With a voice of joy and thanksgiving, a multitude celebrating a festival.

column.name: text
column.value: Why are you ①in despair, my soul? And why are you restless within me? Wait for God, for I will ②again praise ③Him For the ④help of His ⑤presence, my God. ▷ ①Lit dissolved away ②Or still ③Some ancient versions Him, the help of my face and my God ④Or saving acts of ⑤Or presence. O my God, my soul...

column.name: text
column.value: My soul is ①in despair within me; Therefore I remember You from the land of the Jordan And the ②peaks of Hermon, from Mount Mizar. ▷ ①Or dissolved away ②Lit Hermons

column.name: text
column.value: Deep calls to deep at the sound of Your waterfalls; All Your breakers and Your waves have passed over me.

column.name: text
text
column.value: I will say to God my rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why do I go about mourning ①because of the oppression of the enemy?” ▷ ①Or while the enemy oppresses

column.name: text
column.value: As a shattering of my bones, my adversaries taunt me, While they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”

column.name: text
column.value: Why are you ①in despair, my soul? And why are you restless within me? Wait for God, for I will again praise ②Him For the ③help of His presence, my God. ▷ ①Or dissolved away ②As in some ancient mss, cf. v 5; MT Him, the help of my face and my God ③Or saving acts of

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director. A ①Maskil of the sons of Korah.] God, we have heard with our ears, Our fathers have told us The work that You did in their days, In the days of old. ▷ ①Possibly Contemplative; or Didactic; or Skillful Psalm

column.name: text
text
column.value: For by their own sword they did not possess the land, And their own arm did not save them, But Your right hand and Your arm and the light of Your presence, For You favored them.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Through You we will push back our adversaries; Through Your name we will trample down those who rise up against us.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will not trust in my bow, Nor will my sword save me.

column.name: text
column.value: But You have saved us from our adversaries, And You have put to shame those who hate us.

column.name: text
column.value: In God we have boasted all day long, And we will give thanks to Your name forever. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Yet You have rejected us and brought us to dishonor, And do not go out with our armies.

column.name: text
column.value: You cause us to turn back from the enemy; And those who hate us have taken spoils for themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: You turn us over ①to be eaten like sheep, And have scattered us among the nations. ▷ ①Lit for food

column.name: text
column.value: You sell Your people ①cheaply, And have not ②profited by their sale. ▷ ①Lit for no wealth ②Or set a high price on them

column.name: text
