column.value: You make us an object of reproach to our neighbors, Of scoffing and ridicule to those around us.

column.name: text
column.value: You make us a proverb among the nations, A ①laughingstock among the peoples. ▷ ①Lit shaking of the head

column.name: text
column.value: All day long my dishonor is before me And ①I am covered with my humiliation, ▷ ①Lit the shame of my face has covered me

column.name: text
column.value: Because of the voice of one who taunts and reviles, Because of the presence of the enemy and the avenger.

column.name: text
column.value: All this has come upon us, but we have not forgotten You, And we have not dealt falsely with Your covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: Our heart has not turned back, And our steps have not deviated from Your way,

column.name: text
column.value: Yet You have crushed us in a place of jackals And covered us with ①deep darkness. ▷ ①Or the shadow of death

column.name: text
column.value: If we had forgotten the name of our God Or extended our ①hands to a strange god, ▷ ①Lit palms

column.name: text
column.value: Would God not find this out? For He knows the secrets of the heart.

column.name: text
column.value: But for Your sake we are killed all day long; We are regarded as sheep to be slaughtered.

column.name: text
column.value: Wake Yourself up, why do You sleep, Lord? Awake, do not reject us forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Why do You hide Your face And forget our affliction and oppression?

column.name: text
column.value: For our souls have sunk down into the dust; Our bodies cling to the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Rise up, be our help, And redeem us because of Your mercy.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For You are the God of my strength; why have You rejected me? Why do I go about mourning ①because of the oppression of the enemy? ▷ ①Or while the enemy oppresses

column.name: text
text
column.value: Then I will go to the altar of God, To God ①my exceeding joy; And I will praise You on the lyre, God, my God. ▷ ①Lit the gladness of my joy

column.name: text
column.value: Why are you ①in despair, my soul? And why are you restless within me? Wait for God, for I will ②again praise ③Him For the ④help of His presence, my God. ▷ ①Or dissolved away ②Or still ③As in some ancient mss; MT Him, the help of my face and my God ④Or saving acts of

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Strap Your sword on Your thigh, ①Mighty One, In Your splendor and majesty! ▷ ①Or Warrior

column.name: text
column.value: And in Your majesty ride on victoriously, For the cause of truth, humility, and righteousness; Let Your right hand teach You ①awesome things. ▷ ①Or fearful

column.name: text
text
column.value: Your throne, God, is forever and ever; The scepter of Your kingdom is a scepter of justice.

column.name: text
text
column.value: All Your garments are fragrant with myrrh, aloes, and cassia; From ivory palaces stringed instruments have made You joyful.

column.name: text
column.value: Kings’ daughters are among Your noble women; At Your right hand stands the queen in gold from Ophir.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen, daughter, look and incline your ear: Forget your people and your father’s house;

column.name: text
column.value: Then the King will crave your beauty. Because He is your Lord, bow down to Him.

column.name: text
column.value: The daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; The wealthy among the people will seek your favor.

column.name: text
column.value: The King’s daughter is all glorious within; Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

column.name: text
text
column.value: They will be brought with joy and rejoicing; They will enter into the King’s palace.

column.name: text
column.value: In place of your fathers will be your sons; You shall make them princes in all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make Your name known among all generations; Therefore the peoples will praise You forever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director. A Psalm of the sons of Korah, ①set to Alamoth. A Song.] God is our refuge and strength, A ②very ready help in ③trouble. ▷ ①Possibly for soprano voices ②Lit help easily found ③Or needs

column.name: text
text
column.value: Though its waters roar and foam, Though the mountains quake at its swelling pride. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: There is a river whose streams make the city of God happy, The holy dwelling places of the Most High.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: The LORD of armies is with us; The God of Jacob is our stronghold. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Come, behold the works of the LORD, ①Who has inflicted horrific events on the earth. ▷ ①Or Which He has inflicted as desolations

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: The LORD of armies is with us; The God of Jacob is our stronghold. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: [A Song; a Psalm of the sons of Korah.] Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised In the city of our God, His holy mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, Is Mount Zion in the far north, The city of the great King.

column.name: text
column.value: In its palaces, God has made Himself known as a stronghold.

column.name: text
column.value: For, behold, the kings arrived, They passed by together.

column.name: text
column.value: They saw it, then they were amazed; They were terrified, they fled in a hurry.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Panic seized them there, Anguish, as that of a woman in childbirth. ▷ ①Lit Trembling

column.name: text
column.value: With the east wind You smash the ships of Tarshish.

column.name: text
text
column.value: We have thought over Your goodness, God, In the midst of Your temple.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Mount Zion shall be glad, The daughters of Judah shall rejoice Because of Your judgments.

column.name: text
column.value: Walk around Zion and encircle her; Count her towers;

column.name: text
text
column.value: For ①such is God, Our God forever and ever; He will lead us ②until death. ▷ ①Lit this ②Lit upon; some mss and LXX forever

column.name: text
text
column.value: For the LORD Most High is to be feared, A great King over all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: He subdues peoples under us And nations under our feet.

column.name: text
column.value: He chooses our inheritance for us, The pride of Jacob whom He loves. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: God has ascended ①with a shout, The LORD, ②with the sound of a trumpet. ▷ ①Or amid ②Or amid

column.name: text
column.value: Sing praises to God, sing praises; Sing praises to our King, sing praises.

column.name: text
column.value: For God is the King of all the earth; Sing praises with a psalm of wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: God reigns over the nations, God ①sits on His holy throne. ▷ ①Or has taken His seat

column.name: text
column.value: The ①princes of the people have assembled as the people of the God of Abraham, For the shields of the earth belong to God; He is highly exalted. ▷ ①Or nobles

column.name: text
text
column.value: Both low and high, Rich and poor together.

column.name: text
column.value: My mouth will speak wisdom, And the meditation of my heart will be understanding.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Why should I fear in days of adversity, When the injustice of those who betray me surrounds me,

column.name: text
column.value: Those who trust in their wealth And boast in the abundance of their riches?

column.name: text
column.value: No one can by any means redeem another Or give God a ransom for him—

column.name: text
column.value: For the redemption of ①his soul is priceless, And he should cease imagining forever— ▷ ①Lit their

column.name: text
column.value: That he might live on eternally, That he might not ①undergo decay. ▷ ①Or see corruption; lit see the pit

column.name: text
text
column.value: Their ①inner thought is that their houses are forever And their dwelling places to all generations; They have named their lands after their own names. ▷ ①Some ancient versions graves are their houses

column.name: text
text
column.value: This is the way of those who are foolish, And of those after them who approve their words. Selah

column.name: text
text
column.value: But God will redeem my soul from the ①power of ②Sheol, For He will receive me. Selah ▷ ①Lit hand ②I.e., the netherworld

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be afraid when a person becomes rich, When the splendor of his house is increased;

column.name: text
text
column.value: Though while he lives he congratulates ①himself— And though people praise you when you do well for yourself— ▷ ①Lit his soul

column.name: text
text
column.value: Mankind in its splendor, yet without understanding, Is like the animals that ①perish. ▷ ①Lit are destroyed

column.name: text
column.value: [A Psalm of ①Asaph.] The Mighty One, God, the LORD, has spoken And summoned the earth, from ②the rising of the sun to its setting. ▷ ①1 Chr 15:17; 2 Chr

column.name: text
column.value: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God has shone.

column.name: text
text
column.value: He summons the heavens above, And the earth, to judge His people:

column.name: text
column.value: “Gather My godly ones to Me, Those who have made a covenant with Me by sacrifice.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the heavens declare His righteousness, For God Himself is judge. Selah

column.name: text
text
column.value: I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices, And your burnt offerings are continually before Me.

column.name: text
column.value: I will not take a bull from your house, Nor male goats from your folds.

column.name: text
column.value: For every animal of the forest is Mine, The cattle on a thousand hills.

column.name: text
column.value: I know every bird of the mountains, And everything that moves in the field is ①Mine. ▷ ①Or in My mind; lit with Me

column.name: text
column.value: If I were hungry I would not tell you, For the world is Mine, and ①everything it contains. ▷ ①Lit its fullness

column.name: text
column.value: Shall I eat the flesh of ①bulls Or drink the blood of male goats? ▷ ①Lit strong ones

column.name: text
column.value: Offer God a sacrifice of thanksgiving And pay your vows to the Most High;

column.name: text
column.value: Call upon Me on the day of trouble; I will rescue you, and you will honor Me.”

column.name: text
column.value: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to tell of My statutes And to take My covenant in your mouth?

column.name: text
column.value: For you yourself hate discipline, And you throw My words behind you.

column.name: text
column.value: When you see a thief, you become friends with him, And ①you associate with adulterers. ▷ ①Lit your part is with

column.name: text
column.value: You ①let your mouth loose in evil, And your tongue harnesses deceit. ▷ ①Lit send

column.name: text
column.value: You sit and speak against your brother; You slander your own mother’s son.

column.name: text
text
column.value: “Now consider this, you who forget God, Or I will tear you in pieces, and there will be no one to save you.

column.name: text
text
column.value: [For the music director. A ①Maskil of David, ②when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul and said to him, “David has come to the house of Ahimelech.”] Why do you boast in evil, you mighty man? The faithfulness of God endures all day long. ▷ ①Possibly Contemplative; or Didactic; or Skillful Psalm ②1 Sam

column.name: text
column.value: Your tongue devises destruction, Like a sharp razor, you worker of deceit.

column.name: text
column.value: You love evil more than good, Lies more than speaking what is right. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: You love all words that devour, You deceitful tongue.

column.name: text
column.value: ①But God will break you down forever; He will snatch you up and tear you away from your tent, And uproot you from the land of the living. Selah ▷ ①Or Also

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous will see and fear, And they will laugh at him, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, the man who would not make God his refuge, But trusted in the abundance of his riches And was strong in ①his evil desire.” ▷ ①Or his destruction

column.name: text
column.value: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in the house of God; I trust in the faithfulness of God forever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: I will praise You forever, because You have done it, And I will wait on Your name, for it is good, in the presence of Your godly ones.

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director. A Psalm of David, when ①Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.] Be gracious to me, God, according to Your faithfulness; According to the greatness of Your compassion, wipe out my wrongdoings. ▷ ①2 Sam

column.name: text
column.value: Wash me thoroughly from my guilt And cleanse me from my sin.

column.name: text
column.value: For I know my wrongdoings, And my sin is constantly before me.

column.name: text
column.value: Against You, You only, I have sinned And done what is evil in Your sight, So that You ①are justified ②when You speak And ③blameless when You judge. ▷ ①Or may be in the right ②Many mss in Your words ③Lit pure

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I was brought forth in guilt, And in sin my mother conceived me.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, You desire truth in the ①innermost being, And in secret You will make wisdom known to me. ▷ ①Or inward parts

column.name: text
text
column.value: ①Let me hear joy and gladness, Let the bones You have broken rejoice. ▷ ①Or May You cause

column.name: text
column.value: Hide Your face from my sins And wipe out all my guilty deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: Create ①in me a clean heart, God, And renew a steadfast spirit within me. ▷ ①Lit for

column.name: text
column.value: Do not cast me away from Your presence, And do not take Your Holy Spirit from me.

column.name: text
column.value: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, And sustain me with a willing spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will teach wrongdoers Your ways, And sinners will ①be converted to You. ▷ ①Or turn back

column.name: text
column.value: Save me from the guilt of bloodshed, God, the God of my salvation; Then my tongue will joyfully sing of Your righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: Lord, ①open my lips, So that my mouth may declare Your praise. ▷ ①Or may You open

column.name: text
column.value: For You do not delight in sacrifice, otherwise I would give it; You do not take pleasure in burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; A broken and a contrite heart, God, You will not despise.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Then You will delight in ①righteous sacrifices, In burnt offering and whole burnt offering; Then ②bulls will be offered on Your altar. ▷ ①Or sacrifices of righteousness ②Lit they will offer bulls

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director; according to ①Mahalath. A ②Maskil of David.] The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have committed abominable injustice; There is no one who does good. ▷ ①I.e., sickness, a sad tone ②Possibly Contemplative; or Didactic; or Skillful Psalm

column.name: text
column.value: God has looked down from heaven upon the sons of mankind To see if there is anyone who ①understands, Who seeks after God. ▷ ①Or acts wisely

column.name: text
column.value: Every one of them has turned aside; together they have become corrupt; There is no one who does good, not even one.

column.name: text
column.value: Have the workers of injustice no knowledge, Who eat up My people like they ate bread, And have not called upon God?

column.name: text
text
column.value: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When God restores the fortunes of His people, Jacob shall rejoice, Israel shall be glad.

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director; on stringed instruments. A ①Maskil of David.] Listen to my prayer, God; And do not hide Yourself from my pleading. ▷ ①Possibly Contemplative; or Didactic; or Skillful Psalm

column.name: text
text
column.value: Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the pressure of the wicked; For they bring down ①trouble upon me And in anger they hold a grudge against me. ▷ ①Or wickedness

column.name: text
column.value: My heart is in anguish within me, And the terrors of death have fallen upon me.

column.name: text
column.value: Fear and trembling come upon me, And ①horror has ②overwhelmed me. ▷ ①Lit shuddering ②Lit covered

column.name: text
column.value: I said, “Oh, that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away and ①be at rest. ▷ ①Lit settle down

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I would flee far away, I would spend my nights in the wilderness. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: I would hurry to my place of refuge From the stormy wind and heavy gale.”

column.name: text
column.value: Confuse them, Lord, divide their tongues, For I have seen violence and strife in the city.

column.name: text
column.value: Day and night they go around her upon her walls, And evil and harm are in her midst.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For it is not an enemy who taunts me, Then I could endure it; Nor is it one who hates me who has exalted himself against me, Then I could hide myself from him.

column.name: text
text
column.value: We who had sweet ①fellowship together, Walked in the house of God among the commotion. ▷ ①Lit counsel; or intimacy

column.name: text
column.value: May ①death come deceitfully upon them; May they go down alive to ②Sheol, For evil is in their dwelling, in their midst. ▷ ①Another reading is devastation be upon them ②I.e., the netherworld

column.name: text
column.value: As for me, I shall call upon God, And the LORD will save me.

column.name: text
column.value: Evening and morning and at noon, I will complain and moan, And He will hear my voice.

column.name: text
column.value: He will redeem my soul in peace ①from the battle which is against me, For they are many who are aggressive toward me. ▷ ①Or so that none may approach me

column.name: text
column.value: God will hear and humiliate them— Even the one who ①sits enthroned from ancient times—Selah With whom there ②is no change, And who do not fear God. ▷ ①Or remains from ②Lit are no changes

column.name: text
text
column.value: His ①speech was smoother than butter, But his heart was war; His words were softer than oil, Yet they were drawn swords. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: [For the music director; on stringed instruments. A ①Maskil of David, ②when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Is David not keeping himself hidden among us?”] Save me, God, by Your name, And ③vindicate me by Your power. ▷ ①Possibly Contemplative; or Didactic; or Skillful Psalm ②1 Sam 23:19;

column.name: text
column.value: Hear my prayer, God; Listen to the words of my mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: For strangers have risen against me And violent men have sought my ①life; They have not set God before them. Selah ▷ ①Or soul

column.name: text
text
text
text
column.value: For ①He has saved me from all ②trouble, And my eye has looked with satisfaction upon my enemies. ▷ ①Or it; i.e., His name ②Or distress

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director; according to ①Jonath elem rehokim. A ②Mikhtam of David, ③when the Philistines seized him in Gath.] Be gracious to me, God, for a man has ④trampled upon me; ⑤Fighting all day long he oppresses me. ▷ ①Or The silent dove of those who are far off; or The dove of the distant terebinths ②Possibly Epigrammatic Poem; or Atonement Psalm ③1 Sam 21:10, 11 ④Or snapped at ⑤Or A fighting man

column.name: text
column.value: My enemies have trampled upon me all day long, For ①they are many who fight proudly against me. ▷ ①Or many are fighting

column.name: text
column.value: ①When I am afraid, ②I will put my trust in You. ▷ ①Lit The day ②Or I am one who puts

column.name: text
column.value: In God, whose word I praise, In God I have put my trust; I shall not be afraid. What can mere ①mortals do to me? ▷ ①Lit flesh

column.name: text
text
column.value: They ①attack, they lurk, They watch my ②steps, As they have waited to take my ③life. ▷ ①Or stir up strife ②Lit heels ③Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: Because of their wickedness, will there be an escape for them? In anger make the peoples fall down, God!

column.name: text
column.value: You have taken account of my ①miseries; Put my tears in Your bottle. Are they not in Your book? ▷ ①Or wanderings

column.name: text
text
column.value: In God, whose word I praise, In the LORD, whose word I praise,

column.name: text
column.value: In God I have put my ①trust, I shall not be afraid. What can mankind do to me? ▷ ①Or trust without fear

column.name: text
column.value: Your vows are binding upon me, God; I will render thanksgiving offerings to You.

column.name: text
column.value: For You have saved my soul from death, ①Indeed my feet from stumbling, So that I may walk before God In the light of the ②living. ▷ ①Or Have You not delivered ②Or life

column.name: text
text
column.value: I will cry to God Most High, To God who accomplishes all things for me.

column.name: text
text
column.value: My soul is among lions; I must lie among those who devour, Among sons of mankind whose teeth are spears and arrows, And their tongue is a sharp sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Be exalted above the heavens, God; May Your glory be above all the earth.

column.name: text
text
column.value: My heart is steadfast, God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing, yes, I will sing praises!

column.name: text
column.value: Awake, my glory! Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For Your goodness is great to the heavens And Your ①truth to the clouds. ▷ ①Or faithfulness

column.name: text
column.value: Be exalted above the heavens, God; May Your glory be above all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director; set to ①Al-tashheth. A ②Mikhtam of David.] Do you indeed ③speak righteousness, you ④gods? Do you judge ⑤fairly, you sons of mankind? ▷ ①Lit Do Not Destroy ②Possibly Epigrammatic Poem or Atonement Psalm ③Another reading is speak righteousness in silence ④Or mighty ones; or judges ⑤Or mankind fairly?

column.name: text
column.value: No, in heart you practice injustice; On earth you clear a way for the violence of your hands.

column.name: text
text
column.value: They have venom like the venom of a serpent; Like a deaf cobra that stops up its ear,

column.name: text
column.value: So that it does not hear the voice of ①charmers, Or a skillful caster of spells. ▷ ①Or whisperers

column.name: text
column.value: God, shatter their teeth in their mouth; Break out the fangs of the young lions, LORD.

column.name: text
text
column.value: May they be like a snail which goes along in slime, Like the miscarriage of a woman that never sees the sun.

column.name: text
column.value: Before your pots can feel the fire of thorns He will sweep them away with a whirlwind, the ①green and the burning alike. ▷ ①Lit living

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous will rejoice when he sees vengeance; He will wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

column.name: text
text
column.value: [For the music director; according to ①Shushan Eduth. A ②Mikhtam of David, to teach; ③when he fought with Aram-naharaim and Aram-zobah, and Joab returned, and killed twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt.] God, You have rejected us. You have ④broken us; You have been angry; restore us! ▷ ①Lit The lily of testimony ②Possibly, Epigrammatic Poem or Atonement Psalm ③2 Sam 8:3, 13; 1 Chr 18:3, 12 ④Or broken out upon us

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: You have given a banner to those who fear You, That it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: That Your beloved may be rescued, Save us with Your right hand, and answer ①us! ▷ ①Some authorities me

column.name: text
column.value: God has spoken in His ①holiness: “I will triumph, I will divide up Shechem, and measure out the Valley of Succoth. ▷ ①Or sanctuary

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Who will bring me into the besieged city? Who ①will lead me to Edom? ▷ ①Or has led

column.name: text
column.value: Have You Yourself not rejected us, God? And will You not go out with our armies, God?

column.name: text
column.value: Oh give us help against the enemy, For rescue ①by man is worthless. ▷ ①Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: ①Through God we will do valiantly, And it is He who will trample down our enemies. ▷ ①Or In; or With

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director; set to ①Al-tashheth. A ②Mikhtam of David, ③when Saul sent men and they watched the house in order to kill him.] Rescue me from my enemies, my God; ④Set me securely on high away from those who rise up against me. ▷ ①Lit Do Not Destroy ②Possibly Epigrammatic Poem or Atonement Psalm ③1 Sam

column.name: text
column.value: Rescue me from those who practice injustice, And save me from men of bloodshed.

column.name: text
column.value: For behold, they have ①set an ambush for my ②life; ③Fierce men attack me, Not for my wrongdoing nor for my sin, LORD, ▷ ①Or lain in wait ②Lit soul ③Or Strong

column.name: text
column.value: ①For no guilt of mine, they run and take their stand against me. Stir Yourself to ②help me, and see! ▷ ①Lit Without guilt ②Lit meet

column.name: text
column.value: You, LORD God of armies, the God of Israel, Awake to ①punish all the nations; Do not be gracious to any who deal treacherously in wrongdoing. Selah ▷ ①Lit visit

column.name: text
column.value: They return at evening, they howl like a dog, And prowl around the city.

column.name: text
text
column.value: But You, LORD, laugh at them; You scoff at all the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of ①his strength I will watch for You, For God is my refuge. ▷ ①LXX, some mss and some ancient versions my strength (cf. v 17)

column.name: text
text
column.value: Do not kill them, or my people will forget; ①Scatter them by Your power and bring them down, Lord, our shield. ▷ ①Or Make them wander

column.name: text
column.value: ①On account of the sin of their mouths and the words of their lips, May they even be caught in their pride, And on account of curses and lies which they tell. ▷ ①Or The sin of their mouth is the word of their lips,

column.name: text
column.value: ①Destroy them in wrath, ②destroy them so that they will no longer exist; So that people may know that God ③rules in Jacob, To the ends of the earth. Selah ▷ ①Lit Bring to an end ②Lit Bring to an end ③Or is Ruler

column.name: text
column.value: They return at evening, they howl like a dog, And prowl around the city.

column.name: text
column.value: They wander about ①for food And ②murmur if they are not satisfied. ▷ ①Lit to eat ②Another reading is linger all night

column.name: text
column.value: But as for me, I will sing of Your strength; Yes, I will joyfully sing of Your faithfulness in the morning, For You have been my refuge And a place of refuge on the day of my distress.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: From the end of the earth I call to You when my heart is faint; Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

column.name: text
column.value: For You have been a refuge for me, A tower of strength against the enemy.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For You have heard my vows, God; You have given me the inheritance of those who fear Your name.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: So I will sing praise to Your name forever, That I may pay my vows day by day.

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director; ①according to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.] My soul waits in silence for God alone; From Him comes my salvation. ▷ ①Cf. 1 Chr 16:41; 25:1; Ps 39 and 77 titles

column.name: text
column.value: He alone is my rock and my salvation, My stronghold; I will not be greatly shaken.

column.name: text
column.value: How long will you attack a man, That you may murder him, all of you, Like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

column.name: text
text
column.value: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, For my hope is from Him.

column.name: text
column.value: He alone is my rock and my salvation, My refuge; I will not be shaken.

column.name: text
column.value: My salvation and my glory rest on God; The rock of my strength, my refuge is in God.

column.name: text
text
text
text
text
column.value: And faithfulness is Yours, Lord, For You reward a person according to his work.

column.name: text
text
column.value: So have I seen You in the sanctuary, To see Your power and glory.

column.name: text
column.value: Because Your ①favor is better than life, My lips will praise You. ▷ ①Or faithfulness

column.name: text
column.value: So I will bless You as long as I live; I will lift up my hands in Your name.

column.name: text
column.value: My soul is satisfied as with fat and fatness, And my mouth offers praises with joyful lips.

column.name: text
column.value: When I remember You on my bed, I meditate on You in the night watches,

column.name: text
column.value: For You have been my help, And in the shadow of Your wings I sing for joy.

column.name: text
text
column.value: But those who seek my ①life to destroy it, Will go into the ②depths of the earth. ▷ ①Lit soul ②Lit lowest places

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: [For the music director. A Psalm of David.] Hear my voice, God, in my ①complaint; Protect my life from dread of the enemy. ▷ ①Or concern

column.name: text
column.value: Hide me from the secret discussion of evildoers, From the restlessness of the workers of injustice,

column.name: text
column.value: Who have sharpened their tongues like a sword. They aimed bitter speech as their arrows,

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: They ①devise injustices, saying, “We are ②ready with a well-conceived plot”; For the ③inward thought and the heart of a person are ④deep. ▷ ①Or search out ②Lit complete ③Or inward part ④Or unsearchable

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Then all people ①will fear, And they ②will declare the work of God, And ③will consider ④what He has done. ▷ ①Or feared ②Or declared ③Or considered ④Lit His work

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous person will be glad in the LORD and take refuge in Him; And all the upright in heart will boast.

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director. A Psalm of David. A Song.] There will be silence ①before You, and praise in Zion, God, And the vow will be fulfilled for You. ▷ ①Lit to

column.name: text
column.value: You who hear prayer, To You all ①mankind comes. ▷ ①Lit flesh comes

column.name: text
text
column.value: Blessed is the one You choose and allow to approach You; He will dwell in Your courtyards. We will be satisfied with the goodness of Your house, Your holy temple.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Who establishes the mountains by His strength, Who is encircled with might;

column.name: text
column.value: Who stills the roaring of the seas, The roaring of their waves, And the turmoil of the nations.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: You water its furrows abundantly, You ①settle its ridges, You soften it with showers, You bless its growth. ▷ ①Or smooth

column.name: text
column.value: You have crowned the year ①with Your goodness, And Your ②paths drip with fatness. ▷ ①Lit of ②I.e., wagon tracks

column.name: text
column.value: The pastures of the wilderness drip, And the hills encircle themselves with rejoicing.

column.name: text
text
column.value: [For the music director. A Song. A Psalm.] Shout joyfully to God, all the earth;

column.name: text
column.value: Sing the glory of His name; Make His praise glorious.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to God, “How awesome are Your works! Because of the greatness of Your power Your enemies will pretend to obey You.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Come and see the works of God, Who is awesome in His deeds toward the sons of mankind.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Bless our God, you peoples, And ①sound His praise abroad, ▷ ①Lit cause to hear the sound of His praise

column.name: text
column.value: Who ①keeps us in life, And does not allow our feet to ②slip. ▷ ①Lit puts our soul in life ②Or dodder, stumble

column.name: text
column.value: For You have put us to the test, God; You have refined us as silver is refined.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: I shall come into Your house with burnt offerings; I shall pay You my vows,

column.name: text
column.value: Which my lips uttered And my mouth spoke when I was in distress.

column.name: text
column.value: I shall offer to You burnt offerings of fat animals, With the smoke of rams; I shall make an offering of ①bulls with male goats. Selah ▷ ①Or cattle

column.name: text
column.value: Come and hear, all who ①fear God, And I will tell of what He has done for my soul. ▷ ①Or revere

column.name: text
column.value: I cried to Him with my mouth, And ①He was exalted with my tongue. ▷ ①Or praise was under my tongue

column.name: text
text
column.value: But God has heard; He has given attention to the sound of my prayer.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed be God, Who has not turned away my prayer Nor His favor from me.

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director; with stringed instruments. A Psalm. A Song.] God be gracious to us and bless us, And cause His face to shine ①upon us—Selah ▷ ①Lit with

column.name: text
column.value: That Your way may be known on the earth, Your salvation among all nations.

column.name: text
column.value: May the peoples praise You, God; May all the peoples praise You.

column.name: text
text
column.value: May the peoples praise You, God; May all the peoples praise You.

column.name: text
column.value: The earth has yielded its produce; God, our God, blesses us.

column.name: text
column.value: God blesses us, ①So that all the ends of the earth may fear Him. ▷ ①Or And let all...earth fear Him

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director. A Psalm of David. A Song.] ①May God arise, ②may His enemies be scattered, And ③may those who hate Him flee from His presence. ▷ ①Or God shall ②Or His enemies shall ③Or those who hate Him shall

column.name: text
text
column.value: But the righteous will be joyful; they will rejoice before God; Yes, they will rejoice with gladness.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing to God, sing praises to His name; ①Exalt Him who rides through the deserts, Whose name is ②the LORD, and be jubilant before Him. ▷ ①Or Prepare the way for Him ②Heb YAH

column.name: text
column.value: A father of the fatherless and a judge ①for the widows, Is God in His holy dwelling. ▷ ①Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: God ①makes a home for the lonely; He leads out the prisoners into prosperity, Only the rebellious live in parched lands. ▷ ①Lit makes the solitary to dwell in a house

column.name: text
column.value: God, when You went forth before Your people, When You marched through the desert, Selah

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Your creatures settled in it; In Your kindness You provided for the poor, God.

column.name: text
text
column.value: “Kings of armies flee, they flee, And she who remains at home will divide the spoils!”

column.name: text
column.value: ①When you lie down among the sheepfolds, You are like the wings of a dove covered with silver, And its pinions with ②glistening gold. ▷ ①Lit If ②I.e., gold alloyed with silver

column.name: text
column.value: When the Almighty scattered the kings ①there, It was snowing in Zalmon. ▷ ①Lit in it

column.name: text
text
column.value: Why do you look with envy, you mountains of many peaks, At the mountain God has desired as His dwelling? Indeed, the LORD will dwell there forever.

column.name: text
text
column.value: You have ascended on high, You have led captive Your captives; You have received gifts among people, Even among the rebellious as well, that ①the LORD God may dwell there. ▷ ①Heb YAH

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden, The God who is our salvation. Selah

column.name: text
text
column.value: God certainly will shatter the heads of His enemies, The hairy ①head of one who goes about in his guilt. ▷ ①Lit skull

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord ①said, “I will bring them back from Bashan. I will bring them back from the depths of the sea, ▷ ①Or says

column.name: text
column.value: So that ①your foot may shatter them in blood, And the tongue of your dogs may have its portion from your enemies.” ▷ ①Some ancient versions render, you may bathe your foot in blood

column.name: text
column.value: They have seen Your procession, God, The procession of my God, my King, ①into the sanctuary. ▷ ①Or in holiness

column.name: text
column.value: The singers went on, the musicians after them, ①In the midst of the young women beating tambourines. ▷ ①Or The maidens in the midst

column.name: text
column.value: Bless God in the congregations, Even the LORD, you who are of the fountain of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Benjamin, the ①youngest, is there, ②ruling them, The leaders of Judah in their company, The leaders of Zebulun, the leaders of Naphtali. ▷ ①Or smallest ②Or their ruler

column.name: text
text
column.value: ①Because of Your temple at Jerusalem Kings will bring gifts to You. ▷ ①Or From Your temple

column.name: text
column.value: Rebuke the animals ①in the reeds, The herd of bulls with the calves of the peoples, Trampling the pieces of silver; He has scattered the peoples who delight in war. ▷ ①Lit of

column.name: text
text
column.value: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth, Sing praises to the Lord, Selah

column.name: text
text
column.value: Ascribe strength to God; His majesty is over Israel, And His strength is in the ①skies. ▷ ①Lit clouds

column.name: text
column.value: ①God, You are awesome from Your ②sanctuary. The God of Israel Himself gives strength and power to the people. Blessed be God! ▷ ①Or Awesome is God from your sanctuary ②Lit holy places

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director; according to ①Shoshannim. A Psalm of David.] Save me, God, For the waters have ②threatened my life. ▷ ①Or possibly Lilies ②Lit come up to my soul

column.name: text
text
column.value: I am weary with my crying; my throat is parched; My eyes fail while I wait for my God.

column.name: text
text
column.value: God, You know my foolishness, And my guilt is not hidden from You.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Because for Your sake I have endured disgrace; Dishonor has covered my face.

column.name: text
column.value: I have become estranged ①from my brothers, And a stranger to my mother’s sons. ▷ ①Lit to

column.name: text
column.value: For zeal for Your house has consumed me, And the taunts of those who taunt You have fallen on me.

column.name: text
column.value: When I wept in my soul with fasting, It became my disgrace.

column.name: text
column.value: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a proverb to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who sit in the gate talk about me, And songs of mockery by those habitually drunk are about me.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for me, my prayer is to You, LORD, at an acceptable time; God, in the greatness of Your mercy, Answer me with ①Your saving truth. ▷ ①Or the faithfulness of Your salvation

column.name: text
column.value: Rescue me from the mud and do not let me sink; May I be rescued from those who hate me, and from the depths of water.

column.name: text
column.value: May the ①flood of water not overflow me Nor the deep swallow me up, Nor the pit close its mouth on me. ▷ ①Lit stream

column.name: text
column.value: Answer me, LORD, for Your mercy is good; According to the greatness of Your compassion, turn to me,

column.name: text
column.value: And do not hide Your face from Your servant, For I am in distress; answer me quickly.

column.name: text
column.value: Come near to my soul and redeem it; Ransom me because of my enemies!

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: They also gave me ①a bitter herb in my food, And for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink. ▷ ①Or poison

column.name: text
text
column.value: May their eyes grow dim so that they cannot see, And make their hips shake continually.

column.name: text
column.value: Pour out Your indignation on them, And may Your burning anger overtake them.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For they have persecuted him whom You Yourself struck, And they tell of the pain of those whom You have ①wounded. ▷ ①Lit pierced

column.name: text
column.value: Add guilt to their guilt, And may they not come into Your righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: May they be wiped out of the book of life, And may they not be ①recorded with the righteous. ▷ ①Lit written

column.name: text
text
column.value: I will praise the name of God with song, And exalt Him with thanksgiving.

column.name: text
column.value: And it will please the LORD better than an ox Or bull with horns and hoofs.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For the LORD hears the needy, And does not despise those of His who are prisoners.

column.name: text
column.value: Heaven and earth shall praise Him, The seas and everything that moves in them.

column.name: text
column.value: For God will save Zion and build the cities of Judah, So that they may live there and possess it.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①descendants of His servants will inherit it, And those who love His name will live in it. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: In You, LORD, I have taken refuge; Let me never be put to shame.

column.name: text
column.value: In Your righteousness rescue me and save me; Extend Your ear to me and help me.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Save me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, From the ①grasp of the wrongdoer and the ruthless, ▷ ①Lit palm

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: I have become a marvel to many, For You are my strong refuge.

column.name: text
column.value: My mouth is filled with Your praise And with Your glory all day long.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not cast me away at the time of my old age; Do not abandon me when my strength fails.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Saying, “God has abandoned him; Pursue and seize him, for there is no one to save him.”

column.name: text
column.value: God, do not be far from me; My God, hurry to my aid!

column.name: text
text
column.value: But as for me, I will wait continually, And will ①praise You yet more and more. ▷ ①Lit add upon all Your praise

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: God, You have taught me from my youth, And I still declare Your wondrous deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: And even when I am old and gray, God, do not abandon me, Until I declare Your ①strength to this generation, Your power to all who are to come. ▷ ①Lit arm

column.name: text
column.value: ①For Your righteousness, God, reaches to the ②heavens, You who have done great things; God, who is like You? ▷ ①Or And ②Lit height

column.name: text
column.value: You who have shown ①me many troubles and distresses Will revive ②me again, And will bring ③me up again from the depths of the earth. ▷ ①Another reading is us ②Another reading is us ③Another reading is us

column.name: text
column.value: May You increase my greatness And turn to comfort me.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also praise You with ①a harp, And Your ②truth, my God; I will sing praises to You with the lyre, Holy One of Israel. ▷ ①Lit an instrument of a harp ②Or faithfulness

column.name: text
column.value: My lips will shout for joy when I sing praises to You; And my soul, which You have redeemed.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: May those who seek my ①life Be put to shame and humiliated; May those who delight ②in my harm Be turned back and dishonored. ▷ ①Or soul ②Or to injure me

column.name: text
column.value: May those who say, “Aha, aha!” be ①turned back Because of their shame. ▷ ①Some mss appalled

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: [A Psalm of Solomon.] Give the king Your judgments, God, And Your righteousness to the king’s son.

column.name: text
column.value: ①May ②he judge Your people with righteousness And ③Your afflicted with justice. ▷ ①Or He will judge ②Many of the pronouns in this Psalm may be rendered He since the typical reference is to the Messiah ③Or Your humble

column.name: text
column.value: ①May the mountains bring ②peace to the people, And the hills, in righteousness. ▷ ①Or The mountains will bring ②Or prosperity

column.name: text
column.value: ①May he vindicate the ②afflicted of the people, Save the children of the needy, And crush the oppressor. ▷ ①Or He will vindicate ②Or humble

column.name: text
column.value: ①May they fear You while the sun shines, And ②as long as the moon shines, throughout all generations. ▷ ①Or They will fear ②Lit before the moon

column.name: text
column.value: ①May he come down like rain upon the mown grass, Like showers that water the earth. ▷ ①Or He will come down

column.name: text
column.value: ①May the righteous flourish in his days, As well as an abundance of peace, until the moon is no more. ▷ ①Or The righteous will flourish

column.name: text
column.value: May he also rule from sea to sea, And from the Euphrates River to the ends of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: ①May the nomads of the desert bow before him, And his enemies lick the dust. ▷ ①Or The nomads...will bow

column.name: text
text
column.value: ①And may all kings bow down before him, All nations serve him. ▷ ①Or All kings will bow down

column.name: text
column.value: For he will save the needy when he cries for help, The ①afflicted also, and him who has no helper. ▷ ①Or humble

column.name: text
column.value: He will have compassion on the poor and needy, And he will save the ①lives of the needy. ▷ ①Lit souls

column.name: text
text
text
text
text
column.value: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, Who alone works wonders.

column.name: text
text
column.value: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

column.name: text
column.value: [A Psalm of Asaph.] God certainly is good to Israel, To those who are pure in heart!

column.name: text
column.value: But as for me, my feet came close to stumbling, My steps ①had almost slipped. ▷ ①Lit were caused to slip

column.name: text
column.value: For I was envious of the ①arrogant As I saw the prosperity of the wicked. ▷ ①Or boasters

column.name: text
column.value: For there are no pains in their death, And their belly is fat.

column.name: text
column.value: They are not ①in trouble like other people, Nor are they tormented together with the rest of mankind. ▷ ①Lit in the trouble of people

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore arrogance is their necklace; The garment of violence covers them.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: They have set their mouth ①against the heavens, And their tongue ②parades through the earth. ▷ ①Or in ②Lit walks

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore ①his people return here, And abundant waters are drunk by them. ▷ ①Or His

column.name: text
column.value: They say, “How does God know? And is there knowledge ①with the Most High?” ▷ ①Lit in

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, these are the wicked; And always at ease, they have increased in wealth.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For I have been stricken all day long, And ①punished every morning. ▷ ①Lit my punishment

column.name: text
column.value: If I had said, “I will speak this way,” Behold, I would have betrayed the generation of Your children.

column.name: text
column.value: When I thought of understanding this, It was ①troublesome in my sight ▷ ①Lit labor, trouble

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: How they are ①destroyed in a moment! They are utterly swept away by sudden terrors! ▷ ①Lit become a desolation

column.name: text
column.value: Like a dream when one awakes, Lord, when stirred, You will despise their image.

column.name: text
column.value: When my heart was embittered And I was pierced ①within, ▷ ①Lit in my kidneys

column.name: text
text
column.value: Nevertheless I am continually with You; You have taken hold of my right hand.

column.name: text
column.value: You will guide me with Your plan, And afterward receive me ①to glory. ▷ ①Or with honor

column.name: text
column.value: Whom do I have in heaven but You? And with You, I desire nothing on earth.

column.name: text
column.value: My flesh and my heart may fail, But God is the ①strength of my heart and my portion forever. ▷ ①Lit rock

column.name: text
text
column.value: But as for me, the nearness of God is good for me; I have made the Lord ①GOD my refuge, So that I may tell of all Your works. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director; set to ①Al-tashheth. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song.] We give thanks to You, God, we give thanks, For Your name is near; People declare Your wondrous works. ▷ ①Lit Do Not Destroy

column.name: text
column.value: “When I select an appointed time, It is I who judge fairly.

column.name: text
text
column.value: I said to the boastful, ‘Do not boast,’ And to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up the horn;

column.name: text
column.value: Do not lift up your horn on high, Do not speak with insolent ①pride.’ ” ▷ ①Lit neck

column.name: text
text
column.value: But God is the Judge; He puts down one and exalts another.

column.name: text
text
column.value: But as for me, I will declare it forever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: And ①He will cut off all the horns of the wicked, But the horns of the righteous will be lifted up. ▷ ①Heb I

column.name: text
column.value: [A ①Maskil of Asaph.] God, why have You rejected us forever? Why does Your anger smoke against the sheep of Your ②pasture? ▷ ①Possibly, Contemplative; or Didactic; or Skillful Psalm ②Or pasturing

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Your adversaries have roared in the midst of Your meeting place; They have set up their own signs as signs.

column.name: text
column.value: It ①seems like one bringing up His axe into a ②forest of trees. ▷ ①Lit is known as ②Lit thicket

column.name: text
column.value: And now they break down ①all its carved work With axe and hammers. ▷ ①Lit altogether

column.name: text
text
column.value: They said in their heart, “Let’s ①completely ②subdue them.” They have burned all the meeting places of God in the land. ▷ ①Lit altogether ②Or oppress

column.name: text
text
column.value: How long, God, will the enemy taunt You? Shall the enemy treat Your name disrespectfully forever?

column.name: text
column.value: Why do You withdraw Your hand, even Your right hand? Extend it from Your chest and destroy them!

column.name: text
column.value: Yet God is my King from long ago, Who performs acts of salvation in the midst of the earth.

column.name: text
text
text
text
text
text
column.value: Remember this, ①LORD, that the enemy has taunted You, And a foolish people has treated Your name disrespectfully. ▷ ①Or that the enemy has taunted the LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Do not give the soul of Your turtledove to the wild animal; Do not forget the life of Your afflicted forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Consider the covenant; For the dark places of the land are full of the places of violence.

column.name: text
column.value: May the oppressed person not return dishonored; May the afflicted and the needy praise Your name.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Do not forget the voice of Your adversaries, The uproar of those who rise against You, which ascends continually.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: There He broke the ①flaming arrows, The shield, the sword, and the ②weapons of war. Selah ▷ ①Lit fiery shafts of the bow ②Lit battle

column.name: text
column.value: You are resplendent, ①More majestic than the mountains of prey. ▷ ①Or Majestic from the mountains

column.name: text
column.value: The stouthearted were plundered, ①They sank into sleep; And none of the ②warriors could use his hands. ▷ ①Lit They slumbered their sleep ②Lit men of might have found their hands

column.name: text
column.value: At Your rebuke, God of Jacob, Both ①rider and horse were cast into a dead sleep. ▷ ①Lit chariot

column.name: text
column.value: You, You indeed are to be feared, And who may stand in Your presence, ①once You are angry? ▷ ①Lit since Your anger

column.name: text
column.value: You caused judgment to be heard from heaven; The earth feared and was still

column.name: text
column.value: When God arose to judgment, To save all the humble of the earth. Selah

column.name: text
text
column.value: Make vows to the LORD your God and fulfill them; All who are around Him are to bring gifts to Him who is to be feared.

column.name: text
text
column.value: [For the music director; ①according to Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph.] My voice rises to God, and I will cry aloud; My voice rises to God, and He will listen to me. ▷ ①1 Chr

column.name: text
text
column.value: When I remember God, then I am restless; When I sigh, then my spirit feels weak. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: You have held my eyelids open; I am so troubled that I cannot speak.

column.name: text
column.value: I have considered the days of old, The years of long ago.

column.name: text
column.value: I will remember my song in the night; I will meditate with my heart, And my spirit ①ponders: ▷ ①Lit searched

column.name: text
column.value: Will the Lord reject forever? And will He never be favorable again?

column.name: text
column.value: Has His favor ceased forever? Has His ①promise come to an end ②forever? ▷ ①Lit word ②Lit from generation to generation

column.name: text
column.value: Has God forgotten to be gracious, Or has He in anger ①withdrawn His compassion? Selah ▷ ①Lit shut up

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, “It is my ①grief, That the right hand of the Most High has changed.” ▷ ①Or infirmity, the years of the right hand of the Most High

column.name: text
text
column.value: I will meditate on all Your work, And on Your deeds with thanksgiving.

column.name: text
column.value: Your way, God, is holy; What god is great like our God?

column.name: text
column.value: You are the God who works wonders; You have made known Your strength among the peoples.

column.name: text
column.value: By Your ①power You have redeemed Your people, The sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah ▷ ①Lit arm

column.name: text
text
text
text
column.value: Your way was in the sea And Your paths in the mighty waters, And Your footprints were not known.

column.name: text
column.value: You led Your people like a flock By the hand of Moses and Aaron.

column.name: text
column.value: [A ①Maskil of Asaph.] Listen, my people, to my ②instruction; Incline your ears to the words of my mouth. ▷ ①Possibly, Contemplative; or Didactic; or Skillful Psalm ②Or law, teaching

column.name: text
column.value: I will open my mouth in a parable; I will tell riddles of old,

column.name: text
column.value: Which we have heard and known, And our fathers have told us.

column.name: text
column.value: We will not conceal them from their children, But we will tell the generation to come the praises of the LORD, And His power and His wondrous works that He has done.

column.name: text
column.value: For He established a testimony in Jacob, And appointed a law in Israel, Which He commanded our fathers That they were to ①teach them to their children, ▷ ①Lit make them known

column.name: text
column.value: So that the generation to come would know, the children yet to be born, That they would arise and tell them to their children,

column.name: text
column.value: So that they would put their confidence in God And not forget the works of God, But comply with His commandments,

column.name: text
column.value: And not be like their fathers, A stubborn and rebellious generation, A generation that did not ①prepare its heart And whose spirit was not faithful to God. ▷ ①Or put right

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Ephraim ①were archers equipped with bows, Yet they turned back on the day of battle. ▷ ①Or being

column.name: text
column.value: They did not keep the covenant of God And refused to walk in His Law;

column.name: text
column.value: They forgot His deeds And His ①miracles that He had shown them. ▷ ①Or wonderful works

column.name: text
column.value: He performed wonders before their fathers In the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

column.name: text
column.value: He divided the sea and caused them to pass through, And He made the waters stand up like a heap.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He led them with the cloud by day And all the night with a light of fire.

column.name: text
column.value: He split the rocks in the wilderness And gave them plenty to drink like the ocean depths.

column.name: text
column.value: He brought forth streams from the rock And made waters run down like rivers.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they still continued to sin against Him, To rebel against the Most High in the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: And in their heart they put God to the test By asking for food ①that suited their taste. ▷ ①Lit to their soul

column.name: text
column.value: Then they spoke against God; They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, He struck the rock so that waters gushed out, And streams were overflowing; Can He also provide bread? Will He prepare meat for His people?”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the LORD heard and ①was full of wrath; And a fire was kindled against Jacob, And anger also mounted against Israel, ▷ ①Or became infuriated

column.name: text
column.value: Because they did not believe in God And did not trust in His salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet He commanded the clouds above And opened the doors of heaven;

column.name: text
column.value: He rained down manna upon them to eat, And gave them ①food from heaven. ▷ ①Lit grain

column.name: text
text
column.value: He made the east wind blow in the sky And by His ①power He directed the south wind. ▷ ①Or strength

column.name: text
column.value: When He rained meat upon them like the dust, Even winged fowl like the sand of the seas,

column.name: text
column.value: He let them fall in the midst of ①their camp, All around their dwellings. ▷ ①Lit His

column.name: text
column.value: So they ate and were well filled, And He ①satisfied their longing. ▷ ①Lit brought to them their

column.name: text
column.value: ①Yet before they had abandoned their longing, While their food was in their mouths, ▷ ①Lit They did not turn away from their

column.name: text
column.value: The anger of God rose against them And killed ①some of their strongest ones, And ②subdued the choice men of Israel. ▷ ①Lit among their fat ones ②Lit caused to bow down

column.name: text
column.value: In spite of all this they still sinned And did not believe in His wonderful works.

column.name: text
column.value: So He brought their days to an end in futility, And their years to an end in sudden terror.

column.name: text
column.value: When He killed them, then they sought Him, And they returned and searched diligently for God;

column.name: text
column.value: And they remembered that God was their rock, And the Most High God their Redeemer.

column.name: text
column.value: But they flattered Him with their mouth And lied to Him with their tongue.

column.name: text
column.value: For their heart was not steadfast toward Him, Nor were they faithful with His covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: But He, being compassionate, ①forgave their wrongdoing and did not destroy them; And often He ②restrained His anger And did not stir up all His wrath. ▷ ①Lit covered over, atoned for ②Lit turned away

column.name: text
column.value: So He remembered that they were only flesh, A ①wind that passes and does not return. ▷ ①Or breath

column.name: text
column.value: How often they rebelled against Him in the wilderness And grieved Him in the desert!

column.name: text
column.value: Again and again they ①tempted God, And pained the Holy One of Israel. ▷ ①Or put God to the test

column.name: text
column.value: They did not remember His ①power, The day when He redeemed them from the enemy, ▷ ①Lit hand

column.name: text
column.value: When He performed His signs in Egypt And His marvels in the field of Zoan,

column.name: text
column.value: And turned their rivers to blood, And their streams, so that they could not drink.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent swarms of flies among them that devoured them, And frogs that destroyed them.

column.name: text
column.value: He also gave their crops to the grasshopper And the product of their labor to the locust.

column.name: text
column.value: He ①destroyed their vines with hailstones And their sycamore trees with frost. ▷ ①Lit was killing

column.name: text
column.value: He also turned their cattle over to the hailstones, And their herds to bolts of lightning.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent His burning anger upon them, Fury and indignation and trouble, A band of ①destroying angels. ▷ ①Lit angels of evil ones; another reading is evil angels

column.name: text
text
column.value: And struck all the firstborn in Egypt, The first and best of their vigor in the tents of Ham.

column.name: text
column.value: But He led His own people out like sheep, And guided them in the wilderness like a flock;

column.name: text
column.value: He led them safely, so that they did not fear; But the sea engulfed their enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: So He brought them to His holy ①land, To this ②hill country which His right hand had gained. ▷ ①Lit border, territory ②Or mountain

column.name: text
column.value: He also drove out the nations from them And apportioned them as an inheritance by measurement, And had the tribes of Israel dwell in their tents.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they ①tempted and rebelled against the Most High God And did not keep His testimonies, ▷ ①Or put to the test

column.name: text
column.value: But turned back and acted treacherously like their fathers; They turned aside like a treacherous bow.

column.name: text
column.value: For they provoked Him with their high places And moved Him to jealousy with their carved images.

column.name: text
text
column.value: So that He abandoned the dwelling place at Shiloh, The tent ①which He had pitched among people, ▷ ①Some ancient versions where He dwelt

column.name: text
column.value: And He gave up His strength to captivity And His glory into the hand of the enemy.

column.name: text
column.value: He also turned His people over to the sword, And ①was filled with wrath at His inheritance. ▷ ①Or became infuriated

column.name: text
column.value: Fire devoured ①His young men, And ②His virgins had no wedding songs. ▷ ①Or their ②Or their

column.name: text
column.value: ①His priests fell by the sword, And ②His widows could not weep. ▷ ①Or their ②Or their

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Lord awoke as if from sleep, Like a warrior ①overcome by wine. ▷ ①Or sobered up from

column.name: text
text
column.value: He also rejected the tent of Joseph, And did not choose the tribe of Ephraim,

column.name: text
column.value: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which He loved.

column.name: text
column.value: And He built His sanctuary like the heights, Like the earth which He has established forever.

column.name: text
column.value: He also chose His servant David And took him from the sheepfolds;

column.name: text
column.value: From ①the care of the ②ewes with nursing lambs He brought him To shepherd Jacob His people, And Israel His inheritance. ▷ ①Lit following ②Lit ewes that wet-nurse, He

column.name: text
column.value: So he shepherded them according to the integrity of his heart, And guided them with his skillful hands.

column.name: text
text
column.value: They have given the dead bodies of Your servants to the birds of the sky as food, The flesh of Your godly ones to the animals of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: They have poured out their blood like water all around Jerusalem; And there was no one to bury them.

column.name: text
column.value: We have become a disgrace before our neighbors, An object of derision and ridicule to those around us.

column.name: text
column.value: How long, LORD? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?

column.name: text
column.value: Pour out Your wrath upon the nations which do not know You, And upon the kingdoms which do not call upon Your name.

column.name: text
column.value: For they have devoured Jacob And laid waste his ①settlement. ▷ ①Lit pasture

column.name: text
column.value: Do not ①hold us responsible for ②the guilty deeds of our forefathers; Let Your compassion come quickly to meet us, For we have become very low. ▷ ①Lit remember against us ②Or our former sins

column.name: text
text
column.value: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let vengeance for the blood of Your servants which has been shed Be known among the nations in our sight.

column.name: text
text
column.value: And return to our neighbors seven times as much into their lap Their taunts with which they have taunted You, Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: So we Your people and the sheep of Your ①pasture Will give thanks to You forever; To all generations we will tell of Your praise. ▷ ①Or pasturing

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director; set to ①El Shoshannim; ②Eduth. A Psalm of Asaph.] Listen, Shepherd of Israel, Who leads Joseph like a flock; You who are enthroned above the cherubim, shine forth! ▷ ①Possibly, to the Lilies ②Lit A testimony

column.name: text
column.value: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, awaken Your power, And come to save us!

column.name: text
column.value: God, restore us And make Your face shine upon us, ①and we will be saved. ▷ ①Or that we may

column.name: text
column.value: LORD God of armies, How long will You ①be angry with the prayer of Your people? ▷ ①Lit smoke against

column.name: text
column.value: You have fed them with the bread of tears, And You have made them drink tears in ①large measure. ▷ ①Lit a third part of a

column.name: text
column.value: You make us ①an object of contention to our neighbors, And our enemies laugh among themselves. ▷ ①Lit strife to

column.name: text
column.value: God of armies, restore us And make Your face shine upon us, ①and we will be saved. ▷ ①Or that we may

column.name: text
text
column.value: You cleared the ground before it, And it took deep root and filled the land.

column.name: text
column.value: The mountains were covered with its shadow, And ①the cedars of God with its branches. ▷ ①Or its boughs are like the cedars of God

column.name: text
column.value: It was sending out its branches to the sea And its shoots to the Euphrates River.

column.name: text
column.value: Why have You broken down its ①hedges, So that all who pass that way pick its fruit? ▷ ①Or walls, fences

column.name: text
column.value: A boar from the forest eats it away, And whatever moves in the field feeds on it.

column.name: text
column.value: God of armies, do turn back; Look down from heaven and see, and take care of this vine,

column.name: text
column.value: The ①shoot which Your right hand has planted, And of the ②son whom You have ③strengthened for Yourself. ▷ ①Or root ②Or figuratively: branch ③Or secured

column.name: text
column.value: It is burned with fire, it is cut down; They perish from the rebuke of Your face.

column.name: text
column.value: Let Your hand be upon the man of Your right hand, Upon the son of man whom You made strong for Yourself.

column.name: text
column.value: Then we will not turn back from You; Revive us, and we will call upon Your name.

column.name: text
text
column.value: [For the music director; ①on the Gittith. A Psalm of Asaph.] Sing for joy to God our strength; Shout joyfully to the God of Jacob. ▷ ①Or according to

column.name: text
column.value: Raise a song, strike the tambourine, The sweet sounding lyre with the harp.

column.name: text
column.value: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, At the full moon, on our feast day.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is a statute for Israel, An ordinance of the God of Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: He established it as a testimony in Joseph When he ①went throughout the land of Egypt. I heard a language I did not know: ▷ ①Lit went out over

column.name: text
column.value: “I ①relieved his shoulder of the burden, His hands were freed from the ②basket. ▷ ①Lit removed his shoulder from ②Or brick load

column.name: text
text
column.value: Hear, My people, and I will admonish you; Israel, if you would listen to Me!

column.name: text
column.value: There shall be no strange god among you; Nor shall you worship a foreign god.

column.name: text
text
column.value: “But My people did not listen to My voice, And Israel did not ①obey Me. ▷ ①Lit yield to

column.name: text
column.value: So I gave ①them over to the stubbornness of their heart, To walk by their own plans. ▷ ①Lit him

column.name: text
column.value: Oh that My people would listen to Me, That Israel would walk in My ways!

column.name: text
column.value: I would quickly subdue their enemies And turn My hand against their adversaries.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who hate the LORD would pretend to obey Him, And their time of punishment would be forever.

column.name: text
column.value: ①But I would feed you with the ②finest of the wheat, And with honey from the rock I would satisfy you.” ▷ ①Lit He would feed him ②Lit fat

column.name: text
text
column.value: For behold, Your enemies make an uproar, And those who hate You have ①exalted themselves. ▷ ①Lit lifted up the head

column.name: text
column.value: They make shrewd plans against Your people, And ①conspire together against Your ②treasured ones. ▷ ①Or consult ②Or hidden ones

column.name: text
column.value: They have said, “Come, and let’s wipe them out ①as a nation, So that the name of Israel will no longer be remembered.” ▷ ①Lit from

column.name: text
text
column.value: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites;

column.name: text
column.value: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

column.name: text
text
column.value: Deal with them as with Midian, As with Sisera and Jabin at the river of Kishon,

column.name: text
column.value: Who were destroyed at En-dor, Who became like dung for the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, And all their leaders like Zebah and Zalmunna,

column.name: text
column.value: Who said, “Let’s possess for ourselves The pastures of God.”

column.name: text
column.value: My God, make them like the ①whirling dust, Like chaff before the wind. ▷ ①Or tumbleweed

column.name: text
column.value: Like fire that burns the forest, And like a flame that sets the mountains on fire,

column.name: text
column.value: So pursue them with Your heavy gale, And terrify them with Your storm.

column.name: text
column.value: Fill their faces with dishonor, So that they will seek Your name, LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: May they be ashamed and dismayed forever, And may they be humiliated and perish,

column.name: text
column.value: So that they will know that You alone, whose name is the LORD, Are the Most High over all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: [A Psalm of Asaph.] God takes His position in ①His assembly; He judges in the midst of the gods. ▷ ①Lit the assembly of God

column.name: text
column.value: How long will you judge unjustly And show partiality to the wicked? Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Vindicate the weak and fatherless; Do justice to the afflicted and destitute.

column.name: text
column.value: Rescue the weak and needy; Save them from the hand of the wicked.

column.name: text
text
column.value: ①I said, “You are gods, And all of you are sons of the Most High. ▷ ①Lit I, on my part

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless you will die like men, And fall like one of the princes.”

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, God, judge the earth! For You possess all the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director; ①on the Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.] How lovely are Your dwelling places, LORD of armies! ▷ ①Or according to

column.name: text
column.value: My soul longed and even yearned for the courtyards of the LORD; My heart and my flesh sing for joy to the living God.

column.name: text
column.value: The bird also has found a house, And the swallow a nest for herself, where she may put her young: Your altars, LORD of armies, My King and my God.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are those who dwell in Your house! They are ever praising You. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is the person whose strength is in You, In ①whose heart are the roads to Zion! ▷ ①Lit their

column.name: text
text
column.value: They go from strength to strength, ①Every one of them appears before God in Zion. ▷ ①Some ancient versions The God of gods will be seen in Zion

column.name: text
column.value: LORD God of armies, hear my prayer; Listen, God of Jacob! Selah

column.name: text
column.value: See our shield, God, And look at the face of Your anointed.

column.name: text
column.value: For a day in Your courtyards is better than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather stand at the threshold of the house of my God Than live in the tents of wickedness.

column.name: text
text
column.value: LORD of armies, Blessed is the person who trusts in You!

column.name: text
text
column.value: You forgave the guilt of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: You withdrew all Your fury; You turned away from Your burning anger.

column.name: text
