text
column.value: A perverse heart shall leave me; I will know no evil.

column.name: text
text
text
text
column.value: Every morning I will ①destroy all the wicked of the land, So as to eliminate from the city of the LORD all those who do injustice. ▷ ①Or silence

column.name: text
column.value: [A Psalm of David.] Bless the LORD, my soul, And all that is within me, bless His holy name.

column.name: text
column.value: Bless the LORD, my soul, And do not forget any of His benefits;

column.name: text
column.value: Who pardons all your guilt, Who heals all your diseases;

column.name: text
column.value: Who redeems your life from the pit, Who crowns you with favor and compassion;

column.name: text
column.value: Who satisfies your ①years with good things, So that your youth is renewed like the eagle. ▷ ①Or desire

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD performs ①righteous deeds And judgments for all who are oppressed. ▷ ①Or deeds of vindication

column.name: text
column.value: He made known His ways to Moses, His deeds to the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, Slow to anger and abounding in mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: He will not always contend with us, Nor will He keep His anger forever.

column.name: text
column.value: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, Nor rewarded us according to our guilty deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, So great is His mercy toward those who ①fear Him. ▷ ①Or revere

column.name: text
column.value: As far as the east is from the west, So far has He removed our wrongdoings from us.

column.name: text
column.value: Just as a father has compassion on his children, So the LORD has compassion on those who ①fear Him. ▷ ①Or revere

column.name: text
text
column.value: As for man, his days are like grass; Like a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

column.name: text
column.value: When the wind has passed over it, it is no more, And its place no longer knows about it.

column.name: text
column.value: But the ①mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting for those who ②fear Him, And His justice to the children’s children, ▷ ①Or faithfulness ②Or revere

column.name: text
column.value: To those who keep His covenant And remember His precepts, so as to do them.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has established His throne in the heavens, And His ①sovereignty rules over ②all. ▷ ①Or kingdom ②I.e., the universe

column.name: text
column.value: Bless the LORD, you His angels, Mighty in strength, who perform His word, Obeying the voice of His word!

column.name: text
column.value: Bless the LORD, all you His ①angels, You who serve Him, doing His will. ▷ ①Lit hosts

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Covering Yourself with light as with a cloak, Stretching out heaven like a tent curtain.

column.name: text
text
column.value: ①He makes ②the winds His messengers, ③Flaming fire His ministers. ▷ ①Lit Who ②Or His angels, spirits ③Or His ministers flames of fire

column.name: text
column.value: He established the earth upon its foundations, So that it will not ①totter forever and ever. ▷ ①Or move out of place

column.name: text
column.value: You covered it with the deep sea as with a garment; The waters were standing above the mountains.

column.name: text
column.value: They fled from Your rebuke, At the sound of Your thunder they hurried away.

column.name: text
column.value: The mountains rose; the valleys sank down To the place which You established for them.

column.name: text
column.value: You set a boundary so that they will not pass over, So that they will not return to cover the earth.

column.name: text
text
column.value: They give drink to every animal of the field; The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: ①He causes the grass to grow for the ②cattle, And vegetation for the labor of mankind, So that ③they may produce ④food from the earth, ▷ ①Lit Who ②Or animals ③Or He ④Lit bread

column.name: text
column.value: And wine, which makes a human heart cheerful, So that he makes his face gleam with oil, And ①food, which sustains a human heart. ▷ ①Lit bread

column.name: text
column.value: The trees of the LORD ①drink their fill, The cedars of Lebanon which He planted, ▷ ①Lit are satisfied

column.name: text
column.value: Where the birds build their nests, And the stork, whose home is the juniper trees.

column.name: text
column.value: The high mountains are for the wild goats; The cliffs are a refuge for the rock hyrax.

column.name: text
column.value: He made the moon for the seasons; The sun knows the place of its setting.

column.name: text
column.value: You appoint darkness and it becomes night, In which all the animals of the forest ①prowl about. ▷ ①Lit crawl

column.name: text
column.value: The young lions roar for their prey ①And seek their food from God. ▷ ①Lit And to seek

column.name: text
column.value: When the sun rises they withdraw, And they lie down in their dens.

column.name: text
column.value: A person goes out to his work And to his labor until evening.

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, how many are Your works! ①In wisdom You have made them all; The earth is full of Your ②possessions. ▷ ①Or With ②Or creatures

column.name: text
column.value: ①There is the sea, great and ②broad, In which are swarms without number, Animals both small and great. ▷ ①Or This ②Or broad of dimensions; lit hands

column.name: text
column.value: The ships move along there, And ①Leviathan, which You have formed to have fun in it. ▷ ①Or a sea monster

column.name: text
column.value: They all wait for You To give them their food in ①due season. ▷ ①Lit its appointed time

column.name: text
column.value: You give to them, they gather it up; You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; May the LORD rejoice in His works;

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: May my praise be pleasing to Him; As for me, I shall rejoice in the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: May sinners be removed from the earth And may the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my soul. ①Praise ②the LORD! ▷ ①Or Hallelujah! ②Heb YAH

column.name: text
column.value: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; Make His deeds known among the peoples.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Boast in His holy name; May the heart of those who seek the LORD be joyful.

column.name: text
column.value: Seek the LORD and His strength; Seek His face continually.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember His ①wonders which He has done, His marvels and the judgments ②spoken by His mouth, ▷ ①I.e., wonderful acts ②Lit of His mouth

column.name: text
column.value: You ①descendants of Abraham, His servant, You sons of Jacob, His chosen ones! ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: He is the LORD our God; His judgments are in all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: He has remembered His covenant forever, The word which He commanded to a thousand generations,

column.name: text
column.value: The covenant which He made with Abraham, And His oath to Isaac.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He confirmed it to Jacob as a statute, To Israel as an everlasting covenant,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan As the ①portion of your inheritance,” ▷ ①Lit measuring line

column.name: text
column.value: When they were only a few people in number, Very few, and strangers in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And they wandered from nation to nation, From one kingdom to another people,

column.name: text
column.value: He allowed no one to oppress them, And He ①rebuked kings for their sakes, saying, ▷ ①Or punished

column.name: text
column.value: “Do not touch My anointed ones, And do not harm My prophets.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He called for a famine upon the land; He broke the whole staff of bread.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent a man before them, Joseph, who was sold as a slave.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of the LORD refined him.

column.name: text
column.value: The king sent and released him, The ruler of peoples, and set him free.

column.name: text
column.value: He made him lord of his house, And ruler over all his possessions,

column.name: text
column.value: To ①imprison his high officials ②at will, That he might teach his elders wisdom. ▷ ①Lit bind ②Lit at his

column.name: text
column.value: Israel also came into Egypt; So Jacob lived in the land of Ham.

column.name: text
column.value: And He made His people very fruitful, And made them stronger than their enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: He turned their heart to hate His people, To deal cunningly with His servants.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent His servant Moses, And Aaron, whom He had chosen.

column.name: text
column.value: They ①performed His wondrous acts among them, And miracles in the land of Ham. ▷ ①Lit set the words of His signs

column.name: text
column.value: He sent darkness and made it dark; And they did not rebel against His words.

column.name: text
column.value: He turned their waters into blood, And caused their fish to die.

column.name: text
column.value: Their land swarmed with frogs Even in the chambers of their kings.

column.name: text
column.value: He spoke, and a swarm of flies And gnats invaded all their territory.

column.name: text
column.value: He ①gave them hail for rain, And flaming fire in their land. ▷ ①Or made their rain hail

column.name: text
column.value: He also struck their vines and their fig trees, And smashed the trees of their territory.

column.name: text
column.value: He spoke, and locusts came, And creeping locusts, beyond number,

column.name: text
column.value: And they ate all the vegetation in their land, And ate the fruit of their ground.

column.name: text
column.value: He also fatally struck all the firstborn in their land, The first fruits of all their vigor.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He brought ①the Israelites out with silver and gold, And among His tribes there was not one who stumbled. ▷ ①Lit them

column.name: text
column.value: Egypt was glad when they departed, For the dread of them had fallen upon ①the Egyptians. ▷ ①Lit them

column.name: text
column.value: He spread out a cloud as a ①covering, And fire to illumine by night. ▷ ①Or curtain

column.name: text
column.value: ①They asked, and He brought quail, And satisfied them with the ②bread of heaven. ▷ ①Or One ②Or food

column.name: text
text
column.value: For He remembered His holy word With His servant Abraham;

column.name: text
column.value: And He led out His people with joy, His chosen ones with a joyful shout.

column.name: text
column.value: He also gave them the lands of the ①nations, So that they might take possession of the fruit of the peoples’ labor, ▷ ①Or Gentiles

column.name: text
column.value: And that they might keep His statutes And comply with His laws; ①Praise ②the LORD! ▷ ①Or Hallelujah! ②Heb YAH

column.name: text
column.value: ①Praise ②the LORD! Oh give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; For His mercy is everlasting. ▷ ①Or Hallelujah! ②Heb YAH

column.name: text
column.value: Who can speak of the mighty deeds of the LORD, Or can proclaim all His praise?

column.name: text
column.value: How blessed are those who maintain ①justice, ②Who practice righteousness at all times! ▷ ①Or judgment ②Many Heb mss The one who performs

column.name: text
column.value: Remember me, LORD, in Your favor ①toward Your people. Visit me with Your salvation, ▷ ①Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: So that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, That I may rejoice in the joy of Your nation, That I may boast with Your ①inheritance. ▷ ①I.e., people

column.name: text
column.value: We have sinned ①like our fathers, We have gone astray, we have behaved wickedly. ▷ ①Lit with

column.name: text
column.value: Our fathers in Egypt did not understand Your ①wonders; They did not remember ②Your abundant kindnesses, But rebelled by the sea, at the ③Red Sea. ▷ ①I.e., wonderful acts ②Lit the multitude of Your kindnesses ③Lit Sea of Reeds

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless He saved them for the sake of His name, So that He might make His power known.

column.name: text
column.value: So He rebuked the ①Red Sea and it dried up, And He led them through the mighty waters, as through the wilderness. ▷ ①Lit Sea of Reeds

column.name: text
column.value: So He saved them from the ①hand of one who hated them, And redeemed them from the ②hand of the enemy. ▷ ①Or power ②Or power

column.name: text
column.value: The waters covered their adversaries; Not one of them was left.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they believed His words; They sang His praise.

column.name: text
column.value: They quickly forgot His works; They did not wait for His plan,

column.name: text
column.value: But became lustfully greedy in the wilderness, And put God to the test in the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: So He gave them their request, But sent a ①wasting disease among them. ▷ ①Or leanness into their soul

column.name: text
column.value: When they became envious of Moses in the camp, And of Aaron, the holy one of the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, And engulfed the ①company of Abiram. ▷ ①Or assembly, band

column.name: text
text
column.value: They made a calf in Horeb, And worshiped a cast metal image.

column.name: text
column.value: So they exchanged their glory For the image of an ox that eats grass.

column.name: text
column.value: They forgot God their Savior, Who had done great things in Egypt,

column.name: text
column.value: ①Wonders in the land of Ham, And awesome things by the ②Red Sea. ▷ ①I.e., Wonderful acts ②Lit Sea of Reeds

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore He said that He would destroy them, If Moses, His chosen one, had not stood in the gap before Him, To turn away His wrath from destroying them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they rejected the pleasant land; They did not believe His word,

column.name: text
column.value: But grumbled in their tents; They did not listen to the voice of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore He ①swore to them That He would have them fall in the wilderness, ▷ ①Lit lifted up His hand

column.name: text
column.value: And that He would bring down their ①descendants among the nations, And scatter them in the lands. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: They also followed ①Baal-peor, And ate sacrifices offered to the dead. ▷ ①Or Baal of Peor

column.name: text
column.value: So they provoked Him to anger with their deeds, And a plague broke out among them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Phinehas stood up and ①intervened, And so the plague was brought to a halt. ▷ ①Or pronounced judgment

column.name: text
column.value: And it was credited to him as righteousness, To all generations forever.

column.name: text
column.value: They also provoked Him to wrath at the waters of ①Meribah, So that it went badly for Moses on their account. ▷ ①Lit strife

column.name: text
column.value: Because they were rebellious against ①His Spirit, He spoke rashly with his lips. ▷ ①Or his spirit

column.name: text
column.value: They did not destroy the peoples, As the LORD had commanded them,

column.name: text
column.value: But they got involved with the nations And learned their ①practices, ▷ ①Lit works

column.name: text
column.value: And served their idols, Which became a snare to them.

column.name: text
column.value: They even sacrificed their sons and their daughters to the demons,

column.name: text
column.value: And shed innocent blood, The blood of their sons and their daughters Whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan; And the land was defiled with the blood.

column.name: text
column.value: So they became unclean in their ①practices, And ②were unfaithful in their deeds. ▷ ①Lit works ②Or prostituted themselves

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the anger of the LORD was kindled against His people, And He loathed His ①inheritance. ▷ ①I.e., people

column.name: text
column.value: So He handed them over to the ①nations, And those who hated them ruled over them. ▷ ①Or Gentiles

column.name: text
column.value: Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were subdued under their ①power. ▷ ①Lit hand

column.name: text
text
column.value: Nevertheless He looked at their distress When He heard their cry;

column.name: text
column.value: And He remembered His covenant for their sake, And ①relented according to the greatness of His mercy. ▷ ①Lit was sorry

column.name: text
column.value: He also made them objects of compassion In the presence of all their captors.

column.name: text
column.value: Save us, LORD our God, And gather us from the nations, To give thanks to Your holy name And glory in Your praise.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, From everlasting to everlasting. And all the people shall say, “Amen.” ①Praise ②the LORD! ▷ ①Or Hallelujah! ②Heb YAH

column.name: text
column.value: [A Song, a Psalm of David.] My heart is steadfast, God; I will sing, I will sing praises also with my ①soul. ▷ ①Lit glory

column.name: text
column.value: Awake, harp and lyre; I will awaken the dawn!

column.name: text
column.value: I will give thanks to You, LORD, among the peoples, And I will sing praises to You among the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: For Your mercy is great above the heavens, And Your truth reaches to the skies.

column.name: text
column.value: Be exalted above the heavens, God, And may Your glory be above all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: So that Your beloved may be rescued, Save with Your right hand, and answer me!

column.name: text
column.value: God has spoken in His ①holiness: “I will triumph, I will divide up Shechem, And measure out the Valley of Succoth. ▷ ①Or sanctuary

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who ①will lead me to Edom? ▷ ①Or has led

column.name: text
column.value: God, have You Yourself not rejected us? And will You not go forth with our armies, God?

column.name: text
column.value: Give us help against the enemy, For deliverance ①by man is worthless. ▷ ①Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: ①Through God we will do valiantly, And it is He who will trample down our enemies. ▷ ①Or In; or With

column.name: text
column.value: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good, For His mercy is everlasting.

column.name: text
column.value: The redeemed of the LORD shall say so, Those whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy

column.name: text
column.value: And gathered from the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the ①south. ▷ ①Lit sea

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble; He saved them from their distresses.

column.name: text
column.value: He also had them walk on a ①straight way, To go to ②an inhabited city. ▷ ①Or level ②Or a habitable city; lit a city of habitation

column.name: text
column.value: They shall give thanks to the LORD for His mercy, And for His ①wonders to the sons of mankind! ▷ ①I.e., wonderful acts

column.name: text
column.value: For He has satisfied the ①thirsty soul, And He has filled the hungry soul with what is good. ▷ ①Or parched

column.name: text
column.value: There were those who lived in darkness and in ①the shadow of death, Prisoners in misery and ②chains, ▷ ①Or deep gloom ②Lit irons

column.name: text
column.value: Because they had rebelled against the words of God And rejected the plan of the Most High.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore He humbled their heart with labor; They stumbled and there was no one to help.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble; He saved them from their distresses.

column.name: text
column.value: He brought them out of darkness and ①the shadow of death And broke their bands apart. ▷ ①Or deep darkness

column.name: text
column.value: They shall give thanks to the LORD for His mercy, And for His ①wonders to the sons of mankind! ▷ ①I.e., wonderful acts

column.name: text
column.value: For He has shattered gates of bronze And cut off bars of iron.

column.name: text
column.value: Fools, because of ①their rebellious way, And because of their guilty deeds, were afflicted. ▷ ①Lit the way of their offense

column.name: text
column.value: Their souls loathed all kinds of food, And they came close to the gates of death.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble; He saved them from their distresses.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent His word and healed them, And saved them from their ①destruction. ▷ ①Lit pits

column.name: text
column.value: They shall give thanks to the LORD for His mercy, And for His ①wonders to the sons of mankind! ▷ ①I.e., wonderful acts

column.name: text
column.value: They shall also offer sacrifices of thanksgiving, And tell of His works with joyful singing.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who go down to the sea in ships, Who do business on great waters;

column.name: text
column.value: They have seen the works of the LORD, And His ①wonders in the deep. ▷ ①I.e., wonderful acts

column.name: text
column.value: For He spoke and raised a stormy wind, Which lifted the waves ①of the sea. ▷ ①Lit of it

column.name: text
column.value: They rose up to the heavens, they went down to the depths; Their soul melted away in their misery.

column.name: text
column.value: They reeled and staggered like a drunken person, And ①were at their wits’ end. ▷ ①Lit all their wisdom was swallowed up

column.name: text
column.value: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, And He brought them out of their distresses.

column.name: text
column.value: He caused the storm to be still, So that the waves ①of the sea were hushed. ▷ ①Lit of it

column.name: text
column.value: Then they were glad because they were quiet, So He guided them to their desired harbor.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall give thanks to the LORD for His mercy, And for His ①wonders to the sons of mankind! ▷ ①I.e., wonderful acts

column.name: text
column.value: They shall also exalt Him in the congregation of the people, And praise Him at the seat of the elders.

column.name: text
text
column.value: And a fruitful land into a salt waste, Because of the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

column.name: text
text
column.value: And He has the hungry live there, So that they may establish ①an inhabited city, ▷ ①Or a habitable city; lit a city of habitation

column.name: text
column.value: And sow fields and plant vineyards, And ①gather a fruitful harvest. ▷ ①Lit acquire fruits of yield

column.name: text
column.value: He also blesses them and they multiply greatly, And He does not let their cattle decrease.

column.name: text
column.value: When they become few and lowly Because of oppression, misery, and sorrow,

column.name: text
column.value: He pours contempt upon noblemen And makes them wander in a pathless wasteland.

column.name: text
column.value: But He sets the needy ①securely on high, away from affliction, And makes his families like a flock. ▷ ①Lit in an inaccessibly high place

column.name: text
column.value: The upright see it and are glad; But all injustice shuts its mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is wise? He is to pay attention to these things, And consider the mercy of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director. A Psalm of David.] God of my praise, Do not be silent!

column.name: text
text
column.value: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, And have fought against me without cause.

column.name: text
column.value: In return for my love they act as my accusers; But I am in prayer.

column.name: text
column.value: So they have ①repaid me evil for good, And hatred for my love. ▷ ①Lit laid upon me

column.name: text
column.value: Appoint a wicked person over him, And may an ①accuser stand at his right hand. ▷ ①Or adversary, Satan

column.name: text
column.value: When he is judged, may he come out guilty, And may his prayer become sin.

column.name: text
column.value: May his days be few; May another take his office.

column.name: text
column.value: May his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.

column.name: text
text
column.value: May the creditor ①seize everything that he has, And may strangers plunder the product of his labor. ▷ ①Lit ensnare, strike at

column.name: text
column.value: May there be none to ①extend kindness to him, Nor any to be gracious to his fatherless children. ▷ ①Lit continue

column.name: text
text
column.value: May the guilt of his fathers be remembered ①before the LORD, And do not let the sin of his mother be wiped out. ▷ ①Lit to

column.name: text
column.value: May they be before the LORD continually, So that He may eliminate their memory from the earth;

column.name: text
column.value: Because he did not remember to show mercy, But persecuted the afflicted and needy person, And the despondent in heart, to put them to death.

column.name: text
column.value: He also loved cursing, so it came to him; And he did not delight in blessing, so it was far from him.

column.name: text
column.value: But he clothed himself with cursing as with his garment, And it entered ①his body like water, And like oil into his bones. ▷ ①Lit his inward parts

column.name: text
column.value: May it be to him as a garment with which he covers himself, And as a belt which he constantly wears around himself.

column.name: text
column.value: May this be the reward of my accusers from the LORD, And of those who speak evil against my soul.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For I am afflicted and needy, And ①my heart is wounded within me. ▷ ①Lit one has pierced my heart within me

column.name: text
column.value: I am passing like a shadow when it lengthens; I am shaken off like the locust.

column.name: text
column.value: My knees ①are weak from fasting, And my flesh has grown lean, without fatness. ▷ ①Or totter

column.name: text
column.value: I also have become a disgrace to them; When they see me, they shake their head.

column.name: text
column.value: Help me, LORD my God; Save me according to Your mercy.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: ①May my accusers be clothed with dishonor, And ②may they cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe. ▷ ①Or My accusers will be ②Or they will cover

column.name: text

column.value: Sustain me so that I may be safe, That I may have regard for Your statutes continually.

column.name: text
column.value: You have ①rejected all those who stray from Your statutes, For their deceitfulness is ②useless. ▷ ①Lit made light of ②Lit falsehood

column.name: text
text
column.value: My flesh ①trembles from the fear of You, And I am afraid of Your judgments. ▷ ①Lit bristles up from

column.name: text
column.value: [Ayin] I have done justice and righteousness; Do not leave me to my oppressors.

column.name: text
column.value: Be a guarantor for Your servant for good; Do not let the arrogant oppress me.

column.name: text
column.value: My eyes fail with longing for Your salvation, And for Your righteous ①word. ▷ ①Or promise

column.name: text
column.value: Deal with Your servant according to Your graciousness, And teach me Your statutes.

column.name: text
column.value: I am Your servant; give me understanding, So that I may know Your testimonies.

column.name: text
column.value: It is time for the LORD to act, For they have broken Your Law.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I love Your commandments Above gold, yes, above pure gold.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I carefully follow all Your precepts concerning everything, I hate every false way.

column.name: text
column.value: [Pe] Your testimonies are wonderful; Therefore my soul complies with them.

column.name: text
column.value: The unfolding of Your words gives light; It gives understanding to the simple.

column.name: text
column.value: I opened my mouth wide and panted, For I longed for Your commandments.

column.name: text
column.value: Turn to me and be gracious to me, As is right for those who love Your name.

column.name: text
column.value: Establish my footsteps in Your ①word, And do not let any ②wrongdoing have power over me. ▷ ①Or promise ②Or injustice

column.name: text
column.value: Redeem me from oppression by man, So that I may keep Your precepts.

column.name: text
column.value: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, And teach me Your statutes.

column.name: text
column.value: My eyes ①shed streams of water, Because they do not keep Your Law. ▷ ①Lit run down

column.name: text
column.value: [Tsadhe] You are righteous, LORD, And Your judgments are right.

column.name: text
column.value: You have commanded Your testimonies in righteousness And great faithfulness.

column.name: text
column.value: My zeal has ①consumed me, Because my enemies have forgotten Your words. ▷ ①Lit put an end to

column.name: text
column.value: Your word is very ①pure, Therefore Your servant loves it. ▷ ①Lit refined

column.name: text
column.value: I am small and despised, Yet I do not forget Your precepts.

column.name: text
column.value: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, And Your Law is truth.

column.name: text
column.value: Trouble and anguish have ①come upon me, Yet Your commandments are my delight. ▷ ①Lit found me

column.name: text
column.value: Your testimonies are righteous forever; Give me understanding that I may live.

column.name: text
column.value: [Qoph] I cried out with all my heart; answer me, LORD! I will comply with Your statutes.

column.name: text
column.value: I cried to You; save me And I shall keep Your testimonies.

column.name: text
text
column.value: My eyes anticipate the night watches, So that I may meditate on Your ①word. ▷ ①Or promise

column.name: text
column.value: Hear my voice according to Your faithfulness; Revive me, LORD, according to Your judgments.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who follow after wickedness approach; They are far from Your Law.

column.name: text
column.value: You are near, LORD, And all Your commandments are truth.

column.name: text
column.value: From long ago I have known from Your testimonies That You have founded them forever.

column.name: text
column.value: [Resh] Look at my affliction and rescue me, For I have not forgotten Your Law.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Salvation is far from the wicked, For they do not seek Your statutes.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Many are my persecutors and my enemies, Yet I do not turn aside from Your testimonies.

column.name: text
column.value: I see the treacherous and loathe them, Because they do not keep Your word.

column.name: text
column.value: Consider how I love Your precepts; Revive me, LORD, according to Your faithfulness.

column.name: text
column.value: The sum of Your word is truth, And every one of Your righteous judgments is everlasting.

column.name: text
column.value: [Shin] Rulers persecute me without cause, But my heart stands in awe of Your words.

column.name: text
column.value: I rejoice at Your ①word, Like one who finds great plunder. ▷ ①Or promise

column.name: text
column.value: I hate and loathe falsehood, But I love Your Law.

column.name: text
column.value: Seven times a day I praise You Because of Your righteous judgments.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who love Your Law have great peace, And ①nothing causes them to stumble. ▷ ①Lit they have no stumbling block.

column.name: text
column.value: I hope for Your salvation, LORD, And do Your commandments.

column.name: text
column.value: My soul keeps Your testimonies, And I love them exceedingly.

column.name: text
column.value: I keep Your precepts and Your testimonies, For all my ways are before You.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Let my lips pour out praise, For You teach me Your statutes.

column.name: text
column.value: Let my tongue sing about Your ①word, For all Your commandments are righteousness. ▷ ①Or promise

column.name: text
column.value: Let Your hand be ①ready to help me, For I have chosen Your precepts. ▷ ①Lit to help me

column.name: text
column.value: I long for Your salvation, LORD, And Your Law is my delight.

column.name: text
column.value: Let my soul live that it may praise You, And let Your ordinances help me.

column.name: text
column.value: I have wandered about like a lost sheep; search for Your servant, For I do not forget Your commandments.

column.name: text
column.value: [A Song of ①Ascents.] I cried to the LORD in my trouble, And He answered me. ▷ ①Ex 34:24; 1 Kin

column.name: text
column.value: Rescue my soul, LORD, from lying lips, From a deceitful tongue.

column.name: text
column.value: What will He give to you, and what more will He do to you, You deceitful tongue?

column.name: text
column.value: Sharp arrows of the warrior, With the burning coals of the broom tree!

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to me, for I reside in Meshech, For I have settled among the tents of Kedar!

column.name: text
column.value: Too long has my soul had its dwelling With those who hate peace.

column.name: text
column.value: I am for peace, but when I speak, They are for war.

column.name: text
text
column.value: My help comes from the LORD, Who made heaven and earth.

column.name: text
column.value: He will not allow your foot to slip; He who watches over you will not slumber.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, He who watches over Israel Will neither slumber nor sleep.

column.name: text
text
column.value: The sun will not ①beat down on you by day, Nor the moon by night. ▷ ①Lit strike you

column.name: text
text
column.value: The LORD will ①guard your going out and your coming in From this time and forever. ▷ ①Or keep

column.name: text
column.value: [A Song of Ascents, of David.] “Had it not been the LORD who was on our side,” Let Israel say,

column.name: text
column.value: “Had it not been the LORD who was on our side When people rose up against us,

column.name: text
column.value: Then they would have swallowed us alive, When their anger was kindled against us;

column.name: text
text
column.value: Then the raging waters would have ①swept over our souls.” ▷ ①Or passed over

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed be the LORD, Who has not given us ①to be torn by their teeth. ▷ ①Lit as a prey to

column.name: text
column.value: Our souls have escaped like a bird from the trapper’s snare; The snare is broken and we have escaped.

column.name: text
column.value: Our help is in the name of the LORD, Who made heaven and earth.

column.name: text
column.value: [A Song of Ascents, of David.] I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the house of the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: Our feet are standing Within your gates, Jerusalem,

column.name: text
column.value: Jerusalem, that has been built As a city that is firmly joined together;

column.name: text
column.value: To which the tribes go up, the tribes of ①the LORD— ②An ordinance for Israel— To give thanks to the name of the LORD. ▷ ①Heb YAH ②Or A testimony

column.name: text
column.value: For thrones were set there for judgment, The thrones of the house of David.

column.name: text
column.value: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May they prosper who love you.

column.name: text
column.value: May peace be within your walls, And prosperity within your palaces.”

column.name: text
column.value: For the sake of my brothers and my friends, I will now say, “May peace be within you.”

column.name: text
column.value: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.

column.name: text
column.value: [A Song of Ascents.] Those who trust in the LORD Are like Mount Zion, which cannot be moved but remains forever.

column.name: text
column.value: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, So the LORD surrounds His people From this time and forever.

column.name: text
column.value: For the scepter of wickedness will not rest upon the ①land of the righteous, So that the righteous will not extend their hands to do wrong. ▷ ①Lit lot

column.name: text
column.value: Do good, LORD, to those who are good And to those who are upright in their hearts.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for those who turn aside to their crooked ways, The LORD will lead them away with those who practice injustice. Peace be upon Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: [A Song of Ascents.] To You I have raised my eyes, You who are enthroned in the heavens!

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, As the eyes of a female servant to the hand of her mistress, So our eyes look to the LORD our God, Until He is gracious to us.

column.name: text
column.value: Be gracious to us, LORD, be gracious to us, For we have had much more than enough of contempt.

column.name: text
column.value: Our soul has had much more than enough Of the scoffing of those who are at ease, And with the contempt of the proud.

column.name: text
column.value: [A Song of Ascents.] When the LORD brought back ①the captives of Zion, We were like those who dream. ▷ ①Or those who returned to

column.name: text
column.value: Then our mouth was filled with laughter And our tongue with joyful shouting; Then they said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has done great things for us; We are joyful.

column.name: text
column.value: Restore our fortunes, LORD, As the ①streams in the ②South. ▷ ①Lit stream-beds ②Heb Negev

column.name: text
column.value: Those who sow in tears shall harvest with joyful shouting.

column.name: text
column.value: One who goes here and there weeping, carrying his bag of seed, Shall indeed come again with a shout of joy, bringing his sheaves with him.

column.name: text
column.value: [A Song of Ascents, of Solomon.] Unless the LORD builds a house, They who build it labor in vain; Unless the LORD guards a city, The watchman stays awake in vain.

column.name: text
column.value: It is futile for you to rise up early, To ①stay up late, To eat the bread of painful labor; This is how He gives to His beloved sleep. ▷ ①Lit sit late

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, children are a ①gift of the LORD, The fruit of the womb is a reward. ▷ ①Or heritage

column.name: text
column.value: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, So are the children of one’s youth.

column.name: text
text
column.value: [A Song of Ascents.] “ ①Many times they have attacked me from my youth up,” Let Israel say, ▷ ①Lit Much

column.name: text
text
column.value: The plowers plowed upon my back; They lengthened their furrows.”

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is righteous; He has cut up the ropes of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: May all who hate Zion Be put to shame and turned backward;

column.name: text
text
text
text
column.value: [A Song of Ascents.] Out of the depths I have cried to You, LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Lord, hear my voice! Let Your ears be attentive To the sound of my pleadings.

column.name: text
column.value: If You, ①LORD, were to keep account of guilty deeds, Lord, who could stand? ▷ ①Heb YAH

column.name: text
column.value: But there is forgiveness with You, So that You may be ①revered. ▷ ①Or feared

column.name: text
column.value: I wait for the LORD, my soul waits, And I ①wait for His word. ▷ ①Or hope in

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: And He will redeem Israel From all his guilty deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: [A Song of Ascents, of David.] LORD, my heart is not proud, nor my eyes arrogant; Nor do I ①involve myself in great matters, Or in things too ②difficult for me. ▷ ①Lit go after, walk ②Or marvelous

column.name: text
column.value: I have certainly soothed and quieted my soul; Like a weaned child resting ①against his mother, My soul ②within me is like a weaned child. ▷ ①Or upon ②Or upon

column.name: text
column.value: Israel, wait for the LORD From this time on and forever.

column.name: text
text
column.value: How he swore to the LORD And vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob,

column.name: text
text
column.value: I will not give sleep to my eyes Or slumber to my eyelids,

column.name: text
column.value: Until I find a place for the LORD, ①A dwelling place for the Mighty One of Jacob.” ▷ ①Lit Dwelling places

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, we heard about it in Ephrathah, We found it in the field of ①Jaar. ▷ ①Or the wood

column.name: text
text
column.value: Arise, LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.

column.name: text
column.value: May Your priests be clothed with righteousness, And may Your godly ones sing for joy.

column.name: text
column.value: For the sake of Your servant David, Do not turn away the face of Your anointed.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has sworn to David A truth from which He will not turn back: “I will set upon your throne one from the fruit of your body.

column.name: text
column.value: If your sons will keep My covenant And My testimony which I will teach them, Their sons also will sit upon your throne forever.”

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired it as His dwelling place.

column.name: text
column.value: “This is My resting place forever; Here I will dwell, for I have desired it.

column.name: text
column.value: I will abundantly bless her food; I will satisfy her needy with bread.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also clothe her priests with salvation, And her godly ones will sing aloud for joy.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make the horn of David spring forth there; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed.

column.name: text
column.value: I will clothe his enemies with shame, But upon himself his crown will gleam.”

column.name: text
column.value: [A Song of Ascents, of David.] Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brothers to live together in unity!

column.name: text
column.value: It is like the precious oil on the head, Running down upon the beard, As on Aaron’s beard, The oil which ran down upon the edge of his robes.

column.name: text
text
column.value: ①Praise ②the LORD! Praise the name of the LORD; Praise Him, you servants of the LORD, ▷ ①Or Hallelujah! ②Heb YAH

column.name: text
column.value: You who stand in the house of the LORD, In the courtyards of the house of our God!

column.name: text
text
column.value: For ①the LORD has chosen Jacob for Himself, Israel as His own possession. ▷ ①Heb YAH

column.name: text
column.value: For I know that the LORD is great And that our Lord is above all gods.

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever the LORD pleases, He does, In heaven and on earth, in the seas and in all the ocean depths.

column.name: text
column.value: ①He causes the ②mist to ascend from the ends of the earth, ③He makes lightning for the rain; ④He brings forth the wind from His treasuries. ▷ ①Lit The one who ②I.e., clouds ③Lit The one who ④Lit The one who

column.name: text
column.value: ①He struck the firstborn of Egypt, ②Both human firstborn and animal. ▷ ①Lit The one who ②Lit From man to animal

column.name: text
column.value: ①He sent signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, Upon Pharaoh and all his servants. ▷ ①Lit The one who

column.name: text
column.value: ①He struck many nations And brought death to mighty kings, ▷ ①Lit The one who

column.name: text
text
column.value: And He gave their land as an inheritance, An inheritance to His people Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Your name, LORD, is everlasting, The mention of You, LORD, is ①throughout all generations. ▷ ①Lit to

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD will judge His people And will have compassion on His servants.

column.name: text
column.value: The idols of the nations are nothing but silver and gold, The work of human hands.

column.name: text
column.value: They have mouths, but they do not speak; They have eyes, but they do not see;

column.name: text
column.value: They have ears, but they do not hear, Nor is there any breath at all in their mouths.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who make them will become like them, Yes, everyone who trusts in them.

column.name: text
column.value: House of Israel, bless the LORD; House of Aaron, bless the LORD;

column.name: text
text
column.value: Blessed be the LORD from Zion, Who dwells in Jerusalem. ①Praise ②the LORD! ▷ ①Or Hallelujah! ②Heb YAH

column.name: text
column.value: [A Song of Ascents.] Behold, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, Who ①serve by night in the house of the LORD! ▷ ①Lit stand

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary And bless the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: May the LORD bless you from Zion, He who made heaven and earth.

column.name: text
column.value: By the rivers of Babylon, There we sat down and wept, When we remembered Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: Upon the ①willows in the midst of it We hung our ②harps. ▷ ①Or poplars ②Lit lyres

column.name: text
column.value: For there our captors ①demanded of us ②songs, And our tormentors, jubilation, saying, “Sing for us one of the songs of Zion!” ▷ ①Lit asked ②Lit words of song

column.name: text
column.value: How can we sing the LORD’S song In a foreign land?

column.name: text
column.value: If I forget you, Jerusalem, May my right hand ①forget its skill. ▷ ①I.e., become useless

column.name: text
column.value: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth If I do not remember you, If I do not ①exalt Jerusalem Above my chief joy. ▷ ①Lit cause to ascend

column.name: text
column.value: Remember, LORD, against the sons of Edom The day of Jerusalem, Those who said, “Lay it bare, lay it bare To its foundation!”

column.name: text
column.value: Daughter of Babylon, you ①devastated one, Blessed will be one who repays you With ②the retribution with which you have repaid us. ▷ ①Or devastator ②Lit your requital

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed will be one who seizes and dashes your children Against the rock.

column.name: text
column.value: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good, For His ①faithfulness is everlasting. ▷ ①Or mercy, and so throughout the Psalm

column.name: text
column.value: Give thanks to the God of gods, For His faithfulness is everlasting.

column.name: text
column.value: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, For His faithfulness is everlasting.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: To Him who spread out the earth above the waters, For His faithfulness is everlasting;

column.name: text
column.value: To Him who made the great lights, For His faithfulness is everlasting:

column.name: text
column.value: The sun to rule ①by day, For His faithfulness is everlasting, ▷ ①Or over the

column.name: text
column.value: The moon and stars to rule ①by night, For His faithfulness is everlasting. ▷ ①Or over the

column.name: text
column.value: To Him who struck ①the Egyptians, that is, their firstborn, For His faithfulness is everlasting, ▷ ①Lit Egypt

column.name: text
column.value: And brought Israel out from their midst, For His faithfulness is everlasting,

column.name: text
column.value: With a strong hand and an outstretched arm, For His faithfulness is everlasting.

column.name: text
column.value: To Him who divided the ①Red Sea in parts, For His faithfulness is everlasting, ▷ ①Lit Sea of Reeds

column.name: text
column.value: And allowed Israel to pass through the midst of it, For His faithfulness is everlasting;

column.name: text
column.value: But He ①overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the ②Red Sea, For His faithfulness is everlasting. ▷ ①Lit shook off ②Lit Sea of Reeds

column.name: text
column.value: To Him who led His people through the wilderness, For His faithfulness is everlasting;

column.name: text
column.value: To Him who struck great kings, For His faithfulness is everlasting,

column.name: text
column.value: And brought death to ①mighty kings, For His faithfulness is everlasting: ▷ ①Lit majestic

column.name: text
column.value: Sihon, king of the Amorites, For His faithfulness is everlasting,

column.name: text
column.value: And Og, king of Bashan, For His faithfulness is everlasting,

column.name: text
column.value: And gave their land as an inheritance, For His faithfulness is everlasting,

column.name: text
column.value: An inheritance to His servant Israel, For His faithfulness is everlasting.

column.name: text
column.value: Who remembered us in our lowliness, For His faithfulness is everlasting,

column.name: text
column.value: And has rescued us from our enemies, For His faithfulness is everlasting;

column.name: text
column.value: Who gives food to all flesh, For His faithfulness is everlasting.

column.name: text
column.value: Give thanks to the God of heaven, For His faithfulness is everlasting.

column.name: text
text
column.value: I will bow down toward Your holy temple And give thanks to Your name for Your mercy and Your ①truth; For You have made Your ②word great ③according to all Your name. ▷ ①Or faithfulness ②Or promise ③Or together with

column.name: text
column.value: On the day I called, You answered me; You made me bold with strength in my soul.

column.name: text
column.value: All the kings of the earth will give thanks to You, LORD, When they have heard the words of Your mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: And they will sing of the ways of the LORD, For great is the glory of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD is exalted, Yet He looks after the lowly, But He knows the haughty from afar.

column.name: text
column.value: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, You will ①revive me; You will reach out with Your hand against the wrath of my enemies, And Your right hand will save me. ▷ ①Or keep me alive

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Who devise evil things in their hearts; They continually stir up wars.

column.name: text
column.value: They sharpen their tongues like a snake; The venom of a viper is under their lips. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: Keep me, LORD, from the hands of the wicked; Protect me from violent men Who ①intend to ②trip up my feet. ▷ ①Or devise ②Lit push

column.name: text
text
column.value: I said to the LORD, “You are my God; Listen, LORD, to the sound of my pleadings.

column.name: text
column.value: ①GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You have covered my head on the day of ②battle. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD ②Lit weapons

column.name: text
column.value: Do not grant, LORD, the desires of the wicked; Do not bring about his evil planning, so that they are not exalted. Selah

column.name: text
column.value: “As for the head of those who surround me, May the harm of their lips cover them.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, And justice for the poor.

column.name: text
column.value: Certainly the righteous will give thanks to Your name; The upright will dwell in Your presence.

column.name: text
column.value: [For the music director. A Psalm of David.] LORD, You have searched me and known me.

column.name: text
text
column.value: You ①scrutinize my ②path and my lying down, And are acquainted with all my ways. ▷ ①Lit winnow ②Or journeying

column.name: text
column.value: ①Even before there is a word on my tongue, Behold, LORD, You know it all. ▷ ①Lit For there is not

column.name: text
column.value: You have encircled me behind and in front, And placed Your hand upon me.

column.name: text
column.value: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; It is too high, I cannot comprehend it.

column.name: text
column.value: Where can I go from Your Spirit? Or where can I flee from Your presence?

column.name: text
text
column.value: If I take up the wings of the dawn, If I dwell in the remotest part of the sea,

column.name: text
column.value: Even there Your hand will lead me, And Your right hand will take hold of me.

column.name: text
column.value: If I say, “Surely the darkness will ①overwhelm me, And the light around me will be night,” ▷ ①Lit bruise; some commentators cover

column.name: text
column.value: Even darkness is not dark ①to You, And the night is as bright as the day. Darkness and light are alike to You. ▷ ①Lit from

column.name: text
column.value: For You created my innermost parts; You wove me in my mother’s womb.

column.name: text
column.value: I will give thanks to You, because ①I am awesomely and wonderfully made; Wonderful are Your works, And my soul knows it very well. ▷ ①Some ancient versions You are fearfully wonderful

column.name: text
column.value: My ①frame was not hidden from You When I was made in secret, And skillfully formed in the depths of the earth; ▷ ①Lit bones were

column.name: text
column.value: Your eyes have seen my formless substance; And in Your book were written All the days that were ordained for me, When as yet there was not one of them.

column.name: text
column.value: How precious also are Your thoughts for me, God! How vast is the sum of them!

column.name: text
column.value: Were I to count them, they would outnumber the sand. When I awake, I am still with You.

column.name: text
column.value: If only You would put the wicked to death, God; Leave me, you men of bloodshed.

column.name: text
column.value: For they speak ①against You wickedly, And Your enemies ②take Your name in vain. ▷ ①Or of ②Some mss lift themselves up against You

column.name: text
column.value: Do I not hate those who hate You, LORD? And do I not loathe those who rise up against You?

column.name: text
column.value: I hate them with the utmost hatred; They have become my enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: Search me, God, and know my heart; Put me to the test and know my anxious thoughts;

column.name: text
column.value: And see if there is any ①hurtful way in me, And lead me in the everlasting way. ▷ ①Lit way of pain

column.name: text
column.value: [A Psalm of David.] Hear my prayer, LORD, Listen to my pleadings! Answer me in Your faithfulness, in Your righteousness!

column.name: text
column.value: And do not enter into judgment with Your servant, For no person living is righteous in Your sight.

column.name: text
text
text
text
column.value: I spread out my hands to You; My soul longs for You, like a weary land. Selah

column.name: text
text
text
text
column.value: Teach me to do Your will, For You are my God; Let Your good Spirit lead me on level ①ground. ▷ ①Lit land

column.name: text
column.value: For the sake of Your name, LORD, revive me. In Your righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: And in Your faithfulness, ①destroy my enemies, And eliminate all those who attack my soul, For I am Your servant. ▷ ①Or silence

column.name: text
column.value: [A Psalm of David.] Blessed be the LORD, my rock, Who trains my hands for war, And my fingers for battle;

column.name: text
column.value: My faithfulness and my fortress, My stronghold and my savior, My shield and He in whom I take refuge, Who subdues ①my people under me. ▷ ①Another reading is peoples

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, what is man, that You look after him? Or a son of man, that You think of him?

column.name: text
column.value: Man is like the breath; His days are like a passing shadow.

column.name: text
column.value: Bend down Your heavens, LORD, and come down; Touch the mountains, that they may smoke.

column.name: text
column.value: Flash forth lightning and scatter them; Send out Your arrows and confuse them.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Whose mouths speak deceit, And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

column.name: text
column.value: God, I will sing a new song to You; On a harp of ten strings I will sing praises to You,

column.name: text
column.value: Who gives salvation to kings, Who rescues His servant David from the evil sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Rescue me and save me from the hand of foreigners, Whose mouth speaks deceit And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

column.name: text
column.value: When our sons in their youth are like growing plants, And our daughters like corner pillars ①fashioned for a palace, ▷ ①Lit cut after the pattern of

column.name: text
text
column.value: May our cattle ①be bred Without ②mishap and without ③loss, May there be no outcry in our streets! ▷ ①Lit be laden ②Lit breach ③Lit going out; i.e., miscarriage

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are the people who are so situated; Blessed are the people whose God is the LORD!

column.name: text
text
column.value: I pour out my complaint before Him; I declare my trouble before Him.

column.name: text
column.value: When my spirit felt weak within me, You knew my path. In the way where I walk They have hidden a trap for me.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Give Your attention to my cry, For I have been brought very low; Rescue me from my persecutors, For they are too strong for me.

column.name: text
column.value: Bring my soul out of prison, So that I may give thanks to Your name; The righteous will surround me, For You will look after me.”

column.name: text
column.value: [A Psalm of David.] LORD, I call upon You; hurry to me! Listen to my voice when I call to You!

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Do not incline my heart to any evil thing, To practice deeds ①of wickedness With people who do wrong; And may I not taste their delicacies. ▷ ①Lit in

column.name: text
text
column.value: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock, And they hear my words, for they are pleasant.

column.name: text
column.value: As when one plows and breaks open the earth, Our bones have been scattered at the mouth of ①Sheol. ▷ ①I.e., the netherworld

column.name: text
text
column.value: Keep me from the ①jaws of the trap which they have set for me, And from the snares of those who do wrong. ▷ ①Lit hands of the trap

column.name: text
column.value: May the wicked fall into their own nets, While I pass by ①safely. ▷ ①Lit altogether

column.name: text
column.value: [A Psalm of Praise, of David.] I will exalt You, my God, the King, And I will bless Your name forever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Every day I will bless You, And I will praise Your name forever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Great is the LORD, and highly to be praised; And His greatness is unsearchable.

column.name: text
column.value: One generation will praise Your works to another, And will declare Your mighty acts.

column.name: text
column.value: On the glorious ①splendor of Your majesty And on Your wonderful works, I will meditate. ▷ ①Or majesty of Your splendor

column.name: text
column.value: People will speak of the ①power of Your awesome acts, And I will tell of Your greatness. ▷ ①Or strength

column.name: text
column.value: They will burst forth ①in speaking of Your abundant goodness, And will shout joyfully of Your righteousness. ▷ ①Lit the mention of

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is gracious and compassionate; Slow to anger and great in mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is good to all, And His mercies are over all His works.

column.name: text
column.value: All Your works will give thanks to You, LORD, And Your godly ones will bless You.

column.name: text
column.value: They will speak of the glory of Your kingdom, And talk of Your might,

column.name: text
column.value: To make known to the sons of mankind ①Your mighty acts, And the glory of the majesty of ②Your kingdom. ▷ ①Lit His ②Lit His

column.name: text
column.value: Your kingdom is ①an everlasting kingdom, And Your dominion endures throughout all generations. ②The LORD is faithful in His words, And holy in all His works. ▷ ①Lit a kingdom of all ages ②The LORD...His works in LXX (cf. DSS); not found in MT

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD supports all who fall, And raises up all who are bowed down.

column.name: text
column.value: The eyes of all ①look to You, And You give them their food in due time. ▷ ①Lit wait; or hope for

column.name: text
column.value: You open Your hand And satisfy the desire of every living thing.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is righteous in all His ways, And kind in all His works.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is near to all who call on Him, To all who call on Him in truth.

column.name: text
column.value: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear Him; He will also hear their cry for help and save them.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD watches over all who love Him, But He will destroy all the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD, And all flesh will bless His holy name forever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Praise ②the LORD! Sing a new song to the LORD, And His praise in the congregation of the godly ones. ▷ ①Or Hallelujah! ②Heb YAH

column.name: text
column.value: Israel shall be joyful in his Maker; The sons of Zion shall rejoice in their King.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall praise His name with dancing; They shall sing praises to Him with tambourine and lyre.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He will glorify the lowly with salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: The godly ones shall be jubilant in glory; They shall sing for joy on their beds.

column.name: text
column.value: The high praises of God shall be in their ①mouths, And a two-edged sword in their hands, ▷ ①Lit throat

column.name: text
column.value: To execute vengeance on the nations, And punishment on the peoples,

column.name: text
column.value: To bind their kings with chains, And their dignitaries with shackles of iron,

column.name: text
column.value: To execute against them the judgment written. This is an honor for all His godly ones. ①Praise ②the LORD! ▷ ①Or Hallelujah! ②Heb YAH

column.name: text
column.value: ①Praise ②the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens; Praise Him in the heights! ▷ ①Or Hallelujah! ②Heb YAH

column.name: text
column.value: Praise Him, all His angels; Praise Him, all His heavenly armies!

column.name: text
column.value: Praise Him, sun and moon; Praise Him, all stars of light!

column.name: text
column.value: Praise Him, ①highest heavens, And the waters that are above the heavens! ▷ ①Lit heavens of heavens

column.name: text
column.value: They are to praise the name of the LORD, For He commanded and they were created.

column.name: text
column.value: He has also established them forever and ever; He has made a decree, and it will not pass away.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD from the earth, Sea monsters, and all the ocean depths;

column.name: text
column.value: Fire and hail, snow and clouds; Stormy wind, fulfilling His word;

column.name: text
column.value: Mountains and all hills; Fruit trees and all cedars;

column.name: text
column.value: Animals and all cattle; Crawling things and winged fowl;

column.name: text
column.value: Kings of the earth and all peoples; Rulers and all judges of the earth;

column.name: text
column.value: Both young men and virgins; Old men and children.

column.name: text
text
column.value: And He has lifted up a horn for His people, Praise for all His godly ones, For the sons of Israel, a people near to Him. ①Praise ②the LORD! ▷ ①Or Hallelujah! ②Heb YAH

column.name: text
column.value: ①Praise ②the LORD! For it is good to sing praises to our God; For ③it is pleasant and praise is ④beautiful. ▷ ①Or Hallelujah! ②Heb YAH ③Or He is delightful ④Or fitting

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD builds up Jerusalem; He gathers the outcasts of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: He heals the brokenhearted And binds up their ①wounds. ▷ ①Lit pains

column.name: text
text
text
text
column.value: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; Sing praises to our God on the lyre;

column.name: text
column.value: It is He who covers the heavens with clouds, Who provides rain for the earth, Who makes grass sprout on the mountains.

column.name: text
column.value: It is He who gives an animal its food, And feeds young ravens that cry.

column.name: text
text
column.value: The LORD favors those who fear Him, Those who wait for His ①faithfulness. ▷ ①Or mercy

column.name: text
column.value: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!

column.name: text
column.value: For He has strengthened the bars of your gates; He has blessed your sons among you.

column.name: text
text
column.value: He sends His command to the earth; His word runs very swiftly.

column.name: text
text
column.value: He hurls His ice as fragments; Who can stand before His cold?

column.name: text
column.value: He sends His word and makes them melt; He makes His wind blow, and the waters flow.

column.name: text
column.value: He declares His words to Jacob, His statutes and His judgments to Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: He has not dealt this way with any other nation; And as for His judgments, ①they have not known them. ②Praise ③the LORD! ▷ ①I.e., the other nations ②Or Hallelujah! ③Heb YAH

column.name: text
column.value: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: To know wisdom and instruction, To discern the sayings of understanding,

column.name: text
column.value: To receive instruction in wise behavior, Righteousness, justice, and integrity;

column.name: text
column.value: To give prudence to the naive, To the youth knowledge and discretion,

column.name: text
column.value: A wise person will hear and increase in learning, And a person of understanding will acquire wise counsel,

column.name: text
column.value: To understand a proverb and a saying, The words of the wise and their riddles.

column.name: text
column.value: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge; Fools despise wisdom and instruction.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen, my son, to your father’s instruction, And do not ignore your mother’s teaching;

column.name: text
column.value: For they are a graceful wreath for your head And necklaces for your neck.

column.name: text
column.value: My son, if sinners entice you, Do not consent.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Let’s swallow them alive like Sheol, Even whole, like those who go down to the pit;

column.name: text
column.value: We will find all kinds of precious wealth, We will fill our houses with plunder;

column.name: text
text
column.value: My son, do not walk on the way with them. Keep your feet from their path,

column.name: text
column.value: For their feet run to evil, And they are quick to shed blood.

column.name: text
text
column.value: But they lie in wait for their own blood; They ambush their own lives.

column.name: text
column.value: Such are the ways of everyone who makes unjust gain; It takes away the life of its possessors.

column.name: text
text
column.value: At the head of the noisy streets she cries out; At the entrance of the gates in the city she declares her sayings:

column.name: text
column.value: “How long, you naive ones, will you love simplistic thinking? And how long will scoffers delight themselves in scoffing And fools hate knowledge?

column.name: text
text
column.value: Because I called and you refused, I stretched out my hand and no one paid attention;

column.name: text
column.value: And you neglected all my advice And did not want my rebuke;

column.name: text
column.value: I will also laugh at your disaster; I will mock when your dread comes,

column.name: text
column.value: When your dread comes like a storm And your disaster comes like a whirlwind, When distress and anguish come upon you.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer; They will seek me diligently but will not find me,

column.name: text
column.value: Because they hated knowledge And did not choose the fear of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: They did not accept my advice, They disdainfully rejected every rebuke from me.

column.name: text
column.value: So they shall eat of the fruit of their own way, And be filled with their own schemes.

column.name: text
column.value: For the faithlessness of the naive will kill them, And the complacency of fools will destroy them.

column.name: text
column.value: But whoever listens to me will live securely And will be at ease from the dread of evil.”

column.name: text
column.value: ①Praise ②the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul! ▷ ①Or Hallelujah! ②Heb YAH

column.name: text
text
column.value: Do not trust in noblemen, In ①mortal man, in whom there is no salvation. ▷ ①Lit a son of man

column.name: text
text
column.value: Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, Whose hope is in the LORD his God,

column.name: text
text
text
text
column.value: The LORD watches over strangers; He ①supports the fatherless and the widow, But He ②thwarts the way of the wicked. ▷ ①Or relieves ②Lit bends

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will reign forever, Your God, Zion, to all generations. ①Praise ②the LORD! ▷ ①Or Hallelujah! ②Heb YAH

column.name: text
column.value: My son, if you will receive my words And treasure my commandments within you,

column.name: text
column.value: Make your ear attentive to wisdom; Incline your heart to understanding.

column.name: text
text
column.value: If you seek her as silver And search for her as for hidden treasures;

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will understand the fear of the LORD, And discover the knowledge of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD gives wisdom; From His mouth come knowledge and understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: He stores up sound wisdom for the upright; He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,

column.name: text
column.value: Guarding the paths of justice, And He watches over the way of His godly ones.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will discern righteousness, justice, And integrity, and every good path.

column.name: text
column.value: For wisdom will enter your heart, And knowledge will be delightful to your soul;

column.name: text
column.value: Discretion will watch over you, Understanding will guard you,

column.name: text
column.value: To rescue you from the way of evil, From a person who speaks perverse things;

column.name: text
column.value: From those who leave the paths of uprightness To walk in the ways of darkness;

column.name: text
column.value: Who delight in doing evil And rejoice in the perversity of evil;

column.name: text
column.value: Whose paths are crooked, And who are devious in their ways;

column.name: text
column.value: To rescue you from the strange woman, From the foreign woman who flatters with her words,

column.name: text
column.value: Who leaves the companion of her youth And forgets the covenant of her God;

column.name: text
text
column.value: None who go to her return, Nor do they reach the paths of life.

column.name: text
column.value: So you will walk in the way of good people And keep to the paths of the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: For the upright will live in the land, And the blameless will remain in it;

column.name: text
column.value: But the wicked will be eliminated from the land, And the treacherous will be torn away from it.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Praise ②the LORD! Praise God in His sanctuary; Praise Him in His mighty ③expanse. ▷ ①Or Hallelujah! ②Heb YAH ③Or firmament; i.e., atmosphere and space

column.name: text
column.value: Praise Him for His mighty deeds; Praise Him according to His excellent greatness.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise Him with trumpet sound; Praise Him with harp and lyre.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; Praise Him with stringed instruments and flute.

column.name: text
column.value: Praise Him with loud cymbals; Praise Him with resounding cymbals.

column.name: text
column.value: Everything that has breath shall praise ①the LORD. ②Praise ③the LORD! ▷ ①Heb YAH ②Or Hallelujah! ③Heb YAH

column.name: text
text
column.value: For length of days and years of life And peace they will add to you.

column.name: text
text
column.value: So you will find favor and a good ①reputation In the sight of God and man. ▷ ①Lit understanding

column.name: text
column.value: Trust in the LORD with all your heart And do not lean on your own understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: In all your ways acknowledge Him, And He will make your paths straight.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be wise in your own eyes; Fear the LORD and turn away from evil.

column.name: text
column.value: It will be healing to your ①body And refreshment to your bones. ▷ ①Lit navel

column.name: text
column.value: Honor the LORD from your wealth, And from the first of all your produce;

column.name: text
column.value: Then your barns will be filled with plenty, And your vats will overflow with new wine.

column.name: text
column.value: My son, do not reject the ①discipline of the LORD Or loathe His rebuke, ▷ ①Or instruction

column.name: text
column.value: For whom the LORD loves He disciplines, Just as a father disciplines the son in whom he delights.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is a person who finds wisdom, And one who obtains understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: For ①her profit is better than the profit of silver, And her produce better than gold. ▷ ①I.e., the profit from Wisdom (personified)

column.name: text
column.value: She is more precious than ①jewels, And nothing you desire compares with her. ▷ ①Lit corals

column.name: text
text
column.value: Her ways are pleasant ways, And all her paths are peace.

column.name: text
column.value: She is a tree of life to those who take hold of her, And happy are those who hold on to her.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD founded the earth by wisdom, He established the heavens by understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: By His knowledge the ocean depths were burst open, And the clouds drip with dew.

column.name: text
column.value: My son, see that they do not escape from your sight; Comply with sound wisdom and discretion,

column.name: text
column.value: And they will be life to your soul And adornment to your neck.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will walk in your way securely, And your foot will not stumble.

column.name: text
column.value: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; When you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be afraid of sudden danger, Nor of trouble from the wicked when it comes;

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD will be ①your confidence, And will keep your foot from being caught. ▷ ①Or at your side

column.name: text
column.value: Do not withhold good from ①those to whom it is due, When it is in your power to do it. ▷ ①Lit its owners

column.name: text
column.value: Do not say to your neighbor, “Go, and come back, And tomorrow I will give it to you,” When you have it with you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not devise harm against your neighbor, While he lives securely beside you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not contend with a person for no reason, If he has done you no harm.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not envy a violent person, And do not choose any of his ways.

column.name: text
text
column.value: The curse of the LORD is on the house of the wicked, But He blesses the home of the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: Though He scoffs at the scoffers, Yet He gives grace to the needy.

column.name: text
column.value: The wise will inherit honor, But fools ①increase dishonor. ▷ ①Lit raise high

column.name: text
column.value: Listen, my sons, to the instruction of a father, And pay attention so that you may ①gain understanding, ▷ ①Lit know

column.name: text
text
column.value: When I was a son to my father, Tender and the only son in the sight of my mother,

column.name: text
text
column.value: Acquire wisdom! Acquire understanding! Do not forget nor turn away from the words of my mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not abandon her, and she will guard you; Love her, and she will watch over you.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Prize her, and she will exalt you; She will honor you if you embrace her.

column.name: text
column.value: She will place on your head a garland of grace; She will present you with a crown of beauty.”

column.name: text
column.value: Listen, my son, and accept my sayings, And the years of your life will be many.

column.name: text
column.value: I have instructed you in the way of wisdom; I have led you in upright paths.

column.name: text
column.value: When you walk, your steps will not be hampered; And if you run, you will not stumble.

column.name: text
column.value: Take hold of instruction; do not let go. Guard her, for she is your life.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not enter the path of the wicked And do not proceed in the way of evil people.

column.name: text
column.value: Avoid it, do not pass by it; Turn away from it and pass on.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For they eat the bread of wickedness, And drink the wine of violence.

column.name: text
column.value: But the path of the righteous is like the light of dawn That shines brighter and brighter until the full day.

column.name: text
text
column.value: My son, pay attention to my words; Incline your ear to my sayings.

column.name: text
column.value: They are not to escape from your sight; Keep them in the midst of your heart.

column.name: text
column.value: For they are life to those who find them, And healing to all ①their body. ▷ ①Lit his

column.name: text
column.value: Watch over your heart with all diligence, For from it flow the springs of life.

column.name: text
column.value: Rid yourself of a deceitful mouth And keep devious ①speech far from you. ▷ ①Or lips

column.name: text
column.value: Let your eyes look directly ahead And let your ①gaze be fixed straight in front of you. ▷ ①Or eyelids

column.name: text
column.value: ①Watch the path of your feet, And all your ways will be established. ▷ ①I.e., prob. stay on the path

column.name: text
column.value: Do not turn to the right or to the left; Turn your foot from evil.

column.name: text
column.value: My son, if you have become a guarantor for your neighbor, Or have given a handshake for a stranger,

column.name: text
column.value: If you have been ensnared by the words of your mouth, Or caught by the words of your mouth,

column.name: text
column.value: Then do this, my son, and save yourself: Since you have come into the ①hand of your neighbor, Go, humble yourself, and be urgent with your neighbor to free yourself. ▷ ①Lit palm

column.name: text
column.value: Give no sleep to your eyes, Nor slumber to your eyelids;

column.name: text
column.value: Save yourself like a gazelle from the hunter’s hand, And like a bird from the hand of the fowler.

column.name: text
column.value: Go to the ant, you ①lazy one, Observe its ways and be wise, ▷ ①Lit idle one

column.name: text
column.value: Which, having no chief, Officer, or ruler,

column.name: text
column.value: Prepares its food in the summer And gathers its provision in the harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: How long will you lie down, you ①lazy one? When will you arise from your sleep? ▷ ①Lit idle one

column.name: text
