column.value: “A little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to ①rest,” ▷ ①Lit lie down

column.name: text
column.value: Then your poverty will come in like a ①drifter, And your need like ②an armed man. ▷ ①Lit one who moves about ②Lit a man with a shield

column.name: text
column.value: A worthless person, a wicked man, Is one who walks with a perverse mouth,

column.name: text
text
column.value: Who, with perversion in his heart, continually devises evil, Who ①spreads strife. ▷ ①Lit sends out

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore his disaster will come suddenly; Instantly he will be broken and there will be no healing.

column.name: text
column.value: There are six things that the LORD hates, Seven that are an abomination ①to Him: ▷ ①Lit of His soul

column.name: text
column.value: Haughty eyes, a lying tongue, And hands that shed innocent blood,

column.name: text
column.value: A heart that devises wicked plans, Feet that run rapidly to evil,

column.name: text
column.value: A false witness who declares lies, And one who ①spreads strife among brothers. ▷ ①Lit sends out

column.name: text
text
column.value: Bind them continually on your heart; Tie them around your neck.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: To keep you from the evil woman, From the smooth tongue of the foreign woman.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not desire her beauty in your heart, Nor let her capture you with her eyelids.

column.name: text
column.value: For the price of a prostitute reduces one to a loaf of bread, And ①an adulteress hunts for a precious life. ▷ ①Lit a man’s wife

column.name: text
column.value: Can anyone take fire in his lap And his clothes not be burned?

column.name: text
column.value: Or can a person walk on hot coals And his feet not be scorched?

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: But when he is found, he must repay seven times as much; He must give up all the property of his house.

column.name: text
text
column.value: He will find wounds and disgrace, And his shame will not be removed.

column.name: text
column.value: For jealousy ①enrages a man, And he will not have compassion on the day of vengeance. ▷ ①Lit is the rage of

column.name: text
column.value: He will not ①accept any settlement, Nor will he be ②satisfied though you make it a large gift. ▷ ①Lit lift up the face of any ②Lit willing

column.name: text
column.value: My son, pay attention to my wisdom, Incline your ear to my understanding,

column.name: text
column.value: So that you may maintain discretion And your lips may comply with knowledge.

column.name: text
text
column.value: But in the end she is bitter as wormwood, Sharp as a two-edged sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Her feet go down to death, Her steps take hold of Sheol.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Now then, my sons, listen to me And do not turn away from the words of my mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep your way far from her, And do not go near the door of her house,

column.name: text
column.value: Otherwise you will give your vigor to others, And your years to the cruel one;

column.name: text
column.value: And strangers will be filled with your strength, And your hard-earned possessions will go to the house of a foreigner;

column.name: text
text
column.value: And you say, “How I hated instruction! And my heart disdainfully rejected rebuke!

column.name: text
column.value: I did not listen to the voice of my teachers, Nor incline my ear to my instructors!

column.name: text
column.value: I was almost in total ruin In the midst of the assembly and congregation.”

column.name: text
column.value: Drink water from your own cistern, And ①fresh water from your own well. ▷ ①Lit flowing

column.name: text
column.value: Should your springs overflow into the street, Streams of water in the public squares?

column.name: text
column.value: Let them be yours alone, And not for strangers with you.

column.name: text
column.value: Let your fountain be blessed, And rejoice in the wife of your youth.

column.name: text
column.value: Like a loving doe and a graceful mountain goat, Let her breasts satisfy you at all times; Be ①exhilarated always with her love. ▷ ①Lit intoxicated

column.name: text
column.value: For why should you, my son, be exhilarated with an ①adulteress, And embrace the breasts of a foreigner? ▷ ①Lit strange woman

column.name: text
column.value: For the ways of everyone are before the eyes of the LORD, And He observes all his paths.

column.name: text
column.value: His own wrongdoings will trap the wicked, And he will be held by the ropes of his sin.

column.name: text
column.value: He will die for lack of instruction, And in the greatness of his foolishness he will go astray.

column.name: text
column.value: My son, keep my words And treasure my commandments within you.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep my commandments and live, And my ①teaching as the ②apple of your eye. ▷ ①Or law ②Lit pupil

column.name: text
column.value: Bind them on your fingers; Write them on the tablet of your heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to wisdom, “You are my sister,” And call understanding your intimate friend,

column.name: text
column.value: So that they may keep you from an ①adulteress, From the foreigner who flatters with her words. ▷ ①Lit strange woman

column.name: text
column.value: For at the window of my house I looked out through my lattice,

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw among the naive, And discerned among the ①youths A young man lacking ②sense, ▷ ①Lit sons ②Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: Passing through the street near her corner; And he walks along the way to her house,

column.name: text
column.value: In the twilight, in the ①evening, In the ②middle of the night and the darkness. ▷ ①Lit evening of the day ②Lit pupil (of the eye)

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, a woman comes to meet him, Dressed as a prostitute and cunning of heart.

column.name: text
column.value: She is boisterous and rebellious, Her feet do not remain at home;

column.name: text
column.value: She is now in the streets, now in the public squares, And lurks by every corner.

column.name: text
column.value: So she seizes him and kisses him, ①And with a brazen face she says to him: ▷ ①Lit She makes bold her face and says

column.name: text
text
column.value: Therefore I have come out to meet you, To seek your presence diligently, and I have found you.

column.name: text
column.value: I have spread my couch with coverings, With colored linens of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: I have sprinkled my bed With myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

column.name: text
column.value: Come, let’s drink our fill of love until morning; Let’s delight ourselves with caresses.

column.name: text
text
column.value: He has taken a bag of money ①with him. At the full moon he will come home.” ▷ ①Lit in his hand

column.name: text
text
column.value: Suddenly he follows her As an ox goes to the slaughter, Or as ①one walks in ankle bracelets to the discipline of a fool, ▷ ①Or as a stag goes into a trap; as in some ancient versions, Heb is uncertain

column.name: text
text
column.value: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, And pay attention to the words of my mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways, Do not stray into her paths.

column.name: text
column.value: For many are the ①victims she has brought to ruin, And numerous are all those slaughtered by her. ▷ ①Lit wounded

column.name: text
column.value: Her house is the way to Sheol, Descending to the chambers of death.

column.name: text
column.value: Wisdom has built her house, She has carved out her seven pillars;

column.name: text
text
column.value: She has sent out her attendants, she calls out From the tops of the heights of the city:

column.name: text
column.value: “Whoever is naive, let him turn in here!” To him who lacks ①understanding she says, ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: “Come, eat of my food And drink of the wine I have mixed.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Abandon your foolishness and live, And proceed in the way of understanding.” ▷ ①Or Abandon the naive

column.name: text
column.value: One who corrects a scoffer gets dishonor for himself, And one who rebukes a wicked person gets ①insults for himself. ▷ ①Lit a blemish

column.name: text
column.value: Do not rebuke a scoffer, or he will hate you; Rebuke a wise person and he will love you.

column.name: text
column.value: Give instruction to a wise person and he will become still wiser; Teach a righteous person and he will increase his insight.

column.name: text
column.value: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, And the knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: For by me your days will be multiplied, And years of life will be added to you.

column.name: text
column.value: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself, And if you scoff, you alone will ①suffer from it. ▷ ①Lit bear

column.name: text
column.value: ①A woman of foolishness is boisterous, She has a lack of understanding and knows nothing. ▷ ①Or A foolish woman

column.name: text
column.value: She sits at the doorway of her house, On a seat by the high places of the city,

column.name: text
column.value: Calling to those who pass by, Who are going straight on their paths:

column.name: text
column.value: “Whoever is naive, let him turn in here,” And to him who lacks ①understanding she says, ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: “Stolen water is sweet; And bread eaten in secret is pleasant.”

column.name: text
column.value: But he does not know that the ①dead are there, That her guests are in the depths of Sheol. ▷ ①Lit departed spirits

column.name: text
column.value: Does not wisdom call, And understanding ①raise her voice? ▷ ①Lit give

column.name: text
column.value: On top of the heights beside the way, Where the paths meet, she takes her stand;

column.name: text
column.value: Beside the gates, at the opening to the city, At the entrance of the doors, she cries out:

column.name: text
column.value: “To you, people, I call, And my voice is to ①mankind. ▷ ①Lit sons of mankind

column.name: text
text
column.value: Listen, for I will speak noble things; And the opening of my lips will reveal right things.

column.name: text
column.value: For my mouth will proclaim truth; And wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

column.name: text
column.value: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; There is nothing crooked or perverted in them.

column.name: text
column.value: They are all straightforward to him who understands, And right to those who find knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: Accept my instruction and not silver, And knowledge rather than choice gold.

column.name: text
text
column.value: “I, wisdom, dwell with prudence, And I find knowledge and discretion.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Advice is mine and sound wisdom; I am understanding, power is mine.

column.name: text
column.value: By me kings reign, And rulers decree justice.

column.name: text
column.value: By me princes rule, and nobles, All who judge rightly.

column.name: text
column.value: I love those who love me; And those who diligently seek me will find me.

column.name: text
column.value: Riches and honor are with me, Enduring wealth and righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: My fruit is better than gold, even pure gold; And my yield better than choice silver.

column.name: text
column.value: I walk in the way of righteousness, In the midst of the paths of justice,

column.name: text
column.value: To endow those who love me with wealth, That I may fill their treasuries.

column.name: text
column.value: “The LORD ①created me at the beginning of His way, Before His works ②of old. ▷ ①Or possessed ②Lit from then

column.name: text
column.value: From eternity I was ①established, From the beginning, from the earliest times of the earth. ▷ ①Or consecrated

column.name: text
column.value: When there were no ocean depths, I was born, When there were no springs abounding with water.

column.name: text
column.value: Before the mountains were settled, Before the hills, I was born;

column.name: text
column.value: While He had not yet made the earth and the ①fields, Nor the first dust of the world. ▷ ①Lit outside places

column.name: text
column.value: When He established the heavens, I was there; When He inscribed a circle on the face of the deep,

column.name: text
column.value: When He made firm the skies above, When the springs of the deep became ①fixed, ▷ ①Lit strong

column.name: text
column.value: When He set a boundary for the sea So that the water would not violate His ①command, When He marked out the foundations of the earth; ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Then I was beside Him, as a master workman; And I was His delight daily, ①Rejoicing always before Him, ▷ ①Or Playing

column.name: text
column.value: ①Rejoicing in the world, His earth, And having my delight in the sons of mankind. ▷ ①Or Playing

column.name: text
column.value: “Now then, sons, listen to me, For blessed are those who keep my ways.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen to instruction and be wise, And do not neglect it.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is the person who listens to me, Watching daily at my gates, Waiting at my doorposts.

column.name: text
column.value: For one who finds me finds life, And obtains favor from the LORD.

column.name: text
text
column.value: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a father glad, But a foolish son is a grief to his mother.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Ill-gotten gains do not benefit, But righteousness rescues from death. ▷ ①Lit Treasures of wickedness

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will not allow the ①righteous to hunger, But He will ②reject the craving of the wicked. ▷ ①Lit soul of the righteous ②Lit thrust away

column.name: text
column.value: Poor is one who works with ①a lazy hand, But the hand of the diligent makes rich. ▷ ①Lit an idle hand

column.name: text
column.value: He who gathers in summer is a son who acts wisely, But he who sleeps in harvest is a son who acts shamefully.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, But the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.

column.name: text
column.value: The mentioning of the righteous is a blessing, But the name of the wicked will rot.

column.name: text
column.value: The wise of heart will receive commands, But ①a babbling fool will come to ruin. ▷ ①Lit the foolish of lips

column.name: text
column.value: One who walks in integrity walks securely, But one who perverts his ways will be found out.

column.name: text
column.value: He who winks the eye causes trouble, And ①a babbling fool will come to ruin. ▷ ①Lit the foolish of lips

column.name: text
column.value: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, But the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.

column.name: text
column.value: Hatred stirs up strife, But love covers all offenses.

column.name: text
column.value: On the lips of the discerning, wisdom is found, But a rod is for the back of him who has no ①sense. ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: Wise people store up knowledge, But with the mouth of the foolish, ruin is at hand.

column.name: text
column.value: The rich person’s wealth is his ①fortress, The ruin of the poor is their poverty. ▷ ①Lit strong city

column.name: text
column.value: The ①wages of the righteous is life, The income of the wicked, punishment. ▷ ①Or work

column.name: text
column.value: One who is on the path of life follows instruction, But one who ignores a rebuke goes astray.

column.name: text
column.value: One who conceals hatred has lying lips, And one who spreads slander is a fool.

column.name: text
column.value: When there are many words, wrongdoing is unavoidable, But one who restrains his lips is wise.

column.name: text
column.value: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver, The heart of the wicked is worth little.

column.name: text
column.value: The lips of the righteous feed many, But fools die for lack of ①understanding. ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: It is the blessing of the LORD that makes rich, And He adds no sorrow to it.

column.name: text
column.value: Doing wickedness is like sport to a fool, And so is wisdom to a person of understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: What the wicked fears will come upon him, But the desire of the righteous will be granted.

column.name: text
column.value: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more, But the righteous has an everlasting foundation.

column.name: text
column.value: Like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, So is the ①lazy one to those who send him. ▷ ①Lit idle one

column.name: text
column.value: The fear of the LORD prolongs ①life, But the years of the wicked will be shortened. ▷ ①Lit days

column.name: text
column.value: The hope of the righteous is gladness, But the expectation of the wicked perishes.

column.name: text
column.value: The way of the LORD is a stronghold for the upright, But ruin to the workers of injustice.

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous will never be shaken, But the wicked will not live in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: The mouth of the righteous flows with wisdom, But the perverted tongue will be cut out.

column.name: text
column.value: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, But the mouth of the wicked, what is perverted.

column.name: text
column.value: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, But a just weight is His delight.

column.name: text
column.value: When pride comes, then comes dishonor; But with the humble there is wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: The integrity of the upright will guide them, But the perversity of the treacherous will destroy them.

column.name: text
column.value: Riches do not benefit on the day of wrath, But righteousness rescues from death.

column.name: text
column.value: The righteousness of the blameless will smooth his way, But the wicked will fall by his own wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: The righteousness of the upright will rescue them, But the treacherous will be caught by their own greed.

column.name: text
column.value: When a wicked person dies, his expectation will perish, And the hope of strong people perishes.

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous is rescued from trouble, But the wicked ①takes his place. ▷ ①Lit enters

column.name: text
column.value: With his mouth the godless person destroys his neighbor, But through knowledge the righteous will be rescued.

column.name: text
column.value: When things go well for the righteous, the city rejoices, And when the wicked perish, there is joyful shouting.

column.name: text
column.value: By the blessing of the upright a city is exalted, But by the mouth of the wicked, it is torn down.

column.name: text
column.value: One who despises his neighbor lacks ①sense, But a person of understanding keeps silent. ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: One who goes about as a slanderer reveals secrets, But one who is ①trustworthy conceals a matter. ▷ ①Lit faithful of spirit

column.name: text
column.value: Where there is no guidance the people fall, But in an abundance of counselors there is ①victory. ▷ ①Lit deliverance

column.name: text
column.value: One who is a guarantor for a stranger will certainly suffer for it, But one who hates ①being a guarantor is secure. ▷ ①Lit those who strike hands

column.name: text
column.value: A gracious woman attains honor, And ruthless men attain riches.

column.name: text
column.value: A merciful person does ①himself good, But the cruel person ②does himself harm. ▷ ①Lit his soul ②Lit ruins his flesh

column.name: text
column.value: A wicked person earns deceptive wages, But one who sows righteousness gets a true reward.

column.name: text
column.value: One who is steadfast in righteousness attains life, But one who pursues evil attains his own death.

column.name: text
column.value: The perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, But the blameless in their ①walk are His delight. ▷ ①Lit way

column.name: text
column.value: ①Be assured, the evil person will not go unpunished, But the ②descendants of the righteous will be rescued. ▷ ①Lit Hand to hand ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: As a ring of gold in a pig’s snout So is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

column.name: text
column.value: The desire of the righteous is only good, But the expectation of the wicked is wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: There is one who scatters, and yet increases all the more, And there is one who withholds what is justly due, and yet it results only in poverty.

column.name: text
column.value: A ①generous person will be ②prosperous, And one who gives others plenty of water will himself be given plenty. ▷ ①Lit soul of blessing ②Lit made fat

column.name: text
column.value: One who withholds grain, the people will curse him, But blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.

column.name: text
column.value: One who diligently seeks good seeks favor, But one who seeks evil, evil will come to him.

column.name: text
column.value: One who trusts in his riches will fall, But the righteous will flourish like the green leaf.

column.name: text
column.value: One who troubles his own house will inherit wind, And the foolish will be servant to the wise-hearted.

column.name: text
column.value: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, And one who is wise ①gains souls. ▷ ①Lit takes

column.name: text
column.value: If the righteous will be repaid on the earth, How much more the wicked and the sinner!

column.name: text
column.value: A wise son accepts his father’s discipline, But a scoffer does not listen to rebuke.

column.name: text
column.value: From the fruit of a person’s mouth he ①enjoys good, But the ②desire of the treacherous is violence. ▷ ①Lit eats ②Lit soul

column.name: text
text
column.value: The soul of the ①lazy one craves and gets nothing, But the soul of the diligent is made ②prosperous. ▷ ①Lit idle ②Lit fat

column.name: text
column.value: A righteous person hates a false statement, But a wicked person ①acts disgustingly and shamefully. ▷ ①Lit causes a bad odor and causes shame

column.name: text
column.value: Righteousness guards the ①one whose way is blameless, But wickedness brings the ②sinner to ruin. ▷ ①Lit blamelessness of way ②Lit sin

column.name: text
column.value: There is one who pretends to be rich but has nothing; Another pretends to be poor, but has great wealth.

column.name: text
column.value: The ransom of a person’s life is his wealth, But the poor hears no rebuke.

column.name: text
column.value: The light of the righteous ①rejoices, But the lamp of the wicked goes out. ▷ ①I.e., shines brightly

column.name: text
column.value: Through overconfidence ①comes nothing but strife, But wisdom is with those who receive counsel. ▷ ①Lit gives

column.name: text
column.value: Wealth obtained from ①nothing dwindles, But one who gathers ②by labor increases it. ▷ ①Prob. referring to fraud ②Lit by hand

column.name: text
column.value: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, But desire ①fulfilled is a tree of life. ▷ ①Lit coming

column.name: text
column.value: One who despises the word will do badly, But one who fears the commandment will be rewarded.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, To turn aside from the snares of death. ▷ ①Or law

column.name: text
column.value: Good understanding produces favor, But the way of the treacherous is ①their own disaster. ▷ ①Cf. LXX in destruction; MT constant

column.name: text
column.value: Every prudent person acts with knowledge, But a fool ①displays foolishness. ▷ ①Lit spreads out

column.name: text
column.value: A wicked messenger falls into adversity, But a faithful messenger brings healing.

column.name: text
column.value: Poverty and shame will come to one who neglects ①discipline, But one who complies with rebuke will be honored. ▷ ①Or instruction

column.name: text
column.value: Desire realized is sweet to the soul, But it is an abomination to fools to turn away from evil.

column.name: text
column.value: One who walks with wise people will be wise, But a companion of fools will suffer harm.

column.name: text
column.value: Adversity pursues sinners, But the righteous will be rewarded with prosperity.

column.name: text
column.value: A good person leaves an inheritance to his ①grandchildren, And the wealth of a sinner is stored up for the righteous. ▷ ①Lit sons’ sons

column.name: text
column.value: Abundant food is in the uncultivated ground of the poor, But ①it is swept away by injustice. ▷ ①Lit there is what is swept

column.name: text
column.value: He who withholds his ①rod hates his son, But he who loves him ②disciplines him diligently. ▷ ①I.e., correction or discipline ②Lit seeks him diligently with discipline

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous ①has enough to satisfy his appetite, But the stomach of the wicked is in need. ▷ ①Lit eats to the satisfaction of his soul

column.name: text
column.value: The wise woman builds her house, But the foolish tears it down with her own hands.

column.name: text
column.value: One who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, But one who is devious in his ways despises Him.

column.name: text
column.value: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod for his back, But the lips of the wise will protect them.

column.name: text
column.value: Where there are no oxen, the manger is clean; But much revenue comes by the strength of the ox.

column.name: text
column.value: A trustworthy witness will not lie, But a false witness declares lies.

column.name: text
column.value: A scoffer seeks wisdom and finds none, But knowledge is easy for one who has understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: Leave the presence of a fool, Or you will not ①discern ②words of knowledge. ▷ ①Lit know ②Lit lips

column.name: text
column.value: The wisdom of the sensible is to understand his way, But the foolishness of fools is deceit.

column.name: text
column.value: Fools mock at ①sin, But among the upright there is ②goodwill. ▷ ①Lit guilt ②Or the favor of God

column.name: text
column.value: The heart knows its own bitterness, And a stranger does not share its joy.

column.name: text
column.value: The house of the wicked will be destroyed, But the tent of the upright will flourish.

column.name: text
column.value: There is a way which seems right to a person, But its end is the way of death.

column.name: text
column.value: Even in laughter the heart may be in pain, And the end of joy may be grief.

column.name: text
column.value: One with a wayward heart will have his fill of his own ways, But a good person will be satisfied ①with his. ▷ ①Lit from himself

column.name: text
column.value: The naive believes everything, But the sensible person considers his steps.

column.name: text
column.value: A wise person ①is cautious and turns away from evil, But a fool is arrogant and careless. ▷ ①Lit fears

column.name: text
column.value: A quick-tempered person acts foolishly, And a person of evil devices is hated.

column.name: text
column.value: The naive inherit foolishness, But the sensible are crowned with knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: The evil will bow down before the good, And the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: The poor is hated even by his neighbor, But those who love the rich are many.

column.name: text
column.value: One who despises his neighbor sins, But one who is gracious to the ①poor is blessed. ▷ ①Or afflicted

column.name: text
column.value: Will they who devise evil not go astray? But kindness and truth will be to those who devise good.

column.name: text
column.value: In all labor there is profit, But ①mere talk leads only to poverty. ▷ ①Lit word of lips

column.name: text
column.value: The crown of the wise is their riches, But the foolishness of fools is simply foolishness.

column.name: text
column.value: A truthful witness saves lives, But one who declares lies is ①deceitful. ▷ ①Lit a fraud

column.name: text
column.value: In ①the fear of the LORD there is strong confidence, And ②his children will have refuge. ▷ ①Or reverence for ②Or His

column.name: text
column.value: ①The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, By which one may avoid the snares of death. ▷ ①Or Reverence for

column.name: text
column.value: In a multitude of people is a king’s glory, But in the scarcity of people is a prince’s ruin.

column.name: text
text
column.value: A tranquil heart is life to the body, But jealousy is rottenness to the bones.

column.name: text
column.value: One who oppresses the poor taunts his Maker, But one who is gracious to the needy honors Him.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked is thrust down by his own wrongdoing, But the righteous has a refuge when he dies.

column.name: text
column.value: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, But among fools it is made known.

column.name: text
column.value: Righteousness exalts a nation, But sin is a disgrace to any people.

column.name: text
column.value: The king’s favor is toward a servant who acts wisely, But his anger is toward him who acts shamefully.

column.name: text
column.value: A gentle answer turns away wrath, But a ①harsh word stirs up anger. ▷ ①Lit painful

column.name: text
column.value: The tongue of the wise makes knowledge pleasant, But the mouth of fools spouts foolishness.

column.name: text
column.value: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, Watching the evil and the good.

column.name: text
column.value: A ①soothing tongue is a tree of life, But perversion in it ②crushes the spirit. ▷ ①Lit healing ②Lit is the crushing of the spirit

column.name: text
column.value: A fool ①rejects his father’s discipline, But he who complies with rebuke is sensible. ▷ ①Or despises

column.name: text
column.value: Great wealth is in the house of the righteous, But trouble is in the income of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: The lips of the wise spread knowledge, But the hearts of fools are not so.

column.name: text
column.value: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, But the prayer of the upright is His delight.

column.name: text
column.value: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, But He loves the one who pursues righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: There is severe punishment for one who abandons the way; One who hates a rebuke will die.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Sheol and ②Abaddon lie open before the LORD, How much more the hearts of ③mankind! ▷ ①I.e., The netherworld ②I.e., place of destruction ③Lit sons of mankind

column.name: text
column.value: A scoffer does not love one who rebukes him; He will not go to the wise.

column.name: text
column.value: A joyful heart makes a ①cheerful face, But ②when the heart is sad, the spirit is broken. ▷ ①Lit good ②Lit in sadness of heart

column.name: text
column.value: The mind of the intelligent seeks knowledge, But the mouth of fools feeds on foolishness.

column.name: text
column.value: All the days of the ①needy are bad, But a ②cheerful heart has a continual feast. ▷ ①Or wretched ②Lit good

column.name: text
column.value: Better is a little with ①the fear of the LORD Than great treasure, and turmoil with ②the treasure. ▷ ①Or reverence for ②Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: Better is a portion of ①vegetables where there is love, Than a fattened ox served with hatred. ▷ ①Or herbs

column.name: text
column.value: A hot-tempered person stirs up strife, But the slow to anger calms a dispute.

column.name: text
column.value: The way of the ①lazy one is like a hedge of thorns, But the path of the upright is a highway. ▷ ①Lit idle

column.name: text
column.value: A wise son makes a father glad, But a foolish man despises his mother.

column.name: text
column.value: Foolishness is joy to one who lacks ①sense, But a person of understanding walks straight. ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: Without consultation, plans are frustrated, But with many counselors they ①succeed. ▷ ①Or are established

column.name: text
column.value: A person has joy in an ①apt answer, And how delightful is a timely word! ▷ ①Lit answer of his mouth

column.name: text
column.value: The path of life leads upward for the wise, So that he may keep away from ①Sheol below. ▷ ①I.e., the netherworld

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will tear down the house of the proud, But He will set the boundary of the widow.

column.name: text
column.value: Evil plans are an abomination to the LORD, But pleasant words are pure.

column.name: text
column.value: He who profits illicitly troubles his own house, But he who hates bribes will live.

column.name: text
column.value: The heart of the righteous ponders how to answer, But the mouth of the wicked pours out evil things.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is far from the wicked, But He hears the prayer of the righteous.

column.name: text
text
column.value: One whose ear listens to a life-giving rebuke Will stay among the wise.

column.name: text
column.value: One who neglects discipline rejects himself, But one who listens to a rebuke acquires ①understanding. ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: ①The fear of the LORD is the instruction for wisdom, And before honor comes humility. ▷ ①Or Reverence for

column.name: text
column.value: The plans of the heart belong to a person, But the answer of the tongue is from the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: All the ways of a person are clean in his own sight, But the LORD examines the ①motives. ▷ ①Lit spirits

column.name: text
column.value: ①Commit your works to the LORD, And your plans will be established. ▷ ①Lit Roll

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has made everything for ①its own purpose, Even the wicked for the day of evil. ▷ ①Or His

column.name: text
text
column.value: By mercy and truth atonement is made for wrongdoing, And by ①the fear of the LORD one keeps away from evil. ▷ ①Or reverence for

column.name: text
column.value: When a person’s ways are pleasing to the LORD, He causes even his enemies to make peace with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Better is a little with righteousness Than great income with injustice.

column.name: text
column.value: The mind of a person plans his way, But the LORD directs his steps.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: It is an abomination for kings to commit wicked acts, Because a throne is established on righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: Righteous lips are the delight of kings, And one who speaks right is loved.

column.name: text
column.value: The fury of a king is like messengers of death; But a wise person will appease it.

column.name: text
column.value: In the light of a king’s face is life, And his favor is like a cloud with the ①spring rain. ▷ ①Lit latter

column.name: text
column.value: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! And to get understanding is to be chosen above silver.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Pride goes before destruction, And a haughty spirit before stumbling.

column.name: text
column.value: It is better to be humble in spirit with the needy Than to divide the spoils with the proud.

column.name: text
column.value: One who pays attention to the word will find good, And blessed is one who trusts in the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The wise in heart will be called understanding, And sweetness of ①speech increases ②persuasiveness. ▷ ①Lit lips ②Or learning

column.name: text
column.value: Understanding is a fountain of life to those who have it, But the discipline of fools is foolishness.

column.name: text
column.value: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth And adds ①persuasiveness to his lips. ▷ ①Or learning

column.name: text
column.value: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, Sweet to the soul and healing to the bones.

column.name: text
column.value: There is a way which seems right to a person, But its end is the way of death.

column.name: text
column.value: A worker’s appetite works for him, For his ①hunger urges him on. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: A worthless person digs up evil, While ①his words are like scorching fire. ▷ ①Lit on his lips

column.name: text
column.value: A perverse person spreads strife, And a ①slanderer separates close friends. ▷ ①Or gossip

column.name: text
column.value: A person of violence entices his neighbor And leads him in a way that is not good.

column.name: text
column.value: He who winks his eyes does so to devise perverse things; He who compresses his lips brings evil to pass.

column.name: text
column.value: A gray head is a crown of glory; It is found in the way of righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty, And one who rules his spirit, than one who captures a city.

column.name: text
column.value: The lot is cast into the lap, But its every decision is from the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: One who loves ①discipline loves knowledge, But one who hates rebuke is stupid. ▷ ①Or instruction

column.name: text
column.value: A good person will obtain favor from the LORD, But He will condemn a person ①who devises evil. ▷ ①Lit of evil devices

column.name: text
column.value: A person will not be established by wickedness, But the root of the righteous will not be moved.

column.name: text
column.value: An ①excellent wife is the crown of her husband, But she who shames him is like rottenness in his bones. ▷ ①Or virtuous

column.name: text
column.value: The thoughts of the righteous are just, But the counsels of the wicked are deceitful.

column.name: text
column.value: The words of the wicked wait in ambush for blood, But the mouth of the upright will rescue them.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked are overthrown and are no more, But the house of the righteous will stand.

column.name: text
column.value: A person will be praised according to his insight, But one of perverse ①mind will be despised. ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: Better is one who is lightly esteemed and has a servant, Than one who honors himself and lacks bread.

column.name: text
column.value: A righteous person has regard for the life of his animal, But even the compassion of the wicked is cruel.

column.name: text
column.value: One who works his land will have plenty of bread, But one who pursues worthless things lacks ①sense. ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked person desires the ①plunder of evil people, But the root of the righteous yields fruit. ▷ ①Lit net (for trapping prey); another reading is mountain stronghold

column.name: text
column.value: ①An evil person is ensnared by the offense of his lips, But the righteous will escape from trouble. ▷ ①Lit In the offense of the lips is an evil snare

column.name: text
column.value: A person will be satisfied with good by the fruit of his ①words, And the deeds of a person’s hands will return to him. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, But a person who listens to advice is wise.

column.name: text
column.value: A fool’s anger is known at once, But a prudent person conceals dishonor.

column.name: text
column.value: One who declares truth tells what is right, But a false witness, deceit.

column.name: text
column.value: There is one who speaks rashly like the thrusts of a sword, But the tongue of the wise brings healing.

column.name: text
column.value: Truthful lips will endure forever, But a lying tongue is only for a moment.

column.name: text
column.value: Deceit is in the heart of those who devise evil, But counselors of peace have joy.

column.name: text
column.value: No harm happens to the righteous, But the wicked are filled with trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD, But those who deal faithfully are His delight.

column.name: text
column.value: A prudent person conceals knowledge, But the heart of fools proclaims foolishness.

column.name: text
column.value: The hand of the diligent will rule, But the ①lazy hand will be put to forced labor. ▷ ①Lit idle

column.name: text
column.value: Anxiety in a person’s heart weighs it down, But a good word makes it glad.

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous person is a guide to his neighbor, But the way of the wicked leads them astray.

column.name: text
column.value: ①A lazy person does not ②roast his prey, But the precious possession of a person is diligence. ▷ ①Lit An indolent ②Or catch

column.name: text
column.value: In the way of righteousness there is life, And in its pathway there is no death.

column.name: text
column.value: Better is a dry morsel and quietness with it Than a house full of ①feasting with strife. ▷ ①Lit sacrifices of strife

column.name: text
column.value: A servant who acts wisely will rule over a son who acts shamefully, And will share in the inheritance among brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: The refining pot is for silver and the furnace for gold, But the LORD tests hearts.

column.name: text
text
column.value: One who mocks the poor taunts his Maker; One who rejoices at disaster will not go unpunished.

column.name: text
column.value: Grandchildren are the crown of the old, And the glory of sons is their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Excellent speech is not fitting for a fool, Much less are lying lips to a prince. ▷ ①Lit A lip of abundance

column.name: text
text
column.value: One who conceals an offense seeks love, But one who repeats a matter separates close friends.

column.name: text
column.value: A rebuke goes deeper into one who has understanding Than a hundred blows into a fool.

column.name: text
column.value: A rebellious person seeks only evil, So a cruel messenger will be sent against him.

column.name: text
column.value: Let a person meet a bear robbed of her cubs, Rather than a fool in his foolishness.

column.name: text
column.value: One who returns evil for good, Evil will not depart from his house.

column.name: text
column.value: The beginning of strife is like letting out water, So abandon the quarrel before it breaks out.

column.name: text
column.value: One who justifies the wicked and one who condemns the righteous, Both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, When ①he has no sense? ▷ ①Lit there is no heart

column.name: text
column.value: A friend loves at all times, And a brother is born for adversity.

column.name: text
column.value: A person lacking in ①sense shakes hands And becomes guarantor in the presence of his neighbor. ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: One who loves wrongdoing loves strife; One who makes his doorway high seeks destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: One who has a crooked ①mind finds nothing good, And one who is ②corrupted in his language falls into evil. ▷ ①Lit heart ②Lit altered in his tongue

column.name: text
column.value: He who fathers a fool does so to his sorrow, And the father of a fool has no joy.

column.name: text
column.value: A joyful heart ①is good medicine, But a broken spirit dries up the bones. ▷ ①Lit causes good healing

column.name: text
column.value: A wicked person accepts a bribe ①from an inside pocket To pervert the ways of justice. ▷ ①Lit a fold in a robe; i.e., secretly

column.name: text
column.value: Wisdom is in the presence of one who has understanding, But the eyes of a fool are on the ends of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: A foolish son is a grief to his father, And bitterness to her who gave birth to him.

column.name: text
column.value: It is also not good to fine the righteous, Nor to strike the noble for their uprightness.

column.name: text
column.value: One who withholds his words ①has knowledge, And one who has a cool spirit is a person of understanding. ▷ ①Lit knows

column.name: text
column.value: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is considered wise; When he closes his lips, he is considered prudent.

column.name: text
text
column.value: A fool does not delight in understanding, But in revealing his own ①mind. ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: When a wicked person comes, contempt also comes, And with dishonor comes taunting.

column.name: text
text
column.value: To show partiality to the wicked is not good, Nor to suppress the righteous in judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: A fool’s lips ①bring strife, And his mouth invites beatings. ▷ ①Lit come with

column.name: text
column.value: A fool’s mouth is his ruin, And his lips are the snare of his soul.

column.name: text
column.value: The words of a gossiper are like dainty morsels, And they go down into the ①innermost parts of the body. ▷ ①Lit chambers of the belly

column.name: text
column.value: He also who is lax in his work Is a brother to him who destroys.

column.name: text
text
column.value: A rich person’s wealth is his strong city, And like a high wall in his own imagination.

column.name: text
column.value: Before destruction the heart of a person is haughty, But humility goes before honor.

column.name: text
column.value: One who gives an answer before he hears, It is foolishness and shame to him.

column.name: text
column.value: The spirit of a person can endure his sickness, But as for a broken spirit, who can endure it?

column.name: text
column.value: The ①mind of the discerning acquires knowledge, And the ear of the wise seeks knowledge. ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: A person’s gift makes room for him And brings him before great people.

column.name: text
column.value: The first ①to plead his case seems right, Until ②another comes and examines him. ▷ ①Lit in his plea ②Lit his neighbor

column.name: text
column.value: The cast lot puts an end to quarrels, And ①decides between the mighty ones. ▷ ①Lit makes a division

column.name: text
column.value: A brother who is offended is harder to be won than a strong city, And quarrels are like the bars of a citadel.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Death and life are in the ①power of the tongue, And those who love it will eat its fruit. ▷ ①Lit hand

column.name: text
column.value: He who finds a wife finds a good thing And obtains favor from the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: A poor person utters pleadings, But a rich person answers defiantly.

column.name: text
column.value: A person of too many friends comes to ①ruin, But there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother. ▷ ①Lit be broken in pieces

column.name: text
column.value: Better is a poor person who walks in his integrity Than a person who is perverse in ①speech and is a fool. ▷ ①Lit his lips

column.name: text
column.value: Also it is not good for a person to be without knowledge, And one who hurries ①his footsteps ②errs. ▷ ①Lit with his feet ②Lit sins

column.name: text
column.value: The foolishness of a person ruins his way, And his heart rages against the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Wealth adds many friends, But a poor person is separated from his friend.

column.name: text
column.value: A false witness will not go unpunished, And one who declares lies will not escape.

column.name: text
column.value: Many will seek the favor of a ①generous person, And every person is a friend to him who gives gifts. ▷ ①Or noble

column.name: text
column.value: All the brothers of a poor person hate him; How much more do his friends abandon him! He pursues them with words, but they are ①gone. ▷ ①Lit not

column.name: text
text
column.value: A false witness will not go unpunished, And one who declares lies will perish.

column.name: text
column.value: Luxury is not fitting for a fool; Much less for a slave to rule over princes.

column.name: text
column.value: A person’s discretion makes him slow to anger, And it is his glory to overlook an offense.

column.name: text
column.value: A king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, But his favor is like dew on the grass.

column.name: text
column.value: A foolish son is destruction to his father, And the quarrels of a wife are a constant dripping.

column.name: text
column.value: House and wealth are an inheritance from fathers, But a prudent wife is from the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Laziness casts one into a deep sleep, And ①a lazy ②person will suffer hunger. ▷ ①Lit an idle ②Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: One who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, But one who ①is careless of ②conduct will die. ▷ ①Lit despises ②Lit ways

column.name: text
column.value: One who is gracious to a poor person lends to the LORD, And He will repay him for his ①good deed. ▷ ①Or benefits

column.name: text
column.value: Discipline your son while there is hope, And do not desire ①his death. ▷ ①Lit causing him to die

column.name: text
column.value: A person of great anger will suffer the penalty, For if you rescue him, you will only have to do it again.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen to advice and accept discipline, So that you may be wise ①the rest of your days. ▷ ①Lit in your latter end

column.name: text
column.value: Many plans are in a person’s heart, But the advice of the LORD will stand.

column.name: text
column.value: What is desirable in a person is his ①kindness, And it is better to be a poor person than a liar. ▷ ①Or loyalty

column.name: text
column.value: ①The fear of the LORD leads to life, So that one may sleep satisfied, ②untouched by evil. ▷ ①Or Reverence for ②Lit not visited

column.name: text
column.value: The ①lazy one buries his hand in the dish, But will not even bring it back to his mouth. ▷ ①Lit idle person

column.name: text
column.value: Strike a scoffer and the naive may become clever, But rebuke one who has understanding, and he will ①gain knowledge. ▷ ①Lit discern

column.name: text
column.value: He who assaults his father and drives his mother away Is a shameful and disgraceful son.

column.name: text
column.value: Stop listening, my son, to discipline, And you will stray from the words of knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: A worthless witness makes a mockery of justice, And the mouth of the wicked ①swallows wrongdoing. ▷ ①Another reading is pours out

column.name: text
column.value: ①Judgments are prepared for scoffers, And beatings for the backs of fools. ▷ ①LXX Rods

column.name: text
column.value: The king’s heart is like channels of water in the hand of the LORD; He turns it wherever He pleases.

column.name: text
column.value: Every person’s way is right in his own eyes, But the LORD examines the hearts.

column.name: text
column.value: To do righteousness and justice Is preferred by the LORD more than sacrifice.

column.name: text
column.value: Haughty eyes and a proud heart, The lamp of the wicked, is sin.

column.name: text
column.value: The plans of the diligent certainly lead to advantage, But everyone who is in a hurry certainly comes to poverty.

column.name: text
column.value: The acquisition of treasures by a lying tongue Is a fleeting vapor, the ①pursuit of death. ▷ ①Lit seekers

column.name: text
column.value: The violence of the wicked will sweep them away, Because they refuse to act with justice.

column.name: text
column.value: The way of a guilty person is crooked, But as for the pure, his conduct is upright.

column.name: text
column.value: It is better to live on a corner of a roof Than ①in a house shared with a contentious woman. ▷ ①Lit with a woman of contentions and a house of association

column.name: text
column.value: The soul of the wicked desires evil; His neighbor is shown no compassion in his eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: When the scoffer is punished, the naive becomes wise; But when the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①righteous one considers the house of the wicked, Bringing the wicked to ruin. ▷ ①Or Righteous One

column.name: text
column.value: One who shuts his ear to the outcry of the poor Will also call out himself, and not be answered.

column.name: text
column.value: A gift in secret subdues anger, And a bribe ①in an inside pocket, strong wrath. ▷ ①Lit a fold in a robe; i.e., secretly

column.name: text
column.value: The exercise of justice is joy for the righteous, But terror to those who practice injustice.

column.name: text
column.value: A person who wanders from the way of understanding Will rest in the assembly of the ①dead. ▷ ①Lit departed spirits

column.name: text
column.value: One who loves pleasure will become a poor person; One who loves wine and oil will not become rich.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, And the treacherous is in the place of the upright.

column.name: text
column.value: It is better to live in a desert land Than with a contentious and irritating woman.

column.name: text
column.value: There is precious treasure and oil in the home of the wise, But a foolish person swallows it up.

column.name: text
column.value: One who pursues righteousness and loyalty Finds life, righteousness, and honor.

column.name: text
column.value: A wise person scales the city of the mighty And brings down the ①stronghold in which they trust. ▷ ①Lit strength of trust

column.name: text
column.value: One who guards his mouth and his tongue, Guards his soul from troubles.

column.name: text
column.value: “Proud,” “Arrogant,” “Scoffer,” are his names, One who acts with insolent pride.

column.name: text
text
column.value: All day long he ①is craving, While the righteous gives and does not hold back. ▷ ①Lit desires desire

column.name: text
column.value: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination, How much more when he brings it with evil intent!

column.name: text
column.value: A false witness will perish, But a person who listens will speak forever.

column.name: text
column.value: A wicked person ①displays a bold face, But as for the upright, he makes his way sure. ▷ ①Lit makes firm with his face

column.name: text
column.value: There is no wisdom, no understanding, And no ①plan against the LORD. ▷ ①Or advice

column.name: text
column.value: The horse is prepared for the day of battle, But the victory belongs to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Wine is a mocker, intoxicating drink a brawler, And whoever ①is intoxicated by it is not wise. ▷ ①Lit errs

column.name: text
text
column.value: Avoiding strife is an honor for a person, But any fool will ①quarrel. ▷ ①Lit burst out

column.name: text
column.value: The ①lazy one does not plow after the autumn, So he ②begs during the harvest and has nothing. ▷ ①Lit idle ②Lit asks

column.name: text
column.value: A plan in the heart of a person is like deep water, But a person of understanding draws it out.

column.name: text
column.value: Many a person proclaims his own loyalty, But who can find a trustworthy person?

column.name: text
column.value: A righteous person who walks in his integrity— How blessed are his sons after him.

column.name: text
column.value: A king who sits on the throne of justice ①Disperses all evil with his eyes. ▷ ①Or Sifts

column.name: text
column.value: Who can say, “I have cleansed my heart, I am pure from my sin”?

column.name: text
column.value: ①Differing weights and differing measures, Both of them are abominable to the LORD. ▷ ①Lit A stone and a stone, an ephah and an ephah

column.name: text
column.value: It is by his deeds that a boy ①distinguishes himself, If his conduct is pure and right. ▷ ①Or makes himself known

column.name: text
column.value: The hearing ear and the seeing eye, The LORD has made both of them.

column.name: text
text
column.value: “Bad, bad,” says the buyer, But when he goes his way, then he boasts.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Take his garment when he becomes guarantor for a stranger; And for foreigners, seize a pledge from him.

column.name: text
column.value: Bread obtained by a lie is sweet to a person, But afterward his mouth will be filled with gravel.

column.name: text
column.value: Prepare plans by consultation, And make war by wise guidance.

column.name: text
text
column.value: He who curses his father or his mother, His lamp will go out in time of darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: An inheritance gained in a hurry at the beginning Will not be blessed in the end.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not say, “I will repay evil”; Wait for the LORD, and He will save you.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Differing weights are an abomination to the LORD, And a ②false scale is not good. ▷ ①Lit A stone and a stone ②Lit balance of deceit

column.name: text
column.value: A man’s steps are ordained by the LORD; How then can a person understand his way?

column.name: text
column.value: It is a trap for a person to say carelessly, “It is holy!” And after the vows to make inquiry.

column.name: text
column.value: A wise king scatters the wicked, And ①drives a threshing wheel over them. ▷ ①Lit turns

column.name: text
column.value: The ①spirit of a person is the lamp of the LORD, Searching all the ②innermost parts of his being. ▷ ①Lit breath ②Lit chambers of the body

column.name: text
column.value: ①Loyalty and truth watch over the king, And he upholds his throne by ②loyalty. ▷ ①I.e., covenant loyalty ②I.e., covenant loyalty

column.name: text
column.value: The glory of young men is their strength, And the ①honor of old men is their gray hair. ▷ ①Or splendor

column.name: text
column.value: Bruising wounds clean away evil, And blows cleanse the ①innermost parts. ▷ ①Lit chambers of the body

column.name: text
column.value: A good name is to be more desired than great wealth; Favor is better than silver and gold.

column.name: text
column.value: The rich and the poor ①have a common bond, The LORD is the Maker of them all. ▷ ①Lit meet together

column.name: text
column.value: A prudent person sees evil and hides himself, But the naive proceed, and pay the penalty.

column.name: text
column.value: The reward of humility and ①the fear of the LORD Are riches, honor, and life. ▷ ①Or reverence for

column.name: text
column.value: Thorns and snares are in the way of the perverse; One who guards himself will be far from them.

column.name: text
column.value: Train up a child ①in the way he should go, Even when he grows older he will not abandon it. ▷ ①Lit according to his way

column.name: text
column.value: The rich rules over the poor, And the borrower becomes the lender’s slave.

column.name: text
column.value: One who sows injustice will reap disaster, And the rod of his fury will perish.

column.name: text
column.value: One who ①is generous will be blessed, Because he gives some of his food to the poor. ▷ ①Lit has a good eye

column.name: text
column.value: Drive out the scoffer, and strife will leave, Even quarreling and dishonor will cease.

column.name: text
column.value: One who loves purity of heart And ①whose speech is gracious, the king is his friend. ▷ ①Lit has grace on his lips

column.name: text
column.value: The eyes of the LORD protect knowledge, But He overthrows the words of the treacherous person.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Foolishness is bound up in the heart of a child; The rod of discipline will remove it far from him.

column.name: text
column.value: One who oppresses the poor to make ①more for himself, Or gives to the rich, will only come to poverty. ▷ ①Lit much

column.name: text
column.value: Extend your ear and hear the words of the wise, And apply your mind to my knowledge;

column.name: text
column.value: For it will be pleasant if you keep them within you, ①So that they may be ready on your lips. ▷ ①Lit They together

column.name: text
column.value: So that your trust may be in the LORD, I have ①taught you today, you indeed. ▷ ①Lit made you know

column.name: text
column.value: Have I not written to you ①excellent things Of counsels and knowledge, ▷ ①Or previous

column.name: text
column.value: To make you know the ①certainty of the words of truth, So that you may ②correctly answer him who sent you? ▷ ①Lit truth ②Lit return words of truth

column.name: text
column.value: Do not rob the poor because he is poor, Nor crush the needy at the gate;

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD will plead their case And ①take the life of those who rob them. ▷ ①Lit rob the soul

column.name: text
column.value: Do not make friends with a person given to anger, Or go with a hot-tempered person,

column.name: text
column.value: Or you will learn his ways And ①find a snare for yourself. ▷ ①Lit take

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be among those who shake hands, Among those who become guarantors for debts.

column.name: text
column.value: If you have nothing with which to repay, Why should he take your bed from under you?

column.name: text
column.value: Do not move the ancient boundary Which your fathers have set.

column.name: text
text
column.value: When you sit down to dine with a ruler, Consider carefully ①what is before you, ▷ ①Or who

column.name: text
column.value: And put a knife to your throat If you are a person of great appetite.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not desire his delicacies, For it is deceptive food.

column.name: text
text
column.value: ①When you set your eyes on it, it is gone. For wealth certainly makes itself wings Like an eagle that flies toward the heavens. ▷ ①Lit Will your eyes fly upon it and it is not?

column.name: text
text
column.value: For as he ①thinks within himself, so he is. He says to you, “Eat and drink!” But his heart is not with you. ▷ ①Lit reckons in his soul

column.name: text
column.value: You will vomit up ①the morsel you have eaten And waste your ②compliments. ▷ ①Lit your ②Lit pleasant words

column.name: text
column.value: Do not speak ①to be heard by a fool, For he will despise the wisdom of your words. ▷ ①Lit in the ears of a

column.name: text
column.value: Do not move the ancient boundary Or go into the fields of the fatherless,

column.name: text
column.value: For their Redeemer is strong; He will plead their case against you.

column.name: text
column.value: Apply your heart to discipline, And your ears to words of knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not withhold discipline from a child; Though you strike him with the rod, he will not die.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall strike him with the rod And rescue his soul from Sheol.

column.name: text
column.value: My son, if your heart is wise, My own heart also will be glad,

column.name: text
column.value: And my ①innermost being will rejoice When your lips speak what is right. ▷ ①Lit kidneys

column.name: text
column.value: Do not let your heart envy sinners, But live in ①the fear of the LORD ②always. ▷ ①Or reverence for ②Lit all the day

column.name: text
column.value: Certainly there is a ①future, And your hope will not be cut off. ▷ ①Lit latter end

column.name: text
column.value: Listen, my son, and be wise, And direct your heart in the way.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be with heavy drinkers of wine, Or with gluttonous eaters of meat;

column.name: text
column.value: For the heavy drinker and the glutton will come to poverty, And drowsiness will clothe one with rags.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen to your father, who fathered you, And do not despise your mother when she is old.

column.name: text
column.value: Buy truth, and do not sell it, Get wisdom, instruction, and understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: The father of the righteous will greatly rejoice, And he who fathers a wise son will be glad in him.

column.name: text
column.value: Let your father and your mother be glad, And let her rejoice who gave birth to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Give me your heart, my son, And let your eyes ①delight in my ways. ▷ ①Another reading is observe

column.name: text
column.value: For a prostitute is a deep pit, And a ①strange woman is a narrow well. ▷ ①Lit foreign

column.name: text
column.value: Certainly she lurks as a robber, And increases the treacherous among mankind.

column.name: text
column.value: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has contentions? Who has complaining? Who has wounds without cause? Who has red eyes?

column.name: text
column.value: Those who linger long over wine, Those who go to ①taste mixed wine. ▷ ①Or search out

column.name: text
column.value: Do not look at wine when it is red, When it ①sparkles in the cup, When it goes down smoothly; ▷ ①Lit gives its eye

column.name: text
column.value: In the end it bites like a snake And stings like a viper.

column.name: text
column.value: Your eyes will see strange things And your ①mind will say perverse things. ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: And you will be like one who lies down in the ①middle of the sea, Or like one who lies down on the top of a ②mast. ▷ ①Lit heart ②Or lookout

column.name: text
column.value: “They struck me, but I did not become ①ill; They beat me, but I did not know it. When will I awake? I will seek ②another drink.” ▷ ①I.e., from the effect of wounds ②Lit it yet again

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be envious of evil people, Nor desire to be with them;

column.name: text
column.value: For their ①minds plot violence, And their lips talk of trouble. ▷ ①Lit hearts

column.name: text
column.value: By wisdom a house is built, And by understanding it is established;

column.name: text
column.value: And by knowledge the rooms are filled With all precious and pleasant riches.

column.name: text
column.value: A wise man is ①strong, And a person of knowledge ②increases power. ▷ ①Lit in strength ②Lit strengthens power

column.name: text
column.value: For by wise guidance you will ①wage war, And in an abundance of counselors there is victory. ▷ ①Lit make battle for yourself

column.name: text
column.value: Wisdom is too exalted for a fool, He does not open his mouth at the gate.

column.name: text
column.value: One who plans to do evil, People will call a ①schemer. ▷ ①Or deviser of evil

column.name: text
column.value: The devising of foolishness is sin, And the scoffer is an abomination to humanity.

column.name: text
column.value: If you show yourself lacking courage on the day of distress, Your strength is meager.

column.name: text
column.value: Rescue those who are being taken away to death, And those who are staggering to the slaughter, Oh hold them back!

column.name: text
column.value: If you say, “See, we did not know this,” Does He who weighs the hearts not consider it? And does He who watches over your soul not know it? And will He not ①repay a person according to his work? ▷ ①Lit bring back to

column.name: text
column.value: My son, eat honey, for it is good; Yes, the honey from the comb is sweet to your taste;

column.name: text
column.value: Know that wisdom is the same for your soul; If you find it, then there will be a ①future, And your hope will not be cut off. ▷ ①Lit latter end

column.name: text
column.value: Do not lie in ambush, you wicked person, against the home of the righteous; Do not destroy his resting place;

column.name: text
column.value: For a righteous person falls seven times and rises again, But the wicked stumble in time of disaster.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not rejoice when your enemy falls, And do not let your heart rejoice when he stumbles,

column.name: text
column.value: Otherwise, the LORD will see and ①be displeased, And turn His anger away from him. ▷ ①Lit it is evil in His eyes

column.name: text
column.value: Do not get upset because of evildoers Or be envious of the wicked;

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: For their disaster will rise suddenly, And who knows the ruin that can come from both of them?

column.name: text
column.value: These also are sayings of the wise: To ①show partiality in judgment is not good. ▷ ①Lit regard the face

column.name: text
column.value: One who says to the wicked, “You are righteous,” Peoples will curse him, nations will scold him;

column.name: text
column.value: But for those who rebuke the wicked there will be delight, And a good blessing will come upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: One who gives ①a right answer Kisses the lips. ▷ ①Or an honest

column.name: text
text
column.value: Do not be a witness against your neighbor for no reason, And do not deceive with your lips.

column.name: text
text
column.value: I passed by the field of ①a lazy one, And by the vineyard of a person lacking ②sense, ▷ ①Lit an idle ②Lit heart

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: “A little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to rest,”

column.name: text
column.value: Then your poverty will come like ①a drifter, And your need like ②an armed man. ▷ ①Lit one who moves about ②Lit a man with a shield

column.name: text
column.value: These also are proverbs of Solomon which the men of Hezekiah, king of Judah, transcribed.

column.name: text
column.value: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter, But the glory of kings is to search out a matter.

column.name: text
column.value: As the heavens for height and the earth for depth, So the heart of kings is unsearchable.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Take away the wicked before the king, And his throne will be established in righteousness.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” Than for you to be placed lower in the presence of the prince, Whom your eyes have seen.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not go out hastily to ①argue your case; ②Otherwise, what will you do in ③the end, When your neighbor humiliates you? ▷ ①Lit contend ②Lit Lest ③Lit its

column.name: text
column.value: ①Argue your case with your neighbor, And do not reveal the secret of another, ▷ ①Lit Contend

column.name: text
column.value: Or one who hears it will put you to shame, And the evil report about you will not ①pass away. ▷ ①Lit return

column.name: text
column.value: Like apples of gold in settings of silver, Is a word spoken at ①the proper time. ▷ ①Lit its time

column.name: text
column.value: Like ①an earring of gold and a jewelry piece of fine gold, Is a wise person who offers rebukes to a listening ear. ▷ ①Or a nose ring

column.name: text
column.value: Like the cold of snow in the ①time of harvest Is a faithful messenger to those who send him, For he refreshes the soul of his masters. ▷ ①Lit day

column.name: text
column.value: Like clouds and wind without rain Is a person who boasts ①of his gifts falsely. ▷ ①Lit in a gift of falsehood

column.name: text
column.value: Through ①patience a ruler may be persuaded, And a gentle tongue breaks bone. ▷ ①Lit length of anger

column.name: text
column.value: Have you found honey? Eat only ①what you need, So that you do not have it in excess and vomit it. ▷ ①Lit your sufficiency

column.name: text
column.value: Let your foot rarely be in your neighbor’s house, Or he will become ①weary of you and hate you. ▷ ①Lit surfeited with

column.name: text
column.value: Like a club, a sword, and a sharp arrow Is a person who gives false testimony against his neighbor.

column.name: text
column.value: Like a bad tooth and ①an unsteady foot Is confidence in a treacherous person in time of trouble. ▷ ①Lit a slipping foot

column.name: text
column.value: Like one who takes off a garment on a cold day, or like vinegar on ①soda, Is one who sings songs to ②a troubled heart. ▷ ①I.e., natron ②Lit an evil

column.name: text
text
column.value: For you will ①heap burning coals on his head, And the LORD will reward you. ▷ ①Lit snatch up

column.name: text
column.value: The north wind brings rain, And a ①gossiping tongue brings an angry face. ▷ ①Lit tongue of secrecy

column.name: text
column.value: It is better to live on a corner of the roof, Than ①in a house shared with a contentious woman. ▷ ①Lit with a woman of contentions and a house of association

column.name: text
column.value: Like cold water to a weary soul, So is good news from a distant land.

column.name: text
column.value: Like a trampled spring and a ①polluted well, So is a righteous person who gives way before the wicked. ▷ ①Lit ruined

column.name: text
column.value: It is not good to eat much honey, Nor is it glory to search out ①one’s own glory. ▷ ①Lit their

column.name: text
column.value: Like a city that is broken into and without walls So is a person who has no self-control over his spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Like snow in summer and like rain in harvest, So honor is not fitting for a fool.

column.name: text
column.value: Like a sparrow in its ①flitting, like a swallow in its flying, So a curse without cause does not come to rest. ▷ ①Lit wandering

column.name: text
column.value: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, And a rod for the back of fools.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not answer a fool ①according to his foolishness, Or you will also be like him. ▷ ①I.e., taking his question or argument seriously

column.name: text
column.value: Answer a fool as his foolishness deserves, So that he will not be wise in his own eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool Chops off his own feet and drinks violence.

column.name: text
column.value: Like ①useless legs to one who cannot walk, So is a proverb in the mouths of fools. ▷ ①Lit legs that dangle from one paralyzed

column.name: text
column.value: Like ①one who binds a stone in a sling, So is one who gives honor to a fool. ▷ ①Lit the binding of

column.name: text
column.value: Like a thorn that ①sticks in the hand of a heavy drinker, So is a proverb in the mouths of fools. ▷ ①Lit goes up

column.name: text
column.value: ①Like an archer who wounds everyone, So is one who hires a fool or hires those who pass by. ▷ ①Or A master workman produces all things, But one who hires a fool is like one who hires those who pass by

column.name: text
column.value: Like a dog that returns to its vomit, So is a fool who repeats ①his foolishness. ▷ ①Lit with his

column.name: text
column.value: Do you see a person wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

column.name: text
column.value: ①A lazy one says, “There is a lion on the road! A lion is ②in the public square!” ▷ ①Lit an idle, and so throughout the ch ②Lit within

column.name: text
column.value: As the door turns on its hinges, So does a lazy one on his bed.

column.name: text
column.value: A lazy one buries his hand in the dish; He is weary of bringing it to his mouth again.

column.name: text
column.value: A lazy one is wiser in his own eyes Than seven people who can ①give a discreet answer. ▷ ①Lit return discreetly

column.name: text
column.value: Like one who takes a dog by the ears, So is one who passes by and ①meddles with strife not belonging to him. ▷ ①Lit infuriates himself

column.name: text
column.value: Like a maniac who shoots Flaming arrows, arrows, and death,

column.name: text
column.value: So is a person who deceives his neighbor, And says, “Was I not joking?”

column.name: text
column.value: For lack of wood the fire goes out, And where there is no gossiper, quarreling quiets down.

column.name: text
column.value: Like charcoal to hot embers and wood to fire, So is a contentious person to kindle strife.

column.name: text
column.value: The words of a gossiper are like dainty morsels, And they go down into the ①innermost parts of the body. ▷ ①Lit chambers of the belly

column.name: text
column.value: Like an earthenware vessel overlaid with silver ①impurities Are burning lips and a wicked heart. ▷ ①Lit dross

column.name: text
column.value: One who hates disguises it with his lips, But he harbors deceit in his ①heart. ▷ ①Lit inward part

column.name: text
column.value: When ①he speaks graciously, do not believe him, Because there are seven abominations in his heart. ▷ ①Lit his voice is gracious

column.name: text
column.value: Though his hatred covers itself with deception, His wickedness will be revealed in the assembly.

column.name: text
column.value: One who digs a pit will fall into it, And one who rolls a stone, it will come back on him.

column.name: text
column.value: A lying tongue hates ①those it crushes, And a flattering mouth works ruin. ▷ ①Lit its crushed ones

column.name: text
column.value: Do not boast about tomorrow, For you do not know what a day may bring.

column.name: text
column.value: Let another praise you, and not your own mouth; A stranger, and not your own lips.

column.name: text
column.value: A stone is heavy and the sand weighty, But the provocation of a fool is heavier than both of them.

column.name: text
column.value: Wrath is fierce and anger is a flood, But who can stand before jealousy?

column.name: text
column.value: Better is open rebuke Than love that is concealed.

column.name: text
column.value: Faithful are the wounds of a friend, But ①deceitful are the kisses of an enemy. ▷ ①Or excessive

column.name: text
column.value: A satisfied ①person ②despises honey, But to a hungry ③person any bitter thing is sweet. ▷ ①Lit soul ②Lit tramples on ③Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: Like a bird that wanders from its nest, So is a person who wanders from his ①home. ▷ ①Lit place

column.name: text
column.value: Oil and perfume make the heart glad, And a ①person’s advice is sweet to his friend. ▷ ①Lit soul’s

column.name: text
text
column.value: Be wise, my son, and make my heart glad, So that I may reply to one who taunts me.

column.name: text
column.value: A prudent person sees evil and hides himself; But the naive proceed, and pay the penalty.

column.name: text
column.value: Take his garment when he becomes a guarantor for a stranger; And for a foreign woman seize a pledge from him.

column.name: text
column.value: One who blesses his friend with a loud voice early in the morning, It will be considered a curse to him.

column.name: text
column.value: A constant dripping on a day of steady rain And a contentious woman are alike;

column.name: text
column.value: He who would ①restrain her ②restrains the wind, And ③grasps oil with his right hand. ▷ ①Lit hide(s) ②Lit hide(s) ③Lit encounters

column.name: text
column.value: As iron sharpens iron, So one person sharpens another.

column.name: text
column.value: One who tends the fig tree will eat its fruit, And one who cares for his master will be honored.

column.name: text
column.value: As in water a face reflects the face, So the heart of a person reflects the person.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Sheol and ②Abaddon are never satisfied, Nor are the eyes of a person ever satisfied. ▷ ①I.e., The netherworld ②I.e., the place of destruction

column.name: text
column.value: The crucible is for silver and the furnace for gold, And each is tested by the praise accorded him.

column.name: text
column.value: Though you pound the fool in a mortar with a pestle along with crushed grain, His foolishness still will not leave him.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For riches are not forever, Nor does a crown endure to all generations.

column.name: text
column.value: When the grass disappears, the new growth is seen, And the herbs of the mountains are gathered in,

column.name: text
column.value: The lambs will be for your clothing, And the goats will bring the price of a field,

column.name: text
column.value: And there will be enough goats’ milk for your food, For the food of your household, And sustenance for your attendants.

column.name: text
