column.value: Moreover, the LORD said, “Because the daughters of Zion are haughty And walk with ①heads held high and seductive eyes, And go along with mincing steps And jingle the anklets on their feet, ▷ ①Lit outstretched necks

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord will afflict the scalp of the daughters of Zion with scabs, And the LORD will make their foreheads bare.”

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: headdresses, ankle chains, sashes, perfume boxes, amulets,

column.name: text
column.value: ①finger rings, nose rings, ▷ ①Or signet rings

column.name: text
column.value: festive robes, outer garments, shawls, purses,

column.name: text
column.value: papyrus garments, undergarments, headbands, and veils.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Your men will fall by the sword And your ①mighty ones in battle. ▷ ①Lit strength

column.name: text
column.value: And her ①gates will lament and mourn, And she will sit deserted on the ground. ▷ ①Lit entrances

column.name: text
column.value: The word which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it will come about that In the last days The mountain of the house of the LORD Will be established ①as the chief of the mountains, And will be raised above the hills; And all the nations will stream to it. ▷ ①Lit on

column.name: text
column.value: And many peoples will come and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of the LORD, To the house of the God of Jacob; So that He may teach us ①about His ways, And that we may walk in His paths.” For ②the law will go out from Zion And the word of the LORD from Jerusalem. ▷ ①Or some of ②Or instruction

column.name: text
column.value: And He will judge between the nations, And will mediate for many peoples; And they will beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning knives. Nation will not lift up a sword against nation, And never again will they learn war.

column.name: text
column.value: Come, house of Jacob, and let’s walk in the light of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For You have abandoned Your people, the house of Jacob, Because they are filled with influences from the east, And they are soothsayers like the Philistines. They also ①strike bargains with the children of foreigners. ▷ ①Lit clap their hands

column.name: text
column.value: Their land has also been filled with silver and gold And there is no end to their treasures; Their land has also been filled with horses, And there is no end to their chariots.

column.name: text
text
column.value: So the common person has been humbled And the person of importance has been brought low, But do not forgive them.

column.name: text
column.value: Enter the rocky place and hide in the dust From the terror of the LORD and from the splendor of His majesty.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①proud look of humanity will be brought low, And the arrogance of people will be humbled; And the LORD alone will be exalted on that day. ▷ ①Lit eyes of the pride of man

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD of armies will have a day of reckoning Against everyone who is arrogant and haughty, And against everyone who is lifted up, That he may be brought low.

column.name: text
column.value: And it will be against all the cedars of Lebanon that are lofty and lifted up, Against all the oaks of Bashan,

column.name: text
column.value: Against all the lofty mountains, Against all the hills that are lifted up,

column.name: text
column.value: Against every high tower, Against every fortified wall,

column.name: text
column.value: Against all the ships of Tarshish And against all the delightful ships.

column.name: text
text
column.value: And the idols will completely vanish.

column.name: text
column.value: People will go into caves of the rocks And into holes in the ①ground Away from the terror of the LORD And the splendor of His majesty, When He arises to terrify the earth. ▷ ①Lit dust

column.name: text
column.value: On that day people will throw away to the moles and the bats Their idols of silver and their idols of gold, Which they made for themselves to worship,

column.name: text
column.value: In order to go into the clefts of the rocks and the crannies of the cliffs Before the terror of the LORD and the splendor of His majesty, When He arises to terrify the earth.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For seven women will take hold of one man on that day, saying, “We will eat our own bread and wear our own clothes, only let us be called by your name; take away our disgrace!”

column.name: text
column.value: On that day the Branch of the LORD will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth will be the pride and the beauty of the survivors of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And it will come about that the one who is left in Zion and remains behind in Jerusalem will be called holy—everyone who is recorded for life in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: When the Lord has washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion and ①purged the bloodshed of Jerusalem from her midst, by the spirit of judgment and the spirit of ②burning, ▷ ①Lit rinsed away ②Or destruction

column.name: text
column.value: then the LORD will create over the entire area of Mount Zion and over her assemblies a cloud by day, and smoke, and the brightness of a flaming fire by night; for over all the glory will be a canopy.

column.name: text
column.value: And there will be a shelter to give shade from the heat by day, and refuge and ①protection from the storm and the rain. ▷ ①Lit a hiding place

column.name: text
column.value: Let me sing now for my beloved A song of my beloved about His vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on ①a fertile hill. ▷ ①Lit horn, a son of fatness

column.name: text
column.value: He dug it all around, cleared it of stones, And planted it with ①the choicest vine. And He built a tower in the middle of it, And also carved out a ②wine vat in it; Then He expected it to produce good grapes, But it produced only ③worthless ones. ▷ ①Lit a bright red grape ②Or wine press ③Or unripe

column.name: text
column.value: “And now, you inhabitants of Jerusalem and people of Judah, Judge between Me and My vineyard.

column.name: text
column.value: What more was there to do for My vineyard ①that I have not done in it? Why, when I expected it to produce good grapes did it produce ②worthless ones? ▷ ①Lit and I have not done ②Or unripe

column.name: text
text
column.value: I will lay it waste; It will not be pruned nor hoed, But briars and thorns will come up. I will also command the clouds not to rain on it.”

column.name: text
column.value: For the vineyard of the LORD of armies is the house of Israel, And the people of Judah are His delightful plant. So He waited for justice, but behold, there was bloodshed; For righteousness, but behold, a cry for help.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to those who attach house to house and join field to field, Until there is no more room, And you alone are a landowner in the midst of the land!

column.name: text
column.value: In my ears the LORD of armies has sworn, “Many houses shall certainly become desolate, Even great and fine ones, without occupants.

column.name: text
column.value: For ten acres of vineyard will yield only one ①bath of wine, And a ②homer of seed will yield only an ③ephah of grain.” ▷ ①About 6 gallons or 23 liters ②About 7.7 cubic feet or 0.22 cubit meters or more ③About 1 cubic foot or 0.03 cubic meters

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to those who rise early in the morning so that they may pursue intoxicating drink, Who stay up late in the evening so that wine may inflame them!

column.name: text
text
column.value: Therefore My people go into exile for their lack of knowledge; And their ①nobles are famished, And their multitude is parched with thirst. ▷ ①Lit glory is men of famine

column.name: text
text
column.value: So the common people will be humbled and the person of importance brought low, The eyes of the haughty also will be brought low.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD of armies will be exalted in judgment, And the holy God will show Himself holy in righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, And strangers will eat in the ruins of the ①wealthy. ▷ ①Lit fat

column.name: text
text
text
text
column.value: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes And ①clever in their own sight! ▷ ①Lit discerning

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to those who are heroes in drinking wine, And valiant men in mixing intoxicating drink,

column.name: text
column.value: Who declare the wicked innocent for a bribe, And take away the ①rights of the ones who are in the right! ▷ ①Lit justice

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, as a tongue of fire consumes stubble, And dry grass collapses in the flame, So their root will become like rot, and their blossom ①blow away like dust; For they have rejected the Law of the LORD of armies, And discarded the word of the Holy One of Israel. ▷ ①Lit ascend

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason the anger of the LORD has burned against His people, And He has stretched out His hand against them and struck them. And the mountains quaked, and their corpses ①lay like refuse in the middle of the streets. Despite all this, His anger ②is not spent, But His hand is still stretched out. ▷ ①Lit were ②Lit has not turned away

column.name: text
column.value: He will also lift up a flag to the distant ①nation, And whistle for it from the ends of the earth; And behold, it will come with speed swiftly. ▷ ①Lit nations; prob. Assyria

column.name: text
column.value: No one in it is tired or stumbles, No one slumbers or sleeps; Nor is the undergarment at his waist loosened, Nor his sandal strap broken.

column.name: text
text
text
text
column.value: In the year of King Uzziah’s death I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, lofty and exalted, with the train of His robe filling the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: Seraphim were standing above Him, each having six wings: with two each covered his face, and with two each covered his feet, and with two each flew.

column.name: text
column.value: And one called out to another and said, “Holy, Holy, Holy, is the LORD of armies. The ①whole earth is full of His glory.” ▷ ①Lit fullness of the whole earth is His glory

column.name: text
column.value: And the ①foundations of the thresholds trembled at the voice of him who called out, while the ②temple was filling with smoke. ▷ ①Lit door sockets ②Lit house

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, “Woe to me, for I am ruined! Because I am a man of unclean lips, And I live among a people of unclean lips; For my eyes have seen the King, the LORD of armies.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then one of the seraphim flew to me with a burning coal in his hand, which he had taken from the altar with tongs.

column.name: text
column.value: He touched my mouth with it and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your guilt is taken away and atonement is made for your sin.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for Us?” Then I said, “Here am I. Send me!”

column.name: text
text
column.value: Make the hearts of this people ①insensitive, Their ears ②dull, And their eyes ③blind, So that they will not see with their eyes, Hear with their ears, Understand with their hearts, And return and be healed.” ▷ ①Lit fat ②Lit heavy ③Lit sealed over

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, “Lord, how long?” And He answered, “Until cities are devastated and without inhabitant, Houses are without people And the land is utterly desolate,

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has completely removed people, And there ①are many forsaken places in the midst of the land. ▷ ①Or forsakenness will be great

column.name: text
column.value: Yet there will still be a tenth portion in it, And it will again be subject to burning, Like a terebinth or an oak Whose stump remains when it is cut down. The holy seed is its stump.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me, “Take for yourself a large tablet and write on it ①in ordinary letters: ②Maher-shalal-hash-baz. ▷ ①Lit with the stylus of man ②I.e., swift is the plunder, speedy is the prey

column.name: text
column.value: And ①I will take to Myself faithful witnesses for testimony, Uriah the priest and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.” ▷ ①Another reading is take for me

column.name: text
column.value: So I approached the prophetess, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. Then the LORD said to me, “Name him ①Maher-shalal-hash-baz; ▷ ①I.e., swift is the plunder, speedy is the prey

column.name: text
column.value: for before the boy knows how to cry out ‘My father’ or ‘My mother,’ the wealth of Damascus and the spoils of Samaria will be carried away before the king of Assyria.”

column.name: text
column.value: Again the LORD spoke to me further, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Inasmuch as these people have rejected the gently flowing waters of Shiloah And rejoice in Rezin and the son of Remaliah;

column.name: text
text
column.value: Then it will sweep on into Judah, it will overflow and pass through, It will reach as far as the neck; And the spread of its wings will ①fill the expanse of ②your land, Immanuel. ▷ ①Lit be the fullness of ②Or Your

column.name: text
text
column.value: Devise a plan, but it will fail; State a ①proposal, but it will not stand, For ②God is with us.” ▷ ①Lit word ②Heb Immanu-el

column.name: text
column.value: For so the LORD spoke to me ①with mighty power and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying, ▷ ①Lit according to the strength of hand

column.name: text
column.value: “You are not to say, ‘It is a conspiracy!’ Regarding everything that this people call a conspiracy, And you are not to fear ①what they fear or be in dread of it. ▷ ①Lit their fear

column.name: text
column.value: It is the LORD of armies whom you are to regard as holy. And He shall be your fear, And He shall be your dread.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He will become a sanctuary; But to both houses of Israel, He will be a stone of stumbling and a rock ①of offense, And a snare and a trap for the inhabitants of Jerusalem. ▷ ①Or to trip on

column.name: text
text
column.value: Bind up the testimony, seal the ①Law among my disciples. ▷ ①Or teaching

column.name: text
column.value: And I will wait for the LORD who is hiding His face from the house of Jacob; I will wait eagerly for Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD has given me are for signs and wonders in Israel from the LORD of armies, who dwells on Mount Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: When they say to you, “Consult the mediums and the spiritists who whisper and mutter,” should a people not consult their God? Should they consult the dead in behalf of the living?

column.name: text
column.value: To the ①Law and to the testimony! If they do not speak in accordance with this word, it is because they have no dawn. ▷ ①Or teaching

column.name: text
column.value: They will pass through ①the land dejected and hungry, and it will turn out that when they are hungry, they will become enraged and curse ②their king and their God as they face upward. ▷ ①Lit it ②Or by their king

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will look to the earth, and behold, distress and darkness, the gloom of anguish; and they will be driven away into darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about in the days of Ahaz, the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Aram and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to wage war against it, but could not ①conquer it. ▷ ①Lit fight against

column.name: text
column.value: When it was reported to the house of David, saying, “The Arameans have taken a stand by Ephraim,” his heart and the hearts of his people shook as the trees of the forest shake from the wind.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you and your son ①Shear-jashub, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the road to the ②fuller’s field, ▷ ①I.e., a remnant shall return ②I.e., launderer’s

column.name: text
column.value: and say to him, ‘Take care and be calm, have no fear and do not be fainthearted because of these two stumps of smoldering logs, on account of the fierce anger of Rezin and Aram and the son of Remaliah.

column.name: text
column.value: Because Aram, with Ephraim and the son of Remaliah, has planned evil against you, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Let’s go up against Judah and ①terrorize it, and take it for ourselves by assault and set up the son of Tabeel as king in the midst of it,” ▷ ①Or demolish

column.name: text
column.value: this is what the Lord ①GOD says: “It shall not stand nor shall it come to pass. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: For the head of Aram is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin (now within another sixty-five years Ephraim will be broken to pieces, so that it is no longer a people),

column.name: text
column.value: and the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is the son of Remaliah. If you will not believe, you certainly shall not ①last.” ’ ” ▷ ①Or endure

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD spoke again to Ahaz, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Ask for a sign for yourself from the LORD your God; ①make it deep as Sheol or high as ②heaven.” ▷ ①As in most ancient versions; MT make the request deep or high ②Lit heights

column.name: text
column.value: But Ahaz said, “I will not ask, nor will I put the LORD to the test!”

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said, “Listen now, house of David! Is it too trivial a thing for you to ①try the patience of men, that you will ②try the patience of my God as well? ▷ ①Lit make men weary ②Lit make my God weary

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the Lord Himself will give you a sign: Behold, the ①virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and she will name Him ②Immanuel. ▷ ①As in LXX; MT young unmarried woman ②I.e., God is with us

column.name: text
column.value: He will eat ①curds and honey ②at the time He knows enough to refuse evil and choose good. ▷ ①Possibly butter ②Lit with respect to his knowing

column.name: text
column.value: For before the boy knows enough to refuse evil and choose good, the land whose two kings you dread will be abandoned.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will bring on you, on your people, and on your father’s house such days as have not come since the day that Ephraim separated from Judah—the days of the king of Assyria.”

column.name: text
column.value: On that day the LORD will whistle for the fly that is in the ①remotest part of the canals of Egypt and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria. ▷ ①Or mouth of the rivers; i.e., the Nile Delta

column.name: text
column.value: They will all come and settle on the steep ①ravines, on the ledges of the cliffs, on all the thorn bushes, and on all the watering places. ▷ ①Or wadis

column.name: text
column.value: On that day the Lord will shave with a razor, hired from regions beyond the Euphrates River (that is, with the king of Assyria), the head and the hair of the legs; and it will also remove the beard.

column.name: text
column.value: Now on that day a person may keep alive only a heifer and a pair of sheep;

column.name: text
column.value: and because of the abundance of the milk produced he will eat ①curds, for everyone who is left within the land will eat ②curds and honey. ▷ ①Possibly butter ②Possibly butter

column.name: text
column.value: And it will come about on that day, that every place where there used to be a thousand vines, valued at a thousand shekels of silver, will become briars and thorns.

column.name: text
column.value: People will come there with bows and arrows, because all the land will be briars and thorns.

column.name: text
column.value: As for all the hills which used to be cultivated with the plow, you will not go there for fear of briars and thorns; but they will become a place for ①pasturing oxen and for sheep to trample. ▷ ①Lit pastureland of

column.name: text
column.value: ①The people who walk in darkness Will see a great light; Those who live in a dark land, The light will shine on them. ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: in Heb

column.name: text
column.value: You will multiply the nation, You will ①increase ②their joy; They will rejoice in Your presence As with the joy ③of harvest, As people rejoice when they divide the spoils. ▷ ①Another reading is not increase ②Lit the ③Lit in

column.name: text
column.value: For You will break the yoke of their burden and the staff on their shoulders, The rod of their oppressor, as ①at the battle of Midian. ▷ ①Lit in the day of Midian

column.name: text
column.value: For every boot of the marching warrior in the roar of battle, And cloak rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.

column.name: text
text
column.value: There will be no end to the increase of His government or of peace On the throne of David and over ①his kingdom, To establish it and to uphold it with justice and righteousness From then on and forevermore. The zeal of the LORD of armies will accomplish this. ▷ ①I.e., David’s

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord sends a ①message against Jacob, And it falls on Israel. ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people know it, That is, Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, Asserting in pride and in arrogance of heart:

column.name: text
column.value: “The bricks have fallen down, But we will rebuild with smooth stones; The sycamores have been cut down, But we will replace them with cedars.”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the LORD raises superior adversaries against them from Rezin And provokes their enemies,

column.name: text
column.value: The Arameans from the east and the Philistines from the west; And they devour Israel with ①gaping jaws. In spite of all this, His anger does not turn away, And His hand is still stretched out. ▷ ①Lit the whole mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Yet the people do not turn back to Him who struck them, Nor do they seek the LORD of armies.

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD cuts off head and tail from Israel, Both palm branch and bulrush in a single day.

column.name: text
column.value: The head is the elder and esteemed man, And the prophet who teaches falsehood is the tail.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Therefore the Lord does not rejoice over their young men, Nor does He have compassion on their ①orphans or their widows; For every one of them is godless and an evildoer, And every mouth is speaking foolishness. In spite of all this, His anger does not turn away, And His hand is still stretched out. ▷ ①Or fatherless

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: ①They devour what is on the right hand but are still hungry, And ②they eat what is on the left hand, but they are not satisfied; Each of them eats the flesh of his own arm. ▷ ①Lit And he slices ②Lit he eats

column.name: text
column.value: Manasseh devours Ephraim, and Ephraim Manasseh, And together they are against Judah. In spite of all this, His anger does not turn away And His hand is still stretched out.

column.name: text
column.value: Then a shoot will spring from the stem of Jesse, And a Branch from his roots will bear fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: The Spirit of the LORD will rest on Him, The spirit of wisdom and understanding, The spirit of counsel and strength, The spirit of knowledge and the fear of the LORD.

column.name: text
text
column.value: But with righteousness He will judge the poor, And decide with fairness for the humble of the earth; And He will strike the earth with the rod of His mouth, And with the breath of His lips He will slay the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: Also righteousness will be the belt around His hips, And faithfulness the belt around His waist.

column.name: text
column.value: And the wolf will dwell with the lamb, And the leopard will lie down with the young goat, And the calf and the young lion ①and the fattened steer will be together; And a little boy will lead them. ▷ ①Some ancient versions will feed together

column.name: text
column.value: Also the cow and the bear will graze, Their young will lie down together, And the lion will eat straw like the ox.

column.name: text
column.value: The nursing child will play by the hole of the cobra, And the weaned child will put his hand on the viper’s den.

column.name: text
column.value: They will not hurt or destroy in all My holy mountain, For the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD As the waters cover the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: Then on that day The nations will resort to the root of Jesse, Who will stand as a signal flag for the peoples; And His resting place will be ①glorious. ▷ ①Lit glory

column.name: text
column.value: Then it will happen on that day that the Lord Will again recover with His hand the second time The remnant of His people who will remain, From Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Cush, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, And from the ①islands of the sea. ▷ ①Or coastlands

column.name: text
column.value: And He will lift up a flag for the nations And assemble the banished ones of Israel, And will gather the dispersed of Judah From the four corners of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the jealousy of Ephraim will depart, And those who harass Judah will be eliminated; Ephraim will not be jealous of Judah, And Judah will not harass Ephraim.

column.name: text
text
column.value: And the LORD will ①utterly destroy The tongue of the ②Sea of Egypt; And He will wave His hand over the Euphrates River With His scorching wind; And He will strike it into seven streams And make people walk over in dry sandals. ▷ ①Another reading is dry up the tongue ②Perhaps the Red Sea

column.name: text
column.value: And there will be a highway from Assyria For the remnant of His people who will be left, Just as there was for Israel On the day that they came up out of the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to those who enact unjust statutes And to those who constantly record ①harmful decisions, ▷ ①Lit harm

column.name: text
column.value: So as to ①deprive the needy of justice And rob the poor among My people of their rights, So that widows may be their spoil And that they may plunder the ②orphans. ▷ ①Lit turn the needy aside from ②Or fatherless

column.name: text
column.value: Now what will you do in the day of punishment, And in the devastation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? And where will you leave your wealth?

column.name: text
column.value: Nothing remains but to crouch ①among the captives Or fall ②among those killed. In spite of all this, His anger does not turn away And His hand is still stretched out. ▷ ①Lit under ②Lit under

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to Assyria, the rod of My anger And the staff in whose hands is My indignation,

column.name: text
column.value: I send it against a godless nation And commission it against the people of My fury To capture spoils and to seize plunder, And to ①trample them down like mud in the streets. ▷ ①Lit make them a trampled place

column.name: text
column.value: Yet it does not so intend, Nor does ①it plan so in its heart, But rather it is ②its purpose to destroy And to eliminate ③many nations. ▷ ①Lit its heart so plan ②Lit in its heart ③Lit not a few

column.name: text
column.value: For it says, “Are not my officers ①all kings? ▷ ①Lit altogether

column.name: text
column.value: Is not Calno like Carchemish, Or Hamath like Arpad, Or Samaria like Damascus?

column.name: text
column.value: As my hand has reached to the kingdoms of the idols, Whose carved images were greater than those of Jerusalem and Samaria,

column.name: text
column.value: Shall I not do the same to Jerusalem and her images Just as I have done to Samaria and her idols?”

column.name: text
column.value: So it will be that when the Lord has completed all His work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, He will say, “I will ①punish the fruit of the arrogant heart of the king of Assyria and the arrogant pride of his eyes.” ▷ ①Lit visit

column.name: text
column.value: For he has said, “By the power of my hand and by my wisdom I did this, Because I have understanding; And I removed the boundaries of the peoples And plundered their treasures, And like a powerful man I brought down ①their inhabitants, ▷ ①Or those who sit on thrones

column.name: text
text
column.value: Is the axe to boast itself over the one who chops with it? Is the saw to exalt itself over the one who wields it? That would be like a ①club wielding those who lift it, Or like a rod lifting the one who is not wood. ▷ ①Lit staff

column.name: text
text
column.value: And the Light of Israel will become a fire and ①Israel’s Holy One a flame, And it will burn and devour ②his thorns and his briars in a single day. ▷ ①Lit his ②I.e., the Assyrian king’s forces

column.name: text
column.value: And He will destroy the glory of his forest and of his fruitful garden, both soul and body, And it will be as when a sick person wastes away.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the trees of his forest will be so small in number That a child could write them down.

column.name: text
column.value: Now on that day the remnant of Israel, and those of the house of Jacob who have escaped, will no longer rely on the one who struck them, but will truly rely on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: A remnant will return, the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For a complete destruction, one that is determined, the Lord ①GOD of armies will execute in the midst of the whole land. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the Lord ①GOD of armies says: “My people, you who dwell in Zion, do not fear the Assyrian ②who strikes you with the rod, and lifts up his staff against you the way Egypt did. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD ②Lit he

column.name: text
column.value: For in a very little while My indignation against you will be ended and My anger will be directed toward their destruction.”

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD of armies will wield a whip against him like the defeat of Midian at the rock of Oreb; and His staff will be over the sea, and He will lift it up the way He did in Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: So it will be on that day, that ①his burden will be removed from your shoulders, and his yoke from your neck; and the yoke will be broken because of fatness. ▷ ①I.e., the Assyrian

column.name: text
text
column.value: They have gone through the pass, saying, “Geba will be our encampment for the night.” Ramah is terrified, and Gibeah of Saul has fled.

column.name: text
column.value: Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Pay attention, Laishah and ①wretched Anathoth! ▷ ①An ancient version reads Answer her, O Anathoth

column.name: text
column.value: Madmenah has fled. The inhabitants of Gebim have sought refuge.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Behold, the Lord, the ①GOD of armies, will lop off the branches with terrifying power; Those also who are tall in stature will be cut down, And those who are lofty will be brought low. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with an iron axe, And Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.

column.name: text
column.value: The pronouncement concerning Babylon which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw:

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up a flag on the ①bare hill, Raise your voice to them, Wave the hand that they may enter the doors of the nobles. ▷ ①Or wind-swept mountain

column.name: text
column.value: I have commanded My consecrated ones, I have also called for My warriors Who boast in My eminence, To execute My anger.

column.name: text
column.value: A sound of a roar on the mountains, Like that of many people! A sound of an uproar of kingdoms, Of nations gathered together! The LORD of armies is mustering the army for battle.

column.name: text
column.value: They are coming from a distant country, From the ①farthest horizons, The LORD and the weapons of His indignation, To destroy the whole land. ▷ ①Lit end of heaven

column.name: text
column.value: Wail, for the day of the LORD is near! It will come as destruction from ①the Almighty. ▷ ①Heb Shaddai

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore all hands will fall limp, And every human heart will melt.

column.name: text
column.value: They will be terrified, Pains and anguish will take hold of them; They will writhe like a woman in labor, They will look at one another in astonishment, Their faces aflame.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the day of the LORD is coming, Cruel, with fury and burning anger, To make the land a desolation; And He will exterminate its sinners from it.

column.name: text
column.value: For the stars of heaven and their constellations Will not flash their light; The sun will be dark when it rises And the moon will not shed its light.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will punish the world for its evil And the wicked for their wrongdoing; I will also put an end to the audacity of the proud And humiliate the arrogance of the ①tyrants. ▷ ①Or violent

column.name: text
column.value: I will make mortal man scarcer than pure gold And mankind than the gold of Ophir.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, And the earth will be shaken from its place At the fury of the LORD of armies In the day of His burning anger.

column.name: text
column.value: And it will be that, like a hunted gazelle, Or like sheep with no one to gather them, Each of them will turn to his own people, And each of them will flee to his own land.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who is found will be thrust through, And anyone who is captured will fall by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Their little ones also will be dashed to pieces Before their eyes; Their houses will be plundered And their wives raped.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I am going to stir up the Medes against them, Who will not value silver or take pleasure in gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And their bows will ①mow down the young men, They will not even have compassion on the fruit of the womb, Nor will their eye pity ②children. ▷ ①Lit dash in pieces ②Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: And Babylon, the beauty of kingdoms, the glory of the Chaldeans’ pride, Will be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

column.name: text
text
column.value: But desert creatures will lie down there, And their houses will be full of ①owls; Ostriches also will live there, and ②shaggy goats will frolic there. ▷ ①Or howling creatures ②Or goat demons

column.name: text
column.value: ①Hyenas will howl in their fortified towers And jackals in their luxurious palaces. Her fateful time also ②will soon come, And her days will not be prolonged. ▷ ①Or howling creatures ②Lit is near to come

column.name: text
text
column.value: ①The people have gone up to the ②temple and to Dibon, to the high places to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and Medeba; Everyone’s head is bald and every beard is cut off. ▷ ①Lit He has gone; i.e., Moab, meaning the people of Moab ②Lit house

column.name: text
column.value: In their streets they have put on sackcloth; On their housetops and in their public squares Everyone is wailing, ①overcome with weeping. ▷ ①Lit going down in weeping

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: For the waters of Nimrim are ①desolate. Indeed, the grass is withered, the new growth has died, There is no greenery. ▷ ①Lit desolations

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the abundance which they have acquired and stored up, They carry it off over the brook of ①Arabim. ▷ ①Or the poplars

column.name: text
column.value: For the cry of distress has gone around the territory of Moab, Its wailing goes as far as Eglaim and its howling to Beer-elim.

column.name: text
column.value: For the waters of Dimon are full of ①blood; I will certainly bring added woes upon Dimon, A lion upon the fugitives of Moab and the remnant of the land. ▷ ①Heb dam (a wordplay)

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will say on that day, “I will give thanks to You, LORD; For although You were angry with me, Your anger is turned away, And You comfort me.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, God is my salvation, I will trust and not be afraid; For the LORD GOD is my strength and song, And He has become my salvation.”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore you will joyously draw water From the springs of salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: And on that day you will say, “Give thanks to the LORD, call on His name. Make known His deeds among the peoples; ①Make them remember that His name is exalted.” ▷ ①Or Proclaim to them that

column.name: text
text
column.value: Rejoice and shout for joy, you inhabitant of Zion, For great in your midst is the Holy One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: When the LORD has compassion on Jacob and again chooses Israel, and settles them on their own land, then strangers will join them and attach themselves to the house of Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: The peoples will take them along and bring them to their place, and the house of Israel will make them their own possession in the land of the LORD as male and female servants; and ①they will take their captors captive and will rule over their oppressors. ▷ ①Lit the captors will become their captives

column.name: text
column.value: And it will be on the day when the LORD gives you rest from your hardship, your turmoil, and from the harsh service in which you have been enslaved,

column.name: text
column.value: that you will take up this ①taunt against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased, And how the ②onslaught has ceased! ▷ ①Or proverb ②As in DSS and ancient versions; MT uncertain

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, The scepter of rulers,

column.name: text
column.value: Which used to strike the peoples in fury with unceasing strokes, Which ①subdued the nations in anger with unrestrained persecution. ▷ ①Or ruled

column.name: text
column.value: The whole earth is at rest and is quiet; They break forth into shouts of joy.

column.name: text
column.value: Even the juniper trees rejoice over you, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, ‘Since you have been laid low, no tree cutter comes up against us.’

column.name: text
text
column.value: They will all respond and say to you, ‘Even you have become weak as we, You have become like us.

column.name: text
column.value: Your pride and the music of your harps Have been brought down to Sheol; Maggots are spread out as your bed beneath you And worms are your covering.’

column.name: text
column.value: How you have fallen from heaven, You ①star of the morning, son of the dawn! You have been cut down to the earth, You who defeated the nations! ▷ ①Heb Helel; i.e., shining one

column.name: text
column.value: But you said in your heart, ‘I will ascend to heaven; I will raise my throne above the stars of God, And I will sit on the mount of assembly In the recesses of the north.

column.name: text
column.value: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will make myself like the Most High.’

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless you will be brought down to Sheol, To the recesses of the pit.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who see you will stare at you, They will ①closely examine you, saying, ‘Is this the man who made the earth tremble, Who shook kingdoms, ▷ ①Lit show themselves attentive to

column.name: text
column.value: Who made the world like a wilderness And overthrew its cities, Who did not ①allow his prisoners to go home?’ ▷ ①Lit open

column.name: text
column.value: All the kings of the nations lie in glory, Each in his own ①tomb. ▷ ①Lit house

column.name: text
column.value: But you have been hurled out of your tomb Like ①a rejected branch, ②Clothed with those killed who have been pierced with a sword, Who go down to the stones of the pit Like a trampled corpse. ▷ ①Lit an abhorred branch ②Or As the clothing of those who are slain

column.name: text
column.value: You will not be united with them in burial, Because you have ruined your country, You have killed your people. May the descendants of evildoers never be mentioned.

column.name: text
column.value: Prepare a place of slaughter for his sons Because of the wrongdoing of their fathers. They must not arise and take possession of the earth, And fill the surface of the world with cities.”

column.name: text
column.value: “I will rise up against them,” declares the LORD of armies, “and eliminate from Babylon name and survivors, offspring and descendants,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “I will also make it the property of the hedgehog and swamps of water, and I will sweep it away with the broom of destruction,” declares the LORD of armies.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD of armies has sworn, saying, “Certainly, just as I have intended, so it has happened, and just as I have planned, so it will stand,

column.name: text
column.value: to break Assyria in My land, and I will trample him on My mountains. Then his yoke will be removed from them, and his burden removed from their shoulders.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the plan ①devised against the entire earth; and this is the hand that is stretched out against all the nations. ▷ ①Lit planned

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD of armies has planned, and who can frustrate it? And as for His stretched-out hand, who can turn it back?”

column.name: text
column.value: In the year that King Ahaz died, this pronouncement came:

column.name: text
column.value: “Do not rejoice, Philistia, all of you, Because the rod that struck you is broken; For from the serpent’s root a viper will come out, And its fruit will be a winged serpent.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Those who are most helpless will eat, And the poor will lie down in security; I will kill your root with famine, And it will kill your survivors. ▷ ①Lit The firstborn of the helpless

column.name: text
column.value: Wail, you gate; cry, you city; ①Melt away, Philistia, all of you! For smoke comes from the north, And there is no straggler in his ranks. ▷ ①Or Become demoralized

column.name: text
column.value: What answer will one give the messengers of the nation? That the LORD has founded Zion, And the poor of His people will take refuge in it.”

column.name: text
column.value: Send the tribute lamb to the ruler of the land, From ①Sela by way of the wilderness to the mountain of the daughter of Zion. ▷ ①I.e., Petra in Edom

column.name: text
column.value: Then, like fluttering birds or scattered nestlings, The daughters of Moab will be at the crossing places of the Arnon.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Let the ①outcasts of Moab stay with you; Be a hiding place to them from the destroyer.” For the oppressor has come to an end, destruction has ceased, Oppressors have been removed from the land. ▷ ①As in most ancient versions; MT My outcasts, as for Moab

column.name: text
column.value: A throne will be established in faithfulness, And a judge will sit on it in trustworthiness in the tent of David; Moreover, he will seek justice, And be prompt in righteousness.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Therefore Moab will wail; everyone of Moab will wail. You will moan for the raisin cakes of Kir-hareseth As those who are utterly stricken.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Gladness and joy are taken away from the fruitful field; In the vineyards also there will be no cries of joy or jubilant shouting, No treader treads out wine in the presses, For I have made the shouting to cease.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore my ①inner being sounds like a harp for Moab. And my ②heart for Kir-hareseth. ▷ ①Lit entrails murmur ②Lit inward parts

column.name: text
column.value: So it will come about when Moab presents himself, When he tires himself upon his high place And comes to his sanctuary to pray, That he will not prevail.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the word which the LORD spoke earlier concerning Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: But now the LORD has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as ①a hired worker would count them, the glory of Moab will become contemptible along with all his great population, and his remnant will be very small and ②impotent.” ▷ ①Lit the years of a hired ②Lit not mighty

column.name: text
column.value: Woe, land of whirring wings Which lies beyond the rivers of ①Cush, ▷ ①Or Ethiopia

column.name: text
column.value: Which sends messengers by the sea, Even in papyrus vessels on the surface of the waters. Go, swift messengers, to a nation ①tall and smooth, To a people feared ②far and wide, A powerful and oppressive nation Whose land the rivers divide. ▷ ①Lit drawn out ②Lit from it and beyond

column.name: text
column.value: All you who inhabit the world, and live on earth, As soon as a flag is raised on the mountains, you will see it, And as soon as the trumpet is blown, you will hear it.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD has told me: “I will quietly look ①from My dwelling place Like dazzling heat in the ②sunshine, Like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.” ▷ ①Lit in ②Lit light

column.name: text
column.value: For before the harvest, as soon as the bud ①blossoms And the flower becomes a ripening grape, He will cut off the shoots with pruning knives, And remove and tear away the spreading branches. ▷ ①Lit is finished

column.name: text
column.value: They will be left together for mountain birds of prey, And for the animals of the earth; And the birds of prey will spend the summer feeding on them, And all the animals of the earth will spend harvest time on them.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time a gift of tribute will be brought to the LORD of armies ①From a people ②tall and smooth, From a people feared ③far and wide, A powerful and oppressive nation, Whose land the rivers divide— To the place of the name of the LORD of armies, to Mount Zion. ▷ ①Some ancient versions and DSS; MT implies Consisting of a people ②Lit drawn out ③Lit from it and beyond

column.name: text
column.value: In the year that the ①commander came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him and he fought against Ashdod and captured it, ▷ ①Heb Tartan

column.name: text
column.value: at that time the LORD spoke through Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, “Go and loosen the sackcloth from your hips and take your sandals off your feet.” And he did so, going naked and barefoot.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said, “Even as My servant Isaiah has gone naked and barefoot for three years as a sign and symbol against Egypt and ①Cush, ▷ ①Or Ethiopia, as in vv 4, 5

column.name: text
column.value: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Cush, young and old, naked and barefoot with buttocks uncovered, to the ①shame of Egypt. ▷ ①Lit nakedness

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will be terrified and ashamed because of Cush their hope and Egypt their pride.

column.name: text
column.value: So the inhabitants of this coastland will say on that day, ‘Behold, such is our hope, where we fled for help to be saved from the king of Assyria; and how are we ourselves to escape?’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: The pronouncement concerning the ①wilderness of the sea: As windstorms in the ②Negev come in turns, It comes from the wilderness, from a terrifying land. ▷ ①Or sandy wastes, sea country ②I.e., South country

column.name: text
text
text
text
text
column.value: For this is what the Lord says to me: “Go, station the lookout, have him report what he sees.

column.name: text
column.value: When he sees ①a column of chariots, horsemen in pairs, A train of donkeys, a train of camels, He is to pay close attention, very close attention.” ▷ ①Or riders

column.name: text
column.value: Then ①the lookout called, “Lord, I stand continually by day on the watchtower, And I am stationed every night at my guard post. ▷ ①As in DSS; MT he called like a lion

column.name: text
column.value: Now behold, here comes a troop of riders, horsemen in pairs.” And one said, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon; And all the images of her gods ①are shattered on the ground.” ▷ ①Lit he has shattered to the earth

column.name: text
column.value: My downtrodden people, and my ①afflicted of the threshing floor! What I have heard from the LORD of armies, The God of Israel, I make known to you. ▷ ①Lit son

column.name: text
column.value: The pronouncement concerning ①Edom: One keeps calling to me from Seir, “Watchman, ②how far gone is the night? Watchman, ③how far gone is the night?” ▷ ①As in LXX; MT Dumah, silence ②Lit what is the time of the night? ③Lit what is the time of the night?

column.name: text
column.value: The watchman says, “Morning comes but also night. If you would inquire, inquire; Come back again.”

column.name: text
column.value: The pronouncement about Arabia: In the thickets of Arabia you ①must spend the night, You caravans of Dedanites. ▷ ①Or will spend

column.name: text
column.value: Bring water ①for the thirsty, You inhabitants of the land of Tema; Meet the fugitive with bread. ▷ ①Lit to meet

column.name: text
column.value: For they have fled from the swords, From the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, And from the press of battle.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the Lord said to me: “In a year, as ①a hired worker would count it, all the splendor of Kedar will come to an end; ▷ ①Lit the years of a hired

column.name: text
column.value: and the remainder of the number of bowmen, the warriors of the sons of Kedar, will be few; for the LORD God of Israel has spoken.”

column.name: text
column.value: The pronouncement concerning Damascus: “Behold, Damascus is about to be removed from being a city And will become a fallen ruin.

column.name: text
column.value: The cities ①of Aroer are abandoned; They will be for herds ②to lie down in, And there will be no one to frighten them. ▷ ①LXX forever and ever ②Lit and they will lie down

column.name: text
column.value: The ①fortified city will disappear from Ephraim, And ②sovereignty from Damascus And the remnant of Aram; They will be like the glory of the sons of Israel,” Declares the LORD of armies. ▷ ①Or fortification ②Or royal power

column.name: text
column.value: Now on that day the glory of Jacob will ①fade, And the fatness of his flesh will become lean. ▷ ①Lit become little

column.name: text
column.value: It will be like the ①reaper gathering the standing grain, As his arm harvests the ears, Or it will be like one gleaning ears of grain In the Valley of Rephaim. ▷ ①Lit gathering of the harvest, the standing grain

column.name: text
column.value: Yet gleanings will be left in it like the ①shaking of an olive tree, Two or three olives on the topmost branch, Four or five on the branches of a fruitful tree, Declares the LORD, the God of Israel. ▷ ①Lit striking

column.name: text
column.value: On that day man will look to his Maker And his eyes will look to the Holy One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he will not look to the altars, the work of his hands, Nor will he look to that which his fingers have made, Even the ①Asherim and incense altars. ▷ ①I.e., wooden symbols of a female deity (Asherah)

column.name: text
column.value: On that day ①their strong cities will be like ②abandoned places in the forest, Or like branches which they abandoned before the sons of Israel; And ③the land will be a desolation. ▷ ①Lit his; i.e., mankind’s ②LXX the deserted places of the Amorites and the Hivites which they abandoned ③Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation And have not remembered the rock of your refuge. Therefore you plant delightful plants And set them with vine shoots of a strange god.

column.name: text
column.value: On the day that you plant it you carefully fence it in, And in the morning you bring your seed to blossom; But the harvest will flee On a day of illness and incurable pain.

column.name: text
column.value: Oh, the uproar of many peoples Who roar like the roaring of the seas, And the rumbling of nations Who rush on like the rumbling of mighty waters!

column.name: text
column.value: The nations rumble on like the rumbling of many waters, But He will rebuke them, and they will flee far away, And be chased like chaff on the mountains before the wind, Or like whirling dust before a gale.

column.name: text
column.value: At evening time, behold, there is terror! Before morning they are gone. This will be the ①fate of those who plunder us And the lot of those who pillage us. ▷ ①Lit portion

column.name: text
column.value: The pronouncement concerning the valley of vision: What is the matter with you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops?

column.name: text
column.value: You who were full of noise, You tumultuous town, you jubilant city; Your dead were not killed with the sword, Nor ①did they die in battle. ▷ ①Lit dead in battle

column.name: text
column.value: All your rulers have fled together, And have been captured ①without the bow; All of you who were found were taken captive together, ②Though they had fled far away. ▷ ①Lit from a bow ②As in ancient versions; MT They fled far away

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I say, “Look away from me, Let me weep bitterly, Do not ①try to comfort me concerning the destruction of the daughter of my people.” ▷ ①Lit insist

column.name: text
column.value: For the Lord ①GOD of armies has a day of panic, subjugation, and confusion In the valley of vision, A breaking down of walls And a crying ②to the mountain. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD ②Or against

column.name: text
column.value: Elam picked up the quiver, With the chariots, ①infantry, and horsemen; And Kir uncovered the shield. ▷ ①Lit man

column.name: text
column.value: Then your choicest valleys were full of chariots, And the horsemen took positions at the gate.

column.name: text
column.value: And He removed the ①defense of Judah. On that day you ②depended on the weapons of the house of the forest, ▷ ①Lit covering ②Lit looked to

column.name: text
text
column.value: Then you counted the houses of Jerusalem And tore down houses to fortify the wall.

column.name: text
column.value: And you made a reservoir between the two walls For the waters of the old pool. But you did not ①depend on Him who made it, Nor did you ②take into consideration Him who planned it long ago. ▷ ①Or look to, consider ②Lit see Him

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore on that day the Lord ①GOD of armies called you to weeping, to wailing, To shaving the head, and to wearing sackcloth. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, there is joy and jubilation, Killing of cattle and slaughtering of sheep, Eating of meat and drinking of wine: “Let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we may die.”

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD of armies revealed Himself ①to me: “Certainly this wrongdoing will not be ②forgiven you Until you die,” says the Lord ③GOD of armies. ▷ ①Lit in my ears ②Lit atoned for ③Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Lord ①GOD of armies says: “Come, go to this steward, To Shebna who is in charge of the royal household, ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: ‘What right do you have here, And whom do you have here, That you have cut out a tomb for yourself here, You who cut out a tomb on the height, You who carve a resting place for ①yourself in the rock? ▷ ①Lit himself

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the LORD is about to hurl you violently, you strong man. And He is about to grasp you firmly

column.name: text
column.value: And wrap you up tightly like a ball, To be driven into a vast country; There you will die, And there your splendid chariots will be, You shame of your master’s house!’

column.name: text
column.value: I will depose you from your office, And ①I will pull you down from your position. ▷ ①As in many ancient versions; MT He

column.name: text
column.value: Then it will come about on that day, That I will summon My servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,

column.name: text
column.value: And I will clothe him with your tunic And tie your sash securely around him. I will hand your ①authority over to him, And he will become a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. ▷ ①Lit dominion

column.name: text
text
column.value: I will drive him like a peg in a firm place, And he will become a throne of glory to his father’s house.

column.name: text
column.value: So they will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the ①descendants, all the least of vessels, from bowls to all the jars. ▷ ①Or perhaps, leaf

column.name: text
column.value: On that day,” declares the LORD of armies, “the peg driven into a firm place will give way; it will even break off and fall, and the load that is hanging on it will be cut off, for the LORD has spoken.”

column.name: text
column.value: The pronouncement concerning Tyre: Wail, you ships of Tarshish, For Tyre is destroyed, without house or ①harbor; It is reported to them from the land of ②Cyprus. ▷ ①Lit entering ②Heb Kittim

column.name: text
column.value: Be silent, you inhabitants of the coastland, You merchants of Sidon; ①Your messengers crossed the sea ▷ ①As in DSS; MT Who passed over the sea, they replenished you

column.name: text
column.value: And were on many waters. The grain of the ①Nile, the harvest of the River was her revenue; And she was the market of nations. ▷ ①Heb Shihor

column.name: text
column.value: Be ashamed, Sidon, For the sea speaks, the stronghold of the sea, saying, “I have neither been in labor nor given birth, I have neither brought up young men nor raised virgins.”

column.name: text
column.value: When the report reaches Egypt, They will be in anguish over the report of Tyre.

column.name: text
column.value: Pass over to Tarshish; Wail, you inhabitants of the coastland.

column.name: text
column.value: Is this your jubilant city, Whose origin is from antiquity, Whose feet used to bring her to ①colonize distant places? ▷ ①Lit sojourn afar off

column.name: text
column.value: Who has planned this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, Whose merchants were princes, whose traders were the honored of the earth?

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD of armies has planned it, to defile the pride of all beauty, To despise all the honored of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Overflow your land like the Nile, you daughter of Tarshish, There is no more ②restraint. ▷ ①Lit Pass over ②Perhaps girdle or shipyard

column.name: text
text
column.value: He has said, “You shall not be jubilant anymore, you crushed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to ①Cyprus; even there you will find no rest.” ▷ ①Heb Kittim

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans—this is the people that did not exist; Assyria allocated it for desert creatures—they erected their siege towers, they stripped its palaces, they made it a ruin.

column.name: text
column.value: Wail, you ships of Tarshish, For your stronghold is destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: Now on that day Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years like the days of one king. At the end of seventy years it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the prostitute:

column.name: text
column.value: Take your harp, wander around the city, You forgotten prostitute; Pluck the strings skillfully, sing many songs, That you may be remembered.

column.name: text
column.value: It will come about at the end of seventy years that the LORD will visit Tyre. Then she will go back to her prostitute’s wages and commit prostitution with all the kingdoms ①on the face of the earth. ▷ ①Lit of the earth on the face of the land

column.name: text
column.value: Her profit and her prostitute’s wages will be sacred to the LORD; it will not be stored up or hoarded, but her profit will become sufficient food and magnificent attire for those who dwell in the presence of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The pronouncement concerning Egypt: Behold, the LORD is riding on a swift cloud and is about to come to Egypt; The idols of Egypt will tremble at His presence, And the heart of the Egyptians will melt within them.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Then the spirit of the Egyptians will be demoralized within them; And I will confuse their strategy, So that they will resort to idols and ghosts of the dead, And to ①mediums and spiritists. ▷ ①Or ghosts and spirits

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore, I will hand the Egyptians over to a cruel master, And a ①mighty king will rule over them,” declares the Lord ②GOD of armies. ▷ ①Or fierce ②Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: The waters from the sea will dry up, And the river will be parched and dry.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①canals will emit a stench, The ②streams of Egypt will thin out and dry up; The reeds and rushes will rot away. ▷ ①Lit rivers ②Or Nile branches; i.e., the delta

column.name: text
column.value: The bulrushes by the Nile, by the ①edge of the Nile And all the sown fields by the Nile Will become dry, be driven away, and be no more. ▷ ①Or mouth

column.name: text
column.value: And the fishermen will grieve, And all those who cast a ①line into the Nile will mourn, And those who spread nets on the waters will dwindle away. ▷ ①Lit hook

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the manufacturers of linen made from combed flax And the weavers of white cloth will be ①utterly dejected. ▷ ①Lit ashamed

column.name: text
text
column.value: The officials of ①Zoan are mere fools; The advice of Pharaoh’s wisest advisers has become ②stupid. How can you say to Pharaoh, “I am a son of the wise, a son of ancient kings”? ▷ ①Or Tanis ②Or brutish

column.name: text
column.value: Well then, where are your wise men? Please let them tell you, And let them ①understand what the LORD of armies Has planned against Egypt. ▷ ①Or know

column.name: text
column.value: The officials of ①Zoan have turned out to be fools, The officials of Memphis are deluded; Those who are the cornerstone of her tribes Have ②led Egypt astray. ▷ ①Or Tanis ②Or have caused Egypt to stagger

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has mixed within her a spirit of distortion; They have led Egypt astray in all ①that it does, As a drunken person ②staggers in his vomit. ▷ ①Lit its work ②Or goes astray

column.name: text
column.value: There will be no work for Egypt Which its head or tail, its palm branch or bulrush, may do.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day the Egyptians will become like women, and they will tremble and be in great fear because of the waving of the hand of the LORD of armies, which He is going to wave over them.

column.name: text
column.value: The land of Judah will become a cause of shame to Egypt; everyone to whom it is mentioned will be in great fear because of the plan of the LORD of armies which He is making against them.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day five cities in the land of Egypt will be speaking the language of Canaan and swearing allegiance to the LORD of armies; one will be called the City of ①Destruction. ▷ ①Some mss and ancient versions the Sun

column.name: text
column.value: On that day there will be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a memorial stone to the LORD beside its border.

column.name: text
column.value: And it will become a sign and a witness to the LORD of armies in the land of Egypt; for they will cry out to the LORD because of oppressors, and He will send them a Savior and a Champion, and He will save them.

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD will make Himself known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know the LORD on that day. They will even worship with sacrifice and offering, and will make a vow to the LORD and perform it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD will strike Egypt, striking but healing; so they will return to the LORD, and He will respond to their pleas and heal them.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day there will be a road from Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrians will come into Egypt and the Egyptians into Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day Israel will be the third party to Egypt and Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the earth,

column.name: text
column.value: whom the LORD of armies has blessed, saying, “Blessed is Egypt My people, and Assyria the work of My hands, and Israel My inheritance.”

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the LORD lays the earth waste, devastates it, twists its surface, and scatters its inhabitants.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people will be like the priest, the servant like his master, the female servant like her mistress, the buyer like the seller, the lender like the borrower, the creditor like the debtor.

column.name: text
column.value: The earth will be completely laid waste and completely plundered, for the LORD has spoken this word.

column.name: text
column.value: The earth dries up and crumbles away, the mainland dries out and crumbles away, the exalted of the people of the earth dwindle.

column.name: text
column.value: The earth is also defiled ①by its inhabitants, for they violated laws, altered statutes, and broke the everlasting covenant. ▷ ①Lit under

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, a curse devours the earth, and those who live on it suffer for their guilt. Therefore, the inhabitants of the earth decrease in number, and few people are left.

column.name: text
column.value: The new wine mourns, The vine decays, All the joyful-hearted sigh.

column.name: text
column.value: The joy of tambourines ceases, The noise of revelers stops, The joy of the harp ceases.

column.name: text
column.value: They do not drink wine with song; Intoxicating drink is bitter to those who drink it.

column.name: text
column.value: The city of chaos is broken down; Every house is shut up so that no one may enter.

column.name: text
column.value: There is an outcry in the streets concerning the wine; All joy ①turns to gloom. The joy of the earth is banished. ▷ ①Lit is darkened

column.name: text
column.value: Desolation is left in the city And the gate is battered to ruins.

column.name: text
column.value: For so it will be in the midst of the earth among the peoples, As the ①shaking of an olive tree, As the gleanings when the grape harvest is over. ▷ ①Lit striking

column.name: text
text
column.value: Therefore glorify the LORD in the ①east, The name of the LORD, the God of Israel, In the ②coastlands of the sea. ▷ ①Lit region of light ②Or islands

column.name: text
column.value: From the ends of the earth we hear songs: “Glory to the Righteous One,” But I say, “ ①I am finished! I am finished! Woe to me! The treacherous deal treacherously, And the treacherous deal very treacherously.” ▷ ①Meaning uncertain

column.name: text
column.value: Terror and pit and snare ①Confront you, you inhabitant of the earth. ▷ ①Lit Are upon you

column.name: text
column.value: Then it will be that the one who flees the sound of terror will fall into the pit, And the one who ①climbs out of the pit will be caught in the snare; For the windows ②above are opened, and the foundations of the earth shake. ▷ ①Lit goes up from the midst of ②Lit from the height; i.e., heaven

column.name: text
column.value: The earth is broken apart, The earth is split through, The earth is shaken violently.

column.name: text
column.value: The earth trembles like a heavy drinker And sways like a hut, For its wrongdoing is heavy upon it, And it will fall, never to rise again.

column.name: text
column.value: So it will happen on that day, That the LORD will punish the rebellious ①angels of ②heaven on high, And the kings of the earth on earth. ▷ ①Lit host ②Lit the height in the height

column.name: text
column.value: They will be gathered together Like prisoners in the ①dungeon, And will be confined in prison; And after many days they will be punished. ▷ ①Lit pit

column.name: text
column.value: Then the moon will be ashamed and the sun be put to shame, For the LORD of armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, And His glory will be before His elders.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day the LORD will punish ①Leviathan the fleeing serpent, With His fierce and great and mighty sword, Even ②Leviathan the twisted serpent; And He will kill the dragon who lives in the sea. ▷ ①Or sea monster ②Or sea monster

column.name: text
column.value: On that day, “A ①vineyard of beauty, sing of it! ▷ ①Some mss a vineyard of wine

column.name: text
column.value: I, the LORD, am its keeper; I water it every moment. So that no one will ①damage it, I guard it night and day. ▷ ①Lit punish

column.name: text
column.value: I have no wrath. Should ①someone give Me briars and thorns in battle, Then I would step on them, I would burn them ②completely. ▷ ①Lit who ②Lit altogether

column.name: text
column.value: Or let him ①rely on My protection, Let him make peace with Me, Let him make peace with Me.” ▷ ①Lit take hold of

column.name: text
column.value: ①In the days to come Jacob will take root, Israel will blossom and sprout, And they will fill the ②whole world with fruit. ▷ ①Lit Those coming ②Lit face of the world

column.name: text
column.value: Like the striking of Him who has struck them, has He struck them? Or like the slaughter of His slain, ①have they been slain? ▷ ①Lit he was slain

column.name: text
column.value: You contended with them ①by banishing them, by driving them away. With His fierce wind He has expelled them on the day of the east wind. ▷ ①Some ancient versions by exact measure

column.name: text
text
column.value: For the fortified city is isolated, A ①homestead deserted and abandoned like the desert; There the calf will graze, And there it will lie down and ②feed on its branches. ▷ ①Lit pasture ②Lit consume

column.name: text
column.value: When its limbs are dry, they are broken off; Women come and make a fire with them, For they are not a people of discernment, Therefore their Maker will not have compassion on them. And their Creator will not be gracious to them.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day the LORD will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates River to the brook of Egypt, and you will be gathered up one by one, you sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: It will come about also on that day that a great trumpet will be blown, and those who were perishing in the land of Assyria and who were scattered in the land of Egypt will come and worship the LORD on the holy mountain in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For You have turned a city into a heap, A fortified city into a ruin; A palace of strangers is no longer a city, It will never be rebuilt.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore a strong people will glorify You; Cities of ruthless nations will revere You.

column.name: text
column.value: For You have been a stronghold for the helpless, A stronghold for the poor in his distress, A refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat; For the breath of the ruthless Is like a rain storm against a wall.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Now the LORD of armies will prepare a ①lavish banquet for all peoples on this mountain; A banquet of ②aged wine, ③choice pieces with marrow, And ④refined, aged wine. ▷ ①Lit feast of fat things; i.e., abundance ②Lit wine on the lees ③Lit fat pieces ④Lit wine refined on the lees

column.name: text
column.value: And on this mountain He will destroy the ①covering which is over all peoples, The veil which is ②stretched over all nations. ▷ ①Lit face of the covering ②Lit woven

column.name: text
column.value: He will ①swallow up death for all time, And the Lord ②GOD will wipe tears away from all faces, And He will remove the disgrace of His people from all the earth; For the LORD has spoken. ▷ ①I.e., destroy ②Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: And it will be said on that day, “Behold, this is our God for whom we have waited ①that He might save us. This is the LORD for whom we have waited; Let’s rejoice and be glad in His salvation.” ▷ ①Or and He saved us

column.name: text
column.value: For the hand of the LORD will rest on this mountain, And Moab will be trampled down in his place As straw is trampled down in the water of a manure pile.

column.name: text
column.value: And he will spread out his hands in the middle of it As a swimmer spreads out his hands to swim, But the Lord will lay low his pride together with the trickery of his hands.

column.name: text
column.value: The unassailable fortifications of your walls He will bring down, Lay low, and throw to the ground, to the dust.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city; He sets up walls and ramparts for ①security. ▷ ①Or salvation

column.name: text
column.value: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter, The one that ①remains faithful. ▷ ①Lit keeps faithfulness

column.name: text
column.value: The steadfast of mind You will keep in perfect peace, Because he trusts in You.

column.name: text
column.value: Trust in the LORD forever, For in ①GOD the LORD, we have an everlasting Rock. ▷ ①Heb YAH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: For He has brought low those who dwell on high, the unassailable city; He lays it low, He lays it low to the ground, He casts it to the dust.

column.name: text
column.value: The foot will trample it, The feet of the poor, the steps of the helpless.”

column.name: text
column.value: The way of the righteous is smooth; O Upright One, make the path of the righteous level.

column.name: text
text
column.value: At night ①my soul longs for You, Indeed, ②my spirit within me seeks You diligently; For when the earth ③experiences Your judgments, The inhabitants of the world learn righteousness. ▷ ①Lit with my soul I long ②Lit with my spirit...I seek ③Lit has

column.name: text
column.value: Though the wicked person is shown compassion, He does not learn righteousness; He deals unjustly in the land of uprightness, And does not perceive the majesty of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, Your hand is lifted up, yet they do not see it. ①They see Your zeal for the people and are put to shame; Indeed, ②fire will devour Your enemies. ▷ ①Or Let them see...and be ②Or let the fire for Your adversaries devour them

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, You will establish peace for us, Since You have also performed for us all our works.

column.name: text
text
column.value: The dead will not live, the ①departed spirits will not rise; Therefore You have punished and destroyed them, And You have eliminated all remembrance of them. ▷ ①Or shades

column.name: text
text
column.value: LORD, they sought You in distress; They ①could only whisper a prayer, Your discipline was upon them. ▷ ①Lit sound forth a whisper

column.name: text
text
column.value: We were pregnant, we writhed in labor, We gave birth, as it seems, only to wind. We could not accomplish deliverance for the earth, Nor were inhabitants of the world ①born. ▷ ①Lit fallen

column.name: text
column.value: Your dead will live; ①Their corpses will rise. You who lie in the dust, awake and shout for joy, For your dew is as the dew of the ②dawn, And the earth will ③give birth to the ④departed spirits. ▷ ①As in some ancient versions; MT My ②Lit lights ③Lit cause to fall ④Or shades

column.name: text
column.value: Come, my people, enter your rooms And close your doors behind you; Hide for a little ①while Until indignation ②runs its course. ▷ ①Lit moment ②Lit passes over

column.name: text
column.value: For behold, the LORD is about to come out from His place To punish the inhabitants of the earth for their wrongdoing; And the earth will reveal her bloodshed And will no longer cover her slain.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to the proud crown of the habitually drunk of Ephraim, And to the fading flower of its glorious beauty, Which is at the head of the ①fertile valley Of those who are ②overcome with wine! ▷ ①Lit valley of fatness ②Lit stricken

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the Lord has a strong and mighty agent; As a storm of hail, a tempest of destruction, Like a storm of mighty overflowing waters, He has thrown it down to the earth with His hand.

column.name: text
column.value: The splendid crown of the habitually drunk of Ephraim is trampled underfoot.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fading flower of its glorious beauty, Which is at the head of the ①fertile valley, Will be like the first-ripe fig prior to the summer, Which ②one sees, And ③as soon as it is in his ④hand, He swallows it. ▷ ①Lit valley of fatness ②Lit the one seeing sees ③Lit while it is yet ④Lit palm

column.name: text
column.value: On that day the LORD of armies will become a beautiful crown And a glorious wreath to the remnant of His people;

column.name: text
column.value: A spirit of justice for him who sits in judgment, A strength to those who repel the ①onslaught at the gate. ▷ ①Lit battle

column.name: text
column.value: And these also reel with wine and stagger from intoxicating drink: The priest and the prophet reel with intoxicating drink, They are confused by wine, they stagger from intoxicating drink; They reel while ①having visions, They stagger when rendering a verdict. ▷ ①Lit seeing

column.name: text
column.value: For all the tables are full of filthy vomit, without a single clean place.

column.name: text
column.value: “To whom would He teach knowledge, And to whom would He interpret the message? Those just weaned from milk? Those just taken from the breast?

column.name: text
column.value: For He says, ‘ ①Order on order, order on order, Line on line, line on line, A little here, a little there.’ ” ▷ ①Heb Sav lasav, sav lasav, Kav lakav, kav lakav, Zeer sham, zeer sham. These Hebrew fragments, imitating the babbling of a child, mock the prophet’s preaching.

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, He will speak to this people Through stammering lips and a foreign tongue,

column.name: text
column.value: He who said to them, “This is the place of quiet, give rest to the weary,” And, “This is the resting place,” but they would not listen.

column.name: text
column.value: So the word of the LORD to them will be, “ ①Order on order, order on order, Line on line, line on line, A little here, a little there,” That they may go and stumble backward, be broken, snared, and taken captive. ▷ ①See note v 10. The LORD responds to their scoffing by imitating their mockery, to represent the unintelligible language of a conqueror.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, hear the word of the LORD, you scoffers, Who rule this people who are in Jerusalem,

column.name: text
