column.value: Because you have said, “We have made a covenant with death, And with ①Sheol we have made a ②pact. The ③gushing flood will not reach us when it passes by, Because we have made falsehood our refuge and we have concealed ourselves with deception.” ▷ ①I.e., the netherworld ②As in some ancient versions; MT seer ③Or overwhelming scourge

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the Lord ①GOD says: “Behold, I am laying a stone in Zion, a tested stone, A precious cornerstone for the foundation, ②firmly placed. The one who believes in it will not be ③disturbed. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD ②Lit well-laid ③Lit in a hurry

column.name: text
column.value: I will make justice the measuring line And righteousness the level; Then hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, And the waters will overflow the secret place.

column.name: text
column.value: Your covenant with death will be ①canceled, And your pact with Sheol will not stand; When the ②gushing flood passes through, Then you will become its trampling ground. ▷ ①Lit covered over ②Or overwhelming scourge

column.name: text
column.value: As often as it passes through, it will ①seize you; For morning after morning it will pass through, anytime during the day or night, And it will be ②sheer terror to understand ③what it means.” ▷ ①Lit take ②Lit only ③Lit the report; or the message

column.name: text
column.value: The bed is too short on which to stretch out, And the blanket is too ①small to wrap oneself in. ▷ ①Lit narrow

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD will rise up as at Mount Perazim, He will be stirred up as in the Valley of Gibeon, To do His task, His ①unusual task, And to work His work, His ②extraordinary work. ▷ ①Lit task is strange ②Lit work is foreign

column.name: text
column.value: And now do not carry on as scoffers, Or your shackles will be made stronger; For I have heard from the Lord ①GOD of armies Of decisive destruction on all the earth. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Listen and hear my voice, Pay attention and hear my words.

column.name: text
column.value: Does the ①farmer plow ②continually to plant seed? Does he continually ③turn and break up his ground? ▷ ①Lit plowman ②Lit all day ③Lit open

column.name: text
column.value: Does he not level its surface And sow dill and scatter cumin And ①plant wheat in rows, Barley in its place and rye within its ②area? ▷ ①Lit put ②Lit region

column.name: text
column.value: For his God instructs and teaches him properly.

column.name: text
column.value: For dill is not threshed with a threshing sledge, Nor is the cartwheel ①driven over cumin; But dill is beaten out with a rod, and cumin with a club. ▷ ①Lit rolled

column.name: text
column.value: Grain for bread is crushed, Indeed, he does not continue to thresh it forever. Because the wheel of his cart and his horses eventually ①damage it, He does not thresh it longer. ▷ ①Lit discomfit

column.name: text
column.value: This also comes from the LORD of armies, Who has made His counsel wonderful and His wisdom great.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe, ①Ariel, ②Ariel the city where David once camped! Add year to year, ③keep your feasts on schedule. ▷ ①I.e., Lion of God, or Jerusalem ②I.e., Lion of God, or Jerusalem ③Lit let your feasts run their round

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring distress to Ariel, And she will be a city of grieving and mourning; And she will be like an ①Ariel to me. ▷ ①Ariel (i.e., Jerusalem) is a Heb word for “altar hearth” where offerings were burned

column.name: text
column.value: I will camp against you ①encircling you, And I will set up siegeworks against you, And I will raise up battle towers against you. ▷ ①Lit like a circle

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will be brought low; From the earth you will speak, And from the dust where you are prostrate Your words will come. Your voice will also be like that of a ①spirit from the ground, And your speech will whisper from the dust. ▷ ①Or ghost

column.name: text
column.value: But the multitude of your ①enemies will become like fine dust, And the multitude of the ruthless ones like the chaff which ②blows away; And it will happen instantly, suddenly. ▷ ①Lit strangers ②Lit passes away

column.name: text
column.value: From the LORD of armies you will be punished with thunder and earthquake and loud noise, With whirlwind and tempest and the flame of a consuming fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And the multitude of all the nations who wage war against ①Ariel, Even all who wage war against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, Will be like a dream, a vision of the night. ▷ ①See note 1 v 1

column.name: text
column.value: It will be as when a hungry person dreams— And behold, he is eating; But when he awakens, his ①hunger is not satisfied, Or as when a thirsty person dreams— And behold, he is drinking, But when he awakens, behold, he is faint And his ②thirst is not quenched. So will the multitude of all the nations be Who wage war against Mount Zion. ▷ ①Lit soul ②Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: Be delayed and horrified, Blind yourselves and be blind; They become drunk, but not with wine, They stagger, but not with intoxicating drink.

column.name: text
text
column.value: The entire vision will be to you like the words of a sealed ①book, which, when they give it to the one who ②is literate, saying, “Please read this,” he will say, “I cannot, because it is sealed.” ▷ ①Or scroll ②Lit knows books

column.name: text
column.value: Then the ①book will be given to the one who ②is illiterate, saying, “Please read this.” And he will say, “I ③cannot read.” ▷ ①Or scroll ②Lit does not know books ③Lit do not know books

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Lord said, “Because this people approaches Me with their ①words And honors Me with their lips, But their heart is far away from Me, And their ②reverence for Me ③consists of the commandment of men that is taught; ▷ ①Lit mouth ②Lit fear of Me ③Lit is

column.name: text
text
column.value: Woe to those who deeply hide their ①plans from the LORD, And whose deeds are done in a dark place, And they say, “Who sees us?” or “Who knows us?” ▷ ①Lit counsel

column.name: text
column.value: You turn things around! Shall the potter be considered ①as equal with the clay, That what is made would say to its maker, “He did not make me”; Or what is formed say to him who formed it, “He has no understanding”? ▷ ①Lit like

column.name: text
column.value: Is it not yet just a little while ①Before Lebanon will be turned into a fertile field, And the fertile field will be considered as a forest? ▷ ①Lit And

column.name: text
column.value: On that day those who are deaf will hear words of a book, And out of their gloom and darkness the eyes of those who are blind will see.

column.name: text
column.value: The afflicted also will increase their joy in the LORD, And the needy of mankind will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: For the ruthless will come to an end and the scorner will be finished, Indeed all who ①are intent on doing evil will be eliminated, ▷ ①Lit watch evil

column.name: text
column.value: Who ①cause a person to be indicted by a word, And set a trap for the arbitrator at the gate, And ②defraud the one in the right with ③meaningless arguments. ▷ ①Lit bring a person under condemnation ②Lit turn aside ③Lit confusion

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, says concerning the house of Jacob: “Jacob will not be ashamed now, nor will his face turn pale now;

column.name: text
column.value: But when ①he sees his children, the work of My hands, in his midst, They will sanctify My name; Indeed, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, And will stand in awe of the God of Israel. ▷ ①Or his children see

column.name: text
column.value: Those who err in ①mind will know ②the truth, And those who ③criticize will ④accept instruction. ▷ ①Lit spirit ②Lit understanding ③Lit murmur ④Lit learn

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help And rely on horses, And trust in chariots because they are many And in horsemen because they are very strong, But they do not look to the Holy One of Israel, nor seek the LORD!

column.name: text
column.value: Yet He also is wise and will bring disaster, And does not retract His words, But will arise against the house of evildoers, And against the help of the workers of injustice.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Egyptians are human and not God, And their horses are flesh and not spirit; So the LORD will stretch out His hand, And any helper will stumble, And one who is helped will fall. And all of them will come to an end together.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says to me: “As the lion or the young lion growls over his prey, Against which a band of shepherds is called out, And he will not be terrified at their voice nor disturbed at their noise, So will the LORD of armies come down to wage war on Mount Zion and on its hill.”

column.name: text
column.value: Like ①flying birds so the LORD of armies will protect Jerusalem. He will protect and save it; He will pass over and rescue it. ▷ ①Or hovering

column.name: text
column.value: Return to Him against whom ①you have been profoundly obstinate, you sons of Israel. ▷ ①Lit they

column.name: text
column.value: For on that day every person will reject his silver idols and his gold idols, which your hands have made for you as a sin.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Assyrian will fall by a sword not wielded by a man, And a sword not of man will devour him. So he will ①not escape the sword, And his young men will become forced laborers. ▷ ①Lit flee

column.name: text
column.value: “His rock will pass away because of panic, And his officers will be terrified by the flag,” Declares the LORD, whose fire is in Zion and whose furnace is in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: “Woe to the rebellious children,” declares the LORD, “Who execute a plan, but not Mine, And ①make an alliance, but not of My Spirit, In order to add sin to sin; ▷ ①Lit pour out a drink offering

column.name: text
column.value: Who proceed down to Egypt Without consulting ①Me, To take refuge in the safety of Pharaoh, And to seek shelter in the shadow of Egypt! ▷ ①Lit My mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the safety of Pharaoh will be your shame, And the shelter in the shadow of Egypt, your humiliation.

column.name: text
column.value: For their officials are at Zoan And their ambassadors arrive at Hanes.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone will be ashamed because of a people who do not benefit them, Who are not a help or benefit, but a source of shame and also disgrace.”

column.name: text
column.value: The pronouncement concerning the animals of the Negev: Through a land of distress and anguish, From ①where come lioness and lion, viper and flying serpent, They carry their riches on the ②backs of young donkeys, And their treasures on camels’ humps, To a people who will not benefit them; ▷ ①Lit them ②Lit shoulders

column.name: text
column.value: Even Egypt, whose help is vain and empty. Therefore, I have called ①her “ ②Rahab who has been exterminated.” ▷ ①Lit this one ②MT They are Rahab or arrogance, to remain; i.e., Egypt, as a sea monster; see note Job

column.name: text
column.value: Now go, write it on a tablet in their presence And inscribe it on a scroll, That it may ①serve in the time to come ②As a witness forever. ▷ ①Lit be ②As in most ancient versions; MT Forever and ever

column.name: text
column.value: For this is a rebellious people, false sons, Sons who ①refuse to listen To the ②instruction of the LORD; ▷ ①Lit are not willing ②Or Law

column.name: text
column.value: Who say to the seers, “You must not see visions”; And to the prophets, “You must not prophesy the truth to us. Speak to us ①pleasant words, Prophesy illusions. ▷ ①Lit smooth things

column.name: text
column.value: Get out of the way, turn aside from the path, Stop speaking before us about the Holy One of Israel!”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the Holy One of Israel says: “Since you have rejected this word And have put your trust in oppression and crookedness, and have relied on them,

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this wrongdoing will be to you Like a breach about to fall, A bulge in a high wall, Whose collapse comes suddenly in an instant,

column.name: text
column.value: Whose collapse is like the smashing of a potter’s jar, ①So ruthlessly shattered That a shard will not be found among its pieces To ②take fire from a hearth Or to scoop water from a cistern.” ▷ ①Lit Crushed, it will not be spared ②Lit snatch up

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the Lord ①GOD, the Holy One of Israel, has said: “In ②repentance and rest you will be saved, In quietness and trust is your strength.” But you were not willing, ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD ②Lit returning

column.name: text
column.value: And you said, “No, for we will flee on horses!” Therefore you shall flee! “And we will ride on swift horses!” Therefore those who pursue you shall be swift.

column.name: text
column.value: One thousand will flee at the threat of one man; You will flee at the threat of five, Until you are left like a signal post on a mountain top, And like a flag on a hill.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the LORD ①longs to be gracious to you, And therefore He ②waits on high to have compassion on you. For the LORD is a God of justice; How blessed are all those who ③long for Him. ▷ ①Lit waits ②Lit is on high ③Lit wait

column.name: text
column.value: ①For, you people in Zion, inhabitant in Jerusalem, you will weep no longer. He will certainly be gracious to you at the sound of your cry; when He hears it, He will answer you. ▷ ①MT For a people will inhabit Zion, Jerusalem

column.name: text
column.value: Although the Lord has given you bread of deprivation and water of oppression, He, your Teacher, will no longer hide Himself, but your eyes will see your Teacher.

column.name: text
column.value: Your ears will hear a word behind you, saying, “This is the way, walk in it,” whenever you turn to the right or to the left.

column.name: text
column.value: And you will desecrate your carved images plated with silver, and your cast metal images plated with gold. You will scatter them as a filthy thing, and say to ①them, “Be gone!” ▷ ①Lit it “Go out”

column.name: text
column.value: Then He will give you rain for your seed which you will sow in the ground, and bread from the yield of the ground, and it will be ①rich and ②plentiful; on that day your livestock will graze in a wide pasture. ▷ ①Lit fatness ②Lit fat

column.name: text
column.value: Also the oxen and the donkeys that work the ground will eat ①seasoned feed, which ②has been winnowed with shovel and pitchfork. ▷ ①Lit sorrel-seasoned ②Lit one winnows

column.name: text
column.value: And on every lofty mountain and every high hill there will be ①streams running with water on the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall. ▷ ①Lit canals, streams of water

column.name: text
column.value: And the light of the full moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, on the day the LORD binds up the fracture of His people and heals the wound ①He has inflicted. ▷ ①Lit of His blow

column.name: text
text
column.value: His breath is like an overflowing river, Which reaches to the neck, To shake the nations back and forth in a ①sieve, And to put in the jaws of the peoples the bridle which leads astray. ▷ ①Lit sifting of the worthless

column.name: text
column.value: You will have ①songs as in the night when you keep the festival, And gladness of heart as when one marches to the sound of the flute, To go to the mountain of the LORD, to the Rock of Israel. ▷ ①Lit the song

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD will cause ①His voice of authority to be heard, And the ②descending of His arm to be seen in fierce anger, And in the flame of a consuming fire In cloudburst, downpour, and hailstones. ▷ ①Lit the majesty of His voice ②Lit descent

column.name: text
column.value: For at the voice of the LORD Assyria will be terrified, When He strikes with the rod.

column.name: text
column.value: And every ①blow of the ②rod of punishment, Which the LORD will lay on him, Will be with the music of tambourines and lyres; And in battles, brandishing weapons, He will fight them. ▷ ①Lit passing ②Lit staff of foundation

column.name: text
column.value: For ①Topheth has long been ready, Indeed, it has been prepared for the king. He has made it deep and large, ②A pyre of fire with plenty of wood; The breath of the LORD, like a torrent of brimstone, sets it afire. ▷ ①I.e., the place of human sacrifice to Molech ②Lit Its pile

column.name: text
column.value: Come near, you nations, to hear; and listen, you peoples! Let the earth and ①all it contains hear, and the world and all that springs from it. ▷ ①Lit its fullness

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD’S anger is against all the nations, And His wrath against all their armies. He has ①utterly destroyed them, He has turned them over to slaughter. ▷ ①Lit put under the ban

column.name: text
column.value: So their slain will be thrown out, And their corpses ①will give off their stench, And the mountains will ②be drenched with their blood. ▷ ①Lit their stench will go up ②Lit dissolve

column.name: text
column.value: And all the heavenly ①lights will ②wear away, And the sky will be rolled up like a scroll; All its ③lights will also wither away As a leaf withers from the vine, Or as one withers from the fig tree. ▷ ①Lit host; i.e., sun, stars, etc. ②Lit rot ③Lit host; i.e., sun, stars, etc.

column.name: text
text
column.value: The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, It drips with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, With the fat of the kidneys of rams. For the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, And a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

column.name: text
column.value: Wild oxen will also ①fall with them And young bulls with strong ones; So their land will be soaked with blood, And their dust ②become greasy with fat. ▷ ①Lit go down ②Lit made fat

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD has a day of vengeance, A year of retribution for the ①cause of Zion. ▷ ①Or controversy

column.name: text
column.value: ①Its streams will be turned into pitch, And its loose earth into brimstone, And its land will become burning pitch. ▷ ①I.e., Edom’s

column.name: text
text
column.value: But ①pelican and hedgehog will possess it, And ②owl and raven will dwell in it; And He will stretch over it the line of ③desolation And the ④plumb line of emptiness. ▷ ①Or owl; or jackdaw ②Or great horned owl ③Or formlessness ④Lit stones of void

column.name: text
column.value: Its nobles—there is no one there Whom they may proclaim king— And all its officials will be nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: Thorns will come up in its fortified towers, Weeds and thistles in its fortified cities; It will also be a haunt of jackals And a habitat of ostriches.

column.name: text
column.value: The desert creatures will meet with the ①wolves, The ②goat also will cry to its kind. Yes, the ③night-bird will settle there And will find herself a resting place. ▷ ①Or howling creatures ②Or goat demon ③Or a demon; Heb Lilith

column.name: text
column.value: The tree snake will make its nest and lay eggs there, And it will hatch and gather them under its ①protection. Yes, the ②hawks will be gathered there, Every one with its kind. ▷ ①Lit shade ②Or kites

column.name: text
column.value: Seek from the book of the LORD, and read: Not one of these will be missing; None will lack its mate. For ①His mouth has commanded, And His Spirit has gathered them. ▷ ①As in DSS; MT My

column.name: text
column.value: He has cast the lot for them, And His hand has divided it to them by the measuring line. They shall possess it forever; From generation to generation they will dwell in it.

column.name: text
text
column.value: LORD, be gracious to us; we have waited for You. Be ①their ②strength every morning, Our salvation also in the time of distress. ▷ ①Some ancient versions our ②Lit arm

column.name: text
column.value: At the sound of a roar, peoples flee; At the lifting up of Yourself, nations disperse.

column.name: text
column.value: Your plunder is gathered as the caterpillar gathers; Like an infestation of locusts, people storm it.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is exalted, for He dwells on high; He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: And He will be the ①stability of your times, A wealth of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge; The fear of the LORD is his treasure. ▷ ①Or faithfulness

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, their brave men cry out ①in the streets, The ②ambassadors of peace weep bitterly. ▷ ①Lit outside ②Lit messengers

column.name: text
column.value: The highways are desolate, ①the traveler has ceased, He has broken the covenant, he has despised the cities, He has no regard for mankind. ▷ ①Lit one who passes along the way

column.name: text
column.value: The land mourns and wastes away, Lebanon is shamed and withers; Sharon is like a desert plain, And Bashan and Carmel ①lose their foliage. ▷ ①Lit shake off

column.name: text
column.value: “Now I will arise,” says the LORD, “Now I will be exalted, now I will be lifted up.

column.name: text
text
column.value: The peoples will be burned to lime, Like cut thorns which are burned in the fire.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Sinners in Zion are terrified; Trembling has seized the godless. “Who among us can live with the consuming fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?”

column.name: text
text
column.value: He will dwell on the heights, His refuge will be the ①impregnable rock; His bread will be given him, His water will be sure. ▷ ①Lit stronghold of rock

column.name: text
column.value: Your eyes will see the King in His beauty; They will see a distant land.

column.name: text
column.value: Your heart will meditate on terror: “Where is one who counts? Where is one who weighs? Where is one who counts the towers?”

column.name: text
column.value: You will no longer see a fierce people, A people of ①unintelligible speech ②which no one comprehends, Of a stammering tongue ③which no one understands. ▷ ①Lit deepness of lip ②Lit from hearing ③Lit there is no understanding

column.name: text
text
column.value: But there the majestic One, the LORD, will be for us A place of rivers and wide canals On which no boat with oars will go, And on which no mighty ship will pass—

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD is our judge, The LORD is our lawgiver, The LORD is our king; He will save us—

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Behold, a king will reign righteously, And officials will rule justly.

column.name: text
column.value: Each will be like a refuge from the wind And a shelter from the storm, Like ①streams of water in a dry country, Like the shade of a ②huge rock in an exhausted land. ▷ ①Lit canals ②Lit heavy

column.name: text
column.value: Then the eyes of those who see will not be ①blinded, And the ears of those who hear will listen. ▷ ①Or turned away

column.name: text
column.value: The ①mind of the rash will discern the ②truth, And the tongue of the stammerers will hurry to speak clearly. ▷ ①Lit heart ②Lit knowledge

column.name: text
column.value: No longer will the fool be called noble, Or the rogue be spoken of as generous.

column.name: text
column.value: For a fool speaks nonsense, And his heart ①inclines toward wickedness: To practice ungodliness and to speak error against the LORD, To ②keep the hungry person unsatisfied And ③to withhold drink from the thirsty. ▷ ①Or does ②Lit make empty the hungry soul ③Lit he deprives the thirsty

column.name: text
column.value: As for a rogue, his weapons are evil; He devises wicked schemes To destroy the poor with ①slander, Even though the needy one speaks ②what is right. ▷ ①Lit words of falsehood ②Lit justly

column.name: text
column.value: But the noble person devises noble plans; And by noble plans he stands.

column.name: text
column.value: Rise up, you women who are at ease, And hear my voice; Listen to my word, You complacent daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Within a year and a few days You will be troubled, you complacent daughters; For the vintage is ended, And the fruit gathering will not come.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine,

column.name: text
column.value: For the land of my people in which thorns and briars will come up; Indeed, for all the joyful houses and for the jubilant city.

column.name: text
column.value: For the palace has been neglected, the ①populated city abandoned. ②Hill and watch-tower have become caves forever, A delight for wild donkeys, a pasture for flocks, ▷ ①Lit multitude of the ②Or Ophel

column.name: text
column.value: Until the Spirit is poured out upon us from on high, And the wilderness becomes a fertile field, And the fertile field is considered as a forest.

column.name: text
column.value: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness, And righteousness will remain in the fertile field.

column.name: text
column.value: And the work of righteousness will be peace, And the service of righteousness, quietness and ①confidence forever. ▷ ①Or security

column.name: text
column.value: Then my people will live in a peaceful settlement, In secure dwellings, and in undisturbed resting places;

column.name: text
column.value: And it will hail when the forest comes down, And the city will be utterly laid low.

column.name: text
column.value: How blessed will you be, you who sow beside all waters, Who ①let the ox and the donkey out freely. ▷ ①Lit send out the foot of the ox

column.name: text
column.value: The wilderness and the desert will rejoice, And the ①desert will shout for joy and blossom; Like the crocus ▷ ①Or Arabah

column.name: text
column.value: It will blossom profusely And rejoice with joy and jubilation. The glory of Lebanon will be given to it, The majesty of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the glory of the LORD, The majesty of our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Strengthen the ①exhausted, and make the ②feeble strong. ▷ ①Lit slack hands ②Lit tottering knees

column.name: text
column.value: Say to those with anxious heart, “Take courage, fear not. Behold, your God will come with vengeance; The retribution of God will come, But He will save you.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the eyes of those who are blind will be opened, And the ears of those who are deaf will be unstopped.

column.name: text
column.value: Then those who limp will leap like a deer, And the tongue of those who cannot speak will shout for joy. For waters will burst forth in the wilderness, And streams in the ①desert. ▷ ①Or Arabah

column.name: text
column.value: The ①scorched land will become a pool And the thirsty ground springs of water; In the haunt of jackals, its resting place, Grass becomes reeds and rushes. ▷ ①Or mirage

column.name: text
column.value: A highway will be there, a roadway, And it will be called the Highway of Holiness. The unclean will not travel on it, But it will be for the one who walks that way, And fools will not wander on it.

column.name: text
column.value: No lion will be there, Nor will any vicious animal go up on it; ①They will not be found there. But the redeemed will walk there, ▷ ①Lit It

column.name: text
column.value: And the redeemed of the LORD will return And come to Zion with joyful shouting, And everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, And sorrow and sighing will flee away.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria marched against all the fortified cities of Judah and seized them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to King Hezekiah with a large army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool on the road to the ①fuller’s field. ▷ ①I.e., launderer’s

column.name: text
column.value: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph, the secretary, went out to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rabshakeh said to them, “Say now to Hezekiah, ‘This is what the great king, the king of Assyria says: “What is this confidence that you have?

column.name: text
column.value: I say, ‘Your plan and strength for the war are only ①empty words.’ Now on whom have you relied, that you have revolted against me? ▷ ①Lit a word of lips

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, you have relied on the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt, on which if a man leans, it will go into his ①hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who rely on him. ▷ ①Lit palm

column.name: text
column.value: But if you say to me, ‘We trust in the LORD our God,’ is it not He whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar’?

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, come make a wager with my master the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to put riders on them!

column.name: text
column.value: How then can you ①drive back even one ②official of the least of my master’s servants and ③rely on Egypt for chariots and horsemen? ▷ ①Lit turn away the face of ②Or governor ③Lit rely on for yourself

column.name: text
column.value: And have I now come up ①without the LORD’S approval against this land to destroy it? The LORD said to me, ‘Go up against this land and destroy it.’ ” ’ ” ▷ ①Lit without the LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Then Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we ①understand it; and do not speak to us in ②Judean ③so that the people who are on the wall hear you.” ▷ ①Lit hear ②I.e., Hebrew ③Lit in the ears of...wall

column.name: text
column.value: But Rabshakeh said, “Has my master sent me only to your master and to you to speak these words, and not to the men who sit on the wall, doomed to eat their own dung and drink their own urine with you?”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Rabshakeh stood and called out with a loud voice in Judean and said, “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the king says: ‘Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to save you;

column.name: text
column.value: and do not let Hezekiah lead you to rely on the LORD, saying, “The LORD will certainly save us. This city will not be handed over to the king of Assyria!”

column.name: text
column.value: Do not listen to Hezekiah,’ for this is what the king of Assyria says: ‘ ①Surrender to me and come out to me, and eat, each one, of his vine and each of his fig tree, and each drink of the waters of his own cistern, ▷ ①Lit Make with me a blessing

column.name: text
column.value: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

column.name: text
column.value: Beware that Hezekiah does not mislead you, saying, “The LORD will save us.” Has any one of the gods of the nations saved his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?

column.name: text
column.value: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? And when have they saved Samaria from my hand?

column.name: text
column.value: Who among all the gods of these lands have saved their land from my hand, that the LORD would save Jerusalem from my hand?’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: But they were silent and did not answer him so much as a word; for the king’s command was, “Do not answer him.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph, the secretary, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and reported to him the words of Rabshakeh.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days Hezekiah became ①mortally ill. And Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him and said to him, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Set your house in order, for you are going to die and not live.’ ” ▷ ①Lit sick to death

column.name: text
column.value: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: and said, “Please, LORD, just remember how I have walked before You wholeheartedly and in truth, and have done what is good in Your sight.” And Hezekiah wept ①profusely. ▷ ①Lit great weeping

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to Isaiah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Go and say to Hezekiah, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of your father David says: “I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears; behold, I will add fifteen years to your ①life. ▷ ①Lit days

column.name: text
column.value: And I will save you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will protect this city.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: “And this shall be the sign to you from the LORD, that the LORD will perform this word that He has spoken:

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will make the shadow on the stairway, which has gone down with the sun on the stairway of Ahaz, go back ten steps.” So the sun’s shadow went back ten steps on the stairway on which it had gone down.

column.name: text
column.value: This is a writing of Hezekiah king of Judah after his illness and ①recovery: ▷ ①Lit he lived after his illness

column.name: text
column.value: I said, “In the middle of my ①life I am to enter the gates of Sheol; I have been deprived of the rest of my years.” ▷ ①Lit days

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: I composed my soul until morning. Like a lion—so He breaks all my bones, From day until night You make an end of me.

column.name: text
text
column.value: “What shall I say? ①For He has spoken to me, and He Himself has done it; I will walk ②quietly all my years because of the bitterness of my soul. ▷ ①Targum and DSS And what shall I say for He ②Or slowly

column.name: text
column.value: Lord, by these things people live, And in all these is the life of my spirit; ①Restore me to health and let me live! ▷ ①Lit You will

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, for my own welfare I had great bitterness; But You have ①kept my soul from the pit of ②nothingness, For You have hurled all my sins behind Your back. ▷ ①As in some ancient versions; MT loved ②Or destruction

column.name: text
text
column.value: It is the living who give thanks to You, as I do today; A father tells his sons about Your faithfulness.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Now Isaiah had said, “Have them take a cake of figs and apply it to the boil, so that he may recover.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Hezekiah had said, “What is the sign that I will go up to the house of the LORD?”

column.name: text
column.value: At that time Merodach-baladan son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah, for he heard that he had been sick and had recovered.

column.name: text
column.value: Hezekiah ①was pleased, and let them see all his treasure house, the silver, the gold, the balsam oil, the excellent olive oil, his entire armory, and everything that was found in his treasuries. There was nothing in his house nor in all his realm that Hezekiah did not let them see. ▷ ①Lit rejoiced over them

column.name: text
column.value: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah and said to him, “What did these men say, and from where did they come to you?” And Hezekiah said, “They came to me from a far country, from Babylon.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said, “What have they seen in your house?” So Hezekiah ①answered, “They have seen everything that is in my house; there is nothing among my treasuries that I have not let them see.” ▷ ①Lit said

column.name: text
column.value: Isaiah then said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of the LORD of armies,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Behold, the days are coming when everything that is in your house, and what your fathers have stored up to this day, will be carried to Babylon; nothing will be left,’ says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘And some of your sons who will come from you, whom you will father, will be taken away, and they will become eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “The word of the LORD which you have spoken is good.” For he ①thought, “For there will be peace and truth in my days.” ▷ ①Lit said

column.name: text
column.value: Now when King Hezekiah heard the report, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and entered the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he sent Eliakim, who was in charge of the household, with Shebna the scribe and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to him, “This is what Hezekiah says: ‘This day is a day of distress, rebuke, and humiliation; for children have come to the point of birth, and there is no strength to ①deliver them. ▷ ①Lit give birth

column.name: text
column.value: Perhaps the LORD your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to taunt the living God, and will avenge the words which the LORD your God has heard. Therefore, offer a prayer for the remnant that is left.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaiah said to them, “This is what you shall say to your master: ‘This is what the LORD says: “Do not be afraid because of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed Me.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I am going to put a spirit in him so that he will hear news and return to his own land. And I will make him fall by the sword in his own land.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria fighting against Libnah, for he had heard that ①the king had left Lachish. ▷ ①Lit he

column.name: text
column.value: Now he heard them say regarding Tirhakah king of ①Cush, “He has come out to fight against you,” and when he heard it he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying, ▷ ①Or Ethiopia

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what you shall say to Hezekiah king of ①Judah: ‘Do not let your God in whom you trust deceive you by saying, “Jerusalem will not be handed over to the king of Assyria.” ▷ ①Lit Judah, saying

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, you yourself have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the lands, destroying them completely. So will you be saved?

column.name: text
column.value: Did the gods of the nations which my fathers destroyed save them: Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the sons of Eden who were in Telassar?

column.name: text
column.value: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, the king of the city of Sepharvaim, and of Hena and Ivvah?’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Hezekiah took the ①letter from the hand of the messengers and read it, and he went up to the house of the LORD and ②spread it out before the LORD. ▷ ①Lit letters ②Lit Hezekiah spread

column.name: text
column.value: Hezekiah prayed to the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “LORD of armies, God of Israel, who is enthroned above the cherubim, You are the God, You alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You made heaven and earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Incline Your ear, LORD, and hear; open Your eyes, LORD, and see; and listen to all the words of Sennacherib, who sent them to taunt the living God.

column.name: text
column.value: Truly, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the countries and their lands,

column.name: text
column.value: and have thrown their gods into the fire, for they were not gods but only the work of human hands, wood and stone. So they have destroyed them.

column.name: text
column.value: But now LORD, our God, save us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that You alone, ①LORD, are God.” ▷ ①As in DSS and 2 Kin 19:19; MT are the LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent word to Hezekiah, saying, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘Because you have prayed to Me about Sennacherib king of Assyria,

column.name: text
column.value: this is the word that the LORD has spoken against him: “She has shown contempt for you and derided you, The virgin daughter of Zion; The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head behind you!

column.name: text
column.value: Whom have you taunted and blasphemed? And against whom have you raised your voice And ①haughtily raised your eyes? Against the Holy One of Israel! ▷ ①Lit on high

column.name: text
column.value: Through your servants you have taunted the Lord, And you have said, ‘With my many chariots I came up to the heights of the mountains, To the remotest parts of Lebanon; And I cut down its tall cedars and its choice junipers. And I will come to its ①highest peak, its thickest forest. ▷ ①Lit farthest height

column.name: text
column.value: I dug wells and drank waters, And with the sole of my feet I dried up All the canals of ①Egypt.’ ▷ ①Or the besieged place

column.name: text
column.value: Have you not heard? Long ago I did it, From ancient times I planned it. Now I have brought it about That you would turn fortified cities into ruined heaps.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore their inhabitants were ①powerless, They were shattered and put to shame; They were like the vegetation of the field and the green grass, Like grass on the housetops ②that is scorched before it has grown. ▷ ①Lit short of hand ②As in DSS and 2 Kin 19:26; MT and as a terraced field

column.name: text
column.value: But I know your sitting down, Your going out, your coming in, And your raging against Me.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of your raging against Me And because your complacency has come up to My ears, I will put My hook in your nose And My bridle in your lips, And I will turn you back by the way that you came.

column.name: text
column.value: “Then this shall be the sign for you: ①you will eat this year what grows of itself, in the second year what grows from the same, and in the third year sow, harvest, plant vineyards, and eat their fruit. ▷ ①Lit eating

column.name: text
column.value: The survivors that are left of the house of Judah will again take root downward and bear fruit upward.

column.name: text
column.value: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go, and out of Mount Zion survivors. The zeal of the LORD of armies will perform this.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore, this is what the LORD says about the king of Assyria: ‘He will not come to this city nor shoot an arrow there; and he will not come before it with a shield, nor heap up an assault ramp against it.

column.name: text
column.value: By the way that he came, by the same he will return, and he will not come to this city,’ declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘For I will protect this city to save it for My own sake, and for My servant David’s sake.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the angel of the LORD went out and struck 185,000 in the camp of the Assyrians; and when the rest got up early in the morning, behold, all of ①the 185,000 were ②dead. ▷ ①Lit them ②Lit dead bodies

column.name: text
column.value: So Sennacherib the king of Assyria departed and ①returned home and lived in Nineveh. ▷ ①Lit went and returned

column.name: text
column.value: Then it came about, as he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, that his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer killed him with the sword; and they escaped to the land of Ararat. And his son Esarhaddon became king in his place.

column.name: text
column.value: “Comfort, comfort My people,” says your God.

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak ①kindly to Jerusalem; And call out to her, that her ②warfare has ended, That her ③guilt has been removed, That she has received of the LORD’S hand Double for all her sins.” ▷ ①Lit to the heart of ②Or hard service ③Or penalty of guilt accepted as paid off

column.name: text
column.value: The voice of one calling out, “Clear the way for the LORD in the wilderness; Make ①straight in the desert a highway for our God. ▷ ①Or smooth

column.name: text
text
column.value: ①Then the glory of the LORD will be revealed, And all flesh will see it together; For the mouth of the LORD has spoken.” ▷ ①Or In order that the

column.name: text
column.value: A voice says, “Call out.” Then ①he answered, “What shall I call out?” All flesh is grass, and all its ②loveliness is like the flower of the field. ▷ ①Another reading is I said ②Or constancy

column.name: text
column.value: The grass withers, the flower fades, ①When the breath of the LORD blows upon it; The people are indeed grass! ▷ ①Or Because

column.name: text
column.value: The grass withers, the flower fades, But the word of our God stands forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Go up on a high mountain, Zion, messenger of good news, Raise your voice forcefully, Jerusalem, messenger of good news; Raise it up, do not fear. Say to the cities of Judah, “Here is your God!”

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the Lord ①GOD will come with might, With His arm ruling for Him. Behold, His compensation is with Him, And His reward before Him. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Like a shepherd He will tend His flock, In His arm He will gather the lambs And carry them in the fold of His robe; He will gently lead the nursing ewes.

column.name: text
column.value: Who has measured the ①waters in the hollow of His hand, And measured the heavens with a ②span, And ③calculated the dust of the earth with a measure, And weighed the mountains in a balance And the hills in a pair of scales? ▷ ①DSS reads waters of the sea ②Or half cubit (9 in. or 22.8 cm) ③Lit contained; or comprehended

column.name: text
column.value: Who has ①directed the Spirit of the LORD, Or as His counselor has informed Him? ▷ ①Or measured, marked off

column.name: text
column.value: With whom did He consult and who gave Him understanding? And who taught Him in the path of justice and taught Him knowledge, And informed Him of the way of understanding?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the nations are like a drop from a bucket, And are regarded as a speck of dust on the scales; Behold, He lifts up the ①islands like fine dust. ▷ ①Or coastlands

column.name: text
column.value: Even Lebanon is not enough to ①burn, Nor its animals enough for a burnt offering. ▷ ①I.e., for fire on an altar

column.name: text
column.value: All the nations are as nothing before Him, They are regarded by Him as less than nothing and ①meaningless. ▷ ①Or void

column.name: text
column.value: To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare with Him?

column.name: text
column.value: As for the ①idol, a craftsman casts it, A goldsmith plates it with gold, And a silversmith fashions chains of silver. ▷ ①Or carved image

column.name: text
column.value: He who is too impoverished for such an offering Selects a tree that does not rot; He seeks out for himself a skillful craftsman To ①prepare ②an idol that will not totter. ▷ ①Or set up ②Or a carved image

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not know? Have you not heard? Has it not been declared to you from the beginning? Have you not understood from the foundations of the earth?

column.name: text
column.value: It is He who ①sits above the ②circle of the earth, And its inhabitants are like grasshoppers, Who stretches out the heavens like a curtain And spreads them out like a tent to live in. ▷ ①Or is enthroned ②Or vault

column.name: text
column.value: It is He who reduces rulers to nothing, Who makes the judges of the earth ①meaningless. ▷ ①Or void

column.name: text
column.value: ①Scarcely have they been planted, ②Scarcely have they been sown, ③Scarcely has their stock taken root in the earth, But He merely blows on them, and they wither, And the storm carries them away like stubble. ▷ ①Or Not even ②Or Not even ③Or Not even

column.name: text
column.value: “To whom then will you compare Me That I would be his equal?” says the Holy One.

column.name: text
column.value: Raise your eyes on high And see who has created these stars, The One who brings out their ①multitude by number, He calls them all by name; Because of the greatness of His might and the ②strength of His power, Not one of them is missing. ▷ ①Lit host ②As in DSS and ancient versions; MT strong

column.name: text
column.value: Why do you say, Jacob, and you assert, Israel, “My way is hidden from the LORD, And the justice due me ①escapes the notice of my God”? ▷ ①Lit passes by my God

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not know? Have you not heard? The Everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth Does not become weary or tired. His understanding is unsearchable.

column.name: text
column.value: He gives strength to the weary, And to the one who lacks might He increases power.

column.name: text
column.value: Though youths grow weary and tired, And vigorous young men stumble badly,

column.name: text
column.value: Yet those who ①wait for the LORD Will gain new strength; They will ②mount up with wings like eagles, They will run and not get tired, They will walk and not become weary. ▷ ①Or hope in ②Or sprout wings

column.name: text
text
column.value: Who has stirred one from the east Whom He calls in righteousness to His ①feet? He turns nations over to him And subdues kings. He makes them like dust with his sword, Like the wind-driven chaff with his bow. ▷ ①Lit foot

column.name: text
column.value: He pursues them, passing on in safety, By a way he had not been ①traversing with his feet. ▷ ①Lit going

column.name: text
column.value: Who has performed and accomplished it, Summoning the generations from the beginning? ‘I, the LORD, am the first, and with the last. I am He.’ ”

column.name: text
text
column.value: Each one helps his neighbor And says to his brother, “Be strong!”

column.name: text
column.value: So the craftsman encourages the smelter, And he who smooths metal with the hammer encourages him who beats the anvil, Saying of the soldering, “It is good”; And he fastens it with nails, So that it will not totter.

column.name: text
column.value: “But you, Israel, My servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, Descendant of Abraham My friend,

column.name: text
column.value: You whom I have ①taken from the ends of the earth And called from its remotest parts, And said to you, ‘You are My servant, I have chosen you and have not rejected you. ▷ ①Lit seized

column.name: text
column.value: Do not fear, for I am with you; Do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you, I will also help you, I will also uphold you with My righteous right hand.’

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, all those who are angered at you will be shamed and dishonored; Those who contend with you will be as nothing and will perish.

column.name: text
column.value: You will seek those who quarrel with you, but will not find them, Those who war with you will be as nothing and non-existent.

column.name: text
column.value: For I am the LORD your God who takes hold of your right hand, Who says to you, ‘Do not fear, I will help you.’

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, And the storm will scatter them; But you will rejoice in the LORD, You will boast in the Holy One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: “The poor and needy are seeking water, but there is none, And their tongues are parched with thirst. I, the LORD, will answer them Myself; As the God of Israel I will not abandon them.

column.name: text
column.value: I will open rivers on the bare heights, And springs in the midst of the valleys; I will make the wilderness a pool of water, And the dry land fountains of water.

column.name: text
column.value: I will put the cedar in the wilderness, The acacia, the myrtle, and the olive tree; I will place the juniper in the desert, Together with the elm tree and the cypress,

column.name: text
column.value: So that they may see and recognize, And consider and gain insight as well, That the hand of the LORD has done this, And the Holy One of Israel has created it.

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①Present your case,” the LORD says. “Bring forward your evidence,” The King of Jacob says. ▷ ①Lit Bring near

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Behold, you are less than nothing, And your work is less than nothing! He who chooses you is an abomination.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Who has declared this from the beginning, that we might know? Or from former times, that we may say, “He is right!”? There was no one at all who declared, There was no one at all who proclaimed, There was no one at all who heard your words.

column.name: text
column.value: “Previously I said to Zion, ‘Behold, here they are.’ And to Jerusalem, ‘I will give a messenger of good news.’

column.name: text
column.value: But when I look, there is no one, And there is no counselor ①among them Who, if I ask, can give an answer. ▷ ①Lit out of those

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, all of them are ①false; Their works are nothing, Their cast metal images are wind and emptiness. ▷ ①Another reading is nothing

column.name: text
text
column.value: He will not cry out nor raise His voice, Nor make His voice heard in the street.

column.name: text
text
column.value: He will not be disheartened or crushed Until He has established justice on the earth; And the coastlands will wait expectantly for His ①law.” ▷ ①Or instruction

column.name: text
column.value: This is what God the LORD says, Who created the heavens and stretched them out, Who spread out the earth and its ①offspring, Who gives breath to the people on it And spirit to those who walk in it: ▷ ①Or vegetation

column.name: text
column.value: “I am the LORD, I have called You in righteousness, I will also hold You by the hand and watch over You, And I will appoint You as a covenant to the people, As a light to the nations,

column.name: text
column.value: To open blind eyes, To bring out prisoners from the dungeon And those who dwell in darkness from the prison.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Sing to the LORD a new song, Sing His praise from the end of the earth! You who go down to the sea, and all that is in it; You islands, and those who live on them.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices, The settlements which Kedar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of Sela sing aloud, Let them shout for joy from the tops of the mountains.

column.name: text
column.value: Let them give glory to the LORD And declare His praise in the coastlands.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will go out like a warrior, He will stir His zeal like a man of war. He will shout, indeed, He will raise a war cry. He will prevail against His enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: “I have kept silent for a long time, I have kept still and restrained Myself. Now like a woman in labor I will groan, I will both gasp and pant.

column.name: text
column.value: I will lay waste the mountains and hills And wither all their vegetation; I will turn the rivers into coastlands And dry up the ponds.

column.name: text
column.value: I will lead those who are blind by a way they have not known, In paths they have not known I will guide them. I will turn darkness into light before them And uneven land into plains. These are the things I will do, And I will not leave them undone.”

column.name: text
column.value: They will be turned back and be utterly put to shame, Who trust in ①idols, Who say to cast metal images, “You are our gods.” ▷ ①Or carved images

column.name: text
column.value: Hear, you who are deaf! And look, you who are blind, so that you may see.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is blind but My servant, Or so deaf as My messenger whom I send? Who is so blind as one who is ①at peace with Me, Or so blind as the servant of the LORD? ▷ ①Or the devoted one

column.name: text
column.value: You have seen many things, but you do not retain them; Your ears are open, but no one hears.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD was pleased for His righteousness’ sake To make the Law great and glorious.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Who among you will listen to this? Who will pay attention and listen in the time to come?

column.name: text
column.value: Who gave Jacob up for spoils, and Israel to plunderers? Was it not the LORD, against whom we have sinned, And in whose ways they were not willing to walk, And whose Law they did not obey?

column.name: text
text
column.value: “But now listen, Jacob, My servant, And Israel, whom I have chosen:

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says, He who made you And formed you from the womb, who will help you: ‘Do not fear, Jacob My servant, And ①Jeshurun, whom I have chosen. ▷ ①I.e., Israel

column.name: text
text
column.value: And they will spring up ①among the grass Like poplars by streams of water.’ ▷ ①Another reading is like grass among the waters

column.name: text
text
column.value: “This is what the LORD says, He who is the King of Israel and his Redeemer, the LORD of armies: ‘I am the first and I am the last, And there is no God besides Me.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is like Me? Let him proclaim and declare it; And, let him confront Me ①Beginning with My establishing of the ancient ②nation. Then let them declare to them the things that are coming And the events that are going to take place. ▷ ①Lit From My establishing of ②Or people

column.name: text
column.value: Do not tremble and do not be afraid; Have I not long since announced it to you and declared it? And you are My witnesses. Is there any God besides Me, Or is there any other Rock? I know of none.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Those who fashion an idol are all futile, and their treasured things are of no benefit; even their own witnesses fail to see or know, so that they will be put to shame.

column.name: text
column.value: Who has fashioned a god or cast an idol to no benefit?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, all his companions will be put to shame, for the craftsmen themselves are mere men. Let them all assemble themselves, let them stand up, let them tremble, let them be put to shame together.

column.name: text
column.value: The craftsman of iron shapes a cutting tool and does his work over the coals, ①fashioning it with hammers and working it with his strong arm. He also gets hungry and ②his strength fails; he drinks no water and becomes weary. ▷ ①Lit and fashions ②Lit there is no strength

column.name: text
column.value: The craftsman of wood extends a measuring line; he outlines it with a marker. He works it with carving knives and outlines it with a compass, and makes it like the form of a man, like the beauty of mankind, so that it may sit in a house.

column.name: text
column.value: He will cut cedars for himself, and he takes a holm-oak or another oak and lets it grow strong for himself among the trees of the forest. He plants a laurel tree, and the rain makes it grow.

column.name: text
column.value: Then it becomes something for a person to burn, so he takes one of them and gets warm; he also makes a fire and bakes bread. He also makes a god and worships it; he makes it a carved image and bows down before it.

column.name: text
column.value: Half of it he burns in the fire; over this half he eats meat, he roasts a roast, and is satisfied. He also warms himself and says, “Aha! I am warm, I have seen the fire.”

column.name: text
column.value: Yet the rest of it he makes into a god, his carved image. He bows down before it and worships; he also prays to it and says, “Save me, for you are my god.”

column.name: text
column.value: They do not know, nor do they understand, for He has smeared over their eyes so that they cannot see, and their hearts so that they cannot comprehend.

column.name: text
column.value: No one ①remembers, nor is there knowledge or understanding to say, “I have burned half of it in the fire and also have baked bread over its coals. I roast meat and eat it. Then ②I make the rest of it into an abomination, ③I bow down before a block of wood!” ▷ ①Lit returns to his heart ②Or shall I make? ③Or shall I bow...?

column.name: text
column.value: He ①feeds on ashes; a deceived heart has misled him. And he cannot save ②himself, nor say, “Is there not a lie in my right hand?” ▷ ①Or is a companion of ashes ②Lit his soul

column.name: text
column.value: “Remember these things, Jacob, And Israel, for you are My servant; I have formed you, you are My servant, Israel, you will not be forgotten by Me.

column.name: text
column.value: I have wiped out your wrongdoings like a thick cloud And your sins like a ①heavy mist. Return to Me, for I have redeemed you.” ▷ ①Or cloud

column.name: text
text
column.value: This is what the LORD says, He who is your Redeemer, and the one who formed you from the womb: “I, the LORD, am the maker of all things, Stretching out the heavens by Myself And spreading out the earth ①alone, ▷ ①Or who was with Me?

column.name: text
column.value: Causing the ①omens of diviners to fail, ②Making fools of fortune-tellers; Causing wise men to turn back And ③making their knowledge ridiculous, ▷ ①Lit signs ②Lit He makes ③Lit He turns

column.name: text
column.value: Confirming the word of His servant And ①carrying out the purpose of His messengers. It is I who says of Jerusalem, ‘She shall be inhabited!’ And of the cities of Judah, ‘They shall be built.’ And I will raise her ruins again. ▷ ①Lit He performs

column.name: text
column.value: I am the One who says to the depth of the sea, ‘Dry up!’ And I will make your rivers dry up.

column.name: text
column.value: It is I who says of Cyrus, ‘He is My shepherd, And he will carry out all My desire.’ And ①he says of Jerusalem, ‘She will be built,’ And of the temple, ‘ ②Your foundation will be laid.’ ” ▷ ①Lit to say ②Lit You will be founded

column.name: text
column.value: But now, this is what the LORD says, He who is your Creator, Jacob, And He who formed you, Israel: “Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name; you are Mine!

column.name: text
column.value: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; And through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be scorched, Nor will the flame burn you.

column.name: text
column.value: For I am the LORD your God, The Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I have given Egypt as your ransom, ①Cush and Seba in exchange for you. ▷ ①Or Ethiopia

column.name: text
column.value: Since you are precious in My sight, Since you are honored and I love you, I will give other people in your place and other nations in exchange for your life.

column.name: text
text
column.value: I will say to the north, ‘Give them up!’ And to the south, ‘Do not hold them back.’ Bring My sons from afar And My daughters from the ends of the earth,

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone who is called by My name, And whom I have created for My glory, Whom I have formed, even whom I have made.”

column.name: text
column.value: Bring out the people who are blind, even though they have eyes, And those who are deaf, even though they have ears.

column.name: text
column.value: All the nations have gathered together So that the peoples may be assembled. Who among them can declare this And proclaim to us the former things? Let them present their witnesses so that they may be justified, Or let them hear and say, “It is true.”

column.name: text
column.value: “You are My witnesses,” declares the LORD, “And My servant whom I have chosen, So that you may know and believe Me And understand that I am He. Before Me there was no God formed, And there will be none after Me.

column.name: text
column.value: I, only I, am the LORD, And there is no savior besides Me.

column.name: text
column.value: It is I who have declared and saved and proclaimed, And there was no strange god among you; So you are My witnesses,” declares the LORD, “And I am God.

column.name: text
column.value: Even ①from eternity I am He, And there is no one who can rescue from My hand; I act, and who can reverse it?” ▷ ①As in LXX; MT from the day

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “For your sake I have sent to Babylon, And will bring them all down as fugitives, ①Even the Chaldeans, into the ships ②over which they rejoice. ▷ ①Another reading is As for the Chaldeans, their rejoicing is turned into mourning ②Lit of their rejoicing

column.name: text
column.value: I am the LORD, your Holy One, The Creator of Israel, your King.”

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says, He who makes a way through the sea And a path through the mighty waters,

column.name: text
column.value: Who brings out the chariot and the horse, The army and the mighty man (They will lie down together and not rise again; They have been extinguished, and have gone out like a wick):

column.name: text
column.value: “Do not call to mind the former things, Or consider things of the past.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I am going to do something new, Now it will spring up; Will you not be aware of it? I will even make a roadway in the wilderness, Rivers in the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: The animals of the field will glorify Me, The jackals and the ostriches, Because I have given waters in the wilderness And rivers in the desert, To give drink to My chosen people.

column.name: text
column.value: The people whom I formed for Myself Will declare My praise.

column.name: text
column.value: “Yet you have not called on Me, Jacob; But you have become weary of Me, Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: You have not brought to Me the sheep of your burnt offerings, Nor have you honored Me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with ①offerings, Nor wearied you with incense. ▷ ①Or a meal offering

column.name: text
column.value: You have not bought Me ①sweet cane with money, Nor have you satisfied Me with the fat of your sacrifices; Rather, you have burdened Me with your sins, You have wearied Me with your wrongdoings. ▷ ①Or calamus

column.name: text
column.value: “I, I alone, am the one who wipes out your wrongdoings for My own sake, And I will not remember your sins.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Your first ①forefather sinned, And your ②spokesmen have rebelled against Me. ▷ ①Lit father ②Or interpreters

column.name: text
column.value: So I will profane the ①officials of the sanctuary, And I will turn Jacob over to destruction and Israel to abuse. ▷ ①Or holy princes

column.name: text
column.value: Bel has bowed down, Nebo stoops over; Their idols have become loads for the animals and the cattle. The things ①that you carry are burdensome, A load for the weary animal. ▷ ①Lit carried by you

column.name: text
column.value: They stooped over, they have bowed down together; They could not rescue the burden, But ①have themselves gone into captivity. ▷ ①Or their soul has

column.name: text
column.value: “Listen to Me, house of Jacob, And all the remnant of the house of Israel, You who have been carried by Me from ①birth And have been carried from the womb; ▷ ①Lit the belly

column.name: text
column.value: Even to your old age I ①will be the same, And even to your ②graying years I will ③carry you! I have ④done it, and I will bear you; And I will ⑤carry you and I will save you. ▷ ①Lit will be He ②Lit gray hairs ③Or support ④Or made you ⑤Or support

column.name: text
column.value: “To whom would you liken Me And make Me equal, and compare Me, That we would be alike?

column.name: text
column.value: Those who lavish gold from the bag And weigh silver on the scale, Hire a goldsmith, and he makes it into a god; They bow down, indeed they worship it.

column.name: text
column.value: They lift it on the shoulder, carry it, And set it in its place, and it stands there. It does not move from its place. Though one may shout to it, it cannot answer; It cannot save him from his distress.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Declaring the end from the beginning, And from ancient times things which have not been done, Saying, ‘My plan will be established, And I will accomplish all My good pleasure’;

column.name: text
column.value: Calling a bird of prey from the east, The man of ①My purpose from a distant country. Truly I have spoken; truly I will bring it to pass. I have planned it, I will certainly do it. ▷ ①Lit His

column.name: text
column.value: “Listen to Me, you stubborn-minded, Who are far from righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: I bring near My righteousness, it is not far off; And My salvation will not delay. And I will grant salvation in Zion, And My glory for Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says to Cyrus His anointed, Whom I have taken by the right hand, To subdue nations before him And ①to undo the weapons belt on the waist of kings; To open doors before him so that gates will not be shut: ▷ ①Lit I will loose

column.name: text
text
column.value: I will give you the ①treasures of darkness And hidden wealth of secret places, So that you may know that it is I, The LORD, the God of Israel, who calls you by your name. ▷ ①Or hoarded treasures

column.name: text
column.value: For the sake of Jacob My servant, And Israel My chosen one, I have also called you by your name; I have given you a title of honor Though you have not known Me.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the LORD, and there is no one else; There is no God except Me. I will ①arm you, though you have not known Me, ▷ ①Or embrace

column.name: text
column.value: So that people may know from the rising to the setting of the sun That there is no one besides Me. I am the LORD, and there is no one else,

column.name: text
column.value: The One forming light and creating darkness, Causing ①well-being and creating disaster; I am the LORD who does all these things. ▷ ①Or peace

column.name: text
column.value: “Drip down, heavens, from above, And let the clouds pour down righteousness; Let the earth open up and salvation bear fruit, And righteousness sprout with it. I, the LORD, have created it.

column.name: text
column.value: “Woe to the one who quarrels with ①his Maker— A piece of pottery ②among the other earthenware pottery pieces! Will the clay say to the ③potter, ‘What are you doing?’ Or the thing you are making say, ‘He has no hands’? ▷ ①Lit He who formed him ②Lit with ③Lit he who formed him

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to him who says to a father, ‘What are you fathering?’ Or to a woman, ‘To what are you ①giving birth?’ ” ▷ ①Lit in labor pains with

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says, the Holy One of Israel and ①his Maker: “ ②Ask Me about the things to come ③concerning My sons, And you shall commit to Me the work of My hands. ▷ ①Lit He who formed him ②Or Will you ask ③Or upon

column.name: text
column.value: It is I who made the earth, and created mankind upon it. I stretched out the heavens with My hands, And I ①ordained all their ②lights. ▷ ①Or commanded ②Lit host; i.e., sun, stars, etc.

column.name: text
column.value: I have stirred him in righteousness, And I will make all his ways smooth. He will build My city and let My exiles go free, Without any payment or reward,” says the LORD of armies.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “The ①products of Egypt and the merchandise of ②Cush And the Sabeans, men of stature, Will come over to you and will be yours; They will walk behind you, they will come over in chains And will bow down to you; They will plead with you: ‘ ③God certainly is ④with you, and there is no one else, No other God.’ ” ▷ ①Lit labor ②Or Ethiopia ③Or God is with you alone ④Or in

column.name: text
column.value: Truly, You are a God who hides Himself, God of Israel, Savior!

column.name: text
column.value: They will be put to shame and even humiliated, all of them; The manufacturers of idols will go away together in humiliation.

column.name: text
column.value: Israel has been saved by the LORD With an everlasting salvation; You will not be put to shame or humiliated To all eternity.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says, He who created the heavens (He is the God who formed the earth and made it, He established it and did not create it ①as a waste place, but formed it to be inhabited): “I am the LORD, and there is no one else. ▷ ①LXX in vain

column.name: text
column.value: I have not spoken in secret, In ①some dark land; I did not say to the ②offspring of Jacob, ‘Seek Me in ③a wasteland’; I, the LORD, speak righteousness, Declaring things that are right. ▷ ①Lit a place of a land of darkness ②Lit seed ③Or vain

column.name: text
column.value: “Gather yourselves and come; Come together, you survivors of the nations! They have no knowledge, Who carry around ①their wooden idol And pray to a god who cannot save. ▷ ①Lit the wood of their carved image

column.name: text
column.value: Declare and present your case; Indeed, let them consult together. Who has announced this long ago? Who has long since declared it? Is it not I, the LORD? And there is no other God besides Me, A righteous God and a Savior; There is none except Me.

column.name: text
column.value: Turn to Me and be saved, all the ends of the earth; For I am God, and there is no other.

column.name: text
column.value: I have sworn by Myself; The word has gone out from My mouth in righteousness And will not turn back, That to Me every knee will bow, every tongue will swear allegiance.

column.name: text
column.value: They will say of Me, ‘Only in the LORD are righteousness and strength.’ People will come to Him, And all who were angry at Him will be put to shame.

column.name: text
column.value: In the LORD all the offspring of Israel Will be justified and will boast.”

column.name: text
column.value: “Come down and sit in the dust, Virgin daughter of Babylon; Sit on the ground without a throne, Daughter of the Chaldeans! For you will no longer be called tender and delicate.

column.name: text
column.value: Take the millstones and grind flour. Remove your veil, strip off the skirt, Uncover the leg, cross the rivers.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Our Redeemer, the LORD of armies is His name, The Holy One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: “Sit silently, and go into darkness, Daughter of the Chaldeans; For you will no longer be called The queen of kingdoms.

column.name: text
column.value: I was angry with My people, I profaned My heritage And handed them over to you. You did not show mercy to them, On the aged you made your yoke very heavy.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet you said, ‘I will be a queen forever.’ These things you did not consider Nor remember the outcome of ①them. ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: “Now, then, hear this, you luxuriant one, Who lives securely, Who says in her heart, ‘I am, and there is no one besides me. I will not sit as a widow, Nor know the loss of children.’

column.name: text
column.value: But these two things will come on you suddenly in one day: Loss of children and widowhood. They will come on you in full measure In spite of your many sorceries, In spite of the great power of your spells.

column.name: text
column.value: You felt secure in your wickedness and said, ‘No one sees me,’ Your wisdom and your knowledge, ①they have led you astray; For you have said in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no one besides me.’ ▷ ①Lit it has

column.name: text
text
column.value: “Persist now in your spells And in your many sorceries With which you have labored from your youth; Perhaps you will be able to benefit, Perhaps you may cause trembling.

column.name: text
column.value: You are wearied with your many counsels; Let now the astrologers, Those who prophesy by the stars, Those who predict by the new moons, Stand up and save you from what will come upon you.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: “Hear this, house of Jacob, who are named Israel And who came from the waters of Judah, Who swear by the name of the LORD And invoke the God of Israel, But not in truth nor in righteousness.

column.name: text
text
column.value: I declared the former things long ago, And they went out of My mouth, and I proclaimed them. Suddenly I acted, and they came to pass.

column.name: text
column.value: Because I know that you are ①obstinate, And your neck is an iron tendon And your forehead bronze, ▷ ①Or harsh

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I declared them to you long ago, Before ①they took place I proclaimed them to you, So that you would not say, ‘My idol has done them, And my carved image and my cast metal image have commanded them.’ ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: You have heard; look at all this. And you, will you not declare it? I proclaim to you new things from this time, Hidden things which you have not known.

column.name: text
text
column.value: You have not heard, you have not known. Even from long ago your ear has not been open, Because I knew that you would deal very treacherously; And you have been called a ①rebel from ②birth. ▷ ①Or transgressor ②Lit the belly

column.name: text
column.value: For the sake of My name I delay My wrath, And for My praise I restrain it for you, In order not to cut you off.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.

column.name: text
text
text
text
column.value: Assemble, all of you, and listen! Who among them has declared these things? The LORD loves him; he will carry out His good pleasure against Babylon, And His arm will be against the Chaldeans.

column.name: text
column.value: I, yes I, have spoken; indeed I have called him, I have brought him, and He will make his ways successful.

column.name: text
column.value: Come near to Me, listen to this: From the beginning I have not spoken in secret, From the time it took place, I was there. And now the Lord ①GOD has sent Me, and His Spirit.” ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says, He who is your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “I am the LORD your God, who teaches you to benefit, Who leads you in the way you should go.

column.name: text
column.value: If only you had paid attention to My commandments! Then your ①well-being would have been like a river, And your righteousness like the waves of the sea. ▷ ①Or peace

column.name: text
column.value: Your ①descendants would have been like the sand, And ②your offspring like its grains; Their name would never be eliminated or destroyed from My presence.” ▷ ①Lit seed ②Lit the offspring of your inward parts

column.name: text
