column.value: Go out from Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! Declare with the sound of joyful shouting, proclaim this, Send it out to the end of the earth; Say, “The LORD has redeemed His servant Jacob.”

column.name: text
text
column.value: “There is no peace for the wicked,” says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen to Me, you islands, And pay attention, you peoples from afar. The LORD called Me from the womb; From the ①body of My mother He named Me. ▷ ①Lit inward parts

column.name: text
column.value: He has made My mouth like a sharp sword, In the shadow of His hand He has concealed Me; And He has also made Me a sharpened arrow, He has hidden Me in His quiver.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to Me, “You are My Servant, Israel, In whom I will show My glory.”

column.name: text
column.value: But I said, “I have labored in vain, I have spent My strength for nothing and futility; Nevertheless, the justice due to Me is with the LORD, And My reward is with My God.”

column.name: text
column.value: And now says the LORD, who formed Me from the womb to be His Servant, To bring Jacob back to Him, so that Israel might be gathered to Him (For I am honored in the sight of the LORD, And My God is My strength),

column.name: text
column.value: He says, “It is too ①small a thing that You should be My Servant To raise up the tribes of Jacob and to restore the protected ones of Israel; I will also make You a light ②of the nations So that My salvation may ③reach to the end of the earth.” ▷ ①Lit light ②Or to ③Lit be

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD, the Redeemer of Israel and its Holy One, Says to the ①despised One, To the One abhorred by the nation, To the Servant of rulers: “Kings will see and arise, Princes will also bow down, Because of the LORD who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel who has chosen You.” ▷ ①Lit despised of soul

column.name: text
text
column.value: Saying to those who are bound, ‘ ①Go free,’ To those who are in darkness, ‘Show yourselves.’ They will feed along the roads, And their pasture will be on all bare heights. ▷ ①Lit Go out

column.name: text
column.value: They will not hunger or thirst, Nor will the scorching heat or sun strike them down; For He who has compassion on them will lead them, And He will guide them to springs of water.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make all My mountains a road, And My highways will be raised up.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Shout for joy, you heavens! And rejoice, you earth! Break forth into joyful shouting, mountains! For the LORD has comforted His people And will have compassion on His afflicted.

column.name: text
column.value: But Zion said, “The LORD has abandoned me, And the Lord has forgotten me.”

column.name: text
column.value: “Can a woman forget her nursing child And have no compassion on the son of her womb? Even these may forget, but I will not forget you.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I have inscribed you on the palms of My hands; Your walls are continually before Me.

column.name: text
column.value: Your ①builders hurry; Your destroyers and devastators Will leave you. ▷ ①Ancient versions and DSS; MT sons

column.name: text
column.value: Raise your eyes and look around; All of them gather together, they come to you. As I live,” declares the LORD, “You will certainly put them all on as ①jewelry and bind them on as a bride. ▷ ①Lit an ornament

column.name: text
column.value: For your ruins and deserted places and your destroyed land— Now you will certainly be too cramped for the inhabitants, And those who swallowed you will be far away.

column.name: text
column.value: The children ①you lost will yet say in your ears, ‘The place is too cramped for me; Make room for me that I may live here.’ ▷ ①Lit of your bereavement

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who has fathered these for me, Since I have been bereaved of my children And cannot conceive, and I am an exile, and a wanderer? And who has raised these? Behold, I was left alone; ①Where are these from?’ ” ▷ ①Lit These, where are they?

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Lord ①GOD says: “Behold, I will lift up My hand to the nations And set up My flag to the peoples; And they will bring your sons ②in their arms, And your daughters will be carried on their shoulders. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD ②Lit on the chest

column.name: text
text
column.value: “Can the prey be taken from a mighty man, Or the captives of ①a tyrant be rescued?” ▷ ①Ancient versions and DSS; MT the righteous, cf. v 25

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, this is what the LORD says: “Even the captives of the mighty man will be taken away, And the prey of a tyrant will be rescued; For I will contend with the one who contends with you, And I will save your sons.

column.name: text
column.value: I will feed your oppressors with their own flesh, And they will become drunk with their own blood as with sweet wine; And ①humanity will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior And your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.” ▷ ①Lit all flesh

column.name: text
column.value: “Listen to Me, you who pursue righteousness, Who seek the LORD: Look to the rock from which you were cut, And to the ①quarry from which you were dug. ▷ ①Lit excavation of a pit

column.name: text
column.value: Look to Abraham your father And to Sarah who gave birth to you in pain; When he was only one I called him, Then I blessed him and multiplied him.”

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, the LORD will comfort Zion; He will comfort all her ruins. And He will make her wilderness like Eden, And her desert like the garden of the LORD. Joy and gladness will be found in her, Thanksgiving and the sound of a melody.

column.name: text
column.value: “Pay attention to Me, My people, And listen to Me, My ①nation; For a law will go out from Me, And I will bring My justice as a light of the peoples. ▷ ①Or people

column.name: text
column.value: My righteousness is near, My salvation has gone forth, And My arms will judge the peoples; The coastlands will wait for Me, And they will wait expectantly for My arm.

column.name: text
column.value: Raise your eyes to the sky, Then look to the earth beneath; For the sky will vanish like smoke, And the earth will wear out like a garment And its inhabitants will die ①in the same way. But My salvation will be forever, And My righteousness will not fail. ▷ ①Another reading is like gnats

column.name: text
column.value: Listen to Me, you who know righteousness, A people in whose heart is My Law; Do not fear the taunting of ①people, Nor be terrified of their abuses. ▷ ①Or mankind

column.name: text
column.value: For the moth will eat them like a garment; Yes, the moth will eat them like wool. But My righteousness will be forever, And My salvation to all generations.”

column.name: text
column.value: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD; Awake as in the days of old, the generations of long ago. Was it not You who cut ①Rahab in pieces, Who pierced the dragon? ▷ ①I.e., a sea monster, not to be confused with Rahab in Joshua 2

column.name: text
column.value: Was it not You who dried up the sea, The waters of the great deep; Who made the depths of the sea a pathway For the redeemed to cross over?

column.name: text
column.value: And the redeemed of the LORD will return And come to Zion with joyful shouting, And everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, And sorrow and sighing will flee away.

column.name: text
column.value: “I, I Myself, am He who comforts you. Who are you that you are afraid of ①mortal man, And of a son of man who is made like grass, ▷ ①Lit man who dies

column.name: text
column.value: That you have forgotten the LORD your Maker, Who stretched out the heavens And laid the foundations of the earth, That you fear continually all day long because of the fury of the oppressor, As he makes ready to destroy? And where is the rage of the oppressor?

column.name: text
column.value: The ①exile will soon be set free, and will not die in the ②dungeon, nor will his bread be lacking. ▷ ①Lit one in chains ②Lit pit

column.name: text
column.value: For I am the LORD your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar (the LORD of armies is His name).

column.name: text
column.value: And I have put My words in your mouth and have covered you with the shadow of My hand, to ①establish the heavens, to found the earth, and to say to Zion, ‘You are My people.’ ” ▷ ①Lit plant

column.name: text
column.value: Pull yourself up! Pull yourself up! Arise, Jerusalem! You who have drunk from the LORD’S hand the cup of His anger; The ①chalice of staggering you have drunk to the dregs. ▷ ①Lit bowl of the cup of reeling

column.name: text
column.value: There is no one to guide her among all the sons to whom she has given birth, Nor is there anyone to take her by the hand among all the sons she has raised.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Your sons have fainted, They lie helpless at the head of every street, Like an antelope in a net, Full of the wrath of the LORD, The rebuke of your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, listen to this, you afflicted, Who are drunk, but not with wine:

column.name: text
column.value: This is what your Lord, the LORD, your God Who contends for His people says: “Behold, I have taken from your hand the cup of staggering, The ①chalice of My anger; You will never drink it again. ▷ ①Lit bowl of the cup of

column.name: text
column.value: I will put it into the hand of your tormentors, Who have said to ①you, ‘Lie down so that we may walk over you.’ You have also made your back like the ground, And like the street for those who walk over it.” ▷ ①Lit your soul

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “Where is the certificate of divorce By which I have sent your mother away? Or to whom of My creditors did I sell you? Behold, you were sold for your wrongdoings, And for your wrongful acts your mother was sent away.

column.name: text
column.value: Why was there no one when I came? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Is My hand so short that it cannot redeem? Or do I have no power to rescue? Behold, I dry up the sea with My rebuke, I turn rivers into a wilderness; Their fish stink for lack of water, And die of thirst.

column.name: text
column.value: I clothe the heavens with blackness, And make sackcloth their covering.”

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord ①GOD has given Me the tongue of disciples, So that I may know how to sustain the weary one with a word. He awakens Me morning by morning, He awakens My ear to listen as a disciple. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord GOD has opened My ear, And I was not disobedient, Nor did I turn back.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For the Lord GOD helps Me, Therefore, I am not disgraced; Therefore, I have made My face like flint, And I know that I will not be ashamed.

column.name: text
column.value: He who vindicates Me is near; Who will contend with Me? Let us stand up to each other. Who has a case against Me? Let him approach Me.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Who is among you who fears the LORD, Who obeys the voice of His servant, Who walks in darkness and has no light? Let him trust in the name of the LORD and rely on his God.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, all you who kindle a fire, Who encircle yourselves with flaming arrows, Walk in the light of your fire And among the flaming arrows you have set ablaze. This you will have from My hand: You will lie down in torment.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Shake yourself from the dust, rise up, Captive Jerusalem; Release yourself from the chains around your neck, Captive daughter of Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says: “You were sold for nothing, and you will be redeemed without money.”

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the Lord ①GOD says: “My people went down to Egypt first to reside there; then the Assyrian oppressed them without reason. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: And now, what do I have here,” declares the LORD, “seeing that My people have been taken away without reason?” Again the LORD declares, “Those who rule over them howl, and My name is continually reviled all day long.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, My people shall know My name; therefore on that day I am the one who is speaking, ‘Here I am.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: How delightful on the mountains Are the feet of one who brings good news, Who announces ①peace And brings good news of ②happiness, Who announces salvation, And says to Zion, “Your God ③reigns!” ▷ ①Or well-being ②Lit good ③Or is King

column.name: text
column.value: Listen! Your watchmen raise their voices, They shout joyfully together; For they will see ①with their own eyes When the LORD restores Zion. ▷ ①Lit eye to eye

column.name: text
column.value: Be cheerful, shout joyfully together, You ruins of Jerusalem; For the LORD has comforted His people, He has redeemed Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has bared His holy arm In the sight of all the nations, ①So that all the ends of the earth may see The salvation of our God. ▷ ①Or And all...will see

column.name: text
column.value: Depart, depart, go out from there, Do not touch what is unclean; Go out of the midst of her, purify yourselves, You who carry the vessels of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But you will not go out in a hurry, Nor will you go ①as fugitives; For the LORD will go before you, And the God of Israel will be your rear guard. ▷ ①Lit in flight

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, My Servant will prosper, He will be high and lifted up and ①greatly exalted. ▷ ①Or very high

column.name: text
column.value: Just as many were appalled at you, My people, So His appearance was marred beyond that of a man, And His form beyond the sons of mankind.

column.name: text
column.value: So ①He will sprinkle many nations, Kings will shut their mouths on account of Him; For what they had not been told, they will see, And what they had not heard, they will understand. ▷ ①LXX many nations will wonder at Him

column.name: text
column.value: Who has believed our report? And to whom has the arm of the LORD been revealed?

column.name: text
column.value: For He grew up before Him like a tender ①shoot, And like a root out of dry ground; He has no stately form or majesty That we would look at Him, Nor an appearance that we would take pleasure in Him. ▷ ①Lit suckling

column.name: text
column.value: He was despised and abandoned by men, A man of ①great pain and familiar with sickness; And like one from whom people hide their faces, He was despised, and we had no regard for Him. ▷ ①Lit pains

column.name: text
column.value: However, it was our sicknesses that He Himself bore, And our pains that He carried; Yet we ourselves assumed that He had been afflicted, Struck down by God, and humiliated.

column.name: text
column.value: But He was ①pierced for our offenses, He was crushed for our wrongdoings; The punishment for our ②well-being was laid upon Him, And by His wounds we are healed. ▷ ①Or wounded ②Or peace

column.name: text
column.value: All of us, like sheep, have gone astray, Each of us has turned to his own way; But the LORD has caused the wrongdoing of us all To ①fall on Him. ▷ ①Lit encounter Him

column.name: text
column.value: He was oppressed and afflicted, Yet He did not open His mouth; Like a lamb that is led to slaughter, And like a sheep that is silent before its shearers, So He did not open His mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: By oppression and judgment He was taken away; And as for His generation, who considered That He was cut off from the land of the ①living For the wrongdoing of my people, to whom the blow was due? ▷ ①Or life

column.name: text
column.value: And His grave was assigned with wicked men, Yet He was with a rich man in His death, Because He had done no violence, Nor was there any deceit in His mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD desired To crush Him, ①causing Him grief; If He renders ②Himself as a guilt offering, He will see His ③offspring, He will prolong His days, And the ④good pleasure of the LORD will prosper in His hand. ▷ ①Lit He made Him sick ②Lit His soul ③Lit seed ④Or will of

column.name: text
column.value: As a result of the ①anguish of His soul, He will ②see it and be satisfied; By His knowledge the Righteous One, My Servant, will justify the many, For He will bear their wrongdoings. ▷ ①Or trouble ②DSS see light; LXX also has light

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, I will allot Him a portion with the great, And He will divide the plunder with the strong, Because He poured out His ①life unto death, And was counted with wrongdoers; Yet He Himself bore the sin of many, And interceded for the wrongdoers. ▷ ①Lit soul

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: For you will spread out to the right and to the left. And your ①descendants will possess nations And will resettle the desolate cities. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
text
column.value: For your husband is your Maker, Whose name is the LORD of armies; And your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel, Who is called the God of all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD has called you, Like a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit, Even like a wife of one’s youth when she is rejected,” Says your God.

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①For a brief moment I abandoned you, But with great compassion I will gather you. ▷ ①Lit In

column.name: text
column.value: In an ①outburst of anger I hid My face from you for a moment, But with everlasting favor I will have compassion on you,” Says the LORD your Redeemer. ▷ ①Lit overflowing

column.name: text
column.value: “For ①this is like the days of Noah to Me, When I swore that the waters of Noah Would not ②flood the earth again; So I have sworn that I will not be angry with you Nor rebuke you. ▷ ①Some mss the waters of Noah this is to Me ②Lit cross over

column.name: text
column.value: For the mountains may be removed and the hills may shake, But My ①favor will not be removed from you, Nor will My covenant of peace be shaken,” Says the LORD who has compassion on you. ▷ ①Or faithfulness

column.name: text
column.value: “Afflicted one, storm-tossed, and not comforted, Behold, I will set your stones in antimony, And I will lay your foundations with ①sapphires. ▷ ①Or lapis lazuli

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, I will make your battlements of ①rubies, And your gates of ②crystal, And your entire ③wall of precious stones. ▷ ①I.e., bright red ②Or carbuncles ③Lit border, boundary

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: If anyone fiercely attacks you, it will not be from Me. Whoever attacks you will fall because of you.

column.name: text
text
column.value: No weapon that is formed against you will succeed; And you will condemn every tongue that ①accuses you in judgment. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, And their vindication is from Me,” declares the LORD. ▷ ①Lit rises against

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①You there! Everyone who thirsts, come to the waters; And you who have no ②money come, buy and eat. Come, buy wine and milk Without money and without cost. ▷ ①Lit Hoy ②Lit silver

column.name: text
column.value: Why do you ①spend money for what is not bread, And your wages for what does not satisfy? Listen carefully to Me, and eat what is good, And delight yourself in abundance. ▷ ①Lit weigh out silver

column.name: text
column.value: Incline your ear and come to Me. Listen, that ①you may live; And I will make an everlasting covenant with you, According to the faithful mercies ②shown to David. ▷ ①Lit your soul ②Lit of David

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I have made him a witness to the peoples, A leader and commander for the peoples.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, you will call a nation you do not know, And a nation which does not know you will run to you, Because of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel; For He has glorified you.”

column.name: text
column.value: Seek the LORD while He may be found; Call upon Him while He is near.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the wicked abandon his way, And the unrighteous person his thoughts; And let him return to the LORD, And He will have compassion on him, And to our God, For He will abundantly pardon.

column.name: text
column.value: “For My thoughts are not your thoughts, Nor are your ways My ways,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, So are My ways higher than your ways And My thoughts than your thoughts.

column.name: text
column.value: For as the rain and the snow come down from heaven, And do not return there without watering the earth And making it produce and sprout, And providing seed to the sower and bread to the eater;

column.name: text
column.value: So will My word be which goes out of My mouth; It will not return to Me empty, Without accomplishing what I desire, And without succeeding in the purpose for which I sent it.

column.name: text
column.value: For you will go out with joy And be led in peace; The mountains and the hills will break into shouts of joy before you, And all the trees of the field will clap their hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead of the thorn bush, the juniper will come up, And instead of the stinging nettle, the myrtle will come up; And ①it will be a ②memorial to the LORD, An everlasting sign which will not be eliminated.” ▷ ①I.e., the transformation of the desert ②Lit name

column.name: text
text
column.value: He enters into peace; They rest in their ①beds, Each one who walked in his upright way. ▷ ①I.e., graves

column.name: text
column.value: “But come here, you sons of a sorceress, Offspring of an adulterer and ①a prostitute! ▷ ①As in ancient versions; MT she prostitutes herself

column.name: text
column.value: Of whom do you make fun? Against whom do you open wide your mouth And stick out your tongue? Are you not children of rebellion, Offspring of deceit,

column.name: text
column.value: Who inflame yourselves among the oaks, Under every luxuriant tree, Who slaughter the children in the ①ravines, Under the clefts of the rocks? ▷ ①Or wadis

column.name: text
column.value: Among the ①smooth stones of the ②ravine Is your portion, ③they are your lot; Even to them you have poured out a drink offering, You have made a grain offering. Should I ④relent of these things? ▷ ①I.e., symbols of fertility gods ②Or wadi ③Lit they, they ④Or repent

column.name: text
column.value: On a high and lofty mountain You have made your bed. You also went up there to offer sacrifice.

column.name: text
column.value: Behind the door and the doorpost You have set up your sign; Indeed, far removed from Me, you have uncovered yourself, And have gone up and made your bed wide. And you have made an agreement for yourself with them, You have loved their bed, You have looked at their ①manhood. ▷ ①Lit hand

column.name: text
column.value: You have journeyed to the king with oil And increased your perfumes; You have sent your messengers a great distance And made them go down to ①Sheol. ▷ ①I.e., the netherworld

column.name: text
column.value: You were tired out by the length of your road, Yet you did not say, ‘It is hopeless!’ You found ①renewed strength, Therefore you did not ②faint. ▷ ①Lit the life of your hand ②Or become sick

column.name: text
column.value: “Of whom were you worried and fearful When you lied, and did not remember Me ①Nor give Me a thought? Was I not silent, even for a long time, So you do not fear Me? ▷ ①Lit You did not set it upon your heart

column.name: text
column.value: I will declare your righteousness and your deeds, And they will not benefit you.

column.name: text
column.value: When you cry out, let your collection of idols save you. But the wind will carry them all up, And a breath will take them away. But the one who takes refuge in Me will inherit the land And possess My holy mountain.”

column.name: text
column.value: And it will be said, “Build up, build up, prepare the way, Remove every obstacle from the way of My people.”

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the high and exalted One Who ①lives forever, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in a high and holy place, And also with the contrite and lowly of spirit In order to revive the spirit of the lowly And to revive the heart of the contrite. ▷ ①Or dwells in eternity

column.name: text
column.value: For I will not contend forever, Nor will I always be angry; For the spirit would grow faint before Me, And the breath of those whom I have made.

column.name: text
text
column.value: I have seen his ways, but I will heal him; I will lead him and restore comfort to him and to his mourners,

column.name: text
column.value: Creating the ①praise of the lips. Peace, peace to him who is far away and to him who is near,” Says the LORD, “and I will heal him.” ▷ ①Lit fruit of the lips

column.name: text
column.value: But the wicked are like the tossing sea, For it cannot be quiet, And its waters toss up refuse and mud.

column.name: text
column.value: “There is no peace,” says my God, “for the wicked.”

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the LORD’S hand is not so short That it cannot save; Nor is His ear so dull That it cannot hear.

column.name: text
column.value: But your wrongdoings have caused a separation between you and your God, And your sins have hidden His ①face from you so that He does not hear. ▷ ①As in ancient versions; MT faces

column.name: text
column.value: For your hands are defiled with blood, And your fingers with wrongdoing; Your lips have spoken deceit, Your tongue mutters wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: No one sues righteously and no one pleads ①honestly. They trust in confusion and speak lies; They conceive trouble and give birth to disaster. ▷ ①Lit in truth

column.name: text
text
column.value: Their webs will not become clothing, Nor will they cover themselves with their works; Their works are works of wrongdoing, And an act of violence is in their ①hands. ▷ ①Lit palms

column.name: text
column.value: Their feet run to evil, And they hurry to shed innocent blood; Their thoughts are thoughts of wrongdoing, Devastation and destruction are in their paths.

column.name: text
column.value: They do not know the way of peace, And there is no justice in their tracks; They have made their paths crooked, Whoever walks on ①them does not know peace. ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore justice is far from us, And righteousness does not reach us; We hope for light, but there is darkness, For brightness, but we walk in gloom.

column.name: text
column.value: We grope for the wall like people who are blind, We grope like those who have no eyes. We stumble at midday as in the twilight; Among those who are healthy we are like the dead.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For our wrongful acts have multiplied before You, And our sins have testified against us; For our wrongful acts are with us, And ①we know our wrongdoings: ▷ ①Lit our wrongdoings we know them

column.name: text
column.value: ①Offending and denying the LORD, And turning away from our God, Speaking oppression and revolt, Conceiving and uttering lying words from the heart. ▷ ①Or Revolting against and

column.name: text
column.value: Justice is turned back, And righteousness stands far away; For truth has stumbled in the street, And uprightness cannot enter.

column.name: text
column.value: Truth is lacking, And one who turns aside from evil makes himself a prey. Now the LORD saw, And it was ①displeasing in His sight that there was no justice. ▷ ①Or evil

column.name: text
column.value: And He saw that there was no one, And was amazed that there was not one to intercede; Then His own arm brought salvation to Him, And His righteousness upheld Him.

column.name: text
column.value: He put on righteousness like a breastplate, And a helmet of salvation on His head; And He put on garments of vengeance for clothing And wrapped Himself with zeal as a cloak.

column.name: text
column.value: According to their deeds, ①so will He repay: Wrath to His adversaries, ②retribution to His enemies; To the coastlands He will ③deal ④retribution. ▷ ①Lit accordingly ②Lit requital ③Lit repay ④Lit requital

column.name: text
column.value: So they will fear the name of the LORD from the west And His glory from the rising of the sun, For He will come like a ①rushing stream Which the wind of the LORD drives. ▷ ①Lit narrow

column.name: text
column.value: “A Redeemer will come to Zion, And to those in Jacob who turn from wrongdoing,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “As for Me, this is My covenant with them,” says the LORD: “My Spirit who is upon you, and My words which I have put in your mouth shall not depart from your mouth, nor from the mouth of your ①offspring, nor from the mouth of your ②offspring’s offspring,” says the LORD, “from now and forever.” ▷ ①Lit seed ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: “Cry loudly, do not hold back; Raise your voice like a trumpet, And declare to My people their wrongdoing, And to the house of Jacob their sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they seek Me day by day and delight to know My ways, As a nation that has done righteousness And has not forsaken the ordinance of their God. They ask Me for just decisions, They delight in the nearness of God.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Why have we fasted and You do not see? Why have we humbled ourselves and You do not ①notice?’ Behold, on the day of your fast you find your desire, And oppress all your workers. ▷ ①Lit know

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, you fast for contention and strife, and to strike with a wicked fist. You do not fast like you have done today to make your voice heard on high!

column.name: text
column.value: Is it a fast like this that I choose, a day for a person to humble himself? Is it for bowing ①one’s head like a reed And for spreading out sackcloth and ashes as a bed? Will you call this a fast, even an acceptable day to the LORD? ▷ ①Lit his

column.name: text
column.value: Is this not the fast that I choose: To release the bonds of wickedness, To undo the ropes of the yoke, And to let the oppressed go free, And break every yoke?

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Then you will call, and the LORD will answer; You will cry for help, and He will say, ‘Here I am.’ If you remove the yoke from your midst, The ①pointing of the finger and speaking wickedness, ▷ ①I.e., an abusive gesture

column.name: text
column.value: And if you offer yourself to the hungry And satisfy the ①need of the afflicted, Then your light will rise in darkness, And your gloom will become like midday. ▷ ①Or soul

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD will continually guide you, And satisfy your ①desire in scorched places, And give strength to your bones; And you will be like a watered garden, And like a spring of water whose waters do not ②fail. ▷ ①Or soul ②Or deceive

column.name: text
text
column.value: “If, because of the Sabbath, you restrain your foot From doing as you wish on My holy day, And call the Sabbath a pleasure, and the holy day of the LORD honorable, And honor it, desisting from your own ways, From seeking your own pleasure And speaking your own word,

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will take delight in the LORD, And I will make you ride on the heights of the earth; And I will feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father, For the mouth of the LORD has spoken.”

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “Guard justice and do righteousness, For My salvation is about to come And My righteousness to be revealed.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is a man who does this, And a son of man who takes hold of it; Who keeps from profaning the Sabbath, And keeps his hand from doing any evil.”

column.name: text
column.value: Let not the foreigner who has joined himself to the LORD say, “The LORD will certainly separate me from His people.” Nor let the eunuch say, “Behold, I am a dry tree.”

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says: “To the eunuchs who keep My Sabbaths, And choose what pleases Me, And hold firmly to My covenant,

column.name: text
column.value: To them I will give in My house and within My walls a memorial, And a name better than that of sons and daughters; I will give ①them an everlasting name which will not be eliminated. ▷ ①As in DSS; MT him

column.name: text
column.value: “Also the foreigners who join themselves to the LORD, To attend to His service and to love the name of the LORD, To be His servants, every one who keeps the Sabbath so as not to profane it, And holds firmly to My covenant;

column.name: text
column.value: Even those I will bring to My holy mountain, And make them joyful in My house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be acceptable on My altar; For My house will be called a house of prayer for all the peoples.”

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord ①GOD, who gathers the dispersed of Israel, declares, “I will yet gather others to ②them, to those already gathered.” ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD ②Lit him

column.name: text
column.value: All you ①wild animals, All you animals in the forest, Come to eat. ▷ ①Lit animals of the field

column.name: text
column.value: His watchmen are blind, All of them know nothing. All of them are mute dogs unable to bark, Dreamers lying down, who love to slumber;

column.name: text
column.value: And the dogs are ①greedy, they ②are never satisfied. And they are shepherds who have no understanding; They have all turned to their own way, Each one to his unjust gain, ③without exception. ▷ ①Lit strong of soul/appetite ②Lit do not know satisfaction ③Lit from his end

column.name: text
text
column.value: “Arise, shine; for your light has come, And the glory of the LORD has risen upon you.

column.name: text
column.value: For behold, darkness will cover the earth And deep darkness the peoples; But the LORD will rise upon you And His glory will appear upon you.

column.name: text
column.value: Nations will come to your light, And kings to the brightness of your rising.

column.name: text
column.value: “Raise your eyes all around and see; They all gather together, they come to you. Your sons will come from afar, And your daughters will be ①carried on the hip. ▷ ①Lit cared for

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will see and be radiant, And your heart will ①thrill and rejoice; Because the ②abundance of the sea will be turned to you, The wealth of the nations will come to you. ▷ ①Lit tremble and open wide ②Lit roar

column.name: text
text
column.value: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered to you, The rams of Nebaioth will serve you; They will go up on My altar with acceptance, And I will glorify My glorious house.

column.name: text
column.value: Who are these who fly like a cloud And like the doves to their windows?

column.name: text
column.value: Certainly the coastlands will wait for Me; And the ships of Tarshish will come first, To bring your sons from afar, Their silver and their gold with them, For the name of the LORD your God, And for the Holy One of Israel because He has glorified you.

column.name: text
column.value: “Foreigners will build up your walls, And their kings will serve you; For in My wrath I struck you, And in My favor I have had compassion on you.

column.name: text
column.value: Your gates will be open continually; They will not be closed day or night, So that people may bring you the wealth of the nations, With their kings led in procession.

column.name: text
column.value: For the nation and the kingdom which will not serve you will perish, And the nations will be utterly ruined.

column.name: text
column.value: The glory of Lebanon will come to you, The juniper, the elm tree and the ①cedar together, To beautify the place of My sanctuary; And I will make the place of My feet glorious. ▷ ①Or cypress

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you, And all those who despised you will bow down at the soles of your feet; And they will call you the city of the LORD, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: “Whereas you have been forsaken and hated With no one passing through, I will make you an object of pride forever, A joy from generation to generation.

column.name: text
column.value: You will also suck the milk of nations, And suck the breast of kings; Then you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior And your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead of bronze I will bring gold, And instead of iron I will bring silver, And instead of wood, bronze, And instead of stones, iron. And I will make peace your administrators, And righteousness your overseers.

column.name: text
text
column.value: No longer will you have the sun for light by day, Nor will the moon give you light for brightness; But you will have the LORD as an everlasting light, And your God as your ①glory. ▷ ①Or beauty

column.name: text
column.value: Your sun will no longer set, Nor will your moon wane; For you will have the LORD as an everlasting light, And the days of your mourning will be over.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all your people will be righteous; They will possess the land forever, The branch of ①My planting, The work of My hands, That I may be glorified. ▷ ①Lit His

column.name: text
column.value: The smallest one will become a thousand, And the least one a mighty nation. I, the LORD, will bring it about quickly in its time.”

column.name: text
column.value: The Spirit of the Lord ①GOD is upon me, Because the LORD anointed me To bring good news to the humble; He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, To proclaim ②release to captives And ③freedom to prisoners; ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD ②Or liberty ③Lit opening to those who are bound

column.name: text
text
column.value: To grant those who mourn in Zion, Giving them a garland instead of ashes, The oil of gladness instead of mourning, The cloak of praise instead of a disheartened spirit. So they will be called ①oaks of righteousness, The planting of the LORD, that He may be glorified. ▷ ①Or terebinths

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will rebuild the ancient ruins, They will raise up the former devastations; And they will repair the ruined cities, The desolations of many generations.

column.name: text
column.value: Strangers will stand and pasture your flocks, And ①foreigners will be your farmers and your vinedressers. ▷ ①Lit sons of the foreigner

column.name: text
column.value: But you will be called the priests of the LORD; You will be spoken of as ministers of our God. You will eat the wealth of nations, And you will boast in their ①riches. ▷ ①Or glory

column.name: text
column.value: Instead of your shame you will have a double portion, And instead of humiliation they will shout for joy over their portion. Therefore they will possess a double portion in their land, Everlasting joy will be theirs.

column.name: text
column.value: For I, the LORD, love justice, I hate robbery ①in the burnt offering; And I will faithfully give them their reward, And make an everlasting covenant with them. ▷ ①Or with malice

column.name: text
column.value: Then their offspring will be known among the nations, And their descendants in the midst of the peoples. All who see them will recognize them Because they are the offspring whom the LORD has blessed.

column.name: text
column.value: I will rejoice greatly in the LORD, My soul will be joyful in my God; For He has clothed me with garments of salvation, He has wrapped me with a robe of righteousness, As a groom puts on a turban, And as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

column.name: text
column.value: For as the earth produces its sprouts, And as a garden causes the things sown in it to spring up, So the Lord ①GOD will cause righteousness and praise To spring up before all the nations. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: For Zion’s sake I will not keep silent, And for Jerusalem’s sake I will not keep quiet, Until her righteousness goes forth like brightness, And her salvation like a torch that is burning.

column.name: text
column.value: The nations will see your righteousness, And all kings your glory; And you will be called by a new name Which the mouth of the LORD will designate.

column.name: text
column.value: You will also be a crown of beauty in the hand of the LORD, And a royal headband in the hand of your God.

column.name: text
column.value: It will no longer be said to you, “ ①Forsaken,” Nor to your land will it any longer be said, “ ②Desolate”; But you will be called, “ ③My delight is in her,” And your land, “ ④Married”; For the LORD delights in you, And to Him your land will be married. ▷ ①I.e., Azubah ②I.e., Shemamah ③I.e., Hephzibah ④I.e., Beulah

column.name: text
column.value: For as a young man marries a virgin, So your sons will marry you; And as the ①groom rejoices over the bride, So your God will rejoice over you. ▷ ①Lit joy of the groom is over

column.name: text
text
column.value: And give Him no rest until He establishes And makes Jerusalem an object of praise on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has sworn by His right hand and by His mighty arm: “I will never again give your grain as food for your enemies, Nor will ①foreigners drink your new wine for which you have labored.” ▷ ①Lit sons of foreigners

column.name: text
column.value: But those who harvest it will eat it and praise the LORD; And those who gather it will drink it in the courtyards of My sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: Go through, go through the gates, Clear a way ①for the people! Build up, build up the highway, Remove the stones, lift up a flag over the peoples. ▷ ①Lit of

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: ①As fire kindles brushwood, as fire causes water to boil— To make Your name known to Your adversaries, That the nations may tremble at Your presence! ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: in Heb

column.name: text
column.value: When You did awesome things which we did not expect, You came down, the mountains quaked at Your presence.

column.name: text
column.value: For from days of old they have not heard or perceived by ear, Nor has the eye seen a God besides You, Who acts in behalf of one who waits for Him.

column.name: text
column.value: You meet him who rejoices in doing righteousness, Who remembers You in Your ways. Behold, You were angry, for we sinned, We continued in ①our sins for a long time; Yet shall we be saved? ▷ ①Lit them

column.name: text
column.value: For all of us have become like one who is unclean, And all our righteous deeds are like a filthy garment; And all of us wither like a leaf, And our wrongdoings, like the wind, take us away.

column.name: text
column.value: There is no one who calls on Your name, Who stirs himself to take hold of You; For You have hidden Your face from us And have ①surrendered us to the power of our wrongdoings. ▷ ①As in DSS and ancient versions; MT melted

column.name: text
text
column.value: Do not be angry beyond measure, LORD, Nor remember wrongdoing forever. Behold, please look, all of us are Your people.

column.name: text
column.value: Your holy cities have become a wilderness, Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

column.name: text
column.value: Our holy and beautiful house, Where our fathers praised You, Has been burned by fire; And all our precious things have become a ruin.

column.name: text
column.value: Will You restrain Yourself at these things, LORD? Will You keep silent and afflict us beyond measure?

column.name: text
column.value: “I permitted Myself to be sought by those who did not ask for Me; I permitted Myself to be found by those who did not seek Me. I said, ‘Here am I, here am I,’ To a nation which did not call on My name.

column.name: text
column.value: I have spread out My hands all day long to a rebellious people, Who walk in the way which is not good, ①following their own thoughts, ▷ ①Lit after

column.name: text
column.value: A people who continually provoke Me to My face, Offering sacrifices in gardens and burning incense on bricks;

column.name: text
text
column.value: Who say, ‘Keep to yourself, do not come near me, For I am holier than you!’ These are smoke in My ①nostrils, A fire that burns all the day. ▷ ①Lit nose

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, it is written before Me: I will not keep silent, but I will repay; I will even repay ①into their laps, ▷ ①I.e., individually and fully

column.name: text
column.value: Both your own wrongdoings and the wrongdoings of your fathers together,” says the LORD. “Because they have burned incense on the mountains And scorned Me on the hills, Therefore I will measure their former work ①into their laps.” ▷ ①I.e., individually and fully

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “Just as the new wine is found in the cluster, And one says, ‘Do not destroy it, for there is ①benefit in it,’ So I will act in behalf of My servants In order not to destroy ②all of them. ▷ ①Lit blessing ②Lit the whole

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring forth ①offspring from Jacob, And an heir of My mountains from Judah; My chosen ones shall inherit it, And My servants will live there. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: Sharon will be a pasture land for flocks, And the Valley of Achor a resting place for herds, For My people who seek Me.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for you who abandon the LORD, Who forget My holy mountain, Who set a table for ①Fortune, And fill a jug of mixed wine for ②Destiny, ▷ ①Heb Gad ②Heb Meni

column.name: text
column.value: I will destine you for the sword, And all of you will bow down to the slaughter. Because I called, but you did not answer; I spoke, but you did not listen. Instead, you did evil in My sight And chose that in which I did not delight.”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, this is what the Lord ①GOD says: “Behold, My servants will eat, but you will be hungry. Behold, My servants will drink, but you will be thirsty. Behold, My servants will rejoice, but you will be put to shame. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, My servants will shout joyfully with a glad heart, But you will cry out from a painful heart, And you will wail from a broken spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: You will leave your name as a curse to My chosen ones, And the Lord ①GOD will put you to death. But ②My servants will be called by another name. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD ②As in LXX; MT He will call His servants

column.name: text
column.value: Because the one who ①is blessed on the earth Will ②be blessed by the God of truth; And the one who swears an oath on the earth Will swear by the God of truth; Because the former troubles are forgotten, And because they are hidden from My sight! ▷ ①Or bless(es) himself ②Or bless(es) himself

column.name: text
text
text
text
column.value: No longer will there be ①in it an infant who lives only a few days, Or an old person who does not ②live out his days; For the youth will die at the age of a hundred, And the ③one who does not reach the age of a hundred Will be thought accursed. ▷ ①Lit from there ②Lit fill out ③Lit one who misses the mark

column.name: text
column.value: They will build houses and inhabit them; They will also plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: They will not build and another inhabit, They will not plant and another eat; For as the ①lifetime of a tree, so will be the days of My people, And My chosen ones will fully enjoy the work of their hands. ▷ ①Lit days

column.name: text
column.value: They will not labor in vain, Or give birth to children for disaster; For they are the ①descendants of those blessed by the LORD, And their descendants with them. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: It will also come to pass that before they call, I will answer; while they are still speaking, I will listen.

column.name: text
column.value: The wolf and the lamb will graze together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox; and dust will be the serpent’s food. They will do no evil or harm on all My holy mountain,” says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is this who comes from Edom, With garments of ①glowing colors from Bozrah, This One who is majestic in His apparel, ②Marching in the greatness of His strength? “It is I, the One who speaks in righteousness, mighty to save.” ▷ ①Or crimson ②Lit Inclining

column.name: text
column.value: Why is Your apparel red, And Your garments like one who treads in the wine press?

column.name: text
column.value: “I have trodden the wine trough alone, And from the peoples there was no one with Me. I also trod them in My anger And trampled them in My wrath; And their ①lifeblood is sprinkled on My garments, And I ②stained all My clothes. ▷ ①Lit juice ②Lit defiled

column.name: text
column.value: For the day of vengeance was in My heart, And My year of redemption has come.

column.name: text
column.value: I looked, but there was no one to help, And I was astonished and there was no one to uphold; So My own arm brought salvation to Me, And My wrath upheld Me.

column.name: text
column.value: I trampled down the peoples in My anger And made them drunk with My wrath, And I ①poured out their lifeblood on the earth.” ▷ ①Lit brought down their juice to the earth

column.name: text
column.value: I will make mention of the mercies of the LORD, and the praises of the LORD, According to all that the LORD has granted us, And the great goodness toward the house of Israel, Which He has granted them according to His compassion And according to the abundance of His mercies.

column.name: text
column.value: For He said, “Certainly they are My people, Sons who will not deal falsely.” So He became their Savior.

column.name: text
column.value: In all their distress ①He was distressed, And the angel of His presence saved them; In His love and in His mercy He redeemed them, And He lifted them and carried them all the days of old. ▷ ①Another reading is He was not an adversary

column.name: text
column.value: But they rebelled And grieved His Holy Spirit; Therefore He turned Himself to become their enemy, He fought against them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then His people remembered the days of old, of Moses. Where is He who brought them up out of the sea with the ①shepherds of His flock? Where is He who put His Holy Spirit in the midst of ②them, ▷ ①Some mss shepherd ②Lit him

column.name: text
column.value: Who caused His glorious arm to go at the right hand of Moses, Who divided the waters before them to make for Himself an everlasting name,

column.name: text
column.value: Who led them through the depths? Like the horse in the wilderness, they did not stumble;

column.name: text
column.value: Like the cattle which go down into the valley, The Spirit of the LORD gave ①them rest. So You led Your people, To make for Yourself a glorious name. ▷ ①Lit him

column.name: text
text
column.value: For You are our Father, though Abraham does not know us And Israel does not recognize us. You, LORD, are our Father, Our Redeemer from ancient times is Your name.

column.name: text
column.value: Why, LORD, do You cause us to stray from Your ways And harden our heart from fearing You? Return for the sake of Your servants, the tribes of Your heritage.

column.name: text
column.value: Your holy people possessed Your sanctuary for a little while, Our adversaries have trampled it down.

column.name: text
column.value: We have become like those over whom You have never ruled, Like those who were not called by Your name.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “Heaven is My throne and the earth is the footstool for My feet. Where then is a house you could build for Me? And where is a place that ①I may rest? ▷ ①Lit is My resting place?

column.name: text
column.value: For My hand made all these things, So all these things came into being,” declares the LORD. “But I will look to this one, At one who is humble and contrite in spirit, and who trembles at My word.

column.name: text
text
column.value: So I will choose their ①punishments And bring on them what they dread. Because I called, but no one answered; I spoke, but they did not listen. Instead, they did evil in My sight And chose that in which I did not delight.” ▷ ①Lit ill treatments

column.name: text
column.value: Hear the word of the LORD, you who tremble at His word: “Your brothers who hate you, who exclude you on account of My name, Have said, ‘Let the LORD be glorified, so that we may see your joy.’ But they will be put to shame.

column.name: text
column.value: A sound of uproar from the city, a voice from the temple, The voice of the LORD who is dealing retribution to His enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: “Before she was in labor, she delivered; Before her pain came, she gave birth to a boy.

column.name: text
column.value: Who has heard such a thing? Who has seen such things? Can a land be ①born in one day? Can a nation be given birth all at once? As soon as Zion was in labor, she also delivered her sons. ▷ ①Lit born through labor-pains

column.name: text
column.value: Shall I bring to the point of birth but not give delivery?” says the LORD. “Or shall I who gives delivery shut the womb?” says your God.

column.name: text
column.value: “Be joyful with Jerusalem and rejoice for her, all you who love her; Be exceedingly glad with her, all you who mourn over her,

column.name: text
column.value: So that you may nurse and be satisfied with her comforting breasts, So that you may drink fully and be delighted with her bountiful breasts.”

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says: “Behold, I extend peace to her like a river, And the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream; And you will ①be nursed, you will be carried on the ②hip and rocked back and forth on the knees. ▷ ①Lit nurse ②Lit side

column.name: text
column.value: As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you; And you will be comforted in Jerusalem.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will see this, and your heart will be glad, And your bones will flourish like the new grass; And the hand of the LORD will be made known to His servants, But He will be indignant toward His enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: For behold, the LORD will come in fire, And His chariots like the whirlwind, To render His anger with fury, And His rebuke with flames of fire.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD will execute judgment by fire And by His sword on ①humanity, And those put to death by the LORD will be many. ▷ ①Lit all flesh

column.name: text
column.value: “Those who sanctify and purify themselves to go to the gardens, ①Following one in the center, Who eat pig’s flesh, detestable things, and mice, Will come to an end altogether,” declares the LORD. ▷ ①Lit After

column.name: text
column.value: “For I ①know their works and their thoughts; ②the time is coming to gather all the nations and tongues. And they shall come and see My glory. ▷ ①As in LXX; know not found in MT ②Lit it is coming

column.name: text
column.value: And I will put a sign among them and send survivors from them to the nations: Tarshish, ①Put, Lud, ②Meshech, Tubal, and ③Javan, to the distant coastlands that have neither heard of My fame nor seen My glory. And they will declare My glory among the nations. ▷ ①As in LXX; MT Pul ②As in LXX; MT those who draw the bow ③I.e., Greece

column.name: text
column.value: Then they shall bring all your countrymen from all the nations as a grain offering to the LORD, on horses, in chariots, in litters, on mules, and on camels, to My holy mountain Jerusalem,” says the LORD, “just as the sons of Israel bring their grain offering in a clean vessel to the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also take some of them as priests and Levites,” says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “For just as the new heavens and the new earth, Which I make, will endure before Me,” declares the LORD, “So will your descendants and your name endure.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be from new moon to new moon And from Sabbath to Sabbath, All ①mankind will come to bow down before Me,” says the LORD. ▷ ①Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: “Then they will go out and look At the corpses of the people Who have rebelled against Me. For their worm will not die And their fire will not be extinguished; And they will be an abhorrence to all ①mankind.” ▷ ①Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,

column.name: text
column.value: to whom the word of the LORD came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

column.name: text
column.value: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the exile of Jerusalem in the fifth month.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
text
column.value: Then I said, “Oh, Lord ①GOD! Behold, I do not know how to speak, Because I am a youth.” ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD said to me, “Do not say, ‘I am a youth,’ Because everywhere I send you, you shall go, And all that I command you, you shall speak.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be afraid of them, For I am with you to save you,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD stretched out His hand and touched my mouth, and the LORD said to me, “Behold, I have put My words in your mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: See, I have appointed you this day over the nations and over the kingdoms, To root out and to tear down, To destroy and to overthrow, To build and to plant.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” And I said, “I see a branch of an ①almond tree.” ▷ ①Heb shaqed, see note v 12

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me, “You have seen well, for I am ①watching over My word to perform it.” ▷ ①Heb shoqed, a wordplay on almond in v 11 (see note v 11)

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me a second time, saying, “What do you see?” And I said, “I see a boiling pot, facing away from the north.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me, “Out of the north the evil ①will be unleashed on all the inhabitants of the land. ▷ ①Lit opened

column.name: text
column.value: For, behold, I am calling all the families of the kingdoms of the north,” declares the LORD; “and they will come and place, each one of them, his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls around, and against all the cities of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will ①pronounce My judgments against them concerning all their wickedness, since they have abandoned Me and have ②offered sacrifices to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands. ▷ ①Lit speak ②Or burned incense

column.name: text
column.value: Now, belt your garment around your waist and arise, and speak to them all that I command you. Do not be dismayed before them, or I will make you dismayed before them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now behold, I have made you today like a fortified city and like a pillar of iron and walls of bronze against the whole land, to the kings of Judah, to its leaders, to its priests, and to the people of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And they will fight against you but they will not overcome you, for I am with you to save you,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, ‘This is what the LORD says: “I remember regarding you the ①devotion of your youth, Your love when you were a bride, Your following after Me in the wilderness, Through a land not sown. ▷ ①Or faithfulness

column.name: text
column.value: Israel was holy to the LORD, The first of His harvest. All who ate of it became guilty; Evil came upon them,” declares the LORD.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Hear the word of the LORD, house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “What injustice did your fathers find in Me, That they went far from Me, And walked after emptiness and became empty?

column.name: text
column.value: They did not say, ‘Where is the LORD Who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, Who led us through the wilderness, Through a land of deserts and of pits, Through a land of drought and of ①deep darkness, Through a land that no one crossed And where no person lived?’ ▷ ①Or the shadow of death

column.name: text
column.value: I brought you into the fruitful land To eat its fruit and its good things. But you came and defiled My land, And you made My inheritance an abomination.

column.name: text
column.value: The priests did not say, ‘Where is the LORD?’ And those who handle the Law did not know Me; The ①rulers also revolted against Me, And the prophets prophesied by Baal And walked after things that were of no benefit. ▷ ①Lit shepherds

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore I will still contend with you,” declares the LORD, “And I will contend with your sons’ sons.

column.name: text
column.value: For cross to the coastlands of ①Kittim and see, And send to Kedar and observe closely, And see if there has been anything like this! ▷ ①I.e., Cyprus and other islands

column.name: text
column.value: Has a nation changed gods, When they were not gods? But My people have exchanged their glory For that which is of no benefit.

column.name: text
column.value: Be appalled at this, you heavens, And shudder, be very desolate,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “For My people have committed two evils: They have abandoned Me, The fountain of living waters, To carve out for themselves cisterns, Broken cisterns That do not hold water.

column.name: text
column.value: “Is Israel a slave? Or is he a servant born in the home? Why has he become plunder?

column.name: text
column.value: The young lions have roared at him, They have ①roared loudly. And they have made his land a waste; His cities have been destroyed, without inhabitant. ▷ ①Lit given their voice

column.name: text
column.value: Also the ①men of Memphis and Tahpanhes Have ②shaved your head. ▷ ①Lit sons ②Lit grazed

column.name: text
column.value: Have you not done this to yourself By your abandoning the LORD your God When He led you in the way?

column.name: text
column.value: But now what are you doing on the road to Egypt, Except to drink the waters of the ①Nile? Or what are you doing on the road to Assyria, Except to drink the waters of the Euphrates River? ▷ ①Heb Shihor

column.name: text
column.value: Your own wickedness will correct you, And your apostasies will punish you; Know therefore and see that it is evil and bitter For you to abandon the LORD your God, And the fear of Me is not in you,” declares the Lord ①GOD of armies. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: “For long ago ①I broke your yoke And tore off your restraints; But you said, ‘I will not serve!’ For on every high hill And under every leafy tree You have lain down as a prostitute. ▷ ①Or you

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I planted you as a choice vine, A completely faithful seed. How then have you turned yourself before Me Into the degenerate shoots of a foreign vine?

column.name: text
column.value: Although you wash yourself with lye And ①use much soap, The stain of your guilt is before Me,” declares the Lord ②GOD. ▷ ①Lit acquire much soap for yourself ②Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: “How can you say, ‘I am not defiled, I have not gone after the Baals’? Look at your way in the valley! Know what you have done! You are a swift young camel running about senselessly on her ways,

column.name: text
column.value: A wild donkey accustomed to the wilderness, That sniffs the wind in her passion. Who can turn her away in her mating season? None who seek her will grow weary; In her month they will find her.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep your feet from being bare, And your throat from thirst; But you said, ‘It is ①hopeless! No! For I have loved strangers, And I will walk after them.’ ▷ ①Or desperate

column.name: text
column.value: “Like the shame of a thief when he is discovered, So the house of Israel is shamed; They, their kings, their leaders, Their priests, and their prophets,

column.name: text
column.value: Who say to a tree, ‘You are my father,’ And to a stone, ‘You gave me birth.’ For they have turned their backs to Me, And not their faces; But in the time of their ①trouble they will say, ‘Arise and save us!’ ▷ ①Or evil

column.name: text
column.value: But where are your gods Which you made for yourself? Let them arise, if they can save you In the time of your ①trouble! For as many as the number of your cities Are your gods, Judah. ▷ ①Or evil

column.name: text
column.value: “Why do you contend with Me? You have all revolted against Me,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “In vain I have struck your sons; They did not accept discipline. Your sword has devoured your prophets Like a destroying lion.

column.name: text
column.value: You generation, look to the word of the LORD. Have I been a wilderness to Israel, Or a land of thick darkness? Why do My people say, ‘We are free to roam; We will no longer come to You’?

column.name: text
column.value: Can a virgin forget her jewelry, Or a bride her attire? Yet My people have forgotten Me For days without number.

column.name: text
column.value: How well you prepare your way To seek love! Therefore even to the wicked women You have taught your ways.

column.name: text
column.value: Also on your skirts is found The lifeblood of the innocent poor; You did not find them breaking in. But in spite of all these things,

column.name: text
column.value: You said, ‘I am innocent; Surely His anger is turned away from me.’ Behold, I will enter into judgment with you Because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’

column.name: text
column.value: Why do you go around so much Changing your way? Also, you will be put to shame by Egypt, Just as you were put to shame by Assyria.

column.name: text
column.value: From this place as well you will go out With your hands on your head; For the LORD has rejected those in whom you trust, And you will not prosper with them.”

column.name: text
column.value: God ①says, “If a husband divorces his wife And she leaves him And becomes another man’s wife, Will he return to her again? Would that land not be completely defiled? But you are a prostitute with many ②lovers; Yet you turn to Me,” declares the LORD. ▷ ①Lit saying ②Lit companions

column.name: text
column.value: “Raise your eyes to the bare heights and see; Where have you not been violated? You have sat for them by the roads Like an Arab in the desert, And you have defiled a land With your prostitution and your wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the showers have been withheld, And there has been no spring rain. Yet you had a prostitute’s ①forehead; You refused to be ashamed. ▷ ①I.e., calloused appearance

column.name: text
column.value: Have you not just now called to Me, ‘My Father, You are the friend of my youth?

column.name: text
column.value: Will He be angry forever, Or keep His anger to the end?’ Behold, you have spoken And have done evil things, And you have ①had your own way.” ▷ ①Lit been able

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me in the days of King Josiah, “Have you seen what faithless Israel did? She went up on every high hill and under every leafy tree, and she prostituted herself there.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I ①thought, ‘After she has done all these things she will return to Me’; but she did not return, and her treacherous sister Judah saw it. ▷ ①Lit said

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw that for all the ①adulteries of faithless Israel, I had sent her away and given her a certificate of divorce, yet her treacherous sister Judah did not fear; but she went and prostituted herself also. ▷ ①I.e., idolatry

column.name: text
column.value: And because of the thoughtlessness of her prostitution, she defiled the land and committed ①adultery with stones and trees. ▷ ①I.e., idolatry

column.name: text
column.value: Yet in spite of all this her treacherous sister Judah did not return to Me with all her heart, but rather in deception,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, “Faithless Israel has proved herself to be more righteous than treacherous Judah.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Only ①acknowledge your wrongdoing, That you have revolted against the LORD your God, And have scattered your ②favors to the strangers under every leafy tree, And you have not obeyed My voice,’ declares the LORD. ▷ ①Lit know ②Lit ways

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Return, you faithless sons,’ declares the LORD; ‘For I am a master to you, And I will take you, one from a city and two from a family, And bring you to Zion.’

column.name: text
column.value: “Then I will give you shepherds ①after My own heart, who will feed you knowledge and understanding. ▷ ①I.e., with hearts like Mine

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be in those days when you become numerous and are fruitful in the land,” declares the LORD, “they will no longer say, ‘The ark of the covenant of the LORD.’ And it will not come to mind, nor will they remember it, nor miss it, nor will it be made again.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time they will call Jerusalem ‘The Throne of the LORD,’ and all the nations will assemble at it, at Jerusalem, for the name of the LORD; and they will no longer follow the stubbornness of their evil heart.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel, and they will come together from the land of the north to the land that I gave your fathers as an inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: “Then I said, ‘How I would set you among ①My sons And give you a pleasant land, The most beautiful inheritance of the nations!’ And I said, ‘You shall call Me, My Father, And not turn away from following Me.’ ▷ ①Lit the

column.name: text
column.value: However, as a woman treacherously leaves her lover, So you have dealt treacherously with Me, House of Israel,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: A voice is heard on the bare heights, The weeping, the pleading of the sons of Israel. Because they have perverted their way, They have forgotten the LORD their God.

column.name: text
column.value: “Return, you faithless sons, I will heal your faithlessness.” “Behold, we come to You; For You are the LORD our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Certainly the hills are a deception, ①Commotion on the mountains. Certainly in the LORD our God Is the salvation of Israel. ▷ ①I.e., from idolatrous rituals

column.name: text
column.value: “But the shame has consumed the product of our fathers’ labor since our youth—their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our humiliation cover us; for we have sinned against the LORD our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day. And we have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God.”

column.name: text
column.value: “Roam about through the streets of Jerusalem, And look and take notice. And seek in her public squares, If you can find a person, If there is one who does justice, who seeks honesty, Then I will forgive ①her. ▷ ①I.e., Jerusalem

column.name: text
column.value: And although they say, ‘As the LORD lives,’ Certainly they swear falsely.”

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, do Your eyes not look for honesty? You have struck them, But they did not ①weaken; You have consumed them, But they refused to accept discipline. They have made their faces harder than rock; They have refused to repent. ▷ ①Or become sick

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, “They are only the poor, They are foolish; For they do not know the way of the LORD Or the judgment of their God.

column.name: text
column.value: I will go to the great And speak to them, For they know the way of the LORD And the judgment of their God.” But together they too have broken the yoke And burst the restraints.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore a lion from the forest will kill them, A wolf of the deserts will destroy them, A leopard is watching their cities. Everyone who goes out of them will be torn in pieces, Because their wrongdoings are many, Their apostasies are numerous.

column.name: text
column.value: “Why should I forgive you? Your sons have forsaken Me And sworn by those who are not gods. When I had fed them to the full, They committed adultery And stayed at the prostitute’s house.

column.name: text
column.value: They were well-fed lusty horses, Each one neighing at his neighbor’s wife.

column.name: text
column.value: Shall I not punish them for these things?” declares the LORD, “And shall I not avenge Myself On a nation such as this?

column.name: text
column.value: “Go up through her vine rows and destroy, But do not execute a complete destruction; Strip away her branches, For they are not the LORD’S.

column.name: text
column.value: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah Have dealt very treacherously with Me,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: They have lied about the LORD And said, “ ①Not He; Misfortune will not come upon us, Nor will we see sword or famine. ▷ ①Lit He is not

column.name: text
column.value: The prophets are as wind, And the word is not in them. So it will be done to them!”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, this is what the LORD, the God of armies says: “Because you have spoken this word, Behold, I am making My words fire in your mouth, And this people wood, and it will consume them.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I am bringing a nation against you from far away, you house of Israel,” declares the LORD. “It is an enduring nation, It is an ancient nation, A nation whose language you do not know, Nor can you understand what they say.

column.name: text
column.value: Their quiver is like an open grave, All of them are warriors.

column.name: text
text
column.value: “Yet even in those days,” declares the LORD, “I will not make a complete destruction of you.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come about when ①they say, ‘Why has the LORD our God done all these things to us?’ then you shall say to them, ‘Just as you have abandoned Me and served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve strangers in a land that is not yours.’ ▷ ①Or you

column.name: text
column.value: “Declare this in the house of Jacob And proclaim it in Judah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Now hear this, you foolish and ①senseless people, Who have eyes but do not see, Who have ears but do not hear. ▷ ①Lit without heart

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not fear Me?’ declares the LORD. ‘Do you not tremble in My presence? For I have placed the sand as a boundary for the sea, An eternal limit, and it will not cross over it. Though the waves toss, they cannot prevail; Though they roar, they will not cross over it.

column.name: text
column.value: But this people has a stubborn and rebellious heart; They have turned aside and departed.

column.name: text
column.value: They do not say in their heart, “Let us now fear the LORD our God, Who gives rain in its season, Both the autumn rain and the spring rain, Who keeps for us The appointed weeks of the harvest.”

column.name: text
column.value: Your wrongdoings have turned these away, And your sins have kept good away from you.

column.name: text
column.value: For wicked people are found among My people, They watch like fowlers ①lying in wait; They set a trap, They catch people. ▷ ①Perhaps, crouching down

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Shall I not punish them for these things?’ declares the LORD, ‘Or shall I not avenge Myself On a nation such as this?’

column.name: text
column.value: “An appalling and horrible thing Has happened in the land:

column.name: text
column.value: The prophets prophesy falsely, And the priests rule ①on their own authority; And My people love it this way! But what will you do ②when the end comes? ▷ ①Lit over their own hands ②Lit at the end of it

column.name: text
column.value: “If you will return, Israel,” declares the LORD, “Then you should return to Me. And if you will put away your detestable things from My presence, And will not waver,

column.name: text
column.value: And if you will swear, ‘As the LORD lives,’ In truth, in justice, and in righteousness; Then the nations will bless themselves in Him, And in Him they will boast.”

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem: “ ①Break up your uncultivated ground, And do not sow among thorns. ▷ ①Lit Plow for yourselves plowed ground

column.name: text
column.value: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD And remove the foreskins of your hearts, Men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem, Or else My wrath will spread like fire And burn with no one to quench it, Because of the evil of your deeds.”

column.name: text
column.value: Declare in Judah and proclaim in Jerusalem, and say, “Blow the trumpet in the land; Cry aloud and say, ‘Assemble, and let’s go Into the fortified cities.’

column.name: text
column.value: Raise a flag toward Zion! Take refuge, do not stand still, For I am bringing evil from the north, And great destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: A lion has gone up from his thicket, And a destroyer of nations has set out; He has gone out from his place To make your land a waste. Your cities will be ruins, Without an inhabitant.

column.name: text
column.value: For this, put on sackcloth, Mourn and wail; For the fierce anger of the LORD Has not turned away from us.”

column.name: text
column.value: “And it shall come about on that day,” declares the LORD, “that the heart of the king and the hearts of the leaders will fail; and the priests will tremble, and the prophets will be astonished.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, “Oh, Lord ①GOD! Surely You have utterly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You will have peace’; yet a sword touches the ②throat.” ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD ②Or life

column.name: text
column.value: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, “A scorching wind from the bare heights in the wilderness, in the direction of the daughter of My people—not to winnow and not to cleanse,

column.name: text
