column.value: a wind too ①strong for ②this—will come ③at My command; now I will also pronounce judgments against them.” ▷ ①Lit full from ②Lit these ③Lit for Me

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, he goes up like clouds, And his chariots like the whirlwind; His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us, for we are ruined!”

column.name: text
column.value: Wash your heart from evil, Jerusalem, So that you may be saved. How long will your wicked thoughts Lodge within you?

column.name: text
column.value: For a voice declares from Dan, And proclaims wickedness from Mount Ephraim.

column.name: text
column.value: “Report it to the nations, now! Proclaim to Jerusalem, ‘ ①Enemies are coming from a remote country, And they raise their voices against the cities of Judah. ▷ ①As indicated in LXX; MT watchmen

column.name: text
column.value: Like watchmen of a field they are against her all around, Because she has rebelled against Me,’ declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Your ways and your deeds Have ①brought these things upon you. This is your evil. How bitter! How it has touched your heart!” ▷ ①Lit done

column.name: text
column.value: My ①soul, my ②soul! I am in anguish! ③Oh, my heart! My heart is pounding in me; I cannot keep silent, Because, ④my soul, you have heard The sound of the trumpet, The alarm of war. ▷ ①Lit inward parts ②Lit inward parts ③Lit The walls of my heart ④Another reading is I have heard

column.name: text
column.value: Disaster upon disaster is proclaimed, For the whole land is devastated; Suddenly my tents are devastated, And my curtains in an instant.

column.name: text
column.value: How long must I see the flag And hear the sound of the trumpet?

column.name: text
column.value: “For My people are foolish, They do not know Me; They are foolish children And have no understanding. They are skillful at doing evil, But they do not know how to do good.”

column.name: text
text
column.value: I looked on the mountains, and behold, they were quaking, And all the hills jolted back and forth.

column.name: text
column.value: I looked, and behold, there was no human, And all the birds of the sky had fled.

column.name: text
column.value: I looked, and behold, ①the fruitful land was a wilderness, And all its cities were pulled down Before the LORD, before His fierce anger. ▷ ①Or Carmel

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says: “The whole land shall be a desolation, Yet I will not execute a complete destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: For this the earth will mourn, And the heavens above will become dark, Because I have spoken, I have purposed, And I have not ①changed My mind, nor will I turn from it.” ▷ ①Or been sorry

column.name: text
text
column.value: And you, desolate one, what will you do? Although you dress in scarlet, Although you adorn yourself with jewelry of gold, Although you enlarge your eyes with makeup, In vain you make yourself beautiful. Your ①lovers despise you; They seek your life. ▷ ①Lit paramours

column.name: text
column.value: For I heard a voice cry as of a woman in labor, The anguish as of one giving birth to her first child. The voice of the daughter of Zion gasping for breath, Stretching out her ①hands, saying, “Ah, woe to me, for ②I faint before murderers.” ▷ ①Lit palms ②Lit my soul faints

column.name: text
column.value: “Flee to safety, you sons of Benjamin, From the midst of Jerusalem! Blow a trumpet in Tekoa And raise a warning signal over ①Beth-haccerem; For evil looks down from the north, Along with a great destruction. ▷ ①I.e., house of the vineyard

column.name: text
column.value: The beautiful and delicate one, the daughter of Zion, I will destroy.

column.name: text
column.value: Shepherds and their flocks will come to her, They will pitch their tents ①around her, They will pasture, each in his ②place. ▷ ①Lit against her round about ②Lit hand

column.name: text
column.value: ‘ ①Prepare for war against her; Arise, and let’s ②attack at noon. Woe to us, for the day declines, For the shadows of the evening lengthen! ▷ ①Lit Sanctify war ②Lit go up

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, and let’s ①attack by night And destroy her ②palaces!’ ” ▷ ①Lit go up ②Or fortified towers

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD of armies says: “Cut down her trees And pile up an assault ramp against Jerusalem. This is the city to be punished, In whose midst there is only oppression.

column.name: text
column.value: As a well ①keeps its waters fresh, So she ②keeps fresh her wickedness. Violence and destruction are heard in her; Sickness and wounds are constantly before Me. ▷ ①Lit keeps cold ②Lit keeps cold

column.name: text
column.value: Be warned, Jerusalem, Or ①I shall be alienated from you, And make you a desolation, An uninhabited land.” ▷ ①Lit my soul

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD of armies says: “They will thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like the vine; Pass your hand over the branches again Like a grape gatherer.”

column.name: text
column.value: To whom shall I speak and give warning, That they may hear? Behold, their ears are ①closed And they cannot listen. Behold, the word of the LORD has become for them a rebuke; They take no delight in it. ▷ ①Lit uncircumcised

column.name: text
column.value: But I am full of the wrath of the LORD; I am weary of holding it in. “Pour it out on the children in the street And on the ①gathering of young men together; For both husband and wife shall be taken, The old ②and the very old. ▷ ①Lit council ②Lit with fullness of days

column.name: text
column.value: Their houses shall be turned over to others, Their fields and their wives together; For I will stretch out My hand Against the inhabitants of the land,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “For from the least of them to the greatest of them, Everyone is greedy for gain, And from the prophet to the priest Everyone deals falsely.

column.name: text
column.value: They have healed the brokenness of My people superficially, Saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ But there is no peace.

column.name: text
column.value: Were they ashamed because of the abomination they had done? They were not ashamed at all, Nor did they know even how to be ashamed. Therefore they will fall among those who fall; At the time that I punish them, They will collapse,” says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “Stand by the ways and see and ask for the ancient paths, Where the good way is, and walk in it; Then you will find a resting place for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it.’

column.name: text
column.value: And I set watchmen over you, saying, ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’ But they said, ‘We will not listen.’

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore hear, you nations, And know, you congregation, what is among them.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear, earth: behold, I am bringing disaster on this people, The fruit of their ①plans, Because they have not listened to My words, And as for My Law, they have rejected it also. ▷ ①Or devices

column.name: text
column.value: For what purpose does frankincense come to Me from Sheba, And the ①sweet cane from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable And your sacrifices are not pleasing to Me.” ▷ ①Lit good

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, this is what the LORD says: “Behold, I am ①placing stumbling blocks before this people. And they will stumble against them, Fathers and sons together; Neighbor and ②friend will perish.” ▷ ①Lit giving ②Lit his friend

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “Behold, there is a people coming from the north land, And a great nation will be stirred up from the remote parts of the earth.

column.name: text
text
column.value: We have heard the report of it; Our hands are limp. Anguish has seized us, Pain like that of a woman in childbirth.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not go out into the field, And do not walk on the road; For the enemy has a sword, Terror is on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: Daughter of my people, put on sackcloth And roll in ashes; ①Mourn as for an only son, A most bitter mourning. For suddenly the destroyer Will come against us. ▷ ①Lit Make for yourself mourning

column.name: text
column.value: “I have made you an assayer and an examiner among My people, So that you may know and put their way to the test.”

column.name: text
column.value: All of them are stubbornly rebellious, Going about as a slanderer; They are bronze and iron. They are, all of them, corrupt.

column.name: text
column.value: The bellows blow fiercely, The lead is consumed by the fire; In vain the refining goes on, But the wicked are not ①separated. ▷ ①Or drawn off

column.name: text
column.value: They call them rejected silver, Because the LORD has rejected them.

column.name: text
column.value: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Stand at the gate of the LORD’S house and proclaim there this word, and say, ‘Hear the word of the LORD, all you of Judah, who enter by these gates to worship the LORD!’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: “Amend your ways and your deeds, and I will let you live in this place.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not trust in deceptive words, saying, ‘ ①This is the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD.’ ▷ ①Lit They are

column.name: text
column.value: For if you truly amend your ways and your deeds, if you truly practice justice between a person and his neighbor,

column.name: text
column.value: if you do not oppress the stranger, the ①orphan, or the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place, nor follow other gods to your own ruin, ▷ ①Or fatherless

column.name: text
column.value: then I will let you live in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers forever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, you are trusting in deceptive words to no avail.

column.name: text
column.value: Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, ①offer sacrifices to Baal, and follow other gods that you have not known, ▷ ①Or burn incense

column.name: text
column.value: then come and stand before Me in this house which is called by My name, and say, ‘We are saved!’—so that you may do all these abominations?

column.name: text
column.value: Has this house, which is called by My name, become a den of robbers in your sight? Behold, I Myself have seen it,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “But go now to My place which was in Shiloh, where I made My name dwell at the beginning, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of My people Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, because you have done all these things,” declares the LORD, “and I spoke to you, speaking again and again, but you did not listen, and I called you but you did not answer,

column.name: text
column.value: therefore I will do to the house which is called by My name, in which you trust, and to the place which I gave you and your fathers, just as I did to Shiloh.

column.name: text
column.value: I will hurl you out of My sight, just as I have hurled out all your brothers, all the ①descendants of Ephraim. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: “As for you, do not pray for this people, and do not lift up a cry or prayer for them, and do not plead with Me; for I am not listening to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

column.name: text
column.value: The ①children gather wood, the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead dough to make sacrificial cakes for the queen of heaven; and they pour out drink offerings to other gods in order to provoke Me to anger. ▷ ①Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: Are they provoking Me?” declares the LORD. “Is it not themselves instead, to their ①own shame?” ▷ ①Lit their faces’

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the Lord ①GOD says: “Behold, My anger and My wrath will be poured out on this place, on human and animal life, and on the trees of the field and the fruit of the ground; and it will burn and not be quenched.” ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: “Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: For I did not speak to your fathers, or command them on the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings and sacrifices.

column.name: text
column.value: But this is ①what I commanded them, saying, ‘Obey My voice, and I will be your God, and you will be My people; and you shall walk ②entirely in the way which I command you, so that it may go well for you.’ ▷ ①Lit the word ②Lit in all the way

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they did not obey or incline their ear, but walked by their own advice and in the stubbornness of their evil hearts, and they ①went backward and not forward. ▷ ①Lit were

column.name: text
column.value: Since the day that your fathers came out of the land of Egypt until this day, I have sent you all My servants the prophets, sending them daily, again and again.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they did not listen to Me or incline their ear, but stiffened their neck; they did more evil than their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: “So you shall speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you; and you shall call to them, but they will not answer you.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall say to them, ‘This is the nation that did not obey the voice of the LORD their God or accept discipline; ①trustworthiness has perished and has been eliminated from their mouth. ▷ ①Or faithfulness

column.name: text
column.value: Cut off ①your hair and throw it away, And take up a song of mourning on the bare heights; For the LORD has rejected and forsaken The generation of His wrath.’ ▷ ①Lit your crown

column.name: text
column.value: For the sons of Judah have done that which is evil in My sight,” declares the LORD. “They have put their detestable things in the house which is called by My name, to defile it.

column.name: text
column.value: They have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which I did not command, and it did not come into My ①mind. ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore, behold, days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when it will no longer be called Topheth, or the Valley of Ben-hinnom, but the Valley of the Slaughter; for they will bury in Topheth ①because there is no other place. ▷ ①Or until there is no place left

column.name: text
column.value: The dead bodies of this people will be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth; and no one will frighten them away.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will eliminate from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the groom and the voice of the bride; for the land will become a site of ruins.

column.name: text
column.value: “At that time,” declares the LORD, “they will bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of its leaders, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem from their graves.

column.name: text
column.value: They will spread them out to the sun, the moon, and to all the heavenly ①lights, which they have loved, which they have served, which they have followed, which they have sought, and which they have worshiped. They will not be gathered nor buried; they will be like dung on the face of the ground. ▷ ①Lit host

column.name: text
column.value: And death will be chosen rather than life by all the remnant that remains of this evil family, that remains in all the places to which I have driven them,” declares the LORD of armies.

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall say to them, ‘This is what the LORD says: “Do people fall and not get up? Does one turn away and not ①repent? ▷ ①Lit turn back

column.name: text
column.value: Why has this people, Jerusalem, Turned away in continual apostasy? They hold on to deceit, They refuse to return.

column.name: text
column.value: I have listened and heard, They have spoken what is not right; No one repented of his wickedness, Saying, ‘What have I done?’ Everyone turned to his own course, Like a horse charging into the battle.

column.name: text
column.value: Even the stork in the sky Knows her seasons; And the turtledove, the swallow, and the crane Keep to the time of their ①migration; But My people do not know The judgment of the LORD. ▷ ①Lit coming

column.name: text
column.value: “How can you say, ‘We are wise, And the Law of the LORD is with us’? But behold, the lying pen of the scribes Has made it into a lie.

column.name: text
column.value: The wise men are put to shame, They are dismayed and caught; Behold, they have rejected the word of the LORD, So what kind of wisdom do they have?

column.name: text
text
column.value: They have healed the brokenness of the daughter of My people superficially, Saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ But there is no peace.

column.name: text
text
column.value: “I will certainly snatch them away,” declares the LORD. “There will be no grapes on the vine And no figs on the fig tree, And the leaf will wither; And what I have given them will pass away.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Why are we sitting still? Assemble yourselves, and let’s go into the fortified cities And perish there, For the LORD our God has doomed us And given us poisoned water to drink, Because we have sinned against the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: We waited for peace, but no good came; For a time of healing, but behold, terror!

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: ①My sorrow is beyond healing, My heart is faint within me! ▷ ①As in LXX and ancient versions

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, listen! The cry of the daughter of my people from a distant land: “Is the LORD not in Zion? Is her King not within her?” “Why have they provoked Me with their carved images, with foreign ①idols?” ▷ ①Lit futilities

column.name: text
column.value: “Harvest is past, summer is over, And we are not saved.”

column.name: text
column.value: I am broken over the brokenness of the daughter of my people. I mourn, dismay has taken hold of me.

column.name: text
column.value: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then has not the ①health of the daughter of my people ②been restored? ▷ ①Or healing ②Lit gone up

column.name: text
column.value: Hear the word which the LORD speaks to you, house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “Do not learn the way of the nations, And do not be terrified by the signs of the heavens, Although the nations are terrified by them;

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: They are like a scarecrow in a cucumber field, And they cannot speak; They must be carried, Because they cannot walk! Do not fear them, For they can do no harm, Nor can they do any good.”

column.name: text
column.value: There is none like You, LORD; You are great, and Your name is great in might.

column.name: text
column.value: Who would not fear You, O King of the nations? For it is Your due! For among all the wise men of the nations And in all their kingdoms, There is none like You.

column.name: text
column.value: But they are altogether stupid and foolish; The instruction from idols is nothing but wood!

column.name: text
text
column.value: But the LORD is the true God; He is the living God and the everlasting King. The earth quakes at His wrath, And the nations cannot endure His indignation.

column.name: text
column.value: ①This is what you shall say to them: “The gods that did not make the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth and from under these heavens.” ▷ ①This verse is in Aram

column.name: text
text
column.value: When He utters His voice, there is a roar of waters in the heavens, And He makes the clouds ascend from the end of the earth; He makes lightning for the rain, And brings out the wind from His storehouses.

column.name: text
column.value: Every person is stupid, devoid of knowledge; Every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols, For his cast metal images are deceitful, And there is no breath in them.

column.name: text
column.value: They are worthless, a work of mockery; At the time of their punishment they will perish.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Pick up your bundle from the ground, You who live under siege!

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says: “Behold, I am slinging out the inhabitants of the land At this time, And I will cause them distress, So that they may ①be found.” ▷ ①Lit find

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to me, because of my ①injury! My wound is incurable. But I said, “This certainly is a sickness, And I must endure it.” ▷ ①Lit breaking

column.name: text
column.value: My tent is destroyed, And all my ropes are broken. My sons have gone from me and are no more. There is no one to stretch out my tent again Or to set up my curtains.

column.name: text
column.value: For the shepherds have become stupid And have not sought the LORD. Therefore they have not prospered, And all their flock is scattered.

column.name: text
column.value: The sound of a report! Behold, it is coming— A great roar from the land of the north— To make the cities of Judah A desolation, a haunt of jackals.

column.name: text
column.value: I know, LORD, that a person’s way is not in himself, Nor is it in a person who walks to direct his steps.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: ①Oh that I had in the desert A travelers’ lodging place; So that I might leave my people And go away from them! For all of them are adulterers, An assembly of treacherous people. ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: in Heb

column.name: text
text
column.value: “Let everyone be on guard against his neighbor, And do not trust any brother; Because every brother utterly ①betrays, And every neighbor goes about as a slanderer. ▷ ①I.e., like Jacob (a play on words)

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone deceives his neighbor And does not speak the truth. They have taught their tongue to speak lies; They weary themselves committing wrongdoing.

column.name: text
column.value: Your dwelling is in the midst of deceit; Through deceit they refuse to know Me,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Shall I not punish them for these things?” declares the LORD. “Shall I not avenge Myself On a nation such as this?

column.name: text
column.value: “I will take up a weeping and wailing for the mountains, And for the pastures of the wilderness a song of mourning, Because they are laid waste so that no one passes through, And the sound of the livestock is not heard; Both the birds of the sky and the animals have fled; they are gone.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Who is the wise person who may understand this? And who is he to whom the mouth of the LORD has spoken, that he may declare it? Why is the land destroyed, laid waste like the desert, so that no one passes through?

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said, “Because they have abandoned My Law which I put before them, and have not obeyed My voice nor walked according to it,

column.name: text
column.value: but have followed the stubbornness of their heart and the Baals, ①as their fathers taught them,” ▷ ①Lit which

column.name: text
column.value: therefore this is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: “Behold, I will feed this people wormwood; and I will give them poisoned water to drink.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also scatter them among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers have known; and I will send the sword after them until I have put an end to them.”

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD of armies says: “Consider and call for the mourning women, that they may come; And send for the ①skillful women, that they may come! ▷ ①I.e., professional mourners

column.name: text
column.value: Have them hurry and take up a wailing for us, So that our eyes may shed tears, And our eyelids flow with water.

column.name: text
column.value: For a voice of wailing is heard from Zion: ‘How devastated we are! We are put to great shame, For we have abandoned the land Because they have torn down our homes.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Now hear the word of the LORD, you women, And let your ears receive the word of His mouth; Teach your daughters wailing, And have every woman teach her neighbor a song of mourning.

column.name: text
column.value: For death has come up through our windows; It has entered our palaces To eliminate the children from the streets, The young men from the public squares.

column.name: text
column.value: Speak, “This is what the LORD says: ‘The corpses of people will fall like dung on the open field, And like the sheaf after the reaper, But no one will gather them.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “Let no wise man boast of his wisdom, nor let the mighty man boast of his might, nor a rich man boast of his riches;

column.name: text
column.value: but let the one who boasts boast of this, that he understands and knows Me, that I am the LORD who exercises ①mercy, justice, and righteousness on the earth; for I delight in these things,” declares the LORD. ▷ ①Or faithfulness

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “that I will punish all who are circumcised and yet uncircumcised—

column.name: text
column.value: Egypt, Judah, Edom, the sons of Ammon, Moab, and all those inhabiting the desert who trim the hair on their temples; for all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised of heart.”

column.name: text
column.value: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;

column.name: text
column.value: and say to them, ‘This is what the LORD, the God of Israel says: “Cursed is the one who does not obey the words of this covenant

column.name: text
column.value: which I commanded your forefathers on the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, ‘Listen to My voice, and ①do according to all that I command you; so you shall be My people, and I will be your God,’ ▷ ①Lit do them

column.name: text
column.value: in order to confirm the oath which I swore to your forefathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day.” ’ ” Then I replied, “Amen, LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Hear the words of this covenant and do them.

column.name: text
column.value: For I solemnly warned your fathers on the day I brought them up from the land of Egypt, even to this day, warning them persistently, saying, “Listen to My voice.”

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they did not obey or incline their ear, but walked in the stubbornness of their evil heart, each one of them; therefore I brought on them all the words of this covenant which I commanded them to do, but they did not.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me, “A conspiracy has been found among the men of Judah and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: They have turned back to the wrongdoings of their ①ancestors who refused to hear My words, and they have followed other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken My covenant which I made with their fathers.” ▷ ①Lit former fathers

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD says: “Behold, I am bringing disaster on them which they will not be able to escape; though they will cry out to Me, I will not listen to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to whom they ①burn incense, but they certainly will not save them in the time of their disaster. ▷ ①Or offer sacrifices

column.name: text
column.value: For your gods are ①as many as your cities, Judah; and ②as many as the streets of Jerusalem are the altars you have set up to the shameful thing, altars for ③burning incense to Baal. ▷ ①Lit the number of ②Lit the number of ③Or offering sacrifices to

column.name: text
column.value: “So as for you, do not pray for this people, nor lift up a cry or prayer for them; for I will not listen when they call to Me because of their disaster.

column.name: text
column.value: What right has My beloved in My house When she has carried out many evil schemes? Can the sacrificial flesh take away from you your disaster, ①So that you can rejoice?” ▷ ①Lit Then

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD named you “A green olive tree, beautiful in fruit and form”; With the noise of a great ①tumult He has set fire to it, And its branches are worthless. ▷ ①I.e., confused noise

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD of armies, who planted you, has pronounced evil against you because of the evil of the house of Israel and the house of Judah, which they have ①done to provoke Me by ②offering sacrifices to Baal. ▷ ①Or done for themselves ②Or burning incense

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the LORD made it known to me and I knew it; Then You showed me their deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: But I was like a gentle lamb led to the slaughter; And I did not know that they had devised plots against me, saying, “Let’s destroy the tree with its ①fruit, And let’s cut him off from the land of the living, So that his name will no longer be remembered.” ▷ ①Lit bread

column.name: text
column.value: But, LORD of armies, who judges righteously, Who puts the ①feelings and the heart to the test, Let me see Your vengeance on them, For to You I have ②committed my cause. ▷ ①Lit kidneys ②Lit rolled

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning the people of Anathoth, who are seeking your life, saying: “Do not prophesy in the name of the LORD, so that you do not die by our hand”;

column.name: text
column.value: therefore, this is what the LORD of armies says: “Behold, I am going to punish them! The young men will die by the sword, their sons and daughters will die by famine;

column.name: text
column.value: and a remnant will not be left to them, because I will bring disaster on the people of Anathoth—the year of their punishment.”

column.name: text
column.value: Righteous are You, LORD, when I plead my case with You; Nevertheless I would discuss matters of justice with You: Why has the way of the wicked prospered? Why are all those who deal in treachery at ease?

column.name: text
column.value: You have planted them, they have also taken root; They grow, they have also produced fruit. You are near ①to their lips But far from their ②mind. ▷ ①Lit in their mouth ②Lit kidneys

column.name: text
column.value: But You know me, LORD; You see me And examine my heart’s attitude toward You. Drag them off like sheep for the slaughter, And ①set them apart for a day of slaughter! ▷ ①Lit sanctify them

column.name: text
column.value: How long is the land to mourn, And the vegetation of the ①countryside to dry up? Due to the wickedness of those who live in it, Animals and birds have been snatched away, Because people have said, “He will not see our final end.” ▷ ①Lit whole field

column.name: text
column.value: “If you have run with infantrymen and they have tired you out, How can you compete with horses? If you fall down in a land of peace, How will you do in the thicket by the Jordan?

column.name: text
column.value: For even your brothers and the household of your father, Even they have dealt treacherously with you, Even they have called aloud after you. Do not believe them, though they say nice things to you.”

column.name: text
column.value: “I have forsaken My house, I have abandoned My inheritance; I have handed the beloved of My soul Over to her enemies.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Is My inheritance like a speckled bird of prey to Me? Are the birds of prey against her on every side? Go, gather all the animals of the field, Bring them to devour!

column.name: text
column.value: Many shepherds have ruined My vineyard, They have trampled down My field; They have made My pleasant field A desolate wilderness.

column.name: text
text
column.value: On all the ①bare heights in the wilderness Destroyers have come, For the sword of the LORD is devouring From one end of the land even to the ②other; There is no peace for ③anyone. ▷ ①Or caravan trails ②Lit other end of the land ③Lit all flesh

column.name: text
column.value: They have sown wheat but have harvested thorns, They have strained themselves ①to no profit. So be ashamed of your produce Because of the fierce anger of the LORD.” ▷ ①Lit they do not profit

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says concerning all My wicked neighbors who do harm to the inheritance with which I have endowed My people Israel: “Behold, I am going to drive them out of their land, and I will drive the house of Judah out from among them.

column.name: text
column.value: And it will come about that after I have driven them out, I will again have compassion on them; and I will bring them back, each one to his inheritance and each one to his land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then, if they will really learn the ways of My people, to swear by My name, ‘As the LORD lives,’ just as they taught My people to swear by Baal, they will be built up in the midst of My people.

column.name: text
column.value: But if they do not listen, then I will drive out that nation, drive it out and destroy it,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD said to me: “Go and buy yourself a linen undergarment and put it around your waist, but do not put it in water.”

column.name: text
column.value: So I bought the undergarment in accordance with the word of the LORD, and put it around my waist.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me a second time, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Take the undergarment that you bought, which is around your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates and hide it there in a crevice of the rock.”

column.name: text
column.value: So I went and hid it by the Euphrates, as the LORD had commanded me.

column.name: text
column.value: After many days the LORD said to me, “Arise, go to the Euphrates and take from there the undergarment which I commanded you to hide there.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then I went to the Euphrates and dug, and I took the undergarment from the place where I had hidden it; and behold, the undergarment was ruined, it was completely useless.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD says: ‘To the same extent I will destroy the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: This wicked people, who refuse to listen to My words, who walk in the stubbornness of their hearts and have followed other gods to serve them and to bow down to them, let them be just like this undergarment which is completely useless.

column.name: text
column.value: For as the undergarment clings to the waist of a man, so I made the entire household of Israel and the entire household of Judah cling to Me,’ declares the LORD, ‘so that they might be My people, for ①renown, for praise, and for glory; but they did not listen.’ ▷ ①Lit a name

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore you are to speak this word to them. ‘This is what the LORD, the God of Israel says: “Every jug is to be filled with wine.” ’ And when they say to you, ‘Do we not very well know that every jug is to be filled with wine?’

column.name: text
column.value: then say to them, ‘This is what the LORD says: “Behold, I am going to fill all the inhabitants of this land—the kings who sit for David on his throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem—with drunkenness!

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will smash them against each other, both the fathers and the sons together,” declares the LORD. “I will not have compassion nor be troubled nor take pity so as to keep from destroying them.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Listen and pay attention, do not be haughty; For the LORD has spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: Give glory to the LORD your God Before He brings darkness And before your feet stumble On the mountains in the dark, And while you are hoping for light He makes it into gloom, And turns it into thick darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you do not listen to it, My soul will weep in secret for such pride; And my eyes will shed And stream down tears, Because the flock of the LORD has been taken captive.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to the king and the queen mother, “Take a lowly seat, For your beautiful crown Has come down from your head.”

column.name: text
column.value: The cities of the Negev have been locked up, And there is no one to open them; All Judah has been taken into exile, Wholly taken into exile.

column.name: text
column.value: “Raise your eyes and see Those coming from the north. Where is the flock that was given you, Your beautiful sheep?

column.name: text
column.value: What will you say when He appoints over you— And you yourself had taught them— Former companions to be head over you? Will sharp pains not take hold of you Like a woman in childbirth?

column.name: text
column.value: If you say in your heart, ‘Why have these things happened to me?’ Because of the magnitude of your wrongdoing Your skirts have been removed And your ①heels have suffered violence. ▷ ①I.e., a euphemism for private parts

column.name: text
column.value: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, Or the leopard his spots? Then you as well can do good Who are accustomed to doing evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I will scatter them like drifting straw To the desert wind.

column.name: text
column.value: This is your lot, the portion measured to you From Me,” declares the LORD, “Because you have forgotten Me And trusted in falsehood.

column.name: text
column.value: So I Myself have stripped your skirts off over your face, So that your shame will be seen.

column.name: text
column.value: As for your adulteries and your lustful neighings, The outrageous sin of your prostitution On the hills in the field, I have seen your abominations. Woe to you, Jerusalem! How long will you remain unclean?”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me, “Even if Moses and Samuel were to stand before Me, My ①heart would not be ②with this people. Send them away from My presence and have them go! ▷ ①Lit soul ②Lit toward

column.name: text
text
column.value: And I will appoint over them four kinds of doom,” declares the LORD: “the sword to kill, the dogs to drag away, and the birds of the sky and the animals of the earth to devour and destroy.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make them an object of terror among all the kingdoms of the earth because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, the king of Judah, for what he did in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: “Indeed, who will have pity on you, Jerusalem, Or who will mourn for you, Or who will turn aside to ask about your welfare?

column.name: text
column.value: You who have forsaken Me,” declares the LORD, “You keep going backward. So I will stretch out My hand against you and destroy you; I am tired of relenting!

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: She who gave birth to seven sons withers away; ①Her breathing is labored. Her sun has set while it was still day; She has been shamed and humiliated. So I will turn over their survivors to the sword Before their enemies,” declares the LORD. ▷ ①Or She has breathed out her soul

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to me, my mother, that you have given birth to me As a man of strife and a man of contention to all the land! I have not lent, nor have people lent money to me, Yet everyone curses me.

column.name: text
text
column.value: “Can anyone smash iron, Iron from the north, or bronze?

column.name: text
column.value: I will give your wealth and your treasures As plunder without cost, For all your sins And within all your borders.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will make your enemies bring your possessions Into a land that you do not know; For a fire has been kindled in My anger, And it will burn upon you.”

column.name: text
text
column.value: Your words were found and I ate them, And Your words became a joy to me and the delight of my heart; For I have been called by Your name, LORD God of armies.

column.name: text
column.value: I did not sit in a circle of revelers and celebrate. Because of Your hand upon me I sat alone, For You filled me with indignation.

column.name: text
column.value: Why has my pain been endless And my wound incurable, refusing to be healed? Will You indeed be to me like a deceptive stream With water that is unreliable?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, this is what the LORD says: “If you return, then I will restore you— You will stand before Me; And if you extract the precious from the worthless, You will become ①My spokesman. They, for their part, may turn to you, But as for you, you are not to turn to them. ▷ ①Lit as My mouth

column.name: text
text
column.value: “So I will rescue you from the hand of the wicked, And I will redeem you from the ①grasp of the violent.” ▷ ①Lit palm

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD also came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall not take a wife for yourself nor have sons or daughters in this place.”

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says concerning the sons and daughters born in this place, and concerning their mothers who give birth to them, and their fathers who father them in this land:

column.name: text
column.value: “They will die of deadly diseases, they will not be mourned or buried; they will be like dung on the surface of the ground. And they will perish by sword and famine, and their dead bodies will become food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.”

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says: “Do not enter a house of mourning, or go to mourn or to console them; for I have withdrawn My peace from this people,” declares the LORD, “and My favor and compassion.

column.name: text
column.value: Both great people and small will die in this land; they will not be buried, people will not mourn for them, nor will anyone make cuts on himself or have his head shaved for them.

column.name: text
column.value: People will not break bread in mourning for them, to comfort anyone for the dead, nor give them a cup of consolation to drink for anyone’s father or mother.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, you shall not go into a house of feasting to sit with them to eat and drink.”

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: “Behold, I am going to eliminate from this place, before your eyes and in your time, the voice of rejoicing and the voice of joy, the voice of the groom and the voice of the bride.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now it will happen that, when you tell this people all these words, they will say to you, ‘For what reason has the LORD declared all this great disaster against us? And what is our wrongdoing, or what is our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?’

column.name: text
column.value: Then you are to say to them, ‘It is because your forefathers have abandoned Me,’ declares the LORD, ‘and have followed other gods, and served and worshiped them; but they have abandoned Me and have not kept My Law.

column.name: text
column.value: You too have done evil, even more than your forefathers; for behold, each one of you is following the stubbornness of his own evil heart, without listening to Me.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will hurl you off this land to the land which you have not known, neither you nor your fathers; and there you will serve other gods day and night, because I will show you no compassion.’

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore behold, days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when it will no longer be said, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up the sons of Israel out of the land of Egypt,’

column.name: text
column.value: but, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up the sons of Israel from the land of the north and from all the lands where He had banished them.’ For I will restore them to their own land which I gave to their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, I am going to send for many fishermen,” declares the LORD, “and they will fish for them; and afterward I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them from every mountain and every hill and from the clefts of the rocks.

column.name: text
column.value: For My eyes are on all their ways; they are not hidden from My face, nor is their wrongdoing concealed from My eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: I will first repay them double for their wrongdoing and their sin, because they have defiled My land; they have filled My inheritance with the carcasses of their detestable idols and their abominations.”

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, my strength and my stronghold, And my refuge in the day of distress, To You the nations will come From the ends of the earth and say, “Our fathers have inherited nothing but falsehood, Futility, and ①things of no benefit.” ▷ ①Lit there is nothing profitable in them

column.name: text
column.value: Can a person make gods for himself? But they are not gods!

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore behold, I am going to make them know— This time I will make them know My ①power and My might; And they will know that My name is the LORD.” ▷ ①Lit hand

column.name: text
column.value: The sin of Judah is written with an iron stylus; With a diamond point it is engraved on the tablet of their hearts And on the horns of ①their altars, ▷ ①As in ancient versions; MT your

column.name: text
column.value: As they remember their children, So they remember their altars and their ①Asherim By green trees on the high hills. ▷ ①I.e., wooden symbols of a female deity (Asherah)

column.name: text
column.value: Mountain of Mine in the countryside, I will turn over your wealth and all your treasures as plunder, Your high places for sin throughout your borders.

column.name: text
text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind And makes flesh his ①strength, And whose heart turns away from the LORD. ▷ ①Lit arm

column.name: text
column.value: For he will be like a bush in the desert, And will not see when prosperity comes, But will live in stony wastes in the wilderness, A land of salt that is not inhabited.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, And whose trust is the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For he will be like a tree planted by the water That extends its roots by a stream, And does not fear when the heat comes; But its leaves will be green, And it will not be anxious in a year of drought, Nor cease to yield fruit.

column.name: text
text
column.value: I, the LORD, search the heart, I test the ①mind, To give to each person according to his ways, According to the ②results of his deeds. ▷ ①Lit kidneys ②Lit fruit

column.name: text
column.value: As a partridge that hatches eggs which it has not laid, So is a person who makes a fortune, but unjustly; In the middle of his days it will abandon him, And in ①the end he will be a fool.” ▷ ①Lit his

column.name: text
column.value: A glorious throne on high from the beginning Is the place of our sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, the hope of Israel, All who abandon You will be put to shame. Those who turn ①away on earth will be written down, Because they have forsaken the fountain of living water, that is the LORD. ▷ ①Lit away from Me

column.name: text
text
column.value: Look, they keep saying to me, “Where is the word of the LORD? Let it come now!”

column.name: text
column.value: But as for me, I have not hurried away from being a shepherd following after You, Nor have I longed for the disastrous day; You Yourself know that the utterance of my lips Was in Your presence.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be a terror to me; You are my refuge in a day of disaster.

column.name: text
column.value: Let those who persecute me be put to shame, but as for me, let me not be put to shame; Let them be dismayed, but let me not be dismayed. Bring on them a day of disaster, And crush them with double destruction!

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD said to me: “Go and stand at the ①public gate, through which the kings of Judah come in and go out, as well as at all the gates of Jerusalem; ▷ ①Lit gate of the sons of the people

column.name: text
column.value: and say to them, ‘Listen to the word of the LORD, you kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all inhabitants of Jerusalem who come in through these gates.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “Take care for yourselves, and do not carry any ①load on the Sabbath day or bring anything in through the gates of Jerusalem. ▷ ①Or burden

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not bring a load out of your houses on the Sabbath day nor do any work, but keep the Sabbath day holy, just as I commanded your ①forefathers. ▷ ①Lit fathers

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they did not listen or incline their ears, but stiffened their necks so as not to listen or accept discipline.

column.name: text
column.value: “But it will come about, if you give your attention to Me,” declares the LORD, “to bring no load in through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, but to keep the Sabbath day holy by doing no work on it,

column.name: text
column.value: then there will come in through the gates of this city kings and officials sitting on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they and their officials, the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and this city will be inhabited forever.

column.name: text
column.value: They will come in from the cities of Judah and from the areas surrounding Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin, from the lowland, from the hill country, and from the Negev, bringing burnt offerings, sacrifices, grain offerings, and frankincense, and bringing sacrifices of thanksgiving to the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you do not listen to Me, to keep the Sabbath day holy by not carrying a load and coming in through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will set fire to its gates, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem and not go out.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Arise and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will announce My words to you.”

column.name: text
column.value: So I went down to the potter’s house, and there he was, making something on the wheel.

column.name: text
column.value: But the vessel that he was making of clay was spoiled in the hand of the potter; so he remade it into another vessel, as it pleased the potter to make.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Am I not able, house of Israel, to deal with you as this potter does?” declares the LORD. “Behold, like the clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in My hand, house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: At one moment I might speak concerning a nation or concerning a kingdom to uproot it, to tear it down, or to destroy it;

column.name: text
column.value: if that nation against which I have spoken turns from its evil, I will relent of the disaster that I planned to bring on it.

column.name: text
column.value: Or at another moment I might speak concerning a nation or concerning a kingdom to build up or to plant it;

column.name: text
column.value: if it does evil in My sight by not obeying My voice, then I will relent of the good with which I said ①that I would bless it. ▷ ①Lit to do it good

column.name: text
column.value: So now, speak to the men of Judah and against the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, ‘This is what the LORD says: “Behold, I am forming a disaster against you and devising a plan against you. Now turn back, each of you from his evil way, and ①correct your ways and your deeds!” ’ ▷ ①Lit make good

column.name: text
column.value: But they will say, ‘It’s hopeless! For we are going to follow our own plans, and each of us will ①persist in the stubbornness of his evil heart.’ ▷ ①Lit do the

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘Just ask among the nations, Who ever heard anything like ①this? The virgin of Israel Has done a most appalling thing. ▷ ①Lit these

column.name: text
column.value: Does the snow of Lebanon leave the rock of the open country alone? Or is the cold flowing water from a foreign land ever dried up?

column.name: text
column.value: For My people have forgotten Me, They burn incense ①to worthless gods. And they ②have stumbled in their ways, In the ancient roads, To walk on paths, Not on a highway, ▷ ①Lit to worthlessness ②As in ancient versions; MT caused them to

column.name: text
column.value: To make their land a desolation, An object of perpetual hissing; Everyone who passes by it will be astonished And shake his head.

column.name: text
column.value: Like an east wind I will scatter them Before the enemy; I will ①show them My back and not My face In the day of their disaster.’ ” ▷ ①As in ancient versions; MT look them in the back and not in the face

column.name: text
column.value: Then they said, “Come and let’s devise plans against Jeremiah. Certainly the Law is not going to be lost by the priest, nor advice by the wise, nor the divine word by the prophet! Come, and let’s strike at him with our tongue, and let’s pay no attention to any of his words.”

column.name: text
column.value: Give Your attention to me, LORD, And listen to ①what my opponents are saying! ▷ ①Lit the voice of my opponents

column.name: text
column.value: Should good be repaid with evil? For they have dug a pit for ①me. Remember how I stood before You To speak good in their behalf, So as to turn Your wrath away from them. ▷ ①Lit my soul

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, give their children over to famine And turn them over to the ①power of the sword; And let their wives become childless and widowed. Let their men also be slaughtered to death, Their young men struck and killed by the sword in battle. ▷ ①Lit hands of

column.name: text
column.value: May a cry be heard from their houses When You suddenly bring raiders upon them; For they have dug a pit to capture me And hidden snares for my feet.

column.name: text
column.value: But You, LORD, know All their ①deadly schemes against me; Do not ②forgive their wrongdoing Or wipe out their sin from Your sight. But may they be ③overthrown before You; Deal with them in the time of Your anger! ▷ ①Lit unto death ②Lit cover over, atone for ③Lit ones made to stumble

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “Go and buy a potter’s earthenware jar, and take some of the elders of the people and some of the ①senior priests. ▷ ①Or elders of the

column.name: text
column.value: Then go out to the Valley of Ben-hinnom, which is by the entrance of the ①Potsherd Gate, and proclaim there the words that I tell you, ▷ ①I.e., pottery fragment

column.name: text
column.value: and say, ‘Hear the word of the LORD, you kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem. This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: “Behold I am going to bring a disaster upon this place, at which the ears of everyone that hears of it will tingle.

column.name: text
column.value: Since they have abandoned Me and have made this place foreign, and have burned ①sacrifices in it to other gods that neither they nor their forefathers nor the kings of Judah had ever known, and since they have filled this place with the blood of the innocent ▷ ①Or incense

column.name: text
column.value: and have built the high places of Baal to burn their sons in the fire as burnt offerings to Baal, a thing which I did not command nor speak of, nor did it ever enter My ①mind; ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: therefore, behold, days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when this place will no longer be called Topheth or the Valley of Ben-hinnom, but rather the Valley of Slaughter.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will frustrate the planning of Judah and Jerusalem in this place, and I will make them fall by the sword before their enemies and by the hand of those who seek their life; and I will make their carcasses food for the birds of the sky and the animals of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also turn this city into an object of horror and ①hissing; everyone who passes by it will be appalled and ②hiss because of all its ③disasters. ▷ ①Or whistling ②Or whistle ③Lit wounds

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they will eat one another’s flesh during the siege and in the hardship with which their enemies and those who seek their life will torment them.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: “Then you are to break the jar in the sight of the men who accompany you,

column.name: text
column.value: and say to them, ‘This is what the LORD of armies says: “To the same extent I will break this people and this city, just as one breaks a potter’s vessel, which cannot again be repaired; and they will bury their dead in Topheth, ①because there is no other place for burial. ▷ ①Or until there is no place left to bury

column.name: text
column.value: This is how I will treat this place and its inhabitants,” declares the LORD, “so as to make this city like Topheth.

column.name: text
column.value: The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah will be defiled like the place Topheth, because of all the houses on whose rooftops they burned ①sacrifices to all the heavenly ②lights and poured out drink offerings to other gods.” ’ ” ▷ ①Or incense ②Lit host; i.e., sun, stars, etc.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeremiah came from Topheth, where the LORD had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the courtyard of the LORD’S house and said to all the people,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘Behold, I am going to bring on this city and all its towns the entire disaster that I have declared against it, because they have stiffened their necks so as not to listen to My words.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: When Pashhur the priest, the son of Immer, who was chief overseer in the house of the LORD, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things,

column.name: text
column.value: Pashhur had Jeremiah the prophet beaten and put him in the stocks that were at the upper Benjamin Gate, which was by the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then on the next day, when Pashhur released Jeremiah from the stocks, Jeremiah said to him, “Pashhur is not the name the LORD has called you, but rather ①Magor-missabib. ▷ ①I.e., horror on every side

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I am going to make you a horror to yourself and to all your friends; and while your eyes look on, they will fall by the sword of their enemies. So I will hand all Judah over to the king of Babylon, and he will take them away as exiles to Babylon and will kill them with the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also give all the wealth of this city, all its produce and all its valuable things—even all the treasures of the kings of Judah I will hand over to their enemies, and they will plunder them, take them away, and bring them to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: And you, Pashhur, and all who live in your house will go into captivity; and you will enter Babylon, and there you will die and there you will be buried, you and all your friends to whom you have falsely prophesied.’ ”

column.name: text
text
column.value: For each time I speak, I cry aloud; I proclaim violence and destruction, Because for me the word of the LORD has ①resulted In taunting and derision all day long. ▷ ①Lit become

column.name: text
column.value: But if I say, “I will not remember Him Nor speak anymore in His name,” Then in my heart it becomes like a burning fire Shut up in my bones; And I am tired of holding it in, And I cannot endure it.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have heard the whispering of many, “Terror on every side! Denounce him; let’s denounce him!” ①All my trusted friends, Watching for my fall, say: “Perhaps he will be persuaded, so that we may prevail against him And take our revenge on him.” ▷ ①Lit Every man of my peace

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD is with me like a powerful champion; Therefore my persecutors will stumble and not prevail. They will be put to great shame because they have ①failed, An everlasting disgrace that will not be forgotten. ▷ ①Lit not succeeded; or not acted wisely

column.name: text
column.value: Yet, LORD of armies, who tests the righteous, Who sees the ①mind and the heart; Let me see Your vengeance on them, For to You I have disclosed my cause. ▷ ①Lit kidneys

column.name: text
column.value: Sing to the LORD, praise the LORD! For He has saved the soul of the needy one From the hand of evildoers.

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed be the day when I was born; May the day when my mother gave birth to me not be blessed!

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed be the man who brought the news To my father, saying, “A ①boy has been born to you!” And made him very happy. ▷ ①Lit male child

column.name: text
column.value: But may that man be like the cities Which the LORD overthrew without ①relenting, And may he hear an outcry in the morning And ②an alarm for war at noon; ▷ ①Lit being sorry ②Or a trumpet blast

column.name: text
column.value: Because he did not kill me ①before birth, So that my mother would have been my grave, And her womb forever pregnant. ▷ ①Lit from the womb

column.name: text
column.value: Why did I ever come out of the womb To look at trouble and sorrow, So that my days have been spent in shame?

column.name: text
column.value: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur the son of Malchijah and Zephaniah the priest, the son of Maaseiah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Please inquire of the LORD in our behalf, because Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is making war against us; perhaps the LORD will deal with us in accordance with all His ①wonderful acts, so that the enemy will withdraw from us.” ▷ ①Or miracles

column.name: text
column.value: But Jeremiah said to them, “You shall say to Zedekiah as follows:

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the LORD, the God of Israel says: “Behold, I am going to turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, with which you are making war against the king of Babylon and the Chaldeans who are besieging you outside the wall; and I will gather them into the middle of this city.

column.name: text
column.value: And I Myself will make war against you with an outstretched hand and a mighty arm, and in anger, wrath, and great indignation.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also strike the inhabitants of this city, both the people and the animals; they will die of a great plague.

column.name: text
column.value: Then afterward,” declares the LORD, “I will hand Zedekiah king of Judah, his servants, and the people, that is, those who survive in this city from the plague, the sword, and the famine, over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, to their enemies, and to those who seek their lives; and he will strike and kill them with the edge of the sword. He will not spare them nor have pity nor compassion.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall also say to this people, ‘This is what the LORD says: “Behold, I am setting before you the way of life and the way of death.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who stays in this city will die by the sword, by famine, or by plague; but anyone who leaves and goes over to the Chaldeans who are besieging you will live, and he will have his own life as plunder.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have set My face against this city for harm and not for good,” declares the LORD. “It will be handed over to the king of Babylon and he will burn it with fire.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: “Then say to the household of the king of Judah, ‘Hear the word of the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: house of David, this is what the LORD says: “Administer justice ①every morning; And save the person who has been robbed from the ②power of his oppressor, So that My wrath will not spread like fire And burn, with no one to extinguish it, Because of the evil of their deeds. ▷ ①Or in the ②Lit hand

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, I am against you, you inhabitant of the valley, You ①rocky plain,” declares the LORD, “You who say, ‘Who will come down against us? Or who will enter our dwellings?’ ▷ ①Lit rock of the level place

column.name: text
column.value: But I will punish you according to the ①results of your deeds,” declares the LORD, “And I will kindle a fire in its forest So that it may devour all its surroundings.” ’ ” ▷ ①Lit fruit

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “Go down to the house of the king of Judah and there speak this word,

column.name: text
column.value: and say, ‘Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, who sits on David’s throne, you and your servants and your people who enter these gates.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “Do justice and righteousness, and save one who has been robbed from the power of his oppressor. And do not mistreat or do violence to the stranger, the orphan, or the widow; and do not shed innocent blood in this place.

column.name: text
column.value: For if you will indeed perform this ①instruction, then kings will enter the gates of this house, sitting ②in David’s place on his throne, riding in chariots and on horses, the king himself, his servants, and his people. ▷ ①Lit word ②Lit for David

column.name: text
column.value: But if you will not obey these words, I swear by Myself,” declares the LORD, “that this house will become a place of ruins.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says concerning the house of the king of Judah: “You are like Gilead to Me, Like the summit of Lebanon; Yet most assuredly I will make you a wilderness, Cities that are not inhabited.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will set apart destroyers against you, Each with his weapons; And they will cut down your choicest cedars And throw them on the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: “Many nations will pass by this city; and they will say to one another, ‘Why has the LORD done this to this great city?’

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will ①answer, ‘Because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD their God and bowed down to other gods and served them.’ ” ▷ ①Lit say

column.name: text
column.value: Do not weep for the dead or mourn for him, But weep deeply for the one who goes away; For he will never return Or see his native land.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says regarding ①Shallum the son of Josiah, king of Judah, who became king in the place of his father Josiah, who went out from this place: “He will never return there; ▷ ①I.e., Jehoahaz

column.name: text
column.value: but in the place where they took him into exile, there he will die and he will not see this land again.

column.name: text
column.value: “Woe to him who builds his house without righteousness, And his upstairs rooms without justice, Who uses his neighbor’s services without pay And does not give him his wages,

column.name: text
column.value: Who says, ‘I will build myself a large house With spacious upstairs rooms, And cut out its windows, ①Paneling it with cedar and painting it ②bright red.’ ▷ ①Or Paneled ②Or vermilion

column.name: text
column.value: Do you become a king because you are competing in cedar? Did your father not eat and drink And do justice and righteousness? Then it was well for him.

column.name: text
column.value: He pled the cause of the afflicted and the poor, Then it was well. Is that not what it means to know Me?” Declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “But your eyes and your heart Are intent only upon your own dishonest gain, And on shedding innocent blood, And on practicing oppression and extortion.”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD says regarding Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah: “They will not mourn for him: ‘Oh, my brother!’ or, ‘Oh, sister!’ They will not mourn for him: ‘Oh, for the master!’ or, ‘Oh, for his splendor!’

column.name: text
column.value: He will be buried with a donkey’s burial, Dragged off and thrown out beyond the gates of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Go up to Lebanon and cry out, And raise your voice in Bashan; Cry out also from Abarim, For all your lovers have been crushed.

column.name: text
column.value: I spoke to you in your prosperity; But you said, ‘I will not listen!’ This has been your way from your youth, That you have not obeyed My voice.

column.name: text
column.value: The wind will sweep away all your shepherds, And your lovers will go into captivity; Then you will certainly be ashamed and humiliated Because of all your wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: You who live in Lebanon, Nested in the cedars, How you will groan when sharp pains come on you, Pain like a woman in childbirth!

column.name: text
column.value: “As I live,” declares the LORD, “even if ①Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were a signet ring on My right hand, yet I would pull ②you ③off; ▷ ①I.e., Jehoiachin ②I.e., Jehoiachin ③Lit off from there

column.name: text
column.value: and I will hand you over to those who are seeking your life, yes, to those of whom you are frightened, that is, to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and the Chaldeans.

column.name: text
column.value: I will hurl you and your mother who gave birth to you into another country where you were not born, and there you will die.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for the land to which they long to return, they will not return to it.

column.name: text
column.value: Is this man Coniah a despised, shattered jar? Or is he an undesirable vessel? Why have he and his descendants been hurled out And cast into a land that they had not known?

column.name: text
column.value: O land, land, land, Hear the word of the LORD!

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: ‘Write this man down as childless, A man who will not prosper in his days; For no man among his descendants will prosper Sitting on the throne of David Or ruling again in Judah.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: “Woe to the shepherds who are causing the sheep of My pasture to perish and are scattering them!” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD, the God of Israel says concerning the shepherds who are ①tending My people: “You have scattered My flock and driven them away, and have not been concerned about them; behold, I am going to call you to account for the evil of your deeds,” declares the LORD. ▷ ①Lit shepherding

column.name: text
column.value: “Then I Myself will gather the remnant of My flock out of all the countries where I have driven them, and bring them back to their pasture, and they will be fruitful and multiply.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also raise up shepherds over them and they will ①tend them; and they will not be afraid any longer, nor be terrified, nor will any be missing,” declares the LORD. ▷ ①Or shepherd

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “When I will raise up for David a righteous ①Branch; And He will reign as king and ②act wisely And do justice and righteousness in the land. ▷ ①Lit Sprout ②Or succeed

column.name: text
column.value: In His days Judah will be saved, And Israel will live securely; And this is His name by which He will be called, ‘The LORD Our Righteousness.’

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore behold, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when they will no longer say, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought the sons of Israel up from the land of Egypt,’

column.name: text
column.value: but, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up and led the descendants of the household of Israel back from the north land and from all the countries where I had driven them.’ Then they will live on their own soil.”

column.name: text
column.value: As for the prophets: My heart is broken within me, All my bones tremble; I have become like a drunken man, And like a man overcome by wine, Because of the LORD And because of His holy words.

column.name: text
column.value: For the land is full of adulterers; For the land mourns because of the curse. The pastures of the wilderness have dried up. Their course is evil And their might is not right.

column.name: text
column.value: “For both prophet and priest are defiled; Even in My house I have found their wickedness,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore their way will be like slippery paths to them, They will be driven away into the gloom and fall down in it; For I will bring disaster upon them, The year of their punishment,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “Moreover, among the prophets of Samaria I saw an offensive thing: They prophesied by Baal and led My people Israel astray.

column.name: text
column.value: Also among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen a horrible thing: The committing of adultery and walking in deceit; And they strengthen the hands of evildoers, So that no one has turned back from his wickedness. All of them have become to Me like Sodom, And her inhabitants like Gomorrah.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD of armies says concerning the prophets: ‘Behold, I am going to feed them wormwood And make them drink poisonous water, For from the prophets of Jerusalem Ungodliness has spread into all the land.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD of armies says: “Do not listen to the words of the prophets who are prophesying to you. They are leading you into futility; They tell a vision of their own ①imagination, Not from the mouth of the LORD. ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: They keep saying to those who despise Me, ‘The LORD has said, “You will have peace” ’; And as for everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart, They say, ‘Disaster will not come on you.’

column.name: text
column.value: But who has stood in the council of the LORD, That he should see and hear His word? Who has paid attention to ①His word and listened? ▷ ①Another reading is My

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: I did not send these prophets, But they ran. I did not speak to them, But they prophesied.

column.name: text
column.value: But if they had stood in My council, Then they would have announced My words to My people, And would have turned them back from their evil way And from the evil of their deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: “Am I a God who is near,” declares the LORD, “And not a God far off?

column.name: text
column.value: Can a person hide himself in hiding places So that I do not see him?” declares the LORD. “Do I not fill the heavens and the earth?” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “I have heard what the prophets have said who prophesy falsely in My name, saying, ‘I had a dream, I had a dream!’

column.name: text
column.value: How long? Is there anything in the hearts of the prophets who prophesy falsehood, these prophets of the deceitfulness of their own heart,

column.name: text
column.value: who intend to make My people forget My name by their dreams which they report to one another, just as their fathers forgot My name because of Baal?

column.name: text
column.value: The prophet who has a dream may report his dream, but let him who has My word speak My word truthfully. What does straw have in common with grain?” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “Is My word not like fire?” declares the LORD, “and like a hammer which shatters a rock?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore behold, I am against the prophets,” declares the LORD, “who steal My words from each other.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I am against the prophets,” declares the LORD, “who ①use their tongues and declare, ‘The Lord declares!’ ▷ ①Lit take

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I am against those who have prophesied false dreams,” declares the LORD, “and reported them and led My people astray by their lies and reckless boasting; yet I did not send them nor command them, nor do they provide this people the slightest benefit,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now when this people or the prophet or a priest asks you, saying, ‘What is the ①pronouncement of the LORD?’ then you shall say to them, ‘What ②pronouncement?’ The LORD declares, ‘I will abandon you.’ ▷ ①Or burden, and so throughout the ch ②Or burden, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: Then as for the prophet or the priest or the people who say, ‘The pronouncement of the LORD,’ I will bring punishment upon that person and his household.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what each one of you will say to his neighbor and to his brother: ‘What has the LORD answered?’ or, ‘What has the LORD spoken?’

column.name: text
column.value: For you will no longer remember the pronouncement of the LORD, because every person’s own word will become the pronouncement, and you have perverted the words of the living God, the LORD of armies, our God.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what you will say to that prophet: ‘What has the LORD answered you?’ and, ‘What has the LORD spoken?’

column.name: text
column.value: And if you say, ‘The pronouncement of the LORD!’ for that reason the LORD says this: ‘Because you said this word, “The pronouncement of the LORD!” I have also sent word to you, saying, “You shall not say, ‘The pronouncement of the LORD!’ ” ’

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore behold, I will certainly forget you and thrust you away from My presence, along with the city which I gave you and your fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: I will put an everlasting disgrace on you and an everlasting humiliation which will not be forgotten.”

column.name: text
