column.value: After Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had taken into exile Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the officials of Judah with the craftsmen and metalworkers from Jerusalem and had brought them to Babylon, the LORD showed me: behold, two baskets of figs placed before the temple of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: One basket had very good figs, like first-ripe figs, and the other basket had very bad figs which could not be eaten due to rottenness.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” And I said, “Figs: the good figs are very good, and the bad ones, very bad, which cannot be eaten due to rottenness.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘Like these good figs, so I will regard as good the captives of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will set My eyes on them for good, and I will bring them back to this land; and I will build them up and not overthrow them, and I will plant them and not uproot them.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also give them a heart to know Me, for I am the LORD; and they will be My people, and I will be their God, for they will return to Me wholeheartedly.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘But like the bad figs which cannot be eaten due to rottenness,’ indeed, this is what the LORD says, ‘so will I give up Zedekiah king of Judah and his officials, and the remnant of Jerusalem who remain in this land, and the ones who live in the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make them an object of terror and an evil for all the kingdoms of the earth, as a disgrace and a proverb, a taunt and a curse in all the places where I will scatter them.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the plague upon them until they are eliminated from the land which I gave to them and their forefathers.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah (that was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),

column.name: text
column.value: the word which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day, ①these twenty-three years the word of the LORD has come to me, and I have spoken to you again and again, but you have not listened. ▷ ①Lit this

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD has sent to you all His servants the prophets again and again, but you have not listened nor inclined your ear to hear,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, ‘Turn now, everyone from his evil way and from the evil of your deeds, and live on the land which the LORD has given to you and your forefathers forever and ever;

column.name: text
column.value: and do not follow other gods to ①serve them and to ②worship them, and do not provoke Me to anger with the work of your hands, then I will do you no harm.’ ▷ ①Or worship ②Or bow down to

column.name: text
column.value: Yet you have not listened to Me,” declares the LORD, “in order to provoke Me to anger with the work of your hands to your own harm.

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore this is what the LORD of armies says: ‘Because you have not obeyed My words,

column.name: text
column.value: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north,’ declares the LORD, ‘and I will send to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, My servant, and will bring them against this land and against its inhabitants and against all these surrounding nations; and I will ①completely destroy them and make them an object of horror and ②hissing, and an everlasting place of ruins. ▷ ①Or put them under the ban ②Or whistling

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, I will eliminate from them the voice of jubilation and the voice of joy, the voice of the groom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones and the light of the lamp.

column.name: text
column.value: This entire land will be a place of ruins and an object of horror, and these nations will serve the king of Babylon for seventy years.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Then it will be when seventy years are completed I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation,’ declares the LORD, ‘for their wrongdoing, and the land of the Chaldeans; and I will make it an everlasting desolation.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring upon that land all My words which I have pronounced against it, all that is written in this book which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: ( ①For many nations and great kings will make slaves of them, even them; and I will repay them according to their deeds and according to the work of their hands.)’ ” ▷ ①Or For they have served many nations and great kings

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says to me: “Take this cup of the wine of wrath from My hand and give it to all the nations to whom I send you, to drink from it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will drink and loudly vomit and act insanely because of the sword that I am going to send among them.”

column.name: text
column.value: So I took the cup from the LORD’S hand and gave it to all the nations to whom the LORD sent me, to drink from it:

column.name: text
column.value: To Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, and its kings and its officials, to make them places of ruins, objects of horror, ①hissing, and a curse, as it is this day; ▷ ①Or whistling

column.name: text
column.value: To Pharaoh king of Egypt, his servants, his officials, and all his people;

column.name: text
column.value: and to all the foreign ①people, all the kings of the land of Uz, all the kings of the land of the Philistines (that is, Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod); ▷ ①Or mercenaries

column.name: text
column.value: To Edom, Moab, and the sons of Ammon;

column.name: text
column.value: and to all the kings of Tyre, all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the coastlands which are beyond the sea;

column.name: text
column.value: and to Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who trim the corners of their hair;

column.name: text
column.value: and to all the kings of Arabia and all the kings of the foreign ①people who live in the desert; ▷ ①Or mercenaries

column.name: text
column.value: and to all the kings of Zimri, all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of Media;

column.name: text
column.value: and to all the kings of the north, near and far, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the earth which are on the face of the ground; and the king of ①Sheshach shall drink it after them. ▷ ①Cryptic name for Babylon

column.name: text
column.value: “And you shall say to them, ‘This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: “Drink, be drunk, vomit, fall down, and do not get up, because of the sword which I am sending among you.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: And if they refuse to take the cup from your hand to drink, then you shall say to them, ‘This is what the LORD of armies says: “You shall certainly drink!

column.name: text
column.value: For behold, I am beginning to inflict disaster on this city which is called by My name, so should you be completely free from punishment? You will not be free from punishment, for I am summoning a sword against all the inhabitants of the earth,” declares the LORD of armies.’

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore you shall prophesy against them all these words, and you shall say to them, ‘The LORD will roar from on high And raise His voice from His holy dwelling; He will roar forcefully against His ①fold. He will shout like those who tread the grapes, Against all the inhabitants of the earth. ▷ ①Or pasture; i.e., a ref to His people

column.name: text
column.value: A clamor has come to the end of the earth, Because the LORD has a controversy with the nations. He is entering into judgment with ①humanity; As for the wicked, He has turned them over to the sword,’ declares the LORD.” ▷ ①Lit all flesh

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD of armies says: “Behold, evil is going out From nation to nation, And a great storm is being stirred up From the remotest parts of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: “Those put to death by the LORD on that day will be from one end of the earth to the ①other. They will not be mourned, gathered, or buried; they will be like dung on the face of the ground. ▷ ①Lit other end of the earth

column.name: text
text
column.value: ①There will be no sanctuary for the shepherds, Nor escape for the masters of the flock. ▷ ①Lit Sanctuary will perish from

column.name: text
column.value: Hear the sound of the cry of the shepherds, And the wailing of the masters of the flock! For the LORD is destroying their pasture,

column.name: text
column.value: And the peaceful grazing places are devastated Because of the fierce anger of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: He has left His hiding place like the lion; For their land has become a horror Because of the fierceness of the ①oppressing sword And because of His fierce anger.” ▷ ①Or oppressor

column.name: text
column.value: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came from the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD says: ‘Stand in the courtyard of the LORD’S house, and speak to all the cities of Judah who have come to worship in the LORD’S house all the words that I have commanded you to speak to them. Do not omit a word!

column.name: text
column.value: Perhaps they will listen and everyone will turn from his evil way, and I will relent of the disaster which I am planning to inflict on them because of the evil of their deeds.’

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall say to them, ‘This is what the LORD says: “If you do not listen to Me, to walk in My Law which I have set before you,

column.name: text
column.value: to listen to the words of My servants the prophets, whom I have been sending to you again and again, but you have not listened;

column.name: text
column.value: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and I will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: The priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet when Jeremiah finished speaking everything that the LORD had commanded him to speak to all the people, then the priests and the prophets and all the people seized him, saying, “You must die!

column.name: text
column.value: Why have you prophesied in the name of the LORD, saying, ‘This house will be like Shiloh and this city will be in ruins, without inhabitant’?” And all the people gathered to Jeremiah at the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: When the officials of Judah heard these things, they came up from the king’s house to the house of the LORD and sat at the entrance of the New Gate of the LORD’S house.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priests and the prophets spoke to the officials and to all the people, saying, “A death sentence for this man! For he has prophesied against this city, just as you have heard with your own ears!”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the officials and to all the people, saying, “The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, reform your ways and your deeds and obey the voice of the LORD your God; and the LORD will relent of the disaster which He has pronounced against you.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for me, behold, I am in your hands; do with me as is good and right in your sight.

column.name: text
column.value: Only know for certain that if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood on yourselves, and on this city and its inhabitants; for truly the LORD has sent me to you to speak all these words ①so that you hear them.” ▷ ①Lit in your ears and the ears of all

column.name: text
column.value: Then the officials and all the people said to the priests and the prophets, “No death sentence for this man! For he has spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then some of the elders of the land rose up and spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①Micah of Moresheth used to prophesy in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah; and he spoke to all the people of Judah, saying, ‘This is what the LORD of armies has said: “Zion will be plowed like a field, And Jerusalem will become heaps of ruins, And the mountain of the house like the ②high places of a forest.” ’ ▷ ①Lit Micaiah the Morasthite ②Or wooded heights

column.name: text
column.value: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah actually put him to death? Did he not fear the LORD and plead for the favor of the LORD, and the LORD relented of the disaster which He had pronounced against them? But we are committing a great evil against our own lives!”

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, there was also a man who used to prophesy in the name of the LORD, Uriah the son of Shemaiah from Kiriath-jearim; and he prophesied against this city and against this land words similar to all those of Jeremiah.

column.name: text
column.value: When King Jehoiakim and all his warriors and all the officials heard his words, then the king sought to put him to death; but Uriah heard about it, and he was afraid, so he fled and went to Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Then King Jehoiakim sent men to Egypt: Elnathan the son of Achbor and certain men with him, to Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought Uriah from Egypt and led him to King Jehoiakim, who killed him with a sword and threw his dead body into the ①burial place of the ②common people. ▷ ①Lit graves ②Lit sons of the people

column.name: text
column.value: But the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so that he was not handed over to the people to put him to death.

column.name: text
column.value: In the beginning of the reign of ①Zedekiah the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying— ▷ ①Many mss Jehoiakim

column.name: text
column.value: this is what the LORD has said to me: “Make for yourself restraints and yokes and put them on your neck,

column.name: text
column.value: and send ①word to the king of Edom, the king of Moab, the king of the sons of Ammon, the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon ②by the messengers who come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah. ▷ ①Lit them ②Lit by the hand of

column.name: text
column.value: Order them to go to their masters, saying, ‘This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: “This is what you shall say to your masters:

column.name: text
column.value: ‘I have made the earth, mankind, and the animals which are on the face of the earth by My great power and by My outstretched arm, and I will give it to the one who is ①pleasing in My sight. ▷ ①Or upright

column.name: text
column.value: And now I have handed all these lands over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, My servant, and I have also given him the animals of the field to serve him.

column.name: text
column.value: All the nations shall serve him and his son and his grandson until the time of his own land comes; then many nations and great kings will ①make him their servant. ▷ ①Or enslave him

column.name: text
column.value: ‘And it will be that the nation or the kingdom which will not serve him, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and will not put its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, I will punish that nation with the sword, with famine, and with plague,’ declares the LORD, ‘until I have eliminated ①it by his hand. ▷ ①Lit them

column.name: text
column.value: And as for you, do not listen to your prophets, your diviners, your ①dreamers, your soothsayers, or your sorcerers who talk to you, saying, “You will not serve the king of Babylon.” ▷ ①Lit dreams

column.name: text
column.value: For they are prophesying a lie to you in order to remove you far from your land; and I will drive you away and you will perish.

column.name: text
column.value: But the nation that will bring its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serve him, I will let remain on its land,’ declares the LORD, ‘and they will cultivate it and live in it.’ ” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: I spoke words like all these to Zedekiah king of Judah, saying, “Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serve him and his people, and live!

column.name: text
column.value: Why should you die, you and your people, by the sword, famine, and plague, as the LORD has spoken to the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

column.name: text
column.value: So do not listen to the words of the prophets who talk to you, saying, ‘You will not serve the king of Babylon,’ for they are prophesying a lie to you;

column.name: text
column.value: for I have not sent them,” declares the LORD, “but they are prophesying falsely in My name, so that I will drive you away and that you will perish, you and the prophets who prophesy to you.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then I spoke to the priests and to all this people, saying: “This is what the LORD says: ‘Do not listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying, “Behold, the vessels of the LORD’S house will now shortly be brought back from Babylon”; for they are prophesying a lie to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not listen to them; serve the king of Babylon, and live! Why should this city become a place of ruins?

column.name: text
column.value: But if they are prophets, and if the word of the LORD is with them, have them now plead with the LORD of armies that the vessels which are left in the house of the LORD and the house of the king of Judah and in Jerusalem do not go to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD of armies says concerning the pillars, concerning the ①sea, concerning the kettle stands, and concerning the rest of the vessels that are left in this city, ▷ ①I.e., the bronze basin or laver from the temple

column.name: text
column.value: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take when he led into exile Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem—

column.name: text
column.value: Yes, this is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel, says concerning the vessels that are left in the house of the LORD and in the house of the king of Judah and in Jerusalem:

column.name: text
column.value: “They will be brought to Babylon and will be there until the day I visit them,” declares the LORD. “Then I will bring them ①back and restore them to this place.” ’ ” ▷ ①Lit up

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, Hananiah the prophet the son of Azzur, who was from Gibeon, spoke to me at the house of the LORD in the sight of the priests and all the people, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Within two years I am going to bring back to this place all the vessels of the LORD’S house, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took from this place and brought to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: I am also going to bring back to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and all the exiles of Judah who went to Babylon,’ declares the LORD, ‘for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke to the prophet Hananiah in the sight of the priests and in the sight of all the people who were standing at the house of the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: and Jeremiah the prophet said, “Amen! May the LORD do so; may the LORD fulfill your words which you have prophesied, to bring back the vessels of the LORD’S house and all the exiles, from Babylon to this place.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet hear now this word which I am going to speak ①so that you and all the people can hear it! ▷ ①Lit in your ears and the ears of...people

column.name: text
column.value: The prophets who were before me and before you from ancient times also prophesied against many lands and against great kingdoms regarding war, disaster, and plague.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the prophet who prophesies of peace, when the word of the prophet comes to pass, then that prophet will be known as one whom the LORD has truly sent.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from the neck of Jeremiah the prophet and broke it.

column.name: text
column.value: Hananiah spoke in the sight of all the people, saying, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Even so within two full years I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all the nations.’ ” Then Jeremiah the prophet went his way.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah after Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from the neck of Jeremiah the prophet, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Go and speak to Hananiah, saying, ‘This is what the LORD says: “You have broken the yokes of wood, but in their place you have made yokes of iron.”

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: “I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations, to serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him. And I have also given him the animals of the field.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeremiah the prophet said to Hananiah the prophet, “Listen now, Hananiah: the LORD has not sent you, and you have made this people trust in a lie.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, this is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I am going to ①remove you from the face of the earth. This year you are going to die, because you spoke falsely against the LORD.’ ” ▷ ①Lit send

column.name: text
column.value: So Hananiah the prophet died in the same year, in the seventh month.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these are the words of the letter which Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the rest of the elders of the exile, the priests, the prophets, and all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had taken into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: (This was after King Jeconiah and the queen mother, the high officials, the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, the craftsmen, and the metalworkers had departed from Jerusalem.)

column.name: text
column.value: The letter was sent by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel, says to all the exiles whom I have sent into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon:

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Build houses and live in them; and plant gardens and eat their ①produce. ▷ ①Lit fruit

column.name: text
column.value: Take wives and father sons and daughters, and take wives for your sons and give your daughters to husbands, so that they may give birth to sons and daughters; and grow in numbers there and do not decrease.

column.name: text
column.value: Seek the ①prosperity of the city where I have sent you into exile, and pray to the LORD in its behalf; for ②in its ③prosperity will be your ④prosperity.’ ▷ ①Or peace ②Or your prosperity will depend on its ③Or peace ④Or peace

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘Do not let your prophets who are in your midst or your diviners deceive you, and do not listen to their interpretations of your dreams which you dream.

column.name: text
column.value: For they prophesy falsely to you in My name; I have not sent them,’ declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “For this is what the LORD says: ‘When seventy years have been completed for Babylon, I will visit you and fulfill My good word to you, to bring you back to this place.

column.name: text
column.value: For I know the plans that I ①have for you,’ declares the LORD, ‘plans for ②prosperity and not for disaster, to give you a future and a hope. ▷ ①Lit am planning ②Or salvation

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And you will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart.

column.name: text
column.value: I will let Myself be found by you,’ declares the LORD, ‘and I will restore your fortunes and gather you from all the nations and all the places where I have driven you,’ declares the LORD, ‘and I will bring you back to the place from where I sent you into exile.’

column.name: text
column.value: “Because you have said, ‘The LORD has raised up prophets for us in Babylon’—

column.name: text
column.value: for this is what the LORD says concerning the king who sits on the throne of David, and concerning all the people who live in this city, your brothers who did not go with you into exile—

column.name: text
column.value: this is what the LORD of armies says: ‘Behold, I am sending upon them the sword, famine, and plague; and I will make them like rotten figs that cannot be eaten due to rottenness.

column.name: text
column.value: I will pursue them with the sword, with famine, and with plague; and I will make them an object of terror to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse and an object of horror and ①hissing, and a disgrace among all the nations where I have driven them, ▷ ①Or whistling

column.name: text
column.value: because they have not listened to My words,’ declares the LORD, ‘which I sent to them again and again by My servants the prophets; but you did not listen,’ declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You, therefore, hear the word of the LORD, all you exiles, whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah and concerning Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who are prophesying to you falsely in My name: “Behold, I am going to hand them over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will kill them before your eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of them a curse will be ①used by all the exiles from Judah who are in Babylon, saying, ‘May the LORD make you like Zedekiah and Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire,’ ▷ ①Lit taken

column.name: text
column.value: because they acted ①foolishly in Israel, and committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives, and falsely spoke words in My name which I did not command them. I am He who knows, and a witness,” declares the LORD.’ ” ▷ ①Or sacrilegiously

column.name: text
column.value: Now you shall speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘Because you have sent letters in your own name to all the people who are in Jerusalem, and to the priest Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, and to all the priests, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “The LORD has made you priest instead of Jehoiada the priest, to be the ①overseer of the house of the LORD for every insane person who prophesies, to put him in the stocks and in the iron collar. ▷ ①Lit overseers

column.name: text
column.value: So now, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth who prophesies to you,

column.name: text
column.value: seeing that he has sent word to us in Babylon, saying, ‘ ①The exile will be long; build houses and live in them, and plant gardens and eat their ②produce’ ?” ’ ” ▷ ①Lit It ②Lit fruit

column.name: text
column.value: Now Zephaniah the priest read this letter ①to Jeremiah the prophet. ▷ ①Lit in the ears of

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Send word to all the exiles, saying, ‘This is what the LORD says concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: “Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, although I did not send him, and he has made you trust in a lie,”

column.name: text
column.value: therefore this is what the LORD says: “Behold, I am going to punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his ①descendants; he will not have anyone living among this people, and he will not see the good that I am going to do for My people,” declares the LORD, “because he has spoken falsely against the LORD.” ’ ” ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘Write all the words which I have spoken to you in a book.

column.name: text
column.value: For behold, days are coming,’ declares the LORD, ‘when I will restore the fortunes of My people Israel and Judah.’ The LORD says, ‘I will also bring them back to the land that I gave to their forefathers, and they shall take possession of it.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Now these are the words which the LORD spoke concerning Israel and Judah:

column.name: text
column.value: “For this is what the LORD says: ‘ ①I have heard a sound of terror, Of fear, and there is no peace. ▷ ①Lit We

column.name: text
column.value: Ask now, and see If a male can give birth. Why do I see every man With his hands on his waist, as a woman in childbirth? And why have all faces turned pale?

column.name: text
column.value: Woe, for that day is great, There is none like it; And it is the time of Jacob’s distress, Yet he will be saved from it.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘It shall come about on that day,’ declares the LORD of armies, ‘that I will break his yoke from ①their necks and will tear to pieces ②their restraints; and strangers will no longer make ③them their slaves. ▷ ①As in LXX; MT your neck ②As in LXX; MT your ③Lit him their slave

column.name: text
column.value: But they shall serve the LORD their God and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.

column.name: text
column.value: And do not fear, Jacob My servant,’ declares the LORD, ‘And do not be dismayed, Israel; For behold, I am going to save you from far away, And your ①descendants from the land of their captivity. And Jacob will return and be at peace, without anxiety, And no one will make him afraid. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: For I am with you,’ declares the LORD, ‘to save you; For I will completely destroy all the nations where I have scattered you, Only I will not destroy you completely. But I will discipline you fairly And will by no means leave you unpunished.’

column.name: text
column.value: “For this is what the LORD says: ‘Your broken limb is irreparable, And your wound is incurable.

column.name: text
text
column.value: All your lovers have forgotten you, They do not seek you; For I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, With the punishment of a cruel one, Because your wrongdoing is great, And your sins are numerous.

column.name: text
column.value: Why do you cry out over your injury? Your pain is incurable. Because your wrongdoing is great And your sins are numerous, I have done these things to you.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For I will ①restore you to ②health And I will heal you of your wounds,’ declares the LORD, ‘Because they have called you an outcast, saying: “It is Zion; no one ③cares for her.” ’ ▷ ①Lit cause to go up ②Or healing ③Lit is seeking

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I will restore the fortunes of the tents of Jacob And have compassion on his dwellings; And the city will be rebuilt on its ruins, And the palace will stand on its rightful place.

column.name: text
text
column.value: ①Their children also will be as before, And ②their congregation will be established before Me; And I will punish all ③their oppressors. ▷ ①Lit His ②Lit his ③Lit his

column.name: text
text
column.value: ‘You shall be My people, And I will be your God.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the tempest of the LORD! Wrath has gone forth, A ①sweeping tempest; It will whirl upon the head of the wicked. ▷ ①Or raging

column.name: text
column.value: The fierce anger of the LORD will not turn back Until He has performed and accomplished The intent of His heart. In the latter days you will understand this.

column.name: text
column.value: “At that time,” declares the LORD, “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be My people.”

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “The people who survived the sword Found grace in the wilderness— Israel, when it went to find its rest.”

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD appeared to ①him ②long ago, saying, “I have loved you with an everlasting love; Therefore I have drawn you out with kindness. ▷ ①Lit me ②Or from far away

column.name: text
column.value: I will build you again and you will be rebuilt, Virgin of Israel! You will ①take up your tambourines again, And go out to the dances of the revelers. ▷ ①Lit adorn yourself with

column.name: text
column.value: Again you will plant vineyards On the ①hills of Samaria; The planters will plant And will ②enjoy the fruit. ▷ ①Or mountains ②Lit defile

column.name: text
column.value: For there will be a day when watchmen On the hills of Ephraim call out, ‘Arise, and let’s go up to Zion, To the LORD our God.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says: “Sing aloud with joy for Jacob, And be joyful with the ①chief of the nations; Proclaim, give praise, and say, ‘LORD, save Your people, The remnant of Israel!’ ▷ ①Lit head

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I am bringing them from the north country, And I will gather them from the remote parts of the earth, Among them those who are blind and those who limp, The pregnant woman and she who is in labor, together; They will return here as a great assembly.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Hear the word of the LORD, you nations, And declare it in the coastlands far away, And say, “He who scattered Israel will gather him, And He will keep him as a shepherd keeps his flock.”

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD has ransomed Jacob And redeemed him from the hand of him who was stronger than he.

column.name: text
column.value: “They will come and shout for joy on the height of Zion, And they will be radiant over the ①bounty of the LORD— Over the grain, the new wine, the oil, And over the young of the flock and the herd. And their life will be like a watered garden, And they will never languish again. ▷ ①Lit goodness

column.name: text
column.value: Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance, And the young men and the old together; For I will turn their mourning into joy And comfort them, and give them joy for their sorrow.

column.name: text
column.value: I will refresh the soul of the priests with ①abundance, And My people will be satisfied with My goodness,” declares the LORD. ▷ ①Lit fatness

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “A voice is heard in Ramah, Lamenting and bitter weeping. Rachel is weeping for her children; She refuses to be comforted for her children, Because they are no more.”

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “Restrain your voice from weeping And your eyes from tears; For your work will be rewarded,” declares the LORD, “And they will return from the land of the enemy.

column.name: text
column.value: There is hope for your future,” declares the LORD, “And your children will return to their own territory.

column.name: text
column.value: I have certainly heard Ephraim grieving, ‘You have disciplined me, and I was corrected, Like an untrained calf; Bring me back that I may be restored, For You are the LORD my God.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Is Ephraim My dear son? Is he a delightful child? Indeed, as often as I have spoken against him, I certainly still remember him; Therefore My ①heart yearns for him; I will certainly have mercy on him,” declares the LORD. ▷ ①Lit inward parts

column.name: text
column.value: “Set up roadmarks for yourself, Place guideposts for yourself; Direct your ①mind to the highway, The way by which you went. Return, O virgin of Israel, Return to these your cities. ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: How long will you waver, You rebellious daughter? For the LORD has created a new thing on the earth: A woman will shelter a man.”

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: “Once again they will speak this word in the land of Judah and in its cities when I restore their fortunes, ‘The LORD bless you, O place of righteousness, O holy hill!’

column.name: text
column.value: Judah and all its cities will live together in it, the farmers and those who travel with flocks.

column.name: text
column.value: For I give plenty of water to the weary ones, and ①refresh everyone who languishes.” ▷ ①Lit fill

column.name: text
column.value: At this I awoke and looked, and my sleep had been pleasant to me.

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of mankind and the seed of animals.

column.name: text
column.value: And just as I have watched over them to uproot them, tear them down, ruin, destroy, and bring disaster on them, so I will watch over them to build and to plant them,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “In those days they will no longer say, ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, ①But it is the children’s teeth that have become blunt.’ ▷ ①I.e., the children suffer for the fathers’ sins

column.name: text
column.value: But everyone will die for his own wrongdoing; each person who eats the sour grapes, his own teeth will become blunt.

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and the house of Judah,

column.name: text
column.value: not like the covenant which I made with their fathers on the day I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt, My covenant which they broke, although I was a husband to them,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “For this is the covenant which I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” declares the LORD: “I will put My law within them and write it on their heart; and I will be their God, and they shall be My people.

column.name: text
column.value: They will not teach again, each one his neighbor and each one his brother, saying, ‘Know the LORD,’ for they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest of them,” declares the LORD, “for I will forgive their wrongdoing, and their sin I will no longer remember.”

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says, He who gives the sun for light by day And the ①fixed order of the moon and the stars for light by night, Who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— The LORD of armies is His name: ▷ ①Lit statutes

column.name: text
column.value: “If ①this fixed order departs From Me,” declares the LORD, “Then the descendants of Israel also will cease To be a nation before Me ②forever.” ▷ ①Lit these statutes ②Lit all the days

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “If the heavens above can be measured And the foundations of the earth searched out below, Then I will also reject all the descendants of Israel For everything that they have done,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when the city will be rebuilt for the LORD from the Tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.

column.name: text
column.value: The measuring line will go out farther straight ahead, to the hill Gareb; then it will turn to Goah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the entire valley of the dead bodies and of the ashes, and all the fields as far as the brook Kidron to the corner of the Horse Gate toward the east, shall be holy to the LORD; it will not be uprooted or overthrown ever again.”

column.name: text
column.value: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.

column.name: text
column.value: Now at that time the army of the king of Babylon was besieging Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet was imprisoned in the courtyard of the guard, which was at the house of the king of Judah,

column.name: text
column.value: because Zedekiah king of Judah had imprisoned him, saying, “Why do you prophesy, saying, ‘This is what the LORD says: “Behold, I am going to hand this city over to the king of Babylon, and he will take it;

column.name: text
column.value: and Zedekiah king of Judah will not escape from the hand of the Chaldeans, but he will certainly be handed over to the king of Babylon, and he will speak with him ①face to face and see him eye to eye. ▷ ①Lit mouth with mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Then he will take Zedekiah to Babylon, and he will be there until I visit him,” declares the LORD. “If you fight against the Chaldeans, you will not succeed” ’?”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jeremiah said, “The word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Behold, Hanamel the son of Shallum your uncle is coming to you, saying, “Buy for yourself my field which is at Anathoth, for you have the right of redemption to buy it.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: Then my uncle’s son Hanamel came to me in the courtyard of the guard in accordance with the word of the LORD and said to me, ‘Buy my field, please, that is at Anathoth, which is in the land of Benjamin; for you have the right of possession and the redemption is yours; buy it for yourself.’ Then I knew that this was the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “So I bought the field which was in Anathoth from Hanamel my uncle’s son, and I weighed out the silver for him, seventeen shekels of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: And I ①signed and sealed the deed, and called in witnesses, and weighed out the silver on the scales. ▷ ①Lit wrote...on and

column.name: text
column.value: Then I took the deeds of purchase, both the sealed copy containing the terms and conditions and the open copy;

column.name: text
column.value: and I gave the deed of purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the sight of Hanamel my uncle’s son and in the sight of the witnesses who signed the deed of purchase, in the sight of all the Jews who were sitting in the courtyard of the guard.

column.name: text
column.value: And I commanded Baruch in their sight, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: “Take these deeds, this sealed deed of purchase and this open deed, and put them in an earthenware jar, so that they may ①last a long time.” ▷ ①Lit stand many days

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: “Houses and fields and vineyards will again be purchased in this land.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: “After giving the deed of purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed to the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Oh, Lord ①GOD! Behold, You Yourself have made the heavens and the earth by Your great power and by Your outstretched arm! Nothing is too difficult for You, ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: who shows mercy to thousands, but repays the wrongdoing of fathers into the laps of their children after them, great and mighty God. The LORD of armies is His name;

column.name: text
column.value: great in counsel and mighty in deed, whose eyes are open to all the ways of the sons of mankind, giving to everyone according to his ways and according to the fruit of his deeds;

column.name: text
column.value: who has accomplished signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, and even to this day both in Israel and among mankind; and You have made a name for Yourself, as at this day.

column.name: text
column.value: You brought Your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs and with wonders, and with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and with great terror;

column.name: text
column.value: and You gave them this land, which You swore to their forefathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey.

column.name: text
column.value: They came in and took possession of it, but they did not obey Your voice or walk in Your Law; they did not do ①anything that You commanded them to do; therefore You have made all this disaster happen to them. ▷ ①Or all that

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the assault ramps have reached the city to take it; and the city has been handed over to the Chaldeans who fight against it, because of the sword, the famine, and the plague; and what You have spoken has come to pass; and behold, You see it.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet You have said to me, Lord ①GOD, “Buy for yourself the field with money and call in witnesses”—although the city has been handed over to the Chaldeans.’ ” ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh; is anything too difficult for Me?”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD says: “Behold, I am going to hand this city over to the Chaldeans and to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will take it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Chaldeans who are fighting against this city will enter and set this city on fire and burn it, with the houses where people have offered incense to Baal on their roofs and poured out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke Me to anger.

column.name: text
column.value: For the sons of Israel and the sons of Judah have been doing only evil in My sight since their youth; for the sons of Israel have been only provoking Me to anger by the work of their hands,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “Indeed this city has been to Me a provocation of My anger and My wrath since the day that they built it, even to this day, so that it should be removed from My sight,

column.name: text
column.value: because of all the evil of the sons of Israel and the sons of Judah which they have done to provoke Me to anger—they, their kings, their leaders, their priests, their prophets, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: They have turned their back to Me and not their face; though I taught them, teaching again and again, they would not listen to accept discipline.

column.name: text
column.value: But they put their detestable things in the house which is called by My name, to defile it.

column.name: text
column.value: They built the high places of Baal that are in the Valley of Ben-hinnom to make their sons and their daughters pass through the fire to Molech, which I had not commanded them, nor had it ①entered My mind that they should do this abomination, to mislead Judah to sin. ▷ ①Lit come up on My heart

column.name: text
column.value: “Now therefore the LORD God of Israel says the following concerning this city of which you say, ‘It has been handed over to the king of Babylon by sword, by famine, and by plague’:

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I am going to gather them out of all the lands to which I have driven them in My anger, in My wrath, and in great indignation; and I will bring them back to this place and have them live in safety.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall be My people, and I will be their God;

column.name: text
column.value: and I will give them one heart and one way, so that they will fear Me always, for their own good and for the good of their children after them.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make an everlasting covenant with them that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; and I will put the fear of Me in their hearts, so that they will not turn away from Me.

column.name: text
column.value: I will rejoice over them to do them good and will ①faithfully plant them in this land with all My heart and all My soul. ▷ ①Or truly

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says: ‘Just as I brought all this great disaster on this people, so I am going to bring on them all the good that I am promising them.

column.name: text
column.value: And fields will be purchased in this land of which you say, “It is a desolation, without man or animal; it has been handed over to the Chaldeans.”

column.name: text
column.value: People will buy fields for money, ①sign and seal ②deeds, and call in witnesses in the land of Benjamin, in the areas surrounding Jerusalem, in the cities of Judah, in the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, and in the cities of the ③Negev; for I will restore their fortunes,’ declares the LORD.” ▷ ①Lit write on...and ②Lit the document ③I.e., South country

column.name: text
column.value: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army, with all the kingdoms of the earth that were under his ①control and all the peoples, were fighting against Jerusalem and all its cities, saying, ▷ ①Lit dominion

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah and say to him, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I am handing this city over to the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And as for you, you will not escape from his hand, for you will assuredly be caught and handed over to him; and you will see the king of Babylon eye to eye, and he will speak with you ①face to face, and you will go to Babylon.’ ” ’ ▷ ①Lit his mouth with your mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Yet hear the word of the LORD, Zedekiah king of Judah! This is what the LORD says concerning you: ‘You will not die by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: You will die in peace; and as spices were burned for your fathers, the former kings who were before you, so they will burn spices for you; and they will mourn for you, crying, “Oh, my lord!” ’ For I have spoken the word,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem

column.name: text
column.value: when the army of the king of Babylon was fighting against Jerusalem and all the remaining cities of Judah, that is, Lachish and Azekah, for they alone remained as fortified cities among the cities of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD after King Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people who were in Jerusalem, to proclaim ①release to them: ▷ ①Or liberty

column.name: text
column.value: that each person was to set his male servant free and each his female servant, a Hebrew man or a Hebrew woman, so that no one would keep them, his Jewish brother or sister, in bondage.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the officials and all the people obeyed who had entered into the covenant that each person was to set his male servant free and each his female servant, so that no one would keep them in bondage any longer; they obeyed, and set them free.

column.name: text
column.value: But afterward they turned around and took back the male servants and the female servants whom they had set free, and brought them into subjection as male servants and as female servants.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘I made a covenant with your forefathers on the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “At the end of seven years each of you shall set free his Hebrew brother who ①has been sold to you and has served you for six years, and you shall send him out free from you.” But your forefathers did not obey Me nor incline their ear to Me. ▷ ①Or has sold himself

column.name: text
column.value: Although recently you had turned and done what is right in My sight, each one proclaiming ①release to his neighbor, and you had made a covenant before Me in the house which is called by My name. ▷ ①Or liberty

column.name: text
column.value: Yet you turned and profaned My name, and each person ①took back his male servant and each his female servant whom you had set free according to their desire, and you brought them into subjection to be your male and female servants.’ ▷ ①Lit made his male servant return and

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘You have not obeyed Me in proclaiming ①release, each one to his brother and each to his neighbor. Behold, I am proclaiming a ②release to you,’ declares the LORD, ‘to the sword, to the plague, and to the famine; and I will make you a terror to all the kingdoms of the earth. ▷ ①Or liberty ②Or liberty

column.name: text
column.value: I will give the people who have violated My covenant, who have not fulfilled the words of the covenant which they made before Me, when they cut the calf in two and passed between its parts—

column.name: text
column.value: the officials of Judah and the officials of Jerusalem, the high officials and the priests, and all the people of the land who passed between the parts of the calf—

column.name: text
column.value: I will hand them over to their enemies and to those who seek their lives. And their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and the animals of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Zedekiah king of Judah and his officials I will also hand over to their enemies and to those who seek their lives, and to the army of the king of Babylon which has withdrawn from you.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I am going to give a command,’ declares the LORD, ‘and I will bring them back to this city, and they will fight against it and take it and burn it with fire; and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without inhabitant.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Go to the house of the Rechabites and speak to them, and bring them into the house of the LORD, into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.”

column.name: text
column.value: So I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, son of Habazziniah, and his brothers and all his sons, and all the household of the Rechabites,

column.name: text
column.value: and I brought them into the house of the LORD, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, the man of God, which was next to the chamber of the officials, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the doorkeeper.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I set before the ①men of the house of the Rechabites pitchers full of wine, and cups; and I said to them, “Drink wine!” ▷ ①Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: But they said, “We will not drink wine, for Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, commanded us, saying, ‘You shall not drink wine, you or your sons, forever.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall not build a house, and you shall not sow seed nor plant a vineyard, nor ①own one; but you shall live in tents all your days, so that you may live many days ②in the land where you live as strangers.’ ▷ ①Lit shall it be to you ②Lit on the face of the

column.name: text
column.value: And we have obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, in all that he commanded us, not to drink wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, or our daughters,

column.name: text
column.value: nor to build ourselves houses to live in; and we do not have a vineyard, a field, or seed.

column.name: text
column.value: But we have lived only in tents, and have obeyed and have done according to all that our father Jonadab commanded us.

column.name: text
column.value: However, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against the land, we said, ‘Come, and let’s go to Jerusalem away from the army of the Chaldeans and the army of the Arameans.’ So we have lived in Jerusalem.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘Go and say to the people of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, “Will you not accept instruction by listening to My words?” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab have been followed, which he commanded his sons: not to drink wine. And they do not drink wine to this day, for they have obeyed their father’s command. But I have spoken to you again and again, yet you have not listened to Me.

column.name: text
column.value: Also I have sent to you all My servants the prophets, sending them again and again, saying: ‘Turn now every person from his evil way and amend your deeds, and do not follow other gods to worship them. Then you will live in the land which I have given to you and to your forefathers; but you have not inclined your ear or listened to Me.

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have followed the command of their father which he commanded them, but this people has not listened to Me.’ ” ’

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD says, the God of armies, the God of Israel: ‘Behold, I am bringing on Judah and on all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the disaster that I have pronounced against them; because I spoke to them but they did not listen, and I have called them but they did not answer.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites, “This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘Because you have obeyed the command of Jonadab your father, kept all his commands, and done according to all that he commanded you,

column.name: text
column.value: therefore this is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: “Jonadab the son of Rechab will not lack a man to stand before Me ①always.” ’ ” ▷ ①Lit all the days

column.name: text
column.value: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Take a ①scroll and write on it all the words which I have spoken to you concerning Israel, Judah, and all the nations, from the day I first spoke to you, from the days of Josiah, even to this day. ▷ ①Lit scroll of a book

column.name: text
column.value: Perhaps the house of Judah will listen to all the disaster which I plan to carry out against them, so that every person will turn from his evil way; then I will forgive their wrongdoing and their sin.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah, and Baruch wrote on a ①scroll ②at the dictation of Jeremiah all the words of the LORD which He had spoken to him. ▷ ①Lit scroll of a book ②Lit from the mouth of

column.name: text
column.value: Jeremiah then commanded Baruch, saying, “I am ①restricted; I cannot go into the house of the LORD. ▷ ①Lit restrained

column.name: text
column.value: So you go and read from the scroll, which you have written ①at my dictation, the words of the LORD ②to the people at the LORD’S house on a day of fasting. And you shall also read them ③to all the people of Judah who come from their cities. ▷ ①Lit from my mouth ②Lit in the ears of, and so throughout this ch ③Lit in the ears of, and so throughout this ch

column.name: text
column.value: Perhaps their pleading will ①come before the LORD, and everyone will turn from his evil way; for great is the anger and the wrath that the LORD has pronounced against this people.” ▷ ①Lit fall

column.name: text
column.value: So Baruch the son of Neriah acted in accordance with all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading from the book the words of the LORD in the LORD’S house.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, in the ninth month, all the people in Jerusalem and all the people who came from the cities of Judah to Jerusalem proclaimed a fast before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Baruch read to all the people from the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of the LORD in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the upper courtyard, at the entry of the New Gate of the LORD’S house.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Micaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard all the words of the LORD from the book,

column.name: text
column.value: he went down to the king’s house, into the scribe’s chamber. And behold, all the officials were sitting there—Elishama the scribe, Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, Elnathan the son of Achbor, Gemariah the son of Shaphan, Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the other officials.

column.name: text
column.value: And Micaiah declared to them all the words that he had heard when Baruch read from the book to the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the officials sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, who was the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to Baruch, saying, “Take in your hand the scroll from which you have read to the people and come.” So Baruch the son of Neriah took the scroll in his hand and came to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to him, “Sit down, please, and read it to us.” So Baruch read it to them.

column.name: text
column.value: When they had heard all the words, they turned in fear one to another. And they said to Baruch, “We will certainly report all these words to the king.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then they asked Baruch, saying, “Tell us, please, how did you write all these words? Was it ①at Jeremiah’s dictation?” ▷ ①Lit from his mouth

column.name: text
column.value: And Baruch said to them, “He dictated all these words to me, and I wrote them with ink on the book.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the officials said to Baruch, “Go, hide yourself, you and Jeremiah, and do not let anyone know where you are.”

column.name: text
column.value: So they came to the king in the courtyard, but they had deposited the scroll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe; and they reported all the words to the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and he took it out of the chamber of Elishama the scribe. And Jehudi read it to the king as well as to all the officials who were standing beside the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the king was sitting in the winter house in the ninth month, with a fire burning in the brazier before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jehudi had read three or four columns, the king cut it with a scribe’s knife and threw it into the fire that was in the brazier, until all of the scroll was consumed in the fire that was in the brazier.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet the king and all his servants who heard all these words did not tremble in fear, nor did they tear their garments.

column.name: text
column.value: Even though Elnathan, Delaiah, and Gemariah urged the king not to burn the scroll, he would not listen to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king commanded Jerahmeel the king’s son, Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel to seize Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet, but the LORD hid them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah after the king had burned the scroll and the words which Baruch had written ①at the dictation of Jeremiah, saying, ▷ ①Lit from his mouth

column.name: text
column.value: “Take again another scroll and write on it all the previous words that were on the first scroll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah burned.

column.name: text
column.value: And concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah you shall say, ‘This is what the LORD says: “You have burned this scroll, saying, ‘Why have you written on it ①that the king of Babylon will certainly come and destroy this land, and will make mankind and animals disappear from it?’ ” ▷ ①Lit saying

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: “He shall have no one to sit on the throne of David, and his dead body shall be thrown out to the heat of the day and the frost of the night.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also punish him, his ①descendants, and his servants for their wrongdoing, and I will bring on them and the inhabitants of Jerusalem and the people of Judah all the disaster that I have declared to them—but they did not listen.” ’ ” ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeremiah took another scroll and gave it to the scribe Baruch the son of Neriah, and he wrote on it at the ①dictation of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire; and many ②similar words were added to them. ▷ ①Lit from his mouth ②Lit like those

column.name: text
column.value: Now Zedekiah the son of Josiah whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had made king in the land of Judah, reigned as king in place of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim.

column.name: text
column.value: But neither he nor his servants nor the people of the land listened to the words of the LORD which He spoke through Jeremiah the prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet King Zedekiah sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah, and the priest Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, to Jeremiah the prophet, saying, “Please pray to the LORD our God in our behalf.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jeremiah was still coming and going among the people, for they had not yet put him in prison.

column.name: text
column.value: Meanwhile, Pharaoh’s army had set out from Egypt; and when the Chaldeans who had been besieging Jerusalem heard the report about them, they withdrew from Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘This is what you are to say to the king of Judah, who sent you to Me to inquire of Me: “Behold, Pharaoh’s army, which has come out to help you, is going to return to its own land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Chaldeans will return and fight against this city, and they will capture it and burn it with fire.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: ‘Do not deceive yourselves, saying, “The Chaldeans will certainly go away from us,” for they will not go.

column.name: text
column.value: For even if you had defeated the entire army of Chaldeans who were fighting against you, and there were only wounded men left among them, each man in his tent, they would rise up and burn this city with fire.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Now it happened when the army of the Chaldeans had withdrawn from Jerusalem because of Pharaoh’s army,

column.name: text
column.value: that Jeremiah left Jerusalem to go to the land of Benjamin in order to take ①possession of some property there among the people. ▷ ①Or part in a dividing

column.name: text
column.value: While he was at the Gate of Benjamin, a captain of the guard whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah the son of Hananiah was there; and he arrested Jeremiah the prophet, saying, “You are deserting to the Chaldeans!”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jeremiah said, “A lie! I am not deserting to the Chaldeans”; yet he would not listen to him. So Irijah arrested Jeremiah and brought him to the officials.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the officials were angry at Jeremiah and they beat him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe, for they had made it into the prison.

column.name: text
column.value: For Jeremiah had come into the ①dungeon, that is, the vaulted cell; and Jeremiah stayed there many days. ▷ ①Lit house of the cistern-pit

column.name: text
column.value: Now King Zedekiah sent men and took him out; and in his palace the king secretly asked him and said, “Is there a word from the LORD?” And Jeremiah said, “There is!” Then he said, “You will be handed over to the king of Babylon!”

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, Jeremiah said to King Zedekiah, “In what way have I sinned against you, or your servants, or this people, that you have put me in prison?

column.name: text
column.value: And where are your prophets who prophesied to you, saying, ‘The king of Babylon will not come against you or against this land’?

column.name: text
column.value: But now, please listen, my lord the king; please let my plea ①come before you and do not make me return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, so that I will not die there.” ▷ ①Lit fall

column.name: text
column.value: Then King Zedekiah gave a command, and they placed Jeremiah in custody in the courtyard of the guardhouse, and gave him a loaf of bread daily from the bakers’ street, until all the bread in the city was gone. So Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guardhouse.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Shephatiah the son of Mattan, Gedaliah the son of Pashhur, Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur the son of Malchijah heard the words that Jeremiah was speaking to all the people, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD says: ‘Anyone who stays in this city will die by the sword, by famine, or by plague; but anyone who surrenders to the Chaldeans will live and have his own life as plunder, and stay alive.’

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: ‘This city will certainly be handed over to the army of the king of Babylon and he will capture it.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the officials said to the king, “Please have this man put to death, since he is ①discouraging the men of war who are left in this city and ②all the people, by speaking words like these to them; for this man is not seeking the well-being of this people, but rather their harm.” ▷ ①Lit making slack the hands of ②Lit the hands of all

column.name: text
column.value: And King Zedekiah said, “Behold, he is in your ①hands; for the king can do nothing against you.” ▷ ①Lit hand

column.name: text
column.value: So they took Jeremiah and threw him into the cistern of Malchijah the king’s son, which was in the courtyard of the guardhouse; and they let Jeremiah down with ropes. Now in the cistern there was no water but only mud, and Jeremiah sank into the mud.

column.name: text
column.value: But Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, a ①eunuch, while he was in the king’s palace, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the cistern. Now the king was sitting at the Gate of Benjamin; ▷ ①Or high official

column.name: text
column.value: and Ebed-melech went out from the king’s palace and spoke to the king, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “My lord the king, these men have acted wickedly in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet whom they have thrown into the cistern; and he will die right where he is because of the famine, for there is no more bread in the city.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king commanded Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, “Take thirty men from here ①under your authority and bring Jeremiah the prophet up from the cistern before he dies.” ▷ ①Lit in your hand

column.name: text
column.value: So Ebed-melech took the men under his ①authority and went into the king’s palace to a place beneath the storeroom, and took from there worn-out clothes and worn-out rags, and let them down by ropes into the cistern to Jeremiah. ▷ ①Lit hand

column.name: text
column.value: Then Ebed-melech the Ethiopian said to Jeremiah, “Now put these worn-out clothes and rags under your armpits under the ropes”; and Jeremiah did so.

column.name: text
column.value: So they pulled Jeremiah out with the ropes and lifted him out of the cistern, and Jeremiah stayed in the courtyard of the guardhouse.

column.name: text
column.value: Then King Zedekiah sent word and ①had Jeremiah the prophet brought to him at the third entrance that is in the house of the LORD; and the king said to Jeremiah, “I am going to ask you something; do not hide anything from me.” ▷ ①Lit took Jeremiah the prophet to him

column.name: text
column.value: And Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “If I tell you, will you not certainly put me to death? Besides, if I give you advice, you will not listen to me.”

column.name: text
column.value: But King Zedekiah swore to Jeremiah in secret, saying, “As the LORD lives, who made this ①life for us, I certainly will not put you to death, nor will I hand you over to these men who are seeking your ②life.” ▷ ①Lit soul ②Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: So Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “This is what the LORD God of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘If you will indeed surrender to the officers of the king of Babylon, then ①you will live, this city will not be burned with fire, and you and your household will ②survive. ▷ ①Lit your soul ②Lit live

column.name: text
column.value: But if you do not surrender to the officers of the king of Babylon, then this city will be handed over to the Chaldeans; and they will burn it with fire, and you yourself will not escape from their hands.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then King Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, “I am in fear of the Jews who have deserted to the Chaldeans, for they may hand me over to them, and they will abuse me.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jeremiah said, “They will not turn you over. Please ①obey the LORD in what I am saying to you, so that it may go well for you and ②you may live. ▷ ①Lit listen to the voice of ②Lit your soul

column.name: text
column.value: But if you keep refusing to surrender, this is the word which the LORD has shown me:

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Behold, all of the women who have been left in the palace of the king of Judah are going to be brought out to the officers of the king of Babylon; and those women will say, “ ①Your close friends Have misled and overpowered you; While your feet were sunk in the mire, They turned back.” ▷ ①Lit The men of your peace

column.name: text
column.value: They are also going to bring out all your wives and your sons to the Chaldeans, and you yourself will not escape from their hand, but will be seized by the hand of the king of Babylon, and this city will be burned with fire.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, “Let no one know about these words, and you will not die.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the officials hear that I have talked with you and come to you and say to you, ‘Tell us now what you said to the king and what the king said to you; do not hide it from us and we will not put you to death,’

column.name: text
column.value: then you are to say to them, ‘I was presenting my plea before the king, not to make me return to the house of Jonathan to die there.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the officials came to Jeremiah and questioned him. So he reported to them in accordance with all these words which the king had commanded; and they stopped speaking with him, since the ①conversation had not been overheard. ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: So Jeremiah stayed in the courtyard of the guard until the day that Jerusalem was captured.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the second time, while he was still confined in the courtyard of the guard, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD says, He who made ①the earth, the LORD who formed it to create it, He whose name is the LORD: ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Call to Me and I will answer you, and I will tell you great and ①mighty things, which you do not know.’ ▷ ①Or incomprehensible

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD, the God of Israel says concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah which have been torn down to make a defense against the assault ramps and the sword:

column.name: text
column.value: ‘While they are coming to fight the Chaldeans and to fill ①their houses with the bodies of people whom I have struck down in My anger and My wrath, and I have hidden My face from this city because of all their wickedness: ▷ ①Lit them

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I am going to bring to it healing and a remedy, and I will heal them; and I will reveal to them an abundance of peace and truth.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will restore the fortunes of Judah and the fortunes of Israel, and will rebuild them as they were at first.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will cleanse them from all their wrongdoing by which they have sinned against Me, and I will forgive all their wrongdoings by which they have sinned against Me and revolted against Me.

column.name: text
column.value: ①It will be to Me a name of joy, praise, and glory before all the nations of the earth, which will hear of all the good that I do for them, and they will be frightened and tremble because of all the good and all the peace that I make for it.’ ▷ ①I.e., This city

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD says: ‘Yet again there will be heard in this place, of which you say, “It is a waste, without man and without animal,” that is, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem that are deserted, without man and without inhabitant and without animal,

column.name: text
column.value: the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the groom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those who say, “Give thanks to the LORD of armies, For the LORD is good, For His mercy is everlasting,” as they bring a thanksgiving offering into the house of the LORD. For I will restore the fortunes of the land as they were at first,’ says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD of armies says: ‘There will again be in this place which is waste, without man or animal, and in all its cities, a pasture for shepherds who rest their flocks.

column.name: text
column.value: In the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, in the cities of the Negev, in the land of Benjamin, in the areas surrounding Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, the flocks will again pass under the hands of the one who counts them,’ says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Behold, days are coming,’ declares the LORD, ‘when I will fulfill the good word which I have spoken concerning the house of Israel and the house of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days and at that time I will make a righteous Branch of David sprout; and He shall execute justice and righteousness on the earth.
