column.name: text
column.value: In those days Judah will be saved and Jerusalem will live in safety; and this is the name by which it will be called: the LORD is our righteousness.’

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says: ‘ ①David shall not lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel; ▷ ①Lit There shall not be cut off for David

column.name: text
column.value: ①and the Levitical priests shall not lack a man before Me to offer burnt offerings, to burn grain offerings, and to prepare sacrifices ②continually.’ ” ▷ ①Lit there shall not be cut off for the Levitical priests ②Lit all the days

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD says: ‘If you can break My covenant for the day and My covenant for the night, so that day and night do not occur at their proper time,

column.name: text
column.value: then My covenant with David My servant may also be broken, so that he will not have a son to reign on his throne, and with the Levitical priests, My ministers.

column.name: text
column.value: As the heavenly ①lights cannot be counted, and the sand of the sea cannot be measured, so I will multiply the ②descendants of My servant David and the Levites who serve Me.’ ” ▷ ①Lit host; i.e., sun, stars, etc. ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Have you not observed what these people have asserted, saying, ‘The two families which the LORD chose, He has rejected them’? So they despise My people as no longer being a nation ①in their sight. ▷ ①Lit to their faces

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: ‘If My covenant for day and night does not continue, and I have not established the ①fixed patterns of heaven and earth, ▷ ①Lit statutes

column.name: text
column.value: then I would reject the ①descendants of Jacob and David My servant, so as not to take from his ②descendants rulers over the ③descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. But I will restore their fortunes and have mercy on them.’ ” ▷ ①Lit seed ②Lit seed ③Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: in Heb

column.name: text
column.value: in the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the city wall was breached.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the officials of the king of Babylon came in and sat down at the Middle Gate: Nergal-sar-ezer, Samgar-nebu, Sar-sekim the ①Rab-saris, Nergal-sar-ezer the ②Rab-mag, and all the rest of the officials of the king of Babylon. ▷ ①I.e., chief official ②I.e., title of a high official

column.name: text
column.value: And when Zedekiah the king of Judah and all the men of war saw them, they fled and left the city at night by way of the king’s garden through the gate between the two walls; and he went out toward the ①Arabah. ▷ ①I.e., Jordan valley

column.name: text
column.value: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued them and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and they took him and brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, and he ①passed sentence on him. ▷ ①Lit spoke judgments with

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes at Riblah; the king of Babylon also slaughtered all the nobles of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: He then blinded Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him in shackles of bronze to bring him to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: The Chaldeans also burned the king’s palace and the houses of the people with fire, and they tore down the walls of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And as for the rest of the people who were left in the city, the deserters who had deserted to him and the rest of the people who remained, Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguard took them into exile in Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: But some of the poorest people, who had nothing, Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguard left behind in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields ①at that time. ▷ ①Lit on that day

column.name: text
column.value: Now Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon gave orders regarding Jeremiah through Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguard, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Take him and ①look after him, and do not do anything harmful to him, but rather deal with him just as he tells you.” ▷ ①Lit set your eyes on

column.name: text
column.value: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguard sent word, along with Nebushazban the ①Rab-saris, Nergal-sar-ezer the ②Rab-mag, and all the leading officers of the king of Babylon; ▷ ①I.e., chief official ②I.e., title of a high official

column.name: text
column.value: they even sent word and took Jeremiah out of the courtyard of the guardhouse and entrusted him to Gedaliah, the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, to take him home. So he stayed among the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the word of the LORD had come to Jeremiah while he was confined in the courtyard of the guardhouse, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Go and speak to Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, ‘This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: “Behold, I am going to bring My words on this city for disaster and not for ①prosperity; and they will take place before you on that day. ▷ ①Lit good

column.name: text
column.value: But I will save you on that day,” declares the LORD, “and you will not be handed over to the men of whom you are afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will assuredly rescue you, and you will not fall by the sword; but you will have your own life as plunder, because you have trusted in Me,” declares the LORD.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD after Nebuzaradan captain of the bodyguard had released him from Ramah, when he had taken him bound in chains among all the exiles of Jerusalem and Judah who were being exiled to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the captain of the bodyguard had taken Jeremiah and said to him, “The LORD your God promised this disaster against this place;

column.name: text
column.value: and the LORD has brought it and done just as He promised. Because you people sinned against the LORD and did not listen to His voice, this thing has happened to you.

column.name: text
column.value: But now, behold, I am setting you free today from the chains that are on your hands. If ①you would prefer to come with me to Babylon, come along, and I will ②look after you; but if ③you would prefer not to come with me to Babylon, ④do not come. Look, the whole land is before you; go wherever it seems good and right for you to go.” ▷ ①Lit it is good in your eyes ②Lit set my eyes on ③Lit it is evil in your eyes ④Lit refrain

column.name: text
column.value: As ①Jeremiah was still not going back, ②he said, “Go on back then to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has appointed over the cities of Judah, and stay with him among the people; or else go anywhere it seems right for you to go.” So the captain of the bodyguard gave him a ration and a gift, and let him go. ▷ ①Lit he ②I.e., Nebuzaradan

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeremiah went to Mizpah to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam and stayed with him among the people who were left in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Now all the commanders of the forces that were in the field, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam over the land, and that he had put him in charge of the men, women, and ①children, those of the poorest of the land who had not been exiled to Babylon. ▷ ①Lit infants

column.name: text
column.value: So they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah, along with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of the Maacathite, both they and their men.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, swore to them and to their men, saying, “Do not be afraid of serving the Chaldeans; stay in the land and serve the king of Babylon, so that it may go well for you.

column.name: text
column.value: Now as for me, behold, I am going to stay in Mizpah to stand for you before the Chaldeans who come to us; but as for you, gather wine, summer fruit, and oil, and put them in your storage vessels, and live in your cities that you have taken over.”

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise, also all the Jews who were in Moab and among the sons of Ammon and in Edom, and who were in all the other countries, heard that the king of Babylon had ①left a remnant for Judah, and that he had appointed over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan. ▷ ①Lit given

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the Jews returned from all the places to which they had been scattered and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah at Mizpah, and gathered wine and summer fruit in great abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Johanan the son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces that were in the field came to Gedaliah at Mizpah,

column.name: text
column.value: and said to him, “Are you well aware that Baalis the king of the sons of Ammon has sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to take your life?” But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam did not believe them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spoke secretly to Gedaliah in Mizpah, saying, “Let me go and kill Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no one will know! Why should he take your life, so that all the Jews who are gathered to you would be scattered and the remnant of Judah would perish?”

column.name: text
column.value: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said to Johanan the son of Kareah, “Do not do this thing, for you are telling a lie about Ishmael.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the seventh month Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal ①family and one of the chief officers of the king, along with ten men, came to Mizpah to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam. While they were eating bread together there in Mizpah, ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah and the ten men who were with him rose up, and struck and killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, with the sword and put to death the one whom the king of Babylon had appointed over the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Ishmael also struck and killed all the Jews who were with him, that is with Gedaliah in Mizpah, and the Chaldeans who were found there, the men of war.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it happened on the ①next day after the killing of Gedaliah, when no one knew about it, ▷ ①Or second

column.name: text
column.value: that eighty men came from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria with their beards shaved off, their clothes torn, and ①their bodies gashed, having grain offerings and incense in their hands to bring to the house of the LORD. ▷ ①Lit having cut themselves

column.name: text
column.value: Then Ishmael the son of Nethaniah left Mizpah to meet them, weeping as he went; and as he met them, he said to them, “Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam!”

column.name: text
column.value: Yet it turned out that as soon as they came inside the city, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah and the men who were with him slaughtered them and threw them into the cistern.

column.name: text
column.value: But ten men who were found among them said to Ishmael, “Do not put us to death, for we have supplies of wheat, barley, oil, and honey hidden in the field.” So he refrained and did not put them to death along with their companions.

column.name: text
column.value: Now as for the cistern where Ishmael had thrown all the bodies of the men whom he had struck and killed ①because of Gedaliah, it was the one that King Asa had constructed on account of Baasha, king of Israel; Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with the dead. ▷ ①Lit by the hand of

column.name: text
column.value: Then Ishmael took captive all the remnant of the people who were in Mizpah, the king’s daughters and all the people who were left in Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguard had put in the custody of Gedaliah the son of Ahikam. Ishmael the son of Nethaniah took them captive and proceeded to cross over to the sons of Ammon.

column.name: text
column.value: But Johanan the son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces that were with him heard about all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done.

column.name: text
column.value: So they took all the men and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah and they found him by the large ①pool that is in Gibeon. ▷ ①Lit waters

column.name: text
column.value: Now as soon as all the people who were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces that were with him, they were joyful.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the people whom Ishmael had taken captive from Mizpah turned around and came back, and went to Johanan the son of Kareah.

column.name: text
column.value: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the sons of Ammon.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Johanan the son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces that were with him took from Mizpah all the remnant of the people whom he had ①recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, after he had struck and killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, that is, the men who were ②soldiers, the women, the ③children, and the high officials, whom he had brought back from Gibeon. ▷ ①Lit brought back ②Lit men of war ③Lit infants

column.name: text
column.value: And they went and stayed in ①Geruth Chimham, which is beside Bethlehem, in order to proceed into Egypt ▷ ①Or the lodging place of Chimham

column.name: text
column.value: because of the Chaldeans; for they were afraid of them, since Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had struck and killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon had appointed over the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the commanders of the forces, Johanan the son of Kareah, Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the small to the great approached

column.name: text
column.value: and said to Jeremiah the prophet, “Please let our pleading ①come before you, and pray for us to the LORD your God for all this remnant—since we have been left only a few out of many, just as your own eyes now see us— ▷ ①Lit fall

column.name: text
column.value: that the LORD your God will tell us the way in which we should walk, and the thing that we should do.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeremiah the prophet said to them, “I have heard you. Behold, I am going to pray to the LORD your God in accordance with your words; and I will tell you the whole ①message which the LORD gives you as an answer. I will not withhold a word from you.” ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: Then they said to Jeremiah, “May the LORD be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not act in accordance with the whole ①message with which the LORD your God will send you to us. ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: Whether it is ①pleasant or ②unpleasant, we will listen to the voice of the LORD our God to whom we are sending you, so that it may go well for us when we listen to the voice of the LORD our God.” ▷ ①Lit good ②Lit evil

column.name: text
column.value: Now at the end of ten days the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he called for Johanan the son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces that were with him, and for all the people from the small to the great,

column.name: text
column.value: and said to them, “This is what the LORD says, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your plea before Him:

column.name: text
column.value: ‘If you will indeed stay in this land, then I will build you up and not tear you down, and I will plant you and not uproot you; for I ①will relent of the disaster that I have inflicted on you. ▷ ①Or shall have changed my mind about

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon, whom you are now fearing; do not be afraid of him,’ declares the LORD, ‘for I am with you to save you and rescue you from his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also show you compassion, so that he will have compassion on you and restore you to your own soil.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you are going to say, “We will not stay in this land,” so as not to listen to the voice of the LORD your God,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “No, but we will go to the land of Egypt, where we will not see war, or hear the sound of a trumpet, or hunger for bread, and we will stay there”;

column.name: text
column.value: then ①in that case listen to the word of the LORD, you remnant of Judah. This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: “If you really set your ②minds to enter Egypt and go in to reside there, ▷ ①Lit now therefore ②Lit face

column.name: text
column.value: then the sword, of which you are afraid, will overtake you there in the land of Egypt; and the famine, about which you are anxious, will follow closely after you there in Egypt, and you will die there.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the people who set their ①minds to go to Egypt to reside there will die by the sword, by famine, or by plague; and they will have no refugees or survivors from the disaster that I am going to bring on them.” ’ ” ▷ ①Lit face

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: “As My anger and wrath have gushed out on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so My wrath will gush out on you when you enter Egypt. And you will become a curse, an object of horror, ①an imprecation, and a disgrace; and you will not see this place again.” ▷ ①Lit a curse-formula

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has spoken to you, you remnant of Judah, “Do not go to Egypt!” You know for certain that I have admonished you today.

column.name: text
column.value: For you have only ①deceived yourselves; for it is you who sent me to the LORD your God, saying, “Pray for us to the LORD our God; and whatever the LORD our God says, tell us so, and we will do it.” ▷ ①Or acted errantly in your souls

column.name: text
column.value: So I have told you today, but you have not ①obeyed the LORD your God in whatever He has sent me to tell you. ▷ ①Lit listened to the voice of

column.name: text
column.value: And now you shall know for certain that you will die by the sword, by famine, or by plague in the place where you desire to go to reside.

column.name: text
column.value: The word that came to Jeremiah for all the Jews living in the land of Egypt, those who were living in Migdol, Tahpanhes, Memphis, and the land of Pathros, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘You yourselves have seen all the disaster that I have brought on Jerusalem and all the cities of Judah; and behold, this day they are in ruins and no one lives in them,

column.name: text
column.value: because of their wickedness which they committed to provoke Me to anger by continuing to burn ①sacrifices and to serve other gods whom they had not known, neither they, you, nor your fathers. ▷ ①Or incense

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I sent you all My servants the prophets again and again, saying, “Oh, do not do this abominable thing which I hate.”

column.name: text
column.value: But they did not listen or incline their ears to turn from their wickedness, so as not to burn ①sacrifices to other gods. ▷ ①Or incense

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore My wrath and My anger gushed out and burned in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, so they have become ruins and a desolation as it is this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, this is what the LORD God of armies, the God of Israel says: “Why are you doing great harm to yourselves, to eliminate from yourselves man and woman, child and infant from among Judah, leaving yourselves without a remnant,

column.name: text
column.value: provoking Me to anger with the works of your hands, burning ①sacrifices to other gods in the land of Egypt where you are entering to reside, so that you may be eliminated and become a curse and a disgrace among all the nations of the earth? ▷ ①Or incense

column.name: text
column.value: Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, the wickedness of the kings of Judah and the wickedness of their wives, your own wickedness and the wickedness of your wives, which they committed in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they have not become ①contrite even to this day, nor have they feared, nor walked in My Law or My statutes, which I placed before you and before your fathers.” ’ ▷ ①Lit crushed

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore this is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘Behold, I am going to set My face against you for a disaster, even to eliminate all Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will take away the remnant of Judah who have set their ①minds on entering the land of Egypt to reside there, and they will all ②meet their end in the land of Egypt; they will fall by the sword or meet their end by famine. From the small to the great, they will die by the sword and famine; and they will become a curse, an object of horror, ③an imprecation, and a disgrace. ▷ ①Lit faces ②Lit be finished ③Lit a curse-formula

column.name: text
column.value: And I will punish those who live in the land of Egypt, just as I have punished Jerusalem, with the sword, with famine, and with plague.

column.name: text
column.value: So there will be no survivor or refugee for the remnant of Judah who have entered the land of Egypt to reside there and then to return to the land of Judah, to which they are ①longing to return to live; for none will return except a few refugees.’ ” ▷ ①Lit lifting up their soul

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the men who were aware that their wives were burning ①sacrifices to other gods, along with all the women who were standing by, as a large assembly, ②including all the people who were living in Pathros in the land of Egypt, responded to Jeremiah, saying, ▷ ①Or incense ②Lit and

column.name: text
column.value: “As for the ①message that you have spoken to us in the name of the LORD, we are not going to listen to you! ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: But we will certainly carry out every word that has proceeded from our mouths, ①by burning ②sacrifices to the queen of heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, just as we ourselves, our forefathers, our kings, and our leaders did in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; for then we had plenty of ③food and were well off and saw no ④misfortune. ▷ ①Or so as to burn ②Or incense ③Lit bread ④Lit evil

column.name: text
column.value: But since we stopped burning ①sacrifices to the queen of heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have lacked everything, and have met our end by the sword and by famine.” ▷ ①Or incense

column.name: text
column.value: “And,” said the women, “when we were burning ①sacrifices to the queen of heaven and ②pouring out drink offerings to her, was it without our husbands that we made for her sacrificial cakes ③in her image, and poured out drink offerings to her?” ▷ ①Or incense ②Lit to pour ③Lit to make an image of her

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, to the men and women—even to all the people who were giving him such an answer—saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “As for the ①smoking sacrifices that you burned in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, you and your forefathers, your kings and your leaders, and the people of the land, did the LORD not remember them, and did all of this not come into His ②mind? ▷ ①Or incense ②Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD was no longer able to endure it, because of the evil of your deeds, because of the abominations which you have committed; so your land has become a place of ruins, an object of horror, and a curse, without an inhabitant, as it is this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Since you have burned ①sacrifices and have sinned against the LORD and not obeyed the voice of the LORD nor walked in His Law, His statutes, or His testimonies, therefore this disaster has happened to you, as it has this day.” ▷ ①Or incense

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, including all the women, “Hear the word of the LORD, all Judah who are in the land of Egypt!

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel ①says: ‘As for you and your wives, you have spoken with your mouths and fulfilled it with your hands, saying, “We will certainly perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn ②sacrifices to the queen of heaven and pour out drink offerings to her.” By all means fulfill your vows, and be sure to perform your vows!’ ▷ ①Lit says, saying ②Or incense

column.name: text
column.value: ①In return, hear the word of the LORD, all Judah who are living in the land of Egypt: ‘Behold, I have sworn by My great name,’ says the LORD, ‘that My name shall never be invoked again by the mouth of anyone of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, “As the Lord ②GOD lives.” ▷ ①Lit Therefore ②Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I am watching over them for harm and not for good, and all the people of Judah who are in the land of Egypt will ①meet their end by the sword or by famine until they ②are completely gone. ▷ ①Lit be finished ②Lit come to an end

column.name: text
column.value: Those who escape the sword will return from the land of Egypt to the land of Judah ①few in number. Then all the remnant of Judah who have gone to the land of Egypt to reside there will know whose word will stand, Mine or theirs. ▷ ①Lit men of number

column.name: text
column.value: And this will be the sign to you,’ declares the LORD, ‘that I am going to punish you in this place, so that you may know that My words will assuredly stand against you for harm.’

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I am going to hand Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt over to his enemies, to those who seek his life, just as I handed Zedekiah king of Judah over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who was his enemy and was seeking his life.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: But as soon as Jeremiah, whom the LORD their God had sent to them, had finished telling all the people all the words of the LORD their God—that is, all these words—

column.name: text
column.value: Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the arrogant men said to Jeremiah, “You are telling a lie! The LORD our God has not sent you to say, ‘You are not to enter Egypt to reside there’;

column.name: text
column.value: but Baruch the son of Neriah is inciting you against us in order to hand us over to the Chaldeans, so they will put us to death or exile us to Babylon!”

column.name: text
column.value: So Johanan the son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces, and all the people, did not obey the voice of the LORD to stay in the land of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, Johanan the son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces took the entire remnant of Judah who had returned from all the nations to which they had been scattered, in order to reside in the land of Judah—

column.name: text
column.value: the men, the women, the ①children, the king’s daughters, and every person whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam ②and grandson of Shaphan, together with Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch the son of Neriah— ▷ ①Lit infants ②Lit the son

column.name: text
column.value: and they entered the land of Egypt (for they did not obey the voice of the LORD) and went in as far as Tahpanhes.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Take some large stones in your ①hands and hide them in the ②mortar in the brick terrace which is at the entrance of Pharaoh’s ③palace in Tahpanhes, in the sight of ④some of the Jews; ▷ ①Lit hand ②Or clay floor ③Lit house ④Lit men

column.name: text
column.value: and say to them, ‘This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: “Behold, I am going to send men and get My servant Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and I am going to set his throne over these stones that I have hidden; and he will spread his ①canopy over them. ▷ ①Or carpet

column.name: text
column.value: He will also come and strike the land of Egypt; those who are meant for death will be given over to death, and those for captivity to captivity, and those for the sword to the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: And ①I shall set fire to the temples of the gods of Egypt, and he will burn them and take them captive. So he will ②wrap himself with the land of Egypt as a shepherd ③wraps himself with his garment, and he will depart from there safely. ▷ ①Some ancient versions He will set ②Or delouse the land ③Or delouses his garment

column.name: text
column.value: He will also smash to pieces the ①obelisks of ②Heliopolis, which is in the land of Egypt; and the temples of the gods of Egypt he will burn with fire.” ’ ” ▷ ①Or stone pillars ②Heb Beth-shemesh; i.e., the house of the sun-god

column.name: text
column.value: This is the message which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch the son of Neriah, when he had written these words in a book ①at Jeremiah’s dictation, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying: ▷ ①Lit from the mouth of Jeremiah

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel says to you, Baruch:

column.name: text
column.value: ‘You said, “Oh, woe to me! For the LORD has added grief to my pain; I am weary with my groaning and have found no rest.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: This is what you are to say to him: ‘This is what the LORD says: “Behold, what I have built I am going to tear down, and what I have planted I am going to uproot, that is, all the people of the land.”

column.name: text
column.value: But as for you, are you seeking great things for yourself? Do not seek them; for behold, I am going to bring disaster on all flesh,’ declares the LORD, ‘but I will give your life to you as plunder in all the places where you may go.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: That which came as the word of the LORD to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: To Egypt, concerning the army of Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates at Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon defeated in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah:

column.name: text
column.value: “Set up the ①buckler and shield, And advance to the battle! ▷ ①I.e., small shield

column.name: text
column.value: Harness the horses, And ①mount the steeds, Take your stand with helmets on! Polish the spears, Put on the coats of armor! ▷ ①Or go up, you horsemen

column.name: text
column.value: Why have I seen it? They are terrified, They are retreating, And their warriors are defeated And have taken refuge in flight, Without facing back. ①Terror is on every side!” Declares the LORD. ▷ ①Heb Magor-missabib i.e., Terror is on every side

column.name: text
column.value: Let not the swift man flee, Nor the warrior escape. In the north beside the river Euphrates They have stumbled and fallen.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is this that rises like the Nile, Like the rivers whose waters surge?

column.name: text
text
column.value: Go up, you horses, and ①drive wildly, you chariots, So that the warriors may ②march forward: ③Cush and ④Put, who handle the shield, And the ⑤Lydians, who handle and bend the bow. ▷ ①Lit act like madmen ②Lit go forth ③Or Ethiopia ④I.e., Libya (or Somaliland) ⑤Heb Ludim

column.name: text
column.value: For that day belongs to the Lord ①GOD of armies, A day of vengeance, so as to avenge Himself on His foes; And the sword will devour and be satisfied, And ②drink its fill of their blood; For there will be a slaughter for the Lord ③GOD of armies, In the land of the north at the river Euphrates. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD ②Lit be saturated with ③Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Go up to Gilead and obtain balm, Virgin daughter of Egypt! You have used many ①remedies in vain; There is no healing for you. ▷ ①Lit healings

column.name: text
column.value: The nations have heard of your shame, And the earth is full of your cry of distress; For one warrior has stumbled over ①another, And both of them have fallen down together. ▷ ①Lit warrior

column.name: text
column.value: This is the ①message which the LORD spoke to Jeremiah the prophet about the coming of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to strike the land of Egypt: ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: “Declare in Egypt and proclaim in Migdol, Proclaim also in Memphis and Tahpanhes; Say, ‘Take your stand and get yourself ready, For the sword has devoured those around you.’

column.name: text
column.value: Why have your powerful ones been cut down? They do not stand because the LORD has thrust them away.

column.name: text
column.value: They have repeatedly stumbled; Indeed, they have fallen, one against another. Then they said, ‘Get up, and let’s go back To our own people and our native land, Away from the ①sword of the oppressor!’ ▷ ①Lit oppressing sword

column.name: text
text
column.value: As I live,” declares the King, Whose name is the LORD of armies, “One certainly shall come who is like Tabor among the mountains, Or like Carmel by the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: Make your baggage ready for exile, Daughter living in Egypt, For Memphis will become a desolation; It will be destroyed and ①deprived of inhabitants. ▷ ①Lit without

column.name: text
column.value: Egypt is a pretty heifer, But a ①horsefly is coming from the north—it is coming! ▷ ①Or possibly mosquito

column.name: text
column.value: Also her mercenaries in her midst Are like fattened calves, For they too have turned away and have fled together; They did not stand their ground. For the day of their disaster has come upon them, The time of their punishment.

column.name: text
column.value: Its sound moves along like a serpent; For they move on ①like an army And come to her as woodcutters with axes. ▷ ①Or in force

column.name: text
column.value: They have cut down her forest,” declares the LORD; “Certainly it will no longer be found, Even though ①they are more numerous than locusts And are without number. ▷ ①I.e., trees of the forest, the Egyptians

column.name: text
column.value: The daughter of Egypt has been put to shame, Turned over to the ①power of the people of the north.” ▷ ①Lit hand

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: “Behold, I am going to punish Amon of Thebes, and Pharaoh, and Egypt along with her gods and her kings, indeed, Pharaoh and those who trust in him.

column.name: text
column.value: I shall hand them over to those who are seeking their lives, that is, to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and to his ①officers. Afterward, however, it will be inhabited as in the days of old,” declares the LORD. ▷ ①Lit servants

column.name: text
column.value: “But as for you, Jacob My servant, do not fear, Nor be dismayed, Israel! For, see, I am going to save you from far away, And your descendants from the land of their captivity; And Jacob will return and be undisturbed And secure, with no one making him afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: Jacob My servant, do not fear,” declares the LORD, “For I am with you. For I will make a complete destruction of all the nations Where I have driven you, Yet I will not make a complete destruction of you; But I will correct you properly And by no means leave you unpunished.”

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh ①conquered Gaza. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “Behold, waters are going to rise from the north And become an overflowing torrent, And overflow the land and everything that is in it, The city and those who live in it; And the people will cry out, And every inhabitant of the land will wail.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of the noise of the ①galloping hoofs of his ②stallions, The roar of his chariots, and the rumbling of his wheels, The fathers have not turned back for their children, Because of the debility of their hands, ▷ ①Lit stamping of the ②Lit mighty ones

column.name: text
column.value: Because of the day that is coming To destroy all the Philistines, To eliminate from Tyre and Sidon Every surviving ally; For the LORD is going to destroy the Philistines, The remnant of the coastland of Caphtor.

column.name: text
column.value: Baldness has come upon Gaza; Ashkelon has been destroyed. Remnant of their valley, How long will you gash yourself?

column.name: text
column.value: Ah, sword of the LORD, How long will you not be quiet? Withdraw into your sheath; Rest and stay still.

column.name: text
column.value: How can ①it be quiet, When the LORD has given it an order? Against Ashkelon and against the sea shore— There He has summoned it.” ▷ ①Lit you

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: The sound of an outcry from Horonaim, ‘Devastation and great destruction!’

column.name: text
column.value: Moab is broken, Her little ones have sounded out a cry of distress.

column.name: text
column.value: For they will go up by the ascent of Luhith With continual weeping; For at the descent of Horonaim They have heard the ①anguished cry of destruction. ▷ ①Lit distresses of outcry

column.name: text
column.value: Flee, save yourselves, So that you may be like a juniper in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: For because of your trust in your own achievements and treasures, You yourself will also be captured; And Chemosh will go off into exile Together with his priests and his leaders.

column.name: text
column.value: A destroyer will come to every city, So that no city will escape; The valley also will be ruined And the plateau will be destroyed, As the LORD has said.

column.name: text
column.value: Give ①wings to Moab, For she will ②flee away; And her cities will become a desolation, Without inhabitants in them. ▷ ①Or salt ②Or fall in ruins

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed is the one who does the LORD’S work negligently, And cursed is the one who restrains his sword from blood.

column.name: text
column.value: “Moab has been at ease since his youth; He has also been peaceful, like wine on ①its dregs, And he has not been poured from vessel to vessel, Nor has he gone into exile. Therefore ②he retains his flavor, And his aroma has not changed. ▷ ①Lit his ②Lit his flavor has stayed in him

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore behold, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will send to him those who tip vessels, and they will tip him over, and they will pour out his vessels and smash ①his jars. ▷ ①Lit their

column.name: text
column.value: And Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, just as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their confidence.

column.name: text
column.value: How can you say, ‘We are warriors, And men competent for battle’?

column.name: text
column.value: Moab has been destroyed and ①men have gone up to ②his cities; His choicest ③young men have also gone down to the slaughter,” Declares the King, whose name is the LORD of armies. ▷ ①Lit one has ②Lit her ③I.e., warriors

column.name: text
column.value: “The disaster of Moab will soon come, And his catastrophe has hurried quickly.

column.name: text
column.value: Mourn for him, all you who live around him, And all of you who know his name; Say, ‘How the mighty ①scepter has been broken, A staff of splendor!’ ▷ ①Or rod

column.name: text
column.value: Come down from your glory And sit on the parched ground, O daughter living in Dibon, For the destroyer of Moab has come up against you, He has ruined your strongholds.

column.name: text
column.value: Stand by the road and keep watch, You inhabitant of Aroer; Ask him who flees and her who escapes And say, ‘What has happened?’

column.name: text
column.value: Moab has been put to shame, for it has been ①shattered. Wail and cry out; Declare by the Arnon That Moab has been destroyed. ▷ ①Or dismayed

column.name: text
column.value: “Judgment has also come upon the plain, upon Holon, Jahzah, and against Mephaath,

column.name: text
column.value: against Dibon, Nebo, and Beth-diblathaim,

column.name: text
column.value: against Kiriathaim, Beth-gamul, and Beth-meon,

column.name: text
column.value: against Kerioth, Bozrah, and all the cities of the land of Moab, far and near.

column.name: text
column.value: The horn of Moab has been cut off, and his arm broken,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “Make him drunk, for he has ①become arrogant toward the LORD; so Moab will ②vomit, and he also will become a laughingstock. ▷ ①Or magnified himself against ②Lit vomit in his vomit

column.name: text
column.value: Now was Israel not a laughingstock to you? Or was he ①caught among thieves? For whenever you speak about him you shake your head in scorn. ▷ ①Or found

column.name: text
column.value: Leave the cities and live among the rocky cliffs, You inhabitants of Moab, And be like a dove that nests Beyond the mouth of the chasm.

column.name: text
column.value: We have heard of the pride of Moab—he is very proud— Of his haughtiness, his pride, his arrogance, and ①his self-exaltation. ▷ ①Lit elevation of his heart

column.name: text
text
column.value: Therefore I will wail for Moab, For all of Moab I will cry out; ①I will moan for the men of Kir-heres. ▷ ①Another reading is He

column.name: text
column.value: More than the weeping for Jazer I will weep for you, O vine of Sibmah! Your tendrils stretched across the sea, They reached to the sea of Jazer; Upon your summer fruits and your grape harvest The destroyer has fallen.

column.name: text
column.value: So joy and rejoicing are removed From the fruitful field, and from the land of Moab. And I have eliminated the wine from the wine presses; No one will tread them with shouting, The shouting will not be shouts of joy.

column.name: text
column.value: From the outcry at Heshbon to Elealeh, to Jahaz they have ①raised their voice, from Zoar to Horonaim, and to Eglath-shelishiyah; for even the waters of Nimrim will become desolate. ▷ ①Lit given forth

column.name: text
column.value: And I will put an end to Moab,” declares the LORD, “the one who offers sacrifice on the high place and the one who ①burns incense to his gods. ▷ ①Or offers up in smoke

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore My heart makes a sound like flutes for Moab; My heart also makes a sound like flutes for the men of Kir-heres. Therefore they have lost the abundance it produced.

column.name: text
column.value: For every head is shaved bald, and every beard cut short; there are gashes on all the hands, and sackcloth around the waists.

column.name: text
column.value: On all the housetops of Moab and in its public squares ①there is mourning everywhere; for I have broken Moab like an undesirable vessel,” declares the LORD. ▷ ①Lit all of it is mourning

column.name: text
column.value: “How ①shattered it is! How they have wailed! How Moab has turned his back—he is ashamed! So Moab will become a laughingstock and an object of terror to all around him.” ▷ ①Or terrified

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says: “Behold, one will fly swiftly like an eagle And spread out his wings against Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: Kerioth has been captured And the strongholds have been seized, So the hearts of the warriors of Moab on that day Will be like the heart of a woman in labor.

column.name: text
column.value: Moab will be destroyed from being a people Because he has ①become arrogant toward the LORD. ▷ ①Or magnified himself against

column.name: text
column.value: Terror, pit, and snare are coming upon you, Inhabitant of Moab,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “The one who flees from the terror Will fall into the pit, And the one who climbs up out of the pit Will be caught in the snare; For I will bring upon her, upon Moab, The year of their punishment,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “In the shadow of Heshbon The fugitives stand without strength; For a fire has spread out from Heshbon And a flame from the midst of Sihon, And it has devoured the forehead of Moab And the scalps of the ①loud revelers. ▷ ①Lit sons of uproar

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you, Moab! The people of Chemosh have perished; For your sons have been taken away captive, And your daughters into captivity.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I will restore the fortunes of Moab In the ①latter days,” declares the LORD. This is the extent of the judgment on Moab. ▷ ①Lit end of the days

column.name: text
column.value: Concerning the sons of Ammon. This is what the LORD says: “Does Israel have no sons? Or has he no heirs? Why then has ①Malcam taken possession of Gad, And his people settled in its cities? ▷ ①In 1 Kin 11:5, 33 and Zeph 1:5, Milcom

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore behold, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “When I will cause an alarm of war to be heard Against Rabbah of the sons of Ammon; And it will become a desolate heap, And her towns will be set on fire. Then Israel will take possession of his possessors,” Says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “Wail, Heshbon, for Ai has been destroyed! Cry out, daughters of Rabbah, Put on sackcloth and mourn, And move about inside the walls; For ①Malcam will go into exile Together with his priests and his leaders. ▷ ①See note v 1

column.name: text
column.value: How you boast about the valleys! Your valley is flowing away, You backsliding daughter Who trusts in her treasures, saying, ‘Who can come against me?’

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I am going to bring terror upon you,” Declares the Lord ①GOD of armies, “From all directions around you; And you will be driven away ②one after another, With no one to gather the fugitives together. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD ②Lit each one before him

column.name: text
column.value: But afterward I will restore The fortunes of the sons of Ammon,” Declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Concerning Edom. This is what the LORD of armies says: “Is there no longer any wisdom in Teman? Has good advice been lost by the prudent? Has their wisdom decayed?

column.name: text
column.value: Flee away, turn back, dwell in the depths, You inhabitants of Dedan, For I ①will bring the disaster of Esau upon him At the time I ②punish him. ▷ ①Or brought ②Or punished

column.name: text
column.value: If grape pickers came to you, Would they not leave gleanings? If thieves came by night, They would destroy only what was sufficient for them.

column.name: text
column.value: But I have stripped Esau bare, I have uncovered his hiding places So that he will not be able to conceal himself; His ①offspring have been destroyed along with his ②brothers And his neighbors, and he no longer exists. ▷ ①Lit seed ②Or relatives

column.name: text
text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says: “Behold, those ①who were not sentenced to drink the cup will certainly drink it, so are you the one who will be held completely blameless? You will not be held blameless, but you will certainly drink it. ▷ ①Lit whose judgment was not to

column.name: text
column.value: For I have sworn by Myself,” declares the LORD, “that Bozrah will become an object of horror, a disgrace, a wasteland, and a curse; and all its cities will become permanent ruins.”

column.name: text
column.value: I have heard a message from the LORD, And a messenger is being sent among the nations, saying, “Gather yourselves together and come against her, And rise up for battle!”

column.name: text
column.value: “For behold, I have made you small among the nations, Despised among people.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the terror you cause, The arrogance of your heart has deceived you, You who live in the clefts of ①the rock, Who occupy the height of the hill. Though you make your nest as high as an eagle’s, I will bring you down from there,” declares the LORD. ▷ ①Or Sela

column.name: text
column.value: “Edom will become an object of horror; everyone who passes by it will be appalled and will ①hiss at all its wounds. ▷ ①Or whistle

column.name: text
column.value: Like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah with its neighbors,” says the LORD, “no one will live there, nor will ①anyone of mankind reside in it. ▷ ①Lit a son of man

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, one will come up like a lion from the thicket of the Jordan to a perennially watered pasture; for in an instant I will chase him away from it, and I will appoint over it whoever is chosen. For who is like Me, and who will summon Me into court? And who then is the shepherd who can stand against Me?”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore hear the plan of the LORD which He has planned against Edom, and His purposes which He has in mind against the inhabitants of Teman: they will certainly drag them off, even the little ones of the flock; He will certainly make their pasture desolate because of them.

column.name: text
column.value: The earth has quaked at the noise of their downfall. There is an outcry! The noise of it has been heard at the ①Red Sea. ▷ ①Lit Sea of Reeds

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, ①He will mount up and swoop like an eagle, and spread out His wings ②against Bozrah; and the hearts of the warriors of Edom on that day will be like the heart of a woman in labor. ▷ ①Or one ②Or over

column.name: text
column.value: Concerning Damascus: “Hamath and Arpad are put to shame, For they have heard bad news; They despair. There is anxiety at the sea, It cannot be calmed.

column.name: text
text
column.value: How the city of praise has not been deserted, The town of My joy!

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, her young men will fall in her streets, And all the men of war will perish on that day,” declares the LORD of armies.

column.name: text
column.value: “I will set fire to the wall of Damascus, And it will devour the fortified palace of Ben-hadad.”

column.name: text
column.value: Concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon defeated. This is what the LORD says: “Arise, go up to Kedar And devastate the ①people of the east. ▷ ①Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: They will take away their tents and their flocks; They will carry off for themselves Their tent curtains, all their goods and their camels, And they will call out to one another, ‘Horror on every side!’

column.name: text
column.value: Run away, flee! Dwell in the depths, You inhabitants of Hazor,” declares the LORD; “For Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has formed a plan against you And devised a scheme against you.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, go up against a nation which is at ease, Which lives securely,” declares the LORD. “It has no gates or bars; They dwell alone.

column.name: text
column.value: Their camels will become plunder, And their many livestock for spoils, And I will scatter to all the winds those who cut the corners of their hair; And I will bring their disaster from every side,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “Hazor will become a haunt of jackals, A desolation forever; No one will live there, Nor will ①anyone of mankind reside in it.” ▷ ①Lit a son of man

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, at the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying:

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD of armies says: ‘Behold, I am going to break the bow of Elam, The ①finest of their might. ▷ ①Lit first

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring upon Elam the four winds From the four ends of heaven, And will scatter them to all these winds; And there will be no nation To which the outcasts of Elam will not go.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will ①shatter Elam before their enemies And before those who seek their lives; And I will bring disaster upon them, Even My fierce anger,’ declares the LORD, ‘And I will send the sword after them Until I have consumed them. ▷ ①Or dismay

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will set My throne in Elam, And eliminate from there the king and officials,’ Declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘But it will come about in the last days That I will restore the fortunes of Elam,’ ” Declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The word which the LORD spoke concerning Babylon, the land of the Chaldeans, through Jeremiah the prophet:

column.name: text
column.value: “Declare and proclaim among the nations. Proclaim it and lift up a flag, Do not conceal it. Say, ‘Babylon has been captured, Bel has been put to shame, ①Marduk has been ②shattered; Her idols have been put to shame, her images have been shattered.’ ▷ ①Heb Merodach ②Or dismayed

column.name: text
column.value: For a nation has come up against her from the north; it will make her land an object of horror, and there will be no inhabitant in it. Whether people or animals, they have wandered off, they have gone!

column.name: text
column.value: “In those days and at that time,” declares the LORD, “the sons of Israel will come, they and the sons of Judah as well; they will go along weeping as they go, and it will be the LORD their God whom they will seek.

column.name: text
column.value: They will ask for the way to Zion, turning their faces ①in its direction; ②they ③will come so that they may join themselves to the LORD in an everlasting covenant that will not be forgotten. ▷ ①Lit toward here ②MT come, that ③Or will have come

column.name: text
column.value: “My people have become lost sheep; Their shepherds have led them astray. They have made them turn aside on the mountains. They have gone from mountain to hill, They have forgotten their resting place.

column.name: text
column.value: All who found them have devoured them; And their adversaries have said, ‘We are not guilty, Since they have sinned against the LORD who is the habitation of righteousness, The LORD, the hope of their fathers.’

column.name: text
column.value: “Wander away from the midst of Babylon And ①go out from the land of the Chaldeans; Be like male goats ②at the head of the flock. ▷ ①Another reading is let them go out ②Or in front of

column.name: text
column.value: For behold, I am going to rouse and bring up against Babylon A contingent of great nations from the land of the north, And they will draw up their battle lines against her; From there she will be taken captive. Their arrows will be like ①an expert warrior Who does not return empty-handed. ▷ ①As in some mss and ancient versions; MT a warrior who makes childless

column.name: text
text
column.value: “Because you are glad, because you are jubilant, You who pillage My heritage, Because you skip about ①like a threshing heifer And neigh like ②stallions, ▷ ①Another reading is in the grass ②Lit mighty ones

column.name: text
column.value: Your mother ①will be greatly ashamed, She who gave you birth ②will be humiliated. Behold, she will be the least of the nations, A wilderness, a dry land and a desert. ▷ ①Or has become ②Or has become

column.name: text
column.value: Because of the wrath of the LORD she will not be inhabited, But she will be completely desolate; Everyone who passes by Babylon will be horrified And will hiss because of all her wounds.

column.name: text
column.value: Draw up your battle lines against Babylon on every side, All of you who ①bend the bow; Shoot at her, do not spare your arrows, For she has sinned against the LORD. ▷ ①Lit step on (in order to string)

column.name: text
column.value: Raise your battle cry against her on every side! She has given ①herself up, her towers have fallen, Her walls have been torn down. For this is the vengeance of the LORD: Take vengeance on her; As she has done to others, so do to her. ▷ ①Lit her hand

column.name: text
column.value: Eliminate the sower from Babylon And the one who wields the sickle at the time of harvest; From ①the sword of the oppressor Each of them will turn back to his own people And each of them will flee to his own land. ▷ ①Or the oppressing sword

column.name: text
column.value: “Israel is a scattered ①flock, the lions have driven them away. The first one who devoured him was the king of Assyria, and this last one who has gnawed his bones is Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. ▷ ①Lit sheep

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘Behold, I am going to punish the king of Babylon and his land, just as I punished the king of Assyria.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring Israel back to his pasture and he will graze on Carmel and Bashan, and his ①desire will be satisfied in the hill country of Ephraim and Gilead. ▷ ①Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: In those days and at that time,’ declares the LORD, ‘search will be made for the wrongdoing of Israel, but there will be none; and for the sins of Judah, but they will not be found; for I will forgive those whom I leave as a remnant.’

column.name: text
column.value: “Against the land of ①Merathaim, go up against it, And against the inhabitants of ②Pekod. Kill and ③completely destroy them,” declares the LORD, “And do according to everything that I have commanded you. ▷ ①Or double rebellion ②I.e., punishment (uncertain) ③Lit put under the ban

column.name: text
column.value: The noise of battle is in the land, And great destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: How the hammer of the whole earth Has been cut off and broken! How Babylon has become An object of horror among the nations!

column.name: text
column.value: I set a trap for you and you were also caught, Babylon, While you yourself were not aware; You have been found and also seized Because you have engaged in conflict with the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has opened His armory And has brought out the weapons of His indignation, For it is a work of the Lord ①GOD of armies In the land of the Chaldeans. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Come to her from the ①farthest border; Open up her barns, Pile her up like heaps of grain And ②completely destroy her, Let nothing be left to her. ▷ ①Lit end ②Lit put under the ban

column.name: text
column.value: Put all her bulls to the sword; Let them go down to the slaughter! Woe be upon them, for their day has come, The time of their punishment.

column.name: text
column.value: There is a sound of fugitives and refugees from the land of Babylon, To declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, Vengeance for His temple.

column.name: text
column.value: “Summon ①many against Babylon, All those who ②bend the bow: Encamp against her on every side, Let there be no escape ③. Repay her according to her work; According to all that she has done, so do to her; For she has become arrogant against the LORD, Against the Holy One of Israel. ▷ ①Another reading is archers ②Lit step on (in order to string) ③Some mss add to her

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets, And all her men of war will perish on that day,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, I am against you, ①arrogant one,” Declares the Lord ②GOD of armies, “For your day has come, The time ③when I will punish you. ▷ ①Lit arrogance ②Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD ③Another reading is of your punishment

column.name: text
column.value: The ①arrogant one will stumble and fall With no one to raise him up; And I will set fire to his cities, And it will devour all his surroundings.” ▷ ①Lit arrogance

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD of armies says: “The sons of Israel are oppressed, And the sons of Judah as well; And all who took them captive have held them firmly, They have refused to let them go.

column.name: text
column.value: Their Redeemer is strong, the LORD of armies is His name; He will vigorously plead their case So that He may bring rest to their land, But turmoil to the inhabitants of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: A sword against the Chaldeans,” declares the LORD, “And against the inhabitants of Babylon And against her leaders and her wise men!

column.name: text
column.value: A sword against the oracle priests, and they will become fools! A sword against her warriors, and they will be ①shattered! ▷ ①Or filled with terror

column.name: text
column.value: A sword against ①their horses, against ②their chariots, And against all the ③foreigners who are in the midst of her, And they will become women! A sword against her treasures, and they will be plundered! ▷ ①Lit his ②Lit his ③Lit mixed multitude

column.name: text
column.value: A ①drought on her waters, and they will be dried up! For it is a land of idols, And they go insane at frightful images. ▷ ①Another reading is sword

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore the desert creatures will live there with the jackals; The ostriches also will live in it. It will never again be inhabited Nor lived in from generation to generation.

column.name: text
column.value: As when God overthrew Sodom And Gomorrah with its neighbors,” declares the LORD, “No one will live there, Nor will ①anyone of mankind reside in it. ▷ ①Lit a son of man

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, a people is coming from the north, And a great nation and many kings Will be roused from the remote parts of the earth.

column.name: text
text
column.value: The king of Babylon has heard the report about them, And his hands hang limp; Distress has gripped him, Agony like a woman in childbirth.

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, one will come up like a lion from the thicket of the Jordan to a perennially watered pasture; for in an instant I will chase them away from it, and I will appoint over it whoever is chosen. For who is like Me, and who will summon Me into court? And who then is the shepherd who can stand against Me?”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore hear the plan of the LORD which He has planned against Babylon, and His purposes which He has in mind against the land of the Chaldeans: they will certainly drag them off, even the little ones of the flock; He will certainly make their pasture desolate because of them.

column.name: text
column.value: At the ①shout, “Babylon has been conquered!” the earth quakes, and an outcry is heard among the nations. ▷ ①Lit voice

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “Behold, I am going to stir up ①The spirit of a destroyer against Babylon And against the inhabitants of ②Leb-kamai. ▷ ①Or a destroying wind ②Cryptic name for Chaldea; or the heart of those who rise up against Me

column.name: text
column.value: I will send ①foreigners to Babylon so that they may winnow her And devastate her land; For they will be opposed to her on every side On the day of her disaster. ▷ ①Some ancient versions winnowers

column.name: text
column.value: Let not ①him who ②bends his bow ③bend it, Nor let him rise up in his coat of armor. Do not spare her young men; Devote all her army to destruction. ▷ ①I.e., the Chaldean defender ②Lit step(s) on; MT in order to string ③Lit step(s) on; MT in order to string

column.name: text
column.value: They will fall down ①dead in the land of the Chaldeans, And pierced through in their streets.” ▷ ①Lit killed; or wounded

column.name: text
column.value: For neither Israel nor Judah has been ①forsaken By his God, the LORD of armies, Although their land is full of guilt ②Before the Holy One of Israel. ▷ ①Lit widowed ②Lit From

column.name: text
column.value: Flee from the midst of Babylon, And each of you save his life! Do not perish in her ①punishment, For this is the LORD’S time of vengeance; He is going to repay to her what she deserves. ▷ ①Or penalty for wrongdoing

column.name: text
column.value: Babylon has been a golden cup in the hand of the LORD, Intoxicating all the earth. The nations have drunk of her wine; Therefore the nations are going insane.

column.name: text
text
column.value: We applied healing to Babylon, but she was not healed; Abandon her and let’s each go to his own country, For her judgment has reached to heaven And it rises to the clouds.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has brought ①about our vindication; Come and let’s recount in Zion The work of the LORD our God! ▷ ①Lit forth

column.name: text
column.value: Sharpen the arrows, fill the quivers! The LORD has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes, Because His plan is against Babylon to destroy it; For it is the vengeance of the LORD, vengeance for His temple.

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up a signal flag against the walls of Babylon; Post a strong guard, Station ①sentries, Set up an ambush! For the LORD has both planned and performed What He spoke concerning the inhabitants of Babylon. ▷ ①Or watchmen

column.name: text
column.value: You who live by many waters, Abundant in treasures, Your end has come, The ①measure of your ②end. ▷ ①Lit cubit ②Lit being cut off

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD of armies has sworn by Himself: “I will certainly fill you with a ①population like locusts, And they will cry out with shouts of victory over you.” ▷ ①Or mankind

column.name: text
column.value: It is He who made the earth by His power, Who established the world by His wisdom, And by His understanding He stretched out the heavens.

column.name: text
column.value: When He utters His voice, there is a roar of waters in the heavens, And He makes the clouds ascend from the end of the earth. He makes lightning for the rain And brings out wind from His storehouses.

column.name: text
column.value: Every person is stupid, devoid of knowledge; Every goldsmith is put to shame by his ①idols, For his cast metal images are deceitful, And there is no breath in them. ▷ ①Or images

column.name: text
column.value: They are worthless, a work of mockery; At the time of their punishment they will perish.

column.name: text
text
column.value: He says, “You are My ①war-club, My weapon of war; And with you I shatter nations, And with you I destroy kingdoms. ▷ ①Lit shatterer

column.name: text
column.value: With you I shatter the horse and his rider, And with you I shatter the chariot and its rider,

column.name: text
column.value: And with you I shatter man and woman, And with you I shatter the old man and youth, And with you I shatter the young man and virgin,

column.name: text
column.value: And with you I shatter the shepherd and his flock, And with you I shatter the farmer and his team, And with you I shatter governors and officials.

column.name: text
column.value: “But I will repay Babylon and all the inhabitants of Chaldea for all their evil that they have done in Zion before your eyes,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, I am against you, mountain of destruction That destroys the whole earth,” declares the LORD, “And I will stretch out My hand against you, And roll you down from the rocky cliffs, And I will make you a burnt out mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: They will not take from you even a stone for a corner Nor a stone for foundations, But you will be desolate forever,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up a signal flag in the land, Blow a trumpet among the nations! Consecrate the nations against her, Summon against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz; Appoint an officer against her, Bring up the horses like bristly locusts.

column.name: text
column.value: Consecrate the nations against her, The kings of the Medes, ①Their governors and all ②their officials, And every land ③under their control. ▷ ①Lit her ②Lit her ③Lit of his dominion

column.name: text
column.value: So the land quakes and writhes, For the plans of the LORD against Babylon stand, To make the land of Babylon ①A desolation without inhabitants. ▷ ①Or An object of horror

column.name: text
column.value: The warriors of Babylon have ceased fighting, They stay in the strongholds; Their strength is ①exhausted, They are becoming like women; Their homes are set on fire, The bars of her gates are broken. ▷ ①Lit dried up

column.name: text
column.value: One ①courier runs to meet ②another, And one ③messenger to meet ④another, To tell the king of Babylon That his city has been captured from end to end; ▷ ①Lit runner ②Lit runner ③Lit announcer ④Lit announcer

column.name: text
column.value: The river crossing places have been seized, And they have burned the marshes with fire, And the men of war are terrified.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel says: “The daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor At the time that ①it is tread down; In just a little while the time of harvest will come for her.” ▷ ①Lit of treading it

column.name: text
text
column.value: May the violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon,” The ①inhabitant of Zion will say; And, “May my blood be upon the inhabitants of Chaldea,” Jerusalem will say. ▷ ①Lit inhabitress

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD says: “Behold, I am going to plead your case And take vengeance for you; And I will dry up her ①sea And make her fountain dry. ▷ ①Or broad river

column.name: text
column.value: Babylon will become a heap of ruins, a haunt of jackals, An object of horror and hissing, without inhabitants.

column.name: text
column.value: They will roar together like young lions, They will growl like lions’ cubs.

column.name: text
column.value: When they become heated up, I will serve them their banquet And make them drunk, so that they may rejoice in triumph, And may sleep a perpetual sleep And not wake up,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “I will bring them down like ①lambs to the slaughter, Like rams together with male goats. ▷ ①Or young rams

column.name: text
column.value: “How ①Sheshak has been captured, And the praise of the whole earth has been seized! How Babylon has become an object of horror among the nations! ▷ ①Cryptic name for Babylon

column.name: text
text
column.value: Her cities have become an object of horror, A dry land and a desert, A land in which no one lives And through which no ①one of mankind passes. ▷ ①Lit son of man

column.name: text
column.value: I will punish Bel in Babylon, And I will make what he has swallowed come out of his mouth; And the nations will no longer stream toward him. Even the wall of Babylon has fallen down!

column.name: text
column.value: “Come out from her midst, My people, And each of you save yourselves From the fierce anger of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Now, so that your heart does not grow faint, And you are not afraid at the report that will be heard in the land— For the report will come in ①one year, And after that ②another report in ③another year, And violence will be in the land With ruler against ruler— ▷ ①Lit the ②Lit the ③Lit the

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore behold, days are coming When I will punish the idols of Babylon; And her whole land will be put to shame. And all her slain will fall in her midst.

column.name: text
column.value: Then heaven and earth and everything that is in them Will shout for joy over Babylon, Because the destroyers will come to her from the north,” Declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, Babylon is to fall for the slain of Israel, As the slain of all the earth have also fallen for Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: You who have escaped the sword, Go! Do not stay! Remember the LORD from far away, And let Jerusalem ①come to your mind. ▷ ①Lit come upon your heart

column.name: text
column.value: We are ashamed because we have heard rebuke; Disgrace has covered our faces, Because strangers have entered The holy places of the LORD’S house.

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore behold, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “When I will punish her idols, And the mortally wounded will groan throughout her land.

column.name: text
column.value: Though Babylon ascends to the heavens, And though she fortifies ①her lofty stronghold, Destroyers will come from Me to her,” declares the LORD. ▷ ①Lit the height of her strength

column.name: text
column.value: The sound of an outcry from Babylon, And of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans!

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD is going to destroy Babylon, And He will make her loud ①noise vanish from her. And their waves will roar like many waters; The clamor of their voices ②sounds forth. ▷ ①Or voice ②Lit is given

column.name: text
column.value: For the destroyer is coming against her, against Babylon, And her warriors will be captured, Their bows shattered; For the LORD is a God of retribution, He will fully repay.

column.name: text
column.value: “I will make her leaders and her wise men drunk, Her governors, her officials, and her warriors, So that they will sleep a perpetual sleep and not wake up,” Declares the King, whose name is the LORD of armies.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD of armies says: “The broad wall of Babylon will be completely demolished, And her high gates will be set on fire; So the peoples will labor for nothing, And the nations become exhausted only for fire.”

column.name: text
column.value: The ①command that Jeremiah the prophet ②gave Seraiah the son of Neriah, the grandson of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. (And Seraiah was quartermaster.) ▷ ①Lit word ②Lit commanded

column.name: text
column.value: Jeremiah wrote ①on a single scroll all the disaster which would come against Babylon, that is, all these words which have been written concerning Babylon. ▷ ①Or in...book

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeremiah said to Seraiah, “As soon as you come to Babylon, see that you read all these words aloud,

column.name: text
column.value: and say, ‘You, LORD, have ①promised concerning this place to cut it off, so that there will be nothing living in it, ②whether man or animal; but it will be a permanent desolation.’ ▷ ①Lit spoken ②Lit from man even to beast

column.name: text
column.value: And as soon as you finish reading this ①scroll, you shall tie a stone to it and throw it into the middle of the Euphrates, ▷ ①Or book

column.name: text
column.value: and say, ‘Just so shall Babylon sink down and not rise again, because of the disaster that I am going to bring upon her; and they will become exhausted.’ ” To this point are the words of Jeremiah.

column.name: text
column.value: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned for eleven years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was ①Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah. ▷ ①Another reading is Hamital

column.name: text
column.value: He did evil in the sight of the LORD, in accordance with everything that Jehoiakim had done.

column.name: text
column.value: For because of the anger of the LORD this came about in Jerusalem and Judah, until He drove them out from His presence. And Zedekiah revolted against the king of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about in the ninth year of his reign, on the tenth day of the tenth month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, camped against it, and built a ①bulwark all around ②it. ▷ ①I.e., a defensive wall ②Lit against it

column.name: text
column.value: So the city was under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

column.name: text
column.value: On the ninth day of the fourth month the famine was so severe in the city that there was no food for the people of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the city was breached, and all the warriors fled and left the city at night by way of the gate between the two walls which was by the king’s garden, though the Chaldeans were ①all around the city. And they went by way of the Arabah. ▷ ①Lit against the city on every side

column.name: text
column.value: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king and overtook Zedekiah in the ①desert plains of Jericho, and all his army was scattered from him. ▷ ①Heb Arabah

column.name: text
column.value: Then they captured the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, and he ①passed sentence on him. ▷ ①Lit spoke judgments with

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and he also slaughtered all the commanders of Judah in Riblah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he blinded the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him with bronze shackles and brought him to Babylon and put him in prison until the day of his death.

column.name: text
column.value: Now on the tenth day of the fifth month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguard, who ①was in the service of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem. ▷ ①Lit stood before the king

column.name: text
column.value: And he burned the house of the LORD, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem; even every large house he burned with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: So the entire army of the Chaldeans who were with the captain of the guard tore down all the walls around Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took into exile some of the poorest of the people, the rest of the people who were left in the city, the deserters who had deserted to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the craftsmen.

column.name: text
column.value: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to be vinedressers and farmers.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the bronze pillars which belonged to the house of the LORD and the stands and the bronze ①sea, which were in the house of the LORD, the Chaldeans smashed to pieces and carried all their bronze to Babylon. ▷ ①I.e., large basin

column.name: text
column.value: They also took the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the basins, the ①pans, and all the bronze vessels which were used in temple service. ▷ ①Or spoons for incense

column.name: text
column.value: The captain of the guard also took the bowls, the firepans, the basins, the pots, the lampstands, the ①pans, and the drink offering bowls, whatever was fine gold, and whatever was fine silver. ▷ ①Or spoons for incense

column.name: text
