column.value: The two pillars, the one ①sea, and the twelve bronze bulls that were under ②the sea, and the stands, which King Solomon had made for the house of the LORD—the bronze of all these vessels was beyond weight. ▷ ①As in LXX and Syriac; MT omits the sea; i.e., large basin ②As in LXX and Syriac; MT omits the sea; i.e., large basin

column.name: text
column.value: As for the pillars, the height of each pillar was ①eighteen cubits, and ②it was twelve cubits in circumference and four fingers in thickness, and hollow. ▷ ①About 27 ft. high and 18 ft. in circumference or 8 m and 5.4 m ②Lit a thread of 12 cubits would encircle it

column.name: text
column.value: Also, a capital of bronze was on top of it; and the height of each capital was ①five cubits, with latticework and pomegranates on the capital all around, all of bronze. And the second pillar was like these, including pomegranates. ▷ ①About 7.5 ft. or 2.3 m

column.name: text
column.value: There were ninety-six ①exposed pomegranates; all the pomegranates numbered a hundred on the latticework all around. ▷ ①Lit windward

column.name: text
column.value: Then the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest and Zephaniah the second priest, with the three ①officers of the temple. ▷ ①Lit keepers of the door

column.name: text
column.value: He also took from the city one official who was overseer of the warriors, seven ①of the king’s advisers who were found in the city, the scribe of the commander of the army who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men from the people of the land who were found inside the city. ▷ ①Lit men of those seeing the king’s face

column.name: text
column.value: Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguards took them and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king of Babylon struck them and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was led into exile from its land.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the people whom Nebuchadnezzar took into exile: in the ①seventh year 3,023 Jews; ▷ ①Or possibly seventeenth

column.name: text
column.value: in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar 832 persons from Jerusalem;

column.name: text
column.value: in the twenty-third year of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took into exile 745 Jewish people; there were 4,600 people in all.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about in the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-fifth of the month, that ①Evil-merodach king of Babylon, in the first year of his reign, ②showed favor to Jehoiachin king of Judah and brought him out of prison. ▷ ①Or Awil-Marduk (“Man of Marduk”) ②Lit lifted up the head of

column.name: text
column.value: Then he spoke kindly to him and set his throne above the thrones of the kings who were with him in Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: So ①Jehoiachin changed his prison clothes, and ②had his meals in ③the king’s presence regularly all the days of his life. ▷ ①Lit he ②Lit ate bread ③Lit his presence

column.name: text
column.value: And as his allowance, a regular allowance was given to him by the king of Babylon, a portion for each day, all the days of his life until the day of his death.

column.name: text
column.value: How lonely sits the city That once had many people! She has become like a widow Who was once great among the nations! She who was a princess among the ①provinces Has become a forced laborer! ▷ ①Or districts

column.name: text
text
column.value: Judah has gone into exile out of affliction And ①harsh servitude; She lives among the nations, But she has not found a resting place; All those who pursued her have overtaken her In the midst of ②distress. ▷ ①Lit great ②Or narrow places

column.name: text
column.value: The roads ①of Zion are in mourning Because no one comes to an appointed feast. All her gates are deserted; Her priests groan, Her virgins are worried, And as for Zion herself, it is bitter for her. ▷ ①Or to

column.name: text
column.value: Her adversaries have become ①her masters, Her enemies are ②secure; For the LORD has ③caused her grief Because of the multitude of her wrongdoings; Her little ones have gone away As captives ④led by the enemy. ▷ ①Lit head ②Or at ease ③Or tormented her ④Lit before

column.name: text
column.value: All of her splendor Is gone from the daughter of Zion; Her leaders have become like deer That have found no pasture, And they have ①fled without strength ②From the pursuer. ▷ ①Lit Before ②Lit gone

column.name: text
column.value: In the days of her affliction and homelessness Jerusalem remembers all her treasures That were hers since the days of old, When her people fell into the hand of the adversary And no one helped her. The adversaries saw her, They laughed at her ①ruin. ▷ ①Lit cessation

column.name: text
column.value: Jerusalem sinned greatly, Therefore she has become an ①object of ridicule. All who honored her despise her Because they have seen her nakedness; Even she herself groans and turns away. ▷ ①Or abomination

column.name: text
column.value: Her uncleanness was in her garment’s seams; She ①did not think of her future. So she has ②fallen in an astonishing way; She has no comforter. “See, LORD, my affliction, For the enemy has ③honored himself!” ▷ ①Orremember her final end ②Lit gone down ③Or boasted

column.name: text
column.value: The adversary has stretched out his hand Over all her precious things, For she has seen the nations enter her sanctuary, The ones whom You commanded That they were not to enter Your congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: All her people groan, seeking bread; They have given their treasures for food To restore their ①lives. “See, LORD, and look, For I am despised.” ▷ ①Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: “Is it nothing to all you who pass this way? Look and see if there is any pain like my pain Which was inflicted on me, With which the LORD tormented me on the day of His fierce anger.

column.name: text
column.value: From ①the height He sent fire into my bones, And it dominated them. He has spread a net for my feet; He has turned me back; He has made me desolate, ②Faint all day long. ▷ ①I.e., heaven ②Or Sick

column.name: text
column.value: The yoke of my wrongdoings is bound; By His hand they are woven together. They have come upon my neck; He has made my strength ①fail. The Lord has handed me over To those against whom I am not able to stand. ▷ ①Lit falter

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord has thrown away all my strong men In my midst; He has called an appointed ①time against me To crush my young men; The Lord has trodden as in a wine press The virgin daughter of Judah. ▷ ①Another reading is feast

column.name: text
column.value: For these things I weep; ①My eyes run down with water; Because far from me is a comforter, One to restore my soul. My children are desolate Because the enemy has prevailed.” ▷ ①Lit My eye, my eye

column.name: text
text
column.value: “The LORD is righteous, For I have rebelled against His ①command; Hear now, all peoples, And see my pain; My virgins and my young men Have gone into captivity. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: I called to my lovers, but they deserted me; My priests and my elders perished in the city While they sought food to restore their ①strength themselves. ▷ ①Lit soul

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: May all their wickedness come before You; And deal with them just as You have dealt with me For all my wrongdoings. For my groans are many and my heart is faint.”

column.name: text
column.value: How the Lord has ①covered the daughter of Zion With a cloud in His anger! He has hurled The glory of Israel from heaven to earth, And has not remembered His footstool In the day of His anger. ▷ ①Or scorned...Zion in His anger

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord has ①destroyed; He has not spared All the settlements of Jacob. In His wrath He has overthrown The strongholds of the daughter of Judah, He has hurled them down to the ground; He has profaned the kingdom and its leaders. ▷ ①Lit engulfed

column.name: text
column.value: In fierce anger He has cut off ①All the strength of Israel; He has pulled back His right hand From the enemy. And He has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire Consuming on all sides. ▷ ①Lit Every horn

column.name: text
column.value: He has bent His bow like an enemy; His right hand is positioned like an adversary, And He has killed everything that was pleasant to the eye. In the tent of the daughter of Zion He has poured out His wrath like fire.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord has become like an enemy. He has engulfed Israel; He has engulfed all its palaces, He has destroyed its strongholds And caused great mourning and grieving in the daughter of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And He has treated His ①tabernacle violently, like a despised garden; He has destroyed His appointed ②meeting place. The LORD has caused The appointed feast and Sabbath in Zion to be forgotten, And He has despised king and priest In the indignation of His anger. ▷ ①Or booth ②Or feast

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord has rejected His altar, He has ①repudiated His sanctuary; He has handed over The walls of her palaces to the enemy. They have made a noise in the house of the LORD As on the day of an appointed feast. ▷ ①I.e., scornfully rejected

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD determined to destroy The wall of the daughter of Zion. He has stretched out a line, He has not restrained His hand from ①destroying, And He has caused rampart and wall to mourn; They have languished together. ▷ ①Lit engulfing

column.name: text
column.value: Her gates have sunk into the ground, He has destroyed and broken her bars. Her king and her leaders are among the nations; The Law is gone. Her prophets, too, find No vision from the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The elders of the daughter of Zion Sit on the ground and ①are silent. They have thrown dust on their heads; They have put on sackcloth. The virgins of Jerusalem Have bowed their heads to the ground. ▷ ①Another reading is wail

column.name: text
column.value: My eyes fail because of tears, My ①spirit is greatly troubled; My ②heart is poured out on the earth Because of the ③destruction of the daughter of my people, When little ones and infants languish In the streets of the city. ▷ ①Lit inward parts are in ferment ②Lit liver ③Lit breaking

column.name: text
column.value: They say to their mothers, “Where is grain and wine?” As they faint like a wounded person In the streets of the city, As their lives are poured out ①In their mothers’ arms. ▷ ①Lit on...breast

column.name: text
column.value: How shall I admonish you? What shall I compare to you, Daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I liken to you as I comfort you, Virgin daughter of Zion? For your collapse is as vast as the sea; Who can heal you?

column.name: text
column.value: Your prophets have seen for you Worthless and deceptive visions; And they have not exposed your wrongdoing So as to restore you from captivity, But they have seen for you worthless and misleading pronouncements.

column.name: text
column.value: All who pass along the way Clap their hands in ridicule at you; They ①hiss and shake their heads At the daughter of Jerusalem: “Is this the city of which they said, ‘Perfect in beauty, A joy to all the earth’?” ▷ ①Or whistle

column.name: text
column.value: All your enemies Have opened their mouths wide against you; They ①hiss and gnash their teeth. They say, “We have engulfed her! This certainly is the day which we awaited; We have reached it, we have seen it!” ▷ ①Or whistle

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has done what He determined; He has accomplished His word Which He commanded from days of old. He has torn down without sparing, And He has helped the enemy to rejoice over you; He has exalted the ①might of your adversaries. ▷ ①Lit horn

column.name: text
column.value: Their heart cried out to the Lord: “You wall of the daughter of Zion, Let your tears stream down like a river day and night; Give yourself no relief, Let ①your eyes have no rest. ▷ ①Lit the daughter of your eye

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, whimper in the night At the beginning of the night watches; Pour out your heart like water Before the presence of the Lord; Raise your hands to Him For the life of your little ones Who languish because of hunger At the head of every street.

column.name: text
column.value: See, LORD, and look! With whom have You dealt this way? Should women really eat their ①children, The little ones who were ②born healthy? Should priest and prophet really be killed In the sanctuary of the Lord? ▷ ①Lit fruit ②Or tenderly cared for

column.name: text
column.value: On the ground in the streets Lie young and old; My virgins and my young men Have fallen by the sword. You have put them to death on the day of Your anger, You have slaughtered, without sparing.

column.name: text
column.value: You called as on the day of an appointed feast My terrors on every side; And there was no one who survived or escaped On the day of the LORD’S anger. As for those whom I brought forth healthy and whom I raised, My enemy annihilated them.”

column.name: text
column.value: How dark the gold has become, How the pure gold has changed! The sacred stones are spilled out At the ①corner of every street. ▷ ①Lit head

column.name: text
column.value: The precious sons of Zion, Weighed against pure gold, How they are regarded as earthenware jars, The work of a potter’s hands!

column.name: text
column.value: Even jackals offer the breast, They nurse their young; But the daughter of my people has proved herself cruel, Like ostriches in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: The tongue of the infant clings To the roof of its mouth because of thirst; The children ask for bread, But no one breaks it for them.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who used to eat delicacies Are made to tremble in the streets; Those who were raised in crimson clothing Embrace garbage heaps.

column.name: text
column.value: For the ①wrongdoing of the daughter of my people Is greater than the ②sin of Sodom, Which was overthrown as in a moment, ③And no hands were turned toward her. ▷ ①Or punishment for wrongdoing ②Or punishment for sin ③I.e., without human intervention

column.name: text
column.value: Her ①consecrated ones were purer than snow, They shined more than milk; They were more ruddy in ②body than pearls of coral, Their form was like ③lapis lazuli. ▷ ①Or Nazirites ②Lit bones ③Heb sappir

column.name: text
column.value: Their appearance is darker than soot, They are not recognized in the streets; Their skin is shriveled on their bones, It is dry, it has become like wood.

column.name: text
column.value: Better off are those killed by the sword Than those killed by hunger; For they ①waste away, ②stricken By the lack of the produce of the field. ▷ ①Lit flow away ②Lit pierced through

column.name: text
column.value: The hands of compassionate women Boiled their own children; They became food for them Due to the destruction of the daughter of my people.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has expended His wrath, He has poured out His fierce anger; And He has kindled a fire in Zion, And it has consumed its foundations.

column.name: text
column.value: The kings of the earth did not believe, Nor did any of the inhabitants of the world, That the adversary and the enemy Would enter the gates of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of the sins of her prophets And the wrongdoings of her priests, Who have shed in her midst The blood of the righteous,

column.name: text
text
column.value: “Keep away! Unclean!” ①they cried out of themselves. “Keep away, keep away, do not touch!” For they distanced themselves as well as wandered; People among the nations said, “They shall not continue to reside with us.” ▷ ①Or they (other people) cried to them

column.name: text
column.value: The presence of the LORD has scattered them, He will not continue to look at them; They did not ①honor the priests, They did not favor the elders. ▷ ①Lit lift up the faces of

column.name: text
column.value: Yet our eyes failed, Looking for ①help was useless; At our observation point we have watched For a nation that could not save. ▷ ①Lit our help

column.name: text
column.value: They hunted our steps So that we could not walk in our streets; Our end drew near, Our days were ①finished For our end had come. ▷ ①Lit full

column.name: text
column.value: Our pursuers were swifter Than the eagles of the sky; They chased us on the mountains, They waited in ambush for us in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: The breath of our nostrils, the LORD’S anointed, Was captured in their pits, Of whom we had said, “ ①In his shadow We shall live among the nations.” ▷ ①I.e., under his protection

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice and be joyful, daughter of Edom, Who lives in the land of Uz; But the cup will pass to you as well, You will become drunk and expose yourself.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Then He said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you.”

column.name: text
column.value: And as He spoke to me the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet; and I heard Him speaking to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He said to me, “Son of man, I am sending you to the sons of Israel, to a rebellious people who have rebelled against Me; they and their fathers have revolted against Me to this very day.

column.name: text
column.value: So I am sending you to those who are ①impudent and obstinate children, and you shall say to them, ‘This is what the Lord ②GOD says:’ ▷ ①Lit hard-faced and hard-hearted ②Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: As for them, whether they listen or ①not—for they are a rebellious house—they will know that a prophet has been among them. ▷ ①Lit refrain

column.name: text
column.value: And as for you, son of man, you are not to fear them nor fear their words, though thistles and thorns are with you and you sit on scorpions; you are not to fear their words nor be dismayed at their presence, since they are a rebellious house.

column.name: text
column.value: But you shall speak My words to them whether they listen or ①not, for they are rebellious. ▷ ①Lit refrain

column.name: text
column.value: “Now you, son of man, listen to what I am speaking to you; do not be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth wide and eat what I am giving you.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then I looked, and behold, a hand was extended to me; and behold, a ①scroll was in it. ▷ ①Lit scroll of a book

column.name: text
column.value: When He spread it out before me, it was written on the front and back, and written on it were songs of mourning, sighing, and woe.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about in the thirtieth year, on the fifth day of the fourth month, while I was by the river Chebar among the exiles, the heavens were opened and I saw ①visions of God. ▷ ①Some ancient versions a vision

column.name: text
column.value: (On the fifth of the month ①in the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s exile, ▷ ①Lit it was

column.name: text
column.value: the word of the LORD came expressly to Ezekiel the priest, son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and there the hand of the LORD came upon him.)

column.name: text
column.value: As I looked, behold, a high wind was coming from the north, a great cloud with fire flashing intermittently and a bright light around it, and in its midst something like gleaming ①metal in the midst of the fire. ▷ ①Heb uncertain; Gr indicates a gold and silver alloy

column.name: text
column.value: And within it there were figures resembling four living beings. And this was their appearance: they had human form.

column.name: text
column.value: Each of them had four faces and four wings.

column.name: text
column.value: Their legs were straight and ①their feet were like a calf’s ②hoof, and they sparkled like polished bronze. ▷ ①Lit the sole of their feet ②Lit sole of a foot

column.name: text
column.value: Under their wings on their four sides were human hands. As for the faces and wings of the four of them,

column.name: text
column.value: their wings touched one another; their faces did not turn when they moved, each went straight forward.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the form of their faces, each had a human face; ①all four had the face of a lion on the right and the face of a bull on the left, and ②all four had the face of an eagle. ▷ ①Lit the four of them ②Lit the four of them

column.name: text
column.value: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above; each had two touching another being, and two covering their bodies.

column.name: text
column.value: And each went straight forward; wherever the spirit was about to go, they would go, without turning as they went.

column.name: text
column.value: ①In the midst of the living beings there was something that looked like burning coals of fire, ②like torches moving among the living beings. The fire was bright, and lightning was ③flashing from the fire. ▷ ①Lit going out ②As in some ancient versions; MT And the likeness of the living beings ③Lit like the appearance of

column.name: text
column.value: And the living beings ran back and forth like bolts of lightning.

column.name: text
column.value: Now as I looked at the living beings, behold, there was one wheel on the ground beside the living beings, for ①each of the four of them. ▷ ①Lit his four faces

column.name: text
column.value: The appearance of the wheels and their workmanship was like ①sparkling topaz, and all four of them had the same form, their appearance and workmanship being as if ②one wheel were within another. ▷ ①Or the look of topaz ②Lit the wheel in the midst of the wheel

column.name: text
column.value: Whenever they ①moved, they ②moved in any of their four ③directions without turning as they ④moved. ▷ ①Lit went ②Lit went ③Lit sides ④Lit went

column.name: text
column.value: As for their rims, they were high and awesome, and the rims of all four of them were ①covered with eyes all around. ▷ ①Lit full of

column.name: text
column.value: Whenever the living beings ①moved, the wheels ②moved with them. And whenever the living beings rose from the earth, the wheels rose also. ▷ ①Lit went ②Lit went

column.name: text
column.value: Wherever the spirit was about to go, they would go in that direction ①. And the wheels rose just as they did; for the spirit of the living ②beings was in the wheels. ▷ ①MT adds the spirit to go ②MT being

column.name: text
column.value: Whenever those went, they went; and whenever those stopped, they stopped. And whenever those rose from the earth, the wheels rose just as they did; for the spirit of the living ①beings was in the wheels. ▷ ①MT being

column.name: text
column.value: Now over the heads of the living ①beings there was something like an expanse, like the awesome gleam of crystal, spread out over their heads. ▷ ①As in some mss and ancient versions; MT being

column.name: text
column.value: Under the expanse their wings were stretched out straight, one toward the other; each one also had two wings covering its body on the one side and on the other.

column.name: text
column.value: And I also heard the sound of their wings, like the sound of abundant waters as they went, like the voice of ①the Almighty, a sound of a crowd like the sound of an army camp; whenever they stopped, they let down their wings. ▷ ①Heb Shaddai

column.name: text
column.value: And a voice came from above the expanse that was over their heads; whenever they stood still, they let down their wings.

column.name: text
column.value: Now above the expanse that was over their heads there was something resembling a throne, like ①lapis lazuli in appearance; and on that which resembled a throne, high up, was a figure with the appearance of a man. ▷ ①Heb eben-sappir

column.name: text
column.value: Then I ①noticed from the appearance of His waist and upward something like gleaming ②metal that looked like fire all around within it, and from the appearance of His waist and downward I saw something like fire; and there was a radiance around Him. ▷ ①Lit saw ②See note v 4

column.name: text
column.value: Like the appearance of the rainbow ①in the clouds on a rainy day, so was the appearance of the surrounding radiance. Such was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw it, I fell on my face and heard a voice speaking. ▷ ①Lit which occurs in

column.name: text
column.value: Remember, LORD, what has come upon us; Look, and see our disgrace!

column.name: text
column.value: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, Our houses to foreigners.

column.name: text
column.value: We have become orphans, without a father; Our mothers are like widows.

column.name: text
column.value: ①We have to pay for our drinking water, Our wood comes to us at a price. ▷ ①Lit We drink our water with silver

column.name: text
text
column.value: We have ①submitted to Egypt and Assyria ②to get enough bread. ▷ ①Lit given Egypt a hand ②Lit to be satisfied with

column.name: text
column.value: Our fathers sinned, and are gone; It is we who have been burdened with the punishment for their wrongdoings.

column.name: text
column.value: Slaves rule over us; There is no one to rescue us from their hand.

column.name: text
column.value: We get our bread ①at the risk of our lives Because of the sword in the wilderness. ▷ ①Lit with our soul

column.name: text
column.value: Our skin has become as hot as an oven, Because of the ravages of hunger.

column.name: text
column.value: They violated the women in Zion, The virgins in the cities of Judah.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Young men ①worked at the grinding mill, And youths staggered under loads of wood. ▷ ①Lit carried the

column.name: text
column.value: Elders are absent from the gate, Young men from their music.

column.name: text
column.value: The joy of our hearts has ended; Our dancing has been turned into mourning.

column.name: text
column.value: The crown has fallen from our head; Woe to us, for we have sinned!

column.name: text
column.value: Because of this our heart is faint, Because of these things our eyes are dim;

column.name: text
column.value: Because of Mount Zion which lies desolate, Jackals prowl in it.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Why will You forget us forever? Why do You abandon us for ①so long? ▷ ①Lit length of days

column.name: text
column.value: Restore us to You, LORD, so that we may be restored; Renew our days as of old,

column.name: text
column.value: Unless You have utterly rejected us And are exceedingly angry with us.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He said to me, “Son of man, eat what you find; eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”

column.name: text
column.value: So I opened my mouth, and He fed me this scroll.

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to me, “Son of man, feed your stomach and fill your ①body with this scroll which I am giving you.” Then I ate it, and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth. ▷ ①Lit inward parts

column.name: text
column.value: Then He said to me, “Son of man, ①go to the house of Israel and speak with My words to them. ▷ ①Lit go, come

column.name: text
column.value: For you are not being sent to a people of ①unintelligible speech or difficult language, but to the house of Israel, ▷ ①Lit deep lip and heavy tongue

column.name: text
column.value: nor to many peoples of ①unintelligible speech or difficult language, whose words you cannot understand. ②But I have sent you to ③the people who understand you; ▷ ①Lit deep lip and heavy tongue ②Or I certainly have sent ③Lit them, they understand

column.name: text
column.value: yet the house of Israel will not be willing to listen to you, since they are not willing to listen to Me. The entire house of Israel certainly is ①stubborn and obstinate. ▷ ①Lit of a hard forehead and hard of heart

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I have made your face just as hard as their faces, and your forehead just as hard as their foreheads.

column.name: text
column.value: Like emery harder than flint I have made your forehead. Do not be afraid of them or be dismayed before them, since they are a rebellious house.”

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, He said to me, “Son of man, take into your heart all My words which I will speak to you and listen ①closely. ▷ ①Lit with your ears

column.name: text
column.value: ①Go to the exiles, to the sons of your people, and speak to them and tell them, whether they listen or ②not, ‘This is what the Lord ③GOD says.’ ” ▷ ①Lit Go, come ②Lit refrain ③Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard a great rumbling sound behind me: “Blessed be the glory of the LORD from His place!”

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard the sound of the wings of the living beings touching one another and the sound of the wheels beside them, even a great rumbling sound.

column.name: text
column.value: So the Spirit lifted me up and took me away; and I went embittered in the rage of my spirit, and the hand of the LORD was strong on me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I came to the exiles who lived beside the river Chebar at Tel-abib, and I sat there for seven days where they were living, causing consternation among them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now at the end of seven days the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, I have appointed you as a watchman for the house of Israel; whenever you hear a word from My mouth, warn them from Me.

column.name: text
column.value: When I say to the wicked, ‘You will certainly die,’ and you do not warn him or speak out to warn the wicked from his wicked way so that he may live, that wicked person shall die for wrongdoing, but his blood I will require from your hand.

column.name: text
column.value: However if you have warned the wicked and he does not turn from his wickedness or from his wicked way, he shall die for wrongdoing, but you have saved yourself.

column.name: text
column.value: Again, when a righteous person turns away from his righteousness and commits sin, and I place an obstacle before him, he will die; since you have not warned him, he shall die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he has done shall not be remembered; but his blood I will require from your hand.

column.name: text
column.value: However, if you have warned ①the righteous person that the righteous is not to sin, and he does not sin, he shall certainly live because he took warning; and you have saved yourself.” ▷ ①Lit him, the righteous

column.name: text
column.value: Now the hand of the LORD was on me there, and He said to me, “Get up, go out to the plain, and there I will speak to you.”

column.name: text
column.value: So I got up and went out to the plain; and behold, the glory of the LORD was standing there, like the glory that I saw by the river Chebar, and I fell on my face.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Spirit entered me and set me up on my feet; and He spoke with me and said to me, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.

column.name: text
column.value: And as for you, son of man, they will put ropes ①around you and bind you with them so that you do not go out among them. ▷ ①Lit on

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be unable to speak and will not be a man who reprimands them, since they are a rebellious house.

column.name: text
column.value: But when I speak to you, I will open your mouth and you will say to them, ‘This is what the Lord ①GOD says:’ The one who hears, let him hear; and the one who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: “As for you, son of man, take a sharp sword; take and ①use it as a barber’s razor on your head and beard. Then take scales for weighing and divide ②the hair. ▷ ①Lit pass it over your head ②Lit them

column.name: text
column.value: A third you shall burn in the fire at the center of the city, when the days of the siege are completed. Then you shall take a third and strike it with the sword all around ①the city, and a third you shall scatter to the wind; for I will unsheathe a sword behind them. ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: Take also a few hairs in number from ①them and bind them in the hems of your robes. ▷ ①Lit there

column.name: text
column.value: Take again some of them and throw them into the fire and burn them in the fire; from it a fire will ①spread to all the house of Israel. ▷ ①Lit go out

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the Lord ①GOD says: ‘This is Jerusalem; I have placed her at the center of the nations, with lands around her. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: But she has rebelled against My ordinances more wickedly than the nations, and against My statutes more than the lands which surround her; for they have rejected My ordinances and have not walked ①in My statutes.’ ▷ ①Lit in them, My statutes

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have more turmoil than the nations that surround you and have not walked in My statutes, nor executed My ordinances, nor acted in accordance with the ordinances of the nations around you,’

column.name: text
column.value: therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I, even I, am against you, and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: And because of all your abominations I will do among you what I have not done, and the like of which I will never do again.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, fathers will eat their sons among you, and sons will eat their fathers; for I will execute judgments on you and scatter all your remnant to every wind.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore as I live,’ declares the Lord GOD, ‘Because you have defiled My sanctuary with all your detestable idols and with all your abominations, I definitely will also withdraw and My eye will have no pity, and I also will not spare.

column.name: text
column.value: A third of you will die by plague or perish by famine among you, a third will fall by the sword around you, and a third I will scatter to every wind, and I will unsheathe a sword behind them.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Then My anger will be spent and I will satisfy My wrath on them, and I will be appeased; then they will know that I, the LORD, have spoken in My zeal, when I have spent My wrath upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, I will make you a site of ruins and a disgrace among the nations that surround you, in the sight of everyone who passes by.

column.name: text
column.value: So ①it will be a disgrace, an object of abuse, a warning, and an object of horror to the nations that surround you when I execute judgments against you in anger, wrath, and raging reprimands. I, the LORD, have spoken. ▷ ①Ancient versions you

column.name: text
column.value: When I send against them the ①deadly arrows of famine which ②were for the destruction of those whom I will send to destroy you, then I will also intensify the famine upon you and break off your ③provision of bread. ▷ ①Lit evil ②Or are for destruction, which I will send ③Lit staff

column.name: text
column.value: I will send on you famine and vicious animals, and they will bereave you of children; plague and bloodshed also will pass through you, and I will bring the sword on you. I, the LORD, have spoken.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “And you, son of man, this is what the Lord ①GOD says to the land of Israel: ‘An end! The end is coming on the four corners of the land. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Now the end is upon you, for I will send My anger against you; I will judge you according to your ways and ①bring all your abominations upon you. ▷ ①Lit give

column.name: text
column.value: And My eye will have no pity on you, nor will I spare you, but I will ①bring your ways upon you, and your abominations will be among you; then you will know that I am the LORD!’ ▷ ①Lit give

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the Lord ①GOD says: ‘A disaster, a unique disaster, behold, it is coming! ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: An end ①is coming; the end has come! It has awakened against you; behold, it has come! ▷ ①Or has come

column.name: text
column.value: Your ①doom has come to you, you inhabitant of the land. The time has come, the day is near—panic rather than joyful shouting on the mountains. ▷ ①Meaning uncertain

column.name: text
column.value: Now I will shortly pour out My wrath on you and expend My anger against you; I will judge you according to your ways and ①bring on you all your abominations. ▷ ①Lit give

column.name: text
column.value: My eye will have no pity nor will I spare you. I will ①repay you according to your ways, while your abominations are in your midst; then you will know that I, the LORD, am striking. ▷ ①Lit give

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Behold, the day! Behold, it is coming! Your ①doom has gone forth; the rod has budded, arrogance has blossomed. ▷ ①Meaning uncertain

column.name: text
column.value: Violence ①has grown into a rod of wickedness. None of them shall remain, none of their ②people, none of their wealth, nor anything eminent among them. ▷ ①Lit has risen ②Or procession

column.name: text
column.value: The time has come, the day has arrived. Let neither the buyer rejoice nor the seller mourn; for wrath is against all their multitude.

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, the seller will not ①regain ②what he sold as long as ③they both live; for the vision regarding all their multitude will not ④be averted, nor will any of them maintain his life by his wrongdoing. ▷ ①Lit return to ②Lit the thing sold; i.e., his inherited land ③Lit their life among the living ones ④Lit return

column.name: text
column.value: ‘They have blown the trumpet and made everything ready, but no one is going to the battle, for My wrath is against all ①their multitude. ▷ ①Lit her

column.name: text
column.value: The sword is outside the city and the plague and the famine are within. Anyone who is in the field will die by the sword, while famine and the plague will consume those in the city.

column.name: text
column.value: Even when their survivors escape, they will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, each over his own wrongdoing.

column.name: text
column.value: All hands will hang limp, and all ①knees will drip with water. ▷ ①Heb idiom meaning to wet oneself

column.name: text
column.value: They will put on sackcloth and shuddering will overwhelm them; and shame will be on all faces, and a ①bald patch on all their heads. ▷ ①I.e., shaved as a sign of mourning

column.name: text
column.value: They will fling their silver into the streets, and their gold will become an abhorrent thing; their silver and their gold will not be able to save them on the day of the wrath of the LORD. They cannot satisfy their ①appetite, nor can they fill their stomachs, because their wrongdoing has become a cause of stumbling. ▷ ①Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, they transformed the splendor of His jewels into pride, and they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things with it; therefore I will make it an abhorrent thing to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will hand it over to the foreigners as plunder, and to the wicked of the earth as spoils; and they will profane it.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also turn My face away from them, and they will profane My treasure; then robbers will enter and profane it.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Make the ①chain, for the land is full of ②bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence. ▷ ①I.e., used for imprisonment ②Lit judgment of blood

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will take possession of their houses. I will also put an end to the pride of the strong ones, and their holy places will be profaned.

column.name: text
column.value: When anguish comes, they will seek peace, but there will be none.

column.name: text
column.value: Disaster will come upon disaster and rumor will be added to rumor; then they will seek a vision from a prophet, but the Law will be lost from the priest, and counsel from the elders.

column.name: text
column.value: The king will mourn, the prince will be clothed in horror, and the hands of the people of the land will ①tremble. I will deal with them because of their conduct, and by their judgments I will judge them. And they will know that I am the LORD.’ ” ▷ ①Lit be horrified

column.name: text
column.value: “Now you, son of man, get yourself a brick, place it before you, and inscribe a city on it—Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Then lay siege against it, build a siege wall, pile up an assault ramp, set up camps, and place battering rams against it all around.

column.name: text
column.value: Then get yourself an iron plate and set it up as an iron wall between yourself and the city, and direct your face toward it so that it is under siege, and besiege it. This will be a sign to the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: “Then you are to lie down on your left side and put the wrongdoing of the house of Israel on it; you shall bear their wrongdoing for the number of days that you lie on it.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have assigned you a number of days corresponding to the years of their wrongdoing, 390 days; so you shall bear the wrongdoing of the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: When you have completed these days, you shall lie down a second time, but on your right side, and bear the wrongdoing of the house of Judah; I have assigned it to you for forty days, a day for each year.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you shall direct your face toward the siege of Jerusalem with your arm bared, and prophesy against it.

column.name: text
column.value: Now behold, I will put ropes ①around you so that you cannot turn from your one side to your other until you have completed the days of your siege. ▷ ①Lit on

column.name: text
column.value: “But as for you, take wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel and make them into bread for yourself; you shall eat it according to the number of the days that you lie on your side, 390 days.

column.name: text
column.value: Your food which you eat shall be twenty shekels a day by weight; you shall eat it from time to time.

column.name: text
column.value: The water you drink shall be a ①sixth of a hin by measure; you shall drink it from time to time. ▷ ①About 0.6 qt. or 0.6 liter

column.name: text
column.value: You shall eat it as a barley cake, having baked it in their sight over human dung.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said, “In this way the sons of Israel will eat their bread unclean among the nations where I will scatter them.”

column.name: text
column.value: But I said, “Oh, Lord ①GOD! Behold, ②I have never been defiled; for from my youth until now I have never eaten what died of itself or was torn by animals, nor has any unclean meat ever entered my mouth!” ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD ②Lit my soul has

column.name: text
column.value: Then He said to me, “See, I will give you cow’s dung in place of human dung, so that you may prepare your bread over it.”

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, He said to me, “Son of man, behold, I am going to break the staff of bread in Jerusalem, and they will eat bread by weight and with anxiety, and drink water by measure and in horror,

column.name: text
column.value: because bread and water will be scarce; and they will tremble with one another and waste away in their guilt.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them

column.name: text
column.value: and say, ‘Mountains of Israel, listen to the word of the Lord ①GOD! This is what the Lord ②GOD says to the mountains, the hills, the ravines, and the valleys: “Behold, I Myself am going to bring a sword against you, and I will destroy your high places. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD ②Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: So your altars will become deserted and your incense altars will be smashed; and I will make your slain fall in front of your idols.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also lay the dead bodies of the sons of Israel in front of their idols; and I will scatter your bones around your altars.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Everywhere you live, cities will be in ruins and the high places will be deserted, so that your altars will be in ruins and ②deserted, your idols will be broken and brought to an end, your incense altars will be cut down, and your works wiped out. ▷ ①Lit In all your dwellings ②As in some ancient versions; MT suffer for their guilt

column.name: text
column.value: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “However, I will leave a remnant, in that you will have those who escaped the sword among the nations when you are scattered among the countries.

column.name: text
column.value: Then those of you who escape will remember Me among the nations to which they will be taken captive, how I have ①been hurt by their adulterous hearts which turned away from Me, and by their eyes which committed infidelity with their idols; and they will loathe themselves in their own sight for the evils which they have committed, for all their abominations. ▷ ①Lit been broken; another reading is broken their (but unlikely)

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will know that I am the LORD; I have not said in vain that I would inflict this disaster on them.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the Lord ①GOD says: ‘Clap your hands, stamp your foot and say, “Woe, because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel, which will fall by the sword, famine, and plague! ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who is far away will die by the plague, anyone who is near will fall by the sword, and anyone who remains and is spared from these will die by the famine. So I will expend My wrath on them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will know that I am the LORD, when their dead are among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, under every leafy tree and under every massive oak with thick branches—the places where they offered a soothing aroma to all their idols.

column.name: text
column.value: So through all their dwelling places I will stretch out My hand against them and make the land more desolate and waste than the wilderness toward Diblah; so they will know that I am the LORD.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about in the sixth year, on the fifth day of the sixth month, as I was sitting in my house with the elders of Judah sitting before me, that the hand of the Lord ①GOD fell upon me there. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Then I looked, and behold, something like the appearance of ①a man; from His waist and downward there was the appearance of fire, and from His waist and upward like the appearance of a glow, like gleaming ②metal. ▷ ①As in LXX; MT fire ②Heb uncertain; Gr indicates a gold and silver alloy

column.name: text
column.value: And He extended the form of a hand and took me by the hair of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the entrance of the ①north gate of the inner courtyard, where the seat of the idol of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy, was located. ▷ ①Lit facing north

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, like the appearance which I saw in the plain.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He said to me, “Son of man, raise your eyes now toward the north.” So I raised my eyes toward the north, and behold, to the north of the altar gate was this idol of jealousy at the entrance.

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they are doing, the great abominations which the house of Israel are committing here, so that I would be far from My sanctuary? But yet you will see still greater abominations!”

column.name: text
column.value: Then He brought me to the entrance of the courtyard, and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall.

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to me, “Son of man, now dig through the wall.” So I dug through the wall, and behold, an entrance.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He said to me, “Go in and see the wicked abominations that they are committing here.”

column.name: text
column.value: So I entered and looked, and behold, every form of crawling things and animals and detestable things, with all the idols of the house of Israel, were carved on the wall all around.

column.name: text
column.value: And standing in front of them were seventy elders of the house of Israel, with Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan standing among them, each man with his censer in his hand; and the fragrance of the cloud of incense was rising.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He said to me, “Do you see, son of man, what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the dark, each man in the rooms of his carved images? For they say, ‘The LORD does not see us; the LORD has abandoned the land.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to me, “Yet you will see still greater abominations which they are committing!”

column.name: text
column.value: Then He brought me to the entrance of the gate of the LORD’S house which was toward the north; and behold, women were sitting there weeping for ①Tammuz. ▷ ①I.e., a Babylonian god

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to me, “Do you see this, son of man? Yet you will see still greater abominations than these!”

column.name: text
column.value: Then He brought me into the inner courtyard of the LORD’S house. And behold, at the entrance to the temple of the LORD, between the porch and the altar, were about twenty-five men with their backs to the temple of the LORD while their faces were toward the east; and they were ①prostrating themselves eastward toward the sun. ▷ ①I.e., worshiping

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to me, “Do you see this, son of man? Is it a trivial thing for the house of Judah to commit the abominations which they have committed here, that they have filled the land with violence and provoked Me to anger repeatedly? Yet behold, they are ①putting the twig to their nose! ▷ ①Possibly an obscene gesture toward God

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, I indeed will deal in wrath. My eye will have no pity nor will I spare; and though they cry out in My ears with a loud voice, yet I will not listen to them.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then He cried out in my ①presence with a loud voice, saying, “Come forward, you ②executioners of the city, each with his weapon of destruction in his hand.” ▷ ①Lit punishers ②Lit ears

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, six men came from the direction of the upper gate which faces north, each with his smashing weapon in his hand; and among them was one man clothed in linen with a scribe’s kit at his waist. And they came in and stood beside the bronze altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the glory of the God of Israel ascended from the cherub on which it had been, to the threshold of the ①temple. And He called to the man clothed in linen at whose waist was the scribe’s kit. ▷ ①Lit house

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to him, “Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and make a mark on the foreheads of the people who groan and sigh over all the abominations which are being committed in its midst.”

column.name: text
column.value: But to the others He said in my ①presence, “Go through the city after him and strike; do not let your eye have pity and do not spare. ▷ ①Lit ears

column.name: text
column.value: ①Utterly kill old men, young men, female virgins, little children, and women, but do not touch any person on whom is the mark; and you shall start from My sanctuary.” So they started with the ②elders who were before the ③temple. ▷ ①Lit To destruction ②Or old men ③Lit house

column.name: text
column.value: He also said to them, “Defile the ①temple and fill the courtyards with the dead. Go out!” So they went out and struck and killed the people in the city. ▷ ①Lit house

column.name: text
column.value: And as they were striking the people and I alone was left, I fell on my face and cried out, ①saying, “Oh, Lord ②GOD! Are You going to destroy the entire remnant of Israel ③by pouring out Your wrath on Jerusalem?” ▷ ①Lit and said ②Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD ③Lit by Your pouring

column.name: text
column.value: Then He said to me, “The guilt of the house of Israel and Judah is very, very great, and the land is filled with blood, and the city is full of perversion; for they say, ‘The LORD has abandoned the land, and the LORD does not see!’

column.name: text
column.value: But as for Me, My eye will have no pity nor will I spare, but I will bring their conduct upon their heads.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then behold, the man clothed in linen, at whose waist was the scribe’s kit, ①reported, saying, “I have done just as You have commanded me.” ▷ ①Lit brought back word

column.name: text
column.value: Then I looked, and behold, in the ①expanse that was over the heads of the cherubim something like a sapphire stone, in appearance resembling a throne, appeared above them. ▷ ①Or firmament; i.e., atmosphere and space

column.name: text
column.value: And He spoke to the man clothed in linen and said, “Enter between the whirling wheels under the ①cherubim and fill your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.” And he entered in my sight. ▷ ①As in LXX; MT cherub

column.name: text
column.value: Now the cherubim were standing on the right side of the ①temple when the man entered, and the cloud filled the inner courtyard. ▷ ①Lit house, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: Then the glory of the LORD went up from the cherub to the threshold of the temple, and the temple was filled with the cloud, and the courtyard was filled with the brightness of the glory of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard as far as the outer courtyard, like the voice of ①God Almighty when He speaks. ▷ ①Heb El Shaddai

column.name: text
column.value: And it came about when He commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from between the whirling wheels, from between the cherubim,” he entered and stood beside a wheel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the cherub reached out with his hand from between the cherubim to the fire which was between the cherubim, took some coals and put them into the hands of the one clothed in linen; and he took them and went out.

column.name: text
column.value: The cherubim appeared to have something like a human hand under their wings.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I looked, and behold, four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside each cherub; and the appearance of the wheels was like the gleam of a ①Tarshish stone. ▷ ①Perhaps topaz

column.name: text
column.value: And as for their appearance, all four of them had the same likeness, as if one wheel were within another wheel.

column.name: text
column.value: When they moved, they went in any of their four ①directions without turning as they went; but they followed in the direction which ②they faced, without turning as they went. ▷ ①Lit sides ②Lit the head turned

column.name: text
column.value: And their whole body, their backs, their hands, their wings and the wheels were ①covered with eyes all around, the wheels belonging to all four of them. ▷ ①Lit full of

column.name: text
column.value: The wheels were called, ①as I heard, the ②whirling wheels. ▷ ①Lit in my ears ②Heb galgal

column.name: text
column.value: And each one had four faces. The first face was the face of a cherub, the second face was the face of a human, the third, the face of a lion, and the fourth, the face of an eagle.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the cherubim rose up. They are the living beings that I saw by the river Chebar.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the cherubim moved, the wheels would move beside them; also when the cherubim lifted up their wings to rise from the ground, the wheels themselves would not turn away from beside them.

column.name: text
column.value: When ①the cherubim stood still, ②the wheels would stand still; and when they rose up, ③the wheels would rise with them, because the spirit of the living beings was in them. ▷ ①Lit they ②Lit they ③Lit they

column.name: text
column.value: Then the glory of the LORD departed from the threshold of the temple and stood over the cherubim.

column.name: text
column.value: When the cherubim departed, they lifted their wings and rose up from the ground in my sight with the wheels beside them; and they stood still at the entrance of the east gate of the LORD’S house, and the glory of the God of Israel ①hovered over them. ▷ ①Lit over them from above

column.name: text
column.value: These are the living beings that I saw beneath the God of Israel by the river Chebar; so I knew that they were cherubim.

column.name: text
column.value: Each one had four faces and each one four wings, and beneath their wings was the form of human hands.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the likeness of their faces, they were the same faces whose appearance I had seen by the river Chebar. Each one went straight ahead.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the LORD’S house which faced eastward. And behold, there were twenty-five men at the entrance of the gate, and among them I saw Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who devise wrongdoing and give evil advice in this city,

column.name: text
column.value: who say, ‘The time is not near to build houses. ①This city is the pot and we are the meat.’ ▷ ①Or This is

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, prophesy against them, prophesy, son of man!”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and He said to me, “Say, ‘This is what the LORD says: “This is how you think, house of Israel, for I know ①your thoughts. ▷ ①Lit what comes up in your spirit

column.name: text
column.value: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and filled its streets with ①them.” ▷ ①Lit the slain

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, this is what the Lord ①GOD says: “Your slain whom you have laid in the midst of ②the city are the meat and this city is the pot; but ③I will bring you out of it. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch ②Lit it ③As in LXX; MT he will bring you out

column.name: text
column.value: You have feared a sword; so I will bring a sword upon you,” the Lord GOD declares.

column.name: text
column.value: “And I will bring you out of the midst of ①the city, and hand you over to strangers, and execute judgments against you. ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: You will fall by the sword. I will judge you to the border of Israel; so you shall know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This city will not be a pot for you, nor will you be meat in the midst of it; I will judge you to the border of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: So you will know that I am the LORD; for you have not walked in My statutes, nor have you executed My ordinances, but you have acted in accordance with the ordinances of the nations around you.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came about, as I prophesied, that Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. Then I fell on my face and cried out with a loud voice, and said, “Oh, Lord GOD! Will You bring the remnant of Israel to a complete destruction?”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, your brothers, your relatives, ①your fellow exiles, and the entire house of Israel, all of them, are those to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, ‘Keep far from the LORD; this land has been given to us as a possession.’ ▷ ①As in LXX and some ancient versions; MT the men of your redemption

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore say, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “Though I had removed them far away among the nations, and though I had scattered them among the countries, yet I was a sanctuary for them for a little while in the countries where they had gone.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore say, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “I will gather you from the peoples and assemble you from the countries among which you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: When they come there, they will remove all its detestable things and all its abominations from it.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will give them one heart, and put a new spirit within ①them. And I will remove the heart of stone from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh, ▷ ①As in LXX and many mss; MT you

column.name: text
column.value: so that they may walk in My statutes, and keep My ordinances and do them. Then they will be My people, and I shall be their God.

column.name: text
column.value: ①But as for those whose hearts go after their detestable things and abominations, I will ②bring their conduct down on their heads,” declares the Lord GOD. ▷ ①Lit And to the heart of their detestable things and their abominations their heart goes ②Lit give...conduct on

column.name: text
column.value: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings with the wheels beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel ①hovered over them. ▷ ①Lit over them from above

column.name: text
column.value: The glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city and stood over the mountain which is east of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God to ①Chaldea, to the exiles. Then the vision that I had seen ②left me. ▷ ①I.e., Babylonia ②Lit went up from

column.name: text
column.value: And I told the exiles all the things that the LORD had shown me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, you live in the midst of the rebellious house, who have eyes to see but do not see, ears to hear but do not hear; for they are a rebellious house.

column.name: text
column.value: So as for you, son of man, prepare for yourself baggage for exile and go into exile by day in their sight; that is, go into exile from your place to another place in their sight. Perhaps they will ①understand, though they are a rebellious house. ▷ ①Or see that they are

column.name: text
column.value: Bring your baggage out by day in their sight, as baggage for exile. Then you shall go out at evening in their sight, as those who are going into exile.

column.name: text
column.value: Dig a hole through the wall in their sight and ①go out through it. ▷ ①Lit bring it out

column.name: text
column.value: Load the baggage on your shoulder in their sight and carry it out in the dark. You shall cover your face so that you cannot see the land, for I have set you as a sign to the house of Israel.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then I did so, just as I had been commanded. By day I brought out my baggage like the baggage of an exile. Then in the evening I dug through the wall with my hands; I went out in the dark and carried the baggage on my shoulder in their sight.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the morning the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, has the house of Israel, the rebellious house, not said to you, ‘What are you doing?’

column.name: text
column.value: Say to them, ‘This is what the Lord ①GOD says: “This pronouncement concerns the prince in Jerusalem as well as all the house of Israel who are ②in it.” ’ ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch ②Lit in their midst

column.name: text
column.value: Say, ‘I am ①a sign to you. Just as I have done, so it will be done to them; they will go into exile, into captivity.’ ▷ ①Lit your sign

column.name: text
column.value: The prince who is among them will load his baggage on his shoulder in the dark and go out. ①They will dig a hole through the wall to bring it out through it. He will cover his face so that he cannot see the land with his eyes. ▷ ①I.e., the king’s attendants

column.name: text
column.value: I will also spread My net over him, and he will be caught in My net. And I will bring him to Babylon in the land of the Chaldeans; yet he will not see it, though he will die there.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will scatter to every wind all who are around him, his helpers and all his troops; and I will draw out a sword after them.

column.name: text
column.value: So they will know that I am the LORD, when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them among the countries.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will ①spare a few of them from the sword, the famine, and plague so that they may tell of all their abominations among the nations where they go, and ②may know that I am the LORD.” ▷ ①Lit leave over men ②Or they will know

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, eat your bread with trembling, and drink your water with quivering and anxiety.

column.name: text
column.value: Then say to the people of the land, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem in the land of Israel: “They will eat their bread with anxiety and drink their water with horror, because ①their land will be ②stripped of its fullness on account of the violence of all who live in it. ▷ ①Lit her ②Lit deserted

column.name: text
column.value: The inhabited cities will be in ruins, and the land will be a desolation. So you will know that I am the LORD.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, what is this proverb you people have about the land of Israel, saying, ‘The days are long, and every vision fails’?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore say to them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “I will put an end to this proverb so that they will no longer use it as a proverb in Israel.” But tell them, “The days are approaching as well as the ①fulfillment of every vision. ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: For there will no longer be any ①false vision or deceptive divination within the house of Israel. ▷ ①Lit worthless

column.name: text
column.value: For I the LORD will speak whatever word I speak, and it will be performed. It will no longer be delayed, for in your days, you rebellious house, I will speak the word and perform it,” declares the Lord GOD.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, behold, the house of Israel is saying, ‘The vision that he sees is for many ①years from now, and he prophesies of times far off.’ ▷ ①Lit days

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore say to them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “None of My words will be delayed any longer. Whatever word I speak will be performed,” ’ ” declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then some elders of Israel came to me and sat down before me.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their hearts and have put in front of their faces the stumbling block of their wrongdoing. Should I let Myself be consulted by them at all?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore speak to them and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord ①GOD says: “Anyone of the house of Israel who sets up his idols in his heart, puts in front of his face the stumbling block of his wrongdoing, and then comes to the prophet, I the LORD will let Myself answer him in ②the matter in view of the multitude of his idols, ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch ②Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: in order to take hold of ①the hearts of the house of Israel who have ②turned away from Me due to all their idols.” ’ ▷ ①Lit their ②Or all turned away from Me due to their idols

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore say to the house of Israel, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “Repent and turn away from your idols, and turn your faces away from all your abominations.

column.name: text
column.value: For anyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who reside in Israel, who deserts Me, sets up his idols in his heart, puts in front of his face the stumbling block of his wrongdoing, and then comes to the prophet to request something of Me for himself, I the LORD will let Myself answer him Myself.

column.name: text
column.value: I will set My face against that person and make him a sign and ①a proverb, and I will eliminate him from among My people. So you will know that I am the LORD. ▷ ①Lit proverbs

column.name: text

column.value: All the ①choice men in all his troops will fall by the sword, and the survivors will be scattered to every wind; and you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken.” ▷ ①As in many mss and ancient versions; MT refugees

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Lord GOD says: “I will also take a sprig from the lofty top of the cedar and ①set it out; I will break off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain. ▷ ①Lit give

column.name: text
column.value: On the high mountain of Israel I will plant it, so that it may bring forth branches and bear fruit, and become a stately cedar. And ①birds of every ②kind will ③nest under it; they will ④nest in the shade of its branches. ▷ ①Lit every bird ②Lit wing ③Lit dwell ④Lit dwell

column.name: text
column.value: All the trees of the field will know that I am the LORD; I bring down the high tree, exalt the low tree, dry up the green tree, and make the dry tree flourish. I am the LORD; I have spoken, and I will perform it.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “What do you people mean by using this proverb about the land of Israel, saying, ‘The fathers eat sour grapes, ①But it is the children’s teeth that have become blunt’? ▷ ①Lit I.e., the children suffer for the fathers’ sins

column.name: text
column.value: As I live,” declares the Lord ①GOD, “you certainly are not going to use this proverb in Israel anymore. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, all ①souls are Mine; the ②soul of the father as well as the ③soul of the son is Mine. The ④soul who sins will die. ▷ ①Or lives ②Or life ③Or life ④Or person

column.name: text
column.value: “But if a man is righteous and practices justice and righteousness,

column.name: text
column.value: if he does not eat at the mountain shrines or raise his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, or defile his neighbor’s wife or approach a woman during her menstrual period—

column.name: text
column.value: and if a man does not oppress anyone, but restores to the debtor his pledge, does not commit robbery, but gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked with clothing,

column.name: text
column.value: and if he does not ①lend money at interest or take ②interest, if he keeps his hand from injustice and executes true justice between one person and another, ▷ ①Lit give ②Or usury, and so throughout the ch; i.e., on other kinds of loans

column.name: text
column.value: if he walks in My statutes and keeps My ordinances so as to deal faithfully—he is righteous and will certainly live,” declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: “However, he may father a violent son who sheds blood, and does any one of these things to a brother

column.name: text
column.value: (though he himself did not do any of these things), that is, he even eats at the mountain shrines, and defiles his neighbor’s wife,

column.name: text
column.value: oppresses the poor and needy, commits robbery, does not restore a pledge, but raises his eyes to the idols and commits abomination,

column.name: text
column.value: lends money at interest and takes ①interest; will he live? He will not live! He has committed all these abominations, he shall certainly be put to death; his blood will be on himself. ▷ ①I.e., on other kinds of loans

column.name: text
column.value: “Now behold, he has fathered a son who saw all his father’s sins which he committed, but he has seen them and does not do likewise.

column.name: text
column.value: He does not eat at the mountain shrines or raise his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel; he has not defiled his neighbor’s wife,

column.name: text
column.value: nor oppressed anyone, nor retained a pledge, nor committed robbery; instead, he gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked with clothing,

column.name: text
column.value: he keeps his hand from ①the poor, does not take any kind of interest on loans, but executes My ordinances, and walks in My statutes; he will not die for his father’s guilt, he will certainly live. ▷ ①As in MT; LXX injustice

column.name: text
column.value: As for his father, because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother, and did what was not good among his people, behold, he will die for his guilt.

column.name: text
column.value: “Yet you say, ‘Why should the son not suffer the punishment for the father’s guilt?’ When the son has practiced justice and righteousness and has kept all My statutes and done them, he shall certainly live.

column.name: text
column.value: The person who sins will die. A son will not suffer the punishment for the father’s guilt, nor will a father suffer the punishment for the son’s guilt; the righteousness of the righteous will be upon himself, and the wickedness of the wicked will be upon himself.

column.name: text
column.value: “But if the wicked person turns from all his sins which he has committed and keeps all My statutes and practices justice and righteousness, he shall certainly live; he shall not die.

column.name: text
column.value: All his offenses which he has committed will not be remembered against him; because of his righteousness which he has practiced, he will live.

column.name: text
column.value: Do I take any pleasure in the death of the wicked,” declares the Lord GOD, “ ①rather than that he would turn from his ways and live? ▷ ①Lit is it not

column.name: text
column.value: “But when a righteous person turns away from his righteousness, commits injustice and does according to all the abominations that the wicked person does, will he live? All his righteous deeds which he has done will not be remembered for his treachery which he has committed and his sin which he has committed; for them he will die.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not right.’ Hear now, house of Israel! Is My way not right? Is it not your ways that are not right?

column.name: text
column.value: When a righteous person turns away from his righteousness, commits injustice and dies because of it, for his injustice which he has committed he dies.

column.name: text
column.value: But when a wicked person turns away from his wickedness which he has committed and practices justice and righteousness, he will save his life.

column.name: text
column.value: Since he understood and turned away from all his offenses which he had committed, he shall certainly live; he shall not die.

column.name: text
column.value: But the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not right.’ Are My ways not right, house of Israel? Is it not your ways that are not right?

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, each according to his conduct,” declares the Lord GOD. “Repent and turn away from all your offenses, so that wrongdoing does not become a stumbling block to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Hurl away from you all your offenses which you have committed and make yourselves a new heart and a new spirit! For why should you die, house of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: For I take no pleasure in the death of anyone who dies,” declares the Lord GOD. “Therefore, repent and live!”

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth of the month, men from the elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, and they sat before me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and say to them, ‘This is what the Lord ①GOD says: “Do you yourselves come to inquire of Me? As I live,” declares the Lord GOD, “I certainly will not be inquired of by you.” ’ ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: Will you judge them, will you judge them, son of man? Make known to them the abominations of their fathers;

column.name: text
column.value: and say to them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “On the day when I chose Israel and ①swore to the ②descendants of the house of Jacob and made Myself known to them in the land of Egypt, when I ③swore to them, saying, I am the LORD your God, ▷ ①Lit lifted up My hand, and so throughout the ch ②Lit seed ③Lit lifted up My hand, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: on that day I swore to them, to bring them out from the land of Egypt into a land that I had ①selected for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all the lands. ▷ ①Lit spied out

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to them, ‘Throw away, each of you, the detestable things of his eyes, and do not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt; I am the LORD your God.’

column.name: text
column.value: But they rebelled against Me and were not willing to listen to Me; they did not throw away, each of them, the detestable things of their eyes, nor did they abandon the idols of Egypt. “Then I ①resolved to pour out My wrath on them, to ②use up My anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt. ▷ ①Lit said ②Or finish

column.name: text
