column.value: But I acted for the sake of My name, that it would not be defiled in the sight of the nations among whom they lived, in whose sight I made Myself known to them by bringing them out of the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: So I took them out of the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: I gave them My statutes and informed them of My ordinances, which, if ①a person ②follows them, then he will live by them. ▷ ①Lit the person ②Lit does them

column.name: text
column.value: Also I gave them My Sabbaths to be a sign between Me and them, so that they might know that I am the LORD who sanctifies them.

column.name: text
column.value: But the house of Israel rebelled against Me in the wilderness. They did not walk in My statutes and they rejected My ordinances, which, if ①a person ②follows them, then he will live by them; and they greatly profaned My Sabbaths. Then I ③resolved to pour out My wrath on them in the wilderness, to annihilate them. ▷ ①Lit the person ②Lit does them ③Lit said

column.name: text
column.value: But I acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be defiled before the eyes of the nations, before whose eyes I had brought them out.

column.name: text
column.value: Also I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all the lands,

column.name: text
column.value: because they rejected My ordinances, and as for My statutes, they did not walk in them; they also profaned My Sabbaths, because their heart continually followed their idols.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet My eye spared them rather than destroying them, and I did not bring about their annihilation in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: “Instead, I said to their ①children in the wilderness, ‘Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers or keep their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols. ▷ ①Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: I am the LORD your God; walk in My statutes and keep My ordinances and ①follow them. ▷ ①Lit do

column.name: text
column.value: Sanctify My Sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between Me and you, so that you may know that I am the LORD your God.’

column.name: text
column.value: But the children rebelled against Me; they did not walk in My statutes, nor were they careful to ①follow My ordinances which, if ②a person ③follows them, then he will live by them; they profaned My Sabbaths. So I ④resolved to pour out My wrath on them, to ⑤use up My anger against them in the wilderness. ▷ ①Lit do My ②Lit the person ③Lit does them ④Lit said ⑤Or finish

column.name: text
column.value: But I withdrew My hand and acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be defiled in the sight of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.

column.name: text
column.value: Also I swore to them in the wilderness that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them among the lands,

column.name: text
column.value: because they had not ①complied with My ordinances, but had rejected My statutes and had profaned My Sabbaths, and their eyes were ②on the idols of their fathers. ▷ ①Lit done My ②Lit after

column.name: text
column.value: I also gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances by which they could not live;

column.name: text
column.value: and I pronounced them unclean because of their gifts, in that they made all ①their firstborn pass through the fire so that I might make them desolate, in order that they might know that I am the LORD.” ’ ▷ ①Lit that which opens the womb

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore speak to the house of Israel, son of man, and say to them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “Again, in this your fathers have blasphemed Me by being disloyal to Me.

column.name: text
column.value: When I had brought them into the land which I swore to give to them, then they saw every high hill and every tree thick with branches, and there they offered their sacrifices and there they presented the provocation of their offering. There also they made their soothing aroma and there they poured out their drink offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said to them, ‘What is the high place to which you go?’ So its name is called ①Bamah to this day.” ’ ▷ ①Or High Place

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, say to the house of Israel, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “Will you defile yourselves in the way of your fathers and adulterously pursue their detestable things?

column.name: text
column.value: And ①when you offer your gifts, when you make your sons pass through the fire, you are defiling yourselves with all your idols to this day. So shall I be inquired of by you, house of Israel? As I live,” declares the Lord GOD, “I certainly will not be inquired of by you. ▷ ①Lit in your lifting up

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever comes ①into your mind certainly will not come about, when you say: ‘We will be like the nations, like the families of the lands, serving wood and stone.’ ▷ ①Lit upon your spirit

column.name: text
column.value: “As I live,” declares the Lord GOD, “with a mighty hand and with an outstretched arm and with wrath poured out, I assuredly shall be king over you.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands where you are scattered, with a mighty hand and with an outstretched arm and with wrath poured out;

column.name: text
column.value: and I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face.

column.name: text
column.value: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you,” declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: “I will make you pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant;

column.name: text
column.value: and I will purge from you the rebels and those who revolt against Me; I will bring them out of the land where they reside, but they will not enter the ①land of Israel. So you will know that I am the LORD. ▷ ①Lit ground; or soil

column.name: text
column.value: “As for you, house of Israel,” this is what the Lord GOD says: “Go, serve, everyone of you his idols; ①but later you will certainly listen to Me, and My holy name you will no longer defile with your gifts and your idols. ▷ ①Or and afterward, if you will not listen to Me, but

column.name: text
column.value: For on My holy mountain, on the high mountain of Israel,” declares the Lord GOD, “there the entire house of Israel, all of them, will serve Me in the land; there I will accept them and there I will demand your contributions and the choicest of your gifts, with all your holy things.

column.name: text
column.value: ①As a soothing aroma I will accept you when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands where you are scattered; and I will show Myself to be holy among you in the sight of the nations. ▷ ①Lit With

column.name: text
column.value: And you will know that I am the LORD, when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the land which I swore to give to your forefathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And there you will remember your ways and all your deeds by which you have defiled yourselves; and you will loathe yourselves in your own ①sight for all the evil things that you have done. ▷ ①Lit faces

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I have dealt with you in behalf of My name, not according to your evil ways or according to your corrupt deeds, house of Israel,” declares the Lord GOD.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: ①Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying, ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, set your face toward the south, and speak prophetically against the south and prophesy against the forest ①land of the Negev, ▷ ①Lit of the field

column.name: text
column.value: and say to the forest of the Negev, ‘Hear the word of the LORD: this is what the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am going to kindle a fire in you, and it will consume every ①green tree in you, as well as every dry tree; the blazing flame will not go out and ②the entire surface from south to north will be scorched by it. ▷ ①Lit moist ②Or all the faces

column.name: text
column.value: And all ①mankind will see that I, the LORD, have kindled it; it will not go out.” ’ ” ▷ ①Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, “Oh, Lord GOD! They are saying of me, ‘Is he not just speaking in riddles?’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “And you, son of man, will you judge, will you judge the bloody city? Then inform her of all her abominations.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall say, ‘This is what the Lord ①GOD says: “A city shedding blood in her midst, so that her time is coming; and a city that makes idols, contrary to her own good, for defilement! ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: You have become guilty by ①the blood which you have shed, and you have become defiled by your idols which you have made. So you have brought your days closer and have come to your years; therefore I have made you a disgrace to the nations, and an object of mocking to all the lands. ▷ ①Lit your

column.name: text
column.value: Those who are near and those who are far from you will make fun of you, you of ill repute, full of turmoil.

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, the rulers of Israel, each according to his ①power, have been among you for the purpose of shedding blood. ▷ ①Lit arm

column.name: text
column.value: They have treated father and mother with contempt among you. They have oppressed the stranger in your midst; they have oppressed the orphan and the widow among you.

column.name: text
column.value: You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths.

column.name: text
column.value: Slanderous men have been among you for the purpose of shedding blood, and among you they have eaten at the mountain shrines. In your midst they have committed outrageous sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Among you ①they have uncovered their fathers’ nakedness; among you they have abused her who was unclean in her menstruation. ▷ ①Lit he has

column.name: text
column.value: And one has committed abomination with his neighbor’s wife, another has outrageously defiled his daughter-in-law, and another among you has sexually abused his sister, his father’s daughter.

column.name: text
column.value: Among you they have taken bribes to shed blood; you have taken ①interest, you have injured your neighbors by oppression, and you have forgotten Me,” declares the Lord GOD. ▷ ①Possibly interest on money and food loans

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, then, I strike with My hand your profit which you have made and ①the bloodshed which is among you. ▷ ①Lit your

column.name: text
column.value: Can your heart endure, or can your hands be strong for the days that I will deal with you? I, the LORD, have spoken and will act.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you among the lands, and I will eliminate your uncleanness from you.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will defile yourself in the sight of the nations, and you will know that I am the LORD.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, the house of Israel has become ①waste metal to Me; all of them are bronze, tin, iron, and lead in the smelting furnace; they are the ②waste metal of silver. ▷ ①Lit dross ②Lit dross

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because all of you have become ①waste metal, therefore, behold, I am going to gather you into the midst of Jerusalem. ▷ ①Lit dross

column.name: text
column.value: As they gather silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin into the smelting furnace to blow fire on it in order to melt it, so I will gather you in My anger and in My wrath, and I will place you there and melt you.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will gather you and blow on you with the fire of My wrath, and you will be melted in the midst of it.

column.name: text
column.value: As silver is melted in the furnace, so you will be melted in the midst of it; and you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out My wrath on you.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, say to her, ‘You are a land that is not clean or rained on in the day of indignation.’

column.name: text
column.value: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in her midst like a roaring lion tearing the prey. They have devoured lives; they have taken treasure and precious things; they have made many widows in the midst of her.

column.name: text
column.value: Her priests have done violence to My Law and have profaned My holy things; they have made no distinction between the holy and the ①common, and they have not taught the difference between the unclean and the clean; and they have closed their eyes from My Sabbaths, and I am defiled among them. ▷ ①Lit profane

column.name: text
column.value: Her leaders within her are like wolves tearing the prey, by shedding blood and destroying lives in order to make dishonest profit.

column.name: text
column.value: And her prophets have coated with whitewash for them, seeing false visions and divining lies for them, saying, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ when the LORD has not spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: The people of the land have practiced extortion and committed robbery, and they have oppressed the poor and needy, and have oppressed the stranger without justice.

column.name: text
column.value: I searched for a man among them who would build up a wall and stand in the gap before Me for the land, so that I would not destroy it; but I found ①no one. ▷ ①Lit not

column.name: text
column.value: So I have poured out My indignation on them; I have consumed them with the fire of My wrath; I have brought their way upon their heads,” declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: ①And the word of the LORD came to me, saying, ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, set your face against Jerusalem, and ①speak prophetically against the sanctuaries and prophesy against the land of Israel; ▷ ①Lit flow

column.name: text
column.value: and say to the land of Israel, ‘This is what the LORD says: “Behold, I am against you; and I will draw My sword from its sheath and cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: Because I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore My sword will go out from its sheath against ①humanity from south to north. ▷ ①Lit all flesh

column.name: text
column.value: So ①humanity will know that I, the LORD, have drawn My sword from its sheath. It will not return to its sheath again.” ’ ▷ ①Lit all flesh

column.name: text
column.value: As for you, son of man, groan with ①a breaking heart and bitter grief; you shall groan in their sight. ▷ ①Lit shaking hips

column.name: text
column.value: And when they say to you, ‘Why are you groaning?’ you shall say, ‘Because of the news, for it is coming; and every heart will melt, all hands will go limp, every spirit will be disheartened, and all ①knees will drip with water. Behold, it is coming and it will happen,’ declares the Lord ②GOD.” ▷ ①Heb idiom meaning to wet oneself ②Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, prophesy and say, ‘This is what the LORD says:’ Say, ‘A sword, a sword sharpened And also polished!

column.name: text
column.value: Sharpened to make a slaughter, Polished ①to flash like lightning!’ Or shall we rejoice, the ②rod of My son despising every tree? ▷ ①Lit that lightning may be to her ②Or scepter

column.name: text
column.value: And it is given to be polished, so that it may be handled; the sword is sharpened and polished, to hand it over to the slaughterer.

column.name: text
column.value: Cry out and wail, son of man; for it is against My people, it is against all the officials of Israel. They are turned over to the sword with My people, therefore ①slap your thigh. ▷ ①I.e., in grief

column.name: text
column.value: For there is a testing; and what if even the ①rod which despises will cease to be?” declares the Lord GOD. ▷ ①Or scepter

column.name: text
column.value: “You therefore, son of man, prophesy and clap your hands; and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword for the slain. It is the sword for the great one slain, which surrounds them,

column.name: text
column.value: so that their hearts will waver, and many fall at all their gates. I have granted the slaughter of the sword. Oh! It is made for striking like lightning, it is sharpened in readiness for slaughter.

column.name: text
column.value: Prove yourself sharp, go to the right; set yourself; go to the left, wherever your ①edge is ordered. ▷ ①Lit face

column.name: text
column.value: I will also clap My hands, and I will satisfy My wrath; I, the LORD, have spoken.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Now as for you, son of man, ①make two ways for the sword of the king of Babylon to come; both of them will go out of one land. And ②make a signpost; ③make it at the head of the way to the city. ▷ ①Or set for yourself ②Lit cut out a hand ③Lit cut it

column.name: text
column.value: You shall ①mark a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the sons of Ammon, and to Judah into fortified Jerusalem. ▷ ①Lit set

column.name: text
column.value: For the king of Babylon stands at the ①parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination; he shakes the arrows, he consults the ②household idols, he looks at the liver. ▷ ①Lit mother ②Heb teraphim

column.name: text
column.value: Into his right hand came the divination, ‘Jerusalem,’ to set up battering rams, to open the mouth ①for ②slaughter, to raise the voice with a battle cry, to set up battering rams against the gates, to pile up assault ramps, to build a siege wall. ▷ ①Lit in ②Another reading is war-cry

column.name: text
column.value: And it will be to them like a false divination in their eyes; they have sworn solemn oaths. But he makes guilt known, so that they may be seized.

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have made your guilt known, in that your offenses are uncovered, so that in all your deeds your sins are seen—because you have come to mind, you will be seized by the hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And you, slain, wicked one, the prince of Israel, whose day has come, in the time of the ①punishment of the end,’ ▷ ①Or wrongdoing

column.name: text
column.value: this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Remove the ①turban and take off the crown; this will ②no longer be the same. Exalt that which is low, and humble that which is high. ▷ ①Or headband ②Lit not this

column.name: text
column.value: Ruins, ruins, ruins, I will make it! This also will be no longer until He comes whose right it is, and I will give it to Him.’

column.name: text
column.value: “And you, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says concerning the sons of Ammon and their taunting,’ and say: ‘A sword, a sword is drawn, sharpened for the slaughter, to make it ①consume, so that it may be like lightning— ▷ ①Lit finish

column.name: text
column.value: while they see false visions for you, while they divine lies for you—to place you on the necks of the wicked who are killed, whose day has come, in the time of the ①punishment of the end. ▷ ①Or wrongdoing

column.name: text
column.value: Return it to its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your origin, I will judge you.

column.name: text
column.value: I will pour out My indignation on you; I will blow on you with the fire of My wrath, and I will hand you over to brutal men, craftsmen of destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: You will be ①fuel for the fire; your blood will be in the midst of the land. You will not be remembered, for I, the LORD, have spoken.’ ” ▷ ①Lit food

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me again, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother;

column.name: text
column.value: and they prostituted themselves in Egypt. They prostituted themselves in their youth; there their breasts were squeezed and there their virgin breasts were handled.

column.name: text
column.value: Their names were Oholah the elder and Oholibah her sister. And they became Mine, and they gave birth to sons and daughters. And as for their names, Samaria is Oholah and Jerusalem is Oholibah.

column.name: text
column.value: “Oholah prostituted herself ①while she was Mine; and she lusted after her lovers, after the Assyrians, her neighbors, ▷ ①Lit under Me

column.name: text
column.value: who were clothed in purple, governors and officials, all of them handsome young men, horsemen riding on horses.

column.name: text
column.value: She bestowed her ①obscene practices on them, all of whom were the choicest ②men of Assyria; and with all whom she lusted after, with all their idols she defiled herself. ▷ ①Lit fornications ②Lit sons of Asshur

column.name: text
column.value: She did not abandon her obscene practices from the time in Egypt; for in her youth ①men had slept with her, and they handled her virgin breasts and poured out their obscene practice on her. ▷ ①Lit they

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, I handed her over to her lovers, to the ①Assyrians, after whom she lusted. ▷ ①Lit sons of Asshur

column.name: text
column.value: They uncovered her nakedness; they took her sons and her daughters, but they killed her with the sword. So she became a ①subject of gossip among women, and they executed judgments on her. ▷ ①Lit name

column.name: text
column.value: “Now her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she was more corrupt in her lust than she, and her obscene practices were ①more than the prostitution of her sister. ▷ ①I.e., more numerous, or worse

column.name: text
column.value: She lusted after the ①Assyrians, governors and officials, the ones near, opulently dressed, horsemen riding on horses, all of them handsome young men. ▷ ①Lit sons of Asshur

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw that she had defiled herself; they both took ①the same way. ▷ ①Lit one

column.name: text
column.value: So she increased her obscene practices. And she saw men carved on the wall, images of the Chaldeans drawn in bright red,

column.name: text
column.value: wearing belts around their waists, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them looking like officers, ①like the ②Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their birth. ▷ ①Lit the likeness of ②Lit sons of Babel

column.name: text
column.value: And ①when she saw them she lusted after them and sent messengers to them in Chaldea. ▷ ①Lit at the sight of her eyes

column.name: text
column.value: And the ①Babylonians came to her to the bed of love and defiled her with their obscene practice. And when she had been defiled by them, ②she turned away from them in disgust. ▷ ①Lit sons of Babel ②Lit her soul

column.name: text
column.value: She exposed her obscene practices and exposed her nakedness; then ①I turned away from her in disgust, just as ②I had turned away from her sister in disgust. ▷ ①Lit My soul ②Lit My soul

column.name: text
column.value: Yet she multiplied her obscene practices, remembering the days of her youth, when she prostituted herself in the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: She lusted after their lovers, whose flesh is like the flesh of donkeys and whose discharge is like the discharge of horses.

column.name: text
column.value: So you longed for the outrageous sin of your youth, when ①the Egyptians handled your breasts because of the breasts of your youth. ▷ ①As in two mss; MT from Egypt

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Lord ①GOD says: ‘Behold I am going to incite your lovers against you, from whom ②you turned away in disgust, and I will bring them against you from every side: ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch ②Lit your soul

column.name: text
column.value: the ①Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, and all the ②Assyrians with them; handsome young men, governors and officials all of them, officers and ③men of renown, all of them riding on horses. ▷ ①Lit sons of Babylon ②Lit sons of Assyria ③Lit called ones

column.name: text
column.value: And they will come against you with weapons, chariots, and ①wagons, and with a contingent of peoples. They will attack you on every side with shield, ②buckler, and helmet; and I will commit the judgment to them, and they will judge you according to their customs. ▷ ①Lit wheel ②I.e., small shield

column.name: text
column.value: I will set My jealousy against you, so that they may deal with you in wrath. They will remove your nose and your ears; and your ①survivors will fall by the sword. They will take your sons and your daughters; and your ②survivors will be consumed by the fire. ▷ ①Lit remainder ②Lit remainder

column.name: text
column.value: They will also strip you of your clothes and take away your beautiful jewelry.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will remove from you your outrageous sin and your prostitution that you brought from the land of Egypt, so that you will not raise your eyes to them or remember Egypt anymore.’

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am going to hand you over to those whom you hate, to those from whom ①you turned away in disgust. ▷ ①Lit your soul

column.name: text
column.value: They will deal with you in hatred, take all your property, and leave you naked and bare. And the nakedness of your prostitution will be exposed, both your outrageous sin and your obscene practices.

column.name: text
column.value: These things will be done to you because you have adulterously pursued the nations, because you have defiled yourself with their idols.

column.name: text
column.value: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will put her cup in your hand.’

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘You will drink your sister’s cup, Which is deep and wide. ①You will be laughed at and held in derision; Because it contains much. ▷ ①Or It will be for laughter and derision because of its great size

column.name: text
column.value: You will be filled with drunkenness and grief, A cup of horror and desolation, The cup of your sister Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: And you will drink it and drain it. Then you will gnaw on its fragments And tear your breasts; for I have spoken,’ declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have forgotten Me and discarded Me behind your back, suffer on your own part the punishment for your outrageous sin and your obscene practices.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the LORD said to me, “Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.

column.name: text
column.value: For they have committed adultery, and blood is on their hands. So they have committed adultery with their idols, and even made their sons, whom they bore to Me, pass through the fire to ①them as food. ▷ ①I.e., the idols

column.name: text
column.value: Again, they have done this to Me: they have defiled My sanctuary on the same day, and have profaned My Sabbaths.

column.name: text
column.value: For when they slaughtered their children for their idols, they entered My sanctuary on the same day to profane it; and behold, this is what they did within My house.

column.name: text
column.value: “Furthermore, ①they have even sent for men who come from a great distance, to whom a messenger was sent; and behold, they came—for whom you bathed, put makeup on your eyes, and adorned yourselves with jewelry; ▷ ①Or you (women)

column.name: text
column.value: and you sat on a splendid couch with a table arranged in front of it on which you had set My incense and My oil.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sound of a ①carefree multitude was with her; and heavy drinkers were brought from the wilderness with people from the multitude of humanity. And they put bracelets on ②the wrists of the women and beautiful crowns on their heads. ▷ ①Lit at ease ②Lit their hands

column.name: text
column.value: “Then I said concerning her who was worn out by adulteries, ‘ ①Will they now commit adultery with her when she is like this?’ ▷ ①Or Now they will commit adultery with her, and she with them

column.name: text
column.value: ①But they went in to her as they would go in to a prostitute. This is how they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the lewd women. ▷ ①Or And

column.name: text
column.value: But they, righteous people, will judge them with the judgment of adulteresses and with the judgment of women who shed blood, because they are adulteresses and blood is on their hands.

column.name: text
column.value: “For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Bring up a contingent against them and turn them over to terror and plunder.

column.name: text
column.value: The contingent will stone them with stones and cut them down with their swords; they will kill their sons and their daughters and burn their houses with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will eliminate outrageous conduct from the land, so that all women will take warning and not commit ①outrageous sin as you have done. ▷ ①Lit according to your lewdness

column.name: text
column.value: Your outrageous conduct ①will be repaid to you, and you will bear the guilt for your idols; so you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’ ” ▷ ①Lit they will give

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, set your face against the sons of Ammon and prophesy against them,

column.name: text
column.value: and say to the sons of Ammon, ‘Hear the word of the Lord ①GOD! This is what the Lord GOD says: “Because you said, ‘Aha!’ against My sanctuary when it was profaned, and against the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and against the house of Judah when they went into exile, ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: therefore, behold, I am going to give you to the ①people of the east as a possession, and they will set up their encampments among you and make their dwellings among you; they will eat your fruit and drink your milk. ▷ ①Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: I will make Rabbah a pasture for camels, and the sons of Ammon a resting place for flocks. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the Lord GOD says: “Because you have clapped your hands and stamped your feet, and have rejoiced with all the malice in your soul against the land of Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: therefore, behold, I have reached out with My hand against you and I will give you as plunder to the nations. And I will cut you off from the peoples and eliminate you from the lands. I will exterminate you. So you will know that I am the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: ‘The Lord GOD says this: “Because Moab and Seir say, ‘Behold, the house of Judah is like all the nations,’

column.name: text
column.value: therefore, behold, I am going to ①deprive the flank of Moab of its cities, of its cities ②which are on its frontiers, the glory of the land, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim; ▷ ①Lit open ②Lit from its end

column.name: text
column.value: and I will give it as a possession along with the sons of Ammon to the ①people of the east, so that the sons of Ammon will not be remembered among the nations. ▷ ①Lit sons

column.name: text
column.value: So I will execute judgments on Moab, and they will know that I am the LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: ‘The Lord GOD says this: “Because Edom has acted against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has incurred great guilt, and avenged themselves upon them,”

column.name: text
column.value: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: “I will also reach out with My hand against Edom and eliminate human and animal life from it. And I will turn it into ruins; from Teman even to Dedan they will fall by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will inflict My vengeance on Edom by the hand of My people Israel. Therefore, they will act in Edom in accordance with My anger and My wrath; so they will know My vengeance,” declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “Because the Philistines have acted in revenge, and have taken vengeance with malice in their souls to destroy with everlasting hostility,”

column.name: text
column.value: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am going to reach out with My hand against the Philistines and eliminate the Cherethites; and I will destroy the remnant of the seacoast.

column.name: text
column.value: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes; and they will know that I am the LORD, when I inflict My vengeance on them.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the eleventh year, on the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, because Tyre has said in regard to Jerusalem, ‘Aha! The gateway of the peoples is broken; it has ①opened to me. I shall be filled, now that she is laid waste,’ ▷ ①Lit turned

column.name: text
column.value: therefore this is what the Lord ①GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring up many nations against you, as the sea brings up its waves. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: They will destroy the walls of Tyre and tear down her towers; and I will sweep her debris away from her and make her a bare rock.

column.name: text
column.value: She will become a dry place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea, for I have spoken,’ declares the Lord GOD; ‘and she will become plunder for the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Also her daughters who are ①on the mainland will be killed by the sword, and they will know that I am the LORD.’ ” ▷ ①Lit in the field

column.name: text
column.value: For the Lord GOD says this: “Behold, I am going to bring upon Tyre from the north Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, with horses, chariots, cavalry, and ①a great army. ▷ ①Lit an assembly, even many people

column.name: text
column.value: He will kill your daughters ①on the mainland with the sword; and he will make siege walls against you, pile up an assault ramp against you, and raise up a large shield against you. ▷ ①Lit in the field

column.name: text
column.value: And he will direct the blow of his battering rams against your walls, and he will tear down your towers with his ①axes. ▷ ①Or crowbars

column.name: text
column.value: Because of the multitude of his horses, the dust raised by them will cover you; your walls will shake from the noise of cavalry, ①wagons, and chariots when he enters your gates as warriors enter a city that is breached. ▷ ①Lit wheel

column.name: text
column.value: With the hoofs of his horses he will trample all your streets. He will kill your people with the sword, and your strong ①pillars will go down to the ground. ▷ ①Or memorial stones (in Tyre’s temple)

column.name: text
column.value: Also they will take your riches as spoils and plunder your merchandise, tear down your walls and destroy your delightful houses, and ①throw your stones, your timbers, and your debris into the water. ▷ ①Lit put

column.name: text
column.value: So I will put an end to the sound of your songs, and the sound of your harps will no longer be heard.

column.name: text
column.value: I will turn you into a bare rock; you will become a dry place for the spreading of nets. You will not be rebuilt, for I the LORD have spoken,” declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord GOD says this to Tyre: “Will the coastlands not shake from the sound of your downfall when the wounded groan, when the slaughter takes place in your midst?

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the princes of the sea will descend from their thrones, remove their robes, and strip off their colorfully woven garments. They will clothe themselves with ①trembling; they will sit on the ground, tremble again and again, and be appalled at you. ▷ ①Lit tremblings

column.name: text
column.value: And they will take up a song of mourning over you and say to you, ‘How you have perished, you inhabited one, From the seas, you famous city, Which was mighty on the sea, She and her inhabitants, Who imposed ①her terror On all her inhabitants! ▷ ①Lit their

column.name: text
column.value: Now the coastlands will tremble On the day of your downfall; Yes, the coastlands which are by the sea Will be horrified at your passing.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the Lord GOD says: “When I make you a desolate city, like the cities which are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep over you and the great waters cover you,

column.name: text
column.value: then I will bring you down with those who go down to the pit, to the people of old, and I will make you remain in the lower parts of the earth, like the ancient ruins, with those who go down to the pit, so that you will not ①be inhabited; but I will put glory in the land of the living. ▷ ①Another reading is return

column.name: text
column.value: I will ①cause you sudden terrors and you will no longer exist; though you will be sought, you will never be found again,” declares the Lord GOD. ▷ ①Lit give

column.name: text
column.value: Now the word of the LORD came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, write the name of the day, this very day. The king of Babylon ①has laid siege to Jerusalem this very day. ▷ ①Lit leaned on

column.name: text
text
column.value: ①Put in it the pieces of meat, Every good piece, the thigh and the shoulder; Fill it with choice bones. ▷ ①Lit Gather her pieces

column.name: text
column.value: Take the choicest of the flock, And also stack ①wood under ②the pot. Make it boil vigorously. Also boil its bones in it.” ▷ ①Cf. v 10; MT bones ②Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: “Woe to the bloody city, To the pot in which there is rust And whose rust has not gone out of it! Take out of it piece after piece, ①Without making a choice. ▷ ①Lit No lot has fallen on it

column.name: text
text
column.value: So that it may cause wrath to come up to take vengeance, I have put her blood on the bare rock, So that it will not be covered.”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: “Woe to the bloody city! I also will make the wood pile great.

column.name: text
column.value: Heap on the wood, kindle the fire, ①Cook the meat thoroughly And mix in the spices, And let the bones be burned up. ▷ ①Lit Finish

column.name: text
column.value: Then set it empty on its burning coals So that it may be hot And its bronze may ①glow, And its filthiness may be melted in it, Its rust eliminated. ▷ ①Lit burn

column.name: text
text
column.value: In your filthiness is outrageous sin. Because I would have cleansed you, Yet you are not clean, You will not be cleansed from your filthiness again Until I have ①expended My wrath on you. ▷ ①Lit caused to rest

column.name: text
column.value: I, the LORD, have spoken; it is coming and I will act. I will not overlook, I will not pity, and I will not be sorry; according to your ways and according to your deeds ①I will judge you,” declares the Lord GOD.’ ” ▷ ①As in several mss and ancient versions; MT they

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, behold, I am about to take from you what is precious to your eyes with a fatal blow; but you shall not mourn and you shall not weep, and your tears shall not come.

column.name: text
column.value: Groan silently; do no mourning for the dead. Bind on your turban and put your sandals on your feet, and do not ①cover your mustache, and do not eat the ②bread of other people.” ▷ ①Covering the beard and mustache was a mourning custom ②I.e., food from others for mourners

column.name: text
column.value: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and in the evening my wife died. And in the morning I did as I was commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people said to me, “Will you not tell us what these things mean for us, that you are doing?”

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said to them, “The word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Speak to the house of Israel, “This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am about to profane My sanctuary, the pride of your power, that which is precious in your eyes and the longing of your soul; and your sons and your daughters whom you have left behind will fall by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: And you will do just as I have done; you will not ①cover your mustache, and you will not eat the ②bread of other people. ▷ ①See note 1 v 17 ②See note 2 v 17

column.name: text
column.value: Your turbans will be on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You will not mourn and you will not weep; but you will rot away in your guilty deeds, and you will groan ①to one another. ▷ ①Lit each to his brother

column.name: text
column.value: So Ezekiel will be a sign to you; according to all that he has done, you will do. When it comes, then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: ‘As for you, son of man, will it not be on the day when I take from them their stronghold, the joy of their splendor, that which is precious in their eyes and their ①heart’s longing, their sons and their daughters, ▷ ①Lit soul’s burden

column.name: text
column.value: that on that day the one who escapes will come to you with information for your ears?

column.name: text
column.value: On that day your mouth will be opened to him who escaped, and you will speak and no longer be silenced. So you will be a sign to them, and they will know that I am the LORD.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “And you, son of man, take up a song of mourning over Tyre;

column.name: text
column.value: and say to Tyre, who sits at the ①entrance to the sea, merchant of the peoples to many coastlands, ‘This is what the Lord ②GOD says: “Tyre, you have said, ‘I am perfect in beauty.’ ▷ ①Lit entrances ②Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: Your borders are in the heart of the seas; Your builders have perfected your beauty.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: Your sail was of colorfully embroidered linen from Egypt So that it became your flag; Your ①awning was violet and purple from the coastlands of Elishah. ▷ ①Lit covering

column.name: text
text
column.value: The elders of Gebal and her wise men were with you repairing your leaks; All the ships of the sea and their sailors were with you in order to deal in your merchandise.

column.name: text
column.value: “Persia, Lud, and Put were in your army, your men of war. They hung up shield and helmet on you; they presented your splendor.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Arvad and your army were on your walls, all around, and the ①Gammadim were in your towers. They hung their shields on your walls all around; they perfected your beauty. ▷ ①Or guardians

column.name: text
column.value: “Tarshish was your customer because of the abundance of all kinds of wealth; with silver, iron, tin, and lead they paid for your merchandise.

column.name: text
column.value: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were your traders; with human lives and vessels of bronze they paid for your merchandise.

column.name: text
column.value: Those from Beth-togarmah gave horses, war horses, and mules for your merchandise.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Dedan were your traders. Many coastlands were ①your market; they brought ivory tusks and ebony as your payment. ▷ ①Lit the market of your hand

column.name: text
column.value: Aram was your customer because of the abundance of your ①goods; they paid for your merchandise with ②emeralds, purple, colorfully woven cloth, fine linen, coral, and rubies. ▷ ①Lit works ②Uncertain, perhaps malachite

column.name: text
column.value: Judah and the land of Israel, they were your traders; with the wheat of Minnith, ①cakes, honey, oil, and balsam they paid for your merchandise. ▷ ①Heb pannag

column.name: text
column.value: Damascus was your customer because of the abundance of your ①goods, because of the abundance of all kinds of wealth, because of the wine of Helbon and white wool. ▷ ①Lit works

column.name: text
column.value: Vedan and Javan paid for your merchandise from Uzal; wrought iron, cassia, and spice reed were among your merchandise.

column.name: text
column.value: Dedan traded with you in saddlecloths for riding.

column.name: text
column.value: Arabia and all the princes of Kedar, they were ①your customers for lambs, rams, and goats; for these they were your customers. ▷ ①Lit customers of your hand

column.name: text
column.value: The traders of Sheba and Raamah, they traded with you; they paid for your merchandise with the best of all balsam oil, and with all kinds of precious stones, and gold.

column.name: text
column.value: Haran, Canneh, Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad traded with you.

column.name: text
column.value: They traded with you in choice garments, in clothes of violet and colorfully woven cloth, and in blankets of two colors, and tightly wound cords, which were among your merchandise.

column.name: text
column.value: The ships of Tarshish were ①the carriers for your merchandise. And you were filled and were very ②glorious In the heart of the seas. ▷ ①Lit your travelers ②Lit honored

column.name: text
column.value: “Your rowers have brought you Into great waters; The east wind has broken you In the heart of the seas.

column.name: text
column.value: Your wealth, your wares, your merchandise, Your seamen and your sailors, Your repairers of leaks, your dealers in merchandise, And all your men of war who are in you, With all your contingent that is in your midst, Will fall into the heart of the seas On the day of your overthrow.

column.name: text
column.value: At the sound of the cry of your sailors, The pasture lands will shake.

column.name: text
column.value: All who handle the oar, The seamen and all the sailors of the sea Will come down from their ships; They will stand on the land,

column.name: text
column.value: And they will make their voice heard over you And cry out bitterly. They will throw dust on their heads, They will wallow in ashes.

column.name: text
column.value: Also they will shave themselves bald for you And put on sackcloth; And they will weep for you in bitterness of soul With bitter mourning.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, in their wailing they will take up a song of mourning for you And sing a song of mourning over you: ‘Who is like Tyre, Like her who is silent in the midst of the sea?

column.name: text
column.value: When your merchandise went out from the seas, You satisfied many peoples; With the abundance of your wealth and your merchandise You enriched the kings of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Now that you are broken by the seas In the depths of the waters, Your merchandise and all your company Have fallen in the midst of you. ▷ ①Lit The time

column.name: text
column.value: All the inhabitants of the coastlands Are appalled at you, And their kings are horribly afraid; They ①have a troubled look. ▷ ①Lit are troubled in face

column.name: text
column.value: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you; You have become ①terrified And you will cease to be forever.’ ” ’ ” ▷ ①Lit terrors

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, say to the ①leader of Tyre, ‘The Lord ②GOD says this: “Because your heart is haughty And you have said, ‘I am a god, I sit in the seat of ③gods In the heart of the seas’; Yet you are a mortal and not God, Although you make your heart like the heart of God— ▷ ①Or ruler, prince ②Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch ③Or God

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, you are wiser than Daniel; There is no secret that is a match for you!

column.name: text
column.value: By your wisdom and understanding You have acquired riches for yourself And have acquired gold and silver for your treasuries.

column.name: text
column.value: By your great wisdom, by your trade You have increased your riches, And your heart is haughty because of your riches—

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have made your heart Like the heart of God,

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, behold, I am going to bring strangers against you, The most ruthless of the nations. And they will draw their swords Against the beauty of your wisdom And profane your splendor.

column.name: text
column.value: They will bring you down to the pit, And you will die the death of those who are killed In the heart of the seas.

column.name: text
column.value: Will you still say, “I am a god,” In the presence of one who kills you, Though you are a mortal and not God, In the hands of those who wound you?

column.name: text
column.value: You will die the death of the uncircumcised By the hand of strangers, For I have spoken!’ declares the Lord GOD!” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, take up a song of mourning over the king of Tyre and say to him, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “You ①had the seal of ②perfection, Full of wisdom and perfect in beauty. ▷ ①Lit were the one sealing ②Or a pattern

column.name: text
text
column.value: You were the anointed cherub who ①covers, And I placed you there. You were on the holy mountain of God; You walked in the midst of the stones of fire. ▷ ①Or guards

column.name: text
column.value: You were blameless in your ways From the day you were created Until unrighteousness was found in you.

column.name: text
column.value: By the abundance of your trade ①You were internally filled with violence, And you sinned; Therefore I have cast you as profane From the mountain of God. And I have destroyed you, you ②covering cherub, From the midst of the stones of fire. ▷ ①Lit They filled your midst ②Or guardian

column.name: text
text
column.value: By the multitude of your wrongdoings, In the unrighteousness of your trade You profaned your sanctuaries. Therefore I have brought fire from the midst of you; It has consumed you, And I have turned you to ashes on the earth In the eyes of all who see you.

column.name: text
column.value: All who know you among the peoples Are appalled at you; You have become ①terrified And you will cease to be forever.” ’ ” ▷ ①Lit terrors

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, prophesy against her

column.name: text
column.value: and say, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Sidon, And I will appear in My glory in your midst. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I execute judgments against her, And I will reveal Myself as holy in her.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will send a plague to her And blood to her streets, And the wounded will ①fall in her midst By the sword upon her on every side; Then they will know that I am the LORD. ▷ ①Or be judged

column.name: text
column.value: And there will no longer be for the house of Israel a painful thorn or a hurtful thorn bush from any surrounding them who despised them; then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.”

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and show Myself holy among them in the sight of the nations, then they will live on their land which I gave to My servant Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: They will live on it securely; and they will build houses, plant vineyards, and live securely when I execute judgments upon all around them who despise them. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Speak and say, ‘This is what the Lord ①GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, The great ②monster that lies in the midst of his ③canals, That has said, ‘My Nile is mine, and I myself have made it.’ ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch ②Heb tannim ③Or Nile

column.name: text
column.value: I will put hooks in your jaws And make the fish of your ①canals cling to your scales. And I will bring you up out of the midst of your ②canals, And all the fish of your ③canals will cling to your scales. ▷ ①Or Nile ②Or Nile ③Or Nile

column.name: text
column.value: I will abandon you to the wilderness, you and all the fish of your ①canals; You will fall on the ②open field; you will not be brought together or ③gathered. I have given you for food to the animals of the earth and to the birds of the sky. ▷ ①Or Nile ②Lit faces of the field ③Or with several mss and Targum, buried

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am the LORD, Because they have been only a staff made of reed to the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: When they took hold of you with the hand, You broke and tore all their ①hands; And when they leaned on you, You broke and made all their hips ②shake.” ▷ ①As in some ancient versions; MT shoulders ②Cf. ancient versions; MT stand

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Therefore the Lord GOD says this: “Behold, I am going to bring upon you a sword, and I will cut off from you human and animal life.

column.name: text
column.value: The land of Egypt will become a desolation and place of ruins. Then they will know that I am the LORD. “Because ①you said, ‘The Nile is mine, and I have made it,’ ▷ ①As in ancient versions; MT he

column.name: text
column.value: therefore, behold, I am against you and against your ①canals, and I will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation, from Migdol to Syene and as far as the border of ②Cush. ▷ ①Or Nile ②Or Ethiopia

column.name: text
column.value: A human foot will not pass through it, nor will the foot of an animal pass through it, and it will not be inhabited for forty years.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the midst of deserted lands. And her cities, in the midst of cities that are laid waste, will be desolate for forty years; and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them among the lands.”

column.name: text
column.value: ‘For this is what the Lord GOD says: “At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples ①among whom they were scattered. ▷ ①Lit where

column.name: text
column.value: And I will restore the fortunes of Egypt and bring them back to the land of Pathros, to the land of their origin, and there they will be a lowly kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: It will be the lowest of the kingdoms, and it will not raise itself above the nations again. And I will make them small so that they will not rule over the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: And it will no longer be a kingdom on which the house of Israel relies, ①bringing to mind the guilt of their having turned ②to Egypt. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.” ’ ” ▷ ①Lit causing to remember ②Lit after them

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, on the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made his army labor ①hard against Tyre; every head ②had a bald spot and every shoulder was rubbed raw. But he and his army acquired no wages from Tyre for the labor that he had ③performed against it.” ▷ ①Lit a great labor ②I.e., injuries from the labor ③Lit labored

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am going to give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. And he will carry off her wealth and capture her spoils and seize her plunder; and it will be wages for his army.

column.name: text
column.value: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labor which he ①performed, because they acted for Me,” declares the Lord GOD. ▷ ①Lit labored

column.name: text
column.value: “On that day I will make a horn sprout for the house of Israel, and I will ①open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.” ▷ ①Lit give you an opening of the mouth

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Lord ①GOD says: “Wail, ‘Woe for the day!’ ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: For the day is near, Indeed, the day of the LORD is near; It will be a day of clouds, A time of doom for the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: A sword will come upon Egypt, And there will be trembling in ①Cush; When the slain fall in Egypt, They will take away her ②wealth, And her foundations will be torn down. ▷ ①Or Ethiopia ②Or multitude

column.name: text
column.value: ①Cush, Put, Lud, all ②Arabia, ③Libya and the ④people of the land ⑤that is in league will fall with them by the sword.” ▷ ①Or Ethiopia ②Or the mixed people ③Or Cub ④Lit sons ⑤Lit of the covenant

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the LORD says: “Indeed, those who support Egypt will fall And the pride of her power will come down; From Migdol to Syene They will fall within her by the sword,” Declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: “They will be desolate In the midst of the desolated lands; And her cities will be In the midst of the devastated cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And they will know that I am the LORD, When I set a fire in Egypt And all her helpers are broken.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day messengers will go out from Me in ships to frighten carefree ①Cush; and trembling will come on them as on the day of Egypt; for behold, it is coming!” ▷ ①Or Ethiopia

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “I will also make the ①hordes of Egypt cease By the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. ▷ ①Or people; lit crowd, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: He and his people with him, The most ruthless of the nations, Will be brought in to destroy the land; And they will draw their swords against Egypt And fill the land with the slain.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, I will make the Nile canals dry And sell the land into the hands of evil men. And I will make the land desolate And ①all that is in it, By the hand of strangers; I the LORD have spoken.” ▷ ①Lit her fullness

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “I will also destroy the idols And make the ①images cease from ②Memphis. And there will no longer be a prince in the land of Egypt; And I will put fear in the land of Egypt. ▷ ①Or futile ones ②Or Noph

column.name: text
column.value: I will make Pathros desolate, Set a fire in Zoan And execute judgments on ①Thebes. ▷ ①Or No

column.name: text
column.value: I will pour out My wrath on ①Sin, The stronghold of Egypt; I will also eliminate the hordes of ②Thebes. ▷ ①Or Pelusium ②Or No

column.name: text
column.value: I will set a fire in Egypt; ①Sin will writhe in anguish, ②Thebes will be breached And ③Memphis will have ④distresses daily. ▷ ①Or Pelusium ②Or No ③Or Noph ④Or adversaries

column.name: text
column.value: The young men of ①On and of Pi-beseth Will fall by the sword, And ②the women will go into captivity. ▷ ①Or Aven ②Lit they

column.name: text
column.value: In Tehaphnehes the day will ①be dark When I break there the yoke bars of Egypt. Then the pride of her power will cease in her; A cloud will cover her, And her daughters will go into captivity. ▷ ①As in many mss and ancient versions; MT restrain

column.name: text
column.value: So I will execute judgments on Egypt, And they will know that I am the LORD.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: In the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, behold, it has not been bound up ①for healing ②or wrapped with a bandage, so that it may be strong to wield the sword. ▷ ①Lit to give healing ②Lit to wrap it

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and I will break his arms, both the strong and the broken; and I will make the sword fall from his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them among the lands.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put My sword in his hand; and I will break the arms of Pharaoh, so that he will groan before him with the groans of a wounded man.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fail. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I put My sword into the hand of the king of Babylon and he reaches out with it against the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: When I scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them among the lands, then they will know that I am the LORD.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: In the eleventh year, in the third month, on the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his hordes, ‘Whom are you like in your greatness?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, Assyria was a cedar in Lebanon With beautiful branches and forest shade, And ①very high, And its top was among the ②clouds. ▷ ①Lit high of stature ②As in LXX; MT thick boughs

column.name: text
column.value: The waters made it grow, the ①deep made it high. With its rivers it continually ②extended all around its planting place, And sent out its channels to all the trees of the field. ▷ ①I.e., subterranean waters ②Lit was going

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore its height was loftier than all the trees of the field And its boughs became many and its branches long Because of many waters ①as it spread them out. ▷ ①Lit in its sending forth

column.name: text
column.value: All the birds of the sky nested in its twigs, And under its branches all the animals of the field gave birth, And all great nations lived under its shade.

column.name: text
text
column.value: The cedars in God’s garden ①could not match it; The junipers ②could not compare with its branches, And the plane trees ③could not match its branches. No tree in God’s garden ④could compare with it in its beauty. ▷ ①Lit did ②Lit did ③Lit were not like ④Lit did

column.name: text
column.value: I made it beautiful with the multitude of its branches, And all the trees of Eden, which were in the garden of God, were jealous of it.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Therefore this is what the Lord ①GOD says: “Because ②it is tall in stature and has put its top among the ③clouds, and its heart is haughty in its loftiness, ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch ②As in Syriac; MT you are ③As in LXX; MT thick branches

column.name: text
column.value: I will hand it over to a ①ruler of the nations; he will thoroughly deal with it. In accordance with its wickedness I have driven it out. ▷ ①Or mighty one

column.name: text
column.value: Foreign tyrants of the nations have cut it down and left it; on the mountains and in all the valleys its branches have fallen, and its branches have been broken in all the ravines of the land. And all the peoples of the earth have gone down from its shade and left it.

column.name: text
column.value: All the birds of the sky will nest on its fallen trunk, and all the animals of the field will ①rest on its fallen branches, ▷ ①Lit be on

column.name: text
column.value: so that all the trees by the waters will not be exalted in their stature, nor put their tops among the ①clouds, nor will any of their ②well-watered mighty ones stand straight in their height. For they have all been turned over to death, to the earth beneath, among ③mankind, ④with those who go down to the pit.” ▷ ①As in LXX; MT thick branches ②Lit drinkers of water ③Lit sons of mankind ④Lit to

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “On the day when it went down to Sheol I caused mourning; I closed the ①deep over it and held back its rivers. And its many waters were stopped up, and I made Lebanon mourn for it, and all the trees of the field wilted away on account of it. ▷ ①I.e., subterranean waters

column.name: text
column.value: I made the nations quake from the sound of its fall when I made it go down to Sheol with those who go down to the pit; and all the ①well-watered trees of Eden, the choicest and best of Lebanon, were comforted in the earth beneath. ▷ ①Lit drinkers of water

column.name: text
column.value: They also went down with it to Sheol to those who were slain by the sword; and those who were its ①strength lived in its shade among the nations. ▷ ①Lit arm

column.name: text
column.value: “To which among the trees of Eden are you so alike in glory and greatness? Yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the earth beneath; you will lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with those who were killed by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his hordes!” ’ declares the Lord GOD.”

column.name: text
column.value: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, take up a song of mourning over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say to him, ‘You ①compared yourself to a young lion of the nations, Yet you are like the monster in the seas; And you burst forth in your rivers And muddied the waters with your feet And ②fouled their rivers.’ ” ▷ ①Or were like ②Lit fouled by stamping

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Lord ①GOD says: “Now I will spread My net over you With a contingent of many peoples, And they will lift you up in My net. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: I will leave you on the land; I will hurl you on the ①open field. And I will cause all the birds of the sky to ②nest on you, And I will satisfy the animals of the whole earth ③with you. ▷ ①Lit faces of the field ②Lit dwell ③Lit from

column.name: text
column.value: I will lay your flesh on the mountains And fill the valleys with your refuse.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also make the land drink the discharge of your blood As far as the mountains, And the ravines will be full of you.

column.name: text
column.value: And when I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens and darken their stars; I will cover the sun with a cloud And the moon will not give its light.

column.name: text
column.value: All the shining lights in the heavens I will darken over you And will set darkness on your land,” Declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: “I will also trouble the hearts of many peoples when I bring your destruction among the nations, into lands which you have not known.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make many peoples appalled at you, and their kings will be horribly afraid of you when I brandish My sword before them; and they will tremble again and again, every person for his own life, on the day of your fall.”

column.name: text
column.value: For the Lord GOD says this: “The sword of the king of Babylon will ①attack you. ▷ ①Lit come upon you

column.name: text
column.value: By the swords of the warriors I will make your multitude fall; all of them are tyrants of the nations, And they will devastate the pride of Egypt, And all its multitude will be destroyed.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Then I will make their waters settle, And make their rivers run like oil,” Declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: “When I make the land of Egypt a desolation, And the land is destitute of that which filled it, When I strike all those who live in it, Then they shall know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This is a song of mourning, and they shall sing it. The daughters of the nations shall sing it. Over Egypt and over all her hordes they shall sing it,” declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, lament for the hordes of Egypt and bring it down, her and the daughters of the mighty nations, to the netherworld, with those who go down to the pit;

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Whom do you surpass in beauty? Go down and make your bed with the uncircumcised.’

column.name: text
column.value: They shall fall in the midst of those who are killed by the sword. ①She is turned over to the sword; they have dragged her and all her hordes away. ▷ ①Or The sword is given

column.name: text
column.value: The strong among the mighty ones shall speak of him and his helpers from the midst of Sheol: ‘They have gone down, they lie still, the uncircumcised, killed by the sword.’

column.name: text
column.value: “Assyria is there and all her company; ①her graves are all around ②her. All of them killed, fallen by the sword, ▷ ①Lit his ②Lit him

column.name: text
column.value: whose graves are set in the remotest parts of the pit, and her company is all around her grave. All of them killed, fallen by the sword, who ①spread terror in the land of the living. ▷ ①Lit gave, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: “Elam is there and all her hordes around her grave; all of them killed, fallen by the sword, who went down uncircumcised to the lower parts of the earth, who inflicted their terror on the land of the living, and bore their disgrace with those who go down to the pit.

column.name: text
column.value: They have made a bed for her among the slain with all her hordes. Her graves are around it, they are all uncircumcised, killed by the sword (although their terror was ①inflicted on the land of the living), and they bore their disgrace with those who go down to the pit; ②they were put in the midst of the slain. ▷ ①Lit given ②As in ancient versions; MT he was

column.name: text
column.value: “Meshech, Tubal, and all their hordes are there; their graves ①surround them. All of them were killed by the sword uncircumcised, though they inflicted their terror on the land of the living. ▷ ①Lit are around him

column.name: text
column.value: Nor do they lie beside the fallen ①heroes of the uncircumcised, who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war and whose swords were placed under their heads; but the punishment for their wrongdoing rested on their bones, though the terror of these ②heroes was once in the land of the living. ▷ ①Or mighty ones ②Or mighty ones

column.name: text
column.value: But in the midst of the uncircumcised you will be broken and lie with those killed by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: “There also is Edom, its kings and all its ①princes, who ②despite all their might are laid with those killed by the sword; they will lie with the uncircumcised and with those who go down to the pit. ▷ ①Or leaders ②Lit in

column.name: text
column.value: “There also are the ①chiefs of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who in spite of the terror resulting from their might, in shame went down with the slain. So they lay down uncircumcised with those killed by the sword and bore their disgrace with those who go down to the pit. ▷ ①Or leaders

column.name: text
column.value: “These Pharaoh will see, and he will find consolation regarding all his hordes killed by the sword, Pharaoh and all his army,” declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: “Though I inflicted the terror of him on the land of the living, yet he will be laid to rest among the uncircumcised along with those killed by the sword, Pharaoh and all his hordes,” declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy and say to ①those shepherds, ‘This is what the Lord ②GOD says: “Woe, shepherds of Israel who have been ③feeding themselves! Should the shepherds not ④feed the flock? ▷ ①Lit them, the shepherds ②Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch ③Lit pasturing, pasture ④Lit pasturing, pasture

column.name: text
column.value: You eat the fat and clothe yourselves with the wool, you slaughter the fat sheep ①without feeding the flock. ▷ ①Lit you do not pasture

column.name: text
column.value: Those who are sickly you have not strengthened, the diseased you have not healed, the broken you have not bound up, the scattered you have not brought back, nor have you searched for the lost; but with force and with violence you have ①dominated them. ▷ ①Or ruled

column.name: text
column.value: They scattered for lack of a shepherd, and they became food for every animal of the field and scattered.

column.name: text
column.value: My flock strayed through all the mountains and on every high hill; My flock was scattered over all the surface of the earth, and there was no one to search or seek for them.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: “As I live,” declares the Lord GOD, “certainly, because My flock has become plunder, and My flock has become food for all the animals of the field for lack of a shepherd, and My shepherds did not search for My flock, but rather the shepherds fed themselves and did not feed My flock,

column.name: text
column.value: therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against the shepherds, and I will demand My ①sheep ②from them and make them stop tending sheep. So the shepherds will not ③feed themselves anymore, but I will save My sheep from their mouth, so that they will not be food for them.” ’ ” ▷ ①Or flock ②Lit from their hand ③Lit pasture, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: For the Lord GOD says this: “Behold, I Myself will search for My sheep and look after them.

column.name: text
column.value: As a shepherd cares for his flock on a day when he is among his scattered ①sheep, so I will care for My ②sheep and will rescue them from all the places where they were scattered on a cloudy and gloomy day. ▷ ①Or flock ②Or flock

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring them out from the peoples and gather them from the countries and bring them to their own land; and I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the streams, and in all the inhabited places of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: I will feed them in a good pasture, and their grazing place will be on the mountain heights of Israel. There they will lie down in a good grazing place and feed in ①rich pasture on the mountains of Israel. ▷ ①Lit fat

column.name: text
column.value: I Myself will feed My flock and I Myself will ①lead them to rest,” declares the Lord GOD. ▷ ①Lit let them lie down

column.name: text
column.value: “I will seek the lost, bring back the scattered, bind up the broken, and strengthen the sick; but the fat and the strong I will eliminate. I will feed them with judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: “As for you, My flock, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am going to judge between one ①sheep and another, between the rams and the male goats. ▷ ①Or lamb

column.name: text
column.value: Is it too little a thing for you to feed in the good pasture, that you must trample with your feet the rest of your pastures? Or too little for you to drink the clear waters, that you must muddy the rest with your feet?

column.name: text
column.value: But as for My flock, they must eat what you trample with your feet, and drink what you muddy with your feet!’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says to them: “Behold, I, I Myself will also judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: Since you push away with your side and shoulder, and gore all the ①weak with your horns until you have scattered them ②abroad, ▷ ①Or sick ②Lit to the outside

column.name: text
column.value: therefore, I will save My flock, and they will no longer be plunder; and I will judge between one sheep and another.

column.name: text
column.value: “Then I will appoint over them one shepherd, My servant David, and he will feed them; he will feed them himself and be their shepherd.

column.name: text
column.value: And I, the LORD, will be their God, and My servant David will be prince among them; I the LORD have spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: “And I will make a covenant of peace with them and eliminate harmful animals from the land, so that they may live securely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make them and the places around My hill a blessing. And I will make showers fall in their season; they will be showers of blessing.

column.name: text
column.value: Also the tree of the field will yield its fruit and the earth will yield its produce, and they will be secure on their land. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have broken the bars of their yoke and have saved them from the hand of those who enslaved them.

column.name: text
column.value: They will no longer be plunder to the nations, and the animals of the earth will not devour them; but they will live securely, and no one will make them afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: I will establish for them a renowned planting place, and they will not again be ①victims of famine in the land, and they will not endure the insults of the nations anymore. ▷ ①Lit those gathered

column.name: text
