column.value: Then they will know that I, the LORD their God, am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are My people,” declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: “As for you, My sheep, ①the sheep of My pasture, you are mankind, and I am your God,” declares the Lord GOD. ▷ ①As in MT; LXX you are sheep of My flock, and

column.name: text
column.value: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it

column.name: text
column.value: and say to it, ‘This is what the Lord ①GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, And I will reach out with My hand against you And make you a desolation and a waste. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: I will turn your cities to ruins, And you will become a desolation. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Since you have had everlasting hostility and have turned over the sons of Israel to the power of the sword at the time of their disaster, at the time of the ①punishment of the end, ▷ ①Or injustice

column.name: text
column.value: therefore as I live,” declares the Lord GOD, “I will certainly ①doom you to bloodshed, and bloodshed will pursue you; since you have not hated bloodshed, therefore bloodshed will pursue you. ▷ ①Lit make bloodshed of you

column.name: text
column.value: I will make Mount Seir a waste and a desolation and I will eliminate from it one who passes through and returns.

column.name: text
column.value: I will fill its mountains with its slain; those killed by the sword will fall on your hills, in your valleys, and in all your ravines.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make you a permanent desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “Since you have said, ‘These two nations and these two lands will be mine, and we will possess ①them,’ although the LORD was there, ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: therefore as I live,” declares the Lord GOD, “I will deal with you according to your anger and according to your envy which you displayed because of your hatred for them; so I will make Myself known among them when I judge you.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will know ①that I, the LORD, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel saying, ‘They are desolate; they have been given to us as food.’ ▷ ①Or that I am the LORD: I have heard

column.name: text
column.value: And you have ①spoken arrogantly against Me and have multiplied your words against Me; I Myself have heard it.” ▷ ①Lit magnified yourselves with your mouth

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Lord GOD says: “As all the earth rejoices, I will make you a desolation.

column.name: text
column.value: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, so I will do to you. You will be a desolation, Mount Seir, and all Edom, all of it. Then they will know that I am the LORD.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, set your face toward Gog of the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,

column.name: text
column.value: and say, ‘This is what the Lord ①GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: So I will turn you around and put hooks into your jaws, and I will bring you out, and all your army, horses and horsemen, all of them magnificently dressed, a great contingent with shield and ①buckler, all of them wielding swords; ▷ ①I.e., small shield

column.name: text
column.value: Persia, ①Cush, and Put with them, all of them with buckler and helmet; ▷ ①Or Ethiopia

column.name: text
column.value: Gomer with all its troops; Beth-togarmah from the remote parts of the north with all its troops—many peoples with you.

column.name: text
column.value: “Be ready, and be prepared, you and all your contingents that are assembled around you, and be a guard for them.

column.name: text
column.value: After many days you will be summoned; in the latter years you will come into the land that is restored from the sword, whose inhabitants have been gathered from many ①nations to the mountains of Israel which had been a continual place of ruins; but ②its people were brought out from the ③nations, and they are living securely, all of them. ▷ ①Lit peoples ②Lit it was ③Lit peoples

column.name: text
column.value: And you will go up, you will come like a storm; you will be like a cloud covering the land, you and all your troops, and many peoples with you.”

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “It will come about on that day, that ①thoughts will come into your mind and you will devise an evil plan, ▷ ①Lit words

column.name: text
column.value: and you will say, ‘I will go up against the land of ①unwalled villages. I will go against those who are at rest, who live securely, all of them living without walls and having no bars or gates, ▷ ①Or open country

column.name: text
column.value: to capture spoils and to seize plunder, to turn your hand against the ruins that are now inhabited, and against the people who are gathered from the nations, who have acquired livestock and goods, who live at the ①center of the world.’ ▷ ①Lit navel

column.name: text
column.value: Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish with all its ①villages will say to you, ‘Have you come to capture spoils? Have you assembled your contingent to seize plunder, to carry away silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods, to capture great spoils?’ ” ’ ▷ ①As in ancient versions; MT young lions

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore prophesy, son of man, and say to Gog, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “On that day when My people Israel are living securely, will you not know it?

column.name: text
column.value: You will come from your place out of the remote parts of the north, you and many peoples with you, all of them riding horses, a large assembly and a mighty army;

column.name: text
column.value: and you will come up against My people Israel like a cloud to cover the land. It shall come about in the last days that I will bring you against My land, so that the nations may know Me when I show Myself holy through you before their eyes, Gog.”

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “Are you the one of whom I spoke in former days through My servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days for many years that I would bring you against them?

column.name: text
column.value: It will come about on that day, when Gog comes against the land of Israel,” declares the Lord GOD, “that My fury will mount up in My anger.

column.name: text
column.value: In My zeal and in My blazing wrath I declare that on that day there will certainly be a great ①earthquake in the land of Israel. ▷ ①Or shaking

column.name: text
column.value: The fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, the animals of the field, all the crawling things that crawl on the earth, and all mankind who are on the face of the earth will shake at My presence; and the mountains will be thrown down, the steep pathways will ①collapse, and every wall will fall to the ground. ▷ ①Lit fall

column.name: text
column.value: And I will call for a sword against ①him on all My mountains,” declares the Lord GOD. “Every man’s sword will be against his brother. ▷ ①I.e., Gog

column.name: text
column.value: With plague and with blood I will enter into judgment with him; and I will rain on him and on his troops, and on the many peoples who are with him, ①a torrential rain, hailstones, fire, and brimstone. ▷ ①Lit an overflowing

column.name: text
column.value: So I will prove Myself great, show Myself holy, and make Myself known in the sight of many nations; and they will know that I am the LORD.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: The hand of the LORD was upon me, and He brought me out ①by the Spirit of the LORD and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones. ▷ ①Or in

column.name: text
column.value: He had me pass among them all around, and behold, there were very many on the surface of the valley; and behold, they were very dry.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” And I answered, “Lord ①GOD, You Yourself know.” ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: Again He said to me, “Prophesy over these bones and say to them, ‘You dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.’

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Lord GOD says to these bones: ‘Behold, I am going to make ①breath enter you so that you may come to life. ▷ ①Or spirit, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: And I will ①attach tendons to you, make flesh grow back on you, cover you with skin, and put breath in you so that you may come to life; and you will know that I am the LORD.’ ” ▷ ①Lit give

column.name: text
column.value: So I prophesied as I was commanded; and as I prophesied, there was a loud noise, and behold, a ①rattling; and the bones came together, bone to its bone. ▷ ①Or rustling

column.name: text
column.value: And I looked, and behold, tendons were on them, and flesh grew and skin covered them; but there was no breath in them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He said to me, “Prophesy to the breath, prophesy, son of man, and say to the breath, ‘The Lord GOD says this: “Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe on these slain, so that they come to life.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: So I prophesied as He commanded me, and the breath entered them, and they came to life and stood on their feet, an exceedingly great army.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the entire house of Israel; behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up and our hope has perished. We are ①completely cut off.’ ▷ ①Lit cut off to ourselves

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore prophesy and say to them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am going to open your graves and cause you to come up out of your graves, My people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I have opened your graves and caused you to come up out of your graves, My people.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will put My ①Spirit within you and you will come to life, and I will place you on your own land. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken and done it,” declares the LORD.’ ” ▷ ①Or breath

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Now you, son of man, take for yourself one stick and write on it, ‘For Judah and for the sons of Israel, his companions’; then take another stick and write on it, ‘For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim and all the house of Israel, his companions.’

column.name: text
column.value: Then put them together for yourself one to another into one stick, so that they may become one in your hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the sons of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Will you not declare to us what ①you mean by these?’ ▷ ①Lit these are to you

column.name: text
column.value: say to them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am going to take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel, his companions; and I will put them with it, with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they will be one in My hand.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: The sticks on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: And say to them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am going to take the sons of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and I will gather them from every side and bring them into their own land;

column.name: text
column.value: and I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel; and one king will be king for all of them; and they will no longer be two nations, and no longer be divided into two kingdoms.

column.name: text
column.value: They will no longer defile themselves with their idols, or with their detestable things, or with any of their offenses; but I will rescue them from all their ①dwelling places in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them. And they will be My people, and I will be their God. ▷ ①Another reading is offenses

column.name: text
column.value: “And My servant David will be king over them, and they will all have one shepherd; and they will walk in My ordinances, and keep My statutes and ①follow them. ▷ ①Lit do them

column.name: text
column.value: And they will live on the land that I gave to My servant Jacob, in which your fathers lived; and they will live on it, they, and their sons and their sons’ sons, forever; and My servant David will be their leader forever.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make a covenant of peace with them; it will be an everlasting covenant with them. And I will ①place them and multiply them, and set My sanctuary in their midst forever. ▷ ①Lit give

column.name: text
column.value: My dwelling place also will be among them; and I will be their God, and they will be My people.

column.name: text
column.value: And the nations will know that I am the LORD who sanctifies Israel, when My sanctuary is in their midst forever.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: “Now you, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say, ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Lord ①GOD says: “Since the enemy has spoken against you, ‘Aha!’ and, ‘The everlasting ②heights have become our possession,’ ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch ②Heb bamoth

column.name: text
column.value: therefore prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “ ①For good reason they have made you desolate and harassed you from every side, so that you would become a possession of the rest of the nations; and you have been taken up in the ②talk and the rumor of the people.” ’ ” ▷ ①Lit Because; or By the cause ②Lit lip of the tongue

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, you mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD. This is what the Lord GOD says to the mountains and to the hills, to the ravines and to the valleys, to the desolate ruins and to the abandoned cities which have become plunder and an object of ridicule to the rest of the nations which are all around—

column.name: text
column.value: therefore the Lord GOD says this: “Certainly in the fire of My jealousy I have spoken against the rest of the nations, and against all Edom, who ①appropriated My land for themselves as a possession with wholehearted joy and with contempt of soul, in order to make its pastureland plunder.” ▷ ①Lit gave

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore prophesy in regard to the land of Israel and say to the mountains and to the hills, to the ravines and to the valleys, “This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I have spoken in My jealousy and in My wrath because you have endured the insults of the nations.’

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the Lord GOD says this: ‘I have ①sworn that the nations that are around you will certainly endure their insults themselves. ▷ ①Lit lifted up My hand

column.name: text
column.value: But as for you, mountains of Israel, you will ①grow your branches and bear fruit for My people Israel; for they are about to come. ▷ ①Lit give

column.name: text
column.value: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn to you, and you will be cultivated and sown.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will multiply people on you, all the house of Israel, all of it; and the cities will be inhabited and the ruins will be rebuilt.

column.name: text
column.value: I will multiply on you people and animals, and they will increase and be fruitful; and I will populate you as you were previously, and treat you better than at the beginning. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Yes, I will have people—My people Israel—walk on you and possess you, so that you will become their inheritance and never again bereave them of children.’

column.name: text
column.value: “The Lord GOD says this: ‘Since they say to you, “You are a devourer of people and have bereaved your nation of children,”

column.name: text
column.value: for that reason you will no longer devour people and no longer bereave your nation of children,’ declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: I will not let you hear insults from the nations anymore, nor will you suffer disgrace from the peoples any longer, nor will you make your nation stumble any longer,” declares the Lord GOD.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, when the house of Israel was living on their own land, they defiled it by their ways and their deeds; their way before Me was like the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I poured out My wrath on them for the blood which they had shed on the land, because they had defiled it with their idols.

column.name: text
column.value: I also scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed throughout the lands. According to their ways and their deeds I judged them.

column.name: text
column.value: When they came to the nations where they went, they profaned My holy name, because it was said of them, ‘These are the people of the LORD, yet they have left His land.’

column.name: text
column.value: But I had ①concern for My holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went. ▷ ①Lit compassion

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore say to the house of Israel, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “It is not for your sake, house of Israel, that I am about to act, but for My holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you went.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will vindicate the holiness of My great name which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD,” declares the Lord GOD, “when I show Myself holy among you in their sight.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will take you from the nations, and gather you from all the lands; and I will bring you into your own land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean; I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; and I will remove the heart of stone from your flesh and give you a heart of flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will put My Spirit within you and bring it about that you walk in My statutes, and are careful and ①follow My ordinances. ▷ ①Lit do My

column.name: text
column.value: And you will live in the land that I gave to your forefathers; so you will be My people, and I will be your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, I will save you from all your uncleanness; and I will call for the grain and multiply it, and I will not ①bring a famine on you. ▷ ①Lit give

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the produce of the field, so that you will not receive again the disgrace of famine among the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will remember your evil ways and your deeds that were not good, and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for your wrongdoings and your abominations.

column.name: text
column.value: I am not doing this for your sake,” declares the Lord GOD; “let that be known to you. Be ashamed and humiliated for your ways, house of Israel!”

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “On the day that I cleanse you from all your wrongdoings, I will populate the cities, and the places of ruins will be rebuilt.

column.name: text
column.value: The desolated land will be cultivated instead of being a desolation in the sight of everyone who passes by.

column.name: text
column.value: And they will say, ‘This desolated land has become like the Garden of Eden; and the waste, desolated and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.’

column.name: text
column.value: Then the nations around you that are left will know that I, the LORD, have rebuilt the ruined places and planted that which was desolated; I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it.”

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “This too I will let the house of Israel ask Me to do for them: I will increase their people like a flock.

column.name: text
column.value: Like the flock ①for sacrifices, like the flock at Jerusalem during her appointed feasts, so will the waste cities be filled with flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the LORD.” ’ ” ▷ ①Lit of holy things

column.name: text
column.value: “And you, son of man, prophesy against Gog and say, ‘This is what the Lord ①GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal; ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: and I will turn you around, lead you on a rope, take you up from the remotest parts of the north, and bring you against the mountains of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will strike your bow from your left hand and make your arrows fall from your right hand.

column.name: text
column.value: You will fall on the mountains of Israel, you and all your troops, and the peoples who are with you; I will give you as food to every ①kind of predatory bird and animal of the field. ▷ ①Lit wing

column.name: text
column.value: You will fall on the ①open field; for it is I who have spoken,” declares the Lord GOD. ▷ ①Lit faces of the field

column.name: text
column.value: “And I will send fire upon Magog and those who inhabit the coastlands in safety; and they will know that I am the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “And I will make My holy name known in the midst of My people Israel; and I will not allow My holy name to be profaned anymore. But the nations will know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, it is coming and it shall be done,” declares the Lord GOD. “That is the day of which I have spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: “Then those who inhabit the cities of Israel will go out and make fires with the weapons and burn them, both ①bucklers and shields, bows and arrows, war clubs and spears, and for seven years they will make fires of them. ▷ ①I.e., small shields

column.name: text
column.value: They will not take wood from the field or gather firewood from the forests, because they will make fires with the weapons; and they will take the spoils of those who plundered them and seize the plunder of those who plundered them,” declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: “On that day I will give Gog a burial place there in Israel, the valley of those who pass by east of the sea, and it will block the way of those who would pass by. So they will bury Gog there with all his horde, and they will call it the Valley of ①Hamon-gog. ▷ ①Or the multitude of Gog

column.name: text
column.value: For seven months the house of Israel will be burying them in order to cleanse the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people of the land will bury them; and it will be ①to their renown on the day that I appear in My glory,” declares the Lord GOD. ▷ ①Or a memorial for them

column.name: text
column.value: “They will also select men who will constantly pass through the land, burying those who were passing through, those left on the surface of the ground, in order to cleanse it. At the end of seven months they will conduct a search.

column.name: text
column.value: As those who pass through the land pass through and anyone sees a human bone, then he will ①set up a marker by it until the burial detail has buried it in the Valley of ②Hamon-gog. ▷ ①Lit build ②Or the multitude of Gog

column.name: text
column.value: And even the name of the city will be Hamonah. So they will cleanse the land.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: “Now as for you, son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Say to every ①kind of bird and to every animal of the field: “Assemble and come, gather from every direction to My sacrifice, which I am going to sacrifice for you as a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel; and you will eat flesh and drink blood. ▷ ①Lit wing

column.name: text
column.value: You will eat the flesh of warriors and drink the blood of the leaders of the earth, as though they were rams, lambs, goats, and bulls, all of them fattened livestock of Bashan.

column.name: text
column.value: So you will eat fat until you are full, and drink blood until you are drunk, from My sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.

column.name: text
column.value: You will eat your fill at My table with horses and charioteers, with warriors and all the men of war,” declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: “And I will place My glory among the nations; and all the nations will see My judgment which I have executed, and My hand which I have laid on them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God, from that day onward.

column.name: text
column.value: The nations will know that the house of Israel went into exile for their wrongdoing, because they were disloyal to Me, and I hid My face from them; so I handed them over to their adversaries, and all of them fell by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: In accordance with their uncleanness and their offenses I dealt with them, and I hid My face from them.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: “Now I will restore the fortunes of Jacob and have mercy on all the house of Israel; and I will be jealous for My holy name.

column.name: text
column.value: They will ①forget their disgrace and all their ②treachery which they perpetrated against Me, when they live securely on their own land with no one to make them afraid. ▷ ①Another reading is bear ②Or disloyalty

column.name: text
column.value: When I bring them back from the peoples and gather them from the lands of their enemies, then I shall show Myself holy ①through them in the sight of the many nations. ▷ ①Lit in

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will know that I am the LORD their God because I made them go into exile among the nations, and then I gathered them again to their own land; and I will leave none of them there any longer.

column.name: text
column.value: I will not hide My face from them any longer, for I will have poured out My Spirit on the house of Israel,” declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, speak to the sons of your people and say to them, ‘If I bring a sword upon a land, and the people of the land take one man from among them and make him their watchman,

column.name: text
column.value: and he sees the sword coming upon the land and blows the ①horn and warns the people, ▷ ①Heb shofar; i.e., ram’s horn

column.name: text
column.value: then ①someone who hears the sound of the horn but does not take warning, and a sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head. ▷ ①Lit the one who hears the sound...hears it but

column.name: text
column.value: He heard the sound of the horn but did not take warning; his blood will be on himself. But had he taken warning, he would have saved his life.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow the horn and the people are not warned, and a sword comes and takes a person from them, he is taken away for his wrongdoing; but I will ①require his blood from the watchman’s hand.’ ▷ ①I.e., hold the watchman responsible

column.name: text
column.value: “Now as for you, son of man, I have ①appointed you as a watchman for the house of Israel; so you will hear a ②message from My mouth and give them a warning from Me. ▷ ①Or given ②Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: When I say to the wicked, ‘You wicked person, you will certainly die,’ and you do not speak to warn the wicked about his way, that wicked person shall die for his wrongdoing, but I will ①require his blood from your hand. ▷ ①I.e., hold you responsible

column.name: text
column.value: But if you on your part warn a wicked person to turn from his way and he does not turn from his way, he will die for his wrongdoing, but you have saved your life.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now as for you, son of man, say to the house of Israel, ‘This is what you have ①said: “Surely our offenses and our sins are upon us, and we are rotting away in them; how then can we ②survive?” ’ ▷ ①Lit said, saying ②Lit live

column.name: text
column.value: Say to them, ‘As I live!’ declares the Lord ①GOD, ‘I take no pleasure at all in the death of the wicked, but rather that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn back, turn back from your evil ways! Why then should you die, house of Israel?’ ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: And you, son of man, say to ①your fellow citizens, ‘The righteousness of a righteous one will not save him on the day of his offense, and as for the wickedness of a wicked one, he will not stumble because of it on the day when he turns from his wickedness; whereas a righteous one will not be able to live ②by his righteousness on the day when he commits sin.’ ▷ ①Lit the sons of your people ②Lit by it

column.name: text
column.value: When I say to the righteous that he will certainly live, and he so trusts in his righteousness that he commits injustice, none of his righteous deeds will be remembered; but for that same injustice of his which he has committed he will die.

column.name: text
column.value: But when I say to the wicked, ‘You will certainly die,’ and he turns from his sin and practices justice and righteousness,

column.name: text
column.value: if a wicked person returns a pledge, pays back what he has taken by robbery, walks by the statutes ①which ensure life without committing injustice, he shall certainly live; he shall not die. ▷ ①Lit of life

column.name: text
column.value: None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him. He has practiced justice and righteousness; he shall certainly live.

column.name: text
column.value: “Yet ①your fellow citizens say, ‘The way of the Lord is not right,’ when it is their own way that is not right. ▷ ①Lit the sons of your people

column.name: text
column.value: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits injustice, then he shall die in ①it. ▷ ①Lit them

column.name: text
column.value: But when the wicked turns from his wickedness and practices justice and righteousness, he will live by them.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not right.’ I will judge each of you according to his ways, house of Israel.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the twelfth year of our exile, on the fifth of the tenth month, the survivor from Jerusalem came to me, saying, “The city has been ①taken.” ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: Now the hand of the LORD had been upon me in the evening, before the survivors came. And He opened my mouth ①at the time they came to me in the morning; so my mouth was opened and I was no longer ②speechless. ▷ ①Lit until he came ②Or mute

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Son of man, they who live in these ruins in the land of Israel are saying, ‘Abraham was only one, yet he possessed the land; so to us who are many the land has been given as a possession.’

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore say to them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “You eat meat with the blood in it, raise your eyes to your idols as you shed blood. Should you then possess the land?

column.name: text
column.value: You ①rely on your sword, you commit abominations, and each of you defiles his neighbor’s wife. Should you then possess the land?” ’ ▷ ①Lit stand

column.name: text
column.value: You shall say this to them: ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “As I live, those who are in the places of ruins certainly will fall by the sword, and whoever is in the ①open field I will give to the animals to be devoured, and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves will die of plague. ▷ ①Lit faces of the field

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make the land a desolation and a waste, and the pride of her power will be brought to an end; and the mountains of Israel will be deserted so that no one will pass through.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I make the land a desolation and a waste because of all their abominations which they have committed.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: “But as for you, son of man, ①your fellow citizens who talk with one another about you by the walls and in the doorways of the houses, speak one with another, each with his brother, saying, ‘Come now and hear what the ②message is that comes from the LORD.’ ▷ ①Lit the sons of your people ②Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: And they come to you as people come, and sit before you as My people and hear your words, but they do not do them; for they do the lustful desires expressed by their mouth, and their heart follows their unlawful gain.

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, you are to them like a love song by one who has a beautiful voice and plays well on an instrument; for they hear your words but they do not practice them.

column.name: text
column.value: So when it comes— ①as it certainly will—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.” ▷ ①Lit behold, it is coming

column.name: text
column.value: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was ①taken, on this very day the hand of the LORD was upon me and He brought me there. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
column.value: In the visions of God He brought me into the land of Israel and set me on a very high mountain, and on it to the south there was something like a structure of a city.

column.name: text
column.value: So He brought me there; and behold, there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a thread of flax and a measuring ①rod in his hand; and he was standing in the gateway. ▷ ①Lit reed, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: And the man said to me, “Son of man, see with your eyes, hear with your ears, and ①pay attention to all that I am going to show you; for you have been brought here in order to show it to you. Declare to the house of Israel all that you see.” ▷ ①Lit set your heart

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, there was a wall on the outside of the ①temple all around, and in the man’s hand was a measuring rod of six ②cubits, ③each of which was a ④cubit and a hand width. So he measured the thickness of the ⑤wall, one rod; and the height, one rod. ▷ ①Lit house ②I.e., “long” cubits, see note 4 ③Lit by the cubit and ④A cubit and hand width equals about 21 in. or 53 cm ⑤Lit building

column.name: text
column.value: Then he went to the gate which faced east, went up its steps, and measured the threshold of the gate, one rod ①in width; and the other threshold was one rod ②in width. ▷ ①Or in depth ②Or in depth

column.name: text
column.value: The guardroom was one rod long and one rod wide; and there were five cubits between the guardrooms. And the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate ①facing inward was one rod. ▷ ①Lit from the house

column.name: text
column.value: Then he measured the porch of the gate ①facing inward, one rod. ▷ ①Lit from the house

column.name: text
column.value: And he measured the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and its side pillars, two cubits. And the porch of the gate was ①faced inward. ▷ ①Lit from the house

column.name: text
column.value: The guardrooms of the gate toward the east numbered three on each side; the three of them had the same measurement. The side pillars also had the same measurement on each side.

column.name: text
column.value: And he measured the width of the ①gateway, ten cubits, and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits. ▷ ①Lit entrance of the gate

column.name: text
column.value: There was a ①barrier wall one cubit wide in front of the guardrooms on each side; and the guardrooms were six cubits square on each side. ▷ ①Lit border

column.name: text
column.value: And he measured the gate from the roof of the one guardroom to the roof of the other, a width of twenty-five cubits, from one door to the door opposite.

column.name: text
column.value: He made the side pillars sixty cubits high; the gate extended all around to the side pillar of the courtyard.

column.name: text
column.value: And from the front of the entrance gate to the front of the inner porch of the gate was fifty cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: And there were ①shuttered windows looking toward the guardrooms, and toward their side pillars within the gate all around, and likewise for the porches. And there were windows all around inside; and on each side pillar were palm tree decorations. ▷ ①Or beveled inwards

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me into the outer courtyard, and behold, there were chambers and a stone pavement made for the courtyard all around; thirty chambers ①faced the pavement. ▷ ①Lit to

column.name: text
column.value: And the pavement (that is, the lower pavement) was by the ①side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates. ▷ ①Lit shoulder

column.name: text
column.value: Then he measured the width from the front of the lower gate to the front of the exterior of the inner courtyard, a hundred cubits on the east and on the north.

column.name: text
column.value: And as for the gate of the outer courtyard which faced north, he measured its length and its width.

column.name: text
column.value: ①It had three guardrooms on each side; and its side pillars and its porches ②had the same measurement as the first gate. Its length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits. ▷ ①Lit Its guardrooms were three ②Lit were

column.name: text
column.value: Its windows, its porches, and its palm tree decorations had the same measurements as the gate which faced east; and ①it was reached by seven steps, and its ②porch was in front of them. ▷ ①Lit they were going up into it ②Another reading is porches

column.name: text
column.value: The inner courtyard had a gate opposite the gate on the north as well as the gate on the east; and he measured a hundred cubits from gate to gate.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he led me toward the south, and behold, there was a gate toward the south; and he measured its side pillars and its porches according to ①those same measurements. ▷ ①Lit these measurements, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: ①The gate and its porches had windows all around like ②those other windows; the length was fifty cubits and the width, twenty-five cubits. ▷ ①Lit It ②Lit these windows

column.name: text
column.value: There were seven steps going up to it, and its porches were in front of them; and it had palm tree decorations on its side pillars, one on each side.

column.name: text
column.value: The inner courtyard had a gate toward the south; and he measured from gate to gate toward the south, a hundred cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me to the inner courtyard by the south gate; and he measured the south gate according to those same measurements.

column.name: text
column.value: Its guardrooms also, its side pillars, and its porches were according to those same measurements. And ①the gate and its porches had windows all around; it was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide. ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: There were porches all around, twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.

column.name: text
column.value: And its porches were toward the outer courtyard; and palm tree decorations were on its side pillars, and its stairway had eight steps.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me into the inner courtyard toward the east. And he measured the gate according to those same measurements.

column.name: text
column.value: Its guardrooms also, its side pillars, and its porches were according to those same measurements. And ①the gate and its porches had windows all around; it was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide. ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: Its porches were toward the outer courtyard; and palm tree decorations were on its side pillars, on each side, and its stairway had eight steps.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me to the north gate; and he measured it according to those same measurements,

column.name: text
column.value: with its guardrooms, its side pillars, and its porches. And ①the gate had windows all around; the length was fifty cubits and the width twenty-five cubits. ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: And its side pillars were toward the outer courtyard; and palm tree decorations were on its side pillars, on each side, and its stairway had eight steps.

column.name: text
column.value: A chamber with its doorway was by the side pillars at the gates; there they rinse the burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on each side, on which to slaughter the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: On the outer ①side, ②as one went up to the ③gateway toward the north, were two tables; and on the other ④side of the porch of the gate were two tables. ▷ ①Lit shoulder ②Lit to the one going up ③Lit entrance of the gate ④Lit shoulder

column.name: text
column.value: Four tables were on each side ①next to the gate; eight tables on which they slaughter sacrifices. ▷ ①Lit to the shoulder of

column.name: text
column.value: For the burnt offering there were four tables of cut stone, a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide, and one cubit high, on which they set the utensils with which they slaughter the burnt offering and the sacrifice.

column.name: text
column.value: And the double ①hooks, ②one hand width in length, were installed ③in the house all around; and on the tables was the flesh of the offering. ▷ ①Or ledges ②About 3 in. or 7.5 cm ③Or inside

column.name: text
column.value: From the outside to the inner gate were ①chambers for the singers in the inner courtyard, one of which was at the ②side of the north gate, with ③its front toward the south, and one at the ④side of the ⑤south gate facing north. ▷ ①LXX two chambers ②Lit shoulder ③Lit their ④Lit shoulder ⑤As in LXX; MT east

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to me, “This is the chamber which faces south, intended for the priests who ①are responsible for the ②temple; ▷ ①Lit keep the duty of ②Lit house

column.name: text
column.value: but the chamber which faces north is for the priests who ①are responsible for the altar. They are the sons of Zadok, who from the sons of Levi come near to the LORD to serve Him.” ▷ ①Lit keep the duty of

column.name: text
column.value: He measured the courtyard, a perfect square, a hundred cubits long and a hundred cubits wide; and the altar was in front of the ①temple. ▷ ①Lit house

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me to the porch of the ①temple and measured each side pillar of the porch, five cubits on each side; and the width of the gate was three cubits on each side. ▷ ①Lit house

column.name: text
column.value: The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the width eleven cubits; and at the stairway by which it was ascended were columns belonging to the side pillars, one on each side.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me out into the outer courtyard, the way toward the north; and he brought me to the chamber which was opposite the separate area and opposite the building toward the north.

column.name: text
column.value: Along the length, which was a hundred ①cubits, was the north door; the width was fifty cubits. ▷ ①Each of these cubits equals about 21 in. or 53 cm

column.name: text
column.value: Opposite the twenty cubits which belonged to the inner courtyard, and opposite the stone pavement which belonged to the outer courtyard, was ①gallery corresponding to ②gallery in three stories. ▷ ①Or passageway ②Or passageway

column.name: text
column.value: In front of the chambers was an inner passage ten cubits wide, a way of one hundred cubits; and their openings were on the north.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the upper chambers were ①smaller because the ②galleries took more space away from them than from the lower and middle ones in the building. ▷ ①Lit shorter ②Or passageways

column.name: text
column.value: For they were in three stories and had no pillars like the pillars of the courtyards; for that reason the upper chambers were ①set back from the ground upward, more than the lower and middle ones. ▷ ①Or reduced

column.name: text
column.value: As for the outer wall by the side of the chambers, toward the outer courtyard facing the chambers, its length was fifty cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: For the length of the chambers which were in the outer courtyard was fifty cubits; and behold, the length of those facing the main room was a hundred cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: And below these chambers was the entrance on the east side, as one enters them from the outer courtyard.

column.name: text
column.value: In the ①thickness of the wall of the courtyard toward the east, facing the separate area and facing the building, there were chambers. ▷ ①Lit width

column.name: text
column.value: And the way in front of them was like the appearance of the chambers which were on the north; according to their length, so was their width, and all their exits were according to their building plans and openings.

column.name: text
column.value: Corresponding to the openings of the chambers which were toward the south was an opening at the head of the way, the way in front of the wall toward the east, as one enters them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to me, “The north chambers and the south chambers, which are opposite the separate area, they are the holy chambers where the priests who are near to the LORD shall eat the most holy things. There they shall set the most holy things, the grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering; for the place is holy.

column.name: text
column.value: When the priests enter, they shall not go out into the outer courtyard from the sanctuary ①without laying their garments there in which they minister, for they are holy. They shall put on other garments; then they shall approach that which is for the people.” ▷ ①Lit but there they shall lay

column.name: text
column.value: Now when he had finished measuring the inner house, he brought me out by way of the gate which faced east, and measured it all around.

column.name: text
column.value: He measured on the east side with the measuring ①rod: five hundred rods by the measuring rod. ▷ ①Lit reed, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: He measured on the north side: five hundred rods by the measuring rod.

column.name: text
column.value: On the south side he measured five hundred rods with the measuring rod.

column.name: text
column.value: He turned to the west side and measured five hundred rods with the measuring rod.

column.name: text
column.value: He measured it ①on the four sides; it had a wall all around, the length five hundred rods and the width five hundred, to divide between the holy and the ②common. ▷ ①Lit toward the four winds ②Lit profane

column.name: text
column.value: Then he led me to the gate, the gate facing east;

column.name: text
column.value: and behold, the glory of the God of Israel was coming from the way of the east. And His voice was like the sound of many waters; and the earth shone from His glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was like the appearance of the vision which I saw, like the vision which I saw when ①He came to destroy the city. And the visions were like the vision which I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face. ▷ ①As in some mss and some ancient versions; MT I

column.name: text
column.value: And the glory of the LORD entered the house by way of the gate facing east.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner courtyard; and behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I heard Him speaking to me from the house, while a man was standing beside me.

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to me, “Son of man, this is the place of My throne and the place of the soles of My feet, where I will dwell among the sons of Israel forever. And the house of Israel will not again defile My holy name, neither they nor their kings, by their prostitution and by the ①corpses of their kings ②when they die, ▷ ①Or monuments as in Ugaritic ②Lit in their death; MT on their high places

column.name: text
column.value: by putting their threshold by My threshold, and their door post beside My door post, with only the wall between Me and them. And they have defiled My holy name by their abominations which they have committed. So I have consumed them in My anger.

column.name: text
column.value: Now let them remove their prostitution and the ①corpses of their kings far from Me, and I will dwell among them forever. ▷ ①Or monuments as in Ugaritic

column.name: text
column.value: “As for you, son of man, inform the house of Israel of the ①temple, so that they will be ashamed of their wrongdoings; and have them measure the ②plan. ▷ ①Lit house ②Or perfection; or pattern

column.name: text
column.value: And if they are ashamed of everything that they have done, make known to them the plan of the house, its layout, its exits, its entrances, all its plans, all its ①statutes, and all its laws. And write it in their sight, so that they may observe its entire plan and all its statutes and execute them. ▷ ①MT repeats and all its plans after statutes

column.name: text
column.value: This is the ①law of the house: its entire ②area on the top of the mountain all around shall be most holy. Behold, this is the ③law of the house. ▷ ①Or instruction for ②Lit border ③Or instruction for

column.name: text
column.value: “And these are the measurements of the altar by cubits (the cubit being a ①cubit and a hand width): the ②base shall be a cubit and the width a cubit, and its border on its edge all around one span; and this shall be the height of the ③base of the altar. ▷ ①A cubit and hand width equals about 21 in. or 53 cm ②Lit lap ③Or back

column.name: text
column.value: And from the base on the ground to the lower ledge shall be two cubits, and the width one cubit; and from the smaller ledge to the larger ledge shall be four cubits, and the width ①one cubit. ▷ ①Lit the

column.name: text
column.value: The ①altar hearth shall be four cubits; and from the ②altar hearth shall extend upward four horns. ▷ ①Or ariel shall ②Or ariel shall

column.name: text
column.value: Now the ①altar hearth shall be twelve cubits long by twelve wide, square in its four sides. ▷ ①Heb ariel

column.name: text
column.value: And the ledge shall be fourteen cubits long by fourteen wide in its four sides, the border around it shall be half a cubit, and its base shall be a cubit all around; and its steps shall ①face east.” ▷ ①Or be on the east side

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to me, “Son of man, this is what the Lord ①GOD says: ‘These are the statutes for the altar on the day it is built, to offer burnt offerings on it and to sprinkle blood on it. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: You shall give to the Levitical priests who are from the descendants of Zadok, who come near to Me to serve Me,’ declares the Lord GOD, ‘a ①bull as a sin offering. ▷ ①Or young bull

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall take some of its blood and put it on its four horns and on the four corners of the ledge, and on the border all around; so you shall cleanse it and make atonement for it.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also take the bull as the sin offering, and it shall be burned in the appointed place of the house, outside the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘And on the second day you shall offer a male goat without blemish as a sin offering, and they shall cleanse the altar from sin as they cleansed it with the bull.

column.name: text
column.value: When you have finished cleansing it, you shall offer a ①bull without blemish and a ram without blemish from the flock. ▷ ①Or young bull

column.name: text
column.value: You shall offer them before the LORD, and the priests shall throw salt on them, and they shall offer them up as a burnt offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For seven days you shall prepare a goat as a sin offering daily; also a ①bull and a ram from the flock, both without blemish, shall be prepared. ▷ ①Or young bull

column.name: text
column.value: For seven days they shall make atonement for the altar and purify it; so shall they ①consecrate it. ▷ ①Lit fill its hands

column.name: text
column.value: When they have completed the days, it shall be that on the eighth day and onward, the priests shall ①offer your burnt offerings on the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you,’ declares the Lord GOD.” ▷ ①Lit make

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me to the sanctuary, and he measured the side pillars: six ①cubits wide on each side was the width of the ②side pillar. ▷ ①Each of these cubits equals about 21 in. or 53 cm ②As in LXX; MT tent

column.name: text
column.value: The width of the entrance was ten cubits and the ①sides of the entrance were five cubits on each side. He also measured ②the length of the sanctuary, forty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits. ▷ ①Lit shoulders ②Lit its length,

column.name: text
column.value: Then he went ①inside and measured each side pillar of the doorway, two cubits, and the doorway, six cubits high; and the width of the doorway, seven cubits. ▷ ①I.e., of the inner sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: And he measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the sanctuary; and he said to me, “This is the Most Holy Place.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then he measured the wall of the ①temple, six cubits; and the width of the side chambers, four cubits, all around the house on every side. ▷ ①Lit house, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: The side chambers were in three stories, ①one above another, and ②thirty in each story; and ③the side chambers extended to the wall which stood on ④their inward side all around, so that they could be attached, but not be attached to the wall of the temple itself. ▷ ①Lit chamber upon chamber ②Lit thirty times ③Lit they were coming ④Lit the inside of the side chambers

column.name: text
column.value: And the side chambers surrounding the temple were wider at each successive story. Because the structure surrounding the temple went upward by stages on all sides of the temple, for that reason the width of the temple increased as it went higher; and so one went up from the lowest story to the highest by way of the ①second story. ▷ ①Lit middle

column.name: text
column.value: I saw also that the house had a raised ①platform all around; the foundations of the side chambers were a full ②rod of six ③long cubits in height. ▷ ①Lit height ②Lit reed ③Or to the joint

column.name: text
column.value: The ①thickness of the outer wall of the side chambers was five cubits. But the free space between the side chambers belonging to the temple ▷ ①Lit width

column.name: text
column.value: and the outer chambers was twenty cubits in width around the temple on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①doorways of the side ②chambers toward the free space consisted of one doorway toward the north, and another doorway toward the south; and the width of the free space was five cubits all around. ▷ ①Lit doorway ②Lit chamber

column.name: text
column.value: The building that was in front of the separate area at the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide; and the wall of the building was five cubits ①thick all around, and its length was ninety cubits. ▷ ①Lit wide

column.name: text
column.value: Then he measured the temple, a hundred cubits long; the separate area with the building and its walls were also a hundred cubits long.

column.name: text
column.value: Also the width of the front of the temple and that of the separate ①areas along the east side totaled a hundred cubits. ▷ ①Lit area

column.name: text
column.value: And he measured the length of the building ①along the front of the separate area behind it, with a ②gallery on each side, a hundred cubits; he also measured the inner sanctuary and the porches of the courtyard. ▷ ①Lit to ②Or passageway

column.name: text
column.value: The thresholds, the ①latticed windows, and the ②galleries all around their three stories, opposite the threshold, were paneled with wood all around, and from the ground to the windows (but the windows were covered), ▷ ①Or framed ②Or passageways

column.name: text
column.value: over the entrance, and to the inner house, and on the outside, and on all the wall all around inside and outside, by measurement.

column.name: text
column.value: It was ①carved with cherubim and palm trees; and a palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces: ▷ ①Lit made

column.name: text
column.value: a human face toward the palm tree on one side and a young lion’s face toward the palm tree on the other side; they were ①carved on all the house all around. ▷ ①Lit made

column.name: text
column.value: From the ground to above the entrance cherubim and palm trees were ①carved, as well as on the wall of the sanctuary. ▷ ①Lit made

column.name: text
column.value: The doorposts of the sanctuary were square; as for the front of the inner ①sanctuary, the appearance of one doorpost was like that of the other. ▷ ①Lit holy place

column.name: text
column.value: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits; its corners, its ①base, and its ②sides were of wood. And he said to me, “This is the table that is before the LORD.” ▷ ①Lit length ②Lit walls

column.name: text
column.value: The sanctuary and the inner ①sanctuary each had a double door. ▷ ①Lit holy place

column.name: text
column.value: Each of the doors had two leaves, two ①swinging leaves; two leaves for one door and two leaves for the other. ▷ ①Or turning

column.name: text
column.value: Also there were ①carved on them, on the doors of the main room, cherubim and palm trees like those ②carved on the walls; and there was a ③threshold of wood on the front of the porch outside. ▷ ①Lit made ②Lit made ③Or canopy of wood over

column.name: text
column.value: And there were ①latticed windows and palm trees on one side and on the other, on the sides of the porch; the same were on the side chambers of the house and the ②thresholds. ▷ ①Or framed ②Or canopies

column.name: text
column.value: Then He brought me back by way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which faces east; and it was shut.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, “This gate shall be shut; it shall not be opened, and no one shall enter by it, for the LORD God of Israel has entered by it; therefore it shall be shut.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the prince, he shall sit in it as prince to eat bread before the LORD; he shall enter by way of the porch of the gate and shall go out ①by the same way.” ▷ ①Lit its way

column.name: text
column.value: Then He brought me by way of the north gate to the front of the house; and I looked, and behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD, and I fell on my face.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, “Son of man, ①pay attention, see with your eyes and hear with your ears everything that I say to you concerning all the statutes of the house of the LORD and all its laws; and ②pay attention to the entrance of the house, with all the exits of the sanctuary. ▷ ①Lit set your heart ②Lit set your heart

column.name: text
column.value: You shall say to the ①rebellious ones, to the house of Israel, ‘This is what the Lord ②GOD says: “Enough of all your abominations, house of Israel, ▷ ①Lit rebellion ②Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: when you brought in foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in My sanctuary to profane it, My house, when you offered My food, the fat, and the blood and they broke My covenant—this in addition to all your abominations.

column.name: text
column.value: And you have not ①taken responsibility for My holy things yourselves, but you have appointed foreigners ②to take responsibility for My sanctuary.” ▷ ①Lit kept charge of ②Lit as keepers of duty to Me in My

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “No foreigner uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, of all the foreigners who are among the sons of Israel, shall enter My sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Levites who went far from Me when Israel went astray, who went astray from Me ①following their idols, shall suffer the punishment for their wrongdoing. ▷ ①Lit after

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they shall be ministers in My sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house and ministering in the house; they shall slaughter the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Since they ministered to them before their idols and became a stumbling block of wrongdoing to the house of Israel, for that reason I have ①sworn against them,” declares the Lord GOD, “that they shall suffer the punishment for their wrongdoing. ▷ ①Lit lifted up My hand

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall not approach Me to serve as priests for Me, nor approach any of My holy things, to the things that are most holy; but they will bear their shame and their abominations which they have committed.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless I will ①appoint them ②to take responsibility for the house, of all its service and of everything that shall be done in it. ▷ ①Lit give ②Lit keepers of the charge of

column.name: text
column.value: “But the Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, who ①took responsibility for My sanctuary when the sons of Israel went astray from Me, shall come near to Me to serve Me; and they shall stand before Me to offer Me the fat and the blood,” declares the Lord GOD. ▷ ①Lit kept charge of

column.name: text
column.value: “They shall enter My sanctuary; they shall come near to My table to serve Me and ①assume the responsibility I give them. ▷ ①Lit keep the duty to Me

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be that when they enter at the gates of the inner courtyard, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and wool shall not ①be worn by them while they are ministering in the gates of the inner courtyard or in the house. ▷ ①Lit go up on

column.name: text
column.value: Linen turbans shall be on their heads and linen undergarments shall be around their waists; they shall not put on anything that makes them sweat.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they go out into the outer courtyard, into the outer courtyard to the people, they shall take off their garments in which they have been ministering and lay them in the holy chambers; then they shall put on other garments, so that they will not transfer holiness to the people with their garments.

column.name: text
column.value: Also they shall not shave their heads, yet they shall not let their locks ①grow long; they shall only trim the hair of their heads. ▷ ①Or hang loose

column.name: text
column.value: Nor shall any of the priests drink wine when they enter the inner courtyard.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall not ①marry a widow or a divorced woman, but shall take virgins from the descendants of the house of Israel, or a widow who is the widow of a priest. ▷ ①Lit take as wives for themselves

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, they shall teach My people the difference between the holy and the ①common, and teach them to distinguish between the unclean and the clean. ▷ ①Lit profane

column.name: text
column.value: In a dispute they shall take their stand to judge; they shall judge it according to My ordinances. They shall also keep My laws and My statutes in all My appointed feasts, and sanctify My Sabbaths.

column.name: text
column.value: ①They shall not go to a dead person to defile themselves; however, for father, for mother, for son, for daughter, for brother, or for a sister who has not had a husband, they may defile themselves. ▷ ①Lit He

column.name: text
column.value: And after he is cleansed, seven days ①shall elapse for him. ▷ ①Lit they shall count

column.name: text
column.value: On the day that he goes into the sanctuary, to the inner courtyard to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering,” declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: “And it shall be regarding an inheritance for them, that I am their inheritance; and you shall give them no property in Israel—I am their property.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall eat the grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering; and everything banned from secular use in Israel shall be theirs.

column.name: text
column.value: And the first of all the first fruits of every kind and every ①contribution of every kind, from all your ②contributions, shall be for the priests; you shall also give to the priest the first of your ③dough, to make a blessing rest on your house. ▷ ①Or uplifted offering(s) ②Or uplifted offering(s) ③Or coarse meal

column.name: text
column.value: The priests shall not eat any bird or animal that has died a natural death or has been torn to pieces by animals.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the Lord ①GOD says: “The gate of the inner courtyard facing east shall be shut for the six working days; but it shall be opened on the Sabbath day and opened on the day of the new moon. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: The prince shall enter by way of the porch of the gate from outside and stand by the post of the gate. Then the priests shall provide his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate and then go out; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: The people of the land shall also worship at the doorway of that gate before the LORD on the Sabbaths and on the new moons.

column.name: text
column.value: The burnt offering which the prince shall offer to the LORD on the Sabbath day shall be six lambs without blemish and a ram without blemish;

column.name: text
column.value: and the grain offering shall be an ①ephah ②with the ram, and the grain offering ③with the lambs ④as much as he is able to give, and a ⑤hin of oil ⑥with an ephah. ▷ ①About 1 cubic foot or 0.03 cubic meters, and so throughout the ch ②Lit for ③Lit for ④Lit a gift of his hand ⑤About 1 gallon or 3.8 liters, and so throughout the ch ⑥Lit for

column.name: text
column.value: On the day of the new moon he shall offer a ①bull without blemish, and six lambs and a ram, which shall be without blemish. ▷ ①Or young bull

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall provide a grain offering, an ephah ①with the bull and an ephah ②with the ram, and ③with the lambs as ④much as he is able, and a hin of oil ⑤with an ephah. ▷ ①Lit for ②Lit for ③Lit for ④Lit his hand can reach ⑤Lit for

column.name: text
column.value: When the prince enters, he shall go in by way of the porch of the gate, and go out by ①the same way. ▷ ①Lit its way

column.name: text
column.value: But when the people of the land come before the LORD at the appointed feasts, one who enters by way of the north gate to worship shall go out by way of the south gate. And one who enters by way of the south gate shall go out by way of the north gate. ①No one shall return by way of the gate by which he entered, but shall go straight out. ▷ ①Lit He shall not

column.name: text
column.value: And when they go in, the prince shall go in among them; and when they go out, ①he shall go out. ▷ ①As in many mss and ancient versions; MT they

column.name: text
column.value: “At the festivals and the appointed feasts, the grain offering shall be an ephah ①with a bull and an ephah ②with a ram, and ③with the lambs as ④much as one is able to give, and a hin of oil ⑤with an ephah. ▷ ①Lit for ②Lit for ③Lit for ④Lit a gift of his hand ⑤Lit for

column.name: text
column.value: And when the prince provides a ①voluntary offering, a burnt offering, or peace offerings as a ②voluntary offering to the LORD, the gate facing east shall be opened for him. And he shall provide his burnt offering and his peace offerings as he does on the Sabbath day. Then he shall go out, and the gate shall be shut after he goes out. ▷ ①Or freewill offering ②Or freewill offering

column.name: text
column.value: “And you shall provide a lamb a year old without blemish as a burnt offering to the LORD daily; morning by morning you shall provide it.

column.name: text
column.value: You shall also provide a grain offering with it morning by morning, a sixth of an ephah and a third of a hin of oil to moisten the fine flour, a grain offering to the LORD continually by ①a permanent ordinance. ▷ ①Lit perpetual statutes

column.name: text
column.value: So they shall provide the lamb, the grain offering, and the oil, morning by morning, as a continual burnt offering.”

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “If the prince gives a gift from his inheritance to any of his sons, it shall belong to his sons; it is their possession by inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he gives a gift from his inheritance to one of his servants, it shall be his until the year of ①release; then it shall return to the prince. His inheritance shall be only his sons’; it shall belong to them. ▷ ①Or liberty

column.name: text
column.value: And the prince shall not take from the people’s inheritance, ①depriving them of their property; he shall give his sons inheritance from his own property, so that My people will not be scattered, anyone from his property.” ’ ” ▷ ①Lit oppressing

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me through the entrance, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers for the priests, which faced north; and behold, a place was there at the extreme rear toward the west.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, “This is the place where the priests shall boil the guilt offering and the sin offering, and where they shall bake the grain offering, so that they do not bring them out into the outer courtyard ①and transfer holiness to the people.” ▷ ①Lit to

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me out into the outer courtyard and led me across to the four corners of the courtyard; and behold, in every corner of the courtyard there was a small courtyard.

column.name: text
column.value: In the four corners of the courtyard there were enclosed courtyards, forty ①cubits long and thirty wide; these four in the corners were ②the same size. ▷ ①Each of these cubits equals about 21 in. or 53 cm ②Lit one measure

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a row of masonry all around in them, around the four of them, and cooking hearths were made under the rows all around.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to me, “These are the cooking ①places where the ministers of the house shall cook the sacrifices of the people.” ▷ ①Lit houses

column.name: text
column.value: “Now when you divide the land by lot for inheritance, you shall offer ①an allotment to the LORD, a holy portion of the land; the length shall be a length of twenty-five thousand ②cubits, and the width shall be ③twenty thousand. It shall be holy within its entire surrounding boundary. ▷ ①Or a contribution ②Each of these cubits equals about 21 in. or 53 cm ③As in LXX; MT 10,000

column.name: text
column.value: Out of this there shall be for the sanctuary a square encompassing five hundred by five hundred cubits, and fifty cubits for its ①open space round about. ▷ ①Or pasture land

column.name: text
column.value: From this ①area you shall measure a length of twenty-five thousand cubits and a width of ten thousand cubits; and in it shall be the sanctuary, the Most Holy Place. ▷ ①Lit measure

column.name: text
column.value: It shall be the holy portion of the land; it shall be for the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, who come near to serve the LORD, and it shall be a place for their houses and a holy place for the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: An area twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width shall be for the Levites, the ministers of the house, and for their possession ①cities in which to live. ▷ ①As in LXX; MT twenty chambers

column.name: text
column.value: “And you shall give the city possession of an area five thousand cubits wide and twenty-five thousand cubits long, alongside the ①allotment of the holy portion; it shall be for the entire house of Israel. ▷ ①Or contribution

column.name: text
column.value: “And the prince shall have land on either side of the holy ①allotment and the ②property of the city, adjacent to the holy ③allotment and the ④property of the city, on the west side toward the west and on the east side toward the east, and in length comparable to one of the portions, from the west border to the east border. ▷ ①Or contribution ②Lit possession ③Or contribution ④Lit possession

column.name: text
column.value: This shall be his land as a possession in Israel; so My princes shall no longer oppress My people, but they shall give the rest of the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.”

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the Lord ①GOD says: “Enough, you princes of Israel; get rid of violence and destruction, and practice justice and righteousness. Revoke your evictions of My people,” declares the Lord GOD. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: “You shall have accurate balances, an accurate ①ephah, and an accurate ②bath. ▷ ①I.e., a dry measure, about 1 cubic foot or 0.03 cubic meters ②I.e., a liquid measure, about 6 gallons or 23 liters

column.name: text
column.value: The ephah and the bath shall be ①the same quantity, so that the bath will contain a tenth of a homer, and the ephah a tenth of a ②homer; ③their standard shall be according to the homer. ▷ ①Lit one ②About 7.7 cubic feet or 0.22 cubic meters ③Lit its measure

column.name: text
column.value: And the shekel shall be twenty gerahs; twenty shekels, twenty-five shekels, and fifteen shekels shall be your mina.

column.name: text
column.value: “This is the offering that you shall offer: a sixth of an ephah from each homer of wheat; a sixth of an ephah from each homer of barley;

column.name: text
column.value: and the prescribed portion of oil (namely, the bath of oil), a tenth of a bath from each kor (which is ten baths or a homer, for ten baths are a homer);

column.name: text
column.value: and one sheep from each flock of two hundred from the watering places of Israel—for a grain offering, for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make atonement for them,” declares the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: “All the people of the land shall ①give to this offering for the prince in Israel. ▷ ①Lit be

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be the prince’s part to provide the burnt offerings, the grain offerings, and the drink offerings, at the feasts, on the new moons, and on the Sabbaths, at all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel; he shall provide the sin offering, the grain offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make atonement for the house of Israel.”

column.name: text
column.value: ‘This is what the Lord GOD says: “In the first month, on the first of the month, you shall take a ①bull without blemish and cleanse the sanctuary from sin. ▷ ①Or young bull

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall take some of the blood from the sin offering and put it on the door posts of the house, on the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and on the posts of the gate of the inner courtyard.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall do this on the seventh day of the month for everyone who does wrong inadvertently or is naive; so you shall make atonement for the house.

column.name: text
column.value: “In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall have the Passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day the prince shall provide for himself and all the people of the land a bull as a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And during the seven days of the feast he shall provide as a burnt offering to the LORD seven bulls and seven rams without blemish on every day of the seven days, and a male goat daily as a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall provide as a grain offering an ①ephah ②with a bull, an ③ephah ④with a ram, and a ⑤hin of oil ⑥with an ephah. ▷ ①About 1 cubic foot or 0.03 cubic meters ②Lit for ③About 1 cubic foot or 0.03 cubic meters ④Lit for ⑤About 1 gallon or 3.8 liters ⑥Lit for

column.name: text
column.value: In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month, at the feast, he shall provide like these, seven days ①for the sin offering, the burnt offering, the grain offering, and the oil.” ▷ ①Lit according to

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me back to the door of the house; and behold, water was flowing from under the threshold of the house toward the east, for the house faced east. And the water was flowing down from under, from the right side of the house, from south of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought me out by way of the north gate and led me around ①on the outside to the outer gate, by the way facing east. And behold, water was spurting out from the south side. ▷ ①Lit by way of

column.name: text
column.value: When the man went out toward the east with a line in his hand, he measured a thousand ①cubits, and he led me through the water, water reaching the ankles. ▷ ①Each of these cubits equals about 21 in. or 53 cm

column.name: text
