column.value: Then the LORD said to me, “Go again, love ①a woman who is loved by her ②husband, yet is committing adultery, as the LORD loves the sons of Israel, though they turn to other gods and love ③raisin cakes.” ▷ ①I.e., Gomer ②Lit companion ③Used in idolatry

column.name: text
column.value: So I purchased her for myself for fifteen shekels of silver, and a ①homer and a ②lethech of barley. ▷ ①About 7.7 cubic feet or 0.22 cubic meters ②About 3.8 cubic feet or 0.11 cubic meters

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said to her, “You shall live with me for many days. You shall not play the prostitute, nor shall you have another man; so I will also be toward you.”

column.name: text
column.value: For the sons of Israel will live for many days without a king or leader, without sacrifice or memorial stone, and without ephod or ①household idols. ▷ ①Heb teraphim

column.name: text
column.value: Afterward the sons of Israel will return and seek the LORD their God and David their king; and they will come trembling to the LORD and to His goodness in the last days.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen to the word of the LORD, you sons of Israel, Because the LORD has a case against the inhabitants of the land, For there is no ①faithfulness, nor ②loyalty, Nor knowledge of God in the land. ▷ ①Or truth ②Or kindness

column.name: text
column.value: There is oath-taking, ①denial, murder, stealing, and adultery. They employ violence, so that bloodshed ②follows bloodshed. ▷ ①I.e., of truth ②Lit touches

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the land mourns, And everyone who lives in it languishes Along with the animals of the field and the birds of the sky, And even the fish of the sea ①disappear. ▷ ①Lit are taken away

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Since you have rejected knowledge, I also will reject you from being My priest. Since you have forgotten the Law of your God, I also will forget your children.

column.name: text
column.value: The more they multiplied, the more they sinned against Me; I will change their glory into shame.

column.name: text
column.value: They feed on the ①sin of My people, And long for their wrongdoing. ▷ ①Or sin offering

column.name: text
text
column.value: They will eat, but not have enough; They will play the prostitute, but not ①increase, Because they gave up devoting themselves to the LORD. ▷ ①I.e., either in population or wealth

column.name: text
column.value: ①Infidelity, wine, and new wine take away the ②understanding. ▷ ①Or Prostitution ②Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: My people consult their wooden idol, and their diviner’s wand informs them; For a spirit of infidelity has led them astray, And they have been unfaithful, departing ①from their God. ▷ ①Lit from under

column.name: text
column.value: They offer sacrifices on the tops of the mountains And ①burn incense on the hills, Under oak, poplar, and terebinth, Because their shade is pleasant. Therefore your daughters play the prostitute, And your ②brides commit adultery. ▷ ①Or offer sacrifices ②Or daughters-in-law

column.name: text
column.value: I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute, Or your ①brides when they commit adultery, Because the men themselves slip away with the prostitutes And offer sacrifices with temple prostitutes; So the people without understanding are ruined. ▷ ①Or daughters-in-law

column.name: text
column.value: Though you, Israel, play the prostitute, Judah must not become guilty; Also you are not to go to Gilgal, Nor go up to Beth-aven And take the oath: “As the LORD lives!”

column.name: text
column.value: Since Israel is stubborn Like a stubborn cow, ①Will the LORD now pasture them Like a lamb in a large field? ▷ ①Or The LORD will now pasture...field.

column.name: text
column.value: Ephraim is allied with idols; Leave him alone.

column.name: text
column.value: Their liquor is gone, They prostitute themselves continually; ①Their ②rulers dearly love shame. ▷ ①Another reading is They dearly love the shame of gifts ②Lit shields

column.name: text
column.value: The wind wraps them in its wings, And they will be ①put to shame because of their sacrifices. ▷ ①Or ashamed

column.name: text
column.value: Hear this, you priests! Pay attention, house of Israel! Listen, you of the house of the king! For the judgment applies to you, Because you have been a trap at Mizpah, And a net spread out on Tabor.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rebels have gone deep in ①depravity, But I will discipline all of them. ▷ ①Or slaughter

column.name: text
text
column.value: Their deeds will not allow them To return to their God. For a spirit of ①infidelity is within them, And they do not know the LORD. ▷ ①Or prostitution

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: They have dealt treacherously with the LORD, For they have given birth to ①illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their ②land. ▷ ①Lit strange ②Lit portions

column.name: text
column.value: Blow the horn in Gibeah, And the trumpet in Ramah. Sound an alarm at Beth-aven: “Behind you, Benjamin!”

column.name: text
column.value: Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke; Among the tribes of Israel I make known what is trustworthy.

column.name: text
column.value: The leaders of Judah have become like those who displace a boundary marker; On them I will pour out My anger like water.

column.name: text
column.value: Ephraim is oppressed, broken by judgment, Because he was determined to follow ①man’s command. ▷ ①Or with some ancient versions, nothingness

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I am like a moth to Ephraim, And like rottenness to the house of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: When Ephraim saw his sickness, And Judah his ①sore, Ephraim then went to Assyria And sent word to ②King Jareb. But he is unable to heal you, Or to cure you of your ③sore. ▷ ①Or ulcer ②Or another reading is the great king; or the contentious king ③Or ulcer

column.name: text
column.value: For I will be like a lion to Ephraim And like a young lion to the house of Judah. I, yes I, will tear to pieces and go away, I will carry away, and there will be no one to rescue.

column.name: text
column.value: I will go away and return to My place Until they ①acknowledge their guilt and seek My face; In their distress they will search for Me. ▷ ①Or suffer their punishment

column.name: text
column.value: “Come, let’s return to the LORD. For He has torn us, but He will heal us; He has ①wounded us, but He will bandage us. ▷ ①Lit struck

column.name: text
text
column.value: So let’s learn, let’s press on to know the LORD. His appearance is as sure as the dawn; And He will come to us like the rain, As the spring rain waters the earth.”

column.name: text
column.value: What shall I do with you, Ephraim? What shall I do with you, Judah? For your loyalty is like a morning cloud, And like the dew which goes away early.

column.name: text
text
column.value: For I ①desire loyalty rather than sacrifice, And the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings. ▷ ①Or take pleasure in

column.name: text
text
column.value: Gilead is a city of wrongdoers, Tracked with bloody footprints.

column.name: text
text
column.value: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing; Ephraim’s infidelity is there, Israel has defiled itself.

column.name: text
column.value: Also, Judah, there is a harvest appointed for you, When I restore the fortunes of My people.

column.name: text
column.value: Put the trumpet to your ①lips! Like an eagle the enemy comes against the house of the LORD, Because they have violated My covenant And rebelled against My Law. ▷ ①Lit palate

column.name: text
column.value: They cry out to Me, “My God, we of Israel know You!”

column.name: text
column.value: Israel has rejected the good; The enemy will pursue him.

column.name: text
column.value: They have set up kings, but not by Me; They have appointed officials, but I did not know it. With their silver and gold they have made idols for themselves, So that ①they will be eliminated. ▷ ①Lit he

column.name: text
column.value: ①He has rejected your calf, Samaria, saying, “My anger burns against them!” How long will they be incapable of innocence? ▷ ①Or Your calf has rejected you

column.name: text
column.value: For from Israel comes even this! A craftsman made it, so it is not God; Assuredly, the calf of Samaria will be broken to ①pieces. ▷ ①Or splinters

column.name: text
column.value: For they sow wind And they harvest a storm. The standing grain has no ①kernels; It yields no ②grain. If it were to yield, strangers would swallow it. ▷ ①Lit growth ②Or meal

column.name: text
text
column.value: For they have gone up to Assyria, Like a wild donkey all alone; Ephraim has paid fees for ①lovers. ▷ ①Lit love gifts

column.name: text
column.value: Even though they ①pay for allies among the nations, I will gather them up now; And they will begin to diminish Because of the burden of the king of officials. ▷ ①Or recruit allies

column.name: text
column.value: Since Ephraim has multiplied altars for sin, They have become altars of sinning for him.

column.name: text
column.value: Though I wrote for him ten thousand precepts of My Law, They are regarded as a strange thing.

column.name: text
column.value: As for My sacrificial gifts, They sacrifice the flesh and eat it, But the LORD has taken no delight in them. Now He will remember their guilt, And punish them for their sins; They will return to Egypt.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Do not rejoice, Israel, ①with jubilation like the ②nations! For you have been unfaithful, ③abandoning your God. You have loved the earnings of unfaithfulness on ④every threshing floor. ▷ ①Lit to ②Lit peoples ③Lit away from your God ④Lit all threshing floors of grain

column.name: text
column.value: Threshing floor and wine press will not feed them, And the new wine will fail ①them. ▷ ①Lit her

column.name: text
column.value: They will not remain in the LORD’S land, But Ephraim will return to Egypt, And in Assyria they will eat unclean food.

column.name: text
column.value: They will not pour out drink offerings of wine to the LORD, Nor will ①their sacrifices please Him. Their bread will be to them like ②mourners’ bread; All who eat it will be defiled, Because their bread will be for ③themselves alone; It will not enter the house of the LORD. ▷ ①Or they offer to Him their ②Lit bread of mourning ③Lit their soul

column.name: text
column.value: What will you do on the day of the appointed festival And on the day of the feast of the LORD?

column.name: text
text
column.value: The days of punishment have come, The days of retribution have come; ①Let Israel know this! The prophet is a fool, The ②inspired person is insane, Because of the grossness of your wrongdoing, And because your ③hostility is so great. ▷ ①Or Israel will know this ②Lit man of the spirit ③Or persecution

column.name: text
column.value: Ephraim was a watchman with my God, a prophet; Yet the snare of a bird catcher is in all his ways, And there is only ①hostility in the house of his God. ▷ ①Or persecution

column.name: text
column.value: They are deeply depraved As in the days of Gibeah; He will remember their guilt, He will punish their sins.

column.name: text
column.value: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your forefathers as the earliest fruit on the fig tree in its first season. But they came to Baal-peor and devoted themselves to ①shame, And they became as detestable as that which they loved. ▷ ①I.e., Baal

column.name: text
column.value: As for Ephraim, their glory will fly away like a bird— No birth, no pregnancy, and no conception!

column.name: text
column.value: Though they bring up their children, Yet I will bereave them of their children ①until not a person is left. Yes, woe to them indeed when I depart from them! ▷ ①Lit without a person

column.name: text
text
column.value: Give to them, LORD—what will You give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dried-up breasts.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Ephraim is stricken, their root is dried up, They will produce no fruit. Even though they give birth to children, I will put to death the precious ones of their womb.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Israel is a luxuriant vine; He produces fruit for himself. The more his fruit, The more altars he made; The ①richer his land, The better ②he made the memorial stones. ▷ ①Lit better ②Lit they

column.name: text
column.value: Their heart is ①deceitful; Now they must suffer for their guilt. ②The LORD will break down their altars And destroy their memorial stones. ▷ ①Lit slippery; or divided ②Lit He

column.name: text
column.value: Certainly now they will say, “We have no king, For we do not revere the LORD. As for the king, what can he do for us?”

column.name: text
column.value: They speak mere words, ①With worthless oaths they make covenants; And judgment sprouts like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field. ▷ ①Or Swearing falsely in making a covenant

column.name: text
column.value: The inhabitants of Samaria will fear For the ①calf of Beth-aven. Indeed, its people will mourn for it, And its idolatrous priests ②will cry out over it, Over its glory, since it has left it. ▷ ①As in some ancient versions; MT calves ②Or who used to rejoice over

column.name: text
column.value: The thing itself will be brought to Assyria As a gift of tribute to ①King Jareb; Ephraim will ②be seized with shame, And Israel will be ashamed of its own plan. ▷ ①Another reading is the great king; or the contentious king ②Lit receive shame

column.name: text
column.value: Samaria will be destroyed with her king, Like a twig on the surface of the water.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: When it is My desire, I will ①discipline them; And the peoples will be gathered against them When they are bound for their double guilt. ▷ ①Or instruct

column.name: text
column.value: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh, ①And I passed over her lovely neck; I will harness Ephraim, Judah will plow, Jacob will ②harrow for himself. ▷ ①Or But I put a yoke on her lovely ②I.e., pull a harrow, a farming device

column.name: text
column.value: Sow for yourselves, with a view to righteousness; Harvest in accordance with ①kindness. Break up your uncultivated ground, For it is time to seek the LORD Until He comes and rains righteousness on you. ▷ ①Or loyalty

column.name: text
column.value: You have plowed wickedness, you have harvested injustice, You have eaten the fruit of lies. Because you have trusted in your way, in your many warriors,

column.name: text
column.value: An uproar will arise among your people, And all your fortresses will be destroyed, As Shalman destroyed Beth-arbel on the day of battle, When mothers were ①slaughtered with their children. ▷ ①Lit shattered

column.name: text
column.value: So it will be done to you at Bethel because of your great wickedness. At dawn the king of Israel will be completely destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: When I would heal Israel, The wrongdoing of Ephraim is uncovered, And the evil deeds of Samaria, For they practice deception; The thief enters, A band of robbers attack outside,

column.name: text
column.value: And they do not ①consider in their hearts That I remember all their wickedness. Now their deeds surround them; They are before My face. ▷ ①Lit say to their

column.name: text
column.value: With their wickedness they make the king happy, And the officials with their lies.

column.name: text
column.value: They are all adulterers, Like an oven heated by the baker, Who stops ①stoking the fire From the time the dough is kneaded until it is leavened. ▷ ①Lit stirring up

column.name: text
text
column.value: For their hearts are like an oven As they approach their ①plotting; Their ②anger ③smolders all night, In the morning it burns like flaming fire. ▷ ①Lit ambush ②As in some ancient versions; MT baker ③Lit is asleep

column.name: text
column.value: All of them are hot like an oven, And they consume their rulers; All their kings have fallen. None of them calls on Me.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Strangers devour his strength, Yet he does not know it; Gray hairs also are sprinkled on him, Yet he does not know it.

column.name: text
column.value: Though the pride of Israel testifies against him, Yet they have not returned to the LORD their God, Nor have they sought Him, despite all this.

column.name: text
text
column.value: When they go, I will spread My net over them; I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will discipline them in accordance with the ①proclamation to their assembly. ▷ ①Lit report

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to them, for they have strayed from Me! Destruction is theirs, for they have rebelled against Me! I would redeem them, but they have spoken lies against Me.

column.name: text
column.value: And they do not cry to Me from their heart When they wail on their beds; For the sake of grain and new wine they ①assemble themselves, They turn against Me. ▷ ①Or LXX and many ancient mss gash themselves

column.name: text
column.value: Although I trained and strengthened their arms, Yet they devise evil against Me.

column.name: text
column.value: They turn, but not ①upward, They are like a loose bow; Their officials will fall by the sword Because of the ②insolence of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Egypt. ▷ ①Or possibly to the Most High ②Lit cursing

column.name: text
column.value: When Israel was a youth I loved him, And out of Egypt I called My son.

column.name: text
column.value: The more ①they called them, The more they went away from ②them; They kept sacrificing to the Baals And burning incense to idols. ▷ ①I.e., God’s prophets ②I.e., God’s prophets

column.name: text
column.value: Yet it is I who taught Ephraim to walk, ①I took them in My arms; But they did not know that I healed them. ▷ ①As in ancient versions; MT He...His

column.name: text
text
column.value: ①They will not return to the land of Egypt; But Assyria—he will be ②their king Because they refused to return to Me. ▷ ①Lit He ②Lit his

column.name: text
column.value: And the sword will whirl against ①their cities, And will destroy ②their oracle priests And consume them, because of their counsels. ▷ ①Lit his ②Lit his

column.name: text
column.value: So My people are determined to turn from Me. Though ①they call ②them to the One on high, None at all exalts Him. ▷ ①I.e., God’s prophets ②Lit him; i.e., Israel

column.name: text
column.value: How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I surrender you, Israel? How can I ①make you like Admah? How can I treat you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned over within Me, ②All My compassions are kindled. ▷ ①Lit give ②Lit Together

column.name: text
column.value: I will not carry out My fierce anger; I will not destroy Ephraim again. For I am God and not a man, the Holy One in your midst, And I will not come in ①wrath. ▷ ①Lit agitation

column.name: text
column.value: They will walk after the LORD, He will roar like a lion; Indeed He will roar, And His sons will come trembling from the west.

column.name: text
text
column.value: ①Ephraim surrounds Me with lies And the house of Israel with deceit; ②Judah is still unruly against God, Even against the Holy One who is faithful. ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: ①Ephraim feeds on wind, And pursues the east wind continually; He multiplies lies and violence. Moreover, ②he makes a covenant with Assyria, And oil is brought to Egypt. ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
text
column.value: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, And in his mature strength he contended with God.

column.name: text
column.value: Yes, he wrestled with the angel and prevailed; He wept and implored His favor. He found Him at Bethel, And there He spoke with us,

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD, the God of armies, The LORD is His ①name. ▷ ①Lit invocation

column.name: text
column.value: So as for you, return to your God, Maintain ①kindness and justice, And wait for your God continually. ▷ ①Or loyalty

column.name: text
column.value: A ①merchant, in whose hands are fraudulent balances, Loves to exploit. ▷ ①Or Canaanite

column.name: text
column.value: And Ephraim said, “I have certainly become rich, I have found wealth for myself; In all my labors they will find in me No wrongdoing, which would be sin.”

column.name: text
text
column.value: I have also spoken to the prophets, And I ①provided many visions, And through the prophets I spoke in parables. ▷ ①Lit multiplied the vision

column.name: text
column.value: Is there injustice in Gilead? Certainly they are worthless. In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls, Yes, their altars are like stone heaps Beside the furrows of a field.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jacob fled to the ①land of Aram, And Israel worked for a wife, And for a wife he kept sheep. ▷ ①Lit field

column.name: text
column.value: But by a prophet the LORD brought Israel up from Egypt, And by a prophet he was protected.

column.name: text
text
column.value: When Ephraim ①spoke, there was trembling. He exalted himself in Israel, But through Baal he incurred guilt and died. ▷ ①Or spoke with trembling, he exalted

column.name: text
column.value: And now they sin more and more, And make for themselves cast metal images, Idols ①skillfully made from their silver, All of them the work of craftsmen. They say of them, “Let the ②people who sacrifice kiss the calves!” ▷ ①Or according to their skill ②Lit sacrificers of; or among mankind

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they will be like the morning cloud And like dew which ①soon disappears, Like chaff which is blown away from the threshing floor, And like smoke from a chimney. ▷ ①Lit goes away early

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I have been the LORD your God Since the land of Egypt; And you were not to know any god except Me, For there is no savior besides Me.

column.name: text
column.value: I ①cared for you in the wilderness, In the land of drought. ▷ ①Or knew

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: I will confront them like a bear deprived of her cubs, And I will tear open ①their chests; I will also devour them there like a lioness, As a wild animal would tear them to pieces. ▷ ①Lit the enclosure of their heart

column.name: text
column.value: ①It is to your own destruction, Israel, That you are against Me, against your help. ▷ ①Lit It has destroyed you

column.name: text
column.value: Where then is your king, That he might save you in all your cities; And your judges, to whom you said, “Give me a king and princes”?

column.name: text
column.value: I gave you a king in My anger, And took him away in My wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: The guilt of Ephraim is wrapped up; His sin is stored up.

column.name: text
column.value: The pains of childbirth come on him; He is not a wise son, For ①it is not the time that he should delay at the opening of the womb. ▷ ①Lit it is the time that he should not remain at the opening of children

column.name: text
column.value: Shall I ransom them from the ①power of Sheol? Shall I redeem them from death? Death, where are your ②thorns? Sheol, where is your sting? Compassion will be hidden from My sight. ▷ ①Lit hand ②Or stings

column.name: text
column.value: Though he flourishes among the ①reeds, An east wind will come, The wind of the LORD coming up from the wilderness; And his fountain will become dry And his spring will dry up; It will plunder his treasury of every precious article. ▷ ①Another reading is brothers

column.name: text
column.value: ①Samaria will pay the penalty for her guilt, Because she has rebelled against her God. They will fall by the sword, Their children will be ②slaughtered, And their pregnant women will be ripped open. ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: ①Return, Israel, to the LORD your God, For you have stumbled ②because of your wrongdoing. ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: Take words with you and return to the LORD. Say to Him, “Take away all guilt And ①receive us graciously, So that we may present ②the fruit of our lips. ▷ ①Or accept that which is good ②As in ancient versions; MT our lips as bulls

column.name: text
text
column.value: I will heal their apostasy, I will love them freely, Because My anger has turned away from them.

column.name: text
column.value: I will be like the dew to Israel; He will blossom like the lily, And he will ①take root like the cedars of Lebanon. ▷ ①Lit strike his roots

column.name: text
column.value: His shoots will ①sprout, His ②majesty will be like the olive tree, And his fragrance like the cedars of Lebanon. ▷ ①Lit go ②Lit splendor

column.name: text
column.value: Those who live in his shadow Will ①again raise grain, And they will blossom like the vine. His fame will be like the wine of Lebanon. ▷ ①Or return, they will raise grain

column.name: text
column.value: Ephraim, what more have I to do with idols? It is I who answer and look after ①you. I am like a luxuriant juniper; From Me ②comes your fruit. ▷ ①Lit him ②Lit is found

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever is wise, let him understand these things; Whoever is discerning, let him know them. For the ways of the LORD are right, And the righteous will walk in them, But wrongdoers will stumble in them.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel:

column.name: text
column.value: Hear this, you elders, And listen, all inhabitants of the land. Has anything like this happened in your days, Or in your fathers’ days?

column.name: text
column.value: Tell your sons about it, And have your sons tell their sons, And their sons the next generation.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Awake, you heavy drinkers, and weep; And wail, all you wine drinkers, Because of the sweet wine, For it has been eliminated from your mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: For a nation has ①invaded my land, Mighty and without number; Its teeth are the teeth of a lion, And it has the jaws of a lioness. ▷ ①Lit gone up against

column.name: text
column.value: It has made my vine a waste And my fig tree a stump. It has stripped them bare and hurled them away; Their branches have become white.

column.name: text
column.value: Wail like a virgin clothed with sackcloth For the groom of her youth.

column.name: text
column.value: The grain offering and the drink offering have been cut off From the house of the LORD. The priests mourn, The ministers of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The field is ruined, The land mourns; For the grain is ruined, The new wine has dried up, Fresh oil has ①failed. ▷ ①Lit dried out

column.name: text
column.value: Be ashamed, you farm workers, Wail, you vinedressers, For the wheat and the barley; Because the harvest of the field is destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: The vine has dried up And the fig tree has withered; The pomegranate, the palm also, and the apple tree, All the trees of the field have dried up. Indeed, joy has dried up From the sons of mankind.

column.name: text
column.value: Put on sackcloth And mourn, you priests; Wail, you ministers of the altar! Come, spend the night in sackcloth, You ministers of my God, For the grain offering and the drink offering Have been withheld from the house of your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Consecrate a fast, Proclaim a solemn assembly; Gather the elders And all the inhabitants of the land To the house of the LORD your God, And cry out to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe for the day! For the day of the LORD is near, And it will come as destruction from the ①Almighty. ▷ ①Heb Shaddai

column.name: text
column.value: Has food not been cut off before our eyes, and Joy and rejoicing from the house of our God?

column.name: text
column.value: The ①seeds have dried up under their shovels; The storehouses have become desolate, The grain silos are ruined, Because the grain has dried up. ▷ ①Or dried figs

column.name: text
column.value: How the animals have groaned! The herds of cattle have wandered aimlessly Because there is no pasture for them; Even the flocks of sheep have ①suffered. ▷ ①Lit suffered punishment

column.name: text
text
column.value: Even the animals of the field ①pant for You; For the stream beds of water are dried up, And fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness. ▷ ①Or long for

column.name: text
column.value: Blow a trumpet in Zion, And sound an alarm on My holy mountain! Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble, For the day of the LORD is coming; Indeed, it is near,

column.name: text
column.value: A day of darkness and gloom, A day of clouds and thick darkness. As dawn is spread over the mountains, So there is a great and mighty people; There has never been anything like it, Nor will there be again after it To the years of many generations.

column.name: text
column.value: A fire consumes before them, And behind them a flame devours. The land is like the Garden of Eden before them, But a desolate wilderness behind them, And nothing at all escapes them.

column.name: text
column.value: Their appearance is like the appearance of horses; And like war horses, so they run.

column.name: text
column.value: ①With a noise as of chariots They leap about on the tops of the mountains, Like the ②crackling of a flame of fire consuming the stubble, Like a mighty people drawn up for battle. ▷ ①Lit Like the noise of chariots ②Lit sound

column.name: text
text
column.value: They run like warriors, They climb the wall like soldiers; And each of them marches ①in line, Nor do they lose their way. ▷ ①Lit in his ways

column.name: text
column.value: They do not crowd each other, Every warrior of them marches in his path; When they ①burst through the ②defenses, They do not break ranks. ▷ ①Lit fall ②Lit weapon, prob. javelin

column.name: text
column.value: They storm the city, They run on the wall; They climb into the houses, They enter through the windows like a thief.

column.name: text
column.value: Before them the earth quakes, The heavens tremble, The sun and the moon become dark, And the stars lose their brightness.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD utters His voice before His army; His camp is indeed very great, For mighty is one who carries out His word. The day of the LORD is indeed great and very awesome, And who can endure it?

column.name: text
text
column.value: And tear your heart and not merely your garments.” Now return to the LORD your God, For He is gracious and compassionate, Slow to anger, abounding in mercy And relenting of catastrophe.

column.name: text
column.value: Who knows, He might turn and relent, And leave a blessing behind Him, Resulting in a grain offering and a drink offering For the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Blow a trumpet in Zion, Consecrate a fast, proclaim a solemn assembly,

column.name: text
column.value: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, Assemble the elders, Gather the children and the nursing infants. Have the groom come out of his room And the bride out of her bridal chamber.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the priests, the LORD’S ministers, Weep between the porch and the altar, And let them say, “ ①Spare Your people, LORD, And do not make Your inheritance a disgrace, With the nations jeering at them. Why should those among the peoples say, ‘Where is their God?’ ” ▷ ①Or Look compassionately on

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD ①will be zealous for His land, And ②will have compassion for His people. ▷ ①Or was zealous ②Or had compassion

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD ①will answer and say to His people, “Behold, I am going to send you grain, new wine, and oil, And you will be satisfied in full with ②them; And I will never again make you a disgrace among the nations. ▷ ①Or answered and said ②Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: But I will remove the northern army far from you, And I will drive it into a dry and desolate land, Its advance guard into the eastern sea, And its rear guard into the western sea. And its stench will ascend and its odor of decay will come up, Because it has done great things.”

column.name: text
column.value: Do not fear, land; shout for joy and rejoice, For the LORD has done great things.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not fear, animals of the field, For the pastures of the wilderness have turned green, For the tree has produced its fruit, The fig tree and the vine have yielded ①in full. ▷ ①Lit their wealth

column.name: text
column.value: So shout for joy, you sons of Zion, And rejoice in the LORD your God; For He has given you ①the early rain for your vindication. And He has brought down for you the rain, The ②early and ③latter rain ④as before. ▷ ①I.e., autumn; or possibly the teacher for righteousness ②I.e., autumn ③I.e., spring ④As in ancient versions; MT in the first

column.name: text
column.value: The threshing floors will be full of grain, And the vats will overflow with the new wine and oil.

column.name: text
column.value: “Then I will compensate you for the years That the ①swarming locust has eaten, The creeping locust, the stripping locust, and the gnawing locust— My great army which I sent among you. ▷ ①Or migratory

column.name: text
column.value: You will have plenty to eat and be satisfied, And you will praise the name of the LORD your God, Who has dealt wondrously with you; Then My people will never be put to shame.

column.name: text
column.value: So you will know that I am in the midst of Israel, And that I am the LORD your God And there is no other; And My people will never be put to shame.

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①It will come about after this That I will pour out My Spirit on all ②mankind; And your sons and your daughters will prophesy, Your old men will have dreams, Your young men will see visions. ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: And even on the male and female servants I will pour out My Spirit in those days.

column.name: text
column.value: I will ①display wonders in the sky and on the earth, Blood, fire, and columns of smoke. ▷ ①Lit give

column.name: text
column.value: The sun will be turned into darkness, And the moon into blood, Before the great and awesome day of the LORD comes.

column.name: text
column.value: And it will come about that everyone who calls on the name of the LORD Will ①be saved; For on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem There will be those who escape, Just as the LORD has said, Even among the survivors whom the LORD calls. ▷ ①Or flee to safety

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①For behold, in those days and at that time, When I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem, ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: I will gather all the nations And bring them down to the Valley of ①Jehoshaphat. Then I will enter into judgment with them there On behalf of My people and My inheritance, Israel, Whom they have scattered among the nations; And they have divided up My land. ▷ ①I.e., YHWH judges

column.name: text
column.value: They have also cast lots for My people, ①Traded a boy for a prostitute, And sold a girl for wine so that they may drink. ▷ ①Lit Given

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, what are you to Me, Tyre, Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Are you repaying Me with retribution? But if you are showing Me retribution, swiftly and speedily I will return your retribution on your head!

column.name: text
column.value: Since you have taken My silver and My gold, brought My precious ①treasures to your temples, ▷ ①Lit goodly things

column.name: text
column.value: and sold the sons of Judah and Jerusalem to the ①Greeks in order to remove them far from their territory, ▷ ①Lit sons of Javan

column.name: text
column.value: behold, I am going to stir them up from the place where you have sold them, and return your retribution on your head.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the sons of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, to a distant nation,” for the LORD has spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: Proclaim this among the nations: Prepare for holy war; stir up the warriors! Have all the soldiers come forward, have them come up!

column.name: text
text
column.value: ①Hurry and come, all you surrounding nations, And gather yourselves there. Bring down, LORD, Your warriors. ▷ ①Or Come help

column.name: text
column.value: Let the nations be awakened And come up to the Valley of ①Jehoshaphat, For there I will sit to judge All the surrounding nations. ▷ ①I.e., YHWH judges

column.name: text
text
column.value: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of ①decision! For the day of the LORD is near in the valley of ②decision. ▷ ①I.e., God’s verdict ②I.e., God’s verdict

column.name: text
column.value: The sun and moon have become dark, And the stars have lost their brightness.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD roars from Zion And utters His voice from Jerusalem, And the heavens and the earth quake. But the LORD is a refuge for His people, And a stronghold for the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, Dwelling on Zion, My holy mountain. So Jerusalem will be holy, And strangers will no longer pass through it.

column.name: text
column.value: And on that day The mountains will drip with ①sweet wine, And the hills will flow with milk, And all the brooks of Judah will flow with water; And a spring will go out from the house of the LORD And water the Valley of ②Shittim. ▷ ①Lit freshly pressed-out grape juice ②Or acacias

column.name: text
column.value: Egypt will become a wasteland, And Edom will become a desolate wilderness, Because of the violence ①done to the sons of Judah, In whose land they have shed innocent blood. ▷ ①Lit of the sons

column.name: text
column.value: But Judah will be inhabited forever, And Jerusalem for all generations.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will avenge their blood which I have not avenged, For the LORD dwells in Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: The words of Amos, who was among the sheepherders from Tekoa, which he saw in visions concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam son of Joash, king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, “The LORD roars from Zion, And from Jerusalem He utters His voice; And the shepherds’ pasture grounds mourn, And the ①summit of Carmel dries up.” ▷ ①Lit head

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “For three offenses of Damascus, and for four, I will not ①revoke its punishment, Because they threshed Gilead with iron sledges. ▷ ①Lit cause it to turn back, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: So I will send fire upon the house of Hazael, And it will consume the citadels of Ben-hadad.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also break the gate bar of Damascus, And eliminate every inhabitant from the ①Valley of Aven, As well as him who holds the scepter, from Beth-eden; So the people of Aram will be exiled to Kir,” Says the LORD. ▷ ①Possibly Baalbek

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “For three offenses of Gaza, and for four, I will not revoke its punishment, Because they led into exile an entire population To turn them over to Edom.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will send fire on the wall of Gaza And it will consume her citadels.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also eliminate every inhabitant from Ashdod, As well as him who holds the scepter, from Ashkelon; And I will direct My ①power against Ekron, And the remnant of the Philistines will perish,” Says the Lord ②GOD. ▷ ①Lit hand ②Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “For three offenses of Tyre, and for four, I will not revoke its punishment, Because they turned an entire population over to Edom And did not remember the covenant of ①brotherhood. ▷ ①Lit brothers

column.name: text
column.value: So I will send fire on the wall of Tyre, And it will consume her citadels.”

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “For three offenses of Edom, and for four, I will not revoke its punishment, Because he pursued his brother with the sword And stifled his compassion; His anger also tore continually, And he maintained his fury forever.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will send fire upon Teman And it will consume the citadels of Bozrah.”

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “For three offenses of the sons of Ammon, and for four, I will not revoke its punishment, Because they ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead In order to enlarge their borders.

column.name: text
column.value: So I will kindle a fire on the wall of Rabbah, And it will consume her citadels Amid ①war cries on the day of battle, And amid a storm on the day of tempest. ▷ ①Or shouts

column.name: text
column.value: Their king will go into exile, He and his princes together,” says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “For three offenses of Moab, and for four, I will not ①revoke its punishment, Because he burned the bones of the king of Edom to lime. ▷ ①Lit cause it to turn back, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: So I will send fire upon Moab And it will consume the citadels of Kerioth; And Moab will die amid the panic of battle, Amid war cries and the sound of a trumpet.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also eliminate the ①judge from her midst And slay all her leaders with him,” says the LORD. ▷ ①Or executive officer

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “For three offenses of Judah, and for four, I will not revoke its punishment, Because they rejected the Law of the LORD And have not kept His statutes; Their ①lies also have led them astray, Those which their fathers followed. ▷ ①Or false gods

column.name: text
column.value: So I will send fire upon Judah, And it will consume the citadels of Jerusalem.”

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “For three offenses of Israel, and for four, I will not revoke its punishment, Because they sell the righteous for ①money, And the needy for a pair of sandals. ▷ ①Lit silver

column.name: text
column.value: These who ①trample the head of the helpless to the dust of the earth Also divert the way of the humble; And a man and his father ②resort to the same ③girl So as to profane My holy name. ▷ ①Or pant for the dust...on the head of the helpless ②Lit go ③Possibly a prostitute, or a temple prostitute

column.name: text
column.value: And on garments seized as pledges they stretch out beside every altar, And in the house of their God they drink the wine of those who have been fined.

column.name: text
column.value: “Yet it was I who destroyed the Amorite before them, ①Though his height was like the height of cedars And he was as strong as the oaks; I also destroyed his fruit above and his roots below. ▷ ①Lit Whose height

column.name: text
column.value: And it was I who brought you up from the land of Egypt, And led you in the wilderness for forty years So that you might take possession of the land of the Amorite.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I raised up some of your sons to be prophets, And some of your young men to be Nazirites. Is this not so, you sons of Israel?” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “But you made the Nazirites drink wine, And you commanded the prophets, saying, ‘You shall not prophesy!’

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I am making a rut in the ground beneath you, Just as a wagon makes a rut when filled with sheaves.

column.name: text
column.value: Refuge will be lost from the swift, And the strong will not strengthen his power, Nor the warrior save his ①life. ▷ ①Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: The one who grasps the bow will not stand his ground, The swift of foot will not escape, Nor will the one who rides the horse save his ①life. ▷ ①Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: Even the ①bravest among the warriors will flee naked on that day,” declares the LORD. ▷ ①Lit strong of his heart

column.name: text
column.value: Hear this word which the LORD has spoken against you, sons of Israel, against the entire ①family which ②He brought up from the land of Egypt: ▷ ①I.e., nation ②Lit I

column.name: text
text
column.value: Do two people walk together unless they have agreed to meet?

column.name: text
column.value: Does a lion roar in the forest when he has no prey? Does a young lion ①growl from his den unless he has captured something? ▷ ①Lit give his voice

column.name: text
column.value: Does a bird fall into a trap on the ground when there is no ①device in it? Does a trap spring up from the earth when it captures nothing at all? ▷ ①Lit snare

column.name: text
column.value: If a trumpet is blown in a city, will the people not tremble? If a disaster occurs in a city, has the LORD not brought it about?

column.name: text
column.value: ①Certainly the Lord ②GOD does nothing Unless He reveals His secret plan To His servants the prophets. ▷ ①Or For ②Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: A lion has roared! Who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken! Who can do anything but prophesy?

column.name: text
column.value: Proclaim on the citadels in Ashdod and on the citadels in the land of Egypt and say, “Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria and see the great panic within her and the oppressions in her midst.

column.name: text
column.value: But they do not know how to do what is right,” declares the LORD, “these who store up ①violence and devastation in their citadels.” ▷ ①I.e., the plunder from violence

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, this is what the Lord GOD says: “An enemy, one surrounding the land, Will take down your fortifications from you, And your citadels will be looted.”

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “Just as the shepherd ①snatches from the lion’s mouth a couple of legs or a piece of an ear, So will the sons of Israel living in Samaria be ②snatched away— With the corner of a bed and the ③cover of a couch! ▷ ①Or rescues ②Or rescued ③Or headrest; lit damask

column.name: text
column.value: Hear and testify against the house of Jacob,” Declares the Lord GOD, the God of armies.

column.name: text
column.value: “For on the day that I punish Israel’s offenses, I will also punish the altars of Bethel; The horns of the altar will be cut off, And will fall to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also strike the winter house together with the summer house; The houses of ①ivory will also perish, And the great houses will come to an end,” Declares the LORD. ▷ ①I.e., ivory inlay

column.name: text
column.value: Hear this word, you ①cows of Bashan who are on the mountain of Samaria, Who exploit the poor, who oppress the needy, ②And say to their ③husbands, “Bring now, that we may drink!” ▷ ①I.e., haughty, prominent women ②Lit Who ③Lit lords

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord ①GOD has sworn by His holiness, “For behold, the days are coming upon you When ②they will take you away with meat hooks, And the last of you with fish hooks. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch ②Lit he

column.name: text
column.value: You will go out through holes in the walls, One in front of the other, And you ①will be hurled to Harmon,” declares the LORD. ▷ ①As in LXX; MT will hurl

column.name: text
column.value: “Enter Bethel and do wrong; In Gilgal multiply wrongdoing! Bring your sacrifices every morning, Your tithes every three days.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Offer a thanksgiving offering also from that which is leavened, And proclaim ②voluntary offerings, make them known. For so you love to do, you sons of Israel,” Declares the Lord GOD. ▷ ①Lit Offer up in smoke ②Or freewill offerings

column.name: text
text
column.value: “Furthermore, I withheld the rain from you While there were still three months until harvest. Then I would send rain on one city, But on another city I would not send rain; One part would be rained on, While the part not rained on would dry up.

column.name: text
text
text
text
text
text
column.value: For behold, He who forms mountains and creates the wind, And declares to a person what are His thoughts, He who makes dawn into darkness And treads on the high places of the earth, The LORD God of armies is His name.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear this word which I am taking up for you as a song of mourning, house of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: She has fallen, she will not rise again— The virgin Israel. She lies unnoticed on her land; There is no one to raise her up.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the Lord ①GOD says: “The city which goes forth a thousand strong Will have a hundred left, And the one which goes forth a hundred strong Will have ten left to the house of Israel.” ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD says to the house of Israel: “Seek Me so that you may live.

column.name: text
column.value: But do not ①resort to Bethel And do not come to Gilgal, Nor cross over to Beersheba; For Gilgal will certainly go into captivity And Bethel will ②come to nothing. ▷ ①Lit seek ②Lit be

column.name: text
column.value: Seek the LORD so that you may live, Or He will break through like a fire, ①house of Joseph, And it will consume with no one to extinguish it for Bethel, ▷ ①Or in the house

column.name: text
column.value: For those who turn justice into wormwood, And ①throw righteousness to the earth.” ▷ ①Lit they have thrown

column.name: text
column.value: He who made the Pleiades and Orion, And changes deep darkness into morning, ①Who also darkens day into night, Who calls for the waters of the sea And pours them out on the surface of the earth, The LORD is His name. ▷ ①Lit And He darkened

column.name: text
column.value: It is He who makes destruction flash upon the strong, So that destruction comes upon the fortress.

column.name: text
column.value: They hate him who rebukes in the ①gate, And they despise him who speaks with integrity. ▷ ①I.e., the place where court was held

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore because you impose heavy ①rent on the poor And take a tribute of grain from them, Though you have built houses of cut stone, Yet you will not live in them; You have planted beautiful vineyards, yet you will not drink their wine. ▷ ①Or tax

column.name: text
column.value: For I know your offenses are many and your sins are great, You who are hostile to the righteous and accept bribes, And ①turn away the poor from justice at the ②gate. ▷ ①Lit they turn ②I.e., the place where court was held

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore at ①such a time the prudent person keeps quiet, because it is an evil time. ▷ ①Lit that time

column.name: text
text
column.value: Hate evil, love good, And establish justice in the ①gate! Perhaps the LORD God of armies Will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph. ▷ ①I.e., the place where court was held

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD God of armies, the Lord says: “There is mourning in all the public squares, And in all the streets they say, ‘Oh no! Oh no!’ They also call the farmer to mourning And ①professional mourners to mourning rites. ▷ ①Lit those who know mourning

column.name: text
column.value: And in all the vineyards there is mourning, Because I will pass through the midst of you,” says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you who are longing for the day of the LORD, For what ①purpose will the day of the LORD be to you? It will be darkness and not light; ▷ ①Lit will this be to you, the day

column.name: text
column.value: As when a man flees from a lion And a bear confronts him, ①Or he goes home, leans with his hand against the wall, And a snake bites him. ▷ ①Or Then

column.name: text
column.value: Will the day of the LORD not be darkness instead of light, Even gloom with no brightness in it?

column.name: text
column.value: “I hate, I reject your festivals, Nor do I ①delight in your festive assemblies. ▷ ①Lit like to smell your

column.name: text
text
column.value: Take away from Me the noise of your songs; I will not even listen to the sound of your harps.

column.name: text
column.value: But let justice roll out like waters, And righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①Did you present Me with sacrifices and grain offerings in the wilderness for forty years, house of Israel? ▷ ①Or You presented Me with the sacrifices and a grain offering

column.name: text
column.value: You also carried along ①Sikkuth your king and ②Kiyyun, your images, ③the star of your gods which you made for yourselves. ▷ ①Or Sakkuth (Saturn), or the tabernacle of your Moloch ②Or Kaiwan (Saturn), or stands of ③Or your star gods

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I will make you go into exile beyond Damascus,” says the LORD, whose name is the God of armies.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to those who are carefree in Zion, And to those who feel secure on the mountain of Samaria, The dignitaries of the foremost of nations, To whom the house of Israel comes.

column.name: text
column.value: Go over to Calneh and look, And go from there to Hamath the great, Then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Are ①they better than these kingdoms, Or is their territory greater than yours? ▷ ①Or you

column.name: text
column.value: Are you postponing the day of disaster, And would you bring near the seat of violence?

column.name: text
column.value: Those who lie on beds of ivory, And lounge around on their couches, And eat lambs from the flock, And calves from the midst of the fattened cattle,

column.name: text
column.value: Who improvise to the sound of the harp, And like David have ①composed songs for themselves, ▷ ①Or invented musical instruments

column.name: text
column.value: Who drink wine from sacred bowls While they anoint themselves with the finest of oils— Yet they have not grieved over the collapse of Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, they will now go into exile at the head of the exiles, And the revelry of those who lounge around will come to an end.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord ①GOD has sworn by Himself, the LORD God of armies has declared: “I loathe the arrogance of Jacob, And ②detest his citadels; Therefore I will give up the city and ③all it contains.” ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD ②Lit hate ③Lit its fullness

column.name: text
column.value: And it will be, if ten men are left in one house, they will die.

column.name: text
column.value: Then one’s ①uncle, or his undertaker, will lift him up to carry out his bones from the house, and he will say to the one who is in the innermost part of the house, “Is anyone else with you?” And that one will say, “No one.” Then he will ②answer, “Keep quiet! For ③the name of the LORD is not to be mentioned.” ▷ ①Or beloved one ②Lit say ③Lit not to make mention in the name of

column.name: text
column.value: For behold, the LORD is going to command that the great house be smashed to pieces, and the small house to rubble.

column.name: text
column.value: Do horses run on rocks? Or does one ①plow them with oxen? Yet you have turned justice into poison, And the fruit of righteousness into ②wormwood, ▷ ①Another reading is plow the sea with oxen ②I.e., bitterness

column.name: text
column.value: You who rejoice in ①Lodebar, ②And say, “Have we not by our own strength taken ③Karnaim for ourselves?” ▷ ①Lit nothing ②Lit Who say ③Lit a pair of horns

column.name: text
column.value: “For behold, I am going to raise up a nation against you, House of Israel,” declares the LORD God of armies, “And they will torment you from the entrance of Hamath To the brook of the Arabah.”

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Lord ①GOD showed me, and behold, He was forming a swarm of locusts ②when the spring crop began to sprout. And behold, the spring crop was after the king’s mowing. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch ②Lit at the beginning of the coming up of

column.name: text
column.value: And it came about, ①when it had finished eating the vegetation of the land, that I said, “Lord GOD, please pardon! How can Jacob stand? For he is small.” ▷ ①Lit if

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD relented of this. “It shall not be,” said the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So the Lord GOD showed me, and behold, the Lord GOD was calling to contend with them by fire, and it consumed the great deep and began to consume the ①farmland. ▷ ①Lit plot of land

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, “Lord GOD, please stop! How can Jacob stand? For he is small.”

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD relented of this. “This too shall not be,” said the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: So He showed me, and behold, the Lord was standing ①by a ②vertical wall with a plumb line in His hand. ▷ ①Or on ②Lit wall of a plumb line

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, “What do you see, Amos?” And I said, “A plumb line.” Then the Lord said, “Behold I am about to put a plumb line In the midst of My people Israel. I will not ①spare them any longer. ▷ ①Lit pass him by

column.name: text
column.value: The high places of Isaac will become deserted, And the sanctuaries of Israel will be in ruins. Then I will rise up against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Amaziah, the priest of Bethel, sent word to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, “Amos has conspired against you in the midst of the house of Israel; the land is unable to endure all his words.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what Amos says: ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel will certainly go from its land into exile.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Amaziah said to Amos, “Go, you seer, flee to the land of Judah; and eat bread there and do your prophesying there!

column.name: text
column.value: But do not prophesy at Bethel any longer, for it is a sanctuary of the king and a royal ①residence.” ▷ ①Lit house

column.name: text
column.value: Then Amos replied to Amaziah, “I am not a prophet, nor am I the son of a prophet; for I am a herdsman and a ①grower of sycamore figs. ▷ ①Or picker

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD took me from ①following the flock, and the LORD said to me, ‘Go prophesy to My people Israel.’ ▷ ①Lit behind

column.name: text
column.value: So now hear the word of the LORD: you are saying, ‘You shall not prophesy against Israel nor shall you ①prophesy against the house of Isaac.’ ▷ ①Lit drivel

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, this is what the LORD says: ‘Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, your sons and your daughters will fall by the sword, your land will be parceled up by a measuring line, and you yourself will die ①upon unclean soil. Furthermore Israel will certainly go from its land into exile.’ ” ▷ ①Or in an unclean land

column.name: text
column.value: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and He said, “Strike the pillar capitals so that the thresholds will shake, And break them on the heads of them all! Then I will put to death the rest of them with the sword; They will not have a fugitive who will flee, Nor a survivor who will escape.

column.name: text
column.value: Though they dig into Sheol, From there My hand will take them; And though they ascend to heaven, From there I will bring them down.

column.name: text
column.value: And though they hide on the summit of Carmel, I will track them down and take them from there; And though they hide themselves from My sight on the bottom of the sea, I will command the serpent from there, and it will bite them.

column.name: text
column.value: And though they go into captivity before their enemies, From there I will command the sword and it will kill them, And I will set My eyes against them for harm and not for good.”

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord ①GOD of armies, The One who touches the land so that it quakes, And all those who live in it mourn, And all of it rises up like the Nile And subsides like the Nile of Egypt; ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: The One who builds His upper chambers in the heavens And has founded His vaulted dome over the earth, He who calls for the waters of the sea And pours them out on the face of the earth, The LORD is His name.

column.name: text
column.value: “Are you not as the sons of Ethiopia to Me, You sons of Israel?” declares the LORD. “Have I not brought up Israel from the land of Egypt, And the Philistines from Caphtor and the Arameans from Kir?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the eyes of the Lord GOD are on the sinful kingdom, And I will eliminate it from the face of the earth; Nevertheless, I will not totally eliminate the house of Jacob,” Declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “For behold, I am commanding, And I will shake the house of Israel among all nations As grain is shaken in a sieve, But not a pebble will fall to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: All the sinners of My people will die by the sword, Those who say, ‘The catastrophe will not overtake or confront us.’

column.name: text
text
column.value: So that they may ①possess the remnant of Edom And all the ②nations who are called by My name,” Declares the LORD who does this. ▷ ①Or take possession of ②Or Gentiles

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, days are coming,” declares the LORD, “When the plowman will overtake the reaper, And the one who treads grapes will overtake him who sows the seed; When the mountains will drip grape juice, And all the hills will come apart.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also restore the fortunes of My people Israel, And they will rebuild the desolated cities and live in them; They will also plant vineyards and drink their wine, And make gardens and eat their fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also plant them on their land, And they will not be uprooted again from their land Which I have given them,” Says the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the Lord ①GOD showed me, and behold, there was a basket of summer fruit. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: And He said, “What do you see, Amos?” And I said, “A basket of summer fruit.” Then the LORD said to me, “The end has come for My people Israel. I will not ①spare them any longer. ▷ ①Lit pass him by

column.name: text
column.value: ①The songs of the palace will turn to wailing on that day,” declares the Lord GOD. “The corpses will be many; in every place ②they will throw them out. ③Hush!” ▷ ①Lit They will howl the palace songs ②Lit he has thrown ③An order for sacred silence

column.name: text
column.value: Hear this, you who ①trample the needy, to put an end to the humble of the land, ▷ ①Or snap at

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “When will the new moon ①be over, So that we may sell grain; And the Sabbath, so that we may open the wheat market, To make the ②ephah smaller and the ③shekel bigger, And to cheat with dishonest scales, ▷ ①Lit pass by ②About 1 cubic foot or 0.03 cubic meters ③About 0.5 oz. or 14 gm

column.name: text
column.value: So as to buy the helpless for ①money, And the needy for a pair of sandals, And that we may sell the refuse of the wheat?” ▷ ①Lit silver

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has sworn by the pride of Jacob, “Indeed, I will never forget any of their deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of this will the land not quake, And everyone who lives in it mourn? Indeed, all of it will rise up like the Nile, And it will be tossed about And subside like the Nile of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And it will come about on that day,” declares the Lord GOD, “That I will make the sun go down at noon, And make the earth dark in ①broad daylight. ▷ ①Lit a day of light

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will turn your festivals into mourning, And all your songs into songs of mourning; And I will put sackcloth around everyone’s waist, And ①baldness on every head. And I will make it like a time of mourning for an only son, And the end of it will be like a bitter day. ▷ ①I.e., shaved as a sign of mourning

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, days are coming,” declares the Lord GOD, “When I will send a famine on the land, Not a famine of bread or a thirst for water, But rather for hearing the words of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: People will stagger from sea to sea And from the north even to the east; They will roam about to seek the word of the LORD, But they will not find it.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day the beautiful virgins And the young men will faint from thirst.

column.name: text
column.value: As for those who swear by the ①guilt of Samaria, And say, ‘As your god lives, Dan,’ And, ‘As the way of Beersheba lives,’ They will fall and not rise again.” ▷ ①Or Ashimah

column.name: text
column.value: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord ①GOD says concerning Edom— We have heard a report from the LORD, And a messenger has been sent among the nations saying, “Arise, and let’s go up against her for battle”— ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, I will make you small among the nations; You are greatly despised.

column.name: text
column.value: The arrogance of your heart has deceived you, The one who lives in the clefts of ①the rock, On the height of his dwelling place, Who says in his heart, ‘Who will bring me down to earth?’ ▷ ①Or Sela

column.name: text
column.value: Though you make your home high like the eagle, Though you set your nest among the stars, From there I will bring you down,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “If thieves came to you, If ①robbers by night— Oh how you will be ruined!— Would they not steal only ②until they had enough? If grape-pickers came to you, Would they not leave some gleanings? ▷ ①Lit devastators of the night ②Lit their sufficiency

column.name: text
column.value: Oh how Esau will be searched, And his hidden treasures searched out!

column.name: text
column.value: All the people ①allied with you Will send you to the border, And the people at peace with you Will deceive you and overpower you. They who eat your bread Will set an ambush for you. (There is no understanding ②in him.) ▷ ①Lit of your covenant ②I.e., in Esau; or of it

column.name: text
column.value: Will I not on that day,” declares the LORD, “Eliminate wise men from Edom, And understanding from the mountain of Esau?

column.name: text
column.value: Then your warriors will be filled with terror, Teman, So that everyone will be eliminated from the mountain of Esau by murder.

column.name: text
column.value: “Because of violence to your brother Jacob, Shame will cover you, And you will be eliminated forever.

column.name: text
column.value: On the day that you stood aloof, On the day that strangers carried off his wealth, And foreigners entered his gate And cast lots for Jerusalem— You too were as one of them.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not ①gloat over your brother’s day, The day of his misfortune. And do not rejoice over the sons of Judah On the day of their destruction; Yes, do not ②boast On the day of their distress. ▷ ①Lit look on ②Lit make your mouth large

column.name: text
column.value: Do not enter the gate of My people On the day of their disaster. You indeed, do not ①gloat over their catastrophe On the day of their disaster. And do not lay a hand on their wealth On the day of their disaster. ▷ ①Lit look at

column.name: text
column.value: Do not stand at the crossroads To eliminate their survivors; And do not hand over their refugees On the day of their distress.

column.name: text
column.value: “For the day of the LORD is near for all the nations. Just as you have done, it will be done to you. Your dealings will return on your own head.

column.name: text
column.value: For just as you drank on My holy mountain, All the nations will drink continually. They will drink ①to the last drop, And become as if they had never existed. ▷ ①Lit and slurp

column.name: text
column.value: But on Mount Zion there will be those who escape, And it will be holy. And the house of Jacob will ①possess their ②property. ▷ ①Or take possession of ②or inheritance

column.name: text
column.value: Then the house of Jacob will be a fire, And the house of Joseph a flame; But the house of Esau will be like stubble. And they will set ①them on fire and consume ②them, So that there will be no survivor of the house of Esau,” For the LORD has spoken. ▷ ①I.e., the people of Esau ②I.e., the people of Esau

column.name: text
column.value: Then those of the ①Negev will ②possess the mountain of Esau, And those of the ③Shephelah the Philistine plain; Also, they will ④possess the territory of Ephraim and the territory of Samaria, And Benjamin the territory of Gilead. ▷ ①I.e., South country ②Or take possession of ③I.e., the foothills ④Or take possession of

column.name: text
column.value: And the exiles of this army of the sons of Israel, Who are among the Canaanites as far as Zarephath, And the exiles of Jerusalem who are in Sepharad, Will ①possess the cities of the Negev. ▷ ①Or take possession of

column.name: text
column.value: ①The deliverers will ascend Mount Zion To judge the mountain of Esau, And the kingdom will be the LORD’S. ▷ ①Or with ancient versions Those who are rescued

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to those who devise wrongdoing, Who practice evil on their beds! ①When morning comes, they do it, Because it is in the power of their hands. ▷ ①Lit In the light of the morning

column.name: text
column.value: They covet fields, so they seize them; And houses, so they take them. They ①exploit a man and his house, A person and his inheritance. ▷ ①Or oppress

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this is what the LORD says: “Behold, I am planning against this family a catastrophe From which you cannot remove your necks; And you will not walk haughtily, For it will be an evil time.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day they will take up against you a ①song of mocking And ②utter a song of mourning and say, ‘We are completely destroyed! He exchanges the share of my people; How He removes it from me! To the apostate He apportions our fields.’ ▷ ①Or proverb ②Lit lament

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore you will have no one ①applying a measuring line For you by lot in the assembly of the LORD. ▷ ①Lit casting

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Do not prophesy,’ so they prophesy. But if ①they do not prophesy about these things, Insults will not be turned back. ▷ ①I.e., God’s prophets

column.name: text
column.value: Is it being said, house of Jacob: ‘Is the Spirit of the LORD impatient? Are these His works?’ Do My words not do good For the one walking rightly?

column.name: text
column.value: ①Recently My people have arisen as an enemy— You strip the robe off the garment From unsuspecting passers-by, From those returned from war. ▷ ①Lit And yesterday

column.name: text
column.value: You evict the women of My people, Each one from her pleasant house. From her children you take My splendor forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise and go, For this is no place of rest Because of the uncleanness that brings on destruction, A painful destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: If someone walking after wind and falsehood Had lied and said, ‘I will prophesy to you about wine and liquor,’ He would become a prophet to this people.

column.name: text
column.value: “I will certainly assemble all of you, Jacob, I will certainly gather the remnant of Israel. I will put them together like sheep in the fold; Like a flock in the midst of its pasture They will be noisy with people.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who breaks through goes up before them; They break through, pass through the gate, and go out by it. So their king passes on before them, And the LORD at their head.”

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD which came to Micah of Moresheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and which he saw regarding Samaria and Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear, you peoples, all of ①you; Listen carefully, earth and ②all it contains, And may the Lord ③GOD be a witness against you, The Lord from His holy temple. ▷ ①Lit them ②Lit its fullness ③Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: For behold, the LORD is coming forth from His place. He will come down and tread on the high places of the ①earth. ▷ ①Or land

column.name: text
column.value: The mountains will melt under Him And the valleys will be split, Like wax before the fire, Like water poured down a steep place.

column.name: text
column.value: All this is due to the ①wrongdoing of Jacob And the sins of the house of Israel. What is the ②wrongdoing of Jacob? Is it not Samaria? What is the high ③place of Judah? Is it not Jerusalem? ▷ ①Or rebellion ②Or rebellion ③Lit places

column.name: text
column.value: For I will make Samaria a heap of ruins ①in the open country, Planting places for a vineyard. I will hurl her stones down into the valley, And lay bare her foundations. ▷ ①Lit of the field

column.name: text
column.value: All of her idols will be crushed, All of her earnings will be burned with fire, And all of her images I will make desolate; For she collected them from a prostitute’s earnings, And to the earnings of a prostitute they will return.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of this I must mourn and wail, I must go barefoot and naked; I must do mourning like the jackals, And a mourning like the ostriches.

column.name: text
column.value: For her wound is incurable, For it has come to Judah; It has reached the gate of my people, Even to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not tell it in Gath, Do not weep at all. At ①Beth-le-aphrah roll yourself in the dust in mourning. ▷ ①I.e., house of dust

column.name: text
column.value: ①Go on your way, inhabitant of ②Shaphir, in shameful nakedness. The inhabitant of ③Zaanan does not ④escape. The mourning of ⑤Beth-ezel: “He will take from you its ⑥support.” ▷ ①I.e., Go into captivity ②I.e., pleasantness ③I.e., going out ④Lit go out ⑤I.e., the house beside ⑥Lit standing place

column.name: text
column.value: For the inhabitant of ①Maroth ②Waits for something good, Because a disaster has come down from the LORD To the gate of Jerusalem. ▷ ①I.e., bitterness ②Or possibly has been in agony for

column.name: text
column.value: Harness the chariot to the team of horses, You inhabitant of Lachish— She was the beginning of sin To the daughter of Zion— Because in you were found The rebellious acts of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore you will give parting gifts In behalf of Moresheth-gath; The houses of Achzib will become a ①deception To the kings of Israel. ▷ ①Heb achzab, wordplay on Achzib

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, I will bring on you The one who takes possession, You inhabitant of ①Mareshah. The glory of Israel will enter Adullam. ▷ ①I.e., possession

column.name: text
column.value: Shave yourself bald, yes, cut off your hair, Because of the children of your delight; Extend your baldness like the eagle, For they will go from you into exile.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said, “Hear now, you ①leaders of Jacob And rulers of the house of Israel: Is it not for you to know justice? ▷ ①Lit heads

column.name: text
column.value: You who hate good and love evil, Who tear off their skin from them And their flesh from their bones,

column.name: text
column.value: Who eat the flesh of my people, Strip off their skin from them, Smash their bones, And chop them up as for the pot, And as meat in a cauldron!”

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will cry out to the LORD, But He will not answer them. Instead, He will hide His face from them at that time Because they have practiced evil deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray: When they have something to bite with their teeth, They cry out, “Peace!” But against him who puts nothing in their mouths They declare holy war.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore it will be night for you—without vision, And darkness for you—without divination. The sun will go down on the prophets, And the day will become dark over them.

column.name: text
column.value: The seers will be put to shame, And the diviners will be ashamed. Indeed, they will all cover their ①lips Because there is no answer from God. ▷ ①Lit mustache

column.name: text
column.value: On the other hand, I am filled with power— With the Spirit of the LORD— And with justice and courage To make known to Jacob his rebellious act, And to Israel his sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Now hear this, you heads of the house of Jacob And rulers of the house of Israel, Who despise justice And twist everything that is straight,

column.name: text
column.value: Who build Zion with bloodshed, And Jerusalem with malice.

column.name: text
column.value: Her leaders pronounce judgment for a bribe, Her priests teach for pay, And her prophets divine for money. Yet they lean on the LORD, saying, “Is the LORD not in our midst? Catastrophe will not come upon us.”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore on account of you, Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of ruins, And the mountain of the ①temple will become high places of a forest. ▷ ①Lit house

column.name: text
column.value: And it will come about in the last days That the mountain of the house of the LORD Will be established ①as the chief of the mountains. It will be raised above the hills, And the peoples will stream to it. ▷ ①Lit on

column.name: text
column.value: Many nations will come and say, “Come and let’s go up to the mountain of the LORD And to the house of the God of Jacob, So that He may teach us about His ways, And that we may walk in His paths.” For from Zion will go forth the law, And the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And He will judge between many peoples And render decisions for mighty, ①distant nations. Then they will beat their swords into plowshares, And their spears into pruning hooks; Nation will not lift a sword against nation, And never again will they ②train for war. ▷ ①Lit at a distance ②Lit learn

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, each of them will sit under his vine And under his fig tree, With no one to make them afraid, Because the mouth of the LORD of armies has spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: Though all the peoples walk, Each in the name of his god, As for us, we will walk In the name of the LORD our God forever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: “On that day,” declares the LORD, “I will assemble those who limp And gather the scattered, Those whom I have afflicted.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make those who limp a remnant, And those who ①have strayed a mighty nation, And the LORD will reign over them on Mount Zion From now on and forever. ▷ ①Or are far removed

column.name: text
