column.value: As for you, ①tower of the flock, ②Hill of the daughter of Zion, To you it will come— Yes, the former dominion will come, The kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem. ▷ ①Heb Migdal-eder ②Heb Ophel

column.name: text
column.value: “Now, why do you cry out loudly? Is there no king among you, Or has your counselor perished, That agony has gripped you like a woman in childbirth?

column.name: text
column.value: Writhe and scream, Daughter of Zion, Like a woman in childbirth; For now you will go out of the city, Live in the field, And go to Babylon. There you will be rescued, There the LORD will redeem you From the hand of your enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: And now many nations have been assembled against you Who say, ‘Let her be defiled, And let our eyes ①gloat over Zion!’ ▷ ①Lit see with pleasure

column.name: text
text
column.value: Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion, For I will make your horn iron, And I will make your hoofs bronze, So that you may pulverize many peoples, And dedicate to the LORD their unjust profit, And their wealth to the Lord of all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear now what the LORD is saying, “Arise, plead your case ①before the mountains, And let the hills hear your voice. ▷ ①Lit with

column.name: text
column.value: Listen, you mountains, to the indictment by the LORD, And you enduring foundations of the earth, Because the LORD has a case against His people; And He will dispute with Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: My people, what have I done to you, And how have I wearied you? Answer Me.

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, I brought you up from the land of Egypt, I redeemed you from the house of slavery, And I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

column.name: text
column.value: My people, remember now What Balak king of Moab planned And what Balaam son of Beor answered him, And what happened from Shittim to Gilgal, ①So that you might know the righteous acts of the LORD.” ▷ ①Lit In order to know

column.name: text
column.value: With what shall I come to the LORD And bow myself before the God on high? Shall I come to Him with burnt offerings, With yearling calves?

column.name: text
column.value: Does the LORD take pleasure in thousands of rams, In ten thousand rivers of ①oil? Shall I give Him my firstborn for my wrongdoings, The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul? ▷ ①I.e., olive oil

column.name: text
column.value: He has told you, mortal one, what is good; And what does the LORD require of you But to do justice, to love ①kindness, And to walk ②humbly with your God? ▷ ①Or loyalty ②Or circumspectly

column.name: text
column.value: The voice of the LORD will call to the city— And it is sound wisdom to fear Your name: “ ①Hear, you tribe. Who has designated ②its time? ▷ ①Or Hear about the rod and who designated it ②Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: Is there still a person in the wicked house, Along with treasures of wickedness, And a ①short measure that is cursed? ▷ ①Lit shrunken ephah

column.name: text
column.value: Can I justify dishonest balances, And a bag of fraudulent weights?

column.name: text
column.value: For the rich people of ①the city are full of violence, Her residents speak lies, And their tongue is deceitful in their mouth. ▷ ①Lit her are

column.name: text
column.value: So also I will make you sick, striking you down, Making you desolate because of your sins.

column.name: text
column.value: You will eat, but you will not be satisfied, And your filth will be in your midst. You will try to remove valuables for safekeeping, But you will not save it all, And what you do save I will turn over to the sword.

column.name: text
text
column.value: The statutes of Omri And every work of the house of Ahab are maintained, And you walk by their plans. Therefore I will give you up for destruction, And ①your inhabitants for ②derision, And you will suffer the taunting of My people.” ▷ ①Lit her ②Lit whistling (in mockery)

column.name: text
column.value: ①But as for you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, Too little to be among the clans of Judah, From you One will come forth for Me to be ruler in Israel. His times of coming forth are from long ago, From the days of eternity.” ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: in Heb

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore He will give them up until the time When she who is in labor has given birth. Then the remainder of His kinsmen Will return to the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And He will arise and shepherd His flock In the strength of the LORD, In the majesty of the name of the LORD His God. And they will ①remain, Because ②at that time He will be great To the ends of the earth. ▷ ①Or live in safety ②Lit now

column.name: text
column.value: This One will be our peace. When the Assyrian invades our land, When he tramples on our ①citadels, Then we will raise against him Seven shepherds and eight leaders of people. ▷ ①Or palaces

column.name: text
column.value: They will shepherd the land of Assyria with the sword, The land of Nimrod at its entrances; And He will rescue us from the Assyrian When he invades our land, And when he tramples our territory.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the remnant of Jacob Will be among many peoples Like dew from the LORD, Like showers on vegetation That do not wait for man, Or delay for ①mankind. ▷ ①Lit sons of mankind

column.name: text
column.value: The remnant of Jacob Will be among the nations, Among many peoples Like a lion among the animals of the forest, Like a young lion among flocks of sheep, Which, if he passes through, Tramples and tears, And there is no one who can rescue.

column.name: text
column.value: Your hand will be lifted up against your adversaries, And all your enemies will be eliminated.

column.name: text
column.value: “And it will be on that day,” declares the LORD, “That I will eliminate your horses from among you, And destroy your chariots.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also eliminate the cities of your land, And tear down all your fortifications.

column.name: text
column.value: I will eliminate sorceries from your hand, And you will have no fortune-tellers.

column.name: text
column.value: I will eliminate your carved images And your memorial stones from among you, So that you will no longer bow down To the work of your hands.

column.name: text
column.value: I will uproot your ①Asherim from among you, And destroy your cities. ▷ ①I.e., wooden symbols of a female deity (Asherah)

column.name: text
column.value: And I will execute vengeance in anger and wrath On the nations which have not obeyed.”

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to me! For I am Like harvests of summer fruit, like gleanings of grapes. There is not a cluster of grapes left to eat, Nor an early fig, which ①I crave. ▷ ①Lit my soul desires

column.name: text
column.value: The ①godly person has perished from the land, And there is no upright person among mankind. All of them lie in wait for bloodshed; Each of them hunts the other with a net. ▷ ①Or faithful

column.name: text
column.value: As for evil, both hands do it well. The leader asks for a bribe, also the judge, And the great one speaks the capricious desire of his soul; So they plot it together.

column.name: text
column.value: The best of them is like a thorn bush, The most upright like a thorn hedge. The day ①when you post your watchmen, Your punishment is coming. Then their confusion will occur. ▷ ①Lit of your

column.name: text
column.value: Do not trust in a neighbor; Do not have confidence in a close friend. Guard ①your lips From her who lies ②in your arms. ▷ ①Lit the openings of your mouth ②Lit on your chest

column.name: text
column.value: For son disavows father, Daughter rises up against her mother, Daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; A person’s enemies are the people of his own household.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: I will endure the rage of the LORD Because I have sinned against Him, Until He pleads my case and executes justice for me. He will bring me out to the light, And I will look at His ①righteousness. ▷ ①I.e., right dealing

column.name: text
column.value: Then my enemy will see, And shame will cover her who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?” My eyes will look at her; ①At that time she will ②be trampled down Like mud of the streets. ▷ ①Lit Now ②Lit become a trampled place

column.name: text
column.value: It will be a day for building your walls. On that day your boundary will be extended.

column.name: text
column.value: It will be a day when ①they will come to you From Assyria and the cities of Egypt, From Egypt even to the Euphrates River, Even from sea to sea and mountain to mountain. ▷ ①Lit he

column.name: text
column.value: And the earth will become a wasteland because of her inhabitants, On account of the fruit of their deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: Shepherd Your people with Your scepter, The flock of Your ①possession Which lives by itself in the woodland, In the midst of ②a fruitful field. Let them feed in Bashan and Gilead As in the days of old. ▷ ①Or inheritance ②Or Carmel

column.name: text
column.value: “As in the days when you went out from the land of Egypt, I will show ①you miracles.” ▷ ①Lit him

column.name: text
column.value: Nations will see and be ashamed Of all their might. They will put their hand on their mouth, Their ears will be deaf.

column.name: text
column.value: They will lick up dust like a snake, Like ①reptiles of the earth. They will come trembling out of their ②fortresses; To the LORD our God they will come in trepidation, And they will be afraid of You. ▷ ①Lit crawling things ②Or prisons

column.name: text
column.value: Who is a God like You, who pardons wrongdoing And passes over a rebellious act of the remnant of His ①possession? He does not retain His anger forever, Because He delights in mercy. ▷ ①Or inheritance

column.name: text
column.value: He will again take pity on us; He will trample on our wrongdoings. Yes, You will cast all ①their sins Into the depths of the sea. ▷ ①Several ancient versions our

column.name: text
column.value: You will give ①truth to Jacob And favor to Abraham, Which You swore to our forefathers From the days of old. ▷ ①Or faithfulness

column.name: text
column.value: The pronouncement of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite:

column.name: text
column.value: A jealous and avenging God is the LORD; The LORD is avenging and ①wrathful. The LORD takes vengeance on His adversaries, And He reserves wrath for His enemies. ▷ ①Lit a possessor of wrath

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is slow to anger and great in power, And the LORD will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. In the gale and the storm is His way, And clouds are the dust beneath His feet.

column.name: text
column.value: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; He dries up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel wither, The blossoms of Lebanon wither.

column.name: text
column.value: Mountains quake because of Him, And the hills come apart; Indeed the earth is upheaved by His presence, The world and all the inhabitants in it.

column.name: text
column.value: Who can stand before His indignation? Who can endure the burning of His anger? His wrath gushes forth like fire, And the rocks are broken up by Him.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is good, A stronghold in the day of trouble, And He knows those who take refuge in Him.

column.name: text
column.value: But with an overflowing flood He will make a complete end of ①its site, And will pursue His enemies into darkness. ▷ ①I.e., Nineveh’s

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever you devise against the LORD, He will make a complete end of it. Distress will not rise up twice.

column.name: text
column.value: Like tangled thorns, And like those who are drunken with their drink, They are consumed Like stubble completely dried up.

column.name: text
column.value: From you has gone out One who plotted evil against the LORD, A ①wicked counselor. ▷ ①Or worthless; Heb Belial

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD says: “Though they are at full strength and so they are many, So also they will be cut off and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no longer.

column.name: text
column.value: So now, I will break his yoke from upon you, And I will tear your shackles to pieces.”

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has issued a command concerning ①you: “ ②Your name will no longer be perpetuated. I will eliminate the carved image and the cast metal image From the house of your gods. I will prepare your grave, For you are contemptible.” ▷ ①I.e., the king of Nineveh ②Lit No more of your name will be sown

column.name: text
column.value: ①Behold, on the mountains, the feet of him who brings good news, Who announces peace! Celebrate your feasts, Judah, Pay your vows. For never again will the ②wicked one pass through you; He is eliminated completely. ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: ①The one who scatters has come up against ②you. Keep watch over the fortress, watch the road; ③Bind up your waist, ④summon all your strength. ▷ ①Lit Strengthen your loins ②Lit strengthen power greatly ③Ch

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD will restore the splendor of Jacob Like the splendor of Israel, Even though destroyers have laid waste to them And ruined their vines.

column.name: text
column.value: The shields of ①his warriors are dyed red, The warriors are dressed in scarlet, The chariots are fitted with ②flashing steel ③When he is prepared to march, And the juniper spears are brandished. ▷ ①I.e., those attacking Nineveh ②Lit fire of steel ③Lit On the day of his preparation

column.name: text
column.value: The chariots drive wildly in the streets, They rush around in the ①public squares; Their appearance is like torches, They drive back and forth like lightning flashes. ▷ ①Lit broad places

column.name: text
column.value: He remembers his officers; They stumble in their advance, They hurry to her wall, And the ①mantelet is set up. ▷ ①I.e., a shield used for stopping projectiles

column.name: text
column.value: The gates of the rivers are opened And the palace sways back and forth.

column.name: text
column.value: It is set: She is stripped, she is led away, And her slave women are sobbing like the sound of doves, Beating their ①breasts. ▷ ①Lit hearts

column.name: text
column.value: Though Nineveh was like a pool of water throughout her days, Yet they are fleeing; “Stop, stop,” But no one turns back.

column.name: text
column.value: Plunder the silver, Plunder the gold! For there is no end to the treasure— Wealth from every kind of desirable object.

column.name: text
column.value: She is emptied! Yes, she is desolate and waste! Hearts are melting and knees wobbling! Also trembling is in ①the entire body, And all their faces have become pale! ▷ ①Lit all the loins

column.name: text
column.value: Where is the den of the lions And the feeding place of the young lions, Where the lion, lioness, and lion’s cub went With nothing to disturb them?

column.name: text
column.value: The lion tore enough for his cubs, ①Killed enough prey for his lionesses, And filled his lairs with prey And his dens with torn flesh. ▷ ①Lit Strangled

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, I am against you,” declares the LORD of armies. “I will burn up her chariots in smoke, and a sword will devour your young lions; I will eliminate your prey from the land, and no longer will the voice of your messengers be heard.”

column.name: text
column.value: I will stand at my guard post And station myself on the watchtower; And I will keep watch to see what He will say to me, And how I may reply ①when I am reprimanded. ▷ ①Lit upon my reprimand

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD answered me and said, “Write down the vision And inscribe it clearly on tablets, So that one who ①reads it may run. ▷ ①Or is to proclaim; or reads it may read it fluently

column.name: text
text
column.value: “Behold, as for the impudent one, His soul is not right within him; But the righteous one will live by his ①faith. ▷ ①Or faithfulness

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore, wine betrays an arrogant man, So that he does not achieve his objective. He enlarges his appetite like Sheol, And he is like death, never satisfied. He also gathers to himself all the nations And collects to himself all the peoples.

column.name: text
column.value: “Will all of these not take up a song of ridicule against him, Even a saying and insinuations against him And say, ‘Woe to him who increases what is not his— For how long— And makes himself ①rich with debts!’ ▷ ①Lit heavy

column.name: text
column.value: Will ①your creditors not rise up suddenly, And those who ②collect from you awaken? Indeed, you will become plunder for them. ▷ ①Lit those who bite you ②Lit violently shake you

column.name: text
column.value: Since you have looted many nations, All the rest of the peoples will loot you— Because of human bloodshed and violence ①done to the land, To the town and all its inhabitants. ▷ ①Lit of the land

column.name: text
column.value: “Woe to him who makes evil profit for his household, To put his nest on high, To be saved from the hand of catastrophe!

column.name: text
text
column.value: For the stone will cry out from the wall, And the rafter will answer it from the ①framework. ▷ ①Lit wood

column.name: text
column.value: “Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed, And founds a town with ①violence! ▷ ①Lit injustice

column.name: text
column.value: Is it not indeed from the LORD of armies That peoples labor merely for fire, And nations become weary for nothing?

column.name: text
column.value: For the earth will be filled With the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, As the waters cover the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: “Woe to him who makes his neighbor drink; ①To you who mix in your venom even to make your neighbors drunk, So as to look at their genitalia! ▷ ①Another reading is From the cup of your venom

column.name: text
column.value: You will be filled with disgrace rather than honor. Drink, you yourself, and ①expose your own foreskin! The cup in the LORD’S right hand will come around to you, And utter disgrace will come upon your glory. ▷ ①Lit show yourself uncircumcised; DSS and ancient versions stagger

column.name: text
column.value: For the violence ①done to Lebanon will ②overwhelm you, And the devastation of its animals ③by which you terrified them, Because of human bloodshed and violence ④done to the land, To the town and all its inhabitants. ▷ ①Lit of Lebanon ②Lit cover ③Lit which shattered them ④Lit of the land

column.name: text
column.value: “What benefit is a carved image when its maker has carved it, Or a cast metal image, a teacher of falsehood? For its maker trusts in his own handiwork When he fashions speechless idols.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to him who says to a piece of wood, ‘Awake!’ To a mute stone, ‘Arise!’ That is your teacher? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, Yet there is no breath at all inside it.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD is in His holy temple. ①Let all the earth be silent before Him.” ▷ ①Lit Hush before Him, all the earth

column.name: text
column.value: The pronouncement which Habakkuk the prophet saw:

column.name: text
column.value: How long, LORD, have I called for help, And You do not hear? I cry out to You, “Violence!” Yet You do not save.

column.name: text
column.value: Why do You make me see disaster, And make me look at destitution? Yes, devastation and violence are before me; Strife exists and contention arises.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the Law ①is ignored, And justice ②is never upheld. For the wicked surround the righteous; Therefore justice comes out confused. ▷ ①Or is ineffective; lit turns cold ②Lit never goes forth

column.name: text
column.value: “Look among the nations! Watch! Be horrified! Be frightened speechless! For I am accomplishing a work in your days— You would not believe it even if ①you were told! ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: For behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans, That ①grim and impetuous people Who march ②throughout the earth, To take possession of dwelling places that are not theirs. ▷ ①Lit bitter ②Lit the breadth of

column.name: text
text
column.value: Their horses are faster than leopards, And quicker than wolves in the evening. Their ①horsemen charge along, Their ②horsemen come from afar; They fly like an eagle ③swooping down to devour. ▷ ①Lit hurrying to ②Or horses ③Or horses

column.name: text
column.value: All of them come for violence. ①Their horde of faces moves forward. They gather captives like sand. ▷ ①Lit The totality of

column.name: text
column.value: They make fun of kings, And dignitaries are an object of laughter to them. They laugh at every fortress, Then heap up dirt and ①capture it. ▷ ①Or overthrow

column.name: text
column.value: Then they fly along like the wind and pass on. But they will be held guilty, They whose strength is their god.”

column.name: text
column.value: Are You not from time everlasting, LORD, my God, my Holy One? We will not die. You, LORD, have appointed them to deliver judgment; And You, O Rock, have destined them to punish.

column.name: text
column.value: Your eyes are too pure to look at evil, And You cannot look at harm favorably. Why do You look favorably At those who deal treacherously? Why are You silent when the wicked swallow up Those more righteous than they?

column.name: text
column.value: Why have You made people like the fish of the sea, Like crawling things that have no ruler over them?

column.name: text
column.value: The Chaldeans bring all of them up with a hook, Drag them away with their net, And gather them together in their fishing net. Therefore they rejoice and are joyful.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they offer a sacrifice to their net And ①burn incense to their fishing net, Because through these things their ②catch is ③large, And their food is ④plentiful. ▷ ①Or sacrifice ②Lit portion ③Lit fat; or plentiful ④Lit fat

column.name: text
column.value: Will they therefore empty their net, And continually slay nations without sparing?

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to the bloody city, completely full of lies and pillage; Her prey does not leave.

column.name: text
column.value: The sound of the whip, The sound of the roar of the wheel, Galloping horses And ①bounding chariots! ▷ ①Lit leaping

column.name: text
column.value: Horsemen charging, Swords flashing, spears gleaming, Many killed, a mass of corpses, And there is no end to the dead bodies— They stumble over ①the dead bodies! ▷ ①Lit their

column.name: text
column.value: All because of the many sexual acts of the prostitute, The charming one, the mistress of sorceries, Who sells nations by her sexual acts, And families by her sorceries.

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, I am against you,” declares the LORD of armies; “And I will ①lift up your skirts over your face, And show the nations your nakedness, And the kingdoms your shame. ▷ ①Lit uncover your private parts

column.name: text
column.value: I will throw filth on you And declare you worthless, And set you up as a spectacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And it will come about that all who see you Will ①shrink from you and say, ‘Nineveh is devastated! Who will have sympathy for her?’ Where shall I seek comforters for you?” ▷ ①Lit flee

column.name: text
column.value: Are you better than ①No-amon, Which was situated by the canals of the Nile, With water surrounding her, Whose rampart was ②the sea, Whose wall consisted of ③the sea? ▷ ①I.e., the city of Amon: Thebes ②I.e., the Nile ③I.e., the Nile

column.name: text
column.value: Ethiopia was her might, Egypt too, without limits. Put and Lubim were among ①her helpers. ▷ ①Lit your

column.name: text
text
column.value: You too will become drunk, You will be hidden. You too will search for a refuge from the enemy.

column.name: text
column.value: All your fortifications are fig trees with ①ripe fruit— When shaken, they fall into the eater’s mouth. ▷ ①Lit first fruits

column.name: text
text
column.value: Draw for yourself water for a siege! Strengthen your fortifications! Go into the clay and tread the mortar! Take hold of the brick mold!

column.name: text
column.value: There fire will consume you, The sword will cut you down; It will consume you as the creeping locust consumes a crop. Multiply yourself like the creeping locust, Multiply yourself like the migratory locust.

column.name: text
column.value: You have made your traders more numerous than the stars of heaven— The creeping locust sheds its skin and flies away.

column.name: text
column.value: Your courtiers are like the migratory locust. Your officials are like a swarm of locusts Settling in the stone shelters on a cold day. The sun rises and they flee, And the place where they are is not known.

column.name: text
column.value: Your shepherds are sleeping, O king of Assyria; Your officers are lying down. Your people are scattered on the mountains And there is no one to gather them.

column.name: text
column.value: There is no relief for your collapse, Your wound is incurable. All who hear ①about you Will clap their hands over you, For upon whom has your evil not come continually? ▷ ①Lit your report

column.name: text
column.value: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, according to ①Shigionoth. ▷ ①Perhaps a highly emotional poetic form

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, I have heard ①the report about You, and ②I was afraid. LORD, revive Your work in the midst of the years, In the midst of the years make it known. In anger remember ③mercy. ▷ ①Or Your report ②Or I am in awe, O LORD, of Your work; In the midst of the years revive it, ③Or compassion

column.name: text
column.value: God comes from Teman, And the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His splendor covers the heavens, And the earth is full of His praise.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Before Him goes plague, And plague comes forth ①after Him. ▷ ①Lit at His feet

column.name: text
column.value: He stood and caused the earth to shudder; He looked and caused the nations to jump. Yes, the everlasting mountains were shattered, The ancient hills ①collapsed. His paths are everlasting. ▷ ①Lit cowered

column.name: text
column.value: I saw the tents of Cushan under distress, The tent curtains of the land of Midian were trembling.

column.name: text
column.value: Did the LORD rage against the rivers, Or was Your anger against the rivers, Or was Your rage against the sea, That You rode on Your horses, On Your chariots of salvation?

column.name: text
column.value: You removed Your bow from its holder, The arrows of Your word were ①sworn. Selah You divided the earth with rivers. ▷ ①Lit oaths

column.name: text
column.value: The mountains saw You and quaked; The downpour of waters swept by. The deep raised its voice, It lifted high its hands.

column.name: text
text
text
column.value: You went forth for the salvation of Your people, For the salvation of Your anointed. You smashed the head of the house of evil To uncover him from ①foot to neck. Selah ▷ ①Lit base

column.name: text
column.value: You pierced with his own ①arrows The head of his ②leaders. They stormed in to scatter ③us; Their arrogance was like those Who devour the oppressed in secret. ▷ ①Lit shafts ②Or villagers ③Lit me

column.name: text
column.value: You trampled on the sea with Your horses, On the foam of many waters.

column.name: text
column.value: I heard, and my ①inner parts trembled; At the sound, my lips quivered. Decay enters my bones, And in my place I tremble; Because I ②must wait quietly for the day of distress, ③For the people to arise who will attack us. ▷ ①Lit belly ②Or sigh for ③Or To come upon the people who will

column.name: text
column.value: Even if the fig tree does not blossom, And there is no ①fruit on the vines, If the yield of the olive fails, And the fields produce no food, Even if the flock disappears from the fold, And there are no cattle in the stalls, ▷ ①Lit produce

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I will triumph in the LORD, I will rejoice in the God of my salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord ①GOD is my strength, And He has made my feet like deer’s feet, And has me walk on my high places. For the choir director, on my stringed instruments. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD which came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, son of Gedaliah, son of Amariah, son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah:

column.name: text
column.value: “I will completely remove all things From the face of the ①earth,” declares the LORD. ▷ ①Lit ground

column.name: text
text
column.value: “So I will stretch out My hand against Judah And against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. And I will eliminate the remnant of Baal from this place, And the names of the idolatrous priests along with the other priests.

column.name: text
column.value: And those who bow down on the housetops to the heavenly ①lights, And those who bow down and swear to the LORD, but also swear by ②Milcom, ▷ ①Lit host; i.e., sun, stars, etc. ②Or their king; MT Malcam, prob. a variant spelling of Milcom, the Ammonite god

column.name: text
column.value: And those who have turned back from following the LORD, And those who have not sought the LORD nor inquired of Him.”

column.name: text
column.value: ①Be silent before the Lord ②GOD! For the day of the LORD is near, Because the LORD has prepared a sacrifice, He has consecrated His guests. ▷ ①Lit Hush ②Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
column.value: “Then it will come about on the day of the LORD’S sacrifice That I will punish the princes, the king’s sons, And all who clothe themselves with foreign garments.

column.name: text
column.value: And on that day I will punish all who leap on the temple threshold, Who fill the house of their ①lord with violence and deceit. ▷ ①Or Lord

column.name: text
column.value: And on that day,” declares the LORD, “There will be the sound of a cry from the Fish Gate, Wailing from the ①Second Quarter, And a loud crash from the hills. ▷ ①I.e., a district of Jerusalem

column.name: text
column.value: Wail, you inhabitants of the ①Mortar, Because all the ②people of Canaan will be destroyed; All who weigh out silver will be eliminated. ▷ ①I.e., a district of Jerusalem ②Or merchant people will

column.name: text
column.value: And it will come about at that time That I will search Jerusalem with lamps, And I will punish the people Who are ①stagnant in spirit, Who say in their hearts, ‘The LORD will not do good nor harm!’ ▷ ①Lit thickening on their dregs

column.name: text
column.value: Their wealth will become plunder, And their houses desolate; Yes, they will build houses but not inhabit them, And plant vineyards but not drink their wine.”

column.name: text
column.value: The great day of the LORD is near, Near and coming very quickly; Listen, the day of the LORD! ①In it the warrior cries out bitterly. ▷ ①Lit There

column.name: text
column.value: That day is a day of anger, A day of trouble and distress, A day of destruction and desolation, A day of darkness and gloom, A day of clouds and thick darkness,

column.name: text
column.value: A day of trumpet and battle cry Against the fortified cities And the high corner towers.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring distress on mankind So that they will walk like those who are blind, Because they have sinned against the LORD; And their blood will be poured out like dust, And their flesh like dung.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither their silver nor their gold Will be able to save them On the day of the LORD’S anger; And all the earth will be devoured By the fire of His jealousy, For He will make a complete end, Indeed a horrifying one, Of all the inhabitants of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Gather yourselves together, yes, join together, You nation without ①shame, ▷ ①Or longing

column.name: text
column.value: Before the decree ①takes effect— The day passes like chaff— Before the burning anger of the LORD comes upon you, Before the day of the LORD’S anger comes upon you. ▷ ①Lit gives birth

column.name: text
column.value: Seek the LORD, All you humble of the ①earth Who have practiced His ②ordinances; Seek righteousness, seek humility. Perhaps you will remain hidden On the day of the LORD’S anger. ▷ ①Or land ②Or justice

column.name: text
column.value: For Gaza will be abandoned, And Ashkelon will become a desolation; The inhabitants of Ashdod will be driven out at noon, And Ekron will be uprooted.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to the inhabitants of the seacoast, The nation of the ①Cherethites! The word of the LORD is against you, Canaan, land of the Philistines; And I will eliminate you So that there will be no inhabitant. ▷ ①I.e., a segment of the Philistines with roots in Crete

column.name: text
column.value: So the seacoast will become grazing places, With pastures for shepherds and folds for flocks.

column.name: text
column.value: And the coast will be For the remnant of the house of Judah, They will drive sheep to pasture on it. In the houses of Ashkelon they will lie down at evening; For the LORD their God will care for them And restore their fortunes.

column.name: text
column.value: “I have heard the taunting of Moab And the abusive speech of the sons of Ammon, With which they have taunted My people And boasted against their territory.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, as I live,” declares the LORD of armies, The God of Israel, “Moab will assuredly be like Sodom, And the sons of Ammon like Gomorrah— Ground overgrown with weeds and full of salt mines, And a permanent desolation. The remnant of My people will plunder them, And the remainder of My nation will inherit them.”

column.name: text
column.value: This they will have in return for their arrogance, because they have taunted and boasted against the people of the LORD of armies.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will be terrifying to them, for He will ①starve all the gods of the earth; and all the coastlands of the nations will bow down to Him, everyone from his own place. ▷ ①Lit allow to dwindle

column.name: text
column.value: “You also, Ethiopians, will be slain by My sword.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He will stretch out His hand against the north And eliminate Assyria, And He will make Nineveh a desolation, Parched like the wilderness.

column.name: text
text
column.value: This is the presumptuous city That dwells securely, Who says in her heart, “I am, and there is no one besides me.” How she has become a desolation, A resting place for animals! Everyone who passes by her will ①hiss And wave his hand in contempt. ▷ ①Or whistle

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to her who is rebellious and defiled, The oppressive city!

column.name: text
column.value: She obeyed no voice, She accepted no discipline. She did not trust in the LORD, She did not approach her God.

column.name: text
text
text
text
text
column.value: I said, ‘You will certainly revere Me, You will accept discipline.’ So her dwelling will not be eliminated In accordance with everything that I have stipulated for her. Instead, they were eager to corrupt all their deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore wait for Me,” declares the LORD, “For the day when I rise up as a witness. Indeed, My decision is to gather nations, To assemble kingdoms, To pour out on them My indignation, All My burning anger; For all the earth will be devoured By the fire of My zeal.

column.name: text
column.value: For then I will ①restore to the peoples pure lips, So that all of them may call on the name of the LORD, To serve Him ②shoulder to shoulder. ▷ ①Lit change ②Lit with one shoulder

column.name: text
column.value: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia My worshipers, ①My dispersed ones, Will bring My offerings. ▷ ①Lit the daughter of My dispersed ones

column.name: text
column.value: On that day you will feel no shame Because of all your deeds By which you have rebelled against Me; For then I will remove from your midst Your proud, arrogant ones, And you will never again be haughty On My holy mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will leave among you A humble and lowly people, And they will take refuge in the name of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The remnant of Israel will do no wrong And tell no lies, Nor will a deceitful tongue Be found in their mouths; For they will feed and lie down With no one to frighten them.”

column.name: text
column.value: Shout for joy, daughter of Zion! Shout in triumph, Israel! Rejoice and triumph with all your heart, Daughter of Jerusalem!

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD has taken away His judgments against you, He has cleared away your enemies. The King of Israel, the LORD, is in your midst; You will no longer fear disaster.

column.name: text
text
column.value: The LORD your God is in your midst, A ①victorious warrior. He will rejoice over you with joy, He will ②be quiet in His love, He will rejoice over you with shouts of joy. ▷ ①Lit A warrior who saves ②Or with some ancient versions, renew you in

column.name: text
column.value: I will gather those who are worried about the appointed feasts— They ①came from you, Zion; The disgrace of exile is a burden on ②them. ▷ ①Lit were ②Lit her

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I am going to deal at that time With all your oppressors; I will save those who limp And gather the scattered, And I will turn their shame into praise and fame In all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time I will bring you in, Even at the time when I gather you together; Indeed, I will make you famous and praiseworthy Among all the peoples of the earth, When I restore your fortunes before your eyes,” Says the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: In the second year of Darius the king, on the first day of the sixth month, the word of the LORD came by the prophet Haggai to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD of armies ①says: ‘This people says, “The time has not come, the time for the house of the LORD to be rebuilt.” ’ ” ▷ ①Lit says, saying

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Is it time for you yourselves to live in your paneled houses while this house remains desolate?”

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, the LORD of armies says this: “ ①Consider your ways! ▷ ①Lit Set your heart on

column.name: text
column.value: You have sown much, only to ①harvest little; you eat, but there is not enough to be satisfied; you drink, but there is not enough to become drunk; you put on clothing, but there is not enough for ②anyone to get warm; and the one who earns, earns wages to put into a money bag full of holes.” ▷ ①Lit bring in ②Lit him

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD of armies says this: “ ①Consider your ways! ▷ ①Lit Set your heart on

column.name: text
column.value: Go up to the ①mountains, bring wood, and rebuild the ②temple, that I may be pleased with it and be honored,” says the LORD. ▷ ①Lit mountain ②Lit house

column.name: text
column.value: “You ①start an ambitious project, but behold, it comes to little; when you bring it home, I blow it away. Why?” declares the LORD of armies. “It is because of My house which remains desolate, while each of you runs to his own house. ▷ ①Lit turn to much

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, because of you the sky has withheld ①its dew, and the earth has withheld its produce. ▷ ①Lit from dew

column.name: text
column.value: And I called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on what the ground produces, on mankind, on cattle, and on all the products of the labor of ①your hands.” ▷ ①Lit palms

column.name: text
column.value: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the LORD their God and the words of Haggai the prophet, just as the LORD their God had sent him. And the people ①showed reverence for the LORD. ▷ ①Lit feared before

column.name: text
column.value: Then Haggai, the messenger of the LORD, spoke ①by the commission of the LORD to the people, saying, “ ‘I am with you,’ declares the LORD.” ▷ ①Or with the commissioned message

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of the LORD of armies, their God,

column.name: text
column.value: on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month in the second year of Darius the king.

column.name: text
column.value: In the eighth month of the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah the prophet, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “The LORD was very angry with your fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore say to them, ‘This is what the LORD of armies says: “Return to Me,” declares the LORD of armies, “ ①that I may return to you,” says the LORD of armies. ▷ ①Or and I will

column.name: text
column.value: “Do not be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying, ‘This is what the LORD of armies says: “Return now from your evil ways and from your evil deeds.” ’ But they did not listen or pay attention to Me,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever?

column.name: text
column.value: But did My words and My statutes, which I commanded My servants the prophets, not ①overtake your fathers? Then they repented and said, ‘Just as the LORD of armies planned to do to us in accordance with our ways and our deeds, so He has dealt with us.’ ” ’ ” ▷ ①Or reach

column.name: text
column.value: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, that is, the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah the prophet, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, ①as follows: ▷ ①Lit saying

column.name: text
column.value: I saw at night, and behold, a man was riding on a red horse, and he was standing among the myrtle trees which were in the ravine, with red, ①sorrel, and white horses behind him. ▷ ①I.e., light reddish-brown

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, “What are these, my lord?” And the angel who was speaking with me said to me, “I will show you what these are.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the man who was standing among the myrtle trees responded and said, “These are the ones whom the LORD has sent to ①patrol the earth.” ▷ ①Lit walk about through

column.name: text
column.value: So they responded to the angel of the LORD who was standing among the myrtle trees and said, “We have ①patrolled the earth, and behold, all the earth is ②still and quiet.” ▷ ①Lit walked about through ②Lit sitting

column.name: text
column.value: Then the angel of the LORD said, “LORD of armies, how long will You take no pity on Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, with which You have been indignant for these seventy years?”

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD responded to the angel who was speaking with me with ①gracious words, comforting words. ▷ ①Lit good

column.name: text
column.value: So the angel who was speaking with me said to me, “Proclaim, saying, ‘This is what the LORD of armies says: “I am exceedingly jealous for Jerusalem and Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: But I am very angry with the nations who are carefree; for while I was only a little angry, they ①furthered the disaster.” ▷ ①Lit helped for evil

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the LORD says this: “I will return to Jerusalem with compassion; My house will be built in it,” declares the LORD of armies, “and a measuring line will be stretched over Jerusalem.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: Again, proclaim, saying, ‘This is what the LORD of armies says: “My cities will again overflow with prosperity, and the LORD will again comfort Zion and again choose Jerusalem.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: ①Then I raised my eyes and looked, and behold, there were four horns. ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: So I said to the angel who was speaking with me, “What are these?” And he said to me, “These are the horns that have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD showed me four craftsmen.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said, “What are these coming to do?” And he said, “These are the horns that have scattered Judah so that no one lifts up his head; but these craftsmen have come to frighten them, to throw down the horns of the nations who have lifted up their horns against the land of Judah in order to scatter it.”

column.name: text
column.value: On the twenty-first of the seventh month, the word of the LORD came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Who is left among you who saw this ①temple in its former glory? And how do you see it now? ②Does it not seem to you like nothing ③in comparison? ▷ ①Lit house ②Lit Is it not in your eyes like ③Lit like it

column.name: text
column.value: But now ①take courage, Zerubbabel,’ declares the LORD, ‘take courage also, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and all you people of the land take courage,’ declares the LORD, ‘and work; for I am with you,’ declares the LORD of armies. ▷ ①Lit be strong

column.name: text
column.value: ‘As for the ①promise which I ②made you when you came out of Egypt, ③My Spirit remains in your midst; do not fear!’ ▷ ①Lit word ②Lit cut with ③Or while My Spirit was standing

column.name: text
column.value: For this is what the LORD of armies says: ‘Once more ①in a little while, I am going to shake the heavens and the earth, the sea also and the dry land. ▷ ①Lit it is a little

column.name: text
column.value: I will shake all the nations; and ①they will come with the wealth of all nations, and I will fill this house with glory,’ says the LORD of armies. ▷ ①Another reading is the wealth of all nations will come

column.name: text
column.value: ‘The silver is Mine and the gold is Mine,’ declares the LORD of armies.

column.name: text
column.value: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says the LORD of armies, ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ declares the LORD of armies.”

column.name: text
column.value: On the twenty-fourth of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to Haggai the prophet, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “The LORD of armies says this: ‘Now ask the priests for a ①ruling: ▷ ①Lit law; or saying

column.name: text
column.value: If someone carries holy meat in the ①fold of his garment, and touches bread with ②this fold, or touches cooked food, wine, oil, or any other food, will it become holy?’ ” And the priests answered, “No.” ▷ ①Lit wing ②Lit his wing

column.name: text
column.value: Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean from a ①corpse touches any of these things, will the latter become unclean?” And the priests answered, “It will become unclean.” ▷ ①Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: Then Haggai responded and said, “ ‘So is this people. And so is this nation before Me,’ declares the LORD, ‘and so is every work of their hands; and what they offer there is unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: But now, do ①consider from this day ②onward: before one stone was placed on another in the temple of the LORD, ▷ ①Lit set your heart ②Or backward

column.name: text
column.value: ①from that time when one came to a grain heap of twenty measures, there would be only ten; and when one came to the wine vat to draw fifty ②measures, there would be only twenty. ▷ ①Lit since they were ②Lit troughs

column.name: text
column.value: I struck you and every work of your hands with scorching wind, mildew, and hail; ①yet you did not come back to Me,’ declares the LORD. ▷ ①As in LXX; MT but you were not to Me

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Do ①consider from this day ②onward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month; from the day when the temple of the LORD was founded, ③consider: ▷ ①Lit set your heart ②Or backward ③Lit set your heart

column.name: text
column.value: Is the seed still in the barn? Even including the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree, it has not produced fruit. Yet from this day on I will bless you.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came a second time to Haggai on the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Speak to Zerubbabel governor of Judah, saying, ‘I am going to shake the heavens and the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will overthrow the thrones of kingdoms and destroy the power of the kingdoms of the ①nations; and I will overthrow the chariots and their riders, and the horses and their riders will go down, every one by the sword of another.’ ▷ ①Or Gentiles

column.name: text
column.value: ‘On that day,’ declares the LORD of armies, ‘I will take you, Zerubbabel, son of Shealtiel, My servant,’ declares the LORD, ‘and I will make you like a ①signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ ” declares the LORD of armies. ▷ ①Or seal

column.name: text
column.value: ①Then I raised my eyes and looked, and behold, there was a man with a measuring line in his hand. ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: So I said, “Where are you going?” And he said to me, “To measure Jerusalem, to see how wide it is and how long it is.”

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, the angel who had been speaking with me was going out, and another angel was going out to meet him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, “Run, speak to that young man there, saying, ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as open country because of the multitude of people and cattle within it.

column.name: text
column.value: But I,’ declares the LORD, ‘will be a wall of fire to her on all sides, and I will be the glory in her midst.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①You there! Flee from the land of the north,” declares the LORD, “because I have spread you out like the four winds of the heavens,” declares the LORD. ▷ ①Lit Hoy

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①You, Zion! Escape, you who are living with the daughter of Babylon.” ▷ ①Lit Hoy

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD of armies says this: “After glory He has sent me against the nations that plunder you, for the one who touches you, touches the ①apple of His eye. ▷ ①Lit pupil

column.name: text
column.value: For behold, I am going to wave My hand over them so that they will be plunder for their slaves. Then you will know that the LORD of armies has sent Me.

column.name: text
column.value: Shout for joy and rejoice, daughter of Zion; for behold I am coming and I will dwell in your midst,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: “And many nations will join themselves to the LORD on that day and will become My people. Then I will dwell in your midst, and you will know that the LORD of armies has sent Me to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD will ①possess Judah as His portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem. ▷ ①Or inherit

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①Be silent, all ②mankind, before the LORD; for He has roused Himself from His holy dwelling.” ▷ ①Lit Hush ②Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: Then I raised my eyes again and looked, and behold, there was a flying scroll.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, “What do you see?” And I said, “I see a flying scroll; its length is ①twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits.” ▷ ①About 30 ft. long and 15 ft. wide or 9 m and 4.5 m

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to me, “This is the curse that is going forth over the face of the entire ①land; everyone who steals certainly will be purged away according to ②the writing on one side, and everyone who swears falsely will be purged away according to ③the writing on the other side. ▷ ①Or earth ②Lit it ③Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: I will make it go forth,” declares the LORD of armies, “and it will enter the house of the thief and the house of the one who swears falsely by My name; and it will spend the night within that house and destroy it with its timber and stones.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the angel who had been speaking with me went out and said to me, “Now raise your eyes and see what this is that is going forth.”

column.name: text
column.value: And I said, “What is it?” Then he said, “This is the ①ephah going forth.” Again he said, “This is their ②appearance in all the ③land. ▷ ①I.e., a measuring basket, about 1 cubic foot or 0.03 cubic meters, and so throughout the ch ②Lit eye; some ancient versions wrongdoing ③Or earth

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, a lead cover was lifted up.” He continued, “And this is a woman sitting inside the ephah.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said, “This is Wickedness!” And he thrust her into the middle of the ephah and threw the lead weight on its ①opening. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Then I raised my eyes and looked, and there two women were coming out with the wind in their wings; and they had wings like the wings of the stork, and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heavens.

column.name: text
column.value: So I said to the angel who was speaking with me, “Where are they taking the ephah?”

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to me, “To build a ①temple for her in the land of Shinar; and when it is prepared, she will be set there on her own pedestal.” ▷ ①Lit house

column.name: text
column.value: Then the angel who had been speaking with me returned and woke me, like a person who is awakened from his sleep.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, “What do you see?” And I said, “I see, and behold, a lampstand all of gold with its bowl on the top of it, and its seven lamps on it with seven ①spouts belonging to each of the lamps which are on the top of it; ▷ ①Or reeds

column.name: text
column.value: also two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl and the other on its left side.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said to the angel who was speaking with me, saying, “What are these, my lord?”

column.name: text
column.value: So the angel who was speaking with me answered and said to me, “Do you not know what these are?” And I said, “No, my lord.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to ①me, “This is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit,’ says the LORD of armies. ▷ ①Lit me, saying

column.name: text
column.value: ‘What are you, you great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you will become a plain; and he will bring out the top stone with shouts of “Grace, grace to it!” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Also the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house, and his hands will finish it. Then you will know that the LORD of armies has sent me to ①you. ▷ ①Lit you (plural)

column.name: text
column.value: For who has shown contempt for the day of small things? ①But these seven will rejoice when they see the ②plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel—they are the eyes of the LORD roaming throughout the earth.” ▷ ①Or But they will rejoice when they see...Zerubbabel. These seven are the eyes of the LORD ②Lit plummet stone

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said to him, “What are these two olive trees on the right of the lampstand and on its left?”

column.name: text
column.value: And I responded the second time and said to him, “What are the two olive ①branches which are beside the two golden pipes, which empty the golden oil from themselves?” ▷ ①Or clusters

column.name: text
column.value: So he answered me, saying, “Do you not know what these are?” And I said, “No, my lord.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said, “These are the two ①anointed ones, who are standing by the Lord of the whole earth.” ▷ ①Lit sons of fresh oil

column.name: text
column.value: In the fourth year of King Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, which is Chislev.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the town of Bethel had sent Sharezer and Regemmelech and ①their men to ②seek the favor of the LORD, ▷ ①Lit his ②Lit soften the face of

column.name: text
column.value: speaking to the priests who belong to the house of the LORD of armies, and to the prophets, saying, “Shall I weep in the fifth month ①and fast, as I have done these many years?” ▷ ①Lit to fast

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD of armies came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Say to all the people of the land and to the priests, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months ①these seventy years, was it actually for Me that you fasted? ▷ ①Lit and this

column.name: text
column.value: And when you eat and drink, ①do you not eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves? ▷ ①Lit is it not you who eat and you who drink

column.name: text
column.value: Are these not the words which the LORD proclaimed by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and carefree along with its cities around it, and the ①Negev and the ②foothills were inhabited?’ ” ▷ ①I.e., South country ②Heb Shephelah

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to Zechariah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “This is what the LORD of armies has said: ‘Dispense true justice and practice kindness and compassion each to his brother;

column.name: text
column.value: and do not oppress the widow or the ①orphan, the stranger or the poor; and do not devise evil in your hearts against one another.’ ▷ ①Or fatherless

column.name: text
column.value: But they refused to pay attention, and ①turned a stubborn shoulder and ②plugged their ears from hearing. ▷ ①Lit gave ②Lit made their ears heavy

column.name: text
column.value: They also made their hearts as hard as a diamond ①so that they could not hear the Law and the words which the LORD of armies had sent by His Spirit through the former prophets; therefore great wrath came from the LORD of armies. ▷ ①Lit from hearing

column.name: text
column.value: And just as He called and they would not listen, so they called and I would not listen,” says the LORD of armies;

column.name: text
column.value: “but I ①scattered them with a storm wind among all the nations whom they did not know. So the land was desolated behind them ②so that no one went back and forth, since they made the pleasant land desolate.” ▷ ①Lit stormed them away upon all ②Lit from passing and from returning

column.name: text
column.value: Then he showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, and ①Satan standing at his right to accuse him. ▷ ①Satan is Heb for Adversary; or Accuser

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Satan, “The LORD rebuke you, Satan! Indeed, the LORD who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Is this not a log snatched from the fire?”

column.name: text
column.value: Now Joshua was clothed in filthy garments and was standing before the angel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he responded and said to those who were standing before him, saying, “Remove the filthy garments from him.” Again he said to him, “See, I have taken your guilt away from you and ①will clothe you with festive robes.” ▷ ①Lit to clothe

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, “Have them put a clean headband on his head.” So they put the clean headband on his head and clothed him with garments, while the angel of the LORD was standing by.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of the LORD admonished Joshua, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “The LORD of armies says this: ‘If you walk in My ways and perform My service, then you will both govern My house and be in charge of My courtyards, and I will grant you ①free access among these who are standing here. ▷ ①Lit goings

column.name: text
column.value: Now listen, Joshua, you high priest, you and your friends who are sitting in front of you—indeed they are men who are a sign: for behold, I am going to bring in My servant the ①Branch. ▷ ①Lit Sprout

column.name: text
column.value: For behold, the stone that I have put before Joshua; on one stone are seven eyes. Behold, I am going to engrave an inscription on it,’ declares the LORD of armies, ‘and I will remove the guilt of that land in one day.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day,’ declares the LORD of armies, ‘every one of you will invite his neighbor to sit under his vine and under his fig tree.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: The pronouncement of the word of the LORD is against the land of Hadrach, with Damascus as its resting place (for the eyes of mankind, especially of all the tribes of Israel, are toward the LORD),

column.name: text
text
column.value: For Tyre built herself a fortress, And piled up silver like dust, And gold like the mud of the streets.

column.name: text
text
column.value: Ashkelon will see it and be afraid. Gaza too will writhe in great pain; Also Ekron, because her hope has been ruined. Moreover, the king will perish from Gaza, And Ashkelon will not be inhabited.

column.name: text
column.value: And a people of mixed origins will live in Ashdod, And I will eliminate the pride of the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will remove their blood from their mouth And their detestable things from between their teeth. Then they also will be a remnant for our God, And be like a ①clan in Judah, And Ekron will be like a Jebusite. ▷ ①Or chief

column.name: text
column.value: But I will camp around My house ①because of an army, Because of him who passes by and returns; And no oppressor will pass over them anymore, For now I have seen with My eyes. ▷ ①Or as a garrison, so that none will go back and forth

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout in triumph, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your king is coming to you; He is ①righteous and endowed with salvation, Humble, and mounted on a donkey, Even on a colt, the ②foal of a donkey. ▷ ①Or vindicated and victorious ②Lit son of a female donkey

column.name: text
text
column.value: As for you also, because of the blood of My covenant with you, I have set your prisoners free from the ①waterless pit. ▷ ①Lit cistern in which there is no water

column.name: text
text
column.value: For I will bend Judah ①as My bow, I will fill the bow with Ephraim. And I will stir up your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece; And I will make you like a warrior’s sword. ▷ ①Lit for Me as a bow

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD will appear over them, And His arrow will go forth like lightning; And the Lord ①GOD will blow the trumpet, And march in the storm winds of the south. ▷ ①Heb YHWH, usually rendered LORD

column.name: text
text
column.value: And the LORD their God will save them on that day As the flock of His people; For they are like the precious stones of a crown, Sparkling on His land.

column.name: text
column.value: For how great will ①their loveliness and beauty be! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine, the virgins. ▷ ①Lit his

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD of armies came, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “The LORD of armies says this: ‘I am exceedingly jealous for Zion, yes, with great wrath I am jealous for her.’

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD says this: ‘I will return to Zion and dwell in the midst of Jerusalem. Then Jerusalem will be called the City of Truth, and the mountain of the LORD of armies will be called the Holy Mountain.’

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD of armies says this: ‘Old men and old women will again sit in the public squares of Jerusalem, each person with his staff in his hand because of ①age. ▷ ①Lit the multitude of days

column.name: text
column.value: And the public squares of the city will be filled with boys and girls playing in its squares.’

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD of armies says this: ‘If it is too difficult in the sight of the remnant of this people in those days, will it also be too difficult in My sight?’ declares the LORD of armies.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD of armies says this: ‘Behold, I am going to save My people from the land of the ①east and from the land of the ②west; ▷ ①Lit sunrise ②Lit setting sun

column.name: text
column.value: and I will bring them back and they will live in the midst of Jerusalem; and they shall be My people, and I will be their God in ①truth and righteousness.’ ▷ ①Or faithfulness

column.name: text
column.value: “The LORD of armies says this: ‘Let your hands be strong, you who are listening in these days to these words from the mouth of the prophets, those who spoke in the day that the foundation of the house of the LORD of armies was laid, so that the temple might be built.

column.name: text
column.value: For before those days there was no wage for man nor any wage for animal; and for him who went out or came in there was no ①peace because of ②his enemies, and I sent all the people against one another. ▷ ①Or security ②Lit the adversary

column.name: text
column.value: But now I will not ①treat the remnant of this people as in the former days,’ declares the LORD of armies. ▷ ①Lit be to the

column.name: text
column.value: ‘For there will be the seed of peace: the vine will yield its fruit, the land will yield its produce, and the heavens will provide their dew; and I will give to the remnant of this people all these things as an inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: And it will come about that just as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you that you may become a blessing. Do not fear; let your hands be strong.’

column.name: text
column.value: “For this is what the LORD of armies says: ‘Just as I determined to do harm to you when your fathers provoked Me to anger,’ says the LORD of armies, ‘and I have not relented,

column.name: text
column.value: so I have again determined in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. Do not fear!

column.name: text
column.value: These are the things which you shall do: speak the truth to one another; judge with truth and judgment for peace at your ①gates. ▷ ①I.e., the place where court was held

column.name: text
column.value: Also let none of you devise evil in your heart against another, and do not love ①perjury; for all these things are what I hate,’ declares the LORD.” ▷ ①Lit a false oath

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD of armies came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “The LORD of armies says this: ‘The fast of the fourth, the fast of the fifth, the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth months will become joy, jubilation, and ①cheerful festivals for the house of Judah; so love truth and peace.’ ▷ ①Or goodly

column.name: text
column.value: “The LORD of armies says this: ‘It will yet turn out that peoples will come, that is, the inhabitants of many cities.

column.name: text
column.value: The inhabitants of one city will go to another, saying, “Let’s go at once to plead for the favor of the LORD, and to seek the LORD of armies; ①I also will go.” ▷ ①Or let me go too

column.name: text
column.value: So many peoples and mighty nations will come to seek the LORD of armies in Jerusalem, and to plead for the favor of the LORD.’

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD of armies says this: ‘In those days ten people from all the ①nations will ②grasp the ③garment of a Jew, saying, “Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.” ’ ” ▷ ①Lit languages of the nations ②Lit grasp, and they will grasp ③Lit hem of a garment

column.name: text
column.value: Ask for rain from the LORD at the time of the spring rain— The LORD who makes the ①storm winds; And He will give them showers of rain, vegetation in the field to each person. ▷ ①Or thunderbolts

column.name: text
column.value: For the ①household idols speak deception, And the diviners see ②an illusion And tell deceitful dreams; They comfort in vain. Therefore the people ③wander like sheep, They are wretched because there is no shepherd. ▷ ①Heb teraphim ②Lit a lie ③Lit journey

column.name: text
column.value: “My anger is kindled against the shepherds, And I will punish the ①male goats; For the LORD of armies has visited His flock, the house of Judah, And will make them like His majestic horse in battle. ▷ ①I.e., leaders

column.name: text
column.value: From ①them will come the cornerstone, From ②them the tent peg, From ③them the bow of battle, From ④them every tyrant, all of them together. ▷ ①Lit him ②Lit him ③Lit him ④Lit him

column.name: text
text
column.value: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, And I will save the house of Joseph, And I will ①bring them back, Because I have had compassion on them; And they will be as though I had not rejected them, For I am the LORD their God and I will answer them. ▷ ①Another reading is have them dwell

column.name: text
column.value: Ephraim will be like a warrior, And their heart will be joyful as if from wine; Indeed, their children will see it and be joyful, ①Their heart will rejoice in the LORD. ▷ ①Or Let their heart rejoice

column.name: text
column.value: I will whistle for them and gather them together, For I have redeemed them; And they will be as numerous as they ①were before. ▷ ①Lit were numerous

column.name: text
column.value: When I ①scatter them among the peoples, They will remember Me in distant countries, And they with their children will live and come back. ▷ ①Lit sow

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring them back from the land of Egypt And gather them from Assyria; And I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon ①Until no room can be found for them. ▷ ①Lit And

column.name: text
column.value: And they will pass through the sea of distress And He will strike the waves in the sea, So that all the depths of the Nile will dry up; And the pride of Assyria will be brought down, And the scepter of Egypt will depart.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will strengthen them in the LORD, And in His name they will walk,” declares the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I raised my eyes again and looked, and behold, four chariots were going out from between the two mountains; and the mountains were bronze mountains.

column.name: text
column.value: With the first chariot were red horses, with the second chariot black horses,

column.name: text
column.value: with the third chariot white horses, and with the fourth chariot strong spotted horses.

column.name: text
column.value: So I responded and said to the angel who was speaking with me, “What are these, my lord?”

column.name: text
column.value: The angel replied to me, “These are the four spirits of heaven, going out after taking their stand before the Lord of all the earth,

column.name: text
column.value: with one of which the black horses are going out to the north country; and the white ones are to go out after them, while the spotted ones are to go out to the south country.”

column.name: text
column.value: When the strong ones went out, they ①were eager to go to ②patrol the earth. And He said, “Go, ③patrol the earth.” So they ④patrolled the earth. ▷ ①Lit sought to go ②Lit walk about through ③Lit walk about through ④Lit walked about through

column.name: text
column.value: Then He called out to me and spoke to me, saying, “See, those who are going to the land of the north have ①appeased My wrath in the land of the north.” ▷ ①Lit pacified My spirit in

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD also came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Take an offering from the exiles, from Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah; and you shall go the same day and enter the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, where they have arrived from Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Also take silver and gold, make an ornate crown, and set it on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest.

column.name: text
column.value: Then say to him, ‘The LORD of armies says this: “Behold, there is a Man whose name is ①Branch, for He will ②branch out from where He is; and He will build the temple of the LORD. ▷ ①Lit Sprout ②Lit sprout up

column.name: text
column.value: Yes, it is He who will build the temple of the LORD, and He who will bear the majesty and sit and rule on His throne. So He will be a priest on His throne, and the counsel of peace will be between the two ①offices.” ’ ▷ ①Lit of them

column.name: text
column.value: Now the crown will become a reminder in the temple of the LORD to Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and ①Hen the son of Zephaniah. ▷ ①I.e., Josiah

column.name: text
column.value: Those who are far away will come and ①build the temple of the LORD.” Then you will know that the LORD of armies has sent me to you. And it will take place if you completely obey ②the LORD your God. ▷ ①Lit build in ②Lit the voice of the LORD

column.name: text
column.value: Open your doors, Lebanon, So that a fire may feed on your cedars.

column.name: text
column.value: Wail, juniper, because the cedar has fallen, For the magnificent trees have been destroyed; Wail, oaks of Bashan, Because the ①impenetrable forest has come down. ▷ ①Another reading is forest of the vintage

column.name: text
column.value: There is a sound of the shepherds’ wail, For their splendor is ruined; There is a sound of the young lions’ roar, For the ①pride of the Jordan is ruined. ▷ ①Or thicket

column.name: text
column.value: This is what the LORD my God says: “Pasture the flock doomed to slaughter.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who buy them slaughter them and ①go unpunished, and each of those who sell them says, ‘Blessed be the LORD, for I have become rich!’ And their own shepherds have no compassion for them. ▷ ①Lit are not held guilty

column.name: text
column.value: For I will no longer have compassion for the inhabitants of the land,” declares the LORD; “but behold, I will let the people fall, each into another’s ①power and into the ②power of his king; and they will crush the land, and I will not rescue them from their ③power.” ▷ ①Lit hand ②Lit hand ③Lit hand

column.name: text
column.value: So I pastured the flock doomed to slaughter, ①therefore also the afflicted of the flock. And I took for myself two staffs: the one I called ②Favor, and the other I called Union; so I pastured the flock. ▷ ①Another reading is for the sheep dealers ②Or Pleasantness

column.name: text
column.value: Then I did away with the three shepherds in one month, for my soul was impatient with them, and their soul also ①was tired of me. ▷ ①Or detested

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, “I will not pasture you. What is to die, ①let it die, and what is to perish, ②let it perish; and ③let those who are left eat one another’s flesh.” ▷ ①Or will die ②Or will perish ③Or those...will eat

column.name: text
column.value: And I took my staff ①Favor and cut it in pieces, to ②break my covenant which I had made with all the peoples. ▷ ①Or Pleasantness ②Or annul

column.name: text
column.value: So it was ①broken on that day, and ②so the afflicted of the flock who were watching me realized that it was the word of the LORD. ▷ ①Or annulled ②Another reading is the sheep dealers who

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to them, “If it is good in your sight, give me my wages; but if not, ①never mind!” So they weighed out thirty shekels of silver as my wages. ▷ ①Lit cease

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me, “Throw it to the potter, that magnificent price at which I was valued by them.” So I took the thirty shekels of silver and threw them to the potter in the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I cut in pieces my second staff Union, to break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, “Take again for yourself the equipment of a foolish shepherd.

column.name: text
column.value: For behold, I am going to raise up a shepherd in the land who will not care for the perishing, seek the scattered, heal the broken, or provide for the one who is exhausted, but will devour the flesh of the fat sheep and tear off their hoofs.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to the worthless shepherd Who abandons the flock! A sword will be on his arm And on his right eye! His arm will be totally withered, And his right eye will be ①blind.” ▷ ①Lit completely dimmed

column.name: text
column.value: The pronouncement of the word of the LORD concerning Israel: The LORD who stretches out the heavens, lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of a person within him, declares:

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, I am going to make Jerusalem a cup ①that causes staggering to all the peoples around; and when the siege is against Jerusalem, it will also be against Judah. ▷ ①Lit of reeling

column.name: text
column.value: It will come about on that day that I will make Jerusalem a heavy stone for all the peoples; all who lift it will injure themselves severely. And all the nations of the earth will be gathered against it.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day,” declares the LORD, “I will strike every horse with confusion and its rider with insanity. But I will ①watch over the house of Judah, while I strike every horse of the peoples with blindness. ▷ ①Lit open My eyes

column.name: text
column.value: Then the ①clans of Judah will say in their hearts, ‘The inhabitants of Jerusalem are a ②strong support for us through the LORD of armies, their God.’ ▷ ①Or chiefs ②Lit strength for me

column.name: text
column.value: “On that day I will make the ①clans of Judah like a firepot among pieces of wood and a flaming torch among sheaves, so they will consume on the right and on the left all the surrounding peoples, while ②the inhabitants of Jerusalem again live on their own sites in Jerusalem. ▷ ①Or chiefs ②Lit Jerusalem...is again inhabited on its

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD also will save the tents of Judah first, so that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem will not be greater than Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day the LORD will protect the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the one who ①is feeble among them on that day will be like David, and the house of David will be like God, like the angel of the LORD before them. ▷ ①Lit stumbles

column.name: text
column.value: And on that day I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

column.name: text
