column.value: “And I will pour out on the house of David and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem ①the Spirit of grace and of pleading, so that they will look at Me whom they pierced; and they will mourn for Him, like one mourning for an only son, and they will weep bitterly over Him like the bitter weeping over a firstborn. ▷ ①Or a spirit

column.name: text
column.value: On that day the mourning in Jerusalem will be great, like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the ①plain of ②Megiddo. ▷ ①I.e., broad valley ②Heb Megiddon

column.name: text
column.value: The land will mourn, every family by itself; the family of the house of David by itself and their wives by themselves; the family of the house of Nathan by itself and their wives by themselves;

column.name: text
column.value: the family of the house of Levi by itself and their wives by themselves; the family of the Shimeites by itself and their wives by themselves;

column.name: text
column.value: all the families that are left, every family by itself, and their wives by themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: “On that day a fountain will be opened for the house of David and for the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for defilement.

column.name: text
column.value: “And it will come about on that day,” declares the LORD of armies, “that I will eliminate the names of the idols from the land, and they will no longer be remembered; and I will also remove the prophets and the unclean spirit from the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And if anyone still prophesies, then his father and mother who gave birth to him will say to him, ‘You shall not live, because you have spoken falsely in the name of the LORD’; and his father and mother who gave birth to him shall pierce him through when he prophesies.

column.name: text
column.value: Also it will come about on that day that the prophets will each be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies, and they will not put on a hairy robe in order to deceive;

column.name: text
column.value: but he will say, ‘I am not a prophet; I am a cultivator of the ground, because a man ①sold me as a slave in my youth.’ ▷ ①Lit caused another to buy me

column.name: text
column.value: And someone will say to him, ‘What are these wounds between your ①arms?’ Then he will say, ‘Those with which I was wounded at the house of ②my friends.’ ▷ ①Lit hands ②Lit those who love me

column.name: text
column.value: “Awake, sword, against My Shepherd, And against the Man, My Associate,” Declares the LORD of armies. “Strike the Shepherd and the sheep will be scattered; And I will turn My hand ①against the little ones. ▷ ①Or upon

column.name: text
column.value: And it will come about in all the land,” Declares the LORD, “That two parts in it will be cut off and perish; But the third will be left in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring the third part through the fire, Refine them as silver is refined, And test them as gold is tested. They will call on My name, And I will answer them; I will say, ‘They are My people,’ And they will say, ‘The LORD is my God.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, a day is coming for the LORD when the spoils taken from you will be divided among you.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will gather all the nations against Jerusalem to battle, and the city will be taken, the houses plundered, the women raped, and half of the city exiled, but the rest of the people will not be eliminated from the city.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD will go forth and fight against those nations, as ①when He fights on a day of battle. ▷ ①Lit a day of His fighting

column.name: text
column.value: On that day His feet will stand on the Mount of Olives, which is in front of Jerusalem on the east; and the Mount of Olives will be split ①in its middle from east to west forming a very large valley. Half of the mountain will move toward the north, and the other half toward the south. ▷ ①Lit from

column.name: text
column.value: And you will flee by the valley of My mountains, for the valley of the mountains will reach to Azel; yes, you will flee just as you fled from the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Then the LORD, my God, will come, and all the holy ones with ①Him! ▷ ①As in many mss and ancient versions; MT You

column.name: text
column.value: On that day there will be no light; the ①luminaries will die out. ▷ ①Lit glorious ones will congeal

column.name: text
column.value: For it will be a unique day which is known to the LORD, neither day nor night, but it will come about that at the time of evening there will be light.

column.name: text
column.value: And on that day living waters will flow out of Jerusalem, half of them toward the eastern sea and the other half toward the western sea; it will be in summer as well as in winter.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD will be King over all the earth; on that day the LORD will be the only one, and His name the only one.

column.name: text
column.value: All the land will change into a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; but ①Jerusalem will rise and remain on its site from Benjamin’s Gate as far as the place of the First Gate to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the king’s wine presses. ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: People will live in it, and there will no longer be a curse, for Jerusalem will live in security.

column.name: text
column.value: Now this will be the plague with which the LORD will strike all the peoples who have gone to war against Jerusalem; their flesh will rot while they stand on their feet, and their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongue will rot in their mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: And it will come about on that day that a great panic from the LORD will ①fall on them; and they will seize one another’s hand, and the hand of one will ②be raised against the hand of another. ▷ ①Lit be among ②Lit rise

column.name: text
column.value: Judah also will fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be gathered, gold, silver, and garments in great abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: And just like this plague, there will be a plague on the horse, the mule, the camel, the donkey, and all the cattle that will be in those camps.

column.name: text
column.value: Then it will come about that any who are left of all the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up from year to year to worship the King, the LORD of armies, and to celebrate the Feast of Booths.

column.name: text
column.value: And it will be that whichever of the families of the earth does not go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of armies, there will be no rain on them.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the family of Egypt does not go up or enter, then no rain will fall on them; it will be the plague with which the LORD strikes the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Feast of Booths.

column.name: text
column.value: This will be the ①punishment of Egypt, and the ②punishment of all the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Feast of Booths. ▷ ①Lit sin ②Lit sin

column.name: text
column.value: On that day there will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, “HOLY TO THE LORD.” And the cooking pots in the LORD’S house will be like the bowls before the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Every cooking pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to the LORD of armies; and all who sacrifice will come and take of them and boil in them. And there will no longer be a ①Canaanite in the house of the LORD of armies on that day. ▷ ①Or merchant

column.name: text
column.value: “And now, this commandment is for you, the priests.

column.name: text
column.value: If you do not listen, and if you do not take it to heart to give honor to My name,” says the LORD of armies, “then I will send the curse upon you and I will curse your blessings; and indeed, I have cursed them already, because you are not taking it to heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I am going to rebuke your ①descendants, and I will spread ②dung on your faces, the ③dung of your feasts; and you will be taken away ④with it. ▷ ①Lit seed ②Or vomit ③Or vomit ④Lit to

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will know that I have sent this commandment to you, ①so that My covenant may ②continue with Levi,” says the LORD of armies. ▷ ①Or to be My covenant with ②Lit be

column.name: text
column.value: “My covenant with him was one of life and peace, and I gave them to him as an object of ①reverence; so he ②revered Me and was in awe of My name. ▷ ①Or fear ②Or feared

column.name: text
column.value: ①True instruction was in his mouth and injustice was not found on his lips; he walked with Me in peace and justice, and he turned many back from wrongdoing. ▷ ①Or Law of truth

column.name: text
column.value: For the lips of a priest should maintain knowledge, and people should seek ①instruction from his mouth; for he is the messenger of the LORD of armies. ▷ ①Or the Law

column.name: text
column.value: But as for you, you have turned aside from the way; you have caused many to stumble ①by the instruction; you have ruined the covenant of Levi,” says the LORD of armies. ▷ ①Or in the Law

column.name: text
column.value: “So I also have made you despised and of low reputation ①in the view of all the people, since you are not keeping My ways but are showing partiality in the ②instruction.” ▷ ①Lit to ②Or law

column.name: text
column.value: Do we not all have one Father? Is it not one God who has created us? Why do we deal treacherously, each against his brother so as to profane the covenant of our fathers?

column.name: text
column.value: Judah has dealt treacherously, and an abomination has been committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah has profaned the sanctuary of the LORD ①which He loves, and has married the daughter of a foreign god. ▷ ①Or in that he has loved and married

column.name: text
column.value: As for the man who does this, may the LORD eliminate from the tents of Jacob everyone who is awake and answers, or who presents ①an offering to the LORD of armies. ▷ ①Or a grain offering

column.name: text
column.value: And this is ①another thing you do: you cover the altar of the LORD with tears, with weeping and sighing, because He no longer gives attention to the ②offering or accepts it with favor from your hand. ▷ ①Lit a second ②Or grain offering

column.name: text
column.value: Yet you say, “For what reason?” Because the LORD has been a witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously, though she is your marriage companion and your wife by covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: ①But not one has done so who has a remnant of the Spirit. And ②why the one? He was seeking a godly offspring. Be careful then about your spirit, and see that none of you deals treacherously against the wife of your youth. ▷ ①Or Did He not make one, although He had the remnant ②Or what did the one do while he was seeking

column.name: text
column.value: “For ①I hate ②divorce,” says the LORD, the God of Israel, “and ③him who covers his garment with violence,” says the LORD of armies. “So be careful about your spirit, that you do not deal treacherously.” ▷ ①Lit He hates ②Lit sending away ③Lit he covers

column.name: text
column.value: You have wearied the LORD with your words. Yet you say, “How have we wearied Him?” In that you say, “Everyone who does evil is good in the sight of the LORD, and He delights in them,” or, “Where is the God of justice?”

column.name: text
column.value: The pronouncement of the word of the LORD to Israel through ①Malachi: ▷ ①Or My messenger

column.name: text
column.value: “I have loved you,” says the LORD. But you say, “How have You loved us?” “Was Esau not Jacob’s brother?” declares the LORD. “Yet I have loved Jacob;

column.name: text
column.value: but I have hated Esau, and I have made his mountains a desolation and given his inheritance to the jackals of the wilderness.”

column.name: text
column.value: Though Edom says, “We have been beaten down, but we will ①return and build up the ruins”; this is what the LORD of armies says: “They may build, but I will tear down; and people will call them the ②territory of wickedness, and the people ③with whom the LORD is indignant forever.” ▷ ①Or rebuild the ruins ②Lit border of wickedness ③Or whom the LORD has cursed

column.name: text
column.value: And your eyes will see this, and you will say, “The LORD ①be exalted beyond the ②border of Israel!” ▷ ①Or will be great ②Or territory

column.name: text
column.value: “ ‘A son honors his father, and a servant his master. Then if I am a father, where is My honor? And if I am a master, where is My ①respect?’ says the LORD of armies to you, the priests who despise My name! But you say, ‘How have we despised Your name?’ ▷ ①Lit fear

column.name: text
column.value: You are presenting defiled ①food upon My altar. But you say, ‘How have we defiled You?’ In that you say, ‘The table of the LORD is to be despised.’ ▷ ①Lit bread

column.name: text
column.value: And when you present a blind animal for sacrifice, is it not evil? Or when you present a lame or sick animal, is it not evil? So offer it to your governor! Would he be pleased with you, or would he receive you kindly?” says the LORD of armies.

column.name: text
column.value: “But now, do indeed plead for God’s favor, so that He will be gracious to us. ①With such an offering on your part, will He receive any of you kindly?” says the LORD of armies. ▷ ①Lit This has been from your hand

column.name: text
column.value: “If only there were one among you who would shut the ①gates, so that you would not kindle fire on My altar for nothing! I am not pleased with you,” says the LORD of armies, “nor will I accept an offering from your hand. ▷ ①Or doors

column.name: text
column.value: For from the rising of the sun even to its setting, My name shall be great among the nations, and in every place frankincense is going to be offered to My name, and a grain offering that is pure; for My name shall be great among the nations,” says the LORD of armies.

column.name: text
column.value: “But you are profaning it by your saying, ‘The table of the Lord is defiled, and as for its fruit, its food is to be despised.’

column.name: text
column.value: You also say, ‘See, ①how tiresome it is!’ And you view it as trivial,” says the LORD of armies, “and you bring what was taken by robbery and what is lame or sick; so you bring the offering! Should I accept it from your hand?” says the LORD. ▷ ①Lit it is hardship

column.name: text
column.value: “But cursed be the swindler who has a male in his flock and vows it, but sacrifices a blemished animal to the Lord, for I am a great King,” says the LORD of armies, “and My name is ①feared among the ②nations.” ▷ ①Or revered ②Or Gentiles

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, I am sending My ①messenger, and he will clear a way before Me. And the Lord, whom you are seeking, will suddenly come to His temple; ②and the ③messenger of the covenant, in whom you delight, behold, He is coming,” says the LORD of armies. ▷ ①Or angel ②Or that is, the ③Or angel

column.name: text
column.value: “But who can endure the day of His coming? And who can stand when He appears? For He is like a refiner’s fire, and like launderer’s soap.

column.name: text
column.value: And He will sit as a smelter and purifier of silver, and He will purify the sons of Levi and refine them like gold and silver, so that they may present to the LORD ①offerings in righteousness. ▷ ①Or grain offerings

column.name: text
column.value: Then the ①offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasing to the LORD as in the days of old, and as in former years. ▷ ①Or grain offering

column.name: text
column.value: “Then I will come near to you for judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, the adulterers, against those who swear falsely, those who ①oppress the wage earner in his wages or the widow or the ②orphan, and those who turn away the stranger from justice and do not ③fear Me,” says the LORD of armies. ▷ ①Or exploit ②Or fatherless ③Or revere

column.name: text
column.value: “For ①I, the LORD, do not change; therefore you, the sons of Jacob, have not come to an end. ▷ ①Or I am the LORD; I do not

column.name: text
column.value: “From the days of your fathers you have turned away from My statutes and have not kept them. Return to Me, and I will return to you,” says the LORD of armies. “But you say, ‘How shall we return?’

column.name: text
column.value: “Would anyone rob God? Yet you are robbing Me! But you say, ‘How have we robbed You?’ In tithes and ①offerings. ▷ ①Or contributions

column.name: text
column.value: You are cursed with a curse, for you are robbing Me, the entire nation of you!

column.name: text
column.value: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, so that there may be food in My house, and put Me to the test now in this,” says the LORD of armies, “if I do not open for you the windows of heaven and pour out for you a blessing until ①it overflows. ▷ ①Or there is not room enough

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will rebuke the devourer for you, so that it will not destroy the fruit of your ground; nor will the vine in the field prove fruitless to you,” says the LORD of armies.

column.name: text
column.value: “All the nations will call you blessed, for you will be a delightful land,” says the LORD of armies.

column.name: text
column.value: “Your words have been ①arrogant against Me,” says the LORD. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against You?’ ▷ ①Lit strong

column.name: text
column.value: You have said, ‘It is pointless to serve God; and what benefit is it for us that we have done what He required, and that we have walked in mourning before the LORD of armies?

column.name: text
column.value: So now we call the arrogant blessed; not only are the doers of wickedness built up, but they also put God to the test and escape punishment.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then those who ①feared the LORD spoke to one another, and the LORD listened attentively and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before Him for those who ②fear the LORD and esteem His name. ▷ ①Or revere(d) ②Or revere(d)

column.name: text
column.value: “And they will be Mine,” says the LORD of armies, “on the day that I ①prepare My own possession, and I will have compassion for them just as a man has compassion for his own son who serves him.” ▷ ①Lit make

column.name: text
column.value: So you will again distinguish between the righteous and the wicked, between one who serves God and one who does not serve Him.

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①For behold, the day is coming, burning like a furnace; and all the arrogant and every evildoer will be chaff; and the day that is coming will set them ablaze,” says the LORD of armies, “so that it will leave them neither root nor branches. ▷ ①Ch

column.name: text
column.value: But for you who ①fear My name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings; and you will go forth and frolic like calves from the stall. ▷ ①Or revere

column.name: text
column.value: And you will crush the wicked underfoot, for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet on the day ①that I am preparing,” says the LORD of armies. ▷ ①Or when I act

column.name: text
column.value: “Remember the Law of Moses My servant, the statutes and ordinances which I commanded him in Horeb for all Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, I am going to send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and terrible day of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: He will turn the hearts of the fathers back to their children and the hearts of the children to their fathers, so that I will not come and strike the land with complete destruction.”

column.name: text
column.value: The ①record of the genealogy of ②Jesus the ③Messiah, the son of David, the son of Abraham: ▷ ①Lit book ②In Heb Yeshua (Joshua), meaning The LORD is salvation ③From Gr Christos, which means Messiah (Heb for Anointed One)

column.name: text
column.value: Abraham fathered Isaac, Isaac fathered Jacob, and Jacob fathered ①Judah and his brothers. ▷ ①Gr Judas; a name of a person in the Old Testament is given in its Old Testament form

column.name: text
column.value: Judah fathered Perez and Zerah by Tamar, Perez fathered Hezron, and Hezron fathered ①Ram. ▷ ①Gr Aram

column.name: text
column.value: Ram fathered Amminadab, Amminadab fathered Nahshon, and Nahshon fathered Salmon.

column.name: text
column.value: Salmon fathered Boaz by Rahab, Boaz fathered Obed by Ruth, and Obed fathered Jesse.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesse fathered David the king. David fathered Solomon by ①her who had been the wife of Uriah. ▷ ①I.e., Bathsheba

column.name: text
column.value: Solomon fathered Rehoboam, Rehoboam fathered Abijah, and Abijah fathered ①Asa. ▷ ①Gr Asaph

column.name: text
column.value: Asa fathered Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat fathered ①Joram, and Joram fathered Uzziah. ▷ ①Also Gr for Jehoram in 2 Kin 8:16; cf. 1 Chr

column.name: text
column.value: Uzziah fathered ①Jotham, Jotham fathered Ahaz, and Ahaz fathered Hezekiah. ▷ ①Gr Joatham

column.name: text
column.value: Hezekiah fathered Manasseh, Manasseh fathered ①Amon, and Amon fathered Josiah. ▷ ①Gr Amos

column.name: text
column.value: Josiah fathered ①Jeconiah and his brothers, at the time of the deportation to Babylon. ▷ ①Jehoiachin in 2 Kin

column.name: text
column.value: After the deportation to Babylon: Jeconiah fathered ①Shealtiel, and Shealtiel fathered Zerubbabel. ▷ ①Gr Salathiel

column.name: text
column.value: Zerubbabel fathered ①Abihud, Abihud fathered Eliakim, and Eliakim fathered Azor. ▷ ①Gr Abioud, usually spelled Abiud

column.name: text
column.value: Azor fathered Zadok, Zadok fathered Achim, and Achim fathered Eliud.

column.name: text
column.value: Eliud fathered Eleazar, Eleazar fathered Matthan, and Matthan fathered Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: Jacob fathered Joseph the husband of Mary, by whom Jesus was born, who is called the ①Messiah. ▷ ①From Gr Christos, which means Messiah (Heb for Anointed One)

column.name: text
column.value: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the deportation to Babylon, fourteen generations; and from the deportation to Babylon to the ①Messiah, fourteen generations. ▷ ①See note v 16

column.name: text
column.value: Now the birth of Jesus the ①Messiah was as follows: when His mother Mary had been ②betrothed to Joseph, before they came together she was found to be pregnant by the Holy Spirit. ▷ ①See note v 16 ②Unlike engagement, a betrothed couple was considered married, but did not yet live together

column.name: text
column.value: And her husband Joseph, since he was a righteous man and did not want to disgrace her, planned to ①send her away secretly. ▷ ①Or divorce her

column.name: text
column.value: But when he had thought this over, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary as your wife; for ①the Child who has been conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit. ▷ ①Lit that which

column.name: text
column.value: She will give birth to a Son; and you shall name Him Jesus, for ①He will save His people from their sins.” ▷ ①Lit He Himself

column.name: text
column.value: Now all this ①took place so that what was spoken by the Lord through ②the prophet would be fulfilled: ▷ ①Lit has happened ②I.e., Isaiah

column.name: text
column.value: “BEHOLD, THE VIRGIN WILL ①CONCEIVE AND GIVE BIRTH TO A SON, AND THEY SHALL NAME HIM ②IMMANUEL,” which translated means, “GOD WITH US.” ▷ ①Or be pregnant ②Gr Emmanuel

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph awoke from his sleep and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took Mary as his wife,

column.name: text
column.value: ①but kept her a virgin until she gave birth to a Son; and he named Him Jesus. ▷ ①Lit and did not know her intimately

column.name: text
column.value: Now in those days John the Baptist * ①came, ②preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying, ▷ ①Or arrived; or appeared ②Or proclaiming as a herald

column.name: text
column.value: “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven ①is at hand.” ▷ ①Lit has come near

column.name: text
column.value: For this is the one referred to ①by Isaiah the prophet when he said, “THE VOICE OF ONE ②CALLING ③OUT IN THE WILDERNESS, ‘PREPARE THE WAY OF THE LORD, MAKE HIS PATHS STRAIGHT!’ ” ▷ ①Or through ②Or shouting ③Or out, Prepare in the wilderness the way

column.name: text
column.value: Now John himself had ①a garment of camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist; and his food was locusts and wild honey. ▷ ①Lit his garment

column.name: text
column.value: At that time Jerusalem was going out to him, and all Judea and all the region around the Jordan;

column.name: text
column.value: and they were being baptized by him in the Jordan River, as they confessed their sins.

column.name: text
column.value: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for ①baptism, he said to them, “You ②offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come? ▷ ①Later mss his baptism ②Or brood

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore produce fruit consistent with repentance;

column.name: text
column.value: and do not assume that you can say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father’; for I tell you that God is able, from these stones, to raise up children for Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: And the axe is already laid at the root of the trees; therefore, every tree that does not bear good fruit is being cut down and thrown into the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: “As for me, I baptize you ①with water for repentance, but He who is coming after me is mightier than I, and I am not fit to remove His sandals; He will baptize you ②with the Holy Spirit and fire. ▷ ①The Gr here can be translated in, with, or by ②The Gr here can be translated in, with, or by

column.name: text
column.value: His winnowing fork is in His hand, and He will thoroughly clear His threshing floor; and He will gather His wheat into the barn, but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus *arrived from Galilee at the Jordan, coming to John to be baptized by him.

column.name: text
column.value: But John tried to prevent Him, saying, “I have the need to be baptized by You, and yet You are coming to me?”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it at this time; for in this way it is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he *allowed Him.

column.name: text
column.value: After He was baptized, Jesus came up immediately from the water; and behold, the heavens were opened, and ①he saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove and ②settling on Him, ▷ ①Or He ②Lit coming upon Him

column.name: text
column.value: and behold, a voice from the heavens said, “This is ①My beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.” ▷ ①Or My Son, the Beloved

column.name: text
column.value: Now after Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king, behold, ①magi from the east arrived in Jerusalem, saying, ▷ ①A caste of educated men specializing in astronomy, astrology, and natural science

column.name: text
column.value: “Where is He who has been born King of the Jews? For we saw His star in the east and have come to worship Him.”

column.name: text
column.value: When Herod the king heard this, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he inquired of them where the ①Messiah was to be born. ▷ ①From Gr Christos, which means Messiah (Heb for Anointed One)

column.name: text
column.value: They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea; for this is what has been written ①by ②the prophet: ▷ ①Or through ②I.e., Micah

column.name: text
column.value: ‘AND YOU, BETHLEHEM, LAND OF JUDAH, ARE BY NO MEANS LEAST AMONG THE LEADERS OF JUDAH; FOR FROM YOU WILL COME FORTH A RULER WHO WILL SHEPHERD MY PEOPLE ISRAEL.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Herod secretly called for the magi and determined from them the exact ①time the star appeared. ▷ ①Lit time of the appearing star

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent them to Bethlehem and said, “Go and search carefully for the Child; and when you have found Him, report to me, so that I too may come and worship Him.”

column.name: text
column.value: After hearing the king, they went on their way; and behold, the star, which they had seen in the east, went on ahead of them until it came to a stop over the place where the Child was to be found.

column.name: text
column.value: When they saw the star, they rejoiced exceedingly with great joy.

column.name: text
column.value: And after they came into the house, they saw the Child with His mother Mary; and they fell down and ①worshiped Him. Then they opened their treasures and presented to Him gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh. ▷ ①Lit prostrated themselves to; i.e., lay face down in a prone position to indicate worship

column.name: text
column.value: And after being warned by God in a dream not to return to Herod, the magi left for their own country by another way.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when they had gone, behold, an angel of the Lord *appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, “Get up! Take the Child and His mother and flee to Egypt, and stay there until I tell you; for Herod is going to search for the Child to kill Him.”

column.name: text
column.value: So ①Joseph got up and took the Child and His mother while it was still night, and left for Egypt. ▷ ①Lit he

column.name: text
column.value: He ①stayed there until the death of Herod; this happened so that what had been spoken by the Lord through ②the prophet would be fulfilled: “OUT OF EGYPT I CALLED MY SON.” ▷ ①Lit was ②I.e., Hosea

column.name: text
column.value: Then when Herod saw that he had been tricked by the magi, he became very enraged, and sent men and killed all the boys who were in Bethlehem and all its vicinity ①who were two years old or under, according to the time which he had determined from the magi. ▷ ①Lit from two...and under

column.name: text
column.value: Then what had been spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled:

column.name: text
column.value: “A VOICE WAS HEARD IN RAMAH, WEEPING AND GREAT MOURNING, RACHEL WEEPING FOR HER CHILDREN; AND SHE REFUSED TO BE COMFORTED, BECAUSE THEY WERE NO MORE.”

column.name: text
column.value: But when Herod died, behold, an angel of the Lord *appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, and said,

column.name: text
column.value: “Get up, take the Child and His mother, and go to the land of Israel; for those who sought the Child’s life are dead.”

column.name: text
column.value: So ①Joseph got up, took the Child and His mother, and came into the land of Israel. ▷ ①Lit he

column.name: text
column.value: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. Then after being warned by God in a dream, he left for the regions of Galilee,

column.name: text
column.value: and came and settled in a city called Nazareth. This happened so that what was spoken through the prophets would be fulfilled: “He will be called a Nazarene.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

column.name: text
column.value: And after He had fasted for forty days and forty nights, He ①then became hungry. ▷ ①Or later became; or afterward became

column.name: text
column.value: And the tempter came and said to Him, “If You are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”

column.name: text
column.value: But He answered and said, “It is written: ‘MAN SHALL NOT LIVE ON BREAD ALONE, BUT ON EVERY WORD THAT COMES OUT OF THE MOUTH OF GOD.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the devil *took Him along into the holy city and had Him stand on the pinnacle of the temple,

column.name: text
column.value: and he *said to Him, “If You are the Son of God, throw Yourself down; for it is written: ‘HE WILL GIVE HIS ANGELS ORDERS CONCERNING YOU’; and ‘ON their hands they will lift YOU UP, SO THAT YOU DO NOT STRIKE YOUR FOOT AGAINST A STONE.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to him, “ ①On the other hand, it is written: ‘YOU SHALL NOT PUT THE LORD YOUR GOD TO THE TEST.’ ” ▷ ①Or Again

column.name: text
column.value: Again, the devil *took Him along to a very high mountain and *showed Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory;

column.name: text
column.value: and he said to Him, “All these things I will give You, if You fall down and ①worship me.” ▷ ①Lit prostrate Yourself to

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus *said to him, “Go away, Satan! For it is written: ‘YOU SHALL WORSHIP THE LORD YOUR GOD, AND ①SERVE HIM ONLY.’ ” ▷ ①Or fulfill religious duty to Him

column.name: text
column.value: Then the devil *left Him; and behold, angels came and began to serve Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Jesus heard that John had been taken into custody, He withdrew into Galilee;

column.name: text
column.value: and leaving Nazareth, He came and settled in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali.

column.name: text
column.value: This happened so that what was spoken through Isaiah the prophet would be fulfilled:

column.name: text
column.value: “THE LAND OF ZEBULUN AND THE LAND OF NAPHTALI, ①BY THE WAY OF THE SEA, ON THE OTHER SIDE OF THE JORDAN, GALILEE OF THE ②GENTILES— ▷ ①Or Toward the sea ②Lit nations, usually non-Jewish

column.name: text
column.value: THE PEOPLE WHO WERE SITTING IN DARKNESS SAW A GREAT LIGHT, AND THOSE WHO WERE SITTING IN THE LAND AND SHADOW OF DEATH, UPON THEM A LIGHT DAWNED.”

column.name: text
column.value: From that time Jesus began to ①preach and say, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven ②is at hand.” ▷ ①Or proclaim ②Lit has come near

column.name: text
column.value: Now as Jesus was walking by the Sea of Galilee, He saw two brothers, Simon, who was called Peter, and his brother Andrew, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

column.name: text
column.value: And He *said to them, “ ①Follow Me, and I will make you fishers of people.” ▷ ①Or Come after Me

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately they left their nets and followed Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Going on from there He saw two other brothers, ①James the son of Zebedee, and his brother ②John, in the boat with their father Zebedee, mending their nets; and He called them. ▷ ①Or Jacob ②Gr Joannes, for Heb Johanan

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately they left the boat and their father, and followed Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus was going about in all of Galilee, teaching in their synagogues and proclaiming the ①gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people. ▷ ①Or good news

column.name: text
column.value: And the news about Him spread throughout Syria; and they brought to Him all who were ill, those suffering with various diseases and severe pain, demon-possessed, people with epilepsy, and people who were paralyzed; and He healed them.

column.name: text
column.value: Large crowds followed Him from Galilee and the Decapolis, and Jerusalem, and Judea, and from beyond the Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Jesus saw the crowds, He went up on the ①mountain; and after He sat down, His disciples came to Him. ▷ ①Or hill

column.name: text
column.value: And He opened His mouth and began to teach them, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven. ▷ ①I.e., fortunate or prosperous, and so through v 11

column.name: text
column.value: “Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.

column.name: text
column.value: “Blessed are the ①gentle, for they will inherit the earth. ▷ ①Or humble, meek

column.name: text
column.value: “Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be satisfied.

column.name: text
column.value: “Blessed are the merciful, for they will receive mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: “Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.

column.name: text
column.value: “Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.

column.name: text
column.value: “Blessed are those who have been persecuted for the sake of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: “Blessed are you when people insult you and persecute you, and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of Me.

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice and be glad, for your reward in heaven is great; for in this same way they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

column.name: text
column.value: “You are the salt of the earth; but if the salt has become tasteless, how ①can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled underfoot by people. ▷ ①Lit will

column.name: text
column.value: “You are the light of the world. A city set on a ①hill cannot be hidden; ▷ ①Or mountain

column.name: text
column.value: nor do people light a lamp and put it under a ①basket, but on the lampstand, and it gives light to all who are in the house. ▷ ①Lit peck-measure

column.name: text
column.value: Your light must shine before people in such a way that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: “Do not presume that I came to abolish the Law or the Prophets; I did not come to abolish, but to fulfill.

column.name: text
column.value: For truly I say to you, until heaven and earth pass away, not ①the smallest letter or stroke of a letter shall pass from the Law, until all is accomplished! ▷ ①Lit one iota (Heb yodh) or one projection (serif)

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, whoever nullifies one of the least of these commandments, and teaches ①others to do the same, shall be called least in the kingdom of heaven; but whoever ②keeps and teaches them, he shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven. ▷ ①Lit people ②Lit does

column.name: text
column.value: “For I say to you that unless your righteousness far surpasses that of the scribes and Pharisees, you will not enter the kingdom of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: “You have heard that ①the ancients were told, ‘YOU SHALL NOT MURDER,’ and ‘Whoever commits murder shall be answerable to the court.’ ▷ ①Lit it was said to the ancients

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you that everyone who is angry with his brother shall be answerable to the court; and whoever says to his brother, ‘ ①You good-for-nothing,’ shall be answerable to ②the supreme court; and whoever says, ‘You fool,’ shall be guilty enough to go into the ③fiery hell. ▷ ①Or You empty-head; Gr Raka (Raca) from Aramaic reqa ②Lit the Sanhedrin; i.e., Jewish High Court ③Lit Gehenna of fire

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, if you are presenting your ①offering at the altar, and there you remember that your brother has something against you, ▷ ①Or gift

column.name: text
column.value: leave your ①offering there before the altar and go; first be reconciled to your brother, and then come and present your ②offering. ▷ ①Or gift ②Or gift

column.name: text
column.value: ①Come to good terms with your accuser quickly, while you are with him on the way to court, so that your accuser will not hand you over to the judge, and the judge to the officer, and you will not be thrown into prison. ▷ ①I.e., settle the case

column.name: text
column.value: Truly I say to you, you will not come out of there until you have paid up the last ①quadrans. ▷ ①A small Roman copper coin, worth about 1/64 of a laborer’s daily wage

column.name: text
column.value: “You have heard that it was said, ‘YOU SHALL NOT COMMIT ADULTERY’;

column.name: text
column.value: but I say to you that everyone who looks at a woman with lust for her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Now if your right eye is causing you to sin, tear it out and throw it away from you; for it is better for you to lose one of the parts of your body, ①than for your whole body to be thrown into ②hell. ▷ ①Lit and that your whole body not be ②Gr Gehenna

column.name: text
column.value: And if your right hand is causing you to sin, cut it off and throw it away from you; for it is better for you ①to lose one of the parts of your body, ②than for your whole body to go into ③hell. ▷ ①Lit that one...be lost ②Lit and not your whole body ③Gr Gehenna

column.name: text
column.value: “Now it was said, ‘WHOEVER SENDS HIS WIFE AWAY IS TO GIVE HER A CERTIFICATE OF DIVORCE’;

column.name: text
column.value: but I say to you that everyone who ①divorces his wife, except for the reason of sexual immorality, makes her commit adultery; and whoever marries a ②divorced woman commits adultery. ▷ ①Lit sends away, the Heb term for divorce ②Lit woman sent away

column.name: text
column.value: “Again, you have heard that ①the ancients were told, ‘ ②YOU SHALL NOT ③MAKE FALSE VOWS, BUT SHALL FULFILL YOUR ④VOWS TO THE LORD.’ ▷ ①Lit it was said to the ancients ②you and your are singular here ③Or break your vows ④Lit oaths

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you, take no oath at all, neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God,

column.name: text
column.value: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of His feet, nor ①by Jerusalem, for it is THE CITY OF THE GREAT KING. ▷ ①Or toward

column.name: text
column.value: Nor shall you take an oath by your head, for you cannot make a single hair white or black.

column.name: text
column.value: But make sure your statement is, ‘ ①Yes, yes’ or ‘No, no’; anything beyond these is ②of evil origin. ▷ ①I.e., a clear “yes” or “no” ②Or from the evil one

column.name: text
column.value: “You have heard that it was said, ‘EYE FOR EYE, and TOOTH FOR TOOTH.’

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you, do not show opposition against an evil person; but whoever slaps you on your right cheek, turn the other toward him also.

column.name: text
column.value: And if anyone wants to sue you and take your ①tunic, let him have your ②cloak also. ▷ ①A long shirt worn next to the skin ②Or outer garment

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever ①forces you to go one mile, go with him two. ▷ ①Lit will force

column.name: text
column.value: Give to him who asks of you, and do not turn away from him who wants to borrow from you.

column.name: text
column.value: “You have heard that it was said, ‘YOU SHALL LOVE YOUR NEIGHBOR and hate your enemy.’

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,

column.name: text
column.value: so that you may prove yourselves to be sons of your Father who is in heaven; for He causes His sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.

column.name: text
column.value: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Even the tax collectors, do they not do the same?

column.name: text
column.value: And if you greet only your brothers and sisters, what more are you doing than others? Even the Gentiles, do they not do the same?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore you shall be perfect, as your heavenly Father is perfect.

column.name: text
column.value: “Take care not to practice your righteousness in the sight of people, to be noticed by them; otherwise you have no reward with your Father who is in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: “So when you ①give to the poor, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, so that they will be praised by people. Truly I say to you, they have their reward in full. ▷ ①Lit make a charitable gift

column.name: text
column.value: But when you ①give to the poor, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing, ▷ ①Lit make a charitable gift

column.name: text
column.value: so that your charitable giving will be in secret; and your Father who sees what is done in secret will reward you.

column.name: text
column.value: “And when you pray, you are not to be like the hypocrites; for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and on the street corners so that they ①will be seen by people. Truly I say to you, they have their reward in full. ▷ ①Lit may show themselves to

column.name: text
column.value: But as for you, when you pray, go into your inner room, close your door, and pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees what is done in secret will reward you.

column.name: text
column.value: “And when you are praying, do not use thoughtless repetition as the Gentiles do, for they think that they will be heard because of their many words.

column.name: text
column.value: So do not be like them; for your Father knows what you need before you ask Him.

column.name: text
column.value: “Pray, then, in this way: ‘Our Father, who is in heaven, ①Hallowed be Your name. ▷ ①I.e., treated as sacred or holy

column.name: text
column.value: ①Your kingdom come. Your will be done, ②On earth as it is in heaven. ▷ ①Or May Your...come ②Lit as in heaven, also on earth

column.name: text
column.value: Give us this day ①our daily bread. ▷ ①Or our bread for tomorrow

column.name: text
column.value: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.

column.name: text
column.value: And do not lead us into temptation, but deliver us from ①evil. ②’ ▷ ①Or the evil one ②Late mss add For Yours is the kingdom and the power and the glory forever. Amen

column.name: text
column.value: For if you forgive other people for their ①offenses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you. ▷ ①Or wrongdoings

column.name: text
column.value: But if you do not forgive other people, then your Father will not forgive your ①offenses. ▷ ①Or wrongdoings

column.name: text
column.value: “Now whenever you fast, do not make a gloomy face as the hypocrites do, for they ①distort their faces so that they will be noticed by people when they are fasting. Truly I say to you, they have their reward in full. ▷ ①I.e., leave unwashed, or discolor their faces with makeup

column.name: text
column.value: But as for you, when you fast, ①anoint your head and wash your face, ▷ ①I.e., rub oil in the hair

column.name: text
column.value: so that your fasting will not be noticed by people but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees what is done in secret will reward you.

column.name: text
column.value: “Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy, and where thieves break in and steal.

column.name: text
column.value: But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys, and where thieves do not break in or steal;

column.name: text
column.value: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

column.name: text
column.value: “The eye is the lamp of the body; so then, if your eye is ①clear, your whole body will be full of light. ▷ ①Or healthy; or sincere

column.name: text
column.value: But if your eye is ①bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. So if the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness! ▷ ①Or evil

column.name: text
column.value: “No one can serve two masters; for either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and ①wealth. ▷ ①Gr mamonas, for Aramaic mamon (mammon); i.e., wealth etc. personified as an object of worship

column.name: text
column.value: “For this reason I say to you, ①do not be worried about your ②life, as to what you will eat or what you will drink; nor for your body, as to what you will put on. Is life not more than food, and the body more than clothing? ▷ ①Or stop being worried ②Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: Look at the birds of the sky, that they do not sow, nor reap, nor gather crops into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more important than they?

column.name: text
column.value: And which of you by worrying can add a single ①day to his ②life’s span? ▷ ①Lit cubit (about 18 in. or 45 cm) ②Or height

column.name: text
column.value: And why are you worried about clothing? Notice how the lilies of the field grow; they do not labor nor do they spin thread for cloth,

column.name: text
column.value: yet I say to you that not even Solomon in all his glory clothed himself like one of these.

column.name: text
column.value: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which is alive today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you? You of little faith!

column.name: text
column.value: Do not worry then, saying, ‘What are we to eat?’ or ‘What are we to drink?’ or ‘What are we to wear for clothing?’

column.name: text
column.value: For the Gentiles eagerly seek all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.

column.name: text
column.value: But ①seek first ②His kingdom and His righteousness, and all these things will be ③provided to you. ▷ ①Or continually seek ②Or the kingdom ③Or added

column.name: text
column.value: “So do not worry about tomorrow; for tomorrow will ①worry about itself. ②Each day has enough trouble of its own. ▷ ①Or look after itself ②Lit Sufficient for the day is its evil

column.name: text
column.value: When ①Jesus came down from the mountain, ②large crowds followed Him. ▷ ①Lit He ②Or many

column.name: text
column.value: And a man with ①leprosy came to Him and ②bowed down before Him, and said, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.” ▷ ①I.e., leprosy or a serious, unspecified skin disease, and so throughout the ch; see Lev 13 ②Or worshiped Him

column.name: text
column.value: ①Jesus reached out with His hand and touched him, saying, “I am willing; be cleansed.” And immediately his leprosy was cleansed. ▷ ①Lit And He

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus *said to him, “See that you tell no one; but go, show yourself to the priest and present the ①offering that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.” ▷ ①Lit gift

column.name: text
column.value: And when ①Jesus entered Capernaum, a ②centurion came to Him, begging Him, ▷ ①Lit He ②I.e., a Roman military officer

column.name: text
column.value: and saying, “ ①Lord, my ②servant is lying paralyzed at home, terribly tormented.” ▷ ①Or Sir ②Lit boy

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *said to him, “I will come and heal him.”

column.name: text
column.value: But the centurion replied, “ ①Lord, I am not worthy for You to come under my roof, but just ②say the word, and my ③servant will be healed. ▷ ①Or Sir ②Lit say with a word ③Lit boy

column.name: text
column.value: For I also am a man under authority, with soldiers under me; and I say to this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes, and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes, and to my slave, ‘Do this!’ and he does it.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Jesus heard this, He was amazed and said to those who were following, “Truly I say to you, I have not found such great faith ①with anyone in Israel. ▷ ①One early ms not even in Israel

column.name: text
column.value: And I say to you that many will come from east and west, and ①recline at the table with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven; ▷ ①I.e., to dine

column.name: text
column.value: but the sons of the kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness; in that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to the centurion, “Go; ①it shall be done for you as you have believed.” And the ②servant was healed at that very ③moment. ▷ ①Or it is to be done; Gr imperative, i.e., a command ②Lit boy ③Lit hour

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus came into Peter’s ①home, He saw his mother-in-law lying sick in bed with a fever. ▷ ①Or house

column.name: text
column.value: And He touched her hand, and the fever left her; and she got up and ①waited on Him. ▷ ①Or served

column.name: text
column.value: Now when evening came, they brought to Him many who were demon-possessed; and He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were ill.

column.name: text
column.value: This happened so that what was spoken through Isaiah the prophet would be fulfilled: “HE HIMSELF TOOK OUR ILLNESSES AND ①CARRIED AWAY OUR DISEASES.” ▷ ①Or removed

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Jesus saw a crowd around Him, He gave orders to depart to the other side of the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: Then a scribe came and said to Him, “Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus *said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay His head.”

column.name: text
column.value: And another of the disciples said to Him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus *said to him, “Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead.”

column.name: text
column.value: When He got into the boat, His disciples followed Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, a ①violent storm developed on the sea, so that the boat was being covered by the waves; but Jesus Himself was asleep. ▷ ①Lit great

column.name: text
column.value: And they came to Him and woke Him, saying, “Save us, Lord; we are perishing!”

column.name: text
column.value: He *said to them, “Why are you ①afraid, you men of little faith?” Then He got up and rebuked the winds and the sea, and ②it became perfectly calm. ▷ ①Or cowardly ②Lit a great calm occurred

column.name: text
column.value: The men were amazed, and said, “What kind of a man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey Him?”

column.name: text
column.value: And when He came to the other side into the country of the Gadarenes, two demon-possessed men confronted Him as they were coming out of the tombs. They were so extremely violent that no one could pass by that way.

column.name: text
column.value: And they cried out, saying, “ ①What business do You have with us, Son of God? Have You come here to torment us before ②the time?” ▷ ①Lit What to us and to you (an ancient idiom) ②I.e., the appointed time of judgment

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding at a distance from them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the demons begged Him, saying, “If You are going to cast us out, send us into the herd of pigs.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “Go!” And they came out and went into the pigs; and behold, the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and ①drowned in the waters. ▷ ①Lit died

column.name: text
column.value: And the herdsmen ran away, and went to the city and reported everything, ①including what had happened to the demon-possessed men. ▷ ①Lit and the things of

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus; and when they saw Him, they pleaded with Him to leave their region.

column.name: text
column.value: “Do not ①judge, so that you will not be judged. ▷ ①I.e., make a habit of judging or have a judgmental attitude

column.name: text
column.value: For in the way you judge, you will be judged; and ①by your standard of measure, it will be measured to you. ▷ ①Lit by which measure you measure

column.name: text
column.value: Why do you look at the ①speck that is in your brother’s eye, but do not notice the log that is in your own eye? ▷ ①Or splinter

column.name: text
column.value: Or how ①can you say to your brother, ‘Let me take the ②speck out of your eye,’ and look, the log is in your own eye? ▷ ①Lit will ②Or splinter

column.name: text
column.value: You hypocrite, first take the log out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to take the ①speck out of your brother’s eye! ▷ ①Or splinter

column.name: text
column.value: “Do not give what is holy to dogs, and do not throw your pearls before pigs, or they will trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①Ask, and it will be given to you; ②seek, and you will find; ③knock, and it will be opened to you. ▷ ①Or Keep asking ②Or keep seeking ③Or keep knocking

column.name: text
column.value: For everyone who asks receives, and the one who seeks finds, and to the one who knocks it will be opened.

column.name: text
column.value: Or what person is there among you ①who, when his son asks for a loaf of bread, ②will give him a stone? ▷ ①Lit whom his son will ask ②Lit he will not give him a stone, will he?

column.name: text
column.value: Or ①if he asks for a fish, he will not give him a snake, will he? ▷ ①Lit also will ask

column.name: text
column.value: So if you, despite being ①evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask Him! ▷ ①I.e., as sinful mankind

column.name: text
column.value: “In everything, therefore, ①treat people the same way you want ②them to treat you, for this is the Law and the Prophets. ▷ ①Lit you, too, do so for them ②Lit people

column.name: text
column.value: “Enter through the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter through it.

column.name: text
column.value: For the gate is narrow and the way is constricted that leads to life, and there are few who find it.

column.name: text
column.value: “Beware of the false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravenous wolves.

column.name: text
column.value: You will ①know them by their fruits. ②Grapes are not gathered from thorn bushes, nor figs from thistles, are they? ▷ ①Or recognize ②Lit They do not gather

column.name: text
column.value: So every good tree bears good fruit, but the bad tree bears bad fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, nor can a bad tree bear good fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: So then, you will ①know them by their fruits. ▷ ①Or recognize

column.name: text
column.value: “Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but the one who does the will of My Father who is in heaven will enter.

column.name: text
column.value: Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and in Your name cast out demons, and in Your name perform many ①miracles?’ ▷ ①Or works of power

column.name: text
column.value: And then I will declare to them, ‘I never knew you; LEAVE ME, YOU WHO PRACTICE LAWLESSNESS.’

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore, everyone who hears these words of Mine, and ①acts on them, will be like a wise man who built his house on the rock. ▷ ①Lit does them

column.name: text
column.value: And the rain fell and the ①floods came, and the winds blew and slammed against that house; and yet it did not fall, for it had been founded on the rock. ▷ ①Lit rivers

column.name: text
column.value: And everyone who hears these words of Mine, and does not ①act on them, will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand. ▷ ①Lit do them

column.name: text
column.value: And the rain fell and the ①floods came, and the winds blew and slammed against that house; and it fell—and its collapse was great.” ▷ ①Lit rivers

column.name: text
column.value: ①When Jesus had finished these words, the crowds were amazed at His teaching; ▷ ①Lit And it happened when

column.name: text
column.value: for He was teaching them as one who had authority, and not as their scribes.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus summoned His twelve disciples and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these: The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and his brother Andrew; and ①James the son of Zebedee, and his brother ②John; ▷ ①Or Jacob ②Gr Joannes, for Heb Johanan

column.name: text
column.value: Philip and ①Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; ②James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus; ▷ ①I.e., son of Talmai (Aram) ②Or Jacob

column.name: text
column.value: Simon the ①Zealot, and Judas Iscariot, the one who also betrayed Him. ▷ ①Or Cananaean

column.name: text
column.value: These twelve Jesus sent out after instructing them, saying, “Do not go on a road ①to Gentiles, and do not enter a city of Samaritans; ▷ ①Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: but rather go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And as you go, ①preach, saying, ‘The kingdom of heaven ②has come near.’ ▷ ①Or proclaim ②Or is at hand

column.name: text
column.value: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse those with leprosy, cast out demons. Freely you received, freely give.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not acquire gold, or silver, or copper for your money belts,

column.name: text
column.value: or a ①bag for your journey, or even two ②tunics, or sandals, or a staff; for the worker is deserving of his ③support. ▷ ①Or knapsack; or beggar’s bag ②A long shirt worn next to the skin ③Lit nourishment

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever city or village you enter, inquire who is worthy in it, and stay ①at his house until you leave that city. ▷ ①Lit there until

column.name: text
column.value: As you enter the ①house, give it your ②greeting. ▷ ①Or household ②I.e., the familiar Heb blessing, “Peace be to this house!”

column.name: text
column.value: If the house is worthy, see that your blessing of peace comes upon it. But if it is not worthy, ①take back your blessing of peace. ▷ ①Lit your peace is to return to you

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever does not receive you nor listen to your words, as you leave that house or city, shake the dust off your feet.

column.name: text
column.value: Truly I say to you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of judgment, than for that city.

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, I am sending you out as sheep in the midst of wolves; so be as wary as serpents, and as innocent as doves.

column.name: text
column.value: But be on guard against people, for they will hand you over to the courts and flog you in their synagogues;

column.name: text
column.value: and you will even be brought before governors and kings on My account, as a testimony to them and to the Gentiles.

column.name: text
column.value: But when they hand you over, do not worry about how or what you are to say; for what you are to say will be given you in that hour.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is not you who are speaking, but it is the Spirit of your Father who is speaking ①in you. ▷ ①Or by you

column.name: text
column.value: “Now brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child; and children will rise up against parents and ①cause them to be put to death. ▷ ①Lit put them to death

column.name: text
column.value: And you will be hated by all because of My name, but it is the one who has endured to the end who will be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: “But whenever they persecute you in ①one city, flee to the ②next; for truly I say to you, you will not finish going through the cities of Israel until the Son of Man comes. ▷ ①Lit this ②Lit other

column.name: text
column.value: “A ①disciple is not above his teacher, nor a slave above his master. ▷ ①Or student

column.name: text
column.value: It is enough for the disciple that he may become like his teacher, and the slave like his master. If they have called the head of the house ①Beelzebul, how much more will they insult the members of his household! ▷ ①Two early mss Beezebul; meaning uncertain, perhaps lord prince, referring to Satan

column.name: text
column.value: “So do not fear them, for there is nothing concealed that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.

column.name: text
column.value: What I tell you in the darkness, tell in the light; and what you hear whispered in your ear, proclaim on the housetops.

column.name: text
column.value: And do not be afraid of those who kill the body but are unable to kill the soul; but rather fear Him who is able to destroy both soul and body in ①hell. ▷ ①Gr Gehenna

column.name: text
column.value: Are two sparrows not sold for an ①assarion? And yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from your Father. ▷ ①A Roman copper coin, worth about 1/16 of a laborer’s daily wage

column.name: text
column.value: But even the hairs of your head are all counted.

column.name: text
column.value: So do not fear; you are more valuable than a great number of sparrows.

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore, everyone who ①confesses Me before people, I will also confess ②him before My Father who is in heaven. ▷ ①Lit will confess in Me ②Lit in him

column.name: text
column.value: But whoever denies Me before people, I will also deny him before My Father who is in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: “Do not think that I came to ①bring peace on the earth; I did not come to ②bring peace, but a sword. ▷ ①Lit cast ②Lit cast

column.name: text
column.value: For I came to TURN A MAN AGAINST HIS FATHER, AND A DAUGHTER AGAINST HER MOTHER, AND A DAUGHTER-IN-LAW AGAINST HER MOTHER-IN-LAW;

column.name: text
column.value: and A PERSON’S ENEMIES will be the members of his household.

column.name: text
column.value: “The one who loves father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me; and the one who loves son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me.

column.name: text
column.value: And the one who does not take his cross and follow after Me is not worthy of Me.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who has found his ①life will lose it, and the one who has lost his ②life on My account will find it. ▷ ①Or soul ②Or soul

column.name: text
column.value: “The one who ①receives you ②receives Me, and the one who ③receives Me ④receives Him who sent Me. ▷ ①Or welcomes ②Or welcomes ③Or welcomes ④Or welcomes

column.name: text
column.value: The one who ①receives a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet’s reward; and the one who ②receives a righteous person in the name of a righteous person shall receive a righteous person’s reward. ▷ ①Or welcomes ②Or welcomes

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever gives one of these ①little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, truly I say to you, he shall by no means lose his reward.” ▷ ①Possibly someone of low social standing

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus had finished ①giving instructions to His twelve disciples, He went on from there to teach and ②preach in their cities. ▷ ①Or commanding ②Or proclaim

column.name: text
column.value: Now while in prison, John heard about the works of Christ, and he sent word by his disciples,

column.name: text
column.value: and said to Him, “Are You the Coming One, or are we to ①look for someone else?” ▷ ①Or wait for

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to them, “Go and report to John what you hear and see:

column.name: text
column.value: those who are BLIND RECEIVE SIGHT and those who limp walk, those with leprosy are cleansed and those who are deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the POOR HAVE THE ①GOSPEL PREACHED TO THEM. ▷ ①Or good news

column.name: text
column.value: And blessed is ①any person who does not ②take offense at Me.” ▷ ①Lit whoever ②Or stumble over Me

column.name: text
column.value: As these disciples of John were going away, Jesus began speaking to the crowds about John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

column.name: text
column.value: ①But what did you go out to see? A man dressed in soft clothing? Those who wear soft clothing are in kings’ ②palaces! ▷ ①Or Well then, ②Lit houses

column.name: text
column.value: ①But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and one who is more than a prophet. ▷ ①Or Well then,

column.name: text
column.value: This is the one about whom it ①is written: ‘BEHOLD, I AM SENDING MY MESSENGER ②AHEAD OF YOU, WHO WILL PREPARE YOUR WAY BEFORE YOU.’ ▷ ①Lit has been written ②Lit before Your face

column.name: text
column.value: Truly I say to you, among those born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptist! Yet the one who is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

column.name: text
column.value: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven has been treated violently, and violent men take it by force.

column.name: text
column.value: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.

column.name: text
column.value: And if you are willing to accept it, John himself is Elijah who ①was to come. ▷ ①Or is going to come

column.name: text
column.value: The one who has ears to hear, ①let him hear. ▷ ①Or hear! Or listen!

column.name: text
column.value: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call out to the other children,

column.name: text
column.value: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a song of mourning, and you did not ①mourn.’ ▷ ①Lit beat the breast

column.name: text
column.value: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon!’

column.name: text
column.value: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a ①heavy drinker, a friend of tax collectors and ②sinners!’ And yet wisdom is vindicated by her deeds.” ▷ ①Or wine drinker ②I.e., irreligious Jews

column.name: text
column.value: Then He began to reprimand the cities in which most of His ①miracles were done, because they did not repent. ▷ ①Or works of power

column.name: text
column.value: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the ①miracles that occurred in you had occurred in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in ②sackcloth and ashes. ▷ ①Or works of power ②I.e., symbols of mourning

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless I say to you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

column.name: text
column.value: And you, Capernaum, will not be exalted to heaven, will you? You will be brought down to Hades! For if the ①miracles that occurred in you had occurred in Sodom, it would have remained to this day. ▷ ①Or works of power

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless I say to you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment, than for you.”

column.name: text
column.value: ①At that time Jesus said, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that You have hidden these things from the wise and intelligent, and have revealed them to infants. ▷ ①Or On that occasion

column.name: text
column.value: Yes, Father, for this way was well pleasing in Your sight.

column.name: text
column.value: All things have been handed over to Me by My Father; and no one knows the Son except the Father; nor does anyone know the Father except the Son, and anyone to whom the Son determines to reveal Him.

column.name: text
column.value: “Come to Me, all ①who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. ▷ ①Or who work to exhaustion

column.name: text
column.value: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and YOU WILL FIND ①REST FOR YOUR SOULS. ▷ ①Or a resting place

column.name: text
column.value: For My yoke is comfortable, and My burden is light.”

column.name: text
column.value: Getting into a boat, Jesus crossed over the Sea of Galilee and came to His own city.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought to Him a paralyzed man lying on a stretcher. And seeing their faith, Jesus said to the man who was paralyzed, “Take courage, ①son; your sins are forgiven.” ▷ ①Lit child

column.name: text
column.value: And some of the scribes said ①to themselves, “This man is blaspheming!” ▷ ①Lit among

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, said, “Why are you thinking evil in your hearts?

column.name: text
column.value: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?

column.name: text
column.value: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—then He *said to the paralyzed man, “Get up, pick up your stretcher and go home.”

column.name: text
column.value: And he got up and ①went home. ▷ ①Lit departed to his home

column.name: text
column.value: But when the crowds saw this, they were ①awestruck, and they glorified God, who had given such authority to men. ▷ ①Lit afraid

column.name: text
column.value: As Jesus went on from there, He saw a man called Matthew sitting in the tax collector’s office; and He *said to him, “Follow Me!” And he got up and followed Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then it happened that as ①Jesus was reclining at the table in the house, behold, many tax collectors and ②sinners came and began dining with Jesus and His disciples. ▷ ①Lit He ②I.e., irreligious Jews

column.name: text
column.value: And when the Pharisees saw this, they said to His disciples, “Why is your Teacher eating with the tax collectors and sinners?”

column.name: text
column.value: But when Jesus heard this, He said, “It is not those who are healthy who need a physician, but those who are sick.

column.name: text
column.value: Now go and learn ①what this means: ‘I DESIRE ②COMPASSION, ③RATHER THAN SACRIFICE,’ for I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners.” ▷ ①Lit what is ②Or mercy ③Lit and not

column.name: text
column.value: Then the disciples of John *came to Him, asking, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast, but Your disciples do not fast?”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to them, “The ①attendants of the groom cannot mourn as long as the groom is with them, can they? But the days will come when the groom is taken away from them, and then they will fast. ▷ ①Lit sons of the wedding place

column.name: text
column.value: But no one puts a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for ①the patch pulls away from the garment, and a worse tear results. ▷ ①Lit that which fills up

column.name: text
column.value: Nor do people put new wine into old wineskins; otherwise the wineskins burst, and the wine pours out and the wineskins are ruined; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”

column.name: text
column.value: While He was saying these things to them, behold, ①a synagogue ②official came and ③bowed down before Him, and said, “My daughter has just died; but come and lay Your hand on her, and she will become alive again.” ▷ ①Or one ②Lit ruler ③Or worshiped

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus got up from the table and began to accompany him, along with His disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, a woman who had been suffering from a hemorrhage for twelve years came up behind Him, and touched the ①border of His ②cloak; ▷ ①Or tassel; i.e., a ritual tassel sewn to corners of garments for Jewish men ②Or outer garment

column.name: text
column.value: for she was ①saying ②to herself, “If I only touch His cloak, I will ③get well.” ▷ ①Or thinking ②Lit in herself ③Lit be saved

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus, turning and seeing her, said, “Daughter, take courage; your faith has ①made you well.” And ②at once the woman was ③made well. ▷ ①Lit saved you ②Lit from that hour ③Lit saved

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus came into the ①official’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder, ▷ ①Lit ruler’s

column.name: text
column.value: He said, “Leave; for the girl has not died, but is asleep.” And they began laughing at Him.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the crowd had been sent out, He entered and took her by the hand, and the girl ①got up. ▷ ①Or was raised up

column.name: text
column.value: And this news spread throughout that land.

column.name: text
column.value: As Jesus went on from there, two men who were blind followed Him, crying out, “Have mercy on us, Son of David!”

column.name: text
column.value: And after He entered the house, the men who were blind came up to Him, and Jesus *said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They *said to Him, “Yes, Lord.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then He touched their eyes, saying, “ ①It shall be done for you according to your faith.” ▷ ①Or it is to be done; Gr imperative, i.e., a command

column.name: text
column.value: And their eyes were opened. And Jesus sternly warned them, saying, “See that no one knows about this!”

column.name: text
column.value: But they went out and spread the news about Him throughout that land.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they were going out, behold, a demon-possessed man who was unable to speak ①was brought to Him. ▷ ①Lit they brought

column.name: text
column.value: And after the demon was cast out, the man who was previously unable to speak talked; and the crowds were amazed, and were saying, “Nothing like this has ever ①been seen in Israel.” ▷ ①Lit appeared

column.name: text
column.value: But the Pharisees were saying, “He casts out the demons by the ruler of the demons.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus was going through all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues and proclaiming the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness.

column.name: text
column.value: Seeing the crowds, He felt compassion for them, because they were ①distressed and downcast, like sheep ②without a shepherd. ▷ ①Or weary ②Lit not having

column.name: text
column.value: Then He *said to His disciples, “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, plead with the Lord of the harvest to send out workers into His harvest.”

column.name: text
column.value: ①At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath, and His disciples became hungry and began to pick the heads of grain and eat. ▷ ①Or On that occasion

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the Pharisees saw this, they said to Him, “Look, Your disciples are doing what is not lawful to do on a Sabbath!”

column.name: text
column.value: But He said to them, “Have you not read what David did when he became hungry, he and his companions—

column.name: text
column.value: how he entered the house of God, and they ate the ①consecrated bread, which was not lawful for him to eat nor for those with him, but for the priests alone? ▷ ①Lit loaves of presentation

column.name: text
column.value: Or have you not read in the Law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple ①violate the Sabbath, and yet are innocent? ▷ ①Or profane

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you that something greater than the temple is here.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you had known what this ①means: ‘I DESIRE ②COMPASSION, ③RATHER THAN SACRIFICE,’ you would not have condemned ④the innocent. ▷ ①Lit is ②Or mercy ③Lit and not ④Plural in the Gr

column.name: text
column.value: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

column.name: text
column.value: Departing from there, He went into their synagogue.

column.name: text
