column.value: And a man was there whose hand was withered. And they questioned ①Jesus, asking, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”—so that they might bring charges against Him. ▷ ①Lit Him

column.name: text
column.value: But He said to them, “What man ①is there among you who ②has a sheep, and if it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will he not take hold of it and lift it out? ▷ ①Lit will be from you ②Lit will have

column.name: text
column.value: How much more valuable then is a person than a sheep! So then, it is lawful to do ①good on the Sabbath.” ▷ ①Lit well

column.name: text
column.value: Then He *said to the man, “Stretch out your hand!” He stretched it out, and it was restored to ①normal, like the other. ▷ ①Lit health

column.name: text
column.value: But the Pharisees went out and ①conspired against Him, as to how they might destroy Him. ▷ ①Lit took counsel

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus, ①aware of this, withdrew from there. Many followed Him, and He healed them all, ▷ ①Lit knowing

column.name: text
column.value: and warned them not to ①tell who He was. ▷ ①Lit make Him known

column.name: text
column.value: This happened so that what was spoken through Isaiah the prophet would be fulfilled:

column.name: text
text
column.value: HE WILL NOT QUARREL, NOR CRY OUT; NOR WILL ANYONE HEAR HIS VOICE IN THE STREETS.

column.name: text
column.value: A BENT REED HE WILL NOT BREAK off, AND A DIMLY BURNING WICK HE WILL NOT EXTINGUISH, UNTIL HE ①LEADS ②JUSTICE TO VICTORY. ▷ ①Or brings forth ②Or judgment

column.name: text
column.value: AND IN HIS NAME THE ①GENTILES WILL HOPE.” ▷ ①Or nations

column.name: text
column.value: Then a demon-possessed man who was blind and unable to speak was brought to ①Jesus, and He healed him so that the man who was unable to speak talked and ②could see. ▷ ①Lit Him ②Lit saw

column.name: text
column.value: And all the crowds were amazed and were saying, “This man cannot be the Son of David, can he?”

column.name: text
column.value: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, “This man casts out demons only by ①Beelzebul the ruler of the demons.” ▷ ①Or Beezebul; meaning uncertain, perhaps lord prince, referring to Satan

column.name: text
column.value: And knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is laid waste; and no city or house divided against itself will stand.

column.name: text
column.value: And if Satan is casting out Satan, he ①has become divided against himself; how then will his kingdom stand? ▷ ①Lit was

column.name: text
column.value: And if by ①Beelzebul I cast out the demons, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore, they will be your judges. ▷ ①See note v 24

column.name: text
column.value: But if I cast out the demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.

column.name: text
column.value: Or, how can anyone enter the strong man’s house and carry off his property, unless he first ties up the strong man? And then he will plunder his house.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who is not with Me is against Me; and the one who does not gather with Me scatters.

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore I say to you, every sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven people, but blasphemy against the Spirit shall not be forgiven.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it shall be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it shall not be forgiven him, either in this age or in the age to come.

column.name: text
column.value: “Either ①assume the tree to be good as well as its fruit good, or ②assume the tree to be bad as well as its fruit bad; for the tree is known by its fruit. ▷ ①Lit make ②Lit make

column.name: text
column.value: You ①offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, express any good things? For the mouth speaks from that which fills the heart. ▷ ①Or brood

column.name: text
column.value: The good person brings out of his good treasure good things; and the evil person brings out of his evil treasure evil things.

column.name: text
column.value: But I tell you that for every ①careless word that people ②speak, they will give an account of it on the day of judgment. ▷ ①Or useless ②Lit will speak

column.name: text
column.value: For ①by your words you will be justified, and ②by your words you will be condemned.” ▷ ①Or in accordance with ②Or in accordance with

column.name: text
column.value: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees said to Him, “Teacher, we want to see a ①sign from You.” ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracle

column.name: text
column.value: But He answered and said to them, “An evil and adulterous generation craves a ①sign; and so no ②sign will be given to it except the ③sign of Jonah the prophet; ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracle ②I.e., confirming miracle ③I.e., confirming miracle

column.name: text
column.value: for just as JONAH WAS IN THE STOMACH OF THE SEA MONSTER FOR THREE DAYS AND THREE NIGHTS, so will the Son of Man be in the heart of the earth for three days and three nights.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Nineveh will stand up with this generation at the judgment, and will condemn it because they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, something greater than Jonah is here.

column.name: text
column.value: The Queen of the South will rise up with this generation at the judgment and will condemn it, because she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, something greater than Solomon is here.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now when the unclean spirit comes out of a person, it passes through waterless places seeking rest, and does not find it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then it says, ‘I will return to my house from which I came’; and when it comes, it finds it unoccupied, swept, and put in order.

column.name: text
column.value: Then it goes and brings along with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they come in and live there; and the last condition of that person becomes worse than the first. That is the way it will also be with this evil generation.”

column.name: text
column.value: While He was still speaking to the crowds, behold, His mother and brothers were standing outside, seeking to speak to Him.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Someone said to Him, “Look, Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside, seeking to speak to You.”] ▷ ①This verse is not found in early mss

column.name: text
column.value: But ①Jesus replied to the one who was telling Him and said, “Who is My mother, and who are My brothers?” ▷ ①Lit He

column.name: text
column.value: And extending His hand toward His disciples, He said, “Behold: My mother and My brothers!

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever does the will of My Father who is in heaven, he is My brother, and sister, and mother.”

column.name: text
column.value: ①At that time ②Herod ③the tetrarch heard the news about Jesus, ▷ ①Or On that occasion ②I.e., Herod Antipas ③I.e., a regional ruler

column.name: text
column.value: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptist; he himself has been raised from the dead, and that is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”

column.name: text
column.value: For when Herod had John arrested, he bound him and put him in prison because of Herodias, the wife of his brother Philip.

column.name: text
column.value: For John had been saying to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

column.name: text
column.value: Although Herod wanted to put him to death, he feared the crowd, because they regarded ①John as a prophet. ▷ ①Lit him

column.name: text
column.value: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced ①before them and pleased Herod, ▷ ①Lit in the midst

column.name: text
column.value: so much that he promised with an oath to give her whatever she asked.

column.name: text
column.value: And after being prompted by her mother, she *said, “Give me the head of John the Baptist here on a platter.”

column.name: text
column.value: And although he was grieved, the king commanded it to be given because of his oaths and ①his dinner guests. ▷ ①Lit those who reclined at the table with him

column.name: text
column.value: He sent word and had John beheaded in the prison.

column.name: text
column.value: And his head was brought on a platter and given to the girl, and she brought it to her mother.

column.name: text
column.value: ①John’s disciples came and took away the body and buried ②it; and they went and reported to Jesus. ▷ ①Lit his ②Lit him

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Jesus heard about John, He withdrew from there in a boat to a secluded place by Himself; and when the ①people heard about this, they followed Him on foot from the cities. ▷ ①Lit the crowds

column.name: text
column.value: When He came ①ashore, He saw a large crowd, and felt compassion for them and healed their sick. ▷ ①Lit out

column.name: text
column.value: Now when it was evening, the disciples came to Him and said, “This place is secluded and the hour is already past to eat; send the crowds away, so that they may go into the villages and buy food for themselves.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said to them, “They do not need to go; you give them something to eat!”

column.name: text
column.value: They *said to Him, “We have nothing here except five loaves and two fish.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said, “Bring them here to Me.”

column.name: text
column.value: And ordering the crowds to ①sit down on the grass, He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looked up toward heaven. He blessed the food and breaking the loaves, He gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the crowds. ▷ ①Lit recline

column.name: text
column.value: And they all ate and were satisfied, and they picked up what was left over of the broken pieces: twelve full baskets.

column.name: text
column.value: There were about five thousand men who ate, besides women and children.

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately afterward He compelled the disciples to get into the boat and to go ahead of Him to the other side, while He sent the crowds away.

column.name: text
column.value: After He had sent the crowds away, He went up on the mountain by Himself to pray; and when it was evening, He was there alone.

column.name: text
column.value: But the boat was already ①a long distance from the land, ②battered by the waves; for the wind was ③contrary. ▷ ①Lit many stadia from; a Roman stadion perhaps averaged 607 ft. or 185 m ②Lit tormented ③Or adverse

column.name: text
column.value: And in the ①fourth watch of the night He came to them, walking on the sea. ▷ ①I.e., 3-6 a.m.

column.name: text
column.value: When the disciples saw Him walking on the sea, they were terrified, and said, “It is a ghost!” And they cried out ①in fear. ▷ ①Lit from

column.name: text
column.value: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Take courage, ①it is I; do not be afraid.” ▷ ①Lit I am

column.name: text
column.value: Peter responded and said to Him, “Lord, if ①it is You, command me to come to You on the water.” ▷ ①Lit You are

column.name: text
column.value: And He said, “Come!” And Peter got out of the boat and walked on the water, and came toward Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: But seeing the wind, he became frightened, and when he began to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately Jesus reached out with His hand and took hold of him, and *said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”

column.name: text
column.value: When they got into the boat, the wind stopped.

column.name: text
column.value: And those who were in the boat worshiped Him, saying, “You are truly God’s Son!”

column.name: text
column.value: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the men of that place ①recognized Him, they sent word into all that surrounding region and brought to Him all who were sick; ▷ ①Or found out about

column.name: text
column.value: and they pleaded with Him that they might just touch the ①border of His cloak; and all who touched it were cured. ▷ ①Or tassel; i.e., a ritual tassel sewn to corners of garments for Jewish men

column.name: text
column.value: On that day Jesus had gone out of the house and was sitting by the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And large crowds gathered to Him, so He got into a boat and sat down, and the whole crowd was standing on the beach.

column.name: text
column.value: And He told them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, the sower went out to sow;

column.name: text
column.value: and as he sowed, some seeds fell beside the road, and the birds came and ate them up.

column.name: text
column.value: Others fell on the rocky places, where they did not have much soil; and they sprang up immediately, because they had no depth of soil.

column.name: text
column.value: But after the sun rose, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.

column.name: text
column.value: Others fell ①among the thorns, and the thorns came up and choked them out. ▷ ①Lit upon

column.name: text
column.value: But others fell on the good soil and yielded a crop, some a hundred, some sixty, and some thirty times as much.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who has ears, ①let him hear.” ▷ ①Or hear! Or listen!

column.name: text
column.value: And the disciples came up and said to Him, “Why do You speak to them in parables?”

column.name: text
column.value: And ①Jesus answered them, “To you it has been granted to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it has not been granted. ▷ ①Lit He

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever has, to him more shall be given, and he will have an abundance; but whoever does not have, even what he has shall be taken away from him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I speak to them in parables; because while seeing they do not see, and while hearing they do not hear, nor do they understand.

column.name: text
text
column.value: FOR THE HEART OF THIS PEOPLE HAS BECOME DULL, WITH THEIR EARS THEY SCARCELY HEAR, AND THEY HAVE CLOSED THEIR EYES, OTHERWISE THEY MIGHT SEE WITH THEIR EYES, HEAR WITH THEIR EARS, UNDERSTAND WITH THEIR HEART, AND RETURN, AND I WOULD HEAL THEM.’

column.name: text
column.value: But blessed are your eyes, because they see; and your ears, because they hear.

column.name: text
column.value: For truly I say to you that many prophets and righteous people longed to see what you see, and did not see it, and to hear what you hear, and did not hear it.

column.name: text
column.value: “Listen then to the parable of the sower.

column.name: text
column.value: When anyone hears the ①word of the kingdom and does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what has been sown in his heart. This is the one sown with seed beside the road. ▷ ①I.e., message

column.name: text
column.value: The one sown with seed on the rocky places, this is the one who hears the word and immediately receives it with joy;

column.name: text
column.value: yet he has no firm root in himself, but is only temporary, and when affliction or persecution occurs because of the ①word, immediately he ②falls away. ▷ ①I.e., message ②I.e., from the faith

column.name: text
column.value: And the one sown with seed among the thorns, this is the one who hears the word, and the anxiety of the ①world and the deceitfulness of wealth choke the word, and it ②becomes unfruitful. ▷ ①Or age ②Or proves to be unfruitful

column.name: text
column.value: But the one sown with seed on the good soil, this is the one who hears the word and understands it, who indeed bears fruit and produces, some a hundred, some sixty, and some thirty times as much.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus presented another parable to them, saying, “The kingdom of heaven ①is like a man who sowed good seed in his field. ▷ ①Lit has been compared to

column.name: text
column.value: But while his men were sleeping, his enemy came and sowed ①weeds among the wheat, and left. ▷ ①Prob. darnel, a weed resembling wheat

column.name: text
column.value: And when the ①wheat sprouted and produced grain, then the weeds also became evident. ▷ ①Lit grass

column.name: text
column.value: And the slaves of the landowner came and said to him, ‘Sir, did you not sow good seed in your field? ①How then does it have weeds?’ ▷ ①Lit From where

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, ‘ ①An enemy has done this!’ The slaves *said to him, ‘Do you want us, then, to go and gather them up?’ ▷ ①Lit A hostile person

column.name: text
column.value: But he *said, ‘No; while you are gathering up the weeds, you may uproot the wheat with them.

column.name: text
column.value: Allow both to grow together until the harvest; and at the time of the harvest I will say to the reapers, “First gather up the weeds and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: He presented another parable to them, saying, “The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed, which a person took and sowed in his field;

column.name: text
column.value: and this is smaller than all the other seeds, but when it is fully grown, it is larger than the garden plants and becomes a tree, so that THE BIRDS OF THE SKY come and NEST IN ITS BRANCHES.”

column.name: text
column.value: He spoke another parable to them: “The kingdom of heaven is like ①leaven, which a woman took and hid in three ②sata of flour until it was all leavened.” ▷ ①I.e., fermented dough ②A Gr term for a Heb measure, totaling about 48 lb. or 22 kg of flour

column.name: text
column.value: All these things Jesus spoke to the crowds in parables, and He did not speak anything to them without a parable.

column.name: text
column.value: This was so that what was spoken through the prophet would be ①fulfilled: “I WILL OPEN MY MOUTH IN PARABLES; I WILL PROCLAIM THINGS HIDDEN SINCE THE FOUNDATION OF THE WORLD.” ▷ ①Lit fulfilled, saying

column.name: text
column.value: Then He left the crowds and went into the house. And His disciples came to Him and said, “Explain to us the parable of the ①weeds of the field.” ▷ ①Prob. darnel, a weed resembling wheat

column.name: text
column.value: And He said, “The one who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,

column.name: text
column.value: and the field is the world; and as for the good seed, these are the sons of the kingdom; and the weeds are the sons of the evil one;

column.name: text
column.value: and the enemy who sowed them is the devil, and the harvest is the ①end of the age; and the reapers are angels. ▷ ①Or consummation

column.name: text
column.value: So just as the weeds are gathered up and burned with fire, so shall it be at the ①end of the age. ▷ ①Or consummation

column.name: text
column.value: The Son of Man will send forth His angels, and they will gather out of His kingdom ①all stumbling blocks, and those who commit lawlessness, ▷ ①Or everything that is offensive

column.name: text
column.value: and they will throw them into the furnace of fire; in that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then THE RIGHTEOUS WILL SHINE FORTH LIKE THE SUN in the kingdom of their Father. The one who has ears, ①let him hear. ▷ ①Or hear! Or listen!

column.name: text
column.value: “The kingdom of heaven is like a treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid again; and from ①joy over it he goes and sells everything that he has, and buys that field. ▷ ①Or his joy, he goes

column.name: text
column.value: “Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant seeking fine pearls,

column.name: text
column.value: and upon finding one pearl of great value, he went and sold everything that he had and bought it.

column.name: text
column.value: “Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered fish of every kind;

column.name: text
column.value: and when it was filled, they pulled it up on the beach; and they sat down and gathered the good fish into containers, but the bad they threw away.

column.name: text
column.value: So it will be at the ①end of the age: the angels will come forth and remove the wicked from among the righteous, ▷ ①Or consummation

column.name: text
column.value: and they will throw them into the furnace of fire; in that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

column.name: text
column.value: “Have you understood all these things?” They *said to Him, “Yes.”

column.name: text
column.value: And ①Jesus said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has become a disciple of the kingdom of heaven is like a head of a household, who brings out of his treasure new things and old.” ▷ ①Lit He

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus had finished these parables, He departed from there.

column.name: text
column.value: And He came to ①His hometown and began teaching them in their synagogue, with the result that they were astonished, and said, “Where did this man acquire this wisdom and these ②miraculous powers? ▷ ①Or His own part of the country ②Or miracles

column.name: text
column.value: Is this not the carpenter’s son? Is His mother not called Mary, and His brothers, James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas?

column.name: text
column.value: And His sisters, are they not all with us? Where then did this man acquire all these things?”

column.name: text
column.value: And they took offense at Him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not dishonored except in his ①hometown and in his own household.” ▷ ①Or own part of the country

column.name: text
column.value: And He did not do many ①miracles there because of their unbelief. ▷ ①Or works of power

column.name: text
column.value: Then some Pharisees and scribes *came to Jesus from Jerusalem and said,

column.name: text
column.value: “Why do Your disciples break the tradition of the elders? For they do not wash their hands when they eat bread.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He answered and said to them, “Why do you yourselves also break the commandment of God for the sake of your tradition?

column.name: text
column.value: For God said, ‘HONOR YOUR FATHER AND MOTHER,’ and, ‘THE ONE WHO SPEAKS EVIL OF FATHER OR MOTHER IS TO ①BE PUT TO DEATH.’ ▷ ①Lit die the death

column.name: text
column.value: But you say, ‘Whoever says to his father or mother, “Whatever I have that would help you has been ①given to God,” ▷ ①Lit a gift; i.e., an offering

column.name: text
column.value: he is not to ①honor his father or mother.’ And by this you have invalidated the word of God for the sake of your tradition. ▷ ①I.e., by supporting them with it

column.name: text
column.value: You hypocrites, rightly did Isaiah prophesy about you, by saying:

column.name: text
column.value: ‘THIS PEOPLE HONORS ME WITH THEIR LIPS, BUT THEIR HEART IS FAR AWAY FROM ME.

column.name: text
column.value: AND IN VAIN DO THEY WORSHIP ME, TEACHING AS DOCTRINES THE COMMANDMENTS OF MEN.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: After Jesus called the crowd to Him, He said to them, “Hear and understand!

column.name: text
column.value: It is not what enters the mouth that defiles the person, but what comes out of the mouth, this defiles the person.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the disciples came and *said to Him, “Do You know that the Pharisees were ①offended when they heard this statement?” ▷ ①Lit caused to stumble

column.name: text
column.value: But He answered and said, “Every plant which My heavenly Father did not plant will be uprooted.

column.name: text
column.value: Leave them alone; they are blind guides ①of blind people. And if a person who is blind guides another who is blind, both will fall into a pit.” ▷ ①Later mss add of blind people

column.name: text
column.value: Peter ①said to Him, “Explain the parable to us.” ▷ ①Lit answering, said

column.name: text
column.value: ①Jesus said, “Are you also still lacking in understanding? ▷ ①Lit and He

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not understand that everything that goes into the mouth passes into the stomach, and is ①eliminated? ▷ ①Lit thrown out into the latrine

column.name: text
column.value: But the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart, and those things defile the person.

column.name: text
column.value: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, acts of adultery, other immoral sexual acts, thefts, false testimonies, and ①slanderous statements. ▷ ①Or abusive speech

column.name: text
column.value: These are the things that defile the person; but to eat with unwashed hands does not defile the person.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus went away from there, and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

column.name: text
column.value: And a Canaanite woman from that region came out and began to cry out, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, Son of David; my daughter is severely demon-possessed.”

column.name: text
column.value: But He did not answer her with even a word. And His disciples came up and urged Him, saying, “Send her away, because she keeps shouting ①at us!” ▷ ①Lit behind us

column.name: text
column.value: But He answered and said, “I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

column.name: text
column.value: But she came and began ①to bow down before Him, saying, “Lord, help me!” ▷ ①Or worshiped

column.name: text
column.value: Yet He answered and said, “It is not ①good to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.” ▷ ①Or proper

column.name: text
column.value: And she said, “Yes, Lord; but please help, for even the dogs feed on the crumbs that fall from their masters’ table.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to her, “O woman, your faith is great; it shall be done for you as you desire.” And her daughter was healed ①at once. ▷ ①Lit from that hour

column.name: text
column.value: Departing from there, Jesus went along the Sea of Galilee, and after going up on the mountain, He was sitting there.

column.name: text
column.value: And ①large crowds came to Him bringing with them those who were limping, had impaired limbs, were blind, or were unable to speak, and many others, and they laid them down at His feet; and He healed them. ▷ ①Lit many

column.name: text
column.value: So the crowd was astonished as they saw those who were unable to speak talking, those with impaired limbs ①restored, those who were limping walking around, and those who were blind seeing; and they glorified the God of Israel. ▷ ①Or healthy

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jesus called His disciples to Him and said, “I feel compassion for the ①people, because they ②have remained with Me now for three days and have nothing to eat; and I do not want to send them away hungry, for they might faint on the way.” ▷ ①Lit crowd ②Lit are remaining

column.name: text
column.value: The disciples *said to Him, “Where would we get so many loaves in this desolate place to satisfy such a large crowd?”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus *said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” And they said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He directed the ①people to ②sit down on the ground; ▷ ①Lit crowd ②Lit recline

column.name: text
column.value: and He took the seven loaves and the fish; and after giving thanks, He broke them and started giving them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the crowds.

column.name: text
column.value: And they all ate and were satisfied, and they picked up what was left over of the broken pieces, seven large baskets full.

column.name: text
column.value: And those who ate were four thousand men, besides women and children.

column.name: text
column.value: And sending away the crowds, Jesus got into the boat and came to the region of Magadan.

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees and Sadducees came up, and putting Jesus to the test, they asked Him to show them a ①sign from heaven. ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracle

column.name: text
column.value: But He replied to them, “ ①When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’ ▷ ①Early mss do not contain the rest of v 2 and v 3

column.name: text
column.value: And in the morning, ‘There will be a storm today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ You know how to discern the ①appearance of the sky, but are you unable to discern the signs of the times? ▷ ①Lit face

column.name: text
column.value: An evil and adulterous generation wants a ①sign; and so a ②sign will not be given to it, except the sign of Jonah.” And He left them and went away. ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracle ②I.e., confirming miracle

column.name: text
column.value: And the disciples came to the other side of the sea, but they had forgotten to bring any bread.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to them, “Watch out and beware of the ①leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.” ▷ ①I.e., fermented dough

column.name: text
column.value: They began to discuss this among themselves, saying, “He said that because we did not bring any bread.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus, aware of this, said, “You men of little faith, why are you discussing among yourselves the fact that you have no bread?

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not yet understand nor remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets you picked up?

column.name: text
column.value: Nor the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many large baskets you picked up?

column.name: text
column.value: How is it that you do not understand that I did not speak to you about bread? But beware of the ①leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.” ▷ ①I.e., as a symbol of corruption

column.name: text
column.value: Then they understood that He did not say to beware of the ①leaven of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees. ▷ ①I.e., fermented dough

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Jesus came into the region of Caesarea Philippi, He was asking His disciples, “Who do people say that the Son of Man is?”

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, “Some say John the Baptist; and others, ①Elijah; and still others, ②Jeremiah, or one of the other prophets.” ▷ ①Gr Elias ②Gr Jeremias

column.name: text
column.value: He *said to them, “But who do you yourselves say that I am?”

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter answered, “You are the ①Christ, the Son of the living God.” ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to him, “Blessed are you, Simon ①Barjona, because flesh and blood did not reveal this to you, but My Father who is in heaven. ▷ ①I.e., son of Jonah

column.name: text
column.value: And I also say to you that you are ①Peter, and upon this ②rock I will build My church; and the gates of Hades will not overpower it. ▷ ①Gr Petros, a stone ②Gr petra, massive rock formation; bedrock

column.name: text
column.value: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven; and whatever you ①bind on earth ②shall have been bound in heaven, and whatever you ③loose on earth ④shall have been loosed in heaven.” ▷ ①I.e., forbid ②Gr fut. pft. pass. tense ③I.e., permit ④Gr fut. pft. pass. tense

column.name: text
column.value: Then He gave the disciples strict orders that they were to tell no one that He was the ①Christ. ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: From that time ①Jesus began to ②point out to His disciples that it was necessary for Him to go to Jerusalem and to suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and to be killed, and to be raised up on the third day. ▷ ①Two early mss Jesus Christ ②Or show

column.name: text
column.value: And yet Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him, saying, “ ①God forbid it, Lord! This shall never ②happen to You!” ▷ ①Lit (God be) merciful to You ②Lit be

column.name: text
column.value: But He turned and said to Peter, “Get behind Me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to Me; for you are not setting your mind on ①God’s purposes, but men’s.” ▷ ①Lit the things of God

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to His disciples, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself, take up his cross, and follow Me.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever wants to save his ①life will lose it; but whoever loses his ②life for My sake will find it. ▷ ①Or soul ②Or soul

column.name: text
column.value: For what good will it do a person if he gains the whole world, but ①forfeits his soul? Or what will a person give in exchange for his soul? ▷ ①I.e., suffers the loss of

column.name: text
column.value: For the Son of Man is going to come in the glory of His Father with His angels, and WILL THEN REPAY EVERY PERSON ACCORDING TO HIS ①DEEDS. ▷ ①Lit activity

column.name: text
column.value: “Truly I say to you, there are some of those who are standing here who will not taste death until they see the Son of Man coming in His kingdom.”

column.name: text
column.value: Six days later, Jesus *took with Him Peter and ①James, and his brother John, and *led them up on a high mountain by themselves. ▷ ①Or Jacob

column.name: text
column.value: And He was transfigured before them; and His face shone like the sun, and His garments became as white as light.

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them, talking with Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Peter responded and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good that we are here. If You want, I will make three ①tabernacles here: one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.” ▷ ①Or sacred tents

column.name: text
column.value: While he was still speaking, a bright cloud overshadowed them, and behold, a voice from the cloud said, “This is My beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased; listen to Him!”

column.name: text
column.value: When the disciples heard this, they fell ①face down to the ground and were terrified. ▷ ①Lit on their faces

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus came to them and touched them and said, “Get up, and do not be afraid.”

column.name: text
column.value: And raising their eyes, they saw no one except Jesus Himself alone.

column.name: text
column.value: When they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Tell the vision to no one until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”

column.name: text
column.value: And His disciples asked Him, “Why then do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

column.name: text
column.value: And He answered and said, “Elijah is coming and will restore all things;

column.name: text
column.value: but I say to you that Elijah already came, and they did not recognize him, but did ①to him whatever they wanted. So also the Son of Man is going to suffer ②at their hands.” ▷ ①Lit in him; or in his case ②Lit by them

column.name: text
column.value: Then the disciples understood that He had spoken to them about John the Baptist.

column.name: text
column.value: When they came to the crowd, a man came up to ①Jesus, falling on his knees before Him and saying, ▷ ①Lit Him

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①Lord, have mercy on my son, because he has seizures and suffers terribly; for he often falls into the fire and often into the water. ▷ ①Or Sir

column.name: text
column.value: And I brought him to Your disciples, and they could not cure him.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and said, “You unbelieving and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I put up with you? Bring him here to Me.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus rebuked him, and the demon came out of him, and the boy was healed ①at once. ▷ ①Lit from that hour

column.name: text
column.value: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately and said, “Why could we not cast it out?”

column.name: text
column.value: And He *said to them, “Because of your meager faith; for truly I say to you, if you have faith ①the size of a mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you. ②” ▷ ①Lit like ②Late mss add (traditionally v 21): But this kind does not go out except by prayer and fasting

column.name: text
column.value: And while they were gathering together in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is going to be ①handed over to men; ▷ ①Or betrayed

column.name: text
column.value: and they will kill Him, and He will be raised on the third day.” And they were deeply grieved.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when they came to Capernaum, those who collected the ①two-drachma tax came to Peter and said, “Does your teacher not pay the ②two-drachma tax?” ▷ ①Equivalent to about two denarii or two days’ wages for a laborer, paid as a temple tax ②Equivalent to about two denarii or two days’ wages for a laborer, paid as a temple tax

column.name: text
column.value: He *said, “Yes.” And when he came into the house, Jesus spoke to him first, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth collect customs or ①poll-tax, from their sons or from strangers?” ▷ ①I.e., a tax on each person in the census

column.name: text
column.value: When Peter said, “From strangers,” Jesus said to him, “Then the sons are ①exempt. ▷ ①Lit free

column.name: text
column.value: However, so that we do not offend them, go to the sea and throw in a hook, and take the first fish that comes up; and when you open its mouth, you will find a ①stater. Take that and give it to them for you and Me.” ▷ ①A silver four-drachma Greek coin

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus had finished these words, He left Galilee and came into the region of Judea beyond the Jordan;

column.name: text
column.value: and ①large crowds followed Him, and He healed them there. ▷ ①Or many

column.name: text
column.value: Some Pharisees came to ①Jesus, testing Him and ②asking, “Is it lawful for a man to ③divorce his wife for any reason at all?” ▷ ①Lit Him ②Lit saying ③Lit send away

column.name: text
column.value: And He answered and said, “Have you not read that He who created them from the beginning MADE THEM MALE AND FEMALE,

column.name: text
column.value: and said, ‘FOR THIS REASON A MAN SHALL LEAVE HIS FATHER AND HIS MOTHER AND BE JOINED TO HIS WIFE, AND THE TWO SHALL BECOME ONE FLESH’?

column.name: text
column.value: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore, what God has joined together, no person is to separate.”

column.name: text
column.value: They *said to Him, “Why, then, did Moses command to GIVE her a certificate of divorce and send her away?”

column.name: text
column.value: He *said to them, “Because of your hardness of heart Moses permitted you to ①divorce your wives; but from the beginning it has not been this way. ▷ ①Lit send away

column.name: text
column.value: And I say to you, whoever ①divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another woman ②commits adultery ③.” ▷ ①Lit sends away ②One early ms makes her commit adultery ③One early ms adds and he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery

column.name: text
column.value: The disciples *said to Him, “If the relationship of the man with his wife is like this, it is better not to marry.”

column.name: text
column.value: But He said to them, “Not all men can accept this statement, but only those to whom it has been given.

column.name: text
column.value: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb; and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by people; and there are also eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. The one who is able to accept this, let him accept it.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then some children were brought to Him so that He would lay His hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said, “ ①Leave the children alone, and do not ②forbid them to come to Me; for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.” ▷ ①Or Permit the children ②Or prevent them from coming

column.name: text
column.value: After laying His hands on them, He departed from there.

column.name: text
column.value: And someone came to Him and said, “Teacher, what good thing shall I do so that I may obtain eternal life?”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to him, “Why are you asking Me about what is good? There is only One who is good; but if you want to enter life, keep the commandments.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then he *said to Him, “Which ones?” And Jesus said, “YOU SHALL NOT COMMIT MURDER; YOU SHALL NOT COMMIT ADULTERY; YOU SHALL NOT STEAL; YOU SHALL NOT GIVE FALSE TESTIMONY;

column.name: text
column.value: HONOR YOUR FATHER AND MOTHER; and YOU SHALL LOVE YOUR NEIGHBOR AS YOURSELF.”

column.name: text
column.value: The young man *said to Him, “All these I have kept; what am I still lacking?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be ①complete, go and sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow Me.” ▷ ①Or perfect

column.name: text
column.value: But when the young man heard this statement, he went away grieving; for he was one who owned much property.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to His disciples, “Truly I say to you, it will be hard for a rich person to enter the kingdom of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And again I say to you, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich person to enter the kingdom of God.”

column.name: text
column.value: When the disciples heard this, they were very astonished and said, “Then who can be saved?”

column.name: text
column.value: And looking at them, Jesus said to them, “With people this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter responded and said to Him, “Behold, we have left everything and followed You; what then will there be for us?”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to them, “Truly I say to you, that you who have followed Me, in the ①regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on ②His glorious throne, you also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel. ▷ ①Or renewal; i.e., the new world ②Lit the throne of His glory

column.name: text
column.value: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother ①or children or farms on account of My name, will receive ②many times as much, and will inherit eternal life. ▷ ①One early ms adds or wife ②One early ms a hundred times

column.name: text
column.value: But many who are first will be last; and the last, first.

column.name: text
column.value: “For the kingdom of heaven is like ①a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard. ▷ ①Lit a man, a landowner

column.name: text
column.value: When he had agreed with the laborers for a ①denarius for the day, he sent them into his vineyard. ▷ ①The denarius was a day’s wages for a laborer

column.name: text
column.value: And he went out about the ①third hour and saw others standing idle in the marketplace; ▷ ①I.e., 9 a.m.

column.name: text
column.value: and to those he said, ‘You go into the vineyard also, and whatever is right, I will give you.’ And so they went.

column.name: text
column.value: Again he went out about the ①sixth and the ninth hour, and did ②the same thing. ▷ ①I.e., noon and 3 p.m. ②Lit similarly

column.name: text
column.value: And about the ①eleventh hour he went out and found others standing around; and he *said to them, ‘Why have you been standing here idle all day long?’ ▷ ①I.e., 5 p.m.

column.name: text
column.value: They *said to him, ‘Because no one hired us.’ He *said to them, ‘You go into the vineyard too.’

column.name: text
column.value: “Now when evening came, the ①owner of the vineyard *said to his foreman, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, starting with the last group to the first.’ ▷ ①Or lord

column.name: text
column.value: When those hired about the eleventh hour came, each one received a ①denarius. ▷ ①The denarius was a day’s wages for a laborer

column.name: text
column.value: And so when those hired first came, they thought that they would receive more; ①but each of them also received a denarius. ▷ ①Lit each one a denarius

column.name: text
column.value: When they received it, they grumbled at the landowner,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, ‘These who were hired last worked only one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day’s work and the scorching heat.’

column.name: text
column.value: But he answered and said to one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong; did you not agree with me for a denarius?

column.name: text
column.value: Take what is yours and go; but I want to give to this last person the same as to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Is it not lawful for me to do what I want with what is my own? Or is your eye ①envious because I am ②generous?’ ▷ ①Lit evil ②Lit good

column.name: text
column.value: So the last shall be first, and the first, last.”

column.name: text
column.value: As Jesus was about to go up to Jerusalem, He took the twelve disciples aside by themselves, and on the road He said to them,

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be ①handed over to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn Him to death, ▷ ①Or betrayed

column.name: text
column.value: and they will hand Him over to the Gentiles to mock and flog and crucify, and on the third day He will be raised up.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the mother of the ①sons of Zebedee came to ②Jesus with her sons, bowing down and making a request of Him. ▷ ①I.e., the apostles James and John ②Lit Him

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to her, “What do you desire?” She *said to Him, “Say that in Your kingdom these two sons of mine shall sit, one at Your right, and one at Your left.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus replied, “You do not know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink?” They *said to Him, “We are able.”

column.name: text
column.value: He *said to them, “My cup you shall drink; but to sit at My right and at My left is not Mine to give, but it is for those for whom it has been prepared by My Father.”

column.name: text
column.value: And after hearing this, the other ten disciples became indignant with the two brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus called them to Himself and said, “You know that the rulers of the Gentiles domineer over them, and ①those in high position exercise authority over them. ▷ ①Lit the great ones

column.name: text
column.value: It ①is not this way among you, but whoever wants to become ②prominent among you shall be your servant, ▷ ①One early ms shall not be ②Lit great

column.name: text
column.value: and whoever desires to be first among you shall be your slave;

column.name: text
column.value: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His ①life as a ransom for many.” ▷ ①Or soul

column.name: text
column.value: As they were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And two people who were blind, sitting by the road, hearing that Jesus was passing by, cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, Son of David!”

column.name: text
column.value: But the crowd sternly warned them to be quiet; yet they cried out all the more, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus stopped and called them, and said, “What do you want Me to do for you?”

column.name: text
column.value: They *said to Him, “Lord, we want our eyes to be opened.”

column.name: text
column.value: Moved with compassion, Jesus touched their eyes; and immediately they regained their sight and followed Him.

column.name: text
column.value: When they had approached Jerusalem and had come to Bethphage, at the Mount of Olives, Jesus then sent two disciples,

column.name: text
column.value: saying to them, “Go into the village opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied there and a colt with it. Untie them and bring them to Me.

column.name: text
column.value: And if anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and he will send them on immediately.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now this ①took place so that what was spoken through ②the prophet would be fulfilled: ▷ ①Lit has happened ②I.e., Zechariah

column.name: text
column.value: “SAY TO THE DAUGHTER OF ZION, ‘BEHOLD YOUR KING IS COMING TO YOU, HUMBLE, AND MOUNTED ON A DONKEY, EVEN ON A COLT, THE FOAL OF A DONKEY.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: The disciples went and did just as Jesus had instructed them,

column.name: text
column.value: and brought the donkey and the colt, and laid their cloaks on them; and He sat on ①the cloaks. ▷ ①Lit them

column.name: text
column.value: Most of the crowd spread their cloaks on the road, and others were cutting branches from the trees and spreading them on the road.

column.name: text
text
column.value: When He had entered Jerusalem, all the city was stirred, saying, “Who is this?”

column.name: text
column.value: And the crowds were saying, “This is Jesus the prophet, from Nazareth in Galilee.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus entered the temple area and drove out all those who were selling and buying on the temple grounds, and He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those who were selling doves.

column.name: text
column.value: And He *said to them, “It is written: ‘MY HOUSE WILL BE CALLED A HOUSE OF PRAYER’; but you are making it a DEN OF ROBBERS.”

column.name: text
column.value: And those who were blind and those who limped came to Him in the temple area, and He healed them.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that He had done, and the children who were shouting in the temple area, “ ①Hosanna to the Son of David,” they became indignant, ▷ ①Aramaic for Save, we pray

column.name: text
column.value: and they said to Him, “Do You hear what these children are saying?” And Jesus *said to them, “Yes. Have you never read, ‘FROM THE MOUTHS OF INFANTS AND NURSING BABIES YOU HAVE PREPARED PRAISE FOR YOURSELF’?”

column.name: text
column.value: And He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and spent the night there.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the early morning, when He was returning to the city, He became hungry.

column.name: text
column.value: And seeing a lone fig tree by the road, He came to it and found nothing on it except leaves alone; and He *said to it, “No longer shall there ever be any fruit from you.” And at once the fig tree withered.

column.name: text
column.value: Seeing this, the disciples were amazed and ①asked, “How did the fig tree wither all at once?” ▷ ①Lit said

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and said to them, “Truly I say to you, if you have faith and do not doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you say to this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it will happen.

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive it all.”

column.name: text
column.value: When He entered the temple area, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to Him while He was teaching, and said, “By what authority are You doing these things, and who gave You this authority?”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus responded and said to them, “I will also ask you one ①question, which, if you tell Me, I will also tell you by what authority I do these things. ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: The baptism of John was from what source: from heaven or from men?” And they began considering the implications among themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will say to us, ‘Then why did you not believe him?’

column.name: text
column.value: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the ①people; for they all regard John as a prophet.” ▷ ①Lit crowd

column.name: text
column.value: And answering Jesus, they said, “We do not know.” He also said to them, “Neither am I telling you by what authority I do these things.

column.name: text
column.value: “But what do you think? A man had two ①sons, and he came to the first and said, ‘ ②Son, go work today in the vineyard.’ ▷ ①Lit children ②Lit Child

column.name: text
column.value: But he replied, ‘I do not want to.’ Yet afterward he regretted it and went.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man came to his second son and said the same thing; and he replied, ‘I will, sir’; and yet he did not go.

column.name: text
column.value: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They *said, “The first.” Jesus *said to them, “Truly I say to you that the tax collectors and prostitutes ①will get into the kingdom of God before you. ▷ ①Lit are getting into

column.name: text
column.value: For John came to you in the way of righteousness and you did not believe him; but the tax collectors and prostitutes did believe him; and you, seeing this, did not even ①have second thoughts afterward so as to believe him. ▷ ①Or change your minds

column.name: text
column.value: “Listen to another parable. There was a ①landowner who PLANTED A VINEYARD AND PUT A ②FENCE AROUND IT, AND DUG A WINE PRESS IN IT, AND BUILT A TOWER, and he leased it to ③vine-growers and went on a journey. ▷ ①Lit a man, head of a household ②Or hedge ③Or tenant farmers, also vv 34, 35, 38, 40

column.name: text
column.value: And when the ①harvest time approached, he sent his slaves to the vine-growers to receive his fruit. ▷ ①Lit the fruit season

column.name: text
column.value: And the vine-growers took his slaves and beat one, killed another, and stoned another.

column.name: text
column.value: Again, he sent other slaves, more than the first; and they did the same things to them.

column.name: text
column.value: But afterward he sent his son to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

column.name: text
column.value: But when the vine-growers saw the son, they said among themselves, ‘This is the heir; come, let’s kill him and take possession of his inheritance!’

column.name: text
column.value: And they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, when the ①owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those vine-growers?” ▷ ①Lit lord

column.name: text
column.value: They *said to Him, “He will bring those wretches to a wretched end and lease the vineyard to other vine-growers, who will pay him the fruit in the proper seasons.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘A STONE WHICH THE BUILDERS REJECTED, THIS HAS BECOME THE ①CHIEF CORNERSTONE; THIS CAME ABOUT FROM THE LORD, AND IT IS MARVELOUS IN OUR EYES’? ▷ ①Lit head of the corner

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I say to you, the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a ①people producing its fruit. ▷ ①Lit nation

column.name: text
column.value: And the one who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces; and on whomever it falls, it will crush him.”

column.name: text
column.value: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard His parables, they understood that He was speaking about them.

column.name: text
column.value: And although they sought to arrest Him, they feared the crowds, since they considered Him to be a prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus spoke to the crowds and to His disciples,

column.name: text
column.value: saying: “The scribes and the Pharisees have seated themselves in the chair of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, whatever they tell you, do and ①comply with it all, but do not do ②as they do; for they say things and do not do them. ▷ ①Lit keep all ②Lit according to their deeds

column.name: text
column.value: And they tie up heavy burdens and lay them on people’s shoulders, but they themselves are unwilling to move them with so much as their finger.

column.name: text
column.value: And they do all their deeds to be noticed by other people; for they broaden their ①phylacteries and lengthen the tassels of their garments. ▷ ①I.e., small pouches containing Scripture texts, worn on the left forearm and forehead for religious purposes

column.name: text
column.value: And they love the place of honor at banquets, and the seats of honor in the synagogues,

column.name: text
column.value: and personal greetings in the marketplaces, and being called ①Rabbi by the people. ▷ ①In Heb “My Teacher” or “My Master”

column.name: text
column.value: But as for you, do not be called ①Rabbi; for only One is your Teacher, and you are all brothers and sisters. ▷ ①In Heb “My Teacher” or “My Master”

column.name: text
column.value: And do not call anyone on earth your father; for only One is your Father, He who is in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And do not be called ①leaders; for only One is your Leader, that is, Christ. ▷ ①Or teachers

column.name: text
column.value: But the greatest of you shall be your servant.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever exalts himself shall be humbled, and whoever humbles himself shall be exalted.

column.name: text
column.value: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you shut the kingdom of heaven in front of people; for you do not enter it yourselves, nor do you allow those who are entering to go in. ① ▷ ①Late mss add (traditionally v 14): Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you devour widows’ houses even while for appearances’ sake you make long prayers; therefore you will receive greater condemnation (as v 14); cf. Mark 12:40; Luke

column.name: text
column.value: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you travel around on sea and land to make one ①proselyte; and when he becomes one, you ②make him twice as much a son of ③hell as yourselves. ▷ ①Or convert ②I.e., doom him to hell ③Gr Gehenna

column.name: text
column.value: “Woe to you, blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the ①temple, that is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the ②temple is obligated.’ ▷ ①Or sanctuary ②Or sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: You fools and blind men! Which is ①more important, the gold or the ②temple that sanctified the gold? ▷ ①Lit greater ②Or sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: And you say, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, that is nothing; but whoever swears by the ①offering that is on it is obligated.’ ▷ ①Or gift

column.name: text
column.value: You blind men, which is ①more important, the ②offering or the altar that sanctifies the ③offering? ▷ ①Lit greater ②Or gift ③Or gift

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, the one who swears by the altar, swears both by ①the altar and by everything on it. ▷ ①Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: And the one who swears by the ①temple, swears both by ②the temple and by Him who dwells in it. ▷ ①Or sanctuary ②Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: And the one who swears by ①heaven, swears both by the throne of God and by Him who sits upon it. ▷ ①I.e., an indirect reference to God

column.name: text
column.value: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint and dill and ①cumin, and have neglected the weightier provisions of the Law: justice and mercy and faithfulness; but these are the things you should have done without neglecting the others. ▷ ①Similar to caraway seeds

column.name: text
column.value: You blind guides, who ①strain out a gnat and swallow a camel! ▷ ①Or filter out

column.name: text
column.value: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the dish, but inside they are full ①of robbery and self-indulgence. ▷ ①Or as a result of

column.name: text
column.value: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the dish, so that the ①outside of it may also become clean. ▷ ①If the inside was ritually unclean, the entire vessel was unclean whether the outside was cleaned or not (cf. Num 19:15)

column.name: text
column.value: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitewashed tombs which on the outside appear beautiful, but inside they are full of dead men’s bones and all uncleanness.

column.name: text
column.value: So you too, outwardly appear righteous to people, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and lawlessness.

column.name: text
column.value: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs for the prophets and decorate the monuments of the righteous,

column.name: text
column.value: and you say, ‘If we had been living in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partners with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’

column.name: text
column.value: So you testify against yourselves, that you are ①sons of those who murdered the prophets. ▷ ①Or descendants

column.name: text
column.value: ①Fill up, then, the measure of the guilt of your fathers. ▷ ①I.e., finish what they started

column.name: text
column.value: You snakes, you ①offspring of vipers, how ②will you escape the ③sentence of ④hell? ▷ ①Or brood ②Lit are you to escape ③Or judgment ④Gr Gehenna

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore, behold, I am sending you prophets and wise men and scribes; some of them you will kill and crucify, and some of them you will flog in your synagogues, and persecute from city to city,

column.name: text
column.value: so that upon you will fall the guilt of all the righteous blood shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the ①temple and the altar. ▷ ①Or sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: Truly I say to you, all these things will come upon this generation.

column.name: text
column.value: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who have been sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, the way a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you were unwilling.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, your house is being left to you desolate!

column.name: text
column.value: For I say to you, from now on you will not see Me until you say, ‘BLESSED IS THE ONE WHO COMES IN THE NAME OF THE LORD!’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus spoke to them again in parables, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “The kingdom of heaven ①is like ②a king who ③held a wedding feast for his son. ▷ ①Lit has been compared to ②Lit a man, a king ③Lit made

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent his slaves to call those who had been invited to the wedding feast, and they were unwilling to come.

column.name: text
column.value: Again he sent other slaves, saying, ‘Tell those who have been invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner; my oxen and my fattened cattle are all butchered and everything is ready. Come to the wedding feast!” ’

column.name: text
column.value: But they paid no attention and went their separate ways, one to his own ①farm, another to his business, ▷ ①Or field

column.name: text
column.value: and the rest seized his slaves and treated them abusively, and then killed them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the king was angry, and he sent his armies and destroyed those murderers and set their city on fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he *said to his slaves, ‘The wedding feast is ready, but those who were invited were not worthy.

column.name: text
column.value: So go to the main roads, and invite whomever you find there to the wedding feast.’

column.name: text
column.value: Those slaves went out into the streets and gathered together all whom they found, both bad and good; and the wedding hall was filled with ①dinner guests. ▷ ①Lit those reclining at the table

column.name: text
column.value: “But when the king came in to look over the ①dinner guests, he saw a man there who was not dressed in wedding clothes, ▷ ①Lit those reclining at the table

column.name: text
column.value: and he *said to him, ‘Friend, how did you get in here without wedding clothes?’ And the man was speechless.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Tie his hands and feet, and throw him into the outer darkness; there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth in that place.’

column.name: text
column.value: For many are ①called, but few are chosen.” ▷ ①Or invited

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Pharisees went and ①plotted together how they might trap Him ②in what He said. ▷ ①Lit took counsel ②Lit in word

column.name: text
column.value: And they *sent their disciples to Him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that You are truthful and teach the way of God in truth, and ①do not care what anyone thinks; for You ②are not partial to anyone. ▷ ①Lit it is not a concern to You about anyone; ②Lit do not look at the face of people

column.name: text
column.value: Tell us then, what do You think? Is it ①permissible to pay a ②poll-tax to Caesar, or not?” ▷ ①Or lawful; i.e., by Jewish law and tradition ②I.e., a tax on each person in the census

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus perceived their ①malice, and said, “Why are you testing Me, you hypocrites? ▷ ①Or wickedness

column.name: text
column.value: Show Me the coin used for the poll-tax.” And they brought Him a ①denarius. ▷ ①The denarius was a day’s wages for a laborer

column.name: text
column.value: And He *said to them, “Whose image and inscription is this?”

column.name: text
column.value: They *said to Him, “Caesar’s.” Then He *said to them, “Then pay to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s; and to God the things that are God’s.”

column.name: text
column.value: And hearing this, they were amazed; and they left Him and went away.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day some Sadducees (who say there is no resurrection) came to ①Jesus and questioned Him, ▷ ①Lit Him

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies having no children, his brother as next of kin shall marry his wife, and raise up ①children for his brother.’ ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: Now there were seven brothers among us; and the first married and died, and having no ①children, he left his wife to his brother. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: It was the same also with the second brother, and the third, down to the seventh.

column.name: text
column.value: Last of all, the woman died.

column.name: text
column.value: In the resurrection, therefore, whose wife of the seven will she be? For they all had her in marriage.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus answered and said to them, “You are mistaken, since you do not ①understand the Scriptures nor the power of God. ▷ ①Or know

column.name: text
column.value: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: But regarding the resurrection of the dead, have you not read what was spoken to you by God:

column.name: text
column.value: ‘I AM THE GOD OF ABRAHAM, THE GOD OF ISAAC, AND THE GOD OF JACOB’? He is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”

column.name: text
column.value: When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at His teaching.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the Pharisees heard that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, they gathered together.

column.name: text
column.value: And one of them, ①a lawyer, asked Him a question, testing Him: ▷ ①I.e., an expert in the Mosaic Law

column.name: text
column.value: “Teacher, which is the great commandment in the Law?”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to him, “ ‘YOU SHALL LOVE THE LORD YOUR GOD WITH ALL YOUR HEART, AND WITH ALL YOUR SOUL, AND WITH ALL YOUR MIND.’

column.name: text
column.value: This is the great and ①foremost commandment. ▷ ①Or first

column.name: text
column.value: The second is like it, ‘YOU SHALL LOVE YOUR NEIGHBOR AS YOURSELF.’

column.name: text
column.value: Upon these two commandments ①hang the whole Law and the Prophets.” ▷ ①I.e., completely depend

column.name: text
column.value: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question:

column.name: text
column.value: “What do you think about the ①Christ? Whose son is He?” They *said to Him, “The son of David.” ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: He *said to them, “Then ①how does David ②in the Spirit call Him ‘Lord,’ saying, ▷ ①Or in what sense does ②I.e., by inspiration

column.name: text
column.value: ‘THE LORD SAID TO MY LORD, “SIT AT MY RIGHT HAND, UNTIL I PUT YOUR ENEMIES UNDER YOUR FEET” ’?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, if David calls Him ‘Lord,’ ①how is He his son?” ▷ ①Or in what sense is

column.name: text
column.value: No one was able to offer Him a word in answer, nor did anyone dare from that day on to ask Him any more questions.

column.name: text
column.value: At that ①time the disciples came to Jesus and said, “Who then is greatest in the kingdom of heaven?” ▷ ①Lit hour

column.name: text
column.value: And He called a child to Himself and set him among them,

column.name: text
column.value: and said, “Truly I say to you, unless you ①change and become like children, you will not enter the kingdom of heaven. ▷ ①Lit turn

column.name: text
column.value: So whoever will humble himself like this child, he is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever receives one such child in My name, receives Me;

column.name: text
column.value: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to ①sin, it is better for him that a ②heavy millstone be hung around his neck, and that he be drowned in the depths of the sea. ▷ ①Or stumble, and so throughout the ch ②Lit millstone turned by a donkey

column.name: text
column.value: “Woe to the world because of its ①stumbling blocks! For it is inevitable that ②stumbling blocks come; but woe to the person through whom the ③stumbling block comes! ▷ ①I.e., enticements to sin ②I.e., enticements to sin ③I.e., enticements to sin

column.name: text
column.value: “And if your hand or your foot is causing you to sin, cut it off and throw it away from you; it is better for you to enter life maimed or without a foot, than to have two hands or two feet and be thrown into the eternal fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And if your eye is causing you to sin, tear it out and throw it away from you. It is better for you to enter life with one eye, than to have two eyes and be thrown into the ①fiery hell. ▷ ①Lit Gehenna of fire

column.name: text
column.value: “See that you do not look down on one of these little ones; for I say to you that their angels in heaven continually see the face of My Father who is in heaven. ① ▷ ①Late mss add (traditionally v 11): For the Son of Man has come to save that which was lost

column.name: text
column.value: “What do you think? If any man has a hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the mountains, and go and search for the one that is lost?

column.name: text
column.value: And if it turns out that he finds it, truly I say to you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine that have not gone astray.

column.name: text
column.value: So it is not the will ①of your Father who is in heaven for one of these little ones to perish. ▷ ①Lit before

column.name: text
column.value: “Now if your brother sins ①, go and ②show him his fault ③in private; if he listens to you, you have gained your brother. ▷ ①Late mss add against you ②Or correct ③Lit between you and him alone

column.name: text
column.value: But if he does not listen to you, take one or two more with you, so that ON THE ①TESTIMONY OF TWO OR THREE WITNESSES EVERY ②MATTER MAY BE CONFIRMED. ▷ ①Lit mouth ②Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: And if he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the church; and if he refuses to listen even to the church, he is to be to you as ①a Gentile and ②a tax collector. ▷ ①Lit the ②Lit the

column.name: text
column.value: Truly I say to you, whatever you ①bind on earth ②shall have been bound in heaven; and whatever you ③loose on earth ④shall have been loosed in heaven. ▷ ①I.e., forbid ②Gr fut. pft. pass. tense ③I.e., permit ④Gr fut. pft. pass. tense

column.name: text
column.value: “Again I say to you, that if two of you agree on earth about anything that they may ask, it shall be done for them ①by My Father who is in heaven. ▷ ①Lit from

column.name: text
column.value: For where two or three have gathered together in My name, I am there in their midst.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter came up and said to Him, “Lord, how many times shall my brother sin against me and I still forgive him? Up to seven times?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *said to him, “I do not say to you, up to seven times, but up to ①seventy-seven times. ▷ ①Or possibly seventy times seven

column.name: text
column.value: “For this reason the kingdom of heaven ①is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his slaves. ▷ ①Lit has been compared to

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had begun to settle them, one who owed him ①ten thousand talents was brought to him. ▷ ①By one estimate, a debt of 60 million working days for a laborer

column.name: text
column.value: But since he ①did not have the means to repay, his master commanded that he be sold, along with his wife and children and all that he had, and repayment be made. ▷ ①Or was unable to

column.name: text
column.value: So the slave fell to the ground and prostrated himself before him, saying, ‘Have patience with me and I will repay you everything.’

column.name: text
column.value: And the master of that slave felt compassion, and he released him and forgave him the ①debt. ▷ ①Or loan

column.name: text
column.value: But that slave went out and found one of his fellow slaves who owed him a hundred ①denarii; and he seized him and began to choke him, saying, ‘Pay back what you owe!’ ▷ ①The denarius was a day’s wages for a laborer

column.name: text
column.value: So his fellow slave fell to the ground and began to plead with him, saying, ‘Have patience with me and I will repay you.’

column.name: text
column.value: But he was unwilling, ①and went and threw him in prison until he would pay back what was owed. ▷ ①Lit but

column.name: text
column.value: So when his fellow slaves saw what had happened, they were deeply grieved and came and reported to their master all that had happened.

column.name: text
column.value: Then summoning him, his master *said to him, ‘You wicked slave, I forgave you all that debt because you pleaded with me.

column.name: text
column.value: Should you not also have had mercy on your fellow slave, in the same way that I had mercy on you?’

column.name: text
column.value: And his master, moved with anger, handed him over to the ①torturers until he would repay all that was owed him. ▷ ①I.e., jailors assigned to torture prisoners

column.name: text
column.value: My heavenly Father will also do the same to you, if each of you does not forgive his brother from your ①heart.” ▷ ①Lit hearts

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus left the temple area and was going on His way ①when His disciples came up to point out the temple buildings to Him. ▷ ①Lit and

column.name: text
column.value: But He responded and said to them, “Do you not see all these things? Truly I say to you, not one stone here will be left upon another, which will not be torn down.”

column.name: text
column.value: And as He was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things happen, and what will be the sign of Your coming, and of the ①end of the age?” ▷ ①Or consummation

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and said to them, “See to it that no one ①misleads you. ▷ ①Or deceives

column.name: text
column.value: For many will come in My name, saying, ‘I am the ①Christ,’ and they will ②mislead many people. ▷ ①I.e., Messiah ②Or deceive

column.name: text
column.value: And you will be hearing of wars and rumors of wars. See that you are not alarmed, for those things must take place, but that is not yet the end.

column.name: text
column.value: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom, and there will be famines and earthquakes in various places.

column.name: text
column.value: But all these things are merely the beginning of birth pains.

column.name: text
column.value: “Then they will hand you over to tribulation and kill you, and you will be hated by all nations because of My name.

column.name: text
column.value: And at that time many will ①fall away, and they will ②betray one another and hate one another. ▷ ①I.e., from the faith ②Or hand over

column.name: text
column.value: And many false prophets will rise up and ①mislead many people. ▷ ①Or deceive

column.name: text
column.value: And because lawlessness is increased, ①most people’s love will become cold. ▷ ①Lit the love of the many

column.name: text
column.value: But the one who endures to the end is the one who will be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: This gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in the whole ①world as a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come. ▷ ①Lit inhabited earth

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore when you see the ABOMINATION OF DESOLATION which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place— ①let the ②reader understand— ▷ ①Or the reader is to understand ②I.e., the reader of Daniel

column.name: text
column.value: then those who are in Judea must flee to the mountains.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Whoever is on the ②housetop must not go down to get things out of his house. ▷ ①Lit The one who ②Housetops were flat living areas

column.name: text
column.value: And ①whoever is in the field must not turn back to get his cloak. ▷ ①Lit the one who

column.name: text
column.value: But woe to those women who are pregnant, and to those who are nursing babies in those days!

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, pray that ①when you flee, it will not be in the winter, or on a Sabbath. ▷ ①Lit your flight will not be

column.name: text
column.value: For then there will be a great tribulation, such as has not occurred since the beginning of the world until now, nor ever will again.

column.name: text
column.value: And if those days had not been cut short, no ①life would have been saved; but for the sake of the ②elect those days will be cut short. ▷ ①Lit flesh ②Or chosen ones

column.name: text
column.value: Then if anyone says to you, ‘Behold, here is the ①Christ,’ or ‘He is over here,’ do not believe him. ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: For false christs and false prophets will arise and will provide great ①signs and wonders, so as to mislead, if possible, even the ②elect. ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracles ②Or chosen ones

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I have told you in advance.

column.name: text
column.value: So if they say to you, ‘Behold, He is in the wilderness,’ do not go out; or, ‘Behold, He is in the inner rooms,’ do not believe them.

column.name: text
column.value: For just as the lightning comes from the east and flashes as far as the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man ①be. ▷ ①I.e., be visible everywhere

column.name: text
column.value: Wherever the corpse is, there the ①vultures will gather. ▷ ①Or eagles

column.name: text
