column.value: “But immediately after the tribulation of those days THE SUN WILL BE DARKENED, AND THE MOON WILL NOT GIVE ITS LIGHT, AND THE STARS WILL FALL from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

column.name: text
column.value: And then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky, and then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the SON OF MAN COMING ON THE CLOUDS OF THE SKY with power and great glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And He will send forth His angels with A GREAT TRUMPET BLAST, and THEY WILL GATHER TOGETHER His ①elect from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other. ▷ ①Or chosen ones

column.name: text
column.value: “Now learn the parable from the fig tree: as soon as its branch has become tender and sprouts its leaves, you know that summer is near;

column.name: text
column.value: so you too, when you see all these things, ①recognize that ②He is near, right at the ③door. ▷ ①Or know ②Or it ③Lit doors

column.name: text
column.value: Truly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things take place.

column.name: text
column.value: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will not pass away.

column.name: text
column.value: “But about that day and hour no one knows, not even the angels of heaven, nor the Son, but the Father alone.

column.name: text
column.value: For ①the coming of the Son of Man will be just like the days of Noah. ▷ ①Lit just like the days...so will be

column.name: text
column.value: For as in those days before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered the ark,

column.name: text
column.value: and they did not ①understand until the flood came and took them all away; so will the coming of the Son of Man be. ▷ ①Lit know

column.name: text
column.value: At that time there will be two men in the field; one ①will be taken and one ②will be left. ▷ ①Lit is ②Lit is

column.name: text
column.value: Two women will be grinding at the ①mill; one ②will be taken and one ③will be left. ▷ ①I.e., handmill ②Lit is ③Lit is

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore be on the alert, for you do not know which day your Lord is coming.

column.name: text
column.value: But ①be sure of this, that if the head of the house had known at what time of the night the thief was coming, he would have been on the alert and would not have allowed his house to be broken into. ▷ ①Lit know that

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason you must be ready as well; for the Son of Man is coming at an hour when you do not think He will.

column.name: text
column.value: “Who then is the faithful and sensible slave whom his ①master put in charge of his household slaves, to give them their food at the proper time? ▷ ①Or lord

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is that slave whom his ①master finds so doing when he comes. ▷ ①Or lord

column.name: text
column.value: Truly I say to you that he will put him in charge of all his possessions.

column.name: text
column.value: But if that evil slave says in his heart, ‘My ①master ②is not coming for a long time,’ ▷ ①Or lord ②Lit lingers

column.name: text
column.value: and he begins to beat his fellow slaves, and he eats and drinks with those habitually drunk;

column.name: text
column.value: then the ①master of that slave will come on a day that he does not expect, and at an hour that he does not know, ▷ ①Or lord

column.name: text
column.value: and he will ①cut him in two and assign ②him a place with the hypocrites; in that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth. ▷ ①Possibly referring to other extreme punishment ②Lit his portion with

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus had finished all these words, He said to His disciples,

column.name: text
column.value: “You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man is to be handed over for crucifixion.”

column.name: text
column.value: At that time the chief priests and the elders of the people were gathered together in the courtyard of the high priest named Caiaphas;

column.name: text
column.value: and they plotted together to arrest Jesus covertly and kill Him.

column.name: text
column.value: But they were saying, “Not during the festival, otherwise a riot might occur among the people.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, at the home of Simon ①the Leper, ▷ ①I.e., a nickname; the man no doubt was cured

column.name: text
column.value: a woman came to Him with an alabaster vial of very expensive perfume, and she poured it on His head as He was reclining at the table.

column.name: text
column.value: But the disciples were indignant when they saw this, and said, “Why this waste?

column.name: text
column.value: For this perfume could have been sold for a high price and the money given to the poor.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus, aware of this, said to them, “Why are you bothering the woman? For she has done a good deed for Me.

column.name: text
column.value: For you always have the poor with you; but you do not always have Me.

column.name: text
column.value: For when she poured this perfume on My body, she did it to prepare Me for burial.

column.name: text
column.value: Truly I say to you, wherever this gospel is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be told in memory of her.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then one of the twelve, named Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests

column.name: text
column.value: and said, “What are you willing to give me ①to ②betray Him to you?” And they set out for him thirty ③pieces of silver. ▷ ①Lit and I will ②Or hand Him over to ③I.e., silver shekels

column.name: text
column.value: And from then on he looked for a good opportunity to ①betray ②Jesus. ▷ ①Or hand over ②Lit Him

column.name: text
column.value: Now on the first day of ①Unleavened Bread the disciples came to Jesus and ②asked, “Where do You want us to prepare for You to eat the Passover?” ▷ ①I.e., Passover week ②Lit said

column.name: text
column.value: And He said, “Go into the city to a certain man, and say to him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is near; I am keeping the Passover at your house with My disciples.” ’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: The disciples did as Jesus had directed them; and they prepared the Passover.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when evening came, Jesus was reclining at the table with the ①twelve. ▷ ①One early ms twelve disciples

column.name: text
column.value: And as they were eating, He said, “Truly I say to you that one of you will betray Me.”

column.name: text
column.value: Being deeply grieved, they began saying to Him, each one: “Surely it is not I, Lord?”

column.name: text
column.value: And He answered, “He who dipped his hand with Me in the bowl is the one who will betray Me.

column.name: text
column.value: The Son of Man is going away just as it is written about Him; but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would have been good ①for that man if he had not been born.” ▷ ①Lit for him if that man had not

column.name: text
column.value: And Judas, who was betraying Him, said, “Surely it is not I, Rabbi?” Jesus *said to him, “You have said it yourself.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now while they were eating, Jesus took some bread, and ①after a blessing, He broke it and gave it to the disciples, and said, “Take, eat; this is My body.” ▷ ①Lit having blessed

column.name: text
column.value: And when He had taken a cup and given thanks, He gave it to them, saying, “Drink from it, all of you;

column.name: text
column.value: for this is My blood of the covenant, which is being poured out for many for forgiveness of sins.

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you, I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it with you, new, in My Father’s kingdom.”

column.name: text
column.value: And after singing a ①hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives. ▷ ①Ps 113-118 were traditionally sung at Passover

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus *said to them, “You will all ①fall away because of Me this night, for it is written: ‘I WILL STRIKE THE SHEPHERD, AND THE SHEEP OF THE FLOCK WILL BE SCATTERED.’ ▷ ①I.e., have a lapse in faith

column.name: text
column.value: But after I have been raised, I will go ahead of you to Galilee.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter replied to Him, “Even if they all ①fall away because of You, I will never fall away!” ▷ ①I.e., from the faith

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to him, “Truly I say to you that this very night, before a rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.”

column.name: text
column.value: Peter *said to Him, “Even if I have to die with You, I will not deny You!” All the disciples said the same thing as well.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus *came with them to a place called ①Gethsemane, and *told His disciples, “Sit here while I go over there and pray.” ▷ ①I.e., oil press

column.name: text
column.value: And He took Peter and the two sons of Zebedee with Him, and began to be grieved and distressed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He *said to them, “My soul is deeply grieved, to the point of death; remain here and keep watch with Me.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He went a little beyond them, and fell on His face and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from Me; yet not as I will, but as You will.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He *came to the disciples and *found them sleeping, and He *said to Peter, “So, you men could not keep watch with Me for one hour?

column.name: text
column.value: Keep watching and praying, so that you do not come into temptation; the spirit is ①willing, but the flesh is weak.” ▷ ①Or eager

column.name: text
column.value: He went away again a second time and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup cannot pass away unless I drink from it, Your will be done.”

column.name: text
column.value: Again He came and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

column.name: text
column.value: And He left them again, and went away and prayed a third time, saying the same thing once more.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He *came to the disciples and *said to them, “ ①Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour ②is at hand and the Son of Man is being betrayed into the hands of sinners. ▷ ①Or Keep on sleeping for the time remaining and ②Or has approached

column.name: text
column.value: Get up, let’s go; behold, the one who is betraying Me is near!”

column.name: text
column.value: And while He was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came ①accompanied by a large crowd with swords and clubs, who came from the chief priests and elders of the people. ▷ ①Lit and with him

column.name: text
column.value: Now he who was betraying Him gave them a sign previously, saying, “Whomever I kiss, He is the one; arrest Him.”

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately Judas went up to Jesus and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed Him.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said to him, “Friend, do what you have come for.” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus and arrested Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, one of those who were with Jesus ①reached and drew his sword, and struck the slave of the high priest and ②cut off his ear. ▷ ①Lit extended the hand ②Lit took off

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus *said to him, “Put your sword back into its place; for all those who take up the sword will perish by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Or do you think that I cannot appeal to My Father, and He will at once put at My disposal more than twelve ①legions of angels? ▷ ①A legion equaled 6,000 troops

column.name: text
column.value: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled, which say that it must happen this way?”

column.name: text
column.value: At that time Jesus said to the crowds, “Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me as you would against a man inciting a revolt? Every day I used to sit within the temple grounds teaching, and you did not arrest Me.

column.name: text
column.value: But all this has taken place so that the Scriptures of the prophets will be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left Him and fled.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who had arrested Jesus led Him away to Caiaphas, the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter was following Him at a distance, as far as the courtyard of the high priest, and he came inside and sat down with the ①officers to see the outcome. ▷ ①Or servants

column.name: text
column.value: Now the chief priests and the entire ①Council kept trying to obtain false testimony against Jesus, so that they might put Him to death. ▷ ①Or Sanhedrin

column.name: text
column.value: They did not find any, even though many false witnesses came forward. But later on two came forward,

column.name: text
column.value: and said, “This man stated, ‘I am able to destroy the ①temple of God and to rebuild it ②in three days.’ ” ▷ ①Or sanctuary ②Or after

column.name: text
column.value: The high priest stood up and said to Him, “Do You offer no answer for what these men are testifying against You?”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus kept silent. And the high priest said to Him, “I place You under oath by the living God, to tell us whether You are the ①Christ, the Son of God.” ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *said to him, “You have said it yourself. But I tell you, from now on you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of power, and coming on the clouds of heaven.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the high priest tore his ①robes and said, “He has blasphemed! What further need do we have of witnesses? See, you have now heard the blasphemy; ▷ ①Or outer garments

column.name: text
column.value: what do you think?” They answered, “He deserves death!”

column.name: text
column.value: Then they spit in His face and beat Him with their fists; and others ①slapped Him, ▷ ①Or possibly beat Him with rods

column.name: text
column.value: and said, “Prophesy to us, You ①Christ; who is the one who hit You?” ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: Now Peter was sitting outside in the courtyard, and a slave woman came to him and said, “You too were with Jesus the Galilean.”

column.name: text
column.value: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I do not know what you are talking about.”

column.name: text
column.value: When he had gone out to the gateway, another slave woman saw him and *said to those who were there, “This man was with Jesus of Nazareth.”

column.name: text
column.value: And again he denied it, with an oath: “I do not know the man.”

column.name: text
column.value: A little later the bystanders came up and said to Peter, “You really are one of them as well, since even the way you talk ①gives you away.” ▷ ①Lit makes you evident

column.name: text
column.value: Then he began to curse and swear, “I do not know the man!” And immediately a rooster crowed.

column.name: text
column.value: And Peter remembered the statement that Jesus had ①made: “Before a rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.” And he went out and wept bitterly. ▷ ①Lit said

column.name: text
column.value: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to look at the tomb.

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, a severe earthquake had occurred, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven and came and rolled away the stone, and sat upon it.

column.name: text
column.value: And his appearance was like lightning, and his clothing as white as snow.

column.name: text
column.value: The guards shook from fear of him and became like dead men.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel said to the women, “ ①Do not be afraid; for I know that you are looking for Jesus who has been crucified. ▷ ①Or Stop being afraid

column.name: text
column.value: He is not here, for He has risen, just as He said. Come, see the place where He was lying.

column.name: text
column.value: And go quickly and tell His disciples that He has risen from the dead; and behold, He is going ahead of you to Galilee. There you will see Him; behold, I have told you.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they left the tomb quickly with fear and great joy, and ran to report to His disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, Jesus met them ①and said, “ ②Rejoice!” And they came up and took hold of His feet, and worshiped Him. ▷ ①Lit saying ②Or Greetings

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus *said to them, “ ①Do not be afraid; go, bring word to My brothers to leave for Galilee, and there they will see Me.” ▷ ①Or Stop being afraid

column.name: text
column.value: Now while they were on their way, some of the men from the guard came into the city and reported to the chief priests all that had happened.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had assembled with the elders and consulted together, they gave a large sum of money to the soldiers,

column.name: text
column.value: and said, “You are to say, ‘His disciples came at night and stole Him while we were asleep.’

column.name: text
column.value: And if this comes to the governor’s ears, we will appease him and ①keep you out of trouble.” ▷ ①Lit make you free from care

column.name: text
column.value: And they took the money and did as they had been instructed; and this story was widely spread among the Jews and is to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: But the eleven disciples proceeded to Galilee, to the mountain which Jesus had designated to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they saw Him, they worshiped Him; but some ①were doubtful. ▷ ①Or hesitated

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus came up and spoke to them, saying, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Go, therefore, and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, ▷ ①Or Having gone (Gr aorist part.)

column.name: text
column.value: teaching them to ①follow all that I commanded you; and behold, I am with you ②always, to the end of the age.” ▷ ①Or keep ②Lit all the days

column.name: text
column.value: “Then the kingdom of heaven will be comparable to ten virgins, who took their lamps and went out to meet the groom.

column.name: text
column.value: Five of them were foolish, and five were prudent.

column.name: text
column.value: For when the foolish took their lamps, they did not take extra oil with them;

column.name: text
column.value: but the prudent ones took oil in flasks with their lamps.

column.name: text
column.value: Now while the groom was delaying, they all became drowsy and began to sleep.

column.name: text
column.value: But at midnight ①there finally was a shout: ‘Behold, the groom! Come out to meet him.’ ▷ ①Lit a shout has occurred

column.name: text
column.value: Then all those virgins got up and trimmed their lamps.

column.name: text
column.value: But the foolish virgins said to the prudent ones, ‘Give us some of your oil, because our lamps are going out.’

column.name: text
column.value: However, the prudent ones answered, ‘No, there most certainly would not be enough for us and you too; go instead to the merchants and buy some for yourselves.’

column.name: text
column.value: But while they were ①on their way to buy the oil, the groom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast; and the door was shut. ▷ ①Lit departing

column.name: text
column.value: Yet later, the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, lord, open up for us.’

column.name: text
column.value: But he answered, ‘Truly I say to you, I do not know you.’

column.name: text
column.value: Be on the alert then, because you do not know the day nor the hour.

column.name: text
column.value: “For it is just like a man about to go on a journey, who called his own slaves and entrusted his possessions to them.

column.name: text
column.value: To one he gave five ①talents, to another, two, and to another, one, each according to his own ability; and he went on his journey. ▷ ①A talent was worth about fifteen years’ wages for a laborer

column.name: text
column.value: The one who had received the five talents immediately went and did business with them, and earned five more talents.

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way the one who had received the two talents earned two more.

column.name: text
column.value: But he who received the one talent went away and dug a hole in the ground, and hid his ①master’s money. ▷ ①Or lord’s

column.name: text
column.value: “Now after a long time the master of those slaves *came and *settled accounts with them.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who had received the five talents came up and brought five more talents, saying, ‘Master, you entrusted five talents to me. See, I have earned five more talents.’

column.name: text
column.value: His master said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful slave. You were faithful with a few things, I will put you in charge of many things; enter the joy of your ①master.’ ▷ ①Or lord

column.name: text
column.value: “Also the one who had received the two talents came up and said, ‘Master, you entrusted two talents to me. See, I have earned two more talents.’

column.name: text
column.value: His master said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful slave. You were faithful with a few things, I will put you in charge of many things; enter the joy of your master.’

column.name: text
column.value: “Now the one who had received the one talent also came up and said, ‘Master, I knew you to be a hard man, reaping where you did not sow, and gathering where you did not scatter seed.

column.name: text
column.value: And I was afraid, so I went away and hid your talent in the ground. See, you still have what is yours.’

column.name: text
column.value: “But his master answered and said to him, ‘You ①worthless, lazy slave! Did you know that I reap where I did not sow, and gather where I did not scatter seed? ▷ ①Or wicked

column.name: text
column.value: Then you ought to have ①put my money in the bank, and ②on my arrival I would have received my money back with interest. ▷ ①Lit cast...to the bankers ②Lit having come

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore: take the talent away from him, and give it to the one who has the ten talents.’

column.name: text
column.value: “For to everyone who has, more shall be given, and he will have an abundance; but from the one who does not have, even what he does have shall be taken away.

column.name: text
column.value: And throw the worthless slave into the outer darkness; in that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

column.name: text
column.value: “But when the Son of Man comes in His glory, and all the angels with Him, then He will sit on His glorious throne.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the nations will be gathered before Him; and He will separate them from one another, just as the shepherd separates the sheep from the goats;

column.name: text
column.value: and He will put the sheep on His right, but the goats on the left.

column.name: text
column.value: “Then the King will say to those on His right, ‘Come, you who are blessed of My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: For I was hungry, and you gave Me something to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave Me something to drink; I was a stranger, and you invited Me in;

column.name: text
column.value: naked, and you clothed Me; I was sick, and you visited Me; I was in prison, and you came to Me.’

column.name: text
column.value: Then the righteous will answer Him, ‘Lord, when did we see You hungry, and feed You, or thirsty, and give You something to drink?

column.name: text
column.value: And when did we see You as a stranger, and invite You in, or naked, and clothe You?

column.name: text
column.value: And when did we see You sick, or in prison, and come to You?’

column.name: text
column.value: And the King will answer and say to them, ‘Truly I say to you, to the extent that you did it for one of the least of these brothers or sisters of Mine, you did it for Me.’

column.name: text
column.value: “Then He will also say to those on His left, ‘Depart from Me, you accursed people, into the eternal fire which has been prepared for the devil and his angels;

column.name: text
column.value: for I was hungry, and you gave Me nothing to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave Me nothing to drink;

column.name: text
column.value: I was a stranger, and you did not invite Me in; naked, and you did not clothe Me; sick, and in prison, and you did not visit Me.’

column.name: text
column.value: Then they themselves also will answer, ‘Lord, when did we see You hungry, or thirsty, or as a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not ①take care of You?’ ▷ ①Or serve

column.name: text
column.value: Then He will answer them, ‘Truly I say to you, to the extent that you did not do it for one of the least of these, you did not do it for Me, either.’

column.name: text
column.value: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now when morning came, all the chief priests and the elders of the people conferred together against Jesus to put Him to death;

column.name: text
column.value: and they bound Him and led Him away, and handed Him over to Pilate the governor.

column.name: text
column.value: Then when Judas, who had betrayed Him, saw that He had been condemned, he felt remorse and returned the thirty ①pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders, ▷ ①Or silver shekels

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “I have sinned by betraying innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You shall see to it yourself!”

column.name: text
column.value: And he threw the pieces of silver into the temple sanctuary and left; and he went away and hanged himself.

column.name: text
column.value: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It is not lawful to put them in the temple treasury, since it is money paid for blood.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they conferred together and ①with the money bought the Potter’s Field as a burial place for strangers. ▷ ①Lit from them

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason that field has been called the Field of Blood to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled: “AND ①THEY TOOK THE THIRTY PIECES OF SILVER, THE PRICE OF THE ONE WHOSE PRICE HAD BEEN SET by the sons of Israel; ▷ ①Or I took; cf. Zech

column.name: text
column.value: AND ①THEY GAVE THEM FOR THE POTTER’S FIELD, JUST AS THE LORD DIRECTED ME.” ▷ ①Some early mss I gave

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor questioned Him, saying, “So You are the King of the Jews?” And Jesus said to him, “It is as you say.”

column.name: text
column.value: And while He was being accused by the chief priests and elders, He did not offer any answer.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Pilate *said to Him, “Do You not hear how many things they are testifying against You?”

column.name: text
column.value: And still He did not answer him in regard to even a single ①charge, so the governor was greatly amazed. ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: Now at the Passover Feast the governor was accustomed to release for the ①people any one prisoner whom they wanted. ▷ ①Lit crowd

column.name: text
column.value: And at that time they were holding a notorious prisoner called Barabbas.

column.name: text
column.value: So when the people gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release for you: Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”

column.name: text
column.value: For he knew that it was because of envy that ①they had handed Him over. ▷ ①I.e., the Jewish leaders

column.name: text
column.value: And while he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent him a message, saying, “See that you have nothing to do with that righteous Man; for ①last night I suffered greatly in a dream because of Him.” ▷ ①Lit today

column.name: text
column.value: But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowds to ask for Barabbas, and to put Jesus to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And the governor ①said to them, “Which of the two do you want me to release for you?” And they said, “Barabbas.” ▷ ①Lit answering, said to them

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate *said to them, “Then what shall I do with Jesus who is called Christ?” They all *said, “ ①Crucify Him!” ▷ ①Lit Have Him crucified

column.name: text
column.value: But he said, “Why, what evil has He done?” Yet they kept shouting all the more, saying, “ ①Crucify Him!” ▷ ①Lit Have Him crucified

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Pilate saw that he was accomplishing nothing, but rather that a riot was starting, he took water and washed his hands in front of the crowd, saying, “I am innocent of this Man’s blood; you yourselves shall see.”

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people replied, “His blood shall be on us and on our children!”

column.name: text
column.value: Then he released Barabbas ①for them; but after having Jesus flogged, he handed Him over to be crucified. ▷ ①Or to them

column.name: text
column.value: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the ①Praetorium and gathered the whole Roman ②cohort to Him. ▷ ①I.e., the governor’s official residence ②Normally 600 men (the number varied)

column.name: text
column.value: And they stripped Him and put a red ①cloak on Him. ▷ ①I.e., a Roman soldier’s cloak

column.name: text
column.value: And after twisting together a crown of thorns, they put it on His head, and put a ①reed in His right hand; and they knelt down before Him and mocked Him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” ▷ ①Or staff; i.e., to mimic a king’s scepter

column.name: text
column.value: And they spit on Him, and took the reed and beat Him on the head.

column.name: text
column.value: And after they had mocked Him, they took the cloak off Him and put His own garments back on Him, and led Him away to crucify Him.

column.name: text
column.value: As they were coming out, they found a man of Cyrene named Simon, ①whom they compelled to carry His ②cross. ▷ ①Lit this one ②I.e., the crossbeam for a cross

column.name: text
column.value: And when they came to a place called Golgotha, which means Place of a Skull,

column.name: text
column.value: they gave Him wine mixed with ①bile to drink; and after tasting it, He was unwilling to drink it. ▷ ①Prob. referring to the taste of myrrh, added to lessen pain

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had crucified Him, they divided His garments among themselves by casting ①lots. ▷ ①Lit a lot

column.name: text
column.value: And sitting down, they began to keep watch over Him there.

column.name: text
column.value: And above His head they put up the charge against Him ①which read, “THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.” ▷ ①Lit written

column.name: text
column.value: At that time two ①rebels *were being crucified with Him, one on the right and one on the left. ▷ ①Or robbers

column.name: text
column.value: And those passing by were ①speaking abusively to Him, shaking their heads, ▷ ①Or blaspheming

column.name: text
column.value: and saying, “You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days, save Yourself! If You are the Son of God, come down from the cross.”

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way the chief priests also, along with the scribes and elders, were mocking Him and saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “He saved others; ①He cannot save Himself! He is the King of Israel; let Him now come down from the cross, and we will believe in Him. ▷ ①Or can He not save Himself?

column.name: text
column.value: HE HAS TRUSTED IN GOD; LET GOD RESCUE Him now, IF HE ①TAKES PLEASURE IN HIM; for He said, ‘I am the Son of God.’ ” ▷ ①Or desires;

column.name: text
column.value: And the ①rebels who had been crucified with Him were also insulting Him in the same way. ▷ ①Or robbers

column.name: text
column.value: Now from the ①sixth hour darkness ②fell upon all the land until the ③ninth hour. ▷ ①I.e., noon ②Lit occurred ③I.e., 3 p.m.

column.name: text
column.value: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried out with a loud voice, saying, “ELI, ELI, LEMA SABAKTANEI?” that is, “MY GOD, MY GOD, WHY HAVE YOU FORSAKEN ME?”

column.name: text
column.value: And some of those who were standing there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling for Elijah.”

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately one of them ran, and taking a sponge, he filled it with sour wine and put it on a reed, and gave Him a drink.

column.name: text
column.value: But the rest of them said, “ ①Let us see if Elijah comes to save Him ②.” ▷ ①Lit Allow that we see ②Some early mss And another took a spear and pierced His side, and there came out water and blood (cf. John 19:34)

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus cried out again with a loud voice, and gave up His spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, the ①veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom; and the earth shook and the rocks were split. ▷ ①Or curtain

column.name: text
column.value: Also the tombs were opened, and many bodies of the ①saints who had fallen asleep were raised; ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: and coming out of the tombs after His resurrection, they entered the holy city and appeared to many.

column.name: text
column.value: Now as for the centurion and those who were with him keeping guard over Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the other things that were happening, they became extremely frightened and said, “Truly this was ①the Son of God!” ▷ ①Or a son of God; or a son of a god

column.name: text
column.value: And many women were there watching from a distance, who had followed Jesus from Galilee while caring for Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when it was evening, a rich man from Arimathea came, named Joseph, who himself had also become a disciple of Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: This man went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus. Then Pilate ordered it to be given to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

column.name: text
column.value: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock; and he rolled a large stone against the entrance of the tomb and went away.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

column.name: text
column.value: Now on the next day, that is, the day which is after the preparation, the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered together with Pilate,

column.name: text
column.value: and they said, “Sir, we remember that when that deceiver was still alive, He said, ‘After three days I am rising.’

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, give orders for the tomb to be made secure until the third day; otherwise, His disciples may come and steal Him, and say to the people, ‘He has risen from the dead,’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard; go, make it as secure as you know how.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they went and made the tomb secure with the guard, sealing the stone.

column.name: text
column.value: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God,

column.name: text
column.value: just as it is written in Isaiah the prophet: “BEHOLD, I AM SENDING MY MESSENGER ①BEFORE YOU, WHO WILL PREPARE YOUR WAY; ▷ ①Lit before your face

column.name: text
column.value: THE VOICE OF ONE CALLING ①OUT IN THE WILDERNESS, ‘PREPARE THE WAY OF THE LORD, MAKE HIS PATHS STRAIGHT!’ ” ▷ ①Or out, Prepare in the wilderness the way

column.name: text
column.value: John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness, ①preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins. ▷ ①Or proclaiming

column.name: text
column.value: And all the country of Judea was going out to him, and all the people of Jerusalem; and they were being baptized by him in the Jordan River, confessing their sins.

column.name: text
column.value: John was clothed with camel’s hair and wore a leather belt around his waist, and ①his diet was locusts and wild honey. ▷ ①Lit was eating

column.name: text
column.value: And he was ①preaching, saying, “After me One is coming who is mightier than I, and I am not fit to bend down and untie the straps of His sandals. ▷ ①Or proclaiming

column.name: text
column.value: I baptized you ①with water; but He will baptize you ②with the Holy Spirit.” ▷ ①The Gr here can be translated in, with, or by ②The Gr here can be translated in, with, or by

column.name: text
column.value: In those days Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately coming up out of the water, He saw the heavens ①opening, and the Spirit, like a dove, descending upon Him; ▷ ①Or being parted

column.name: text
column.value: and a voice came from the heavens: “You are My beloved Son; in You I ①am well pleased.” ▷ ①Or delight

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately the Spirit *brought Him out into the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And He was in the wilderness for forty days, being tempted by Satan; and He was with the wild animals, and the angels were serving Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now after John was ①taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, ②preaching the gospel of God, ▷ ①Lit handed over ②Or proclaiming

column.name: text
column.value: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God ①is at hand; repent and ②believe in the gospel.” ▷ ①Lit has come near ②Or put your trust in

column.name: text
column.value: As He was going along the Sea of Galilee, He saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net in the sea; for they were fishermen.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to them, “Follow Me, and I will have you become fishers of people.”

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately they left their nets and followed Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And going on a little farther, He saw ①James the son of Zebedee, and his brother John, ②who were also in the boat mending the nets. ▷ ①Or Jacob ②Lit also them in

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately He called them; and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men, and went away ①to follow Him. ▷ ①Lit after Him

column.name: text
column.value: They *went into Capernaum; and immediately on the Sabbath Jesus entered the synagogue and began to teach.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were amazed at His teaching; for He was teaching them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.

column.name: text
column.value: Just then there was a man in their synagogue with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “What ①business do you have with us, Jesus ②of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are: the Holy One of God!” ▷ ①Lit What to us and to You (an ancient idiom) ②Or the Nazarene

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”

column.name: text
column.value: After throwing him into convulsions and crying out with a loud voice, the unclean spirit came out of him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were all amazed, so they debated among themselves, saying, “What is this? A new teaching with authority! He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey Him.”

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately the news about Him spread everywhere into all the surrounding region of Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately after they left the synagogue, they entered the house of Simon and Andrew, with ①James and John. ▷ ①Or Jacob

column.name: text
column.value: Now Simon’s mother-in-law was lying sick with a fever; and they immediately *spoke to ①Jesus about her. ▷ ①Lit Him

column.name: text
column.value: And He came to her and raised her up, taking her by the hand, and the fever left her, and she served them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when evening came, after the sun had set, they began bringing to Him all who were ill and those who were demon-possessed.

column.name: text
column.value: And the whole city had gathered at the door.

column.name: text
column.value: And He healed many who were ill with various diseases, and cast out many demons; and He would not permit the demons to speak, because they knew ①who He was. ▷ ①Lit Him

column.name: text
column.value: And in the early morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up, left the house, and went away to a secluded place, and prayed there for a time.

column.name: text
column.value: Simon and his companions eagerly searched for Him;

column.name: text
column.value: and they found Him and *said to Him, “Everyone is looking for You.”

column.name: text
column.value: He *said to them, “Let’s go somewhere else to the towns nearby, so that I may also ①preach there; for this is why I came.” ▷ ①Or proclaim

column.name: text
column.value: And He went into their synagogues ①preaching throughout Galilee, and casting out the demons. ▷ ①Or proclaiming

column.name: text
column.value: And a man with ①leprosy *came to ②Jesus, imploring Him and kneeling down, and saying to Him, “If You are willing, You can make me clean.” ▷ ①I.e., leprosy or a serious, unspecified disease, and so throughout the ch; see Lev 13 ②Lit Him

column.name: text
column.value: Moved with compassion, Jesus reached out with His hand and touched him, and *said to him, “I am willing; be cleansed.”

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately the leprosy left him, and he was cleansed.

column.name: text
column.value: And He sternly warned him and immediately sent him away,

column.name: text
column.value: and He *said to him, “See that you say nothing to anyone; but go, show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing what Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”

column.name: text
column.value: But he went out and began to proclaim it ①freely and to spread the news around, to such an extent that ②Jesus could no longer publicly enter a city, but ③stayed out in unpopulated areas; and they were coming to Him from everywhere. ▷ ①Lit much ②Lit He ③Lit was

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus came back to Capernaum a few days later, it was heard that He was at home.

column.name: text
column.value: And many were gathered together, so that there was no longer space, not even near the door; and He was speaking the word to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And some people *came, bringing to Him a man who was paralyzed, carried by four men.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they were unable to ①get to Him because of the crowd, they removed the roof ②above Him; and after digging an opening, they let down the pallet on which the paralyzed man was lying. ▷ ①Lit bring to ②Lit where He was

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus, seeing their faith, *said to the paralyzed man, “Son, your sins are forgiven.”

column.name: text
column.value: But some of the scribes were sitting there and thinking it over in their hearts,

column.name: text
column.value: “Why does this man speak that way? He is blaspheming! Who can forgive sins except God alone?”

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately Jesus, aware ①in His spirit that they were thinking that way within themselves, *said to them, “Why are you thinking about these things in your hearts? ▷ ①Lit by

column.name: text
column.value: Which is easier, to say to the paralyzed man, ‘Your sins are forgiven’; or to say, ‘Get up, and pick up your pallet and walk’?

column.name: text
column.value: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—He *said to the paralyzed man,

column.name: text
column.value: “I say to you, get up, pick up your pallet, and go home.”

column.name: text
column.value: And he got up and immediately picked up the pallet and went out in the sight of everyone, so that they were all amazed and were glorifying God, saying, “We have never seen anything like this!”

column.name: text
column.value: And He went out again by the seashore; and all the ①people were coming to Him, and He was teaching them. ▷ ①Lit crowd

column.name: text
column.value: As He passed by, He saw ①Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting in the tax office, and He *said to him, “Follow Me!” And he got up and followed Him. ▷ ①Also called Matthew

column.name: text
column.value: And it *happened that He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and ①sinners were ②dining with Jesus and His disciples; for there were many of them, and they were following Him. ▷ ①I.e., irreligious Jews ②Lit reclining with

column.name: text
column.value: When the scribes of the Pharisees saw that He was eating with the ①sinners and tax collectors, they said to His disciples, “Why is He eating with tax collectors and ②sinners?” ▷ ①I.e., irreligious Jews ②I.e., irreligious Jews

column.name: text
column.value: And hearing this, Jesus *said to them, “It is not those who are healthy who need a physician, but those who are sick; I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”

column.name: text
column.value: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting; and they *came and *said to Him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but Your disciples do not fast?”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to them, “While the groom is with them, ①the attendants of the groom cannot fast, can they? As long as they have the groom with them, they cannot fast. ▷ ①Lit sons of the bridal chamber

column.name: text
column.value: But the days will come when the groom is taken away from them, and then they will fast, on that day.

column.name: text
column.value: “No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; otherwise, ①the patch pulls away from it, the new from the old, and a worse tear results. ▷ ①Lit that which fills up

column.name: text
column.value: And no one puts new wine into old wineskins; otherwise the wine will burst the skins, and the wine is lost and the skins as well; but one puts new wine into fresh wineskins.”

column.name: text
column.value: And it happened that He was passing through the grainfields on the Sabbath, and His disciples began to make their way along while picking the heads of grain.

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees were saying to Him, “Look, why are they doing what is not lawful on the Sabbath?”

column.name: text
column.value: And He *said to them, “Have you never read what David did when he was in need and he and his companions became hungry;

column.name: text
column.value: how he entered the house of God in the ①time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the ②consecrated bread, which is not lawful for anyone to eat except the priests, and he also gave it to those who were with him?” ▷ ①Or passage about ②Lit loaves of presentation

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, “The Sabbath ①was made ②for man, and not man ③for the Sabbath. ▷ ①Or came into being ②Lit because of; or for the sake of ③Lit because of; or for the sake of

column.name: text
column.value: So the Son of Man is Lord, even of the Sabbath.”

column.name: text
column.value: He entered a synagogue again; and a man was there whose hand was withered.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were watching Him ①closely to see if He would heal him on the Sabbath, so that they might accuse Him. ▷ ①Or maliciously

column.name: text
column.value: He *said to the man with the withered hand, “ ①Get up and come forward!” ▷ ①Lit Arise into the midst

column.name: text
column.value: And He *said to them, “Is it lawful to do good on the Sabbath or to do harm, to save a life or to kill?” But they kept silent.

column.name: text
column.value: After looking around at them with anger, grieved at their hardness of heart, He *said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” And he stretched it out, and his hand was restored.

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees went out and immediately began ①conspiring with the Herodians against Him, as to how they might put Him to death. ▷ ①Lit giving counsel

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus withdrew to the sea with His disciples; and a large multitude from Galilee followed, and also from Judea,

column.name: text
column.value: and from Jerusalem, and from Idumea, and beyond the Jordan, and the vicinity of Tyre and Sidon, a great number of people heard about everything that He was doing and came to Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And He told His disciples to see that a boat would be ready for Him because of the ①masses, so that they would not crowd Him; ▷ ①Lit crowd

column.name: text
column.value: for He had healed many, with the result that all those who had diseases pushed in around Him in order to touch Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And whenever the unclean spirits saw Him, they would fall down before Him and shout, “You are the Son of God!”

column.name: text
column.value: And He strongly warned them not to ①reveal who He was. ▷ ①Lit make Him known

column.name: text
column.value: And He *went up on the mountain and *summoned those whom He Himself wanted, and they came to Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And He appointed twelve, so that they would be with Him and that He could send them out to preach,

column.name: text
column.value: and to have authority to cast out the demons.

column.name: text
column.value: And He appointed the twelve: Simon (to whom He gave the name Peter),

column.name: text
column.value: ①James the son of Zebedee and John the brother of ②James (to them He gave the name Boanerges, which means, “Sons of Thunder”); ▷ ①Or Jacob ②Or Jacob

column.name: text
column.value: and Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, ①James the son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, and Simon the ②Zealot; ▷ ①Or Jacob ②Or Cananaean

column.name: text
column.value: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And He *came ①home, and the crowd *gathered again, to such an extent that they could not even eat ②a meal. ▷ ①Lit into a house ②Lit bread

column.name: text
column.value: And when His own ①people heard about this, they came out to take custody of Him; for they were saying, “He has lost His senses.” ▷ ①Or family

column.name: text
column.value: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem were saying, “He ①is possessed by ②Beelzebul,” and “He casts out the demons by the ruler of the demons.” ▷ ①Lit has Beelzebul ②One early ms Beezebul; some early ancient versions Beelzebub

column.name: text
column.value: And so He called them to Himself and began speaking to them in parables: “How can Satan cast out Satan?

column.name: text
column.value: And if a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

column.name: text
column.value: If a house is divided against itself, that house will not be able to stand.

column.name: text
column.value: And if Satan has risen up against himself and is divided, he cannot stand, but ①he is finished! ▷ ①Lit he has an end

column.name: text
column.value: But no one can enter the strong man’s house and plunder his property unless he first ties up the strong man, and then he will plunder his house.

column.name: text
column.value: “Truly I say to you, all sins will be forgiven the sons and daughters of men, and whatever blasphemies they commit;

column.name: text
column.value: but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is guilty of an eternal sin”—

column.name: text
column.value: because they were saying, “He has an unclean spirit.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then His mother and His brothers *came, and while standing outside they sent word to Him, calling for Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And a crowd was sitting around Him, and they *said to Him, “Behold, Your mother and Your brothers are outside looking for You.”

column.name: text
column.value: Answering them, He *said, “Who are My mother and My brothers?”

column.name: text
column.value: And looking around at those who were sitting around Him, He *said, “Here are My mother and My brothers!

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever does the will of God, this is My brother, and sister, and mother.”

column.name: text
column.value: They came to the other side of the sea, into the region of the Gerasenes.

column.name: text
column.value: When He got out of the boat, immediately a man from the tombs with an unclean spirit met Him.

column.name: text
column.value: He lived among the tombs; and no one was able to bind him anymore, not even with a chain,

column.name: text
column.value: because he had often been bound with shackles and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him and the shackles broken in pieces; and no one was strong enough to subdue him.

column.name: text
column.value: Constantly, night and day, he was screaming among the tombs and in the mountains, and cutting himself with stones.

column.name: text
column.value: Seeing Jesus from a distance, he ran up and bowed down before Him;

column.name: text
column.value: and shouting with a loud voice, he *said, “ ①What business do You have with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I implore You by God, do not torment me!” ▷ ①Lit What to me and to you (an ancient idiom)

column.name: text
column.value: For He had already been saying to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”

column.name: text
column.value: And He was asking him, “What is your name?” And he *said to Him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”

column.name: text
column.value: And he begged Him earnestly not to send them out of the region.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was a large herd of pigs feeding ①nearby on the mountain. ▷ ①Lit there

column.name: text
column.value: And the demons begged Him, saying, “Send us into the pigs so that we may enter them.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus gave them permission. And coming out, the unclean spirits entered the pigs; and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea, about two thousand of them; and they were drowned in the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: Their herdsmen ran away and reported it in the city and in the countryside. And the people came to see what it was that had happened.

column.name: text
column.value: And then they *came to Jesus and *saw the man who had been demon-possessed sitting down, clothed and in his right mind, the very man who had previously had the “legion”; and they became frightened.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who had seen it described to them how it had happened to the demon-possessed man, and all about the pigs.

column.name: text
column.value: And they began to beg Him to leave their region.

column.name: text
column.value: And as He was getting into the boat, the man who had been demon-possessed was begging Him that he might ①accompany Him. ▷ ①Lit be with Him

column.name: text
column.value: And He did not let him, but He *said to him, “Go home to your people and report to them ①what great things the Lord has done for you, and how He had mercy on you.” ▷ ①Or everything that

column.name: text
column.value: And he went away and began to proclaim in Decapolis ①what great things Jesus had done for him; and everyone was amazed. ▷ ①Or everything that

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus had crossed over again in the boat to the other side, a large crowd gathered around Him; and He ①stayed by the seashore. ▷ ①Lit was by the sea

column.name: text
column.value: And one of the synagogue ①officials, named Jairus, *came, and upon seeing Him, *fell at His feet ▷ ①Or rulers

column.name: text
column.value: and *pleaded with Him earnestly, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death; please come and lay Your hands on her, so that she will ①get well and live.” ▷ ①Lit be saved

column.name: text
column.value: And He went off with him; and a large crowd was following Him and pressing in on Him.

column.name: text
column.value: A woman who had had a hemorrhage for twelve years,

column.name: text
column.value: and had endured much at the hands of many physicians, and had spent all that she had and was not helped at all, but instead had become worse—

column.name: text
column.value: after hearing about Jesus, she came up in the crowd behind Him and touched His ①cloak. ▷ ①Or outer garment

column.name: text
column.value: For she had been saying to herself, “If I just touch His garments, I will ①get well.” ▷ ①Lit be saved

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately the flow of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of her disease.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately Jesus, perceiving in Himself that power from Him had gone out, turned around in the crowd and said, “Who touched My garments?”

column.name: text
column.value: And His disciples said to Him, “You see the crowd pressing in on You, and You say, ‘Who touched Me?’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: And He looked around to see the woman who had done this.

column.name: text
column.value: But the woman, fearing and trembling, aware of what had happened to her, came and fell down before Him and told Him the whole truth.

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has ①made you well; go in peace and be cured of your disease.” ▷ ①Lit saved you

column.name: text
column.value: While He was still speaking, people *came from the house of the synagogue official, saying, “Your daughter has died; why bother the Teacher further?”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus, overhearing what was being spoken, *said to the synagogue official, “Do not be afraid, only ①believe.” ▷ ①Or keep on believing

column.name: text
column.value: And He allowed no one to accompany Him except Peter, ①James, and John the brother of ②James. ▷ ①Or Jacob ②Or Jacob

column.name: text
column.value: They *came to the house of the synagogue official, and He *saw a commotion, and people loudly weeping and wailing.

column.name: text
column.value: And after entering, He *said to them, “Why are you making a commotion and weeping? The child has not died, but is asleep.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they began laughing at Him. But putting them all outside, He *took along the child’s father and mother and His own companions, and *entered the room where the child was in bed.

column.name: text
column.value: And taking the child by the hand, He *said to her, “Talitha, kum!” (which translated means, “Little girl, I say to you, get up!”).

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately the girl got up and began to walk, for she was twelve years old. And immediately they were completely astonished.

column.name: text
column.value: And He gave them strict orders that no one was to know about this, and He told them to have something given her to eat.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus went out from there and *came into ①His hometown; and His disciples *followed Him. ▷ ①Or His own part of the country

column.name: text
column.value: And when the Sabbath came, He began to teach in the synagogue; and ①the many listeners were astonished, saying, “Where did this man learn these things, and what is this wisdom that has been given to Him, and such ②miracles as these performed by His hands? ▷ ①One early ms many listeners ②Or works of power

column.name: text
column.value: Is this not the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of ①James, Joses, Judas, and Simon? And are His sisters not here with us?” And they took offense at Him. ▷ ①Or Jacob

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not dishonored except in ①his hometown and among his own relatives, and in his own household.” ▷ ①Or his own part of the country

column.name: text
column.value: And He could not do any ①miracle there except that He laid His hands on a few sick people and healed them. ▷ ①Or work of power

column.name: text
column.value: And He was amazed at their unbelief. And He was going around the villages, teaching.

column.name: text
column.value: And He *summoned the twelve and began to send them out in pairs, and gave them authority over the unclean spirits;

column.name: text
column.value: and He instructed them that they were to take nothing for their journey, except a mere staff—no bread, no ①bag, no money in their belt— ▷ ①Or knapsack; or beggar’s bag

column.name: text
column.value: but ①to wear sandals; and He added, “Do not wear two ②tunics.” ▷ ①Lit having tied on ②A long shirt worn next to the skin

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “Wherever you enter a house, stay there until you ①leave town. ▷ ①Lit go out from there

column.name: text
column.value: Any place that does not receive you or listen to you, as you go out from there, shake the dust ①off the soles of your feet as a testimony against them.” ▷ ①Lit under your feet

column.name: text
column.value: And they went out and ①preached that people are to repent. ▷ ①Or proclaimed as heralds

column.name: text
column.value: And they were casting out many demons and were anointing with oil many sick people and healing them.

column.name: text
column.value: And King Herod heard about it, for His name had become well known; and people were saying, “John the Baptist has risen from the dead, and that is why these miraculous powers are at work in Him.”

column.name: text
column.value: But others were saying, “He is Elijah.” And others were saying, “He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of old.”

column.name: text
column.value: But when Herod heard about it, he kept saying, “John, whom I beheaded, has risen!”

column.name: text
column.value: For Herod himself had sent men and had John arrested and bound in prison on account of Herodias, the wife of his brother Philip, because he had married her.

column.name: text
column.value: For John had been saying to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Herodias held a grudge against him and wanted to put him to death, and could not do so;

column.name: text
column.value: for Herod was afraid of John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and he had been protecting him. And when he heard him, he was very perplexed; and yet he ①used to enjoy listening to him. ▷ ①Lit was hearing him gladly

column.name: text
column.value: An opportune day came when Herod, on his birthday, held a banquet for his nobles and military commanders, and the leading people of Galilee;

column.name: text
column.value: and when the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and ①his dinner guests; and the king said to the girl, “Ask me for whatever you want, and I will give it to you.” ▷ ①Lit those who reclined at the table with him

column.name: text
column.value: And he swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give it to you, up to half of my kingdom.”

column.name: text
column.value: And she went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask for?” And she said, “The head of John the Baptist.”

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately she came in a hurry to the king and asked, saying, “I want you to give me at once the head of John the Baptist on a platter.”

column.name: text
column.value: And although the king was very sorry, because of his oaths and ①his dinner guests, he was unwilling to refuse her. ▷ ①Lit those reclining at the table

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately the king sent an executioner and commanded him to bring back his head. And he went and beheaded him in the prison,

column.name: text
column.value: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the girl; and the girl gave it to her mother.

column.name: text
column.value: When his disciples heard about this, they came and carried away his body, and laid it in a tomb.

column.name: text
column.value: The apostles *gathered together with Jesus; and they reported to Him all that they had done and taught.

column.name: text
column.value: And He *said to them, “Come away by yourselves to a secluded place and rest a little while.” (For there were many people coming and going, and they did not even have time to eat.)

column.name: text
column.value: And they went away in the boat to a secluded place by themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: The people saw them going, and many recognized them and ran there together on foot from all the cities, and got there ahead of them.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus went ①ashore, He saw a large crowd, and He felt compassion for them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and He began to teach them many things. ▷ ①Lit out

column.name: text
column.value: And when it was already late, His disciples came up to Him and said, “ ①This place is secluded and it is already late; ▷ ①Lit The

column.name: text
column.value: send them away so that they may go into the surrounding countryside and villages and buy themselves ①something to eat.” ▷ ①Lit what they may eat

column.name: text
column.value: But He answered them, “You give them something to eat!” And they *said to Him, “Shall we go and spend two hundred ①denarii on bread, and give it to them to eat?” ▷ ①The denarius was a day’s wages for a laborer

column.name: text
column.value: But He *said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go look!” And when they found out, they *said, “Five, and two fish.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He ordered them all to recline by groups on the green grass.

column.name: text
column.value: They reclined in groups of hundreds and fifties.

column.name: text
column.value: And He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up toward heaven, He blessed the food and broke the loaves and He gave them to the disciples again and again to set before them; and He divided the two fish among them all.

column.name: text
column.value: And they all ate and were satisfied;

column.name: text
column.value: and they picked up twelve full baskets of the broken pieces of bread, and of the fish.

column.name: text
column.value: There were five thousand ①men who ate the loaves. ▷ ①I.e., 5,000 men plus women and children, cf. Matt

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately Jesus had His disciples get into the boat and go ahead of Him to the other side, to Bethsaida, while He Himself *dismissed the crowd.

column.name: text
column.value: And after saying goodbye to them, He left for the mountain to pray.

column.name: text
column.value: When it was evening, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and He was alone on the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Seeing them ①straining at the oars—for the wind was against them—at about the ②fourth watch of the night, He *came to them, walking on the sea; and He intended to pass by them. ▷ ①Lit tormented in rowing ②I.e., 3-6 a.m.

column.name: text
column.value: But when they saw Him walking on the sea, they thought that it was a ghost, and they cried out;

column.name: text
column.value: for they all saw Him and were ①terrified. But immediately He spoke with them and *said to them, “Take courage; it is I, do not be afraid.” ▷ ①Or troubled

column.name: text
column.value: Then He got into the boat with them, and the wind stopped; and they were utterly astonished,

column.name: text
column.value: for they ①had not gained any insight from the incident of the loaves, but ②their hearts were hardened. ▷ ①Lit had not understood on the basis of ②Lit heart was hardened; or their mind was closed, made dull; or insensible

column.name: text
column.value: When they had crossed over they came to land at Gennesaret, and moored at the shore.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they got out of the boat, immediately the people recognized Him,

column.name: text
column.value: and ran about that entire country and began carrying here and there on their pallets those who were sick, ①to wherever they heard He was. ▷ ①Lit where they were hearing that He

column.name: text
column.value: And wherever He entered villages, or cities, or a countryside, they were laying the sick in the marketplaces and imploring Him that they might just touch the fringe of His cloak; and all who touched it were being ①healed. ▷ ①Lit saved

column.name: text
column.value: Again He began to teach by the sea. And such a very large crowd gathered to Him that He got into a boat on the sea and sat down; and the whole crowd was by the sea on the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And He was teaching them many things in parables, and was saying to them in His teaching,

column.name: text
column.value: “Listen to this! Behold, the sower went out to sow;

column.name: text
column.value: as he was sowing, some seed fell beside the road, and the birds came and ate it up.

column.name: text
column.value: Other seed fell on the rocky ground where it did not have much soil; and immediately it sprang up because it had no depth of soil.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

column.name: text
column.value: Other seed fell among the thorns, and the thorns came up and choked it, and it yielded no crop.

column.name: text
column.value: Other seeds fell into the good soil, and as they grew up and increased, they yielded a crop and produced thirty, sixty, and a hundred times as much.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He was saying, “He who has ears to hear, ①let him hear.” ▷ ①Or hear! or listen!

column.name: text
column.value: As soon as He was alone, ①His followers, along with the twelve disciples, began asking Him about the parables. ▷ ①Lit those about Him

column.name: text
column.value: And He was saying to them, “To you has been given the mystery of the kingdom of God, but for those who are outside, everything comes in parables,

column.name: text
column.value: so that WHILE SEEING THEY MAY SEE, AND NOT PERCEIVE, AND WHILE HEARING, THEY MAY HEAR, AND NOT UNDERSTAND, OTHERWISE THEY MIGHT RETURN AND IT WOULD BE FORGIVEN THEM.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He *said to them, “Do you not understand this parable? How will you understand all the parables?

column.name: text
column.value: The sower sows the word.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the ones who are beside the road where the word is sown; and when they hear, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.

column.name: text
column.value: And in a similar way these are the ones sown with seed on the rocky places, who, when they hear the word, immediately receive it with joy;

column.name: text
column.value: and yet they have no firm root in themselves, but are only temporary; then, when affliction or persecution occurs because of the word, immediately they ①fall away. ▷ ①I.e., from the faith

column.name: text
column.value: And others are the ones sown with seed among the thorns; these are the ones who have heard the word,

column.name: text
column.value: but the worries of the ①world, and the deceitfulness of wealth, and the desires for other things enter and choke the word, and it ②becomes unfruitful. ▷ ①Or age ②Or proves to be unfruitful

column.name: text
column.value: And those are the ones sown with seed on the good soil; and they hear the word and accept it and bear fruit, thirty, sixty, and a hundred times as much.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He was saying to them, “A lamp is not brought to be put under a ①basket, or under a bed, is it? Is it not brought to be put on the lampstand? ▷ ①Lit peck-measure

column.name: text
column.value: For nothing is hidden, except to be revealed; nor has anything been secret, but that it would come to light.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone has ears to hear, ①let him hear.” ▷ ①Or hear! or listen!

column.name: text
column.value: And He was saying to them, “Take care what you listen to. ①By your standard of measure it will be measured to you; and more will be given you besides. ▷ ①Lit By what measure you measure

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever has, to him more will be given; and whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He was saying, “The kingdom of God is like a man who casts seed upon the soil;

column.name: text
column.value: and he goes to bed at night and gets up daily, and the seed sprouts and grows—how, he himself does not know.

column.name: text
column.value: The soil produces crops by itself; first the stalk, then the head, then the mature grain in the head.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the crop permits, he immediately ①puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.” ▷ ①Lit sends forth

column.name: text
column.value: And He was saying, “How shall we ①picture the kingdom of God, or by what parable shall we present it? ▷ ①Lit compare

column.name: text
column.value: It is like a mustard seed, which, when sown upon the soil, though it is the smallest of all the seeds that are upon the soil,

column.name: text
column.value: yet when it is sown, it grows up and becomes larger than all the garden plants, and forms large branches, with the result that THE BIRDS OF THE SKY can NEST UNDER its shade.”

column.name: text
column.value: And with many such parables He was speaking the word to them, so far as they were able to ①understand it; ▷ ①Lit hear

column.name: text
column.value: and He did not speak to them without a parable; but He was explaining everything privately to His own disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day, when evening came, He *said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”

column.name: text
column.value: After dismissing the crowd, they *took Him along with them in the boat, just as He was; and other boats were with Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And a fierce gale of wind *developed, and the waves were breaking over the boat so much that the boat was already filling with water.

column.name: text
column.value: And yet Jesus Himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they *woke Him and *said to Him, “Teacher, do You not care that we are perishing?”

column.name: text
column.value: And He got up and rebuked the wind and said to the sea, “Hush, be still.” And the wind died down and ①it became perfectly calm. ▷ ①Lit a great calm occurred

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “Why are you ①afraid? Do you still have no faith?” ▷ ①Lit cowardly

column.name: text
column.value: They became very much afraid and said to one another, “Who, then, is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?”

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees and some of the scribes *gathered to Him after they came from Jerusalem,

column.name: text
column.value: and saw that some of His disciples were eating their bread with ①unholy hands, that is, unwashed. ▷ ①Lit common; i.e., ritually unclean

column.name: text
column.value: (For the Pharisees and all the other Jews do not eat unless they ①carefully wash their hands, thereby holding firmly to the tradition of the elders; ▷ ①Lit with a fist (following a prescribed ritual)

column.name: text
column.value: and when they come from the marketplace, they do not eat unless they ①completely cleanse themselves; and there are many other things which they have received as traditions to firmly hold, such as the ②washing of cups, pitchers, and copper pots.) ▷ ①Lit baptize; i.e., immerse; two early mss purify ②Lit baptisms

column.name: text
column.value: And the Pharisees and the scribes *asked Him, “Why do Your disciples not walk in accordance with the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with ①unholy hands?” ▷ ①Lit common; i.e., ritually unclean

column.name: text
column.value: But He said to them, “Rightly did Isaiah prophesy about you hypocrites, as it is written: ‘THIS PEOPLE HONORS ME WITH THEIR LIPS, BUT THEIR HEART IS FAR AWAY FROM ME.

column.name: text
column.value: AND IN VAIN DO THEY WORSHIP ME, TEACHING AS DOCTRINES THE COMMANDMENTS OF MEN.’

column.name: text
column.value: Neglecting the commandment of God, you hold to the tradition of men.”

column.name: text
column.value: He was also saying to them, “You are experts at setting aside the commandment of God in order to keep your tradition.

column.name: text
column.value: For Moses said, ‘HONOR YOUR FATHER AND YOUR MOTHER’; and, ‘THE ONE WHO SPEAKS EVIL OF FATHER OR MOTHER, IS ①CERTAINLY TO BE PUT TO DEATH’; ▷ ①Lit to die with death

column.name: text
column.value: but you say, ‘If a person says to his father or his mother, whatever I have that would help you is Corban (that is, ①given to God),’ ▷ ①Lit a gift; i.e., an offering

column.name: text
column.value: you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother;

column.name: text
column.value: thereby invalidating the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down; and you do many things such as that.”

column.name: text
column.value: After He called the crowd to Him again, He began saying to them, “Listen to Me, all of you, and understand:

column.name: text
column.value: there is nothing outside the person which can defile him if it goes into him; but the things which come out of the person are what defile the person ①.” ▷ ①Late mss add, as v 16: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear.

column.name: text
column.value: And when He later entered a house, away from the crowd, His disciples asked Him about the parable.

column.name: text
column.value: And He *said to them, “Are you so lacking in understanding as well? Do you not understand that whatever goes into the person from outside cannot defile him,

column.name: text
column.value: because it does not go into his heart, but into his stomach, and ①is eliminated?” (Thereby He declared all foods clean.) ▷ ①Lit goes out into the latrine

column.name: text
column.value: And He was saying, “That which comes out of the person, that is what defiles the person.

column.name: text
column.value: For from within, out of the ①hearts of people, come the evil thoughts, acts of sexual immorality, thefts, murders, acts of adultery, ▷ ①heart

column.name: text
column.value: deeds of greed, wickedness, deceit, indecent behavior, ①envy, slander, ②pride, and foolishness. ▷ ①Lit an evil eye ②Or arrogance

column.name: text
column.value: All these evil things come from within and defile the person.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jesus got up and went from there to the region of Tyre ①. And when He had entered a house, He wanted no one to know about it; and yet He could not escape notice. ▷ ①Two early mss add and Sidon

column.name: text
column.value: But after hearing about Him, a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit immediately came and fell at His feet.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the woman was a ①Gentile, of Syrophoenician descent. And she repeatedly asked Him to cast the demon out of her daughter. ▷ ①Lit Greek

column.name: text
