column.value: And He was saying to her, “Let the children be satisfied first, for it is not ①good to take the children’s bread and throw it to the ②dogs.” ▷ ①Or proper ②I.e., pet dogs

column.name: text
column.value: But she answered and *said to Him, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs under the table feed on the children’s crumbs.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to her, “Because of this ①answer, go; the demon has gone out of your daughter.” ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: And after going back to her home, she found the child ①lying on the bed, and the demon gone. ▷ ①Lit thrown

column.name: text
column.value: Again He left the region of Tyre and came through Sidon to the Sea of Galilee, within the region of Decapolis.

column.name: text
column.value: And they *brought to Him one who was deaf and had difficulty speaking, and they *begged Him to lay His hand on him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus took him aside from the crowd, by himself, and put His fingers in his ears, and after spitting, He touched his tongue with the saliva;

column.name: text
column.value: and looking up to heaven with a deep sigh, He *said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”

column.name: text
column.value: And his ears were opened, and the ①impediment of his tongue was ②removed, and he began speaking plainly. ▷ ①Lit bond ②Lit undone

column.name: text
column.value: And He gave them orders not to tell anyone; but the more He ordered them, the more widely they continued to proclaim it.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were utterly astonished, saying, “He has done all things well; He makes even those who are deaf hear, and those who are unable to talk, speak.”

column.name: text
column.value: In those days, when there was again a large crowd and they had nothing to eat, Jesus summoned His disciples and *said to them,

column.name: text
column.value: “I feel compassion for the ①people because they have remained with Me for three days already and have nothing to eat. ▷ ①Lit crowd

column.name: text
column.value: And if I send them away hungry to their homes, they will faint on the way; and some of them have come from a great distance.”

column.name: text
column.value: And His disciples replied to Him, “Where will anyone be able to find enough ①bread here in this desolate place to satisfy these people?” ▷ ①Lit loaves

column.name: text
column.value: And He was asking them, “How many loaves do you have?” And they said, “Seven.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He *directed the ①people to recline on the ground; and taking the seven loaves, He gave thanks and broke them, and started giving them to His disciples to serve, and they served them to the ②people. ▷ ①Lit crowd ②Lit crowd

column.name: text
column.value: They also had a few small fish; and after He had blessed them, He told the disciples to serve these as well.

column.name: text
column.value: And they ate and were satisfied; and they picked up seven large baskets full of what was left over of the broken pieces.

column.name: text
column.value: About four thousand ①men were there; and He dismissed them. ▷ ①I.e., 4,000 men plus women and children, cf. Matt

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately He got into the boat with His disciples and came to the region of Dalmanutha.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Pharisees came out and began to argue with Him, demanding from Him a ①sign from heaven, ②to test Him. ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracle ②Lit testing Him

column.name: text
column.value: Sighing deeply in His spirit, He *said, “Why does this generation demand a ①sign? Truly I say to you, ②no ③sign will be given to this generation!” ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracle ②Lit if a sign shall be given, a very strong refusal ③I.e., confirming miracle

column.name: text
column.value: And leaving them, He again embarked and went away to the other side.

column.name: text
column.value: And the disciples had forgotten to take bread, and did not have more than one loaf in the boat with them.

column.name: text
column.value: And He was giving orders to them, saying, “Watch out! Beware of the ①leaven of the Pharisees, and the leaven of Herod.” ▷ ①I.e., fermented dough

column.name: text
column.value: And they began to discuss with one another the fact that they had no bread.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus, aware of this, *said to them, “Why are you discussing the fact that you have no bread? Do you not yet comprehend or understand? Do you still have your heart ①hardened? ▷ ①Or dull, insensible

column.name: text
column.value: HAVING EYES, DO YOU NOT SEE? AND HAVING EARS, DO YOU NOT HEAR? And do you not remember,

column.name: text
column.value: when I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces you picked up?” They *said to Him, “Twelve.”

column.name: text
column.value: “When I broke the seven for the four thousand, how many large baskets full of broken pieces did you pick up?” And they *said to Him, “Seven.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He was saying to them, “Do you not yet understand?”

column.name: text
column.value: And they *came to Bethsaida. And some people *brought a man who was blind to ①Jesus and *begged Him to touch him. ▷ ①Lit Him

column.name: text
column.value: Taking the man who was blind by the hand, He brought him out of the village; and after spitting in his eyes and laying His hands on him, He asked him, “Do you see anything?”

column.name: text
column.value: And he ①looked up and said, “I see people, for I see them like trees, walking around.” ▷ ①Or gained sight

column.name: text
column.value: Then again He laid His hands on his eyes; and he looked intently and was restored, and began to see everything clearly.

column.name: text
column.value: And He sent him to his home, saying, “Do not even enter the village.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus went out, along with His disciples, to the villages of Caesarea Philippi; and on the way He questioned His disciples, saying to them, “Who do people say that I am?”

column.name: text
column.value: They told Him, saying, “John the Baptist; and others say Elijah; and others, one of the prophets.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He continued questioning them: “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered and *said to Him, “You are the ①Christ.” ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: And He ①warned them to tell no one about Him. ▷ ①Or strictly admonished

column.name: text
column.value: And He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders and the chief priests and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And He was stating the matter plainly. And Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him.

column.name: text
column.value: But turning around and seeing His disciples, He rebuked Peter and *said, “Get behind Me, Satan; for you are not setting your mind on ①God’s purposes, but on man’s.” ▷ ①Lit the things of God

column.name: text
column.value: And He summoned the crowd together with His disciples, and said to them, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself, take up his cross, and follow Me.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever wants to save his ①life will lose it, but whoever loses his ②life for My sake and the gospel’s will save it. ▷ ①Or soul ②Or soul

column.name: text
column.value: For what does it benefit a person to gain the whole world, and forfeit his soul?

column.name: text
column.value: For what could a person give in exchange for his soul?

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever is ashamed of Me and My words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will also be ashamed of him when He comes in the glory of His Father with the holy angels.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus was saying to them, “Truly I say to you, there are some of those who are standing here who will not taste death until they see the kingdom of God when it has come with power.”

column.name: text
column.value: And six days later Jesus *took with Him Peter, ①James, and John, and *brought them up on a high mountain by themselves. And He was ②transfigured before them; ▷ ①Or Jacob ②I.e., visibly changed

column.name: text
column.value: and His garments became radiant and exceedingly white, as no launderer on earth can whiten them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elijah appeared to them along with Moses; and they were talking with Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Peter responded and *said to Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good that we are here; let’s make three ①tabernacles, one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.” ▷ ①Or sacred tents

column.name: text
column.value: For he did not know how to reply; for they became terrified.

column.name: text
column.value: Then a cloud ①formed, overshadowing them, and a voice ②came out of the cloud: “This is My beloved Son; ③listen to Him!” ▷ ①Lit occurred ②Lit occurred ③Or give constant heed

column.name: text
column.value: And suddenly they looked around and saw no one with them anymore, except Jesus alone.

column.name: text
column.value: As they were coming down from the mountain, He gave them orders not to relate to anyone what they had seen, ①until the Son of Man rose from the dead. ▷ ①Lit except when

column.name: text
column.value: They ①seized upon ②that statement, discussing with one another ③what rising from the dead meant. ▷ ①Or kept to themselves ②Lit the word ③Lit what was the rising from the dead

column.name: text
column.value: And they asked Him, saying, “Why is it that the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “Elijah does come first and he restores all things. And yet how is it written of the Son of Man that He will suffer many things and be treated with contempt?

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you that Elijah has ①indeed come, and they did to him whatever they wanted, just as it is written of him.” ▷ ①Lit even

column.name: text
column.value: And when they came back to the other disciples, they saw a large crowd around them, and some scribes arguing with them.

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately, when the entire crowd saw Him, they were amazed and began running up to greet Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And He asked them, “What are you disputing with them?”

column.name: text
column.value: And one person from the crowd answered Him, “Teacher, I brought You my son, because he has a spirit that makes him unable to speak;

column.name: text
column.value: and ①whenever it seizes him, it slams him to the ground, and he foams at the mouth and grinds his teeth and becomes stiff. And I told Your disciples so that they would cast it out, but they could not do it.” ▷ ①Or wherever

column.name: text
column.value: And He answered them and *said, “O unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I put up with you? Bring him to Me!”

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought ①the boy to Him. When he saw Him, the spirit immediately threw him into convulsions, and falling to the ground, he began rolling around and foaming at the mouth. ▷ ①Lit him

column.name: text
column.value: And He asked his father, “How long has this been happening to him?” And he said, “From childhood.

column.name: text
column.value: It has often thrown him both into the fire and into the water to kill him. But if You can do anything, take pity on us and help us!”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said to him, “ ‘If You can?’ All things are possible for the one who believes.”

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately the boy’s father cried out and said, “I do believe; help my unbelief!”

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus saw that a crowd was ①rapidly gathering, He rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to it, “You mute and deaf spirit, I ②command you, come out of him and do not enter him ③again!” ▷ ①Lit running together ②Or Myself command ③Or from now on

column.name: text
column.value: And after crying out and throwing him into terrible convulsions, it came out; and the boy became so much like a corpse that most of them said, “He is dead!”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him, and he got up.

column.name: text
column.value: When He came into the house, His disciples began asking Him privately, “Why is it that we could not cast it out?”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “This kind cannot come out by anything except prayer.”

column.name: text
column.value: And from there they went out and began to go through Galilee, and He did not want anyone to know about it.

column.name: text
column.value: For He was teaching His disciples and telling them, “The Son of Man is to be ①handed over to men, and they will kill Him; and when He has been killed, He will rise three days later.” ▷ ①Or betrayed

column.name: text
column.value: But they ①did not understand this statement, and they were afraid to ask Him. ▷ ①Lit were not knowing

column.name: text
column.value: They came to Capernaum; and when He was in the house, He began to question them: “What were you discussing on the way?”

column.name: text
column.value: But they kept silent, for on the way they had discussed with one another which of them was the greatest.

column.name: text
column.value: And sitting down, He called the twelve and *said to them, “If anyone wants to be first, he shall be last of all and servant of all.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He took a child and placed him among them, and taking him in His arms, He said to them,

column.name: text
column.value: “Whoever ①receives ②one child like this in My name ③receives Me; and whoever ④receives Me does not ⑤receive Me, but Him who sent Me.” ▷ ①Or welcomes ②Lit one of such children ③Or welcomes ④Or welcomes ⑤Or welcome

column.name: text
column.value: John said to Him, “Teacher, we saw someone casting out demons in Your name, and we tried to prevent him because he was not following us.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said, “Do not hinder him, for there is no one who will perform a miracle in My name, and be able soon afterward to speak evil of Me.

column.name: text
column.value: For the one who is not against us is ①for us. ▷ ①Or on our side

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever gives you a cup of water to drink ①because of your name as followers of Christ, truly I say to you, he shall by no means lose his reward. ▷ ①Lit in a name that you are Christ’s

column.name: text
column.value: “Whoever causes one of these ①little ones who believe in Me to ②sin, it is better for him if a heavy millstone is hung around his neck and he ③is thrown into the sea. ▷ ①Or lowly ②Or stumble ③Lit has been thrown (intensified)

column.name: text
column.value: And if your hand causes you to sin, cut it off; it is better for you to enter life maimed, than, having your two hands, to go into ①hell, into the unquenchable fire. ② ▷ ①Gr Gehenna ②Late mss repeat v 48 here as v 44

column.name: text
column.value: And if your foot is causing you to sin, cut it off; it is better for you to enter life without a foot, than, having your two feet, to be thrown into ①hell. ② ▷ ①Gr Gehenna ②Late mss repeat v 48 here as v 46; cf. note 2 v 43

column.name: text
column.value: And if your eye is causing you to sin, throw it away; it is better for you to enter the kingdom of God with one eye, than, having two eyes, to be thrown into ①hell, ▷ ①Gr Gehenna

column.name: text
column.value: where THEIR WORM DOES NOT DIE, AND THE FIRE IS NOT EXTINGUISHED.

column.name: text
column.value: For everyone will be salted with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Salt is good; but if the salt becomes unsalty, with what will you ①make it salty again? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.” ▷ ①Lit season it

column.name: text
column.value: Setting out from there, Jesus *went to the region of Judea and beyond the Jordan; crowds *gathered to Him again, and, as He was accustomed, He once more began to teach them.

column.name: text
column.value: And some Pharisees came up to Jesus, testing Him, and began questioning Him whether it was lawful for a man to ①divorce his wife. ▷ ①Lit send away, the Heb term for divorce

column.name: text
column.value: And He answered and said to them, “What did Moses command you?”

column.name: text
column.value: They said, “Moses permitted a man to write a ①certificate of divorce and ②send his wife away.” ▷ ①Permitting her to remarry ②Or divorce her

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said to them, “ ①Because of your hardness of heart he wrote you this commandment. ▷ ①Or With reference to

column.name: text
column.value: But from the beginning of creation, God CREATED THEM MALE AND FEMALE.

column.name: text
column.value: FOR THIS REASON A MAN SHALL LEAVE HIS FATHER AND MOTHER ①, ▷ ①Many late mss add and shall cling to his wife

column.name: text
column.value: AND THE TWO SHALL BECOME ONE FLESH; so they are no longer two, but one flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, what God has joined together, no person is to separate.”

column.name: text
column.value: And in the house the disciples again began questioning Him about this.

column.name: text
column.value: And He *said to them, “Whoever ①divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her; ▷ ①Or sends away

column.name: text
column.value: and if she herself ①divorces her husband and marries another man, she is committing adultery.” ▷ ①Or sends away

column.name: text
column.value: And they were bringing children to Him so that He would touch them; but the disciples rebuked them.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Jesus saw this, He was indignant and said to them, “Allow the children to come to Me; do not ①forbid them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these. ▷ ①Or prevent

column.name: text
column.value: Truly I say to you, whoever does not receive the kingdom of God like a child will not enter it at all.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He took them in His arms and began blessing them, laying His hands on them.

column.name: text
column.value: As He was setting out on a journey, a man ran up to Him and knelt before Him, and asked Him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do so that I may inherit eternal life?”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said to him, “Why do you call Me good? No one is good except God alone.

column.name: text
column.value: You know the commandments: ‘DO NOT MURDER, DO NOT COMMIT ADULTERY, DO NOT STEAL, DO NOT GIVE FALSE TESTIMONY, Do not defraud, HONOR YOUR FATHER AND MOTHER.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to Him, “Teacher, I have kept all these things from my youth.”

column.name: text
column.value: Looking at him, Jesus showed love to him and said to him, “One thing you lack: go and sell all you possess and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow Me.”

column.name: text
column.value: But he ①was deeply dismayed by ②these words, and he went away grieving; for he was one who owned much property. ▷ ①Or became gloomy at; or was shocked by ②Lit the word

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus, looking around, *said to His disciples, “How hard it will be for those who are wealthy to enter the kingdom of God!”

column.name: text
column.value: And the disciples were amazed at His words. But Jesus responded again and *said to them, “Children, how hard it is to enter the kingdom of God!

column.name: text
column.value: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter the kingdom of God.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they were even more astonished, and said to Him, “ ①Then who can be saved?” ▷ ①Lit And

column.name: text
column.value: Looking at them, Jesus *said, “With people it is impossible, but not with God; for all things are possible with God.”

column.name: text
column.value: Peter began to say to Him, “Behold, we have left everything and have followed You.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said, “Truly I say to you, there is no one who has left house or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or farms, for My sake and for the gospel’s sake,

column.name: text
column.value: ①but that he will receive a hundred times as much now in ②the present age, houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and farms, along with persecutions; and in the age to come, eternal life. ▷ ①Lit if he does not ②Lit this time

column.name: text
column.value: But many who are first will be last, and the last, first.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now they were on the road going up to Jerusalem, and Jesus was walking on ahead of them; and they were amazed, and those who followed were fearful. And again He took the twelve aside and began to tell them what was going to happen to Him,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be ①handed over to the chief priests and the scribes; and they will condemn Him to death and will ②hand Him over to the Gentiles. ▷ ①Or betrayed ②Or betray

column.name: text
column.value: And they will mock Him and spit on Him, and flog Him and kill Him; and three days later He will rise from the dead.”

column.name: text
column.value: ①James and John, the two sons of Zebedee, *came up to ②Jesus, saying to Him, “Teacher, we want You to do for us whatever we ask of You.” ▷ ①Or Jacob ②Lit Him

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “What do you want Me to do for you?”

column.name: text
column.value: They said to Him, “ ①Grant that we may sit, one on Your right and one on Your left, in Your glory.” ▷ ①Lit Give to us

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said to them, “You do not know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, or to be baptized with the baptism with which I am baptized?”

column.name: text
column.value: They said to Him, “We are able.” And Jesus said to them, “The cup that I drink you shall drink; and you shall be baptized with the baptism with which I am baptized.

column.name: text
column.value: But to sit on My right or on My left is not Mine to give; but it is for those for whom it has been prepared.”

column.name: text
column.value: Hearing this, the other ten began to feel indignant with ①James and John. ▷ ①Or Jacob

column.name: text
column.value: Calling them to Himself, Jesus *said to them, “You know that those who are recognized as rulers of the Gentiles domineer over them; and their ①people in high position exercise authority over them. ▷ ①Lit great ones

column.name: text
column.value: But it is not this way among you; rather, whoever wants to become ①prominent among you shall be your servant; ▷ ①Lit great

column.name: text
column.value: and whoever wants to be first among you shall be slave of all.

column.name: text
column.value: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His ①life as a ransom for many.” ▷ ①Or soul

column.name: text
column.value: Then they *came to Jericho. And later, as He was leaving Jericho with His disciples and a large crowd, a beggar who was blind named Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, was sitting by the road.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”

column.name: text
column.value: Many were sternly telling him to be quiet, but he kept crying out all the more, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus stopped and said, “Call him here.” So they *called the man who was blind, saying to him, “Take courage, stand up! He is calling for you.”

column.name: text
column.value: And throwing off his cloak, he jumped up and came to Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And replying to him, Jesus said, “What do you want Me to do for you?” And the man who was blind said to Him, “ ①Rabboni, I want to regain my sight!” ▷ ①I.e., My Master

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to him, “Go; your faith has ①made you well.” And immediately he regained his sight and began following Him on the road. ▷ ①Lit saved you

column.name: text
column.value: And as they *approached Jerusalem, at Bethphage and Bethany, near the Mount of Olives, He *sent two of His disciples,

column.name: text
column.value: and *said to them, “Go into the village opposite you, and immediately as you enter it you will find a colt tied there, on which no one has ever sat; untie it and bring it here.

column.name: text
column.value: And if anyone says to you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord has need of it’; and immediately he ①will send it back here.” ▷ ①Lit sends

column.name: text
column.value: They went away and found a colt tied at the door, outside in the street; and they *untied it.

column.name: text
column.value: And some of the bystanders were saying to them, “What are you doing, untying the colt?”

column.name: text
column.value: And they told them just as Jesus had said, and they gave them permission.

column.name: text
column.value: They *brought the colt to Jesus and *put their cloaks on it; and He sat on it.

column.name: text
column.value: And many people spread their cloaks on the road, and others spread leafy branches which they had cut from the fields.

column.name: text
column.value: And those who went in front and those who followed were shouting: “ ①Hosanna! BLESSED IS HE WHO COMES IN THE NAME OF THE LORD; ▷ ①Aramaic for Save, we pray

column.name: text
text
column.value: And Jesus entered Jerusalem and came into the temple area; and after looking around at everything, He left for Bethany with the twelve, since it was already late.

column.name: text
column.value: On the next day, when they had left Bethany, He became hungry.

column.name: text
column.value: Seeing from a distance a fig tree in leaf, He went to see if perhaps He would find anything on it; and when He came to it, He found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” And His disciples were listening.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they *came to Jerusalem. And He entered the temple area and began to drive out those who were selling and buying on the temple grounds, and He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those who were selling ①doves; ▷ ①Lit the doves

column.name: text
column.value: and He would not allow anyone to carry ①merchandise through the temple grounds. ▷ ①Lit a vessel; i.e., a receptacle or implement of any kind

column.name: text
column.value: And He began to teach and say to them, “Is it not written: ‘MY HOUSE WILL BE CALLED A HOUSE OF PRAYER FOR ALL THE NATIONS’? But you have made it a DEN OF ROBBERS.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the chief priests and the scribes heard this, and they began seeking how to put Him to death; for they were afraid of Him, because all the crowd was astonished at His teaching.

column.name: text
column.value: And whenever evening came, ①they would leave the city. ▷ ①I.e., Jesus and His disciples

column.name: text
column.value: As they were passing by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered from the roots up.

column.name: text
column.value: And being reminded, Peter *said to Him, “Rabbi, look, the fig tree that You cursed has withered.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and *said to them, “Have faith in God.

column.name: text
column.value: Truly I say to you, whoever says to this mountain, ‘Be taken up and thrown into the sea,’ and does not doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is going to happen, it will be granted to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, I say to you, all things for which you pray and ask, believe that you have received them, and they will be granted to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone, so that your Father who is in heaven will also forgive you for your ①offenses. ▷ ①Or wrongdoings

column.name: text
column.value: ①But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father who is in heaven forgive your ②offenses.”] ▷ ①Early mss do not contain this v ②Or wrongdoings

column.name: text
column.value: And they *came again to Jerusalem. And as He was walking in the temple area, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders *came to Him,

column.name: text
column.value: and began saying to Him, “By what authority are You doing these things, or who gave You this authority to do these things?”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question, and you answer Me, and then I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

column.name: text
column.value: Was the baptism of John from heaven, or from men? Answer Me.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they began considering the implications among themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will say, ‘Then why did you not believe him?’

column.name: text
column.value: But should we say, ‘From men’?”—they were afraid of the ①people, for they all considered John to have been a real prophet. ▷ ①Lit crowd

column.name: text
column.value: Answering Jesus, they *said, “We do not know.” And Jesus *said to them, “Neither am I telling you by what authority I do these things.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He began to speak to them in parables: “A man planted a vineyard and put a ①fence around it, and dug a vat under the wine press and built a tower, and leased it to ②vine-growers and went on a journey. ▷ ①Or hedge ②Or tenant farmers, also vv 2, 7, 9

column.name: text
column.value: And at the harvest time he sent a slave to the vine-growers, in order to receive his share of the produce of the vineyard from the vine-growers.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took him, and beat him, and sent him away empty-handed.

column.name: text
column.value: And again he sent them another slave, and they wounded him in the head, and treated him shamefully.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent another, and that one they killed; and so with many others, beating some and killing others.

column.name: text
column.value: He had one more man to send, a beloved son; he sent him to them last of all, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

column.name: text
column.value: But those vine-growers said to one another, ‘This is the heir; come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours!’

column.name: text
column.value: And they took him and killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.

column.name: text
column.value: What will the ①owner of the vineyard do? He will come and put the vine-growers to death, and give the vineyard to others. ▷ ①Lit lord

column.name: text
column.value: Have you not even read this Scripture: ‘A STONE WHICH THE BUILDERS REJECTED, THIS HAS BECOME THE ①CHIEF CORNERSTONE; ▷ ①Lit head of the corner

column.name: text
column.value: THIS CAME ABOUT FROM THE LORD, AND IT IS MARVELOUS IN OUR EYES’?”

column.name: text
column.value: And they were seeking to seize Him, and yet they feared the ①people, for they understood that He told the parable against them. And so they left Him and went away. ▷ ①Lit crowd

column.name: text
column.value: Then they *sent some of the Pharisees and Herodians to Him in order to trap Him in a statement.

column.name: text
column.value: They came and *said to Him, “Teacher, we know that You are truthful and ①do not care what anyone thinks; for You ②are not partial to anyone, but You teach the way of God in truth. Is it ③permissible to pay a ④poll-tax to Caesar, or not? ▷ ①Lit it is not a concern to You about anyone ②Lit do not look at the face of people ③I.e., by Jewish law and tradition ④I.e., a tax on each person in the census

column.name: text
column.value: Are we to pay, or not pay?” But He, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why are you testing Me? Bring Me a ①denarius to look at.” ▷ ①The denarius was a day’s wages for a laborer

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought one. And He *said to them, “Whose image and inscription is this?” And they said to Him, “Caesar’s.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to them, “Pay to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” And they were utterly amazed at Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Some Sadducees (who say that there is no resurrection) *came to ①Jesus, and began questioning Him, saying, ▷ ①Lit Him

column.name: text
column.value: “Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves behind a wife and does not leave a child, his brother is to ①marry the wife and raise up ②children for his brother. ▷ ①Lit take ②Lit seed, also vv 20-22

column.name: text
column.value: There were seven brothers; and the first took a wife, and died leaving no children.

column.name: text
column.value: The second one ①married her, and died leaving behind no children; and the third likewise; ▷ ①Lit took

column.name: text
column.value: and so the seven together left no children. Last of all the woman also died.

column.name: text
column.value: In the resurrection, which one’s wife will she be? For each of the seven had her as his wife.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, “Is this not the reason you are mistaken, that you do not ①understand the Scriptures nor the power of God? ▷ ①Or know

column.name: text
column.value: For when they rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: But ①regarding the fact that the dead rise, have you not read in the book of Moses, in the passage about the burning bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I AM THE GOD OF ABRAHAM, THE GOD OF ISAAC, AND THE GOD OF JACOB’? ▷ ①Lit concerning the dead, that they rise

column.name: text
column.value: He is not the God ①of the dead, but of the living; you are greatly mistaken.” ▷ ①Or of corpses

column.name: text
column.value: One of the scribes came up and heard them arguing, and recognizing that He had answered them well, asked Him, “What commandment is the ①foremost of all?” ▷ ①Or first

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, “The ①foremost is, ‘HEAR, ISRAEL! THE LORD IS OUR GOD, THE LORD IS ONE; ▷ ①Or first

column.name: text
column.value: AND YOU SHALL LOVE THE LORD YOUR GOD WITH ALL YOUR HEART, AND WITH ALL YOUR SOUL, AND WITH ALL YOUR MIND, AND WITH ALL YOUR STRENGTH.’

column.name: text
column.value: The second is this: ‘YOU SHALL LOVE YOUR NEIGHBOR AS YOURSELF.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the scribe said to Him, “Well said, Teacher; You have truly stated that HE IS ONE, AND THERE IS NO OTHER BESIDES HIM;

column.name: text
column.value: and to love Him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the strength, and to love one’s neighbor as oneself, is much more than all the burnt offerings and sacrifices.”

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus saw that he had answered intelligently, He said to him, “You are not far from the kingdom of God.” And then, no one dared any longer to question Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus responded and began saying, as He taught in the temple area, “How is it that the scribes say that the ①Christ is the son of David? ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: David himself said ①in the Holy Spirit, ‘THE LORD SAID TO MY LORD, “SIT AT MY RIGHT HAND, UNTIL I PUT YOUR ENEMIES UNDER YOUR FEET.” ’ ▷ ①Or by

column.name: text
column.value: David himself calls Him ‘Lord’; so in what sense is He his son?” And the large crowd ①enjoyed listening to Him. ▷ ①Lit was gladly hearing Him

column.name: text
column.value: And in His teaching He was saying: “Beware of the scribes who like to walk around in long robes, and like personal greetings in the marketplaces,

column.name: text
column.value: and seats of honor in the synagogues, and places of honor at banquets,

column.name: text
column.value: who devour widows’ houses, and for appearance’s sake offer long prayers. These will receive all the more condemnation.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus sat down opposite the treasury, and began watching how the ①people were putting ②money into the treasury; and many rich people were putting in large amounts. ▷ ①Lit crowd was ②I.e., copper coins

column.name: text
column.value: And a poor widow came and put in two ①lepta coins, which amount to a ②quadrans. ▷ ①The smallest Greek copper coin, about 1/128 of a laborer’s daily wage ②A small Roman copper coin, worth about 1/64 of a laborer’s daily wage

column.name: text
column.value: Calling His disciples to Him, He said to them, “Truly I say to you, this poor widow put in more than all ①the contributors to the treasury; ▷ ①Lit those who were putting in

column.name: text
column.value: for they all put in out of their ①surplus, but she, out of her poverty, put in all she owned, ②all she had to live on.” ▷ ①Or abundance ②Lit her whole livelihood

column.name: text
column.value: As He was going out of the temple, one of His disciples *said to Him, “Teacher, look! ①What wonderful stones and ②what wonderful buildings!” ▷ ①Or How great the ②Or How great the

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? Not one stone will be left upon another, which will not be torn down.”

column.name: text
column.value: As He was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, ①James, John, and Andrew were questioning Him privately, ▷ ①Or Jacob

column.name: text
column.value: “Tell us, when will these things come about, and what will be the ①sign when all these things are going to be fulfilled?” ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracle

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus began to say to them, “See to it that no one misleads you.

column.name: text
column.value: Many will come in My name, saying, ‘I am He!’ and they will mislead many.

column.name: text
column.value: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed; those things must take place; but that is not yet the end.

column.name: text
column.value: For nation will rise up against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; there will be earthquakes in various places; there will also be famines. These things are only the beginning of birth pains.

column.name: text
column.value: “But ①be on your guard; for they will hand you over to the ②courts, and you will be flogged in the synagogues, and you will stand before governors and kings for My sake, as a testimony to them. ▷ ①Lit look to yourselves ②Or Sanhedrin; or Council

column.name: text
column.value: And the gospel must first be preached to all the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they ①arrest you and hand you over, do not worry beforehand about what you are to say, but say whatever is given you at that time; for you are not the ones speaking, but it is the Holy Spirit. ▷ ①Lit lead

column.name: text
column.value: And brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child; and children will rise up against parents and ①have them put to death. ▷ ①Lit put them to death

column.name: text
column.value: And you will be hated by everyone because of My name, but it is the one who has endured to the end who will be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now when you see the ABOMINATION OF DESOLATION standing where it should not be— ①let the ②reader understand—then those who are in Judea must flee to the mountains. ▷ ①Or the reader is to understand ②I.e., of the book of Daniel

column.name: text
column.value: ①Whoever is on the ②housetop must not go down, nor go in to get anything out of his house. ▷ ①Lit The one who ②Housetops were flat living areas

column.name: text
column.value: And ①whoever is in the field must not turn back to get his cloak. ▷ ①Lit The one who

column.name: text
column.value: But woe to those women who are pregnant, and to those who are nursing babies in those days!

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, pray that it will not happen in winter.

column.name: text
column.value: For those days will be such a time of tribulation as has not occurred since the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will again.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the Lord had not shortened those days, no ①life would have been saved; but for the sake of the ②elect, whom He chose, He shortened the days. ▷ ①Lit flesh ②Or chosen ones

column.name: text
column.value: And then if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the ①Christ’; or, ‘Look, there He is’; do not believe it; ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: for false christs and false prophets will arise, and will provide signs and wonders, in order to mislead, if possible, the elect.

column.name: text
column.value: But beware; I have told you everything in advance.

column.name: text
column.value: “But in those days, after that tribulation, THE SUN WILL BE DARKENED AND THE MOON WILL NOT GIVE ITS LIGHT,

column.name: text
column.value: AND THE STARS WILL BE FALLING from heaven, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.

column.name: text
column.value: And then they will see THE SON OF MAN COMING IN CLOUDS with great power and glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And then He will send forth the angels, and will gather together His ①elect from the four winds, from the end of the earth to the end of heaven. ▷ ①Or chosen ones

column.name: text
column.value: “Now learn the parable from the fig tree: as soon as its branch has become tender and sprouts its leaves, you know that summer is near.

column.name: text
column.value: So you too, when you see these things happening, ①recognize that ②He is near, right at the ③door. ▷ ①Or know ②Or it ③Lit doors

column.name: text
column.value: Truly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things take place.

column.name: text
column.value: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will not pass away.

column.name: text
column.value: But about that day or hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but the Father alone.

column.name: text
column.value: “Watch out, stay alert; for you do not know when the appointed time is.

column.name: text
column.value: It is like a man away on a journey, who upon leaving his house and ①putting his slaves in charge, assigning to each one his task, also commanded the doorkeeper to stay alert. ▷ ①Lit giving the authority to

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, stay alert—for you do not know when the ①master of the house is coming, whether in the evening, at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning— ▷ ①Or lord

column.name: text
column.value: so that he does not come suddenly and find you asleep.

column.name: text
column.value: What I say to you I say to all: ‘Stay alert!’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Early in the morning the chief priests with the elders, scribes, and the entire ①Council immediately held a consultation; and they bound Jesus and led Him away, and turned Him over to Pilate. ▷ ①Or Sanhedrin

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate questioned Him: “So You are the King of the Jews?” And He answered him, “It is as you say.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the chief priests started accusing Him ①of many things. ▷ ①Or harshly

column.name: text
column.value: But Pilate questioned Him again, saying, “Do You offer nothing in answer? See how many charges they are bringing against You!”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said nothing further in answer, so Pilate was amazed.

column.name: text
column.value: Now at the Passover Feast he used to release for them any one prisoner whom they requested.

column.name: text
column.value: And the one named Barabbas had been imprisoned with the rebels who had committed murder in the revolt.

column.name: text
column.value: And the crowd went up and began asking Pilate to do as he had been accustomed to do for them.

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release for you the King of the Jews?”

column.name: text
column.value: For he was aware that the chief priests had handed Him over because of envy.

column.name: text
column.value: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to ask him to release Barabbas for them instead.

column.name: text
column.value: And responding again, Pilate said to them, “Then what shall I do with Him whom you call the King of the Jews?”

column.name: text
column.value: They shouted ①back, “Crucify Him!” ▷ ①Or again

column.name: text
column.value: But Pilate said to them, “Why, what ①evil has He done?” But they shouted all the more, “Crucify Him!” ▷ ①Or crime has He committed

column.name: text
column.value: Intent on satisfying the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas for them, and after having Jesus flogged, he handed Him over to be crucified.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the soldiers took Him away into the ①palace (that is, the Praetorium), and they *called together the whole Roman ②cohort. ▷ ①Or court ②Normally 600 men (the number varied)

column.name: text
column.value: And they *dressed Him in ①purple, and after twisting together a crown of thorns, they put it on Him; ▷ ①Prob. a term for a Roman soldier’s red cloak (cf. Matt 27:28)

column.name: text
column.value: and they began saluting Him: “Hail, King of the Jews!”

column.name: text
column.value: And they repeatedly beat His head with a ①reed and spit on Him, and kneeling, they bowed down before Him. ▷ ①Or staff (made of a reed)

column.name: text
column.value: And after they had mocked Him, they took the ①purple cloak off Him and put His own garments on Him. And they *led Him out to crucify Him. ▷ ①See note v 17

column.name: text
column.value: And they *compelled a passer-by coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene (the father of Alexander and Rufus), to carry His cross.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they *brought Him to the place Golgotha, which is translated, Place of a Skull.

column.name: text
column.value: And they tried to give Him wine mixed with myrrh; but He did not take it.

column.name: text
column.value: And they *crucified Him, and *divided up His garments among themselves, casting ①lots for them to decide ②what each man would take. ▷ ①Lit a lot upon ②Lit who would take what

column.name: text
column.value: Now it was the ①third hour ②when they crucified Him. ▷ ①I.e., 9 a.m. ②Lit and

column.name: text
column.value: The inscription of the charge against Him ①read, “THE KING OF THE JEWS.” ▷ ①Lit had been inscribed

column.name: text
column.value: And they *crucified two ①rebels with Him, one on His right and one on His left. ② ▷ ①Or robbers ②Late mss add the following as v 28: And the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “And He was counted with wrongdoers.”

column.name: text
column.value: Those passing by were ①hurling abuse at Him, shaking their heads and saying, “Ha! You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days, ▷ ①Or blaspheming Him

column.name: text
column.value: save Yourself by coming down from the cross!”

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way the chief priests also, along with the scribes, were mocking Him among themselves and saying, “He saved others; ①He cannot save Himself! ▷ ①Or can He not save Himself?

column.name: text
column.value: Let this Christ, the King of Israel, come down now from the cross, so that we may see and believe!” Those who were crucified with Him were also insulting Him.

column.name: text
column.value: When the ①sixth hour came, darkness ②fell over the whole land until the ③ninth hour. ▷ ①I.e., noon ②Lit occurred ③I.e., 3 p.m.

column.name: text
column.value: At the ①ninth hour Jesus cried out with a loud voice, “ELOI, ELOI, LEMA SABAKTANEI?” which is translated, “MY GOD, MY GOD, WHY HAVE YOU FORSAKEN ME?” ▷ ①I.e., 3 p.m.

column.name: text
column.value: And when some of the bystanders heard Him, they began saying, “Look! He is calling for Elijah!”

column.name: text
column.value: And someone ran and filled a sponge with sour wine, put it on a reed, and gave Him a drink, saying, “ ①Let us see if Elijah comes to take Him down.” ▷ ①Lit Allow that we see; or Hold off, let us see

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus let out a loud cry, and ①died. ▷ ①Lit expired

column.name: text
column.value: And the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the centurion, who was standing ①right in front of Him, saw that He ②died in this way, he said, “Truly this man was ③the Son of God!” ▷ ①Or opposite Him ②Lit expired ③Or a son of God; or a son of a god

column.name: text
column.value: Now there were also some women watching from a distance, among whom were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of ①James the ②Less and Joses, and Salome. ▷ ①Or Jacob ②Lit little (either in stature or age)

column.name: text
column.value: When He was in Galilee, they used to follow Him and serve Him; and there were many other women who came up with Him to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: When evening had already come, since it was the preparation day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

column.name: text
column.value: Joseph of Arimathea came, a prominent member of the Council, who was himself also waiting for the kingdom of God; and he gathered up courage and went in before Pilate, and asked for the body of Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Pilate wondered if He was dead by this time, and summoning the centurion, he questioned him as to whether He was already dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And after learning this from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: Joseph bought a linen cloth, took Him down, wrapped Him in the linen cloth, and laid Him in a tomb which had been cut out in the rock; and he rolled a stone against the entrance of the tomb.

column.name: text
column.value: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses were watching to see where He was laid.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Passover and Festival of Unleavened Bread were two days away; and the chief priests and the scribes were seeking how to arrest Him covertly and kill Him;

column.name: text
column.value: for they were saying, “Not during the festival, otherwise there will be a riot of the people.”

column.name: text
column.value: While He was in Bethany at the home of Simon ①the Leper, He was reclining at the table, and a woman came with an alabaster vial of very expensive perfume of pure ②nard. She broke the vial and poured the perfume over His head. ▷ ①I.e., a nickname; the man no doubt was cured ②An aromatic oil extracted from an East Indian plant

column.name: text
column.value: But there were some indignantly remarking to one another, “Why has this perfume been wasted?

column.name: text
column.value: For this perfume could have been sold for over three hundred ①denarii, and the money given to the poor.” And they were scolding her. ▷ ①The denarius was a day’s wages for a laborer

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone! Why are you bothering her? She has done a good deed for Me.

column.name: text
column.value: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want, you can do good to them; but you do not always have Me.

column.name: text
column.value: She has done what she could; she has anointed My body beforehand for the burial.

column.name: text
column.value: Truly I say to you, wherever the gospel is preached in the entire world, what this woman has done will also be told in memory of her.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went off to the chief priests in order to ①betray Him to them. ▷ ①Or hand Him over

column.name: text
column.value: They were delighted when they heard this, and promised to give him money. And he began seeking how to betray Him at an opportune time.

column.name: text
column.value: On the first day of ①Unleavened Bread, when ②the Passover lamb was being sacrificed, His disciples *said to Him, “Where do You want us to go and prepare for You to eat the Passover?” ▷ ①I.e., Passover week ②Lit they were sacrificing

column.name: text
column.value: And He *sent two of His disciples and *said to them, “Go into the city, and a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you; follow him;

column.name: text
column.value: and wherever he enters, say to the owner of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is My guest room in which I may eat the Passover with My disciples?” ’

column.name: text
column.value: And he himself will show you a large upstairs room furnished and ready; prepare for us there.”

column.name: text
column.value: The disciples left and came to the city, and found everything just as He had told them; and they prepared the Passover.

column.name: text
column.value: When it was evening He *came with the twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they were reclining at the table and eating, Jesus said, “Truly I say to you that one of you will ①betray Me— ②one who is eating with Me.” ▷ ①Or deliver Me over ②Or the one

column.name: text
column.value: They began to be grieved and to say to Him one by one, “Surely not I?”

column.name: text
column.value: But He said to them, “It is one of the twelve, the one who dips bread with Me in the bowl.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Son of Man is going away just as it is written about Him; but woe to that man ①by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would have been good ②for that man if he had not been born.” ▷ ①Or through ②Lit for him if that man had not

column.name: text
column.value: While they were eating, He took some bread, and ①after a blessing He broke it, and gave it to them, and said, “Take it; this is My body.” ▷ ①Lit having blessed

column.name: text
column.value: And when He had taken a cup and given thanks, He gave it to them, and they all drank from it.

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “This is My blood of the covenant, which is being poured out for many.

column.name: text
column.value: Truly I say to you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine again, until that day when I drink it, new, in the kingdom of God.”

column.name: text
column.value: And after singing a ①hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives. ▷ ①Ps 113-118 were traditionally sung at Passover

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus *said to them, “You will all ①fall away, because it is written: ‘I WILL STRIKE THE SHEPHERD, AND THE SHEEP WILL BE SCATTERED.’ ▷ ①I.e., have a lapse in faith

column.name: text
column.value: But after I am raised, I will go ahead of you to Galilee.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter said to Him, “Even if they all ①fall away, yet I will not!” ▷ ①I.e., have a lapse in faith

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus *said to him, “Truly I say to you, that ①this very night, before a rooster crows twice, you yourself will deny Me three times.” ▷ ①Lit today, on this night

column.name: text
column.value: But ①Peter repeatedly said insistently, “Even if I have to die with You, I will not deny You!” And they all were saying the same thing as well. ▷ ①Lit he

column.name: text
column.value: They *came to a place named ①Gethsemane; and He *said to His disciples, “Sit here until I have prayed.” ▷ ①I.e., oil press

column.name: text
column.value: And He *took with Him Peter, ①James, and John, and began to be very distressed and troubled. ▷ ①Or Jacob

column.name: text
column.value: And He *said to them, “My soul is deeply grieved, to the point of death; remain here and ①keep watch.” ▷ ①Or stay awake

column.name: text
column.value: And He went a little beyond them, and fell to the ground and began praying that if it were possible, the hour might ①pass Him by. ▷ ①Lit pass from Him

column.name: text
column.value: And He was saying, “Abba! ①Father! All things are possible for You; remove this cup from Me; yet not what I will, but what You will.” ▷ ①A translation of Aramaic Abba, prob. added by Mark

column.name: text
column.value: And He *came and *found them sleeping, and *said to Peter, “Simon, are you asleep? Could you not ①keep watch for one hour? ▷ ①Or stay awake

column.name: text
column.value: ①Keep watching and praying, so that you will not come into temptation; the spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.” ▷ ①Or Stay awake and keep praying

column.name: text
column.value: And again He went away and prayed, saying the same ①words. ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: And again He came and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy; and they did not know what to say in reply to Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And He *came the third time, and *said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? That is enough. The hour has come; behold, the Son of Man is being ①betrayed into the hands of sinners. ▷ ①Or delivered

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: Now he who was betraying Him had given them a signal, saying, “Whomever I kiss, He is the one; arrest Him and lead Him away ①under guard.” ▷ ①Lit safely

column.name: text
column.value: And after coming, Judas immediately went to Him and *said, “Rabbi!” and kissed Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they laid hands on Him and arrested Him.

column.name: text
column.value: But one of those who stood by drew his sword, and struck the slave of the high priest and ①cut off his ear. ▷ ①Lit took off

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: And ①His disciples all left Him and fled. ▷ ①Lit they

column.name: text
column.value: But he ①pulled free of the linen sheet and escaped naked. ▷ ①Lit left behind

column.name: text
column.value: They led Jesus away to the high priest; and all the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes *gathered together.

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: Now the chief priests and the entire ①Council were trying to obtain testimony against Jesus to put Him to death, and they were not finding any. ▷ ①Or Sanhedrin

column.name: text
column.value: For many people were giving false testimony against Him, and so their testimonies were not consistent.

column.name: text
column.value: And then some stood up and began giving false testimony against Him, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “We heard Him say, ‘I will destroy this ①temple that was made by hands, and in three days I will build another, made without hands.’ ” ▷ ①Or sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: And not even in this respect was their testimony consistent.

column.name: text
column.value: And then the high priest stood up and came forward and questioned Jesus, saying, “Do You not offer any answer for what these men are testifying against You?”

column.name: text
column.value: But He kept silent and did not offer any answer. Again the high priest was questioning Him, and *said to Him, “Are You the ①Christ, the Son of ②the Blessed One?” ▷ ①I.e., Messiah ②A common way for the Jewish leaders to refer to God

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said, “I am; and you shall see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of power, and coming with the clouds of heaven.”

column.name: text
column.value: Tearing his clothes, the high priest *said, “What further need do we have of witnesses?

column.name: text
column.value: You have heard the blasphemy; how does it seem to you?” And they all condemned Him as deserving of death.

column.name: text
column.value: And some began to spit on Him, and ①to blindfold Him, and to beat Him with their fists and say to Him, “Prophesy!” Then the officers took custody of Him ②and slapped Him in the face. ▷ ①Or cover over His face ②Or with blows inflicted by rods

column.name: text
column.value: And while Peter was below in the courtyard, one of the slave women of the high priest *came,

column.name: text
column.value: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and *said, “You were with Jesus the Nazarene as well.”

column.name: text
column.value: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are talking about.” And he went out onto the ①porch. ② ▷ ①Or forecourt, gateway ②Later mss add and a rooster crowed

column.name: text
column.value: The slave woman saw him, and began once more to say to the bystanders, “This man is one of them!”

column.name: text
column.value: But again he denied it. And after a little while the bystanders were again saying to Peter, “You really are one of them, for you are a Galilean as well.”

column.name: text
column.value: But he began to ①curse himself and to swear, “I do not know this man of whom you speak!” ▷ ①Litput himself under a curse

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: And very early on the first day of the week, they *came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

column.name: text
column.value: They were saying to one another, “Who will roll away the stone from the entrance of the tomb for us?”

column.name: text
column.value: And looking up, they *noticed that the stone had been rolled away; ①for it was extremely large. ▷ ①I.e., its size drew their attention

column.name: text
column.value: And entering the tomb, they saw a young man sitting at the right, wearing a white robe; and they were amazed.

column.name: text
column.value: But he *said to them, “Do not be amazed; you are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen; He is not here; see, here is the place where they laid Him.

column.name: text
column.value: But go, tell His disciples and Peter, ‘He is going ahead of you to Galilee; there you will see Him, just as He told you.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: And they went out and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had gripped them; and they said nothing to anyone, for they were afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Now after He had risen early on the first day of the week, He first appeared to Mary Magdalene, from whom He had cast out seven demons. ▷ ①Later mss add vv 9-20

column.name: text
column.value: She went and reported to those who had been with Him, while they were mourning and weeping.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they heard that He was alive and had been seen by her, they refused to believe it.

column.name: text
column.value: Now after that, He appeared in a different form to two of them while they were walking along on their way to the country.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went away and reported it to the rest, but they did not believe them, either.

column.name: text
column.value: Later He appeared to the eleven disciples themselves as they were reclining at the table; and He reprimanded them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they had not believed those who had seen Him after He had risen from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who has believed and has been baptized will be saved; but the one who has not believed will be condemned.

column.name: text
column.value: These signs will accompany those who have believed: in My name they will cast out demons, they will speak with new tongues;

column.name: text
column.value: they will pick up serpents, and if they drink any deadly poison, it will not harm them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”

column.name: text
column.value: So then, when the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, He was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.

column.name: text

And after that, Jesus Himself also sent out through them from east to west the sacred and imperishable proclamation of eternal salvation. ]] ▷ ①A few late mss and ancient versions contain this paragraph, usually after v 8; a few have it at the end of the ch

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: just as they were handed down to us by those who from the beginning ①were eyewitnesses and ②servants of the ③word, ▷ ①Lit became ②Or ministers ③I.e., gospel

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: In the days of Herod, king of Judea, there was a priest named Zechariah, of the division of ①Abijah; and he had a wife ②from the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth. ▷ ①Gr Abia ②I.e., of priestly descent

column.name: text
column.value: They were both righteous in the sight of God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and requirements of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And yet they had no child, because Elizabeth was infertile, and they were both advanced in ①years. ▷ ①Lit days

column.name: text
column.value: Now it happened that while he was performing his priestly service before God in the appointed order of his division,

column.name: text
column.value: according to the custom of the priestly office, he was chosen by lot to enter the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

column.name: text
column.value: And the whole multitude of the people were in prayer outside at the hour of the incense offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Now an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing to the right of the altar of incense.

column.name: text
column.value: Zechariah was troubled when he saw the angel, and fear ①gripped him. ▷ ①Lit fell upon

column.name: text
column.value: But the angel said to him, “Do not be afraid, Zechariah, for your prayer has been heard, and your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you shall ①name him John. ▷ ①Lit call his name

column.name: text
column.value: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice over his birth.

column.name: text
column.value: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord; and he will drink no wine or liquor, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit ①while still in his mother’s womb. ▷ ①Lit still from his

column.name: text
column.value: And he will turn many of the sons of Israel back to the Lord their God.

column.name: text
column.value: And it is he who will go as a forerunner before Him in the spirit and power of Elijah, TO TURN THE HEARTS OF FATHERS BACK TO their children, and the disobedient to the attitude of the righteous, to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.”

column.name: text
column.value: Zechariah said to the angel, “How will I know this? For I am an old man, and my wife is advanced in her ①years.” ▷ ①Lit days

column.name: text
column.value: The angel answered and said to him, “I am Gabriel, who ①stands in the presence of God, and I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news. ▷ ①Lit stand beside

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, you will be silent and unable to speak until the day when these things take place, because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled at their proper time.”

column.name: text
column.value: And meanwhile the people were waiting for Zechariah, and were wondering at his delay in the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: But when he came out, he was unable to speak to them; and they realized that he had seen a vision in the temple, and he repeatedly ①made signs to them, and remained speechless. ▷ ①Possibly gesturing or nodding to them

column.name: text
column.value: When the days of his priestly service were concluded, he went back home.

column.name: text
column.value: Now after these days his wife Elizabeth became pregnant, and she kept herself ①in seclusion for five months, saying, ▷ ①Or hidden

column.name: text
column.value: “This is the way the Lord has dealt with me in the days when He looked with favor upon me, to take away my disgrace among people.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city in Galilee named Nazareth,

column.name: text
column.value: to a virgin ①betrothed to a man whose name was Joseph, of the ②descendants of David; and the virgin’s name was ③Mary. ▷ ①Unlike engagement, a betrothed couple was considered married, but did not yet live together ②Lit house ③Gr Mariam, Heb Miriam; so throughout Luke

column.name: text
column.value: And coming in, he said to her, “Greetings, favored one! The Lord ①is with you.” ▷ ①Or be

column.name: text
column.value: But she was very perplexed at this statement, and was pondering what kind of greeting this was.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel said to her, “Do not be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and you shall name Him Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High; and the Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David;

column.name: text
column.value: and He will reign over the house of Jacob forever, and His kingdom will have no end.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Mary said to the angel, “How will this be, since I ①am a virgin?” ▷ ①Lit do not know a man

column.name: text
column.value: The angel answered and said to her, “The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you; for that reason also the ①holy Child will be called the Son of God. ▷ ①Lit the holy one fathered

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, even your relative Elizabeth herself has conceived a son in her old age, and ①she who was called infertile is now in her sixth month. ▷ ①Lit this is the sixth month for her who

column.name: text
column.value: For nothing will be impossible with God.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Mary said, “Behold, the Lord’s bond-servant; may it be done to me according to your word.” And the angel departed from her.

column.name: text
column.value: Now ①at this time Mary set out and went in a hurry to the hill country, to a city of Judah, ▷ ①Lit in these days

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And she cried out with a loud voice and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!

column.name: text
column.value: And ①how has it happened to me that the mother of my Lord would come to me? ▷ ①Lit from where this to me

column.name: text
column.value: For behold, when the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy.

column.name: text
column.value: And blessed is she who ①believed that there would be a fulfillment of what had been spoken to her ②by the Lord.” ▷ ①Or believed, because there will be ②Lit from

column.name: text
column.value: And Mary said: “My soul ①exalts the Lord, ▷ ①Lit makes great

column.name: text

column.name: text
text
column.value: For the Mighty One has done great things for me; And holy is His name.

column.name: text
column.value: And His mercy is to generation ①after generation Toward those who fear Him. ▷ ①Lit and

column.name: text
text

column.name: text
column.value: He has filled the hungry with good things, And sent the rich away empty-handed.

column.name: text
column.value: He has given help to His servant Israel, ①In remembrance of His mercy, ▷ ①Lit So as to remember

column.name: text
column.value: Just as He spoke to our fathers, To Abraham and his ①descendants forever.” ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text

column.value: Now the time ①had come for Elizabeth to give birth, and she gave birth to a son. ▷ ①Lit was fulfilled

column.name: text
column.value: And they ①made signs to his father, as to what he wanted him called. ▷ ①I.e., gestured or nodded

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: And fear came on all those who lived around them; and all these matters were being talked about in the entire hill country of Judea.

column.name: text
column.value: All who heard them kept them in mind, saying, “What then will this child turn out to be?” For indeed the hand of the Lord was with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And his father Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied, saying:

column.name: text
column.value: “Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, For He has visited us and accomplished redemption for His people,

column.name: text
column.value: And has raised up a horn of salvation for us In the house of His servant David—

column.name: text
column.value: Just as He spoke by the mouth of His holy prophets from ancient times—

column.name: text
text
column.value: To show mercy to our fathers, And to remember His holy covenant,

column.name: text
column.value: The oath which He swore to our father Abraham,

column.name: text
column.value: To grant us that we, being rescued from the hand of our enemies, Would serve Him without fear,

column.name: text
column.value: In holiness and righteousness before Him all our days.

column.name: text
column.value: And you, child, also will be called the prophet of the Most High; For you will go on before the Lord to prepare His ways;

column.name: text
column.value: To give His people the knowledge of salvation ①By the forgiveness of their sins, ▷ ①Or Consisting in

column.name: text
column.value: Because of the tender mercy of our God, With which the Sunrise from on high will visit us,

column.name: text
column.value: To shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death, To guide our feet into the way of peace.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now the child grew and was becoming strong in spirit, and he lived in the deserts until the day of his public appearance to Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, when Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, and Herod was tetrarch of Galilee and his brother Philip was tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias was tetrarch of Abilene,

column.name: text
column.value: in the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zechariah, in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance ①for the forgiveness of sins; ▷ ①Or with reference to

column.name: text
column.value: as it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet: “THE VOICE OF ONE CALLING ①OUT IN THE WILDERNESS, ‘PREPARE THE WAY OF THE LORD, MAKE HIS PATHS STRAIGHT! ▷ ①Or out, Prepare in the wilderness the way

column.name: text
text
column.value: AND ALL ①FLESH WILL SEE THE SALVATION OF GOD!’ ” ▷ ①I.e., mankind

column.name: text
column.value: So he was saying to the crowds who were going out to be baptized by him, “You ①offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come? ▷ ①Or brood

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore produce fruits that are consistent with repentance, and do not start saying ①to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father,’ for I say to you that from these stones God is able to raise up children for Abraham. ▷ ①Or among

column.value: But indeed the axe is already being laid at the root of the trees; so every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the crowds were questioning him, saying, “Then what are we to do?”

column.name: text
column.value: And he would answer and say to them, “The one who has two ①tunics is to share with the one who has none; and the one who has food is to do likewise.” ▷ ①A long shirt worn next to the skin

column.name: text
column.value: Now even tax collectors came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what are we to do?”

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, “ ①Collect no more than what you have been ordered to.” ▷ ①Lit Do

column.name: text
column.value: And soldiers also were questioning him, saying, “What are we to do, we as well?” And he said to them, “Do not extort money from anyone, nor ①harass anyone, and be content with your wages.” ▷ ①Or blackmail

column.name: text
column.value: Now while the people were in a state of expectation and they all were thinking carefully in their hearts about John, whether he himself perhaps was the ①Christ, ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: His winnowing fork is in His hand to thoroughly clear His threshing floor, and to gather the wheat into His barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

column.name: text
column.value: So with many other exhortations he preached the gospel to the people.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Herod the tetrarch was reprimanded by him regarding Herodias, his brother’s wife, and regarding all the evil things which Herod had done,

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.value: In the same region there were some shepherds staying out in the fields and keeping watch over their flock at night.

column.name: text
column.value: And an angel of the Lord suddenly stood near them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them; and they were terribly frightened.

column.name: text
column.value: And so the angel said to them, “Do not be afraid; for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be for all the people;

column.name: text
column.value: for today in the city of David there has been born for you a Savior, who is ①Christ the Lord. ▷ ①I.e., the Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: And this will be a sign for you: you will find a baby wrapped in cloths and lying in a ①manger.” ▷ ①Or feeding trough

column.name: text
column.value: And suddenly there appeared with the angel a multitude of the heavenly ①army of angels praising God and saying, ▷ ①Or host

column.name: text
column.value: “Glory to God in the highest, And on earth peace among people ①with whom He is pleased.” ▷ ①Lit of good pleasure; or of goodwill

column.name: text
column.value: When the angels had departed from them into heaven, the shepherds began saying to one another, “Let’s go straight to Bethlehem, then, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they came in a hurry and found their way to Mary and Joseph, and the baby as He lay in the ①manger. ▷ ①Or feeding trough

column.name: text
column.value: When they had seen Him, they made known the statement which had been told them about this Child.

column.name: text
column.value: And all who heard it were amazed about the things which were told them by the shepherds.

column.name: text
column.value: But Mary treasured all these things, pondering them in her heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And the shepherds went back, glorifying and praising God for all that they had heard and seen, just as had been told them.

column.name: text
column.value: And when eight days were completed ①so that it was time for His circumcision, He was also named Jesus, the name given by the angel before He was conceived in the womb. ▷ ①Lit so as to circumcise Him

column.name: text
column.value: And when the days for ①their purification according to the Law of Moses were completed, they brought Him up to Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord ▷ ①I.e., Mary’s, with Joseph’s support

column.name: text
column.value: (as it is written in the Law of the Lord: “EVERY firstborn male that opens the womb shall be called holy to the LORD”),

column.name: text
column.value: and to offer a sacrifice according to what has been stated in the Law of the Lord: “A PAIR OF TURTLEDOVES OR TWO YOUNG DOVES.”

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon; and this man was righteous and devout, looking forward to the consolation of Israel; and the Holy Spirit was upon him.

column.name: text
