column.value: And it had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he would not see death before he had seen the Lord’s ①Christ. ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: And he came ①by the Spirit into the temple; and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, ②to carry out for Him the custom of the Law, ▷ ①Or in ②Lit to do for Him according to

column.name: text
column.value: then he took Him in his arms, and blessed God, and said,

column.name: text
column.value: “Now, Lord, You are letting Your bond-servant depart in peace, According to Your word;

column.name: text
column.value: For my eyes have seen Your salvation,

column.name: text
column.value: Which You have prepared in the presence of all the peoples:

column.name: text
column.value: A light for revelation ①for the Gentiles, And the glory of Your people Israel.” ▷ ①Lit of the Gentiles

column.name: text
column.value: And His father and mother were amazed at the things which were being said about Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Simeon blessed them and said to His mother Mary, “Behold, this Child is appointed for the fall and ①rise of many in Israel, and as a sign to be ②opposed— ▷ ①Or resurrection ②Or refused

column.name: text
column.value: and a sword will pierce your own soul—to the end that thoughts from many hearts may be revealed.”

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a prophetess, ①Anna, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher. She was advanced in ②years and had lived with her husband for seven years after her ③marriage, ▷ ①Or Hannah ②Lit days ③Lit virginity

column.name: text
column.value: and then as a widow to the age of eighty-four. She did not leave the temple grounds, serving night and day with fasts and prayers.

column.name: text
column.value: And at that very ①moment she came up and began giving thanks to God, and continued to speak about Him to all those who were looking forward to the redemption of Jerusalem. ▷ ①Lit hour

column.name: text
column.value: And when His parents had completed everything in accordance with the Law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own city of Nazareth.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Child continued to grow and to become strong, ①increasing in wisdom; and the favor of God was upon Him. ▷ ①Lit becoming full of

column.name: text
column.value: His parents went to Jerusalem every year at the Feast of the Passover.

column.name: text
column.value: And when He was twelve years old, they went up there according to the custom of the feast;

column.name: text
column.value: and as they were returning, after spending the full number of days required, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem, but His parents were unaware of it.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, they thought that He was somewhere in the caravan, and they went a day’s journey; and then they began looking for Him among their relatives and acquaintances.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they did not find Him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then, after three days they found Him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.

column.name: text
column.value: And all who heard Him were amazed at His understanding and His answers.

column.name: text
column.value: When Joseph and Mary saw Him, they were bewildered; and His mother said to Him, “Son, why have You treated us this way? Behold, Your father and I have been anxiously looking for You!”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “Why is it that you were looking for Me? Did you not know that I had to be in My Father’s ①house?” ▷ ①Or affairs; or business; lit in the things of My Father

column.name: text
column.value: And yet they on their part did not understand the statement which He had ①made to them. ▷ ①Lit spoken

column.name: text
column.value: And He went down with them and came to Nazareth, and He continued to be subject to them; and His mother treasured all these ①things in her heart. ▷ ①Lit words

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus kept increasing in wisdom and ①stature, and in favor with God and people. ▷ ①Or age

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led around ①by the Spirit in the wilderness ▷ ①Or under the influence of; lit in

column.name: text
column.value: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. And He ate nothing during those days, and when they had ended, He was hungry.

column.name: text
column.value: And the devil said to Him, “If You are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered him, “It is written: ‘MAN SHALL NOT LIVE ON BREAD ALONE.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: And he led Him up and showed Him all the kingdoms of ①the world in a moment of time. ▷ ①Lit the inhabited earth

column.name: text
column.value: And the devil said to Him, “I will give You all this domain and ①its glory, for it has been handed over to me, and I give it to whomever I want. ▷ ①Lit their (referring to the kingdoms in v 5)

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore if You ①worship before me, it shall all be Yours.” ▷ ①Or bow down before

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied to him, “It is written: ‘YOU SHALL WORSHIP THE LORD YOUR GOD AND SERVE HIM ONLY.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought Him into Jerusalem and had Him stand on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to Him, “If You are the Son of God, throw Yourself down from here;

column.name: text
column.value: for it is written: ‘HE WILL GIVE HIS ANGELS ORDERS CONCERNING YOU, TO PROTECT YOU,’

column.name: text
column.value: and, ‘ON their hands they will lift YOU UP, SO THAT YOU DO NOT STRIKE YOUR FOOT AGAINST A STONE.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and said to him, “It has been stated, ‘YOU SHALL NOT PUT THE LORD YOUR GOD TO THE TEST.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: And so when the devil had finished every temptation, he left Him until an opportune time.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and news about Him spread through all the surrounding region.

column.name: text
column.value: And He began teaching in their synagogues and was praised by all.

column.name: text
column.value: And He came to Nazareth, where He had been brought up; and as was His custom, He entered the synagogue on the Sabbath, and stood up to read.

column.name: text
column.value: And the scroll of Isaiah the prophet was handed to Him. And He unrolled the scroll and found the place where it was written:

column.name: text
column.value: “THE SPIRIT OF THE LORD IS UPON ME, BECAUSE HE ANOINTED ME TO BRING GOOD NEWS TO THE POOR. HE HAS SENT ME TO PROCLAIM RELEASE TO CAPTIVES, AND RECOVERY OF SIGHT TO THE BLIND, TO SET FREE THOSE WHO ARE OPPRESSED,

column.name: text
column.value: TO PROCLAIM THE FAVORABLE YEAR OF THE LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He rolled up the scroll, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down; and the eyes of all the people in the synagogue were intently directed at Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now He began to say to them, “Today this Scripture has been fulfilled in your ①hearing.” ▷ ①Lit ears

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people were ①speaking well of Him, and admiring the ②gracious words which were coming from His ③lips; and yet they were saying, “Is this not Joseph’s son?” ▷ ①Lit mouth ②Or testifying ③Lit words of grace

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “No doubt you will ①quote this proverb to Me: ‘Physician, heal yourself! All the miracles that we heard were done in Capernaum, do here in your hometown as well.’ ” ▷ ①Lit tell me this

column.name: text
column.value: But He said, “Truly I say to you, no prophet is welcome in his hometown.

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you in truth, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up for three years and six months, when a ①severe famine came over all the land; ▷ ①Lit great

column.name: text
column.value: and yet Elijah was sent to none of them, but only to ①Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow. ▷ ①Gr Sarepta

column.name: text
column.value: And there were many with leprosy in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet; and none of them was ①cleansed, but only Naaman the Syrian.” ▷ ①I.e., healed

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people in the synagogue were filled with rage as they heard these things;

column.name: text
column.value: and they got up and drove Him out of the city, and brought Him to the ①crest of the hill on which their city had been built, so that they could throw Him down from the cliff. ▷ ①Lit brow

column.name: text
column.value: But He passed through their midst and went on His way.

column.name: text
column.value: And He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee; and He was teaching them on the Sabbath;

column.name: text
column.value: and they were amazed at His teaching, because His ①message was delivered with authority. ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: In the synagogue there was a man ①possessed by the spirit of an unclean demon, and he cried out with a loud voice, ▷ ①Lit having a spirit

column.name: text
column.value: “Leave us alone! ①What business do You have with us, Jesus ②of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!” ▷ ①Lit What to us and to you (an ancient idiom) ②Lit the Nazarene

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet and come out of him!” And when the demon had thrown him down in the midst of the people, it came out of him without doing him any harm.

column.name: text
column.value: And amazement came upon them all, and they began talking with one another, saying, “What is ①this message? For with authority and power He commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!” ▷ ①Or this word, that with authority...come out?

column.name: text
column.value: And the news about Him was spreading into every locality of the surrounding region.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He got up and left the synagogue, and entered Simon’s home. Now Simon’s mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever, and they asked Him ①to help her. ▷ ①Lit about her

column.name: text
column.value: And standing over her, He rebuked the fever, and it left her; and she immediately got up and served them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now while the sun was setting, all those who had any who were sick with various diseases brought them to Him; and He was laying His hands on each one of them and healing them.

column.name: text
column.value: Demons also were coming out of many, shouting, “You are the Son of God!” And yet He was rebuking them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew that He was the ①Christ. ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: Now when day came, Jesus left and went to a secluded place; and the crowds were searching for Him, and they came to Him and tried to keep Him from leaving them.

column.name: text
column.value: But He said to them, “I must also preach the kingdom of God to the other cities, because I was sent for this purpose.”

column.name: text
column.value: So He kept on preaching in the synagogues of ①Judea. ▷ ①I.e., the country of the Jews (including Galilee)

column.name: text
column.value: Now it happened that while the crowd was pressing around Him and listening to the word of God, He was standing by the lake of Gennesaret;

column.name: text
column.value: and He saw two boats lying at the edge of the lake; but the fishermen had gotten out of them and were washing their nets.

column.name: text
column.value: And He got into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little distance from the land. And He sat down and continued teaching the crowds from the boat.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when He had finished speaking, He said to Simon, “Put out into the deep water and let down your nets for a catch.”

column.name: text
column.value: Simon responded and said, “Master, we worked hard all night and caught nothing, but ①I will do as You say and let down the nets.” ▷ ①Lit upon Your word

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had done this, they caught a great quantity of fish, and their nets began to tear;

column.name: text
column.value: so they signaled to their partners in the other boat to come and help them. And they came and filled both of the boats, to the point that they were sinking.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Simon Peter saw this, he fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Go away from me, Lord, for I am a sinful man!”

column.name: text
column.value: For amazement had seized him and all his companions because of the catch of fish which they had taken;

column.name: text
column.value: and likewise also were ①James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. And Jesus said to Simon, “Do not fear; from now on you will be catching people.” ▷ ①Or Jacob

column.name: text
column.value: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything and followed Him.

column.name: text
column.value: While He was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man ①covered with leprosy; and when he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged Him, saying, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.” ▷ ①Lit full of

column.name: text
column.value: And He reached out with His hand and touched him, saying, “I am willing; be cleansed.” And immediately the leprosy left him.

column.name: text
column.value: And He ordered him to tell no one, saying, “But go and show yourself to the priest, and make an offering for your cleansing, just as Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”

column.name: text
column.value: But the news about Him was spreading even farther, and large crowds were gathering to hear Him and to be healed of their sicknesses.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus Himself would often slip away ①to the ②wilderness and pray. ▷ ①Lit in ②Or deserted places

column.name: text
column.value: ①One day He was teaching, and there were some Pharisees and teachers of the Law sitting there who had come from every village of Galilee and Judea, and from Jerusalem; and the power of the Lord was present for Him to perform healing. ▷ ①Lit On one of the days

column.name: text
column.value: And some men were carrying a man on a stretcher who was paralyzed; and they were trying to bring him in and to set him down in front of Him.

column.name: text
column.value: But when they did not find any way to bring him in because of the crowd, they went up on the roof and let him down through the tiles with his stretcher, into the middle of the crowd, in front of Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And seeing their faith, He said, “ ①Friend, your sins are forgiven you.” ▷ ①Lit Man

column.name: text
column.value: The scribes and the Pharisees began thinking of the implications, saying, “Who is this man who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, except God alone?”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus, ①aware of their thoughts, responded and said to them, “Why are you thinking this way in your hearts? ▷ ①Or perceiving

column.name: text
column.value: Which is easier, to say: ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?

column.name: text
column.value: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins,” He said to the man who was paralyzed, “I say to you, get up, and pick up your stretcher, and go home.”

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately he got up before them, and picked up what he had been lying on, and went home glorifying God.

column.name: text
column.value: And ①they were all struck with astonishment and began glorifying God. They were also filled with fear, saying, “We have seen remarkable things today!” ▷ ①Lit astonishment took them all

column.name: text
column.value: After that He went out and looked at a tax collector named ①Levi sitting in the tax office, and He said to him, “Follow Me.” ▷ ①Also called Matthew

column.name: text
column.value: And he left everything behind, and got up and began following Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Levi gave a big reception for Him in his house; and there was a large crowd of tax collectors and other people who were reclining at the table with them.

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees and their scribes began grumbling to His disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and ①sinners?” ▷ ①I.e., irreligious Jews

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and said to them, “It is not those who are healthy who need a physician, but those who are sick.

column.name: text
column.value: I have not come to call the righteous to repentance, but sinners.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to Him, “The disciples of John often fast and offer prayers, the disciples of the Pharisees also do ①the same, but Yours eat and drink.” ▷ ①Lit likewise

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to them, “You cannot make the ①attendants of the groom fast while the groom is with them, can you? ▷ ①Lit sons of the bridal chamber

column.name: text
column.value: But the days will come; and when the groom is taken away from them, then they will fast in those days.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He was also telling them a parable: “No one tears a piece of cloth from a new garment and puts it on an old garment; otherwise he will both tear the new, and the patch from the new garment will not match the old.

column.name: text
column.value: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins; otherwise the new wine will burst the skins and it will be spilled out, and the skins will be ruined.

column.name: text
column.value: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins.

column.name: text
column.value: And no one, after drinking old wine wants new; for he says, ‘The old is fine.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: When He had completed all His ①teaching in the hearing of the people, He went to Capernaum. ▷ ①Lit words

column.name: text
column.value: Now a centurion’s slave, who was highly regarded by him, was sick and about to die.

column.name: text
column.value: When he heard about Jesus, he sent some ①Jewish elders to Him, asking Him to come and save the life of his slave. ▷ ①Lit elders of the Jews

column.name: text
column.value: When they came to Jesus, they strongly urged Him, saying, “He is worthy for You to grant this to him;

column.name: text
column.value: for he loves our nation, and it was he who built us our synagogue.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jesus started on His way with them; but already, when He was not yet far from the house, the centurion sent friends, saying to Him, “ ①Lord, do not trouble Yourself further, for I am not worthy for You to enter under my roof; ▷ ①Or Sir

column.name: text
column.value: for that reason I did not even consider myself worthy to come to You; but just ①say the word, and my servant ②shall be healed. ▷ ①Lit say with a word ②A command in Greek

column.name: text
column.value: For I also am a man placed under authority, with soldiers under myself; and I say to this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes, and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes, and to my slave, ‘Do this!’ and he does it.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Jesus heard this, He was amazed at him, and turned and said to the crowd that was following Him, “I say to you, not even in Israel have I found such great faith.”

column.name: text
column.value: And when those who had been sent returned to the house, they found the slave in good health.

column.name: text
column.value: Soon afterward Jesus went to a city called Nain; and His disciples were going along with Him, ①accompanied by a large crowd. ▷ ①Lit and a

column.name: text
column.value: Now as He approached the gate of the city, ①a dead man was being carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow; and a sizeable crowd from the city was with her. ▷ ①Lit one who had died

column.name: text
column.value: When the Lord saw her, He felt compassion for her and said to her, “Do not go on weeping.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He came up and touched the coffin; and the bearers came to a halt. And He said, “Young man, I say to you, arise!”

column.name: text
column.value: And the dead man sat up and began to speak. And Jesus gave him back to his mother.

column.name: text
column.value: Fear gripped them all, and they began glorifying God, saying, “A great prophet has appeared among us!” and, “God has ①visited His people!” ▷ ①Or cared for

column.name: text
column.value: And this report about Him spread throughout Judea and in all the surrounding region.

column.name: text
column.value: The disciples of John also reported to him about all these things.

column.name: text
column.value: And after summoning ①two of his disciples, John sent them to the Lord, saying, “Are You the Coming One, or are we to ②look for another?” ▷ ①Lit a certain two ②Or wait for

column.name: text
column.value: When the men came to Him, they said, “John the Baptist has sent us to You, ①to ask, ‘Are You the Coming One, or are we to ②look for another?’ ” ▷ ①Lit saying ②Or wait for

column.name: text
column.value: At that very ①time He cured many people of diseases and afflictions and evil spirits; and He gave sight to many who were blind. ▷ ①Lit hour

column.name: text
column.value: And He answered and said to them, “Go and report to John what you have seen and heard: people who were blind receive sight, people who limped walk, people with leprosy are cleansed and people who were deaf hear, dead people are raised up, and people who are poor have the gospel preached to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And blessed is ①anyone who does not take offense at Me.” ▷ ①Lit whoever

column.name: text
column.value: When the messengers of John had left, He began to speak to the crowds about John: “What did you go out into the ①wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind? ▷ ①I.e., desert

column.name: text
column.value: ①But what did you go out to see? A man dressed in soft clothing? Those who are splendidly clothed and live in luxury are found in royal palaces! ▷ ①Or Well then, what

column.name: text
column.value: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and one who is more than a prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the one about whom it is written: ‘BEHOLD, I AM SENDING MY MESSENGER ①AHEAD OF YOU, WHO WILL PREPARE YOUR WAY BEFORE YOU.’ ▷ ①Lit before Your face

column.name: text
column.value: I say to you, among those born of women there is no one greater than John; yet the one who is ①least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.” ▷ ①Or less

column.name: text
column.value: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they acknowledged God’s justice, having been baptized with the baptism of John.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Pharisees and the ①lawyers rejected God’s purpose for themselves, not having been baptized by ②John. ▷ ①I.e., experts in the Mosaic Law ②Lit him

column.name: text
column.value: “To what then shall I compare the people of this generation, and what are they like?

column.name: text
column.value: They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another, and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a song of mourning, and you did not weep.’

column.name: text
column.value: For John the Baptist has come neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon!’

column.name: text
column.value: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a ①heavy drinker, a friend of tax collectors and ②sinners!’ ▷ ①Or wine drinker ②I.e., irreligious Jews

column.name: text
column.value: And yet wisdom is vindicated by all her children.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now one of the Pharisees was requesting Him to eat with him, and He entered the Pharisee’s house and reclined at the table.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a woman in the city who was a ①sinner; and when she learned that He was reclining at the table in the Pharisee’s house, she brought an alabaster vial of perfume, ▷ ①I.e., an immoral woman

column.name: text
column.value: and standing behind Him at His feet, weeping, she began to wet His feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, and began kissing His feet and anointing them with the perfume.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the Pharisee who had invited Him saw this, he said to himself, “If this man were a prophet He would know who and what sort of person this woman is who is touching Him, that she is a ①sinner!” ▷ ①I.e., an immoral woman

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus responded and said to him, “Simon, I have something to say to you.” And he ①replied, “Say it, Teacher.” ▷ ①Lit says

column.name: text
column.value: “A moneylender had two debtors: the one owed five hundred ①denarii, and the other, fifty. ▷ ①The denarius was a day’s wages for a laborer

column.name: text
column.value: When they were unable to repay, he canceled the debts of both. So which of them will love him more?”

column.name: text
column.value: Simon answered and said, “I assume the one for whom he canceled the greater debt.” And He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”

column.name: text
column.value: And turning toward the woman, He said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered your house; you gave Me no water for My feet, but she has wet My feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.

column.name: text
column.value: You ①gave Me no kiss; but she has not stopped kissing My feet since the time I came in. ▷ ①A customary form of greeting between rabbis

column.name: text
column.value: You did not ①anoint My head with oil, but she anointed My feet with perfume. ▷ ①A customary act of hospitality

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason I say to you, her sins, which are many, have been forgiven, for she loved much; but the one who is forgiven little, loves little.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to her, “Your sins have been forgiven.”

column.name: text
column.value: And then those who were reclining at the table with Him began saying ①to themselves, “Who is this man who even forgives sins?” ▷ ①Or among

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you; go in peace.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now it happened that ①Jesus was passing through some grainfields on a Sabbath, and His disciples were picking the heads of grain, rubbing them in their hands, and eating them. ▷ ①Lit He

column.name: text
column.value: But some of the Pharisees said, “Why are you doing what is not lawful on the Sabbath?”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus, answering them, said, “Have you not even read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,

column.name: text
column.value: how he entered the house of God, and took and ate the ①consecrated bread, which is not lawful for anyone to eat except the priests alone, and gave it to his companions?” ▷ ①Lit loaves of presentation

column.name: text
column.value: And He was saying to them, “The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

column.name: text
column.value: On another Sabbath He entered the synagogue and taught; and a man was there ①whose right hand was withered. ▷ ①Lit and his

column.name: text
column.value: Now the scribes and the Pharisees were watching Him ①closely to see if He healed on the Sabbath, so that they might find a reason to accuse Him. ▷ ①Or maliciously

column.name: text
column.value: But He knew ①what they were thinking, and He said to the man with the withered hand, “Get up and ②come forward!” And he got up and ③came forward. ▷ ①Lit their thoughts ②Lit stand into the middle ③Lit stood

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to them, “I ask you whether it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath or to do harm, to save a life or to destroy it?”

column.name: text
column.value: And after looking around at them all, He said to him, “Stretch out your hand!” And he did so; and his hand was restored.

column.name: text
column.value: But they themselves were filled with senseless rage, and began discussing together what they might do to Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it was ①at this time that He went off to the mountain to pray, and He spent the whole night in prayer with God. ▷ ①Lit in these days

column.name: text
column.value: And when day came, He called His disciples to Him and chose twelve of them, whom He also named as apostles:

column.name: text
column.value: Simon, whom He also named Peter, and his brother Andrew; and ①James and John; and Philip and Bartholomew; ▷ ①Or Jacob, also vv 15 and 16

column.name: text
column.value: and Matthew and Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon who was called the Zealot;

column.name: text
column.value: Judas the son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.

column.name: text
column.value: And then Jesus came down with them and stood on a level place; and there was a large crowd of His disciples, and a great multitude of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem, and the coastal region of Tyre and Sidon,

column.name: text
column.value: who had come to hear Him and to be healed of their diseases; and those who were troubled by unclean spirits were being cured.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the ①people were trying to touch Him, because power was coming from Him and healing them all. ▷ ①Lit crowd

column.name: text
column.value: And He raised His eyes toward His disciples and began saying, “Blessed are ①you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God. ▷ ①Lit the poor

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are ①you who are hungry now, for you will be satisfied. Blessed are ②you who weep now, for you will laugh. ▷ ①Lit the ones who ②Lit the ones who

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are you when the people hate you, and when they ①exclude you, and insult you, and scorn your name as evil, on account of the Son of Man. ▷ ①Or excommunicate

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice on that day and jump for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven. For their fathers used to ①treat the prophets the same way. ▷ ①Lit do to

column.name: text
column.value: But woe to you who are rich, for you are receiving your comfort in full.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you who ①are well-fed now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep. ▷ ①Or have plenty to eat

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you when all the people speak well of you; for their fathers used to ①treat the false prophets the same way. ▷ ①Lit do to

column.name: text
column.value: “But I say to you who hear, love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

column.name: text
column.value: bless those who curse you, pray for those who are abusive to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever hits you on the cheek, offer him the other also; and whoever takes away your ①cloak, do not withhold your ②tunic from him either. ▷ ①Or outer garment ②A long shirt worn next to the skin

column.name: text
column.value: Give to everyone who asks of you, and whoever takes away what is yours, do not demand it back.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Treat people the same way you want them to ②treat you. ▷ ①Lit Do to ②Lit do to

column.name: text
column.value: If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.

column.name: text
column.value: And if you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.

column.name: text
column.value: And if you lend to those from whom you expect to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners in order to receive back the same amount.

column.name: text
column.value: But love your enemies and do good, and lend, expecting nothing in return; and your reward will be great, and you will be sons of the Most High; for He Himself is kind to ungrateful and evil people.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful. ▷ ①Or Prove yourselves merciful

column.name: text
column.value: “Do not ①judge, and you will not be judged; and do not ②condemn, and you will not be condemned; ③pardon, and you will be pardoned. ▷ ①Or continually judge ②Or continually condemn ③Or continually pardon

column.name: text
column.value: Give, and it will be given to you. They will ①pour into your lap a good measure—pressed down, shaken together, and running over. For by your standard of measure it will be measured to you in return.” ▷ ①Lit give

column.name: text
column.value: Now He also spoke a parable to them: “A person who is blind cannot guide another who is blind, can he? Will they not both fall into a pit?

column.name: text
column.value: A ①student is not above the teacher; but everyone, when he has been fully trained, will be like his teacher. ▷ ①Or disciple

column.name: text
column.value: Why do you look at the ①speck that is in your brother’s eye, but do not notice the log that is in your own eye? ▷ ①Or splinter

column.name: text
column.value: How can you say to your brother, ‘Brother, let me take out the ①speck that is in your eye,’ when you yourself do not see the log that is in your own eye? You hypocrite, first take the log out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to take out the ②speck that is in your brother’s eye. ▷ ①Or splinter ②Or splinter

column.name: text
column.value: For there is no good tree that bears bad fruit, nor, ①on the other hand, a bad tree that bears good fruit. ▷ ①Lit again

column.name: text
column.value: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people do not gather figs from thorns, nor do they pick grapes from a briar bush.

column.name: text
column.value: The good person out of the good ①treasure of his heart brings forth what is good; and the evil person out of the evil treasure brings forth what is evil; for his mouth speaks from ②that which fills his heart. ▷ ①Or treasury, storehouse ②Lit the abundance of

column.name: text
column.value: “Now why do you call Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and do not do what I say?

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone who comes to Me and hears My words and ①acts on them, I will show you whom he is like: ▷ ①Lit does

column.name: text
column.value: he is like a man building a house, who ①dug deep and laid a foundation on the rock; and when there was a flood, the river burst against that house and yet it could not shake it, because it had been well built. ▷ ①Lit dug and went deep

column.name: text
column.value: But the one who has heard and has not acted accordingly is like a man who built a house on the ground without a foundation; and the river burst against it and it immediately collapsed, and the ruin of that house was great.”

column.name: text
column.value: Soon afterward, ①Jesus began going around from one city and village to another, proclaiming and preaching the kingdom of God. The twelve were with Him, ▷ ①Lit He Himself

column.name: text
column.value: and also some women who had been healed of evil spirits and sicknesses: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out,

column.name: text
column.value: and Joanna the wife of Chuza, Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others who were contributing to their support out of their private means.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when a large crowd was coming together, and those from the various cities were journeying to Him, He spoke by way of a parable:

column.name: text
column.value: “The sower went out to sow his seed; and as he sowed, some fell beside the road, and it was trampled underfoot, and the birds of the sky ate it up.

column.name: text
column.value: Other seed fell on rocky soil, and when it came up, it withered away because it had no moisture.

column.name: text
column.value: Other seed fell among the thorns; and the thorns grew up with it and choked it out.

column.name: text
column.value: And yet other seed fell into the good soil, and grew up, and produced a crop a hundred times as much.” As He said these things, He would call out, “The one who has ears to hear, ①let him hear.” ▷ ①Or hear! Or listen!

column.name: text
column.value: Now His disciples began asking Him what this parable ①meant. ▷ ①Lit was

column.name: text
column.value: And He said, “To you it has been granted to know the ①mysteries of the kingdom of God, but to the rest they are told in parables, so that ②while seeing they may not see, and ③while hearing they may not understand. ▷ ①I.e., secrets ②Or though seeing, they will not ③Or though hearing, they will not

column.name: text
column.value: “Now this is the parable: the seed is the word of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And those beside the road are the ones who have heard, then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, so that they will not believe and be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: Those on the rocky soil are the ones who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and yet these do not have a firm root; ①they believe for a while, and in a time of temptation they ②fall away. ▷ ①Lit who believe ②I.e., from the faith

column.name: text
column.value: And the seed which fell among the thorns, these are the ones who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked by worries, riches, and pleasures of this life, and they bring no fruit to maturity.

column.name: text
column.value: But the seed in the good soil, these are the ones who have heard the word ①with a good and virtuous heart, and hold it firmly, and produce fruit with ②perseverance. ▷ ①Or in ②Or endurance

column.name: text
column.value: “Now no one lights a lamp and covers it over with a container, or puts it under a bed; but he puts it on a lampstand so that those who come in may see the light.

column.name: text
column.value: For nothing is concealed that will not become evident, nor anything hidden that will not be known and come to light.

column.name: text
column.value: So take care how you listen; for whoever has, to him more will be given; and whoever does not have, even what he ①thinks he has will be taken away from him.” ▷ ①Or seems to have

column.name: text
column.value: Now His mother and brothers came to Him, and they were unable to get to Him because of the crowd.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was reported to Him, “Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside, wishing to see You.”

column.name: text
column.value: But He answered and said to them, “My mother and My brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now on one of those days ①Jesus and His disciples got into a boat, and He said to them, “Let’s cross over to the other side of the lake.” So they launched out. ▷ ①Lit He

column.name: text
column.value: But as they were sailing along He fell asleep; and a fierce gale of wind descended on the lake, and they began to be swamped and to be in danger.

column.name: text
column.value: They came up to Jesus and woke Him, saying, “Master, Master, we are perishing!” And He got up and rebuked the wind and the surging ①waves, and they stopped, and ②it became calm. ▷ ①Lit waves of water ②Lit a calm occurred

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “Where is your faith?” But they were fearful and amazed, saying to one another, “Who then is this, that He commands even the winds and the water, and they obey Him?”

column.name: text
column.value: Then they sailed to the country of the Gerasenes, which is opposite Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: And when He stepped out onto the land, a man from the city met Him who was possessed with demons; and he had not put on clothing for a long time and was not living in a house, but among the tombs.

column.name: text
column.value: And seeing Jesus, he cried out and fell down before Him, and said with a loud voice, “ ①What business do You have with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You, do not torment me!” ▷ ①Lit What to me and to you (an ancient idiom)

column.name: text
column.value: For He had already commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For it had seized him many times; and he was bound with chains and shackles and kept under guard, and yet he would break the restraints and be driven by the demon into the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” And he said, “Legion”; because many demons had entered him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were begging Him not to command them to go away into the abyss.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding there on the mountain; and the demons begged Him to permit them to enter ①the pigs. And He gave them permission. ▷ ①Lit those

column.name: text
column.value: And the demons came out of the man and entered the pigs; and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and was drowned.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the herdsmen saw what had happened, they ran away and reported everything in the city, and in the country.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people came out to see what had happened; and they came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting down at the feet of Jesus, clothed and in his right mind; and they became frightened.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who had seen everything reported to them how the man who had been demon-possessed had been ①made well. ▷ ①Lit saved

column.name: text
column.value: And all the ①people of the territory of the Gerasenes and the surrounding region asked Him to leave them, because they were overwhelmed by great fear; and He got into a boat and returned. ▷ ①Lit multitude

column.name: text
column.value: But the man from whom the demons had gone out was begging Him that he might ①accompany Him; but Jesus sent him away, saying, ▷ ①Lit be with

column.name: text
column.value: “Return to your home and describe what great things God has done for you.” So he went away, proclaiming throughout the city what great things Jesus had done for him.

column.name: text
column.value: And as Jesus was returning, the ①people welcomed Him, for they had all been waiting for Him. ▷ ①Lit crowd

column.name: text
column.value: And a man named Jairus came, and he was an ①official of the synagogue; and he fell at Jesus’ feet, and began urging Him to come to his house; ▷ ①Lit ruler

column.name: text
column.value: for he had an only daughter, about twelve years old, and she was dying. But as He went, the crowds were pressing against Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And a woman who had suffered a chronic flow of blood for twelve years, and could not be healed by anyone,

column.name: text
column.value: came up behind Him and touched the fringe of His ①cloak, and immediately her bleeding stopped. ▷ ①Or outer garment

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said, “Who is the one who touched Me?” And while they were all denying it, Peter said, “Master, the ①people are crowding and pressing in on You.” ▷ ①Lit crowds

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch Me, for I was aware that power had left Me.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the woman saw that she had not escaped notice, she came trembling and fell down before Him, and admitted in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched Him, and how she had been immediately healed.

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has ①made you well; go in peace.” ▷ ①Lit saved you

column.name: text
column.value: While He was still speaking, someone *came from the house of the synagogue official, saying, “Your daughter has died; do not trouble the Teacher anymore.”

column.name: text
column.value: But when Jesus heard this, He responded to him, “Do not be afraid any longer; only believe, and she will be ①made well.” ▷ ①Lit saved

column.name: text
column.value: When He came to the house, He did not allow anyone to enter with Him except Peter, John, and James, and the girl’s father and mother.

column.name: text
column.value: Now they were all weeping and mourning for her; but He said, “Stop weeping, for she has not died, but is asleep.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they began laughing at Him, knowing that she had died.

column.name: text
column.value: He, however, took her by the hand and spoke ①forcefully, saying, “Child, arise!” ▷ ①Lit loudly

column.name: text
column.value: And her spirit returned, and she got up immediately; and He ordered that something be given her to eat.

column.name: text
column.value: Her parents were amazed; but He instructed them to tell no one what had happened.

column.name: text
column.value: Now He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all the demons, and the power to heal diseases.

column.name: text
column.value: And He sent them out to proclaim the kingdom of God and to perform healing.

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey, neither a staff, nor a ①bag, nor bread, nor money; and do not even have two ②tunics. ▷ ①Or knapsack ②A long shirt worn next to the skin

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever house you enter, stay there ①until you leave that city. ▷ ①Lit and leave from there

column.name: text
column.value: And as for all who do not receive you, when you leave that city, shake the dust off your feet as a testimony against them.”

column.name: text
column.value: And as they were leaving, they began going ①throughout the villages, preaching the gospel and healing everywhere. ▷ ①Or from village to village

column.name: text
column.value: Now Herod the tetrarch heard about all that was happening; and he was greatly perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,

column.name: text
column.value: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the prophets of old had risen.

column.name: text
column.value: Herod said, “I myself had John beheaded; but who is this man about whom I hear such things?” And he kept trying to see Him.

column.name: text
column.value: When the apostles returned, they gave an account to Him of all that they had done. And taking them with Him, He withdrew privately to a city called Bethsaida.

column.name: text
column.value: But the crowds were aware of this and followed Him; and He welcomed them and began speaking to them about the kingdom of God, and curing those who had need of healing.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the day ①was ending, and the twelve came up and said to Him, “Dismiss the crowd, so that they may go into the surrounding villages and countryside and find lodging and get ②something to eat; because here, we are in a secluded place.” ▷ ①Lit began to decline ②Lit provisions

column.name: text
column.value: But He said to them, “You give them something to eat!” But they said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless perhaps we go and buy food for all these people.”

column.name: text
column.value: (For there were about five thousand men.) But He said to His disciples, “Have them recline to eat in groups of about fifty each.”

column.name: text
column.value: They did so, and had them all recline.

column.name: text
column.value: And He took the five loaves and the two fish, and, looking up to heaven, He blessed them and broke them, and gave them to the disciples again and again, to serve the crowd.

column.name: text
column.value: And they all ate and were satisfied; and ①the broken pieces which they had left over were picked up, twelve baskets full. ▷ ①Lit what was left over to them of the broken pieces was

column.name: text
column.value: And it happened that while He was praying alone, the disciples were with Him, and He questioned them, saying, “Who do the ①people say that I am?” ▷ ①Lit crowds

column.name: text
column.value: They answered and said, “John the Baptist, and others say Elijah; but others, that one of the prophets of old has risen.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” And Peter answered and said, “The ①Christ of God.” ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: But He ①warned them and instructed them not to tell this to anyone, ▷ ①Or strictly admonished

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed and be raised on the third day.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He was saying to them all, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself, take up his cross daily, and follow Me.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever wants to save his ①life will lose it, but whoever loses his ②life for My sake, this is the one who will save it. ▷ ①Or soul ②Or soul

column.name: text
column.value: For what good does it do a person if he gains the whole world, but loses or forfeits himself?

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever is ashamed of Me and My words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of him when He comes in His glory and the glory of the Father and the holy angels.

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you truthfully, there are some of those standing here who will not taste death until they see the kingdom of God.”

column.name: text
column.value: About eight days after these sayings, He took along Peter, John, and James, and went up on the mountain to pray.

column.name: text
column.value: And while He was praying, the appearance of His face became different, and His clothing became white and ①gleaming. ▷ ①Or flashing like lightning

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, two men were talking with Him; and they were Moses and Elijah,

column.name: text
column.value: who, appearing in ①glory, were speaking of His departure, which He was about to accomplish at Jerusalem. ▷ ①Or splendor

column.name: text
column.value: Now Peter and his companions had been overcome with sleep; but when they were fully awake, they saw His glory and the two men who were standing with Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And as ①these two men were leaving Him, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good that we are here; and let’s make three ②tabernacles: one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah”—not realizing what he was saying. ▷ ①Lit they ②Or sacred tents

column.name: text
column.value: But while he was saying this, a cloud ①formed and began to overshadow them; and they were afraid as they entered the cloud. ▷ ①Lit occurred

column.name: text
column.value: And then a voice came from the cloud, saying, “This is My Son, My Chosen One; listen to Him!”

column.name: text
column.value: And when the voice ①had spoken, Jesus was found alone. And they kept silent, and reported to no one in those days any of the things which they had seen. ▷ ①Lit occurred

column.name: text
column.value: On the next day, when they came down from the mountain, a large crowd met Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And a man from the crowd shouted, saying, “Teacher, I beg You to look at my son, because he is my only son,

column.name: text
column.value: and a spirit seizes him and he suddenly screams, and it throws him into a convulsion with foaming at the mouth; and only with difficulty does it leave him, mauling him as it leaves.

column.name: text
column.value: And I begged Your disciples to cast it out, and they could not.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and said, “You unbelieving and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and put up with you? Bring your son here.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now while he was still approaching, the demon slammed him to the ground and threw him into a convulsion. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the boy and gave him back to his father.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were all amazed at the ①greatness of God. But while everyone was astonished at all that He was doing, He said to His disciples, ▷ ①Or majesty

column.name: text
column.value: “As for you, let these words sink into your ears: for the Son of Man is going to be ①handed over to men.” ▷ ①Or betrayed

column.name: text
column.value: But they ①did not understand this statement, and it was concealed from them so that they would not comprehend it; and they were afraid to ask Him about this statement. ▷ ①Lit were not knowing

column.name: text
column.value: Now an argument ①started among them as to which of them might be the greatest. ▷ ①Lit entered

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus, knowing ①what they were thinking in their hearts, took a child and had him stand by His side, ▷ ①Lit the reasoning; or argument

column.name: text
column.value: and He said to them, “Whoever receives this child in My name receives Me, and whoever receives Me receives Him who sent Me; for the one who is least among all of you, this is the one who is great.”

column.name: text
column.value: John answered and said, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in Your name; and we tried to prevent him, because he does not follow along with us.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said to him, “Do not hinder him; for the one who is not against you is ①for you.” ▷ ①Or on your side

column.name: text
column.value: When the days were approaching for His ①ascension, He ②was determined to go to Jerusalem; ▷ ①Lit taking up ②Lit set His face

column.name: text
column.value: and He sent messengers on ahead of Him, and they went and entered a village of the Samaritans to ①make arrangements for Him. ▷ ①Or prepare

column.name: text
column.value: And they did not receive Him, because ①He was traveling toward Jerusalem. ▷ ①Lit His face was proceeding toward

column.name: text
column.value: When His disciples James and John saw this, they said, “Lord, do You want us to command fire to come down from heaven and consume them?”

column.name: text
column.value: But He turned and rebuked them. ① ▷ ①Some late mss add: and said, “You do not know of what kind of spirit you are; for the Son of Man did not come to destroy people’s lives, but to save them.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they went on to another village.

column.name: text
column.value: As they were going on the road, someone said to Him, “I will follow You wherever You go.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay His head.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to another, “Follow Me.” But he said, “Lord, permit me first to go and bury my father.”

column.name: text
column.value: But He said to him, “Allow the dead to bury their own dead; but as for you, go and proclaim everywhere the kingdom of God.”

column.name: text
column.value: Another also said, “I will follow You, Lord; but first permit me to say goodbye to those at my home.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said to him, “No one, after putting his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now after this the Lord appointed ①seventy-two others, and sent them in pairs ahead of Him to every city and place where He Himself was going to come. ▷ ①One early ms seventy

column.name: text
column.value: And He was saying to them, “The harvest is plentiful, but the laborers are few; therefore plead with the Lord of the harvest to send out laborers into His harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: Go; behold, I am sending you out like lambs in the midst of wolves.

column.name: text
column.value: Carry no money belt, no ①bag, no sandals, and greet no one along the way. ▷ ①Or knapsack

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’

column.name: text
column.value: And if a ①man of peace is there, your peace will rest upon him; but if not, it will return to you. ▷ ①Lit son of

column.name: text
column.value: Stay in ①that house, eating and drinking ②what they provide; for the laborer is deserving of his wages. Do not move from house to house. ▷ ①Lit the house itself ②Lit the things from them

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat what is served to you;

column.name: text
column.value: and heal those in it who are sick, and say to them, ‘The kingdom of God has come near to you.’

column.name: text
column.value: But whatever city you enter and they do not receive you, go out into its streets and say,

column.name: text
column.value: ‘Even the dust of your city which clings to our feet we wipe off in protest against you; yet ①be sure of this, that the kingdom of God has come near.’ ▷ ①Lit know

column.name: text
column.value: I say to you, it will be more tolerable on that day for Sodom than for that city.

column.name: text
column.value: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the ①miracles that occurred in you had occurred in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in ②sackcloth and ashes. ▷ ①Or works of power ②I.e., symbols of mourning

column.name: text
column.value: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.

column.name: text
column.value: And you, Capernaum, will not be exalted to heaven, will you? You will be brought down to Hades!

column.name: text
column.value: “The one who listens to you listens to Me, and the one who rejects you rejects Me; but the one who rejects Me rejects the One who sent Me.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now the ①seventy-two returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us ②in Your name!” ▷ ①One early ms seventy ②Or by

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “I watched Satan fall from heaven like lightning.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I have given you authority to walk on snakes and scorpions, and authority over all the power of the enemy, and nothing will injure you.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, do not ①rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are recorded in heaven.” ▷ ①Or go on rejoicing

column.name: text
column.value: At that very ①time He rejoiced greatly in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I ②praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that You have hidden these things from the wise and intelligent and have revealed them to infants. Yes, Father, for doing so was well pleasing in Your sight. ▷ ①Lit hour ②Or acknowledge to You

column.name: text
column.value: All things have been handed over to Me by My Father, and no one knows who the Son is except the Father, and who the Father is except the Son, and anyone to whom the Son determines to reveal Him.”

column.name: text
column.value: Turning to the disciples, He said privately, “Blessed are the eyes that see the things you see;

column.name: text
column.value: for I tell you that many prophets and kings wanted to see the things that you see, and did not see them, and to hear the things that you hear, and did not hear them.”

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, a ①lawyer stood up and put Him to the test, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?” ▷ ①I.e., an expert in the Mosaic Law

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to him, “What is written in the Law? ①How does it read to you?” ▷ ①Lit How do you read?

column.name: text
column.value: And he answered, “YOU SHALL LOVE THE LORD YOUR GOD ①WITH ALL YOUR HEART, AND WITH ALL YOUR SOUL, AND WITH ALL YOUR STRENGTH, AND WITH ALL YOUR MIND; AND YOUR NEIGHBOR AS YOURSELF.” ▷ ①Lit from all

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to him, “You have answered correctly; do this and you will live.”

column.name: text
column.value: But wanting to justify himself, he said to Jesus, “And who is my neighbor?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied and said, “A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he encountered robbers, and they stripped him and ①beat him, and went away leaving him half dead. ▷ ①Lit laid blows upon

column.name: text
column.value: And by coincidence a priest was going down on that road, and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.

column.name: text
column.value: But a Samaritan who was on a journey came upon him; and when he saw him, he felt compassion,

column.name: text
column.value: and came to him and bandaged up his wounds, pouring oil and wine on them; and he put him on his own animal, and brought him to an inn and took care of him.

column.name: text
column.value: On the next day he took out two ①denarii and gave them to the innkeeper and said, ‘Take care of him; and whatever more you spend, when I return, I will repay you.’ ▷ ①The denarius was a day’s wages for a laborer

column.name: text
column.value: Which of these three do you think ①proved to be a neighbor to the man who fell into the robbers’ hands?” ▷ ①Lit has proved

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, “The one who showed compassion to him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do ①the same.” ▷ ①Or likewise

column.name: text
column.value: Now as they were traveling along, He entered a village; and a woman named Martha welcomed Him into her home.

column.name: text
column.value: And she had a sister called Mary, who was also seated at the Lord’s feet, and was listening to His word.

column.name: text
column.value: But Martha was distracted with ①all her preparations; and she came up to Him and said, “Lord, do You not care that my sister has left me to do the serving ②by myself? Then tell her to help me.” ▷ ①Lit much service ②Lit alone

column.name: text
column.value: But the Lord answered and said to her, “Martha, Martha, you are worried and distracted by many things;

column.name: text
column.value: but only one thing is necessary; for Mary has chosen the good part, which shall not be taken away from her.”

column.name: text
column.value: It happened that while ①Jesus was praying in a certain place, when He had finished, one of His disciples said to Him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.” ▷ ①Lit He

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “When you pray, say: ‘ ①Father, ②hallowed be Your name. ③Your kingdom come. ▷ ①Later mss add phrases from Matt 6:9-13 to make the two passages closely similar ②I.e., treated as sacred or holy ③Or May Your...come

column.name: text
column.value: Give us each day our ①daily bread. ▷ ①Or bread for the coming day; or needful bread

column.name: text
column.value: And forgive us our sins, For we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. And do not lead us into temptation.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “ ①Suppose one of you has a friend, and goes to him at midnight and says to him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves, ▷ ①Lit Which one of you will have...and will go

column.name: text
column.value: because a friend of mine has come to me from a journey and I have nothing to serve him’;

column.name: text
column.value: and from inside he answers and says, ‘Do not bother me; the door has already been shut and my children ①and I are in bed; I cannot get up and give you anything.’ ▷ ①Lit are with me

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you, even if he will not get up and give him anything just because he is his friend, yet because of his ①shamelessness he will get up and give him as much as he needs. ▷ ①Prob. by continued knocking

column.name: text
column.value: “So I say to you, ①ask, and it will be given to you; ②seek, and you will find; ③knock, and it will be opened to you. ▷ ①Or keep asking ②Or keep seeking ③Or keep knocking

column.name: text
column.value: For everyone who asks receives, and the one who seeks finds, and to the one who knocks, it will be opened.

column.name: text
column.value: Now ①which one of you fathers will his son ask for a ②fish, and instead of a fish, he will give him a snake? ▷ ①Lit which of you, the father, will the son ask ②One early ms inserts loaf, he will not give him a stone, will he, or for a

column.name: text
column.value: Or he will even ask for an egg, and his father will give him a scorpion?

column.name: text
column.value: So if you, despite being ①evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will ②your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him?” ▷ ①I.e., as sinful mankind ②Lit the Father from heaven

column.name: text
column.value: And He was casting out a mute demon; when the demon had gone out, the man who was previously unable to speak talked, and the crowds were amazed.

column.name: text
column.value: But some of them said, “He casts out the demons by Beelzebul, the ruler of the demons.”

column.name: text
column.value: Others, ①to test Him, were demanding of Him a ②sign from heaven. ▷ ①Lit testing ②I.e., confirming miracle

column.name: text
column.value: But He knew their thoughts and said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is laid waste; and a house divided against ①itself falls. ▷ ①Lit a house

column.name: text
column.value: And if Satan also has been divided against himself, how will his kingdom ①stand? For you claim that I cast out the demons by Beelzebul. ▷ ①I.e., remain stable

column.name: text
column.value: Yet if by Beelzebul I cast out the demons, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore, they will be your judges.

column.name: text
column.value: But if I cast out the demons by ①the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you. ▷ ①I.e., an undeniable act of God

column.name: text
column.value: When ①a strong man, fully armed, guards his own house, his possessions are ②secure. ▷ ①Lit the ②Lit in peace

column.name: text
column.value: But when someone stronger than he attacks him and overpowers him, that man takes away his armor on which he had relied and distributes his plunder.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who is not with Me is against Me; and the one who does not gather with Me scatters.

column.name: text
column.value: “When the unclean spirit comes out of ①a person, it passes through waterless places seeking rest, and not finding any, it then says, ‘I will return to my house from which I came.’ ▷ ①Lit the

column.name: text
column.value: And when it comes, it finds it swept and put in order.

column.name: text
column.value: Then it goes and brings along seven other spirits more evil than itself, and they come in and live there; and the last condition of that person becomes worse than the first.”

column.name: text
column.value: While ①Jesus was saying these things, one of the women in the crowd raised her voice and said to Him, “Blessed is the womb that carried You, and the breasts at which You nursed!” ▷ ①Lit He

column.name: text
column.value: But He said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God and follow it.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now as the crowds were increasing, He began to say, “This generation is a wicked generation; it demands a ①sign, and so no ②sign will be given to it except the ③sign of Jonah. ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracle ②I.e., confirming miracle ③I.e., confirming miracle

column.name: text
column.value: For just as Jonah became a ①sign to the Ninevites, so will the Son of Man be to this generation. ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracle

column.name: text
column.value: The Queen of the South will rise up with the men of this generation at the judgment and condemn them, because she came from the ends of the earth to listen to the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, something greater than Solomon is here.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Nineveh will stand up with this generation at the judgment and condemn it, because they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, something greater than Jonah is here.

column.name: text
column.value: “No one lights a lamp and puts it away in a cellar nor under a basket, but on the lampstand, so that those who enter may see the light.

column.name: text
column.value: Your eye is the lamp of your body; when your eye is ①clear, your whole body also is full of light; but when it is ②bad, your body also is full of darkness. ▷ ①Or healthy ②Or evil

column.name: text
column.value: So watch out that the light in you is not darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore if your whole body is full of light, without any dark part, it will be wholly illuminated, as when the lamp illuminates you with its light.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now when He had spoken, a Pharisee *asked Him to have lunch with him; and He went in and reclined at the table.

column.name: text
column.value: When the Pharisee saw this, he was surprised that Jesus had not first ①ceremonially washed before the ②meal. ▷ ①Lit baptized; here, immersed the hands ②Or lunch

column.name: text
column.value: But the Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and of the dish; but your inside is full of greed and wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: You foolish ones, did He who made the outside not make the inside also?

column.name: text
column.value: But give that which is within as a charitable gift, and ①then all things are clean for you. ▷ ①Lit behold

column.name: text
column.value: “But woe to you Pharisees! For you pay tithes of mint, rue, and every kind of garden herb, and yet you ①ignore justice and the love of God; but these are the things you should have done without neglecting the others. ▷ ①Or neglect

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the seat of honor in the synagogues and personal greetings in the marketplaces.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you! For you are like ①unseen tombs, and the people who walk over them are unaware of it.” ▷ ①I.e., unmarked

column.name: text
column.value: One of the ①lawyers *said to Him in reply, “Teacher, when You say these things, You insult us too.” ▷ ①I.e., experts in the Mosaic Law

column.name: text
column.value: But He said, “Woe to you lawyers as well! For you load people with burdens that are hard to bear, ①while you yourselves will not even ②touch the burdens with one of your fingers. ▷ ①Lit and ②I.e., to assist them

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you! For you build the ①tombs of the prophets, and it was your fathers who killed them. ▷ ①Or monuments to

column.name: text
column.value: So you are witnesses and you approve of the deeds of your fathers; because it was they who killed them, and you build their ①tombs. ▷ ①Or monuments

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason also, the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they will kill, and some they will ①persecute, ▷ ①Or drive out

column.name: text
column.value: so that the blood of all the prophets, shed since the foundation of the world, may be charged ①against this generation, ▷ ①Or to

column.name: text
column.value: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the house of God; yes, I tell you, it shall be charged ①against this generation.’ ▷ ①Or to

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you ①lawyers! For you have taken away the key of knowledge; you yourselves did not enter, and you hindered those who were entering.” ▷ ①I.e., experts in the Mosaic Law

column.name: text
column.value: When He left that place, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be very hostile and to interrogate Him about many subjects,

column.name: text
column.value: plotting against Him to catch ①Him in something He might say. ▷ ①Lit something out of His mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Under these circumstances, after ①so many thousands of ②people had gathered together that they were stepping on one another, He began saying to His disciples first of all, “Beware of the ③leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy. ▷ ①Lit myriads ②Lit the crowd ③I.e., fermented dough

column.name: text
column.value: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed, and hidden that will not be known.

column.name: text
column.value: Accordingly, whatever you have said in the dark will be heard in the light, and what you have ①whispered in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops. ▷ ①Lit spoken to the ear

column.name: text
column.value: “Now I say to you, My friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have nothing more that they can do.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will warn you whom to fear: fear the One who, after He has killed someone, has the power to throw that person into ①hell; yes, I tell you, fear ②Him! ▷ ①Gr Gehenna ②Lit this one

column.name: text
column.value: Are five sparrows not sold for two ①assaria? And yet not one of them has gone unnoticed in the sight of God. ▷ ①A Roman copper coin (singular assarion), about 1/16 of a laborer’s daily wage

column.name: text
column.value: But even the hairs of your head are all counted. ①Do not fear; you are more valuable than a great number of sparrows. ▷ ①Or Stop being afraid

column.name: text
column.value: “Now I say to you, everyone who confesses Me before people, the Son of Man will also confess him before the angels of God;

column.name: text
column.value: but the one who denies Me before people will be denied before the angels of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And everyone who ①speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but the one who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him. ▷ ①Lit will speak

column.name: text
column.value: Now when they bring you before the synagogues and the officials and the authorities, do not worry about how or what you are to speak in your defense, or what you are to say;

column.name: text
column.value: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that very hour what you ought to say.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now someone ①in the crowd said to Him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the family inheritance with me.” ▷ ①Lit from

column.name: text
column.value: But He said to him, “ ①You there—who appointed Me a judge or arbitrator over the two of you?” ▷ ①Lit Man, who

column.name: text
column.value: But He said to them, “Beware, and be on your guard against every form of greed; for not even when one is affluent does his life consist of his possessions.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He told them a parable, saying, “The land of a rich man was very productive.

column.name: text
column.value: And he began thinking to himself, saying, ‘What shall I do, since I have no place to store my crops?’

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, ‘This is what I will do: I will tear down my barns and build larger ones, and I will store all my grain and my goods there.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will say to ①myself, “You have many goods stored up for many years to come; relax, eat, drink, and enjoy yourself!” ’ ▷ ①Lit my soul, “Soul, you have...”

column.name: text
column.value: But God said to him, ‘You fool! This very night ①your soul is demanded of you; and as for all that you have prepared, who will own it now?’ ▷ ①Lit they are demanding your soul from you

column.name: text
column.value: Such is the one who stores up treasure for himself, and is not rich in relation to God.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to His disciples, “For this reason I tell you, ①do not worry about your ②life, as to what you are to eat; nor for your body, as to what you are to wear. ▷ ①Or stop being worried ②Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: For life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.

column.name: text
column.value: Consider the ravens, that they neither sow nor reap; they have no storeroom nor barn, and yet God feeds them; how much more valuable you are than the birds!

column.name: text
column.value: And which of you by worrying can add a ①day to his ②life’s span? ▷ ①Lit cubit (about 18 in. or 45 cm) ②Or height

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore if you cannot do even a very little thing, why do you worry about the other things?

column.name: text
column.value: Consider the lilies, how they grow: they neither labor nor ①spin; but I tell you, not even Solomon in all his glory clothed himself like one of these. ▷ ①I.e., spin thread for cloth

column.name: text
column.value: Now if God so clothes the grass in the field, which is alive today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, how much more will He clothe you? You of little faith!

column.name: text
column.value: And do not ①seek what you are to eat and what you are to drink, and do not keep worrying. ▷ ①Or keep seeking

column.name: text
column.value: For ①all these things are what the nations of the world ②eagerly seek; and your Father knows that you need these things. ▷ ①Or these things all the nations of the world ②Or wish for

column.name: text
column.value: But ①seek His kingdom, and these things will be ②provided to you. ▷ ①Or continually seek ②Or added to

column.name: text
column.value: ①Do not be afraid, little flock, because your Father has chosen to give you the kingdom. ▷ ①Or Stop being afraid

column.name: text
column.value: “Sell your possessions and give to charity; make yourselves money belts that do not wear out, an inexhaustible treasure in heaven, where no thief comes near nor does a moth destroy.

column.name: text
column.value: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①Be prepared, and keep your lamps lit. ▷ ①Lit Have your waist belted

column.name: text
column.value: You are also to be like people who are waiting for their master when he returns from the wedding feast, so that they may immediately open the door for him when he comes and knocks.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are those slaves whom the master will find on the alert when he comes; truly I say to you, that he will ①prepare himself to serve, and have them recline at the table, and he will come up and serve them. ▷ ①Lit belt himself up

column.name: text
column.value: Whether he comes in the ①second watch, or even in the ②third, and finds them so, blessed are those slaves. ▷ ①I.e., 9 p.m. to midnight ②I.e., midnight to 3 a.m.

column.name: text
column.value: “But ①be sure of this, that if the head of the house had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would not have allowed his house to be broken into. ▷ ①Lit know

column.name: text
column.value: You too, be ready; because the Son of Man is coming at an hour that you do not think He will.”

column.name: text
column.value: Peter said, “Lord, are You telling this parable to us, or to everyone else as well?”

column.name: text
column.value: And the Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and sensible steward, whom his master will put in charge of his servants, to give them their rations at the proper time?

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is that slave whom his ①master finds so doing when he comes. ▷ ①Or lord

column.name: text
column.value: Truly I say to you that he will put him in charge of all his possessions.

column.name: text
column.value: But if that slave says in his heart, ‘My master will take a long time to come,’ and he begins to beat the other slaves, both men and women, and to eat and drink and get drunk;

column.name: text
