column.value: then the master of that slave will come on a day that he does not expect, and at an hour that he does not know, and will ①cut him in two, and assign ②him a place with the unbelievers. ▷ ①Possibly referring to other extreme punishment ②Lit his part with

column.name: text
column.value: And that slave who knew his master’s will and did not get ready or act in accordance with his will, will receive many blows,

column.name: text
column.value: but the one who did not know it, and committed acts deserving of ①a beating, will receive only a few blows. From everyone who has been given much, much will be demanded; and to whom they entrusted much, of him they will ask all the more. ▷ ①Lit blows

column.name: text
column.value: “I ①have come to cast fire upon the earth; and ②how I wish it were already kindled! ▷ ①Or came ②Lit what do I wish if...?

column.name: text
column.value: But I have a baptism ①to undergo, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished! ▷ ①Lit with which to be baptized

column.name: text
column.value: Do you think that I came to provide peace on earth? No, I tell you, but rather division;

column.name: text
column.value: for from now on five members in one household will be divided, three against two and two against three.

column.name: text
column.value: They will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He was also saying to the crowds, “Whenever you see a cloud rising ①in the west, you immediately say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it turns out. ▷ ①I.e., from the Mediterranean

column.name: text
column.value: And whenever you feel a ①south wind blowing, you say, ‘It will be a hot day,’ and it turns out that way. ▷ ①I.e., from the desert

column.name: text
column.value: You hypocrites! You know how to analyze the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you do not know how to analyze this present time?

column.name: text
column.value: “And why do you not even judge by yourselves what is right?

column.name: text
column.value: For when you are going with your accuser to appear before the magistrate, on the way, make an effort to ①settle with him, so that he does not drag you before the judge, and the judge hand you over to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison. ▷ ①Lit be rid of him

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you, you will not get out of there until you have paid up ①the very last ②lepton.” ▷ ①Lit even the last ②The smallest Greek copper coin, about 1/128 of a laborer’s daily wage

column.name: text
column.value: Now all the tax collectors and ①sinners were coming near ②Jesus to listen to Him. ▷ ①I.e., irreligious Jews ②Lit Him

column.name: text
column.value: And both the Pharisees and the scribes began to complain, saying, “This man receives sinners and eats with them.”

column.name: text
column.value: And so He told them this parable, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “What man among you, if he has a hundred sheep and has lost one of them, does not leave the other ninety-nine in the ①open pasture and go after the one that is lost, until he finds it? ▷ ①Lit wilderness

column.name: text
column.value: And when he has found it, he puts it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, because I have found my sheep that was lost!’

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you that in the same way, there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous people who have no need of repentance.

column.name: text
column.value: “Or what woman, if she has ten ①silver coins and loses one coin, does not light a lamp and sweep the house and search carefully until she finds it? ▷ ①Gr drachmas; one drachma was a day’s wages for a laborer

column.name: text
column.value: And when she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, because I have found the coin which I had lost!’

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said, “A man had two sons.

column.name: text
column.value: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me the share of the estate that ①is coming to me.’ And so he divided his ②wealth between them. ▷ ①Lit falls ②Lit means of subsistence

column.name: text
column.value: And not many days later, the younger son gathered everything together and went on a journey to a distant country, and there he squandered his estate in ①wild living. ▷ ①Or wasteful

column.name: text
column.value: Now when he had ①spent everything, a severe famine occurred in that country, and he began doing without. ▷ ①Or wasted

column.name: text
column.value: So he went and ①hired himself out to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs. ▷ ①Lit joined himself to

column.name: text
column.value: And he longed to have his fill of the carob pods that the pigs were eating, and no one was giving him anything.

column.name: text
column.value: But when he came to ①his senses, he said, ‘How many of my father’s hired laborers have more than enough bread, but I am dying here ②from hunger! ▷ ①Lit himself ②Lit by

column.name: text
column.value: I will set out and go to my father, and will say to him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven, and ①in your sight; ▷ ①Lit before you

column.name: text
column.value: I am no longer worthy to be called your son; treat me as one of your hired laborers.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: So he set out and came to ①his father. But when he was still a long way off, his father saw him and felt compassion for him, and ran and ②embraced him and kissed him. ▷ ①Lit his own ②Lit fell on his neck

column.name: text
column.value: And the son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and ①in your sight; I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’ ▷ ①Lit before you

column.name: text
column.value: But the father said to his slaves, ‘Quickly bring out the best robe and put it on him, and ①put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet; ▷ ①Lit give...into his hand

column.name: text
column.value: and bring the fattened calf, slaughter it, and let’s eat and celebrate;

column.name: text
column.value: for this son of mine was dead and has come to life again; he was lost and has been found.’ And they began to celebrate.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now his older son was in the field, and when he came and approached the house, he heard music and dancing.

column.name: text
column.value: And he summoned one of the servants and began inquiring what these things could be.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has slaughtered the fattened calf because he has received him back safe and sound.’

column.name: text
column.value: But he became angry and was not willing to go in; and his father came out and began pleading with him.

column.name: text
column.value: But he answered and said to his father, ‘Look! For so many years I have been serving you and I have never ①neglected a command of yours; and yet you never gave me a young goat, so that I might celebrate with my friends; ▷ ①Or disobeyed

column.name: text
column.value: but when this son of yours came, who has devoured your ①wealth with prostitutes, you slaughtered the fattened calf for him.’ ▷ ①Lit means of subsistence

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, ‘Son, you ①have always been with me, and all that is mine is yours. ▷ ①Lit are always with me

column.name: text
column.value: But we had to celebrate and rejoice, because this brother of yours was dead and has begun to live, and was lost and has been found.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Now on that very occasion there were some present who reported to Him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had ①mixed with their sacrifices. ▷ ①I.e., shed along with

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus responded and said to them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans just because they have suffered this fate?

column.name: text
column.value: No, I tell you, but unless you ①repent, you will all likewise perish. ▷ ①Or are repentant

column.name: text
column.value: Or do you think that those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them were worse ①offenders than all the other people who live in Jerusalem? ▷ ①Lit debtors

column.name: text
column.value: No, I tell you, but unless you repent, you will all likewise perish.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He began telling this parable: “A man had a fig tree which had been planted in his vineyard; and he came looking for fruit on it and did not find any.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to the vineyard-keeper, ‘Look! For three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree ①without finding any. Cut it down! Why does it even use up the ground?’ ▷ ①Lit and I do not find

column.name: text
column.value: But he answered and said to him, ‘Sir, leave it alone for this year too, until I dig around it and put in fertilizer;

column.name: text
column.value: and if it bears fruit next year, fine; but if not, cut it down.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: And ①there was a woman who for eighteen years had had a ②sickness caused by a spirit; and she was bent over double, and could not straighten up at all. ▷ ①Lit behold, a woman ②Lit spirit of sickness

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus saw her, He called her over and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your sickness.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He laid His hands on her; and immediately she stood up straight again, and began glorifying God.

column.name: text
column.value: But the synagogue leader, indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, began saying to the crowd in response, “There are six days during which work should be done; so come during them and get healed, and not on the Sabbath day.”

column.name: text
column.value: But the Lord answered him and said, “You hypocrites, does each of you on the Sabbath not untie his ox or donkey from the stall and lead it away to water it?

column.name: text
column.value: And this woman, a daughter of Abraham as she is, whom Satan has bound for ①eighteen long years, should she not have been released from this restraint on the Sabbath day?” ▷ ①Lit behold, eighteen years

column.name: text
column.value: And as He said this, all His opponents were being ①humiliated; and the entire crowd was rejoicing over all the glorious things being done by Him. ▷ ①Or put to shame

column.name: text
column.value: So He was saying, “What is the kingdom of God like, and to what shall I compare it?

column.name: text
column.value: It is like a mustard seed, which a man took and threw into his own garden; and it grew and became a tree, and the birds of the sky nested in its branches.”

column.name: text
column.value: And again He said, “To what shall I compare the kingdom of God?

column.name: text
column.value: It is like ①leaven, which a woman took and hid in three ②sata of flour until it was all leavened.” ▷ ①I.e., fermented dough ②A Gr term for a Heb measure, totaling about 48 lb. or 22 kg of flour

column.name: text
column.value: And He was passing through one city and village after another, teaching, and proceeding on His way to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And someone said to Him, “Lord, are there just a few who are being saved?” And He said to them,

column.name: text
column.value: “Strive to enter through the narrow door; for many, I tell you, will seek to enter and will not be able.

column.name: text
column.value: Once the head of the house gets up and shuts the door, and you begin standing outside and knocking on the door, saying, ‘Lord, open up to us!’ and He then will answer and say to you, ‘I do not know where you are from.’

column.name: text
column.value: Then you will begin saying, ‘We ate and drank in Your presence, and You taught in our streets!’

column.name: text
column.value: And yet He will ①say, ‘I do not know where you are from; LEAVE ME, ALL YOU ②EVILDOERS.’ ▷ ①Lit say, telling you ②Or workers of injustice

column.name: text
column.value: In that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but yourselves being thrown out.

column.name: text
column.value: And they will come from east and west, and from north and south, and will recline at the table in the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, some are last who will be first, and some are first who will be last.”

column.name: text
column.value: At that very time some Pharisees approached, saying to Him, “Go away and leave this place, because Herod wants to kill You.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “Go and tell that ①fox, ‘Behold, I am casting out demons and performing healings today and tomorrow, and on the third day I ②reach My goal.’ ▷ ①I.e., crafty, devious person ②Or am perfected

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless I must go on My journey today and tomorrow and the next day; for it cannot be that a prophet would perish outside Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the city that kills the prophets and stones those who have been sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, just as a hen gathers her ①young under her wings, and you were unwilling! ▷ ①Lit brood

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, your house is left to you desolate; and I say to you, you will not see Me until you say, ‘BLESSED IS THE ONE WHO COMES IN THE NAME OF THE LORD!’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: It happened that when He went into the house of one of the ①leaders of the Pharisees on the Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching Him ②closely. ▷ ①I.e., members of the Sanhedrin ②Or maliciously

column.name: text
column.value: And ①there in front of Him was a man suffering from ②edema. ▷ ①Lit behold ②I.e., extreme swelling

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus responded and said to the ①lawyers and ②Pharisees, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath, or not?” ▷ ①I.e., experts in Mosaic Law ②Lit Pharisees, saying

column.name: text
column.value: But they kept silent. And He took hold of him and healed him, and sent him away.

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “ ①Which one of you will have a son or an ox fall into a well, and will not immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?” ▷ ①Lit Whose son of you...will fall

column.name: text
column.value: And they could offer no reply to this.

column.name: text
column.value: Now He began telling a parable to the invited guests when He noticed how they had been picking out the places of honor at the table, saying to them,

column.name: text
column.value: “Whenever you are invited by someone to a wedding feast, do not ①take the place of honor, for someone more distinguished than you may have been invited by him, ▷ ①Lit recline at

column.name: text
column.value: and the one who invited you ①both will come and say to you, ‘Give your place to this person,’ and then in disgrace you will proceed to occupy the last place. ▷ ①Lit and him

column.name: text
column.value: But whenever you are invited, go and ①take the last place, so that when the one who has invited you comes, he will say to you, ‘Friend, move up higher’; then you will have honor in the sight of all who are ②dining at the table with you. ▷ ①Lit recline at ②Lit reclining

column.name: text
column.value: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and the one who humbles himself will be exalted.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now He also went on to say to the one who had invited Him, “Whenever you give a luncheon or a dinner, do not invite your friends, your brothers, your relatives, nor wealthy neighbors, otherwise they may also invite you to a meal in return, and that will be your ①repayment. ▷ ①Or reward

column.name: text
column.value: But whenever you give a ①banquet, invite people who are poor, who have disabilities, who are limping, and people who are blind; ▷ ①Or reception

column.name: text
column.value: and you will be blessed, since they ①do not have the means to repay you; for you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous.” ▷ ①Or are unable to

column.name: text
column.value: Now when one of those who were reclining at the table with Him heard this, he said to Him, “Blessed is everyone who will eat bread in the kingdom of God!”

column.name: text
column.value: But He said to him, “A man was giving a big dinner, and he invited many;

column.name: text
column.value: and at the dinner hour he sent his slave to tell those who had been invited, ‘Come, because everything is ready now.’

column.name: text
column.value: And yet they all alike began to make excuses. The first one said to him, ‘I purchased a field and I need to go out to look at it; ①please consider me excused.’ ▷ ①Lit I request of you

column.name: text
column.value: And another one said, ‘I bought five yoke of oxen, and I am going to try them out; ①please consider me excused.’ ▷ ①Lit I request of you

column.name: text
column.value: And another one said, ‘I took a woman as my wife, and for that reason I cannot come.’

column.name: text
column.value: And the slave came back and reported this to his master. Then the head of the household became angry and said to his slave, ‘Go out at once into the streets and lanes of the city and bring in here those who are poor, those with disabilities, those who are blind, and those who are limping.’

column.name: text
column.value: And later the slave said, ‘Master, what you commanded has been done, and still there is room.’

column.name: text
column.value: And the master said to the slave, ‘Go out into the roads and the hedges and press upon them to come in, so that my house will be filled.

column.name: text
column.value: For I tell you, none of those men who were invited shall taste my dinner.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Now ①large crowds were going along with Him, and He turned and said to them, ▷ ①Lit many

column.name: text
column.value: “If anyone comes to Me and does not ①hate his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, sisters, yes, and even his own life, he cannot be My disciple. ▷ ①I.e., in comparison to his love for Me

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever does not carry his own cross and come after Me cannot be My disciple.

column.name: text
column.value: For which one of you, when he wants to build a tower, does not first sit down and calculate the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?

column.name: text
column.value: Otherwise, when he has laid a foundation and is not able to finish, all who are watching it will begin to ridicule him,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, ‘This person began to build, and was not able to finish!’

column.name: text
column.value: Or what king, when he sets out to meet another king in battle, will not first sit down and consider whether he is strong enough with ten thousand men to face the one coming against him with twenty thousand?

column.name: text
column.value: Otherwise, while the other is still far away, he sends a delegation and requests terms of peace.

column.name: text
column.value: So then, none of you can be My disciple who does not ①give up all his own possessions. ▷ ①Or renounce

column.name: text
column.value: “Therefore, salt is good; but if even salt has become tasteless, with what will it be ①seasoned? ▷ ①Or salted

column.name: text
column.value: It is useless either for the soil or the manure pile, so it is thrown out. The one who has ears to hear, ①let him hear.” ▷ ①Or hear! Or listen!

column.name: text
column.value: Now He was also saying to the disciples, “There was a rich man who had a manager, and this manager was ①reported to him as squandering his possessions. ▷ ①Or accused

column.name: text
column.value: And he summoned him and said to him, ‘What is this I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’

column.name: text
column.value: And the manager said to himself, ‘What am I to do, since my ①master is taking the management away from me? I am not strong enough to ②dig; I am ashamed to beg. ▷ ①Or lord ②I.e., do manual labor

column.name: text
column.value: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from the management people will welcome me into their homes.’

column.name: text
column.value: And he summoned each one of his ①master’s debtors, and he began saying to the first, ‘How much do you owe my master?’ ▷ ①Or lord’s

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, ‘A hundred ①jugs of oil.’ And he said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’ ▷ ①Lit baths, a Heb unit of measure equaling about 9 gallons or 34 liters

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to another, ‘And how much do you owe?’ And he said, ‘A hundred ①kors of wheat.’ He *said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’ ▷ ①One kor is about 7.7 cubic feet or 0.22 cubic meters

column.name: text
column.value: And his ①master complimented the unrighteous manager because he had acted shrewdly; for the sons of this age are more shrewd in relation to their own ②kind than the sons of light. ▷ ①Or lord ②Lit generation

column.name: text
column.value: And I say to you, make friends for yourselves by means of the ①wealth of unrighteousness, so that when it ②is all gone, they will receive you into the eternal dwellings. ▷ ①Gr mamonas, for Aramaic mamon (mammon); i.e., wealth, or money ②Or fails

column.name: text
column.value: “The one who is faithful in a very little thing is also faithful in much; and the one who is unrighteous in a very little thing is also unrighteous in much.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore if you have not ①been faithful in the use of unrighteous ②wealth, who will entrust the true wealth to you? ▷ ①Or proved ②See note 1 v 9

column.name: text
column.value: And if you have not ①been faithful in the use of that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own? ▷ ①Or proved

column.name: text
column.value: No ①servant can serve two masters; for either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and ②wealth.” ▷ ①Or house servant ②See note 1 v 9

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Pharisees, who were lovers of money, were listening to all these things and were ①ridiculing Him. ▷ ①Or sneering at

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “You are the ones who justify yourselves in the sight of people, but God knows your hearts; because that which is highly esteemed among people is detestable in the sight of God.

column.name: text
column.value: “The Law and the Prophets were proclaimed until John came; since that time the gospel of the kingdom of God ①has been preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it. ▷ ①Lit is preached

column.name: text
column.value: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one ①stroke of a letter of the Law to fail. ▷ ①I.e., projection of a letter (serif)

column.name: text
column.value: “Everyone who ①divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery, and he who marries one who is ②divorced from a husband commits adultery. ▷ ①Or sends away, the Heb term for divorce ②Or sent away

column.name: text
column.value: “Now there was a rich man, and he habitually dressed in purple and fine linen, enjoying himself in splendor every day.

column.name: text
column.value: And a poor man named Lazarus was laid at his gate, covered with sores,

column.name: text
column.value: and longing to be fed from the scraps which fell from the rich man’s table; not only that, the dogs also were coming and licking his sores.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it happened that the poor man died and was carried away by the angels to ①Abraham’s arms; and the rich man also died and was buried. ▷ ①Lit Abraham’s bosom; or lap; ancient Jewish terminology for the place of the righteous dead

column.name: text
column.value: And in Hades he raised his eyes, being in torment, and *saw Abraham far away and Lazarus in his ①arms. ▷ ①See note v 22

column.name: text
column.value: And he cried out and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me and send Lazarus, so that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool off my tongue, for I am in agony in this flame.’

column.name: text
column.value: But Abraham said, ‘Child, remember that during your life you received your good things, and likewise Lazarus bad things; but now he is being comforted here, and you are in agony.

column.name: text
column.value: And ①besides all this, between us and you a great chasm has been set, so that those who want to go over from here to you will not be able, nor will any people cross over from there to us.’ ▷ ①Lit in all these things

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, ‘Then I request of you, father, that you send him to my father’s house—

column.name: text
column.value: for I have five brothers—in order that he may warn them, so that they will not come to this place of torment as well.’

column.name: text
column.value: But Abraham *said, ‘They have ①Moses and the Prophets; let them hear them.’ ▷ ①I.e., the books of Moses and the prophets, read aloud in the synagogues

column.name: text
column.value: But he said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if someone goes to them from the dead, they will repent!’

column.name: text
column.value: But he said to him, ‘If they do not listen to Moses and the Prophets, they will not be persuaded even if someone rises from the dead.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Now He said to His disciples, “It is inevitable that ①stumbling blocks come, but woe to one through whom they come! ▷ ①Or temptations to sin

column.name: text
column.value: It is better for him if a millstone is hung around his neck and he ①is thrown into the sea, than that he may cause one of these little ones to ②sin. ▷ ①Lit has been thrown (intensive) ②Or stumble

column.name: text
column.value: ①Be on your guard! If your brother sins, rebuke him; and if he repents, forgive him. ▷ ①Lit Take heed for yourselves

column.name: text
column.value: And if he sins against you seven times a day, and returns to you seven times, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”

column.name: text
column.value: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith!”

column.name: text
column.value: But the Lord said, “If you ①had faith ②the size of a mustard seed, you could say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea’; and it would ③obey you. ▷ ①Lit have ②Lit like ③Lit have obeyed

column.name: text
column.value: “Now which of you, having a slave plowing or tending sheep, will say to him after he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and recline at the table to eat’?

column.name: text
column.value: On the contrary, will he not say to him, ‘Prepare something for me to eat, and properly ①clothe yourself and serve me while I eat and drink; and ②afterward you ③may eat and drink’? ▷ ①Lit belt up ②Lit after these things ③Lit will

column.name: text
column.value: He does not thank the slave because he did the things which were commanded, does he?

column.name: text
column.value: So you too, when you do all the things which were commanded you, say, ‘We are ①unworthy slaves; we have done only that which we ought to have done.’ ” ▷ ①I.e., possibly unworthy of praise

column.name: text
column.value: While He was on the way to Jerusalem, He was passing ①between Samaria and Galilee. ▷ ①Lit through the middle of

column.name: text
column.value: And as He entered a village, ten men with leprosy who stood at a distance met Him;

column.name: text
column.value: and they raised their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”

column.name: text
column.value: When He saw them, He said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” And as they were going, they were cleansed.

column.name: text
column.value: Now one of them, when he saw that he had been healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice,

column.name: text
column.value: and he fell on his face at His feet, giving thanks to Him. And he was a Samaritan.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus responded and said, “Were there not ten cleansed? But the nine—where are they?

column.name: text
column.value: ①Was no one found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?” ▷ ①Lit Were they not found who

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to him, “Stand up and go; your faith has ①made you well.” ▷ ①Or saved you

column.name: text
column.value: Now He was questioned by the Pharisees as to when the kingdom of God was coming, and He answered them and said, “The kingdom of God is not coming with ①signs that can be observed; ▷ ①Lit observation

column.name: text
column.value: nor will they say, ‘Look, here it is!’ or, ‘There it is!’ For behold, the kingdom of God is ①in your midst.” ▷ ①Or among you

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.

column.name: text
column.value: And they will say to you, ‘Look there,’ or, ‘Look here!’ Do not leave, and do not run after them.

column.name: text
column.value: For just like the lightning, when it flashes out of one part ①of the sky, shines to the other part ②of the sky, so will the Son of Man be in His day. ▷ ①Lit under heaven; i.e., the lowest heaven, the sky ②Lit under heaven; i.e., the lowest heaven, the sky

column.name: text
column.value: But first He must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

column.name: text
column.value: And just as it happened in the days of Noah, so will it also be in the days of the Son of Man:

column.name: text
column.value: people were eating, they were drinking, they were marrying, and they were being given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered the ark, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

column.name: text
column.value: ①It was the same as happened in the days of Lot: they were eating, they were drinking, they were buying, they were selling, they were planting, and they were building; ▷ ①Lit In the same way as

column.name: text
column.value: but on the day that Lot left Sodom, it rained fire and ①brimstone from heaven and destroyed them all. ▷ ①I.e., burning sulfur

column.name: text
column.value: It will be ①just the same on the day that the Son of Man is revealed. ▷ ①Lit according to the same things

column.name: text
column.value: On that day, the one who will be on the ①housetop, ②with his goods in the house, must not go down to take them out; and likewise the one in the field must not turn back. ▷ ①Housetops were flat living areas ②Lit and his

column.name: text
column.value: Remember Lot’s wife.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever strives to ①save his ②life will lose it, and whoever loses his life will keep it. ▷ ①Or secure ②Or soul

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you, on that night there will be two in one bed; one will be taken and the other will be left.

column.name: text
column.value: There will be two women grinding at the same place; one will be taken and the other will be left.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Two men will be in the field; one will be taken and the other will be left.”] ▷ ①Early mss do not contain this v

column.name: text
column.value: And responding, they *said to Him, “Where, Lord?” And He said to them, “Where the body is, there also the ①vultures will be gathered.” ▷ ①Or eagles

column.name: text
column.value: Now He was telling them a parable to show that at all times they ought to pray and not become discouraged,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “In a certain city there was a judge who did not fear God and did not respect any person.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was a widow in that city, and she kept coming to him, saying, ‘Give me justice against my ①opponent.’ ▷ ①Or enemy

column.name: text
column.value: For a while he was unwilling; but later he said to himself, ‘Even though I do not fear God nor respect any person,

column.name: text
column.value: yet because this widow is bothering me, I will give her justice; otherwise ①by continually coming she will wear me out.’ ” ▷ ①Or in the end she may come and give me a black eye

column.name: text
column.value: And the Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge *said;

column.name: text
column.value: now, will God not bring about justice for His elect who cry out to Him day ①and night, and will He delay long for them? ▷ ①Or and night? He is also patient toward them

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you that He will bring about justice for them quickly. However, when the Son of Man comes, will He find ①faith on the earth?” ▷ ①Lit the faith

column.name: text
column.value: Now He also told this parable to some people who trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and viewed others with contempt:

column.name: text
column.value: “Two men went up into the ①temple to pray, one a Pharisee and the other a tax collector. ▷ ①I.e., the temple grounds

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisee stood and began praying this in regard to himself: ‘God, I thank You that I am not like other people: swindlers, crooked, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.

column.name: text
column.value: I fast twice a week; I pay tithes of all that I get.’

column.name: text
column.value: But the tax collector, standing some distance away, was even unwilling to raise his eyes toward heaven, but was beating his chest, saying, ‘God, be ①merciful to me, the sinner!’ ▷ ①Or propitious

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you, this man went to his house justified rather than the other one; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but the one who humbles himself will be exalted.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now they were bringing even their babies to Him so that He would touch them; but when the disciples saw it, they began rebuking them.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus called for ①the little ones, saying, “Allow the children to come to Me, and do not ②forbid them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these. ▷ ①Lit them ②Or prevent

column.name: text
column.value: Truly I say to you, whoever does not receive the kingdom of God like a child will not enter it at all.”

column.name: text
column.value: A ruler questioned Him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said to him, “Why do you call Me ①good? No one is ②good except God alone. ▷ ①I.e., morally, inherently good ②I.e., morally, inherently good

column.name: text
column.value: You know the commandments, ‘DO NOT COMMIT ADULTERY, DO NOT MURDER, DO NOT STEAL, DO NOT GIVE FALSE TESTIMONY, HONOR YOUR FATHER AND MOTHER.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, “All these things I have kept since my youth.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Jesus heard this, He said to him, “One thing you still lack; sell all that you possess and distribute the money to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow Me.”

column.name: text
column.value: But when he had heard these things, he became very sad, for he was extremely wealthy.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus looked at him and said, “How hard it is for those who are wealthy to enter the kingdom of God!

column.name: text
column.value: For it is easier for a camel to ①go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich person to enter the kingdom of God!” ▷ ①Lit enter

column.name: text
column.value: Those who heard Him said, “And so who can be saved?”

column.name: text
column.value: But He said, “The things that are impossible with people are possible with God.”

column.name: text
column.value: Peter said, “Behold, we have left ①our own homes and followed You.” ▷ ①Lit our own things

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “Truly I say to you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children for the sake of the kingdom of God,

column.name: text
column.value: who will not receive many times as much at this time, and in the age to come, eternal life.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that have been written through the prophets about the Son of Man will be accomplished.

column.name: text
column.value: For He will be ①handed over to the Gentiles, and will be ridiculed, and abused, and spit upon, ▷ ①Or betrayed to

column.name: text
column.value: and after they have flogged Him, they will kill Him; and on the third day He will rise.”

column.name: text
column.value: ①The disciples understood none of these things, and the meaning of this statement was hidden from them, and they did not comprehend the things that were said. ▷ ①Lit And they themselves

column.name: text
column.value: Now as ①Jesus was approaching Jericho, a man who was blind was sitting by the road, begging. ▷ ①Lit He

column.name: text
column.value: But when he heard a crowd going by, he began inquiring what this was.

column.name: text
column.value: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.

column.name: text
column.value: And he called out, saying, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”

column.name: text
column.value: Those who led the way were sternly telling him to be quiet; but he kept crying out all the more, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus stopped and commanded that he be brought to Him; and when he came near, He asked him,

column.name: text
column.value: “What do you want Me to do for you?” And he said, “Lord, I want to regain my sight!”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to him, “Regain your sight; your faith has ①made you well.” ▷ ①Lit saved you

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately he regained his sight and began following Him, glorifying God; and when all the people saw it, they gave praise to God.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through.

column.name: text
column.value: And ①there was a man called by the name of Zaccheus; he was a chief tax collector and he was rich. ▷ ①Lit behold, a man

column.name: text
column.value: Zaccheus was trying to see who Jesus was, and he was unable due to the crowd, because he was short in stature.

column.name: text
column.value: So he ran on ahead and climbed up a ①sycamore tree in order to see Him, because He was about to pass through that way. ▷ ①I.e., fig-mulberry

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jesus came to the place, He looked up and said to him, “Zaccheus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”

column.name: text
column.value: And he hurried and came down, and received Him ①joyfully. ▷ ①Lit rejoicing

column.name: text
column.value: When the people saw this, they all began to complain, saying, “He has gone in ①to be the guest of a man who is a sinner!” ▷ ①Or to find lodging

column.name: text
column.value: But Zaccheus stopped and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my possessions I am giving to the poor, and if I have extorted anything from anyone, I am giving back four times as much.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to him, “Today salvation has come to this house, because he, too, is a son of Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Son of Man has come to seek and to save that which was lost.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now while they were listening to these things, Jesus went on to tell a parable, because He was near Jerusalem and they thought that the kingdom of God was going to appear immediately.

column.name: text
column.value: So He said, “A nobleman went to a distant country to receive a kingdom for himself, and then to return.

column.name: text
column.value: And he called ten of his own slaves and gave them ten ①minas, and said to them, ‘Do business with this money ②until I come back.’ ▷ ①A mina was equal to about 100 days’ wages for a laborer ②Lit while I am coming

column.name: text
column.value: But his citizens hated him and sent a delegation after him, saying, ‘We do not want this man to reign over us.’

column.name: text
column.value: When he returned after receiving the kingdom, he ordered that these slaves, to whom he had given the money, be summoned to him so that he would learn how much they had made by the business they had done.

column.name: text
column.value: The first slave appeared, saying, ‘ ①Master, your ②mina has made ten minas more.’ ▷ ①Or Lord ②See note 1 v 13

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, ‘Well done, good slave; since you have been faithful in a very little thing, you are to have authority over ten cities.’

column.name: text
column.value: The second one came, saying, ‘Your ①mina, ②master, has made five minas.’ ▷ ①See note 1 v 13 ②Lit lord

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him also, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’

column.name: text
column.value: And then another came, saying, ‘Master, here is your mina, which I kept tucked away in a handkerchief;

column.name: text
column.value: for I was afraid of you, because you are a demanding man; you take up what you did not lay down, and reap what you did not sow.’

column.name: text
column.value: He *said to him, ‘ ①From your own lips I will judge you, you worthless slave. Did you know that I am a demanding man, taking up what I did not lay down, and reaping what I did not sow? ▷ ①Lit Out of your mouth

column.name: text
column.value: And so why did you not put my money in the bank, and when I came back, I would have collected it with interest?’

column.name: text
column.value: And then he said to the other slaves who were present, ‘Take the mina away from him and give it to the one who has the ten minas.’

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to him, ‘Master, he already has ten minas.’

column.name: text
column.value: ‘I tell you that to everyone who has, more shall be given, but from the one who does not have, even what he does have shall be taken away.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for these enemies of mine who did not want me to reign over them, bring them here and slaughter them in my presence.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: After Jesus said these things, He was going on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: When He approached Bethphage and Bethany, near the ①mountain that is called Olivet, He sent two of the disciples, ▷ ①Or hill...Olive Grove; Mount of Olives

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “Go into the village ①ahead of you; there, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, on which no one yet has ever sat; untie it and bring it here. ▷ ①Or opposite

column.name: text
column.value: And if anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ you shall say this: ‘ ①The Lord has need of it.’ ” ▷ ①Or Because the Lord

column.name: text
column.value: So those who were sent left and found it just as He had told them.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they were untying the colt, its ①owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?” ▷ ①Lit lords

column.name: text
column.value: They said, “ ①The Lord has need of it.” ▷ ①Or Because the Lord

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought it to Jesus, and they threw their cloaks on the colt and put Jesus on it.

column.name: text
column.value: Now as He was going, they were spreading their cloaks on the road.

column.name: text
column.value: And as soon as He was approaching, near the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole crowd of the disciples began to praise God ①joyfully with a loud voice for all the ②miracles which they had seen, ▷ ①Lit rejoicing ②Or works of power

column.name: text
column.value: ①shouting: “BLESSED IS the King, THE ONE WHO COMES IN THE NAME OF THE LORD; Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!” ▷ ①Lit saying

column.name: text
column.value: And yet some of the Pharisees ①in the crowd said to Him, “Teacher, rebuke Your disciples!” ▷ ①Lit from

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied, “I tell you, if these stop speaking, the stones will cry out!”

column.name: text
column.value: When He approached Jerusalem, He saw the city and wept over it,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “If you had known on this day, even you, the conditions for peace! But now they have been hidden from your eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: For the days will come upon you ①when your enemies will put up a ②barricade against you, and surround you and hem you in on every side, ▷ ①Lit and ②I.e., a dirt wall or mound for siege purposes

column.name: text
column.value: and they will level you to the ground, and throw down your children within you, and they will not leave in you one stone upon ①another, because you did not recognize the time of your visitation.” ▷ ①Lit a stone

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus entered the temple grounds and began to drive out those who were selling,

column.name: text
column.value: saying to them, “It is written: ‘AND MY HOUSE WILL BE A HOUSE OF PRAYER,’ but you have made it a DEN OF ROBBERS.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He was teaching daily in the temple; but the chief priests and the scribes and the leading men among the people were trying to put Him to death,

column.name: text
column.value: and yet they could not find ①anything that they might do, for all the people were hanging on to ②every word He said. ▷ ①Lit what they would do ②Lit Him, listening

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Feast of Unleavened Bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.

column.name: text
column.value: And the chief priests and the scribes were trying to find ①a way to put Him to death, since they were afraid of the people. ▷ ①Lit how they were to

column.name: text
column.value: And Satan entered Judas, the one called Iscariot, ①who belonged to the number of the twelve. ▷ ①Or possibly since he belonged; lit being of the

column.name: text
column.value: And he left and discussed with the chief priests and officers how he was to betray Him to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were delighted, and agreed to give him money.

column.name: text
column.value: And so he consented, and began looking for a good opportunity to betray Him to them ①away from the crowd. ▷ ①Or without a disturbance

column.name: text
column.value: Now the first day of Unleavened Bread came, on which the Passover lamb had to be sacrificed.

column.name: text
column.value: And so Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, so that we may eat it.”

column.name: text
column.value: They said to Him, “Where do You want us to prepare it?”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “When you have entered the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you; follow him into the house that he enters.

column.name: text
column.value: And you shall say to the owner of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room in which I may eat the Passover with My disciples?” ’

column.name: text
column.value: And he will show you a large, furnished upstairs room; prepare it there.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they left and found everything just as He had told them; and they prepared the Passover.

column.name: text
column.value: When the hour came, He reclined at the table, and the apostles with Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer;

column.name: text
column.value: for I say to you, I shall not eat it again until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God.”

column.name: text
column.value: And when He had taken a cup and given thanks, He said, “Take this and share it among yourselves;

column.name: text
column.value: for I say to you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine from now on until the kingdom of God comes.”

column.name: text
column.value: And when He had taken some bread and given thanks, He broke it and gave it to them, saying, “This is My body, which is being given for you; do this in remembrance of Me.”

column.name: text
column.value: And in the same way He took the cup after they had eaten, saying, “This cup, which is poured out for you, is the new covenant in My blood.

column.name: text
column.value: But behold, the hand of the one betraying Me is with ①Mine on the table. ▷ ①Lit Me

column.name: text
column.value: For indeed, the Son of Man is going as it has been determined; but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed!”

column.name: text
column.value: And they began to debate among themselves which one of them it was who was going to do this.

column.name: text
column.value: And a dispute also developed among them as to which one of them was regarded as being the greatest.

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “The kings of the Gentiles domineer over them; and those who have authority over them are called ‘Benefactors.’

column.name: text
column.value: But it is not this way for you; rather, the one who is the greatest among you must become like the youngest, and the leader like the servant.

column.name: text
column.value: For who is greater, the one who reclines at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who reclines at the table? But I am among you as the one who serves.

column.name: text
column.value: “You are the ones who have stood by Me in My trials;

column.name: text
column.value: and just as My Father has granted Me a kingdom, I grant you

column.name: text
column.value: that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom, and you will sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan has ①demanded to sift you men like wheat; ▷ ①Or asked for you men, to sift you

column.name: text
column.value: but I have prayed for ①you, that ②your faith will not fail; and ③you, when you have ④turned back, strengthen your brothers.” ▷ ①Gr singular, referring only to Peter ②Gr singular, referring only to Peter ③Gr singular, referring only to Peter ④I.e., repented

column.name: text
column.value: But he said to Him, “Lord, I am ready to go with You both to prison and to death!”

column.name: text
column.value: But He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow today until you have denied three times that you know Me.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “When I sent you out without money belt and bag and sandals, you did not lack anything, did you?” They said, “No, nothing.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “But now, ①whoever has a money belt is to take it along, likewise also a bag, and ②whoever has no sword is to sell his ③cloak and buy one. ▷ ①Lit he who ②Lit he who ③Or outer garment

column.name: text
column.value: For I tell you that this which is written must be fulfilled in Me: ‘AND HE WAS COUNTED WITH WRONGDOERS’; for that which refers to Me has its ①fulfillment.” ▷ ①Lit end

column.name: text
column.value: They said, “Lord, look, here are two swords.” And He said to them, “It is enough.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He came out and went, as was His habit, to the Mount of Olives; and the disciples also followed Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when He arrived at the place, He said to them, “Pray that you do not come into temptation.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He withdrew from them about a stone’s throw, and He knelt down and began to pray,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “Father, if You are willing, remove this cup from Me; yet not My will, but Yours be done.”

column.name: text
column.value: ①Now an angel from heaven appeared to Him, strengthening Him. ▷ ①Most early mss do not contain vv 43 and 44

column.name: text
column.value: And being in agony, He was praying very fervently; and His sweat became like drops of blood, falling down upon the ground].

column.name: text
column.value: When He rose from prayer, He came to the disciples and found them sleeping from sorrow,

column.name: text
column.value: and He said to them, “Why are you sleeping? Get up and pray that you do not come into temptation.”

column.name: text
column.value: While He was still speaking, behold, a crowd came, and the one called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading the way for them; and he approached Jesus to kiss Him.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?”

column.name: text
column.value: When those who were around Him saw what was going to happen, they said, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”

column.name: text
column.value: And one of them struck the slave of the high priest and cut off his right ear.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus responded and said, “ ①Stop! No more of this.” And He touched his ear and healed him. ▷ ①Or “Leave him alone! No more”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to the chief priests and officers of the temple and elders who had come against Him, “Have you come out with swords and clubs as you would against a man inciting a revolt?

column.name: text
column.value: While I was with you daily in the temple, you did not lay hands on Me; but ①this hour and the power of darkness are yours.” ▷ ①Lit this is your hour and the power of darkness

column.name: text
column.value: Now they arrested Him and led Him away, and brought Him to the house of the high priest; but Peter was following at a distance.

column.name: text
column.value: After they kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter was sitting among them.

column.name: text
column.value: And a slave woman, seeing him as he sat in the firelight, and staring at him, said, “This man was with Him as well.”

column.name: text
column.value: But he denied it, saying, “I do not know Him, woman!”

column.name: text
column.value: And a little later, another person saw him and said, “You are one of them too!” But Peter said, “Man, I am not!”

column.name: text
column.value: And after about an hour had passed, some other man began to insist, saying, “Certainly this man also was with Him, for he, too, is a Galilean.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter said, “Man, I do not know what you are talking about!” And immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

column.name: text
column.value: And then the Lord turned and looked at Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how He had told him, “Before a rooster crows today, you will deny Me three times.”

column.name: text
column.value: And he went out and wept bitterly.

column.name: text
column.value: The men who were holding ①Jesus in custody began mocking Him and beating Him, ▷ ①Lit Him

column.name: text
column.value: and they blindfolded Him and repeatedly asked Him, saying, “Prophesy, who is the one who hit You?”

column.name: text
column.value: And they were saying many other things against Him, blaspheming.

column.name: text
column.value: When it was day, the ①Council of elders of the people assembled, both chief priests and scribes, and they led Him away to their council chamber, saying, ▷ ①Or Sanhedrin

column.name: text
column.value: “If You are the ①Christ, tell us.” But He said to them, “If I tell you, you will not believe; ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: and if I ask a question, you will not answer.

column.name: text
column.value: But from now on the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they all said, “So You are the Son of God?” And He said to them, “You say correctly that I am.”

column.name: text
column.value: And then they said, “What further need do we have of testimony? For we have heard it ourselves from His own mouth!”

column.name: text
column.value: Now He looked up and saw the wealthy putting their gifts into the temple treasury.

column.name: text
column.value: And He saw a poor widow putting ①in two ②lepta coins. ▷ ①Lit there ②The smallest Greek copper coin, about 1/128 of a laborer’s daily wage

column.name: text
column.value: And He said, “Truly I say to you, this poor widow put in more than all of them;

column.name: text
column.value: for they all ①contributed to the ②offering from their ③surplus; but she, from her poverty, put in all ④that she had to live on.” ▷ ①Lit put into ②Lit gifts ③Lit abundance ④Lit the living that she had

column.name: text
column.value: And while some were talking about the temple, that it was decorated with beautiful stones and ①vowed gifts, He said, ▷ ①I.e., gifts promised by vows

column.name: text
column.value: “As for these things which you are observing, the days will come when there will not be left one stone upon ①another, which will not be torn down.” ▷ ①Lit a stone

column.name: text
column.value: They asked Him questions, saying, “Teacher, when therefore will these things happen? And what will be the ①sign when these things are about to take place?” ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracle

column.name: text
column.value: And He said, “See to it that you are not misled; for many will come in My name, saying, ‘I am He,’ and, ‘The time is near.’ Do not go after them.

column.name: text
column.value: And when you hear of wars and revolts, do not be alarmed; for these things must take place first, but the end will not follow immediately.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then He continued by saying to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom,

column.name: text
column.value: and there will be ①massive earthquakes, and in various places plagues and famines; and there will be terrible sights and great ②signs from heaven. ▷ ①Lit great ②I.e., confirming miracles

column.name: text
column.value: “But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and persecute you, turning you over to the synagogues and prisons, ①bringing you before kings and governors on account of My name. ▷ ①Lit being brought

column.name: text
column.value: It will lead to ①an opportunity for your testimony. ▷ ①Lit a testimony for you

column.name: text
column.value: So ①make up your minds not to prepare beforehand to defend yourselves; ▷ ①Lit put in your hearts

column.name: text
column.value: for I will provide you ①eloquence and wisdom which none of your adversaries will be able to oppose or refute. ▷ ①Lit a mouth

column.name: text
column.value: But you will be betrayed even by parents, brothers and sisters, other relatives, and friends, and they will put some of you to death,

column.name: text
column.value: and you will be hated by all people because of My name.

column.name: text
column.value: And yet not a hair of your head will perish.

column.name: text
column.value: By your endurance you will gain your ①lives. ▷ ①Lit souls

column.name: text
column.value: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then ①recognize that her desolation is near. ▷ ①Lit know

column.name: text
column.value: Then those who are in Judea must flee to the mountains, and those who are inside ①the city must leave, and those who are in the country must not enter ②the city; ▷ ①Lit her ②Lit her

column.name: text
column.value: because these are days of punishment, so that all things which have been written will be fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to those women who are pregnant, and to those who are nursing babies in those days; for there will be great distress upon the ①land, and wrath to this people; ▷ ①Or earth

column.name: text
column.value: and they will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations; and Jerusalem will be trampled underfoot by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: “There will be ①signs in the sun and moon and stars, and on the earth distress among nations, in perplexity at the roaring of the sea and the waves, ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracles

column.name: text
column.value: people fainting from fear and the expectation of the things that are coming upon the ①world; for the powers of ②the heavens will be shaken. ▷ ①Lit inhabited earth ②Or heaven

column.name: text
column.value: And then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

column.name: text
column.value: But when these things begin to take place, straighten up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He told them a parable: “Look at the fig tree and all the trees:

column.name: text
column.value: as soon as they put forth leaves, you see for yourselves and know that summer is now near.

column.name: text
column.value: So you too, when you see these things happening, ①recognize that the kingdom of God is near. ▷ ①Lit know

column.name: text
column.value: Truly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all things take place.

column.name: text
column.value: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will not pass away.

column.name: text
column.value: “But be on your guard, so that your hearts will not be weighed down with dissipation and drunkenness and the worries of life, and that ①this day will not come on you suddenly, like a trap; ▷ ①Lit that day

column.name: text
column.value: for it will come upon all those who live on the face of all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: But stay alert at all times, praying that you will have strength to escape all these things that are going to take place, and to stand before the Son of Man.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now ①during the day He was teaching in the temple, but ②at evening He would go out and spend the night on the ③mountain that is called ④Olivet. ▷ ①Lit days ②Lit nights ③Or hill ④Or Olive Grove

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people would get up very early in the morning to come to Him in the temple to listen to Him.

column.name: text
column.value: On one of the days while He was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes with the elders confronted Him,

column.name: text
column.value: and they declared, saying to Him, “Tell us by what authority You are doing these things, or who is the one who gave You this authority?”

column.name: text
column.value: But He replied to them, “I will also ask you a ①question, and you tell Me: ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: Was the baptism of John from heaven or from men?”

column.name: text
column.value: They discussed among themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will say, ‘Why did you not believe him?’

column.name: text
column.value: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us to death, since they are convinced that John was a prophet.”

column.name: text
column.value: And so they answered that they did not know where it came from.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to them, “Neither am I telling you by what authority I do these things.”

column.name: text
column.value: But He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard and leased it to ①vine-growers, and went on a journey for a long time. ▷ ①Or tenant farmers, also vv 10, 14, 16

column.name: text
column.value: At the harvest time he sent a slave to the vine-growers, so that they would give him his share of the produce of the vineyard; but the vine-growers beat him and sent him away empty-handed.

column.name: text
column.value: And he proceeded to send another slave; but they beat him also and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty-handed.

column.name: text
column.value: And he proceeded to send a third; but this one too they wounded and threw out.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the ①owner of the vineyard said, ‘What am I to do? I will send my beloved son; perhaps they will respect him.’ ▷ ①Lit lord

column.name: text
column.value: But when the vine-growers saw him, they discussed with one another, saying, ‘This is the heir; let’s kill him so that the inheritance will be ours.’

column.name: text
column.value: And so they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What, then, will the ①owner of the vineyard do to them? ▷ ①Lit lord

column.name: text
column.value: He will come and put these vine-growers to death, and will give the vineyard to others.” However, when they heard this, they said, “May it never happen!”

column.name: text
column.value: But ①Jesus looked at them and said, “Then what is this statement that has been written: ‘A STONE WHICH THE BUILDERS REJECTED, THIS HAS BECOME THE ②CHIEF CORNERSTONE’? ▷ ①Lit He ②Lit head of the corner

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces; but on whomever it falls, it will crush him.”

column.name: text
column.value: The scribes and the chief priests tried to lay hands on Him that very hour, and yet they feared the people; for they were aware that He had spoken this parable against them.

column.name: text
column.value: And so they watched Him ①closely, and sent spies who pretended to be righteous, in order that they might catch Him in some statement, so that they could hand Him over to the jurisdiction and authority of the governor. ▷ ①Or maliciously

column.name: text
column.value: And the spies questioned Him, saying, “Teacher, we know that You speak and teach correctly, and You ①are not partial to anyone, but You teach the way of God on the basis of truth. ▷ ①Lit do not receive a face

column.name: text
column.value: Is it ①permissible for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?” ▷ ①I.e., by Jewish law and tradition

column.name: text
column.value: But He saw through their trickery and said to them,

column.name: text
column.value: “Show Me a ①denarius. Whose image and inscription does it have?” They said, “Caesar’s.” ▷ ①The denarius was a day’s wages for a laborer

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “Then pay to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they were unable to catch Him in a statement in the presence of the people; and they were amazed at His answer, and said nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: Now some of the Sadducees (who maintain that there is no resurrection) came to Him,

column.name: text
column.value: and they questioned Him, saying, “Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if ①a man’s brother dies, ②leaving a wife, and he is childless, that his brother is to ③marry the wife and raise up children ④for his brother. ▷ ①Lit someone’s brother ②Lit having ③Lit take ④I.e., as his brother’s heir

column.name: text
column.value: So then, there were seven brothers; and the first took a wife and died childless;

column.name: text
column.value: and the second

column.name: text
column.value: and the third ①married her; and in the same way ②all seven ③died, leaving no children. ▷ ①Lit took ②Lit the seven also ③Lit left no children, and died

column.name: text
column.value: Finally the woman also died.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, in the resurrection, ①which one’s wife does the woman become? For ②all seven ③married her.” ▷ ①Lit of which of them ②Lit the seven ③Lit had her as wife

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, “The sons of this age marry and the women are given in marriage,

column.name: text
column.value: but those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry nor are given in marriage;

column.name: text
column.value: for they cannot even die anymore, for they are like angels, and are sons of God, being ①sons of the resurrection. ▷ ①I.e., participants in

column.name: text
column.value: But as for the fact that the dead are raised, even Moses revealed this in the passage about the burning bush, where he calls the Lord THE GOD OF ABRAHAM, THE GOD OF ISAAC, AND THE GOD OF JACOB.

column.name: text
column.value: Now He is not the God of the dead, but of the living; for all live to Him.”

column.name: text
column.value: Some of the scribes answered and said, “Teacher, You have spoken well.”

column.name: text
column.value: For they did not have the courage to question Him any longer about anything.

column.name: text
column.value: But He said to them, “How is it that they say the ①Christ is David’s son? ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: For David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘THE LORD SAID TO MY LORD, “SIT AT MY RIGHT HAND,

column.name: text
column.value: UNTIL I MAKE YOUR ENEMIES A FOOTSTOOL FOR YOUR FEET.” ’

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore David calls Him ‘Lord,’ and so how is He his son?”

column.name: text
column.value: And while all the people were listening, He said to the disciples,

column.name: text
column.value: “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk around in long robes, and love personal greetings in the marketplaces, and chief seats in the synagogues and places of honor at banquets,

column.name: text
column.value: who ①devour widows’ houses, and for appearance’s sake offer long prayers. These will receive all the more condemnation.” ▷ ①I.e., misappropriate their property

column.name: text
column.value: Then the entire assembly of them set out and brought Him before Pilate.

column.name: text
column.value: And they began to bring charges against Him, saying, “We found this man misleading our nation and forbidding us to pay taxes to Caesar, and saying that He Himself is ①Christ, a King.” ▷ ①I.e., the Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: Now Pilate asked Him, saying, “So You are the King of the Jews?” And He answered him and said, “It is as you say.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds, “I find no grounds for charges in the case of this man.”

column.name: text
column.value: But they kept on insisting, saying, “He is stirring up the people, teaching all over Judea, starting from Galilee, as far as this place!”

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Pilate heard this, he asked whether the man was a Galilean.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he learned that He belonged to Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent Him to Herod, ①since he also was in Jerusalem ②at this time. ▷ ①Lit himself also being in ②Lit in these days

column.name: text
column.value: Now Herod was overjoyed when he saw Jesus; for he had wanted to see Him for a long time, because he had been hearing about Him and was hoping to see some ①sign performed by Him. ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracle

column.name: text
column.value: And he questioned Him ①at some length; but He offered him no answer at all. ▷ ①Lit in considerable words

column.name: text
column.value: Now the chief priests and the scribes stood there, vehemently charging Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Herod, together with his soldiers, treated Him with contempt and mocked Him, dressing Him in a brightly shining robe, and sent Him back to Pilate.

column.name: text
column.value: And so Herod and Pilate became friends with one another that very day; for previously, they had been enemies toward each other.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Pilate summoned to himself the chief priests, the ①rulers, and the people, ▷ ①I.e., other Jewish leaders

column.name: text
column.value: and he said to them, “You brought this man to me on the ground that he is inciting the people to revolt; and behold, after examining Him before you, I have found no basis at all in the case of this man for the charges which you are bringing against Him.

column.name: text
column.value: No, nor has Herod, for he sent Him back to us; and behold, nothing deserving death has been done by Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I will ①punish Him and release Him.” ▷ ①I.e., by scourging

column.name: text
column.value: ①Now he was obligated to release to them at the feast one prisoner.] ▷ ①Most early mss do not contain this v

column.name: text
column.value: But they cried out all together, saying, “Away with this man, and release to us Barabbas!”

column.name: text
column.value: (He was one who had been thrown into prison for a revolt that took place in the city, and for murder.)

column.name: text
column.value: But Pilate, wanting to release Jesus, addressed them again,

column.name: text
column.value: but they kept on crying out, saying, “Crucify, crucify Him!”

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them a third time, “Why, what has this man done wrong? I have found ①in His case no grounds for a sentence of death; therefore I will ②punish Him and release Him.” ▷ ①Lit in Him no ②I.e., by scourging

column.name: text
column.value: But they were insistent, with loud voices, demanding that He be crucified. And their voices began to prevail.

column.name: text
column.value: And so Pilate decided to have their demand carried out.

column.name: text
column.value: And he released the man for whom they were asking, who had been thrown into prison for a revolt and murder; but he handed Jesus over to their will.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they led Him away, they seized a man, Simon of Cyrene, as he was coming in from the country, and placed on him the cross to carry behind Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Now following Him was a large crowd of the people, and of women who were ①mourning and grieving for Him. ▷ ①Lit beating their breasts

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus turned to them and said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, stop weeping for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

column.name: text
column.value: For behold, days are coming when they will say, ‘Blessed are those who cannot bear, and the wombs that have not given birth, and the breasts that have not nursed.’

column.name: text
column.value: Then they will begin TO SAY TO THE MOUNTAINS, ‘FALL ON US,’ AND TO THE HILLS, ‘COVER US.’

column.name: text
column.value: For if they do these things ①when the tree is green, what will happen ②when it is dry?” ▷ ①Lit in the green tree ②Lit in the dry

column.name: text
column.value: Now two others, who were criminals, were also being led away to be put to death with Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they came to the place called ①The Skull, there they crucified Him and the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left. ▷ ①Gr Kranion, Lat Calvaria (Calvary)

column.name: text
column.value: ①But Jesus was saying, “Father, forgive them; for they do not know what they are doing.”] And they cast lots, dividing His garments among themselves. ▷ ①Most early mss do not contain But Jesus was saying...doing

column.name: text
column.value: And the people stood by, watching. And even the rulers were sneering at Him, saying, “He saved others; let Him save Himself if this is the ①Christ of God, His Chosen One.” ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: The soldiers also ridiculed Him, coming up to Him, offering Him sour wine,

column.name: text
column.value: and saying, “If You are the King of the Jews, save Yourself!”

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was also an inscription above Him, “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

column.name: text
column.value: One of the criminals who were hanged there was ①hurling abuse at Him, saying, “Are You not the ②Christ? Save Yourself and us!” ▷ ①Or blaspheming ②I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: But the other responded, and rebuking him, said, “Do you not even fear God, since you are under the same sentence of condemnation?

column.name: text
column.value: And we indeed are suffering justly, for we are receiving ①what we deserve for our crimes; but this man has done nothing wrong.” ▷ ①Lit things worthy of what we have done

column.name: text
column.value: And he was saying, “Jesus, remember me when You come into Your kingdom!”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to him, “Truly I say to you, today you will be with Me in Paradise.”

column.name: text
column.value: It was now about ①the sixth hour, and darkness came over the entire land until ②the ninth hour, ▷ ①I.e., noon ②I.e., 3 p.m.

column.name: text
column.value: ①because the sun stopped shining; and the veil of the temple was torn ②in two. ▷ ①Lit the sun failing ②Lit in the middle

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus, crying out with a loud voice, said, “Father, INTO YOUR HANDS I ENTRUST MY SPIRIT.” And having said this, He ①died. ▷ ①Lit expired

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the centurion saw what had happened, he began praising God, saying, “This man was in fact ①innocent.” ▷ ①Lit righteous

column.name: text
column.value: And all the crowds who came together for this spectacle, after watching what had happened, began to return home, ①beating their chests. ▷ ①I.e., as a traditional sign of mourning or contrition

column.name: text
column.value: And all His acquaintances and the women who accompanied Him from Galilee were standing at a distance, seeing these things.

column.name: text
column.value: And a man named Joseph, who was a member of the Council, a good and righteous man

column.name: text
column.value: (he had not consented to their plan and action), a man from Arimathea, a city of the Jews, who was waiting for the kingdom of God—

column.name: text
column.value: this man went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid Him in a tomb cut into the rock, where no one had ever lain.

column.name: text
column.value: It was a ①preparation day, and a Sabbath was about to ②begin. ▷ ①I.e., preparation for the Sabbath ②Lit dawn

column.name: text
column.value: Now the women who had come with Him from Galilee followed, and they saw the tomb and how His body was laid.

column.name: text
column.value: And then they returned and prepared spices and perfumes. And on the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.

column.name: text
column.value: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they came to the tomb bringing the spices which they had prepared.

column.name: text
column.value: And they found the stone rolled away from the tomb,

column.name: text
column.value: but when they entered, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: While they were perplexed about this, behold, two men suddenly stood near them in gleaming clothing;

column.name: text
column.value: and as ①the women were terrified and bowed their faces to the ground, the men said to them, “Why are you seeking the living One among the dead? ▷ ①Lit they

column.name: text
column.value: He is not here, but He has ①risen. Remember how He spoke to you while He was still in Galilee, ▷ ①Or been raised

column.name: text
column.value: saying that the Son of Man must be handed over to sinful men, and be crucified, and on the third day rise from the dead.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they remembered His words,

column.name: text
column.value: and returned from the tomb and reported all these things to the eleven, and to all the rest.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these women were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James; also the other women with them were telling these things to the apostles.

column.name: text
