column.value: But these words appeared ①to them as nonsense, and they would not believe ②the women. ▷ ①Lit in their sight ②Lit them

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, Peter got up and ran to the tomb; and when he stooped and looked in, he *saw the linen wrappings ①only; and he went away to his ②home, marveling at what had happened. ▷ ①Or by themselves ②Lit own home

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, on that very day two of them were going to a village named Emmaus, which was ①sixty stadia from Jerusalem. ▷ ①Possibly about 7 miles or 11.3 km; a Roman stadion perhaps averaged 607 ft. or 185 m

column.name: text
column.value: And they were talking with each other about all these things which had taken place.

column.name: text
column.value: While they were talking and discussing, Jesus Himself approached and began traveling with them.

column.name: text
column.value: But their eyes were kept from recognizing Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “What are these words that you are exchanging with one another as you are walking?” And they came to a stop, looking sad.

column.name: text
column.value: One of them, named Cleopas, answered and said to Him, “Are You possibly the only one living near Jerusalem ①who does not know about the things that happened here in these days?” ▷ ①Lit and you do not know

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “What sort of things?” And they said to Him, “Those about Jesus the Nazarene, who proved to be a prophet mighty in deed and word in the sight of God and all the people,

column.name: text
column.value: and how the chief priests and our rulers handed Him over to be sentenced to death, and crucified Him.

column.name: text
column.value: But we ①were hoping that it was He who was going to redeem Israel. Indeed, besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened. ▷ ①Or expected that

column.name: text
column.value: But also some women among us left us bewildered. When they were at the tomb early in the morning,

column.name: text
column.value: and did not find His body, they came, saying that they had also seen a vision of angels who said that He was alive.

column.name: text
column.value: And so some of those who were with us went to the tomb, and found it just exactly as the women also had said; but Him they did not see.”

column.name: text
column.value: And then He said to them, “ ①You foolish men and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken! ▷ ①Lit O foolish

column.name: text
column.value: Was it not necessary for the ①Christ to suffer these things and to come into His glory?” ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: Then beginning ①with Moses and ②with all the Prophets, He explained to them the things written about Himself in all the Scriptures. ▷ ①Lit from ②Lit from

column.name: text
column.value: And they approached the village where they were going, and He gave the impression that He was going farther.

column.name: text
column.value: And so they strongly urged Him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is getting toward evening, and the day ①is now nearly over.” So He went in to stay with them. ▷ ①Lit has now declined

column.name: text
column.value: And it came about, when He had reclined at the table with them, that He took the bread and blessed it, and He broke it and began giving it to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And then their eyes were opened and they recognized Him; and He vanished from ①their sight. ▷ ①Lit them

column.name: text
column.value: They said to one another, “ ①Were our hearts not burning within us when He was speaking to us on the road, while He was ②explaining the Scriptures to us?” ▷ ①Lit Was our heart ②Lit opening

column.name: text
column.value: And they got up that very hour and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together and those who were with them,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “The Lord has really risen and has appeared to Simon!”

column.name: text
column.value: They began to relate ①their experiences on the road, and how He was recognized by them at the breaking of the bread. ▷ ①Lit the things

column.name: text
column.value: Now while they were telling these things, Jesus Himself suddenly stood in their midst and *said to them, “Peace be to you.”

column.name: text
column.value: But they were startled and frightened, and thought that they were looking at a spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “Why are you frightened, and why are doubts arising in your ①hearts? ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: See My hands and My feet, that ①it is I Myself; touch Me and see, because a spirit does not have flesh and bones as you plainly see that I have.” ▷ ①Lit I Myself am

column.name: text
column.value: And when He had said this, He showed them His hands and His feet.

column.name: text
column.value: While they still ①could not believe it because of their joy and astonishment, He said to them, “Have you anything here to eat?” ▷ ①Lit were disbelieving

column.name: text
column.value: They served Him a piece of broiled fish;

column.name: text
column.value: and He took it and ate it in front of them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now He said to them, “These are My words which I spoke to you while I was still with you, that all the things that are written about Me in the Law of Moses and the Prophets and the Psalms must be fulfilled.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then He opened their ①minds to understand the Scriptures, ▷ ①Lit mind

column.name: text
column.value: and He said to them, “So it is written, that the ①Christ would suffer and rise from the dead on the third day, ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: and that repentance ①for forgiveness of sins would be proclaimed ②in His name to all the nations, beginning from Jerusalem. ▷ ①Later mss and forgiveness ②Or on the basis of

column.name: text
column.value: You are witnesses of these things.

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, I am sending the promise of My Father upon you; but you are to stay in the city until you are clothed with power from on high.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He led them out as far as Bethany, and He lifted up His hands and blessed them.

column.name: text
column.value: While He was blessing them, He parted from them and was carried up into heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And they, after worshiping Him, returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

column.name: text
column.value: and were continually in the temple ①praising God. ▷ ①Lit blessing

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews;

column.name: text
column.value: this man came to ①Jesus at night and said to Him, “Rabbi, we know that You have come from God as a teacher; for no one can do these ②signs that You do unless God is with him.” ▷ ①Lit Him ②I.e., confirming miracles

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus responded and said to him, “Truly, truly, I say to you, unless someone is born ①again he cannot see the kingdom of God.” ▷ ①Or from above

column.name: text
column.value: Nicodemus *said to Him, “How can a person be born when he is old? He cannot enter his mother’s womb a second time and be born, can he?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, “Truly, truly, I say to you, unless someone is born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: That which has been born of the flesh is flesh, and that which has been born of the Spirit is spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be amazed that I said to you, ‘You must be born ①again.’ ▷ ①Or from above

column.name: text
column.value: The wind blows where it wishes, and you hear the sound of it, but you do not know where it is coming from and where it is going; so is everyone who has been born of the Spirit.”

column.name: text
column.value: Nicodemus responded and said to Him, “How can these things be?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to him, “You are the teacher of Israel, and yet you do not understand these things?

column.name: text
column.value: Truly, truly, I say to you, we speak of what we know and testify of what we have seen, and you people do not accept our testimony.

column.name: text
column.value: If I told you earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

column.name: text
column.value: No one has ascended into heaven, except He who descended from heaven: the Son of Man.

column.name: text
column.value: And just as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

column.name: text
column.value: so that everyone who ①believes will have eternal life in Him. ▷ ①Or believes in Him will have eternal life

column.name: text
column.value: “For God so loved the world, that He gave His only Son, so that everyone who believes in Him will not perish, but have eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: For God did not send the Son into the world to judge the world, but so that the world might be saved through Him.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who believes in Him is not judged; the one who does not believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only Son of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is the judgment, that the Light has come into the world, and people loved the darkness rather than the Light; for their deeds were evil.

column.name: text
column.value: For everyone who does evil hates the Light, and does not come to the Light, so that his deeds will not be exposed.

column.name: text
column.value: But the one who practices the truth comes to the Light, so that his deeds will be revealed ①as having been performed in God.” ▷ ①Lit that they have been

column.name: text
column.value: After these things Jesus and His disciples came into the land of Judea; and there He was spending time with them and baptizing.

column.name: text
column.value: Now John also was baptizing in Aenon, near Salim, because there was an abundance of water there; and people were coming and being baptized—

column.name: text
column.value: for John had not yet been thrown into prison.

column.name: text
column.value: Then a matter of dispute developed on the part of John’s disciples with a Jew about ①purification. ▷ ①I.e., ceremonial washing

column.name: text
column.value: And they came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, He who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified—behold, He is baptizing and all the people are coming to Him.”

column.name: text
column.value: John replied, “A person can receive not even one thing unless it has been given to him from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: You yourselves ①are my witnesses that I said, ‘I am not the ②Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent ahead of Him.’ ▷ ①Lit testify for me ②I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: He who has the bride is the groom; but the friend of the groom, who stands and listens to him, rejoices greatly because of the groom’s voice. So this joy of mine has been made full.

column.name: text
column.value: He must ①increase, but I must ②decrease. ▷ ①Or become greater ②Or become less important

column.name: text
column.value: “He who comes from above is above all; the one who is only from the earth is of the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

column.name: text
column.value: What He has seen and heard, of this He testifies; and no one accepts His testimony.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who has accepted His testimony has certified that God is true.

column.name: text
column.value: For He whom God sent speaks the words of God; for He does not give the Spirit ①sparingly. ▷ ①Lit from measure

column.name: text
column.value: The Father loves the Son and has entrusted all things to His hand.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who believes in the Son has eternal life; but the one who does not ①obey the Son will not see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.” ▷ ①I.e., in belief

column.name: text
column.value: So then, when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that ①He was making and baptizing more disciples than John ▷ ①Lit Jesus

column.name: text
column.value: (although Jesus Himself was not baptizing; rather, His disciples were),

column.name: text
column.value: He left Judea and went away again to Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: And He had to pass through Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: So He *came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of land that Jacob gave to his son Joseph;

column.name: text
column.value: and Jacob’s well was there. So Jesus, tired from His journey, was just sitting by the well. It was about ①the sixth hour. ▷ ①I.e., noon

column.name: text
column.value: A woman of Samaria *came to draw water. Jesus *said to her, “Give Me a drink.”

column.name: text
column.value: For His disciples had gone away to the city to buy food.

column.name: text
column.value: So the Samaritan woman *said to Him, “How is it that You, though You are a Jew, are asking me for a drink, though I am a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.)

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied to her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who is saying to you, ‘Give Me a drink,’ you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.”

column.name: text
column.value: She *said to Him, “ ①Sir, You have no bucket and the well is deep; where then do You get this living water? ▷ ①Or Lord

column.name: text
column.value: You are not greater than our father Jacob, are You, who gave us the well and drank of it himself, and his sons and his cattle?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will be thirsty again;

column.name: text
column.value: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him shall never be thirsty; but the water that I will give him will become in him a fountain of water springing up to eternal life.”

column.name: text
column.value: The woman *said to Him, “ ①Sir, give me this water so that I will not be thirsty, nor come all the way here to draw water.” ▷ ①Or Lord

column.name: text
column.value: He *said to her, “Go, call your husband and come here.”

column.name: text
column.value: The woman answered and said to Him, “I have no husband.” Jesus *said to her, “You have correctly said, ‘I have no husband’;

column.name: text
column.value: for you have had five husbands, and the one whom you now have is not your husband; this which you have said is true.”

column.name: text
column.value: The woman *said to Him, “ ①Sir, I perceive that You are a prophet. ▷ ①Or Lord

column.name: text
column.value: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, and yet you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where one must worship.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *said to her, “Believe Me, woman, that ①a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem. ▷ ①Lit an hour

column.name: text
column.value: You Samaritans worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, because salvation is from the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: But ①a time is coming, and ②even now has arrived, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth; for such people the Father seeks to be ③His worshipers. ▷ ①Lit an hour ②Lit now is, when ③Lit the ones worshiping Him

column.name: text
column.value: God is ①spirit, and those who worship Him must worship in spirit and truth.” ▷ ①Or Spirit

column.name: text
column.value: The woman *said to Him, “I know that Messiah is coming (He who is called Christ); when that One comes, He will declare all things to us.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *said to her, “I am He, the One speaking to you.”

column.name: text
column.value: And at this point His disciples came, and they were amazed that He had been speaking with a woman, yet no one said, “What are You seeking?” or, “Why are You speaking with her?”

column.name: text
column.value: So the woman left her waterpot and went into the city, and *said to the people,

column.name: text
column.value: “Come, see a man who told me all the things that I have done; this is not the ①Christ, is He?” ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: They left the city and were coming to Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Meanwhile the disciples were urging Him, saying, “Rabbi, eat something.”

column.name: text
column.value: But He said to them, “I have food to eat that you do not know about.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the disciples were saying to one another, “No one brought Him anything to eat, did he?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *said to them, “My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me, and to accomplish His work.

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not say, ‘There are still four months, and then comes the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, raise your eyes and observe the fields, that they are white for harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: Already the one who reaps is receiving wages and is gathering fruit for eternal life, so that the one who sows and the one who reaps may rejoice together.

column.name: text
column.value: For in this case the saying is true: ‘One sows and another reaps.’

column.name: text
column.value: I sent you to reap that for which you have not labored; others have labored, and you have ①come into their labor.” ▷ ①I.e., enjoyed the fruit of their labor

column.name: text
column.value: Now from that city many of the Samaritans believed in Him because of the word of the woman who testified, “He told me all the things that I have done.”

column.name: text
column.value: So when the Samaritans came to ①Jesus, they were asking Him to stay with them; and He stayed there two days. ▷ ①Lit Him

column.name: text
column.value: Many more believed because of His word;

column.name: text
column.value: and they were saying to the woman, “It is no longer because of what you said that we believe, for we have heard for ourselves and know that this One truly is the Savior of the world.”

column.name: text
column.value: And after the two days, He departed from there for Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: For Jesus Himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.

column.name: text
column.value: So when He came to Galilee, the Galileans received Him, only because they had seen all the things that He did in Jerusalem at the feast; for they themselves also went to the feast.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore He came again to Cana of Galilee, where He had made the water into wine. And there was a royal official whose son was sick at Capernaum.

column.name: text
column.value: When he heard that Jesus had come from Judea into Galilee, he went to Him and began asking Him to come down and heal his son; for he was at the point of death.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to him, “Unless you people see ①signs and wonders, you simply will not believe.” ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracles

column.name: text
column.value: The royal official *said to Him, “ ①Sir, come down before my child dies.” ▷ ①Or Lord

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *said to him, “Go; your son ①is alive.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him and went home. ▷ ①I.e., is well

column.name: text
column.value: And as he was now going down, his slaves met him, saying that his ①son was ②alive. ▷ ①Or boy ②I.e., well

column.name: text
column.value: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. Then they said to him, “Yesterday at the ①seventh hour the fever left him.” ▷ ①I.e., 1 p.m.

column.name: text
column.value: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son is alive”; and he himself believed, and his entire household.

column.name: text
column.value: This is again a second ①sign that Jesus performed when He had come from Judea into Galilee. ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracle

column.name: text
column.value: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

column.name: text
column.value: ①He was in the beginning with God. ▷ ①Lit This one

column.name: text
column.value: All things came into being through Him, and apart from Him ①not even one thing came into being that has come into being. ▷ ①One early ms nothing came into

column.name: text
column.value: In Him was life, and the life was the Light of mankind.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Light shines in the darkness, and the darkness did not ①grasp it. ▷ ①Or overpower

column.name: text
column.value: A man ①came, one sent from God, and his name was John. ▷ ①Or came into being

column.name: text
column.value: ①He came ②as a witness, to testify about the Light, so that all might believe through him. ▷ ①Lit This one ②Lit for testimony

column.name: text
column.value: ①He was not the Light, but he came to testify about the Light. ▷ ①Lit That one; i.e., John

column.name: text
column.value: ①This was the true Light ②that, coming into the world, enlightens every person. ▷ ①I.e., the Word, Christ ②Or that enlightens every person coming into the world

column.name: text
column.value: He was in the world, and the world came into being through Him, and yet the world did not ①know Him. ▷ ①Or acknowledge

column.name: text
column.value: He came to His ①own, and His own people did not ②accept Him. ▷ ①Or own things, possessions, domain ②Or receive

column.name: text
column.value: But ①as many as received Him, to them He gave the right to become children of God, to those who ②believe in His name, ▷ ①Or all who received ②Or trust in

column.name: text
column.value: who were ①born, not of ②blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of a man, but of God. ▷ ①Or fathered ②Lit bloods

column.name: text
column.value: And the Word became flesh, and dwelt among us; and we saw His glory, glory as of the only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.

column.name: text
column.value: John *testified about Him and called out, saying, “This was He of whom I said, ‘He who is coming after me has proved to be ①my superior, because He existed before me.’ ” ▷ ①Lit before me

column.name: text
column.value: For of His fullness ①we have all received, and ②grace upon grace. ▷ ①Lit we all received ②Lit grace for grace

column.name: text
column.value: For the Law was given through Moses; grace and truth ①were realized through Jesus Christ. ▷ ①Lit came to be

column.name: text
column.value: No one has seen God at any time; God the only Son, who is in the ①arms of the Father, He has ②explained Him. ▷ ①Lit chest; or possibly lap ②I.e., given a detailed account of

column.name: text
column.value: This is the testimony of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites to him from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”

column.name: text
column.value: And he confessed and did not deny; and this is what he confessed: “I am not the ①Christ.” ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: And so they asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” And he *said, “I am not.” “Are you the Prophet?” And he answered, “No.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then they said to him, “Who are you? Tell us, so that we may give an answer to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

column.name: text
column.value: He said, “I am THE VOICE OF ONE CALLING ①OUT IN THE WILDERNESS, ‘MAKE THE WAY OF THE LORD STRAIGHT,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.” ▷ ①Or out, In the wilderness make the way

column.name: text
column.value: And the messengers had been sent from the Pharisees.

column.name: text
column.value: They asked him, and said to him, “Why then are you baptizing, if you are not the ①Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?” ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: John answered them, saying, “I baptize ①in water, but among you stands One whom you do not know. ▷ ①The Gr here can be translated in, with, or by

column.name: text
column.value: It is He who comes after me, of whom I am not worthy even to untie the strap of His sandal.”

column.name: text
column.value: These things took place in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing people.

column.name: text
column.value: The next day he *saw Jesus coming to him, and *said, “Behold, the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!

column.name: text
column.value: This is He in behalf of whom I said, ‘After me is coming a Man who has proved to be ①my superior, because He existed before me.’ ▷ ①Lit before me

column.name: text
column.value: And I did not recognize ①Him, but so that He would be revealed to Israel, I came baptizing ②in water.” ▷ ①I.e., as the Messiah ②The Gr here can be translated in, with, or by

column.name: text
column.value: And John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending as a dove out of heaven, and He remained upon Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And I did not recognize ①Him, but He who sent me to baptize ②in water said to me, ‘He upon whom you see the Spirit descending and remaining upon Him, this is the One who baptizes ③in the Holy Spirit.’ ▷ ①I.e., as the Messiah ②The Gr here can be translated in, with, or by ③The Gr here can be translated in, with, or by

column.name: text
column.value: And I myself have seen, and have testified that this is the ①Son of God.” ▷ ①One early ms Chosen One of

column.name: text
column.value: Again the next day John was standing ①with two of his disciples, ▷ ①Lit and

column.name: text
column.value: and he looked at Jesus as He walked, and *said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”

column.name: text
column.value: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus turned and saw them following, and *said to them, “What are you seeking?” They said to Him, “Rabbi (which translated means Teacher), where are You staying?”

column.name: text
column.value: He *said to them, “Come, and you will see.” So they came and saw where He was staying, and they stayed with Him that day; it was about the ①tenth hour. ▷ ①I.e., about 4 p.m.

column.name: text
column.value: One of the two who heard John speak, and followed Him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

column.name: text
column.value: He first *found his own brother Simon and *said to him, “We have found the Messiah” (which translated means ①Christ). ▷ ①Gr Anointed One

column.name: text
column.value: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of ①John; you shall be called Cephas” (which is translated ②Peter). ▷ ①Gr Joannes ②I.e., Rock or Stone in Gr

column.name: text
column.value: The next day He ①decided to go to Galilee, and He *found Philip. And Jesus *said to him, “Follow Me.” ▷ ①Or resolved

column.name: text
column.value: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

column.name: text
column.value: Philip *found Nathanael and *said to him, “We have found Him of whom Moses wrote in the Law, and the prophets also wrote: Jesus the son of Joseph, from Nazareth!”

column.name: text
column.value: Nathanael said to him, “Can anything good be from Nazareth?” Philip *said to him, “Come and see.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to Him, and *said of him, “Here is truly an Israelite, in whom there is no deceit!”

column.name: text
column.value: Nathanael *said to Him, “How do You know me?” Jesus answered and said to him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”

column.name: text
column.value: Nathanael answered Him, “Rabbi, You are the Son of God; You are the King of Israel!”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to him, “Because I said to you that I saw you under the fig tree, do you believe? You will see greater things than these.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He *said to him, “Truly, truly, I say to you, you will see heaven opened and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”

column.name: text
column.value: After these things there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in Jerusalem, by the Sheep Gate, there is a pool which in ①Hebrew is called ②Bethesda, having five ③porticoes. ▷ ①I.e., Jewish Aramaic ②Some early mss Bethsaida or Bethzatha ③Or colonnades (with roofs)

column.name: text
column.value: In these porticoes lay a multitude of those who were sick, blind, limping, or ①paralyzed. ② ▷ ①Or had shrunken limbs ②Late mss add the following as the remainder of v 3, and v 4: paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the waters; for an angel of the Lord went down at certain seasons into the pool and stirred up the water; whoever then first stepped in after the stirring up of the water was made well from whatever disease with which he was afflicted

column.name: text
column.value: Now a man was there who had been ①ill for thirty-eight years. ▷ ①Lit in his sickness

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus, upon seeing this man lying there and knowing that he had already been in that condition for a long time, *said to him, “Do you want to get well?”

column.name: text
column.value: The sick man answered Him, “Sir, I have no man to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I am coming, another steps down before me.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *said to him, “Get up, pick up your pallet and walk.”

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately the man became well, and picked up his pallet and began to walk. Now it was a Sabbath on that day.

column.name: text
column.value: So the Jews were saying to the man who was cured, “It is a Sabbath, and it is not permissible for you to carry your pallet.”

column.name: text
column.value: But he answered them, “He who made me well was the one who said to me, ‘Pick up your pallet and walk.’”

column.name: text
column.value: They asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Pick it up and walk’?”

column.name: text
column.value: But the man who was healed did not know who it was, for Jesus had slipped away while there was a crowd in that place.

column.name: text
column.value: Afterward, Jesus *found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you have become well; do not sin anymore, so that nothing worse happens to you.”

column.name: text
column.value: The man went away, and informed the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason the Jews were persecuting Jesus, because He was doing these things on a Sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: But He answered them, “My Father ①is working until now, and I Myself am working.” ▷ ①I.e., has been and continues

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason therefore the Jews were seeking all the more to kill Him, because He not only was breaking the Sabbath, but also was calling God His own Father, making Himself equal with God.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Jesus answered and was saying to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you, the Son can do nothing of Himself, unless it is something He sees the Father doing; for whatever ①the Father does, these things the Son also does in the same way. ▷ ①Lit that One

column.name: text
column.value: For the Father loves the Son and shows Him all things that He Himself is doing; and the Father will show Him greater works than these, so that you will be amazed.

column.name: text
column.value: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so the Son also gives life to whom He wishes.

column.name: text
column.value: For not even the Father judges anyone, but He has given all judgment to the Son,

column.name: text
column.value: so that all will honor the Son just as they honor the Father. The one who does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.

column.name: text
column.value: “Truly, truly, I say to you, the one who hears My word, and believes Him who sent Me, has eternal life, and does not come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

column.name: text
column.value: Truly, truly, I say to you, ①a time is coming and ②even now has arrived, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live. ▷ ①Lit an hour ②Lit now is, when

column.name: text
column.value: For just as the Father has life in Himself, so He gave to the Son also to have life in Himself;

column.name: text
column.value: and He gave Him authority to execute judgment, because He is ①the Son of Man. ▷ ①Or a son of man

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be amazed at this; for ①a time is coming when all who are in the tombs will hear His voice, ▷ ①Lit an hour

column.name: text
column.value: and will come out: those who did the good deeds to a resurrection of life, those who committed the bad deeds to a resurrection of judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: “I can do nothing ①on My own. As I hear, I judge; and My judgment is ②righteous, because I do not seek My own will but the will of Him who sent Me. ▷ ①Or of Myself ②Or fair

column.name: text
column.value: “If I alone testify about Myself, My testimony is not ①true. ▷ ①I.e., admissible as legal evidence

column.name: text
column.value: There is another who testifies about Me, and I know that the testimony which He gives about Me is true.

column.name: text
column.value: You have sent messengers to John, and he has testified to the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: But the testimony I receive is not from man, but I say these things so that you may be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: He was the lamp that was burning and shining, and you were willing to rejoice for ①a while in his light. ▷ ①Lit an hour

column.name: text
column.value: But the testimony I have is greater than the testimony of John; for the works which the Father has given Me to accomplish—the very works that I do—testify about Me, that the Father has sent Me.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Father who sent Me, He has testified about Me. You have neither heard His voice at any time, nor seen His form.

column.name: text
column.value: Also you do not have His word remaining in you, because you do not believe Him whom He sent.

column.name: text
column.value: ①You examine the Scriptures because you think that in them you have eternal life; and it is those very Scriptures that testify about Me; ▷ ①Or (a command) Examine the Scriptures

column.name: text
column.value: and yet you are unwilling to come to Me so that you may have life.

column.name: text
column.value: I do not receive glory from people;

column.name: text
column.value: but I know you, that you do not have the love of God in yourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: I have come in My Father’s name, and you do not ①receive Me; if another comes in his own name, you will ②receive him. ▷ ①Or accept ②Or accept

column.name: text
column.value: How can you believe, when you ①accept ②glory from one another and you do not seek the ③glory that is from the one and only God? ▷ ①Or receive ②Or honor ③Or honor

column.name: text
column.value: Do not think that I will accuse you before the Father; the one who accuses you is Moses, in whom you have put your hope.

column.name: text
column.value: For if you believed Moses, you would believe Me; for he wrote about Me.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you do not believe his writings, how will you believe My words?”

column.name: text
column.value: After these things Jesus went away to the other side of the Sea of Galilee (or Tiberias).

column.name: text
column.value: A large crowd was following Him, because they were watching the ①signs which He was performing on those who were sick. ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracles

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus went up on the mountain, and there He sat with His disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was near.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jesus, after raising His eyes and seeing that a large crowd was coming to Him, *said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread so that these people may eat?”

column.name: text
column.value: But He was saying this only to test him, for He Himself knew what He intended to do.

column.name: text
column.value: Philip answered Him, “Two hundred ①denarii worth of bread is not enough for them, for each to receive just a little!” ▷ ①The denarius was a day’s wages for a laborer

column.name: text
column.value: One of His disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, *said to Him,

column.name: text
column.value: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish; but what are these for so many people?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said, “Have the people recline to eat.” Now there was plenty of grass in the place. So the men reclined, about ①five thousand in number. ▷ ①I.e., 5,000 men plus women and children, cf. Matt

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus then took the loaves, and after giving thanks He distributed them to those who were reclining; likewise also of the fish, as much as they wanted.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had eaten their fill, He *said to His disciples, “Gather up the leftover pieces so that nothing will be lost.”

column.name: text
column.value: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with pieces from the five barley loaves which were left over by those who had eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore when the people saw the ①sign which He had performed, they said, “This is truly the Prophet who is to come into the world.” ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracle

column.name: text
column.value: So Jesus, aware that they ①intended to come and take Him by force to make Him king, withdrew again to the mountain by Himself, alone. ▷ ①Or were about

column.name: text
column.value: Now when evening came, His disciples went down to the sea,

column.name: text
column.value: and after getting into a boat, they started to cross the sea to Capernaum. It had already become dark, and Jesus had not yet come to them.

column.name: text
column.value: In addition, the sea began getting rough, because a strong wind was blowing.

column.name: text
column.value: Then, when they had rowed about ①twenty-five or thirty stadia, they *saw Jesus walking on the sea and coming near the boat; and they were frightened. ▷ ①Possibly 3-4 miles or 4.8-6.4 km; a Roman stadion perhaps averaged 607 ft. or 185 m

column.name: text
column.value: But He *said to them, “It is I; ①do not be afraid.” ▷ ①Or stop being afraid

column.name: text
column.value: So they were willing to take Him into the boat, and immediately the boat was at the land to which they were going.

column.name: text
column.value: The next day the crowd that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other small boat there except one, and that Jesus had not gotten into the boat with His disciples, but that His disciples had departed alone.

column.name: text
column.value: Other small boats came from Tiberias near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

column.name: text
column.value: So when the crowd saw that Jesus was not there, nor His disciples, they themselves got into the small boats and came to Capernaum, looking for Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they found Him on the other side of the sea, they said to Him, “Rabbi, when did You get here?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered them and said, “Truly, truly, I say to you, you seek Me, not because you saw ①signs, but because you ate some of the loaves and were filled. ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracles

column.name: text
column.value: Do not work for the food that perishes, but for the food that lasts for eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you, for on Him the Father, God, has set His ①seal.” ▷ ①I.e., of identification or authenticity

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they said to Him, “What are we to do, so that we may accomplish the works of God?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in Him whom He has sent.”

column.name: text
column.value: So they said to Him, “What then are You doing as a sign, so that we may see, and believe You? What work are You performing?

column.name: text
column.value: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness; as it is written: ‘HE GAVE THEM BREAD OUT OF HEAVEN TO EAT.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus then said to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you, it is not Moses who has given you the bread out of heaven, but it is My Father who gives you the true bread out of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: For the bread of God is ①that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.” ▷ ①Or He who comes

column.name: text
column.value: Then they said to Him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life; the one who comes to Me will not be hungry, and the one who believes in Me will never be thirsty.

column.name: text
column.value: But I said to you that you have indeed seen Me, and yet you do not believe.

column.name: text
column.value: Everything that the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I certainly will not cast out.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have come down from heaven, not to do My own will, but the will of Him who sent Me.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that of everything that He has given Me I will lose nothing, but will raise it up on the last day.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is the will of My Father, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in Him will have eternal life, and I Myself will raise him up on the last day.”

column.name: text
column.value: So then the Jews were complaining about Him because He said, “I am the bread that came down out of heaven.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they were saying, “Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How does He now say, ‘I have come down out of heaven’?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to them, “Stop complaining among yourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him; and I will raise him up on the last day.

column.name: text
column.value: It is written in the Prophets: ‘AND THEY SHALL ALL BE TAUGHT OF GOD.’ Everyone who has heard and learned from the Father, comes to Me.

column.name: text
column.value: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except the One who is from God; He has seen the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: Truly, truly, I say to you, the one who believes has eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the bread of life.

column.name: text
column.value: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the bread that comes down out of heaven, so that anyone may eat from it and not die.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the living bread that came down out of heaven; if anyone eats from this bread, he will live forever; and the bread which I will give for the life of the world also is My flesh.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Jews began to argue with one another, saying, “How can this man give us His flesh to eat?”

column.name: text
column.value: So Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink His blood, you have no life in yourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up on the last day.

column.name: text
column.value: For My flesh is true food, and My blood is true drink.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who eats My flesh and drinks My blood remains in Me, and I in him.

column.name: text
column.value: Just as the living Father sent Me, and I live because of the Father, the one who eats Me, he also will live because of Me.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the bread that came down out of heaven, not as the fathers ate and died; the one who eats this bread will live forever.”

column.name: text
column.value: These things He said in the synagogue as He taught in Capernaum.

column.name: text
column.value: So then many of His disciples, when they heard this, said, “This statement is very ①unpleasant; who can listen to it?” ▷ ①Or hard

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus, aware that His disciples were complaining about this, said to them, “Is this ①offensive to you? ▷ ①Or shocking

column.name: text
column.value: What then if you see the Son of Man ascending to where He was before?

column.name: text
column.value: It is the Spirit who gives life; the flesh provides no benefit; the words that I have spoken to you are spirit, and are life.

column.name: text
column.value: But there are some of you who do not believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who did not believe, and who it was who would ①betray Him. ▷ ①Or hand Him over

column.name: text
column.value: And He was saying, “For this reason I have told you that no one can come to Me unless it has been granted him from the Father.”

column.name: text
column.value: As a result of this many of His disciples left, and would no longer walk with Him.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jesus said to the twelve, “You do not want to leave also, do you?”

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter answered Him, “Lord, to whom shall we go? You have words of eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: And we have already believed and have come to know that You are the Holy One of God.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered them, “Did I Myself not choose you, the twelve? And yet one of you is a devil.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now He meant Judas the son of Simon Iscariot; for he, one of the twelve, ①was going to betray Him. ▷ ①Or was intending to

column.name: text
column.value: On the third day there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee, and the mother of Jesus was there;

column.name: text
column.value: and both Jesus and His disciples were invited to the wedding.

column.name: text
column.value: When the wine ran out, the mother of Jesus *said to Him, “They have no wine.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus *said to her, “ ①What business do you have with Me, woman? My hour has not yet come.” ▷ ①Lit What to Me and to you (an ancient idiom)

column.name: text
column.value: His mother *said to the servants, “Whatever He tells you, do it.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now there were six stone waterpots standing there for the Jewish custom of purification, containing ①two or three measures each. ▷ ①About 18 or 27 gallons each; or 68 or 102 liters

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *said to them, “Fill the waterpots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.

column.name: text
column.value: And He *said to them, “Draw some out now and take it to the ①headwaiter.” And they took it to him. ▷ ①I.e., manager of the banquet

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the headwaiter tasted the water which had become wine, and did not know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the headwaiter *called the groom,

column.name: text
column.value: and *said to him, “Every man serves the good wine first, and when the guests are drunk, then he serves the poorer wine; but you have kept the good wine until now.”

column.name: text
column.value: This beginning of His ①signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed His glory; and His disciples believed in Him. ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracles

column.name: text
column.value: After this He went down to Capernaum, He and His mother, and His brothers and His disciples; and they stayed there a few days.

column.name: text
column.value: The Passover of the Jews was near, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And within the temple grounds He found those who were selling oxen, sheep, and doves, and the money changers seated at their tables.

column.name: text
column.value: And He made a whip of ①cords, and drove them all out of the temple area, with the sheep and the oxen; and He poured out the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables; ▷ ①Or pieces of rope

column.name: text
column.value: and to those who were selling the doves He said, “Take these things away from here; stop making My Father’s house a ①place of business!” ▷ ①Lit house

column.name: text
column.value: His disciples remembered that it was written: “ZEAL FOR YOUR HOUSE WILL CONSUME ME.”

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews then said to Him, “What sign do You show us ①as your authority for doing these things?” ▷ ①Lit that You do these

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this ①temple, and in three days I will raise it up.” ▷ ①Or sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews then said, “It took forty-six years to build this ①temple, and yet You will raise it up in three days?” ▷ ①Or sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: But He was speaking about the ①temple of His body. ▷ ①Or sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: So when He was raised from the dead, His disciples remembered that He said this; and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when He was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in His name as they observed His signs which He was doing.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus, on His part, was not entrusting Himself to them, because He knew all people,

column.name: text
column.value: and because He did not need anyone to testify about mankind, for He Himself knew what was in mankind.

column.name: text
column.value: After these things Jesus was walking in Galilee, for He was unwilling to walk in Judea because the Jews were seeking to kill Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was near.

column.name: text
column.value: So His brothers said to Him, “Move on from here and go into Judea, so that Your disciples also may see Your works which You are doing.

column.name: text
column.value: For no one does anything in secret ①when he himself is striving to be known publicly. If You are doing these things, show Yourself to the world.” ▷ ①Lit and

column.name: text
column.value: For not even His brothers believed in Him.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jesus *said to them, “My time is not yet here, but your time is always ready.

column.name: text
column.value: The world cannot hate you, but it hates Me because I testify about it, that its deeds are evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Go up to the feast yourselves; I am not going up to this feast, because My time has not yet fully arrived.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now having said these things to them, He stayed in Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: But when His brothers had gone up to the feast, then He Himself also went up, not publicly, but as though in secret.

column.name: text
column.value: So the Jews were looking for Him at the feast and saying, “Where is He?”

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a great deal of talk about Him in secret among the crowds: some were saying, “He is a good man”; others were saying, “No, on the contrary, He is misleading the people.”

column.name: text
column.value: However, no one was speaking openly about Him, for fear of ①the Jews. ▷ ①I.e., the Jewish leaders

column.name: text
column.value: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple area, and began to teach.

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews then were astonished, saying, “How has this man become learned, not having been educated?”

column.name: text
column.value: So Jesus answered them and said, “My teaching is not My own, but His who sent Me.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone is willing to do His will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is of God, or I am speaking from Myself.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who speaks from himself seeks his own glory; but He who is seeking the glory of the One who sent Him, He is true, and there is no unrighteousness in Him.

column.name: text
column.value: “Did Moses not give you the Law, and yet none of you carries out the Law? Why are you seeking to kill Me?”

column.name: text
column.value: The crowd answered, “You have a demon! Who is seeking to kill You?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered them, “I did one ①deed, and you all are astonished. ▷ ①Or work

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is from Moses, but from the fathers), and even on a Sabbath you circumcise a man.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man receives circumcision on a Sabbath so that the Law of Moses will not be broken, are you angry at Me because I made an entire man well on a Sabbath?

column.name: text
column.value: Do not judge by the outward appearance, but judge ①with righteous judgment.” ▷ ①Lit the righteous judgment

column.name: text
column.value: So some of the people of Jerusalem were saying, “Is this man not the one whom they are seeking to kill?

column.name: text
column.value: And yet look, He is speaking publicly, and they are saying nothing to Him. The rulers do not really know that this is the ①Christ, do they? ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: However, we know where this man is from; but when the Christ comes, no one knows where He is from.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know Me and you know where I am from; and I have not come of Myself, but He who sent Me is true, whom you do not know.

column.name: text
column.value: I do know Him, because I am from Him, and He sent Me.”

column.name: text
column.value: So they were seeking to arrest Him; and yet no one laid a hand on Him, because His hour had not yet come.

column.name: text
column.value: But many of the crowd believed in Him; and they were saying, “When the ①Christ comes, He will not perform more ②signs than those which this man has done, will He?” ▷ ①I.e., Messiah ②I.e., confirming miracles

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees heard the crowd whispering these things about Him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Jesus said, “For a little while longer I am going to be with you, and then I am going to Him who sent Me.

column.name: text
column.value: You will seek Me, and will not find Me; and where I am, you cannot come.”

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews then said to one another, “Where does this man intend to go that we will not find Him? He does not intend to go to the Dispersion among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks, does He?

column.name: text
column.value: What is this statement that He said, ‘You will seek Me, and will not find Me; and where I am, you cannot come’?”

column.name: text
column.value: Now on the last day, the great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, saying, “If anyone is thirsty, ①let him come to Me and drink. ▷ ①Or come to Me and drink

column.name: text
column.value: The one who believes in Me, as the Scripture said, ‘ ①From his innermost being will flow rivers of living water.’ ” ▷ ①Lit Out of his belly

column.name: text
column.value: But this He said in reference to the Spirit, whom those who believed in Him were to receive; for the Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus was not yet glorified.

column.name: text
column.value: Some of the people therefore, after they heard these words, were saying, “This truly is the Prophet.”

column.name: text
column.value: Others were saying, “This is the ①Christ.” But others were saying, “Surely the ②Christ is not coming from Galilee, is He? ▷ ①I.e., Messiah ②I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: Has the Scripture not said that the Christ comes from the descendants of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”

column.name: text
column.value: So a dissension occurred in the crowd because of Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And some of them wanted to arrest Him, but no one laid hands on Him.

column.name: text
column.value: The officers then came to the chief priests and Pharisees, and they said to them, “Why did you not bring Him?”

column.name: text
column.value: The officers answered, “Never has a man spoken in this way!”

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees then replied to them, “You have not been led astray too, have you?

column.name: text
column.value: Not one of the rulers or Pharisees has believed in Him, has he?

column.name: text
column.value: But this crowd that does not know the Law is accursed!”

column.name: text
column.value: Nicodemus (the one who came to Him before, being one of them) *said to them,

column.name: text
column.value: “Our Law does not judge the person unless it first hears from him and knows what he is doing, does it?”

column.name: text
column.value: They answered and said to him, “You are not from Galilee as well, are you? Examine the Scriptures, and see that no prophet arises out of Galilee.”

column.name: text
column.value: ①And everyone went to his home. ▷ ①Later mss add the story of the adulterous woman, numbering it as John 7:53-8:11

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

column.name: text
column.value: And early in the morning He came again into the temple area, and all the people were coming to Him; and He sat down and began teaching them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the scribes and the Pharisees *brought a woman caught in the act of adultery, and after placing her in the center of the courtyard,

column.name: text
column.value: they *said to Him, “Teacher, this woman has been caught in the very act of committing adultery.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the Law, Moses commanded us to stone such women; what then do You say?”

column.name: text
column.value: Now they were saying this to test Him, so that they might have grounds for accusing Him. But Jesus stooped down and with His finger wrote on the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: When they persisted in asking Him, He straightened up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him be the first to throw a stone at her.”

column.name: text
column.value: And again He stooped down and wrote on the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when they heard this, they began leaving, one by one, beginning with the older ones, and He was left alone, and the woman where she was, in the center of the courtyard.

column.name: text
column.value: And straightening up, Jesus said to her, “Woman, where are they? Did no one condemn you?”

column.name: text
column.value: She said, “No one, ①Lord.” And Jesus said, “I do not condemn you, either. Go. From now on do not sin any longer.”]] ▷ ①Or Sir

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus again spoke to them, saying, “I am the Light of the world; the one who follows Me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the Light of life.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the Pharisees said to Him, “You are testifying about Yourself; Your testimony is not ①true.” ▷ ①Or valid

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to them, “Even if I am testifying about Myself, My testimony is ①true, because I know where I came from and where I am going; but you do not know where I come from or where I am going. ▷ ①Or valid

column.name: text
column.value: You judge ①according to the flesh; I am not judging anyone. ▷ ①I.e., by a carnal standard

column.name: text
column.value: But even if I do judge, My judgment is true; for I am not alone in it, but I and the Father who sent Me.

column.name: text
column.value: Even in your Law it has been written that the testimony of two people is ①true. ▷ ①I.e., valid or admissible

column.name: text
column.value: I am He who testifies about Myself, and the Father who sent Me testifies about Me.”

column.name: text
column.value: So they were saying to Him, “Where is Your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither Me nor My Father; if you knew Me, you would know My Father also.”

column.name: text
column.value: These words He spoke ①in the treasury, as He taught in the temple area; and no one arrested Him, because His hour had not yet come. ▷ ①Or at

column.name: text
column.value: Then He said again to them, “I am going away, and you will look for Me, and will die in your sin; where I am going, you cannot come.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the Jews were saying, “Surely He will not kill Himself, will He, since He says, ‘Where I am going, you cannot come’?”

column.name: text
column.value: And He was saying to them, “You are from below, I am from above; you are of this world, I am not of this world.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I said to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that ①I am, you will die in your sins.” ▷ ①Or I AM, you will die...; Jesus may be referring to Ex 3:14, I AM WHO I AM

column.name: text
column.value: Then they were saying to Him, “Who are You?” Jesus said to them, “ ①What have I even been saying to you from the beginning? ▷ ①Or That which I have even been saying to you from the beginning

column.name: text
column.value: I have many things to say and to judge regarding you, but He who sent Me is true; and the things which I heard from Him, these I say to the world.”

column.name: text
column.value: They did not realize that He was speaking to them about the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jesus said, “When you lift up the Son of Man, then you will know that ①I am, and I do nothing ②on My own, but I say these things as the Father instructed Me. ▷ ①Or I AM, and...; (see note v 24) ②Or of Myself

column.name: text
column.value: And He who sent Me is with Me; He ①has not left Me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to Him.” ▷ ①Or did not leave

column.name: text
column.value: As He said these things, many came to believe in Him.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jesus was saying to those Jews who had believed Him, “If you continue in My word, then you are truly My disciples;

column.name: text
column.value: and you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”

column.name: text
column.value: They answered Him, “We are Abraham’s descendants and have never been enslaved to anyone; how is it that You say, ‘You will become free’?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered them, “Truly, truly I say to you, everyone who commits sin is a slave of sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the slave does not remain in the house forever; the son does remain forever.

column.name: text
column.value: So if the Son sets you free, you really will be free.

column.name: text
column.value: I know that you are Abraham’s descendants; yet you are seeking to kill Me, because My word ①has no place in you. ▷ ①Or is making no headway among you

column.name: text
column.value: I speak of the things which I have seen ①with My Father; therefore you also do the things which you heard from your father.” ▷ ①Or in the presence of

column.name: text
column.value: They answered and said to Him, “Abraham is our father.” Jesus *said to them, “If you are Abraham’s children, do the deeds of Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: But as it is, you are seeking to kill Me, a man who has told you the truth, which I heard from God; this Abraham did not do.

column.name: text
column.value: You are doing the deeds of your father.” They said to Him, “We were not born as a result of sexual immorality; we have one Father: God.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love Me, for I came forth from God and am here; for I have not even come ①on My own, but ②He sent Me. ▷ ①Or of Myself ②Lit that One

column.name: text
column.value: Why do you not understand ①what I am saying? It is because you cannot listen to My word. ▷ ①Or My way of speaking

column.name: text
column.value: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and does not stand in the truth because there is no truth in him. Whenever he tells ①a lie, he speaks from his own nature, because he is a liar and the father of ②lies. ▷ ①Lit the lie ②Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: But because I say the truth, you do not believe Me.

column.name: text
column.value: Which one of you convicts Me of sin? If I speak truth, why do you not believe Me?

column.name: text
column.value: The one who is of God hears the words of God; for this reason you do not hear them, because you are not of God.”

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews answered and said to Him, “Do we not rightly say that You are a Samaritan, and You have a demon?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, “I do not have a demon; on the contrary, I honor My Father, and you dishonor Me.

column.name: text
column.value: But I am not seeking My glory; there is One who seeks it, and judges.

column.name: text
column.value: Truly, truly I say to you, if anyone follows My word, he will never see death.”

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews said to Him, “Now we know that You have a demon. Abraham died, and the prophets as well; and yet You say, ‘If anyone follows My word, he will never taste of death.’

column.name: text
column.value: You are not greater than our father Abraham, who died, are You? The prophets died too. Whom do You make Yourself out to be?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, “If I glorify Myself, My glory is nothing; it is My Father who glorifies Me, of whom you say, ‘He is our God’;

column.name: text
column.value: and you have not come to know Him, but I know Him. And if I say that I do not know Him, I will be a liar like you; but I do know Him, and I follow His word.

column.name: text
column.value: Your father Abraham was overjoyed that he would see My day, and he saw it and rejoiced.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the Jews said to Him, “You are not yet fifty years old, and You have seen Abraham?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly I say to you, before Abraham ①was born, ②I am.” ▷ ①Lit came into being ②Or I AM; Jesus may be referring to Ex 3:14, I AM WHO I AM

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they picked up stones to throw at Him, but Jesus hid Himself and left the temple grounds.

column.name: text
column.value: As Jesus passed by, He saw a man who had been blind from birth.

column.name: text
column.value: And His disciples asked Him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he would be born blind?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, “It was neither that this man sinned, nor his parents; but it was so that the works of God might be displayed in him.

column.name: text
column.value: We must carry out the works of Him who sent Me as long as it is day; night is coming, when no one can work.

column.name: text
column.value: While I am in the world, I am the Light of the world.”

column.name: text
column.value: When He had said this, He spit on the ground, and made mud from the saliva, and applied the mud to his eyes,

column.name: text
column.value: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which is translated, Sent). So he left and washed, and came back seeing.

column.name: text
column.value: So the neighbors, and those who previously saw ①him as a beggar, were saying, “Is this not the one who used to sit and beg?” ▷ ①Lit that he was a

column.name: text
column.value: Others were saying, “This is he,” still others were saying, “No, but he is like him.” ①The man himself kept saying, “I am the one.” ▷ ①Lit That one kept

column.name: text
column.value: So they were saying to him, “How then were your eyes opened?”

column.name: text
column.value: He answered, “The man who is called Jesus made mud, and spread it on my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to Siloam and wash’; so I went away and washed, and I received sight.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to him, “Where is He?” He *said, “I do not know.”

column.name: text
column.value: They *brought ①the man who was previously blind to the Pharisees. ▷ ①Lit him who

column.name: text
column.value: Now it was a Sabbath on the day that Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Pharisees also were asking him again how he received his sight. And he said to them, “He applied mud to my eyes, and I washed, and I see.”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore some of the Pharisees were saying, “This man is not from God, because He does not keep the Sabbath.” But others were saying, “How can a man who is a sinner perform such ①signs?” And there was dissension among them. ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracles

column.name: text
column.value: So they *said again to the man who was blind, “What do you say about Him, since He opened your eyes?” And he said, “He is a prophet.”

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews then did not believe it about him, that he had been blind and had received sight, until they called the parents of the very one who had received his sight,

column.name: text
column.value: and they questioned them, saying, “Is this your son, who you say was born blind? Then how does he now see?”

column.name: text
column.value: His parents then answered and said, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;

column.name: text
column.value: but how he now sees, we do not know; or who opened his eyes, we do not know. Ask him; he is of age, he will speak for himself.”

column.name: text
column.value: His parents said this because they were afraid of the ①Jews; for the Jews had already reached the decision that if anyone confessed Him to be ②Christ, he was to be excommunicated from the synagogue. ▷ ①I.e., the Jewish leaders ②I.e., the Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: It was for this reason that his parents said, “He is of age; ask him.”

column.name: text
column.value: So for a second time they summoned the man who had been blind, and said to him, “Give glory to God; we know that this man is a sinner.”

column.name: text
column.value: He then answered, “Whether He is a sinner, I do not know; one thing I do know, that though I was blind, now I see.”

column.name: text
column.value: So they said to him, “What did He do to you? How did He open your eyes?”

column.name: text
column.value: He answered them, “I told you already and you did not listen; why do you want to hear it again? You do not want to become His disciples too, do you?”

column.name: text
column.value: They spoke abusively to him and said, “You are His disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: We know that God has spoken to Moses, but as for this man, we do not know where He is from.”

column.name: text
column.value: The man answered and said to them, “Well, here is the amazing thing, that you do not know where He is from, and yet He opened my eyes!

column.name: text
column.value: We know that God does not listen to sinners; but if someone is ①God-fearing and does His will, He listens to him. ▷ ①Or devout

column.name: text
column.value: ①Since the beginning of time it has never been heard that anyone opened the eyes of a person born blind. ▷ ①Lit From the age it was not heard

column.name: text
column.value: If this man were not from God, He could do nothing.”

column.name: text
column.value: They answered him, “You were born entirely in sins, and yet you are teaching us?” So they ①put him out. ▷ ①I.e., prob. excommunication from the synagogue

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus heard that they had ①put him out, and upon finding him, He said, “Do you believe in the Son of Man?” ▷ ①See note v 34

column.name: text
column.value: He answered ①by saying, “And who is He, ②Sir, that I may believe in Him?” ▷ ①Lit and said ②Or Lord

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen Him, and He is the one who is talking with you.”

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, “I believe, Lord.” And he worshiped Him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said, “For judgment I came into this world, so that those who do not see may see, and those who see may become blind.”

column.name: text
column.value: Those who were with Him from the Pharisees heard these things and said to Him, “We are not blind too, are we?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now that you maintain, ‘We see,’ your sin remains.

column.name: text
column.value: “Truly, truly I say to you, the one who does not enter by the door into the fold of the sheep, but climbs up some other way, he is a thief and a robber.

column.name: text
column.value: But the one who enters by the door is a shepherd of the sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: To him the doorkeeper opens, and the sheep listen to his voice, and he calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

column.name: text
column.value: When he puts all his own sheep outside, he goes ahead of them, and the sheep follow him because they know his voice.

column.name: text
column.value: However, a stranger they simply will not follow, but will flee from him, because they do not know the voice of strangers.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus told them this figure of speech, but they did not understand what the things which He was saying to them ①meant. ▷ ①Lit were

column.name: text
column.value: So Jesus said to them again, “Truly, truly I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: All those who came before Me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the door; if anyone enters through Me, he will be saved, and will go in and out and find pasture.

column.name: text
column.value: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I came so that they would have life, and ①have it abundantly. ▷ ①Or have abundance

column.name: text
column.value: “I am the good shepherd; the good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who is not the owner of the sheep, sees the wolf coming, and leaves the sheep and flees; and the wolf snatches them and scatters the flock.

column.name: text
column.value: He flees because he is a hired hand and does not care about the sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the good shepherd, and I know My own, and My own know Me,

column.name: text
column.value: just as the Father knows Me and I know the Father; and I lay down My life for the sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: And I have other sheep that are not of this fold; I must bring them also, and they will listen to My voice; and they will become one flock, with one shepherd.

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason the Father loves Me, because I lay down My life so that I may take it back.

column.name: text
column.value: No one has taken it away from Me, but I lay it down on My own. I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to take it back. This commandment I received from My Father.”

column.name: text
column.value: Dissension occurred again among the Jews because of these words.

column.name: text
column.value: Many of them were saying, “He has a demon and is insane. Why do you listen to Him?”

column.name: text
column.value: Others were saying, “These are not the words of one who is demon-possessed. A demon cannot open the eyes of those who are blind, can it?”

column.name: text
column.value: At that time the ①Feast of the Dedication took place in Jerusalem; ▷ ①Now known as Hanukkah, also the Feast of Lights

column.name: text
column.value: it was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple area, in the portico of Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews then surrounded Him and began saying to Him, “How long ①will You keep us in suspense? If You are the ②Christ, tell us plainly.” ▷ ①Lit do You lift up our soul ②I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you do not believe; the works that I do in My Father’s name, these testify of Me.

column.name: text
column.value: But you do not believe, because you are not of My sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: My sheep listen to My voice, and I know them, and they follow Me;

column.name: text
column.value: and I give them eternal life, and they will never perish; and no one will snatch them out of My hand.

column.name: text
column.value: ①My Father, who has given them to Me, is greater than all; and no one is able to snatch them out of the Father’s hand. ▷ ①One early ms What My Father has given Me is greater than all

column.name: text
column.value: I and the Father are ①one.” ▷ ①Or a unity; or one essence

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews picked up stones again to stone Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied to them, “I showed you many good works from the Father; for which of them are you stoning Me?”

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews answered Him, “We are not stoning You for a good work, but for blasphemy; and because You, being a man, make Yourself out to be God.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered them, “Has it not been written in your Law: ‘I SAID, YOU ARE GODS’?

column.name: text
column.value: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture cannot be nullified),

column.name: text
column.value: are you saying of Him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You are blaspheming,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?

column.name: text
column.value: If I do not do the works of My Father, do not believe Me;

column.name: text
column.value: but if I do them, even though you do not believe Me, believe the works, so that you may ①know and understand that the Father is in Me, and I in the Father.” ▷ ①Lit know and continue knowing

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they were seeking again to arrest Him, and He eluded their grasp.

column.name: text
column.value: And He went away again beyond the Jordan to the place where John was first baptizing, and He stayed there.

column.name: text
column.value: Many came to Him and were saying, “While John performed no sign, yet everything John said about this man was true.”

column.name: text
column.value: And many believed in Him there.

column.name: text
column.value: Now a certain man was sick: Lazarus of Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was the Mary who anointed the Lord with ①ointment, and wiped His feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick. ▷ ①Or perfume

column.name: text
column.value: So the sisters sent word to Him, saying, “Lord, behold, he whom You love is sick.”

column.name: text
column.value: But when Jesus heard this, He said, “This sickness is not ①meant for death, but is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified by it.” ▷ ①Lit toward death

column.name: text
column.value: (Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister, and Lazarus.)

column.name: text
column.value: So when He heard that he was sick, He then stayed two days longer in the place where He was.

column.name: text
column.value: Then after this He *said to the disciples, “Let’s go to Judea again.”

column.name: text
column.value: The disciples *said to Him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just now seeking to stone You, and yet You are going there again?”

column.name: text
