column.value: Jesus replied, “Are there not twelve hours in the day? If anyone walks during the day, he does not stumble, because he sees the light of this world.

column.name: text
column.value: But if anyone walks during the night, he stumbles, because the light is not in ①him.” ▷ ①Or it; i.e., the world

column.name: text
column.value: This He said, and after this He *said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep; but I am going so that I may awaken him from sleep.”

column.name: text
column.value: The disciples then said to Him, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will ①come out of it.” ▷ ①Lit be saved

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that He was speaking about ①actual sleep. ▷ ①Lit the slumber of sleep

column.name: text
column.value: So Jesus then said to them plainly, “Lazarus died,

column.name: text
column.value: and I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe; but let’s go to him.”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Thomas, who was called ①Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, so that we may die with Him!” ▷ ①I.e., the Twin

column.name: text
column.value: So when Jesus came, He found that he had already been in the tomb four days.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about ①fifteen stadia away; ▷ ①Possibly 2 miles or 3 km; a Roman stadion perhaps averaged 607 ft. or 185 m

column.name: text
column.value: and many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary, to console them about their brother.

column.name: text
column.value: So then Martha, when she heard that Jesus was coming, went to meet Him, but Mary ①stayed in the house. ▷ ①Lit was sitting

column.name: text
column.value: Martha then said to Jesus, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.

column.name: text
column.value: Even now I know that whatever You ask of God, God will give You.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *said to her, “Your brother will rise from the dead.”

column.name: text
column.value: Martha *said to Him, “I know that he will rise in the resurrection on the last day.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life; the one who believes in Me will live, even if he dies,

column.name: text
column.value: and everyone who lives and believes in Me will never die. Do you believe this?”

column.name: text
column.value: She *said to Him, “Yes, Lord; I have come to believe that You are the ①Christ, the Son of God, and ②He who comes into the world.” ▷ ①I.e., Messiah ②The Coming One was a Messianic title

column.name: text
column.value: When she had said this, she left and called Mary her sister, saying secretly, “The Teacher is here and is calling for you.”

column.name: text
column.value: And when she heard this, she *got up quickly and came to Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was still at the place where Martha met Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw that Mary had gotten up quickly and left, they followed her, thinking that she was going to the tomb to weep there.

column.name: text
column.value: So when Mary came to the place where Jesus was, she saw Him and fell at His feet, saying to Him, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore when Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who came with her also weeping, He was deeply moved in spirit and ①was troubled, ▷ ①Lit troubled Himself

column.name: text
column.value: and He said, “Where have you laid him?” They *said to Him, “Lord, come and see.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus wept.

column.name: text
column.value: So the Jews were saying, “See how He loved him!”

column.name: text
column.value: But some of them said, “Could this man, who opened the eyes of the man who was blind, not have also ①kept this man from dying?” ▷ ①Lit done so that this man also would not die

column.name: text
column.value: So Jesus, again being deeply moved within, *came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone was lying against it.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *said, “Remove the stone.” Martha, the sister of the deceased, *said to Him, “Lord, by this time ①there will be a stench, for he has been dead four days.” ▷ ①Lit he stinks

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *said to her, “Did I not say to you that if you believe, you will see the glory of God?”

column.name: text
column.value: So they removed the stone. And Jesus raised His eyes, and said, “Father, I thank You that You have heard Me.

column.name: text
column.value: But I knew that You always hear Me; nevertheless, because of the ①people standing around I said it, so that they may believe that You sent Me.” ▷ ①Lit crowd

column.name: text
column.value: And when He had said these things, He cried out with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

column.name: text
column.value: Out came the man who had died, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus *said to them, “Unbind him, and let him go.”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary, and saw what He had done, believed in Him.

column.name: text
column.value: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the chief priests and the Pharisees convened a council meeting, and they were saying, “What are we ①doing in regard to the fact that this man is performing many ②signs? ▷ ①Or doing? For this ②I.e., confirming miracles

column.name: text
column.value: If we let Him go on like this, all the people will believe in Him, and the Romans will come and take over both our ①place and our nation.” ▷ ①Possibly meaning the temple

column.name: text
column.value: But one of them, Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,

column.name: text
column.value: nor are you taking into account that it is in your best interest that one man die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish instead.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now he did not say this ①on his own, but as he was high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus was going to die for the nation; ▷ ①Lit from himself

column.name: text
column.value: and not for the nation only, but in order that He might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.

column.name: text
column.value: So from that day on they planned together to kill Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Jesus no longer continued to walk publicly among the Jews, but went away from there to the region near the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim; and there He stayed with the disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Passover of the Jews was near, and many went up to Jerusalem from the country prior to the Passover, in order to ①purify themselves. ▷ ①I.e., undergo required cleansing rituals

column.name: text
column.value: So they were looking for Jesus, and saying to one another as they stood in the temple area, “What do you think; that He will not come to the feast at all?”

column.name: text
column.value: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that if anyone knew where He was, he was to report it, so that they might arrest Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany where Lazarus was, whom Jesus had raised from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: So they made Him a dinner there, and Martha was serving; and Lazarus was one of those reclining at the table with Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Mary then took a ①pound of very expensive perfume of pure nard, and anointed the feet of Jesus and wiped His feet with her hair; and the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume. ▷ ①I.e., a Roman pound, about 12 oz. or 340 gm

column.name: text
column.value: But Judas Iscariot, one of His disciples, the one who intended to ①betray Him, *said, ▷ ①Or hand Him over

column.name: text
column.value: “Why was this perfume not sold for three hundred ①denarii and the proceeds given to poor people?” ▷ ①The denarius was a day’s wages for a laborer

column.name: text
column.value: Now he said this, not because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief, and as he kept the money box, he used to ①steal from what was put into it. ▷ ①Lit pilfer

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Jesus said, “Leave her alone, so that she may keep it ①for the day of My burial. ▷ ①Or in view of

column.name: text
column.value: For you always have the poor with you, but you do not always have Me.”

column.name: text
column.value: The large crowd of the Jews then learned that He was there; and they came, not on account of Jesus only, but so that they might also see Lazarus, whom He raised from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: But the chief priests planned to put Lazarus to death also,

column.name: text
column.value: because on account of him many of the Jews were going away and were believing in Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: On the next day, when the large crowd that had come to the feast heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

column.name: text
column.value: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet Him, and began shouting, “Hosanna! BLESSED IS HE WHO COMES IN THE NAME OF THE LORD, indeed, the King of Israel!”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus, finding a young donkey, sat on it; as it is written:

column.name: text
column.value: “DO NOT FEAR, DAUGHTER OF ZION; BEHOLD, YOUR KING IS COMING, SEATED ON A DONKEY’S COLT.”

column.name: text
column.value: These things His disciples did not understand at the first; but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written of Him, and that they had done these things for Him.

column.name: text
column.value: So the ①people, who were with Him when He called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead, continued to testify about Him. ▷ ①Lit crowd

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason also the ①people went to meet Him, because they heard that He had performed this ②sign. ▷ ①Lit crowd ②I.e., confirming miracle

column.name: text
column.value: So the Pharisees said ①to one another, “You see that you are not accomplishing anything; look, the world has gone after Him!” ▷ ①I.e., as one group to another

column.name: text
column.value: Now there were some Greeks among those who were going up to worship at the feast;

column.name: text
column.value: these people then came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and were making a request of him, saying, “Sir, we wish to see Jesus.”

column.name: text
column.value: Philip *came and *told Andrew; then Andrew and Philip *came and *told Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus *answered them by saying, “The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

column.name: text
column.value: Truly, truly I say to you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains alone; but if it dies, it bears much fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who loves his ①life loses it, and the one who hates his ②life in this world will keep it ③to eternal life. ▷ ①Lit soul ②Lit soul ③Or for

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone ①serves Me, he must follow Me; and where I am, there My servant will be also; if anyone ②serves Me, the Father will honor him. ▷ ①Or is serving ②Or is serving

column.name: text
column.value: “Now My soul has become troubled; and what am I to say? ‘Father, save Me from this hour’? But for this purpose I came to this hour.

column.name: text
column.value: Father, glorify Your name.” Then a voice came out of heaven: “I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.”

column.name: text
column.value: So the crowd who stood by and heard it were saying that it had thundered; others were saying, “An angel has spoken to Him!”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus responded and said, “This voice has not come for My sake, but for yours.

column.name: text
column.value: Now judgment is upon this world; now the ruler of this world will be cast out.

column.name: text
column.value: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to Myself.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now He was saying this to indicate what kind of death He was going to die.

column.name: text
column.value: The crowd then answered Him, “We have heard from the Law that the ①Christ is to remain forever; and how is it that You say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?” ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: So Jesus said to them, “For a little while longer the Light is among you. Walk while you have the Light, so that darkness will not overtake you; also, the one who walks in the darkness does not know where he is going.

column.name: text
column.value: While you have the Light, believe in the Light, so that you may become sons of Light.” These things Jesus proclaimed, and He went away and hid Himself from them.

column.name: text
column.value: But though He had performed so many ①signs in their sight, they still were not believing in Him. ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracles

column.name: text
column.value: This happened so that the word of Isaiah the prophet which he spoke would be fulfilled: “LORD, WHO HAS BELIEVED OUR REPORT? AND TO WHOM HAS THE ARM OF THE LORD BEEN REVEALED?”

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason they could not believe, for Isaiah said again,

column.name: text
column.value: “HE HAS BLINDED THEIR EYES AND HE HARDENED THEIR HEART, SO THAT THEY WILL NOT SEE WITH THEIR EYES AND UNDERSTAND WITH THEIR HEART, AND ①BE CONVERTED, AND so I WILL not heal them.” ▷ ①Lit be turned; i.e., turn about

column.name: text
column.value: These things Isaiah said because he saw His glory, and he spoke about Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless many, even of the rulers, believed in Him, but because of the Pharisees they were not confessing Him, so that they would not be excommunicated from the synagogue;

column.name: text
column.value: for they loved the ①approval of people rather than the ②approval of God. ▷ ①Or honor ②Or honor

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jesus cried out and said, “The one who believes in Me, does not believe only in Me, but also in Him who sent Me.

column.name: text
column.value: And the one who sees Me sees Him who sent Me.

column.name: text
column.value: I have come as Light into the world, so that no one who believes in Me will remain in darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone hears My ①teachings and does not keep them, I do not judge him; for I did not come to judge the world, but to save the world. ▷ ①Lit words

column.name: text
column.value: The one who rejects Me and does not ①accept My ②teachings has one who judges him: the word which I spoke. That will judge him on the last day. ▷ ①Or receive ②Lit words

column.name: text
column.value: For I did not speak ①on My own, but the Father Himself who sent Me has given Me a commandment as to what to say and what to speak. ▷ ①Lit from Myself

column.name: text
column.value: And I know that His commandment is eternal life; therefore the things I speak, I speak just as the Father has told Me.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now before the Feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that His hour had come that He would depart from this world to the Father, having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them ①to the end. ▷ ①Or to the uttermost; or eternally

column.name: text
column.value: And during supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon, to betray Him,

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus, knowing that the Father had handed all things over to Him, and that He had come forth from God and was going back to God,

column.name: text
column.value: *got up from supper and *laid His outer garments aside; and He took a towel and tied it around Himself.

column.name: text
column.value: Then He *poured water into the basin, and began washing the disciples’ feet and wiping them with the towel which He had tied around Himself.

column.name: text
column.value: So He *came to Simon Peter. He *said to Him, “Lord, You are washing my feet?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to him, “What I am doing, you do not realize right now, but you will understand later.”

column.name: text
column.value: Peter *said to Him, “Never shall You wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I do not wash you, you have no ①place with Me.” ▷ ①Or part

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter *said to Him, “Lord, then wash not only my feet, but also my hands and my head!”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *said to him, “He who has bathed needs only to wash his feet; otherwise he is completely clean. And you are clean—but ①not all of you.” ▷ ①I.e., not each one

column.name: text
column.value: For He knew the one who was betraying Him; it was for this reason that He said, “Not all of you are clean.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then, when He had washed their feet, and taken His garments and reclined at the table again, He said to them, “Do you know what I have done for you?

column.name: text
column.value: You call Me ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord’; and ①you are correct, for so I am. ▷ ①Lit you say well

column.name: text
column.value: So if I, the Lord and the Teacher, washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.

column.name: text
column.value: For I gave you an example, so that you also would do just as I did for you.

column.name: text
column.value: Truly, truly I say to you, a slave is not greater than his master, nor is ①one who is sent greater than the one who sent him. ▷ ①Gr apostolos used in a non-apostolic sense

column.name: text
column.value: If you know these things, you are blessed if you do them.

column.name: text
column.value: I am not speaking about all of you. I know the ones whom I have chosen; but this is happening so that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘HE WHO EATS MY BREAD HAS LIFTED UP HIS HEEL AGAINST ME.’

column.name: text
column.value: From now on I am telling you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you may believe that I am He.

column.name: text
column.value: Truly, truly I say to you, the one who ①receives anyone I send, ②receives Me; and the one who ③receives Me ④receives Him who sent Me.” ▷ ①Or accepts ②Or accepts ③Or accepts ④Or accepts

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus had said these things, He became troubled in spirit, and ①testified and said, “Truly, truly I say to you that one of you will ②betray Me.” ▷ ①I.e., made a solemn assertion ②Or hand Me over

column.name: text
column.value: The disciples began looking at one another, at a loss to know of which one He was speaking.

column.name: text
column.value: Lying back on Jesus’ chest was one of His disciples, whom Jesus loved.

column.name: text
column.value: So Simon Peter *nodded to this disciple and *said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom He is speaking.”

column.name: text
column.value: He then simply leaned back on Jesus’ chest and *said to Him, “Lord, who is it?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus then *answered, “That man is the one for whom I shall dip the piece of bread and give it to him.” So when He had dipped the piece of bread, He *took and *gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

column.name: text
column.value: After ①this, Satan then entered him. Therefore Jesus *said to him, “What you are doing, do it quickly.” ▷ ①Lit the piece

column.name: text
column.value: Now none of those reclining at the table knew for what purpose He had said this to him.

column.name: text
column.value: For some were assuming, since Judas kept the money box, that Jesus was saying to him, “Buy the things we need for the feast”; or else, that he was to ①give something to the poor. ▷ ①Considered especially fitting at Passover

column.name: text
column.value: So after receiving the piece of bread, he left immediately; and it was night.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore when he had left, Jesus *said, “Now ①is the Son of Man glorified, and God ②is glorified in Him; ▷ ①Or was ②Or was

column.name: text
column.value: ①if God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify Him in Himself, and will glorify Him immediately. ▷ ①Most early mss do not contain this phrase

column.name: text
column.value: Little children, I am still with you a little longer. You will look for Me; and just as I said to the ①Jews, now I also say to you: ‘Where I am going, you cannot come.’ ▷ ①I.e., Jesus’ Jewish enemies

column.name: text
column.value: I am giving you a new commandment, that you love one another; just as I have loved you, that you also love one another.

column.name: text
column.value: By this all people will know that you are My disciples: if you have love for one another.”

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter *said to Him, “Lord, where are You going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you cannot follow Me now; but you will follow later.”

column.name: text
column.value: Peter *said to Him, “Lord, why can I not follow You right now? I will lay down my life for You.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *replied, “Will you lay down your life for Me? Truly, truly I say to you, a rooster will not crow until you deny Me three times.

column.name: text
column.value: “I am the true vine, and My Father is the vinedresser.

column.name: text
column.value: Every branch in Me that does not bear fruit, He takes away; and every branch that bears fruit, He ①prunes it so that it may bear more fruit. ▷ ①Lit cleans; used to describe pruning

column.name: text
column.value: You are already ①clean because of the word which I have spoken to you. ▷ ①I.e., pruned like a branch

column.name: text
column.value: Remain in Me, ①and I in you. Just as the branch cannot bear fruit ②of itself ③but must remain in the vine, so neither can you unless you remain in Me. ▷ ①Or I also remain in you ②Lit from ③Lit if it does not remain

column.name: text
column.value: I am the vine, you are the branches; the one who remains in Me, and I in him ①bears much fruit, for apart from Me you can do nothing. ▷ ①Lit this one bears

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone does not remain in Me, he is thrown away like a branch and dries up; and they gather them and throw them into the fire, and they are burned.

column.name: text
column.value: If you remain in Me, and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.

column.name: text
column.value: My Father is glorified by this, that you bear much fruit, and so ①prove to be My disciples. ▷ ①Or become My disciples

column.name: text
column.value: Just as the Father has loved Me, I also have loved you; remain in My love.

column.name: text
column.value: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love; just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love.

column.name: text
column.value: These things I have spoken to you so that My joy may be in you, and that your joy may be made full.

column.name: text
column.value: “This is My commandment, that you love one another, just as I have loved you.

column.name: text
column.value: Greater love has no one than this, that a person will lay down his life for his friends.

column.name: text
column.value: You are My friends if you do what I command you.

column.name: text
column.value: No longer do I call you slaves, for the slave does not know what his master is doing; but I have called you friends, because all things that I have heard from My Father I have made known to you.

column.name: text
column.value: You did not choose Me but I chose you, and appointed you that you would go and bear fruit, and that your fruit would remain, so that whatever you ask of the Father in My name He may give to you.

column.name: text
column.value: This I command you, that you love one another.

column.name: text
column.value: “If the world hates you, ①you know that it has hated Me before it hated you. ▷ ①Or (command) know that

column.name: text
column.value: If you were of the world, the world would love you as its own; but because you are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, because of this the world hates you.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember the word that I said to you, ‘A slave is not greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will persecute you as well; if they followed My word, they will follow yours also.

column.name: text
column.value: But all these things they will do to you on account of My name, because they do not know the One who sent Me.

column.name: text
column.value: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have ①sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin. ▷ ①I.e., guilt

column.name: text
column.value: The one who hates Me hates My Father also.

column.name: text
column.value: If I had not done among them the works which no one else did, they would not have ①sin; but now they have both seen and hated Me and My Father as well. ▷ ①I.e., responsibility for their sin

column.name: text
column.value: But this has happened so that the word that is written in their Law will be fulfilled: ‘THEY HATED ME FOR NO REASON.’

column.name: text
column.value: “When the ①Helper comes, whom I will send to you from the Father, namely, the Spirit of truth who comes from the Father, He will testify about Me, ▷ ①Or Comforter, Advocate, Intercessor

column.name: text
column.value: and ①you are testifying as well, because you have been with Me from the beginning. ▷ ①Or (command) testify, you as well

column.name: text
column.value: “These things I have spoken to you so that you will not ①be led into sin. ▷ ①Or let yourselves be led; or fall away (in apostasy)

column.name: text
column.value: They will ①ban you from the synagogue, yet an hour is coming for everyone who kills you to think that he is offering a ②service to God. ▷ ①Or excommunicate ②I.e., as an act of worship

column.name: text
column.value: These things they will do because they have not known the Father nor Me.

column.name: text
column.value: But these things I have spoken to you, so that when their hour comes, you ①may remember that I told you of them. However, I did not say these things to you at the beginning, because I was with you. ▷ ①Or will remember them, that I told you

column.name: text
column.value: “But now I am going to Him who sent Me; and none of you asks Me, ‘Where are You going?’

column.name: text
column.value: But because I have said these things to you, grief has filled your heart.

column.name: text
column.value: But I tell you the truth: it is to your advantage that I am leaving; for if I do not leave, the ①Helper will not come to you; but if I go, I will send Him to you. ▷ ①Or Comforter, Advocate, Intercessor

column.name: text
column.value: And He, when He comes, will convict the world regarding sin, and righteousness, and judgment:

column.name: text
column.value: regarding sin, because they do not believe in Me;

column.name: text
column.value: and regarding righteousness, because I am going to the Father and you no longer are going to see Me;

column.name: text
column.value: and regarding judgment, because the ruler of this world has been judged.

column.name: text
column.value: “I have many more things to say to you, but you cannot bear them at the present time.

column.name: text
column.value: But when He, the Spirit of truth, comes, He will guide you into all the truth; for He will not speak on His own, but whatever He hears, He will speak; and He will disclose to you what is to come.

column.name: text
column.value: He will glorify Me, for He will take from Mine and will disclose it to you.

column.name: text
column.value: All things that the Father has are Mine; this is why I said that He takes from Mine and will disclose it to you.

column.name: text
column.value: “A little while, and you no longer are going to see Me; and again a little while, and you will see Me.”

column.name: text
column.value: So some of His disciples said to one another, “What is this that He is telling us, ‘A little while, and you are not going to see Me; and again a little while, and you will see Me’; and, ‘because I am going to the Father’?”

column.name: text
column.value: So they were saying, “What is this that He says, ‘A little while’? We do not know what He is talking about.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus knew that they wanted to question Him, and He said to them, “Are you deliberating together about this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you are not going to see Me, and again a little while, and you will see Me’?

column.name: text
column.value: Truly, truly I say to you that you will weep and mourn, but the world will rejoice; you will grieve, but your grief will be turned into joy!

column.name: text
column.value: Whenever a woman is in labor she has ①pain, because her hour has come; but when she gives birth to the child, she no longer remembers the anguish because of the joy that a ②child has been born into the world. ▷ ①Lit grief ②Lit human being

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore you too have grief now; but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one is going to take your joy away from you.

column.name: text
column.value: And on that day you will not question Me about anything. Truly, truly I say to you, if you ask the Father for anything in My name, He will give it to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Until now you have asked for nothing in My name; ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be made full.

column.name: text
column.value: “These things I have spoken to you in figures of speech; an hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day you will ask in My name, and I am not saying to you that I will request of the Father on your behalf;

column.name: text
column.value: for the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came forth from the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: I came forth from the Father and have come into the world; again, I am leaving the world and going to the Father.”

column.name: text
column.value: His disciples *said, “See, now You are speaking plainly and are not ①using any figure of speech. ▷ ①Lit saying

column.name: text
column.value: Now we know that You know all things, and that You have no need for anyone to question You; this is why we believe that You came forth from God.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus replied to them, “Do you now believe?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, an hour is coming, and has already come, for you to be scattered, each to his own home, and to leave Me alone; and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.

column.name: text
column.value: These things I have spoken to you so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you have tribulation, but take courage; I have overcome the world.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus spoke these things; and raising His eyes to heaven, He said, “Father, the hour has come; glorify Your Son, so that the Son may glorify You,

column.name: text
column.value: just as You gave Him authority over all ①mankind, so that ②to all whom You have given Him, He may give eternal life. ▷ ①Lit flesh ②Lit everything that You have given Him, to them He may

column.name: text
column.value: And this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom You have sent.

column.name: text
column.value: I glorified You on the earth ①by accomplishing the work which You have given Me to do. ▷ ①Or having accomplished

column.name: text
column.value: And now You, Father, glorify Me together with Yourself, with the glory which I had with You before the world existed.

column.name: text
column.value: “I have revealed Your name to the men whom You gave Me out of the world; they were Yours and You gave them to Me, and they have followed Your word.

column.name: text
column.value: Now they have come to know that everything which You have given Me is from You;

column.name: text
column.value: for the words which You gave Me I have given to them; and they received them and truly understood that I came forth from You, and they believed that You sent Me.

column.name: text
column.value: I ask on their behalf; I do not ask on behalf of the world, but on the behalf of those whom You have given Me, because they are Yours;

column.name: text
column.value: and all things that are Mine are Yours, and Yours are Mine; and I have been glorified in them.

column.name: text
column.value: I am no longer going to be in the world; and yet they themselves are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, keep them in Your name, the name which You have given Me, so that they may be one just as We are.

column.name: text
column.value: While I was with them, I was keeping them in Your name, which You have given Me; and I guarded them, and not one of them perished except the ①son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled. ▷ ①Heb idiom for one destined to perish

column.name: text
column.value: But now I am coming to You; and these things I speak in the world so that they may have My joy made full in themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: I have given them Your word; and the world has hated them because they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: I am not asking You to take them out of the world, but to keep them away from ①the evil one. ▷ ①Or evil

column.name: text
column.value: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: Sanctify them in the truth; Your word is truth.

column.name: text
column.value: Just as You sent Me into the world, I also sent them into the world.

column.name: text
column.value: And for their sakes I sanctify Myself, so that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

column.name: text
column.value: “I am not asking on behalf of these alone, but also for those who believe in Me through their word,

column.name: text
column.value: that they may all be one; just as You, Father, are in Me and I in You, that they also may be in Us, so that the world may ①believe that You sent Me. ▷ ①Gr tense indicates continually believe

column.name: text
column.value: The glory which You have given Me I also have given to them, so that they may be one, just as We are one;

column.name: text
column.value: I in them and You in Me, that they may be perfected ①in unity, so that the world may ②know that You sent Me, and You loved them, just as You loved Me. ▷ ①Lit into one ②Gr tense indicates continually know

column.name: text
column.value: Father, I desire that they also, whom You have given Me, be with Me where I am, so that they may see My glory which You have given Me, for You loved Me before the foundation of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: “Righteous Father, ①although the world has not known You, yet I have known You; and these have known that You sent Me; ▷ ①Lit even the world

column.name: text
column.value: and I have made Your name known to them, and will make it known, so that the love with which You loved Me may be in them, and I in them.”

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus had spoken these words, He went away with His disciples across the ①ravine of the Kidron, where there was a garden which He entered ②with His disciples. ▷ ①Lit winter torrent; or wadi ②Lit and

column.name: text
column.value: Now Judas, who was ①betraying Him, also knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with His disciples. ▷ ①Or handing Him over

column.name: text
column.value: So Judas, having obtained the Roman ①cohort and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, *came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons. ▷ ①Normally 600 men (the number varied)

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were coming upon Him, came out into the open and *said to them, “Whom are you seeking?”

column.name: text
column.value: They answered Him, “Jesus the Nazarene.” He *said to them, “I am He.” And Judas also, who was betraying Him, was standing with them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, when He said to them, “I am He,” they drew back and fell to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: He then asked them again, “Whom are you seeking?” And they said, “Jesus the Nazarene.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am He; so if you are seeking Me, let these men go on their way.”

column.name: text
column.value: This took place so that the word which He spoke would be fulfilled: “Of those whom You have given Me I lost not one.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Simon Peter, since he had a sword, drew it and struck the high priest’s slave, and cut off his right ear; and the slave’s name was Malchus.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jesus said to Peter, “Put the sword into the sheath; the cup which the Father has given Me, am I not to drink it?”

column.name: text
column.value: So the Roman ①cohort, the ②commander, and the officers of the Jews arrested Jesus and bound Him, ▷ ①Normally 600 men (the number varied) ②I.e., commander of the cohort

column.name: text
column.value: and brought Him to Annas first; for he was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it was in their best interest for one man to die in behalf of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter was following Jesus, and so was another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and he entered with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest,

column.name: text
column.value: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to the doorkeeper, and brought Peter in.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the slave woman who was the doorkeeper *said to Peter, “You are not also one of this Man’s disciples, are you?” He *said, “I am not.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now the slaves and the officers were standing there, having made a charcoal fire, for it was cold and they were warming themselves; and Peter was also with them, standing and warming himself.

column.name: text
column.value: The high priest then questioned Jesus about His disciples, and about His teaching.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered him, “I have spoken openly to the world; I always taught in ①synagogues and in the temple area, where all the Jews congregate; and I said nothing in secret. ▷ ①Lit a synagogue

column.name: text
column.value: Why are you asking Me? Ask those who have heard what I spoke to them. Look: these people know what I said.”

column.name: text
column.value: But when He said this, one of the officers, who was standing nearby, struck Jesus, saying, “Is that the way You answer the high priest?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken wrongly, testify of the wrong; but if rightly, why do you strike Me?”

column.name: text
column.value: So Annas sent Him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Simon Peter was still standing and warming himself. So they said to him, “You are not one of His disciples as well, are you?” He denied it, and said, “I am not.”

column.name: text
column.value: One of the slaves of the high priest, who was related to the one whose ear Peter cut off, *said, “Did I not see you in the garden with Him?”

column.name: text
column.value: Peter then denied it again, and immediately a rooster crowed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they *brought Jesus from Caiaphas into the ①Praetorium, and it was early; and they themselves did not enter the ②Praetorium, so that they would not be defiled, but might eat the Passover. ▷ ①I.e., governor’s official residence ②I.e., governor’s official residence

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Pilate came out to them and *said, “What accusation are you bringing against this Man?”

column.name: text
column.value: They answered and said to him, “If this Man were not ①a criminal, we would not have handed Him over to you.” ▷ ①Lit one doing evil

column.name: text
column.value: So Pilate said to them, “Take Him yourselves, and judge Him according to your law.” The Jews said to him, “We are not ①permitted to put anyone to death.” ▷ ①I.e., under Roman law

column.name: text
column.value: This happened so that the word of Jesus which He said, indicating what kind of death He was going to die, would be fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Pilate entered the Praetorium again, and summoned Jesus and said to Him, “You are the King of the Jews?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, “Are you saying this ①on your own, or did others tell you about Me?” ▷ ①Lit from yourself

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate answered, “I am not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests handed You over to me; what have You done?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, “My kingdom is not of this world. If My kingdom were of this world, My servants would be fighting so that I would not be handed over to the Jews; but as it is, My kingdom is not ①of this realm.” ▷ ①Lit from here

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Pilate said to Him, “So You are a king?” Jesus answered, “You say correctly that I am a king. For this purpose I have been born, and for this I have come into the world: to testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to My voice.”

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate *said to Him, “What is truth?” And after saying this, he came out again to the Jews and *said to them, “I find no grounds at all for charges in ①His case. ▷ ①Lit Him

column.name: text
column.value: However, you have a custom that I release one prisoner ①for you at the Passover; therefore do you wish that I release ②for you the King of the Jews?” ▷ ①Or to you ②Or to you

column.name: text
column.value: So they shouted again, saying, “Not this Man, but Barabbas.” Now Barabbas was a rebel.

column.name: text
column.value: So Pilate then took Jesus and ①had Him flogged. ▷ ①Lit flogged Him

column.name: text
column.value: And the soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns and placed it on His head, and put a purple ①cloak on Him; ▷ ①I.e., a Roman soldier’s cloak

column.name: text
column.value: and they repeatedly came up to Him and said, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and slapped Him in the face again and again.

column.name: text
column.value: And then Pilate came out again and *said to them, “See, I am bringing Him out to you so that you will know that I find no grounds at all for charges in ①His case.” ▷ ①Lit Him

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus then came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. And Pilate *said to them, “Behold, the Man!”

column.name: text
column.value: So when the chief priests and the officers saw Him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify, crucify!” Pilate *said to them, “Take Him yourselves and crucify Him; for I find no grounds for charges in ①His case!” ▷ ①Lit Him

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by that law He ought to die, because He made Himself out to be the Son of God!”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore when Pilate heard this statement, he was even more afraid;

column.name: text
column.value: and he entered the ①Praetorium again and *said to Jesus, “Where are You from?” But Jesus gave him no answer. ▷ ①I.e., governor’s official residence

column.name: text
column.value: So Pilate *said to Him, “Are you not speaking to me? Do You not know that I have authority to release You, and I have authority to crucify You?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered him, “You would have no authority ①over Me at all, if it had not been given to you from above; for this reason the one who handed Me over to you has the greater sin.” ▷ ①Lit against

column.name: text
column.value: As a result of this, Pilate ①made efforts to release Him; but the Jews shouted, saying, “If you release this Man, you are not a friend of Caesar; everyone who makes himself out to be a king ②opposes Caesar!” ▷ ①Lit was seeking to ②Or speaks against

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore when Pilate heard these words, he brought Jesus out, and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called ①The Pavement—but in ②Hebrew, Gabbatha. ▷ ①Gr Lithostrotos ②I.e., Jewish Aramaic

column.name: text
column.value: Now it was the day of preparation for the Passover; it was about the ①sixth hour. And he *said to the Jews, “Look, your King!” ▷ ①I.e., about noon

column.name: text
column.value: So they shouted, “Away with Him, away with Him, crucify Him!” Pilate *said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king except Caesar.”

column.name: text
column.value: So he then handed Him over to them to be crucified.

column.name: text
column.value: They took Jesus, therefore, and He went out, ①carrying His own cross, to the place called the Place of a Skull, which in ②Hebrew is called, Golgotha. ▷ ①Or carrying the cross by Himself ②I.e., Jewish Aramaic

column.name: text
column.value: There they crucified Him, and with Him two other men, one on either side, and Jesus in between.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Pilate also wrote an inscription and put it on the cross. It was written: “JESUS THE NAZARENE, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore many of the Jews read this inscription, because the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in ①Hebrew, Latin, and in Greek. ▷ ①I.e., Jewish Aramaic

column.name: text
column.value: So the chief priests of the Jews were saying to Pilate, “Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews’; rather, write that He said, ‘I am King of the Jews.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took His outer garments and made four parts: a part to each soldier, and the ①tunic also; but the tunic was seamless, woven ②in one piece. ▷ ①A long shirt worn next to the skin ②Lit from the upper part through the whole

column.name: text
column.value: So they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it, to decide whose it shall be.” This happened so that the Scripture would be fulfilled: “THEY DIVIDED MY GARMENTS AMONG THEMSELVES, AND THEY CAST ①LOTS FOR MY CLOTHING.” Therefore the soldiers did these things. ▷ ①Lit a lot

column.name: text
column.value: Now beside the cross of Jesus stood His mother, His mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

column.name: text
column.value: So when Jesus saw His mother, and the disciple whom He loved standing nearby, He *said to His mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”

column.name: text
column.value: Then He *said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” And from that hour the disciple took her into his own household.

column.name: text
column.value: After this, Jesus, knowing that all things had already been accomplished, in order that the Scripture would be fulfilled, *said, “I am thirsty.”

column.name: text
column.value: A jar full of sour wine was standing there; so they put a sponge full of the sour wine on a branch of hyssop and brought it up to His mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore when Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, “It is finished!” And He bowed His head and gave up His spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, since it was the day of preparation, to prevent the bodies from remaining on the cross on the Sabbath ( ①for that Sabbath was a high day), the Jews requested of Pilate that their legs be broken, and the bodies be taken away. ▷ ①Lit for the day of that Sabbath was great

column.name: text
column.value: So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first man, and of the other who was crucified with Him;

column.name: text
column.value: but after they came to Jesus, when they saw that He was already dead, they did not break His legs.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.

column.name: text
column.value: And he who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true; and he knows that he is telling the truth, so that you also may believe.

column.name: text
column.value: For these things took place so that the Scripture would be fulfilled: “NOT A BONE OF HIM SHALL BE ①BROKEN.” ▷ ①Or crushed; or shattered

column.name: text
column.value: And again another Scripture says, “THEY WILL LOOK AT HIM WHOM THEY PIERCED.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now after these things Joseph of Arimathea, being a disciple of Jesus, but a secret one for fear of the ①Jews, requested of Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus; and Pilate granted permission. So he came and took away His body. ▷ ①I.e., the Jewish leaders

column.name: text
column.value: Nicodemus, who had first come to Him by night, also came, bringing a ①mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a ②hundred litras weight. ▷ ①Two early mss package of ②I.e., Roman libras (about 75 lb. or 34 kg)

column.name: text
column.value: So they took the body of Jesus and bound it in linen wrappings with the spices, as is the burial custom of the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the place where He was crucified there was a garden, and in the garden was a new tomb in which no one had yet been laid.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore because of the Jewish day of preparation, since the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus there.

column.name: text
column.value: After these things Jesus ①revealed Himself again to the disciples at the Sea of Tiberias, and He revealed Himself in this way: ▷ ①Or made Himself visible

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter, Thomas who was called ①Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two others of His disciples were together. ▷ ①I.e., the Twin

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter *said to them, “I am going fishing.” They *said to him, “We are also coming with you.” They went out and got into the boat; and that night they caught nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the day was now breaking, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples did not know that it was Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jesus *said to them, “Children, you do not have any fish to eat, do you?” They answered Him, “No.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He said to them, “Cast the net on the right-hand side of the boat, and you will find the fish.” So they cast it, and then they were not able to haul it in because of the great quantity of fish.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved *said to Peter, “It is the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his outer garment (for he was stripped for work), and threw himself into the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: But the other disciples came in the little boat, for they were not far from the land, but about ①two hundred cubits away, dragging the net full of fish. ▷ ①About 100 yd. or 90 m; a cubit is about 18 in. or 45 cm

column.name: text
column.value: So when they got out on the land, they *saw a charcoal fire already ①made and fish placed on it, and bread. ▷ ①Lit laid

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have now caught.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Simon Peter went up and hauled the net to land, full of large fish, 153; and although there were so many, the net was not torn.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *said to them, “Come and have breakfast.” None of the disciples ventured to inquire of Him, “Who are You?” knowing that it was the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *came and *took the bread and *gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

column.name: text
column.value: This was now the third time that Jesus revealed Himself to the disciples, after He was raised from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when they had finished breakfast, Jesus *said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of John, do you ①love Me more than these?” He *said to Him, “Yes, Lord; You know that I ②love You.” He *said to him, “Tend My lambs.” ▷ ①Gr agapao ②Gr phileo

column.name: text
column.value: He *said to him again, a second time, “Simon, son of John, do you ①love Me?” He *said to Him, “Yes, Lord; You know that I ②love You.” He *said to him, “Shepherd My sheep.” ▷ ①Gr agapao ②Gr phileo

column.name: text
column.value: He *said to him the third time, “Simon, son of John, do you ①love Me?” Peter was ②hurt because He said to him the third time, “Do you ③love Me?” And he said to Him, “Lord, You know all things; You know that I ④love You.” Jesus *said to him, “Tend My sheep. ▷ ①Gr phileo ②Or distressed ③Gr phileo ④Gr phileo

column.name: text
column.value: Truly, truly I tell you, when you were younger, you used to put on your belt and walk wherever you wanted; but when you grow old, you will stretch out your hands and someone else will put your belt on you, and bring you where you do not want to go.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now He said this, indicating by what kind of death he would glorify God. And when He had said this, He *said to him, “Follow Me!”

column.name: text
column.value: Peter turned around and *saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following them—the one who also had leaned back on His chest at the supper and said, “Lord, who is the one who is betraying You?”

column.name: text
column.value: So Peter, upon seeing him, *said to Jesus, “Lord, and what about this man?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *said to him, “If I want him to remain until I come, what is that to you? You follow Me!”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this ①account went out among the brothers, that that disciple would not die; yet Jesus did not say to him that he would not die, but only, “If I want him to remain until I come, what is that to you?” ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: This is the disciple who is testifying about these things and wrote these things, and we know that his testimony is true.

column.name: text
column.value: But there are also many other things which Jesus did, which, if they were written in detail, I expect that even the world itself would not contain the books that would be written.

column.name: text
column.value: The first account I ①composed, Theophilus, about all that Jesus began to do and teach, ▷ ①Lit made

column.name: text
column.value: until the day when He was taken up to heaven, after He had given orders ①by the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom He had chosen. ▷ ①Or through

column.name: text
column.value: To ①these He also presented Himself alive after His suffering, by many convincing proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking of things regarding the kingdom of God. ▷ ①Lit whom

column.name: text
column.value: ①Gathering them together, He commanded them not to leave Jerusalem, but to wait for ②what the Father had promised, “Which,” He said, “you heard of from Me; ▷ ①Or eating with; or lodging with ②Lit the promise of the Father

column.name: text
column.value: for John baptized ①with water, but you will be baptized ②with the Holy Spirit ③not many days from now.” ▷ ①Or in ②Or in ③Lit not long after these many days

column.name: text
column.value: So, when they had come together, they began asking Him, saying, “Lord, is it at this time that You are restoring the kingdom to Israel?”

column.name: text
column.value: But He said to them, “It is not for you to know periods of time or appointed times which the Father has set by His own authority;

column.name: text
column.value: but you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you; and you shall be My witnesses both in Jerusalem and in all Judea, and Samaria, and as far as the remotest part of the earth.”

column.name: text
column.value: And after He had said these things, He was lifted up while they were watching, and a cloud took Him up, out of their sight.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they were gazing intently into the sky while He was going, then behold, two men in white clothing stood beside them,

column.name: text
column.value: and they said, “Men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who has been taken up from you into heaven, will come in the same way as you have watched Him go into heaven.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the ①mountain called ②Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a ③Sabbath day’s journey away. ▷ ①Or Olive Grove ②2,000 cubits, or about 0.6 miles or 1 km ③Or hill

column.name: text
column.value: When they had entered the city, they went up to the upstairs room where they were staying, that is, Peter, John, ①James, and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, ②James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the ③son of ④James. ▷ ①Or Jacob ②Or Jacob ③Or brother ④Or Jacob

column.name: text
column.value: All these were continually devoting themselves with one ①mind to prayer, along with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with His brothers. ▷ ①Or purpose

column.name: text
column.value: ①At this time Peter stood up among the brothers and sisters (a group of about 120 ②people was there together), and said, ▷ ①Lit In these days ②Lit names

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①Brothers, the Scripture had to be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit foretold by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who became a guide to those who arrested Jesus. ▷ ①Lit Men, brothers

column.name: text
column.value: For he was counted among us and received his share in this ministry.”

column.name: text
column.value: (Now this man acquired a field with the price of his wickedness, and falling headlong, he burst open in the middle and all his intestines gushed out.

column.name: text
column.value: And it became known to all the residents of Jerusalem; as a result that field was called Hakeldama in their own language, that is, Field of Blood.)

column.name: text
column.value: “For it is written in the book of Psalms: ‘MAY HIS RESIDENCE BE MADE DESOLATE, AND MAY THERE BE NONE LIVING IN IT’; and, ‘MAY ANOTHER TAKE HIS ①OFFICE.’ ▷ ①Lit position of oversight

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore it is necessary that of the men who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out ①among us— ▷ ①Lit to us

column.name: text
column.value: beginning ①with the baptism of John until the day that He was taken up from us—one of these must become a witness with us of His resurrection.” ▷ ①Lit from

column.name: text
column.value: So they put forward two men, Joseph called Barsabbas (who was also called Justus), and Matthias.

column.name: text
column.value: And they prayed and said, “You, Lord, who know the hearts of all people, show which one of these two You have chosen

column.name: text
column.value: to ①occupy this ministry and apostleship from which Judas turned aside to go to his own place.” ▷ ①Lit take the place of

column.name: text
column.value: And they ①drew lots for them, and the lot fell ②to Matthias; and he was added to the eleven apostles. ▷ ①Lit gave ②Or upon

column.name: text
column.value: “Do not let your heart be troubled; ①believe in God, believe also in Me. ▷ ①Or you believe in God, believe also

column.name: text
column.value: In My Father’s house are many ①rooms; if that were not so, ②I would have told you, because I am going there to prepare a place for you. ▷ ①Or dwelling places ②Or would I have told you that I am going...?

column.name: text
column.value: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I am coming again and will take you to Myself, so that where I am, there you also will be.

column.name: text
column.value: And you know the way where I am going.”

column.name: text
column.value: Thomas *said to Him, “Lord, we do not know where You are going; how do we know the way?”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *said to him, “I am the way, and the truth, and the life; no one comes to the Father except through Me.

column.name: text
column.value: If you ①had known Me, you would have known My Father also; from now on you know Him, and have seen Him.” ▷ ①Two early mss have come to know...you will know

column.name: text
column.value: Philip *said to Him, “Lord, show us the Father, and it is enough for us.”

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus *said to him, “Have I been with ①you for so long a time, and yet ②you have not come to know Me, Philip? The one who has seen Me has seen the Father; how can you say, ‘Show us the Father’? ▷ ①I.e., you plural, the disciples ②I.e., you singular, Philip

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not believe that I am in the Father, and the Father is in Me? The words that I say to you I do not speak on My own, but the Father, as He remains in Me, does His works.

column.name: text
column.value: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me; otherwise believe because of the works themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Truly, truly I say to you, the one who believes in Me, the works that I do, he will do also; and greater works than these he will do; because I am going to the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever you ask in My name, this I will do, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

column.name: text
column.value: If you ask Me anything in My name, I will do it.

column.name: text
column.value: “If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.

column.name: text
column.value: I will ask the Father, and He will give you another ①Helper, so that He may be with you forever; ▷ ①Or Comforter, Advocate, Intercessor

column.name: text
column.value: the Helper is the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it does not see Him or know Him; but you know Him because He remains with you and will be in you.

column.name: text
column.value: “I will not leave you as orphans; I am coming to you.

column.name: text
column.value: ①After a little while, the world no longer is going to see Me, but you are going to see Me; because I live, you also will live. ▷ ①Lit Yet a little and the world

column.name: text
column.value: On that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you are in Me, and I in you.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me; and the one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and will reveal Myself to him.”

column.name: text

column.value: And Peter responded to her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for ①this price?” And she said, “Yes, for ②that price.” ▷ ①Lit so much ②Lit so much

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter said to her, “Why is it that you have agreed together to put the Spirit of the Lord to the test? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out as well.”

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately she collapsed at his feet and ①died; and the young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her beside her husband. ▷ ①Lit expired

column.name: text
column.value: And great fear came over the whole church, and over all who heard about these things.

column.name: text
column.value: ①At the hands of the apostles many ②signs and wonders were taking place among the people; and they were all ③together in Solomon’s ④portico. ▷ ①Lit Through ②I.e., confirming miracles ③Or of one mind ④Or colonnade

column.name: text
column.value: But none of the rest dared to associate with them; however, the people held them in high esteem.

column.name: text
column.value: And increasingly believers in the Lord, large numbers of men and women, were being added to their number,

column.name: text
column.value: to such an extent that they even carried the sick out into the streets and laid them on cots and pallets, so that when Peter came by at least his shadow might fall on any of them.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①people from the cities in the vicinity of Jerusalem were coming together as well, bringing people who were sick ②or tormented with unclean spirits, and they were all being healed. ▷ ①Lit multitude ②Lit and

column.name: text
column.value: But the high priest stood up, along with all his associates (that is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy.

column.name: text
column.value: They laid hands on the apostles and put them in a public prison.

column.name: text
column.value: But during the night an angel of the Lord opened the gates of the prison, and leading them out, he said,

column.name: text
column.value: “Go, stand and ①speak to the people in the temple area ②the whole message of this Life.” ▷ ①Or continue to speak ②Lit all the words

column.name: text
column.value: Upon hearing this, they entered into the temple area about daybreak and began to teach. Now when the high priest and his associates came, they called the ①Council together, that is, all the Senate of the sons of Israel, and sent orders to the prison for them to be brought. ▷ ①Or Sanhedrin

column.name: text
column.value: But the officers who came did not find them in the prison; and they returned and reported,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “We found the prison locked quite securely and the guards standing at the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the captain of the temple guard and the chief priests heard these words, they were greatly perplexed about them as to what ①would come of this. ▷ ①Lit this would become

column.name: text
column.value: But someone came and reported to them, “The men whom you put in prison are standing in the temple area and teaching the people!”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the captain went along with the officers and proceeded to bring them back without violence (for they were afraid of the people, that they might be stoned).

column.name: text
column.value: When they had brought them, they had them stand ①before the Council. The high priest interrogated them, ▷ ①Lit among

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “We gave you strict orders not to continue teaching in this name, and ①yet, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and intend to bring this Man’s blood upon us.” ▷ ①Lit behold

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.

column.name: text
column.value: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you put to death by hanging Him on ①a cross. ▷ ①Lit wood; see Deut

column.name: text
column.value: He is the one whom God exalted ①to His right hand as a ②Prince and a Savior, to grant repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins. ▷ ①Or by ②Or Leader

column.name: text
column.value: And we are witnesses ①of these things; and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey Him.” ▷ ①One early ms adds in Him

column.name: text
column.value: But when they heard this, they became infuriated and nearly decided to execute them.

column.name: text
column.value: But a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the Law, respected by all the people, stood up in the Council and gave orders to put the men outside for a short time.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, “Men of Israel, be careful as to what you are about to do with these men.

column.name: text
column.value: For, some time ago Theudas appeared, claiming to be somebody, and a group of about four hundred men joined him. ①But he was killed, and all who followed him were dispersed and came to nothing. ▷ ①Lit Who was killed

column.name: text
column.value: After this man, Judas of Galilee appeared in the days of the census and drew away some people after him; he also perished, and all those who followed him were scattered.

column.name: text
column.value: And so in the present case, I say to you, stay away from these men and leave them alone, for if the source of this plan or ①movement is men, it will be overthrown; ▷ ①Lit work

column.name: text
column.value: but if the source is God, you will not be able to overthrow them; or else you may even be found fighting against God.”

column.name: text
column.value: They followed his advice; and after calling the apostles in, they flogged them and ordered them not to ①speak in the name of Jesus, and then released them. ▷ ①Lit be speaking

column.name: text
column.value: So they went on their way from the presence of the ①Council, rejoicing that they had been considered worthy to suffer shame for His name. ▷ ①Or Sanhedrin

column.name: text
column.value: And every day, in the temple and ①from house to house, they did not stop teaching and preaching the good news of Jesus as the ②Christ. ▷ ①Or in the various private homes ②I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: Now Saul approved of putting ①Stephen to death. And on that day a great persecution ②began against the church in Jerusalem, and they were all scattered throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles. ▷ ①Lit him ②Lit occurred

column.name: text
column.value: Some devout men buried Stephen, and mourned loudly for him.

column.name: text
column.value: But Saul began ravaging the church, entering house after house; and he would drag away men and women and put them in prison.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, those who had been scattered went through places ①preaching the word. ▷ ①Or bringing the good news of

column.name: text
column.value: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and began proclaiming the ①Christ to them. ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: The crowds were paying attention with one mind to what was being said by Philip, as they heard and saw the ①signs which he was performing. ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracles

column.name: text
column.value: For in the case of many who had unclean spirits, they were coming out of them shouting with a loud voice; and many who had been paralyzed or limped on crutches were healed.

column.name: text
column.value: So there was much rejoicing in that city.

column.name: text
column.value: Now a man named Simon had previously been practicing magic in the city and astonishing the people of Samaria, claiming to be someone great;

column.name: text
column.value: and all the people, from small to great, were paying attention to him, saying, “This man is the Power of God that is called Great.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they were paying attention to him because for a long time he had astounded them with his magic arts.

column.name: text
column.value: But when they believed Philip as he was preaching the good news about the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, both men and women were being baptized.

column.name: text
column.value: Now even Simon himself believed; and after being baptized, he continued on with Philip, and as he observed signs and great miracles taking place, he was repeatedly amazed.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent them Peter and John,

column.name: text
column.value: who came down and prayed for them that they would receive the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: (For He had not yet fallen upon any of them; they had simply been baptized ①in the name of the Lord Jesus.) ▷ ①Lit into

column.name: text
column.value: Then they began laying their hands on them, and they were receiving the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Simon saw that the Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “Give this authority to me as well, so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could acquire the gift of God with money!

column.name: text
column.value: You have no part or share in this ①matter, for your heart is not right before God. ▷ ①Or teaching; lit word

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, repent of this wickedness of yours, and pray to the Lord that, if possible, the intention of your heart will be forgiven you.

column.name: text
column.value: For I see that you are ①in the gall of bitterness and in the ②bondage of unrighteousness.” ▷ ①Or doomed to the ②Lit bond

column.name: text
column.value: But Simon answered and said, “Pray to the Lord for me yourselves, so that nothing of what you have said may come upon me.”

column.name: text
column.value: So, when they had solemnly testified and spoken the word of the Lord, they started back to Jerusalem, and were preaching the gospel to many villages of the Samaritans.

column.name: text
column.value: But an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Get ready and go ①south to the road that descends from Jerusalem to Gaza.” ( ②This is a desert road.) ▷ ①Or at about noon to ②Or This city is deserted

column.name: text
column.value: So he got ready and went; and ①there was an Ethiopian eunuch, a court official of ②Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was in charge of all her treasure; and he had come to Jerusalem to worship, ▷ ①Lit behold, an Ethiopian ②Possibly an Ethiopian title: the Candace

column.name: text
column.value: and he was returning and sitting in his ①chariot, and was reading Isaiah the prophet. ▷ ①Or carriage

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Spirit said to Philip, “Go up and join this ①chariot.” ▷ ①Or carriage

column.name: text
column.value: Philip ran up and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, “Well, how could I, unless someone guides me?” And he invited Philip to come up and sit with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the passage of Scripture which he was reading was this: “HE WAS LED LIKE A SHEEP TO SLAUGHTER; AND LIKE A LAMB THAT IS SILENT BEFORE ITS SHEARER, SO HE DOES NOT OPEN HIS MOUTH.

column.name: text
column.value: IN HUMILIATION HIS JUSTICE WAS TAKEN AWAY; WHO WILL ①DESCRIBE HIS ②GENERATION? FOR HIS LIFE IS TAKEN AWAY FROM THE EARTH.” ▷ ①Or relate ②Or family history

column.name: text
column.value: The eunuch answered Philip and said, “Please tell me, of whom does the prophet say this? Of himself, or of someone else?”

column.name: text
column.value: Then Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture he preached Jesus to him.

column.name: text
column.value: As they went along the road they came to some water; and the eunuch *said, “Look! Water! What prevents me from being baptized?” ① ▷ ①Late mss add as v 37: And Philip said, “If you believe with all your heart, you may.” And he answered and said, “I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.”

column.name: text
column.value: And he ordered that the ①chariot stop; and they both went down into the water, Philip as well as the eunuch, and he baptized him. ▷ ①Or carriage

column.name: text
column.value: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord snatched Philip away; and the eunuch no longer saw him, ①but went on his way rejoicing. ▷ ①Lit for he was going

column.name: text
column.value: But Philip ①found himself at ②Azotus, and as he passed through he kept preaching the gospel to all the cities, until he came to Caesarea. ▷ ①Or was found ②OT: Ashdod

column.name: text
column.value: Now ①Saul, still breathing ②threats and murder against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest, ▷ ①Later called Paul ②Lit threat

column.name: text
column.value: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any belonging to ①the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them in shackles to Jerusalem. ▷ ①See John

column.name: text
column.value: Now as he was traveling, it happened that he was approaching Damascus, and suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him;

column.name: text
column.value: and he fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me?”

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, “Who are You, Lord?” And He said, “I am Jesus whom you are persecuting,

column.name: text
column.value: but get up and enter the city, and it will be told to you what you must do.”

column.name: text
column.value: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the ①voice but seeing no one. ▷ ①Or sound

column.name: text
column.value: Saul got up from the ground, and though his eyes were open, he ①could see nothing; and leading him by the hand, they brought him into Damascus. ▷ ①Lit was seeing

column.name: text
column.value: And for three days he was without sight, and neither ate nor drank.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was a disciple in Damascus named Ananias; and the Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias.” And he said, “Here I am, Lord.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the Lord said to him, “Get up and go to the street called Straight, and inquire at the house of Judas for a man from Tarsus named Saul, for he is praying,

column.name: text
column.value: and he has seen ①in a vision a man named Ananias come in and lay his hands on him, so that he might regain his sight.” ▷ ①A few early mss do not contain in a vision

column.name: text
column.value: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many people about this man, how much harm he did to Your ①saints in Jerusalem; ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: and here he has authority from the chief priests to ①arrest all who call on Your name.” ▷ ①Lit bind

column.name: text
column.value: But the Lord said to him, “Go, for he is a chosen ①instrument of Mine, to bear My name before the Gentiles and kings and the sons of Israel; ▷ ①Or vessel

column.name: text
column.value: for I will show him how much he must suffer in behalf of My name.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Ananias departed and entered the house, and after laying his hands on him said, “Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus, who appeared to you on the road by which you were coming, has sent me so that you may regain your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately something like fish scales fell from his eyes, and he regained his sight, and he got up and was baptized;

column.name: text
column.value: and he took food and was strengthened. Now for several days he was with the disciples who were in Damascus,

column.name: text
column.value: and immediately he began to proclaim Jesus in the synagogues, ①saying, “He is the Son of God.” ▷ ①Lit that

column.name: text
column.value: All those hearing him continued to be amazed, and were saying, “Is this not the one who in Jerusalem destroyed those who called on this name, and had come here for the purpose of bringing them bound before the chief priests?”

column.name: text
column.value: But Saul kept increasing in strength and confounding Jews who lived in Damascus by proving that this Jesus is the ①Christ. ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: When many days had elapsed, the Jews plotted together to do away with him,

column.name: text
