column.value: but their plot became known to Saul. They were also closely watching the gates day and night so that they might put him to death;

column.name: text
column.value: but his disciples took him at night and let him down through an opening in the wall, lowering him in a large basket.

column.name: text
column.value: When he came to Jerusalem, he tried repeatedly to associate with the disciples; and yet they were all afraid of him, as they did not believe that he was a disciple.

column.name: text
column.value: But Barnabas took hold of him and brought him to the apostles and described to them how he had seen the Lord on the road, and that He had talked to him, and how he had spoken out boldly in the name of Jesus at Damascus.

column.name: text
column.value: And he was with them, ①moving about freely in Jerusalem, speaking out boldly in the name of the Lord. ▷ ①Lit going in and going out

column.name: text
column.value: And he was talking and arguing with the ①Hellenistic Jews; but they were attempting to put him to death. ▷ ①Jews who adopted the Gr language and much of Gr culture through acculturation

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the ①brothers learned of it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him away to Tarsus. ▷ ①I.e., disciples

column.name: text
column.value: So the church throughout Judea, Galilee, and Samaria ①enjoyed peace, as it was being built up; and as it ②continued in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit, it kept increasing. ▷ ①Lit was having ②Lit went

column.name: text
column.value: Now as Peter was traveling through all those regions, he also came down to the ①saints who lived at ②Lydda. ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people ②OT: Lod

column.name: text
column.value: There he found a man named Aeneas who had been bedridden for eight years, ①because he was paralyzed. ▷ ①Lit who was

column.name: text
column.value: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you; get up and make your own bed.” Immediately he got up.

column.name: text
column.value: And all who lived at ①Lydda and Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord. ▷ ①OT: Lod

column.name: text
column.value: Now in Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha (which when translated means ①Dorcas); this woman was ②excelling in acts of kindness and charity which she did habitually. ▷ ①I.e., Gr for Gazelle ②Lit full of

column.name: text
column.value: But it happened ①at that time that she became sick and died; and when they had washed her body, they laid it in an upstairs room. ▷ ①Lit in those days

column.name: text
column.value: Since Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, having heard that Peter was there, sent two men to him, urging him, “Do not delay in coming to us.”

column.name: text
column.value: So Peter got ready and went with them. When he arrived, they brought him into the room upstairs; and all the widows stood beside him, weeping and showing all the ①tunics and garments that Dorcas used to make while she was with them. ▷ ①A long shirt worn next to the skin

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter sent them all out and knelt down and prayed, and turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, arise.” And she opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

column.name: text
column.value: And he gave her his hand and raised her up; and calling the ①saints and widows, he presented her alive. ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: It became known all over Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And Peter stayed in Joppa many days with a tanner named Simon.

column.name: text
column.value: Now ①at this time, as the disciples were increasing in number, a complaint developed on the part of the ②Hellenistic Jews against the native Hebrews, because their widows were being overlooked in the daily serving of food. ▷ ①Lit in these days ②Jews who adopted the Gr language and much of Gr culture through acculturation

column.name: text
column.value: So the twelve summoned the ①congregation of the disciples and said, “It is not desirable for us to neglect the word of God in order to serve tables. ▷ ①Lit multitude

column.name: text
column.value: Instead, brothers and sisters, select from among you seven men of good reputation, full of the Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may put in charge of this task.

column.name: text
column.value: But we will devote ourselves to prayer and to the ①ministry of the word.” ▷ ①Or service

column.name: text
column.value: The ①announcement found approval with the whole ②congregation; and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, and Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and ③Nicolas, a ④proselyte from Antioch. ▷ ①Lit word ②Lit multitude ③Gr Nikolaos ④I.e., a Gentile convert to Judaism

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought these men before the apostles; and after praying, they laid their hands on them.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of God kept spreading; and the number of the disciples continued to increase greatly in Jerusalem, and a great many of the priests were becoming obedient to the faith.

column.name: text
column.value: And Stephen, full of grace and power, was performing great wonders and ①signs among the people. ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracles

column.name: text
column.value: But some men from what was called the Synagogue of the Freedmen, including both Cyrenians and Alexandrians, and some from Cilicia and ①Asia, rose up and argued with Stephen. ▷ ①I.e., west coast province of Asia Minor

column.name: text
column.value: But they were unable to ①cope with his wisdom and the Spirit by whom he was speaking. ▷ ①Lit oppose

column.name: text
column.value: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and they came up to him and dragged him away, and brought him ①before the ②Council. ▷ ①Lit into ②Or Sanhedrin

column.name: text
column.value: They put forward false witnesses who said, “This man does not stop ①speaking against this holy place and the Law; ▷ ①Lit speaking words

column.name: text
column.value: for we have heard him say that this Nazarene, Jesus, will destroy this place and change the customs which Moses handed down to us.”

column.name: text
column.value: And all who were sitting in the ①Council stared at him, and they saw his face, which was like the face of an angel. ▷ ①Or Sanhedrin

column.name: text
column.value: Now the high priest said, “Are these things so?”

column.name: text
column.value: And ①Stephen said, “Listen to me, ②brothers and fathers! The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in ③Haran, ▷ ①Lit he ②Lit men, brothers ③Gr Charran

column.name: text
column.value: and He said to him, ‘GO FROM YOUR COUNTRY AND YOUR RELATIVES, AND COME TO THE LAND WHICH I WILL SHOW YOU.’

column.name: text
column.value: Then he left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in ①Haran. And from there, after his father died, God had him move to this country in which you are now living. ▷ ①Gr Charran

column.name: text
column.value: But He gave him no inheritance in it, not even a foot of ground, and yet, He promised that He would give it to him as a possession, and to his descendants after him, even though he had no child.

column.name: text
column.value: But God spoke to this effect, that his DESCENDANTS WOULD BE STRANGERS IN A LAND THAT WAS NOT THEIRS, AND ①THEY WOULD ENSLAVE AND MISTREAT them for four hundred years. ▷ ①I.e., the people of the land (Egypt)

column.name: text
column.value: ‘AND WHATEVER NATION TO WHICH THEY ARE ENSLAVED I MYSELF WILL JUDGE,’ said God, ‘AND AFTER THAT THEY WILL COME OUT AND ①SERVE ME IN THIS PLACE.’ ▷ ①Or worship

column.name: text
column.value: And He gave him ①the covenant of circumcision; and so Abraham fathered Isaac, and circumcised him on the eighth day; and Isaac fathered Jacob, and Jacob, the twelve patriarchs. ▷ ①Or a

column.name: text
column.value: “The patriarchs became jealous of Joseph and sold him into Egypt. Yet God was with him,

column.name: text
column.value: and rescued him from all his afflictions, and granted him favor and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and he made him governor over Egypt and his entire household.

column.name: text
column.value: “Now a famine came over all Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction with it, and our fathers ①could find no food. ▷ ①Lit were not finding

column.name: text
column.value: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our fathers there the first time.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the second visit, Joseph ①made himself known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family was revealed to Pharaoh. ▷ ①Or was made known

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joseph sent word and invited his father Jacob and all his relatives to come to him, seventy-five ①people in all. ▷ ①Lit souls

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob went down to Egypt, and he and our fathers died there.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were brought back from there to ①Shechem and laid in the tomb which Abraham had purchased for a sum of money from the sons of ②Hamor in ③Shechem. ▷ ①Gr Sychem ②Gr Emmor ③Gr Sychem

column.name: text
column.value: “But as the time of the promise which God had assured to Abraham was approaching, the people increased and multiplied in Egypt,

column.name: text
column.value: until ANOTHER KING AROSE OVER EGYPT WHO DID NOT KNOW JOSEPH.

column.name: text
column.value: It was he who shrewdly took advantage of our nation and mistreated our fathers in order that they would abandon their infants in the Nile, so that they would not survive.

column.name: text
column.value: At this time Moses was born; and he was beautiful to God. He was nurtured for three months in his father’s home.

column.name: text
column.value: And after he had been put outside, Pharaoh’s daughter ①took him away and nurtured him as her own son. ▷ ①Or adopted him

column.name: text
column.value: Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and he was proficient in ①speaking and action. ▷ ①Lit his words and actions

column.name: text
column.value: But when he was approaching the age of forty, it entered his ①mind to visit his countrymen, the sons of Israel. ▷ ①Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: And when he saw one of them being treated unjustly, he defended and took vengeance for the oppressed man by fatally striking the Egyptian.

column.name: text
column.value: And he thought that his brothers understood that God was granting them ①deliverance ②through him; but they did not understand. ▷ ①Or salvation ②Lit through his hand

column.name: text
column.value: And on the following day he appeared to them as they were fighting each other, and he tried to reconcile them to peace, by saying, ‘Men, you are brothers, why are you injuring each other?’

column.name: text
column.value: But the one who was injuring his neighbor pushed him away, saying, ‘WHO MADE YOU A RULER AND JUDGE OVER US?

column.name: text
column.value: YOU DO NOT INTEND TO KILL ME AS YOU KILLED THE EGYPTIAN YESTERDAY, DO YOU?’

column.name: text
column.value: At this remark, MOSES FLED AND BECAME A STRANGER IN THE LAND OF ①MIDIAN, where he fathered two sons. ▷ ①Gr Madiam

column.name: text
column.value: “After forty years had passed, an angel appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in the flame of a burning thorn bush.

column.name: text
column.value: When Moses saw it, he was astonished at the sight; and as he approached to look more closely, the voice of the Lord came:

column.name: text
column.value: ‘I AM THE GOD OF YOUR FATHERS, THE GOD OF ABRAHAM, AND ISAAC, AND JACOB.’ Moses shook with fear and did not dare to look closely.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD said to him, ‘ ①REMOVE YOUR SANDALS FROM YOUR FEET, FOR THE PLACE ON WHICH YOU ARE STANDING IS HOLY GROUND. ▷ ①Lit Untie the sandal of your

column.name: text
column.value: I HAVE CERTAINLY SEEN THE OPPRESSION OF MY PEOPLE WHO ARE IN EGYPT, AND HAVE HEARD THEIR GROANING, AND I HAVE COME DOWN TO RESCUE THEM; AND NOW COME, I WILL SEND YOU TO EGYPT.’

column.name: text
column.value: “This Moses whom they disowned, saying, ‘WHO MADE YOU A RULER AND A JUDGE?’ is the one whom God ①sent to be both a ruler and a deliverer with the ②help of the angel who appeared to him in the thorn bush. ▷ ①Lit has sent ②Lit hand

column.name: text
column.value: This man led them out, performing wonders and ①signs in the land of Egypt and in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years. ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracles

column.name: text
column.value: This is the Moses who said to the sons of Israel, ‘GOD WILL RAISE UP FOR YOU A PROPHET ①LIKE ME FROM YOUR COUNTRYMEN.’ ▷ ①Or as He raised up me

column.name: text
column.value: This is the one who was in the ①assembly in the wilderness together with the angel who spoke to him at length on Mount Sinai, and who was with our fathers; and he received living words to pass on to you. ▷ ①Gr ekklesia

column.name: text
column.value: Our fathers were unwilling to be obedient to him; on the contrary they rejected him and turned back to Egypt in their hearts,

column.name: text
column.value: saying to Aaron, ‘MAKE US ①A GOD WHO WILL GO BEFORE US; FOR THIS MOSES WHO LED US OUT OF THE LAND OF EGYPT—WE DO NOT KNOW WHAT HAPPENED TO HIM.’ ▷ ①Lit gods, plural, but prob. refers to a singular deity

column.name: text
column.value: ①At that time they made a ②calf and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and were rejoicing in the works of their hands. ▷ ①Lit in those days ②Or young bull

column.name: text
column.value: But God turned away and gave them over to ①serve the heavenly ②lights; as it is written in the book of the prophets: ‘YOU DID NOT OFFER ME VICTIMS AND SACRIFICES FOR FORTY YEARS IN THE WILDERNESS, DID YOU, HOUSE OF ISRAEL? ▷ ①Or worship ②Lit host

column.name: text
column.value: YOU ALSO TOOK ALONG THE TABERNACLE OF MOLOCH AND THE STAR OF YOUR GOD ①ROMPHA, THE IMAGES WHICH YOU MADE TO WORSHIP. I ALSO WILL DEPORT YOU BEYOND BABYLON.’ ▷ ①Other mss spell it: Romphan, Rempham, Raiphan; or Rephan

column.name: text
column.value: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of testimony in the wilderness, just as He who spoke to Moses directed him to make it according to the pattern which he had seen.

column.name: text
column.value: Our fathers in turn received it, and they also brought it in with Joshua upon dispossessing the ①nations that God drove out from our fathers, until the time of David. ▷ ①Or Gentiles

column.name: text
column.value: ①David found favor in God’s sight, and asked that he might ②find a dwelling place for the ③house of Jacob. ▷ ①Lit He who ②I.e., build the temple ③I.e., the people of Israel

column.name: text
column.value: But it was Solomon who built a house for Him.

column.name: text
column.value: However, the Most High does not dwell in houses made by human hands; as the prophet says:

column.name: text
column.value: ‘HEAVEN IS MY THRONE, AND THE EARTH IS THE FOOTSTOOL OF MY FEET; WHAT KIND OF HOUSE WILL YOU BUILD FOR ME?’ says the Lord, ‘OR WHAT PLACE IS THERE FOR MY REST?

column.name: text
column.value: WAS IT NOT MY HAND THAT MADE ALL THESE THINGS?’

column.name: text
column.value: “You men who are stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears are always resisting the Holy Spirit; you are doing just as your fathers did.

column.name: text
column.value: Which one of the prophets did your fathers not persecute? They killed those who had previously announced the coming of the Righteous One, and you have now become betrayers and murderers of Him;

column.name: text
column.value: you who received the Law as ordained by angels, and yet did not keep it.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now when they heard this, they were infuriated, and they began gnashing their teeth at him.

column.name: text
column.value: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked intently into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing at the right hand of God;

column.name: text
column.value: and he said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God.”

column.name: text
column.value: But they shouted with loud voices, and covered their ears and rushed at him with one ①mind. ▷ ①Or purpose

column.name: text
column.value: When they had driven him out of the city, they began stoning him; and the witnesses laid aside their cloaks at the feet of a young man named Saul.

column.name: text
column.value: They went on stoning Stephen as he called on the Lord and said, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”

column.name: text
column.value: Then he fell on his knees and cried out with a loud voice, “Lord, do not hold this sin against them!” Having said this, he ①fell asleep. ▷ ①I.e., died

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was a man in Caesarea named Cornelius, a centurion of what was called the Italian ①cohort, ▷ ①Normally 600 men (the number varied)

column.name: text
column.value: a devout man and one who feared God with all his household, and made many charitable contributions to the Jewish people and prayed to God continually.

column.name: text
column.value: About the ①ninth hour of the day he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God who had just come in and said to him, “Cornelius!” ▷ ①I.e., 3 p.m.

column.name: text
column.value: And he looked at him intently and became terrified, and said, “What is it, lord?” And he said to him, “Your prayers and charitable gifts have ascended as a memorial offering before God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now dispatch some men to Joppa and send for a man named Simon, who is also called Peter;

column.name: text
column.value: he is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the sea.”

column.name: text
column.value: When the angel who *spoke to him left, he summoned two of his ①servants and a devout soldier from his personal attendants, ▷ ①Or household slaves

column.name: text
column.value: and after he had explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.

column.name: text
column.value: On the next day, as they were on their way and approaching the city, Peter went up on the ①housetop about ②the sixth hour to pray. ▷ ①Housetops were flat living areas ②I.e., noon

column.name: text
column.value: But he became hungry and wanted to eat; but while they were making preparations, he fell into a trance;

column.name: text
column.value: and he *saw the sky opened up, and an ①object like a great sheet coming down, lowered by four corners to the ground, ▷ ①Or vessel

column.name: text
column.value: and on it were all kinds of four-footed animals and ①crawling creatures of the earth and birds of the sky. ▷ ①Or reptiles

column.name: text
column.value: A voice came to him, “Get up, Peter, ①kill and eat!” ▷ ①Or sacrifice

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter said, “By no means, Lord, for I have never eaten anything ①unholy and unclean.” ▷ ①Or profane; lit common

column.name: text
column.value: Again a voice came to him a second time, “What God has cleansed, no longer ①consider unholy.” ▷ ①Lit make common

column.name: text
column.value: This happened three times, and immediately the ①object was taken up into the sky. ▷ ①Or vessel

column.name: text
column.value: Now while Peter was greatly perplexed in ①mind as to what the vision which he had seen might ②mean, behold, the men who had been sent by Cornelius had asked directions to Simon’s house, and they appeared at the gate; ▷ ①Lit himself ②Lit be

column.name: text
column.value: and calling out, they were asking whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was staying there.

column.name: text
column.value: While Peter was reflecting on the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, ①three men are looking for you. ▷ ①One early ms two

column.name: text
column.value: But get up, go downstairs and accompany them ①without misgivings, for I have sent them Myself.” ▷ ①Lit doubting nothing

column.name: text
column.value: Peter went down to the men and said, “Behold, I am the one you are looking for; what is the reason for which you have come?”

column.name: text
column.value: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous and God-fearing man well spoken of by the entire nation of the Jews, was divinely directed by a holy angel to send for you to come to his house and hear ①a message from you.” ▷ ①Lit words

column.name: text
column.value: So he invited them in and gave them lodging. Now on the next day he got ready and went away with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.

column.name: text
column.value: On the following day he entered Caesarea. Now Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.

column.name: text
column.value: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, and fell at his feet and ①worshiped him. ▷ ①Or prostrated himself in reverence

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter helped him up, saying, “Stand up; I, too, am just a man.”

column.name: text
column.value: As he talked with him, he entered and *found many people assembled.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, “You yourselves know that it is forbidden for a Jewish man to associate with or visit a ①foreigner; and yet God has shown me that I am not to call any person ②unholy or unclean. ▷ ①I.e., Gentile ②Or profane; lit common

column.name: text
column.value: That is why I came without even raising any objection when I was sent for. So I ask, for what reason did you send for me?”

column.name: text
column.value: Cornelius said, “Four days ago to this hour, I was praying in my house during the ①ninth hour; and behold, a man stood before me in shining clothing, ▷ ①I.e., 3 to 4 p.m.

column.name: text
column.value: and he *said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer has been heard and your charitable gifts have been remembered before God.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore send some men to Joppa and invite Simon, who is also called Peter, to come to you; he is staying at the house of Simon the tanner, by the sea.’

column.name: text
column.value: So I sent men to you immediately, and you have ①been kind enough to come. Now then, we are all here present before God to hear everything that you have been commanded by the Lord.” ▷ ①Lit done well in coming

column.name: text
column.value: Opening his mouth, Peter said: “I most certainly understand now that God is not one to show partiality,

column.name: text
column.value: but in every nation the one who ①fears Him and ②does what is right is acceptable to Him. ▷ ①Or reveres ②Lit works righteousness

column.name: text
column.value: The word which He sent to the sons of Israel, preaching ①peace through Jesus Christ (He is Lord of all)— ▷ ①Or the gospel of peace

column.name: text
column.value: you yourselves know the thing that happened throughout Judea, starting from Galilee, after the baptism which John proclaimed.

column.name: text
column.value: ①You know of Jesus of Nazareth, how God anointed Him with the Holy Spirit and with power, ②and how He went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with Him. ▷ ①Or How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth ②Lit who went

column.name: text
column.value: We are witnesses of all the things that He did both in the ①country of the Jews and in Jerusalem. They also put Him to death by hanging Him on ②a cross. ▷ ①Or countryside ②Lit wood; see Deut

column.name: text
column.value: God raised Him up on the third day and granted that He ①be revealed, ▷ ①Lit become visible

column.name: text
column.value: not to all the people, but to witnesses who had been chosen beforehand by God, that is, to us who ate and drank with Him after He arose from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And He ordered us to ①preach to the people, and to testify solemnly that this is the One who has been appointed by God as Judge of the living and the dead. ▷ ①Or proclaim

column.name: text
column.value: All the prophets testify of Him, that through His name everyone who believes in Him receives forgiveness of sins.”

column.name: text
column.value: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell upon all those who were listening to the ①message. ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: All the ①Jewish believers who came with Peter were amazed, because the gift of the Holy Spirit had also been poured out on the Gentiles. ▷ ①Lit believers from the circumcision

column.name: text
column.value: For they were hearing them speaking with tongues and exalting God. Then Peter responded,

column.name: text
column.value: “Surely no one can refuse the water for these to be baptized, who have received the Holy Spirit just as we did, can he?”

column.name: text
column.value: And he ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay on for a few days.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the apostles and the brothers and sisters who were throughout Judea heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Peter came up to Jerusalem, ①the Jewish believers took issue with him, ▷ ①Lit those from the circumcision

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “You ①went to ②uncircumcised men and ate with them.” ▷ ①Or entered the house of ②I.e., Gentiles

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter began and explained at length to them in an orderly sequence, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “I was in the city of Joppa praying; and in a trance I saw a vision, an ①object coming down like a great sheet lowered by four corners from the sky; and it came to where I was, ▷ ①Or vessel

column.name: text
column.value: and I stared at it and was thinking about it, and I saw the four-footed animals of the earth, the wild animals, the ①crawling creatures, and the birds of the sky. ▷ ①Or reptiles

column.name: text
column.value: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Get up, Peter; ①kill and eat.’ ▷ ①Or sacrifice

column.name: text
column.value: But I said, ‘By no means, Lord, for nothing ①unholy or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’ ▷ ①Or profane; lit common

column.name: text
column.value: But a voice from heaven answered a second time, ‘What God has cleansed, no longer ①consider unholy.’ ▷ ①Lit make common

column.name: text
column.value: This happened three times, and everything was drawn back up into the sky.

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, at that moment three men who had been sent to me from Caesarea came up to the house where we were staying.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Spirit told me to go with them without ①misgivings. These six brothers also went with me, and we entered the man’s house. ▷ ①Or making any distinction

column.name: text
column.value: And he reported to us how he had seen the angel ①standing in his house, and saying, ‘Send some men to Joppa and have Simon, who is also called Peter, brought here; ▷ ①Or after he had stood in his house and said

column.name: text
column.value: and he will speak words to you by which you will be saved, you and all your household.’

column.name: text
column.value: And as I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell upon them just as He did upon us at the beginning.

column.name: text
column.value: And I remembered the word of the Lord, how He used to say, ‘John baptized with water, but you will be baptized ①with the Holy Spirit.’ ▷ ①Or in

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, if God gave them the same gift as He also gave to us after believing in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I that I could ①stand in God’s way?” ▷ ①Lit prevent God

column.name: text
column.value: When they heard this, they ①quieted down and glorified God, saying, “Well then, God has also granted to the Gentiles the repentance that leads to life.” ▷ ①Lit became silent

column.name: text
column.value: So then those who were scattered because of the ①persecution that occurred in connection with Stephen made their way ②to Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews alone. ▷ ①Lit tribulation ②Lit as far as

column.name: text
column.value: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who came to Antioch and began speaking to the ①Greeks as well, preaching the good news of the Lord Jesus. ▷ ①Lit Hellenists; people who lived by Greek customs and culture

column.name: text
column.value: And the hand of the Lord was with them, and a large number who believed turned to the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: The ①news about them ②reached the ears of the church in Jerusalem, and they sent Barnabas off ③to Antioch. ▷ ①Lit word ②Lit was heard in ③Lit as far as

column.name: text
column.value: Then when he arrived and ①witnessed the grace of God, he rejoiced and began to encourage them all with ②resolute heart to remain true to the Lord; ▷ ①Lit saw ②Lit purpose of heart

column.name: text
column.value: for he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and faith. And ①considerable numbers were added to the Lord. ▷ ①Lit a considerable crowd was

column.name: text
column.value: And he left for Tarsus to look for Saul;

column.name: text
column.value: and when he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. And for an entire year they ①met with the church and taught ②considerable numbers of people; and the disciples were first called Christians in Antioch. ▷ ①Or were gathered together ②Lit a considerable crowd

column.name: text
column.value: Now ①at this time some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch. ▷ ①Lit in these days

column.name: text
column.value: One of them, named Agabus, stood up and ①indicated ②by the Spirit that there would definitely be a severe famine all over the ③world. ④And this took place in the reign of Claudius. ▷ ①I.e., a prophetic communication of some kind ②Or through ③Lit inhabited earth ④Lit which took place

column.name: text
column.value: And to the extent that any of the disciples had means, each of them determined to send a contribution for the ①relief of the brothers and sisters living in Judea. ▷ ①Lit service

column.name: text
column.value: And they did this, sending it ①with Barnabas and Saul to the elders. ▷ ①Lit by the hand of

column.name: text
column.value: Now about that time ①Herod the king laid hands on some who belonged to the church, to do them harm. ▷ ①I.e., Herod Agrippa I

column.name: text
column.value: And he had James the brother of John executed with a sword.

column.name: text
column.value: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to arrest Peter as well. (Now these were ①the days of Unleavened Bread.) ▷ ①I.e., Passover week

column.name: text
column.value: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison, turning him over to four ①squads of soldiers to guard him, intending only after the Passover to bring him before the people. ▷ ①Lit quaternions; a quaternion was composed of four soldiers

column.name: text
column.value: So Peter was kept in the prison, but prayer for him was being made to God ①intensely by the church. ▷ ①Or constantly

column.name: text
column.value: On ①the very night when Herod was about to bring him forward, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, and guards in front of the door were watching over the prison. ▷ ①Lit that night

column.name: text
column.value: And behold, an angel of the Lord suddenly stood near Peter, and a light shone in the cell; and he struck Peter’s side and woke him, saying, “Get up quickly.” And his chains fell off his hands.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel said to him, “Put on your belt and ①strap on your sandals.” And he did so. And he *said to him, “Wrap your cloak around you and follow me.” ▷ ①Lit bind

column.name: text
column.value: And he went out and continued to follow, and yet he did not know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he was seeing a vision.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when they had passed the first and second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened for them by itself; and they went out and went along one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.

column.name: text
column.value: When Peter came ①to himself, he said, “Now I know for sure that the Lord has sent forth His angel and rescued me from the hand of Herod and from all ②that the Jewish people were expecting.” ▷ ①Lit in himself ②Lit the expectation of the people of the Jews

column.name: text
column.value: And when he realized this, he went to the house of Mary, the mother of John, who was also called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.

column.name: text
column.value: When he knocked at the door of the gate, a slave woman named Rhoda came to answer.

column.name: text
column.value: When she recognized Peter’s voice, because of her joy she did not open the gate, but ran in and announced that Peter was standing in front of the gate.

column.name: text
column.value: They said to her, “You are out of your mind!” But she kept insisting that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter continued knocking; and when they had opened the door, they saw him and were amazed.

column.name: text
column.value: But motioning to them with his hand to be silent, he described to them how the Lord had led him out of the prison. And he said, “Report these things to ①James and the brothers.” Then he left and went to another place. ▷ ①Or Jacob

column.name: text
column.value: Now when day came, there was no small disturbance among the soldiers as to ①what could have become of Peter. ▷ ①Lit what therefore had become

column.name: text
column.value: When Herod had searched for him and had not found him, he examined the guards and ordered that they be led away to execution. Then he went down from Judea to Caesarea and was spending time there.

column.name: text
column.value: Now he was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon; and with one mind they came to him, and having won over Blastus the king’s chamberlain, they were asking for peace, because their country was supported with grain from the king’s country.

column.name: text
column.value: On an appointed day, after putting on his royal apparel, Herod took his seat on the ①rostrum and began delivering an address to them. ▷ ①Or judgment seat

column.name: text
column.value: The people repeatedly cried out, “The voice of a god and not of a man!”

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately an angel of the Lord struck him because he did not give God the glory, and he was eaten by worms and ①died. ▷ ①Lit expired

column.name: text
column.value: But the word of the Lord continued to grow and to be multiplied.

column.name: text
column.value: And Barnabas and Saul returned when they had fulfilled their ①mission to Jerusalem, taking along with them John, who was also called Mark. ▷ ①Lit ministry

column.name: text
column.value: In Iconium they entered the synagogue of the Jews together, and spoke in such a way that a large number of people believed, both of Jews and of Greeks.

column.name: text
column.value: But the ①unbelieving Jews stirred up the ②minds of the Gentiles and embittered them against the brothers. ▷ ①Or disobeying ②Lit souls

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they spent a long time there speaking boldly with reliance upon the Lord, who was testifying to the word of His grace, granting that ①signs and wonders be performed by their hands. ▷ ①I.e., confirming miracles

column.name: text
column.value: But the ①people of the city were divided; and some ②sided with the Jews, while others, with the apostles. ▷ ①Lit multitude ②Lit were

column.name: text
column.value: And when an attempt was made by both the Gentiles and the Jews with their rulers, to treat them abusively and to stone them,

column.name: text
column.value: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra and Derbe, and the surrounding region;

column.name: text
column.value: and there they continued to preach the gospel.

column.name: text
column.value: In Lystra a man was sitting whose feet were incapacitated. He had been disabled from his mother’s womb, and had never walked.

column.name: text
column.value: This man was listening to Paul as he spoke. Paul looked at him intently and saw that he had faith to be ①made well, ▷ ①Lit saved

column.name: text
column.value: and he said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” And the man leaped up and began to walk.

column.name: text
column.value: When the crowds saw what Paul had done, they raised their voice, saying in the Lycaonian language, “The gods have become like men and have come down to us!”

column.name: text
column.value: And they began calling Barnabas, ①Zeus, and Paul, ②Hermes, since he was ③the chief speaker. ▷ ①In Lat Jupiter, the chief pagan god of Rome ②In Lat Mercury, considered the messenger or spokesman for the pagan gods of Rome ③Lit the leader of the speaking

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, the priest of Zeus, whose temple was ①just outside the city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and wanted to offer sacrifice with the crowds. ▷ ①Lit in front of

column.name: text
column.value: But when the apostles Barnabas and Paul heard about it, they tore their ①robes and rushed out into the crowd, crying out ▷ ①Or outer garments

column.name: text
column.value: and saying, “Men, why are you doing these things? We are also men, of the same nature as you, preaching the gospel to you, to turn from these ①useless things to a living God, who MADE THE HEAVEN AND THE EARTH AND THE SEA, AND EVERYTHING THAT IS IN THEM. ▷ ①I.e., idols

column.name: text
column.value: ①In past generations He permitted all the ②nations to go their own ways; ▷ ①Lit Who in past generations permitted ②Or Gentiles

column.name: text
column.value: yet He did not leave Himself without witness, in that He did good and gave you rains from heaven and fruitful seasons, ①satisfying your hearts with food and gladness.” ▷ ①Lit filling

column.name: text
column.value: And even by saying these things, only with difficulty did they restrain the crowds from offering sacrifices to them.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jews came from Antioch and Iconium, and having won over the crowds, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, thinking that he was dead.

column.name: text
column.value: But while the disciples stood around him, he got up and entered the city. The next day he left with Barnabas for Derbe.

column.name: text
column.value: And after they had preached the gospel to that city and had made a good number of disciples, they returned to Lystra, to Iconium, and to Antioch,

column.name: text
column.value: strengthening the souls of the disciples, encouraging them to continue in the faith, and saying, “It is through many tribulations that we must enter the kingdom of God.”

column.name: text
column.value: When they had appointed elders for them in every church, having prayed with fasting, they entrusted them to the Lord in whom they had believed.

column.name: text
column.value: They passed through Pisidia and came into Pamphylia.

column.name: text
column.value: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.

column.name: text
column.value: From there they sailed to Antioch, where they had been entrusted to the grace of God for the work that they had ①accomplished. ▷ ①Lit fulfilled

column.name: text
column.value: When they had arrived and gathered the church together, they began to report all the things that God had done with them and ①how He had opened a door of faith to the Gentiles. ▷ ①Lit that

column.name: text
column.value: And they spent ①a long time with the disciples. ▷ ①Lit not a little

column.name: text
column.value: Now there were prophets and teachers at Antioch, in the church that was there: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

column.name: text
column.value: While they were ①serving the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, “Set Barnabas and Saul apart for Me for the work to which I have called them.” ▷ ①Lit performing ministry to

column.name: text
column.value: Then, when they had fasted, prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

column.name: text
column.value: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia and from there they sailed to Cyprus.

column.name: text
column.value: When they reached Salamis, they began to proclaim the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews; and they also had John as their helper.

column.name: text
column.value: When they had gone through the whole island as far as Paphos, they found a magician, a Jewish false prophet whose name was Bar-Jesus,

column.name: text
column.value: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of intelligence. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul and sought to hear the word of God.

column.name: text
column.value: But Elymas the magician (for so his name is translated) was opposing them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.

column.name: text
column.value: But Saul, who was also known as Paul, ①filled with the Holy Spirit, stared at him, ▷ ①Or having just been filled

column.name: text
column.value: and said, “ ①You who are full of all deceit and fraud, you son of the devil, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not stop making crooked the straight ways of the Lord? ▷ ①Lit O full of

column.name: text
column.value: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon you, and you will be blind and not see the sun for a time.” And immediately a mist and a darkness fell upon him, and he went about seeking those who would lead him by the hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the proconsul believed when he saw what had happened, being amazed at the teaching of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Paul and his companions put out to sea from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia; but John left them and returned to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: But going on from Perga, they arrived at Pisidian Antioch, and on the Sabbath day they went into the synagogue and sat down.

column.name: text
column.value: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the synagogue officials sent word to them, saying, “ ①Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, say it.” ▷ ①Lit Men, brothers

column.name: text
column.value: Paul stood up, and motioning with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen:

column.name: text
column.value: The God of this people Israel chose our fathers and ①made the people great during their stay in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm He led them out from it. ▷ ①Or exalted

column.name: text
column.value: For a period of about forty years He put up with them in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: When He had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, He distributed their land as an inheritance—all of which took about 450 years.

column.name: text
column.value: After these things He gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they asked for a king, and God gave them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.

column.name: text
column.value: After He had removed him, He raised up David to be their king, concerning whom He also testified and said, ‘I have found David, the son of Jesse, a man after My heart, who will do all My ①will.’ ▷ ①Lit wishes

column.name: text
column.value: From the descendants of this man, according to promise, God has brought to Israel a Savior, Jesus,

column.name: text
column.value: after John had proclaimed, before ①His coming, a baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel. ▷ ①Lit the face of His entering

column.name: text
column.value: And while John was completing his course, he kept saying, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not He. But behold, one is coming after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’

column.name: text
column.value: “ ①Brothers, sons of Abraham’s family, and those among you who fear God, to us the message of this salvation has been sent. ▷ ①Lit Men, brothers

column.name: text
column.value: For those who live in Jerusalem, and their rulers, recognizing neither Him nor the ①declarations of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled these by condemning Him. ▷ ①Lit voices

column.name: text
column.value: And though they found no grounds for putting Him to death, they asked Pilate that He be executed.

column.name: text
column.value: When they had carried out everything that was written concerning Him, they took Him down from the ①cross and laid Him in a tomb. ▷ ①Lit wood; see Deut

column.name: text
column.value: But God raised Him from the dead;

column.name: text
column.value: and for many days He appeared to those who came up with Him from Galilee to Jerusalem, the very ones who are now His witnesses to the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And we preach to you the good news of the promise made to the fathers,

column.name: text
column.value: that God has fulfilled this promise to those of us who are the descendants by raising Jesus, as it is also written in the second Psalm: ‘YOU ARE MY SON; TODAY I HAVE FATHERED YOU.’

column.name: text
column.value: As for the fact that He raised Him from the dead, never again to return to decay, He has spoken in this way: ‘I WILL GIVE YOU THE HOLY and faithful mercies of DAVID.’

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, He also says in another Psalm: ‘YOU WILL NOT ①ALLOW YOUR ②HOLY ONE TO ③UNDERGO DECAY.’ ▷ ①Lit give ②Or Devout; or Pious ③Lit see corruption

column.name: text
column.value: For David, after he had ①served God’s purpose in his own generation, fell asleep, and was ②buried among his fathers and ③underwent decay; ▷ ①Or served his own generation by the purpose of God ②Lit gathered to his ③Lit saw corruption

column.name: text
column.value: but He whom God raised did not ①undergo decay. ▷ ①Lit see corruption

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore let it be known to you, ①brothers, that through ②Him forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you, ▷ ①Lit men, brothers ②Lit this One

column.name: text
column.value: and ①through Him everyone who believes is ②freed ③from all things, from which you could not be ④freed ⑤through the Law of Moses. ▷ ①Lit in; or by ②Or justified ③Lit by ④Or justified ⑤Lit by

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, see that the thing spoken of in the Prophets does not come upon you:

column.name: text
column.value: ‘LOOK, YOU SCOFFERS, AND BE ASTONISHED, AND ①PERISH; FOR I AM ACCOMPLISHING A WORK IN YOUR DAYS, A WORK WHICH YOU WILL NEVER BELIEVE, THOUGH SOMEONE SHOULD DESCRIBE IT TO YOU.’ ” ▷ ①Lit disappear

column.name: text
column.value: As ①Paul and Barnabas were going out, the people repeatedly begged to have these ②things spoken to them the next Sabbath. ▷ ①Lit they ②Lit words

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the meeting of the synagogue had broken up, many of the Jews and the God-fearing ①proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas, who were speaking to them and urging them to continue in the grace of God. ▷ ①I.e., Gentile converts to Judaism

column.name: text
column.value: The next Sabbath nearly all the city assembled to hear the word of ①the Lord. ▷ ①One early ms God

column.name: text
column.value: But when the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy and began contradicting the things spoken by Paul, and were ①blaspheming. ▷ ①Or slandering him

column.name: text
column.value: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly and said, “It was necessary that the word of God be spoken to you first. Since you repudiate it and consider yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we are turning to the Gentiles.

column.name: text
column.value: For so the Lord has commanded us, ‘I HAVE APPOINTED YOU AS A LIGHT ①TO THE GENTILES, THAT YOU MAY ②BRING SALVATION TO THE END OF THE EARTH.’ ” ▷ ①Lit of ②Lit be for salvation

column.name: text
column.value: When the Gentiles heard this, they began rejoicing and glorifying the word of ①the Lord; and all who had been appointed to eternal life believed. ▷ ①Two early mss God

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the Lord was being spread through the whole region.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Jews incited the ①devout women of prominence and the leading men of the city, and instigated a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and drove them out of their ②region. ▷ ①Or worshiping ②Lit boundaries

column.name: text
column.value: But they shook off the dust from their feet in protest against them and went to Iconium.

column.name: text
column.value: And the disciples were continually filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Some men came down from Judea and began teaching the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised according to the custom of Moses, you cannot be saved.”

column.name: text
column.value: And after Paul and Barnabas had ①a heated argument and debate with them, the brothers determined that Paul and Barnabas and some others of them should go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders concerning this issue. ▷ ①Lit no little

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, after being sent on their way by the church, they were passing through both Phoenicia and Samaria, describing in detail the conversion of the Gentiles, and they were bringing great joy to all the brothers and sisters.

column.name: text
column.value: When they arrived in Jerusalem, they were received by the church, the apostles, and the elders, and they reported all that God had done with them.

column.name: text
column.value: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who had believed stood up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise ①them and to direct them to keep the Law of Moses.” ▷ ①I.e., Gentile believers

column.name: text
column.value: The apostles and the elders came together to ①look into this ②matter. ▷ ①Lit see about ②Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: After there had been much debate, Peter stood up and said to them, “ ①Brothers, you know that ②in the early days God made a choice among you, that by my mouth the Gentiles would hear the word of the gospel and believe. ▷ ①Lit Men, brothers ②Lit from days of old

column.name: text
column.value: And God, who knows the heart, testified to them giving them the Holy Spirit, just as He also did to us;

column.name: text
column.value: and He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.

column.name: text
column.value: Since this is the case, why are you putting God to the test by placing upon the neck of the disciples a yoke which neither our forefathers nor we have been able to bear?

column.name: text
column.value: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, in the same way as they also are.”

column.name: text
column.value: All the people kept silent, and they were listening to Barnabas and Paul as they were relating all the signs and wonders that God had done through them among the Gentiles.

column.name: text
column.value: After they stopped speaking, ①James responded, saying, “ ②Brothers, listen to me. ▷ ①Or Jacob ②Lit Men, brothers

column.name: text
column.value: Simeon has described how God first concerned Himself about taking a people for His name from among the Gentiles.

column.name: text
column.value: The words of the Prophets agree with this, just as it is written:

column.name: text
column.value: ‘AFTER THESE THINGS I will return, AND I WILL REBUILD THE FALLEN ①TABERNACLE OF DAVID, AND I WILL REBUILD ITS RUINS, AND I WILL RESTORE IT, ▷ ①Or tent

column.name: text
column.value: SO THAT THE REST OF MANKIND MAY SEEK THE LORD, AND ALL THE GENTILES ①WHO ARE CALLED BY MY NAME,’ ▷ ①Lit upon whom My name is called

column.name: text
column.value: SAYS THE LORD, WHO ①MAKES THESE THINGS known from long ago. ▷ ①Or does these things which were known

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, it is my judgment that we do not cause trouble for those from the Gentiles who are turning to God,

column.name: text
column.value: but that we write to them that they abstain from ①things contaminated by idols, from acts of sexual immorality, from what has been ②strangled, and from blood. ▷ ①Lit the pollutions of ②I.e., to retain the blood

column.name: text
column.value: For from ancient generations Moses has those who preach him in every city, since ①he is read in the synagogues every Sabbath.” ▷ ①I.e., the books of Moses, Gen through Deut

column.name: text
column.value: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole church, to choose men from among them to send to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas who was called Barsabbas, and Silas, leading men among the brothers,

column.name: text
column.value: and they ①sent this letter with them: “The apostles and the brothers who are elders, to the brothers and sisters in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia who are from the Gentiles: Greetings. ▷ ①Lit wrote by their hand

column.name: text
column.value: Since we have heard that some ①of our number to whom we gave no instruction have confused you by their ②teaching, upsetting your souls, ▷ ①Lit from us ②Lit words

column.name: text
column.value: it seemed good to us, having ①become of one mind, to select men to send to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul, ▷ ①Or met together

column.name: text
column.value: men who have ①risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ. ▷ ①Lit given over

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, we have sent Judas and Silas, who themselves will also report the same things by word of mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit and to us to lay upon you no greater burden than these essentials:

column.name: text
column.value: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from acts of sexual immorality; ①if you keep yourselves free from such things, you will do well. Farewell.” ▷ ①Lit from which keeping yourselves free

column.name: text
column.value: So when they were sent away, they went down to Antioch; and after gathering the ①congregation together, they delivered the letter. ▷ ①Or multitude

column.name: text
column.value: When they had read it, they rejoiced because of its ①encouragement. ▷ ①Or exhortation

column.name: text
column.value: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, ①encouraged and strengthened the brothers and sisters with a lengthy message. ▷ ①Or exhorted

column.name: text
column.value: After they had spent time there, they were sent away from the brothers and sisters in peace to those who had sent them out. ① ▷ ①Late mss add as v 34: But it seemed good to Silas to remain there.

column.name: text
column.value: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

column.name: text
column.value: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return and visit the brothers and sisters in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, and see how they are.”

column.name: text
column.value: Barnabas wanted to take John, called Mark, along with them also.

column.name: text
column.value: But Paul was of the opinion that they should not take along with them this man who had deserted them ①in Pamphylia and had not gone with them to the work. ▷ ①Lit from

column.name: text
column.value: Now it turned into such a sharp disagreement that they separated from one another, and Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus.

column.name: text
column.value: But Paul chose Silas, and left after being entrusted by the brothers to the grace of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And he was traveling through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Paul also came to Derbe and to Lystra. And a disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewish woman who was a believer, but his father was a Greek,

column.name: text
column.value: and he was well spoken of by the brothers and sisters who were in Lystra and Iconium.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul wanted this man to leave with him; and he took him and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.

column.name: text
column.value: Now while they were passing through the cities, they were delivering the ordinances for them to follow which had been determined by the apostles and elders in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: So the churches were being strengthened ①in the faith, and were increasing in number daily. ▷ ①Or in faith

column.name: text
column.value: They passed through the ①Phrygian and Galatian region, after being forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in ②Asia; ▷ ①Or Phrygia and the Galatian region ②I.e., west coast province of Asia Minor

column.name: text
column.value: and after they came to Mysia, they were trying to go into Bithynia, and the Spirit of Jesus did not allow them;

column.name: text
column.value: and passing by Mysia, they went down to Troas.

column.name: text
column.value: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night: a man of Macedonia was standing and pleading with him, and saying, “Come over to Macedonia and help us.”

column.name: text
column.value: When he had seen the vision, we immediately sought to leave for Macedonia, concluding that God had called us to preach the gospel to them.

column.name: text
column.value: So after setting sail from Troas, we ran a straight course to Samothrace, and on the following day to Neapolis;

column.name: text
column.value: and from there to Philippi, which is a leading city of the district of Macedonia, a Roman colony; and we were spending some days in this city.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the Sabbath day we went outside the gate to a riverside, where we were thinking that there was a place of prayer; and we sat down and began speaking to the women who had assembled.

column.name: text
column.value: A woman named Lydia was listening; she was a seller of purple fabrics from the city of Thyatira, and a worshiper of God. ①The Lord opened her heart to respond to the things spoken by Paul. ▷ ①Lit Whose heart the Lord opened

column.name: text
column.value: Now when she and her household had been baptized, she urged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay.” And she prevailed upon us.

column.name: text
column.value: It happened that as we were going to the place of prayer, a slave woman who had a spirit of divination met us, who was bringing great profit to her masters by fortune-telling.

column.name: text
column.value: She followed Paul and us and cried out repeatedly, saying, “These men are bond-servants of the Most High God, who are proclaiming to you a way of salvation.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now she continued doing this for many days. But Paul was greatly annoyed, and he turned and said to the spirit, “I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!” And it came out at that very ①moment. ▷ ①Lit hour

column.name: text
column.value: But when her masters saw that their hope of profit was suddenly gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the authorities,

column.name: text
column.value: and when they had brought them to the chief magistrates, they said, “These men, Jews as they are, are causing our city trouble,

column.name: text
column.value: and they are proclaiming customs that are not lawful for us to accept or to practice, since we are Romans.”

column.name: text
column.value: The crowd joined in an attack against them, and the chief magistrates tore their ①robes off them and proceeded to order ②them to be beaten with rods. ▷ ①Or outer garments ②Lit to beat with rods

column.name: text
column.value: When they had struck them with many blows, they threw them into prison, commanding the jailer to guard them securely;

column.name: text
column.value: ①and he, having received such a command, threw them into the inner prison and fastened their feet in the ②stocks. ▷ ①Lit who ②Lit wood

column.name: text
column.value: Now about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns of praise to God, and the prisoners were listening to them;

column.name: text
column.value: and suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s chains were unfastened.

column.name: text
column.value: When the jailer awoke and saw the prison doors opened, he drew his sword and was about to kill himself, thinking that the prisoners had escaped.

column.name: text
column.value: But Paul called out with a loud voice, saying, “Do not harm yourself, for we are all here!”

column.name: text
column.value: And the jailer asked for lights and rushed in, and trembling with fear, he fell down before Paul and Silas;

column.name: text
column.value: and after he brought them out, he said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”

column.name: text
column.value: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved, you and your household.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they spoke the word of God to him together with all who were in his house.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took them that very hour of the night and washed their wounds, and immediately he was baptized, he and all his household.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought them into his house and set ①food before them, and was ②overjoyed, since he had become a believer in God together with his whole household. ▷ ①Lit a table ②Or overjoyed together with his whole household, since...God

column.name: text
column.value: Now when day came, the chief magistrates sent their officers, saying, “Release those men.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, “The chief magistrates have sent word that you be released. So come out now and go in peace.”

column.name: text
column.value: But Paul said to them, “After beating us in public without due process—men who are Romans—they threw us into prison; and now they are releasing us secretly? No indeed! On the contrary, let them come ①in person and lead us out.” ▷ ①Lit themselves

column.name: text
column.value: The officers reported these words to the chief magistrates. And they became fearful when they heard that they were Romans,

column.name: text
column.value: and they came and pleaded with them, and when they had led them out, they repeatedly asked them to leave the city.

column.name: text
column.value: They left the prison and entered the house of Lydia, and when they saw the brothers and sisters, they ①encouraged them and departed. ▷ ①Or exhorted

column.name: text
column.value: Now when they had traveled through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a synagogue of the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: And according to Paul’s custom, he ①visited them, and for three Sabbaths reasoned with them from the Scriptures, ▷ ①Lit entered to them

column.name: text
column.value: ①explaining and ②giving evidence that the ③Christ had to suffer and rise from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus whom I am proclaiming to you is the ④Christ.” ▷ ①Lit opening ②Lit placing before ③I.e., Messiah ④I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: And some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas, ①along with a large number of the God-fearing Greeks and ②a significant number of the leading women. ▷ ①Lit and a large ②Lit not a few

column.name: text
column.value: But the Jews, becoming jealous and taking along some wicked men from the marketplace, formed a mob and set the city in an uproar; and they attacked the house of Jason and were seeking to bring them out to the people.

column.name: text
column.value: When they did not find them, they began dragging Jason and some brothers before the city authorities, shouting, “These men who have upset ①the world have come here also; ▷ ①Lit the inhabited earth

column.name: text
column.value: ①and Jason has welcomed them, and they all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus.” ▷ ①Lit whom Jason has welcomed

column.name: text
column.value: They stirred up the crowd and the city authorities who heard these things.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had received a ①pledge from Jason and the others, they released them. ▷ ①Or bond

column.name: text
column.value: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Berea, ①and when they arrived, they went into the synagogue of the Jews. ▷ ①Lit who when...arrived went

column.name: text
column.value: Now these people were more noble-minded than those in Thessalonica, ①for they received the word with ②great eagerness, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so. ▷ ①Lit who received ②Lit all

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, many of them believed, ①along with a significant number of prominent Greek women and men. ▷ ①Lit and not a few

column.name: text
column.value: But when the Jews of Thessalonica found out that the word of God had been proclaimed by Paul in Berea also, they came there as well, agitating and stirring up the crowds.

column.name: text
column.value: Then immediately the brothers sent Paul out to go as far as the sea; and Silas and Timothy remained there.

column.name: text
column.value: Now those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens; and receiving a command for Silas and Timothy to come to him as soon as possible, they left.

column.name: text
column.value: Now while Paul was waiting for them in Athens, his spirit was being provoked within him as he observed that the city was full of idols.

column.name: text
column.value: So he was reasoning in the synagogue with the Jews and the God-fearing Gentiles, and in the marketplace every day with those who happened to be present.

column.name: text
column.value: And some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers as well were ①conversing with him. Some were saying, “What could this ②scavenger of tidbits want to say?” Others, “He seems to be a proclaimer of strange deities,”—because he was preaching Jesus and the resurrection. ▷ ①Or disputing ②Lit seed gatherer; i.e., an unlearned person collecting only scraps of knowledge

column.name: text
column.value: And they took him and brought him ①to the ②Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is ③which you are proclaiming? ▷ ①Or before ②Or Hill of Ares; Greek god of war ③Lit which is being spoken by you

column.name: text
column.value: For you are bringing some strange things to our ears; so we want to know what these things mean.”

column.name: text
column.value: (Now all the Athenians and the strangers visiting there used to spend their time in nothing other than telling or hearing something new.)

column.name: text
column.value: So Paul stood in the midst of the ①Areopagus and said, “Men of Athens, I see that you are very religious in all respects. ▷ ①Or the Council of the Areopagus

column.name: text
column.value: For while I was passing through and examining the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription, ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ Therefore, what you worship in ignorance, this I proclaim to you.

column.name: text
column.value: The God who made the world and everything that is in it, since He is Lord of heaven and earth, does not dwell in temples made by hands;

column.name: text
column.value: nor is He served by human hands, as though He needed anything, since He Himself gives to all people life and breath and all things;

column.name: text
column.value: and He made from one man every nation of mankind to live on all the face of the earth, having determined their appointed times and the boundaries of their habitation,

column.name: text
column.value: that they would seek God, if perhaps they might feel around for Him and find Him, though He is not far from each one of us;

column.name: text
column.value: for in Him we live and move and ①exist, as even some of your own poets have said, ‘For we also are His descendants.’ ▷ ①Lit are

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, since we are the descendants of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold or silver or stone, an image formed by human skill and thought.

column.name: text
column.value: So having overlooked the times of ignorance, God is now proclaiming to mankind that all people everywhere are to repent,

column.name: text
column.value: because He has set a day on which He will judge ①the world in righteousness ②through a Man whom He has appointed, having furnished proof to all people ③by raising Him from the dead.” ▷ ①Lit the inhabited earth ②Lit by; or in ③Or when He raised

column.name: text
column.value: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some began to scoff, but others said, “We shall hear from you ①again concerning this.” ▷ ①Lit also again

column.name: text
column.value: So Paul went out from among them.

column.name: text
column.value: But some men joined him and believed, among whom also were Dionysius the Areopagite and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

column.name: text
column.value: After these events Paul left Athens and went to Corinth.

column.name: text
column.value: And he found a Jew named Aquila, a native of Pontus having recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to leave Rome. He came to them,

column.name: text
column.value: and because he was of the same trade he stayed with them, and they worked together, for they were tent-makers by trade.

column.name: text
column.value: And Paul was reasoning in the synagogue every Sabbath and trying to persuade Jews and Greeks.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul began devoting himself completely to the word, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the ①Christ. ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: But when they resisted and blasphemed, he shook out his garments and said to them, “Your blood is ①on your own heads! I am clean. From now on I will go to the Gentiles.” ▷ ①I.e., the responsibility is all yours

column.name: text
column.value: Then he left ①the synagogue and went to the house of a man named ②Titius Justus, a worshiper of God, whose house was next door to the synagogue. ▷ ①Lit from there ②One early ms Titus

column.name: text
column.value: Crispus, the leader of the synagogue, believed in the Lord together with his entire household; and many of the Corinthians, as they listened to Paul, were believing and being baptized.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Lord said to Paul by a vision at night, “Do not be afraid any longer, but go on speaking and do not be silent;

column.name: text
column.value: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”

column.name: text
column.value: And he settled there for a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

column.name: text
column.value: But while Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews rose up together against Paul and brought him before the ①judgment seat, ▷ ①Or tribunal

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “This man is inciting the people to worship God contrary to the ①law.” ▷ ①Or Law

column.name: text
column.value: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If it were a matter of some crime or vicious, unscrupulous act, O Jews, it would be reasonable for me to put up with you;

column.name: text
column.value: but if there are ①questions about ②teaching and ③persons and your own law, see to it yourselves; I am unwilling to be a judge of these matters.” ▷ ①Or arguments ②Lit word ③Lit names

column.name: text
column.value: And he drove them away from the ①judgment seat. ▷ ①Or tribunal

column.name: text
column.value: But they all took hold of Sosthenes, the leader of the synagogue, and began beating him in front of the judgment seat. And yet Gallio was not concerned about any of these things.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Paul, when he had remained many days longer, took leave of the brothers and sisters and sailed away to Syria, and Priscilla and Aquila were with him. ①Paul first had his hair cut at Cenchrea, for he was keeping a vow. ▷ ①Lit Having had his hair cut

column.name: text
column.value: They came to Ephesus, and he left them there. Now he himself entered the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: When they asked him to stay for a longer time, he did not consent,

column.name: text
column.value: but took leave of them and said, “I will return to you again if God wills,” and he set sail from Ephesus.

column.name: text
column.value: When he had landed in Caesarea, he went up to Jerusalem and greeted the church, and went down to Antioch.

column.name: text
column.value: And after spending some time there, he left and passed successively through the Galatian region and Phrygia, strengthening all the disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: Now a Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by birth, ①an eloquent man, came to Ephesus; and he was proficient in the Scriptures. ▷ ①Or a learned man

column.name: text
column.value: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he was accurately speaking and teaching things about Jesus, being acquainted only with the baptism of John;

column.name: text
column.value: and ①he began speaking boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside and explained the way of God more accurately to him. ▷ ①Lit this man

column.name: text
column.value: And when he wanted to go across to Achaia, the brothers encouraged him and wrote to the disciples to welcome him; and when he had arrived, he greatly ①helped those who had believed through grace, ▷ ①Or helped greatly through grace those who had believed

column.name: text
column.value: for he powerfully refuted the Jews in public, demonstrating by the Scriptures that Jesus was the ①Christ. ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, and when he had ①encouraged them and taken his leave of them, he left to go to Macedonia. ▷ ①Or exhorted

column.name: text
column.value: When he had gone through those regions and had given them much ①encouragement, he came to Greece. ▷ ①Or exhortation

column.name: text
column.value: And there he spent three months, and when a plot was formed against him by the Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he decided to return through Macedonia.

column.name: text
column.value: And ①he was accompanied by Sopater of Berea, the son of Pyrrhus, and by Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, and Gaius of Derbe, and Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of ②Asia. ▷ ①Lit there accompanied him ②I.e., west coast province of Asia Minor

column.name: text
column.value: Now these had gone on ahead and were waiting for us at Troas.

column.name: text
column.value: We sailed from Philippi after ①the days of Unleavened Bread, and reached them at Troas within five days; and we stayed there for seven days. ▷ ①I.e., Passover week

column.name: text
column.value: On the first day of the week, when we were gathered together to break bread, Paul began talking to them, intending to leave the next day, and he prolonged his ①message until midnight. ▷ ①Lit word, speech

column.name: text
column.value: There were many lamps in the upstairs room where we were gathered together.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a young man named ①Eutychus sitting ②on the window sill, sinking into a deep sleep; and as Paul kept on talking, Eutychus was overcome by sleep and fell down from the third floor, and was picked up dead. ▷ ①Eutychus means good fortune; i.e., “Lucky” ②Or at the window

column.name: text
column.value: But Paul went down and fell upon him, and after embracing him, he said, “ ①Do not be troubled, for ②he is still alive.” ▷ ①Or Stop being troubled ②Lit his soul is in him

column.name: text
column.value: When Paul had gone back up and had broken the bread and ①eaten, he talked with them a long while until daybreak, and then left. ▷ ①Lit tasted

column.name: text
column.value: They took away the boy alive, and were ①greatly comforted. ▷ ①Lit not moderately

column.name: text
column.value: But we went ahead to the ship and set sail for Assos, intending from there to take Paul on board; for that was what he had arranged, intending himself to go ①by land. ▷ ①Or on foot

column.name: text
column.value: And when he met us at Assos, we took him on board and came to Mitylene.

column.name: text
column.value: Sailing from there, we arrived the following day opposite Chios; and the next day we crossed over to Samos, and on the following day we came to Miletus.

column.name: text
column.value: For Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus so that he would not have to lose time in ①Asia; for he was hurrying, if it might be possible for him to be in Jerusalem the day of Pentecost. ▷ ①I.e., west coast province of Asia Minor

column.name: text
column.value: From Miletus he sent word to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the church.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they came to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in ①Asia, how I was with you the whole time, ▷ ①See note v 16

column.name: text
column.value: serving the Lord with all humility and with tears and trials which came upon me ①through the plots of the Jews; ▷ ①Lit by

column.name: text
column.value: how I did not shrink from declaring to you anything that was beneficial, and teaching you publicly and ①from house to house, ▷ ①Or in the various private homes

column.name: text
column.value: solemnly testifying to both Jews and Greeks of repentance toward God and faith in our Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, behold, bound by the ①Spirit, I am on my way to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there, ▷ ①Or in spirit

column.name: text
column.value: except that the Holy Spirit solemnly testifies to me in every city, saying that chains and afflictions await me.

column.name: text
column.value: But I do not consider my life of any account as dear to myself, so that I may finish my course and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to testify solemnly of the gospel of God’s grace.

column.name: text
column.value: “And now behold, I know that all of you, among whom I went about preaching the kingdom, will no longer see my face.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, I ①testify to you this day that I am ②innocent of the blood of all people. ▷ ①Or call you to witness ②Lit pure from

column.name: text
column.value: For I did not shrink from declaring to you the whole purpose of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Be on guard for yourselves and for all the flock, among which the Holy Spirit has made you ①overseers, to shepherd the church of God which He ②purchased ③with His own blood. ▷ ①Or bishops ②Lit acquired ③Lit through

column.name: text
column.value: I know that after my departure savage wolves will come in among you, not sparing the flock;

column.name: text
column.value: and from among your own selves men will arise, speaking perverse things to draw away the disciples after them.

column.name: text
