column.value: DESTRUCTION AND MISERY ARE IN THEIR PATHS,

column.name: text
column.value: AND THEY HAVE NOT KNOWN THE WAY OF PEACE.”

column.name: text
column.value: “THERE IS NO FEAR OF GOD BEFORE THEIR EYES.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now we know that whatever the Law says, it speaks to those who are ①under the Law, so that every mouth may be closed and all the world may become accountable to God; ▷ ①Lit in

column.name: text
column.value: because by the works ①of the Law ②none of mankind will be justified in His sight; for ③through the Law comes ④knowledge of sin. ▷ ①Or of law ②Lit no flesh ③Or through law ④Or recognition

column.name: text
column.value: But now apart ①from the Law the righteousness of God has been revealed, being witnessed by the ②Law and the Prophets, ▷ ①Or from law ②I.e., the Old Testament

column.name: text
column.value: but it is the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ for all those ①who believe; for there is no distinction, ▷ ①Or who believe. For there is

column.name: text
column.value: for all ①have sinned and fall short of the glory of God, ▷ ①Or sinned

column.name: text
column.value: being justified as a gift by His grace through the redemption which is in Christ Jesus,

column.name: text
column.value: whom God displayed publicly as a ①propitiation ②in His blood through faith. This was to demonstrate His righteousness, ③because in God’s merciful restraint He let the sins previously committed go unpunished; ▷ ①I.e., a means of reconciliation between God and mankind by paying the penalty for sin ②Or by ③Lit because of the passing over of the sins previously committed, in the restraint of God

column.name: text
column.value: for the demonstration, that is, of His righteousness at the present time, so that He would be just and the justifier of the one who ①has faith in Jesus. ▷ ①Lit is of the faith of Jesus

column.name: text
column.value: Where then is boasting? It has been excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.

column.name: text
column.value: ①For we maintain that a person is justified by faith apart from works ②of the Law. ▷ ①One early ms Therefore ②Or of law

column.name: text
column.value: Or is God the God of Jews only? Is He not the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

column.name: text
column.value: since indeed God who will justify the ①circumcised ②by faith and the ③uncircumcised through faith is one. ▷ ①Lit circumcision ②Lit out of ③Lit uncircumcision

column.name: text
column.value: Do we then nullify ①the Law through faith? Far from it! On the contrary, we establish the Law. ▷ ①Or law

column.name: text
column.value: What shall we say then? Are we to continue in sin so that grace may increase?

column.name: text
column.value: ①Far from it! How shall we who died to sin still live in it? ▷ ①Lit May it never happen!

column.name: text
column.value: Or do you not know that all of us who have been baptized into Christ Jesus have been baptized into His death?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore we have been buried with Him through baptism into death, so that, just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we too may walk in newness of life.

column.name: text
column.value: For if we have become ①united with Him in the likeness of His death, certainly we shall also be ②in the likeness of His resurrection, ▷ ①Or united with the likeness ②Or with

column.name: text
column.value: knowing this, that our old ①self was crucified with Him, in order that our body of sin might be ②done away with, so that we would no longer be slaves to sin; ▷ ①Lit person (Gr anthropos) ②Or made powerless

column.name: text
column.value: for the one who has died is ①freed from sin. ▷ ①Or acquitted

column.name: text
column.value: Now if we have died with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with Him,

column.name: text
column.value: knowing that Christ, having been raised from the dead, ①is never to die again; death no longer is master over Him. ▷ ①Lit no longer dies

column.name: text
column.value: For ①the death that He died, He died to sin once for all time; but ②the life that He lives, He lives to ③God. ▷ ①Lit that which He died ②Lit that which He lives ③I.e., the Father

column.name: text
column.value: So you too, consider yourselves to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore sin is not to reign in your mortal body so that you obey its lusts,

column.name: text
column.value: and do not go on presenting ①the parts of your body to sin as ②instruments of unrighteousness; but present yourselves to God as those who are alive from the dead, and ③your body’s parts as ④instruments of righteousness for God. ▷ ①Lit your parts to sin ②Or weapons ③Lit your parts as ④Or weapons

column.name: text
column.value: For sin shall not be master over you, for you are not under ①the Law but under grace. ▷ ①Or law

column.name: text
column.value: What then? Are we to sin because we are not under ①the Law but under grace? ②Far from it! ▷ ①Or law ②Lit May it never happen!

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not know that the one to whom you present yourselves as slaves for obedience, you are slaves of that same one whom you obey, either of sin ①resulting in death, or of obedience ②resulting in righteousness? ▷ ①Lit to death ②Lit to righteousness

column.name: text
column.value: But thanks be to God that ①though you were slaves of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that ②form of teaching to which you were entrusted, ▷ ①Lit you were slaves...but you became ②Or pattern

column.name: text
column.value: and after being freed from sin, you became slaves to righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: I am speaking ①in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh. For just as you presented ②the parts of your body as slaves to impurity and to lawlessness, ③resulting in further lawlessness, so now present ④your body’s parts as slaves to righteousness, ⑤resulting in sanctification. ▷ ①I.e., reluctantly using slavery as an analogy ②Lit your parts as ③Lit to lawlessness ④Lit your parts as ⑤Lit to sanctification

column.name: text
column.value: For when you were slaves of sin, you were free in relation to righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore what ①benefit were you then ②deriving from the things of which you are now ashamed? For the outcome of those things is death. ▷ ①Lit fruit ②Lit having

column.name: text
column.value: But now having been freed from sin and enslaved to God, you ①derive your ②benefit, ③resulting in sanctification, and the outcome, eternal life. ▷ ①Lit have ②Lit fruit ③Lit to sanctification

column.name: text
column.value: For the wages of sin is death, but the gracious gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Or do you not know, brothers and sisters (for I am speaking to those who know the ①Law), that the ②Law has jurisdiction over a person as long as he lives? ▷ ①Or law ②Or law

column.name: text
column.value: For the married woman is bound by law to her ①husband as long as he is alive; but if her husband dies, she is released from the law ②concerning the husband. ▷ ①Lit living husband; but if ②Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: So then, if while her husband is alive she ①gives herself to another man, she will be called an adulteress; but if her husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is not an adulteress if she ②gives herself to another man. ▷ ①Lit becomes another man’s ②I.e., in marriage; lit becomes another man’s

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, my brothers and sisters, you also were put to death in regard to the Law through the body of Christ, so that you might belong to another, to Him who was raised from the dead, in order that we might bear fruit for God.

column.name: text
column.value: For while we were in the flesh, the sinful passions, which were brought to light by the Law, were at work in ①the parts of our body to bear fruit for death. ▷ ①Lit our parts to bear

column.name: text
column.value: But now we have been released from the Law, having died to that by which we were bound, so that we serve in newness of the ①Spirit and not in oldness of the letter. ▷ ①Or spirit

column.name: text
column.value: What shall we say then? Is the Law sin? ①Far from it! On the contrary, I would not have come to know sin except ②through the Law; for I would not have known about ③coveting if the Law had not said, “YOU SHALL NOT ④COVET.” ▷ ①Lit May it never happen! ②Or through law ③Or lust ④Or lust

column.name: text
column.value: But sin, taking an opportunity through the commandment, produced in me ①coveting of every kind; for apart ②from the Law sin is dead. ▷ ①Or lust ②Or from law

column.name: text
column.value: I was once alive apart ①from the Law; but when the commandment came, sin came to life, and I died; ▷ ①Or from law

column.name: text
column.value: and this commandment, which was ①to result in life, proved ②to result in death for me; ▷ ①Lit to life ②Lit to death

column.name: text
column.value: for sin, taking an opportunity through the commandment, deceived me, and through it, killed me.

column.name: text
column.value: So then, the Law is holy, and the commandment is holy and righteous and good.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore did that which is good become a cause of death for me? ①Far from it! Rather it was sin, in order that it might be shown to be sin by bringing about my death through that which is good, so that through the commandment sin would become utterly sinful. ▷ ①Lit May it never happen!

column.name: text
column.value: For we know that the Law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold ①into bondage to sin. ▷ ①Lit under sin

column.name: text
column.value: For I do not understand what I am doing; for I am not practicing what I want to do, but I do the very thing I hate.

column.name: text
column.value: However, if I do the very thing I do not want to do, I agree with the Law, that the Law is good.

column.name: text
column.value: But now, no longer am I the one doing it, but sin that dwells in me.

column.name: text
column.value: For I know that good does not dwell in me, that is, in my flesh; for the willing is present in me, but the doing of the good is not.

column.name: text
column.value: For the good that I want, I do not do, but I practice the very evil that I do not want.

column.name: text
column.value: But if I do the very thing I do not want, I am no longer the one doing it, but sin that dwells in me.

column.name: text
column.value: I find then the ①principle that evil is present in me, the one who wants to do good. ▷ ①Lit law

column.name: text
column.value: For I joyfully agree with the law of God ①in the inner person, ▷ ①Or with respect to

column.name: text
column.value: but I see a different law in ①the parts of my body waging war against the law of my mind, and making me a prisoner ②of the law of sin, the law which is in ③my body’s parts. ▷ ①Lit my parts waging ②Lit in ③Lit my parts

column.name: text
column.value: Wretched man that I am! Who will set me free from ①the body of this death? ▷ ①Or this body of death

column.name: text
column.value: Thanks be to God through Jesus Christ our Lord! So then, on the one hand I myself with my mind am serving the law of God, but on the other, with my flesh the law of sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore there is now no condemnation at all for those who are in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: For the law of the Spirit of life ①in Christ Jesus has set you free from the law of sin and of death. ▷ ①Or has set you free in Christ Jesus

column.name: text
column.value: For what the Law could not do, ①weak as it was through the flesh, God did: sending His own Son in the likeness of ②sinful flesh and as an offering for sin, He condemned sin in the flesh, ▷ ①Lit in which it was weak ②Lit flesh of sin

column.name: text
column.value: so that the requirement of the Law might be fulfilled in us who do not walk ①according to the flesh but ②according to the Spirit. ▷ ①Or in accordance with ②Or in accordance with

column.name: text
column.value: For those who are in accord with the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who are in accord with the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: For the mind ①set on the flesh is death, but the mind ②set on the Spirit is life and peace, ▷ ①Lit of the ②Lit of the

column.name: text
column.value: because the mind ①set on the flesh is hostile toward God; for it does not subject itself to the law of God, for it is not even able to do so, ▷ ①Lit of the

column.name: text
column.value: and those who are in the flesh cannot please God.

column.name: text
column.value: However, you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if indeed the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, he does not belong to Him.

column.name: text
column.value: If Christ is in you, though the body is dead because of sin, yet the spirit is ①alive because of righteousness. ▷ ①Lit life

column.name: text
column.value: But if the Spirit of Him who raised Jesus from the dead dwells in you, He who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies ①through His Spirit who dwells in you. ▷ ①One early ms because of

column.name: text
column.value: So then, brothers and sisters, we are under obligation, not to the flesh, to live according to the flesh—

column.name: text
column.value: for if you are living in accord with the flesh, you are going to die; but if by the Spirit you are putting to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

column.name: text
column.value: For all who are being led by the Spirit of God, these are sons and daughters of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For you have not received a spirit of slavery ①leading to fear again, but you have received ②a spirit of adoption as sons and daughters by which we cry out, “Abba! ③Father!” ▷ ①Lit for fear again ②Or the Spirit ③Gr translation of the Aramaic Abba provided by Paul

column.name: text
column.value: The Spirit Himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God,

column.name: text
column.value: and if children, heirs also, heirs of God and fellow heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with Him so that we may also be glorified with Him.

column.name: text
column.value: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory that is to be revealed to us.

column.name: text
column.value: For the eagerly awaiting creation waits for the revealing of the sons and daughters of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For the creation was subjected to futility, not willingly, but because of Him who subjected it, ①in hope ▷ ①Or in hope; because the creation

column.name: text
column.value: that the creation itself also will be set free from its slavery to corruption into the freedom of the glory of the children of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For we know that the whole creation groans and suffers the pains of childbirth together until now.

column.name: text
column.value: And not only that, but also we ourselves, having the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting eagerly for our adoption as sons and daughters, the redemption of our body.

column.name: text
column.value: For in hope we have been saved, but hope that is seen is not hope; for who hopes for what he already sees?

column.name: text
column.value: But if we hope for what we do not see, through perseverance we wait eagerly for it.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the same way the Spirit also helps our weakness; for we do not know what to pray for as we should, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with ①groanings too deep for words; ▷ ①Lit wordless groanings

column.name: text
column.value: and He who searches the hearts knows what the mind of the Spirit is, because He intercedes for the ①saints according to the will of God. ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: And we know that ①God ②causes all things to work together for good to those who love God, to those who are called according to His purpose. ▷ ①One early ms He; i.e., God ②Or in all things works together with those...for good

column.name: text
column.value: For those whom He foreknew, He also predestined to become conformed to the image of His Son, so that He would be the firstborn among many brothers and sisters;

column.name: text
column.value: and these whom He predestined, He also called; and these whom He called, He also justified; and these whom He justified, He also glorified.

column.name: text
column.value: What then shall we say to these things? If God is for us, who is against us?

column.name: text
column.value: He who did not spare His own Son, but delivered Him over for us all, how will He not also with Him freely give us all things?

column.name: text
column.value: Who will bring charges against God’s elect? God is the one who justifies;

column.name: text
column.value: who is the one who condemns? Christ Jesus is He who died, but rather, was ①raised, who is at the right hand of God, who also intercedes for us. ▷ ①One early ms raised from the dead

column.name: text
column.value: Who will separate us from the love of ①Christ? Will tribulation, or trouble, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or danger, or sword? ▷ ①Two early mss God

column.name: text
text
column.value: But in all these things we overwhelmingly conquer through Him who loved us.

column.name: text
column.value: For I am convinced that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

column.name: text
column.value: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Brothers and sisters, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God for them is for their salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not in accordance with knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: For not knowing about God’s righteousness and seeking to establish their own, they did not subject themselves to the righteousness of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For Christ is the ①end of the Law for righteousness to everyone who believes. ▷ ①Or goal

column.name: text
column.value: For Moses writes of the righteousness that is ①based on the Law, that the person who performs ②them will live by ③them. ▷ ①Lit out of, from ②I.e., the statutes of the Law ③I.e., the statutes of the Law

column.name: text
column.value: But the righteousness ①based on faith speaks as follows: “DO NOT SAY IN YOUR HEART, ‘WHO WILL GO UP INTO HEAVEN?’ (that is, to bring Christ down), ▷ ①Lit out of, from

column.name: text
column.value: or ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead).”

column.name: text
column.value: But what does it say? “THE WORD IS NEAR YOU, IN YOUR MOUTH AND IN YOUR HEART”—that is, the word of faith which we are preaching,

column.name: text
column.value: ①that if you confess with your mouth Jesus as Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved; ▷ ①Or because

column.name: text
column.value: for with the heart a person believes, ①resulting in righteousness, and with the mouth he confesses, ②resulting in salvation. ▷ ①Lit to righteousness ②Lit to salvation

column.name: text
column.value: For the Scripture says, “WHOEVER BELIEVES IN HIM WILL NOT BE ①PUT TO SHAME.” ▷ ①Or disappointed

column.name: text
column.value: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, abounding in riches for all who call on Him;

column.name: text
column.value: for “EVERYONE WHO CALLS ON THE NAME OF THE LORD WILL BE SAVED.”

column.name: text
column.value: How then are they to call on Him in whom they have not believed? How are they to believe in Him whom they have not heard? And how are they to hear without a preacher?

column.name: text
column.value: But how are they to preach unless they are sent? Just as it is written: “HOW BEAUTIFUL ARE THE FEET OF THOSE WHO ①BRING GOOD NEWS OF GOOD THINGS!” ▷ ①Or preach the gospel

column.name: text
column.value: However, they did not all heed the ①good news; for Isaiah says, “LORD, WHO HAS BELIEVED OUR REPORT?” ▷ ①Or gospel

column.name: text
column.value: So faith comes from hearing, and hearing by the word ①of Christ. ▷ ①Or concerning Christ

column.name: text
column.value: But I say, surely they have never heard, have they? On the contrary: “THEIR VOICE HAS GONE OUT INTO ALL THE EARTH, AND THEIR WORDS TO THE ENDS OF THE ①WORLD.” ▷ ①Or inhabited earth

column.name: text
column.value: But I say, surely Israel did not know, did they? First Moses says, “I WILL MAKE YOU JEALOUS WITH those who are not a nation, WITH A FOOLISH NATION I WILL ANGER YOU.”

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaiah is very bold and says, “I WAS FOUND BY THOSE WHO DID NOT SEEK ME, I REVEALED MYSELF TO THOSE WHO DID NOT ASK FOR ME.”

column.name: text
column.value: But as for Israel, He says, “I HAVE SPREAD OUT MY HANDS ALL DAY LONG TO A DISOBEDIENT AND OBSTINATE PEOPLE.”

column.name: text
column.value: I am telling the truth in Christ, I am not lying; my conscience testifies with me in the Holy Spirit,

column.name: text
column.value: that I have great sorrow and unceasing grief in my heart.

column.name: text
column.value: For I could ①wish that I myself were accursed, separated from Christ for the sake of my countrymen, my kinsmen according to the flesh, ▷ ①Lit pray

column.name: text
column.value: who are Israelites, to whom belongs the adoption as sons and daughters, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the Law, the temple service, and the promises;

column.name: text
column.value: whose are the fathers, and from whom is the ①Christ according to the flesh, who is over all, God blessed ②forever. Amen. ▷ ①I.e., Messiah ②Lit unto the ages

column.name: text
column.value: But it is not as though the word of God has failed. For they are not all Israel who are descended from Israel;

column.name: text
column.value: nor are they all children because they are Abraham’s ①descendants, but: “ ②THROUGH ISAAC YOUR ③DESCENDANTS SHALL BE NAMED.” ▷ ①Lit seed ②Lit in ③Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: That is, it is not the children of the flesh ①who are children of God, but the children of the promise are regarded as ②descendants. ▷ ①Lit these ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: For this is the word of promise: “AT THIS TIME I WILL COME, AND SARAH WILL HAVE A SON.”

column.name: text
column.value: And not only that, but there was also Rebekah, when she had conceived twins by one man, our father Isaac;

column.name: text
column.value: for though the twins were not yet born and had not done anything good or bad, so that God’s purpose according to His choice would ①stand, not ②because of works but ③because of Him who calls, ▷ ①Lit remain ②Lit from ③Lit from

column.name: text
column.value: it was said to her, “THE OLDER WILL SERVE THE YOUNGER.”

column.name: text
column.value: Just as it is written: “JACOB I HAVE LOVED, BUT ESAU I HAVE HATED.”

column.name: text
column.value: What shall we say then? There is no injustice with God, is there? ①Far from it! ▷ ①Lit May it never happen!

column.name: text
column.value: For He says to Moses, “I WILL HAVE MERCY ON WHOMEVER I HAVE MERCY, AND I WILL SHOW COMPASSION TO WHOMEVER I SHOW COMPASSION.”

column.name: text
column.value: So then, it does not depend on the person who ①wants it nor the one who ②runs, but on God who has mercy. ▷ ①Or wills nor ②I.e., to win mercy or favor

column.name: text
column.value: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “FOR THIS VERY REASON I RAISED YOU UP, IN ORDER TO DEMONSTRATE MY POWER IN YOU, AND THAT MY NAME MIGHT BE PROCLAIMED ①THROUGHOUT THE EARTH.” ▷ ①Lit in all

column.name: text
column.value: So then He has mercy on whom He desires, and He hardens whom He desires.

column.name: text
column.value: You will say to me then, “Why does He still find fault? For who has resisted His will?”

column.name: text
column.value: On the contrary, who are you, ①you foolish person, who answers back to God? The thing molded will not say to the molder, “Why did you make me like this,” will it? ▷ ①Lit O

column.name: text
column.value: Or does the potter not have a right over the clay, to make from the same lump one object ①for honorable use, and another ②for common use? ▷ ①Lit for honor ②Lit for dishonor

column.name: text
column.value: ①What if God, although willing to demonstrate His wrath and to make His power known, endured with great patience objects of wrath prepared for destruction? ▷ ①Lit But

column.name: text
column.value: And He did so to make known the riches of His glory upon objects of mercy, which He prepared beforehand for glory,

column.name: text
column.value: namely us, whom He also called, not only from among Jews, but also from among Gentiles,

column.name: text
column.value: as He also says in Hosea: “I WILL CALL THOSE WHO WERE NOT MY PEOPLE, ‘MY PEOPLE,’ AND HER WHO WAS NOT BELOVED, ‘BELOVED.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: “AND IT SHALL BE THAT IN THE PLACE WHERE IT WAS SAID TO THEM, ‘YOU ARE NOT MY PEOPLE,’ THERE THEY SHALL BE CALLED SONS OF THE LIVING GOD.”

column.name: text
column.value: Isaiah cries out concerning Israel, “THOUGH THE NUMBER OF THE SONS OF ISRAEL MAY BE LIKE THE SAND OF THE SEA, ONLY the remnant will be saved;

column.name: text
column.value: FOR THE LORD WILL EXECUTE HIS WORD ON THE EARTH, ①THOROUGHLY AND ②QUICKLY.” ▷ ①Lit finishing it ②Lit cutting it short

column.name: text
column.value: And just as Isaiah foretold: “IF THE LORD ①OF ARMIES HAD NOT LEFT US ②DESCENDANTS, WE WOULD HAVE BECOME LIKE SODOM, AND WOULD HAVE ③BEEN LIKE GOMORRAH.” ▷ ①Gr sabaoth, for Heb tsebaoth (armies) ②Lit seed ③Lit been made like

column.name: text
column.value: What shall we say then? That Gentiles, who did not pursue righteousness, attained righteousness, but the righteousness that is ①by faith; ▷ ①Lit out of

column.name: text
column.value: however, Israel, pursuing a law of righteousness, did not arrive at that law.

column.name: text
column.value: Why? Because they did not pursue it ①by faith, but as though they could ②by works. They stumbled over the stumbling stone, ▷ ①Lit out of ②Lit out of

column.name: text
column.value: just as it is written: “BEHOLD, I AM LAYING IN ZION A STONE OF STUMBLING AND A ROCK OF OFFENSE, AND THE ONE WHO BELIEVES IN HIM WILL NOT BE ①PUT TO SHAME.” ▷ ①Or disappointed

column.name: text
column.value: I say then, God has not rejected His people, has He? ①Far from it! For I too am an Israelite, ②a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin. ▷ ①Lit May it never happen! ②Lit of the seed of Abraham

column.name: text
column.value: God has not rejected His people whom He foreknew. Or do you not know what the Scripture says in the passage about Elijah, how he pleads with God against Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: “Lord, THEY HAVE KILLED YOUR PROPHETS, THEY HAVE TORN DOWN YOUR ALTARS, AND I ALONE AM LEFT, AND THEY ARE SEEKING MY LIFE.”

column.name: text
column.value: But what ①is the divine response to him? “I HAVE KEPT for Myself SEVEN THOUSAND MEN WHO HAVE NOT BOWED THE KNEE TO BAAL.” ▷ ①Lit says

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way then, there has also come to be at the present time a remnant according to God’s ①gracious choice. ▷ ①Lit choice of grace

column.name: text
column.value: But if it is by grace, it is no longer ①on the basis of works, since otherwise grace is no longer grace. ▷ ①Lit out of

column.name: text
column.value: What then? What Israel is seeking, it has not obtained, but ①those who were chosen obtained it, and the rest were hardened; ▷ ①Lit the election

column.name: text
column.value: just as it is written: “GOD GAVE THEM A SPIRIT OF STUPOR, EYES TO SEE NOT AND EARS TO HEAR NOT, DOWN TO THIS VERY DAY.”

column.name: text
column.value: And David says, “MAY THEIR TABLE BECOME A SNARE AND A TRAP, AND A STUMBLING BLOCK AND A RETRIBUTION TO THEM.

column.name: text
column.value: MAY THEIR EYES BE DARKENED TO SEE NOT, AND BEND THEIR BACKS CONTINUALLY.”

column.name: text
column.value: I say then, they did not stumble so as to fall, did they? ①Far from it! But by their wrongdoing salvation has come to the Gentiles, to make them jealous. ▷ ①Lit May it never happen!

column.name: text
column.value: Now if their wrongdoing proves to be riches for the world, and their failure, riches for the Gentiles, how much more will their ①fulfillment be! ▷ ①Or fullness

column.name: text
column.value: But I am speaking to you who are Gentiles. Therefore insofar as I am an apostle of Gentiles, I magnify my ministry

column.name: text
column.value: if somehow I may move my ①own people to jealousy and save some of them. ▷ ①Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: For if their rejection proves to be the reconciliation of the world, what will their acceptance be but life from the dead?

column.name: text
column.value: If the first piece of dough is holy, the lump is also; and if the root is holy, the branches are as well.

column.name: text
column.value: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the ①rich root of the olive tree, ▷ ①Lit root of the fatness

column.name: text
column.value: do not be arrogant toward the branches; but if you are arrogant, remember that it is not you who supports the root, but the root supports you.

column.name: text
column.value: You will say then, “Branches were broken off so that I might be grafted in.”

column.name: text
column.value: Quite right, they were broken off for their unbelief, but you stand by your faith. Do not be conceited, but fear;

column.name: text
column.value: for if God did not spare the natural branches, He will not spare you, either.

column.name: text
column.value: See then the kindness and severity of God: to those who fell, severity, but to you, God’s kindness, if you continue in His kindness; for otherwise you too will be cut off.

column.name: text
column.value: And they also, if they do not continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in; for God is able to graft them in again.

column.name: text
column.value: For if you were cut off from what is by nature a wild olive tree, and contrary to nature were grafted into a cultivated olive tree, how much more will these who are the natural branches be grafted into their own olive tree?

column.name: text
column.value: For I do not want you, brothers and sisters, to be uninformed of this mystery—so that you will not be wise in your own estimation—that a partial hardening has happened to Israel until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in;

column.name: text
column.value: and so all Israel will be saved; just as it is written: “THE DELIVERER WILL COME FROM ZION, HE WILL REMOVE UNGODLINESS FROM JACOB.”

column.name: text
column.value: “THIS IS ①MY COVENANT WITH THEM, WHEN I TAKE AWAY THEIR SINS.” ▷ ①Lit the covenant from Me

column.name: text
column.value: In relation to the gospel they are enemies on your account, but in relation to God’s choice they are beloved on account of the fathers;

column.name: text
column.value: for the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

column.name: text
column.value: For just as you once were disobedient to God, but now have been shown mercy because of their disobedience,

column.name: text
column.value: so these also now have been disobedient, that because of the mercy shown to you they also may now be shown mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: For God has shut up all in disobedience, so that He may show mercy to all.

column.name: text
column.value: Oh, the depth of the riches, ①both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments and unfathomable His ways! ▷ ①Or and the wisdom

column.name: text
column.value: For WHO HAS KNOWN THE MIND OF THE LORD, OR WHO BECAME HIS COUNSELOR?

column.name: text
column.value: Or WHO HAS FIRST GIVEN TO HIM, ①THAT IT WOULD BE PAID BACK TO HIM? ▷ ①Lit and it will be paid back

column.name: text
column.value: For from Him, and through Him, and to Him are all things. To Him be the glory ①forever. Amen. ▷ ①Lit to the ages

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I urge you, brothers and sisters, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies as a living and holy sacrifice, ①acceptable to God, which is your ②spiritual service of worship. ▷ ①Or pleasing ②I.e., in contrast to offering a literal sacrifice

column.name: text
column.value: And do not be conformed to this ①world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may ②prove what the will of God is, that which is good and ③acceptable and perfect. ▷ ①Or age ②Or discover ③Or pleasing

column.name: text
column.value: For through the grace given to me I say to everyone among you not to think more highly of himself than he ought to think; but to think so as to have sound judgment, as God has allotted to each a measure of faith.

column.name: text
column.value: For just as we have many parts in one body and all ①the body’s parts do not have the same function, ▷ ①Lit the parts

column.name: text
column.value: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually parts of one another.

column.name: text
column.value: However, since we have gifts that differ according to the grace given to us, each of us is to use them properly: if prophecy, ①in proportion to one’s faith; ▷ ①Or in agreement with the faith

column.name: text
column.value: if ①service, in the act of serving; or the one who teaches, in the act of teaching; ▷ ①Or office of service

column.name: text
column.value: or the one who ①exhorts, in the work of ②exhortation; the one who gives, with ③generosity; the one who ④is in leadership, with diligence; the one who shows mercy, with cheerfulness. ▷ ①Or encourages ②Or encouragement ③Or sincere concern ④Or provides care

column.name: text
column.value: ①Love must be free of hypocrisy. Detest what is evil; cling to what is good. ▷ ①Or Love has no

column.name: text
column.value: Be devoted to one another in brotherly love; ①give preference to one another in honor, ▷ ①Or outdo one another in showing honor

column.name: text
column.value: not lagging behind in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord;

column.name: text
column.value: rejoicing in hope, persevering in tribulation, devoted to prayer,

column.name: text
column.value: contributing to the needs of the ①saints, ②practicing hospitality. ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people ②Lit pursuing

column.name: text
column.value: Bless those who persecute ①you; bless and do not curse. ▷ ①Two early mss do not contain you

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice with those who rejoice, and weep with those who weep.

column.name: text
column.value: Be of the same mind toward one another; do not be ①haughty in mind, but ②associate with the lowly. Do not be wise in your own estimation. ▷ ①Or arrogant ②Or accommodate yourself to lowly things

column.name: text
column.value: Never repay evil for evil to anyone. ①Respect what is right in the sight of all people. ▷ ①Lit Take thought for

column.name: text
column.value: If possible, so far as it depends on you, be at peace with all people.

column.name: text
column.value: Never take your own revenge, beloved, but ①leave room for the wrath of God, for it is written: “VENGEANCE IS MINE, I WILL REPAY,” says the Lord. ▷ ①Lit give a place

column.name: text
column.value: “BUT IF YOUR ENEMY IS HUNGRY, FEED HIM; IF HE IS THIRSTY, GIVE HIM A DRINK; FOR IN SO DOING YOU WILL HEAP BURNING COALS ON HIS HEAD.”

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

column.name: text
column.value: Every ①person is to be subject to the governing authorities. For there is no authority except ②from God, and those which exist are established by God. ▷ ①Or soul ②Lit by

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore ①whoever resists authority has opposed the ordinance of God; and they who have opposed will receive condemnation upon themselves. ▷ ①Lit the one who

column.name: text
column.value: For rulers are not a cause of fear for ①good behavior, but for evil. Do you want to have no fear of authority? Do what is good and you will have praise from the same; ▷ ①Lit good work

column.name: text
column.value: for it is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do what is evil, be afraid; for it does not bear the sword for nothing; for it is a servant of God, an avenger who brings wrath on the one who practices evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore it is necessary to be in subjection, not only because of wrath, but also for the sake of conscience.

column.name: text
column.value: For because of this you also pay taxes, for rulers are servants of God, devoting themselves to this very thing.

column.name: text
column.value: Pay to all what is due them: tax to whom tax is due; custom to whom custom; ①respect to whom ②respect; honor to whom honor. ▷ ①I.e., for authority; lit fear ②I.e., for authority; lit fear

column.name: text
column.value: Owe nothing to anyone except to love one another; for the one who loves ①his neighbor has fulfilled the Law. ▷ ①Lit the other

column.name: text
column.value: For this, “YOU SHALL NOT COMMIT ADULTERY, YOU SHALL NOT MURDER, YOU SHALL NOT STEAL, YOU SHALL NOT COVET,” and if there is any other commandment, it is summed up in this saying, “YOU SHALL LOVE YOUR NEIGHBOR AS YOURSELF.”

column.name: text
column.value: Love ①does no wrong to a neighbor; therefore love is the fulfillment of the Law. ▷ ①Lit works no evil

column.name: text
column.value: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already the hour for you to awaken from sleep; for now ①salvation is nearer to us than when we first believed. ▷ ①Or our salvation is nearer than when

column.name: text
column.value: The night is almost gone, and the day is near. Therefore let’s rid ourselves of the deeds of darkness and put on the armor of light.

column.name: text
column.value: Let’s ①behave properly as in the day, not in carousing and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and debauchery, not in strife and jealousy. ▷ ①Lit walk

column.name: text
column.value: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh in regard to its lusts.

column.name: text
column.value: Now accept the one who is weak ①in faith, but not ②to have quarrels over opinions. ▷ ①Or in the faith ②Lit for quarrels

column.name: text
column.value: One person has faith that he may eat all things, but the one who is weak eats only vegetables.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who eats is not to regard with contempt the one who does not eat, and the one who does not eat is not to judge the one who eats, for God has accepted him.

column.name: text
column.value: Who are you to judge the ①servant of another? To his own ②master he stands or falls; and he will stand, for the Lord is able to make him stand. ▷ ①Or house servant ②Lit lord

column.name: text
column.value: One person ①values one day over another, another ②values every day the same. Each person must be fully convinced in his own mind. ▷ ①Lit judges ②Lit judges

column.name: text
column.value: The one who observes the day, observes it for the Lord, and the one who eats, ①does so with regard to the Lord, for he gives thanks to God; and the one who does not eat, it is for the Lord that he does not eat, and he gives thanks to God. ▷ ①Lit eats

column.name: text
column.value: For not one of us lives for himself, and not one dies for himself;

column.name: text
column.value: for if we live, we live for the Lord, or if we die, we die for the Lord; therefore whether we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

column.name: text
column.value: For to this end Christ died and lived again, that He might be Lord both of the dead and of the living.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for you, why do you judge your brother or sister? Or you as well, why do you regard your brother or sister with contempt? For we will all appear before the judgment seat of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is written: “AS I LIVE, SAYS THE LORD, TO ME EVERY KNEE WILL BOW, AND EVERY TONGUE WILL ①GIVE PRAISE TO GOD.” ▷ ①Or confess

column.name: text
column.value: So then each one of us will give an account of himself to God.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore let’s not judge one another anymore, but rather ①determine this: not to put an obstacle or a stumbling block in a brother’s or sister’s way. ▷ ①Lit judge

column.name: text
column.value: I know and am convinced ①in the Lord Jesus that nothing is ②unclean in itself; but to the one who thinks something is ③unclean, to that person it is ④unclean. ▷ ①Lit through ②I.e., ceremonially unclean; lit common ③I.e., ceremonially unclean; lit common ④I.e., ceremonially unclean; lit common

column.name: text
column.value: For if because of food your brother or sister is hurt, you are no longer walking in accordance with love. Do not destroy with your choice of food that person for whom Christ died.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore do not let what is for you a good thing be ①spoken of as evil; ▷ ①Lit blasphemed

column.name: text
column.value: for the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: For the one who serves Christ in this way is acceptable to God and approved by other people.

column.name: text
column.value: So then we pursue the things ①which make for peace and the building up of one another. ▷ ①Lit of peace and the things of the building up

column.name: text
column.value: Do not tear down the work of God for the sake of food. All things indeed are clean, but they are evil for the person who eats ①and causes offense. ▷ ①Lit by offense

column.name: text
column.value: It is good not to eat meat or to drink wine, or to do anything by which your brother or sister stumbles.

column.name: text
column.value: The faith which you have, have ①as your own conviction before God. Happy is the one who does not condemn himself in what he approves. ▷ ①Lit according to yourself

column.name: text
column.value: But the one who doubts is condemned if he eats, because his eating is not from faith; and whatever is not from faith is sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of those without strength, and not just please ourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Each of us is to please his neighbor ①for his good, to his edification. ▷ ①Lit for what is good to edification

column.name: text
column.value: For even Christ did not please Himself, but as it is written: “THE TAUNTS OF THOSE WHO TAUNT YOU HAVE FALLEN ON ME.”

column.name: text
column.value: For whatever was written in earlier times was written for our instruction, so that through perseverance and the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

column.name: text
column.value: Now may the God ①who gives perseverance and encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another, according to Christ Jesus, ▷ ①Lit of perseverance

column.name: text
column.value: so that with one purpose and one ①voice you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, ①accept one another, just as Christ also accepted ②us, for the glory of God. ▷ ①I.e., accept into fellowship ②One early ms you

column.name: text
column.value: For I say that Christ has become a servant to the circumcision in behalf of the truth of God, to confirm the promises given to the fathers,

column.name: text
column.value: and for the Gentiles to glorify God for His mercy; as it is written: “THEREFORE I WILL ①GIVE PRAISE TO YOU AMONG THE GENTILES, AND I WILL SING PRAISES TO YOUR NAME.” ▷ ①Or confess

column.name: text
column.value: Again he says, “REJOICE, YOU GENTILES, WITH HIS PEOPLE.”

column.name: text
column.value: And again, “PRAISE THE LORD ALL YOU GENTILES, AND LET ALL THE PEOPLES PRAISE HIM.”

column.name: text
column.value: Again Isaiah says, “THERE SHALL COME THE ROOT OF JESSE, AND HE WHO ARISES TO RULE OVER THE GENTILES, IN HIM WILL THE GENTILES HOPE.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, so that you will abound in hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And concerning you, my brothers and sisters, I myself also am convinced that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge and able also to admonish one another.

column.name: text
column.value: But I have written very boldly to you on some points so as to remind you again, because of the grace that was given to me ①from God, ▷ ①One early ms by God

column.name: text
column.value: to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, ministering as a priest the gospel of God, so that my offering of the Gentiles may become acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore in Christ Jesus I have found reason for boasting in things pertaining to God.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will not presume to speak of anything ①except what Christ has accomplished through me, ②resulting in the obedience of the Gentiles by word and deed, ▷ ①Lit which Christ has not accomplished ②Lit to the obedience

column.name: text
column.value: in the power of ①signs and wonders, in the power of the Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and all around as far as Illyricum I have ②fully preached the gospel of Christ. ▷ ①Or confirming miracles ②Lit fulfilled

column.name: text
column.value: And in this way I aspired to preach the gospel, not where Christ was already known by name, so that I would not build on another person’s foundation;

column.name: text
column.value: but just as it is written: “THEY WHO HAVE NOT BEEN TOLD ABOUT HIM WILL SEE, AND THEY WHO HAVE NOT HEARD WILL UNDERSTAND.”

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason I have often been prevented from coming to you;

column.name: text
column.value: but now, with no further place for me in these regions, and since I have had for many years a longing to come to you

column.name: text
column.value: whenever I go to Spain—for I hope to see you in passing, and to be helped on my way there by you, when I have first enjoyed your company ①for a while— ▷ ①Lit in part

column.name: text
column.value: but now, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the ①saints. ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: For Macedonia and Achaia have been pleased to make a contribution for the poor among the ①saints in Jerusalem. ▷ ①See note v 25

column.name: text
column.value: For they were pleased to do so, and they are indebted to them. For if the Gentiles have shared in their spiritual things, they are indebted to do them a service also in material things.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, when I have finished this, and have ①put my seal on this fruit of theirs, I will go on by way of you to Spain. ▷ ①Lit sealed to them this fruit

column.name: text
column.value: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I urge you, brothers and sisters, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, to strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

column.name: text
column.value: that I may be rescued from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service for Jerusalem may prove acceptable to the ①saints; ▷ ①See note v 25

column.name: text
column.value: so that I may come to you in joy by the will of God and relax in your company.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: I recommend to you our sister Phoebe, who is a ①servant of the church which is at Cenchrea, ▷ ①Or deaconess

column.name: text
column.value: that you receive her in the Lord in a manner worthy of the ①saints, and that you help her in whatever matter she may have need of you; for she herself has also been a helper of many, ②and of myself as well. ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people ②Lit and of me, myself

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

column.name: text
column.value: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only do I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles;

column.name: text
column.value: also greet the church that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first convert to Christ from ①Asia. ▷ ①I.e., west coast province of Asia Minor

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Mary, who has worked hard for you.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Andronicus and ①Junia, my kinsfolk and my fellow prisoners, who are outstanding in the view of the apostles, who also ②were in Christ before me. ▷ ①Or possibly Junias (masc) ②Lit have become

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Ampliatus, my beloved in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet those of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, workers in the Lord. Greet Persis the beloved, who has worked hard in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Rufus, a choice man in the Lord, also his mother and mine.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers and sisters with them.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the ①saints who are with them. ▷ ①See note 1 v 2

column.name: text
column.value: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ greet you.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I urge you, brothers and sisters, keep your eye on those who cause dissensions and ①hindrances contrary to the teaching which you learned, and turn away from them. ▷ ①Lit occasions of stumbling

column.name: text
column.value: For such people are slaves, not of our Lord Christ but of their own ①appetites; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the unsuspecting. ▷ ①Lit belly

column.name: text
column.value: For the report of your obedience has reached everyone; therefore I am rejoicing over you, but I want you to be wise in what is good, and innocent in what is evil.

column.name: text
column.value: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.

column.name: text
column.value: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, and so do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen.

column.name: text
column.value: I, Tertius, who have written this letter, greet you in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Gaius, host to me and to the whole church, greets you. Erastus, the city treasurer, greets you, and Quartus, the brother. ① ▷ ①Late mss add as v 24: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Now to Him who is able to establish you according to my gospel and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which has been kept secret for long ages past,

column.name: text
column.value: but now has been disclosed, and through the Scriptures of the prophets, in accordance with the commandment of the eternal God, has been made known to all the nations, leading to obedience of faith;

column.name: text
column.value: to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, be the glory forever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: And when I came to you, brothers and sisters, I did not come as someone superior in ①speaking ability or ②wisdom, as I proclaimed to you the ③testimony of God. ▷ ①Lit speech ②Or cleverness ③One early ms mystery

column.name: text
column.value: For I determined to know nothing among you except Jesus Christ, and Him crucified.

column.name: text
column.value: I also was with you in weakness and fear, and in great trembling,

column.name: text
column.value: and my ①message and my preaching were not in persuasive words of ②wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power, ▷ ①Lit word ②Or cleverness

column.name: text
column.value: so that your faith would not ①rest on the ②wisdom of mankind, but on the power of God. ▷ ①Lit be ②Or cleverness

column.name: text
column.value: Yet we do speak wisdom among those who are mature; a wisdom, however, not of this age nor of the rulers of this age, who are passing away;

column.name: text
column.value: but we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the hidden wisdom which God predestined before the ages to our glory;

column.name: text
column.value: the wisdom which none of the rulers of this age has understood; for if they had understood it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory;

column.name: text
column.value: but just as it is written: “THINGS WHICH EYE HAS NOT SEEN AND EAR HAS NOT HEARD, AND which have not entered the human heart, ALL THAT GOD HAS PREPARED FOR THOSE WHO LOVE HIM.”

column.name: text
column.value: ①For to us God revealed them through the Spirit; for the Spirit searches all things, even the depths of God. ▷ ①One early ms But

column.name: text
column.value: For who among people knows the thoughts of a person except the spirit of the person that is in him? So also the thoughts of God no one knows, except the Spirit of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now we have not received the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, so that we may know the things freely given to us by God.

column.name: text
column.value: We also speak these things, not in words taught by human wisdom, but in those taught by the Spirit, ①combining spiritual thoughts with spiritual words. ▷ ①Or interpreting spiritual things for spiritual people

column.name: text
column.value: But ①a natural person does not accept the things of the Spirit of God, for they are foolishness to him; and he cannot understand them, because they are spiritually discerned. ▷ ①Or an unspiritual

column.name: text
column.value: But the one who is spiritual discerns all things, yet he himself is ①discerned by no one. ▷ ①Or judged

column.name: text
column.value: For WHO HAS KNOWN THE MIND OF THE LORD, THAT HE WILL INSTRUCT HIM? But we have the mind of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, called as an apostle of Jesus Christ ①by the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes, ▷ ①Lit through

column.name: text
column.value: To the church of God which is in Corinth, to those who have been sanctified in Christ Jesus, ①saints by calling, with all who in every place call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, their Lord and ours: ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: I thank ①my God always concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus, ▷ ①Two early mss do not contain my

column.name: text
column.value: that in everything you were enriched in Him, in all speech and all knowledge,

column.name: text
column.value: just as the testimony concerning Christ was confirmed ①in you, ▷ ①Or among

column.name: text
column.value: so that you are not lacking in any gift, as you eagerly await the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,

column.name: text
column.value: who will also ①confirm you to the end, blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ. ▷ ①Or strengthen

column.name: text
column.value: God is faithful, through whom you were called into fellowship with His Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I urge you, brothers and sisters, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you all ①agree and that there be no ②divisions among you, but that you be ③made complete in the same mind and in the same judgment. ▷ ①Lit say the same thing ②Lit schisms ③Or united

column.name: text
column.value: For I have been informed concerning you, my brothers and sisters, by Chloe’s people, that there are quarrels among you.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I mean this, that each one of you is saying, “I am ①with Paul,” ②or “I am ③with Apollos,” ④or “I am ⑤with ⑥Cephas,” ⑦or “I am ⑧with Christ.” ▷ ①Lit and ②Lit of ③Lit and ④Lit of ⑤Peter’s Aramaic name ⑥Lit and ⑦Lit of ⑧Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: ①Has Christ been divided? Paul was not crucified for you, was he? Or were you baptized ②in the name of Paul? ▷ ①Or Christ has been divided! or Christ is divided! ②Lit into

column.name: text
column.value: I am thankful that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,

column.name: text
column.value: so that no one would say you were baptized ①in my name! ▷ ①Lit into

column.name: text
column.value: But I did baptize the household of Stephanas also; beyond that, I do not know if I baptized anyone else.

column.name: text
column.value: For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel, not with ①cleverness of speech, so that the cross of Christ would not be made of no effect. ▷ ①I.e., persuasive rhetoric

column.name: text
column.value: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who ①are perishing, but to us who ②are being saved it is the power of God. ▷ ①Or perish ②Or are saved

column.name: text
column.value: For it is written: “I WILL DESTROY THE WISDOM OF THE WISE, AND THE UNDERSTANDING OF THOSE WHO HAVE UNDERSTANDING, I WILL CONFOUND.”

column.name: text
column.value: Where is the wise person? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Has God not made foolish the wisdom of the world?

column.name: text
column.value: For since in the wisdom of God the world through its wisdom did not come to know God, God ①was pleased through the foolishness of the ②message preached to save those who believe. ▷ ①Or resolved ②Lit preaching

column.name: text
column.value: For indeed Jews ask for ①signs and Greeks search for wisdom; ▷ ①Or confirming miracles

column.name: text
column.value: but we preach ①Christ crucified, to Jews a stumbling block, and to Gentiles foolishness, ▷ ①I.e., the Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: but to those who are the called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For the foolishness of God is wiser than mankind, and the weakness of God is stronger than mankind.

column.name: text
column.value: For ①consider your calling, brothers and sisters, that there were not many wise according to ②the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble; ▷ ①Lit see ②I.e., human standards

column.name: text
column.value: but God has chosen the foolish things of the world to shame the wise, and God has chosen the weak things of the world to shame the things which are strong,

column.name: text
column.value: and the ①insignificant things of the world and the despised God has chosen, the things that are not, so that He may nullify the things that are, ▷ ①Or lowly

column.name: text
column.value: so that no ①human may boast before God. ▷ ①Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: But it is ①due to Him that you are in Christ Jesus, who became to us wisdom from God, ②and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption, ▷ ①Lit from Him ②Or both

column.name: text
column.value: so that, just as it is written: “LET THE ONE WHO BOASTS, BOAST IN THE LORD.”

column.name: text
column.value: And I, brothers and sisters, could not speak to you as spiritual people, but only as fleshly, as to infants in Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: I gave you milk to drink, not solid food; for you were not yet able to consume it. But even now you are not yet able,

column.name: text
column.value: for you are still fleshly. For since there is jealousy and strife among you, are you not fleshly, and are you not walking like ordinary people?

column.name: text
column.value: For when one person says, “I am ①with Paul,” and another, “I am ②with Apollos,” are you not ordinary people? ▷ ①Lit of ②Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: What then is Apollos? And what is Paul? Servants through whom you believed, even as the Lord gave opportunity to each one.

column.name: text
column.value: I planted, Apollos watered, but God was causing the growth.

column.name: text
column.value: So then neither the one who plants nor the one who waters is anything, but God who causes the growth.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the one who plants and the one who waters are one; but each will receive his own ①reward according to his own labor. ▷ ①Or wages

column.name: text
column.value: For we are God’s fellow workers; you are God’s ①field, God’s building. ▷ ①Or cultivated land

column.name: text
column.value: According to the grace of God which was given to me, like a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another is building on it. But each person must be careful how he builds on it.

column.name: text
column.value: For no one can lay a foundation other than the one which is laid, which is Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Now if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, or straw,

column.name: text
column.value: each one’s work will become evident; for the day will show it because it is to be revealed with fire, and the fire itself will test ①the quality of each one’s work. ▷ ①Lit of what sort each man’s work is

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone’s work which he has built on it remains, he will receive a reward.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone’s work is burned up, he will suffer loss; but he himself will be saved, yet only so as through fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not know that you are a ①temple of God and that the Spirit of God dwells in you? ▷ ①Or sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone destroys the ①temple of God, God will destroy ②that person; for the ③temple of God is holy, ④and that is what you are. ▷ ①Or sanctuary ②Lit this ③Or sanctuary ④Lit who you are

column.name: text
column.value: Take care that no one deceives himself. If anyone among you thinks that he is wise in this age, he must become foolish, so that he may become wise.

column.name: text
column.value: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness in the sight of God. For it is written: “He is THE ONE WHO CATCHES THE WISE BY THEIR CRAFTINESS”;

column.name: text
column.value: and again, “THE LORD KNOWS THE THOUGHTS of the wise, THAT THEY ARE useless.”

column.name: text
column.value: So then, no one is to be boasting in people. For all things belong to you,

column.name: text
column.value: whether Paul or Apollos or ①Cephas, or the world or life or death, or things present or things to come; all things belong to you, ▷ ①Peter’s Aramaic name

column.name: text
column.value: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the way any person is to regard us: as servants of Christ and stewards of the mysteries of God.

column.name: text
column.value: In this case, moreover, it is required ①of stewards that one be found trustworthy. ▷ ①Lit in

column.name: text
column.value: But to me it is an insignificant matter that I would be examined by you, or by any human ①court; in fact, I do not even examine myself. ▷ ①Lit day

column.name: text
column.value: For I am not aware of anything against myself; however I am not vindicated by this, but the one who examines me is the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore do not go on ①passing judgment before ②the time, but wait until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the things hidden in the darkness and disclose the motives of human hearts; and then praise will come to each person from God. ▷ ①Lit judging anything ②I.e., the appointed time of judgment

column.name: text
column.value: Now these things, brothers and sisters, I have figuratively applied to myself and Apollos on your account, so that in us you may learn not to exceed what is written, so that no one of you will become ①arrogant in behalf of one against the other. ▷ ①Lit puffed up

column.name: text
column.value: For who considers you as superior? What do you have that you did not receive? And if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?

column.name: text
column.value: You are already filled, you have already become rich, you have become kings without us; and indeed, I wish that you had become kings so that we also might reign with you!

column.name: text
column.value: For I think, God has exhibited us, the apostles, last of all as men condemned to death, because we have become a spectacle to the world, both to angels and to mankind.

column.name: text
column.value: We are fools on account of Christ, but you are prudent in Christ! We are weak, but you are strong! You are distinguished, but we are without honor!

column.name: text
column.value: Up to this present hour we are both hungry and thirsty, and are poorly clothed and roughly treated and homeless;

column.name: text
column.value: and we labor, working with our own hands; when we are verbally abused, we bless; when we are persecuted, we endure it;

column.name: text
column.value: when we are slandered, we ①reply as friends; we have become as the scum of the world, the dregs of all things, even until now. ▷ ①Or conciliate

column.name: text
column.value: I do not write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.

column.name: text
column.value: For if you were to have countless tutors in Christ, yet you would not have many fathers, for in Christ Jesus I became your father through the gospel.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I urge you, be imitators of me.

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason I have sent to you Timothy, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, and he will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, just as I teach everywhere in every church.

column.name: text
column.value: Now some have become ①arrogant, as though I were not coming to you. ▷ ①Lit puffed up

column.name: text
column.value: But I will come to you soon, if the Lord wills, and I shall find out, not the ①words of those who are arrogant, but their power. ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: For the kingdom of God is not in ①words, but in power. ▷ ①Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: What do you desire? That I come to you with a rod, or with love and a spirit of gentleness?

column.name: text
column.value: Does any one of you, when he has a ①case against ②his neighbor, dare to go to law before the unrighteous and not before the ③saints? ▷ ①Lit matter ②Lit the other ③Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: Or do you not know that the ①saints will judge the world? If the world is judged by you, are you not competent to form the smallest ②law courts? ▷ ①See note 2 v 1 ②I.e., to try trivial cases

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not know that we will judge angels? How much more matters of this life?

column.name: text
column.value: So if you have law courts dealing with matters of this life, ①do you appoint them as judges who are of no account in the church? ▷ ①Or appoint them...church!

column.name: text
column.value: I say this to your shame. Is it so, that there is not among you anyone wise who will be able to decide between his brothers and sisters,

column.name: text
column.value: but brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers?

column.name: text
column.value: Actually, then, it is already a defeat for you, that you have lawsuits with one another. Why not rather suffer the wrong? Why not rather be defrauded?

column.name: text
column.value: On the contrary, you yourselves do wrong and defraud. And this to your brothers and sisters!

column.name: text
column.value: Or do you not know that the unrighteous will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be deceived; neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor ①homosexuals, ▷ ①Two Gr words in the text, prob. submissive and dominant male homosexuals

column.name: text
column.value: nor thieves, nor the greedy, nor those habitually drunk, nor verbal abusers, nor swindlers, will inherit the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Such were some of you; but you were washed, but you were sanctified, but you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and ①in the Spirit of our God. ▷ ①Or by

column.name: text
column.value: All things are permitted for me, but not all things are of benefit. All things are permitted for me, but I will not be mastered by anything.

column.name: text
column.value: Food is for the stomach and the stomach is for food, however God will do away with both ①of them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord is for the body. ▷ ①Lit this and these

column.name: text
column.value: Now God has not only raised the Lord, but will also raise us up through His power.

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not know that your bodies are parts of Christ? Shall I then take away the parts of Christ and make them parts of a prostitute? ①Far from it! ▷ ①Lit May it never happen!

column.name: text
column.value: Or do you not know that the one who joins himself to a prostitute is one body with her? For He says, “THE TWO SHALL BECOME ONE FLESH.”

column.name: text
column.value: But the one who joins himself to the Lord is one spirit with Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Flee sexual immorality. Every other sin that a person commits is outside the body, but the ①sexually immoral person sins against his own body. ▷ ①Or one who practices sexual immorality

column.name: text
column.value: Or do you not know that your body is a ①temple of the Holy Spirit within you, whom you have from ②God, and that you are not your own? ▷ ①Or sanctuary ②Or God? And you...own

column.name: text
column.value: For you have been bought for a price: therefore glorify God in your body.

column.name: text
column.value: Now concerning the things about which you wrote, it is good for a man ①not to touch a woman. ▷ ①Prob. referring to abstinence

column.name: text
column.value: But because of sexual immoralities, each man is to have his own wife, and each woman is to have her own husband.

column.name: text
column.value: The husband must fulfill his duty to his wife, and likewise the wife also to her husband.

column.name: text
column.value: The wife does not have authority over her own body, but the husband does; and likewise the husband also does not have authority over his own body, but the wife does.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Stop depriving one another, except by agreement for a time so that you may devote yourselves to prayer, and ②come together again so that Satan will not tempt you because of your lack of self-control. ▷ ①Or do not deprive ②Lit be

column.name: text
column.value: But this I say by way of concession, not of command.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Yet I wish that all ②men were even as I myself am. However, each has his own gift from God, one in this way, and another in that. ▷ ①One early ms For ②Or people

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to the unmarried and to widows that it is good for them if they remain even as I.

column.name: text
column.value: But if they do not have self-control, let them marry; for it is better to marry than to burn with passion.

column.name: text
column.value: But to the married I give instructions, not I, but the Lord, that the wife is not to leave her husband

column.name: text
column.value: (but if she does leave, she must remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband is not to ①divorce his wife. ▷ ①Or leave his wife

column.name: text
column.value: But to the rest I say, not the Lord, that if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she consents to live with him, he must not ①divorce her. ▷ ①Or leave her

column.name: text
column.value: And ①if any woman has an unbelieving husband, and he consents to live with her, she must not ②divorce her husband. ▷ ①One early ms any woman who has ②Or leave her husband

column.name: text
column.value: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified through his wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified through ①her believing husband; for otherwise your children are unclean, but now they are holy. ▷ ①Lit the brother

column.name: text
column.value: Yet if the unbelieving one is leaving, ①let him leave; the brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called ②us in peace. ▷ ①One early ms you ②Or then he must leave

column.name: text
column.value: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

column.name: text
column.value: Only, as the Lord has assigned to each one, as God has called each, in this way let him walk. And so I direct in all the churches.

column.name: text
column.value: Was any man called when he was already circumcised? He is not to become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? He is not to be circumcised.

column.name: text
column.value: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is the keeping of the commandments of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Each person is to remain in that ①state in which he was called. ▷ ①Lit calling

column.name: text
column.value: Were you called as a slave? Do not let it concern you. But if you are also able to become free, take advantage of that.

column.name: text
column.value: For the one who was called in the Lord as a slave, is the Lord’s freed person; likewise the one who was called as free, is Christ’s slave.

column.name: text
column.value: You were bought for a price; do not become slaves of people.

column.name: text
column.value: Brothers and sisters, each one is to remain with God in that condition in which he was called.

column.name: text
column.value: Now concerning virgins, I have no command of the Lord, but I am offering direction as one who ①by the mercy of the Lord is trustworthy. ▷ ①Lit has been shown mercy by the Lord to be trustworthy

column.name: text
column.value: I think, then, that this is good in view of the ①present distress, that it is good for a man ②to remain as he is. ▷ ①Or impending ②Lit so to be

column.name: text
column.value: Are you bound to a wife? Do not seek to be released. Are you released from a wife? Do not seek a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you marry, you have not sinned; and if a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such people as yourselves will have ①trouble in this life, and I am trying to spare you. ▷ ①Lit tribulation in the flesh

column.name: text
column.value: But this I say, brothers, the time has been shortened, so that from now on those who have wives should be as though they had none;

column.name: text
column.value: and those who weep, as though they did not weep; and those who rejoice, as though they did not rejoice; and those who buy, as though they did not possess;

column.name: text
column.value: and those who use the world, as though they did not make full use of it; for the present form of this world is passing away.

column.name: text
column.value: But I want you to be free from concern. One who is unmarried is concerned about the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;

column.name: text
column.value: but one who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife,

column.name: text
column.value: and his interests are divided. The woman who is unmarried, and the virgin, is concerned about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and spirit; but one who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how she may please her husband.

column.name: text
column.value: I say this for your own benefit, not to put a restraint on you, but ①to promote what is appropriate and to secure undistracted devotion to the Lord. ▷ ①Lit for what is seemly

column.name: text
column.value: But if anyone thinks that he is acting dishonorably toward his virgin, if she is ①past her youth and it ought to be so, let him do what he wishes, he is not sinning; let ②them marry. ▷ ①Or past puberty ②I.e., the woman and her betrothed or fiancé

column.name: text
column.value: But the one who stands firm in his heart, ①if he is not under constraint, but has authority ②over his own will, and has decided this in his own heart, to keep his own virgin, he will do well. ▷ ①Lit having no necessity ②Lit pertaining to

column.name: text
column.value: So then, both the one who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and the one who does not give her in marriage will do better.

column.name: text
column.value: A wife is bound as long as her husband lives; but if her husband ①dies, she is free to be married to whom she wishes, only in the Lord. ▷ ①Lit falls asleep

column.name: text
column.value: But in my opinion she is ①happier if she remains as she is; and I think that I also have the Spirit of God. ▷ ①Or more fortunate

column.name: text
column.value: Now concerning food sacrificed to idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge ①makes one conceited, but love edifies people. ▷ ①Lit puffs up

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone thinks that he knows anything, he has not yet known as he ought to know;

column.name: text
column.value: but if anyone loves God, he is known by Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, concerning the eating of food sacrificed to idols, we know that an idol is ①nothing at all in the world, and that there is no God but one. ▷ ①I.e., what it represents does not exist

column.name: text
column.value: For even if there are so-called gods whether in heaven or on earth, as indeed there are many gods and many lords,

column.name: text
column.value: yet for us there is only one God, the Father, from whom are all things, and we exist for Him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we exist through Him.

column.name: text
column.value: However, not all people have this knowledge; but some, being accustomed to the idol until now, eat food as if it were sacrificed to an idol; and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

column.name: text
column.value: Now food will not bring us ①close to God; we are neither ②the worse if we do not eat, nor ③the better if we do eat. ▷ ①Or before God ②Lit lacking ③Lit abounding

column.name: text
column.value: But take care that this ①freedom of yours does not somehow become a stumbling block to the weak. ▷ ①Lit right

column.name: text
column.value: For if someone sees you, the one who has knowledge, dining in an idol’s temple, will his conscience, if he is weak, not be strengthened to eat things sacrificed to idols?

column.name: text
column.value: For through your knowledge the one who is weak is ruined, the brother or sister for whose sake Christ died.

column.name: text
column.value: And so, by sinning against the brothers and sisters and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, if food causes my brother to sin, I will never eat meat again, so that I will not cause my brother to sin.

column.name: text
