column.value: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are you not my work in the Lord?

column.name: text
column.value: If I am not an apostle to others, at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: My defense to those who examine me is this:

column.name: text
column.value: ①Do we not have a right to eat and drink? ▷ ①Lit It is not that we have no right to eat and drink, is it?

column.name: text
column.value: ①Do we not have a right to take along a ②believing wife, even as the rest of the apostles and the brothers of the Lord, and ③Cephas? ▷ ①Lit It is not that we have no right to take along...Cephas, is it? ②Lit sister, as a wife ③Peter’s Aramaic name

column.name: text
column.value: Or do only ①Barnabas and I have no right to refrain from ②working? ▷ ①Lit I and Barnabas ②I.e., to support themselves

column.name: text
column.value: Who at any time serves as a soldier at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat its fruit? Or who tends a flock and does not ①consume some of the milk of the flock? ▷ ①Lit eat from

column.name: text
column.value: I am not just asserting these things according to human judgment, am I? Or does the Law not say these things as well?

column.name: text
column.value: For it is written in the Law of Moses: “YOU SHALL NOT MUZZLE THE OX WHILE IT IS THRESHING.” God is not concerned about oxen, is He?

column.name: text
column.value: Or is He speaking entirely for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because the plowman ought to plow in hope, and the thresher to thresh in hope of sharing in the crops.

column.name: text
column.value: If we sowed spiritual things in you, is it too much if we reap material things from you?

column.name: text
column.value: If others share the right over you, do we not more? Nevertheless, we did not use this right, but we endure all things so that we will cause no hindrance to the gospel of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not know that those who perform sacred services eat the food of the temple, and those who attend regularly to the altar have their share ①from the altar? ▷ ①Lit with

column.name: text
column.value: So also the Lord directed those who proclaim the gospel to get their living from the gospel.

column.name: text
column.value: But I have used none of these things. And I have not written these things so that it will be done so in my case; for it would be better for me to die than that. No one shall make my boast an empty one!

column.name: text
column.value: For if I preach the gospel, I have nothing to boast about, for I am under compulsion; for woe to me if I do not preach the gospel.

column.name: text
column.value: For if I do this voluntarily, I have a reward; but if against my will, I have been entrusted with a commission nonetheless.

column.name: text
column.value: What, then, is my reward? That, when I preach the gospel, I may offer the gospel without charge, so as not to make full use of my right in the gospel.

column.name: text
column.value: For though I am free from all people, I have made myself a slave to all, so that I may gain more.

column.name: text
column.value: To the Jews I became as a Jew, so that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the Law, I became as one under the Law, though not being under the Law myself, so that I might gain those who are under the Law;

column.name: text
column.value: to those who are without the Law, I became as one without the Law, though not being without the law of God but under the law of Christ, so that I might gain those who are without the Law.

column.name: text
column.value: To the weak I became weak, that I might gain the weak; I have become all things to all people, so that I may by all means save some.

column.name: text
column.value: I do all things for the sake of the gospel, so that I may become a fellow partaker of it.

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not know that those who run in a race all run, but only one receives the prize? Run in such a way that you may win.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone who competes in the games exercises self-control in all things. So they do it to obtain a perishable wreath, but we an imperishable.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I run in such a way as not to run aimlessly; I box in such a way, as ①to avoid hitting air; ▷ ①Lit not hitting

column.name: text
column.value: but I strictly discipline my body and make it my slave, so that, after I have preached to others, I myself will not be disqualified.

column.name: text
column.value: For I do not want you to be unaware, brothers and sisters, that our fathers were all under the cloud and they all passed through the sea;

column.name: text
column.value: and they all were baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

column.name: text
column.value: and they all ate the same spiritual food,

column.name: text
column.value: and all drank the same spiritual drink, for they were drinking from a spiritual rock which followed them; and the rock was ①Christ. ▷ ①I.e., the Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, with most of them God was not pleased; for their dead bodies were spread out in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these things happened as examples for us, so that we would not crave evil things as they indeed craved them.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be idolaters, as some of them were; as it is written: “THE PEOPLE SAT DOWN TO EAT AND TO DRINK, AND ROSE UP TO PLAY.”

column.name: text
column.value: Nor are we to commit sexual immorality, as some of them ①did, and twenty-three thousand fell in one day. ▷ ①Lit committed sexual immorality

column.name: text
column.value: Nor are we to put the Lord to the test, as some of them ①did, and were killed by the snakes. ▷ ①Lit made trial

column.name: text
column.value: Nor grumble, as some of them ①did, and were killed by the destroyer. ▷ ①Lit grumbled

column.name: text
column.value: Now these things happened to them as an example, and they were written for our instruction, upon whom the ends of the ages have come.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore let the one who thinks he stands watch out that he does not fall.

column.name: text
column.value: No temptation has overtaken you except something common to mankind; and God is faithful, ①so He will not allow you to be tempted beyond what you are able, but with the temptation will provide the way of escape also, so that you will be able to endure it. ▷ ①Lit who will not

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

column.name: text
column.value: I speak as to wise people; you then, judge what I say.

column.name: text
column.value: Is the cup of blessing which we bless not a sharing in the blood of Christ? Is the bread which we break not a sharing in the body of Christ?

column.name: text
column.value: Since there is one loaf, we who are many are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf.

column.name: text
column.value: Look at ①the people of Israel; are those who eat the sacrifices not partners in the altar? ▷ ①Lit Israel according to the flesh

column.name: text
column.value: What do I mean then? That food sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is ①anything? ▷ ①I.e., anything real

column.name: text
column.value: No, but I say that things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God; and I do not want you to become partners with demons.

column.name: text
column.value: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons; you cannot partake of the table of the Lord and the table of demons.

column.name: text
column.value: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? We are not stronger than He, are we?

column.name: text
column.value: All things are permitted, but not all things are of benefit. All things are permitted, but not all things ①build people up. ▷ ①Or edify

column.name: text
column.value: No one is to seek his own advantage, but rather that of his ①neighbor. ▷ ①Lit the other

column.name: text
column.value: Eat anything that is sold in the meat market without asking questions, for the sake of conscience;

column.name: text
column.value: FOR THE EARTH IS THE LORD’S, AND ①ALL IT CONTAINS. ▷ ①Lit its fullness

column.name: text
column.value: If one of the unbelievers invites you and you want to go, eat anything that is set before you without asking questions, for the sake of conscience.

column.name: text
column.value: But if anyone says to you, “This is meat sacrificed to idols,” do not eat it, for the sake of that one who informed you and for the sake of conscience;

column.name: text
column.value: Now by “conscience” I do not mean your own, but the other person’s; for why is my freedom judged by another’s conscience?

column.name: text
column.value: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I slandered about that for which I give thanks?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all things for the glory of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not offend Jews or Greeks, or the church of God;

column.name: text
column.value: just as I also please everyone in all things, not seeking my own benefit but the benefit of the many, so that they may be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brothers and sisters, I do not want you to be unaware.

column.name: text
column.value: You know that when you were ①pagans, you were led ②astray to the mute idols, however you were led. ▷ ①Lit Gentiles; i.e., mainly Greeks and Romans, traditionally polytheistic ②Or away

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I make known to you that no one speaking ①by the Spirit of God says, “Jesus is ②accursed”; and no one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” except ③by the Holy Spirit. ▷ ①Or in ②Gr anathema ③Or in

column.name: text
column.value: Now there are varieties of gifts, but the same Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And there are varieties of ministries, and the same Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: There are varieties of effects, but the same God who works all things in all persons.

column.name: text
column.value: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the common good.

column.name: text
column.value: For to one is given the word of wisdom through the Spirit, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit;

column.name: text
column.value: to another faith ①by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of ②healing ③by the one Spirit, ▷ ①Or in ②Lit healings ③Or in

column.name: text
column.value: and to another the ①effecting of ②miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another the ③distinguishing of spirits, to another various kinds of tongues, and to another the interpretation of tongues. ▷ ①Lit effects ②Or works of power ③Lit distinguishings

column.name: text
column.value: But one and the same Spirit works all these things, distributing to each one individually just as He ①wills. ▷ ①Or intends

column.name: text
column.value: For just as the body is one and yet has many parts, and all the parts of the body, though they are many, are one body, so also is Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For ①by one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether slaves or free, and we were all made to drink of one Spirit. ▷ ①Or in

column.name: text
column.value: For the body is not one part, but many.

column.name: text
column.value: If the foot says, “Because I am not a hand, I am not a part of the body,” it is not for this reason ①any less a part of the body. ▷ ①Lit not a part

column.name: text
column.value: And if the ear says, “Because I am not an eye, I am not a part of the body,” it is not for this reason ①any less a part of the body. ▷ ①Lit not a part

column.name: text
column.value: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole body were hearing, where would the sense of smell be?

column.name: text
column.value: But now God has arranged the parts, each one of them in the body, just as He desired.

column.name: text
column.value: If they were all one part, where would the body be?

column.name: text
column.value: But now there are many parts, but one body.

column.name: text
column.value: And the eye cannot say to the hand, “I have no need of you”; or again, the head to the feet, “I have no need of you.”

column.name: text
column.value: On the contrary, ①it is much truer that the parts of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary; ▷ ①Lit to a much greater degree the parts

column.name: text
column.value: and those parts of the body which we ①consider less honorable, ②on these we bestow greater honor, and our less presentable parts become much more presentable, ▷ ①Or think to be ②Or these we clothe with

column.name: text
column.value: whereas our more presentable parts have no need of it. But God has so composed the body, giving more abundant honor to that part which lacked,

column.name: text
column.value: so that there may be no ①division in the body, but that the parts may have the same care for one another. ▷ ①Or dissension

column.name: text
column.value: And if one part of the body suffers, all the parts suffer with it; if a part is ①honored, all the parts rejoice with it. ▷ ①Lit glorified

column.name: text
column.value: Now you are Christ’s body, and individually parts of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And God has ①appointed in the church, first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then ②miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, administrations, and various kinds of tongues. ▷ ①Lit set some in ②Or works of power

column.name: text
column.value: All are not apostles, are they? All are not prophets, are they? All are not teachers, are they? All are not workers of ①miracles, are they? ▷ ①Or works of power

column.name: text
column.value: All do not have gifts of healings, do they? All do not speak with tongues, do they? All do not interpret, do they?

column.name: text
column.value: But earnestly desire the greater gifts. And yet, I am going to show you a far better way.

column.name: text
column.value: Be imitators of me, just as I also am of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I praise you because you remember me in everything and hold firmly to the traditions, just as I handed them down to you.

column.name: text
column.value: But I want you to understand that Christ is the head of every man, and ①the man is the head of a woman, and God is the head of Christ. ▷ ①Or the head of a woman is her husband

column.name: text
column.value: Every man who has something on his head while praying or prophesying disgraces his head.

column.name: text
column.value: But every woman who has her head uncovered while praying or prophesying disgraces her head, for it is one and the same as the woman ①whose head is shaved. ▷ ①Lit who is shaved

column.name: text
column.value: For if a woman does not cover ①her head, have her also ②cut her hair off; however, if it is disgraceful for a woman to ③have her hair cut off or ④her head shaved, have her cover ⑤her head. ▷ ①Lit herself ②Lit shear herself ③Lit shear herself ④Lit herself ⑤Lit herself

column.name: text
column.value: For a man should not have his head covered, since he is the image and glory of God; but the woman is the glory of man.

column.name: text
column.value: For man ①does not originate from woman, but woman from man; ▷ ①Lit is not from

column.name: text
column.value: for indeed man was not created for the woman’s sake, but woman for the man’s sake.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the woman should have a symbol of authority on her head, because of the angels.

column.name: text
column.value: However, in the Lord, neither is woman ①independent of man, nor is man ②independent of woman. ▷ ①Lit without ②Lit without

column.name: text
column.value: For as the woman originated from the man, so also the man has his birth through the woman; and all things originate from God.

column.name: text
column.value: Judge ①for yourselves: is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered? ▷ ①Lit among

column.name: text
column.value: Does even nature itself not teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him,

column.name: text
column.value: but if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her? For her hair is given to her as a covering.

column.name: text
column.value: But if anyone is inclined to be contentious, we have no ①such practice, nor have the churches of God. ▷ ①I.e., the one advocated by Paul’s opponents

column.name: text
column.value: Now in giving this next instruction I do not praise you, because you come together not for the better, but for the worse.

column.name: text
column.value: For, in the first place, when you come together ①as a church, I hear that ②divisions exist among you; and in part I believe it. ▷ ①Lit in church ②Or dissensions

column.name: text
column.value: For there also have to be factions among you, so that those who are approved may become ①evident among you. ▷ ①Or recognizable

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore when you come together it is not to eat the Lord’s Supper,

column.name: text
column.value: for when you eat, each one takes his own supper first; and one goes hungry while another gets drunk.

column.name: text
column.value: What! Do you not have houses in which to eat and drink? Or do you despise the church of God and shame those who have nothing? What am I to say to you? Shall I praise you? In this I do not praise you.

column.name: text
column.value: For I received from the Lord that which I also delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus, on the night when He was betrayed, took bread;

column.name: text
column.value: and when He had given thanks, He broke it and said, “This is My body, which is for you; do this in remembrance of Me.”

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way He also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood; do this, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of Me.”

column.name: text
column.value: For as often as you eat this bread and drink the cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until He comes.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy way, shall be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: But a person must examine himself, and in so doing he is to eat of the bread and drink of the cup.

column.name: text
column.value: For the one who eats and drinks, eats and drinks judgment to himself if he does not properly recognize the ①body. ▷ ①I.e., body of the Lord

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason many among you are weak and sick, and a number ①are asleep. ▷ ①I.e., are dead

column.name: text
column.value: But if we judged ourselves rightly, we would not be judged.

column.name: text
column.value: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord so that we will not be condemned along with the world.

column.name: text
column.value: So then, my brothers and sisters, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone is hungry, have him eat at home, so that you do not come together for judgment. As to the remaining matters, I will give instructions when I come.

column.name: text
column.value: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and sexual immorality of such a kind as does not exist even among the Gentiles, namely, that someone has his father’s wife.

column.name: text
column.value: ①You have become ②arrogant and ③have not mourned instead, so that the one who had done this deed would be removed from your midst. ▷ ①Or have you...? ②Lit puffed up ③Or have you...?

column.name: text
column.value: For I, on my part, though absent in body but present in spirit, have already judged him who has so committed this, as though I were present.

column.name: text
column.value: In the name of our Lord Jesus, when you are assembled, and ①I with you in spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus, ▷ ①Lit my spirit, with the power

column.name: text
column.value: I have decided ①to turn such a person over to Satan for the destruction of his ②body, so that his spirit may be saved on the day of the ③Lord. ▷ ①Or that you are to turn ②Lit flesh ③One early ms Lord Jesus

column.name: text
column.value: Your boasting is not good. Do you not know that a little ①leaven leavens the whole lump of dough? ▷ ①I.e., fermented dough

column.name: text
column.value: Clean out the old leaven so that you may be a new lump, just as you are in fact unleavened. For Christ our Passover also has been sacrificed.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore let’s celebrate the feast, not with old leaven, nor with the leaven of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

column.name: text
column.value: I wrote to you in my letter not to associate with sexually immoral people;

column.name: text
column.value: I did not at all mean with the sexually immoral people of this world, or with the greedy and swindlers, or with idolaters, for then you would have to leave the world.

column.name: text
column.value: But ①actually, I ②wrote to you not to associate ③with any so-called brother if he is a sexually immoral person, or a greedy person, or an idolater, or is verbally abusive, or habitually drunk, or a swindler—not even to eat with such a person. ▷ ①Lit now ②Or have written ③Lit together if anyone called a brother is

column.name: text
column.value: For what business of mine is it to judge outsiders? Do you not judge those who are within the church?

column.name: text
column.value: But those who are outside, God ①judges. REMOVE THE EVIL PERSON FROM AMONG YOURSELVES. ▷ ①Or will judge

column.name: text
column.value: If I speak with the tongues of mankind and of angels, but do not have love, I have become a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.

column.name: text
column.value: If I have the gift of prophecy and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith so as to remove mountains, but do not have love, I am nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: And if I give away all my possessions to charity, and if I surrender my body so that I may ①glory, but do not have love, it does me no good. ▷ ①I.e., in martyrdom

column.name: text
column.value: Love is patient, love is kind, it is not jealous; love does not brag, it is not arrogant.

column.name: text
column.value: It does not act disgracefully, it does not seek its own benefit; it is not provoked, does not keep an account of a wrong suffered,

column.name: text
column.value: it does not rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

column.name: text
column.value: it ①keeps every confidence, it believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things. ▷ ①Lit covers all things

column.name: text
column.value: Love never fails; but if there are gifts of ①prophecy, they will be done away with; if there are tongues, they will cease; if there is knowledge, it will be done away with. ▷ ①Lit prophecies

column.name: text
column.value: For we know in part and prophesy in part;

column.name: text
column.value: but when the perfect comes, the partial will be done away with.

column.name: text
column.value: When I was a child, I used to speak like a child, think like a child, reason like a child; when I ①became a man, I did away with childish things. ▷ ①Lit have become...have done away with

column.name: text
column.value: For now we see in a mirror ①dimly, but then face to face; now I know in part, but then I will know fully, just as I also have been fully known. ▷ ①Lit in a riddle

column.name: text
column.value: But now faith, hope, and love remain, these three; but the ①greatest of these is love. ▷ ①Lit greater

column.name: text
column.value: Pursue love, yet earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

column.name: text
column.value: For the one who speaks in a tongue does not speak to people, but to God; for no one ①understands, but ②in his spirit he speaks mysteries. ▷ ①Lit hears ②Or by the Spirit

column.name: text
column.value: But the one who prophesies speaks to people for edification, ①exhortation, and consolation. ▷ ①Or encouragement

column.name: text
column.value: The one who speaks in a tongue edifies himself; but the one who prophesies edifies the church.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I wish that you all spoke in tongues, but rather that you would prophesy; and greater is the one who prophesies than the one who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets, so that the church may receive edification.

column.name: text
column.value: But now, brothers and sisters, if I come to you speaking in tongues, how will I benefit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophecy, or of teaching?

column.name: text
column.value: Yet even lifeless instruments, whether flute or harp, in producing a sound, if they do not produce a distinction in the tones, how will it be known what is played on the flute or on the harp?

column.name: text
column.value: For if the trumpet produces an indistinct sound, who will prepare himself for battle?

column.name: text
column.value: So you too, unless you produce intelligible speech by the tongue, how will it be known what is spoken? For you will just be talking to the air.

column.name: text
column.value: There are, perhaps, a great many kinds of ①languages in the world, and none is incapable of meaning. ▷ ①Lit voices

column.name: text
column.value: So if I do not know the meaning of the language, I will be unintelligible to the one who speaks, and the one who speaks will be unintelligible ①to me. ▷ ①Or in my estimation

column.name: text
column.value: So you too, since you are eager to possess ①spiritual gifts, strive to excel for the edification of the church. ▷ ①Lit spirits

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, one who speaks in a tongue is to pray that he may interpret.

column.name: text
column.value: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unproductive.

column.name: text
column.value: What is the outcome then? I will pray with the spirit, but I will pray with the mind also; I will sing with the spirit, but I will sing with the mind also.

column.name: text
column.value: For otherwise, if you bless God ①in the spirit only, how will the one who occupies the place of the ②outsider know to say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, since he does not understand what you are saying? ▷ ①Or with the ②Lit private person

column.name: text
column.value: For you are giving thanks well enough, but the other person is not edified.

column.name: text
column.value: I thank God, I speak in tongues more than you all;

column.name: text
column.value: nevertheless, in church I prefer to speak five words with my mind so that I may instruct others also, rather than ten thousand words in a tongue.

column.name: text
column.value: Brothers and sisters, do not be children in your thinking; yet in evil be infants, but in your thinking be mature.

column.name: text
column.value: In the ①Law it is written: “BY MEN OF STRANGE TONGUES AND BY THE LIPS OF STRANGERS I WILL SPEAK TO THIS PEOPLE, AND EVEN SO THEY WILL NOT LISTEN TO ME,” says the Lord. ▷ ①I.e., Old Testament, Isaiah

column.name: text
column.value: So then, tongues are for a sign, not to those who believe but to unbelievers; but prophecy is not for unbelievers, but for those who believe.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore if the whole church gathers together and all the people speak in tongues, and ①outsiders or unbelievers enter, will they not say that you are insane? ▷ ①See note 2 v 16

column.name: text
column.value: But if all prophesy, and an unbeliever or an ①outsider enters, he is convicted by all, he is called to account by all; ▷ ①See note 2 v 16

column.name: text
column.value: the secrets of his heart are disclosed; and so he will fall on his face and worship God, declaring that God is certainly among you.

column.name: text
column.value: What is the outcome then, brothers and sisters? When you assemble, each one has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has a tongue, has an interpretation. All things are to be done for edification.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone speaks in a tongue, it must be by two or at the most three, and each one in turn, and one is to interpret;

column.name: text
column.value: but if there is no interpreter, he is to keep silent in church; and have him speak to himself and to God.

column.name: text
column.value: Have two or three prophets speak, and have the others pass judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: But if a revelation is made to another who is seated, then the first one is to keep silent.

column.name: text
column.value: For you can all prophesy one by one, so that all may learn and all may be ①exhorted; ▷ ①Or encouraged

column.name: text
column.value: and the spirits of prophets are subject to prophets;

column.name: text
column.value: for God is not a God of confusion, but of peace. As in all the churches of the ①saints, ▷ ①I.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: the women are to keep silent in the churches; for they are not permitted to speak, but are to subject themselves, just as the Law also says.

column.name: text
column.value: If they desire to learn anything, let them ask their own husbands at home; for it is ①improper for a woman to speak in church. ▷ ①Or disgraceful

column.name: text
column.value: Or was it from you that the word of God first went out? Or has it come to you only?

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone thinks that he is a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize that the things which I write to you are the Lord’s commandment.

column.name: text
column.value: But if anyone does not recognize this, ①he is not recognized. ▷ ①Two early mss let him continue not to recognize it

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, my brothers and sisters, earnestly desire to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.

column.name: text
column.value: But all things must be done properly and in an orderly way.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I make known to you, brothers and sisters, the gospel which I preached to you, which you also received, in which you also stand,

column.name: text
column.value: by which you also are saved, if you hold firmly to ①the word which I preached to you, unless you believed in vain. ▷ ①Lit to what word I

column.name: text
column.value: For I handed down to you ①as of first importance what I also received, that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures, ▷ ①Lit among the first

column.name: text
column.value: and that He was buried, and that He was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

column.name: text
column.value: and that He appeared to ①Cephas, then to the twelve. ▷ ①Peter’s Aramaic name

column.name: text
column.value: After that He appeared to more than five hundred brothers and sisters at one time, most of whom remain until now, but some have fallen asleep;

column.name: text
column.value: then He appeared to ①James, then to all the apostles; ▷ ①Or Jacob

column.name: text
column.value: and last of all, as ①to one untimely born, He appeared to me also. ▷ ①Lit to an untimely birth

column.name: text
column.value: For I am the least of the apostles, ①and not fit to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God. ▷ ①Lit who am

column.name: text
column.value: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and His grace toward me did not prove vain; but I labored even more than all of them, yet not I, but the grace of God with me.

column.name: text
column.value: Whether then it was I or they, so we preach and so you believed.

column.name: text
column.value: Now if Christ is preached, that He has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

column.name: text
column.value: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised;

column.name: text
column.value: and if Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain, your faith also is in vain.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, we are even found to be false witnesses of God, because we testified ①against God that He raised ②Christ, whom He did not raise, if in fact the dead are not raised. ▷ ①Or concerning ②I.e., the Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: For if the dead are not raised, then not even Christ has been raised;

column.name: text
column.value: and if Christ has not been raised, your faith is worthless; you are still in your sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Then also those who have fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

column.name: text
column.value: If we have hoped in Christ only in this life, we are of all people most to be pitied.

column.name: text
column.value: But the fact is, Christ has been raised from the dead, the first fruits of those who are asleep.

column.name: text
column.value: For since by a man death came, by a man also came the resurrection of the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: For as in Adam all die, so also in ①Christ all will be made alive. ▷ ①I.e., the Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, after that those who are Christ’s at His coming,

column.name: text
column.value: then comes the end, when He hands over the kingdom to our God and Father, when He has abolished all rule and all authority and power.

column.name: text
column.value: For He must reign until He has put all His enemies under His feet.

column.name: text
column.value: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.

column.name: text
column.value: For HE HAS PUT ALL THINGS IN SUBJECTION UNDER HIS FEET. But when He says, “All things are put in subjection,” it is clear that ①this excludes the Father who put all things in subjection to Him. ▷ ①Lit except the

column.name: text
column.value: When all things are subjected to Him, then the Son Himself will also be subjected to the One who subjected all things to Him, so that God may be all in all.

column.name: text
column.value: For otherwise, what will those do who are baptized ①for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why then are they baptized ②for them? ▷ ①Or in behalf of ②Or in behalf of

column.name: text
column.value: Why are we also in danger every hour?

column.name: text
column.value: I affirm, brothers and sisters, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, that I die daily.

column.name: text
column.value: If ①from human motives I fought with wild beasts at Ephesus, what good is it to me? If the dead are not raised, LET’S EAT AND DRINK, FOR TOMORROW WE DIE. ▷ ①Lit according to man

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be deceived: “Bad company corrupts good morals.”

column.name: text
column.value: Sober up ①morally and stop sinning, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame. ▷ ①Lit righteously

column.name: text
column.value: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised? And with what kind of body do they come?”

column.name: text
column.value: You fool! That which you sow does not come to life unless it dies;

column.name: text
column.value: and that which you sow, you do not sow the body which is to be, but a bare grain, perhaps of wheat or of ①something else. ▷ ①Lit some of the rest

column.name: text
column.value: But God gives it a body just as He wished, and to each of the seeds a body of its own.

column.name: text
column.value: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of mankind, another flesh of animals, another flesh of birds, and another of fish.

column.name: text
column.value: There are also heavenly bodies and earthly bodies, but the glory of the heavenly is one, and the glory of the earthly is another.

column.name: text
column.value: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for star differs from star in glory.

column.name: text
column.value: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown ①a perishable body, it is raised ②an imperishable body; ▷ ①Lit in corruption ②Lit in incorruption

column.name: text
column.value: it is sown in dishonor, it is raised in glory; it is sown in weakness, it is raised in power;

column.name: text
column.value: it is sown a natural body, it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.

column.name: text
column.value: So also it is written: “The first MAN, Adam, BECAME A LIVING ①PERSON.” The last Adam was a life-giving spirit. ▷ ①Or soul

column.name: text
column.value: However, the spiritual is not first, but the natural; then the spiritual.

column.name: text
column.value: The first man is from the earth, ①earthy; the second man is from heaven. ▷ ①Or made of dust, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: As is the earthy one, so also are those who are earthy; and as is the heavenly one, so also are those who are heavenly.

column.name: text
column.value: Just as we have borne the image of the earthy, ①we will also bear the image of the heavenly. ▷ ①Two early mss let’s also

column.name: text
column.value: Now I say this, brothers and sisters, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; nor does ①the perishable inherit ②the imperishable. ▷ ①Lit corruption ②Lit incorruption

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I am telling you a ①mystery; we will not all sleep, but we will all be changed, ▷ ①Or secret

column.name: text
column.value: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet; for the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised ①imperishable, and we will be changed. ▷ ①Lit incorruptible

column.name: text
column.value: For this ①perishable must put on ②the imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality. ▷ ①Lit corruptible ②Lit incorruption

column.name: text
column.value: But when this ①perishable puts on ②the imperishable, and this mortal puts on immortality, then will come about the saying that is written: “DEATH HAS BEEN SWALLOWED UP in victory. ▷ ①Lit corruptible ②Lit incorruption

column.name: text
column.value: WHERE, O DEATH, IS YOUR VICTORY? WHERE, O DEATH, IS YOUR STING?”

column.name: text
column.value: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the Law;

column.name: text
column.value: but thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, my beloved brothers and sisters, be firm, immovable, always excelling in the work of the Lord, knowing that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Now concerning the collection for ①the saints, as I directed the churches of Galatia, so you are to do as well. ▷ ①I.e., the Christians in Jerusalem

column.name: text
column.value: On the first day of every week, each of you is to ①put aside and save as he may prosper, so that no collections need to be made when I come. ▷ ①Lit put with himself

column.name: text
column.value: When I arrive, whomever you approve, I will send them with letters to take your gift to Jerusalem;

column.name: text
column.value: and if it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will come to you after I go through Macedonia; for I am going through Macedonia,

column.name: text
column.value: and perhaps I will stay with you or even spend the winter, so that you may send me on my way wherever I go.

column.name: text
column.value: For I do not want to see you now just in passing; for I hope to remain with you for some time, if the Lord permits.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will remain in Ephesus until Pentecost;

column.name: text
column.value: for a wide door ①for effective service has opened to me, and there are many adversaries. ▷ ①Lit and effective

column.name: text
column.value: Now if Timothy comes, see that he ①has no reason to be afraid while among you, for he is doing the Lord’s work, as I also am. ▷ ①Lit is with you without reason to fear

column.name: text
column.value: So do not look down on him, anyone. But send him on his way in peace, so that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

column.name: text
column.value: Now concerning our brother Apollos, I strongly encouraged him to come to you with the brothers; and it was not at all his desire to come now, but he will come when he has the opportunity.

column.name: text
column.value: Be on the alert, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong.

column.name: text
column.value: All that you do must be done in love.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I urge you, brothers and sisters: you know the household of Stephanas, that ①they are the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have devoted themselves to ministry to the ②saints; ▷ ①Lit it is ②Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: I urge that you also be subject to such as these and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

column.name: text
column.value: I rejoice over the ①coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus, because they have ②supplied what was lacking on your part. ▷ ①Or presence ②Or made up for your absence

column.name: text
column.value: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge such men.

column.name: text
column.value: The churches of ①Asia greet you. Aquila and Prisca greet you heartily in the Lord, with the church that is in their house. ▷ ①I.e., west coast province of Asia Minor

column.name: text
column.value: All the brothers and sisters greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

column.name: text
column.value: The greeting is in my own hand—that of Paul.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone does not love the Lord, he is to be ①accursed. ②Maranatha! ▷ ①Gr anathema ②Aramaic [Our] Lord, come!

column.name: text
column.value: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.

column.name: text
column.value: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: But I decided this ①for my own sake, that I would not come to you in sorrow again. ▷ ①Or as far as I am concerned

column.name: text
column.value: For if I cause you sorrow, who then will be the one making me glad but the one who is made sorrowful by me?

column.name: text
column.value: This is the very thing I wrote you, so that when I came, I would not have sorrow from those who ought to make me rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy was the joy of you all.

column.name: text
column.value: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears; not so that you would be made sorrowful, but that you might know the love which I have especially for you.

column.name: text
column.value: But if anyone has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not for me, but in some degree— ①not to say too much—for all of you. ▷ ①Lit so that I not be burdensome

column.name: text
column.value: Sufficient for such a person is this punishment which was imposed by the majority,

column.name: text
column.value: so that on the other hand, you should rather forgive and comfort him, otherwise such a person might be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I urge you to reaffirm your love for him.

column.name: text
column.value: For to this end I also wrote, so that I might ①put you to the test, whether you are obedient in all things. ▷ ①Lit know the proof of you

column.name: text
column.value: But one whom you forgive anything, I also forgive; for indeed what I have forgiven, if I have forgiven anything, I did so for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

column.name: text
column.value: so that no advantage would be taken of us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when I came to Troas for the gospel of Christ and when a door was opened for me in the Lord,

column.name: text
column.value: I had no rest for my spirit, not finding Titus my brother; but saying goodbye to them, I went on to Macedonia.

column.name: text
column.value: But thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and through us reveals the fragrance of the knowledge of Him in every place.

column.name: text
column.value: For we are a fragrance of Christ to God among those who are being saved and among those who are perishing:

column.name: text
column.value: to the one an ①aroma from death to death, to the other an aroma from life to life. And who is adequate for these things? ▷ ①Or odor

column.name: text
column.value: For we are not like the many, ①peddling the word of God, but as from sincerity, but as from God, we speak in Christ in the sight of God. ▷ ①Or diluting

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and our brother Timothy, To the church of God which is at Corinth with all the ①saints who are throughout Achaia: ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,

column.name: text
column.value: who comforts us in all our affliction so that we will be able to comfort those who are in ①any affliction with the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God. ▷ ①Lit every

column.name: text
column.value: For just as the sufferings of Christ are ①ours in abundance, so also our comfort is abundant through Christ. ▷ ①Lit to us

column.name: text
column.value: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; or if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which is effective in the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer;

column.name: text
column.value: and our hope for you is firmly grounded, knowing that as you are partners in our sufferings, so also you are in our comfort.

column.name: text
column.value: For we do not want you to be unaware, brothers and sisters, of our affliction which occurred in ①Asia, that we were burdened excessively, beyond our strength, so that we despaired even of life. ▷ ①I.e., west coast province of Asia Minor

column.name: text
column.value: ①Indeed, we had the sentence of death within ourselves so that we would not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead, ▷ ①Lit But we ourselves

column.name: text
column.value: who rescued us from so great a danger of death, and will rescue us, He ①on whom we have set our hope. And He will yet deliver us, ▷ ①One early ms on whom we have set our hope that He will also

column.name: text
column.value: if you also join in helping us through your prayers, so that thanks may be given by many persons in our behalf for the favor granted to us through the prayers of many.

column.name: text
column.value: For our ①proud confidence is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and godly sincerity, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we have conducted ourselves in the world, and especially toward you. ▷ ①Or source of pride

column.name: text
column.value: For we write nothing else to you than what you read and understand, and I hope you will understand until the end;

column.name: text
column.value: just as you also partially did understand us, that we are your reason to be proud as you also are ours, on the day of our Lord Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: In this confidence I intended at first to come to you, so that you might ①twice receive a ②blessing; ▷ ①Lit have a second grace ②One early ms joy

column.name: text
column.value: ①that is, to pass ②your way into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and by you to be helped on my journey to Judea. ▷ ①Lit and ②Lit through you into

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, I was not vacillating when I intended to do this, was I? Or what I decide, do I decide according to the flesh, so that with me there will be ①yes, yes and no, no at the same time? ▷ ①I.e., a strong yes and no

column.name: text
column.value: But as God is faithful, our word to you is not yes and no.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Son of God, Christ Jesus, who was preached among you by us—by me and Silvanus and Timothy—was not yes and no, but has been yes in Him.

column.name: text
column.value: For as many as the promises of God are, in Him they are yes; therefore through Him also is our Amen to the glory of God through us.

column.name: text
column.value: Now He who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,

column.name: text
column.value: who also sealed us and gave us the Spirit in our hearts as a ①pledge. ▷ ①Or first installment

column.name: text
column.value: But I call God as witness to my soul, that it was to spare you that I did not come again to Corinth.

column.name: text
column.value: Not that we domineer over your faith, but we are workers with you for your joy; for in your faith you are standing firm.

column.name: text
column.value: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or do we need, as some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

column.name: text
column.value: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all people,

column.name: text
column.value: revealing yourselves, that you are a letter of Christ, ①delivered by us, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of ②human hearts. ▷ ①Lit served ②Lit hearts of flesh

column.name: text
column.value: Such is the confidence we have toward God through Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Not that we are adequate in ourselves so as to consider anything as having come from ourselves, but our adequacy is from God,

column.name: text
column.value: who also made us adequate as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the ministry of death, engraved in letters on stones, came ①with glory so that the sons of Israel could not look intently at the face of Moses because of the glory of his face, fading as it was, ▷ ①Or in glory

column.name: text
column.value: how will the ministry of the Spirit fail to be even more with glory?

column.name: text
column.value: For if the ministry of condemnation has glory, much more does the ministry of righteousness excel in glory.

column.name: text
column.value: For indeed what had glory in this case has no glory, because of the glory that surpasses it.

column.name: text
column.value: For if that which fades away was ①with glory, much more that which remains is in glory. ▷ ①Lit through

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, having such a hope, we use great boldness in our speech,

column.name: text
column.value: and we are not like Moses, who used to put a veil over his face so that the sons of Israel would not stare at the end of what was fading away.

column.name: text
column.value: But their minds were hardened; for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil ①remains unlifted, because it is removed in Christ. ▷ ①Or remains, it not being revealed that it is done away in Christ

column.name: text
column.value: But to this day whenever Moses is read, a veil lies over their hearts;

column.name: text
column.value: but whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.

column.name: text
column.value: But we all, with unveiled faces, looking as in a mirror at the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into the same image from glory to glory, just as from the Lord, the Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, since we have this ministry, as we received mercy, we do not lose heart,

column.name: text
column.value: but we have renounced the things hidden because of shame, not walking in trickery nor distorting the word of God, but by the open proclamation of the truth commending ourselves to every person’s conscience in the sight of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled ①to those who are perishing, ▷ ①Lit among

column.name: text
column.value: in whose case the god of this ①world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving so that ②they will not see the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God. ▷ ①Lit age ②Or the light...image of God, will not shine upon them

column.name: text
column.value: For we do not preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your bond-servants ①on account of Jesus. ▷ ①Two early mss through Jesus

column.name: text
column.value: For God, who said, “Light shall shine out of darkness,” is the One who has shone in our hearts to give the Light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: But we have this treasure in ①earthen containers, so that the extraordinary greatness of the power will be of God and not from ourselves; ▷ ①Or earthenware containers

column.name: text
column.value: we are afflicted in every way, but not crushed; perplexed, but not despairing;

column.name: text
column.value: persecuted, but not abandoned; struck down, but not destroyed;

column.name: text
column.value: always carrying around in the body the dying of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

column.name: text
column.value: For we who live are constantly being handed over to death because of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our mortal flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: So death works in us, but life in you.

column.name: text
column.value: But having the same spirit of faith, according to what is written: “I BELIEVED, THEREFORE I SPOKE,” we also believe, therefore we also speak,

column.name: text
column.value: knowing that He who raised the Lord Jesus will also raise us with Jesus, and will present us with you.

column.name: text
column.value: For all things are for your sakes, so that grace, having ①spread to more and more people, will cause thanksgiving to overflow to the glory of God. ▷ ①Lit multiplied through the many

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore we do not lose heart, but though our outer person is decaying, yet our inner person is being renewed day by day.

column.name: text
column.value: For our momentary, light affliction is producing for us an eternal weight of glory far beyond all comparison,

column.name: text
column.value: while we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen; for the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, having these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Make room for us in your hearts; we have wronged no one, we corrupted no one, we have taken advantage of no one.

column.name: text
column.value: I do not speak to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts, to die together and to live together.

column.name: text
column.value: My confidence ①in you is great; my boasting in your behalf is great. I am filled with comfort; I am overflowing with joy in all our affliction. ▷ ①Lit toward

column.name: text
column.value: For even when we came into Macedonia our flesh had no rest, but we were afflicted on every side: conflicts on the outside, fears inside.

column.name: text
column.value: But God, who comforts the ①discouraged, comforted us by the arrival of Titus; ▷ ①Or lowly

column.name: text
column.value: and not only by his arrival, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted among you, as he reported to us your longing, your mourning, your zeal for me; so that I rejoiced even more.

column.name: text
column.value: For though I caused you sorrow by my letter, I do not regret it; though I did regret it—for I see that that letter caused you sorrow, though only for a while—

column.name: text
column.value: I now rejoice, not that you were made sorrowful, but that you were made sorrowful to the point of repentance; for you were made sorrowful according to the will of God, so that you might not suffer loss in anything ①through us. ▷ ①Lit from

column.name: text
column.value: For the sorrow that is according to the will of God produces a repentance ①without regret, leading to salvation, but the sorrow of the world produces death. ▷ ①Or leading to a salvation without regret

column.name: text
column.value: For behold what earnestness this very thing, this ①godly sorrow, has produced in you: what vindication of yourselves, what indignation, what fear, what longing, what zeal, what punishment of wrong! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be innocent in the matter. ▷ ①Lit sorrow according to God

column.name: text
column.value: So although I wrote to you, it was not for the sake of the offender nor for the sake of the one offended, but that your earnestness in our behalf might be made known to you in the sight of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of this, we have been comforted. And besides our comfort, we rejoiced even much more for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.

column.name: text
column.value: For if I have boasted to him about you regarding anything, I was not put to shame. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so also our boasting before Titus proved to be the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: His ①affection abounds all the more toward you, as he remembers the obedience of you all, how you received him with fear and trembling. ▷ ①Lit inward parts

column.name: text
column.value: I rejoice that in everything I have confidence in you.

column.name: text
column.value: And working together with Him, we also urge you not to receive the grace of God in vain—

column.name: text
text
column.value: giving no reason for taking offense in anything, so that the ministry will not be discredited,

column.name: text
column.value: but in everything commending ourselves as ①servants of God, in much endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in difficulties, ▷ ①Or ministers

column.name: text
column.value: in beatings, in imprisonments, in ①mob attacks, in labors, in sleeplessness, in hunger, ▷ ①Lit tumults

column.name: text
column.value: in purity, in knowledge, in patience, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in genuine love,

column.name: text
column.value: in the word of truth, and in the power of God; by the weapons of righteousness for the right hand and the left,

column.name: text
column.value: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report; regarded as deceivers and yet true;

column.name: text
column.value: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and yet behold, we are alive; as ①punished and yet not put to death, ▷ ①Or disciplined

column.name: text
column.value: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.

column.name: text
column.value: Our mouth ①has spoken freely to you, you Corinthians, our heart is opened wide. ▷ ①Lit is open to you

column.name: text
column.value: You are not restrained ①by us, but you are restrained in your own ②affections. ▷ ①Or in us ②Lit inward parts

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the same way in exchange—I am speaking as to children—open wide your hearts to us, you as well.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be ①mismatched with unbelievers; for what do righteousness and lawlessness share together, or what does light have in common with darkness? ▷ ①Lit unevenly yoked

column.name: text
column.value: Or what harmony does Christ have with ①Belial, or ②what does a believer share with an unbeliever? ▷ ①Gr Beliar; a name of the devil and the antichrist ②Lit what part has a believer with an unbeliever

column.name: text
column.value: Or what agreement does ①the temple of God have with idols? For we are ②the temple of the living God; just as God said, “I WILL DWELL AMONG THEM AND WALK AMONG THEM; AND I WILL BE THEIR GOD, AND THEY SHALL BE MY PEOPLE. ▷ ①Or a temple ②Or a temple

column.name: text
text
column.value: And I will be a father to you, And you shall be sons and daughters to Me,” Says the Lord Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: For we know that if our ①earthly tent which is our house is torn down, we have a building from God, a house not made by hands, eternal in the heavens. ▷ ①Lit earthly house of the tent

column.name: text
column.value: For indeed, in this tent we groan, longing to be clothed with our ①dwelling from heaven, ▷ ①I.e., the resurrected body

column.name: text
column.value: since in fact after putting it on, we will not be found naked.

column.name: text
column.value: For indeed, we who are in this tent groan, being burdened, because we do not want to be unclothed but to be clothed, so that what is mortal will be swallowed up by life.

column.name: text
column.value: Now He who prepared us for this very purpose is God, who gave us the Spirit as a ①pledge. ▷ ①Or first installment

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, being always of good courage, and knowing that while we are at home in the body we are absent from the Lord—

column.name: text
column.value: for we walk by faith, not by ①sight— ▷ ①Or appearance

column.name: text
column.value: but we are of good courage and prefer rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore we also have as our ambition, whether at home or absent, to be pleasing to Him.

column.name: text
column.value: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, so that each one may receive compensation for ①his deeds done through the body, in accordance with what he has done, whether good or bad. ▷ ①Lit the things

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, knowing the fear of the Lord, we persuade people, but we are well known to God; and I hope that we are also well known in your consciences.

column.name: text
column.value: We are not commending ourselves to you again, but are giving you an opportunity to be proud of us, so that you will have an answer for those who take pride in appearance and not in heart.

column.name: text
column.value: For if we have lost our minds, it is for God; if we are of sound mind, it is for you.

column.name: text
column.value: For the love of Christ controls us, having concluded this, that one died for all, therefore all died;

column.name: text
column.value: and He died for all, so that those who live would no longer live for themselves, but for Him who died and rose on their behalf.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore from now on we recognize no one ①by the flesh; even though we have known Christ by the flesh, yet now we know Him in this way no longer. ▷ ①I.e., by what one is in the flesh

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, this person is a new ①creation; the old things passed away; behold, new things have come. ▷ ①Or creature

column.name: text
column.value: Now all these things are from God, who reconciled us to Himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation,

column.name: text
column.value: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to Himself, not counting their wrongdoings against them, and ①He has ②committed to us the word of reconciliation. ▷ ①Lit having ②Lit placed in us

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God were making an appeal through us; we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

column.name: text
column.value: He made Him who knew no sin to be ①sin in our behalf, so that we might become the righteousness of God in Him. ▷ ①Or a sin offering

column.name: text
column.value: For it is superfluous for me to write to you about this ministry to the ①saints; ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: for I know your willingness, of which I boast about you to the Macedonians, namely, that Achaia has been prepared since last year, and your zeal has stirred up most of them.

column.name: text
column.value: But I have sent the brothers, in order that our boasting about you may not prove empty in this case, so that, as I was saying, you will be prepared;

column.name: text
column.value: otherwise, if any Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we—not to mention you—would be put to shame by this confidence.

column.name: text
column.value: So I considered it necessary to urge the brothers that they go on ahead to you and arrange in advance your previously promised ①generous gift, that the same would be ready as a ②generous gift, and not as one grudgingly given due to greediness. ▷ ①Lit blessing ②Lit blessing

column.name: text
column.value: Now I say this: the one who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and the one who sows ①generously will also reap ②generously. ▷ ①Lit with blessings ②Lit with blessings

column.name: text
column.value: Each one must do just as he has decided in his heart, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

column.name: text
column.value: And God is able to make all grace overflow to you, so that, always having all sufficiency in everything, you may have an abundance for every good deed;

column.name: text
column.value: as it is written: “HE SCATTERED ABROAD, HE GAVE TO THE POOR, HIS RIGHTEOUSNESS ①ENDURES FOREVER.” ▷ ①Lit remains

column.name: text
column.value: Now He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your seed for sowing and increase the harvest of your righteousness;

column.name: text
column.value: you will be enriched in everything for all liberality, which through us is producing thanksgiving to God.

column.name: text
column.value: For the ministry of this service is not only fully supplying the needs of the ①saints, but is also overflowing through many thanksgivings to God. ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: Because of the proof given by this ministry, they will glorify God for your obedience to your confession of the gospel of Christ and for the liberality of your ①contribution to them and to all, ▷ ①Or sharing with them

column.name: text
column.value: while they also, by prayer on your behalf, yearn for you because of the surpassing grace of God in you.

column.name: text
column.value: Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift!

column.name: text
column.value: Now, brothers and sisters, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the churches of Macedonia,

column.name: text
column.value: that in a ①great ordeal of affliction their abundance of joy and their deep poverty overflowed in the wealth of their liberality. ▷ ①Or severe test of

column.name: text
column.value: For I testify that according to their ability, and beyond their ability, they gave voluntarily,

column.name: text
column.value: begging us with much urging for the favor ①of participation in the ②support of the ③saints, ▷ ①Lit and ②Lit service to the saints ③Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: and this, not as we had ①expected, but they first gave themselves to the Lord and to us by the will of God. ▷ ①Lit hoped

column.name: text
column.value: So we urged Titus that as he had previously made a beginning, so he would also complete in you this gracious work as well.

column.name: text
column.value: But just as you excel in everything, in faith, speaking, knowledge, and in all earnestness and in the ①love we inspired in you, see that you also excel in this gracious work. ▷ ①Lit love from us in you; one early ms love from you in us

column.name: text
column.value: I am not saying this as a command, but as proving, through the earnestness of others, the sincerity of your love as well.

column.name: text
column.value: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though He was rich, yet for your sake He became poor, so that you through His poverty might become rich.

column.name: text
column.value: I give my opinion in this matter, for this is to your advantage, who were the first to begin a year ago not only to do this, but also to desire to do it.

column.name: text
column.value: But now finish ①doing it also, so that just as there was the willingness to desire it, so there may be also the completion of it by your ability. ▷ ①Lit the doing

column.name: text
column.value: For if the willingness is present, it is acceptable according to what a person has, not according to what he does not have.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is not for the relief of others and for your hardship, but by way of equality—

column.name: text
column.value: at this present time your abundance will serve as assistance for their need, so that their abundance also may ①serve as assistance for your need, so that there may be equality; ▷ ①Lit become

column.name: text
column.value: as it is written: “THE ONE WHO had gathered much did not have too much, AND THE ONE WHO had gathered little did not have too little.”

column.name: text
column.value: But thanks be to God who puts the same earnestness in your behalf in the heart of Titus.

column.name: text
column.value: For he not only accepted our appeal, but being himself very earnest, he has gone to you of his own accord.

column.name: text
column.value: We have sent along with him the brother whose fame in the things of the gospel has spread through all the churches;

column.name: text
column.value: and not only that, but he has also been appointed by the churches to travel with us in this gracious work, which is being administered by us for the glory of the Lord Himself, and to show our readiness,

column.name: text
column.value: ①taking precaution so that no one will discredit us in our administration of this generous gift; ▷ ①Lit avoiding this

column.name: text
column.value: for we have regard for what is honorable, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of other people.

column.name: text
column.value: We have sent with them our brother, whom we have often tested and found diligent in many things, but now even more diligent because of his great confidence in you.

column.name: text
column.value: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker ①among you; as for our brothers, they are ②messengers of the churches, a glory to Christ. ▷ ①Lit for you ②Lit apostles

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, ①openly before the churches, ②show them the proof of your love and of our reason for boasting about you. ▷ ①Lit in the face of the churches ②Or show the proof...for boasting about you to them

column.name: text
column.value: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness; but ①indeed you are bearing with me. ▷ ①Or do indeed bear with me

column.name: text
column.value: For I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy; for I betrothed you to one husband, to present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: But I am afraid that, as the serpent deceived Eve by his trickery, your minds will be led astray from sincere and pure devotion to Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For if ①one comes and preaches another Jesus whom we have not preached, or you receive a different spirit which you have not received, or a different gospel which you have not accepted, this you tolerate very well! ▷ ①Lit the one who comes preaches

column.name: text
column.value: For I consider myself not in the least inferior to the ①most eminent apostles. ▷ ①Or super-apostles

column.name: text
column.value: But even if I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not so in knowledge; in fact, in every way we have made this evident to you in all things.

column.name: text
column.value: Or did I commit a sin by humbling myself so that you might be exalted, because I preached the gospel of God to you without charge?

column.name: text
column.value: I robbed other churches by taking wages from them to serve you;

column.name: text
column.value: and when I was present with you and was in need, I was not a burden to anyone; for when the brothers came from Macedonia they fully supplied my need, and in everything I kept myself from being a burden to you, ①and will continue to do so. ▷ ①Lit and I will keep

column.name: text
column.value: As the truth of Christ is in me, this boasting of mine will not be stopped in the regions of Achaia.

column.name: text
column.value: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows that I do!

column.name: text
column.value: But what I am doing I will also continue to do, so that I may eliminate the opportunity from those who want an opportunity to be ①regarded just as we are in the matter about which they are boasting. ▷ ①Lit found

column.name: text
column.value: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, disguising themselves as apostles of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: No wonder, for even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore it is not surprising if his servants also disguise themselves as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: Again I say, let no one think me foolish; but if you do, receive me even as foolish, so that I also may boast a little.

column.name: text
column.value: What I am saying, I am not saying ①as the Lord would, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting. ▷ ①Lit in accordance with the Lord

column.name: text
column.value: Since many boast according to the flesh, I will boast also.

column.name: text
column.value: For you, being so wise, tolerate the foolish gladly.

column.name: text
column.value: For you tolerate it if anyone enslaves you, if anyone devours you, if anyone takes advantage of you, if anyone exalts himself, if anyone hits you in the face.

column.name: text
column.value: To my shame I must say that we have been weak by comparison. But in whatever respect anyone else is bold—I am speaking in foolishness—I too am bold.

column.name: text
column.value: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they ①descendants of Abraham? So am I. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: Are they servants of Christ?—I am speaking as if insane—I more so; in far more labors, in far more imprisonments, ①beaten times without number, often in danger of death. ▷ ①Lit exceedingly in blows

column.name: text
column.value: Five times I received from the Jews thirty-nine lashes.

column.name: text
column.value: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked, a night and a day I have spent adrift at sea.

column.name: text
column.value: I have been on frequent journeys, in dangers from rivers, dangers from robbers, dangers from my countrymen, dangers from the Gentiles, dangers in the city, dangers in the wilderness, dangers at sea, dangers among false brothers;

column.name: text
column.value: I have been in labor and hardship, through many sleepless nights, in hunger and thirst, often without food, in cold and ①exposure. ▷ ①Lit nakedness; i.e., lack of clothing

column.name: text
column.value: Apart from such ①external things, there is the daily pressure on me of concern for all the churches. ▷ ①Or the things unmentioned

column.name: text
column.value: Who is weak without my being weak? Who is ①led into sin ②without my intense concern? ▷ ①Lit made to stumble ②Lit and I do not burn

column.name: text
column.value: If I have to boast, I will boast of what pertains to my weakness.

column.name: text
column.value: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, He who is blessed forever, knows that I am not lying.

column.name: text
column.value: In Damascus the ethnarch under Aretas the king was guarding the city of the Damascenes in order to seize me,

column.name: text
column.value: and I was let down in a basket through a window ①in the wall, and so escaped his hands. ▷ ①Lit through

column.name: text
column.value: Now I, Paul, myself urge you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ—I who am ①meek when face to face with you, but bold toward you when absent! ▷ ①Lit lowly

column.name: text
column.value: I ask that when I am present I need not be bold with the confidence with which I intend to be courageous against some, who regard us as if we walked according to the flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not wage battle according to the flesh,

column.name: text
column.value: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but ①divinely powerful for the destruction of fortresses. ▷ ①Or mighty before God

column.name: text
column.value: We are destroying arguments and all arrogance raised against the knowledge of God, and we are taking every thought captive to the obedience of Christ,

column.name: text
column.value: and we are ready to punish all disobedience, whenever your obedience is complete.

column.name: text
column.value: ①You are looking at ②things as they are outwardly. If anyone is confident in himself that he is Christ’s, have him consider this again within himself, that just as he is Christ’s, so too are we. ▷ ①Or Look at... or Do you look at...? ②Lit what is before your face

column.name: text
column.value: For if I boast somewhat ①more about our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for destroying you, I will not be put to shame, ▷ ①Or more abundantly

column.name: text
column.value: ①for I do not want to seem as if I would terrify you by my letters. ▷ ①Lit so that I may not seem

column.name: text
column.value: For they say, “His letters are weighty and strong, but his ①personal presence is unimpressive and his speech contemptible.” ▷ ①Lit bodily presence is weak

column.name: text
column.value: Have such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when absent, such persons we are also in deed when present.

column.name: text
column.value: For we do not presume to rank or compare ourselves with ①some of those who commend themselves; but when they ②measure themselves by themselves and compare themselves with themselves, they have no understanding. ▷ ①Or any ②I.e., evaluate

column.name: text
column.value: But we will not boast beyond our measure, but ①within the measure of the ②domain which God assigned to us as a measure, to reach even as far as you. ▷ ①Lit according to the measure ②Or assignment; lit standard

column.name: text
column.value: For we are not overextending ourselves, as if we did not reach to you, for we were the first to come even as far as you in the gospel of Christ;

column.name: text
column.value: not boasting beyond our measure, that is, in other people’s labors, but with the hope that as your faith grows, we will be, ①within our ②domain, enlarged even more by you, ▷ ①Lit according to our ②See note 2 v 13

column.name: text
column.value: so as to preach the gospel even to the regions beyond you, and not to boast ①in what has been accomplished in the domain of another. ▷ ①Lit to the things prepared in the

column.name: text
column.value: But THE ONE WHO BOASTS IS TO BOAST IN THE LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is not the one who commends himself that is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.

column.name: text
column.value: Boasting is necessary, though it is not beneficial; but I will go on to visions and revelations ①of the Lord. ▷ ①Or from

column.name: text
