column.value: I know a man in Christ, who fourteen years ago—whether in the body I do not know, or out of the body I do not know, God knows—such a man was caught up to the third heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And I know how such a man—whether in the body or apart from the body I do not know, God knows—

column.name: text
column.value: was caught up into Paradise and heard inexpressible words, which a man is not permitted to speak.

column.name: text
column.value: In behalf of such a man I will boast; but in my own behalf I will not boast, except regarding my weaknesses.

column.name: text
column.value: For if I do wish to boast I will not be foolish, for I will be speaking the truth; but I refrain from this, so that no one will credit me with more than he sees in me or hears from me.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of the extraordinary greatness of the revelations, for this reason, to keep me from exalting myself, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to ①torment me—to keep me from exalting myself! ▷ ①Lit beat

column.name: text
column.value: Concerning this I pleaded with the Lord three times that it might leave me.

column.name: text
column.value: And He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for power is perfected in weakness.” Most gladly, therefore, I will rather boast ①about my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may dwell in me. ▷ ①Lit in

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I delight in weaknesses, in ①insults, in distresses, in persecutions, in difficulties, in behalf of Christ; for when I am weak, then I am strong. ▷ ①Or mistreatment

column.name: text
column.value: I have become foolish; you yourselves compelled me. Actually I should have been commended by you, since I was in no respect inferior to the ①most eminent apostles, even though I am a nobody. ▷ ①Or super-apostles

column.name: text
column.value: The distinguishing marks ①of a true apostle were performed among you with all perseverance, by ②signs, wonders, and ③miracles. ▷ ①Lit of the apostle ②Or confirming miracles ③Or works of power

column.name: text
column.value: For in what respect were you treated as inferior to the rest of the churches, except that I myself did not become a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

column.name: text
column.value: Here for this third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I do not seek what is yours, but you; for children are not responsible to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.

column.name: text
column.value: I will most gladly spend and be expended for your souls. If I love you more, am I to be loved less?

column.name: text
column.value: But be that as it may, I did not burden you myself; nevertheless, devious person that I am, I took you in by deceit.

column.name: text
column.value: Certainly I have not taken advantage of you through any of those whom I have sent to you, have I?

column.name: text
column.value: I urged Titus to go, and I sent the brother with him. Titus did not take any advantage of you, did he? Did we not ①conduct ourselves ②in the same spirit and walk in the same steps? ▷ ①Lit walk ②Or by the same Spirit

column.name: text
column.value: All this time ①you have been thinking that we are defending ourselves to you. Actually, it is in the sight of God that we have been speaking in Christ; and all for building you up, beloved. ▷ ①Or have you been thinking...?

column.name: text
column.value: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come I may find you to be not what I wish, and may be found by you to be not what you wish; that perhaps there will be strife, jealousy, angry tempers, selfishness, slanders, gossip, arrogance, disturbances;

column.name: text
column.value: I am afraid that when I come again my God may humiliate me before you, and I may mourn over many of those who have sinned in the past and not repented of the impurity, sexual immorality, and indecent behavior which they have practiced.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the third time that I am coming to you. ON THE ①TESTIMONY OF TWO OR THREE WITNESSES EVERY MATTER SHALL BE CONFIRMED. ▷ ①Lit mouth

column.name: text
column.value: I have previously said when I was present the second time, and though now absent I say in advance to those who have sinned in the past and to all the rest as well, that if I come again I will not spare anyone,

column.name: text
column.value: since you are seeking proof of the Christ who speaks in me, who is not weak toward you, but mighty in you.

column.name: text
column.value: For indeed He was crucified because of weakness, yet He lives because of the power of God. For we too are weak ①in Him, yet we will live with Him because of the power of God directed toward you. ▷ ①One early ms with Him

column.name: text
column.value: Test yourselves to see if you are in the faith; examine yourselves! Or do you not recognize this about yourselves, that Jesus Christ is in you—unless indeed you ①fail the test? ▷ ①Lit are unapproved

column.name: text
column.value: But I expect that you will realize that we ourselves ①do not fail the test. ▷ ①Lit are not unapproved

column.name: text
column.value: Now we pray to God that you do nothing wrong; not so that we ourselves may appear approved, but that you may do what is right, though we may ①appear unapproved. ▷ ①Lit be as

column.name: text
column.value: For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: For we rejoice when we ourselves are weak, but you are strong; this we also pray for, ①that you become mature. ▷ ①Lit your maturation

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason I am writing these things while absent, so that when present I need not use severity, in accordance with the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.

column.name: text
column.value: Finally, brothers and sisters, ①rejoice, mend your ways, be comforted, be like-minded, live in peace; and the God of love and peace will be with you. ▷ ①Or farewell

column.name: text
column.value: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

column.name: text
column.value: All the ①saints greet you. ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit, be with you all.

column.name: text
column.value: Then after an interval of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus along also.

column.name: text
column.value: ①It was because of a revelation that I went up; and I submitted to them the gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but I did so in private to those who were of reputation, for fear that somehow I might be running, or had run, in vain. ▷ ①Lit according to revelation I went up

column.name: text
column.value: But not even Titus, who was with me, though he was a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet it was a concern because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who had sneaked in to spy on our freedom which we have in Christ Jesus, in order to enslave us.

column.name: text
column.value: But we did not yield in subjection to them, even for an hour, so that the truth of the gospel would remain with you.

column.name: text
column.value: But from those who ①were of considerable repute (what they were makes no difference to me; God shows no favoritism)—well, those who were of repute contributed nothing to me. ▷ ①Lit reputed as being something

column.name: text
column.value: But on the contrary, seeing that I had been entrusted with the gospel ①to the uncircumcised, just as Peter had been ②to the circumcised ▷ ①Lit of the uncircumcision; i.e., to Gentiles ②Lit of the circumcision; i.e., to Jews

column.name: text
column.value: (for He who was at work for Peter in his apostleship ①to the circumcised was at work for me also to the Gentiles), ▷ ①See note 2 v 7

column.name: text
column.value: and recognizing the grace that had been given to me, ①James and ②Cephas and John, who were reputed to be pillars, gave to me and Barnabas the right ③hand of fellowship, so that we might go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcised. ▷ ①Or Jacob ②I.e., Peter ③Lit hands

column.name: text
column.value: They only asked us to remember the poor—the very thing I also was eager to do.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Cephas came to Antioch, I opposed him to his face, because he ①stood condemned. ▷ ①Or was to be condemned; lit was one who was condemned; or was self-condemned

column.name: text
column.value: For prior to the coming of some men from ①James, he used to eat with the Gentiles; but when they came, he began to withdraw and separate himself, fearing those from the circumcision. ▷ ①Or Jacob

column.name: text
column.value: The rest of the Jews joined him in hypocrisy, with the result that even Barnabas was carried away by their hypocrisy.

column.name: text
column.value: But when I saw that they were not ①straightforward about the truth of the gospel, I said to Cephas in the presence of all, “If you, being a Jew, live like the Gentiles and not like the Jews, how is it that you compel the Gentiles to live like Jews? ② ▷ ①Or progressing toward; lit walking straightly ②Some close the direct quotation here, others extend it through v 21

column.name: text
column.value: “We are Jews by nature and not sinners from the Gentiles;

column.name: text
column.value: nevertheless, knowing that a person is not justified by works of ①the Law but through faith in Christ Jesus, even we have believed in Christ Jesus, so that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by works of ②the Law; since by works of ③the Law no ④flesh will be justified. ▷ ①Or law ②Or law ③Or law ④Or mortal man

column.name: text
column.value: But if, while seeking to be justified in Christ, we ourselves have also been found sinners, is Christ then a servant of sin? ①Far from it! ▷ ①Lit May it never happen!

column.name: text
column.value: For if I rebuild what I have once destroyed, I prove myself to be a wrongdoer.

column.name: text
column.value: For through ①the Law I died to ②the Law, so that I might live for God. ▷ ①Or law ②Or law

column.name: text
column.value: I have been crucified with Christ; and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me; and ①the life which I now live in the flesh I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself up for me. ▷ ①Or insofar as I

column.name: text
column.value: I do not nullify the grace of God, for if righteousness comes through ①the Law, then Christ died needlessly.” ▷ ①Or law

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, an apostle (not sent from men nor through human agency, but through Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised Him from the dead),

column.name: text
column.value: and all the brothers who are with me, To the churches of Galatia:

column.name: text
column.value: Grace to you and peace from ①God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ, ▷ ①One early ms God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ

column.name: text
column.value: who gave Himself for our sins so that He might rescue us from this present evil ①age, according to the will of our God and Father, ▷ ①Or world

column.name: text
column.value: to whom be the glory forevermore. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: I am amazed that you are so quickly deserting Him who called you ①by the grace of Christ, for a different gospel, ▷ ①Lit in

column.name: text
column.value: which is not just another account; but there are some who are disturbing you and want to distort the gospel of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: But even if we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you a gospel contrary to what we have preached to you, he is to be ①accursed! ▷ ①Gr anathema

column.name: text
column.value: As we have said before, even now I say again: if anyone is preaching to you a gospel contrary to what you received, he is to be ①accursed! ▷ ①Gr anathema

column.name: text
column.value: For am I now seeking the favor of people, or of God? Or am I striving to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a bond-servant of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For I would have you know, brothers and sisters, that the gospel which was preached by me is not ①of human invention. ▷ ①Lit according to man

column.name: text
column.value: For I neither received it from man, nor was I taught it, but I received it through a revelation of Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For you have heard of my former way of life in Judaism, how I used to persecute the church of God beyond measure and tried to destroy it;

column.name: text
column.value: and I was advancing in Judaism beyond many of my contemporaries among my ①countrymen, being more extremely zealous for my ancestral traditions. ▷ ①Lit race

column.name: text
column.value: But when ①He who had set me apart even from my mother’s womb and called me through His grace was pleased ▷ ①One early ms God who

column.name: text
column.value: to reveal His Son in me so that I might preach Him among the Gentiles, I did not immediately consult with ①flesh and blood, ▷ ①I.e., people

column.name: text
column.value: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me; but I went away to Arabia, and returned once more to Damascus.

column.name: text
column.value: Then three years later I went up to Jerusalem to ①become acquainted with ②Cephas, and stayed with him for fifteen days. ▷ ①Or visit ②I.e., Peter

column.name: text
column.value: But I did not see another one of the apostles except ①James, the Lord’s brother. ▷ ①Or Jacob

column.name: text
column.value: (Now in what I am writing to you, ①I assure you before God that I am not lying.) ▷ ①Lit behold before God

column.name: text
column.value: Then I went into the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

column.name: text
column.value: I was still unknown by ①sight to the churches of Judea which are in Christ; ▷ ①Lit face

column.name: text
column.value: but they only kept hearing, “The man who once persecuted us is now preaching the faith which he once tried to destroy.”

column.name: text
column.value: And they were glorifying God ①because of me. ▷ ①Lit in me

column.name: text
column.value: ①You foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was publicly portrayed as crucified? ▷ ①Lit O

column.name: text
column.value: This is the only thing I want to find out from you: did you receive the Spirit by works of ①the Law, or by hearing ②with faith? ▷ ①Or law ②Lit of faith

column.name: text
column.value: Are you so foolish? Having begun ①by the Spirit, are you now ②being perfected by the flesh? ▷ ①Or with ②Or ending with

column.name: text
column.value: Did you ①suffer so many things in vain—if indeed it was in vain? ▷ ①Or experience

column.name: text
column.value: So then, does He who provides you with the Spirit and works ①miracles among you, do it by works of ②the Law, or by hearing ③with faith? ▷ ①Or works of power ②Or law ③Lit of faith

column.name: text
column.value: Just as Abraham BELIEVED GOD, AND IT WAS CREDITED TO HIM AS RIGHTEOUSNESS.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, recognize that it is those who are of faith who are sons of Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: The Scripture, foreseeing that God ①would justify the ②Gentiles by faith, preached the gospel beforehand to Abraham, saying, “ALL THE NATIONS WILL BE BLESSED IN YOU.” ▷ ①Lit justifies ②Lit nations

column.name: text
column.value: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with ①Abraham, the believer. ▷ ①Lit the believing Abraham

column.name: text
column.value: For all who are of works of ①the Law are under a curse; for it is written: “CURSED IS EVERYONE WHO DOES NOT ABIDE BY ALL THE THINGS WRITTEN IN THE BOOK OF THE LAW, TO DO THEM.” ▷ ①Or law

column.name: text
column.value: Now, that no one is justified ①by ②the Law before God is evident; for, “ ③THE RIGHTEOUS ONE WILL LIVE BY FAITH.” ▷ ①Or in ②Or law ③Or the one who is righteous by faith will live

column.name: text
column.value: ①However, the Law is not ②of faith; on the contrary, “THE PERSON WHO PERFORMS ③THEM WILL LIVE BY ④THEM.” ▷ ①Or And ②Or based on ③I.e., the statutes of the Law ④I.e., the statutes of the Law

column.name: text
column.value: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the Law, having become a curse for us—for it is written: “CURSED IS EVERYONE WHO HANGS ON A ①TREE”— ▷ ①Or cross; lit wood; see Deut

column.name: text
column.value: in order that in Christ Jesus the blessing of Abraham would come to the Gentiles, so that we would receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

column.name: text
column.value: Brothers and sisters, I speak ①in terms of human relations: even though it is only a man’s ②covenant, yet when it has been ratified, no one sets it aside or adds ③conditions to it. ▷ ①Lit according to man ②Or will; or testament ③Or a codicil

column.name: text
column.value: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. He does not say, “And to seeds,” as one would in referring to many, but rather as in referring to one, “And to your seed,” that is, Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: What I am saying is this: the Law, which came 430 years later, does not invalidate a covenant previously ratified by God, so as to nullify the promise.

column.name: text
column.value: For if the inheritance is ①based on law, it is no longer ②based on a promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by means of a promise. ▷ ①Lit out of, from ②Lit out of, from

column.name: text
column.value: Why the Law then? It was added on account of the ①violations, having been ordered through angels at the hand of a ②mediator, until the Seed would come to whom the promise had been made. ▷ ①I.e., of God’s commands ②I.e., Moses

column.name: text
column.value: Now a mediator is not ①for one party only; but God is only one. ▷ ①Lit of one

column.name: text
column.value: Is the Law then contrary to the promises of God? ①Far from it! For if a law had been given that was able to impart life, then righteousness ②would indeed have been ③based on law. ▷ ①Lit May it never happen! ②Or would indeed be ③Lit out of, from

column.name: text
column.value: But the Scripture has confined ①everyone under sin, so that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe. ▷ ①Lit all things

column.name: text
column.value: But before faith came, ①we were kept in custody under the Law, being confined for the faith that was destined to be revealed. ▷ ①I.e., the Jews

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the Law has become our ①guardian to lead us to Christ, so that we may be justified by faith. ▷ ①I.e., children’s escort and supervisor

column.name: text
column.value: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a ①guardian. ▷ ①See note v 24

column.name: text
column.value: For you are all sons and daughters of God through faith in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: For all of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free, there is ①neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus. ▷ ①Lit not male and female

column.name: text
column.value: And if you ①belong to Christ, then you are Abraham’s ②descendants, heirs according to promise. ▷ ①Lit are Christ’s ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: Now I say, as long as the heir is a ①child, he does not differ at all from a slave, although he is ②owner of everything, ▷ ①Or minor ②Lit lord

column.name: text
column.value: but he is under guardians and ①managers until the ②date set by the father. ▷ ①Or stewards ②I.e., when the child is no longer a minor

column.name: text
column.value: So we too, when we were children, were held in bondage under the ①elementary principles of the world. ▷ ①Or rudimentary teachings

column.name: text
column.value: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent His Son, born of a woman, born under ①the Law, ▷ ①Or law

column.name: text
column.value: so that He might redeem those who were under ①the Law, that we might receive the adoption as sons and daughters. ▷ ①Or law

column.name: text
column.value: Because you are sons, God has sent the Spirit of His Son into our hearts, crying out, “Abba! ①Father!” ▷ ①I.e., Paul’s translation of the Aramaic Abba

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore you are no longer a slave, but a son; and if a son, then an heir ①through God. ▷ ①I.e., through the gracious act of

column.name: text
column.value: However at that time, when you did not know God, you were slaves to those which by nature are not gods.

column.name: text
column.value: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, how is it that you turn back again to the weak and worthless ①elementary principles, to which you want to be enslaved all over again? ▷ ①Or rudimentary teachings

column.name: text
column.value: You meticulously observe days and months and seasons and years.

column.name: text
column.value: I fear for you, that perhaps I have labored ①over you in vain. ▷ ①Or for

column.name: text
column.value: I beg of you, brothers and sisters, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You have done me no wrong;

column.name: text
column.value: but you know that it was because of a ①bodily illness that I preached the gospel to you the ②first time; ▷ ①Lit weakness of the flesh ②Or former

column.name: text
column.value: and you did not despise that which was a trial to you in my ①bodily condition, nor express contempt, but you received me as an angel of God, as Christ Jesus Himself. ▷ ①Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: Where then is ①that sense of blessing you had? For I testify about you that, if possible, you would have torn out your eyes and given them to me. ▷ ①I.e., considering yourselves fortunate

column.name: text
column.value: So have I become your enemy by ①telling you the truth? ▷ ①Or dealing truthfully with you

column.name: text
column.value: They eagerly seek you, not ①in a commendable way, but they want to shut you out so that you will seek them. ▷ ①Or with good intentions

column.name: text
column.value: But it is good always to be eagerly sought ①in a commendable way, and not only when I am present with you. ▷ ①Or with good intentions

column.name: text
column.value: My children, with whom I am again in labor until Christ is formed in you—

column.name: text
column.value: but I could wish to be present with you now and to change my tone of voice, for I am at a loss about you!

column.name: text
column.value: Tell me, you who want to be under law, do you not listen to the Law?

column.name: text
column.value: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and one by the free woman.

column.name: text
column.value: But the son by the slave woman ①was born according to the flesh, and the son by the free woman through the promise. ▷ ①Lit has been born

column.name: text
column.value: ①This is speaking allegorically, for these women are two covenants: one coming from Mount Sinai giving birth to children ②who are to be slaves; ③she is Hagar. ▷ ①Lit Which ②Lit into slavery ③Lit which

column.name: text
column.value: Now this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia and corresponds to the present Jerusalem, for she is enslaved with her children.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Jerusalem above is free; ①she is our mother. ▷ ①Lit which

column.name: text
text
column.value: And you, brothers and sisters, like Isaac, are children of promise.

column.name: text
column.value: But as at that time the son who was born according to the flesh persecuted the one who was born according to the Spirit, so it is even now.

column.name: text
column.value: But what does the Scripture say? “DRIVE OUT THE SLAVE WOMAN AND HER SON, FOR THE SON OF THE SLAVE WOMAN SHALL NOT BE AN HEIR WITH THE SON OF THE FREE WOMAN.”

column.name: text
column.value: So then, brothers and sisters, we are not children of a slave woman, but of the free woman.

column.name: text
column.value: It was for freedom that Christ set us free; therefore keep standing firm and do not be subject again to a yoke of slavery.

column.name: text
column.value: Look! I, Paul, tell you that if you have yourselves circumcised, Christ will be of no benefit to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And I testify again to every man who has himself circumcised, that he is obligated to keep the whole Law.

column.name: text
column.value: You have been severed from Christ, you who ①are seeking to be justified by the ②Law; you have fallen from grace. ▷ ①Or law ②Or would be

column.name: text
column.value: For we, ①through the Spirit, ②by faith, are waiting for the hope of righteousness. ▷ ①Lit by ②Lit out of

column.name: text
column.value: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything, but faith working through love.

column.name: text
column.value: You were running well; who hindered you from obeying the truth?

column.name: text
column.value: This persuasion did not come from Him who calls you.

column.name: text
column.value: A little ①leaven leavens the whole lump of dough. ▷ ①I.e., fermented dough

column.name: text
column.value: I have confidence ①in you in the Lord, that you will adopt no other view; but the one who is disturbing you will bear the punishment, whoever he is. ▷ ①Lit toward

column.name: text
column.value: But as for me, brothers and sisters, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been eliminated.

column.name: text
column.value: I wish that those who are troubling you would even ①emasculate themselves. ▷ ①Or cut themselves off

column.name: text
column.value: For you were called to freedom, brothers and sisters; only do not turn your freedom into an opportunity for the flesh, but serve one another through love.

column.name: text
column.value: For the whole Law is fulfilled in one word, in the statement, “YOU SHALL LOVE YOUR NEIGHBOR AS YOURSELF.”

column.name: text
column.value: But if you bite and devour one another, take care that you are not consumed by one another.

column.name: text
column.value: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not carry out the desire of the flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: For the desire of the flesh is against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; for these are in opposition to one another, in order to keep you from doing whatever you want.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the Law.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the deeds of the flesh are evident, which are: sexual immorality, impurity, indecent behavior,

column.name: text
column.value: idolatry, witchcraft, hostilities, strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, selfish ambition, dissensions, factions,

column.name: text
column.value: envy, drunkenness, carousing, and things like these, of which I forewarn you, just as I have forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,

column.name: text
column.value: gentleness, self-control; against such things there is no law.

column.name: text
column.value: Now those who ①belong to Christ Jesus crucified the flesh with its passions and desires. ▷ ①Lit are of Christ Jesus

column.name: text
column.value: If we live by the Spirit, let’s follow the Spirit as well.

column.name: text
column.value: Let’s not become boastful, challenging one another, envying one another.

column.name: text
column.value: Brothers and sisters, even if a person is caught in any wrongdoing, you who are spiritual are to restore such a person in a spirit of gentleness; each one looking to yourself, so that you are not tempted as well.

column.name: text
column.value: Bear one another’s burdens, and thereby fulfill the law of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For if anyone thinks that he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

column.name: text
column.value: But each one must examine his own work, and then he will have reason for boasting, but ①to himself alone, and not ②to another. ▷ ①Or in regard to ②Or in regard to

column.name: text
column.value: For each one will bear his own load.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who is taught the word is to share all good things with the one who teaches him.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be deceived, God is not mocked; for whatever a person sows, this he will also reap.

column.name: text
column.value: For the one who sows to his own flesh will reap destruction from the flesh, but the one who sows to the Spirit will reap eternal life from the Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Let’s not become discouraged in doing good, for in due time we will reap, if we do not become weary.

column.name: text
column.value: So then, ①while we have opportunity, let’s do good to all people, and especially to those who are of the household of the faith. ▷ ①Or as

column.name: text
column.value: See with what large letters I have written to you with my own hand!

column.name: text
column.value: All who want to make a good showing in the flesh try to compel you to be circumcised, simply so that they will not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For those who ①are circumcised do not even keep ②the Law themselves, but they want to have you circumcised so that they may boast in your flesh. ▷ ①Two early mss have been ②Or law

column.name: text
column.value: But ①far be it from me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through ②which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world. ▷ ①Lit may it never be for ②Or whom

column.name: text
column.value: For neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new ①creation. ▷ ①Or creature

column.name: text
column.value: And all who will follow this rule, peace and mercy be upon them, and upon the Israel of God.

column.name: text
column.value: From now on let no one cause trouble for me, for I bear on my body the ①marks of Jesus. ▷ ①I.e., scars and other evidence of persecution

column.name: text
column.value: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers and sisters. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: And ①you ②were dead ③in your offenses and sins, ▷ ①Lit being ②I.e., Gentile believers ③Or by reason of

column.name: text
column.value: in which you previously walked according to the ①course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, of the spirit that is now working in the ②sons of disobedience. ▷ ①Lit age ②I.e., people opposed to God

column.name: text
column.value: Among them ①we too all previously lived in the lusts of our flesh, ②indulging the desires of the flesh and of the ③mind, and were by nature children of wrath, just as the rest. ▷ ①I.e., Jewish believers ②Lit doing ③Lit thoughts

column.name: text
column.value: But God, being rich in mercy, because of His great love with which He loved us,

column.name: text
column.value: even when we were dead ①in our wrongdoings, made us alive together ②with Christ (by grace you have been saved), ▷ ①Or by reason of ②Two early mss in Christ

column.name: text
column.value: and raised us up with Him, and seated us with Him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

column.name: text
column.value: so that in the ages to come He might show the ①boundless riches of His grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus. ▷ ①Lit surpassing

column.name: text
column.value: For by grace you have been saved through faith; and ①this is not of yourselves, it is the gift of God; ▷ ①I.e., this salvation

column.name: text
column.value: not a result of works, so that no one may boast.

column.name: text
column.value: For we are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand so that we would walk in them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore remember that previously you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “Uncircumcision” by the so-called “Circumcision” which is performed in the flesh by human hands—

column.name: text
column.value: remember that you were at that time separate from Christ, ①excluded from ②the people of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world. ▷ ①Or alienated ②Or citizenship in Israel

column.name: text
column.value: But now in Christ Jesus you who previously were far away ①have been brought near ②by the blood of Christ. ▷ ①Lit became; or were made ②Or in

column.name: text
column.value: For He Himself is our peace, who made both groups into one and broke down the ①barrier of the dividing wall, ▷ ①Lit the dividing wall of the barrier

column.name: text
column.value: ①by abolishing ②in His flesh the hostility, which is the Law composed of commandments expressed in ordinances, so that in Himself He might ③make the two one new person, in this way establishing peace; ▷ ①Or the hostility, by abolishing in His flesh the Law ②I.e., by His death ③Lit create

column.name: text
column.value: and that He might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, ①by it having put to death the hostility. ▷ ①Or in Himself

column.name: text
column.value: And He came and preached peace to you who were far away, and peace to those who were near;

column.name: text
column.value: for through Him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the ①saints, and are of God’s household, ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: having been built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus Himself being the cornerstone,

column.name: text
column.value: in whom the whole building, being fitted together, is growing into a holy ①temple in the Lord, ▷ ①Or sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: in whom you also are being built together into a dwelling of God in the Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus ①by the will of God, To the ②saints who are ③at Ephesus and are faithful in Christ Jesus: ▷ ①Lit through ②Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people ③Three early mss do not contain at Ephesus

column.name: text
column.value: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,

column.name: text
column.value: just as He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and blameless before ①Him. In love ▷ ①Or Him, in love. He

column.name: text
column.value: ①He predestined us to adoption as sons and daughters through Jesus Christ to Himself, according to the good pleasure of His will, ▷ ①Lit having predestined

column.name: text
column.value: to the praise of the glory of His grace, with which He favored us in the Beloved.

column.name: text
column.value: In ①Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our wrongdoings, according to the riches of His grace ▷ ①Lit whom

column.name: text
column.value: which He ①lavished on ②us. In all wisdom and insight ▷ ①Lit made abundant toward ②Or us in all wisdom and insight. He

column.name: text
column.value: He ①made known to us the mystery of His will, according to His good pleasure which He set forth in Him, ▷ ①Lit making known

column.name: text
column.value: regarding His plan of the fullness of the times, to bring all things together in Christ, things ①in the heavens and things on the earth. ▷ ①Lit upon

column.name: text
column.value: ①In Him we also have obtained an inheritance, having been predestined according to the purpose of Him who works all things in accordance with the plan of His will, ▷ ①Lit In whom also

column.name: text
column.value: to the end that ①we who were the first to hope in the ②Christ would be to the praise of His glory. ▷ ①I.e., Jewish believers ②I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: In ①Him, ②you also, after listening to the message of truth, the gospel of your salvation—having also ③believed, you were sealed in ④Him with the Holy Spirit of the promise, ▷ ①Lit whom ②I.e., Gentile believers ③Or believed in Him, you were sealed ④Lit whom

column.name: text
column.value: who is a first installment of our inheritance, in regard to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of His glory.

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason I too, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which exists among you and ①your love for all the ②saints, ▷ ①Three early mss do not contain your love ②Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: do not cease giving thanks for you, while making mention of you in my prayers;

column.name: text
column.value: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give you a spirit of wisdom and of revelation in the ①knowledge of Him. ▷ ①Or true knowledge

column.name: text
column.value: I pray that the eyes of your heart ①may be enlightened, so that you will know what is the hope of His calling, what are the riches of the glory of His inheritance in the ②saints, ▷ ①Lit having been ②See note 2 v 15

column.name: text
column.value: and what is the ①boundless greatness of His power toward us who believe. These are in accordance with the working of the strength of His might ▷ ①Lit surpassing

column.name: text
column.value: which He brought about in Christ, when He raised Him from the dead and seated Him at His right hand in the heavenly places,

column.name: text
column.value: far above all rule and authority and power and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age but also in the one to come.

column.name: text
column.value: And He put all things in subjection under His feet, and made Him head over all things to the church,

column.name: text
column.value: which is His body, the fullness of Him who fills all in all.

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles—

column.name: text
column.value: if indeed you have heard of the administration of God’s grace which was given to me for you;

column.name: text
column.value: that by revelation there was made known to me the mystery, as I wrote before briefly.

column.name: text
column.value: ①By referring to this, when you read you can understand my insight ②into the mystery of Christ, ▷ ①Lit To which, when you read ②Lit in

column.name: text
column.value: which in other generations was not made known to ①mankind, as it has now been revealed to His holy apostles and prophets ②in the Spirit; ▷ ①Lit the sons of man ②Or by

column.name: text
column.value: to be specific, that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus through the gospel,

column.name: text
column.value: of which I was made a minister, according to the gift of God’s grace which was given to me according to the working of His power.

column.name: text
column.value: To me, the very least of all ①saints, this grace was given, to preach to the Gentiles the unfathomable riches of Christ, ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: and to ①enlighten all people as to what the plan of the mystery is which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things; ▷ ①One early ms bring to light what

column.name: text
column.value: so that the multifaceted wisdom of God might now be made known through the church to the rulers and the authorities in the heavenly places.

column.name: text
column.value: This was in accordance with the ①eternal purpose which He ②carried out in Christ Jesus our Lord, ▷ ①Lit purpose of the ages ②Or formed

column.name: text
column.value: in whom we have boldness and ①confident access through faith ②in Him. ▷ ①Lit access in confidence ②Lit of Him

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I ask ①you not to become discouraged about my tribulations in your behalf, ②since they are your glory. ▷ ①Or that I may not lose ②Lit which are

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason I bend my knees before the Father,

column.name: text
column.value: from whom ①every family in heaven and on earth derives its name, ▷ ①Or the whole

column.name: text
column.value: that He would grant you, according to the riches of His glory, to be strengthened with power through His Spirit in the inner ①self, ▷ ①Lit person

column.name: text
column.value: so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith; and that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

column.name: text
column.value: may be able to comprehend with all the ①saints what is the width and length and height and depth, ▷ ①See note v 8

column.name: text
column.value: and to know the love of Christ which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled to all the fullness of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now to Him who is able to do far more abundantly beyond all that we ask or think, according to the power that works within us,

column.name: text
column.value: to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus to all generations ①forever and ever. Amen. ▷ ①Lit of the age of the ages

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I, the prisoner of the Lord, urge you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling with which you have been called,

column.name: text
column.value: with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

column.name: text
column.value: being diligent to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

column.name: text
column.value: There is one body and one Spirit, just as you also were called in one hope of your calling;

column.name: text
column.value: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

column.name: text
column.value: one God and Father of all who is over all and through all and in all.

column.name: text
column.value: But to each one of us grace was given according to the measure of Christ’s gift.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore ①it says, “WHEN HE ASCENDED ON HIGH, HE LED CAPTIVE the captives, AND HE GAVE GIFTS TO PEOPLE.” ▷ ①Or He

column.name: text
column.value: (Now this expression, “He ascended,” what ①does it mean except that He also ②had descended into the lower parts of the earth? ▷ ①Lit is it except ②One early ms had first descended

column.name: text
column.value: He who descended is Himself also He who ascended far above all the heavens, so that He might fill all things.)

column.name: text
column.value: And He gave some as apostles, some as prophets, some as evangelists, some as ①pastors and teachers, ▷ ①From Gr for shepherds

column.name: text
column.value: for the equipping of the ①saints for the work of ministry, for the building up of the body of Christ; ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: until we all attain to the unity of the faith, and of the ①knowledge of the Son of God, to a mature man, to the measure of the stature ②which belongs to the fullness of Christ. ▷ ①Or true knowledge ②Lit of the fullness

column.name: text
column.value: ①As a result, we are no longer to be children, tossed here and there by waves and carried about by every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of people, by craftiness ②in deceitful scheming; ▷ ①Lit So that we will no longer be ②Lit with regard to the scheming of deceit

column.name: text
column.value: but ①speaking the truth in love, ②we are to grow up in all aspects into Him who is the head, that is, Christ, ▷ ①Or holding to; or being truthful in ②Or let’s grow up

column.name: text
column.value: from whom the whole body, being fitted and held together ①by what every joint supplies, according to the ②proper working of each individual part, causes the growth of the body for the building up of itself in love. ▷ ①Lit through every joint of the supply ②Lit working in measure

column.name: text
column.value: So I say this, and affirm in the Lord, that you are to no longer walk just as the ①Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their minds, ▷ ①I.e., unbelieving Gentiles

column.name: text
column.value: being darkened in their understanding, ①excluded from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardness of their heart; ▷ ①Or alienated

column.name: text
column.value: and they, having become callous, have given themselves up to indecent behavior ①for the practice of every kind of impurity with greediness. ▷ ①Or greedy for the practice of every kind of impurity

column.name: text
column.value: But you did not learn Christ in this way,

column.name: text
column.value: if indeed you have heard Him and have been taught in Him, just as truth is in Jesus,

column.name: text
column.value: that, in reference to your former way of life, you are to rid yourselves of the old ①self, which is being corrupted in accordance with the lusts of deceit, ▷ ①Lit person

column.name: text
column.value: and that you are to be renewed in the spirit of your minds,

column.name: text
column.value: and to put on the new ①self, which ②in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of the truth. ▷ ①Lit person ②Lit according to God

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, ridding yourselves of falsehood, SPEAK TRUTH EACH ONE of you with his neighbor, because we are parts of one another.

column.name: text
column.value: BE ANGRY, AND yet do not sin; do not let the sun go down on your anger,

column.name: text
column.value: and do not give the devil ①an opportunity. ▷ ①Lit a place

column.name: text
column.value: The one who steals must no longer steal; but rather he must labor, producing with his own hands what is good, so that he will have something to share with the one who has need.

column.name: text
column.value: Let no ①unwholesome word come out of your mouth, but if there is any good word for edification ②according to the need of the moment, say that, so that it will give grace to those who hear. ▷ ①Lit rotten ②Lit of the need

column.name: text
column.value: Do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, ①by whom you were sealed for the day of redemption. ▷ ①Lit in

column.name: text
column.value: All bitterness, wrath, anger, ①clamor, and slander must be removed from you, along with all malice. ▷ ①Or shouting

column.name: text
column.value: Be kind to one another, compassionate, forgiving each other, just as God in Christ also has forgiven ①you. ▷ ①Two early mss us

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore be imitators of God, as beloved children;

column.name: text
column.value: and walk in love, just as Christ also loved ①you and gave Himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God ②as a fragrant aroma. ▷ ①One early ms us ②Lit for an odor of fragrance

column.name: text
column.value: But sexual immorality ①or any impurity or greed must not even be mentioned among you, as is proper among ②saints; ▷ ①Lit and all ②Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: and there must be no filthiness ①or foolish talk, or vulgar joking, which are not fitting, but rather giving of thanks. ▷ ①Lit and

column.name: text
column.value: For this you know with certainty, that no sexually immoral or ①impure or greedy person, which ②amounts to an idolater, has an inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and God. ▷ ①I.e., morally impure ②Lit is

column.name: text
column.value: See that no one deceives you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes upon the ①sons of disobedience. ▷ ①I.e., people opposed to God

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore do not become partners with them;

column.name: text
column.value: for you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord; walk as children of light

column.name: text
column.value: (for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness, and truth),

column.name: text
column.value: ①as you try to learn what is pleasing to the Lord. ▷ ①Lit putting to the test what

column.name: text
column.value: Do not participate in the useless deeds of darkness, but instead even expose them;

column.name: text
column.value: for it is disgraceful even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

column.name: text
column.value: But all things become visible when they are exposed by the light, for everything that becomes visible is light.

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason ①it says, “Awake, sleeper, And arise from the dead, And Christ will shine on you.” ▷ ①Or He

column.name: text
column.value: So then, ①be careful how you walk, not as unwise people but as wise, ▷ ①Lit look carefully

column.name: text
column.value: ①making the most of your time, because the days are evil. ▷ ①Lit redeeming the time

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

column.name: text
column.value: And do not get drunk with wine, ①in which there is debauchery, but be filled with the Spirit, ▷ ①Or by which

column.name: text
column.value: speaking to ①one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody with your hearts to the Lord; ▷ ①Or yourselves

column.name: text
column.value: always giving thanks for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to our God and Father;

column.name: text
column.value: ①and subject yourselves to one another in the ②fear of Christ. ▷ ①Lit being submissive to ②Or reverence for

column.name: text
column.value: Wives, subject yourselves to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the church, He Himself being the Savior of the body.

column.name: text
column.value: But as the church is subject to Christ, so also the wives ought to be to their husbands in everything.

column.name: text
column.value: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ also loved the church and gave Himself up for her,

column.name: text
column.value: so that He might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,

column.name: text
column.value: that He might present to Himself the church ①in all her glory, having no spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that she would be holy and blameless. ▷ ①Lit glorious

column.name: text
column.value: So husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself;

column.name: text
column.value: for no one ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, just as Christ also does the church,

column.name: text
column.value: because we are parts of His body.

column.name: text
column.value: FOR THIS REASON A MAN SHALL LEAVE HIS FATHER AND HIS MOTHER AND BE JOINED TO HIS WIFE, AND THE TWO SHALL BECOME ONE FLESH.

column.name: text
column.value: This mystery is great; but I am speaking with reference to Christ and the church.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, as for you individually, each husband is to love his own wife the same as himself, and the wife must see to it that she respects her husband.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore if there is any encouragement in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any ①affection and compassion, ▷ ①Lit inward parts

column.name: text
column.value: make my joy complete ①by being of the same mind, maintaining the same love, united in spirit, intent on one purpose. ▷ ①Lit that you be

column.name: text
column.value: Do nothing ①from ②selfishness or empty conceit, but with humility consider one another as more important than yourselves; ▷ ①Lit according to ②Or contentiousness

column.name: text
column.value: do not merely look out for your own personal interests, but also for the interests of others.

column.name: text
column.value: Have this attitude ①in yourselves which was also in Christ Jesus, ▷ ①Or among

column.name: text
column.value: who, as He already existed in the form of God, did not consider equality with God something to be ①grasped, ▷ ①Or seized

column.name: text
column.value: but ①emptied Himself by taking the form of a bond-servant and ②being born in the likeness of men. ▷ ①I.e., set aside His divine rights ②Or having come to be

column.name: text
column.value: And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself by becoming obedient to the point of death: death ①on a cross. ▷ ①Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason also God highly exalted Him, and bestowed on Him the name which is above every name,

column.name: text
column.value: so that at the name of Jesus EVERY KNEE WILL BOW, of those who are in heaven and on earth and under the earth,

column.name: text
column.value: and that every tongue will confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: So then, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling;

column.name: text
column.value: for it is God who is at work in you, both to ①desire and to work for His good pleasure. ▷ ①Or be willing

column.name: text
column.value: Do all things without complaining or arguments;

column.name: text
column.value: so that you will ①prove yourselves to be blameless and innocent, children of God above reproach in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you ②appear as ③lights in the world, ▷ ①Or become ②Or shine ③Or luminaries, stars

column.name: text
column.value: holding firmly the word of life, so that on the day of Christ I can take pride because I did not run in vain nor labor in vain.

column.name: text
column.value: But even if I am being poured out as a drink offering upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice and share my joy with you all.

column.name: text
column.value: You too, I urge you, rejoice in the same way and share your joy with me.

column.name: text
column.value: But I hope, ①in the Lord Jesus, to send Timothy to you shortly, so that I also may be encouraged when I learn of your condition. ▷ ①Or trusting in

column.name: text
column.value: For I have no one else of kindred spirit who will genuinely be concerned for your welfare.

column.name: text
column.value: For they all seek after their own interests, not those of Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: But you know of his proven character, that he served with me in the furtherance of the gospel like a child serving his father.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I hope to send him immediately, as soon as I see how things go with me;

column.name: text
column.value: and I trust in the Lord that I myself will also be coming shortly.

column.name: text
column.value: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother and fellow worker and fellow soldier, who is also your ①messenger and minister to my need, ▷ ①Lit apostle

column.name: text
column.value: because he was longing ①for you all and was distressed because you had heard that he was sick. ▷ ①One early ms to see you all

column.name: text
column.value: For indeed he was sick to the point of death, but God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, so that I would not have sorrow upon sorrow.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I have sent him all the more eagerly, so that when you see him again you may rejoice and I may be less concerned about you.

column.name: text
column.value: Receive him then in the Lord with all joy, and hold people like him in high regard,

column.name: text
column.value: because he came close to death ①for the work of Christ, risking his life to compensate ②for your absence in your service to me. ▷ ①Lit because of ②Lit your deficiency of service

column.name: text
column.value: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

column.name: text
column.value: HONOR YOUR FATHER AND MOTHER (which is the first commandment with a promise),

column.name: text
column.value: SO THAT IT MAY TURN OUT WELL FOR YOU, AND THAT YOU MAY LIVE LONG ON THE EARTH.

column.name: text
column.value: Fathers, do not provoke your children to anger, but bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Slaves, be obedient to those who are your ①masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in the sincerity of your heart, as to Christ; ▷ ①I.e., earthly masters, as in first-century Roman culture

column.name: text
column.value: not ①by way of ②eye-service, as people-pleasers, but as slaves of Christ, doing the will of God from the ③heart. ▷ ①Lit according to ②I.e., only when the master is watching ③Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: With goodwill ①render service, as to the Lord, and not to people, ▷ ①Lit rendering

column.name: text
column.value: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive this back from the Lord, whether slave or free.

column.name: text
column.value: And masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of His might.

column.name: text
column.value: Put on the full armor of God, so that you will be able to stand firm against the schemes of the devil.

column.name: text
column.value: For our struggle is not against ①flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the powers, against the world forces of this darkness, against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places. ▷ ①Lit blood and flesh

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, take up the full armor of God, so that you will be able to resist on the evil day, and having done everything, to stand firm.

column.name: text
column.value: Stand firm therefore, having belted your waist with truth, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

column.name: text
column.value: and having strapped on your feet the preparation of the gospel of peace;

column.name: text
column.value: ①in addition to all, taking up the shield of faith with which you will be able to extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one. ▷ ①Lit in all

column.name: text
column.value: And take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.

column.name: text
column.value: ①With every prayer and request, ②pray at all times in the Spirit, and with this in view, ③be alert with all perseverance and every request for all the ④saints, ▷ ①Lit Through ②Lit praying ③Lit being ④Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: and pray in my behalf, that speech may be given to me in the opening of my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the gospel,

column.name: text
column.value: for which I am an ambassador in ①chains; that ②in proclaiming it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak. ▷ ①Lit a chain ②Two early mss I may speak it boldly

column.name: text
column.value: Now, so that you also may know about my circumstances as to ①what I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful ②servant in the Lord, will make everything known to you. ▷ ①Or how ②Or minister

column.name: text
column.value: ①I have sent him to you for this very purpose, so that you may know ②about us, and that he may comfort your hearts. ▷ ①Lit Whom I have sent to you ②Lit the things about us

column.name: text
column.value: Peace be to the brothers and sisters, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ ①with incorruptible love. ▷ ①Lit in incorruption

column.name: text
column.value: Paul and Timothy, bond-servants of Christ Jesus, To all the ①saints in Christ Jesus who are in Philippi, ②including the overseers and deacons: ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people ②Lit with

column.name: text
column.value: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: I thank my God in all my remembrance of you,

column.name: text
column.value: always offering prayer with joy in my every prayer for you all,

column.name: text
column.value: in view of your ①participation in the gospel from the first day until now. ▷ ①Or sharing in the preaching of the gospel

column.name: text
column.value: For I am confident of this very thing, that He who began a good work ①among you will complete it ②by the day of Christ Jesus. ▷ ①Or in ②Lit until

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: For God is my witness, how I long for you all with the ①affection of Christ Jesus. ▷ ①Lit inward parts

column.name: text
column.value: And this I pray, that your love may overflow still more and more in real knowledge and all discernment,

column.name: text
column.value: so that you may ①discover the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and blameless for the day of Christ; ▷ ①Or approve the things that matter

column.name: text
column.value: having been filled with the fruit of righteousness which comes through Jesus Christ, for the glory and praise of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I want you to know, brothers and sisters, that my circumstances have turned out for the greater progress of the gospel,

column.name: text
column.value: so that my ①imprisonment in the cause of Christ has become well known throughout the ②praetorian guard and to everyone else, ▷ ①Lit bonds ②Or governor’s palace

column.name: text
column.value: and that most of the brothers and sisters, ①trusting in the Lord because of my ②imprisonment, have far more courage to speak the word of God without fear. ▷ ①Or in the Lord, trusting because of ②Lit bonds

column.name: text
column.value: Some, to be sure, are preaching Christ even ①from envy and strife, but some also ②from goodwill; ▷ ①Lit because of ②Lit because of

column.name: text
column.value: the latter do it out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel;

column.name: text
column.value: the former proclaim Christ out of selfish ambition ①rather than from pure motives, thinking that they are causing me distress in my ②imprisonment. ▷ ①Lit not sincerely ②Lit bonds

column.name: text
column.value: What then? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed, and in this I rejoice. But not only that, I also will rejoice,

column.name: text
column.value: for I know that this will turn out for my ①deliverance through your ②prayers and the provision of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, ▷ ①Or salvation ②Lit supplication

column.name: text
column.value: according to my eager expectation and hope, that I will not be put to shame in anything, but that with all boldness, Christ will even now, as always, be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death.

column.name: text
column.value: For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

column.name: text
column.value: ①But if I am to live on in the flesh, this will mean fruitful labor for me; and I do not know ②which to choose. ▷ ①Or But if to live in the flesh, this will be fruitful labor for me, then I ②Lit what I shall choose

column.name: text
column.value: But I am hard-pressed from both directions, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, for that is very much better;

column.name: text
column.value: yet to remain on in the flesh is more necessary for your sakes.

column.name: text
column.value: Convinced of this, I know that I will remain and continue with you all for your progress and joy ①in the faith, ▷ ①Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: so that your pride in Christ Jesus may be abundant because of me by my coming to you again.

column.name: text
column.value: Only conduct yourselves in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ, so that whether I come and see you or remain absent, I will hear about you that you are standing firm in one spirit, with one ①mind striving together for the faith of the gospel; ▷ ①Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: and in no way alarmed by your opponents—which is a sign of destruction for them, but of salvation for you, and this too, from God.

column.name: text
column.value: For to you it has been granted for Christ’s sake, not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer on His behalf,

column.name: text
column.value: experiencing the same conflict which you saw in me, and now hear to be in me.

column.name: text
column.value: Finally, my brothers and sisters, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things again is no trouble for me, and it is a safeguard for you.

column.name: text
column.value: Beware of the dogs, beware of the evil workers, beware of the ①false circumcision; ▷ ①Lit mutilation; Gr katatome

column.name: text
column.value: for we are the true ①circumcision, who worship in the Spirit of God and take pride in Christ Jesus, and put no confidence in the flesh, ▷ ①Gr peritome

column.name: text
column.value: although I myself could boast as having confidence even in the flesh. If anyone else thinks he is confident in the flesh, I have more reason:

column.name: text
column.value: circumcised the eighth day, of the nation of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; as to the Law, a Pharisee;

column.name: text
column.value: as to zeal, a persecutor of the church; as to the righteousness which is in the Law, found blameless.

column.name: text
column.value: But whatever things were gain to me, these things I have counted as loss because of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: More than that, I count all things to be loss ①in view of the surpassing value of ②knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, ③for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and count them mere rubbish, so that I may gain Christ, ▷ ①Lit because of ②Lit the knowledge of ③Lit because of

column.name: text
column.value: and may be found in Him, not having a righteousness of my own derived from the Law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which comes from God on the basis of faith,

column.name: text
column.value: that I may know Him and the power of His resurrection and ①the fellowship of His sufferings, being conformed to His death; ▷ ①Or participation in

column.name: text
column.value: if somehow I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: Not that I have already ①grasped it all or have already become perfect, but I press on if I may also take hold of that ②for which I was even taken hold of by Christ Jesus. ▷ ①Or obtained ②Or because also

column.name: text
column.value: Brothers and sisters, I do not regard myself as having taken hold of it yet; but one thing I do: forgetting what lies behind and reaching forward to what lies ahead,

column.name: text
column.value: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the upward call of God in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, all who are ①mature, let’s have this attitude; and if in anything you have a different attitude, God will reveal that to you as well; ▷ ①Or perfect

column.name: text
column.value: however, let’s keep ①living by that same standard to which we have attained. ▷ ①Lit following in line

column.name: text
column.value: Brothers and sisters, join in following my example, and observe those who walk according to the pattern you have in us.

column.name: text
column.value: For many walk, of whom I often told you, and now tell you even as I weep, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ,

column.name: text
column.value: whose end is destruction, whose god is their ①appetite, and whose glory is in their shame, who have their minds on earthly things. ▷ ①Lit belly

column.name: text
column.value: For our ①citizenship is in heaven, from which we also eagerly wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ; ▷ ①Lit commonwealth

column.name: text
column.value: who will transform the body of our lowly condition into conformity with ①His glorious body, by the exertion of the power that He has even to subject all things to Himself. ▷ ①Lit the body of His glory

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, my beloved brothers and sisters, ①whom I long to see, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved. ▷ ①Lit and longed for

column.name: text
column.value: I urge Euodia and I urge Syntyche to ①live in harmony in the Lord. ▷ ①Or be of the same mind

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, true ①companion, I ask you also, help these women who have shared my struggle in the cause of the gospel, together with Clement as well as the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life. ▷ ①Lit yokefellow

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice in the Lord always; again I will say, rejoice!

column.name: text
column.value: Let your gentle spirit be known to all people. The Lord is ①near. ▷ ①Or at hand

column.name: text
column.value: Do not ①be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and pleading with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God. ▷ ①I.e., have anxiety

column.name: text
column.value: And the peace of God, which surpasses all ①comprehension, will guard your hearts and minds in Christ Jesus. ▷ ①Lit mind

column.name: text
column.value: Finally, brothers and sisters, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is ①lovely, whatever is commendable, if there is any excellence and if anything worthy of praise, think about these things. ▷ ①Or lovable and gracious

column.name: text
column.value: As for the things you have learned and received and heard and seen in me, practice these things, and the God of peace will be with you.

column.name: text
column.value: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at last you have revived your concern for me; indeed, you were concerned before, but you lacked an opportunity to act.

column.name: text
column.value: Not that I speak ①from need, for I have learned to be ②content in whatever circumstances I am. ▷ ①Lit according to ②Or self-sufficient

column.name: text
column.value: I know how to get along with little, and I also know how to live in prosperity; in any and every circumstance I have learned the secret of being filled and going hungry, both of having abundance and suffering need.

column.name: text
column.value: I can do all things ①through Him who strengthens me. ▷ ①Lit in

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, you have done well to share with me in my difficulty.

column.name: text
column.value: You yourselves also know, Philippians, that at the ①first preaching of the gospel, after I left Macedonia, no church shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving except you alone; ▷ ①Lit beginning of

column.name: text
column.value: Not that I seek the gift itself, but I seek the ①profit which increases to your account. ▷ ①Lit fruit

column.name: text
column.value: But I have received everything in full and have an abundance; I am ①amply supplied, having received from Epaphroditus ②what you have sent, ③a fragrant aroma, an acceptable sacrifice, pleasing to God. ▷ ①Lit made full ②Lit the things from you ③Lit an odor of fragrance

column.name: text
column.value: And my God will supply ①all your needs according to His riches in glory in Christ Jesus. ▷ ①Or every need of yours

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: Greet every ①saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you. ▷ ①Or holy one; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified us ①to share in the inheritance of the ②saints in light. ▷ ①Lit unto the portion of ②Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and in my flesh I am supplementing what is lacking ①in Christ’s afflictions in behalf of His body, which is the church. ▷ ①Lit of

column.value: But now you also, rid yourselves of all of them: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and obscene speech from your mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Do not lie to one another, since you stripped off the old ②self with its evil practices, ▷ ①Or Stop lying ②Lit person

column.name: text
column.value: and have put on the new self, which is being ①renewed to a true knowledge according to the image of the One who created it— ▷ ①Lit renovated

column.name: text
column.value: a renewal in which there is no distinction between Greek and Jew, circumcised and uncircumcised, ①barbarian, ②Scythian, slave, and free, but Christ is all, and in all. ▷ ①I.e., uncultured ②I.e., a member of an ancient people near the Black Sea, often considered unrefined

column.name: text
column.value: So, as those who have been chosen of God, holy and beloved, put on a heart of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and ①patience; ▷ ①I.e., forbearance toward others

column.name: text
column.value: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, whoever has a complaint against anyone; just as the Lord forgave you, so must you do also.

column.name: text
column.value: In addition to all these things put on love, which is ①the perfect bond of unity. ▷ ①Lit the uniting bond of perfection

column.name: text
column.value: Let the peace of Christ, to which you were ①indeed called in one body, ②rule in your hearts; and ③be thankful. ▷ ①Or also ②Or be in control in ③Or show yourselves thankful

column.name: text
column.value: Let the word of ①Christ richly dwell within you, ②with all wisdom teaching and admonishing ③one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with thankfulness in your hearts to God. ▷ ①One early ms the Lord ②Or in ③Or one another, singing with psalms...

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever you do in word or deed, do everything in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks through Him to God the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: Wives, be subject to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Husbands, love your wives and do not become bitter against them.

column.name: text
column.value: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing ①to the Lord. ▷ ①Lit in

column.name: text
column.value: Fathers, do not ①antagonize your children, so that they will not become discouraged. ▷ ①Or provoke to anger

column.name: text
column.value: ①Slaves, obey those who are your ②human masters in everything, not with ③eye-service, as people-pleasers, but with sincerity of heart, fearing the Lord. ▷ ①I.e., slaves in first-century Roman culture ②Lit masters according to flesh ③I.e., working only when watched

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever you do, do your work ①heartily, as for the Lord and not for people, ▷ ①Lit from the soul

column.name: text
column.value: knowing that it is from the Lord that you will receive the reward ①of the inheritance. It is the Lord Christ whom you serve. ▷ ①I.e., consisting of

column.name: text
column.value: For the one who does wrong will receive the consequences of the wrong which he has done, and ①that without partiality. ▷ ①Lit there is no partiality

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace.

column.name: text
column.value: We always give thanks to God for all of you, making mention of you in our prayers;

column.name: text
column.value: constantly keeping in mind your work of faith and labor of love and ①perseverance of hope ②in our Lord Jesus Christ in the presence of our God and Father, ▷ ①Or steadfastness ②Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: knowing, brothers and sisters, beloved by God, His choice of you;

column.name: text
column.value: for our gospel did not come to you in word only, but also in power and in the Holy Spirit and with full conviction; just as you know what kind of men we proved to be among you for your sakes.

column.name: text
column.value: You also became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word during great affliction with the joy of the Holy Spirit,

column.name: text
column.value: so that you became an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.

column.name: text
column.value: For the word of the Lord has sounded forth from you, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but in every place the news of your faith toward God has gone out, so that we have no need to say anything.

column.name: text
column.value: For they themselves report about us ①as to the kind of reception we had with you, and how you turned to God from ②idols to serve ③a living and true God, ▷ ①Lit what kind of ②Or the idols ③Or the

column.name: text
column.value: and to wait for His Son from ①heaven, whom He raised from the dead, that is, Jesus who rescues us from the wrath to come. ▷ ①Lit the heavens

column.name: text
column.value: Masters, grant your slaves justice and fairness, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Devote yourselves to prayer, keeping alert in it with an attitude of thanksgiving;

column.name: text
column.value: praying at the same time for us as well, that God will open up to us a door for the word, so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ, for which I have also been imprisoned;

column.name: text
column.value: that I may make it clear in the way that I ought to proclaim it.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Conduct yourselves with wisdom toward outsiders, ②making the most of the opportunity. ▷ ①Lit Walk ②Lit redeeming the time

column.name: text
column.value: Your speech must always be ①with grace, as though seasoned with salt, so that you will know how you should respond to each person. ▷ ①Or gracious

column.name: text
column.value: As to all my affairs, Tychicus, our beloved brother and faithful servant and fellow bond-servant in the Lord, will bring you information.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about our circumstances and that he may encourage your hearts;

column.name: text
column.value: ①and with him is Onesimus, our faithful and beloved brother, who is one of your own. They will inform you about the whole situation here. ▷ ①Lit along with Onesimus

column.name: text
column.value: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, sends you his greetings; and also Barnabas’ cousin Mark (about whom you received ①instructions; if he comes to you, welcome him); ▷ ①Or orders

column.name: text
column.value: and also Jesus who is called Justus; these are the only fellow workers for the kingdom of God who are from the circumcision, and they have proved to be an encouragement to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Epaphras, who is one of your own, a bond-servant of Christ Jesus, sends you his greetings, always striving earnestly for you in his prayers, that you may ①stand ②mature and ③fully assured in all the will of God. ▷ ①Or stand firm ②Or fully developed ③Or made complete

column.name: text
column.value: For I testify for him that he has ①a deep concern for you and for those who are in Laodicea and Hierapolis. ▷ ①Or much toil; or great pain

column.name: text
column.value: Luke, the beloved physician, sends you his greetings, and Demas does also.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet the brothers and sisters who are in Laodicea and also ①Nympha and the church that is in ②her house. ▷ ①Or Nymphas (masc) ②One early ms their

column.name: text
