column.value: When ①this letter is read among you, have it also read in the church of the Laodiceans; and you, for your part, read ②my letter that is coming from Laodicea. ▷ ①Lit the ②Lit the

column.name: text
column.value: Tell Archippus, “See to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, so that you may ①fulfill it.” ▷ ①Or continually fulfill

column.name: text
column.value: ①I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my ②imprisonment. Grace be with you. ▷ ①Lit The greeting by my hand of Paul ②Lit bonds

column.name: text
column.value: For you yourselves know, brothers and sisters, that our ①reception among you was not in vain, ▷ ①Or coming to you

column.name: text
column.value: but after we had already suffered and been treated abusively in Philippi, as you know, we had the boldness in our God to speak to you the gospel of God ①amid much ②opposition. ▷ ①Or during ②Or struggle; or conflict

column.name: text
column.value: For our exhortation does not come from error or impurity or ①by way of deceit; ▷ ①Lit in deceit

column.name: text
column.value: but just as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, so we speak, not intending to please people, but to please God, who ①examines our hearts. ▷ ①Or approves

column.name: text
column.value: For we never came ①with flattering speech, as you know, nor with a pretext ②for greed—God is our witness— ▷ ①Lit in a word of flattery ②I.e., to conceal greed

column.name: text
column.value: nor did we seek honor from people, either from you or from others, though ①we could have ②asserted our authority as apostles of Christ. ▷ ①Lit being able to ②Or been burdensome as

column.name: text
column.value: But we ①proved to be ②gentle ③among you. As a nursing mother ④tenderly cares for her own children, ▷ ①Or became gentle ②Three early mss infants ③Lit in the midst of you ④Or cherishes

column.name: text
column.value: in the same way we had a fond affection for you and were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God, but also our own ①lives, because you had become ②very dear to us. ▷ ①Or souls ②Lit beloved

column.name: text
column.value: For you recall, brothers and sisters, our labor and hardship: it was by working night and day so as not to be a burden to any of you, that we proclaimed to you the gospel of God.

column.name: text
column.value: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how devoutly and rightly and blamelessly we ①behaved toward you ②believers; ▷ ①Lit became ②Or who believe

column.name: text
column.value: just as you know how we were exhorting and encouraging and imploring each one of you as a father would his own children,

column.name: text
column.value: so that you would walk in a manner worthy of the God who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason we also constantly thank God that when you received the word of God which you heard from us, you accepted it not as the word of mere men, but as what it really is, the word of God, which also is at work in you who believe.

column.name: text
column.value: For you, brothers and sisters, became imitators of the churches of God in Christ Jesus that are in Judea, for you also endured the same sufferings at the hands of your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews,

column.name: text
column.value: who both killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and ①drove us out. ②They are not pleasing to God, ③but hostile to all people, ▷ ①Or persecuted us ②Lit and ③Lit and

column.name: text
column.value: hindering us from speaking to the Gentiles so that they may be saved; with the result that they always ①reach the limit of their sins. But wrath has come upon them ②fully. ▷ ①Lit complete their ②Or forever; lit to the end

column.name: text
column.value: But we, brothers and sisters, having been orphaned from you by absence for a ①short while—in ②person, not in ③spirit—were all the more eager with great desire to see your face. ▷ ①Lit occasion of an hour ②Lit face ③Lit heart

column.name: text
column.value: ①For we wanted to come to you—I, Paul, ②more than once—and Satan hindered us. ▷ ①Or Because ②Lit both once and twice

column.name: text
column.value: For who is our hope, or joy or crown of pride, in the presence of our Lord Jesus at His ①coming? Or is it not indeed you? ▷ ①Or presence

column.name: text
column.value: For you are our glory and joy.

column.name: text
column.value: Finally then, brothers and sisters, we request and urge you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received instruction from us as to how you ought to ①walk and please God (just as you actually do ②walk), that you excel even more. ▷ ①Or conduct yourselves ②Or conduct yourselves

column.name: text
column.value: For you know what instructions we gave you ①by the authority of the Lord Jesus. ▷ ①Lit through the Lord

column.name: text
column.value: For this is the will of God, your sanctification; that is, that you abstain from sexual immorality;

column.name: text
column.value: that each of you know how to ①possess his own ②vessel in sanctification and honor, ▷ ①Or acquire ②I.e., body; or wife

column.name: text
column.value: not in ①lustful passion, like the Gentiles who do not know God; ▷ ①Lit passion of lust

column.name: text
column.value: and that no one violate the rights and take advantage of his brother or sister in the matter, because the Lord is the avenger in all these things, just as we also told you previously and solemnly warned you.

column.name: text
column.value: For God has not called us for ①impurity, but in sanctification. ▷ ①I.e., moral corruption

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, the one who rejects this is not rejecting man, but the God who gives His Holy Spirit to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Now as to the love of the brothers and sisters, you have no need for anyone to write to you, for you yourselves are taught by God to love one another;

column.name: text
column.value: for indeed you practice it toward all the brothers and sisters who are in all Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers and sisters, to excel even more,

column.name: text
column.value: and to make it your ambition to lead a quiet life and attend to your own business and work with your hands, just as we instructed you,

column.name: text
column.value: so that you will ①behave properly toward outsiders and ②not be in any need. ▷ ①Lit walk ②Lit have need of nothing

column.name: text
column.value: But we do not want you to be uninformed, brothers and sisters, about those who ①are asleep, so that you will not grieve as indeed the rest of mankind do, who have no hope. ▷ ①I.e., have died

column.name: text
column.value: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose from the dead, so also God will bring with Him those who have fallen asleep ①through Jesus. ▷ ①I.e., as believers

column.name: text
column.value: For we say this to you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive ①and remain until the coming of the Lord will not precede those who have fallen asleep. ▷ ①Lit who

column.name: text
column.value: For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a ①shout, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first. ▷ ①Or cry of command

column.name: text
column.value: Then we who are alive, who remain, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air, and so we will always be with the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, ①comfort one another with these words. ▷ ①Or encourage

column.name: text
column.value: Now as to the periods and ①times, brothers and sisters, you have no need of anything to be written to you. ▷ ①I.e., the end times

column.name: text
column.value: For you yourselves know full well that the day of the Lord is coming just like a thief in the night.

column.name: text
column.value: While they are saying, “Peace and safety!” then sudden destruction ①will come upon them like labor pains upon a pregnant woman, and they will not escape. ▷ ①Lit is coming

column.name: text
column.value: But you, brothers and sisters, are not in darkness, so that the day would overtake you ①like a thief; ▷ ①One early ms like thieves

column.name: text
column.value: for you are all sons of light and sons of day. We are not of night nor of darkness;

column.name: text
column.value: so then, let’s not sleep as ①others do, but let’s be alert and ②sober. ▷ ①Lit the rest (of mankind) ②Or self-controlled

column.name: text
column.value: For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who are drunk, get drunk at night.

column.name: text
column.value: But since we are of the day, let’s be ①sober, having put on the breastplate of faith and love, and as a helmet, the hope of salvation. ▷ ①Or self-controlled

column.name: text
column.value: For God has not destined us for wrath, but for obtaining salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

column.name: text
column.value: who died for us, so that whether we are awake or asleep, we will live together with Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, ①encourage one another and build one another up, just as you also are doing. ▷ ①Or comfort

column.name: text
column.value: But we ask you, brothers and sisters, to recognize those who diligently labor among you and ①are in leadership over you in the Lord, and give you ②instruction, ▷ ①Or care for you ②Or admonition

column.name: text
column.value: and that you regard them very highly in love because of their work. Live in peace with one another.

column.name: text
column.value: We urge you, brothers and sisters, admonish the ①unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, be patient with everyone. ▷ ①Or undisciplined

column.name: text
column.value: See that no one repays another with evil for evil, but always seek what is good for one another and for all people.

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice always,

column.name: text
column.value: pray without ceasing,

column.name: text
column.value: in everything give thanks; for this is the will of God for you in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not quench the Spirit,

column.name: text
column.value: do not utterly reject ①prophecies, ▷ ①Or prophetic gifts

column.name: text
column.value: but examine everything; hold firmly to that which is good,

column.name: text
column.value: abstain from every ①form of evil. ▷ ①Or appearance

column.name: text
column.value: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you entirely; and may your spirit and soul and body be kept complete, without blame at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Faithful is He who calls you, and He also will do it.

column.name: text
column.value: Brothers and sisters, pray for us ①. ▷ ①Two early mss add also

column.name: text
column.value: Greet all the brothers and sisters with a holy kiss.

column.name: text
column.value: I put you under oath by the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers and sisters.

column.name: text
column.value: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

column.name: text
column.value: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: We ought always to give thanks to God for you, brothers and sisters, as is only fitting, because your faith is increasing abundantly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another grows ever greater.

column.name: text
column.value: As a result, we ourselves speak proudly of you among the churches of God for your ①perseverance and faith ②in the midst of all your persecutions and afflictions which you endure. ▷ ①Or steadfastness ②Or during all

column.name: text
column.value: This is ①a plain indication of God’s righteous judgment so that you will be considered worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you indeed are suffering. ▷ ①Or proof of

column.name: text
column.value: ①For after all it is only right ②for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you, ▷ ①Lit If indeed ②Or in the sight of

column.name: text
column.value: and to give relief to you who are afflicted, along with us, ①when the Lord Jesus will be revealed from heaven with ②His mighty angels ▷ ①Lit at the revelation of the Lord Jesus ②Lit the angels of His power

column.name: text
column.value: in flaming fire, dealing out retribution to those who do not know God, and to those who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: These people will pay the penalty of eternal destruction, away from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of His power,

column.name: text
column.value: when He comes to be glorified among His ①saints on that day, and to be marveled at among all who have believed—because our testimony to you was believed. ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: To this end also we pray for you always, that our God will consider you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire for goodness and the work of faith with power,

column.name: text
column.value: so that the name of our Lord Jesus will be glorified in you, and you in Him, in accordance with the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Now we ask you, brothers and sisters, regarding the ①coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to Him, ▷ ①Or presence

column.name: text
column.value: that you not be quickly shaken from your ①composure or be disturbed either by a spirit, or a ②message, or a letter as if from us, to the effect that the day of the Lord has come. ▷ ①Lit mind ②Lit word

column.name: text
column.value: No one is to deceive you in any way! For it will not come unless the ①apostasy comes first, and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the son of destruction, ▷ ①Or falling away from the faith

column.name: text
column.value: who opposes and exalts himself above ①every so-called god or object of worship, so that he takes his seat in the temple of God, displaying himself as being God. ▷ ①Or everyone who is called God

column.name: text
column.value: Do you not remember that while I was still with you, I was telling you these things?

column.name: text
column.value: And you know what restrains him now, so that he will be revealed in his time.

column.name: text
column.value: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work; only ①He who now restrains will do so until ②He is ③removed. ▷ ①Or he ②Or he ③Or out of the way

column.name: text
column.value: Then that lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will eliminate with the breath of His mouth and bring to an end by the appearance of His ①coming; ▷ ①Or presence

column.name: text
column.value: that is, the one whose ①coming is in accord with the activity of Satan, with all power and false ②signs and wonders, ▷ ①Or presence ②I.e., confirming miracles

column.name: text
column.value: and with ①all the deception of wickedness for those who perish, because they did not accept the love of the truth so as to be saved. ▷ ①Or every deception

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason God ①will send upon them ②a deluding influence so that they will believe ③what is false, ▷ ①Lit is sending ②Lit an activity of error ③Or the lie

column.name: text
column.value: in order that they all may be ①judged who did not believe the truth, but ②took pleasure in wickedness. ▷ ①Or condemned ②Or approved

column.name: text
column.value: But we should always give thanks to God for you, brothers and sisters beloved by the Lord, because God has chosen you ①from the beginning for salvation ②through sanctification ③by the Spirit and faith in the truth. ▷ ①One early ms first fruits ②Lit in ③Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: It was for this He called you through our gospel, ①that you may obtain the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ. ▷ ①Lit to the obtaining of

column.name: text
column.value: So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold on to the traditions which you were taught, whether by word of mouth or by letter ①from us. ▷ ①Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, who has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope by grace,

column.name: text
column.value: comfort and strengthen your hearts in every good work and word.

column.name: text
column.value: Finally, brothers and sisters, pray for us that the word of the Lord will ①spread rapidly and be glorified, just as it was also with you; ▷ ①Lit run

column.name: text
column.value: and that we will be rescued from troublesome and evil people; for not all have the faith.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Lord is faithful, ①and He will strengthen and protect you ②from the evil one. ▷ ①Lit who will ②Or from evil

column.name: text
column.value: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you are doing, and will do, what we command.

column.name: text
column.value: May the Lord direct your hearts to the love of God and to the perseverance of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Now we command you, brothers and sisters, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you ①keep away from every brother or sister who ②leads a ③disorderly life and not one in accordance with the tradition which ④you received from us. ▷ ①Or avoid ②Lit walks disorderly ③Or undisciplined ④One early ms they

column.name: text
column.value: For you yourselves know how you ought to ①follow our example, because we did not act in an undisciplined way among you, ▷ ①Or imitate us

column.name: text
column.value: nor did we eat ①anyone’s bread ②without paying for it, but with labor and hardship we kept working night and day so that we would not be a burden to any of you; ▷ ①Lit from anyone ②Lit freely

column.name: text
column.value: not because we do not have the right to this, but in order to offer ourselves as a role model for you, so that you would ①follow our example. ▷ ①Or imitate us

column.name: text
column.value: For even when we were with you, we used to give you this order: if anyone is not willing to work, then he is not to eat, either.

column.name: text
column.value: For we hear that some among you are leading an undisciplined life, doing no work at all, but acting like busybodies.

column.name: text
column.value: Now we command and exhort such persons in the Lord Jesus Christ to work ①peacefully and eat their own bread. ▷ ①Lit with quietness

column.name: text
column.value: But as for you, brothers and sisters, do not grow weary of doing good.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone does not obey our ①instruction ②in this letter, take special note of that person so as not to associate with him, so that he will be put to shame. ▷ ①Lit word ②Lit through

column.name: text
column.value: And yet do not regard that person as an enemy, but ①admonish that one as a brother or sister. ▷ ①Or keep admonishing

column.name: text
column.value: Now may the Lord of peace Himself continually grant you peace in every ①circumstance. The Lord be with you all! ▷ ①Lit way

column.name: text
column.value: ①I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, and this is a distinguishing mark in every letter; this is the way I write. ▷ ①Lit The greeting by my hand of Paul

column.name: text
column.value: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus according to the commandment of God our Savior, and of Christ Jesus, who is our hope,

column.name: text
column.value: To Timothy, my true ①son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord. ▷ ①Or child

column.name: text
column.value: Just as I urged you ①upon my departure for Macedonia, to remain on at Ephesus so that you would instruct certain people not to teach strange doctrines, ▷ ①Lit while going to

column.name: text
column.value: nor to ①pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which give rise to useless speculation rather than advance ②the plan of God, which is by faith, so I urge you now. ▷ ①Or occupy themselves with ②I.e., prob. the plan of salvation

column.name: text
column.value: But the goal of our ①instruction is love from a pure heart, from a good conscience, and from a sincere faith. ▷ ①Lit commandment

column.name: text
column.value: Some people have strayed from these things and have turned aside to fruitless discussion,

column.name: text
column.value: wanting to be teachers of the Law, even though they do not understand either what they are saying or the matters about which they make confident assertions.

column.name: text
column.value: But we know that the Law is good, if one uses it lawfully,

column.name: text
column.value: realizing the fact that law is not made for a righteous person but for those who are lawless and rebellious, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and worldly, for those who kill their fathers or mothers, for murderers,

column.name: text
column.value: for the ①sexually immoral, homosexuals, ②slave traders, liars, perjurers, and whatever else is contrary to sound teaching, ▷ ①Or fornicators ②Or kidnappers

column.name: text
column.value: according to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, with which I have been entrusted.

column.name: text
column.value: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has strengthened me, because He considered me faithful, putting me into service,

column.name: text
column.value: even though I was previously a blasphemer and a persecutor and a violent aggressor. Yet I was shown mercy because I acted ignorantly in unbelief;

column.name: text
column.value: and the grace of our Lord was more than abundant, with the faith and love which are found in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: It is a trustworthy statement, deserving full acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, among whom I am foremost.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet for this reason I found mercy, so that in me as the foremost sinner Jesus Christ might demonstrate His perfect patience as an example for those ①who would believe in Him for eternal life. ▷ ①Or destined to

column.name: text
column.value: Now to the King ①eternal, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honor and glory ②forever and ever. Amen. ▷ ①Lit to the ages of the ages ②Lit of the ages

column.name: text
column.value: This command I entrust to you, Timothy, my ①son, in accordance with the prophecies previously made concerning you, that by them you fight the good fight, ▷ ①Or child

column.name: text
column.value: keeping faith and a good conscience, which some have rejected and suffered shipwreck in regard to ①their faith. ▷ ①Or the

column.name: text
column.value: ①Among these are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan, so that they will be taught not to blaspheme. ▷ ①Lit Of

column.name: text
column.value: First of all, then, I urge that requests, prayers, intercession, and thanksgiving be made in behalf of all people,

column.name: text
column.value: for kings and all who are in ①authority, so that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and ②dignity. ▷ ①Or a high position ②Or seriousness

column.name: text
column.value: This is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,

column.name: text
column.value: who wants all people to be saved and to come to the ①knowledge of the truth. ▷ ①Or recognition

column.name: text
column.value: For there is one God, and one mediator also between God and mankind, the man Christ Jesus,

column.name: text
column.value: who gave Himself as a ransom for all, the testimony ①given at ②the proper time. ▷ ①Or to be given ②Lit its own times

column.name: text
column.value: For this I was appointed as a ①preacher and an apostle (I am telling the truth, I am not lying), as a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth. ▷ ①Or herald

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I want the men in every place to pray, lifting up holy hands, without anger and dispute.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise, I want women to adorn themselves with proper clothing, ①modestly and discreetly, not with braided hair and gold or pearls or expensive apparel, ▷ ①Lit with modesty

column.name: text
column.value: but rather by means of good works, as is proper for women making a claim to godliness.

column.name: text
column.value: A woman must quietly receive instruction with entire submissiveness.

column.name: text
column.value: But I do not allow a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man, but to remain quiet.

column.name: text
column.value: For it was Adam who was first ①created, and then Eve. ▷ ①Or formed

column.name: text
column.value: And it was not Adam who was deceived, but the woman was ①deceived and ②became a wrongdoer. ▷ ①Or thoroughly deceived ②Lit has become

column.name: text
column.value: But ①women will be ②preserved through ③childbirth—if they continue in faith, love, and sanctity, with moderation. ▷ ①Lit she ②Or saved ③Or the childbirth; or the bearing of children

column.name: text
column.value: It is a trustworthy statement: if any man aspires to the office of ①overseer, it is a fine work he desires to do. ▷ ①Or bishop

column.name: text
column.value: ①An overseer, then, must be above reproach, the husband of one wife, ②temperate, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, skillful in teaching, ▷ ①Lit The ②Or level-headed

column.name: text
column.value: not overindulging in wine, not ①a bully, but gentle, not contentious, free from the love of money. ▷ ①Or combative

column.name: text
column.value: He must be one who manages his own household well, keeping his children under control with all dignity

column.name: text
column.value: (but if a man does not know how to manage his own household, how will he take care of the church of God?),

column.name: text
column.value: and not a new convert, so that he will not become conceited and fall into condemnation ①incurred by the devil. ▷ ①Lit of the devil

column.name: text
column.value: And he must have a good reputation with those outside the church, so that he will not fall into ①disgrace and the snare of the devil. ▷ ①Or reproach

column.name: text
column.value: Deacons likewise must be men of dignity, not ①insincere, not prone to drink much wine, not greedy for money, ▷ ①Or given to double-talk

column.name: text
column.value: but holding to the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience.

column.name: text
column.value: These men must also first be tested; then have them serve as deacons if they are beyond reproach.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Women must likewise be dignified, not malicious gossips, but ②temperate, faithful in all things. ▷ ①I.e., either deacons’ wives or deaconesses ②Or level-headed

column.name: text
column.value: Deacons must be husbands of one wife, and ①good managers of their children and their own households. ▷ ①Lit managing well

column.name: text
column.value: For those who have served well as deacons obtain for themselves a ①high standing and great confidence in the faith that is in Christ Jesus. ▷ ①Lit good

column.name: text
column.value: I am writing these things to you, hoping to come to you before long;

column.name: text
column.value: but ①in case I am delayed, I write so that you will know how one should act in the household of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and support of the truth. ▷ ①Lit if I delay

column.name: text
column.value: Beyond question, great is the mystery of godliness: He who was revealed in the flesh, Was ①vindicated ②in the Spirit, Seen by angels, Proclaimed among the nations, Believed on in the world, Taken up in glory. ▷ ①Or justified ②Or by

column.name: text
column.value: Do not sharply rebuke an older man, but rather appeal to him as a father, and to the younger men as brothers,

column.name: text
column.value: to the older women as mothers, and to the younger women as sisters, in all purity.

column.name: text
column.value: Honor widows who are actually widows;

column.name: text
column.value: but if any widow has children or grandchildren, they must first learn to show proper respect for their own family and to give back compensation to their parents; for this is acceptable in the sight of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now she who is actually a widow and has been left alone has set her hope on God, and she continues in requests and prayers night and day.

column.name: text
column.value: But she who indulges herself in luxury is dead, even while she lives.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Give these instructions as well, so that they may be above reproach. ▷ ①Or Keep commanding

column.name: text
column.value: But if anyone does not provide for his own, and especially for those of his household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

column.name: text
column.value: A widow is to be put on the list only if she is not less than sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

column.name: text
column.value: having a reputation for good works; and if she has brought up children, if she has shown hospitality to strangers, if she has washed the ①saints’ feet, if she has assisted those in distress, and if she has devoted herself to every good work. ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: But refuse to register younger widows, for when they feel physical desires alienating them from Christ, they want to get married,

column.name: text
column.value: thereby incurring condemnation, because they have ①ignored their previous pledge. ▷ ①Or broken

column.name: text
column.value: At the same time they also learn to be idle, as they go around from house to house; and not merely idle, but also they become gossips and busybodies, talking about things not proper to mention.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, I want younger widows to get married, have children, manage their households, and give the enemy no opportunity for reproach;

column.name: text
column.value: for some have already turned away to follow Satan.

column.name: text
column.value: If any woman who is a believer has dependent widows, she must assist them and the church must not be burdened, so that it may assist those who are actually widows.

column.name: text
column.value: The elders who lead well are to be considered worthy of double honor, especially those who work hard ①at preaching and teaching. ▷ ①Lit in word

column.name: text
column.value: For the Scripture says, “YOU SHALL NOT MUZZLE THE OX WHILE IT IS THRESHING,” and “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”

column.name: text
column.value: Do not accept an accusation against an elder except on the basis of two or three witnesses.

column.name: text
column.value: Those who continue in sin, rebuke in the presence of all, so that the rest also will be fearful of sinning.

column.name: text
column.value: I solemnly exhort you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus and of His chosen angels, to maintain these principles without bias, doing nothing in a spirit of partiality.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not lay hands upon anyone too quickly and ①thereby share responsibility for the sins of others; keep yourself ②free from sin. ▷ ①Lit do not share ②Lit pure

column.name: text
column.value: Do not go on drinking only water, but use a little wine for the sake of your stomach and your frequent ailments.

column.name: text
column.value: The sins of some people are quite evident, going before them to judgment; for others, their sins follow after.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise also, deeds that are good are quite evident, and those which are otherwise cannot be concealed.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Spirit explicitly says that in later times some will ①fall away from the faith, paying attention to deceitful spirits and teachings of demons, ▷ ①I.e., apostatize

column.name: text
column.value: by means of the hypocrisy of liars seared in their own conscience as with a branding iron,

column.name: text
column.value: who forbid marriage and advocate abstaining from foods which God has created to be gratefully shared in by those who believe and know the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: For everything created by God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with gratitude;

column.name: text
column.value: for it is sanctified by means of the word of God and prayer.

column.name: text
column.value: In pointing out these things to the brothers and sisters, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, constantly nourished on the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have been following.

column.name: text
column.value: But ①stay away from worthless stories that are typical of old women. Rather, ②discipline yourself for the purpose of godliness; ▷ ①Or reject ②Or train

column.name: text
column.value: for bodily training is just slightly beneficial, but godliness is beneficial for all things, since it holds promise for the present life and also for the life to come.

column.name: text
column.value: It is a trustworthy statement deserving full acceptance.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is for this we labor and strive, because we have set our hope on the living God, who is the Savior of all mankind, especially of believers.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Prescribe and teach these things. ▷ ①Or Keep commanding and teaching

column.name: text
column.value: Let no one look down on your youthfulness, but rather in speech, conduct, love, faith, and purity, show yourself an example ①of those who believe. ▷ ①Or to

column.name: text
column.value: Until I come, give your attention to the public ①reading, to exhortation, and teaching. ▷ ①I.e., of Scripture in the church service

column.name: text
column.value: Do not neglect the spiritual gift within you, which was granted to you through words of prophecy with the laying on of hands by the ①council of elders. ▷ ①Or board of elders

column.name: text
column.value: Take pains with these things; be absorbed in them, so that your progress will be evident to all.

column.name: text
column.value: Pay close attention to yourself and to the teaching; persevere in these things, for as you do this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

column.name: text
column.value: All who are under the yoke as slaves are to regard their own masters as worthy of all honor so that the name of God and our doctrine will not be ①spoken against. ▷ ①Or blasphemed

column.name: text
column.value: Those who have believers as their masters must not be disrespectful to them because they are brothers or sisters, but must serve them all the more, because those who ①partake of the benefit are believers and beloved. Teach and ②preach these principles. ▷ ①Or devote themselves to kindness ②Lit exhort, urge

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone advocates a different doctrine and does not ①agree with sound words, those of our Lord Jesus Christ, and with the doctrine conforming to godliness, ▷ ①Lit come to; or come with

column.name: text
column.value: he is conceited and understands nothing; but he ①has a sick craving for controversial questions and disputes about words, from which come envy, strife, abusive language, evil suspicions, ▷ ①Lit is sick about

column.name: text
column.value: and constant friction between people of depraved mind and deprived of the truth, who suppose that ①godliness is a means of gain. ▷ ①Or religion

column.name: text
column.value: But godliness actually is a means of great gain when accompanied by contentment.

column.name: text
column.value: For we have brought nothing into the world, so we cannot take anything out of it, either.

column.name: text
column.value: If we have food and ①covering, with these we shall be content. ▷ ①I.e., any covering for protection, mainly clothing

column.name: text
column.value: But those who want to get rich fall into temptation and a trap, and many foolish and harmful desires which plunge people into ruin and destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: For the love of money is a root of all ①sorts of evil, and some by longing for it have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many ②griefs. ▷ ①Lit the evils ②Lit pains

column.name: text
column.value: But flee from these things, you man of God, and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, ①perseverance, and gentleness. ▷ ①Or steadfastness

column.name: text
column.value: Fight the good fight of faith; take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and for which you made the good confession in the presence of many witnesses.

column.name: text
column.value: I direct you in the presence of God, who ①gives life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who testified the good confession before Pontius Pilate, ▷ ①Or keeps alive

column.name: text
column.value: that you keep the commandment without ①fault or reproach until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ, ▷ ①Lit spot

column.name: text
column.value: which He will ①bring about at the proper time—He who is the blessed and only Sovereign, the King of ②kings and Lord of ③lords, ▷ ①Lit show ②Lit those who reign as kings ③Lit those who rule as lords

column.name: text
column.value: who alone possesses immortality and dwells in unapproachable light, whom ①no one has seen or can see. To Him be honor and eternal dominion! Amen. ▷ ①Lit none of mankind

column.name: text
column.value: Instruct those who are rich in this present world not to be conceited or to set their hope on the uncertainty of riches, but on God, who richly supplies us with all things to enjoy.

column.name: text
column.value: Instruct them to do good, to be rich in good ①works, to be generous and ready to share, ▷ ①Or deeds

column.name: text
column.value: storing up for themselves the treasure of a good foundation for the future, so that they may take hold of that which is truly life.

column.name: text
column.value: Timothy, protect what has been entrusted to you, avoiding worldly, empty chatter and the opposing arguments of what is falsely called “knowledge”—

column.name: text
column.value: which some have professed and thereby have gone astray ①from the faith. Grace be with you. ▷ ①Lit concerning

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus ①by the will of God, according to the promise of life in Christ Jesus, ▷ ①Lit through

column.name: text
column.value: To Timothy, my beloved ①son: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord. ▷ ①Or child

column.name: text
column.value: I thank God, whom I serve with a clear conscience ①the way my forefathers did, as I constantly remember you in my ②prayers night and day, ▷ ①Lit from my forefathers ②Or petitions

column.name: text
column.value: longing to see you, even as I recall your tears, so that I may be filled with joy.

column.name: text
column.value: ①For I am mindful of the sincere faith within you, which first dwelled in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and I am sure that it is in you as well. ▷ ①Lit Receiving remembrance of

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason I remind you to kindle afresh the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

column.name: text
column.value: For God has not given us a spirit of ①timidity, but of power and love and ②discipline. ▷ ①Or cowardice ②Or sound judgment

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord or of me His prisoner, but join with me in suffering for the gospel according to the power of God,

column.name: text
column.value: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to His own purpose and grace, which was granted to us in Christ Jesus from all eternity,

column.name: text
column.value: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior Christ Jesus, who abolished death and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel,

column.name: text
column.value: for which I was appointed a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason I also suffer these things; but I am not ashamed, for I know whom I have believed, and I am convinced that He is able to protect what I have entrusted to Him ①until that day. ▷ ①Or for

column.name: text
column.value: Hold on to the example of sound words which you have heard from me, in the faith and love which are in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Protect, through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us, the ①treasure which has been entrusted to you. ▷ ①Lit good deposit

column.name: text
column.value: You are aware of the fact that all who are in ①Asia turned away from me, among whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes. ▷ ①I.e., the province of Asia

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me and was not ashamed of my ①chains; ▷ ①Lit chain

column.name: text
column.value: but when he was in Rome, he eagerly searched for me and found me—

column.name: text
column.value: the Lord grant to him to find mercy from the Lord on that day—and you know very well what services he rendered at Ephesus.

column.name: text
column.value: You therefore, my ①son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus. ▷ ①Or child

column.name: text
column.value: The things which you have heard from me in the presence of many witnesses, entrust these to faithful ①people who will be able to teach others also. ▷ ①Or men

column.name: text
column.value: Suffer hardship with me, as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: No soldier in active service entangles himself in the affairs of everyday life, so that he may please the one who enlisted him.

column.name: text
column.value: And if someone likewise competes as an athlete, he is not ①crowned as victor unless he competes according to the rules. ▷ ①I.e., with a wreath

column.name: text
column.value: The hard-working farmer ought to be the first to receive his share of the crops.

column.name: text
column.value: Consider what I say, for the Lord will give you understanding in everything.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, descendant of David, according to my gospel,

column.name: text
column.value: ①for which I suffer hardship even to imprisonment as a criminal; but the word of God is not imprisoned. ▷ ①Lit in which

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason I endure all things for the sake of ①those who are chosen, so that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus and with it eternal glory. ▷ ①Or the chosen

column.name: text
column.value: The statement is trustworthy: For if we died with Him, we will also live with Him;

column.name: text
text
column.value: If we are faithless, He remains faithful, for He cannot deny Himself.

column.name: text
column.value: Remind them of these things, and solemnly exhort them in the presence of God not to dispute about words, which is useless and leads to the ruin of the listeners.

column.name: text
column.value: Be diligent to present yourself approved to God as a worker who ①does not need to be ashamed, accurately handling the word of truth. ▷ ①Or has no reason to

column.name: text
column.value: But avoid worldly and empty chatter, for ①it will lead to further ungodliness, ▷ ①Lit they will make further progress in ungodliness

column.name: text
column.value: and their ①talk will spread like ②gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus, ▷ ①Lit word ②Or cancer

column.name: text
column.value: men who have gone astray from the truth, claiming that the resurrection has already taken place; and they are jeopardizing the faith of some.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, the firm foundation of God stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are His;” and, “Everyone who names the name of the Lord is to keep away from wickedness.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now in a large house there are not only gold and silver implements, but also implements of wood and of earthenware, and some are for honor while others are for dishonor.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, if anyone cleanses himself from these things, he will be an implement for honor, sanctified, useful to the Master, prepared for every good work.

column.name: text
column.value: Now flee from youthful lusts and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord from a pure heart.

column.name: text
column.value: But refuse foolish and ignorant speculations, knowing that they produce ①quarrels. ▷ ①Lit fightings

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord’s bond-servant must not be quarrelsome, but be kind to all, skillful in teaching, patient when wronged,

column.name: text
column.value: with gentleness correcting those who are in opposition, if perhaps God may grant them repentance leading to the knowledge of the truth,

column.name: text
column.value: and they may come to their senses and escape from the snare of the devil, having been held captive ①by him to do his will. ▷ ①Or by him, to do His will

column.name: text
column.value: I solemnly exhort you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who is to judge the living and the dead, and by His appearing and His kingdom:

column.name: text
column.value: preach the word; be ready ①in season and out of season; correct, rebuke, and ②exhort, with ③great patience and instruction. ▷ ①I.e., whether it is convenient or not ②Or encourage ③Lit all

column.name: text
column.value: For the time will come when they will not tolerate sound doctrine; but wanting to have their ears tickled, they will accumulate for themselves teachers in accordance with their own desires,

column.name: text
column.value: and they will turn their ears away from the truth and will turn aside to myths.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for you, use self-restraint in all things, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.

column.name: text
column.value: For I am already being poured out as a drink offering, and the time of my departure has come.

column.name: text
column.value: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the faith;

column.name: text
column.value: in the future there is reserved for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day; and not only to me, but also to all who have loved His appearing.

column.name: text
column.value: Make every effort to come to me soon;

column.name: text
column.value: for Demas, having loved this present ①world, has deserted me and gone to Thessalonica; Crescens has gone to ②Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia. ▷ ①Or age ②One early ms Gaul

column.name: text
column.value: Only Luke is with me. Take along Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

column.name: text
column.value: But I have sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

column.name: text
column.value: When you come, bring the overcoat which I left at Troas with Carpus, and the books, especially the parchments.

column.name: text
column.value: Alexander the coppersmith did me great harm; the Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: Be on guard against him yourself too, for he vigorously opposed our ①teaching. ▷ ①Lit words

column.name: text
column.value: At my first defense no one supported me, but all deserted me; may it not be counted against them.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Lord stood with me and strengthened me, so that through me the proclamation might ①be fully accomplished, and that all the Gentiles might hear; and I was rescued out of the lion’s mouth. ▷ ①Or be fulfilled

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord will rescue me from every evil deed, and will ①bring me safely to His heavenly kingdom; to ②Him be the glory forever and ever. Amen. ▷ ①Or save me for ②Lit Whom

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.

column.name: text
column.value: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus sick at Miletus.

column.name: text
column.value: Make every effort to come before winter. Eubulus greets you, also Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers and sisters.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you.

column.name: text
column.value: But realize this, that in the last days difficult times will come.

column.name: text
column.value: For people will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, slanderers, disobedient to parents, ungrateful, unholy,

column.name: text
column.value: unloving, irreconcilable, malicious gossips, without self-control, brutal, ①haters of good, ▷ ①Lit not loving good

column.name: text
column.value: treacherous, reckless, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

column.name: text
column.value: holding to a form of ①godliness although they have denied its power; avoid such people as these. ▷ ①Or religion

column.name: text
column.value: For among them are those who ①slip into households and captivate ②weak women weighed down with sins, led on by various impulses, ▷ ①Or creep into ②Or idle

column.name: text
column.value: always learning and never able to come to the ①knowledge of the truth. ▷ ①Or recognition

column.name: text
column.value: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these men also oppose the truth, men of depraved mind, ①worthless in regard to the faith. ▷ ①Or unfit

column.name: text
column.value: But they will not make further progress; for their foolishness will be obvious to all, just as was that also of ①Jannes and Jambres. ▷ ①Lit those

column.name: text
column.value: Now you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, ①perseverance, ▷ ①Or steadfastness

column.name: text
column.value: persecutions, and sufferings, such as happened to me at Antioch, at Iconium, and at Lystra; what persecutions I endured, and out of them all the Lord rescued me!

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, all who want to live in a godly way in Christ Jesus will be persecuted.

column.name: text
column.value: But evil people and impostors will proceed from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.

column.name: text
column.value: You, however, continue in the things you have learned and become convinced of, knowing from whom you have learned them,

column.name: text
column.value: and that from childhood you have known the sacred writings which are able to give you the wisdom that leads to salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: All Scripture is ①inspired by God and beneficial for teaching, for ②rebuke, for correction, for training in righteousness; ▷ ①Lit God-breathed ②Or reprimand

column.name: text
column.value: so that the man or woman of God may be ①fully capable, equipped for every good work. ▷ ①Or proficient

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, a bond-servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, ①for the faith of those chosen of God and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness, ▷ ①Or according to

column.name: text
column.value: in the hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised ①long ages ago, ▷ ①Lit before eternal times

column.name: text
column.value: but at the proper time revealed His word in the proclamation with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior;

column.name: text
column.value: To Titus, my true ①son ②in a common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior. ▷ ①Or child ②Lit according to

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason I left you in Crete, that you would set in order what remains and appoint elders in every city as I directed you,

column.name: text
column.value: namely, if any man is beyond reproach, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, not accused of indecent behavior or rebellion.

column.name: text
column.value: For the ①overseer must be beyond reproach as God’s steward, not self-willed, not quick-tempered, not overindulging in wine, not ②a bully, not greedy for money, ▷ ①Or bishop ②Or combative

column.name: text
column.value: but hospitable, loving what is good, self-controlled, righteous, holy, disciplined,

column.name: text
column.value: holding firmly the faithful word which is in accordance with the teaching, so that he will be able both to ①exhort in sound doctrine and to refute those who contradict it. ▷ ①Or encourage

column.name: text
column.value: For there are many rebellious people, empty talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

column.name: text
column.value: who must be silenced because they are upsetting whole families, teaching things they should not teach for the sake of ①dishonest gain. ▷ ①Or disgraceful

column.name: text
column.value: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.”

column.name: text
column.value: This testimony is true. For this reason reprimand them severely so that they may be sound in the faith,

column.name: text
column.value: not paying attention to Jewish myths and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: To the pure, all things are pure; but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure, but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

column.name: text
column.value: They profess to know God, but by their deeds they deny Him, being detestable and disobedient and worthless for any good deed.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for you, proclaim the things which are fitting for sound doctrine.

column.name: text
column.value: Older men are to be ①temperate, dignified, self-controlled, sound in faith, in love, in ②perseverance. ▷ ①Or steadfastness ②Or level-headed

column.name: text
column.value: Older women likewise are to be reverent in their behavior, not malicious gossips nor enslaved to much wine, teaching what is good,

column.name: text
column.value: so that they may ①encourage the young women to love their husbands, to love their children, ▷ ①Or train

column.name: text
column.value: to be sensible, pure, workers at home, kind, being subject to their own husbands, so that the word of God will not be dishonored.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise urge the young men to be ①sensible; ▷ ①Or sensible in all things; show

column.name: text
column.value: in all things show yourself to be an example of good deeds, with ①purity in doctrine, dignified, ▷ ①Or soundness; lit uncorruptness

column.name: text
column.value: sound in speech which is beyond reproach, so that the opponent will be put to shame, having nothing bad to say about us.

column.name: text
column.value: Urge ①slaves to be subject to their own masters in everything, to be pleasing, not ②argumentative, ▷ ①I.e., slaves in first-century Roman culture ②Lit contradicting

column.name: text
column.value: not stealing, but showing all good faith so that they will adorn the doctrine of God our Savior in every respect.

column.name: text
column.value: For the grace of God has appeared, ①bringing salvation to all people, ▷ ①Or to all mankind, bringing

column.name: text
column.value: ①instructing us to deny ungodliness and worldly desires and to live sensibly, righteously, and in a godly manner in the present age, ▷ ①Or disciplining

column.name: text
column.value: looking for the blessed hope and the appearing of the glory of ①our great God and Savior, Christ Jesus, ▷ ①Or the great God and our Savior

column.name: text
column.value: who gave Himself for us to redeem us from every lawless deed, and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, eager for good deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: These things speak and ①exhort, and rebuke with all authority. No one is to disregard you. ▷ ①Or encourage

column.name: text
column.value: Remind them to be subject to rulers, to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good deed,

column.name: text
column.value: to slander no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing every consideration for all people.

column.name: text
column.value: For we too were once foolish, disobedient, deceived, enslaved to various lusts and pleasures, spending our life in malice and envy, hateful, hating one another.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the kindness of God our Savior and His love for mankind appeared,

column.name: text
column.value: He saved us, not on the basis of deeds which we did in righteousness, but in accordance with His mercy, by the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

column.name: text
column.value: whom He richly poured out upon us through Jesus Christ our Savior,

column.name: text
column.value: so that being justified by His grace we would be made heirs ①according to the hope of eternal life. ▷ ①Or of eternal life according to hope

column.name: text
column.value: This statement is trustworthy; and concerning these things I want you to speak confidently, so that those who have believed God will be careful to engage in good deeds. These things are good and beneficial for people.

column.name: text
column.value: But avoid foolish controversies and genealogies and strife and disputes about the Law, for they are useless and worthless.

column.name: text
column.value: Reject a ①divisive person after a first and second warning, ▷ ①Or factious

column.name: text
column.value: knowing that such a person has deviated from what is right and is sinning, being self-condemned.

column.name: text
column.value: When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis, for I have decided to spend the winter there.

column.name: text
column.value: Diligently help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their way so that nothing is lacking for them.

column.name: text
column.value: Our people must also learn to engage in good ①deeds to meet pressing needs, so that they will not be unproductive. ▷ ①Or occupations

column.name: text
column.value: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with you all.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy ①our brother, To Philemon our beloved brother and fellow worker, ▷ ①Lit the

column.name: text
column.value: and to Apphia ①our sister, and to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church in your house: ▷ ①Lit the

column.name: text
column.value: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,

column.name: text
column.value: because I hear of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the ①saints; ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: and I pray that the fellowship of your faith may become effective ①through the knowledge of every good thing which is in you ②for the sake of Christ. ▷ ①Or in ②Lit toward Christ

column.name: text
column.value: For I have had great joy and comfort in your love, because the ①hearts of the ②saints have been refreshed through you, brother. ▷ ①Lit inward parts ②See note v 5

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, though I have ①enough confidence in Christ to order you to do what is proper, ▷ ①Lit much

column.name: text
column.value: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you—since I am such a person as Paul, ①an old man, and now also a prisoner of Christ Jesus— ▷ ①Or an ambassador

column.name: text
column.value: I appeal to you for my ①son ②Onesimus, whom I ③fathered in my ④imprisonment, ▷ ①Or child ②I.e., useful ③I.e., led to the Lord ④Lit bonds

column.name: text
column.value: who previously was useless to you, but now is useful both to you and to me.

column.name: text
column.value: I have sent him back to you in person, that is, sending my very heart,

column.name: text
column.value: whom I wanted to keep with me, so that in your behalf he might be at my service in my ①imprisonment for the gospel; ▷ ①Lit bonds

column.name: text
column.value: but I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that your goodness would not be, in effect, by compulsion, but of your own free will.

column.name: text
column.value: For perhaps it was for this reason that he was separated from you for a while, that you would have him back forever,

column.name: text
column.value: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother, especially to me, but how much more to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: If then you regard me as a partner, accept him as you would me.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he has wronged you in any way or owes you anything, charge that to my account;

column.name: text
column.value: I, Paul, have written this with my own hand, I will repay it (not to ①mention to you that you owe to me even your own self as well). ▷ ①Lit say

column.name: text
column.value: Yes, brother, let me benefit from you in the Lord; refresh my heart in Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, since I know that you will do even more than what I say.

column.name: text
column.value: At the same time also prepare me a guest room, for I hope that through your prayers I will be given to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

column.name: text
column.value: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

column.name: text
column.value: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. ① ▷ ①One early ms adds Amen

column.name: text
column.value: God, after He spoke long ago to the fathers in the prophets in many portions and in many ways,

column.name: text
column.value: ①in these last days has spoken to us ②in His Son, whom He appointed heir of all things, through whom He also made the ③world. ▷ ①Or at the end of these days ②Or in the person of a Son; lit in Son ③Lit ages

column.name: text
column.value: ①And He is the radiance of His glory and the exact representation of His nature, and ②upholds all things by ③the word of His power. When He had made purification of sins, He sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high, ▷ ①Lit Who being ②Lit upholding ③Or His word of power

column.name: text
column.value: having become so much better than the angels, to the extent that He has inherited a more excellent name than they.

column.name: text
column.value: For to which of the angels did He ever say, “YOU ARE MY SON, TODAY I HAVE FATHERED YOU”? And again, “I WILL BE A FATHER TO HIM AND HE WILL BE A SON TO ME”?

column.name: text
column.value: And ①when He again brings the firstborn into ②the world, He says, “AND LET ALL THE ANGELS OF GOD WORSHIP HIM.” ▷ ①Or again when He brings ②Lit the inhabited earth

column.name: text
column.value: And regarding the angels He says, “HE MAKES HIS ANGELS WINDS, AND HIS MINISTERS A FLAME OF FIRE.”

column.name: text
column.value: But regarding the Son He says, “YOUR THRONE, GOD, IS FOREVER AND EVER, AND THE SCEPTER OF RIGHTEOUSNESS IS THE SCEPTER OF ①HIS KINGDOM. ▷ ①Late mss Your

column.name: text
text
text
text
column.value: AND LIKE A ROBE YOU WILL ROLL THEM UP; LIKE A GARMENT THEY WILL ALSO BE CHANGED. BUT YOU ARE THE SAME, AND YOUR YEARS WILL NOT COME TO AN END.”

column.name: text
column.value: But to which of the angels has He ever said, “SIT AT MY RIGHT HAND, UNTIL I MAKE YOUR ENEMIES A FOOTSTOOL FOR YOUR FEET”?

column.name: text
column.value: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent out to provide service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason we must pay much closer attention to ①what we have heard, so that we do not drift away from it. ▷ ①Lit the things that have been heard

column.name: text
column.value: For if the word spoken through angels proved ①unalterable, and every violation and act of disobedience received a just ②punishment, ▷ ①Or steadfast ②Lit retribution

column.name: text
column.value: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation? ①After it was at first spoken through the Lord, it was confirmed to us by those who heard, ▷ ①Lit Which was

column.name: text
column.value: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, and by various ①miracles and by ②gifts of the Holy Spirit according to His own will. ▷ ①Or works of power ②Lit distributions

column.name: text
column.value: For He did not subject to angels ①the world to come, about which we are speaking. ▷ ①Lit the inhabited earth

column.name: text
column.value: But someone has testified somewhere, saying, “WHAT IS MAN, THAT YOU THINK OF HIM? OR A SON OF MAN, THAT YOU ARE CONCERNED ABOUT HIM?

column.name: text
text
column.value: YOU HAVE PUT EVERYTHING IN SUBJECTION UNDER HIS FEET.” For in subjecting all things to him, He left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we do not yet see all things subjected to him.

column.name: text
column.value: But we do see Him who was made ①for a little while lower than the angels, namely, Jesus, because of His suffering death crowned with glory and honor, so that by the grace of God He might taste death for everyone. ▷ ①Or a little lower

column.name: text
column.value: For it was fitting for Him, for whom are all things, and through whom are all things, in bringing many sons to glory, to perfect the ①originator of their salvation through sufferings. ▷ ①Or leader

column.name: text
column.value: For both He who sanctifies and those who are ①sanctified are all from one Father; for this reason He is not ashamed to call them brothers and sisters, ▷ ①Or being sanctified

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “I WILL PROCLAIM YOUR NAME TO MY BROTHERS, IN THE MIDST OF THE ASSEMBLY I WILL SING YOUR PRAISE.”

column.name: text
column.value: And again, “I WILL PUT MY TRUST IN HIM.” And again, “BEHOLD, I AND THE CHILDREN WHOM GOD HAS GIVEN ME.”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, since the children share in ①flesh and blood, He Himself likewise also partook of the same, so that through death He might destroy the one who has the power of death, that is, the devil, ▷ ①Lit blood and flesh

column.name: text
column.value: and free those who through fear of death were subject to slavery all their lives.

column.name: text
column.value: For clearly He does not ①give help to angels, but He gives help to the ②descendants of Abraham. ▷ ①Lit take hold of angels, but He takes hold of ②Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, in all things He ①had to be made like His brothers so that He might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make ②propitiation for the sins of the people. ▷ ①Lit was obligated to be ②I.e., reconciliation with God by atoning for the sins

column.name: text
column.value: For since He Himself was ①tempted in that which He has suffered, He is able to come to the aid of those who are ②tempted. ▷ ①Or tested ②Or tested

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, we must fear if, while a promise remains of entering His rest, any one of you may seem to have come short of it.

column.name: text
column.value: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, just as they also did; but the word ①they heard did not benefit them, because ②they were not united with those who listened with faith. ▷ ①Lit of hearing ②One early ms it was not united with faith in those who heard

column.name: text
column.value: For we who have believed enter that rest, just as He has said, “AS I SWORE IN MY ANGER, THEY CERTAINLY SHALL NOT ENTER MY REST,” although His works were finished from the foundation of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: For He has said somewhere concerning the seventh day: “AND GOD RESTED ON THE SEVENTH DAY FROM ALL HIS WORKS”;

column.name: text
column.value: and again in this passage, “THEY CERTAINLY SHALL NOT ENTER MY REST.”

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, since it remains for some to enter it, and those who previously had good news preached to them failed to enter because of disobedience,

column.name: text
column.value: He again sets a certain day, “Today,” saying ①through David after so long a time just as has been said before, “TODAY IF YOU HEAR HIS VOICE, DO NOT HARDEN YOUR HEARTS.” ▷ ①Or in

column.name: text
column.value: For if ①Joshua had given them rest, He would not have spoken of another day after that. ▷ ①Gr Jesus

column.name: text
column.value: Consequently, there remains a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For the one who has entered His rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from His.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore let’s make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one will fall by following the same example of disobedience.

column.name: text
column.value: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, even penetrating as far as the division of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and able to ①judge the thoughts and intentions of the heart. ▷ ①Or discern

column.name: text
column.value: And there is no creature hidden from His sight, but all things are open and laid bare to the eyes of Him to whom ①we must answer. ▷ ①Lit is our word

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let’s hold firmly to our confession.

column.name: text
column.value: For we do not have a high priest who cannot sympathize with our weaknesses, but One who has been tempted in all things just as we are, yet without sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore let’s approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace for help at the time of our need.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, holy brothers and sisters, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus;

column.name: text
column.value: ①He was faithful to Him who appointed Him, as Moses also was in all His house. ▷ ①Lit being faithful

column.name: text
column.value: For He has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, by just so much as the builder of the house has more honor than the house.

column.name: text
column.value: For every house is built by someone, but the builder of all things is God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Moses was faithful in all ①God’s house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken later; ▷ ①Lit His

column.name: text
column.value: but Christ was faithful as a Son over His house—whose house we are, if we hold firmly to our confidence and the boast of our ①hope. ▷ ①One early ms adds firm until the end

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, just as the Holy Spirit says, “TODAY IF YOU HEAR HIS VOICE,

column.name: text
column.value: DO NOT HARDEN YOUR HEARTS AS ①WHEN THEY PROVOKED ME, AS ON THE DAY OF TRIAL IN THE WILDERNESS, ▷ ①Lit in the provocation

column.name: text
column.value: WHERE YOUR FATHERS PUT ME to the test, AND SAW MY WORKS FOR FORTY YEARS.

column.name: text
text
column.value: AS I SWORE IN MY ANGER, ‘THEY CERTAINLY SHALL NOT ENTER MY REST.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: Take care, brothers and sisters, that there will not be in any one of you an evil, unbelieving heart ①that falls away from the living God. ▷ ①Or that leaves the; lit in falling away from

column.name: text
column.value: But encourage one another every day, as long as it is still called “today,” so that none of you will be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

column.name: text
column.value: For we have become partakers of Christ if we keep the beginning of our ①commitment firm until the end, ▷ ①Or assurance

column.name: text
column.value: while it is said, “TODAY IF YOU HEAR HIS VOICE, DO NOT HARDEN YOUR HEARTS, AS ①WHEN THEY PROVOKED ME.” ▷ ①Lit in the rebellion

column.name: text
column.value: For who provoked Him when they had heard? Indeed, did not all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?

column.name: text
column.value: And with whom was He angry for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose dead bodies fell in the wilderness?

column.name: text
column.value: And to whom did He swear that they would not enter His rest, but to those who were disobedient?

column.name: text
column.value: And so we see that they were not able to enter because of unbelief.

column.name: text
column.value: For every high priest taken from among men is appointed on behalf of people in things pertaining to God, in order to offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins;

column.name: text
column.value: ①he can deal gently with the ignorant and misguided, since he himself also is ②clothed in weakness; ▷ ①Lit being able to ②I.e., weak by nature

column.name: text
column.value: and because of it he is obligated to offer sacrifices for sins for himself, as well as for the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And no one takes the honor for himself, but receives it when he is called by God, just as Aaron also was.

column.name: text
text
column.value: just as He also says in another passage, “YOU ARE A PRIEST FOREVER ACCORDING TO THE ORDER OF MELCHIZEDEK.”

column.name: text
column.value: In the days of ①His humanity, ②He offered up both prayers and pleas with loud crying and tears to the One able to save Him ③from death, and He ④was heard because of His devout behavior. ▷ ①Lit His flesh ②Lit who having offered up ③Or out of ④Lit having been heard

column.name: text
column.value: Although He was a Son, He learned obedience from the things which He suffered.

column.name: text
column.value: And having been perfected, He became the source of eternal salvation for all those who obey Him,

column.name: text
column.value: being designated by God as High Priest according to the order of Melchizedek.

column.name: text
column.value: Concerning ①him we have much to say, and it is difficult to explain, since you have become ②poor listeners. ▷ ①Lit whom; or which ②Lit sluggish in hearing

column.name: text
column.value: For though ①by this time you ought to be teachers, you have need again for someone to teach you the ②elementary principles of the actual words of God, and you have come to need milk and not solid food. ▷ ①Lit because of the time ②Lit elements of the beginning

column.name: text
column.value: For everyone who partakes only of milk is unacquainted with the word of righteousness, for he is an infant.

column.name: text
column.value: But solid food is for the mature, who because of practice have their senses trained to distinguish between good and evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore leaving the ①elementary teaching about the ②Christ, let us press on to ③maturity, not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works and of faith toward God, ▷ ①Lit word of the beginning ②I.e., Messiah ③Or perfection

column.name: text
column.value: of instruction about ①washings and laying on of hands, and about the resurrection of the dead and eternal judgment. ▷ ①Or baptisms

column.name: text
column.value: And this we will do, if God permits.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is impossible, in the case of those who have once been enlightened and have tasted of the heavenly gift and have been made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

column.name: text
column.value: and have tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,

column.name: text
column.value: and then have ①fallen away, to restore them again to repentance, ②since they again crucify to themselves the Son of God and put Him to open shame. ▷ ①Or committed apostasy; i.e., renounced the faith ②Or while

column.name: text
column.value: For ground that drinks the rain which often ①falls on it and produces vegetation useful to those for whose sake it is also tilled, receives a blessing from God; ▷ ①Lit comes

column.name: text
column.value: but if it yields thorns and thistles, it is worthless and ①close to being cursed, and ②it ends up being burned. ▷ ①Lit near to a curse ②Lit whose end is for burning

column.name: text
column.value: But, beloved, we are convinced of better things regarding you, and things that ①accompany salvation, even though we are speaking in this way. ▷ ①Or belong to

column.name: text
column.value: For God is not unjust so as to forget your work and the love which you have shown toward His name, by having served and by still serving the ①saints. ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: And we desire that each one of you demonstrate the same diligence ①so as to realize the full assurance of hope until the end, ▷ ①Lit to the full

column.name: text
column.value: so that you will not be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and endurance inherit the promises.

column.name: text
column.value: For when God made the promise to Abraham, since He could swear an oath by no one greater, He swore by Himself,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “INDEED I WILL GREATLY BLESS YOU AND I WILL GREATLY MULTIPLY YOU.”

column.name: text
column.value: And so, having patiently waited, he obtained the promise.

column.name: text
column.value: For people swear an oath by ①one greater than themselves, and with them an oath serving as confirmation is an end of every dispute. ▷ ①Or Him who is greater

column.name: text
column.value: ①In the same way God, desiring even more to demonstrate to the heirs of the promise ②the fact that His purpose is unchangeable, ③confirmed it with an oath, ▷ ①Lit In which ②Lit the unchangeableness of His ③Or mediated

column.name: text
column.value: so that by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have taken refuge would have strong encouragement to hold firmly to the hope set before us.

column.name: text
column.value: ①This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and reliable and one which enters ②within the veil, ▷ ①Lit Which hope we have ②Or inside

column.name: text
column.value: where Jesus has entered as a forerunner for us, having become a high priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek.

column.name: text
column.value: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of the Most High God, who met Abraham as he was returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

column.name: text
column.value: to whom also Abraham apportioned a tenth of all the spoils, was first of all, by the translation of his name, king of righteousness, and then also king of Salem, which is king of peace.

column.name: text
column.value: Without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God, he remains a priest perpetually.

column.name: text
column.value: Now observe how great this man was to whom Abraham, the patriarch, gave a tenth of the choicest spoils.

column.name: text
column.value: And those indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment ①in the Law to collect ②a tenth from the people, that is, from their countrymen, although they ③are descended from Abraham. ▷ ①Lit according to ②Or tithes ③Lit have come out of the loins of

column.name: text
column.value: But the one whose genealogy is not traced from them collected ①a tenth from Abraham and ②blessed the one who had the promises. ▷ ①Or tithes ②Lit has blessed

column.name: text
column.value: But without any dispute the lesser person is blessed by the greater.

column.name: text
column.value: In this case mortal men receive tithes, but in that case one receives them, of whom it is witnessed that he lives on.
