column.name: text
column.value: And, so to speak, through Abraham even Levi, who received tithes, has paid tithes,

column.name: text
column.value: for he was still in the loins of his ①forefather when Melchizedek met him. ▷ ①Lit father

column.name: text
column.value: So if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for on the basis of it the people received the Law), what further need was there for another priest to arise according to the order of Melchizedek, and not be designated according to the order of Aaron?

column.name: text
column.value: For when the priesthood is changed, of necessity there takes place a change of law also.

column.name: text
column.value: For the one about whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is evident that our Lord ①was descended from Judah, a tribe with reference to which Moses said nothing concerning priests. ▷ ①Lit has arisen from

column.name: text
column.value: And this is clearer still, if another priest arises according to the likeness of Melchizedek,

column.name: text
column.value: who has become a priest not on the basis of a law of ①physical requirement, but according to the power of an indestructible life. ▷ ①Lit fleshly commandment; i.e., to be a descendant of Levi

column.name: text
column.value: For it is attested of Him, “YOU ARE A PRIEST FOREVER ACCORDING TO THE ORDER OF MELCHIZEDEK.”

column.name: text
column.value: For, on the one hand, there is the nullification of a former commandment because of its weakness and uselessness

column.name: text
column.value: (for the Law made nothing perfect); on the other hand, there is the introduction of a better hope, through which we come near to God.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the extent that it was not without an oath

column.name: text
column.value: (for they indeed became priests without an oath, but He with an oath through the One who said to Him, “THE LORD HAS SWORN AND WILL NOT CHANGE HIS MIND, ‘YOU ARE A PRIEST FOREVER’ ”);

column.name: text
column.value: by the same extent Jesus also has become the ①guarantee of a better covenant. ▷ ①Or guarantor

column.name: text
column.value: ①The former priests, on the one hand, existed in greater numbers because they were prevented by death from continuing; ▷ ①Lit The greater number have become priests...

column.name: text
column.value: ①Jesus, on the other hand, because He continues forever, holds His priesthood permanently. ▷ ①Lit He

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore He is also able to save ①forever those who come to God through Him, since He always lives to make intercession for them. ▷ ①Or completely

column.name: text
column.value: For it was fitting for us to have such a high priest, holy, innocent, undefiled, separated from sinners, and exalted above the heavens;

column.name: text
column.value: who has no daily need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices, first for His own sins and then for the sins of the people, because He did this once for all time when He offered up Himself.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Law appoints men as high priests who are weak, but the word of the oath, which came after the Law, appoints a Son, who has been made perfect forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the main point in what has been said is this: we have such a high priest, who has taken His seat at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,

column.name: text
column.value: a minister ①in the sanctuary and ②in the true ③tabernacle, which the Lord set up, not man. ▷ ①Or of ②Or of ③Or sacred tent

column.name: text
column.value: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices; so it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.

column.name: text
column.value: Now if He were on earth, He would not be a priest at all, since there are ①those who offer the gifts according to the Law; ▷ ①I.e., temple priests

column.name: text
column.value: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, just as Moses ①was warned by God when he was about to erect the ②tabernacle; for, “SEE,” He says, “THAT YOU MAKE all things BY THE PATTERN WHICH WAS SHOWN TO YOU ON THE MOUNTAIN.” ▷ ①Lit has been ②Or sacred tent

column.name: text
column.value: But now He has obtained a more excellent ministry, to the extent that He is also the mediator of a better covenant, which has been enacted on better promises.

column.name: text
column.value: For if that first covenant had been free of fault, no ①circumstances would have been sought for a second. ▷ ①Lit place

column.name: text
column.value: For in finding fault with ①the people, He says, “BEHOLD, DAYS ARE COMING, SAYS THE LORD, ②WHEN I WILL BRING ABOUT A NEW COVENANT WITH THE HOUSE OF ISRAEL AND THE HOUSE OF JUDAH, ▷ ①Lit them ②Lit And

column.name: text
column.value: NOT LIKE THE COVENANT WHICH I MADE WITH THEIR FATHERS ON THE DAY I TOOK THEM BY THE HAND TO BRING THEM OUT OF THE LAND OF EGYPT; FOR THEY DID NOT CONTINUE IN MY COVENANT, AND I DID NOT CARE ABOUT THEM, SAYS THE LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: FOR THIS IS THE COVENANT WHICH I WILL MAKE WITH THE HOUSE OF ISRAEL AFTER THOSE DAYS, DECLARES THE LORD: ①I WILL PUT MY LAWS INTO THEIR MINDS, AND WRITE THEM ON THEIR HEARTS. AND I WILL BE THEIR GOD, AND THEY SHALL BE MY PEOPLE. ▷ ①Lit Putting my laws into...

column.name: text
column.value: AND THEY WILL NOT TEACH, EACH ONE HIS FELLOW CITIZEN, AND EACH ONE HIS BROTHER, SAYING, ‘KNOW THE LORD,’ FOR THEY WILL ALL KNOW ME, FROM ①THE LEAST TO THE GREATEST OF THEM. ▷ ①Lit small to great of them

column.name: text
column.value: FOR I WILL BE MERCIFUL TOWARD THEIR WRONGDOINGS, AND THEIR SINS I WILL NO LONGER REMEMBER.”

column.name: text
column.value: ①When He said, “A new covenant,” He has made the first obsolete. But whatever is becoming obsolete and growing old is ②about to disappear. ▷ ①Or In His saying ②Or near destruction

column.name: text
column.value: Now even the first covenant had regulations for divine worship and the earthly sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: For a ①tabernacle was equipped, the ②outer sanctuary, in which were the lampstand, the table, and the ③sacred bread; this is called the Holy Place. ▷ ①Or sacred tent ②Lit first ③Lit loaves of presentation

column.name: text
column.value: Behind the second veil there was a ①tabernacle which is called the Most Holy Place, ▷ ①Or sacred tent

column.name: text
column.value: having a golden ①altar of incense and the ark of the covenant covered on all sides with gold, in which was a golden jar holding the manna, Aaron’s staff which budded, and the tablets of the covenant; ▷ ①Or censer

column.name: text
column.value: and above it were the cherubim of glory overshadowing the ①atoning cover; but about these things we cannot now speak in detail. ▷ ①Also called mercy seat; i.e., where blood was sprinkled on the Day of Atonement

column.name: text
column.value: Now when these things have been so prepared, the priests are continually entering the ①outer ②tabernacle, performing the divine worship, ▷ ①Lit first ②Or sacred tent

column.name: text
column.value: but into the second, only the high priest enters once a year, not without taking blood which he offers for himself and for the ①sins of the people committed in ignorance. ▷ ①Lit ignorance of the people

column.name: text
column.value: The Holy Spirit is signifying this, that the way into the holy place has not yet been disclosed while the ①outer tabernacle is still standing, ▷ ①Lit first

column.name: text
column.value: which is a symbol for the present time. Accordingly both gifts and sacrifices are offered which cannot make the worshiper perfect in conscience,

column.name: text
column.value: since they relate only to food, drink, and various washings, regulations for the ①body imposed until a time of reformation. ▷ ①Lit flesh

column.name: text
column.value: But when Christ appeared as a high priest of the good things ①having come, He entered through the greater and more perfect ②tabernacle, not made by hands, that is, not of this creation; ▷ ①One early ms to come ②Or sacred tent

column.name: text
column.value: and not through the blood of goats and calves, but through His own blood, He entered the holy place once for all time, ①having obtained eternal redemption. ▷ ①Or obtaining

column.name: text
column.value: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ①ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify for the ②cleansing of the flesh, ▷ ①I.e., ashes mixed in water ②Lit purity

column.name: text
column.value: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through ①the eternal Spirit offered Himself without blemish to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God? ▷ ①Or His eternal spirit

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason He is the mediator of a new covenant, so that, since a death has taken place for the redemption of the violations that were committed under the first covenant, those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: For where there is a ①covenant, there must of necessity ②be the death of the one who made it. ▷ ①Or testament ②Lit be brought

column.name: text
column.value: For a ①covenant is valid only when people are dead, ②for it is never in force while the one who made it lives. ▷ ①Or testament ②One early ms for is it then...lives?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore even the first covenant was not inaugurated without blood.

column.name: text
column.value: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the Law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “THIS IS THE BLOOD OF THE COVENANT WHICH GOD COMMANDED YOU.”

column.name: text
column.value: And in the same way he sprinkled both the ①tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry with the blood. ▷ ①Or sacred tent

column.name: text
column.value: And almost all things are cleansed with blood, according to the Law, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore it was necessary for the copies of the things in the heavens to be cleansed with these things, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

column.name: text
column.value: For Christ did not enter a holy place made by hands, a mere copy of the true one, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;

column.name: text
column.value: nor was it that He would offer Himself often, as the high priest enters the Holy Place year by year with blood that is not his own.

column.name: text
column.value: Otherwise, He would have needed to suffer often since the foundation of the world; but now once at the consummation of the ages He has been revealed to put away sin ①by the sacrifice of Himself. ▷ ①Or by His sacrifice

column.name: text
column.value: And just as it is destined for people to die once, and after this comes judgment,

column.name: text
column.value: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time for salvation without reference to sin, to those who eagerly await Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now faith is the certainty of things ①hoped for, a ②proof of things not seen. ▷ ①Or expected ②Or conviction about

column.name: text
column.value: For by it the people of old ①gained approval. ▷ ①Lit obtained a good testimony

column.name: text
column.value: By faith we understand that the ①world has been created by the word of God so that what is seen has not been made out of things that are visible. ▷ ①Or worlds were; lit ages

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Abel offered to God a better sacrifice than Cain, through which he was attested to be righteous, God testifying ①about his gifts, and through ②faith, though he is dead, he still speaks. ▷ ①I.e., by receiving his gifts ②Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Enoch was taken up so that he would not see death; AND HE WAS NOT FOUND BECAUSE GOD TOOK HIM UP; for before he was taken up, he was attested to have been pleasing to God.

column.name: text
column.value: And without faith it is impossible to please Him, for the one who comes to God must believe that He exists, and that He proves to be One who rewards those who seek Him.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Noah, being warned by God about things not yet seen, ①in reverence prepared an ark for the salvation of his household, by which he condemned the world, and became an heir of the righteousness which is according to faith. ▷ ①Or was reverent and prepared

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed ①by going out to a place which he was to receive for an inheritance; and he left, not knowing where he was going. ▷ ①Lit to go out

column.name: text
column.value: By faith he lived as a stranger in the land of promise, as in a foreign land, living in tents with Isaac and Jacob, fellow heirs of the same promise;

column.name: text
column.value: for he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose architect and builder is God.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith even Sarah herself received ①ability to conceive, even beyond the proper time of life, since she considered Him faithful who had promised. ▷ ①Lit power for the laying down of seed

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore even from one man, and one who was as good as dead ①at that, there were born descendants who were just as the stars of heaven in number, and as the innumerable grains of sand along the seashore. ▷ ①Lit in these things

column.name: text
column.value: All these died in faith, without receiving the promises, but having seen and welcomed them from a distance, and having confessed that they were strangers and exiles on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

column.name: text
column.value: And indeed if they had been ①thinking of that country which they left, they would have had opportunity to return. ▷ ①Or remembering

column.name: text
column.value: But as it is, they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ①ashamed to be called their God; for He has prepared a city for them. ▷ ①Lit ashamed of them, to be

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Abraham, when he was tested, offered up Isaac, and the one who had received the promises was offering up his ①only son; ▷ ①I.e., only son with Sarah

column.name: text
column.value: it was he to whom it was said, “THROUGH ISAAC YOUR ①DESCENDANTS SHALL BE NAMED.” ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: ①He considered that God is able to raise people even from the dead, from which he also received him back ②as a ③type. ▷ ①Lit Considering ②Lit in ③I.e., of resurrection, figuratively, pointing to the future

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even regarding things to come.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Jacob, as he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Joseph, when he was dying, made mention of the exodus of the sons of Israel, and gave orders concerning his bones.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s edict.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,

column.name: text
column.value: choosing rather to endure ill-treatment with the people of God than to enjoy the temporary pleasures of sin,

column.name: text
column.value: considering the ①reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he was looking to the reward. ▷ ①I.e., insults like those later suffered by Christ

column.name: text
column.value: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he persevered, as though seeing Him who is unseen.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith he ①kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch them. ▷ ①Lit has kept

column.name: text
column.value: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as through dry land; and the Egyptians, when they attempted it, were ①drowned. ▷ ①Lit swallowed up

column.name: text
column.value: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down ①after the Israelites had marched around them for seven days. ▷ ①Lit after they had been encircled for

column.name: text
column.value: By faith the prostitute Rahab did not perish along with those who were disobedient, after she had welcomed the spies ①in peace. ▷ ①Lit with

column.name: text
column.value: And what more shall I say? For time will fail me if I tell of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, of David and Samuel and the prophets,

column.name: text
column.value: who by faith conquered kingdoms, performed acts of righteousness, obtained promises, shut the mouths of lions,

column.name: text
column.value: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, became mighty in war, put foreign armies to flight.

column.name: text
column.value: Women received back their dead by resurrection; and others were tortured, not accepting their ①release, so that they might obtain a better resurrection; ▷ ①Lit redemption

column.name: text
column.value: and others ①experienced mocking and flogging, and further, chains and imprisonment. ▷ ①Lit received the trial of

column.name: text
column.value: They were stoned, they were sawn in two, ①they were tempted, they were put to death with the sword; they went about in sheepskins, in goatskins, being destitute, afflicted, tormented ▷ ①One early ms does not contain they were tempted

column.name: text
column.value: (people of whom the world was not worthy), wandering in deserts, on mountains, and sheltering in caves and holes ①in the ground. ▷ ①Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: And all these, having gained approval through their faith, did not receive ①what was promised, ▷ ①Lit the promise

column.name: text
column.value: because God had ①provided something better for us, so that apart from us they would not be made perfect. ▷ ①Or foreseen

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, since we also have such a great cloud of witnesses surrounding us, let’s rid ourselves of every obstacle and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with endurance the race that is set before us,

column.name: text
column.value: looking only at Jesus, the ①originator and perfecter of the faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, despising the shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God. ▷ ①Or leader

column.name: text
column.value: For consider Him who has endured such hostility by sinners against Himself, so that you will not grow weary ①and lose heart. ▷ ①Lit fainting in your souls

column.name: text
column.value: You have not yet resisted ①to the point of shedding blood in your striving against sin; ▷ ①Lit as far as blood

column.name: text
text
column.value: FOR WHOM THE LORD LOVES HE DISCIPLINES, AND HE PUNISHES EVERY SON WHOM HE ACCEPTS.”

column.name: text
column.value: It is for discipline that you endure; God deals with you as with sons; for what son is there whom his father does not discipline?

column.name: text
column.value: But if you are without discipline, of which all have become partakers, then you are illegitimate children and not sons.

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore, we had ①earthly fathers to discipline us, and we respected them; shall we not much more be subject to the Father of ②spirits, and live? ▷ ①Lit fathers of our flesh ②Or our spirits

column.name: text
column.value: For they disciplined us for a short time as seemed best to them, but He disciplines us for our good, so that we may share His holiness.

column.name: text
column.value: For the moment, all discipline seems not to be pleasant, but painful; yet to those who have been trained by it, afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, ①strengthen the hands that are weak and the knees that are feeble, ▷ ①Lit make straight

column.name: text
column.value: and make straight paths for your feet, so that the limb which is impaired may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.

column.name: text
column.value: Pursue peace with all people, and the holiness without which no one will see the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: See to it that no one comes short of the grace of God; that no root of bitterness springing up causes trouble, and by it many become defiled;

column.name: text
column.value: that there be no sexually immoral or godless person like Esau, who sold his own birthright for a single meal.

column.name: text
column.value: For you know that even afterward, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for repentance, though he sought for it with tears.

column.name: text
column.value: For you have not come to a mountain that can be touched and to a blazing fire, and to darkness and gloom and whirlwind,

column.name: text
column.value: and to the blast of a trumpet and the sound of words, which sound was such that those who heard begged that no further word be spoken to them.

column.name: text
column.value: For they could not ①cope with the command, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned.” ▷ ①Lit bear

column.name: text
column.value: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”

column.name: text
column.value: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to myriads of ①angels, ▷ ①Or angels in festive gathering, and to the church

column.name: text
column.value: to the general assembly and church of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, and to God, the Judge of all, and to the spirits of the righteous made perfect,

column.name: text
column.value: and to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood, which speaks better than the blood of Abel.

column.name: text
column.value: See to it that you do not refuse Him who is speaking. For if those did not escape when they refused him who warned them on earth, ①much less will we escape who turn away from Him who warns us from heaven. ▷ ①Lit much rather we will not escape...

column.name: text
column.value: And His voice shook the earth then, but now He has promised, saying, “YET ONCE MORE I WILL SHAKE NOT ONLY THE EARTH, BUT ALSO THE HEAVEN.”

column.name: text
column.value: This expression, “Yet once more,” denotes the removing of those things which can be shaken, as of created things, so that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, since we receive a kingdom which cannot be shaken, let’s ①show gratitude, by which we may offer to God an acceptable service with reverence and awe; ▷ ①Lit have

column.name: text
column.value: for our God is a consuming fire.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Law, since it has only a shadow of the good things to come and not the ①form of those things itself, ②can never, by the same sacrifices which they offer continually every year, make those who approach perfect. ▷ ①Lit image ②One early ms they can

column.name: text
column.value: Otherwise, would they not have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having once been cleansed, would no longer have had consciousness of sins?

column.name: text
column.value: But in ①those sacrifices there is a reminder of sins every year. ▷ ①Lit them there is

column.name: text
column.value: For it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.

column.name: text
text
column.value: YOU HAVE NOT TAKEN PLEASURE IN WHOLE BURNT OFFERINGS AND offerings for sin.

column.name: text
column.value: THEN I SAID, ‘BEHOLD, I HAVE COME (IT IS WRITTEN OF ME IN THE SCROLL OF THE BOOK) TO DO YOUR WILL, O GOD.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: After saying above, “SACRIFICES AND OFFERINGS AND WHOLE BURNT OFFERINGS AND offerings for sin YOU HAVE NOT DESIRED, NOR HAVE YOU TAKEN PLEASURE in them” (which are offered according to the Law),

column.name: text
column.value: then He ①said, “BEHOLD, I HAVE COME TO DO YOUR WILL.” He takes away the first in order to establish the second. ▷ ①Lit has said

column.name: text
column.value: By ①this will, we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all time. ▷ ①Lit which

column.name: text
column.value: Every priest stands daily ministering and offering time after time the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins;

column.name: text
column.value: but He, having offered one sacrifice for ①sins for all time, SAT DOWN AT THE RIGHT HAND OF GOD, ▷ ①Or sins, forever sat down

column.name: text
column.value: waiting from that time onward UNTIL HIS ENEMIES ARE MADE A FOOTSTOOL FOR HIS FEET.

column.name: text
column.value: For by one offering He has perfected for all time those who are ①sanctified. ▷ ①Or being sanctified

column.name: text
column.value: And the Holy Spirit also testifies to us; for after saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “THIS IS THE COVENANT WHICH I WILL MAKE WITH THEM AFTER THOSE DAYS, DECLARES THE LORD: I WILL PUT MY LAWS UPON THEIR HEARTS, AND WRITE THEM ON THEIR MIND,” He then says,

column.name: text
column.value: “AND THEIR SINS AND THEIR LAWLESS DEEDS I WILL NO LONGER REMEMBER.”

column.name: text
column.value: Now where there is forgiveness of these things, an offering for sin is no longer required.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, brothers and sisters, since we have confidence to enter the holy place by the blood of Jesus,

column.name: text
column.value: by a new and living way which He inaugurated for us through the veil, that is, through His flesh,

column.name: text
column.value: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,

column.name: text
column.value: let’s approach God with a ①sincere heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled clean from an evil conscience and our bodies washed with pure water. ▷ ①Lit true

column.name: text
column.value: Let’s hold firmly to the confession of our hope without wavering, for He who promised is faithful;

column.name: text
column.value: and let’s consider how to ①encourage one another in love and good deeds, ▷ ①Or stir up

column.name: text
column.value: not abandoning our own meeting together, as is the habit of some people, but encouraging one another; and all the more as you see the day drawing near.

column.name: text
column.value: For if we go on sinning willfully after receiving the knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains a sacrifice for sins,

column.name: text
column.value: but a terrifying expectation of judgment and THE FURY OF A FIRE WHICH WILL CONSUME THE ADVERSARIES.

column.name: text
column.value: Anyone who has ignored the Law of Moses is put to death without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.

column.name: text
column.value: How much more severe punishment do you think he will deserve who has trampled underfoot the Son of God, and has regarded as unclean the blood of the covenant by which he was sanctified, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?

column.name: text
column.value: For we know Him who said, “VENGEANCE IS MINE, I WILL REPAY.” And again, “THE LORD WILL JUDGE HIS PEOPLE.”

column.name: text
column.value: It is a terrifying thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

column.name: text
column.value: But remember the former days, ①when, after being enlightened, you endured a great conflict of sufferings, ▷ ①Lit in which

column.name: text
column.value: partly by being made a public spectacle through insults and distress, and partly by becoming ①companions with those who were so treated. ▷ ①Or partners

column.name: text
column.value: For you showed sympathy to the prisoners and accepted joyfully the seizure of your property, knowing that you have for yourselves a better and lasting possession.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, do not throw away your confidence, which has a great reward.

column.name: text
column.value: For you have need of endurance, so that when you have done the will of God, you may receive ①what was promised. ▷ ①Lit the promise

column.name: text
column.value: FOR YET IN A VERY LITTLE WHILE, HE WHO IS COMING WILL COME, AND WILL NOT DELAY.

column.name: text
column.value: BUT MY RIGHTEOUS ONE WILL LIVE BY FAITH; AND IF HE SHRINKS BACK, MY SOUL HAS NO PLEASURE IN HIM.

column.name: text
column.value: But ①we are not among those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith for the safekeeping of the soul. ▷ ①Lit we are not of shrinking back...but of faith

column.name: text
column.value: Let love of the brothers and sisters continue.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not neglect hospitality to strangers, for by this some have entertained angels without knowing it.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember the prisoners, as though in prison with them, and those who are badly treated, since you yourselves also are in the body.

column.name: text
column.value: Marriage is to be held in honor among all, and the marriage bed is to be undefiled; for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

column.name: text
column.value: Make sure that your character is free from the love of money, being content with what you have; for He Himself has said, “I WILL NEVER DESERT YOU, NOR WILL I EVER ABANDON YOU,”

column.name: text
column.value: so that we confidently say, “THE LORD IS MY HELPER, I WILL NOT BE AFRAID. WHAT WILL MAN DO TO ME?”

column.name: text
column.value: Remember those who led you, who spoke the word of God to you; and considering the ①result of their way of life, imitate their faith. ▷ ①Or end of their life

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today, and forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be misled by varied and strange teachings; for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace, not by foods, through which those who ①were so occupied were not benefited. ▷ ①Lit walked

column.name: text
column.value: We have an altar from which those who serve the ①tabernacle have no right to eat. ▷ ①Or sacred tent

column.name: text
column.value: For the bodies of those animals whose blood is brought into the Holy Place by the high priest as an offering for sin are burned outside the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Jesus also suffered outside the gate, that He might sanctify the people through His own blood.

column.name: text
column.value: So then, let us go out to Him outside the camp, bearing His reproach.

column.name: text
column.value: For here we do not have a lasting city, but we are seeking the city which is to come.

column.name: text
column.value: Through Him then, let’s continually offer up a sacrifice of praise to God, that is, the fruit of lips praising His name.

column.name: text
column.value: And do not neglect doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.

column.name: text
column.value: Obey your leaders and submit to them—for they keep watch over your souls as those who will give an account—so that they may do this with joy, not ①groaning; for this would be unhelpful for you. ▷ ①Or sighing

column.name: text
column.value: Pray for us, for we are sure that we have a good conscience, desiring to conduct ourselves honorably in all things.

column.name: text
column.value: And I urge you all the more to do this, so that I may be restored to you more quickly.

column.name: text
column.value: Now may the God of peace, who brought up from the dead the great Shepherd of the sheep ①through the blood of the eternal covenant, that is, Jesus our Lord, ▷ ①Lit in

column.name: text
column.value: equip you in every good thing to do His will, working in us that which is pleasing in His sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: But I urge you, brothers and sisters, ①listen patiently to ②this word of exhortation, for I have written to you briefly. ▷ ①Or listen to ②Lit the

column.name: text
column.value: Know that our brother Timothy has been released, with whom, if he comes soon, I will see you.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet all of your leaders and all the ①saints. Those from Italy greet you. ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: Grace be with you all.

column.name: text
column.value: ①James, a bond-servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes who are ②dispersed abroad: Greetings. ▷ ①Or Jacob ②Lit in the Dispersion

column.name: text
column.value: Consider it all joy, my brothers and sisters, when you encounter various ①trials, ▷ ①Or temptations

column.name: text
column.value: knowing that the testing of your faith produces ①endurance. ▷ ①Or steadfastness

column.name: text
column.value: And let ①endurance have its perfect ②result, so that you may be ③perfect and complete, lacking in nothing. ▷ ①Or steadfastness ②Lit work ③Or mature

column.name: text
column.value: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all generously and ①without reproach, and it will be given to him. ▷ ①Lit does not reproach

column.name: text
column.value: But he must ask in faith without any doubting, for the one who doubts is like the surf of the sea, driven and tossed by the wind.

column.name: text
column.value: For that person ought not to expect that he will receive anything from the Lord,

column.name: text
column.value: being a ①double-minded man, unstable in all his ways. ▷ ①I.e., a chronic doubter

column.name: text
column.value: Now the brother or sister of humble circumstances is to glory in his high position;

column.name: text
column.value: but the rich person is to glory in his ①humiliation, because like ②flowering grass he will pass away. ▷ ①Or downfall ②Lit the flower of the grass

column.name: text
column.value: For the sun rises with its scorching heat and withers the grass; and its flower falls off and the beauty of its appearance is destroyed; so also the rich person, in the midst of his pursuits, will die out.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is a man who perseveres under trial; for once he has ①been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord has promised to those who love Him. ▷ ①Or passed the test

column.name: text
column.value: No one is to say when he is tempted, “I am being tempted ①by God”; for God cannot be tempted ②by evil, and He Himself does not tempt anyone. ▷ ①Lit from ②Lit of evil things

column.name: text
column.value: But each one is tempted when he is carried away and enticed by his own lust.

column.name: text
column.value: Then when lust has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it has run its course, brings forth death.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be ①deceived, my beloved brothers and sisters. ▷ ①Or misled

column.name: text
column.value: Every good thing given and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom there is no variation or ①shifting shadow. ▷ ①Lit shadow of turning

column.name: text
column.value: In the exercise of His will He gave us birth by the word of truth, so that we would be ①a kind of first fruits ②among His creatures. ▷ ①Or a certain first fruits ②Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: ①You know this, my beloved brothers and sisters. Now everyone must be quick to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger; ▷ ①Or Know this

column.name: text
column.value: for a man’s anger does not bring about the righteousness of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, ridding yourselves of all filthiness and all ①that remains of wickedness, in ②humility receive the word implanted, which is able to save your souls. ▷ ①Lit abundance of malice ②Or gentleness

column.name: text
column.value: But prove yourselves doers of the word, and not just hearers who deceive themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man who looks at his ①natural face in a mirror; ▷ ①Lit the face of his birth; or nature

column.name: text
column.value: for once he has looked at himself and gone away, ①he has immediately forgotten what kind of person he was. ▷ ①Lit and he

column.name: text
column.value: But one who has looked intently at the perfect law, the law of freedom, and has continued in it, not having become a forgetful hearer but ①an active doer, this person will be blessed in ②what he does. ▷ ①Lit a doer of a work ②Lit his doing

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone thinks himself to be religious, yet does not ①bridle his tongue but deceives his own heart, this person’s religion is worthless. ▷ ①Or control

column.name: text
column.value: Pure and undefiled religion in the sight of our God and Father is this: to visit orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself unstained ①by the world. ▷ ①Lit from

column.name: text
column.value: My brothers and sisters, do not hold your faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with an attitude of personal favoritism.

column.name: text
column.value: For if a man comes into your ①assembly with a gold ring and is dressed in bright clothes, and a poor man in dirty clothes also comes in, ▷ ①Or synagogue

column.name: text
column.value: and you ①pay special attention to the one who is wearing the bright clothes, and say, “You sit here in a good place,” and you say to the poor man, “You stand over there, or sit down by my footstool,” ▷ ①Lit look at

column.name: text
column.value: have you not made distinctions among yourselves, and become judges with evil ①motives? ▷ ①Lit reasonings

column.name: text
column.value: Listen, my beloved brothers and sisters: did God not choose the poor ①of this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the kingdom which He promised to those who love Him? ▷ ①Lit to the

column.name: text
column.value: But you have dishonored the poor man. Is it not the rich who oppress you and ①personally drag you into ②court? ▷ ①Lit they themselves ②Lit courts

column.name: text
column.value: Do they not blaspheme the good name ①by which you have been called? ▷ ①Lit which has been called upon you

column.name: text
column.value: If, however, you are fulfilling the ①royal law according to the Scripture, “YOU SHALL LOVE YOUR NEIGHBOR AS YOURSELF,” you are doing well. ▷ ①Or law of our King

column.name: text
column.value: But if you show partiality, you are committing sin and are convicted by the Law as violators.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever keeps the whole Law, yet stumbles in one point, has become guilty of all.

column.name: text
column.value: For He who said, “DO NOT COMMIT ADULTERY,” also said, “DO NOT MURDER.” Now if you do not commit adultery, but do murder, you have become a violator of the Law.

column.name: text
column.value: So speak, and so act, as those who are to be judged by the law of freedom.

column.name: text
column.value: For judgment will be merciless to one who has shown no mercy; mercy ①triumphs over judgment. ▷ ①Lit boasts against

column.name: text
column.value: What use is it, my brothers and sisters, if someone says he has faith, but he has no works? Can ①that faith save him? ▷ ①Lit the

column.name: text
column.value: If a brother or sister is without clothing and in need of daily food,

column.name: text
column.value: and one of you says to them, “Go in peace, ①be warmed and be filled,” yet you do not give them what is necessary for their body, what use is that? ▷ ①Or warm yourselves and fill yourselves

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way, faith also, if it has no works, is ①dead, being by itself. ▷ ①Or dead by its own standards

column.name: text
column.value: But someone ①may well say, “You have faith and I have works; show me your faith without the works, and I will show you my faith by my works.” ▷ ①Lit will

column.name: text
column.value: You believe that ①God is one. You do well; the demons also believe, and shudder. ▷ ①One early ms there is one God

column.name: text
column.value: But are you willing to acknowledge, you foolish person, that faith without works is useless?

column.name: text
column.value: Was our father Abraham not justified by works when he offered up his son Isaac on the altar?

column.name: text
column.value: You see that faith was working with his works, and ①as a result of the works, faith was ②perfected; ▷ ①Or by the deeds ②Or completed

column.name: text
column.value: and the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “AND ABRAHAM BELIEVED GOD, AND IT WAS CREDITED TO HIM AS RIGHTEOUSNESS,” and he was called a friend of God.

column.name: text
column.value: You see that a person is justified by works and not by faith alone.

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way, was Rahab the prostitute not justified by works also when she received the messengers and sent them out by another way?

column.name: text
column.value: For just as the body without the spirit is dead, so also faith without works is dead.

column.name: text
column.value: ①What is the source of quarrels and conflicts among you? ②Is the source not your pleasures that wage war in ③your body’s parts? ▷ ①Lit From where wars and from where fightings ②Lit Are they not from here, from your ③Lit your parts

column.name: text
column.value: You lust and do not have, so you commit murder. And you are envious and cannot obtain, so you fight and quarrel. You do not have because you do not ask.

column.name: text
column.value: You ask and do not receive, because you ask ①with the wrong motives, so that you may spend what you request ②on your pleasures. ▷ ①Lit wrongly ②Lit in

column.name: text
column.value: You adulteresses, do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Therefore whoever wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Or do you think that the Scripture says to no purpose, “ ①He ②jealously desires the Spirit whom He has made to dwell in us”? ▷ ①Or The spirit which He has made to dwell in us lusts with envy ②Lit desires to jealousy

column.name: text
column.value: But He gives a greater grace. Therefore it says, “GOD IS OPPOSED TO THE PROUD, BUT GIVES GRACE TO THE HUMBLE.”

column.name: text
column.value: Submit therefore to God. But ①resist the devil, and he will flee from you. ▷ ①Or oppose

column.name: text
column.value: Come close to God and He will come close to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you ①double-minded. ▷ ①I.e., chronic doubters

column.name: text
column.value: Be miserable, and mourn, and weep; let your laughter be turned into mourning, and your joy into gloom.

column.name: text
column.value: Humble yourselves in the presence of the Lord, and He will exalt you.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not speak against one another, brothers and sisters. The one who speaks against a brother or sister, or judges his brother or sister, speaks against the law and judges the law; but if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge of it.

column.name: text
column.value: There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the One who is able to save and to destroy; but who are you, ①judging your neighbor? ▷ ①Lit the one judging

column.name: text
column.value: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to such and such a city, and spend a year there and engage in business and make a profit.”

column.name: text
column.value: ①Yet you do not know ②what your life will be like tomorrow. For you are just a vapor that appears for a little while, and then vanishes away. ▷ ①Lit Who do not ②Or what will happen tomorrow. What kind of life is yours?

column.name: text
column.value: ①Instead, you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will live and also do this or that.” ▷ ①Lit Instead of your saying

column.name: text
column.value: But as it is, you boast in your ①arrogance; all such boasting is evil. ▷ ①Or pretensions

column.name: text
column.value: So for one who knows the ①right thing to do and does not do it, for him it is sin. ▷ ①Or good

column.name: text
column.value: Come now, you rich people, weep and howl for your miseries which are coming upon you.

column.name: text
column.value: Your riches have rotted and your garments have become moth-eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: Your gold and your silver have corroded, and their corrosion will ①serve as a testimony against you and will consume your flesh like fire. It is in the last days that you have stored up your treasure! ▷ ①Lit be for

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the pay of the laborers who mowed your fields, and which has been withheld by you, cries out against you; and the outcry of those who did the harvesting has reached the ears of the Lord ①of armies. ▷ ①Gr sabaoth, for Heb tsebaoth

column.name: text
column.value: You have ①lived for pleasure on the earth and lived luxuriously; you have ②fattened your hearts in a day of slaughter. ▷ ①Or led a life of self-indulgence ②Lit nourished

column.name: text
column.value: You have condemned and ①put to death the righteous person; he offers you no resistance. ▷ ①Or murdered

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore be patient, brothers and sisters, until the coming of the Lord. The farmer waits for the precious produce of the soil, being patient about it, until ①it gets the early and late rains. ▷ ①Or he

column.name: text
column.value: You too be patient; strengthen your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is near.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not ①complain, brothers and sisters, against one another, so that you may not be judged; behold, the Judge is standing ②right at the ③door. ▷ ①Lit groan ②Lit before ③Lit doors

column.name: text
column.value: As an example, brothers and sisters, of suffering and patience, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: We count those blessed who endured. You have heard of the ①endurance of Job and have seen the ②outcome of the Lord’s dealings, that the Lord is full of compassion and is merciful. ▷ ①Or steadfastness ②Lit end of the Lord

column.name: text
column.value: But above all, my brothers and sisters, do not swear, either by heaven or by earth or with any other oath; but ①your yes is to be yes, and your no, no, so that you do not fall under judgment. ▷ ①Lit yours is to be yes, yes, and no, no

column.name: text
column.value: Is anyone among you suffering? Then he must pray. Is anyone cheerful? He is to sing praises.

column.name: text
column.value: Is anyone among you sick? Then he must call for the elders of the church and they are to pray over him, ①anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord; ▷ ①Lit having anointed

column.name: text
column.value: and the prayer of faith will ①restore the one who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up, and if he has committed sins, ②they will be forgiven him. ▷ ①Lit save ②Lit it

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, confess your sins to one another, and pray for one another so that you may be healed. A ①prayer of a righteous person, when it is ②brought about, can accomplish much. ▷ ①Or supplication ②I.e., granted by God

column.name: text
column.value: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed ①earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain on the earth for three years and six months. ▷ ①Lit with prayer

column.name: text
column.value: Then he prayed again, and the sky ①poured rain and the earth produced its fruit. ▷ ①Lit gave

column.name: text
column.value: My brothers and sisters, if anyone among you strays from the truth and someone turns him back,

column.name: text
column.value: let him know that the one who has turned a sinner from the error of his way will save his soul from death and cover a multitude of sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, rid yourselves of all ①malice and all deceit and ②hypocrisy and ③envy and all ④slander, ▷ ①Or wickedness ②plural nouns ③plural nouns ④plural nouns

column.name: text
column.value: and like newborn babies, long for the ①pure ②milk of the word, so that by it you may grow ③in respect to salvation, ▷ ①Or unadulterated ②Or spiritual (Gr logikos) milk, so ③Or up to salvation

column.name: text
column.value: if you have tasted ①the kindness of the Lord. ▷ ①Lit that the Lord is kind

column.name: text
column.value: And coming to Him as to a living stone which has been rejected by people, but is ①choice and precious in the sight of God, ▷ ①Lit chosen; or elect

column.name: text
column.value: you also, as living stones, ①are being built up as a spiritual house for a holy priesthood, to offer spiritual sacrifices that are acceptable to God through Jesus Christ. ▷ ①Or allow yourselves to be built up; or build yourselves up

column.name: text
column.value: For this is contained in ①Scripture: “BEHOLD, I AM LAYING IN ZION A CHOICE STONE, A PRECIOUS CORNERSTONE, AND THE ONE WHO BELIEVES IN ②HIM WILL NOT BE ③PUT TO SHAME.” ▷ ①Or a scripture ②Or it ③Or disappointed

column.name: text
column.value: This precious value, then, is for you who believe; but for unbelievers, “A STONE WHICH THE BUILDERS REJECTED, THIS BECAME THE ①CHIEF CORNERSTONE,” ▷ ①Lit head of the corner

column.name: text
column.value: and, “A STONE OF STUMBLING AND A ROCK OF OFFENSE”; for they stumble because they are disobedient to the word, and to this they were also appointed.

column.name: text
column.value: But you are A CHOSEN PEOPLE, A royal PRIESTHOOD, A HOLY NATION, A PEOPLE FOR GOD’S own possession, so that you may proclaim the excellencies of Him who has called you out of darkness into His marvelous light;

column.name: text
column.value: for you once were NOT A PEOPLE, but now you are THE PEOPLE OF GOD; you had NOT RECEIVED MERCY, but now you have RECEIVED MERCY.

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, I urge you as foreigners and strangers to abstain from fleshly lusts, which wage war against the soul.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep your behavior excellent among the Gentiles, so that in the thing in which they slander you as evildoers, they may ①because of your good deeds, as they observe them, glorify God on the day of ②visitation. ▷ ①Or as a result of ②I.e., Christ’s coming again in judgment

column.name: text
column.value: Submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human institution, whether to a king as the one in authority,

column.name: text
column.value: or to governors as sent ①by him for the punishment of evildoers and the praise of those who do right. ▷ ①Lit through

column.name: text
column.value: For ①such is the will of God, that by doing right you silence the ignorance of foolish people. ▷ ①Lit so

column.name: text
column.value: Act as free people, and ①do not use your freedom as a ②covering for evil, but use it as bond-servants of God. ▷ ①Lit not having ②I.e., a way to conceal

column.name: text
column.value: Honor all people, love the brotherhood, fear God, honor the ①king. ▷ ①Or emperor

column.name: text
column.value: Servants, be subject to your masters with all respect, not only to those who are good and gentle, but also to those who are ①harsh. ▷ ①Or unscrupulous

column.name: text
column.value: For this finds favor, if for the sake of conscience toward God a person endures ①grief when suffering unjustly. ▷ ①Or pain

column.name: text
column.value: For what credit is there if, when you sin and are harshly treated, you endure it with patience? But if when you do what is right and suffer for it you patiently endure it, this finds favor with God.

column.name: text
column.value: For you have been called for this purpose, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, so that you would follow in His steps,

column.name: text
column.value: HE who committed no sin, NOR WAS ANY DECEIT found IN HIS MOUTH;

column.name: text
column.value: ①and while being abusively insulted, He did not insult in return; while suffering, He did not threaten, but kept entrusting Himself to Him who judges righteously; ▷ ①Lit who

column.name: text
column.value: and He Himself ①brought our sins in His body up on the ②cross, so that we might die to ③sin and live for righteousness; by His ④wounds you were healed. ▷ ①Or offered...up ②Lit wood; see Deut

column.name: text
column.value: For you were continually straying like sheep, but now you have returned to the Shepherd and ①Guardian of your souls. ▷ ①Or Bishop, Overseer

column.name: text
column.value: Do not become teachers in large numbers, my brothers, since you know that we who are teachers will incur a ①stricter judgment. ▷ ①Or greater condemnation; i.e., for erroneous doctrine

column.name: text
column.value: For we all stumble in many ways. If anyone does not stumble in ①what he says, he is a perfect man, able to ②rein in the whole body as well. ▷ ①Lit word ②Or hold in check

column.name: text
column.value: Now if we put the bits into the horses’ mouths so that they will obey us, we direct their whole body as well.

column.name: text
column.value: Look at the ships too: though they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are nevertheless directed by a very small rudder wherever the inclination of the pilot determines.

column.name: text
column.value: So also the tongue is a small part of the body, and yet it boasts of great things. See how great a forest is set aflame by such a small fire!

column.name: text
column.value: And the tongue is a fire, the very world of unrighteousness; the tongue is set among ①our body’s parts as that which defiles the whole body and sets on fire the course of our ②life, and is set on fire by ③hell. ▷ ①Lit our parts ②Or existence, origin ③Gr Gehenna

column.name: text
column.value: For every ①species of beasts and birds, of reptiles and creatures of the sea, is tamed and has been tamed by the human ②race. ▷ ①Lit nature ②Lit nature

column.name: text
column.value: But no one among mankind can tame the tongue; it is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

column.name: text
column.value: With it we bless our Lord and Father, and with it we curse people, who have been made in the likeness of God;

column.name: text
column.value: from the same mouth come both blessing and cursing. My brothers and sisters, these things should not be this way.

column.name: text
column.value: Does a spring send out from the same opening both ①fresh and bitter water? ▷ ①Lit sweet

column.name: text
column.value: Can a fig tree, my brothers and sisters, bear olives, or a vine bear figs? Nor can salt water produce ①fresh. ▷ ①Lit sweet

column.name: text
column.value: Who among you is wise and understanding? Let him show by his good behavior his deeds in the gentleness of wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: But if you have bitter jealousy and ①selfish ambition in your heart, do not be arrogant and so lie against the truth. ▷ ①Or strife

column.name: text
column.value: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, ①natural, demonic. ▷ ①Or unspiritual

column.name: text
column.value: For where jealousy and ①selfish ambition exist, ②there is disorder and every evil thing. ▷ ①Or strife ②I.e., in that place

column.name: text
column.value: But the wisdom from above is first pure, then peace-loving, gentle, ①reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, ②impartial, free of hypocrisy. ▷ ①Or willing to yield ②Or unwavering

column.name: text
column.value: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace ①by those who make peace. ▷ ①Or for

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way, you wives, be subject to your own husbands so that even if any of them are disobedient to the word, they may be won over without a word by the behavior of their wives,

column.name: text
column.value: as they observe your pure ①and respectful behavior. ▷ ①Lit with respect

column.name: text
column.value: Your adornment must not be merely the external—braiding the hair, wearing gold jewelry, or putting on apparel;

column.name: text
column.value: but it should be the hidden person of the heart, with the imperishable quality of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is precious in the sight of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For in this way the holy women of former times, who hoped in God, also used to adorn themselves, being subject to their own husbands,

column.name: text
column.value: just as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord; and you have proved to be her children if you do what is right ①without being frightened by any fear. ▷ ①Lit and are not

column.name: text
column.value: You husbands in the same way, live with your wives in an understanding way, as with ①someone weaker, since she is a woman; and show her honor as a fellow heir of the grace of life, so that your prayers will not be hindered. ▷ ①Lit a weaker vessel

column.name: text
column.value: ①To sum up, all of you be harmonious, sympathetic, ②loving, compassionate, and humble; ▷ ①Or Finally ②I.e., as brothers and sisters

column.name: text
column.value: not returning evil for evil or insult for insult, but giving a blessing instead; for you were called for the very purpose that you would inherit a blessing.

column.name: text
column.value: For, “THE ONE WHO DESIRES LIFE, TO LOVE AND SEE GOOD DAYS, MUST KEEP HIS TONGUE FROM EVIL AND HIS LIPS FROM SPEAKING DECEIT.

column.name: text
column.value: HE MUST TURN AWAY FROM EVIL AND DO GOOD; HE MUST SEEK PEACE AND PURSUE IT.

column.name: text
column.value: FOR THE EYES OF THE LORD ARE TOWARD THE RIGHTEOUS, AND HIS EARS ATTEND TO THEIR PRAYER, BUT THE FACE OF THE LORD IS AGAINST EVILDOERS.”

column.name: text
column.value: And who is ①there to harm you if you prove zealous for what is good? ▷ ①Lit the one who will harm you

column.name: text
column.value: But even if you should suffer for the sake of righteousness, you ①are blessed. AND DO NOT FEAR THEIR ②INTIMIDATION, AND DO NOT BE IN DREAD, ▷ ①Or would be ②Lit fear

column.name: text
column.value: but ①sanctify Christ as Lord in your hearts, always being ready to make a ②defense to everyone who asks you to give an account for the hope that is in you, but with gentleness and respect; ▷ ①I.e., set apart ②Or argument; or explanation

column.name: text
column.value: ①and keep a good conscience so that in the thing in which you are slandered, those who disparage your good behavior in Christ will be put to shame. ▷ ①Lit having a good

column.name: text
column.value: For it is better, if ①God should will it so, that you suffer for doing what is right rather than for doing what is wrong. ▷ ①Lit the will of God

column.name: text
column.value: For Christ also ①suffered for sins once for all time, the just for the unjust, so that He might bring us to God, having been put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the ②spirit; ▷ ①One early ms died ②Or Spirit

column.name: text
column.value: in ①which He also went and made proclamation to the spirits in prison, ▷ ①Or whom

column.name: text
column.value: who once were disobedient when the patience of God kept waiting in the days of Noah, during the construction of the ark, in which a few, that is, eight persons, were brought safely through the water.

column.name: text
column.value: Corresponding to that, baptism now saves you—not the removal of dirt from the flesh, but an appeal to God ①for a good conscience—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ, ▷ ①Or from

column.name: text
column.value: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, after angels and authorities and powers had been subjected to Him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, I urge elders among you, as your fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and one who is also a ①fellow partaker of the glory that is to be revealed: ▷ ①Or partner in

column.name: text
column.value: shepherd the flock of God among you, exercising oversight, not under compulsion but voluntarily, according to the will of God; and not ①with greed but with eagerness; ▷ ①Or for dishonest gain

column.name: text
column.value: nor yet as domineering over ①those assigned to your care, but by ②proving to be ③examples to the flock. ▷ ①Lit the allotments ②Or becoming examples ③Or role models

column.name: text
column.value: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the unfading ①crown of glory. ▷ ①Lit wreath

column.name: text
column.value: You ①younger men, likewise, be subject to your elders; and all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because GOD IS OPPOSED TO THE PROUD, BUT HE GIVES GRACE TO THE HUMBLE. ▷ ①Or young people

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God, so that He may exalt you at the proper time,

column.name: text
column.value: having cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares about you.

column.name: text
column.value: Be of sober spirit, be on the alert. Your adversary, the devil, prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.

column.name: text
column.value: ①So resist him, firm in your faith, knowing that the same experiences of suffering are being accomplished by your ②brothers and sisters who are in the world. ▷ ①Lit Whom resist ②Lit fellowship

column.name: text
column.value: After you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself perfect, confirm, strengthen, and establish you.

column.name: text
column.value: To Him be dominion forever and ever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother ①(for so I regard him), I have written to you briefly, ②exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it! ▷ ①Lit (as I consider) ②Or encouraging

column.name: text
column.value: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings, and so does my son, Mark.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to you all who are in Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, since Christ has ①suffered in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same purpose, because the one who has ②suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin, ▷ ①I.e., suffered death ②I.e., suffered death

column.name: text
column.value: so as to live the rest of the time in the flesh no longer for human lusts, but for the will of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For the time already past is sufficient for you to have carried out the desire of the Gentiles, ①having pursued a course of indecent behavior, lusts, drunkenness, carousing, drinking parties, and wanton idolatries. ▷ ①Lit having gone in

column.name: text
column.value: In all this, they are surprised that you do not run with them in the same excesses of ①debauchery, and they slander you; ▷ ①Or reckless abandon

column.name: text
column.value: but they will give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: For the gospel has for this purpose been ①preached even to those who are dead, that though they are judged in the flesh as people, they may live in the spirit according to the will of God. ▷ ①I.e., preached in their lifetimes

column.name: text
column.value: The end of all things ①is near; therefore, be of sound judgment and sober spirit for the purpose of ②prayer. ▷ ①Lit has come near ②Lit prayers

column.name: text
column.value: Above all, keep fervent in your love for one another, because love covers a multitude of sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Be hospitable to one another without complaint.

column.name: text
column.value: As each one has received a special gift, employ it in serving one another as good stewards of the ①multifaceted grace of God. ▷ ①Or manifold

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever speaks is to do so as one who is speaking actual words of God; whoever serves is to do so as one who is serving ①by the strength which God supplies; so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belongs the glory and ②dominion forever and ever. Amen. ▷ ①Lit from ②Or power

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery ordeal among you, which comes upon you for your testing, as though something strange were happening to you;

column.name: text
column.value: but to the degree that you share the sufferings of Christ, keep on rejoicing, so that at the revelation of His glory you may also rejoice and be overjoyed.

column.name: text
column.value: If you are insulted ①for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory, and of God, rests upon you. ▷ ①Lit in

column.name: text
column.value: Make sure that none of you suffers as a murderer, or thief, or evildoer, or a ①troublesome meddler; ▷ ①Lit one who oversees others’ affairs

column.name: text
column.value: but if anyone suffers as a Christian, he is not to be ashamed, but is to glorify God in this name.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is time for judgment to begin ①with the household of God; and if it begins ②with us first, what will be the outcome for those who do not obey the gospel of God? ▷ ①Lit from ②Lit from

column.name: text
column.value: AND IF IT IS WITH DIFFICULTY THAT THE RIGHTEOUS IS SAVED, ①WHAT WILL BECOME OF THE GODLESS MAN AND THE SINNER? ▷ ①Lit where will appear

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, those also who suffer according to the will of God are to entrust their souls to a faithful Creator in doing what is right.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Simon Peter, a bond-servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who have received a faith of the same ②kind as ours, ③by the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ: ▷ ①One early ms Simeon ②Or value ③Or in

column.name: text
column.value: Grace and peace be multiplied to you in the knowledge of God and of Jesus ①our Lord, ▷ ①Or our Lord. Since His...excellence, through these (vv 3-4)

column.name: text
column.value: for His divine power has granted to us everything pertaining to life and godliness, through the true knowledge of Him who called us ①by His own glory and ②excellence. ▷ ①Or to ②Or virtue

column.name: text
column.value: Through ①these He has granted to us His precious and magnificent promises, so that by them you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world on account of lust. ▷ ①Lit which

column.name: text
column.value: Now for this very reason also, applying all diligence, in your faith supply moral ①excellence, and in your moral excellence, knowledge, ▷ ①Or virtue

column.name: text
column.value: and in your knowledge, self-control, and in your self-control, perseverance, and in your perseverance, godliness,

column.name: text
column.value: and in your godliness, brotherly kindness, and in your brotherly kindness, love.

column.name: text
column.value: For if these qualities are yours and are increasing, they do not make you useless nor unproductive in the true knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For the one who lacks these qualities is blind or short-sighted, having forgotten his purification from his former sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, brothers and sisters, be all the more diligent to make certain about His calling and choice of you; for as long as you practice these things, you will never stumble;

column.name: text
column.value: for in this way the entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will be abundantly supplied to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, I will always be ready to remind you of these things, even though you already know them and have been established in the truth which is present with you.

column.name: text
column.value: I consider it right, as long as I am in this earthly ①dwelling, to stir you up by way of reminder, ▷ ①I.e., human body

column.name: text
column.value: knowing that the laying aside of my earthly dwelling is imminent, as also our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will also be diligent that at any time after my departure you will be able to call these things to mind.

column.name: text
column.value: For we did not follow cleverly devised tales when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of His majesty.

column.name: text
column.value: For when He received honor and glory from God the Father, such a ①declaration as this was made to Him by the Majestic Glory: “This is ②My beloved Son with whom I am well pleased”— ▷ ①Lit voice ②Or My Son, My beloved, with

column.name: text
column.value: and we ourselves heard this ①declaration made from heaven when we were with Him on the holy mountain. ▷ ①Lit voice

column.name: text
column.value: And so we have the prophetic word made more sure, to which you do well to pay attention as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts.

column.name: text
column.value: But know this first of all, that no prophecy of Scripture ①becomes a matter of ②someone’s own interpretation, ▷ ①Or comes from someone’s ②Or the prophet’s own

column.name: text
column.value: for no prophecy was ever made by an act of human will, but men moved by the Holy Spirit spoke from God.

column.name: text
column.value: But false prophets also appeared among the people, just as there will also be false teachers among you, who will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them, bringing swift destruction upon themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Many will follow their indecent behavior, and because of them the way of the truth will be maligned;

column.name: text
column.value: and in their greed they will exploit you with false words; their judgment from long ago is not idle, and their destruction is not asleep.

column.name: text
column.value: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but cast them into ①hell and committed them to ②pits of darkness, held for judgment; ▷ ①Gr Tartarus, a name used as a reference to the netherworld (hell) ②One early ms chains of darkness

column.name: text
column.value: and did not spare the ancient world, but protected Noah, a ①preacher of righteousness, with seven others, when He brought a flood upon the world of the ungodly; ▷ ①Or herald

column.name: text
column.value: and if He condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to destruction by reducing them to ashes, having made them an example ①of what is coming for the ungodly; ▷ ①One early ms to those who were going to live ungodly lives

column.name: text
column.value: and if He rescued righteous Lot, who was oppressed by the perverted conduct of ①unscrupulous people ▷ ①Or disgraceful

column.name: text
column.value: (for by what he saw and heard that righteous man, while living among them, felt his righteous soul tormented day after day by their lawless deeds),

column.name: text
column.value: then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from ①a trial, and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment, ▷ ①Or temptation; one early ms trials (temptations)

column.name: text
column.value: and especially those who ①indulge the flesh in its corrupt passion, and despise ②authority. ③Reckless, self-centered, they speak abusively of angelic ④majesties without trembling, ▷ ①Lit go after ②Lit lordship ③Or Audacious ④Lit glories

column.name: text
column.value: whereas angels who are greater in might and power do not bring a demeaning judgment against them before the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: But these, like unreasoning animals, born as creatures of instinct to be captured and killed, using abusive speech where they have no knowledge, will in ①the destruction of those creatures also be destroyed, ▷ ①Lit their destruction also

column.name: text
column.value: suffering wrong as the wages of doing wrong. They count it a pleasure to revel in the daytime. They are stains and blemishes, reveling in their ①deceptions as they feast with you, ▷ ①One early ms love feasts

column.name: text
column.value: having eyes full of adultery ①that never cease from sin, enticing unstable souls, having hearts trained in greed, accursed children; ▷ ①Lit and unceasing from sin

column.name: text
column.value: abandoning the right way, they have gone astray, having followed the way of Balaam, the son of Beor, who loved the ①reward of unrighteousness; ▷ ①Or wages

column.name: text
column.value: but he received a rebuke for his own offense, for a mute donkey, speaking with a human voice, restrained the insanity of the prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: These are springs without water and mists driven by a storm, for whom the ①black darkness has been reserved. ▷ ①Lit blackness of darkness

column.name: text
column.value: For, while speaking out arrogant words of no value they entice by fleshly desires, by indecent behavior, those who barely escape from the ones who live in error,

column.name: text
column.value: promising them freedom while they themselves are slaves of corruption; for by what anyone is overcome, by this he is enslaved.

column.name: text
column.value: For if, after they have escaped the defilements of the world by the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in them and are overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

column.name: text
column.value: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than having known it, to turn away from the holy commandment handed on to them.

column.name: text
column.value: ①It has happened to them according to the true proverb, “A DOG RETURNS TO ITS OWN VOMIT,” and, “A sow, after washing, returns to wallowing in the mire.” ▷ ①Lit The thing of the true proverb has happened to them

column.name: text
column.value: What was from the beginning, what we have heard, what we have seen with our eyes, what we have looked at and touched with our hands, concerning the Word of Life—

column.name: text
column.value: and the life was revealed, and we have seen and testify and proclaim to you the eternal life, which was with the Father and was revealed to us—

column.name: text
column.value: what we have seen and heard we proclaim to you also, so that you too may have fellowship with us; and indeed our fellowship is with the Father, and with His Son Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: These things we write, so that our joy may be made complete.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you, that God is Light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.

column.name: text
column.value: If we say that we have fellowship with Him and yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth;

column.name: text
column.value: but if we walk in the Light as He Himself is in the Light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.

column.name: text
column.value: If we say that we have no sin, we are deceiving ourselves and the truth is not in us.

column.name: text
column.value: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and righteous, so that He will forgive us our sins and cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: If we say that we have not sinned, we make Him a liar and His word is not in us.

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, this is now the second letter I am writing to you in which I am stirring up your sincere mind by way of a reminder,

column.name: text
column.value: to remember the words spoken beforehand by the holy prophets and the commandment of the Lord and Savior spoken by your apostles.

column.name: text
column.value: Know this first of all, that in the last days mockers will come with their mocking, following after their own lusts,

column.name: text
column.value: and saying, “Where is the promise of His coming? For ever since the fathers ①fell asleep, all things continue just as they were from the beginning of creation.” ▷ ①I.e., died

column.name: text
column.value: For ①when they maintain this, it escapes their notice that by the word of God the heavens existed long ago and the earth was formed out of water and by water, ▷ ①Or they are willfully ignorant of this fact, that

column.name: text
column.value: through which the world at that time was destroyed by being flooded with water.

column.name: text
column.value: But by His word the present heavens and earth are being reserved for fire, kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly people.

column.name: text
column.value: But do not let this one fact escape your notice, beloved, that with the Lord one day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years like one day.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord is not slow about His promise, as some count slowness, but is patient toward you, not willing for any to perish, but for all to come to repentance.

column.name: text
column.value: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief, in which the heavens will pass away with a roar and the elements will be destroyed with intense heat, and the earth and ①its works will be ②discovered. ▷ ①Lit the works in it ②I.e., as worthless; late mss burned up

column.name: text
column.value: Since all these things are to be destroyed in this way, what sort of people ought you to be in holy conduct and godliness,

column.name: text
column.value: looking for and hastening the coming of the day of God, because of which the heavens will be destroyed by burning, and the elements will melt with intense heat!

column.name: text
column.value: But according to His promise we are looking for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, beloved, since you look for these things, be diligent to be found spotless and blameless by Him, at peace,

column.name: text
column.value: and regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; just as also our beloved brother Paul, according to the wisdom given him, wrote to you,

column.name: text
column.value: as also in all his letters, speaking in them of these things, in which there are some things that are hard to understand, which the untaught and unstable distort, as they do also the rest of the Scriptures, to their own destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: You therefore, beloved, knowing this beforehand, be on your guard so that you are not carried away by the error of ①unscrupulous people and lose your own ②firm commitment, ▷ ①Or disgraceful ②Or firm hold

column.name: text
column.value: but grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory, both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who reside as strangers, scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia, who are chosen

column.name: text
column.value: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, by the sanctifying work of the Spirit, ①to obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with His blood: May grace and peace be multiplied to you. ▷ ①Lit unto obedience and sprinkling

column.name: text
