column.value: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to His great mercy has caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

column.name: text
column.value: to obtain an inheritance which is imperishable, undefiled, and will not fade away, reserved in heaven for you,

column.name: text
column.value: who are protected by the power of God through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

column.name: text
column.value: In this you greatly rejoice, even though now for a little while, if necessary, you have been distressed by various ①trials, ▷ ①Or temptations

column.name: text
column.value: so that the ①proof of your faith, being more precious than gold which perishes though tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ; ▷ ①Or genuineness

column.name: text
column.value: and though you have not seen Him, you love Him, and though you do not see Him now, but believe in Him, you greatly rejoice with joy inexpressible and ①full of glory, ▷ ①Lit glorified

column.name: text
column.value: obtaining as the outcome of your faith, the salvation of ①your souls. ▷ ①One early ms does not contain your

column.name: text
column.value: As to this salvation, the prophets who prophesied of the grace that would come to you made careful searches and inquiries,

column.name: text
column.value: ①seeking to know what person or time the Spirit of Christ within them was indicating as He predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories ②to follow. ▷ ①Or inquiring ②Lit after these

column.name: text
column.value: It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves, but you, in these things which now have been announced to you through those who preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven—things into which angels long to ①look. ▷ ①Or gain a clear glimpse

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, ①prepare your minds for action, ②keep sober in spirit, set your hope completely on the grace to be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ. ▷ ①Lit be sober ②Lit belt up the waist of your mind

column.name: text
column.value: As ①obedient children, do not ②be conformed to the former lusts which were yours in your ignorance, ▷ ①Lit children of obedience ②Or conform yourselves

column.name: text
column.value: but ①like the Holy One who called you, ②be holy yourselves also in all your behavior; ▷ ①Lit according to ②Or become

column.name: text
column.value: because it is written: “YOU SHALL BE HOLY, FOR I AM HOLY.”

column.name: text
column.value: If you address as Father the One who impartially judges according to each one’s work, conduct yourselves in fear during the time of your stay on earth;

column.name: text
column.value: knowing that you were not ①redeemed with perishable things like silver or gold from your futile way of life inherited from your forefathers, ▷ ①Or ransomed

column.name: text
column.value: but with precious blood, as of a lamb unblemished and spotless, the blood of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For He was foreknown before the foundation of the world, but has appeared ①in these last times for the sake of you ▷ ①Lit at the end of the times

column.name: text
column.value: who through Him are believers in God, who raised Him from the dead and gave Him glory, so that your faith and hope are in God.

column.name: text
column.value: Since you have purified your souls in obedience to the truth for a sincere love of the brothers and sisters, fervently love one another from ①the heart, ▷ ①Two early mss a pure heart

column.name: text
column.value: for you have been born again not of seed which is perishable, but imperishable, that is, through the living and enduring word of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For, “ALL FLESH IS LIKE GRASS, AND ALL ITS GLORY IS LIKE THE FLOWER OF GRASS. THE GRASS WITHERS, AND THE FLOWER FALLS OFF,

column.name: text
column.value: BUT THE WORD OF THE LORD ENDURES FOREVER.” And this is the word which was ①preached to you. ▷ ①Lit preached as good news to you

column.name: text
column.value: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you may not sin. And if anyone sins, we have an ①Advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous; ▷ ①Or Intercessor

column.name: text
column.value: and He Himself is the ①propitiation for our sins; and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world. ▷ ①I.e., means of reconciliation with God by atoning for sins; or sin-offering

column.name: text
column.value: By this we know that we have come to know Him, if we keep His commandments.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who says, “I have come to know Him,” and does not keep His commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him;

column.name: text
column.value: but whoever follows His word, in him the love of God has truly been perfected. By this we know that we are in Him:

column.name: text
column.value: the one who says that he remains in Him ought, himself also, walk just as He walked.

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, I am not writing a new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you have had from the beginning; the old commandment is the word which you have heard.

column.name: text
column.value: ①On the other hand, I am writing a new commandment to you, which is true in Him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true Light is already shining. ▷ ①Lit Again

column.name: text
column.value: The one who says that he is in the Light and yet hates his brother or sister is in the darkness until now.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who loves his brother and sister remains in the Light, and there is nothing in him to cause stumbling.

column.name: text
column.value: But the one who hates his brother or sister is in the darkness and walks in the darkness, and does not know where he is going because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: I am writing to you, little children, because your sins have been forgiven you on account of His name.

column.name: text
column.value: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know Him who has been from the beginning. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I have written to you, children, because you know the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: I have written to you, fathers, because you know Him who has been from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not love the world nor the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

column.name: text
column.value: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh and the lust of the eyes and the boastful pride of life, is not from the Father, but is from the world.

column.name: text
column.value: The world is passing away and also its lusts; but the one who does the will of God continues to live forever.

column.name: text
column.value: Children, it is the last hour; and just as you heard that antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have appeared; from this we know that it is the last hour.

column.name: text
column.value: They went out from us, but they were not really of us; for if they had been of us, they would have remained with us; but they went out, so that ①it would be evident that they all are not of us. ▷ ①Lit they would be revealed

column.name: text
column.value: ①But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all know. ▷ ①Lit And

column.name: text
column.value: I have not written to you because you do not know the truth, but because you do know it, and ①because no lie is of the truth. ▷ ①Or you know that no lie

column.name: text
column.value: Who is the liar except the one who denies that Jesus is the ①Christ? This is the antichrist, the one who denies the Father and the Son. ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever denies the Son does not have the Father; the one who confesses the Son has the Father also.

column.name: text
column.value: As for you, see that what you heard from the beginning remains in you. If what you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son and in the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the promise which He Himself ①made to us: eternal life. ▷ ①Lit promised us

column.name: text
column.value: These things I have written to you concerning those who are trying to deceive you.

column.name: text
column.value: And as for you, the anointing which you received from Him remains in you, and you have no need for anyone to teach you; but as His anointing teaches you about all things, and is true and is not a lie, and just as it has taught you, ①you remain in Him. ▷ ①Or remain in Him (a command)

column.name: text
column.value: Now, little children, remain in Him, so that when He appears, we may have confidence and not ①draw back from Him in shame ②at His coming. ▷ ①Lit be put to shame from Him ②Or in His presence

column.name: text
column.value: If you know that He is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness also has been born of Him.

column.name: text
column.value: See ①how great a love the Father has given us, that we would be called children of God; and in fact we are. For this reason the world does not know us: because it did not know Him. ▷ ①Lit what kind of love

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, now we are children of God, and it has not appeared as yet what we will be. We know that when He appears, we will be like Him, because we will see Him just as He is.

column.name: text
column.value: And everyone who has this hope set on Him purifies himself, just as He is pure.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone who practices sin also practices lawlessness; and sin is lawlessness.

column.name: text
column.value: You know that He appeared in order to take away sins; and in Him there is no sin.

column.name: text
column.value: No one who remains in Him sins continually; no one who sins continually has seen Him or ①knows Him. ▷ ①Or has known

column.name: text
column.value: Little children, make sure no one deceives you; the one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as He is righteous;

column.name: text
column.value: the one who practices sin is of the devil; for the devil ①has been sinning from the beginning. The Son of God appeared for this purpose, to destroy the works of the devil. ▷ ①Lit sins

column.name: text
column.value: No one who has been born of God practices sin, because His seed remains in him; and he cannot sin continually, because he has been born of God.

column.name: text
column.value: By this the children of God and the children of the devil are obvious: ①anyone who does not practice righteousness is not of God, nor the one who does not love his brother and sister. ▷ ①Lit everyone

column.name: text
column.value: For this is the message which you have heard from the beginning, that we are to love one another;

column.name: text
column.value: not as Cain, who was of the evil one and murdered his brother. And for what reason did he murder him? Because his own deeds were evil, but his brother’s were righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not be surprised, brothers and sisters, if the world hates you.

column.name: text
column.value: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers and sisters. The one who does not love remains in death.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone who hates his brother or sister is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

column.name: text
column.value: We know love by this, that He laid down His life for us; and we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers and sisters.

column.name: text
column.value: But whoever has worldly goods and sees his brother or sister in need, and closes his ①heart ②against him, how does the love of God remain in him? ▷ ①Lit inward parts ②Lit from

column.name: text
column.value: Little children, let’s not love with word or with tongue, but in deed and truth.

column.name: text
column.value: We will know by this that we are of the truth, and will set our heart at ease before Him,

column.name: text
column.value: that if our heart condemns us, that God is greater than our heart, and He knows all things.

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, if our heart does not condemn us, we have confidence ①before God; ▷ ①Lit toward

column.name: text
column.value: and whatever we ask, we receive from Him, because we keep His commandments and do the things that are pleasing in His sight.

column.name: text
column.value: This is His commandment, that we ①believe in the name of His Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, just as He ②commanded us. ▷ ①Or believe the name ②Lit gave us a commandment

column.name: text
column.value: The one who keeps His commandments remains in Him, and He in him. We know by this that He remains in us, by the Spirit whom He has given us.

column.name: text
column.value: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the ①Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the ②Father loves the child born of Him. ▷ ①I.e., Messiah ②Lit one who has fathered

column.name: text
column.value: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and ①follow His commandments. ▷ ①Lit do

column.name: text
column.value: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments; and His commandments are not burdensome.

column.name: text
column.value: For ①whoever has been born of God overcomes the world; and this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith. ▷ ①Lit everything that

column.name: text
column.value: Who is the one who overcomes the world, but the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

column.name: text
column.value: This is the One who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not ①with the water only, but ②with the water and ③with the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth. ▷ ①Lit in ②Lit in ③Lit in

column.name: text
column.value: For there are three that testify:

column.name: text
column.value: ①the Spirit and the water and the blood; and the three are ②in agreement. ▷ ①A few late mss add ...in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit, and these three are one. And there are three that testify on earth, the Spirit ②Lit for the one thing

column.name: text
column.value: If we receive the testimony of people, the testimony of God is greater; for the testimony of God is this, that He has testified concerning His Son.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself; the one who does not believe God has made Him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning His Son.

column.name: text
column.value: And the testimony is this, that God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who has the Son has the life; the one who does not have the Son of God does not have the life.

column.name: text
column.value: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the confidence which we have ①before Him, that, if we ask anything according to His will, He hears us. ▷ ①Lit toward

column.name: text
column.value: And if we know that He hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we have the requests which we have asked from Him.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone sees his brother or sister ①committing a sin not leading to death, he shall ask and ②God will, for him, give life to those who commit sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death; I am not saying that he should ask about that. ▷ ①Lit sinning ②Or God will give him life, that is, to those who...

column.name: text
column.value: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.

column.name: text
column.value: We know that no one who has been born of God ①sins; but He who was born of God keeps him, and the evil one does not touch him. ▷ ①Or sins continually

column.name: text
column.value: We know that we are of God, and that the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

column.name: text
column.value: And we know that the Son of God has come, and has given us understanding so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true, in His Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: Little children, guard yourselves from idols.

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

column.name: text
column.value: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God;

column.name: text
column.value: and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God; this is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming, and now it is already in the world.

column.name: text
column.value: You are from God, little children, and have overcome them; because greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world.

column.name: text
column.value: They are from the world, therefore they speak as from the world, and the world listens to them.

column.name: text
column.value: We are from God. The one who knows God listens to us; the one who is not from God does not listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth and the spirit of error.

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, let’s love one another; for love is from God, and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who does not love does not know God, because God is love.

column.name: text
column.value: By this the love of God was revealed ①in us, that God has sent His only Son into the world so that we may live through Him. ▷ ①Or among us; or in our case

column.name: text
column.value: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son to be the ①propitiation for our sins. ▷ ①I.e., means of reconciliation with God by atoning for sins; or sin-offering

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

column.name: text
column.value: No one has ever seen God; if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.

column.name: text
column.value: By this we know that we remain in Him and He in us, because He has given to us of His Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son to be the Savior of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.

column.name: text
column.value: We have come to know and have believed the love which God has ①for us. God is love, and the one who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him. ▷ ①Lit in

column.name: text
column.value: By this, love is perfected with us, so that we may have confidence in the day of judgment; because as He is, we also are in this world.

column.name: text
column.value: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear ①involves punishment, and the one who fears is not perfected in love. ▷ ①Lit has

column.name: text
column.value: We love, because He first loved us.

column.name: text
column.value: If someone says, “I love God,” and yet he hates his brother or sister, he is a liar; for the one who does not love his brother and sister whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.

column.name: text
column.value: And this commandment we have from Him, that the one who loves God must also love his brother and sister.

column.name: text
column.value: The elder to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth; and not only I, but also all who know the truth,

column.name: text
column.value: because of the truth which remains in us and will be with us forever:

column.name: text
column.value: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

column.name: text
column.value: I was overjoyed to find some of your children walking in truth, just as we have received a commandment to do from the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I ask you, lady, not as though I were writing to you a new commandment, but the one which we have had from the beginning, that we love one another.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the commandment, just as you have heard from the beginning, that you are to walk in it.

column.name: text
column.value: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who do not acknowledge Jesus Christ as coming in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the antichrist.

column.name: text
column.value: Watch yourselves, that you do not lose what we have accomplished, but that you may receive a full reward.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Anyone who ②goes too far and does not remain in the teaching of Christ, does not have God; the one who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son. ▷ ①Lit Everyone ②Lit goes on ahead

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your house, and do not ①give him a greeting; ▷ ①Lit say to him

column.name: text
column.value: for the one who ①gives him a greeting ②participates in his evil deeds. ▷ ①Lit says to him ②I.e., shares responsibility for them

column.name: text
column.value: Though I have many things to write to you, I do not want to do so with paper and ink; but I hope to come to you and speak ①face to face, so that ②your joy may be made complete. ▷ ①Lit mouth to mouth ②One early ms our

column.name: text
column.value: The children of your chosen sister greet you.

column.name: text
column.value: The elder to the beloved Gaius, whom I love in truth.

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, I pray that in all respects you may prosper and be in good health, just as your soul prospers.

column.name: text
column.value: For I was overjoyed when brothers came and testified to your truth, that is, how you are walking in truth.

column.name: text
column.value: I have no greater joy than ①this, to hear of my children walking in the truth. ▷ ①Lit these things, that I hear

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, you are acting faithfully in whatever you accomplish for the brothers and sisters, and ①especially when they are strangers; ▷ ①Lit this

column.name: text
column.value: and they have testified to your love before the church. You will do well to ①send them on their way in a manner worthy of God. ▷ ①I.e., give them whatever they might need for the journey

column.name: text
column.value: For they went out for the sake of the Name, accepting nothing from the Gentiles.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore we ought to ①support such people, so that we may ②prove to be fellow workers ③with the truth. ▷ ①Or receive as guests ②Or become fellow ③Or for

column.name: text
column.value: I wrote something to the church; but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, does not accept ①what we say. ▷ ①Lit us

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with malicious words; and not satisfied with this, he himself does not receive the brothers either, and he forbids those who want to do so and puts them out of the church.

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does what is good is of God; the one who does what is evil has not seen God.

column.name: text
column.value: Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself; and we testify too, and you know that our testimony is true.

column.name: text
column.value: I had many things to write to you, but I do not want to write to you with pen and ink;

column.name: text
column.value: but I hope to see you shortly, and we will speak ①face to face. ▷ ①Lit mouth to mouth

column.name: text
column.value: Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.

column.name: text
column.value: ①Jude, a bond-servant of Jesus Christ and brother of ②James, To those who are the called, beloved in God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ: ▷ ①Gr Judas ②Or Jacob

column.name: text
column.value: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, while I was making every effort to write you about our common salvation, I felt the necessity to write to you appealing that you contend earnestly for the faith that was once for all time handed down to the ①saints. ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: For certain people have crept in unnoticed, those who were long beforehand ①marked out for this condemnation, ungodly persons who turn the grace of our God into indecent behavior and deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ. ▷ ①Or written about regarding this

column.name: text
column.value: Now I want to remind you, though you know everything once and for all, that ①the Lord, after saving a people out of the land of Egypt, ②subsequently destroyed those who did not believe. ▷ ①One early ms Jesus ②Lit the second time

column.name: text
column.value: And angels who did not keep their own domain but abandoned their proper dwelling place, these He has kept in eternal restraints under darkness for the judgment of the great day,

column.name: text
column.value: just as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, since they in the same way as these angels indulged in sexual perversion and went after ①strange flesh, are exhibited as an ②example in undergoing the punishment of eternal fire. ▷ ①Lit different; or other flesh ②Or example of eternal fire, in undergoing punishment

column.name: text
column.value: Yet in the same way these people also, dreaming, defile the flesh, reject authority, and speak abusively of angelic ①majesties. ▷ ①Lit glories

column.name: text
column.value: But Michael the archangel, when he disputed with the devil and argued about the body of Moses, did not dare pronounce against him an abusive judgment, but said, “The Lord rebuke you!”

column.name: text
column.value: But these people disparage all the things that they do not understand; and all the things that they know by instinct, like unreasoning animals, by these things they are destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to them! For they have gone the way of Cain, and for pay ①they have given themselves up to the error of Balaam, and perished in the rebellion of Korah. ▷ ①Lit they have poured themselves out

column.name: text
column.value: These are the ones who are ①hidden reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you without fear, like shepherds caring only for themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, ②doubly dead, uprooted; ▷ ①Or stains ②Lit twice

column.name: text
column.value: wild waves of the sea, churning up their own shameful deeds like dirty foam; wandering stars, for whom the ①gloom of darkness has been reserved forever. ▷ ①Or netherworld gloom

column.name: text
column.value: It was also about these people that Enoch, in the seventh generation from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord has come with ①many thousands of His holy ones, ▷ ①Lit His holy ten thousands

column.name: text
column.value: to execute judgment upon all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their ungodly deeds which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the harsh things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.”

column.name: text
column.value: These are grumblers, finding fault, following after their own lusts; ①they speak arrogantly, flattering people for the sake of gaining an advantage. ▷ ①Lit their mouth speaks

column.name: text
column.value: But you, beloved, ought to remember the words that were spoken beforehand by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ,

column.name: text
column.value: that they were saying to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, following after their own ungodly lusts.”

column.name: text
column.value: These are the ones who cause divisions, ①worldly-minded, ②devoid of the Spirit. ▷ ①Or merely natural ②Lit not having

column.name: text
column.value: But you, beloved, building yourselves up on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit,

column.name: text
column.value: keep yourselves in the love of God, looking forward to the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: And have mercy on some, who are doubting;

column.name: text
column.value: save others, snatching them out of the fire; and on some have mercy with fear, hating even the garment polluted by the flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: Now to Him who is able to protect you from stumbling, and to make you stand in the presence of His glory, blameless with great joy,

column.name: text
column.value: to the only God our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority before all time and now and ①forever. Amen. ▷ ①Lit to all the ages

column.name: text
column.value: “To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: The One who holds the seven stars in His right hand, the One who walks ①among the seven golden lampstands, says this: ▷ ①Lit in the middle of

column.name: text
column.value: ‘I know your deeds and your labor and ①perseverance, and that you cannot tolerate evil people, and you have put those who call themselves apostles to the test, and they are not, and you found them to be false; ▷ ①Or steadfastness

column.name: text
column.value: and you have ①perseverance and have endured on account of My name, and have not become weary. ▷ ①Or steadfastness

column.name: text
column.value: But I have this against you, that you have left your first love.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, remember from where you have fallen, and repent, and do the ①deeds you did at first; or else I am coming to you and I will remove your lampstand from its place—unless you repent. ▷ ①Lit first deeds

column.name: text
column.value: But you have this, that you hate the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will grant to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of God.’

column.name: text
column.value: “And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write: The first and the last, who ①was dead, and has come to life, says this: ▷ ①Lit became

column.name: text
column.value: ‘I know your tribulation and your poverty (but you are rich), and the ①slander by those who say they are Jews, and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan. ▷ ①Or blasphemy

column.name: text
column.value: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, so that you will be tested, and you will have tribulation for ten days. ①Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life. ▷ ①Or Prove yourself faithful

column.name: text
column.value: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who overcomes will not be hurt by the second death.’

column.name: text
column.value: “And to the angel of the church in Pergamum write: The One who has the sharp two-edged sword says this:

column.name: text
column.value: ‘I know where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is; and you hold firmly to My name, and did not deny My faith even in the days of Antipas, My witness, My faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

column.name: text
column.value: But I have a few things against you, because you have some there who hold the teaching of Balaam, who kept teaching Balak to put a ①stumbling block before the sons of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols and to commit sexual immorality. ▷ ①I.e., a temptation to sin

column.name: text
column.value: So you too, have some who in the same way hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore repent; or else I am coming to you quickly, and I will wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will give some of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and a new name written on the stone which no one knows except the one who receives it.’

column.name: text
column.value: “And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write: The Son of God, who has ①eyes like a flame of fire, and ②feet like burnished bronze, says this: ▷ ①Lit His eyes ②Lit His feet

column.name: text
column.value: ‘I know your deeds, and your love and faith, and service and ①perseverance, and that your ②deeds of late are greater than ③at first. ▷ ①Or steadfastness ②Lit last deeds ③Lit the first

column.name: text
column.value: But I have this against you, that you tolerate the woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess, and she teaches and leads My bond-servants astray so that they commit sexual immorality and eat things sacrificed to idols.

column.name: text
column.value: I gave her time to repent, and she does not want to repent of her sexual immorality.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will throw her on a bed of sickness, and those who commit adultery with her into great tribulation, unless they repent of ①her deeds. ▷ ①One early ms their

column.name: text
column.value: And I will kill her children with ①plague, and all the churches will know that I am He who searches the ②minds and hearts; and I will give to each one of you according to your deeds. ▷ ①Lit death; i.e., a particular kind of death ②Lit kidneys; i.e., inner man

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you, the rest who are in Thyatira, who do not hold this teaching, who have not known the deep things of Satan, as they call them—I place no other burden on you.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless what you have, hold firmly until I come.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who overcomes, and the one who keeps My deeds until the end, I will give him authority over the ①nations; ▷ ①Or Gentiles

column.name: text
column.value: AND HE SHALL ①RULE THEM WITH A ROD OF IRON, AS THE VESSELS OF THE POTTER ARE SHATTERED, as I also have received authority from My Father; ▷ ①Lit shepherd

column.name: text
column.value: and I will give him the morning star.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.’

column.name: text
column.value: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show to His bond-servants, the things which must soon take place; and He sent and ①communicated it by His angel to His bond-servant John, ▷ ①Or signified

column.name: text
column.value: who testified to the word of God and to the testimony of Jesus Christ, everything that he saw.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed is the one who reads, and those who hear the words of the prophecy and ①keep the things which are written in it; for the time is near. ▷ ①Or follow

column.name: text
column.value: John to the seven churches that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from Him who is, and who was, and who ①is to come, and from the ②seven spirits who are before His throne, ▷ ①Or is coming ②Possibly a symbolic reference to the Holy Spirit in His fullness, or to seven key angels

column.name: text
column.value: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To Him who loves us and released us from our sins by His blood—

column.name: text
column.value: and He made us into a kingdom, priests to ①His God and Father—to Him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen. ▷ ①Or God and His Father

column.name: text
column.value: BEHOLD, HE IS COMING WITH THE CLOUDS, and every eye will see Him, even those who pierced Him; and all the tribes of the earth will mourn over Him. ①So it is to be. Amen. ▷ ①Or Yes. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who ①is to come, the Almighty.” ▷ ①Or is coming

column.name: text
column.value: I, John, your brother and fellow participant in the tribulation and kingdom and ①perseverance in Jesus, was on the island called Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus. ▷ ①Or steadfastness

column.name: text
column.value: I was in the ①Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice like the sound of a trumpet, ▷ ①Or spirit

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “Write ①on a scroll what you see, and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.” ▷ ①Or in a book

column.name: text
column.value: Then I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me. And after turning I saw seven golden lampstands;

column.name: text
column.value: and in the middle of the lampstands I saw one like ①a son of man, clothed in a robe reaching to the feet, and wrapped around the chest with a golden sash. ▷ ①Or the Son of Man

column.name: text
column.value: His head and His hair were white like white wool, like snow; and His eyes were like a flame of fire.

column.name: text
column.value: His feet were like ①burnished bronze when it has been heated to a glow in a furnace, and His voice was like the sound of many waters. ▷ ①Or fine brass

column.name: text
column.value: In His right hand He held seven stars, and out of His mouth came a sharp two-edged sword; and His face was like the sun ①shining in its strength. ▷ ①Lit shines

column.name: text
column.value: When I saw Him, I fell at His feet like a dead man. And He placed His right hand on me, saying, “Do not be afraid; I am the first and the last,

column.name: text
column.value: and the living One; and I ①was dead, and behold, I am alive forevermore, and I have the keys of death and of Hades. ▷ ①Lit became

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore write the things which you have seen, ①and the things which are, and the things which will take place after these things. ▷ ①Or both the things

column.name: text
column.value: As for the mystery of the seven stars which you saw in My right hand, and the seven golden lampstands: the seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.

column.name: text
column.value: After these things I looked, and behold, a door standing open in heaven, and the first voice which I had heard, like the sound of a trumpet speaking with me, said, “Come up here, and I will show you what must take place after these things.”

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately I was in the ①Spirit; and behold, a throne was standing in heaven, and someone was sitting on the throne. ▷ ①Or spirit

column.name: text
column.value: And He who was sitting was like a jasper stone and a sardius in appearance; and there was a ①rainbow around the throne, like an emerald in appearance. ▷ ①Or halo

column.name: text
column.value: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones; and upon the thrones I saw twenty-four elders sitting, clothed in white garments, and golden crowns on their heads.

column.name: text
column.value: Out from the throne *came flashes of lightning and sounds and peals of thunder. And there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are ①the seven spirits of God; ▷ ①Possibly a symbolic reference to the Holy Spirit in His fullness, or to seven key angels

column.name: text
column.value: and before the throne there was something like a sea of glass, like crystal; and in the ①center and around the throne, four living creatures full of eyes in front and behind. ▷ ①Lit middle of the throne and around

column.name: text
column.value: The first living creature was like a lion, the second creature like a calf, the third creature had a face like that of a man, and the fourth creature was like a flying eagle.

column.name: text
column.value: And the four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within; and day and night ①they do not cease to say, “HOLY, HOLY, HOLY is the LORD GOD, THE ALMIGHTY, who was and who is and who ②is to come.” ▷ ①Lit they have no rest, saying, ②Or is coming

column.name: text
column.value: And when the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to Him who sits on the throne, to Him who lives forever and ever,

column.name: text
column.value: the twenty-four elders will fall down before Him who sits on the throne, and they will worship Him who lives forever and ever, and will cast their crowns before the throne, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: “Worthy are You, our Lord and our God, to receive glory and honor and power; for You created all things, and because of Your will they ①existed, and were created.” ▷ ①Lit were

column.name: text
column.value: I saw ①in the right hand of Him who sat on the throne a ②scroll written inside and on the back, sealed up with seven seals. ▷ ①Lit upon ②Or book, and so throughout the ch

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and to break its seals?”

column.name: text
column.value: And no one in heaven or on the earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or to look into it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I began to weep greatly because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or to look into it.

column.name: text
column.value: And one of the elders *said to me, “Stop weeping; behold, the Lion that is from the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome so as to be able to open the scroll and its seven seals.”

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw ①between the throne (with the four living creatures) and the elders a Lamb standing, as if slaughtered, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are ②the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth. ▷ ①Lit in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders ②Possibly a symbolic reference to the Holy Spirit in His fullness, or to seven key angels

column.name: text
column.value: And He came and took the scroll out of the right hand of Him who sat on the throne.

column.name: text
column.value: When He had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one holding a harp and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the ①saints. ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: And they *sang a new song, saying, “Worthy are You to take the scroll and to break its seals; for You were slaughtered, and You purchased people for God with Your blood from every tribe, language, people, and nation.

column.name: text
column.value: You have made them into a kingdom and priests to our God, and they will reign upon the earth.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then I looked, and I heard the voices of many angels around the throne and the living creatures and the elders; and the number of them was ①myriads of myriads, and thousands of thousands, ▷ ①Gr for 10,000s of 10,000s

column.name: text
column.value: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb that was slaughtered to receive power, wealth, wisdom, might, honor, glory, and blessing.”

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard every created thing which is in heaven, or on the earth, or under the earth, or on the sea, and all the things in them, saying, “To Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion forever and ever.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the four living creatures were saying, “Amen.” And the elders fell down and worshiped.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I saw when the Lamb broke one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying as with a voice of thunder, “Come ①!” ▷ ①One early ms and see

column.name: text
column.value: I looked, and behold, a white horse, and the one who sat on it had a bow; and a crown was given to him, and he went out conquering and to conquer.

column.name: text
column.value: When He broke the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come ①!” ▷ ①One early ms and see

column.name: text
column.value: And another, a red horse, went out; and to him who sat on it, it was granted to take peace from the earth, and that people would kill one another; and a large sword was given to him.

column.name: text
column.value: When He broke the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come ①!” I looked, and behold, a black horse, and the one who sat on it had a pair of scales in his hand. ▷ ①One early ms and see

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard something like a voice in the center of the four living creatures saying, “A ①quart of wheat for a ②denarius, and three ③quarts of barley for a ④denarius; and do not damage the oil and the wine.” ▷ ①Gr choenix; i.e., a dry measure almost equal to a qt. ②The denarius was a day’s wages for a laborer ③Gr choenix; i.e., a dry measure almost equal to a qt. ④The denarius was a day’s wages for a laborer

column.name: text
column.value: When the Lamb broke the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying, “Come ①!” ▷ ①One early ms and see

column.name: text
column.value: I looked, and behold, ①an ashen horse; and the one who sat on it had the name Death, and Hades was following with him. Authority was given to them over a fourth of the earth, to kill with sword, and famine, and ②plague, and by the wild animals of the earth. ▷ ①Or a sickly pale green ②Lit death; i.e., a particular kind of death

column.name: text
column.value: When the Lamb broke the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed because of the word of God, and because of the testimony which they had maintained;

column.name: text
column.value: and they cried out with a loud voice, saying, “How long, O ①Lord, holy and true, ②will You refrain from judging and avenging our blood on those who live on the earth?” ▷ ①Or Master ②Lit do You not judge and avenge

column.name: text
column.value: And a white robe was given to each of them; and they were told that they were to rest for a little while longer, until the number of their fellow servants and their brothers and sisters who were to be killed even as they had been, was completed also.

column.name: text
column.value: And I looked when He broke the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake; and the sun became as black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became like blood;

column.name: text
column.value: and the stars of the sky fell to the earth, as a fig tree drops its unripe figs when shaken by a great wind.

column.name: text
column.value: The sky was split apart like a scroll when it is rolled up, and every mountain and island was removed from its place.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the kings of the earth and the eminent people, and the commanders and the wealthy and the strong, and every slave and free person hid themselves in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains;

column.name: text
column.value: and they *said to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us and hide us from the ①sight of Him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb; ▷ ①Lit face

column.name: text
column.value: for the great day of Their wrath has come, and who is able to stand?”

column.name: text
column.value: “To the angel of the church in Sardis write: He who has ①the seven spirits of God and the seven stars, says this: ‘I know your deeds, that you have a name that you are alive, and yet you are dead. ▷ ①Possibly a symbolic reference to the Holy Spirit in His fullness, or to seven key angels

column.name: text
column.value: Be constantly alert, and strengthen the things that remain, which were about to die; for I have not found your deeds completed in the sight of My God.

column.name: text
column.value: So remember ①what you have received and heard; and ②keep it, and repent. Then if you are not alert, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what hour I will come to you. ▷ ①Lit how ②Or follow

column.name: text
column.value: But you have a few ①people in Sardis who have not soiled their garments; and they will walk with Me in white, for they are worthy. ▷ ①Lit names

column.name: text
column.value: The one who overcomes will be clothed the same way, in white garments; and I will not erase his name from the book of life, and I will confess his name before My Father and before His angels.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.’

column.name: text
column.value: “And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: He who is holy, who is true, who has the key of David, who opens and no one will shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says this:

column.name: text
column.value: ‘I know your ①deeds. Behold, I have put before you an open door which no one can shut, because you have a little power, and have followed My word, and have not denied My name. ▷ ①Or deeds (behold...shut), that you have

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I ①will make those of the synagogue of Satan, who say that they are Jews and are not, but lie—I will make them come and bow down before your feet, and make them know that I have loved you. ▷ ①Lit give

column.name: text
column.value: Because you have kept My ①word of perseverance, I also will keep you from the hour of the ②testing, that hour which is about to come upon the whole ③world, to ④test those who live on the earth. ▷ ①Or instruction ②Or temptation ③Lit inhabited earth ④Or tempt

column.name: text
column.value: I am coming quickly; hold firmly to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of My God, and he will not go out from it anymore; and I will write on him the name of My God, and the name of the city of My God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from My God, and My new name.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.’

column.name: text
column.value: “To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: The Amen, the faithful and true Witness, the ①Origin of the creation of God, says this: ▷ ①Or Beginning; i.e., Originator

column.name: text
column.value: ‘I know your deeds, that you are neither cold nor hot; I wish that you were cold or hot.

column.name: text
column.value: So because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of My mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Because you say, “I am rich, and have become wealthy, and have no need of anything,” and you do not know that you are wretched, miserable, poor, blind, and naked,

column.name: text
column.value: I advise you to buy from Me gold refined by fire so that you may become rich, and white garments so that you may clothe yourself and the shame of your nakedness will not be revealed; and eye salve to apply to your eyes so that you may see.

column.name: text
column.value: Those whom I love, I rebuke and discipline; therefore be zealous and repent.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I stand at the door and knock; if anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with Me.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who overcomes, I will grant to him to sit with Me on My throne, as I also overcame and sat with My Father on His throne.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.’ ”

column.name: text
column.value: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw another angel ascending from the rising of the sun, holding the seal of the living God; and he called out with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was granted to harm the earth and the sea,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “Do not harm the earth, or the sea, or the trees until we have sealed the bond-servants of our God on their foreheads.”

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard the number of those who were sealed: 144,000, sealed from every tribe of the sons of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Judah, twelve thousand were sealed, from the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, from the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, from the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, from the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, from the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, from the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,

column.name: text
column.value: from the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, from the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, and from the tribe of Benjamin, twelve thousand were sealed.

column.name: text
column.value: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no one could count, from every nation and all the tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed in white robes, and palm branches were in their hands;

column.name: text
column.value: and they *cried out with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation belongs to our God who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb.”

column.name: text
column.value: And all the angels were standing around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “Amen, blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might belong to our God forever and ever. Amen.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then one of the elders responded, saying to me, “These who are clothed in the white robes, who are they, and where have they come from?”

column.name: text
column.value: I ①said to him, “My lord, you know.” And he said to me, “These are the ones who come out of the great tribulation, and they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb. ▷ ①Lit have said

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason they are before the throne of God, and they serve Him day and night in His ①temple; and He who sits on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them. ▷ ①Or sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: They will no longer hunger nor thirst, nor will the sun ①beat down on them, nor any scorching heat; ▷ ①Lit fall

column.name: text
column.value: for the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd, and will guide them to springs of the ①water of life; and God will wipe every tear from their eyes.” ▷ ①Lit waters

column.name: text
column.value: When the Lamb broke the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Another angel came and stood at the altar, holding a golden censer; and much incense was given to him, so that he might ①add it to the prayers of all the ②saints on the golden altar which was before the throne. ▷ ①Lit give ②Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: And the smoke of the incense ascended from the angel’s hand with the prayers of the ①saints before God. ▷ ①See note 2 v 3

column.name: text
column.value: Then the angel ①took the ②censer and filled it with the fire of the altar, and hurled it to the earth; and there were peals of thunder and sounds, and flashes of lightning and an earthquake. ▷ ①Lit has taken ②I.e., container to burn incense

column.name: text
column.value: And the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound them.

column.name: text
column.value: The first sounded, and there was hail and fire mixed with blood, and it was hurled to the earth; and a third of the earth was burned up, and a third of the trees were burned up, and all the green grass was burned up.

column.name: text
column.value: The second angel sounded, and something like a great mountain burning with fire was hurled into the sea; and a third of the sea became blood,

column.name: text
column.value: and a third of the creatures which were in the sea ①and had life, died; and a third of the ships were destroyed. ▷ ①Lit the ones having

column.name: text
column.value: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from heaven, burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of waters.

column.name: text
column.value: The star is named Wormwood; and a third of the waters became wormwood, and many people died from the waters because they were made bitter.

column.name: text
column.value: The fourth angel sounded, and a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck, so that a third of them would be darkened and the day would not shine for a third of it, and the night in the same way.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I looked, and I heard ①an eagle flying in midheaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe, woe, woe to those who live on the earth, because of the remaining blasts of the trumpet of the three angels who are about to sound!” ▷ ①Lit one eagle

column.name: text
column.value: I saw another strong angel coming down from heaven, clothed with a cloud; and the rainbow was on his head, and his face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire;

column.name: text
column.value: and he had in his hand a little scroll, which was open. He placed his right foot on the sea and his left on the land;

column.name: text
column.value: and he cried out with a loud voice, as when a lion roars; and when he had cried out, the seven peals of thunder ①uttered their voices. ▷ ①Or spoke

column.name: text
column.value: When the seven peals of thunder had spoken, I was about to write; and I heard a voice from heaven, saying, “Seal up the things which the seven peals of thunder have spoken, and do not write them.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand to heaven,

column.name: text
column.value: and swore by Him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things in it, and the earth and the things in it, and the sea and the things in it, that there will no longer be a delay,

column.name: text
column.value: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as He announced to His servants the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the voice which I heard from heaven, I heard again speaking with me, and saying, “Go, take the scroll which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”

column.name: text
column.value: And I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little scroll. And he *said to me, “Take it and eat it; it will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be sweet as honey.”

column.name: text
column.value: I took the little scroll from the angel’s hand and ate it, and in my mouth it was sweet as honey; and when I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.

column.name: text
column.value: And they *said to me, “You must prophesy again concerning many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from heaven which had fallen to the earth; and the key to the shaft of the abyss was given to him.

column.name: text
column.value: He opened the shaft of the abyss, and smoke ascended out of the shaft like the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened from the smoke of the shaft.

column.name: text
column.value: Then out of the smoke came locusts ①upon the earth, and power was given them, as the scorpions of the earth have power. ▷ ①Lit into

column.name: text
column.value: They were told not to hurt the grass of the earth, nor any green thing, nor any tree, but only the people who do not have the seal of God on their foreheads.

column.name: text
column.value: And ①they were not permitted to kill ②anyone, but to torment for five months; and their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it ③stings a person. ▷ ①Lit it was given to them ②Lit them ③Lit strikes

column.name: text
column.value: And in those days people will seek death and will not find it; they will long to die, and death ①will flee from them! ▷ ①Lit flees (intensive expression)

column.name: text
column.value: The ①appearance of the locusts was like horses prepared for battle; and on their heads appeared to be crowns like gold, and their faces were like human faces. ▷ ①Lit likenesses

column.name: text
column.value: They had hair like the hair of women, and their teeth were like the teeth of lions.

column.name: text
column.value: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was like the sound of chariots, of many horses rushing to battle.

column.name: text
column.value: They have tails like scorpions, and stings; and in their tails is their power to hurt people for five months.

column.name: text
column.value: They have as king over them, the angel of the abyss; his name in Hebrew is ①Abaddon, and in the Greek he has the name ②Apollyon. ▷ ①I.e., destruction ②I.e., destroyer

column.name: text
column.value: The first woe has passed; behold, two woes are still coming after these things.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the sixth angel sounded, and I heard ①a voice from the ②four horns of the golden altar which is before God, ▷ ①Lit one voice ②Two early mss do not contain four

column.name: text
column.value: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the four angels, who had been prepared for the hour and day and month and year, were released, so that they would kill a third of mankind.

column.name: text
column.value: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million; I heard the number of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is how I saw in my vision the horses and those who sat on them: the riders had breastplates the color of fire, of hyacinth, and of ①brimstone; and the heads of the horses are like the heads of lions; and out of their mouths *came fire and smoke and ②brimstone. ▷ ①I.e., burning sulfur ②I.e., burning sulfur

column.name: text
column.value: A third of mankind was killed by these three plagues, by the fire, the smoke, and the ①brimstone which came out of their mouths. ▷ ①I.e., burning sulfur

column.name: text
column.value: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails; for their tails are like serpents and have heads, and with them they do harm.

column.name: text
column.value: The rest of mankind, who were not killed by these plagues, did not repent of the works of their hands so as not to worship demons and the idols of gold, silver, brass, stone, and wood, which can neither see nor hear nor walk;

column.name: text
column.value: and they did not repent of their murders, nor of their witchcraft, nor of their sexual immorality, nor of their thefts.

column.name: text
column.value: Then there was given to me a ①measuring rod like a staff; ②and someone said, “Get up and measure the ③temple of God and the altar, and those who worship in it. ▷ ①Lit reed ②Lit saying ③Or sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: ①Leave out the courtyard which is outside the ②temple and do not measure it, because it has been given to the nations; and they will trample the holy city for forty-two months. ▷ ①Or sanctuary ②Lit Throw out

column.name: text
column.value: And I will grant authority to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth.”

column.name: text
column.value: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And if anyone wants to harm them, fire flows out of their mouth and devours their enemies; and so if anyone wants to harm them, he must be killed in this way.

column.name: text
column.value: These have the power to shut up the sky, so that rain will not fall during the days of their prophesying; and they have power over the waters to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.

column.name: text
column.value: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them and kill them.

column.name: text
column.value: And their dead bodies will lie on the street of the great city which ①spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified. ▷ ①I.e., from the viewpoint of the Holy Spirit

column.name: text
column.value: Those from the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations will look at their dead ①bodies for three and a half days, and ②will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb. ▷ ①Lit body ②Lit do not permit

column.name: text
column.value: And those who live on the earth will rejoice over them and celebrate; and they will send gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who live on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And after the three and a half days, the breath of life from God came into them, and they stood on their feet; and great fear fell upon those who were watching them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here.” And they went up into heaven in the cloud, and their enemies watched them.

column.name: text
column.value: And ①at that time there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell; ②seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven. ▷ ①Or in that hour ②Lit names of people, seven thousand

column.name: text
column.value: The second woe has passed; behold, the third woe is coming quickly.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the seventh angel sounded; and there were loud voices in heaven, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His ①Christ; and He will reign forever and ever.” ▷ ①I.e., Messiah

column.name: text
column.value: And the twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, “We give You thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the One who is and who was, because You have taken Your great power and have begun to reign.

column.name: text
column.value: And the nations were enraged, and Your wrath came, and the time came for the dead to be judged, and the time to ①reward Your bond-servants the prophets and the ②saints and those who fear Your name, the small and the great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.” ▷ ①Lit give the reward to ②Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: And the ①temple of God which is in heaven was opened; and the ark of His covenant appeared in His ②temple, and there were flashes of lightning and sounds and peals of thunder, and an earthquake, and a great ③hailstorm. ▷ ①Or sanctuary ②Or sanctuary ③Lit hail

column.name: text
column.value: A great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars;

column.name: text
column.value: and she was pregnant and she *cried out, being in labor and in pain to give birth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then another sign appeared in heaven: and behold, a great red dragon having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads were seven crowns.

column.name: text
column.value: And his tail *swept away a third of the stars of heaven and hurled them to the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her Child.

column.name: text
column.value: And she gave birth to a Son, a male, who is going to ①rule all the ②nations with a rod of iron; and her Child was caught up to God and to His throne. ▷ ①Or shepherd ②Or Gentiles

column.name: text
column.value: Then the woman fled into the wilderness where she *had a place prepared by God, so that there ①she would be nourished for 1,260 days. ▷ ①Lit they would nourish her for

column.name: text
column.value: And there was war in heaven, Michael and his angels waging war with the dragon. The dragon and his angels waged war,

column.name: text
column.value: and they did not prevail, and there was no longer a place found for them in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And the great dragon was thrown down, the serpent of old who is called the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole ①world; he was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him. ▷ ①Lit inhabited earth

column.name: text
column.value: Then I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, and the power, and the kingdom of our God and the authority of His Christ have come, for the accuser of our brothers and sisters has been thrown down, the one who accuses them before our God day and night.

column.name: text
column.value: And they overcame him because of the blood of the Lamb and because of the word of their testimony, and they did not love their life even ①when faced with death. ▷ ①Lit to the point of death

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason, rejoice, you heavens and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and the sea, because the devil has come down to you with great wrath, knowing that he has only a short time.”

column.name: text
column.value: And when the dragon saw that he was thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male Child.

column.name: text
column.value: But the two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, so that she could fly into the wilderness to her place, where she *was nourished for a time, times, and half a time, away from the presence of the serpent.

column.name: text
column.value: And the serpent hurled water like a river out of his mouth after the woman, so that he might cause her to be swept away with the flood.

column.name: text
column.value: ①But the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and drank up the river which the dragon had hurled out of his mouth. ▷ ①Lit And

column.name: text
column.value: So the dragon was enraged with the woman, and went off to make war with the rest of her ①children, who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus. ▷ ①Lit seed

column.name: text
column.value: 없음.

column.name: text
column.value: And the dragon stood on the sand of the ①seashore. Then I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads, and on his horns were ten crowns, and on his heads were blasphemous names. ▷ ①Lit sea

column.name: text
column.value: And the beast that I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. And the dragon gave him his power and his throne, and great authority.

column.name: text
column.value: I saw one of his heads as if it had been ①fatally wounded, and his fatal wound was healed. And the whole earth was amazed and followed after the beast; ▷ ①Lit slaughtered to death

column.name: text
column.value: they worshiped the dragon because he gave his authority to the beast; and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast, and who is able to wage war with him?”

column.name: text
column.value: A mouth was given to him speaking ①arrogant words and blasphemies, and authority to act for forty-two months was given to him. ▷ ①Lit great things

column.name: text
column.value: And he opened his mouth in blasphemies against God, to blaspheme His name and His tabernacle, that is, those who dwell in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: It was also given to him to make war with the ①saints and to overcome them, and authority was given to him over every tribe, people, language, and nation. ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: All who live on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been ①written since the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who has been slaughtered. ▷ ①Or written in the book...slain from the foundation of the world

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.

column.name: text
column.value: If anyone ①is destined for captivity, to captivity he goes; if anyone kills with the sword, with the sword he must be killed. Here is the ②perseverance and the faith of the ③saints. ▷ ①Or leads into captivity ②Or steadfastness ③See note v 7

column.name: text
column.value: Then I saw another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spoke as a dragon.

column.name: text
column.value: He exercises all the authority of the first beast ①in his presence. And he makes the earth and those who live on it worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed. ▷ ①Or by his authority

column.name: text
column.value: He performs great signs, so that he even makes fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the presence of people.

column.name: text
column.value: And he deceives those who live on the earth because of the signs which it was given him to perform ①in the presence of the beast, telling those who live on the earth to make an image to the beast who *had the wound of the sword and has come to life. ▷ ①Or by the authority of

column.name: text
column.value: And it was given to him to give breath to the image of the beast, so that the image of the beast would even ①speak and cause all who do not worship the image of the beast to be killed. ▷ ①One early ms speak, and he will cause

column.name: text
column.value: And he causes all, the small and the great, the rich and the poor, and the free and the slaves, ①to be given a mark on their right hands or on their foreheads, ▷ ①Lit so that they give them a mark

column.name: text
column.value: and he decrees that no one will be able to buy or to sell, except the one who has the mark, either the name of the beast or the number of his name.

column.name: text
column.value: Here is wisdom. Let him who has understanding calculate the number of the beast, for the number is that of a ①man; and his number is ②six hundred and sixty-six. ▷ ①Or human ②I.e., spelled out in Gr as 600 + 60 + 6; one early ms has the letters for 616

column.name: text
column.value: Then I looked, and behold, the Lamb was standing on Mount Zion, and with Him 144,000 who had His name and the name of His Father written on their foreheads.

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard a voice from heaven, like the sound of many waters and like the sound of loud thunder, and the voice which I heard was like the sound of harpists playing on their harps.

column.name: text
column.value: And they *sang ①a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders; and no one was able to learn the song except the 144,000 who had been purchased from the earth. ▷ ①One early ms something like a new song

column.name: text
column.value: These are the ones who have not defiled themselves with women, for they are celibate. These are the ones who follow the Lamb wherever He goes. These have been purchased from mankind as first fruits to God and to the Lamb.

column.name: text
column.value: And no lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw another angel flying in midheaven with an eternal gospel to preach to those who ①live on the earth, and to every nation, tribe, language, and people; ▷ ①Lit sit

column.name: text
column.value: and he said with a loud voice, “Fear God and give Him glory, because the hour of His judgment has come; worship Him who made the heaven and the earth, and sea and springs of waters.”

column.name: text
column.value: And another angel, a second one, followed, saying, “ ①Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, she who has made all the nations drink of the wine of the ②passion of her sexual immorality.” ▷ ①Lit Babylon...fell, fell, she who ②Or wrath (incurred from God)

column.name: text
column.value: Then another angel, a third one, followed them, saying with a loud voice, “If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,

column.name: text
column.value: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is mixed ①in full strength in the cup of His anger; and he will be tormented with fire and ②brimstone in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb. ▷ ①Lit unmixed; in ancient times wine was usually diluted with water ②I.e., burning sulfur

column.name: text
column.value: And the smoke of their torment ascends forever and ever; they have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and his image, and ①whoever receives the mark of his name.” ▷ ①Lit if anyone

column.name: text
column.value: Here is the ①perseverance of the ②saints who keep the commandments of God and ③their faith in Jesus. ▷ ①Or steadfastness ②Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people ③Lit the faith of

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard a voice from heaven, saying, “Write: ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on!’ ” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “so that they may rest from their labors, for their deeds follow with them.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then I looked, and behold, a white cloud, and sitting on the cloud was one like ①a son of man, with a golden crown on His head and a sharp sickle in His hand. ▷ ①Or the Son of Man

column.name: text
column.value: And another angel came out of the ①temple, calling out with a loud voice to Him who sat on the cloud, “ ②Put in your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come, because the harvest of the earth ③is ripe.” ▷ ①Or sanctuary ②Lit Send forth ③Lit has become dry

column.name: text
column.value: Then He who sat on the cloud ①swung His sickle over the earth, and the earth was reaped. ▷ ①Lit cast

column.name: text
column.value: And another angel came out of the ①temple which is in heaven, and he also had a sharp sickle. ▷ ①Or sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: Then another angel, the one who has power over fire, came out from the altar; and he called with a loud voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, “ ①Put in your sharp sickle and gather the clusters ②from the vine of the earth, because her grapes are ripe.” ▷ ①Lit Send forth ②Lit of

column.name: text
column.value: So the angel ①swung his sickle to the earth and gathered the clusters from the vine of the earth, and threw them into the great wine press of the wrath of God. ▷ ①Lit cast

column.name: text
column.value: And the wine press was trampled outside the city, and blood came out from the wine press, up to the horses’ bridles, ①for a distance of ②1,600 stadia. ▷ ①Lit from ②Possibly about 184 miles or 296 km; a Roman stadion perhaps averaged 607 ft. or 185 m

column.name: text
