column.value: Then I heard a loud voice from the ①temple, saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out on the earth the seven bowls of the wrath of God.” ▷ ①Or sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: So the first angel went and poured out his bowl on the earth; and a harmful and painful sore ①afflicted the people who had the mark of the beast and who worshiped his image. ▷ ①Lit came upon

column.name: text
column.value: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood like that of a dead man; and every living ①thing in the sea died. ▷ ①Lit soul

column.name: text
column.value: Then the third angel poured out his bowl into the rivers and the springs of waters; and they became blood.

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard the angel of the waters saying, “Righteous are You, the One who is and who was, O Holy One, because You judged these things;

column.name: text
column.value: for they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and You have given them blood to drink. They ①deserve it.” ▷ ①Lit are worthy

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are Your judgments.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the fourth angel poured out his bowl upon the sun, and it was given power to scorch people with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people were scorched with ①fierce heat; and they blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues, and they did not repent so as to give Him glory. ▷ ①Lit great

column.name: text
column.value: And the fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom became darkened; and they gnawed their tongues because of pain,

column.name: text
column.value: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pain and their sores; and they did not repent of their deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates; and its water was dried up, so that the way would be prepared for the kings from the ①east. ▷ ①Lit rising of the sun

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits like frogs;

column.name: text
column.value: for they are spirits of demons, performing signs, which go out to the kings of the entire ①world, to gather them together for the war of the great day of God, the Almighty. ▷ ①Lit inhabited earth

column.name: text
column.value: (“Behold, I am coming like a thief. Blessed is the one who stays awake and keeps his clothes, so that he will not walk about naked and people will not see his shame.”)

column.name: text
column.value: And they gathered them together to the place which in Hebrew is called Har-Magedon.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the seventh angel poured out his bowl upon the air, and a loud voice came out of the ①temple from the throne, saying, “It is done.” ▷ ①Or sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: And there were flashes of lightning and sounds and peals of thunder; and there was a great earthquake, such as there had not been since mankind came to be upon the earth, so great an earthquake was it, and so mighty.

column.name: text
column.value: The great city ①was split into three parts, and the cities of the ②nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give her the cup of the wine of ③His fierce wrath. ▷ ①Lit became three ②Or Gentiles ③Lit wrath of His anger

column.name: text
column.value: And every island fled, and no mountains were found.

column.name: text
column.value: And huge ①hailstones, weighing about ②a talent each, *came down from heaven upon people; and people blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, because ③the hailstone plague *was extremely ④severe. ▷ ①Lit hail ②I.e., as a measure of weight about 100 lb. or 45 kg ③Lit its plague ④Lit great

column.name: text
column.value: Then I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvelous, seven angels who had seven plagues, which are the last, because in them the wrath of God is finished.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who were victorious ①over the beast and his image and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, holding harps of God. ▷ ①Lit from

column.name: text
column.value: And they *sang the song of Moses, the bond-servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are Your works, Lord God, the Almighty; Righteous and true are Your ways, King of the ①nations! ▷ ①Two early mss ages

column.name: text
column.value: Who will not fear You, Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy; For ALL THE NATIONS WILL COME AND WORSHIP BEFORE YOU, For Your ①righteous acts have been revealed.” ▷ ①Or judgments

column.name: text
column.value: After these things I looked, and the ①temple of the tabernacle of testimony in heaven was opened, ▷ ①Or sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: and the seven angels who had the seven plagues came out of the ①temple, clothed in ②linen, clean and bright, and their chests wrapped with golden sashes. ▷ ①Or sanctuary ②One early ms stone

column.name: text
column.value: And one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And the ①temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power; and no one was able to enter the ②temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were finished. ▷ ①Or sanctuary ②Or sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, “Come here, I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,

column.name: text
column.value: with whom the kings of the earth committed acts of sexual immorality, and those who live on the earth became drunk with the wine of her sexual immorality.”

column.name: text
column.value: And he carried me away ①in the Spirit into a wilderness; and I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns. ▷ ①Or in spirit

column.name: text
column.value: The woman was clothed in purple and scarlet, and ①adorned with gold, precious ②stones, and pearls, holding in her hand a gold cup full of abominations and of the unclean things of her sexual immorality, ▷ ①Lit gilded ②Lit stone

column.name: text
column.value: and on her forehead a name was written, ①a mystery: “BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.” ▷ ①Or “MYSTERY...”

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw the woman drunk with the blood of the ①saints, and with the blood of the witnesses of Jesus. When I saw her, I wondered ②greatly. ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people ②Lit with great wonder

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel said to me, “Why ①do you wonder? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns. ▷ ①Lit have you wondered

column.name: text
column.value: “The beast that you saw was, and is not, and is about to come up out of the abyss and ①go to destruction. And those who live on the earth, whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, will wonder when they see the beast, that he was, and is not, and will ②come. ▷ ①One early ms is going ②Lit be present

column.name: text
column.value: Here is the mind which has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains upon which the woman sits,

column.name: text
column.value: and they are seven kings; five have fallen, one is, the other has not yet come; and when he comes, he must remain a little while.

column.name: text
column.value: The beast which was, and is not, is himself also an eighth and is one of the seven, and he goes to destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: The ten horns which you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but they receive authority as kings with the beast for one hour.

column.name: text
column.value: These have one ①purpose, and they give their power and authority to the beast. ▷ ①Or mind

column.name: text
column.value: These will wage war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them because He is Lord of lords and King of kings; and those who are with Him are the called and chosen and faithful.”

column.name: text
column.value: And he *said to me, “The waters which you saw where the prostitute sits are peoples and multitudes, and nations and languages.

column.name: text
column.value: And the ten horns which you saw, and the beast, these will hate the prostitute and will make her desolate and naked, and will eat her flesh and will burn her up with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: For God has put it in their hearts to execute His ①purpose ②by having a common purpose, and by giving their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God will be fulfilled. ▷ ①Or mind ②Lit even to do one mind and to give

column.name: text
column.value: The woman whom you saw is the great city, which ①reigns over the kings of the earth.” ▷ ①Lit has a kingdom

column.name: text
column.value: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation, glory, and power belong to our God,

column.name: text
column.value: BECAUSE HIS JUDGMENTS ARE TRUE AND RIGHTEOUS; for He has judged the great prostitute who was corrupting the earth with her sexual immorality, and HE HAS AVENGED THE BLOOD OF HIS BOND-SERVANTS ①ON HER.” ▷ ①Lit from her hand

column.name: text
column.value: And a second time they said, “Hallelujah! HER SMOKE RISES FOREVER AND EVER.”

column.name: text
column.value: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, “Amen. Hallelujah!”

column.name: text
column.value: And a voice came from the throne, saying, “Give praise to our God, all you His bond-servants, you who fear Him, the small and the great.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then I heard something like the voice of a great multitude and like the sound of many waters, and like the sound of mighty peals of thunder, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns.

column.name: text
column.value: Let’s rejoice and be glad and give the glory to Him, because the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His ①bride has prepared herself.” ▷ ①Lit wife

column.name: text
column.value: It was given to her to clothe herself in fine linen, bright and clean; for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the ①saints. ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: Then he *said to me, “Write: ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb.’ ” And he *said to me, “These are the true words of God.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then I fell at his feet to worship him. But he *said to me, “ ①Do not do that; I am a fellow servant of yours and your brothers and sisters who hold the testimony of Jesus; worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.” ▷ ①Lit See that you do not

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and He who sat on it is called Faithful and True, and in righteousness He judges and wages war.

column.name: text
column.value: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on His head are many crowns; and He has a name written on Him which no one knows except Himself.

column.name: text
column.value: He is clothed with a robe dipped in blood, and His name is called The Word of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the armies which are in heaven, clothed in fine linen, white and clean, were following Him on white horses.

column.name: text
column.value: From His mouth comes a sharp sword, so that with it He may strike down the nations, and He will ①rule them with a rod of iron; and He treads the ②wine press of the fierce wrath of God, the Almighty. ▷ ①Or shepherd ②Lit wine press of the wine of the wrath of God’s anger

column.name: text
column.value: And on His robe and on His thigh He has a name written: “KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then I saw ①an angel standing in the sun, and he cried out with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in midheaven, “Come, assemble for the great feast of God, ▷ ①Lit one

column.name: text
column.value: so that you may eat the flesh of kings and the flesh of commanders, the flesh of mighty men, the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them, and the flesh of all people, both free and slaves, and small and great.”

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies, assembled to make war against Him who sat on the horse, and against His army.

column.name: text
column.value: And the beast was seized, and with him the false prophet who performed the signs ①in his presence, by which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image; these two were thrown alive into the lake of fire, which burns with ②brimstone. ▷ ①Or by his authority ②I.e., burning sulfur

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest were killed with the sword which came from the mouth of Him who sat on the horse, and all the birds were filled with their flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: After these things I saw another angel coming down from heaven, having great authority, and the earth was illuminated from his glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And he cried out with a mighty voice, saying, “ ①Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a dwelling place of demons and a ②prison of every unclean spirit, and a ③prison of every unclean and hateful bird. ▷ ①Lit Babylon...fell, fell ②Or haunt ③Or haunt

column.name: text
column.value: For all the nations have fallen because of the wine of the passion of her sexual immorality, and the kings of the earth have committed acts of sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth have become rich from the ①excessive wealth of her ②luxury.” ▷ ①Lit power ②Or sensuality

column.name: text
column.value: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, so that you will not participate in her sins and receive any of her plagues;

column.name: text
column.value: for her sins have ①piled up as high as heaven, and God has remembered her offenses. ▷ ①Lit joined together

column.name: text
column.value: Pay her back even as she has paid, and ①give back to her double according to her deeds; in the cup which she has mixed, mix twice as much for her. ▷ ①Lit double to her

column.name: text
column.value: To the extent that she glorified herself and lived luxuriously, to the same extent give her torment and mourning; for she says in her heart, ‘I sit as a queen and I am not a widow, and will never see mourning.’

column.name: text
column.value: For this reason in one day her plagues will come, ①plague and mourning and famine, and she will be burned up with fire; for the Lord God who judges her is strong. ▷ ①Lit death; i.e., a particular kind of death

column.name: text
column.value: “And the kings of the earth, who committed acts of sexual immorality and lived luxuriously with her, will weep and mourn over her when they see the smoke of her burning,

column.name: text
column.value: standing at a distance because of the fear of her torment, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For in one hour your judgment has come.’

column.name: text
column.value: “And the merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, because no one buys their cargo any more—

column.name: text
column.value: cargo of gold, silver, precious ①stones, and pearls; fine linen, purple, silk, and scarlet; every kind of citron wood, every article of ivory, and every article made from very valuable wood, ②bronze, iron, and marble; ▷ ①Lit stone ②Or brass

column.name: text
column.value: cinnamon, ①spice, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, and cargo of horses, carriages, ②slaves, and human lives. ▷ ①Gr amomon, an Indian spice plant ②Lit bodies

column.name: text
column.value: The fruit ①you long for has left you, and all things that were luxurious and splendid have passed away from you and people will no longer find them. ▷ ①Lit of your soul’s desire

column.name: text
column.value: The merchants of these things, who became rich from her, will stand at a distance because of the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning,

column.name: text
column.value: saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, she who was clothed in fine linen and purple and scarlet, and ①adorned with gold, precious ②stones, and pearls; ▷ ①Lit gilded ②Lit stone and pearl

column.name: text
column.value: for in one hour such great wealth has been laid waste!’ And every shipmaster and every ①passenger and sailor, and all who ②make their living by the sea, stood at a distance, ▷ ①Lit one who sails to a place ②Lit work the sea

column.name: text
column.value: and were crying out as they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What city is like the great city?’

column.name: text
column.value: And they threw dust on their heads and were crying out, weeping and mourning, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had ships at sea became rich from her prosperity, for in one hour she has been laid waste!’

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you ①saints and apostles and prophets, because God has ②pronounced judgment for you against her.” ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people ②Lit judged your judgment of her

column.name: text
column.value: Then ①a strong angel picked up a stone like a great millstone and threw it into the sea, saying, “So will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down with violence, and will never be found again. ▷ ①Lit one

column.name: text
column.value: And the sound of harpists, musicians, flute players, and trumpeters will never be heard in you again; and no craftsman of any craft will ever be found in you again; and the sound of a mill will never be heard in you again;

column.name: text
column.value: and the light of a lamp will never shine in you again; and the voice of the groom and bride will never be heard in you again; for your merchants were the powerful people of the earth, because all the nations were deceived by your witchcraft.

column.name: text
column.value: And in her was found the blood of prophets and of ①saints, and of all who have been slaughtered on the earth.” ▷ ①Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: And he showed me a river of the water of life, ①clear as crystal, coming from the throne of God and of ②the Lamb, ▷ ①Lit bright ②Or the Lamb. In the middle of its street, and on either side of the river, was

column.name: text
column.value: in the middle of its street. On either side of the river was the tree of life, bearing twelve ①kinds of fruit, yielding its fruit every month; and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations. ▷ ①Or crops of fruit

column.name: text
column.value: There will no longer be any curse; and the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and His bond-servants will serve Him;

column.name: text
column.value: they will see His face, and His name will be on their foreheads.

column.name: text
column.value: And there will no longer be any night; and they ①will not have need of the light of a lamp nor the light of the sun, because the Lord God will illuminate them; and they will reign forever and ever. ▷ ①Lit do not have

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, “These words are faithful and true”; and the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent His angel to show His bond-servants the things which must soon take place.

column.name: text
column.value: “And behold, I am coming quickly. Blessed is the one who ①keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.” ▷ ①Or follows

column.name: text
column.value: I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. And when I heard and saw them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who showed me these things.

column.name: text
column.value: And he *said to me, “ ①Do not do that; I am a fellow servant of yours and of your brothers the prophets, and of those who ②keep the words of this book. Worship God!” ▷ ①Lit See that you do not ②Or follows

column.name: text
column.value: And he *said to me, “Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is near.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the one who does wrong still do wrong, and the one who is filthy still be filthy; and let the one who is righteous still practice righteousness, and the one who is holy still keep himself holy.”

column.name: text
column.value: “Behold, I am coming quickly, and My reward is with Me, to reward each one as his work ①deserves. ▷ ①Lit is

column.name: text
column.value: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.”

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they will have the right to the tree of life, and may enter the city by the gates.

column.name: text
column.value: Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral persons, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices lying.

column.name: text
column.value: “I, Jesus, have sent My angel to testify to you of these things ①for the churches. I am the root and the descendant of David, the bright morning star.” ▷ ①Or concerning

column.name: text
column.value: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come.” And let the one who hears say, “Come.” And let the one who is thirsty come; let the one who desires, take the water of life without cost.

column.name: text
column.value: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues that are written in this book;

column.name: text
column.value: and if anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his part from the tree of life and ①from the holy city, which are written in this book. ▷ ①Lit out of

column.name: text
column.value: He who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming quickly.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with ①all. Amen. ▷ ①One early ms the saints

column.name: text
column.value: Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven, holding the key of the abyss and a great chain ①in his hand. ▷ ①Lit upon

column.name: text
column.value: And he took hold of the dragon, the serpent of old, who is the devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years;

column.name: text
column.value: and he threw him into the abyss and shut it and sealed it over him, so that he would not deceive the nations any longer, until the thousand years were completed; after these things he must be released for a short time.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded because of ①their testimony of Jesus and because of the word of God, and those who had not worshiped the beast or his image, and had not received the mark on their foreheads and on their hands; and they came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years. ▷ ①Lit the

column.name: text
column.value: The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were completed. This is the first resurrection.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed and holy is the one who has a part in the first resurrection; over these the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with Him for a thousand years.

column.name: text
column.value: When the thousand years are completed, Satan will be released from his prison,

column.name: text
column.value: and will come out to deceive the nations which are at the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together for the war; the number of them is like the sand of the ①seashore. ▷ ①Lit sea

column.name: text
column.value: And they came up on the ①broad plain of the earth and surrounded the camp of the ②saints and the beloved city, and fire came down from heaven and devoured them. ▷ ①Lit breadth of the earth ②Lit holy ones; i.e., God’s people

column.name: text
column.value: And the devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and ①brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are also; and they will be tormented day and night forever and ever. ▷ ①I.e., burning sulfur

column.name: text
column.value: Then I saw a great white throne and Him who sat upon it, from whose ①presence earth and heaven fled, and no place was found for them. ▷ ①Lit face

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and ①books were opened; and another ②book was opened, which is the book of life; and the dead were judged from the things which were written in the ③books, according to their deeds. ▷ ①Or scrolls ②Or scroll ③Or scrolls

column.name: text
column.value: And the sea gave up the dead who were in it, and Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them; and they were judged, each one of them according to their deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And if ①anyone’s name was not found written in the book of life, he was thrown into the lake of fire. ▷ ①Lit anyone was not

column.name: text
column.value: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth; for the first heaven and the first earth passed away, and there is no longer any sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard a loud voice from the throne, saying, “Behold, the tabernacle of God is among the people, and He will dwell among them, and they shall be His ①people, and God Himself will be among them ②, ▷ ①Lit peoples ②One early ms adds, as their God

column.name: text
column.value: and He will wipe away every tear from their eyes; and there will no longer be any death; there will no longer be any mourning, or crying, or pain; the first things have passed away.”

column.name: text
column.value: And He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” And He *said, “Write, for these words are faithful and true.”

column.name: text
column.value: Then He said to me, “ ①It is done. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give water to the one who thirsts from the spring of the water of life, without cost. ▷ ①Lit They are

column.name: text
column.value: The one who overcomes will inherit these things, and I will be his God and he will be My son.

column.name: text
column.value: But for the cowardly, and ①unbelieving, and abominable, and murderers, and sexually immoral persons, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, their part will be in the lake that burns with fire and ②brimstone, which is the second death.” ▷ ①Or untrustworthy ②I.e., burning sulfur

column.name: text
column.value: Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls, ①full of the seven last plagues, came and spoke with me, saying, “Come here, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.” ▷ ①Lit who were full; i.e., (previously) loaded with

column.name: text
column.value: And he carried me away ①in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, ▷ ①Or in spirit

column.name: text
column.value: having the glory of God. Her ①brilliance was like a very valuable stone, like a stone of crystal-clear jasper. ▷ ①Or radiance

column.name: text
column.value: ①It had a great and high wall, ②with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels; and names were written on the gates, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel. ▷ ①Lit having ②Lit having

column.name: text
column.value: There were three gates on the east, three gates on the north, three gates on the south, and three gates on the west.

column.name: text
column.value: And the wall of the city had twelve foundation stones, and on them were the twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

column.name: text
column.value: The one who spoke with me had a ①gold measuring rod to measure the city, its gates, and its wall. ▷ ①Lit measure, a gold reed

column.name: text
column.value: The city is laid out as a square, and its length is as great as the width; and he measured the city with the ①rod, ②twelve thousand stadia; its length, width, and height are equal. ▷ ①Lit reed ②Possibly about 1,380 miles or 2,220 km; a Roman stadion perhaps averaged 607 ft. or 185 m

column.name: text
column.value: And he measured its wall, ①144 cubits, by human ②measurements, which are also angelic measurements. ▷ ①Possibly about 216 ft. or 65 m; a cubit is about 18 in. or 45 cm ②Lit measure

column.name: text
column.value: The material of the wall was jasper; and the city was pure gold, like ①clear glass. ▷ ①Lit pure

column.name: text
column.value: The foundation stones of the city wall were decorated with every kind of precious stone. The first foundation stone was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, chalcedony; the fourth, emerald;

column.name: text
column.value: the fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, topaz; the tenth, chrysoprase; the eleventh, jacinth; the twelfth, amethyst.

column.name: text
column.value: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; each one of the gates was a single pearl. And the street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.

column.name: text
column.value: I saw no ①temple in it, for the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb are its ②temple. ▷ ①Or sanctuary ②Or sanctuary

column.name: text
column.value: And the city has no need of the sun or of the moon to shine on it, for the glory of God has illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.

column.name: text
column.value: The nations will walk by its light, and the kings of the earth ①will bring their glory into it. ▷ ①Lit bring

column.name: text
column.value: In the daytime (for there will be no night there) its gates will never be closed;

column.name: text
column.value: and they will bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it;

column.name: text
column.value: and nothing unclean, and no one who practices abomination and lying, shall ever come into it, but only those ①whose names are written in the Lamb’s book of life. ▷ ①Lit who have been written
